Na ɔbaa dɛ, Isaak wiee Jakob nhyira no, na Jakob fii n’egya nkyɛn firii ara pɛ nna no nua Esau fi n’ahayɛ baa fie.
Na ɔno so yɛɛ edziban a ɔyɛ huam, na ɔdze brɛɛ n’egya; na ɔsee n’egya dɛ, Wɔmma m’egya nsoɛr, na ondzi ne ba ne hanam yi bi, ma ne kra nhyira me
Na n’egya Isaak bisaa no dɛ, Woana nye wo? Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mara wo ba, w’abakan Esau a.
Na Isaak no ho popoo kɛsenara, na ɔsee dɛ, Woana mbɔ na ɔakɛfa hanam, na ɔdze abrɛ me, ma medzi ne nyinara bi ansaana ereba, na mehyira no yi? Ampa, mehyiraa no.
Aber a Esau tsee n’egya ne nsɛm no, osuu su kɛse a ɔyɛ wen, na ɔsee n’egya dɛ, Hyira mo so, mo so bi, ao m’egya.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Wo nua dze ndaadaa aba abɛgye wo nhyira kɔ.
Na Esau see dɛ, Ana ɔno wɔmmfrɛ no Jakob bi? Iyi ka ho a oedzi me emim mpɛn ebien: ɔagye me panyin; na, hwɛ, afei ɔagye me nhyira. Na obisaa dɛ, Ana enngyaa me nhyira biara?
Na Isaak buae na ɔsee Esau dɛ. Hwɛ mayɛ no wo wura, na medze no nuanom nyinara mayɛ no nkowaa; na eburow nye nsa nna medze awowaw no: na ɔwo dze, ebɛnadze na menyɛ mma wo, me ba?
Na Esau bisaa n’egya dɛ, Aso nhyira kor pɛ na ewɔ, m’egya? Hyira mo so, mo so bi, ao m’egya. Na Esau maa ne ndze do na osui.
Na n’egya Isaak buae na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, mbrɛ asaase a seradze nnyi no na ɔbɛyɛ wo tsenabea, Na mbrɛ ɔsor ɔbɔsu yɛ hɔ na;
Na edze w’afona bɛtsena ase, na ebɔsom wo nua; Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ egye woho a, ɔno ibeyi no kɔndua wɔ wo kɔn ho.
Na Esau taan Jakob wɔ nhyira a n’egya dze hyiraa no ntsi: na Esau see n’akoma mu dɛ, Nda a wɔdze bosu m’egya no abɛn; afei muruboku mo nua Jakob.
Na ne ba panyin Esua ne nsɛm no wɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ Rebeka; na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ ne ba kuma Jakob, na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, wo nua Esau kyekye no werɛ wɔ wo ho dɛ oruboku wo.
Dɛm ntsi afei, me ba, tsie me ndze; na soɛr, guan kɔ mo nua Laban nkyɛn wɔ Haran;
na kɛtsena ne nkyɛn nda kakra, kɛpem dɛ wo nua n’ebufuw befi no mu;
na no werɛ befir dza edze ayɛ no no; na mobɔsoma ma wɔaabɛfa wo wɔ hɔ aba: bɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na mobɔhwer hom beenu nyina da kor?
Na Rebeka see Isaak dɛ, Mo nkwa afon me, osian Het mbabaa ntsi: sɛ Jakob war yer wɔ Het mbabaa mu, dɛ woyinom a, wɔ asaase yi do mbabaa yi mu a, nna membrɛe ngui bi? Nna metse ase reyɛ dɛn?
Na Isaak frɛɛ Jakob, na ohyiraa no, na ɔhyɛɛ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Mma nnwar yer wɔ Keenan mbabaa mu.
Soɛr, kɔ Paddan-aram, wo na n’egya Betuel fie; na kɔwar yer wɔ wo na no nua Laban ne mbabaa no hɔn mu.
Na Nyankopɔn Otumfo nhyira wo, na ɔmma wo, na dɔr, ama aayɛ aman asafo;
na ɔmfa Abraham nhyira mma ɔwo nye w’asefo a wɔka wo ho; ama eenya asaase a eyɛ do hɔho a Nyankopɔn dze maa Abraham yi.
Na Isaak gyaa Jakob kwan: na ɔkɔr Sirianyi Betuel ne ba Laban a ɔyɛ Jakob nye Esau hɔn na Rebeka no nuabanyin no nkyɛn wɔ Paddan-aram.
Afei Esau hun dɛ Isaak ehyira Jakob, na oegya no kwan dɛ ɔnkɔ Paddan-Aram nkɔwar yer wɔ hɔ; na orihyira no no ɔhyɛɛ no dɛ, Mma nnwar yer wɔ Keenan mbabaa hɔn mu;
ma Jakob etsie n’egya nye ne na, na ɔkɔ Paddan-aram.
Na Esau hun dɛ Keenan mbabaa no nnyɛ n’egya Isaak enyisɔ no;
osii mu kɔr Ismael nkyɛn, na ɔkɔwaar Abraham ne ba Ismael ne babaa Mahalat a ɔyɛ Nebaiot n’akyerɛbaa, kaa no yernom no ho.
Na Jakob fii Beer-seba, na osii mu kɔr Haran afamu.
Na ɔsoɛɛ bea bi do, na ɔtsenaa hɔ anafua no nyinara, osiandɛ iwi akɔtɔ, na ɔfaa hɔ abo no kor na ɔdze ne tsir sunii, na ɔdaa hɔ.
Na ɔsoo daa, na hwɛ atwer si asaase do, na n’etsifi pem sor; Nyankopɔn n’abɔfoe ridzi do mfowsian.
Na, hwɛ, EWURADZE gyina n’etsifi, na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye EWURADZE, w’egya Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, na Isaak ne Nyankopɔn: asaase a eda do no, medze mebɛma ɔwo, nye w’asefo.
Na w’asefo bɛyɛ dɛ asaase do huntuma, na ebɛtserɛw akɔ anee, boka, nye kwaamu, nye pomu: na ɔwo nye w’asefo mu na wobehyira asaase do ebusua ebusua nyinara.
Na, hwɛ, menye wo nam, na mobɔhwɛ wo do wɔ beebiara a ebɔkɔ, na medze wo maba asaase yi do bio; na minnkegya wo hɔ, ekodu dɛ mebɛma dza maka makyerɛ wo yi ayɛ hɔ.
Na Jakob fii ne nda mu nyanee, na ɔsee dɛ, Ampaara, EWURADZE wɔ ha; naaso nna minnyim.
Na n’akoma tui, na ɔsee dɛ, ha yi yɛ hu ampa ae! Ha nnyɛ beebiara dɛ Nyankopɔn ne fie a, na ha nye hɛben abotsen no.
Na Jakob soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔfaa ɔbo no a osunii no, na ɔdze yɛɛ idum sii hɔ, na ohuee ngo guu do.
Na ɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Bɛtɛl: na asɔpɔn no nkyɛ kurow no ne dzin dze Luz.
Na Jakob bɔɔ anohoba see dɛ, Sɛ Nyankopɔn dzi m’ekyir, na ɔhwɛ mo do wɔ ɔkwan yi a murutu yi mu, na ɔma me edziban ma midzi, nye atar ma mehyɛ,
ma meba m’egya fie bio wɔ asomdwee mu a, ɔno EWURADZE bɛyɛ me Nyankopɔn,
na ɔbo yi a medze mayɛ idum esi hɔ yi, bɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ne fi: na dza ebɛma me nyinara mebɛma wo mu ebupɛn du du.
Na Jakob sii no kwan do, na ɔbaa bokamba hɔn asaase do.
Na ɔhwɛe no, nna ohun dɛ, bura bi wɔ haban no mu, na, hwɛ, nguankuw ebiasa gugu ho wɔ hɔ; osiandɛ bura no no mu nsu na wɔsaw ma nguankuw no ma wɔnom: na ɔbo a ɔda bura no n’ano no so.
Na hɔ na nguankuw no nyinara wohyia: na sɛ wohyia a wopirew ɔbo no fi bura no n’ano, na wɔma nguan no nsu ma wɔnom, na wopirew ɔbo no hin bura no n’ano bio.
Na Jakob bisaa hɔn dɛ, Mo nuanom, hom fi hen? Na wobuaa dɛ, Yefi Haran.
Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nyim Nahor ne ba Laban a? Na wɔsee dɛ, Yenyim no,
Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, No ho ye? Na wɔsee dɛ, No ho ye: na, hwɛ, ne babaa Rahel na ɔnye nguan reba yi.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, adze nnyae nnsae, nkyii so aber a wɔka mbowa nnyae nndurii: hom mma nguan no nsu ma wɔnnom, na hom nkɔ nkɛma hɔn edziban.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Yennkotum, gyedɛ wɔaboaboa nguankuw no nyinara ano, na woepirew ɔbo efi bura no n’ano; ansaana yɛama nguan no nsu ma wɔaanom.
Na Jakob nye hɔn da ho rekasa no, nna Rahel nye n’egya no nguan no bae: nna ɔno na ɔhwɛ hɔn.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jakob hun ne na no nua Laban ne babaa Rahel, na ne na no nua Laban no nguan no, ɔtwee pinii, na okepireew ɔbo no fii bura no n’ano, na ɔmaa ne na no nua Laban no nguan no nsu ma wɔnomee.
Na Jakob feew Rahel n’ano, na ɔmaa ne ndze do, na osui.
Na Jakob kaa kyerɛɛ Rahel dɛ, n’egya n’awɔfase nye no, na ɔyɛ Rebeka ne ba: na Rahel tuu enguan na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ n’egya.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Laban tsee n’akyerɛbaa ne ba Jakob ne nka no, otutuu enguan kehyiaa no kwan, na ɔyɛɛ no etuu, na ɔfeew n’ano, na ɔdze no baa ne fie. Na ɔbɔɔ n’amandzɛɛ yi nyinara kyerɛɛ Laban.
Na Laban see dɛ, Ampaara, eyɛ me biew nye mo honam. Na ɔtsenaa ne nkyɛn bosoom.
Na Laban see Jakob dɛ, Ana osiandɛ mo nua nye wo ntsi, ebɔsom me kwa? Ka kyerɛ me, ebɛnadze na ɔnyɛ w’akatua?
Na Laban wɔ mbabaa beenu: panyin dze no ne dzin dze Leah, na ekumaba no ne dzin dze Rahel.
Na Leah n’enyiwa yɛ meamea; na Rahel dze no ho yɛ fɛw na n’enyim wɔ nyam.
Na Jakob dɔɔ Rahel; na ɔsee dɛ, Wo ba kuma Rahel ntsi mobɔsom wo mfe esuon.
Na Laban see dɛ, Oye dɛ medze no mebɛma wo sen dɛ medze no mebɛma ɔbarimba bi: enye me ntsena.
Na Rahel ntsi Jakob soom mfe esuon; na ɔdɔ a ɔdɔ no ntsi, ɔyɛɛ n’enyi do dɛ nda kumaabi.
Na Jakob see Laban dɛ, Fa me yer ma me, na me nda aso, ma monkɔ ne nkyɛn.
Na Laban hyiahyiaa ekuromfo nyinara, na ɔtoo pon.
Na ɔbaa dɛ anafua no ɔfaa ne babaa Leah, na ɔdze no brɛɛ no; na ɔnye no dae
Na Laban dze n’abaawa Zilpa maa ne babaa Leah abaawa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyee no, nna Jakob nkɔhwɛ a saana Leah a: na obisaa Laban dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ayɛ me yi? Nnyɛ Rahel ntsi na mosoom wo bi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na adaadaa me yi?
Na Laban see dɛ, Hɛn ha wɔnnyɛ no dɛm; wɔmmfa ekumaba no mma awar ana wɔdze abakan no ama.
Ma oyi ne dapɛn nso, na yɛdze ɔno so bɛma wo wɔ ɔsom a ebɔsom me mfe esuon fofor bio ntsi.
Na Jakob yɛɛ dɛm, na ɔmaa ne dapɛn kor soe: na ɔdze ne babaa Rahel so maa no awar.
Na Laban dze n’abaawa Bilha maa ne babaa Rahel dɛ abaawa.
Na Jakob kɔr Rahel so nkyɛn nye no dae, na ɔdɔɔ Rahel seen Leah, na ɔsoom Laban mfe esuon fofor bio.
Na EWURADZE hun dɛ wɔtan Leah no, obuee n’awoo kwan: na Rahel dze nna ɔbɔnyin a.
Na Leah nyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Reuben a asekyerɛ nye; Monhwɛ ɔbabanyin: na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE ahwɛ m’amandzehu; na afei dze mo kun bɔdɔ me.
Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔsee dɛ, Osiandɛ EWURADZE atse dɛ wɔtan me ntsi, na ɔdze ɔba yi so ama me: na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Simeon a asekyerɛ nye; Otsie.
Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔsee dɛ, Afei na mo kun nye me bɛka, osiandɛ mawo mbabanyin baasa ama no: dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Levi asekyerɛ nye; Ahofam.
Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin: na ɔsee dɛ, Afei mibeyi EWURADZE ayɛw: dɛm ntsi ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Juda; a asekyerɛ nye; Ayɛyi na ogyaa awoo.
Na Rahel hun dɛ ɔnnwo ba mma Jakob no, Rahel n’enyi beer no nua no; na ɔsee Jakob dɛ, Ma me mba, ɔno mubowu.
Na Jakob no bo fuuw Rahel: na ɔsee dɛ, Ana midzi Nyankopɔn a ɔakam wo yamu mba no ananmu?
Rahel see dɛ, Hwɛ, m’abaawa Bilha nye yi, nye no nda; ama ɔaawo egu me serɛ do, na mo so menam no do meenya mba.
Na ɔdze n’abaawa Bilha maa no awar: na Jakob kɔr ne nkyɛn.
Na Bilha nyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin maa Jakob.
Na Rahel see dɛ, Nyankopɔn edzi m’asɛm ama me, na eso oetsie me ndze, na ɔama me babanyin: dɛm ntsi ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Dan a asekyerɛ nye: ɔsɛndzifo.
Na Rahel n’abaawa Bilha nyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin a otsia ebien maa Jakob.
Na Rahel see dɛ, Menye m’akyerɛbaa edzi aper a no mu yɛ dzen, na medzi nyim: na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Naftali a asekyerɛ nye, M’akodzi.
Na aber a Leah hun dɛ n’awoo mu atwe oegyaa awoo no, ɔfaa n’abaawa Zilpa, na ɔdze no maa Jakob awar.
Na Leah n’abaawa Zilpa woo babanyin maa Jakob.
Na Leah see dɛ, Siar aba, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Gad a asekyerɛ nye, Yiedzi.
Na Leah n’abaawa Zilpa woo babanyin a otsia ebien maa Jakob.
Na Leah see dɛ, Ahomkanyi nye me, na mbabaa bɛfrɛ me ɔhomkanyi: na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Aser a asekyerɛ nye Nhyira.
Na ewifua twaber mu no, Reuben kɔr hamu kohun mandreke, na ɔdze brɛɛ ne na Leah. Nna Rahel see Leah dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma me wo ba ne mandreke yi bi.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ana ɔyɛ asɛm ba dɛ egye mo kun, na me ba ne mandreke yi so erebɛgye? Na Rahel see dɛ, Nna ma ɔnye wo nda anafua yi osian wo ba ne mandreke no ntsi.
Na Jakob fi hamu ewimbir reba no, Leah puei kehyiaa no kwan, na ɔsee dɛ, Bra me nkyɛn, na ampaara medze me ba ne mandreke abɔ wo paa. Na ɔnye no daa anafua no.
Na Nyankopɔn tsiee Leah, na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin a otsia enum maa Jakob.
Na Leah see dɛ, Nyankopɔn dze m’apaabɔdze ama me, osiandɛ medze m’abaawa memaa mo kun awar: na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Isakar; ase nye, Akatua nye yi.
Na Leah nyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin a otsia esia maa Jakob.
Na Leah see dɛ, Nyankopɔn ama me akyɛdze a oye; afei na mo kun nye me bɛtsena, osiandɛ mawo mbabanyin beesia ama no; na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Zebulun; ase nye, Atseyie.
Na n’ekyir no ɔwoo babaa, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Dina.
Na Nyankopɔn kaa Rahel, na otsiee no, na obuee n’awoo kwan.
Na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin: na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn eyi m’ahorohoraa:
na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Josef, see dɛ, EWURADZE mma me ɔba kor so nka ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Rahel woo Josef no, nna Jakob see Laban dɛ, Gya me kwan ma monkɔ mbrɛ mifi na me man mu.
Fa me yernom nye me mba a hɔn ntsi masom wo no ma me, na ma monkɔ: na ɔwoara nyim mo som a medze masom wo.
Na Laban see no dɛ, Sɛ afei menya w’enyim enyimnyam a, tsintsim: na mehu dɛ ɔwo ntsi na EWURADZE ehyira me.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Kyerɛ me w’akatua, na medze bɛma.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔwoara nyim beebi mbrɛ mesi na masom wo, na mbrɛ wo mbowakuw esi na wɔayɛ wɔ me nsamu.
Na mebae no, nna kumaabi na ewɔ, nna ɔadɔr ɔayɛ pii yi; na EWURADZE ehyira wo wɔ beebiara a mefae: na afei aber bɛn na mobɔhwɛ mara me fie so?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na memfa memma wo? Na Jakob see dɛ, Mma mma me hwee: sɛ ebɛyɛ iyi ama me a, ɔno mebɛnyɛn wo nguan bio, na mahwɛ hɔn.

Ndɛ mebɛfa wo nguan nyinara mu, na meyiyi nguan a hɔn ho yɛ woranworan nye ntokowa ntokowa nyinara, na nguan etuntum a wɔwɔ nguantsen no mu nyinara, nye mpɔnkye no dza hɔn ho yɛ ntokowa ntokowa nye woranworan no efi mu: na hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no na ɔnyɛ m’apaabɔdze.

Ama daakye eba m’apaabɔdze a ɔda w’enyim yi do a, me ndzeyɛtsenenee eebua ama me; mpɔnkye no mu dza hɔn ho nnyɛ woranworan nye ntokowa ntokowa no, na nguantsen no hɔn mu dza wɔnnyɛ etuntum no nyinara, ɔno na sɛ wohu wɔ mo hɔ a, wombu no adzewiadze.
Na Laban see dɛ, Hwɛ, ka mo nko a nkyɛ dza aka no ara ɔbɛyɛ dɛmara.

Na da no ara Jakob yiyii mpɔnkyenyin a hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee nye ntokowa ntokowa no; nye mpɔnkyeber a hɔn ho yɛ woranworan nye ntokowa ntokowa no nyinara, dza fufuw wɔ hɔn ho no nyinara, nye nguantsen no hɔn mu etuntum no nyinara, na ɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ ne mbabanyin nsa;
na ɔmaa ndaansa kwan daa ɔnoara nye Jakob ntamu: na Jakob nyɛɛn Laban no nguan nkaa no.
Na Jakob faa sɛsɛ dua nye almɔnd dua nye odwon dua mbaa momon; na oyiyii ho nsema efufuw, na ɔmaa mbaa no ho efufuw no puepuei.
Na ɔdze mbaa no a oyiyii ho no guu nguan no hɔn tsentsen do wɔ nsuka a ɔwɔ mu mbrɛ nguan no ba hɔ bɔnom nsu no mu; na wɔba bɔnom nsu a nna wɔfow hɔnho.
Na nguan no nyinsenyinsenii wɔ mbaa no enyim, na nguan no wowoo nsensanee nsensanee, woranworan, nye ntokowa ntokowa.

Na Jakob paa nguambaa no na ɔmaa nguan no hɔn enyim kɔr Laban nguan no mu nsensanee nsensanee nye etuntum no nyinara hɔn do; na ɔyɛɛ narankasa no nguankuw wɔ nkyɛn, na ɔammfa ammfora Laban no nguan no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber biara sɛ nguan a hɔn ho yɛ dzen no wonyinsenyinsen a, nna Jakob dze mbaa no ekogu nguan no hɔn enyim wɔ nsuka no mu, ama woeenyinsenyinsen mbaa no do;
na sɛ nguan no yɛ mberɛw dze a, ɔno ɔmmfa nngu mu: dɛm ntsi hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw no nye Laban dze, na hɔn a hɔn ho yɛ dzen no nye Jakob dze.
Na Jakob yɛɛ kɛsenara, na onyaa nguan pii, nye mfonabaa nye nkowaa, nye efumpɔnkɔ nye nsoasopɔnkɔ.
Na ɔtsee Laban ne mbabanyin nsɛm a wɔkae, dɛ, Jakob afa dza ɔyɛ hɛn egya dze nyinara; na dza ɔyɛ hɛn egya dze na ɔdze enya egyapadze yi nyinara.
Na Jakob hwɛɛ Laban no ntɔn mu, na hwɛ, ɔnntse dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ nkan no ɔtse wɔ no do no.
Na EWURADZE see Jakob dɛ, San kɔ w’egyanom asaase do, na w’ebusua mu; na mibedzi w’ekyir.
Na Jakob somae na wɔkɛfrɛɛ Rahel nye Leah ma wɔbaa hamu wɔ no nguan no nkyɛn,
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Muhu hom egya no ntɔn dɛ ɔnntse me dɛ nkan no; na m’egya ne Nyankopɔn na oedzi m’ekyir.
Na homara nyim dɛ m’ahoɔdzen nyinara na medze asom hom egya.
Na hom egya adaadaa me, na ɔasakyer m’akatua mpɛn du; na Nyankopɔn na ɔamma no kwan ma ɔannyɛ me bɔn.

Sɛ ɔse dɛ, Hɔn a hɔn ho yɛ woranworan no na ɔnyɛ w’akatua a, ɔno nguan no nyinara wowo woranworan: na sɛ ɔse dɛ, Hɔn a hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee na ɔnyɛ w’akatua a, ɔno nguan no nyinara wowo nsensanee nsensanee.
Dɛm na Nyankopɔn agye hom egya no mbowa, na ɔdze hɔn ama me.

Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a nguan no nyinsenyinsenii no, nna memaa m’enyiwa do, na muhun no wɔ adaaso mu, na, hwɛ, mpɔnkyenyin a wɔfow nguan no nyinara hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee, woranworan, nye ntokowa ntokowa.
Na Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe see me wɔ adaaso mu dɛ, Jakob: na mesee dɛ, Emi nye yi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Afei ma w’enyiwa do, na hwɛ, mpɔnkyenyin a wɔfow mpɔnkyeber no nyinara hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee, woranworan, nye ntokowa ntokowa: na mehu dza Laban reyɛ wo nyinara.
Emi nye Bɛtɛl Nyankopɔn, beebi mbrɛ eseraa idum ho no a, beebi mbrɛ ebɔɔ me anohoba no a; afei soɛr, fi asaase yi do, na san kɔ w’awobea asaase do.
Na Rahel nye Leah buae na wɔsee no dɛ, Ana kyɛpɛn anaa egyapadze biara da ho wɔ hɔ ma hɛn wɔ hɛn egya fie a?
Ana ommbuu hɛn ahɔho bi a? Osiandɛ ɔatɔn hɛn, na eso oedzi hɛn tsisika ewie.
Osiandɛ ahonyadze a Nyankopɔn agye no hɛn egya hɔ nyinara hɛn nye hɛn mba dze a: na afei, dza Nyankopɔn aka akyerɛ wo no nyinara, yɛ.
Nna Jakob soɛree, na ɔfaa ne mba nye ne yernom tsenatsenaa efumpɔnkɔ do;
na ɔfaa no mbowa nyinara, nye n’ahodze a onyae wɔ Paddan-aram no nyinara na, osii mu dɛ ɔrokɔ n’egya Isaak nkyɛn wɔ Keenan asaase do.
Nna Laban kɔ rukotwitwa no nguan ho nhwi: na Rahel wiaa n’egya no suman.
Na Jakob wiaa noho guanee; osiandɛ ɔannka annkyerɛ Laban, Sirianyi no.
Na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara guanee; na ɔsoɛree, na otwaa Esutsen no, na ɔmaa n’enyi kɔr Gilead bepɔw do.
Na ne ndaansa no wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Laban dɛ Jakob eguan.
Na ɔfaa no nkorɔfo kaa noho, na otsiiw no nda esuon kwan; na ɔbɔtoo no Gilead bepɔw do.
Na Nyankopɔn baa Laban, Sirianyi no hɔ wɔ anafua adaaso mu, na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ woho yie amma aannkasa papa anaa bɔn annkyerɛ Jakob.
Na Laban too Jakob. Nna Jakob abɔ n’asesee wɔ bepɔw no do: na Laban ɔnye no nkorɔfo so bobɔɔ hɔndze wɔ Gilead bepɔw do.
Na Laban bisaa Jakob dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ayɛ yi, na ewia woho eguan me, na asoa me mbabaa dze hɔn rokɔ dɛ hɔn a wɔdze mfowa afa hɔn ndɔmmum yi?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na isumae guanee, na iwiaa woho fii me nkyɛn; na annka annkyerɛ me, ma maammfa enyigye na ndwom, mpintsin na ɔnye nsanku menngya wo kwan;
na amma maammfew me mbabanyin nye me mbabaa hɔn ano? Afei dze ayɛ nkwaseadze.
Mowɔ tum dɛ nkyɛ menye wo dzi no bɔn: na ndeda anafua w’egya ne Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ me dɛ, Hwɛ woho yie, mma aannkasa papa anaa bɔn annkyerɛ Jakob.
Na afei kaansa afe w’egya fie dodoodow ma ehia dɛ ekɔ mpo a, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ewia mo suman yi?
Na Jakob buae na ɔsee Laban dɛ, Osiandɛ musuroi: na mesee dɛ, ɔbɛyɛ na eregye wo mbabaa wɔ me nsamu enyimpi do.
Nyimpa biara a ibohu wo suman wɔ no hɔ no, onyii no ɔnnkɛtsena ase: hɛn nuanom hɔn enyim ha yi ara hwehwɛ dza ɔyɛ wodze wɔ me nkyɛn, na fa w’adze. Nna Jakob nnyim dɛ Rahel na oewia.
Na Laban kɔr Jakob n’asesee mu, nye Leah n’asesee mu, nye mbaawa beenu no hɔn asesee mu; na oennhu. Na ofii Leah n’asesee mu, na ɔkɛhɛɛn Rahel n’asesee mu.
Afei Rahel afa suman no, na ɔdze ahyehyɛ efupɔnkɔ n’adze a wɔdze hyehyɛ no mu, na ɔatsena do. Na Laban kekaa asese no no ho nyinara, na oennhu.
Na ɔsee n’egya dɛ, Mma mma ɔnnyɛ mo wura ebufuw dɛ munntum monnsoɛr wɔ w’enyim; na mayɛ mbaadze. Na ɔhwehwɛe, na oennhu suman no.
Na Jakob no bo fuwii, na ɔnye Laban hamee: na Jakob buae see Laban dɛ, Mo mfom nye mmuana? Mo bɔn nye mmuana, ma etsiw me ɔhyew do dɛm yi?
Ehwehwɛɛ me ndzɛmba nyinara yi, wo fie ndzɛmba nyinara mu ebɛnadze na ehu no wɔ mu? Fa si mo nuanom nye wo nuanom hɔn enyim ha, ma wombu hɛn beenu ntamu atsɛn.
Matsena wo nkyɛn mfe eduonu nye yi; wo nguamber nye wo mpɔnkyeber ammpon mba da, na wo nguan mu nguannyin so, menndzi bi.
Hɔn a mbowa kum hɔn no, mammfa ammbrɛ wo; ɔyɛɛ mara me kaw. Dza wowiaa no ewia o, dza wowiaa no anafua o, egyee no mo hɔ.
Mbrɛ meyɛe nye yi; adzekyee a nna ewia rehyew me, adzesaa a nna awɔw resar me; na m’enyi so kokwae.
Mfe eduonu nye yi na matsena wo fie; wo mbabaa beenu ntsi mosoom wo mfe duanan, na wo mbowakuw so ntsi mfe esia: na asakyer m’akatua mpɛn du.
Sɛ m’egya ne Nyankopɔn, Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, nye Isaak no Suro, enndzi m’ekyir a, nkyɛ ndɛ egya me kwan nsapan. Nyankopɔn ehu m’amandzehu nye me nsaano edwumayɛ, na anadwe yi ɔaka w’enyim.

Na Laban buae na ɔsee Jakob dɛ, Mbabaa yi me mbabaa a, na mba yi me mba a, na nguan yi mo nguan a, na dza ihu yi nyinara medze a: na ebɛnadze na mubotum mayɛ me mbabaa yi, anaa hɔn mba a wɔawo hɔn yi ndɛ?
Na afei bra, ma yendzi ahyɛmu, emi nye ɔwo; na ma ɔnyɛ dase wɔ emi nye ɔwo ntamu.
Na Jakob faa ɔbo, na ɔdze yɛɛ idum sii hɔ.
Na Jakob see no nkorɔfo dɛ, Hom mboaboa abo ano; na wɔtasee abo, na wɔhɔɔr no isiw: na wodzidzii siw no ho hɔ.
Na Laban frɛɛ no Jegar-sahaduta: na Jakob dze ɔfrɛɛ no Galeed.
Na Laban see dɛ, Isiw yi nyɛ emi nye ɔwo ntamu dase ndɛ. Dɛm ntsi ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Galeed:
na Mizpa osiandɛ ɔsee dɛ, sɛ Yɛpaapaa mu a, EWURADZE nhwɛ emi nye ɔwo ntamu.
Sɛ ebɛtseetsee me mbabaa, na sɛ ebɔwar yernom aka me mbabaa ho a, obi nnka hɛn ho; hwɛ, Nyankopɔn nye emi nye ɔwo ntamu dasefo.
Na Laban see Jakob dɛ, Hwɛ abo siw yi, na hwɛ idum a mama do mesi emi nye ɔwo ntamu yi.
Isiw yi yɛ dase, na idum yi yɛ dase, dɛ mennkɛtra siw yi maba wo nkyɛn, na wo so ennkɛtra siw yi nye idum yi aba me nkyɛn, abɛyɛ bɔn.
Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, nye Nahor Nyankopɔn, hɔn egya ne Nyankopɔn, ombu hɛn ntamu atsɛn. Na Jakob dze n’egya Isaak no Suro no dzii nsew.
Na Jakob bɔɔ afɔr wɔ bepɔw no do, na ɔfrɛɛ no nuanom dɛ wombedzidzi: na wodzidzii, na wotsintsimii wɔ bepɔw no do anafua no nyinara.
Na Laban soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔfeew ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa no hɔn ano, na ohyiraa hɔn: na Laban sanee kɔr no kurow mu.
Na Jakob sii no kwan do, na Nyankopɔn n’abɔfoe behyiaa no.
Na Jakob hun hɔn no ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn no dɔm nye yi: na ɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Mahanaim.
Na Jakob tuu abɔfo ma wodzii n’enyim kan kɔr no nua Esau hɔ wɔ Seir asaase do, Edom haban mu.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɛse mo wura Esau dɛm; dɛ, Mbrɛ w’akowaa Jakob se nye yi, Menye Laban akɛtsena, na makyɛr hɔ ara ma ebodu ndɛ.
Menya anantwi, nsoasopɔnkɔ, nguan, mpɔnkye na nkowaa nye mfonabaa: na masoma dɛ wɔmbɛka nkyerɛ mo wura, ama meenya w’enyim adom.
Na abɔfo no sanee baa Jakob hɔ, dɛ, Yɛkɔr wo nua Esau hɔ na mbom ɔnoara so reba ebehyia wo kwan, na mbarimba ahaanan ka no ho.
Nna Jakob n’akoma tuu kɛsenara, na no ho hiahiaa no. Na obuee nkorɔfo a wɔnye no nam no, nye mpɔnkye, nguan, anantwi nye efumpɔnkɔ no hɔn mu ekuw ebien;
na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ Esau ba kuw kor do, na oboku hɔn a, ɔno ikuw a ɔaka no eefi nsa.
Na Jakob see dɛ, Ao, m’egya Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, na m’egya Isaak ne Nyankopɔn, ao, EWURADZE a esee me dɛ, San kɔ wo man mu, nye w’ebusua mu, na mebɛyɛ wo yie:
ehumbɔbɔr nye nokwar a eyi akyerɛ w’akowaa no mennsɛ no mu biara; osiandɛ mo poma ara na medze twaa Jordan yi; na afei mayɛ ekuw ebien.
Meserɛ wo, gye me fi mo nua Esau nsamu: na musuro no, bɛyɛ na ɔaba eboku emi, nye enanom nye hɔn mba yi.
Na esee me dɛ, Ampaara mebɛyɛ wo yie, na mama w’asefo ayɛ dɛ mpoano anhwea a no dodow ntsi wɔkan a ɔnnyɛ.
Na ɔsoɛɛ hɔ anafua no; na oyii dza ɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no mu bi dɛ ɔdze rekɛkyɛ no nua Esau;
mpɔnkyeber ahaenu nye mpɔnkyenyin eduonu, nguamber ahaenu nye nguannyin eduonu,
efumpɔnkɔ a wɔma enumfo eduasa nye hɔn mba, anantwiber eduanan nye anantwinyin du, nsoasopɔnkɔber eduonu nye nsoasopɔnkɔmba du.
Na ɔdze no ekuwekuw hyɛɛ no nkowaa no nsa; na ɔsee no nkowaa no dɛ, Hom ntwa mu ndzi m’enyim, na hom mma ikuw nye ikuw ntamu mbra kwan.
Na ɔhyɛɛ dza odzi kan no dɛ, Sɛ mo nua Esau nye wo hyia, na obisa wo dɛ, Woana n’abofra nye wo, erokɔ henfa, na dza wodzi w’enyim yi woana dze a?
Ɔno se dɛ, W’akowaa Jakob dze a; ɔyɛ akyɛdze a wɔdze rekɛma mo wura Esau: na, hwɛ, ɔnoara so dzi hɛn ekyir.
Na ɔhyɛɛ dza otsia ebien no so, nye dza otsia ebiasa no, nye hɔn a wɔka mbowakuw no do no nyinara dɛ, Sɛ hom hu Esau a, wɔnka dɛm asɛm yi ara nkyerɛ no.
Na hom nse dɛ, Nkyii so, hwɛ w’akowaa Jakob so dzi hɛn ekyir. Afei ɔkaa ɔsee dɛ, Medze akyɛdze a odzi m’enyim yi bɔkɔ akɔdwedwe no, na n’ekyir no meehu n’enyim; bi a no bo bɔdwe.
Nna akyɛdze no twaa mu dzii n’enyim: na ɔnoara dze, ɔtsenaa dɔm no mu anafua no.
Na ɔsoɛɛr anafua no, na ɔfaa ne yernom beenu no, nye ne mbaawa beenu no, nye ne mba dubiako no, na okotwaa Jabbok esutwaree.
Na ɔmaa wotwaa esutsen no, na ɔmaa dza ɔwɔ nyinara twae.
Na ɔkaa Jakob no nko; na banyin bi nye no dzii aper wɔ hɔ ara ma okodur adzekyee.
Na nyimpa no hun dɛ onndzi Jakob do konyim no, nna ɔkaa n’aserɛ tokur mu; na Jakob no ndwonku huanee wɔ aperper a ɔnye no dzii no mu.
Na banyin no see dɛ, Ma monkɔ, na adze rekye. Na ɔsee dɛ, Mennkɛma akɔ, gyedɛ ehyira me ana.
Na banyin no bisaa no dɛ, Wo dzin dze dɛn? Na obuaa dɛ, Jakob.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔnnkɛfrɛ wo dzin Jakob bio, na mbom, Israel: osiandɛ ɔwo enye Nyankopɔn na ɔnye nyimpa ako, na edzi konyim.
Na Jakob bisaa no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, bɔ wo dzin kyerɛ me. Na ɔsee dɛ, Na iribisa me dzin ayɛ dɛn? Na banyin no hyiraa no wɔ hɔ.
Na Jakob frɛɛ bea no ne dzin Peniel; osiandɛ, ɔsee dɛ, Mehu Nyankopɔn mpu na mpu, naaso me kra enya nkwa.
Na orutwa mu wɔ Peniel no nna ewia epue, na no ndwonku a ehuan no ntsi nna ohuan n’aserɛ mu.
Dɛm ntsi ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi ara Israelmba nndzi ntsin a ɔwɔ ndwonku mu no: osiandɛ ɔkaa Jakob no ndwonku wɔ mbrɛ ntsin no wɔ no.
Na Jakob maa n’enyiwa do, na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, nna Esau reba, na mbarimba ahaanan ka no ho. Na ɔkyɛɛ mbofra no mu maa Leah, nye Rahel, nye mbaawa beenu no.
Na ɔdze mbaawa no nye hɔn mba no dzii kan, na ɔdze Leah nye ne mba no dzii hɔ, na ɔdze Rahel nye Josef dzii ekyir.
Na ɔnoara paa ho kedzii hɔn enyim, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze mpɛn esuon, dze kodur dɛ ɔbɛɛn no nua no.
Na Esau tutuu enguan hyiaa no kwan, na ɔyɛɛ no etuu; na ɔdze ne nsa too no kɔn mu, na ɔfeew n’ano: na wosui.
Na Esau maa n’enyiwa do, na ohun mbaa no nye mbofra no; na obisaa dɛ, Woananom na wɔka wo ho yi? Na Jakob buaa dɛ, Mbofra a Nyankopɔn dze adom w’akowaa a.
Nna mbaawa no nye hɔn mba twee pinii, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze.
Na Leah nye ne mba so twee pinii, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze: na n’ekyir no nna Josef nye Rahel twee pinii, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze.
Na Esau bisaa dɛ, Na ekuw a menye hɔn hyiae yi nyinara n’ase nye dɛn? Na ɔsee dɛ, Medze robɔhwehwɛ mo wura n’enyim enyimnyam.
Na Esau see dɛ, Dza mowɔ no ara dɔɔ so; mo nua, ma w’adze nko hɔ mma wo.
Na Jakob see dɛ, Dabida, meserɛ wo, sɛ afei menya w’enyim enyimnyam a, nna gye me nsamu akyɛdze: susuampa dɛ mehu w’enyim ara dɛ mbrɛ obiara bohu Nyankopɔn enyim, na masɔ w’enyi yi.
Meserɛ wo, gye m’akyɛdze a wɔdze abrɛ wo yi; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn adom me, na eso dza mowɔ no dɔɔ so. Na ɔhyɛɛ no ma ɔgyee.
Na Esau see dɛ, Ma yensi mu, na yɛnkɔ, na mibedzi w’enyim.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mo wura nyim dɛ mbofra yi yɛ mberɛw, na eso nguan nye anantwi a wɔnye me nam yi wɔma enumfo: na sɛ wɔka hɔn dodow da kor a, nguan no nyinara bowuwu.
Meserɛ wo, wɔmma mo wura mpa ho nkedzi n’akowaa enyim: na emi mobɔdwe m’enyi ara manantsew dɛ mbrɛ mbowa a wodzi m’enyim yi botum, na dɛ mbrɛ mbofra no botum, ekodu dɛ mubodu mo wura nkyɛn wɔ Seir.
Na Esau see dɛ, Nna ma memfa nyimpa a wɔka mo ho yi bi mingya wo. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ma ɔnyɛ dɛn? Wɔmma minnya mo wura n’enyim enyimnyam.
Nna Esau saan da no ara faa no kwan do kɔr Seir.
Na Jakob sii mu kɔr Sukɔt, na okesii dan maa noho, na osisii mpata maa no mbowa: dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Sukɔt.
Na Jakob baa Sekem kurow a ɔwɔ Keenan asaase do no mu asomdwee mu, wɔ ber a ofii Paddan-aram bae no; na ɔbɔbɔɔ asese wɔ kurow no n’enyim.
Na ɔtɔɔ asaase kakraba a ɔbɔɔ n’asesee wɔ do no, wɔ Sekem n’egya Hamor ne mba no hɔ, maa dwetɛ ɔha.
Na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ no El-elohe-Israel a asekyerɛ nye Israel Nyankopɔn.
Na Dina, Leah na Jakob hɔn babaa no, puei dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ asaase no do mbabaa.
Na Hamor, Hivinyi no, asaase no do hen no ne ba Sekem hun no; na ɔkyeer no nye no dae, na ɔbrɛɛ no adze.
Na no werɛ kitsaa Dina Jakob ne babaa no, na ɔdɔɔ akataasia no na ɔkasaa ayamuyie mu kyerɛɛ no.
Na Sekem kaa kyerɛɛ n’egya Hamor dɛ, Kɛgye akataasia yi yer ma me.
Afei Jakob tsee dɛ oegu ne babaa Dina ho fi. Nna ne mbabanyin no wɔ no mbowa nkyɛn wɔ hamu ntsi ɔyɛɛ komm ma wɔbae ana.
Na Sekem n’egya puei kɔr Jakob nkyɛn dɛ ɔrekɛnye no atwetwe nkɔmbɔ.
Na Jakob ne mbabanyin no tsee no, wofii hamu baa fie: na ɔyɛɛ hɔn no yaw, na hɔn bo fuuw kɛsenara, osiandɛ Sekem ayɛ nkwaseadze wɔ Israel dɛ ɔnye Jakob ne babaa ada; adze a wɔnnyɛ.
Na Hamor nye hɔn twetwee nkɔmbɔ see dɛ, Me ba Sekem no werɛ ekitsa hom babaa: meserɛ hom, wɔmfa no mma no awar.
Na hom nye hɛn ndzi awarwar; hom mfa hom mbabaa mma hɛn, na hom so mfa hɛn mbabaa.
Na hom nye hɛn ntsena: na asaase a ɔda hom enyim yi hom ntsena do, na hom ndzi gua wɔ do, na hom nnya adze wɔ do.
Na Sekem see n’egya nye no nuanom no dɛ, Wɔmma minnya hom enyim enyimnyam, na dza hom bɛse me no mebɛma.
Hom mbisa me tsiadze nye akyɛdze kɛse biara, na dza hom bɛse me no ara mebɛma: na hom mfa akataasia no mma me awar.
Na Jakob ne mbabanyin no buaa Sekem nye n’egya Hamor ndaadaa mu, na ɔnam dɛ oegu hɔn akyerɛbaa Dina ho fi ntsi.
Na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Yɛyɛ dɛm adze yi a ɔnnkɛyɛ, dɛ yɛdze hɛn akyerɛbaa bɛma obi a wonntwaa no twatsia; na dɛm no yɛ enyimguase ma hɛn.
Dza ogyina do a yɛbɛgye hom pen ara nye yi: dɛ sɛ hom bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ yɛtse, na woetwa hom mu mbanyin nyinara twatsia a;
yɛdze hɛn mbabaa bɛma hom, na hɛn so yɛafa hom mbabaa, na yɛnye hom atsena, na yɛayɛ ɔman kor.
Na sɛ hom nnketsie hɛn, na hom etwitwa twatsia a; ɔno yɛbɛfa hɛn babaa, na yɛakɔ.
Na hɔn nsɛm no yɛɛ Hamor nye Hamor ne ba Sekem hɔn pɛ.
Na aberantsɛ no ennkyinkyim dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛm adze no, osiandɛ ɔpɛ Jakob ne babaa no. Nna wodzi Sekem nyi sen n’egya ne fifo nyinara.
Na Hamor nye ne ba Sekem baa hɔn kurow n’abotsenano, na wɔnye hɔn kurow mu mbanyin no twetwee nkɔmbɔ, dɛ,

Mbarimba yi wɔnye hɛn tse no asomdwee mu; dɛm ntsi hom mma wɔntsena asaase yi do, na wondzi mu gua; na, hwɛ asaase yi dɔɔ so ara yie ma hɔn; hom mma yɛmfa hɔn mbabaa nwar hɔn, na wɔmma hɛn so yɛmfa hɛn mbabaa mma hɔn.
Na adze ara a ogyina do a mbanyin no bɛgye hɛn pen na wɔnye hɛn atsena, ma yaayɛ ɔman kor nye dɛ, hɛn mu mbanyin nyinara botwitwa twatsia, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn woetwitwa no.
Ana nkyɛ hɔn anyɛmbowa nye hɔn ahodze nye hɔn mbowa nyinara nnkɛyɛ hɛndze bi a? Hom mma yɛngye hɔn pen ara, na wɔnye hɛn bɛtsena.
Na hɔn a wɔnam Hamor no kurow n’abotsenano pue nyinara, wotsiee ɔno na ne ba Sekem; na mbanyin a wɔnam no kurow n’abotsenano pue nyinara wotwitwaa hɔn twatsia.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaansa no a ne yaw kitsaa hɔn no, nna Jakob ne mbabanyin beenu, Simeon nye Levi, Dina no nuanom no, wɔfefaa hɔn mfowa, na wokefiir kurow no awora, na wokunkum mbanyin no nyinara.
Na wɔdze afona anomu kum Hamor nye ne ba Sekem, na wɔfaa Dina fii Sekem ne fie, na wɔdze no kɔree.
Jakob ne mbabanyin no baa atɔfo no do na wɔbɔfoom kurow no mu ndzɛmba, osiandɛ woegu hɔn akyerɛbaa no ho fi.
Wɔfaa hɔn nguan nye hɔn anantwi, nye hɔn nsoasopɔnkɔ nye dza ɔwɔ kurow no mu, na dza ɔwɔ haban mu;
na hɔn ahodze nyinara. Wɔfaa hɔn mbofraba nyinara nye hɔn yernom ndɔmmum, na wɔfoom hɔn, mekyerɛ dza ɔwɔ fie nyinara.

Na Jakob see Simeon nye Levi dɛ, Hom afona me, dɛ hom ama mo ho abɔn wɔ hɔn a wɔtse asaase yi do hɔn mu, wɔ Keenanfo nye Perizfo hɔn mu: na mo ho suar ntsi, wɔbɔboaboa hɔn ano aba mo do, na woeboku me; na wɔbɛsɛɛ me, emi nye me fi.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Na nkyɛ ɔnyɛ hɛn akyerɛbaa dɛ edwaman a?
Na Nyankopɔn see Jakob dɛ, Soɛr, kɔ Bɛtɛl, na kɛtsena hɔ: na yɛ afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ ma Nyankopɔn a oyii noho kyerɛɛ wo wɔ aber a ifii wo nua Esau n’enyim guanee no.
Nna Jakob see ne fifo nye hɔn a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ nyinara dɛ, Hom ntow enyame ananaben a ɔwɔ hom mu no ngu, na hom ntsew homho, na hom nsesa hom ntar:
na hom mma yɛnsoɛr, na yɛnkɔ Bɛtɛl; na mebɛyɛ afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ ama Nyankopɔn a m’ahohia da no ɔgyee me do, na odzii m’ekyir wɔ kwan a mutui no mu no.
Na wɔdze hɔn enyame ananaben a ɔwɔ hɔn nsamu nyinara, nye nkaba a ɔhyehyɛ hɔn asomu no maa Jakob; na Jakob dze hyɛɛ esudur no a ɔwɔ Sekem ho no ase.
Na wɔkɔree: na ihu kɛsenara tɔɔ nkurow a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no do, ma woenntsiw Jakob ne mbabanyin no.
Na Jakob baa Luz a ɔwɔ Keenan asaase do no, (ɔnoara nye Bɛtɛl), ɔno nye nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho nyinara.
Na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ bea no El-Bɛtɛl: osiandɛ hɔ na Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ aber a ofii no nua enyim guanee no.
Na Debora, Rebeka no hwɛfo no wui, na wosiee no Bɛtɛl anaafo, wɔ esudur no ase: na wɔtoo ne dzin Allon-bakut a asekyerɛ nye Nyinsuwakyi bea.
Na aber a Jakob fi Paddan-aram bae no, Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ no bio, na ohyiraa no.
Na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, Wo dzin dze Jakob: wɔnnkɛfrɛ wo dzin Jakob bio, na Israel bɛyɛ wo dzin: na ɔtoo ne dzin Israel.
Na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, Emi nye Nyankopɔn Otumfo: wo mba na dɔr; ɔman nye amanaman asafo befi wo mu aba, na ahemfo befi w’asen mu epue.
Asaase a medze memaa Abraham nye Isaak no, ɔwo na medze mebɛma wo, na w’asefo a wodzi w’ekyir no na medze asaase no bɛma hɔn.
Na Nyankopɔn fii ne nkyɛn wɔ mbrɛ ɔnye no kasae no kɔr sor.
Na Jakob sii idum wɔ mbrɛ ɔnye no kasae no; ɔbo dum a: na ohuee ɔnom afɔr guu do, na ohuee ngo guu do.
Na Jakob frɛɛ bea no a Nyankopɔn nye no kasae wɔ hɔ no ne dzin Bɛtɛl.
Na wofii Bɛtɛl sii mu; na aka ɔkwan kakra bi ma woedu Efrat no: awoo kaa Rahel, na n’awoo no mu yɛɛ dzen.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a n’awoo no mu yɛɛ dzen no, nna awogyefo no see no dɛ, Mma nnsuro; ibenya babanyin kor so afei.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ne kra rifi no mu no (osiandɛ owui), ɔtoo no dzin Ben-oni; na n’egya dze ɔfrɛɛ no Benjamin.
Na Rahel wui, na wosiee no wɔ Efrat kwan mu, a ɔnoara nye Bɛtlɛhɛm.
Na Jakob sii ne nda do idum: ɔnoara nye Rahel ne nda do idum dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na Israel tui, na ɔkɔbɔɔ n’asesee wɔ Eder abantsentsen ekyir noho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, Israel tse asaase no do no, nna Reuben kɔree na ɔnye n’egya n’abaawayer Bilha kɛdae: na Israel tsee. Afei Jakob ne mbabanyin yɛ duebien:
Leah ne mba; Jakob n’abakan Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Juda Isakar, nye Zebulun:
Rahel ne mba; Josef nye Benjamin:
na Rahel n’abaawa Bilha ne mba; Dan nye Naftali:
na Leah n’abaawa Zilpa ne mba; Gad nye Aser. Woyinom nye Jakob ne mbabanyin a wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Paddan-aram.
Na Jakob baa n’egya Isaak nkyɛn wɔ Mamre, wɔ Kiriat-arba (ɔnoara nye Hebron), mbrɛ Abraham nye Isaak bɛtsenae no.
Na Isaak ne nda yɛɛ mfe ɔha eduowɔtwe.
Na Isaak gyaa no sunsum mu, na owui, na otsiiw ne nananom wɔ samanadze, a nna ɔayɛ akɔdaa a oedzi mfe pii: na ne mba Esau nye Jakob siee no.
Afei iyinom nye Esau (ɔnoara nye Edom) n’ebusuasantsen.
Esau waar ne yernom wɔ Keenan mbabaa mu; Hetnyi Elon ne babaa Ada, nye Hivinyi Zibeon ne babaa Ana ne babaa Oholibama;
na Ismael ne babaa Basemat, Nebaiot n’akyerɛbaa no.
Na Ada woo Elifaz maa Esau; na Basemat woo Reuel;
na Oholibama woo Jeus, Jalam, nye Kora: woyinom nye Esau ne mba a wɔwoo hɔn wɔ Keenan asaase do no.

Na Esau faa ne yernom, ne mbabanyin, ne mbabaa, ne fie nyimpa nyinara, nye fiembowa, nye no mbowa nyinara, nye n’enyadze a onyaa no wɔ Keenan asaase do nyinara; na ɔtwee noho wɔ no nua Jakob ho kɔr asaase bi do.
Osiandɛ hɔn ahodze so dodow ma hɔn dɛ wɔbɛtsena fakor. Na asaase a wɔtse do no wɔnnsen do wɔ hɔn mbowa no ntsi.
Na Esau a noara so nye Edom no tsenaa Seir bepɔw do.
Na iyinom nye Esau, Edomfo a wɔtse Seir bepɔw do hɔn egya no, n’ebusuasantsen:
Esau ne mbabanyin hɔn edzin nye yi; Elifaz, Esau ne yer Ada ne ba no, Reuel, Esau ne yer Basemat ne ba no.
Na Elifaz ne mba nye Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam, nye Kenaz.
Na Esau ne ba Elifaz no nwewe nye Timna; na ɔwoo Amalek maa Elifaz. Woyinom nye Esau ne yer Ada n’asefo.
Na Reuel ne mba nye woyinom; Nahat, Zera, Samma, nye Miza. Woyinom nye Esau ne yer Basemat ne mba.
Na woyinom nye Esau ne yer Oholibama, Zibeon ne babaa Ana ne babaa no ne mba; na ɔwoo Jeus, Jalam, nye Kora maa Esau.
Woyinom nye Esau ne mba mu ekunyin: Esau n’abakan Elifaz ne mba; ekunyin Teman, Omar, Zefo, Kenaz,
Kora, Gatam, na Amalek. Woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Elifaz no mu puei wɔ Edom asaase do; na woyinom nye Ada n’asefo.
Na Esau ne ba Reuel ne mba nye woyinom; ekunyin Nahat, Zera, Samma, nye Miza: woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Reuel mu puei wɔ Edom asaase do; woyinom nye Esau ne yer Basemat ne mba.
Na woyinom nye Esau ne yer Oholibama ne mba; ekunyin Jeus, Jalam, na okunyin Kora. Woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Esau ne yer Oholibama, Ana ne babaa no no mu puei.
Woyinom nye Esau a ɔnoara nye Edom no n’asefo, na woyinom nye hɔn ekunyin.
Woyinom nye Hornyi Seir ne mba a nna wɔyɛ asaase no do mba no. Lotan, Sobal, Zibeon, Ana,
Dison, Ezer nye Disan. Woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Horfo, Seir ne mba no hɔn mu puei, wɔ Edom asaase do.
Na Lotan ne mba nye Hori na Heman. Nna Lotan n’akyerɛbaa nye Timna.
Na Sobal ne mba nye woyinom; Alvan, Manahat, Ebal, Sefo nye Onam.
Na woyinom nye Zibeon ne mba; Aia nye Ana: oyi nye Ana a, mber a ɔhwɛ n’egya Zibeon no nsoasopɔnkɔ no okohun nsuhyew mpumpunadze wɔ sar do no.
Na woyinom nye Ana ne mba; Dison na Oholibama, Ana ne babaa no.
Na woyinom nye Dison ne mba; Hemdan, Esban, Itran nye Keran.
Ezer ne mba nye woyinom; Bilhan, Zaavan nye Akan.
Dison ne mba nye woyinom: Uz nye Aran.
Ekunyin a wofi Horfo mu puei nye woyinom; ekunyin Lotan, Sobal, Zibeon, na Ana,
Dison, Ezer, na Disan. Ekunyin a wofi Horfo mu puei nye woyinom dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ekunyinyɛ tsetsee wɔ Seir asaase do.
Na ahemfo a wodzi hen wɔ Edom asaase do, ansaana obiara ridzi Israelmba do hen no nye woyinom.
Na Beor ne ba Bela dzii hen wɔ Edom; na no kurow dzin dze Din-haba.
Na Bela wui, na Zera a ofi Bozra ne ba Jobab bedzii n’adze.
Na Jobab wui, na Husam a ofi Temanfo hɔn asaase do bedzii n’adze.
Na Husam wui no Hadad, Bedad a okum Midian wɔ Moab haban mu no, ne ba no bedzii n’adze: na no kurow ne dzin dze Avit.
Na Hadad wui, na Samla a ofi Masreka bedzii n’adze.
Na Samla wui no Saul a ofi Rehobot a ɔwɔ Esutsen no ho no bedzii n’adze.
Na Saul wui, na Akbor ba Baal-hanan bedzii n’adze.
Na Akbor ne ba Baal-hanan wui no, Hadar bedzii n’adze: na no kurow ne dzin dze Pau; na ne yer ne dzin dze Mehetabel, Me-zahab ne babaa Matred ne babaa a.
Na ekunyin a wofi Esau mu puei hɔn edzin nye yi; dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, hɔn tsenabew, nye hɔn edzin tsetsee, ekunyin Timna, Alva, Jetet;
Oholibama, Ela na okunyin Pinon;
Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar;
Magdiel, Iram. Woyinom nye Edom ekunyin, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn tsenabew tsetsee wɔ asaase a ɔyɛ hɔn enyadze no do. Oyi nye Esau, Edomfo hɔn egya no.
Na Jakob tsenaa asaase a n’egya tsenaa do no do, Keenan asaase do.

Iyi nye Jakob n’ebusua ho abakɔsɛm. Josef dzii mfe duesuon no, nna ɔnye no nuanom rohwɛ nguan no; na ɔyɛ abofra a ɔnye n’egya ne yernom Bilha nye Zilpa hɔn mba na wɔwɔ hɔ: na Josef kɛkaa hɔn ho asɛmbɔn kyerɛɛ hɔn egya.
Afei nna Israel dɔ Josef sen ne mba nyinara, osiandɛ ɔno nye no nkɔdaaber mu ba: na ɔyɛɛ asaasaaba atar fɛfɛɛfɛw bi maa no.
Na no nuanom no hun dɛ hɔn egya dɔ no sen hɔn nyinara no wɔtaan no, na woenntum annkasa abodwee do annkyerɛ no.
Na Josef soo daa, na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no nuanom no na nkyii wɔtaan no kɛse.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Meserɛ hom, hom ntsie daa a maso yi:
na hwɛ, nna yɛrekyekyer ewifua ekuwekuw wɔ haban mu, na, hwɛ, mo kuw no soɛree, na ogyinaa tsentsen; na, hwɛ, hom ekuw no botwaa me dze no ho hyiae, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa no.
Na no nuanom bisaa no dɛ, Nna tserɛ ampaara dɛ ibedzi hɛn do hen nye no? Ana tserɛ ampaara dɛ ibenya hɛn do tum nye no? Na nkyii wɔtaan no kɛse wɔ n’adaaso no nye ne nsɛm no ntsi.
Na ɔsoo daa kor so, na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no nuanom, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, maso daa bio; na, hwɛ, ewia nye bosoom nye nworaba dubiako robɔ hɔn mu adze ma me.
Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ n’egya nye no nuanom; na n’egya twuuw n’enyim, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebɛn daa na aso yi? Nna tserɛ ampaara dɛ emi nye wo na nye wo nuanom bɛba abɔbɔ hɛn mu adze wɔ famu ama wo nye no?
Na no nuanom enyi beer no do; na n’egya dze ɔdze asɛm no too ne tsirmu.
Na no nuanom kɔree kɔhwɛɛ hɔn egya no nguan wɔ Sekem.
Na Israel see Josef dɛ, Ana wo nuanom nnyɛn mbowa wɔ Sekem bi a? Bra ma monsoma wo hɔn hɔ. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi nye yi.
Na Israel see no dɛ, Afei kɔ, kɔhwɛ dɛ wo nuanom, nye nguan no hɔn ho ye; na san bɛka kyerɛ me. Nna ofi Hebron bɔnsa mu somaa no ma ɔbaa Sekem.
Na banyin bi hun no dɛ, orikyin haban no mu: na banyin no bisaa no dɛ, Erohwehwɛ ebɛnadze?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Morohwehwɛ mo nuanom: meserɛ wo ara, kyerɛ me mbrɛ wɔwɔ rohwɛ nguan no.
Na banyin no see dɛ, Woefi ha kɔ: na metsee dɛ wɔreka dɛ, Wɔmma yɛnkɔ Dotan. Na Josef tsiiw no nuanom, na okohun hɔn wɔ Dotan.
Na no nuanom no hun no ekyirkyiikyir, na ansaana ɔrebɛn hɔn no, wɔkɔr ne tsir do apam dɛ woboku no.
Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Wɔnhwɛ, ɔdaasofo no na ɔreba no.
Dɛm ntsi afei wɔmbra, wɔmma yenku no, na yɛntow no nkyen mona yi bi mu, na yɛnkɛse dɛ, Abowa bɔn bi na ɔatsetsew no mu: na nkyii yɛnhwɛ mbrɛ n’adaaso no bowie.
Na Reuben tsee, na ɔgyee no wɔ hɔn nsamu; na ɔsee dɛ, Mma wɔmma yennku no;
Mma hom nnka bɔgya: wɔmfa no nto sar do ha mona yi mu, na mma wɔmmfa nsa nnka no: ɔreyɛ ama nkyɛ ɔaagye no wɔ hɔn nsamu dze no asan akɛma n’egya.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, Josef dur no nuanom no nkyɛn no, wɔpɔɔr, asaasaaba atar fɛɛfɛw a ɔhyɛ no no
na wɔdze no kɔtoo mona mu: nna mona no mu awew a, nsu nnyi mu.
Na wɔtsenaa famu dɛ woridzidzi no wɔmaa hɔn enyiwa do na wohun Ismaelfo akwantufo kuw bi dɛ wofi Gilead reba, wɔnye hɔn efumpɔnkɔ a wɔsoso eduhuam nye ngo nye mɛɛr dze rokɔ Egypt.
Na Juda see no nuanom no dɛ, Sɛ yeku hɛn nua na yesiw no bɔgyaa do a, ebɛn mfaso na ɔwɔ mu?
Hom mbra ma yɛntɔn no mma Ismaelfo yi, na mma wɔmma yɛmmfa hɛn nsa nnka no; osiandɛ hɛn nua a, hɛn bɔgyaa a. Na no nuanom no tsiee no.
Nna Midianfo eguadzifo bi rutwa mu; na woyii Josef fii mona no mu, na wɔtɔɔn no maa Ismaelfo no gyee ndwetɛbona eduonu. Na wɔdze Josef kɔr Egypt.
Na ber a Reuben sanee baa mona no do no; hwɛ, nna Josef nnyi mona no mu; na osunsuaan ne ntar mu.
Na ɔsanee kɔr no nuanom no nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Abofra no nnyi hɔ; na iyi mara merefa hen?
Na wɔfaa Josef n’atar no, na wokum apɔnkyenyin, na wɔdze atar no bɔɔ bɔgya no mu;
na wɔdze asaasaaba atar fɛfɛɛfɛw no somae ma wɔdze kɛmaa hɔn egya, kɛsee no dɛ, Adze a yeehu nye yi: hwɛ kyerɛ dɛ wo ba n’atar a.
Na ɔhwɛe, na ɔsee dɛ, Me ba n’atar a; abowa bɔn bi na ɔakyer no; tsetsew na wɔatsetsew Josef no mu.
Na Jakob sunsuaan n’atar mu, na ɔdze kɔben tam bɔɔ n’asen, na osuu ne ba nda pii.
Na ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa nyinara bae dɛ wɔrebɛkyekye no werɛ; naaso oenntsie ma wɔannkyekye no werɛ; na ɔsee dɛ, Mibedzi yaw ara dze akɔ me ba nkyɛn wɔ samanadze. Na n’egya suu no.
Na Midianfo no kɔtɔɔn no wɔ Egypt maa Potifar, Farao no somfo bi a ɔno nye abrafohen no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber no ara mu na Juda fii no nuanom nkyɛn kɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa Adullamnyi bi a ne dzin dze Hira ne nkyɛn.
Na Juda hun Keenannyi bi a ne dzin dze Sua ne babaa bi wɔ hɔ; na ɔwaar no, na ɔnye no dae.
Na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔfrɛɛ no Er.
Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔfrɛɛ no Onan.
Na ɔwoo babanyin bio, na ɔfrɛɛ no Sela: na aber a ɔwoo no no nna ɔwɔ Kezib.
Na Juda gyee yer maa n’abakan Er, na ne dzin dze Tamar.
Na Juda n’abakan Er yɛɛ bɔn wɔ EWURADZE enyim; na EWURADZE kum no.
Na Juda see Onan dɛ, Kɔ wo nua ne yer nkyɛn, na fa no kunabaa, na wo mba ma wo nua.
Na Onan nyim dɛ mba no nnkɛyɛ nedze; na ɔbaa dɛ, aber biara a ɔkɔr no nua ne yer nkyɛn no, ɔmaa no ho nsu no guu famu, amma ɔaamma no nua mba.
Na dza ɔyɛe no yɛ bɔn wɔ EWURADZE enyim: na okum no so.
Nna Juda see n’asew Tamar dɛ, Tsena ekunayɛ mu wɔ w’egya fie kɛpem dɛ me ba Sela benyin: osuro dɛ, bɛyɛ na no so oewu dɛ no nuanom no. Na Tamar kɔree na ɔkɛtsenaa n’egya fie.
Na ɔwɔ hɔ wɔ hɔ nna Juda ne yer a ɔyɛ Sua ne babaa no, owui. Na Juda no werɛ kyekyeree no, ɔkɔr no nguansusuafo nkyɛn wɔ Timna, ɔno nye ne nyɛnko Adullamnyi Hira.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Tamar dɛ, Hwɛ, w’asew rokɔ Timna ekosusua no nguan ho nhwi.
Na oyii no kuna ntar wɔ no ho, na ɔdze ne nkataenyim kataa n’enyim, na ɔkataa noho kɛtsenaa Enaim abotsenano, wɔ Timna kwan nkyɛn; osiandɛ ohun dɛ Sela enyin, naaso Juda ammfa no amma no awar.
Na Juda hun no no, obuu no dɛ edwaman a, osiandɛ ɔakata n’enyim.
Na ɔmanee kɔr ne nkyɛn wɔ kwan no ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Bra, meserɛ wo, ma membra wo nkyɛn: nna onnyim dɛ n’asew no a. Na Tamar bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na edze bɛma me, na enye me ada?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Mebɛma wɔdze apɔnkyeba fi mbowa no mu abrɛ wo. Na obisaa no dɛ, Ebɛma me ahobadze bi ma ɔdze ekodu dɛ ebɛma wɔdze aba?
Na Juda bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛn ahobadze na memfa mma wo? Na ɔsee dɛ, Wo nsɔwanokaba nye w’ahoma, nye wo poma a okitsa wo nsamu no. Na Juda dze maa no, na ɔnye no dae, na ɔnye no nyinsenii.
Na Tamar soɛree kɔree, na oyii ne nkataenyim no wɔ no ho, na ɔfaa no kuna ntar hyɛe.
Na Juda dze apɔnkyeba no maa ne nyɛnko Adullamnyi no, dɛ ɔmfa nkɛgye ahobadze no wɔ ɔbaa no nsa mu: naaso oennhu no.
Nna obisaa no kuromfo no dɛ, edwaman a ɔtse Enaim kwan nkyɛn no wɔ hen? Na wɔsee dɛ, Edwaman biara mmbaa ha.
Na ɔsanee baa Juda hɔ, na ɔbɛsee dɛ, Mennhu no; na eso ekuromfo no see dɛ, Edwaman biara mmbaa ha.
Na Juda see dɛ, Ma ɔmfa, ɔno bohu na hɛn enyim egu ase: hwɛ, memaa wɔdze apɔnkyeba yi kɔree, na ennhu no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ odzii bɛyɛ abosoom ebiasa n’ekyir no, wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Juda dɛ, W’asew Tamar abɔ edwaman, na hwɛ, ɔnam n’edwaman mu enyinsen so. Na Juda see dɛ, Hom nkɛfa no mbra ma wɔnhyew no.

Na wɔkɛfaa no bae no, nna Tamar somae ma wɔkɛsee n’asew no dɛ, banyin a ndzɛmba yi yɛ nedze no, ɔno na menye no nyinsen: ntsi, Meserɛ wo, hwehwɛ nyia ndzɛmba yi yɛ nedze, nsɔwanokaba, nye ahoma, nye poma yi.
Na Juda hun dɛ noara nedze a, na ɔsee dɛ, ɔtsen sen me; susuampa dɛ mammfa no amma me ba Sela ntsi. Na ɔnye no annda bio.
Na ɔbaa no n’awoo durii no, na, hwɛ, nta na wɔwɔ ne yamu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ɔrowo no, nna kor dze ne nsa puei; na awogyefo no faa ahoma memen dze kyekyeer ne nsa dɛ, Oyi na odzii kan puei.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔtwee ne nsa kɔdɔɔ mu, na, hwɛ, no nua puei; na ɔwogyefo no see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na atsew mu aba yi? Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Perez.
Na n’ekyir no na nyia ahoma memen kyekyer ne nsa no bae: na wɔfrɛɛ no Zera.
Na wɔdze Josef kɔr Egypt, na Potifar, Farao no somfo a ɔyɛ n’abrafohen no, tɔɔ no wɔ Ismaelfo a wɔdze no kɔr hɔ no hɔn nsamu.
Na EWURADZE dzii Josef n’ekyir na ɔyɛɛ siar wɔ no wura Egyptnyi no ne fie.
Na no wura hun dɛ EWURADZE nye no nam, na EWURADZE maa dza ɔyɛɛ no nyinara yɛɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ ne nsamu.
Na Josef nyaa n’enyim enyimnyam, na ɔsoom no: na ɔyɛɛ no panyin wɔ ne fie, na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara hyɛɛ ne nsa.

Na ɔbaa dɛ ofitsi aber a ɔyɛɛ no panyin wɔ ne fie, na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara hyɛɛ ne nsa no, Josef ntsi EWURADZE hyiraa Egyptnyi no ne fie; na EWURADZE ne nhyira baa dza ɔwɔ nyinara do, dza ɔwɔ fie nye dza ɔwɔ haban mu.
Na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara hyɛɛ Josef ne nsa; nna noara nnyim dza ɔwɔ no hɔ gyedɛ edziban a ɔnoara dzi. Nna Josef no ho yɛ fɛw, na n’enyim wɔ nyam.
Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, no wura ne yer no dze n’enyi sii Josef do; na ɔsee dɛ, Enye me nda.
Na ɔpowee, na ɔsee no wura ne yer no dɛ, Hwɛ, mo wura nnyim dza ɔwɔ mo hɔ wɔ fie ha, na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara ahyɛ me nsa;
obiara nnyɛ kɛse nnkyɛn me wɔ fie ha; nkyii so ɔnnkam me biribiara ka wo ho, osiandɛ eyɛ ne yer: na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na mebɛyɛ emumuyɛ kɛse yi, na mayɛ bɔn etsia Nyankopɔn?
Na ɔbaa dɛ, daa daa nyinara ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Josef, naaso ɔanngye no pen, dɛ ɔnye no bɛda, anaa ɔnye no bɛyɛ biribi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber yi mu no ɔkɔr fie hɔ dɛ ɔrekɛyɛ n’edwuma; nna fie no mu nyimpa no mu biara nnyi hɔ
na basia no suoo n’atar mu, dɛ, Enye me nda: na Josef gyaa n’atar no wɔ ne nsamu, na oguanee puei.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ohun dɛ oegya n’atar no wɔ ne nsamu, na oeguan epue no,
ɔfrɛfrɛɛ no nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ne fie no, na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Wɔnhwɛ, ɔakɛfa Hebriwnyi aba ma oribesi hɛn atwetwe; ɔbaa me nkyɛn dɛ ɔnye me rebɛda, na medze ndze kɛse kekaa mu:
na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ɔtsee dɛ memaa me ndze do na mekekaa mu no, nna ɔdaan n’atar gyaa me nkyɛn, na oguanee puei.
Na ɔdze n’atar no guu ne nkyɛn ara ma okodur dɛ no wura baa fie.
Na ɔkaa no dɛmara kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Akowaa Hebriwnyi a edze no brɛɛ hɛn no, ɔbaa me nkyɛn dɛ orubogu mo ho fi
na ɔbaa dɛ, memaa me ndze do, na mekekaa mu no, nna ɔdaan n’atar gyaa me nkyɛn, na oguanee puei.
Na aber a no wura tsee ne yer ne nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Mbrɛ w’akowaa ayɛ me nye yi no; no bo fuuw kɛsenara.
Na Josef no wura faa no dze no kɔtoo efiadze, beebi mbrɛ ɔhen n’adaduafo gu no: na ɔdaa efiadze hɔ.
Na EWURADZE dzii Josef n’ekyir, na ɔdoom no, na ɔmaa onyaa efiadzehwɛfo no n’enyim enyimnyam.
Na efiadzehwɛfo no dze adaduafo a wɔwɔ efiadze hɔ no nyinara hyɛɛ Josef ne nsa; na biribiara a wɔyɛɛ no wɔ hɔ no, ɔnoara na ɔhwɛe.
Efiadzehwɛfo no annhaw no ho wɔ dza ɔdze hyɛɛ ne nsa mu no mu biara ho, osiandɛ EWURADZE nye no nam; na biribiara a ɔyɛe no, EWURADZE maa ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm.
Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, Egypthen ne nsahyɛfo nye ne paanootofo no foom hɔn wura Egypthen no.
Na Farao no bo fuuw n’asomfo beenu no, nsahyɛfo panyin no, nye paanootofo panyin no.
Na ɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze wɔ abrafohen no ne fie, wɔ efiadze beebi mbrɛ Josef da no no mu.
Na abrafohen no dze hɔn hyɛɛ Josef ne nsa, na ɔsoom hɔn: na wɔkyɛɛr efiadze hɔ mber kakra.
Na hɔn beenu nyina sosoo daa, anafua da kor a ɔsor obiara ne daa, nye ne nkyerɛasee.
Na Josef baa hɔn nkyɛn anapa no, obohun hɔn dɛ wɔabombɔm.
Na obisaa Farao n’asomfo a wɔnye no gu efiadze hɔ no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na ndɛ hom abombɔm dɛm yi?
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛasoso daa, naaso yennya obi ma ɔnnkyerɛ hɛn ase. Na Josef see hɔn dɛ, Ana nnyɛ Nyankopɔn na ɔma nkyerɛase bi a? Meserɛ hom, hom nka nkyerɛ me.
Na nsahyɛfo panyin no kaa n’adaaso kyerɛɛ Josef, na ɔsee no dɛ, M’adaaso mu, hwɛ, wenyindua si m’enyim;
na nkorbata ebiasa wɔ wenyindua no ho: na ɔyɛ dɛ ɔafefɛw, na ɔabɔ nhyiren; na no do nsiansiaw asow wenyinamba a ɔaber:
na Farao no kɔɔpow kitsa me nsamu, na metsetseew wenyinamba no, na mikyii guu Farao no kɔɔpow mu, na medze kɔɔpow no hyɛɛ Farao ne nsa.
Na Josef see no dɛ, Ne nkyerɛase nye yi; nkorbata ebiasa no ɔyɛ ndaansa.
Aka ndaansa ma Farao eyi wo efi ha na ɔama ekedzi wo dzibew bio: na edze Farao no kɔɔpow bɛhyɛ ne nsa, dɛ nkyɛ kan no a eyɛ ne nsahyɛfo no.
Na sɛ inya beebi si a, ɔno kaa me, na yɛ me ayamuyie, meserɛ wo, na bɔ me dzin kyerɛ Farao, na beyi me fi dan yi mu:
na owia na wowiaa me wɔ Hebriwfo asaase do: na ha so mennyɛɛ biribiara a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔdze me to efiadze.
Na aber a paanootofo panyin no hun dɛ nkyerɛase no ye no, ɔsee Josef dɛ, Mo so m’adaaso mu no, muhun dɛ paanoo fufuw nkɛntsɛn ebiasa sisi m’etsifi:
na kɛntsɛn a odzi sor no adɔkɔdɔkɔdze a wɔto ma Farao nyinara bi wɔ mu; na nnoma ridzi no kɛntsɛn no mu wɔ m’etsifi.
Na Josef buae na ɔsee dɛ, Ne nkyerɛase nye yi: nkɛntsɛn ebiasa no yɛ ndaansa:
na aka ndaansa ma Farao eyi wo tsir wɔ wo do, na wɔasɛn wo wɔ dua do ma nnoma edzi wo nam efi wo ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaansa no a ɔyɛ Farao n’awoda no, ɔtoo pon maa no nkowaa nyinara: na oyii nsahyɛfo panyin no nye paanootofo panyin no fii efiadze dze hɔn baa no nkowaa no enyim.
Na ɔmaa nsahyɛfo panyin no sanee yɛɛ ne nsahyɛdwuma no bio; na ɔdze kɔɔpow no hyɛɛ Farao ne nsa:
na paanootofo panyin no dze, ɔsɛɛn no: dɛ mbrɛ Josef kyerɛɛ hɔn ase no ara.
Naaso nsahyɛfo panyin no annkaa Josef, na no werɛ fiir no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe ebien ekyir no, Farao soo daa: na ohun dɛ nna ogyina esutsen Nael no ho.
Na ohun dɛ anantwiber esuon a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw na wɔadɔ seradze, fi esutsen no mu puei; na wobedzidzii wɔ sar no do.
Na hwɛ, anantwiber esuon afofor so fi esutsen no mu dzi hɔn ekyir puei a hɔn ho yɛ tantan na wɔafomfɔn; na wobegyinaa anantwiber esuon no nkyɛn wɔ esutsen no no kɔn do.
Na anantwiber esuon a hɔn ho yɛ tantan na wɔafomfɔn no, memeen anantwiber esuon a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw na wɔadodɔ seradze no. Nna Farao nyanee.
Na ɔdae na ɔsoo daa bio: na ohun dɛ, eburow mbɛtsem esuon efifir eburonan kor do, amaama na oye.
Na hwɛ, mbɛtsem esuon a ɔyɛ nkɔkɔr na boka mframa enyinyam no fifirii dzii hɔn ekyir.
Na mbɛtsem nkɔkɔr no memeen mbɛtsem esuon a eburow wɔ mu na ɔyɛ amaama no. Na Farao nyanee, na, hwɛ, adaaso a.

Na ɔbaa dɛ anapa no, n’ahom annka noho; na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛɛ Egypt nkongyaayifo nyinara, nye enyansafo a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinara ma wɔbae: na Farao kaa n’adaaso no kyerɛɛ hɔn; naaso obiara enntum annkyerɛ ase annkyerɛ no.
Nna nsahyɛfo panyin no kaa kyerɛɛ Farao dɛ, Mekaa mo mfom ndɛ:
Farao no bo fuuw no nkowaa, emi nye paanootofo panyin no: na ɔdze hɛn koguu efiadze wɔ abrafohen no ne fie,
na yɛsosoo daa anafua da kor, emi nye paanotonyi no; a ɔsor obiara ne daa nye mbrɛ ne nkyerɛase tse.
Na yɛkaa kyerɛɛ Hebriwnyi aberantsɛ bi, abrafohen no n’akowaa a nna ɔnye hɛn wɔ hɔ no, na ɔkyerɛɛ hɛn daa no ase; dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaako ne daa tse no ara na ɔkyerɛɛ no ase.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔyɛɛ hɔ dɛ mbrɛ ɔkyerɛɛ hɛn ase no ara; emi emaa mikedzii me dzibew, na ɔno esɛɛn no.
Na Farao somae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ Josef, na wɔyɛɛ ntsɛm dze no fii efiadze no mu hɔ puei: na osusuae, na ɔsesaa n’atar, na ɔbaa Farao hɔ.
Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Maso daa, na obiara nnyi hɔ a otum kyerɛ ase: na ɔwo na matse wo nka dɛ, etse daa a, ekyerɛ ase.
Na Josef buaa Farao dɛ, Onnyi mo mu: Nyankopɔn na ɔbɛma Farao asomdwee mbuae.
Na Farao kaa kyerɛɛ Josef dɛ, M’adaaso mu no, hwɛ, nna migyina esutsen Nael no kɔn do:
na muhun dɛ anantwiber esuon a wɔadɔ seradze na hɔn ho yɛ fɛw fi nsu no mu bae; na wobedzidzii sar no do:
na hwɛ, anantwiber esuon afofor so dzi hɔn ekyir bae a wɔyɛ mbɔbɔr na hɔn ho tantanntan nkamfenkamfe, a munnhun hɔn ho ne tantan ne saso wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do da:
na anantwiber a wɔyɛ nkamfenkamfe na hɔn ho tantan no memeen anantwiber esuon a wɔadɔ seradze a wodzii kan no.
Na aber a wowiee hɔn memen no, obi ennhu dɛ woewie hɔn men: osiandɛ nna hɔn ho da ho ara yɛ tantan dɛ nkan no ara so bio. Nna minyanee.
Na muhun wɔ m’adaaso mu bio, na hwɛ, mbɛtsem esuon efifir eburonan kor do, amaama na oye:
na muhun dɛ mbɛtsem esuon a enyinyam, na ɔyɛ nkɔkɔr, na boka mframa ama woetwintwam fifirii, dzii hɔn ekyir:
na mbɛtsem esuon nkɔkɔr no memeen mbɛtsem esuon a oye no. Mekaa kyerɛɛ nkongyaayifo no; naaso obiara nnyi hɔ a otumii kyerɛɛ me ase.
Na Josef see Farao dɛ, Farao n’adaaso ebien no yɛ kor: dza Nyankopɔn rebɛyɛ na oeyi akyerɛ Farao no.
Anantwiber pa esuon no yɛ mfe esuon; na mbɛtsem pa esuon no yɛ mfe esuon: daa no yɛ kor.
Na anantwiber esuon a wɔafomfɔn na hɔn ho yɛ tantan no a wodzii hɔn ekyir bae no, yɛ ɔkɔm mfe esuon, mbɛtsem esuon nkɔkɔr a boka mframa ama enyinyam no so dɛmara; ɔbɛyɛ ɔkɔm mfe esuon.
Ɔno nye asɛm a mekaa mekyerɛɛ Farao no; dɛ dza Nyankopɔn rebɛyɛ nna oeyi akyerɛ Farao no.
Hwɛ, mfe esuon reba a edziban piinara bɛba Egypt asaase nyinara do:
na ɔno n’ekyir no nna ɔkɔm mfe esuon bɔsoɛr; na werɛ befir edziban pii no nyinara wɔ Egypt asaase do; na ɔkɔm no bɛhyew asaase no;
na osian ɔkɔm a odzi ekyir no ntsi wɔnnkɛkaa edziban pii no wɔ asaase no do; osiandɛ no mu bɛyɛ dzen dodow.
Na sɛ adaaso no yɛɛ mbɔho ebien maa Farao a, nna ne siantsir nye dɛ, Nyankopɔn esi no pi, na Nyankopɔn bɛma ayɛ hɔ ntsɛntsɛm.
Dɛm ntsi afei wɔmma Farao nhwehwɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ ɔbadwembanyi nye onyansafo, na ɔnyɛ no panyin wɔ Egypt asaase do.
Wɔmma Farao nyɛ iyi, na ɔnhyehyɛ ahwɛdofo wɔ asaase no do, na wɔngyegye Egypt asaase do edziban no mbumu enum enum wɔ mfe esuon a edziban pii wɔ mu no mu.
Na wɔmma wɔmboaboa mfe pa a ɔreba yi no mu edziban nyinara ano, na wɔmfa eburow nhyehyɛ asan do wɔ Farao ne nsa ase, ma ɔnyɛ edziban wɔ nkurow no mu, na wɔmfa nsie.
Na edziban no bɛyɛ dza wɔakora ama asaase no dze esie ɔkɔm mfe esuon a ɔbɛba Egypt asaase do no; amma asaase no aannsɛɛ wɔ ɔkɔm no mu.
Na asɛm no yɛɛ Farao nye no nkowaa nyinara dɛw.
Na Farao see no nkowaa dɛ, Ana yebenya nyimpa a ɔtse dɛ oyi, nyimpa a Nyankopɔn no sunsum wɔ no mu yi?
Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Susuampa dɛ Nyankopɔn dze iyi nyinara akyerɛ wo yi, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛ ɔbadwembanyi nye onyansafo dɛ ɔwo:
ɔwo na ebɔhwɛ me fi yi do, na dza ebɛka no, dza me man nyinara bedzi do nye no; gyedɛ ahengua no nkotsee na medze mebɛsen wo.
Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Hwɛ, mayɛ wo Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin.
Na Farao worɔɔw no nsɔwanonkaba wɔ ne nsa, na ɔdze hyɛɛ Josef ne nsa, na ɔhyɛɛ no ndwera pa ntar, na ɔdze sika ntweaban too no kɔn mu;
na ɔmaa ɔtsenaa ne tseaseanam a otsia ebien no mu; na wɔpaa mu wɔ n’enyim dɛ, Obiara mbu nkotodwe; na ɔyɛɛ no Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin.
Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Emi nye Farao, na obiara nnkokwetsir wo ayɛ biribiara wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
Na Farao frɛɛ Josef ne dzin Zafenat-panea; na ɔdze ɔsɔfo Potifera ne babaa Asenat maa no awar.
Na aber a Josef kopuee Egypthen Farao n’enyim no, nna oedzi mfe eduasa. Na Josef fii Farao n’enyim, na okekyimaa Egypt asaase nyinara do.
Na bafuu mfe esuon no mu no, edziban baa asaase no do ma obuu do.
Na ɔboaboaa mfe esuon edziban a ɔbaa Egypt asaase do no nyinara ano, na ɔdze siesiee nkurow no mu: nhaban a wɔabɔ nkurow no nyinara ho aprɔw no mu edziban na ɔdze siesiee nkurow no mu.
Na Josef boaboaa eburow ano dɛ mpoano anhwea; ɔdɔɔ so dodow, ma nkyii ogyaa kan mpo; osiandɛ wobu ano a ɔnnyɛ yie.
Wɔwoo mba beenu maa Josef ansaana ɔkɔm afe no rudu, hɔn a On ɔsɔfo Potifera ne babaa Asenat woo hɔn maa no no a.
Na Josef frɛɛ abakan no ne dzin Manaasɛ: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn ama mo werɛ efir me berɛ nyinara, nye m’egya fie nyinara.
Na nyia otsia ebien no ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Efraim: osiandɛ ɔsee dɛ Nyankopɔn ama mawo wɔ amandzehu asaase no do.
Na ndɔbaa pii a ɔbaa Egypt asaase do mfe esuon no bɔɔ adze.
Na ɔkɔm mfe esuon hyɛɛ ase dɛ ɔreba, dɛ mbrɛ Josef see no ara; na ɔkɔm baa asaase nyinara do: nna Egypt asaase nyinara do dze, edziban wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔkɔm kaa Egypt asaase nyinara no, ɔman no sui tɔɔ Farao do gyee edziban: na Farao see Egyptfo no nyinara dɛ, Hom nkɔ Josef hɔ; dza ɔbɛse hom no, hom nyɛ.

Na aman nyinara baa Josef hɔ wɔ Egypt bɔtɔɔ eburow; osiandɛ ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ asaase nyinara do.

Na Juda kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, banyin no paa mu ara kaa kyerɛɛ hɛn dɛ, Hom runnhu m’enyim, gyedɛ hom nua no ka hom ho.
Sɛ ebɛma hɛn nua no nye hɛn akɔ a, nna yɛbɔkɔ na yɛakɔtɔ edziban abrɛ wo:
na sɛ ennkɛma ɔaka hɛn ho dze a, ɔno yɛronnkɔ: osiandɛ banyin no see hɛn dɛ, Mma hom nnsi m’enyim, gyedɛ hom nua no ka hom ho.
Na Israel see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom nye me dzi no bɔn dɛm, dɛ hom kaa kyerɛɛ banyin no dɛ hom wɔ nua bi so?

Na wɔsee dɛ, ɔbarimba no bisaa hɛn ntsɛmara wɔ hɛnara hɛnho, nye hɛn ebusuafo ho, dɛ, Ana hom egya da ho tse ase? Hom wɔ nua bi so a? Na mbrɛ nsɛm yi tse no ara na hɛn so yeyii no ano. Ana hɛn so yenyim dɛ ɔreyɛ na ɔase dɛ, Wɔnkɛfa hom nua no mbra?
Na Juda see n’egya Israel dɛ, Ma abofra no nye me nkɔ, na yɛbɔsoɛr na yɛakɔ; ama yeenya nkwa, na yeennwu, hɛn nye ɔwo nyina, nye hɛn mbofraba so.
Mibedzi no ho egyinamu; hwehwɛ no me nsamu: sɛ mammfa no ammbrɛ wo, na mammfa no emmbegyina w’enyim a, ɔno wɔmma asodzi no nka mo kɔn mu daa:
sɛ yennkyinkyim a nkyɛ ebodu sisei, ɔyɛ dɛn ara a yɛakɔ aba mpɛn ebien.

Na hɔn egya Israel see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ mbrɛ ɔtse nye yi a, ɔno hom nyɛ yi; hom mfa asaase yi do ndzepa a oye no bi ngu hom ndzɛmba mu, dɛ akyɛdze nkɛma banyin no, akyenkyendur kakra, ewo kakra, eduhuam mɛɛr, nkatse, nye eduadzewa almɔnd,
na hom mfa sika fofor nkitsa; na sika a wɔdze sanee maa hom a wɔdze hyehyɛɛ hom nkotoku ano no, ɔno so hom mfa nkitsa bio; bi a enyi na oduaa do.
Hom mfa hom nua no so, na wɔnsoɛr nkɔ banyin no hɔ bio:
na Otumfo Nyankopɔn mma banyin no nhu hom mbɔbɔr, ama oeegyaa hom nua kor no nye Benjamin ama hom. Na emi dze, sɛ me mba fi me nsa a, nna woefi me nsa.
Nna nkorɔfo no faa akyɛdze no, na wɔfaa sika fofor siaan ho, nye Benjamin so; na wɔsoɛree kɔr Egypt, na wokegyinaa Josef n’enyim.
Na aber a Josef hun dɛ Benjamin ka hɔn ho no, ɔsee ne fie somfopanyin no dɛ, Fa mbanyin yi kɔ fie, na koku mbowa, na yɛ edziban; na mbanyin yi nye me bedzidzi ewiaber yi.
Na panyin no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Josef see no ara; na ɔdze nkorɔfo no kɔr Josef fie.

Na nkorɔfo no hɔn akoma tui, osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn akɔ Josef ne fie ntsi; na wɔsee dɛ, Sika a wɔsanee dze hyehyɛɛ hɛn nkotoku mu asɔpɔn no ntsi na wɔdze hɛn aba fie yi; ama ɔaahwehwɛ biribi egyina do, na oeesuo hɛn mu, na ɔaafa hɛn ayɛ nkowaa, nye hɛn nsoasopɔnkɔ.
Na wopiin Josef ne fie somfopanyin no nkyɛn wɔ fi no n’abowano,
na wɔsee dɛ, Ao mo wura, yɛbaa ha bɔtɔɔ edziban asɔpɔn no ampa:
na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a yedur asoɛe, na yɛsansaan hɛn nkotoku ano no, nna, hwɛ, hɛn nyinara hɛn sika hyehyɛ hɛn nkotoku ano, hɛn sika mbrɛ ɔtow ara pɛ: na yɛdze asan aba.
Na yɛdze sika fofor so aba a yɛdze robɔtɔ edziban: yennyim nyia ɔdze hɛn sika no hyehyɛɛ hɛn nkotoku mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Asomdwee nka hom, mma hom nnsuro: hom Nyankopɔn, nye hom egya ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔama hom ehutudze wɔ hom nkotoku mu: me nsa kaa hom sika no. Na okeyii Simeon brɛɛ hɔn.
Na banyin no dze nkorɔfo no kɔr Josef fie, na ɔmaa hɔn nsu, na wɔhohoor hɔn anan ho; na ɔmaa hɔn nsoasopɔnkɔ no edziban.
Na wɔyɛɛ akyɛdze no krado dze tweɔɔn Josef ne mbae a ɔbaa ewiaber no: osiandɛ wɔtsee dɛ woribedzidzi wɔ hɔ.
Na Josef baa fie no, wɔdze akyɛdze a okitsa hɔn nsamu no kɔr dan mu kɛmaa no, na wɔkɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze wɔ famu maa no.
Na obisaa hɔn honam mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ana hom egya akɔdaa a hom kaa no ho asɛm no, no ho ye? Ana ɔda ho tse ase?
Na wɔsee dɛ, W’akowaa hɛn egya no ho ye, ɔda ho tse ase. Na wɔbɔɔ hɔn tsir adze, na wɔkotoow no.
Na ɔmaa n’enyiwa do, na ohun no nua Benjamin, ne na ba no, na obisaa dɛ, Ana hom nua kuma a hom kaa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ me no, ɔno nye yi a? Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn nhyira wo, me ba.
Na Josef no ho hiahiaa no; osiandɛ ne yamu hyehyee no wɔ no nua no ho; na ɔhwehwɛɛ beebi a obosuma esu; na ɔkɔr ne pia mu, na okosui wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔhohoor n’enyim, na opuei; na ɔhyɛɛ noho do, na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔmfa edziban mbesisi hɔ.
Na wɔdze ɔnoara nedze sii fa, na wɔdze hɔndze sisii fa, na wɔdze Egyptfo a wɔnye no dzidzi no hɔndze sisii fa; osiandɛ Egyptfo nnye Hebriwfo nndzidzi; na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma Egyptfo.
Na wɔtsenatsenaa n’enyim, abakan no dɛ mbrɛ ne panyin tse, nye ekumaba no dɛ mbrɛ n’ekumaba tse: na ɔyɛɛ nkorɔfo no nwanwa wɔ hɔn mu.
Na oyiyii edziban ma wɔdze fii n’enyim maa hɔn: na Benjamin dze n’edziban no boor hɔn nyinara hɔndze do mpɛn enum. Na wɔnomee, na hɔn nyinara hɔn enyi gyee.
Na Josef hyɛɛ ne fie somfo no dɛ, Fa edziban dodowara a nkorɔfo no botum asoa hyehyɛ hɔn nkotoku mu, na fa nyimpa biara ne sika hyɛ no kotoku ano.
Na fa mo kɔɔpow no, mekyerɛ me dwetɛ kɔɔpow no, hyɛ hɔn mu kakraba no no kotoku mu, nye n’eburow sika no. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Josef kae no ara.
Enyim tsetsewee ara na wogyaa nkorɔfo no kwan, hɔn nye hɔn nsoasopɔnkɔ.
Na wofii kurow no mu kɔree, na wonnyae nndur ekyirekyir no, Josef see ne somfo no dɛ, Soɛr, tsiw nkorɔfo no; na sɛ eto hɔn a, se hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom dze bɔn etua papa kaw yi?
Ana nnyɛ iyi na mo wura nom ano, na ɔdze hyɛ nkɔm ma ɔba mu no bi? Hom ayɛ bɔn dɛ hom ayɛ dɛm adze yi.
Na ɔtoo hɔn, na ɔkaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mo wura ka nsɛm a ɔtse dɛm yi? Nyankopɔn mpa ngu dɛ wo nkowaa bɛyɛ dɛm adze yi.
Hwɛ, sika a yehun no hɛn nkotoku mu no, yɛdze sanee fii Keenan asaase do brɛɛ wo bio: ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na yebowia dwetɛ anaa sika wɔ wo wura ne fie?
Wo nkowaa hɛn mu biara a ibohu no wɔ no hɔ no, ma onwu, na hɛn so yɛbɛyɛ mo wura nkowaa.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Nna afei wɔmma ɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ hom aka yi ara: nyia wobohu no no hɔ no ɔbɛyɛ m’akowaa; na hom dze, hom nndzi so.
Nna wɔyɛɛ no ntsɛm, na nyimpa biara soɛɛ no kotoku too famu, na nyimpa biara saan no kotoku ano.
Na ɔhwehwɛe, ofitsi panyin no do, na ɔdze kɛpeem kakraba no do: na wohun kɔɔpow no wɔ Benjamin no kotoku no mu.
Nna wosunsuaan hɔn ntar mu, na obiara dze n’adze soaa n’asoasopɔnkɔ, na wɔsanee kɔr kurow no mu.
Na Juda nye no nuanom no baa Josef fie; nna ɔda ho wɔ hɔ: na wɔhwehwee famu wɔ n’enyim.
Na Josef see hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom ayɛ yi? Ana hom nnyim dɛ nyimpa a ɔtse dɛ emi yi mubotum dɛ mehyɛ nkɔm ma ɔba mu bi a?
Na Juda see dɛ, Yɛnse mo wura dɛn? Yɛnka dɛn anaadɛ yerudua dɛn asan hɛnho? Nyankopɔn eyi wo nkowaa hɛn emumuyɛ edzi: hwɛ, yɛyɛ mo wura no nkowaa, hɛn nye nyia wohun kɔɔpow no wɔ ne nsamu nyinara.
Na Josef see dɛ, Nyankopɔn mpa ngu dɛ mebɛyɛ dɛm: nyia woehu kɔɔpow no wɔ ne nsamu no, ɔnoara na ɔbɛyɛ m’akowaa; na hom dze, hom nkɔ hom egya nkyɛn wɔ asomdwee mu.
Nna Juda piin Josef nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Ao mo wura, meserɛ wo, ma w’akowaa nka asɛm kor wɔ mo wura n’asomu, na mma wo bo mmfuw w’akowaa: osiandɛ tserɛ woara nye Farao.
Mo wura bisaa no nkowaa dɛ, Ana hom wɔ egya, anaa nua bi?
Na yebuaa mo wura dɛ, Yɛwɔ egya, akɔdaa bi, na no nkɔdaa ba kakraba bi; na no nua ewu na ne ba a aka ara nye no nko, na n’egya dɔ no.
Na esee wo nkowaa dɛ, Wɔnkɛfa no mbrɛ me, ma monhwɛ no.
Na yɛsee mo wura dɛ, Abofra no fi n’egya nkyɛn a ɔnnkɛyɛ: na sɛ ofi n’egya nkyɛn a, n’egya bowu.
Na esee wo nkowaa dɛ, Gyedɛ hom nua kakraba no nye hom ba, ɔno hom nnkohu m’enyim bio.
Na ɔbaa dɛ yɛkɔr w’akowaa, m’egya nkyɛn no, yɛkaa mo wura ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
Na hɛn egya see dɛ, Hom nkɔ bio nkɔtɔ edziban kakra mbrɛ hɛn.
Na yɛsee dɛ, Yɛkɔ a ɔnnkɛyɛ: gyedɛ hɛn nua kakraba no ka hɛn ho, ɔno yɛbɔkɔ: osiandɛ sɛ hɛn nua kakraba no nnka hɛn ho a, ɔno yennkohu banyin no n’enyim.
Na w’akowaa, m’egya no see hɛn dɛ, Homara hom nyim dɛ me yer woo mba beenu maa me:
na baako fii me nkyɛn kɔree, na mesee dɛ, Ampaara wɔatsetsew no mu, na munnhun no ara na ɔdze ebodu ndɛ yi:
na sɛ hom yi oyi so wɔ me nkyɛn, na mbusu bi ba no do a, ɔno hom dze mo gon nam awerɛhow mu bɔkɔ nda mu.
Dɛm ntsi afei sɛ mokɔ w’akowaa, m’egya ne nkyɛn, na sɛ abofra no nnka hɛn ho a, ɔnam dɛ n’akoma da abofra no ho dodow ntsi,
sɛ ohu dɛ abofra no nnka hɛn ho a, ɔno obowu: nna wo nkowaa dze w’akowaa, hɛn egya no, no gon nam awerɛhow mu akɔ nda mu.
Na w’akowaa midzii abofra no ho egyinamu maa m’egya dɛ, Sɛ mammfa no mammbrɛ wo a, ɔno mibedzi so wɔ m’egya n’enyim daa.
Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, ma w’akowaa mindzi abofra no ananmu menyɛ mo wura ɔsomfo; na ma abofra no nye no nuanom nkɔ.
Na mibesi no dɛn na makɔ m’egya nkyɛn, ber a abofra no nnka mo ho? Bɛyɛ na mehu mbusu a ɔbɛba m’egya no do.

Nna afei Josef hyɛ noho do a ɔnnyɛ yie, wɔ hɔn a wogyinagyina ne nkyɛn no nyinara hɔn enyim; na ɔkaa mu dɛ, Wɔmma nkorɔfo nyinara mfi me nkyɛn mfi. Na aber a Josef riyi noho edzi akyerɛ no nuanom no, nna obiara nngyina ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔmaa ne ndze do sui: na Egyptfo no tsee, na Farao fiefo tsee.
Na Josef see no nuanom no dɛ, Emi nye Josef; ana m’egya da ho tse ase? Na no nuanom no enntum emmbua no; osiandɛ hɔn ho popoe wɔ n’enyim.
Na Josef see no nuanom no dɛ, Meserɛ hom, wompin me nkyɛn. Na wopinii. Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye hom nua Josef a hom tɔɔn no baa Egypt no.
Na afei mma ɔnnyɛ hom yaw, na mma hom bo mmfufuw hom ho so, dɛ hom tɔɔn me baa ha: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn na ɔsomaa me ma midzii hom enyim kan, ama maabɛgye nkwa.
Osiandɛ ɔkɔm esi asaase yi do mfe ebien nye yi: na mfe enum so aka a adɔw nye buber so nnyi mu.
Na Nyankopɔn somaa me ma midzii hom enyim kan ama maabɔkora edzinkaa bi ama hom wɔ asaase do, na medze ɔgye kɛsenara agye hom nkwa.
Dɛm ntsi afei, nnyɛ hom bi na wɔsomaa me wɔ ha, na Nyankopɔn a: na ɔayɛ me Farao n’egya, na ne fi nyinara wura na Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin.
Hom nka hom ho nkɔ m’egya hɔ, na wɔnkɛse no dɛ, Mbrɛ wo ba Josef se nye yi, Nyankopɔn ayɛ me Egypt nyinara wura: bra me nkyɛn, mma nnkyinkyim:
Na bɛtsena Gosen asaase do, na bɛn me, ɔwo, nye wo mba, nye wo mbanananom, nye wo nguan, nye w’anantwi, nye dza ewɔ nyinara:
na mobɔhwɛ wo wɔ hɔ; na aka ɔkɔm mfe enum so; bɛyɛ na ehia, ɔwo, nye wo fidua, nye dza ewɔ nyinara.
Na hwɛ, hom enyiwa tua, na mo nua Benjamin so n’enyiwa tua, dɛ m’ano na ɔrekasa kyerɛ hom yi.
Na hom nkɛka m’enyimnyam a mowɔ no wɔ Egypt nyinara no ho asɛm nkyerɛ m’egya, na dza hom ehu no nyinara; na hom nyɛ ntsɛm nkɛfa m’egya mbra ha.
Na ɔbaar no nua Benjamin no kɔn, na osui; na Benjamin so sui wɔ no kɔn ho.
Na ɔfefeew no nuanom nyinara hɔn ano, na ɔdzedze hɔn mu sui: na n’ekyir no no nuanom no nye no kasae.
Na wɔtsee nka wɔ Farao fie dɛ, Josef no nuanom aba: na Farao nye no nkowaa enyi gyee papa.
Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Se wo nuanom no dɛ, Iyi na hom nyɛ: hom mfa ndzɛmba nsoasoa hom mbowa no, na hom nkɔ, hom nsan nkɔ Keenan asaase do;
na hom nkɛfa hom egya nye hom fifo, na hom mbra me nkyɛn: na mebɛma hom Egypt asaase no mu dza oye, na hom bedzi asaase no do ndzepa.
Afei se hɔn dɛ, iyi na hom nyɛ; hom mfa ntseaseanam wɔ Egypt asaase do nkɛfa hom mbofraba, nye hom yernom na hom egya ma wɔmbra.
Eso mma hom mma hom ndzɛmba ho nnhia hom; na dza oye wɔ Egypt asaase do nyinara yɛ homdze.
Na Israel ne mba no yɛɛ dɛm: na Josef maa hɔn ntseaseanam, dɛ mbrɛ Farao hyɛe no ara, na ɔmaa hɔn kwan mu edziban.
Ɔmaa hɔn nyinara ntar nsakyerho nkorkor; na Benjamin dze, ɔmaa no ndwetɛbona ahaasa, nye ntar nsakyerho enum.
Na dza ɔdze kɛmaa n’egya nye yi; nsoasopɔnkɔ du a wɔsoso Egypt ndzɛmba pa, nye nsoasopɔnkɔber du a wɔsoso eburow, nye boodoo, nye edzidzidze a n’egya bedzi no wɔ kwan mu.
Nna ogyaa no nuanom no kwan, na wosii mu na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ mma hom aannka yaw wɔ kwan mu.
Na wofii Egypt kɔree, na wɔbaa hɔn egya Jakob nkyɛn wɔ Keenan asaase do.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Josef da ho tse ase, na ɔno nye Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin. Na bobor boor no, osiandɛ ɔanngye hɔn enndzi.
Na wɔkaa Josef ne nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no nyinara kyerɛɛ no: na aber a ohun ntseaseanam a Josef maa wɔdze kɔree dɛ wɔmfa nkɛfa no no, nna hɔn egya Jakob n’akoma tɔɔ ne yamu:
na Israel see dɛ, ɔdɔɔ so ma me; me ba Josef da ho tse ase: mobɔkɔ mekohu no ana mewu.
Na Israel faa dza ɔwɔ nyinara sii mu, na ɔbaa Beer-seba, na ɔbɔɔ afɔr maa n’egya Isaak ne Nyankopɔn.
Na Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ Israel wɔ anafua nyikyerɛ mu, na ɔfrɛɛ no, Jakob, Jakob, na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye Nyankopɔn, w’egya ne Nyankopɔn: mma nnsuro dɛ ebɔkɔ Egypt; na mebɛyɛ wo ɔman kɛse wɔ hɔ:
menye wo bɔkɔ Egypt; na medze wo efi hɔ aba bio so ampaara: na Josef dze n’abaw mu na ibowu ada.
Na Jakob soɛree fii Beer-seba: na Israel ne mba no twuuw hɔn egya Jakob, nye hɔn mbofraba, nye hɔn yernom, wɔ ntseaseanam a Farao maa wɔdze baa dɛ wɔmfa mbɛfa no no mu.
Na wɔfaa hɔn mbowa, nye hɔn ahodze a wonyaa no wɔ Keenan asaase do no, na wɔbaa Egypt, Jakob nye n’asefo nyinara a wɔka no ho:
ne mbabanyin, nye ne mbabanyin hɔn mbabanyin ka no ho, ne mbabaa nye ne mbabanyin hɔn mbabaa, nye n’asefo nyinara na wɔka no ho na ɔnye hɔn baa Egypt.
Na Israel ne mba a wɔbaa Egypt no hɔn edzin nye yi, Jakob nye ne mbabanyin: Jakob n’abakan Reuben.
Na Reuben ne mbabanyin; Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, nye Karmi.
Na Simeon ne mbabanyin; Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar, nye Saul, Keenannyi ɔbaa bi ne ba no.
Na Levi ne mbabanyin; Gerson, Kohat, nye Merari.
Na Juda ne mbabanyin; Er, Onan, Sela, Perez, nye Zera: mbom Er nye Onan dze, wowuu Keenan asaase do. Na Perez ne mbabanyin nye Hezron na Hamul.
Na Isakar ne mbabanyin; Tola, Puva, Iob, nye Simron.
Na Zebulun ne mbabanyin; Sered, Elon, nye Jaleel.
Woyinom nye Leah ne mbabanyin a ɔwoo hɔn maa Jakob wɔ Paddan-aram nye ne babaa Dina: ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa nyinara yɛ akra eduasa ebiasa.
Na Gad ne mbabanyin; Zifion, Hagi, Suni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, nye Areli.
Aser ne mbabanyin; Imna, Isva, Isvi, Beria, nye hɔn akyerɛbaa Sera: na Beria ne mbabanyin; Heber, nye Malkiel.
Woyinom nye Zilpa a Laban dze no maa ne babaa Leah no ne mbabanyin, na woyinom na ɔwoo hɔn maa Jakob; wɔyɛ akra duesia.
Jakob ne yer Rahel ne mbabanyin; Josef nye Benjamin.
Na wɔwoo Manaasɛ nye Efraim wɔ Egypt asaase do maa Josef, On ɔsɔfo Potifera ne babaa Asenat woo hɔn maa no.
Na Benjamin ne mbabanyin; Bela, Beker, Asbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Ros, Muppim, Huppim, nye Ard.
Woyinom nye Rahel ne mbabanyin a wɔwoo hɔn maa Jakob: hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ akra duanan.
Na Dan ne babanyin nye Husim.
Na Naftali ne mbabanyin nye Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, nye Sillem.
Woyinom nye Bilha a Laban dze no maa ne babaa Rahel no ne mbabanyin na woyinom na ɔwoo hɔn maa Jakob: hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ akra esuon.
Akra a wɔnye Jakob kɔr Egypt a wofi n’asen mu nyinara, sɛ Jakob ne mbabanyin hɔn yernom nnka ho a, akra no nyinara yɛ eduosia esia.
Na Josef ne mbabanyin a wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Egypt no wɔyɛ akra beenu: Jakob ne fie akra a wɔbaa Egypt no nyinara, wɔyɛ eduosuon.
Na ɔsomaa Juda ma odzii n’enyim kan kɔr Josef hɔ, ama oeebedzi n’enyim akyerɛ no Gosen kwan; na wɔbaa Gosen asaase do.
Na Josef yɛɛ ne tseaseanam krado, na ɔkɔree kehyiaa n’egya Israel kwan wɔ Gosen; na ɔdze noho kyerɛɛ no, na ɔbaar no kɔn, na osui wɔ no kɔn ho ara ma ɔkyɛɛr kakra.
Na Israel see Josef dɛ, Menya mehu dɛ eda ho ara etse ase yi dze, afei mutum kɔ me nsamankyir.
Na Josef see no nuanom, nye n’egya ne fifo dɛ, Morokɔ na makɛka akyerɛ Farao, na mase no dɛ, Mo nuanom, nye m’egya ne fifo a wɔwɔ Keenan asaase do no aba me nkyɛn:
na nkorɔfo no yɛ nguanhwɛfo, na mbowa na wɔnyɛn; na wɔdze hɔn nguan, nye hɔn anantwi, nye dza wɔwɔ nyinara aba.
Na sɛ Farao frɛ hom, na obisa dɛ, Wɔyɛ ebɛn edwuma a?

Ɔno hom nse dɛ, Ofitsi hɛn mbofra mu dze bɛpem ndɛ ara wo nkowaa mbowa ara na yɛnyɛn, hɛn, nye hɛn egyanom nyinara: ama hom aatsena Gosen asaase do; osiandɛ oguanhwɛfo biara yɛ ekyiwadze ma Egyptfo; wɔnye nguanhwɛfo nndzi afora.
Na Josef sii mu kɔr fie na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ Farao, na ɔsee dɛ, M’egya nye mo nuanom, hɔn nguan, hɔn anantwi, nye dza wɔwɔ nyinara, fi Keenan asaase do aba; na, wɔwɔ Gosen asaase do.
Na ɔfaa no nuanom no hɔn mu beenum, na ɔdze hɔn kɛkyerɛɛ Farao.
Na Farao bisaa no nuanom no dɛ, Wɔyɛ ebɛn edwuma? Na wɔsee Farao dɛ, Wo nkowaa yɛyɛ nguanhwɛfo, hɛn nye hɛn egyanom nyina.

Na wɔsee Farao dɛ, Yɛaba dɛ yɛrebɛtsena asaase yi do; na wo nkowaa hɔn nguan nnya edzidzibea; osiandɛ ɔkɔm no mu ayɛ dzen wɔ Keenan asaase do: dɛm ntsi afei, yɛserɛ wo, ma wo nkowaa ntsena Gosen asaase do.
Na Farao kaa kyerɛɛ Josef dɛ, W’egya nye wo nuanom aba wo nkyɛn:
Egypt asaase da w’enyim; asaase no mu mbrɛ oye no na ma w’egya nye wo nuanom ntsena; ma wɔntsena Gosen asaase do: na sɛ inyim hɔn mu bi a wɔyɛ mbɔdzembɔfo a, ɔno yɛ hɔn mo mbowa do ahwɛfo.
Na Josef dze n’egya Jakob bae begyinaa Farao n’enyim: na Jakob hyiraa Farao.
Na Farao bisaa Jakob dɛ, Wo nkwa nda mu mfe yɛ ahen?
Na Jakob see Farao dɛ, M’akwantu ne mfe nda yɛ mfe ɔha eduasa: mo nkwa ne mfe nda kumaabi na mbusu nko, na ɔnntoo m’egyanom hɔn nkwa ne mfe nda wɔ hɔn akwantu ber no mu.
Na Jakob hyiraa Farao, na ofii Farao n’enyim kɔree.
Na Josef maa n’egya nye no nuanom no tsenabew, na ɔmaa hɔn beebi wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ asaase no do mbrɛ oye, wɔ Rameses asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ Farao hyɛe no ara.
Na Josef bɔɔ n’egya, nye no nuanom, nye n’egya ne fifo nyinara akɔhoma, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Nna edziban nnyi asaase no do beebiara; na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen dodoodow, ma Egypt asaase nye Keenan asaase tɔɔ bitsi wɔ ɔkɔm no ntsi.
Na Josef boaboaa sika a wonyaa no Egypt asaase do, nye Keenan asaase do no, eburow a wɔtɔe no ne sika no nyinara ano: na Josef dze sika no baa Farao fie.
Na aber a nkorɔfo ho sika nyinara sae wɔ Egypt nye Keenan asaase do no, Egyptfo no nyinara baa Josef hɔ, na wɔbɛsee dɛ, Ma hɛn edziban: na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na yebowuwu wɔ w’enyim? Hɛn ho sika asa.
Na Josef see dɛ, sɛ hom ho sika asa a, hom mfa hom mbowa mma; na mebɛgye hom mbowa na mama hom bi.
Na wɔdze hɔn mbowa brɛɛ Josef: na Josef maa hɔn edziban dze gyee mpɔnkɔ, nye nguan, nye anantwi, nye nsoasopɔnkɔ: na ɔmaa hɔn edziban dze gyee hɔn mbowa nyinara wɔ afe no mu.

Na afe no bɛsenee no, wɔbaa no hɔ afe a otsia ebien no, na wɔbɛsee no dɛ, Yɛnnkɛfa esuma mo wura dɛ, hɛn sika nyinara asa; na hɛn mbowa nyinara yɛ mo wura dze; biribiara nnyi hɔ a ɔaka wɔ mo wura n’enyim, ka hɛn honam nye hɛn asaase ho;

ebɛnadze ntsi na yebowu w’enyim, hɛn nye hɛn asaase nyina? Fa edziban tɔ hɛn nye hɛn asaase, na hɛn nye hɛn asaase bɛyɛ asomfo ama Farao: na ma hɛn eduaba, ama yaatsena ase, na yeennwuwu, na amma asaase yi aannda pan.
Nna Josef tɔɔ Egypt asaase nyinara maa Farao; na Egyptfo nyinara tontɔɔn hɔn haban, osiandɛ ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ hɔn do: na asaase no bɛyɛɛ Farao dze.
Na nkorɔfo no dze, ɔdaan hɔn nkowaa otuu hɔn hɔ ma wɔkɛtsenatsenaa nkurow a ofi Egypt ɔhe no kurotsia kɛpem ne kurotsia no mu.
Asɔfo no hɔn asaase nko na ɔanntɔ: osiandɛ Farao maa asɔfo no kyɛfa bi, na wodzii hɔn kyɛfa a Farao dze maa hɔn no; dɛm ntsi wɔanntɔn hɔn asaase.
Nna Josef see nkorɔfo no dɛ, Hwɛ matɔ hom nye hom asaase ndɛ ama Farao: hwɛ, hom eduaba nye yi, na hom nkoduadua no wɔ asaase no do.
Na dza ɔbɛyɛ nye dɛ, hom dze ekuadze yi mu mbumu enum enum bɛma Farao, na anan no ayɛ homankasa homdze, ma wɔdze bi edua haban mu, na ɔayɛ hom, nye hom fifo nye hom mbofraba edziban.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Agye hɛn nkwa: ma yennya mo wura n’enyim enyimnyam, na yɛbɛyɛ Farao n’asomfo.
Na Josef dze yɛɛ mbra too hɔ wɔ Egypt asaase do ɔdze bɛpem ndɛ ara, dɛ wɔmfa mbumu enum enum mma Farao; gyedɛ asɔfo no hɔn asaase nkotsee na annyɛ Farao dze.
Na Israel tsenaa Egypt wɔ Gosen asaase do; na wonyaa egyapadze wɔ hɔ, na wɔwowoe, na wɔdɔɔr pii.
Na Jakob tsenaa Egypt asaase do mfe duesuon: na Jakob ne nda, no nkwa ne mfe, yɛɛ mfe ɔha eduanan esuon.

Na mber a Israel dze bowu no bɛnee no: ɔfrɛɛ ne ba Josef, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ afei menya w’enyim enyimnyam a, meserɛ wo, fa wo nsa to m’aserɛ ase, na enye me ndzi no ayamuyie mu nye nokwar mu; meserɛ wo, mma nnsie me wɔ Egypt:
na sɛ mokɔ me nsamankyir a, ɔno soa me fi Egypt, na kesie me wɔ m’egyanom hɔn esiei. Na ɔsee dɛ, Mebɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ aka no ara.
Na Jakob see dɛ, Dzi nsew kyerɛ me: nna Josef dzii nsew kyerɛɛ no. Na Israel bɔɔ no mu adze wɔ mpa no n’etsifi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Josef dɛ, Hwɛ, w’egya yar: na ɔfaa ne mbabanyin beenu no, Manaasɛ nye Efraim kaa no ho.
Na obi kaa kyerɛɛ Jakob dɛ, Hwɛ, wo ba Josef reba wo nkyɛn: na Israel miaa n’enyi, na ɔtsenaa mpa do.
Na Jakob see Josef dɛ, Otumfo Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ me wɔ Luz wɔ Keenan asaase do, na ohyiraa me,
na ɔsee me dɛ, Hwɛ, mebɛma awo, na adɔr, na mebɛyɛ wo aman asafo; na medze asaase yi ama w’asefo a wobedzi w’ekyir ma wɔdze ayɛ daa egyapadze.
Na afei wo mba beenu a ewoo hɔn wɔ Egypt asaase do ansaana mereba wo nkyɛn wɔ Egypt no, wɔyɛ medze; Efraim nye Manaasɛ, bɛyɛ medze, dɛ Reuben nye Simeon ara so.
Na wo mba a hɔn ekyir ebɔwo hɔn no, na wɔbɛyɛ wodze; wɔdze hɔn nuanom dzin bɛfrɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn egyapadze mu.
Na emi dze, mifi Paddan mebae no, Rahel wuu m’enyim wɔ kwan mu wɔ Keenan asaase do, aber a aka ɔkwan kakraabi ma edu Efrat no: na misiee no Efrat kwan mu hɔ (ɔnoara nye Bɛtlɛhɛm).
Na Israel hun Josef ne mba no, na ɔsee dɛ, Woananom nye yi?
Na Josef see n’egya dɛ, me mba a Nyankopɔn dze hɔn ama me wɔ ha a. Na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo, fa hɔn brɛ me, ma minhyira hɔn.
Nna onyin dodow ntsi Israel n’enyiwa do ayɛ no nkusunkusu, ma onntum nnhu adze. Na Josef dze hɔn piin ne nkyɛn; na Israel feew hɔn ano, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn etuu.
Na Israel see Josef dɛ, Manndwen dɛ nkyɛ mubohu w’enyim: na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ama mehu wo mba so.
Na Josef yii hɔn wɔ n’anan ntamu bae; na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze dze n’enyim boom famu.
Na Josef faa hɔn beenu nyina, ne nsa enyimfa dze Efraim mu wɔ Israel n’abankum, na ne nsa abankum dze Manaasɛ mu wɔ Israel n’enyimfa, na ɔdze hɔn piin ne nkyɛn.
Na Israel tseen ne nsa enyimfa, na ɔdze too Efraim a ɔyɛ kakraba no n’etsifi, na ɔdze ne nsa abankum too Manaasɛ n’etsifi, ɔboapa ara yɛɛ ne nsa dɛm; osiandɛ Manaasɛ nye abakan.
Na ohyiraa Josef, na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn no a m’egyanom Abraham nye Isaak wɔnantseew n’enyim no, Nyankopɔn no a ɔahwɛ me mo nkwaber nyinara mu ma ɔdze abɛpem ndɛ no,
sor abɔfo no a oeyi me efi mbusu nyinara mu no, onhyira mbofra yi: na wɔmma wɔmfa me dzin nye m’egyanom Abraham nye Isaak hɔn dzin mfrɛ hɔn; na wɔmma wonnyin wɔnyɛ ɔdodow wɔ asaase do.
Na aber a Josef hun dɛ n’egya dze ne nsa enyimfa ato Efraim n’etsifi no, ɔannyɛ no abodwe: na osuoo n’egya ne nsa mu dɛ oriyi wɔ Efraim n’etsifi ato Manaasɛ n’etsifi.
Na Josef see n’egya dɛ, ɔnntse dɛm, m’egya: na abakan no nye yi; fa wo nsa enyimfa to n’etsifi.
Na n’egya ammpen, na ɔsee dɛ, Minyim, me ba, minyim: ɔno so bɛyɛ ɔman, na ɔno so bɛyɛ kɛse: naaso no nua kuma bɛyɛ kɛse asen no, na n’asefo bɛyɛ amanaman pii.
Na ohyiraa hɔn da no see dɛ, ɔwo na Israel dze wo behyira dɛ, Nyankopɔn mma yɛ dɛ Efraim nye dɛ Manaasɛ: na ɔdze Efraim dzii Manaasɛ ne kan.
Na Israel see Josef dɛ, Hwɛ, muruwu: na Nyankopɔn bedzi hom ekyir, na ɔdze hom akɔ hom egyanom hɔn asaase do bio.
Nkyii so medze kyɛpɛn kor a ɔbor wo nuanom do a medze m’afona nye m’egyen megyee no wɔ Amorifo nsamu no ama wo.
Na Jakob frɛɛ ne mbabanyin, na ɔsee dɛ: Hom mboa hom ano, na menka dza ndaamba ɔbɛba hom do nkyerɛ hom.
Hom nhyia, na wontsie, hom Jakob mba; Na wontsie hom egya Israel.
Reuben, ɔwo nye m’abakan, mo tum, nye m’ahoɔdzen ahyɛse; Nyia ɔkyɛn wɔ enyidzi mu na nyia ɔkyɛn wɔ tum mu.
Ihihim dɛ nsu, ennkɛkyɛn; Osiandɛ efoow w’egya ne mpa: Nna iguu ho fi: efoow m’adae.
Simeon nye Levi wɔyɛ enuanom; Hɔn mfona yɛ enyiber akodze.
Ao me kra, mma mmba hɔn apam mu; M’enyimnyam, mma mmfora hɔn mboano mu; Osiandɛ hɔn ebufuw mu na wokum nyimpa, Na hɔn ahopɔw mu na wotwitwaa nantwi anantsir.
Ndom nka hɔn ebufuw, osiandɛ ɔyɛ hyew; Na hɔn enyiber, osiandɛ no mu yɛ dzen: Mebɛpaapaa hɔn mu wɔ Jakob mu, Na mabɔ hɔn apetse wɔ Israel mu.
Juda, ɔwo na wo nuanom beyi wo ayɛw: Wo nsa bɛhyɛ w’atamfo hɔn kɔn do; W’egya mba bɔbɔ hɔn mu adze wɔ w’enyim.
Juda yɛ ogyata ba; Abɔgyanam ara na edze enyin, me ba: ɔkotowee, obutuuw hɔ dɛ ogyata, Na dɛ ogyataber; woana na obekenyan no?
Ahempoma nnkefi Juda nsa, Nna mbrahyɛfo poma nnkefi n’anan ntamu, Kɛpem dɛ Siloh bɛba; Na ɔno na aman bɛyɛ setsie ama no.
Ɔdze n’asoasopɔnkɔba amontan wenyindua, Na n’asoasopɔnkɔber ba wɔ wenyindua pa ho; ɔahor ne ntar wɔ wenyin mu, Na n’akataho wɔ wenyinamba bɔgya mu:
N’enyiwa yɛ dɛnn sen nsa memen, Na numfonsu ama ne se ho ahoa fitaa.
Zebulun bɛtsena po berekyir: Na ɔbɛyɛ mbrɛ ahɛn gyinagyina; Na ɔnye Zidon bɔbɔ ɔhe.
Isakar yɛ asoaso a no ho yɛ dzen, Obutuuw nguamban ntamu:
Na ohun ahomgye bea dɛ oye, Na asaase no dɛ ɔyɛ fɛw; Na ɔbrɛɛ n’abatsir adze dze soae, Na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔsomfo wɔ edwumadzen mu.
Dan bobua no nkorɔfo atsɛn, Dɛ Israel mbusuakuw mu kor.
Dan bɛyɛ ɔwɔ a ɔbew kwan mu, Ehurutsia a ɔda akwantsen, ɔsɔw ɔpɔnkɔ nantsir, na no do atsefo no obu dua n’ekyir.
EWURADZE, matweɔn wo nkwahosan.
Gad, dɔm bɛhyɛ no do: Na ɔno so bɛhyɛ hɔn etsia hɔn anantsir.
Aser n’edziban fi no mu bɔtɔ angoa, Na ɔbɛma ahemfo adɔkɔdɔkɔdze.
Naftali yɛ ɔtrɔmber a woegyaa no: ɔka ahomkasɛm.
Josef yɛ dua a ɔsow, Abaw a ɔsow wɔ nsunyiwa ho; No nkorbata tratra ban.
Egyentofo no eyi no awerɛhow kɛsenara, Na wɔatotow no, na wɔayɛ no enyienyi:
