ɔno banyin a ɔnye no dae no, mfa dwetɛ dwetɛbona eduonum mma akataasia no n’egya, na ɔnyɛ ne yer, osiandɛ ɔabrɛ no adze; mma ɔnnko no ne nda nyinara.
Ɔbanyin bi nnwar n’egya ne yer, na onnyi n’egya n’akatado.
Nyia no ntɔhwɛbo abɔ, anaa ne banyin etwa no, mma ɔnnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu.
Nyia wɔawo no wɔ edwaman bi nnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu; n’ebusuasantsen a otsia du mpo mu biara nnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu.
Ammonnyi anaa Moabnyi nnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu; hɔn ebusuasantsen a otsia du mpo mu biara nnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu ara da:
osiandɛ wɔammfa edziban na ɔnye nsu emmbehyia hom wɔ ɔkwan no mu, aber a hom fi Egypt reba no; na dɛ wɔkɔbɔɔ Beer ne babanyin Balaam a ofi Petor a ɔwɔ Mesopotemia no paa dɛ ɔmbɔdom wo ntsi.
Naaso EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ammpɛ dɛ otsie Balaam; na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn daan ndom no nhyira maa wo, osiandɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dɔɔ wo.
Mma nnhwehwɛ hɔn asomdwee nye hɔn eyiedzi wo nda nyinara daa.
Mma nnkyir Edomnyi; na ɔyɛ wo nua: mma nnkyir Egyptnyi; osiandɛ ekɛyɛɛ n’asaase do ɔhɔho.
Ebusuasantsen a otsia ebiasa mba a wɔbɔwo hɔn ama hɔn no na wɔnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu.
Sɛ ifir edzi kɛkyer w’atamfo ho nsera a, ɔno sie woho yie wɔ adze bɔn biara ho.
Sɛ ɔbanyin bi wɔ hom mu a no ho nntsew wɔ no ha a ɔsen anadwe bi ntsi a, ɔno omfi nseraban no mu nkɔ ekyir, mma ɔmmba nseraban no mu;
na ɔmbra dɛ orudu ewimbir no, onguar noho wɔ nsu mu: na sɛ wi kɔtɔ a, ɔmbra nseraban no mu.
Nya beebi so wɔ nseraban no ekyir, mbrɛ ibefir edzi akɔ:
na nya ɔsɔsɔw wɔ wo ndadzedze mu; na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ekɔkotow ekyir hɔ a, edze eefun, na aasan ekyir akata dza ofi wo mu ba no do:
na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn nenam wo nseraban mu, dɛ ɔregye wo, na ɔdze w’atamfo ama wɔ w’enyim; dɛm ntsi wo nseraban nyɛ krɔnkrɔn: amma oeennhu efifidze bi wɔ wo mu, na ɔaanndan emmfi wo nkyɛn.
Mma nnyi akowaa a oefi no wura nkyɛn eguan aba wo hɔ mma no wura:
ma ɔnye wo ntsena, wɔ wo mu, wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi no wɔ wo nkuropon no kor mu, mbrɛ ɔpɛ no dodow no: mma nnhyɛ no do.
Mma Israel mbabaa mu biara nnyɛ edwaman, nkyii so mma Israel mbabanyin mu biara nndan edwaman.
Mma mmfa ɔbaa edwaman apaabɔdze, anaa ɔkraman (banyin edwaman) n’akatua, mmba EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn fie wɔ anohoba biara mu: na ebien yi nyina yɛ ekyiwadze ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn.
Mma mmbɔ wo nua bosa nngye nsiho:
ɔnanaben na bɔ no bosa gye nsiho; na wo nua dze, mma mmbɔ no bosa nngye nsiho: na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn eehyira wo adze a edze wo nsa bɛka nyinara mu, wɔ asaase a erokɔ akɛfa no do.
Sɛ ebɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn anohoba a, mma nnyɛ nyaa dɛ ebɔpon: na ampaara EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɔhwehwɛ no wɔ wo hɔ; na ɔbɛdan wo bɔn.
Na sɛ ema anohoba no ka a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn mma wo.
Dza efi w’anofamfa do epue no dwen do na yɛ; dɛ mbrɛ abɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn anohoba, ayamuyi afɔr a edze w’ano aka no.
Sɛ idu wo nyɛnko no wenyin ture mu a, ɔno dzi esikyireamba no bi mee; mbom mma mmfa bi nngu w’adze mu.
Sɛ idu wo nyɛnko n’eburow a osisi hɔ mu a, ɔno fa wo nsa pempan mbɛtsem no bi; mbom mma mma dadze do wɔ wo nyɛnko n’eburow a osisi hɔ do.

Sɛ ɔbanyin bi fa ɔbaa, na ɔwar no a, ɔno ɔba dɛ, sɛ onnya n'enyiwa do enyimnyam, osiandɛ oehu no ho enyitodze bi ntsi a, ɔnkyerɛw ɔkonwoma mma no, na ɔmfa nhyɛ ne nsa, na ongya no kwan ma omfi ne fie nkɔ.
Na sɛ ofi ne fie kɔ a, ɔnkɔ nkɛyɛ ɔbanyin fofor bi ne yer.
Na sɛ nkyinkyirii kun no so tan no, na ɔkyerɛw ɔkonwoma ma no, na ɔdze hyɛ ne nsa, na ogya no kwan ma ofi ne fie kɔ; anaa sɛ nkyinkyirii kun no a ɔfaa no yɛɛ ne yer no wu a;

mma no kun kankan no a ogyaa no kwan no, mmfa no nnyɛ ne yer bio, wɔ no ho fi-gu ekyir no; na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Na mma nnyɛ ma asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no do nnyɛ bɔn.
Sɛ ɔbanyin bi hyia yer fofor a, mma ɔnnkɔ sa, nkyii so mma wɔmmfa edwuma biara nnto no do: Ondzi noho wɔ fie afrenhyia, na ɔmma ne yer a oehyia no no akomatɔmu.
Mma nyimpa bi nngye ewuyambo anaa ewuyambobaa a ɔda do no ahoba:
Sɛ wohu nyimpa a owia no nuanom Israel mu bi, na ɔyɛ no dɛ onyimfo, anaa ɔtɔn no a; ɔno owifo no nwu; ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu.
Hwɛ yie wɔ kwata owuyar ho, na aadwen do yie ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ asɔfo Levifo no bɛkyerɛkyerɛ hom no nyinara: Dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛɛ hɔn no, dɛmara so na hom ndwen do nyɛ.
Kaa dza Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze yɛɛ Miriam wɔ ɔkwan no mu aber a hom fi Egypt reba no.
Sɛ ebɔ wo nyɛnko bosa biara a, mma nnkɔ ne fie nnkɛgye n'ahobadze.
Abowenyim na gyina, na nyimpa a ebɔ no bosa no mfa ahobadze no mfir edzi mbrɛ wo wɔ abowenyim.
Na sɛ ɔyɛ ohianyi a, mma mmfa n'ahobadze no nnda:
Sɛ wi kɔtɔ a, fa ahobadze no san kɛma no, na ɔnda wɔ n'atar mu, na onhyira wo: Na ɔnyɛ tsenenee mma wo wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim
Mma nnhyɛ ɔpaanyi a ɔyɛ ɔbɔbɔnyi nye ohianyi no do, sɛ ofi wo nuanom mu o, ofi w'ahɔhoe a wɔwɔ w'asaase do wɔ wo nkuropɔn mu o:
ne da mu na ma no n'apaadze, nkyii so mma wi nnkɔtɔ do; osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔbɔbɔnyi, na ɔdze n'akoma esi do: Amma ɔaannka mu ammfrɛ Ewuradze enntsia wo, na aanyɛ bɔn amma wo.
Mma wonnku egyanom wɔ mba ntsi, nkyii so mma wonnku mba wɔ egyanom ntsi: Nyimpa biara nankasa no bɔn ntsi na wonku no.
Mma nndan ɔhɔho, anaa egyanka n'atsɛmbu enyi na nngye okunafo akataho ahoba:
Na kaa dɛ eyɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt, na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn poon wo wɔ hɔ: Dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo dɛ iyi yi.
Sɛ itwa wo ndɔbaa wɔ wo haban no mu a, mma nnsan nnkɔ nnkɛfa mmba: Ma ɔnyɛ ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafo dze: Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn eehyira wo wɔ wo nsaano edwuma nyinara mu.
Sɛ eporow wo ngodua a, mma nnkɔ n'abaw no do bio: Ma ɔnyɛ ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafa dze.
Sɛ etsew wo wenyin ture mu esikyireamba a, mma nnkedzi w'ekyir mpɛpɛw: Ma ɔnyɛ ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafo dze.
Na kaa dɛ eyɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt asaase do: Dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo dɛ yɛ iyi yi.
Sɛ ɔham ba mbanyin ntamu, na wɔba asɛndzii, na ntsɛmbuafo rubua hɔn atsɛn a; ɔno wombu ɔtseneneenyi no bem, na wombu ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no fɔ;
na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no sɛ hwe a, ɔtsɛmbuafo no mma ɔnda famu, na wɔnhwe no wɔ n’enyim, dodow dɛ mbrɛ no bɔn no tse.
Mbaa eduanan na ɔsɛ no a, mma ɔmmbor: ɔno bɛyɛ na sɛ ɔbor, na ɔhwe no mbaa pii sen iyi a, wo nua no adan w’enyi do ɔhorohoraanyi.
Mma nnkata ɔnantwi ano aber a oritsia ewu.

Sɛ enuanom bɔ mu tsena, na hɔn mu baako wu, na onnyi ɔbabanyin a, mma owufo no ne yer nnkɔ ehuw mu nnkɔwar ɔhɔho: no kun no no nua na ɔnkɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔmfa no nyɛ ne yer, na ɔnyɛ okun no nua asɛdze no mma no.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, abakan a ɔbɔwo no no nhyɛ no nua a oewu no ne dzin ananmu, na ne dzin aammpepa emmfi Israel.

Na sɛ ɔbanyin no mmpɛ dɛ ɔfa no nua yer no a, ɔno no nua ne yer no nkɔ mpanyimfo nkyɛn wɔ kuropon no ano, na ɔnse dɛ, Mo kun no nua pow dɛ ɔma dzin do ma no nua wɔ Israel, ɔmmpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ kun no nua asɛdze no ma me.
Ɔno no kurow no mu mpanyimfo no mfrɛ no, na wɔnkasa nkyerɛ no: na sɛ ogyina hɔ, na ɔse dɛ, Memmpɛ dɛ mefa no a;
ɔno no nua ne yer no mbra ne nkyɛn wɔ mpanyimfo no enyim, onyi banyin no n’ananadze mpaboa na onhima n’enyi do ntafi; na ɔnse dɛ, Dɛm na wɔnyɛ ɔbanyin a ɔnnkyekyer no nua ne fi.
Na wɔmfrɛ ne dzin wɔ Israel dɛ, Nyia ne mpaboa efi n’ananadze no ne fi.
Sɛ mbanyin beenu roko, na ɔbaako ne yer twe bɛn dɛ ɔrebɛgye no kun efi nyia ɔrohwe no ne nsamu, na basia no tsen ne nsa suo banyin kor no ne banyin mu a:
ɔno twa ɔbaa no ne nsa, mma w’enyi nnhu no mbɔbɔr.
Mma nnya wo foto mu abrambo ahorow, kɛse nye kakraba.
Mma nnya wo fi mu esusudze ahorow, kɛse nye kakraba.
Abrambo kwan mu a ɔtsen na nya; esusudze kwan mu a ɔtsen na nya: na wo nda aawar wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do.
Na hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba nyinara, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ dza ɔmmfa kwan mu nyinara, yɛ ekyiwadze ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn.
Kaa dza Amalek dze yɛɛ wo wɔ ɔkwan no mu aber a hom fi Egypt reba no;
mbrɛ osii behyiaa wo wɔ ɔkwan no mu, na ɔbɔɔ w’ekyirfo, hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw wɔ w’ekyir nyinara, aber a atɔ bahaw na aberɛ; na oennsuro Nyankopɔn.

Dɛm ntsi ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ma wo ahomgye fi w’atamfo a woetwa wo ho ehyia nyinara nsamu wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ fa yɛ egyapadze no do a, pepa Amalek nkaa fi ɔsor ase; mma wo werɛ mmfir.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ idu asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no do, na efa, na etsena do a;

fa asaase no do nduadzewa a ibenya no wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do no, no nduadzewa a odzi kan no nyinara mu bi; na fa gu kɛntsɛn mu, na fa kɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi dɛ ne dzin ntsena hɔ no.
Na kɔ ɔsɔfo a ɔbɛtsena hɔ nda no mu no nkyɛn, na se no dɛ ndɛ da yi mepaa mu meka kyerɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, dɛ medu asaase a EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom dɛ ɔdze rema hɛn no do.
Na ɔsɔfo no ngye kɛntsɛn no wɔ wo nsamu, na ɔmfa nsi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn n’afɔrmbukyia no enyim.
Na bua na ka no wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ, Sirianyi a ɔreyɛ ahera nye m’egya, na osianee kɔr Egypt, na ɔkɛtsenaa hɔ, ne nyimpa kumaabi; na ɔyɛɛ ɔman kɛse a wɔyɛ dzen, na wɔdɔree wɔ hɔ:
na Egyptfo no yɛɛ hɛn bɔn, na wohiahiaa hɛnho, na wɔdze nkowaasom dzendzen too hɛn do:
na yɛkekaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE, hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn, na EWURADZE tsiee hɛn ndze, na ohun hɛn ahohiahia, nye hɛn fona, nye hɛn su:
na EWURADZE dze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, nye abasa a wɔatserɛw mu, nye suro akɛse, nye nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye anwanwadze yii hɛn fii Egypt firii:
na ɔdze hɛn aba bea yi do, na ɔdze asaase yi ama hɛn, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do.
Na afei, hwɛ, medze asaase a ɔwo, EWURADZE, dze ama me no do nduadzewa a odzi kan no aba. Na fa si EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim, na sɔr wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim:
na gye w’enyi wɔ adzepa a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze ama ɔwo, nye wo fi nyinara mu, ɔwo, nye Levinyi, nye ɔhɔho a ɔwɔ wo mu no.
Sɛ iwie wo ndɔbaa mu ebupɛn du du nyinara yiyi wɔ afe a otsia ebiasa no a ɔyɛ ebupɛn du du yiyi afe no mu a, ɔno fa ma Levinyi, nye ɔhɔho, nye egyanka, nye ekunafo, ma wondzi wɔ wo kuropon mu, mmee;

na se wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ, Meyi ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no efi me fie, na afei so medze ama Levinyi, nye ɔhɔho, nye egyanka, nye okunafo, dɛ mbrɛ wo mbrasɛm a edze ahyɛ me no nyinara tse monntoo wo mbransɛm mu biara, nkyii so mo werɛ mmfirii.
Minndzii bi wɔ m’eyiyɛ mu, nkyii so minnyii bi nnkyenee dɛ no ho nntsew ntsi, na memmfaa bi memmaa ewufo so: metsie EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn ndze, mayɛ dɛ mbrɛ edze ahyɛ me no nyinara.
Fi wo tsenabew krɔnkrɔn no, wɔ ɔsor, hwɛ famu, na hyira wo man Israel, nye asaase a edze ama hɛn no, dɛ mbrɛ ekaa ntam kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom no, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no.
Ndɛ da yi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn rehyɛ wo dɛ yɛ ahyɛdze nye atsɛmbu yi: dɛm ntsi fa w’akoma nyinara nye wo kra nyinara dzi do na yɛ.
Ndɛ da yi, aka ato gua dɛ edze EWURADZE bɛyɛ wo Nyankopɔn, na anantsew n’akwan mu, na edze n’ahyɛdze, nye ne mbransɛm, nye ne ntsɛmbu do, na etsie ne ndze:
na EWURADZE aka ato gua ndɛ da yi dɛ ebɛyɛ nankasa no soronko man, dɛ mbrɛ ɔabɔ wo anohoba no, na eedzi ne mbransɛm nyinara do;
na ɔaama wo do akyɛn amanaman a ɔayɛ nyinara, wɔ ayɛyi mu, nye dzin mu, nye enyidzi mu; na aayɛ ɔman krɔnkrɔn ama EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, dɛ mbrɛ ɔaka no.
Na Moses nye Israel mpanyimfo no hyɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, Hom ndzi mbrasɛm a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi nyinara do.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, da a hom botwa Jordan akɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do no, fa abo akɛse sisi hɔ, na fa ntarho tetar ho:

na kyerɛw mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara wɔ do, aber a etwa no; na aakɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE, w’egyanom Nyankopɔn, abɔ wo anohoba no.
Na ɔmbra dɛ aber a hom etwa Jordan no, hom mfa abo yi a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi, nsisi hɔ wɔ bepɔw Ebal do, na fa ntarho tetar ho.
Na hɔ na si afɔrmbukyia ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, abo afɔrmbukyia a: mma emma dadze edwindze do wɔ do.
Abo a wonntwae na fa si EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia no: na bɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ do ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn:
na bɔ asomdwee afɔr, na dzidzi wɔ hɔ; na gye w’enyi wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na kyerɛw mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara petee wɔ abo no do.
Na Moses nye Levifo asɔfo no kasaa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara dɛ, Israel, hom nyɛ dzinn, na hom ntsie; ndɛ da yi abɛyɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne man.
Dɛm ntsi tsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze, na dzi ne mbransɛm na n’ahyɛdze a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi do.
Na Moses hyɛɛ ɔman no da no ara, dɛ,
Iyinom na wongyina bepɔw Gerizim do nhyira ɔman no, aber a hom etwa Jordan no; Simeon, Levi, Juda, Isakar Josef, nye Benjamin:
na iyinom ngyina bepɔw Ebal do mpaa; Reuben, Gad Aser, Zebulun, Dan, nye Naftali.
Na Levifo no mfa ndze kɛse ntsea mu, na wɔnse Israelfo no nyinara dɛ:
Mpaa nka nyimpa a ɔbɛyɛ ohonyi a wɔasen anaa woegu, EWURADZE ekyiwadze, odwimfo nsaano edwuma, na ɔdze besi kokoa mu. Na ɔman no nyinara mbua nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nka nyia ɔyaw n’egya anaa ne na. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nka nyia ɔtwe ne nyɛnko n’asaasehe. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nka nyia ɔma onyifurafo fi ɔkwan do kyin. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nka nyia ɔdan ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafo atsɛmbu enyi. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nka nyia ɔnye n’egya yer da; osiandɛ oeyi n’egya n’akataho. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nka nyia ɔnye abowa biara da. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nka nyia ɔnye n’akyerɛbaa da, n’egya ne babaa, anaa ne na ne babaa. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nka nyia ɔnye n’asew da. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nka nyia ɔbɔ ne nyɛnko adze nsumaa mu. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nka nyia ɔgye mboaba dɛ oboku nyimpa a odzi bem. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Mpaa nka nyia ɔnnhyɛ mbra yi mu nsɛm dzen dɛ ɔbɛyɛ. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ itsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze yie, dɛ ebɔdwen do ayɛ ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara a, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma wo do akɔ sor asen asaase do amanaman nyinara:
na nhyira yi nyinara bɛba wo do, na wɔabɔto wo, osiandɛ itsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ndze.
Nhyira bɛka wo wɔ kurow mu, na nhyira aka wo wɔ haban mu.
Nhyira bɛka wo honam mu aba, na w’asaase do aba, na wo fiembowa mu aba, w’anantwi ndɔree, nye wo nguankuw mu mburwa.
Nhyira bɛka wo kɛntsɛn nye wo mbɔrkorow.
Nhyira bɛka wo wɔ wo fie ba mu, na nhyira bɛka wo wɔ w’edzifir mu.
EWURADZE bɛma w’atamfo a wɔsoɛr wo do no edzi nkogu wɔ w’enyim: wɔnam ɔkwan kor do bɛba wo do, na wɔnam akwan esuon do eguan wɔ w’enyim.
EWURADZE bɛhyɛ ma nhyira aba wo do wɔ w’asan do, na dza edze wo nsa bɛka nyinara mu; na obehyira wo wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do.
Sɛ idzi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm do, na enantsew n’akwan do a EWURADZE dze wo betsim hɔ ma aayɛ ɔman krɔnkrɔn ama noara, dɛ mbrɛ ɔaka ntam akyerɛ wo no.
Na asaase do aman nyinara bohu dɛ wɔdze EWURADZE dzin afrɛ wo; na wobosuro wo.
Na EWURADZE bɛma yie ebu wo do, wɔ wo honam mu aba mu, nye wo fiembowa aba mu, nye w’asaase aba mu, wɔ asaase a EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma wo no do.
EWURADZE bobue ɔsor n’adzepa korabea no ama wo na ɔaama w’asaase do nyankom atɔ wɔ n’aber mu, na oeehyira wo nsaano edwuma nyinara do: na edze bɛfɛm amanaman pii, na ɔwo remmfɛm.
sɛ itsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi dɛ ebɔdwen do ayɛ a, EWURADZE bɛma akɔ kan na ennkɛka ekyir; na ɔwo bɔbɔ do ara nko, na eremmba ase.
Ne dɛm ntsi mma nndan mmfi nsɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi ho, mmfa enyimfa, anaa abankum, nnkɔ nnkedzi enyame fofor ekyir nnkɔsom hɔn.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ enntsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze dɛ ebɔdwen do edzi ne mbransɛm nye n’ahyɛdze a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara do a; mpaa yi nyinara bɛba wo do, na wɔabɛmen wo.
Mpaa bɛka wo wɔ kurow mu, na mpaa aka wo wɔ haban mu.
Mpaa bɛka wo kɛntsɛn, nye wo mbɔrkorow.
Mpaa bɛka wo honam mu aba, nye w’asaase mu aba, nye w’anantwi mu ndɔree, nye wo nguankuw mu mburwa.
Mpaa bɛka wo wɔ wo fie ba mu, na mpaa bɛka wo wɔ w’edzifir mu.
EWURADZE bɛma mpaa, nkogu, nye adapaabɔ aba wo do, wɔ dza edze wo nsa bɛka ayɛ nyinara mu, dze ekodu dɛ ebɛsɛɛ, na ayew ntsɛm; osian wo ndzeyɛɛ a enam do apow me ntsi.
EWURADZE bɛma ɔyardɔm afam wo ho, dze ekodu dɛ ɔahyew wo efi asaase a erokɔ do akɛfa no do.
EWURADZE dze asasawaw, nye etsiridii, nye ahohur, nye ahohyehye kɛse, nye nkrantsee, nye ɔhow, nye ɔpo bɔbɔ wo; na wobetsiw wo araa ekodu dɛ ebɛsɛɛ.
Na ɔsor bɛyɛ dɛ boran ama wo, na asaase adan dadze ama wo.
EWURADZE bɛma etudur na huntuma atɔ dɛ nsu egu wo do araa ekodu dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ wo.
EWURADZE bɛma edzi w’atamfo enyim ɔkogu: enam ɔkwan kor do befir edzi ekehyia hɔn, na enam akwan esuon do eguan wɔ hɔn enyim: na wobedzi wo akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do ahendzi nyinara mu.
Na wo fun bɛyɛ wimu ntumbowa nyinara, nye asaase do mbowa edziban, na obiara rennka hɔn.
EWURADZE dze Egypt pɔmpɔ, tukuruw, satwem, nye ntwem a worunntum wo eduyɛ bɔbobɔ wo.
EWURADZE dze abɔdam, nye enyifura, nye akoma mu ahodwuruw bɔbɔ wo;
na ebɛkeka ewiaber ketee, dɛ ofurafo rekeka wɔ sum mu, na w’akwan mu rennyɛ wo yie: na ɔhyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ wo na wɔafow wo dabaa, na obiara renngye wo.
Ebɛgye ayewar, na ɔbanyin fofor bi nye no ada: ibesi dan, na erenntsena mu: ebɛtsɛw wenyin ture, na erenntsew n’aba bi.
Woboku wo nantwi wɔ w’enyim, na irinndzi bi: wɔbɛfa w’asoaso enyimpi do wɔ w’enyim, na wɔrenndan mma wo: wɔdze wo nguan bɛma w’atamfo na innkenya obi ma ɔaagye wo.
Wɔdze wo mbabanyin nye wo mbabaa bɛma ɔman fofor bi na w’enyiwa bɔhwɛ, na hɔn ho enyigyinae egura wo daa nyinara: na tum biara nnyi wo nsamu.
W’asaase do aba, nye w’edwumadze nyinara, na ɔman a innyim hɔn bedzi; na ɔhyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ wo na wɔadwerew wo dabaa:
dɛm ntsi w’enyiwa do adze a ibohu no bɔbɔ wo dam.
EWURADZE dze pɔmpɔ bɔn bɔbɔ wo wɔ anankoroma, nye aserɛ do a worunntum wo eduyɛ, efi w’ananadze ekodu w’etsifipampamu.
EWURADZE dze ɔwo, nye wo hen a ibesi no wo do no, bɔkɔ ɔman a ɔwo nye w’egyanom nnyim no mu; na hɔ na ebɔsom enyame fofor, ndua nye abo.
Na ebɛdan ahodwuruwdze, akasabɛbu, nye ifen, wɔ aman a EWURADZE bɛma akɔ no nyinara mu.
Ebɔsoa aba pii akɔ haban mu, na kakrabaabi na ebɔboa ano aba fie; na mbɛbɛw bedzi.
Ebɛtsetsɛw wenyin nture na esiesie mu, na ne nsa dze eronnom, na erenntsew esikyireamba no so; na mbowaba bedzi.
Ibenya ngodua wɔ wo ntoado nyinara, na ngo no dze erennsera woho bi; na wo ngodua no bɔporow n’aba.
Ebɔwo mbabanyin nye mbabaa, na wɔrennyɛ wodze; na wɔbɔkɔ ndɔmmum mu.
Wo ndua nyinara nye w’asaase do aba no mbɛbɛw bɛfa.
Ɔhɔho a ɔwɔ wo mu bɛkyɛn wo akɔ sorsorsor; na ɔwo dze ibesian aba famufamu.
Ɔno na ɔdze bɛfɛm wo, na ɔwo dze, irinnya mmfɛm no: ɔno na ɔbɔkɔ kan, na ɔwo aka ekyir.
Na mpaa yi nyinara bɛba wo do, na woetsiw wo, na wɔamen wo, ekodu dɛ ebɛsɛɛ; osiandɛ enntsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ndze, dɛ ibedzi ne mbransɛm nye n’ahyɛdze a ɔhyɛ wo no do:
na ɔbɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze, wɔ ɔwo nye w’asefo do daa:
osiandɛ ammfa enyigye, nye akoma pa annsom EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, wɔ adze nyinara no dodow mu ntsi:
dɛm ntsi ebɔsom w’atamfo a EWURADZE bɔsoma hɔn ma wɔaaba wo do no, wɔ ɔkɔm, nsukɔm, adagyaw, nye ndzɛmba nyinara ho hia mu: na ɔdze dadze kɔndua bɔto wo kɔn do, ekodu dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ wo.
EWURADZE dze ɔman bi befi ekyirekyir efi asaase ano aba wo do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkɔr tu; ɔman a enntse hɔn kasaa;
ɔman a hɔn enyim yɛ hu a wɔmmfɛr akɔdaa enyim, na wɔnnkyerɛ enyimtsewee wɔ aberantsɛ do so:
na obedzi wo fiembowa mu aba, na w’asaase do aba, ekodu dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ wo: eso orinngya wo eburow, nsa, anaa ngo, w’anantwi mu ndɔree, anaa wo nguankuw mu mburwa, ekodu dɛ ɔbɛma asɛe.

Na ɔbɔkɔ wo ntua wɔ wo nkuropon nyinara mu, ekodu dɛ w’afasu atsentsen a ɔyɛ dzen no a edze wo werɛ hyɛ mu no bodwuruw egu famu, wɔ w’asaase nyina do: na ɔbɔkɔ wo ntua wɔ wo nkuropon nyinara a ɔwɔ w’asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze ama wo no nyinara do.
Na ibedzi woara wo honam mu aba, wo mbabanyin nye wo mbabaa a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze ama wo no hɔn nam; wɔ ntua nye ahokyer a w’atamfo bɛma wo ho akyer wo no mu.
Ɔbanyin a ɔdwe na ɔwɔ tsema wɔ hom mu no n’enyiwa bɛyɛ bɔn wɔ no nua, nye ne yer a ɔda no bo mu, nye ne mba nkaa a wɔama wɔaka no ho:
dɛ ɔremma hɔn mu biara ne mba nam a oridzi no bi, osiandɛ biribiara annka amma no; wɔ ntua nye ahokyer a wo tamfo bɛma wo ho akyer wo wɔ wo nkuropon nyinara mu no mu.
Hom mu ɔbaa so a ɔdwe na ɔsonsɔn no ho na ɔnam mberɛwyɛ ntsi ɔnnsɔe nnhwɛɛ pɛn dɛ ɔdze n’ananadze bɛka famu no, bɛyɛ nyimpa bɔn wɔ no kun a ɔda no bo mu, nye ne babanyin, nye ne babaa ho;
na ɔbɔwe ne mba a ɔbɔwo hɔn no nye ekyiradze no wɔ nsumaa mu: wɔ ahohia a ofi ntua nye ahokyer a wo tamfo bɛma aba wo do wɔ wo nkuropon mu no ntsi.
Sɛ eronndwen do nnyɛ mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu, na ennsuro enyimnyam dzin a no ho yɛ hu yi, EWURADZE WO NYANKOPƆN no a,
ɔno EWURADZE bɛma wo yardɔm, nye w’asefo yardɔm ayɛ nwanwa; mekyerɛ ɔyardɔm akɛse a ɔkyɛr, nye yarba bɔn a ɔkyɛr.
Na ɔdze Egypt yarba no a isuro no nyinara bɛba wo do bio; na ɔabɛfemfam wo ho.
Eso yarba biara, nye ɔyardɔm biara a wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ mbra yi no nwoma mu no, ɔno na EWURADZE dze bɛba wo do, ekodu dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ wo.
Na ɔbɛka hom nyimpa kakrabaabi, naaso nna nkyɛ hom dodow tse dɛ ɔsor nworaba; osiandɛ hom enntsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’enyi gye hom ho dɛ ɔbɛyɛ hom yie, na ɔama hom adɔr no; dɛmara so na EWURADZE n’enyi bɛgye hom ho dɛ ɔbɛma hom ase etu, na ɔasɛɛ hom: na wɔbɛpempan hom efi asaase a hom rokɔ do akɛfa no do.
Na EWURADZE bɔbɔ wo apetse aman nyinara mu, efi asaase ano kor araa ekodu asaase ano kor so; na hɔ na ebɔsom enyame fofor a ɔwo nye w’egyanom nnyim hɔn, mekyerɛ ndua nye abo.
Na amanaman iyinom mu irinnya ahotɔ, na w’ananadze rinnya ahomgye: na EWURADZE bɛma wo ahopopo akoma, nye enyiwa a ayɛ siamoo, nye ɔkra a etwintwam wɔ hɔ:
na wo nkwa bɛsɛn ehihim wɔ w’enyim; na ibosuro adzesaa nye adzekyee, na irinnya wo nkwa ho gyedzi biara:
anapa ebɛse dɛ, Kɛtseankyɛ ewimbir a: na ewimbir so ebɛse dɛ, Kɛtseankyɛ anapa a: wɔ w’akoma mu suro a ibosuro, nye w’enyiwa do adze a ibohu no ntsi.
Na EWURADZE dze ahɛn dze wo bɛsan akɔ Egypt, wɔ ɔkwan a mekaa wo ho asɛm dɛ irunnhu bio no do: na hɔ na hom bɔtontɔn homho ama hom atamfo ayɛ nkowaa nye mfonabaa, na nyimpa biara ronntɔ hom.
Iyi nye ahyɛmu a EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses dɛ ɔnye Israelmba ndzi wɔ Moab asaase do, nka ahyɛmu a ɔnye hɔn dzii wɔ Horeb no ho no, no mu nsɛm.
Na Moses frɛɛ Israel nyinara, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ehu adze nyinara a EWURADZE dze yɛɛ Farao, nye no nkowaa nyinara, nye n’asaase nyinara, wɔ hom enyiwa mu, wɔ Egypt asaase do;
nsɔhwɛ akɛse a w’enyiwa hunii, nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye anwanwadze akɛse no:
naaso obodu ndɛ da yi, EWURADZE mmaa wo dɛm akoma a onyim dze, enyiwa a wɔdze hwɛ, nye asowa a wɔdze tsie.
Na medzi hom enyim ma hom anantsew mfe eduanan wɔ sar no do; hom ntar nnsuwii wɔ hom ho, na wo mpaboa nntsetsewee wɔ w’ananadze.
Hom nndzii paanoo, nkyii so hom nnoom wenyin anaa nsa dzendzen: ama hom eehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
Na aber a hom dur bea yi do no, Hesbonhen Sihon, nye Basenhen Ɔge, fiir edzi baa hɛn do nye hɛn bɔkoe, na yekum hɔn;
na yɛfaa hɔn asaase, na yɛdze maa Reubenfo, nye Gadfo, nye Manaasɛfo ebusuakuw ɔfa no, dɛ egyapadze.
Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi ahyɛmu yi mu nsɛm do, na hom nyɛ, na hom aayɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ dza hom yɛ nyinara mu.
Ndɛ da yi hom nyinara hom ngyina EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn enyim; hom etsitsir, hom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw, hom mpanyimfo, nye hom ahwɛdofo, mekyerɛ Israel mbanyin nyinara,
hom mbofraba, hom yernom, nye wo hɔhoe a ɔwɔ wo nseraban mu, ofi wo duatwafo do dze kodu wo nsusawfo do:
ama aahɛn EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛmu, nye ne nsew a Ɔnye wo ridzi ndɛ da yi mu:
ama ɔdze wo eesi hɔ ndɛ da yi dɛ ɔman ama noho, na ɔno so aayɛ Nyankopɔn ama wo, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ wo, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ w’egyanom, Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob no.
Nkyii so nnyɛ hom nko na menye hom ridzi ahyɛmu yi nye nsew yi:
mbom menye nyia ɔnye hɛn gyina EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim ha ndɛ da yi, na eso menye nyia ɔnnye hɛn nnyi ha ndɛ da yi:
(na hom nyim mbrɛ yesii tsenaa Egypt asaase do; na mbrɛ yesii twaa mu wɔ amanaman a hom faa hɔn mu baa no mu;
na hom ehu hɔn ekyiwadze, na hɔn abosom, ndua nye abo, dwetɛ nye sika a ɔwɔ hɔn mu no:)

Na hom nhwɛ yie amma hom mu ɔbanyin bi, anaa ɔbaa bi, anaa ebusua bi, anaa ebusuakuw bi n’akoma anndan ndɛ da yi emmfi EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ ɔrokɔ akɔsom amanaman no hɔn enyame no: na ndwow bi aammba hom mu a ɔsow bɔr nye ɔbɔwen;
na aammba dɛ, sɛ ɔtse mpaa yi mu nsɛm a, oeennhyira noho wɔ n’akoma mu, dɛ, mibenya asomdwee, kaansa menam m’akoma no sorow mu mpo a, amma wɔaannsɛɛ dza afɔw annka dza awow ho.
EWURADZE remmfa nnkyɛ no, na mbom EWURADZE n’ebufuw nye ne nyinkuntwe bopun nyimpa no, na mpaa a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu no nyinara bodwir no do, na EWURADZE bɛpepa ne dzin efi asaase do.
Na EWURADZE beyi no efi Israel ebusuakuw nyinara mu esi hɔ ama mbusu, dɛ mbrɛ ahyɛmu a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra nwoma yi mu mpaa no tse nyinara.

Na ebusuasantsen a wɔbɛba no, hom mba a wɔbɔsoɛr edzi hom ekyir no, nye ɔnanaben a ofi ekyirekyir asaase do bɛba no, sɛ wohu asaase no do yardɔm, nye nyarbanyarba a EWURADZE dze ama wɔayar no a, wɔbɛse dɛ;

n’asaase nyinara ayɛ sɔɔfee nye nkyen, nye nkyewee, wonndua do adze, ɔnnsow, nkyɛkyɛr mpo mmfir do, ɔtse dɛ Sodom nye Gomora, Adma nye Zeboim mbutuwii a EWURADZE nam n’ebufuw nye n’ebufuhyew mu butuwii no:
mekyerɛ amanaman nyinara bɛse dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na EWURADZE ayɛ asaase yi dɛm yi? Ebufuw kɛse hyeehyew yi ase nye dɛn?
Nna nkorɔfo bɛse dɛ, Osiandɛ wɔpoow EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn ahyɛmu a oyii hɔn wɔ Egypt asaase do no ɔnye hɔn dzii no;
na wɔkɔree kɔsoom enyame fofor, na wɔsɔɔr hɔn, enyame a wonnyim hɔn, na ɔammfa hɔn amma hɔn:
dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ asaase yi do, ma ɔdze mpaa a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu nyinara aba do;
na EWURADZE tutuu hɔn ase fii hɔn asaase do wɔ ebufuw, nye ebufuhyew, nye ahohyehye kɛse mu, na wɔatow hɔn egu asaase bi so do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Ndzɛmba a osuma yɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn dze: na ndzɛmba a wɔada no edzi no dze ɔyɛ hɛn nye hɛn mba dze daa, ama yeedzi mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara do.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ ndzɛmba iyinom nyinara ba wo do, nhyira nye mpaa a, medze esi w’enyim yi, na ekaakaa no wɔ amanaman nyinara mu mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn apam wo akɔ no,
na sɛ ɔwo, nye wo mba san ba EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na edze w’akoma nyinara, na ɔnye wo kra nyinara tsie ne ndze na eyɛ dza merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara a;
ɔno na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛdan wo ndɔmmumkɔ no, na oenya ayamuhyehye ama wo, na ɔasan aboa w’ano efi aman a ɔnoara EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn abɔ wo apetse mu no nyinara mu.
Sɛ wo nyimpa a wɔapam hɔn no bi wɔ ɔsor ano no ho mpo a, ofitsi hɔ na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɔboa w’ano, na hɔ na ɔbɛfa wo efi:
na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze wo bɛba asaase a w’egyanom nyaa no do, na aafa; na ɔbɛyɛ wo yie, na ɔama adɔr akyɛn w’egyanom.
Na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma ɔwo nye w’asefo akoma, a ɔdwe, na edze w’akoma nye wo kra nyinara, aadɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, na eenya nkwa.
Na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze mpaa yi nyinara bogu w’atamfo, nye hɔn a wokyir wo a wohiahia wo ho no do.
Na ɔwo dze, ebɛsan ebetsie EWURADZE ndze, na edzi ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara do.

Na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma yie ebu wo do wɔ wo nsaano edwuma nyinara mu, wɔ wo honam mu aba mu, nye wo fiembowa aba mu, nye w’asaase do aba mu, wɔ wo yieyɛ ntsi: na EWURADZE n’enyi bɛsan agye wo ho wɔ wo yieyɛ ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ n’enyi gyee w’egyanom ho no:

sɛ ibetsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ndze, dɛ ibedzi ne mbransɛm nye n’ahyɛdze a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra nwoma yi mu no do, dɛ edze w’akoma nyinara, na ɔnye wo kra nyinara bɛsan aba EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn a.
Na mbrasɛm yi a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi, ɔnnyɛ dzendzen dodow mma wo, nkyii so onnyi ekyirekyir.
Onnyi sor, na aase dɛ, Woana na ɔbɔfow akɔ sor ama hɛn, na ɔakɛfa abrɛ hɛn, na ɔama yɛatse, na yɛayɛ.
Nkyii so onnyi po n’egya, na aase dɛ, Woana na obotwa po ama hɛn, na ɔakɛfa abrɛ hɛn, na ɔama yɛatse, ma yaayɛ.
Na asɛm no bɛn wo dodoodow, ɔwɔ w’anomu, na ɔwɔ w’akoma mu, ama aayɛ.
Hwɛ, ndɛ da yi medze nkwa nye papa, nye owu nye bɔn, esi w’enyim;

wɔ dɛ merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi dɛ dɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, nantsew n’akwan do, na dzi ne mbransɛm nye n’ahyɛdze nye ne ntsɛmbu do, na aatsena ase na aadɔr, na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo wɔ asaase a erokɔ do akɛfa no do.
Mbom sɛ w’akoma dan, na enntsie, na ema wɔtwe wo kɔ, na ekɔsɔr enyame fofor, na esom hɔn a;
mepaa mu meka kyerɛ hom ndɛ da yi, dɛ ɔsɛɛ na hom bɛsɛɛ; na hom remma hom nda nnwar wɔ asaase mbrɛ irutwa Jordan akɔ do akɛfa no do.
Mefrɛ ɔsor nye asaase dɛ wondzi hom dase ndɛ da yi, dɛ medze nkwa nye owu, nhyira nye mpaa esi w’enyim: dɛm ntsi fa nkwa, ma ɔwo, nye w’asefo nnya nkwa:

na dɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, tsie ne ndze, na takyer no ho: na ɔno nye wo nkwa, nye wo nda ne tsentsen: ama aatsena asaase a EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’egyanom, Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɔn no do.
Na Moses kɔree kɛkaa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ndɛ yi, medzi mfe ɔha eduonu; emi a munntum nnkɔ, emi so a munntum mmba: na eso EWURADZE ase me dɛ, Irunntwa Jordan yi.
EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, ɔno na odzi w’enyim rukotwa; ɔno na ɔbɛsɛɛ amanaman yi efi w’enyim, na afa hɔn: na Josua na oridzi w’enyim ekotwa, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka no.
Na EWURADZE bɛyɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Amorifo ahemfo, Sihon nye Ɔge a ɔsɛɛ hɔn, nye hɔn asaase no.
EWURADZE beyi hɔn ama wɔ hom enyim, na hom ayɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ mbransɛm a mahyɛ hom nyinara tse.
Hom nhyɛ dzen na hom nnya akokodur, mma hom nnsuro, mma hɔn ho nnyɛ hom hu so; na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno na ɔnye wo rokɔ, ɔremmpa wo, na ɔrommpow wo so.

Na Moses frɛɛ Josua, na ɔsee no wɔ Israel nyinara enyim dɛ, Hyɛ dzen na nya akokodur; na ɔwo na edze ɔman yi bɔkɔ asaase a EWURADZE aka ho ntam akyerɛ hɔn egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɔn no do; na ɔwo na ebɛma woenya edzi.
Na EWURADZE, ɔno nye nyia oridzi w’enyim akɔ; obedzi w’ekyir, ɔremmpa wo, nkyii so ɔrommpow wo; mma nnsuro, nkyii so mma w’akoma nntu.
Na Moses kyerɛɛw mbra yi, na ɔdze maa asɔfo Levi mbabanyin no a wɔsoa EWURADZE ahyɛmudaka no, nye Israel mpanyimfo nyinara.
Na Moses hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Mfe esuon biara n’ewiei, akwangya afe n’aber a wɔahyɛ no mu, ntamadan afahyɛ no mu,
aber a Israel nyinara rubopue wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi no, kenkan mbra yi wɔ Israel nyinara enyim ma wɔntse.
Boaboa ɔman no ano, mbanyin nye mbaa nye mbofraba, nye wo hɔhoe a ɔwɔ wo nkuropon mu, ma wontsie, na wonsua, na wonsuro EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, na wɔndwen do ndzi mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara do;
na hɔn mba a wonnyim no ntsie, na wonsua dɛ wonsuro EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, aber tsentsen nyina a hom tse asaase no do mbrɛ hom rukotwa Jordan akɛfa no.
Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Hwɛ, wo nda a ibowu abɛn: frɛ Josua, na wonkeyi homho nkyerɛ wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, ma menhyɛ no mbra. Na Moses nye Josua kɔree, na wokeyii hɔnho kyerɛe wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu.
Na EWURADZE nam mununkum dum mu yii noho edzi wɔ Buw no mu: na mununkum dum no begyinaa Buw no n’abowano.

Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔwo, iribetsiw wo nananom wɔ samanadze na ɔman yi bɔsoɛr, na woekedzi asaase no do enyame ekyir wɔ ndwamangor mu, wɔ mbrɛ wɔrokɔ akɔforafora hɔn mu no, na wɔbɔpow me na wɔato m’ahyɛmu a menye hɔn edzi no.

Ɔno na m’ebufuw bɛdzɛw wɔ hɔn do wɔ da no mu, na mapow hɔn, na medze m’enyim esuma hɔn, na wɔamen hɔn, na mbusu nye ɔfona pii bɛba hɔn do; ama wɔaaka wɔ da no mu dɛ, Ana nnyɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn a onnyi hɛn mu ntsi na mbusu yi aba hɛn do bi a?
Na suma ara na medze m’enyim mubosuma wɔ da no mu wɔ mbusu a wɔabɔ no nyinara ntsi, wɔ dɛ wɔadan akɔ enyame fofor nkyɛn ntsi.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nkyerɛw ndwom yi mma hom ho, na fa kyerɛkyerɛ Israelmba: fa hyɛ hɔn anomu, ma ndwom yi ndzi me dase ntsia Israelmba.

Na sɛ minya dze hɔn du asaase a mekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom no a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no do a wobedzidzi amee, na wɔayɛ abran. Ɔno nna afei wɔbɛdan akɔ enyame fofor nkyɛn, na wɔakɔsom hɔn, na woebu me enyimtsia, na wɔato m’ahyɛmu.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, aber a mbusu nye ɔfona pii aba hɔn do no, ndwom yi bɛyɛ dɛ ɔdasefo edzi dase wɔ hɔn enyim; osiandɛ ɔnnkɛpa hɔn asefo anomu: na minyim hɔn adwendwen a wɔrodwendwen no seseiara mpo, ansaana medze hɔn bodu asaase a mekaa ho ntam no do.
Nna Moses kyerɛɛw ndwom yi da no ara, na ɔdze kyerɛkyerɛɛ Israelmba.
Na ɔhyɛɛ Nun ne babanyin Josua mbra, na ɔsee dɛ, Hyɛ dzen na nya akokodur: na ɔwo na edze Israelmba bɔkɔ asaase a mekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn no do; na mibedzi w’ekyir.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Moses wiee mbra yi mu nsɛm kyerɛw wɔ nwoma mu no,
Moses hyɛɛ Levifo a wɔsoa EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no, dɛ,
Hom mfa mbra nwoma yi, na hom mfa nto EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛmudaka no ho, ma ɔnko hɔ nyɛ dase ntsia hom.
Na minyim hom etuatsew, nye hom asoɔdzen: hwɛ, meda ho ara menye hom tse ase ndɛ da yi mpo, na hom ayɛ etuatsewfo wɔ EWURADZE do yi; na afei mo wu ekyir ɛ?
Hom mboaboa hom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu mpanyimfo nyinara, nye hom ahwɛdofo ano mbra me nkyɛn, ma menka nsɛm yi wɔ hɔn aso mu, na memfrɛ ɔsor nye asaase ma wondzi hɔn dase.

Na minyim dɛ mo wu ekyir no ɔsɛɛ na hom bɛsɛɛ homho, na hom adan efi ɔkwan a mahyɛ hom no do; na mbusu bɛba hom do nda a odzi ekyir no mu; osiandɛ hom bɛyɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dze nam hom nsaano edwuma do eyi no ebufuw.
Na Moses kaa ndwom yi mu nsɛm wɔ Israel bagua no nyinara asomu dze kodur dɛ owiei.
Ɔsor, hom nyɛ aso, na merebɛkasa; Na wɔmma asaase ntsie m’anomu nsɛm:
Me nkyerɛkyerɛ bɔsosɔ dɛ nyankom, Me kasaa bogugu dɛ ɔbɔsu; Dɛ nkyɛkyɛr do nsumpetsema, Nye haban do nsutɔree:
Na mobɔbɔ EWURADZE dzin akyerɛ: Hom mfa kɛseyɛ mma hɛn Nyankopɔn,
Ɔbotan no, n’edwuma dzi mu; Na n’akwan nyinara yɛ atsɛmbu: Nyankopɔn nokwardzifo a, na onnyi emumuyɛ, Ɔyɛ pɛrpɛr na ɔtsen.
Woedzi no asɛmbɔn, wɔnnyɛ ne mba, hɔn dzɛmdzi a; Ebusuasantsen kɔntɔnkye a wɔakyea a.
Ana EWURADZE na hom nye no dzi no dɛm yi, Ɔman nkwasea a wɔnnyɛ enyansafo? Ana nnyɛ ɔno nye w’egya a ɔawo wo bi a? Ɔno na ɔayɛ wo na oetsintsim wo.
Kaa tsetsentserdee nda no, Dwen ebusuasantsen pii no hɔn mfe ho: Bisa w’egya, na ɔnkyerɛ wo; Wo mpanyimfo, na wɔnka nkyerɛ wo.
Aber a Ɔsorsornyi no memaa amanaman hɔn egyapadze no, Aber a ɔpaapaa nyimpa mba mu no, Osisii aman hɔn ahe Dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba hɔn dodow tse.
Na EWURADZE ne kyɛfa nye ne man; Jakob nye n’egyapadze kyɛfa.
Ohun no wɔ sar asaase do, Na kwaa tuntum sar predede do nkekabowa mu; Otwaa no ho hyiae, ɔhwɛɛ no do yie, Ɔkoraa no do dɛ n’enyiwa kyesua:
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔkɔr huenyan ne birebuw, Na otu bɔ ne ba do faafaa no, Ɔtserɛɛw ne ntsaban mu faa hɔn no, Ɔsoaa hɔn wɔ ne ntɛkyerɛ do:
EWURADZE nkotoo na ogyaa no Na onyame fofor bi annka no ho,
Ɔmaa ɔfaa asaase mbea sorɔnsorɔm do tutui kɔree, Na odzii haban mu ndɔbaa; Na ɔmaa ohwieew ewo fii ɔbotan mu, Nye ngo fii ɔtwerɛbo botan mu;
Anantwi numfonsungo, nye nguan numfonsu, Nye nguambaa seradze, Nye Basan nnyɛmbowa mu nguannyin, nye mpɔnkye, Nye ewifua ntan mu seradze; Na enoom esikyireamba mu bɔgya wenyin.
Na Jesurun yɛɛ ɔbran, na ɔtoow ntsia: Ayɛ bran, ayɛ kɛse, wo mu ayɛ dur: Nna ɔpoow Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ no no, Na obuu no nkwagye botan no tootooba.
Wɔdze enyame nanaben yii no nyinkun, Wɔdze ekyiwadze yii no ebufuw.
Wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa abosom a wɔnnyɛ Nyame, Dze maa enyame a wonnyim hɔn, Dze maa enyame fofor a wɔbaa nkyinkyirii, Dza hom egyanom ennsuro hɔn no.
Ɔbotan a ɔwoo wo no anndwen no ho, Na wo werɛ efir Nyame a ɔkyeem wo no.
Na EWURADZE hunii, na okyiir hɔn, Wɔ ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa ho ehi ntsi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Mibeyi m’enyim esuma hɔn, Mobɔhwɛ mbrɛ hɔn ewiei bɛyɛ: Na wɔyɛ ebusuasantsen kɔntɔnkye, Mba a hɔn mu nnyi gyedzi.
Wɔdze dza ɔnnyɛ Onyame eyi me nyinkun: Wɔdze hɔn egyangyandze eyi me ebufuw: Na medze hɔn a wɔnnyɛ ɔman biara no mibeyi hɔn nyinkun; Medze ɔman nkwasea bi mibeyi hɔn ebufuw.
Na ogya adzɛw wɔ m’ebufuw mu, Na ɔrehyew ekodu samanadze ase, Na ɔremen asaase nye no ndɔbaa, Na ɔato mbepɔw mfapem mu ogya.
Mobɔboa mbusu ano megu hɔn do; Mobɔhwer m’egyen menaba wɔ hɔn do:
Ɔkɔm bɔfɔn hɔn, na ahohyehye yaayaw Nye ɔsɛɛ wenwen bɛmen hɔn; Na mobɔsoma mbowa se ma wɔaaba hɔn do, Nye huntuma mu nweaweambowa bɔr.
Abɔntsen do na nkrantsee bohwim, Adankyir so nketsenketse a; Ɔbɛsɛɛ aberantsɛ nye ɔbaabun nyina, Enumfoanoba nye nyimpa a oefuw gon nyina.
Mesee dɛ nkyɛ mobɔbɔ hɔn apetse ekyirekyir, Nkyɛ mebɛma hɔn nkaa tun do etwa efi nyimpa mu:
Sɛ nnyɛ ɔtamfo ehiyi na musuroi a, Bɛyɛ na hɔn ayɛfo anntse m’akwan ase, Bɛyɛ na wɔase dɛ, Hɛn nsa na akrɔn, Na nnyɛ EWURADZE na ɔayɛ iyi nyinara.
Na wɔyɛ aman a egyinatu abɔ hɔn, Na ntseasee bi nnyi hɔn mu.
Ao kɛtseankyɛ woeehu nyansa, na wɔaatse iyi ase, Na nkyɛ wɔaadwen hɔn ewiei ekyir no ho!
Ɔbaako bɛyɛ dɛn etsiw apem, Na beenu aka mpemdu egu, Gyedɛ hɔn Ɔbotan atɔn hɔn ana, Na EWURADZE eyi hɔn ama ana?
Na hɔn ɔbotan nntse dɛ hɛn Ɔbotan, Na hɛn atamfo ankasa mpo nye atsɛmbuafo.
Na hɔn wenyindua fi Sodom wenyindua mu, Na ofi Gomora haban mu: Hɔn esikyireamba yɛ bɔr esikyireamba, Hɔn esiaw yɛ wenwen:
Hɔn nsa yɛ sasabɔnsam bɔr, Nye nhurutsia owubɔr dzendzen.
Ana wɔnnkora iyi do wɔ me nkyɛn, Wɔnnsɔw ano wɔ m’akoradze mu bi a?
Awerdzi yɛ medze, akatua so, Aber a hɔn anan bɛpatser: Na hɔn mbusu da abɛn, Na ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ dɛ ɔba hɔn do no bɛba ntsɛntsɛm.
Na EWURADZE bobu ne man atsɛn, Na oenu noho wɔ no nkowaa ntsi; Aber a obohu dɛ hɔn ahoɔdzen asa, Na ɔdehye anaa akowaa biara nnyi hɔ bio,
Na ɔbɛse dɛ, Henfa na hɔn enyame no wɔ, Ɔbotan a wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛɛ mu no;
Hɔn a wodzi hɔn okum afɔr seradze, Na wɔnom hɔn ɔnom afɔr nsa no a? Ma wɔnsoɛr mbɔboa hom, Ma wɔnyɛ hom ntwitwagye.
Afei hom nhu dɛ emi, mara nye no, Na onyame bi nnka mo ho: Emi na muku, na mema nkwa; Mipira, na mesa yarba: Na obi nnyi hɔ a obotum agye efi me nsamu.
Na mema me nsa do wɔ ɔsor, Na mese dɛ, Dɛ metse ase daa yi,
Sɛ mesew me nkrantsee nyinamnyinam no, Na me nsa suo atsɛmbu mu a; Mibedzi hɔn a wɔnye me dzi esi do wer, Na metua hɔn a wɔtan me kaw.
Mebɛma bɔgya abow m’egyen menaba, Na me nkrantsee edzi nam; Atɔfo nye ndɔmmumfo bɔgyaa, Ofi ɔtamfo Edzikamfo tsir do.
Amanaman, hom nye ne man ndzi dɛw: Na obedzi no nkowaa bɔgyaa ho wer, Na ɔdze awerdzi etua n’ayɛfo kaw, Na ɔapata ama n’asaase ama ne man.
Na Moses baa bɛkaa ndwom yi mu nsɛm nyinara wɔ ɔman no asomu, ɔno, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua.
Na Moses wiee nsɛm yi nyinara ka kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara:
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa hom akoma nsi nsɛm a miridzi hom ho dase ndɛ da yi nyinara do; ɔno na hom mfa nhyɛ hom mba, dɛ wɔndwen do ndzi mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara do.
Na mma ɔnnyɛ asɛnhun mma hom; osiandɛ ɔyɛ hom nkwa, na asɛm yi do na hom nam bɛma hom nda awar wɔ asaase a hom rukotwa Jordan akɛfa no do.
Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses da no ara dɛ,
Kɔfow bepɔw Abarim yi, kɔ bepɔw Nebo a ɔwɔ Moab asaase do, wɔ Jeriko tsentsendo no; na hwɛ Keenan asaase a medze merema Israelmba dɛ enyadze no:
na wu wɔ bepɔw no a erofow akɔ do no do, na kɛka wo nananom ho wɔ samanadze; dɛ mbrɛ wo nua Aaron wui wɔ bepɔw Horeb do, na ɔkɛkaa ne nananom ho no;
osiandɛ hom foom me wɔ Israelmba mu wɔ Meriba nsu a ɔwɔ Kades, wɔ Zin sar do no ho; osiandɛ hom annyɛ me krɔnkrɔn wɔ Israelmba mu.
Na ibohu asaase no wɔ w’enyim; na mbom eronnkɔ asaase a medze rema Israelmba no do hɔ.
Na iyi nye nhyira a Onyame nyimpa Moses dze hyiraa Israelmba ansaana oruwu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE fi Sinai bae, Na ɔsoɛree fi Seir maa hɔn; Ɔhyerɛɛn fi bepɔw Paran do, Na ofi akrɔnkrɔmfo mpedu mpedu mu bae: Na n’enyimfa wɔ mbra a ɔyɛ ogya ma hɔn.
Nyew, ɔdɔ aman; N’ahotseweefo nyinara wɔ wo nsamu: Na wɔtsenatsenaa famu wɔ w’anan ho; Obiara bɛgye wo nsɛm ato mu.
Moses hyɛɛ hɛn mbra, Jakob bagua egyapadze.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen wɔ Jesurun, Aber a ɔman no mu etsitsir hyiae, Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara bɔ mu no.
Ma Reuben nnya nkwa, na mma onnwu; Na eso mma n’ase nnhyew.
Na iyi nye Juda nhyira: na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, tsie Juda ne ndze, Na fa no kɔ fie no nkorɔfo nkyɛn: Ma ne nsa nso no so, Na yɛ ɔboafo fa tsia n’ayɛfo.
Na Levi ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Wo Tummim nye wo Urim wɔ wo nyamesuronyi no hɔ, Nyia esɔɔ no hwɛe wɔ Massa no, Nye no hamee wɔ Meriba nsu ho no;
Nyia ɔsee wɔ n’egya, nye ne na ho dɛ, Munnhun hɔn; Nkyii so ɔammpen no nuanom do no, Na woennhu nankasa ne mba so no: Na wɔadwen w’asɛm do: Na woedzi w’ahyɛmu do.
Wɔdze w’atsɛmbu bɛkyerɛ Jakob, Na wo mbra akyerɛ Israel: Wɔdze eduhuam bɔto w’enyim, Na ɔhyew afɔr mu ato w’afɔrmbukyia do.
EWURADZE, hyira n’ahoɔdzen, Na ma ne nsaano edwuma nsɔ w’enyi: Bobɔ hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia no no hɔn ndwonku, Na hɔn a wɔtan no, amma wɔaannsoɛr bio.
Benjamin ho dze ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE no dɔfo bɛtsena ne nkyɛn dwudwoodwo; Ɔkata no do adzekyee tsentsen nyinara, Na ɔtse n’abatsir ntamu.
Na Josef ho dze, ɔsee dɛ EWURADZE nhyira n’asaase; Ɔmma ɔsor ndzepa, ɔbɔsu, Nye bun a ɔda daadzetsirmu ne dze,
Nye ewia no nduadzewa mu ndzepa, Nye dza abosoom ma ofifir mu ndzepa, Nye tsetse mbepɔw do adze tsitsir,
Nye daa daa nkoko do ndzepa,
Nye asaase nye ne mayɛ mu ndzepa, Nye nyia ɔtsenaa kwaa mu n’enyisɔ: Ma nhyira no ɔmbra Josef n’etsifi, Nye no nuanom mu nyia woeyi no esi nkyɛn no n’etsifi pampamu.
Ne nantwisaa abakan, tumdzi dzi wɔ no; Na n’ambɛn yɛ eko ambɛn: Ɔno na ɔdze bosunsun aman nyinara, mekyerɛ asaase n’ano n’ano: Na hɔn nye Efraim mpedu mpedu no, Na hɔn nye Manaasɛ mpempem no,
Na Zebulun, ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Zebulun, ma w’enyi ngye wɔ w’edzifir mu; Na, Isakar, wɔ w’asesee mu.
Wɔbɛfrɛ aman akɔ bepɔw do; Hɔ na wɔbɔbɔ tsenenee okum afɔr: Na woehwiew epo no mbordo no, Nye anhwea mu akoradze a ohuntsa no.
Na Gad ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Nhyira aka nyia ɔtserɛw Gad mu: Ɔtsena hɔ dɛ ogyataber, Ɔtsetsew abasa, nyew, etsifi pampamu.
Na osiesiee dza odzi kan no maa noho, Na hɔ na wɔakora mbrahyɛfo ne kyɛfa; Na ɔnye ɔman no mu etsitsir bae, Na ɔyɛɛ EWURADZE ne tseneneedze, Nye ne ntsɛmbu wɔ Israel nkyɛn.
Na Dan ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Dan yɛ ogyata ne ba a Ohuruw fi Basan.
Na Naftali ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Naftali a enyisɔ amee no, EWURADZE ne nhyira ahyɛ no ma: Fa anee nye pomu afamu asaase no fa,
Na Aser ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Wɔmfa mba nhyira Aser; Wɔmma ɔnyɛ nyia ɔsɔ enyi mma no nuanom, Na wɔmma ɔmfa n’anan mbɔ ngo mu.
W’adaban nyɛ dadze nye boran; Na dɛ mbrɛ wo nda tse no, dɛmara so na w’ahoɔdzen nyɛ.
Jesurun, obi nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ Onyame a Otutu nam sor dzi boa wo, Na n’akɛseyɛ wɔ wimu.
Ɔdomankoma Nyankopɔn nye wo tsenabew: Na n’ase na daa daa abasa wɔ: Na ɔpaam ɔtamfo no wɔ w’enyim, Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛɛ hɔn.
Na Israel retsena dwudwoodwo, Jakob nsubura no nkotoo, Wɔ eburow nye nsa asaase do; Nyew, no sor so sosɔw ɔbɔsu.

Osiarfo nye wo, Israel: Woana na ɔnye wo sɛ, ɔman a EWURADZE agye no nkwa, Wo mboa akokyɛm, Na ɔno nye wo kɛseyɛ nkrantsee! Na w’atamfo bɛbrɛ hɔnho adze ama wo; Na ibetsiatsia hɔn mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do.
Na Moses fii Moab tɛtɛr mu fowee kɔr bepɔw Nebo do, wɔ Pisga etsifi a ɔwɔ Jeriko tsentsendo. Na EWURADZE kyerɛɛ no Gilead asaase nyinara, ɔdze kodu Dan:
nye Naftali nyinara, nye Efraim nye Manaasɛ asaase, nye Juda asaase nyinara, ɔdze kodu ekyirekyir epo no ho;
nye Epomu, nye Tɛtɛrmu, nkyiresua kurow Jeriko ɔbɔn no, ɔdze kodu Zoar.
Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Iyi nye asaase a mekaa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob dɛ, W’asefo na medze mebɛma hɔn no: mama wo kwan dɛ fa w’enyiwa hwɛ, na hɔ dze eronnkɔ.
Nna EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses wuu hɔ wɔ Moab asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm tse.
Na osiee no wɔ ɔbɔn no mu wɔ Moab asaase do wɔ Bɛt-peor tsentsendo na n’adakamona dze nyimpa biara nnyim dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na aber a Moses wui no na oedzi mfe ɔha eduonu: n’enyiwa annyɛ kusukusu, na n’ahoɔdzen so do ennhuan.
Na Israelmba sui maa Moses wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu adaduasa: nna Moab n’eyiyɛ mu osu nda no bɔɔ adze.
Na nyansa sunsum hyɛɛ Nun ne babanyin Josua ma: na Israelmba tsiee no, na wɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na ofitsi aber no nkɔnhyɛnyi biara nnsoɛree wɔ Israel mu bio a ɔtse dɛ Moses a EWURADZE nye no nyaa nkitahodzi a no mu dɔ yie
Dɛm Moses yi ara so na EWURADZE somaa no wɔ nsa a ɔyɛ dzen do kɔr Egypt ma ɔkɛyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze pii wɔ Farao nye no nkowaa nye n’asaase nyinara do no.
Afei so, ɔnam Moses do na ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔyɛ hu na tum wɔ mu daa edzi wɔ Israel nyinara enyim.
EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses wui n’ekyir no, EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Nun ne babanyin Josua a nna ɔyɛ Moses no somfo no dɛ,
M’akowaa Moses ewu; dɛm ntsi afei soɛr, twa Jordan yi, ɔwo, nye ɔman yi nyinara, kɔ asaase a medze rema hom, mekyerɛ Israelmba no do.
Beebiara a hom anamɔn betsia no, medze ama hom, dɛ mbrɛ mekaa kyerɛɛ Moses no.
Ofi sar no do, nye Lebanon yi ho araa dze kodu esutsen kɛse Eufrates no ho, Hitifo asaase nyinara, na ɔdze kodu po kɛse no ho wɔ witɔree afamu no, na ɔnyɛ hom he.
Nyimpa biara runntum nngyina w’enyim wɔ wo nkwa nda nyinara mu: na dɛ mbrɛ midzii Moses n’ekyir no, dɛmara so na mibedzi w’ekyir: meremmpa wo, na morommpow wo so.
Hyɛ dzen na nya akokodur: na ɔwo na ebɛma ɔman yi ekenya asaase a mekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom dɛ medze mebɛma hɔn no edzi.
Dzen ara na hyɛ na nya akokodur papaapa, na dwen do dzi mbra a m’akowaa Moses hyɛɛ wo no nyinara do: mma mmfi ho mmfa enyimfa anaa abankum, ama eesi wo yie wɔ beebiara a ebɔkɔ.
Mma mbra nwoma yi mmpa w’anomu, na mbom dwen ho adzekyee nye adzesaa, ama aadwen do ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ mu no nyinara tse no: na ɔno na ebɛma wo kwan ayɛ dwudwoodwo, na ɔno na ibenya no yie.
Ana mennhyɛɛ wo bi a? Hyɛ dzen na nya akokodur; mma mmbɔ hu, nkyii so mma w’abaw mu nntu: na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dzi w’ekyir wɔ beebiara a ebɔkɔ.
Nna Josua hyɛɛ ɔman no hɔn ahwɛdofo no, dɛ,
Hom ndɔ nseraban no mu na hom nhyɛ ɔman no dɛ, Hom nsiesie edzidzidze mma homho, na aka ndaansa hom botwa Jordan yi akɔ akɛfa asaase a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom dɛ wɔnkɛfa no.
Na Josua kasaa kyerɛɛ Reubenfo, nye Gadfo, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw ɔfa no dɛ,
Hom nkaa asɛm a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses hyɛɛ hom no, dɛ, EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn rema hom ahomgye, na ɔdze asaase yi ama hom no.

Hom yernom, hom mbofraba, nye hom fiembowa, ntsena asaase a Moses dze maa hom wɔ Jordan egya yi do; na homara dze, hom mmia ndzi hom nuanom enyim ntwa, hom mu mbarimba akatakyi nyinara, na hom nkɔboa hɔn;

ma onkodu dɛ EWURADZE bɛma hom nuanom ahomgye, dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze ama hom yi, na hɔn so woeenya asaase a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom no afa: na n’ekyir no hom asan abɛfa hom enyadze asaase a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze maa hom wɔ Jordan egya ɔdze kɔ wipuei afamu no.
Na wobuaa Josua, dɛ, Dza edze ahyɛ hɛn nyinara yɛbɛyɛ, na beebiara a ebɔsoma hɛn no, yɛbɔkɔ.
Dɛ mbrɛ yetsiee Moses wɔ adze nyinara mu no, dɛmara so na yebetsie wo: w’ekyir ara na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ndzi, dɛ mbrɛ odzii Moses ekyir no.
Nyimpa biara a ɔbɛtsew etua wɔ wo mbrasɛm do, na onnketsie wo nsɛm wɔ dza edze hyɛ no nyinara mu no, ɔtse dɛ woana ara a wonku no: dzen ara na hyɛ na nya akokodur.
Nna Nun ne babanyin Josua somaa mbanyin beenu nsumaa mu fi Sittim dɛ aserafo dɛ wɔnkɔ nkɔhwɛ asaase no, nye Jeriko. Na wɔkɔree, na wɔkɔr ɔbaa huhunyi bi a ne dzin dze Rahab ne fie, na wɔkɔsoɛɛ hɔ.
Na binom kaa kyerɛɛ Jerikohen no, dɛ, Hwɛ, mbanyin bi fi Israelmba mu baa ha anadwe yi dɛ wɔrebɛsera asaase yi.
Na Jerikohen no somae ma wɔkɔr Rahab hɔ, dɛ, Fa mbanyin no a wɔaba abɛhɛn wo fie no pue: na wɔaba rebɛsera asaase no nyinara.
Na ɔbaa no faa mbanyin beenu no, na ɔdze hɔn sumae; na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔyɛ nokwar, mbanyin no baa me nkyɛn, na mbom, minnyim mbrɛ wofi:
na ɔbaa dɛ aber a wɔdze tow kuropon no mu no durii no, nna mbanyin no fii me nkyɛn: na mbrɛ wɔkɔree no dze, minnyim: hom ntsiw hɔn ntsɛm; na hom bɔto hɔn.
Nna ɔnoara dze hɔn akɔ ɔdan etsifi na ɔdze hɔn ekosuma asaaba a wɔmmpaae bi a ɔaboaboa no yie wɔ ɔdan etsifi no mu.
Na ɔhen no n’asomafo no faa Jordan kwan do tsiiw hɔn araa dze kodur esutwaree: na hɔn a wotsiiw hɔn no kɔree no ara, na wɔtoow kuropon no mu.
Na wonnyae nnkɛdae no, Rahab fowee kɔr hɔn nkyɛn wɔ dan no etsifi hɔ:
na ɔsee mbanyin no dɛ, Minyim dɛ EWURADZE dze asaase yi ama hom, na hom ho hu atɔ hɛn do, na asaase yi do atsefo nyinara hɔn ho mbowa eguan wɔ hom ntsi.

Na yɛatse mbrɛ EWURADZE sii maa Mbɛw Po (Mbɛw Po) no no nsu wewee wɔ hom enyim, aber a hom fi Egypt firii no; na dza hom dze yɛɛ Amorifo ahemfo beenu, Sihon nye Ɔge a wɔwɔ Jordan egya no, na mbrɛ hom sii sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa no nyinara.
Na yɛtsee no ara na hɛn akoma tui, nkyii so ahom biara annka nyimpa biara mu bio, osian hom ntsi: na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn no, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn wɔ sor, nye asaase do.
Dɛm ntsi afei, mepa hom kyɛw, hom mfa EWURADZE ndzi nsew nkyerɛ me dɛ, ɔnam dɛ mayɛ hom yie ntsi, hom so bɛyɛ m’egya fie yie, hom mma me nokwar asɛnkyerɛdze:
dɛ hom bɛgye m’egya, nye me na, nye mo nuanom mbanyin nye mbaa, na adze a wɔwɔ nyinara nkwa, na woeyi hɛn efi owu mu.
Na mbanyin no see no dɛ, Hɛn nkwa nhyɛ homdze ananmu, sɛ hom annka hɛn nsɛm yi annkyerɛ a; ɔno ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ EWURADZE dze asaase yi ma hɛn a, yɛnye wo bedzi no yie nye nokwar mu.
Nna ɔdze ntampee duaa tokura mu gogoow hɔn sisii famu: osiandɛ ne dan no si kurow no ho fasu no do, na fasu no do na ɔtse.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ bepɔw no do, amma etsiwfo no aannto hom; na hom nsuma homho wɔ hɔ, ndaansa, nkodu dɛ etsiwfo no bɛsan: na n’ekyir no hom bɔkɔ hom kwan a, hom aakɔ.
Na mbanyin no see no dɛ, Yennkedzi so wɔ wo ntam a ama yɛaka yi ho.
Hwɛ, sɛ yɛreba asaase yi do a, fa serdaa ahoma yi kyekyer tokura a edze hɛn duaa mu sisii famu no mu: na boa w’egya, nye wo na, nye wo nuanom, nye w’egya ne fifo nyinara ano wɔ wo nkyɛn wɔ fie no mu.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, obiara a obefi wo fi mbobow ano akɔ abɔntsen do no, no bɔgyaa bogu ɔnoara n’etsifi, na yennkedzi so: na obiara a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn wɔ fie no, sɛ obi dze ne nsa ka no a, no bɔgyaa ngu hɛn etsifi.
Na sɛ eka hɛn asɛm yi kyerɛ a, ɔnodze, yennkedzi so wɔ wo ntam a ama yɛaka yi ho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ hom nsɛm yi tse no ara, wɔmma ɔnyɛ hɔ. Na ogyaa hɔn kwan, na wosii mu kɔree: na ɔdze serdaa ahoma no kyekyeer tokura no mu.
Na wɔkɔree kodur bepɔw no do, na wɔtsenaa hɔ ndaansa, kodur dɛ etsiwfo no sanee: na etsiwfo no hwehwɛɛ hɔn wɔ kwan no mu nyina, na woennhu hɔn.
Nna mbanyin beenu no sanee, na wofii bepɔw no do sianee, na wotwae baa Josua, Nun ne babanyin no, ne nkyɛn.
Na wɔsee Josua dɛ, Ampaara, EWURADZE dze asaase no nyinara ahyɛ hɛn nsa; na nkyii so asaase no do atsefo no nyinara hɔn akoma etu kɛsenara wɔ hɛn enyim.
Na Josua soɛɛr ahanamakye, na wotui fii Sittim, ɔno na Israelmba nyinara; na wɔbaa Jordan do, na wɔkyeer nseraban wɔ hɔ ansaana worutwa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ odzii ndaansa no, ahwɛdofo no tui dɔɔ nseraban no mu;
na wɔhyɛɛ ɔman no, dɛ, Sɛ hom hu EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛmudaka no, na Levifo asɔfo a wɔso no a, ɔno hom ntu mfi hom ananmu na hom ndzi ekyir nkɔ;
ama hom eehu kwan kor a ɔwɔ dɛ hom fa do; osiandɛ hom mmfaa kwan yi do da gyedɛ ndɛ. Mbom, hom mma ɔkwan a wosusu a ɔbɛyɛ basafa apem nda hom nye ahyɛmudaka no ntamu: na mma hom mmbɛn no.
Na Josua see ɔman no dɛ, Hom ntsew homho: na ɔkyena EWURADZE bɛyɛ hom mu anwanwadze.
Na Josua kaa kyerɛɛ asɔfo no, dɛ, Hom mma ahyɛmudaka no do, na hom ntwa mu nkedzi ɔman no enyim. Na wɔmaa ahyɛmudaka no do, na wokedzii ɔman no enyim.
Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Ndɛ da yi na mebɛhyɛ ase mama wo do wɔ Israel nyinara enyi do, na woeehu dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ midzii Moses ekyir no, dɛmara so na mibedzi w’ekyir.
Na hyɛ asɔfo a wɔso ahyɛmudaka no, dɛ, Sɛ hom du Jordan nsu no no nkɔkɔnoa a, hom ngyina dzinn wɔ Jordan no mu.
Na Josua see Israelmba no dɛ, Hom mbra ha mbetsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne nsɛm.
Na Josua see dɛ, Ɔnam iyi do na hom dze bohu dɛ tseasefo Nyankopɔn no wɔ hom mu, na dɛ ɔpam ara na ɔbɛpam Keenanfo, Hitifo, Hivifo, Perizfo, Girgasfo, Amorifo, nye Jebusfo no nyinara efi hom enyim.
Hwɛ, asaase nyinara Wura ahyɛmudaka no rutwa mu edzi hom enyim akɔ Jordan mu.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nyiyi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu mbanyin duebien, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa baako.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, aber a asɔfo a wɔso EWURADZE, asaase nyinara Wura no, n’adakaa no, hɔn anamɔn besi Jordan no nsu mu no, Jordan no nsu no botwa, mekyerɛ nsu a ɔpem fi etsifi ba no a; na wɔabɔ kuw kor egyina hɔ.
Na ɔman no tui fii hɔn asesee mu a nna asɔfo no a wɔso ahyɛmudaka no dzi hɔn enyim.
Nna Jordan yir kata no nsukɔn nyinara do buber nyinara naaso, aber a asɔfo a wɔso adaka no dur Jordan do, na hɔn anan sii nsu no nkɔkɔnoa no ara pɛr,

nna nsu a ɔpem fi etsifi ba no gyinae, na ɔbɔɔ kuw kor, wɔ ekyirkyiikyir, wɔ Adam, kurow no a ɔwɔ Zaretan ne nkyɛn no noho: na dza ɔpem kɔ Araba po a ɔnoara nye Nkyen Epo no mu no twaa koraa: na ɔman no twae faa Jeriko tsentsendo.
Na asɔfo a wɔso EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no gyinaa daadze kɛsɛɛ do pintsinn wɔ Jordan ne finimfin, na Israel nyinara nam daadze kɛsɛɛ do twae araa dze kodur dɛ ɔman no nyinara wiee Jordan twa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔman no nyinara wiee Jordan twa no, EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Josua dɛ,
Hom nyiyi ɔman no mu mbanyin duebien, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa baako,
na hom nhyɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa abo duebien wɔ Jordan mu wɔ mbrɛ asɔfo no hɔn anan gyinaa pintsinn no, na hom nsoa nkɔ, na wɔmfa nkogu asoɛe, mbrɛ hom bɔsoɛ anadwe yi no.
Nna Josua frɛɛ mbanyin duebien no a oesiesie hɔn wɔ Israelmba no mu no, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa baako:

na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ntwa mu nkedzi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no enyim nkɔ Jordan ne finimfin, na hom mu nyimpa baako biara mfa ɔbo kor nto no kɔn ho, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no dodow tse:
ama iyi aayɛ hom mu asɛnkyerɛdze, na sɛ ndaamba bi hom mba bisa hom dɛ, Abo yi hom kyerɛ ase dɛn a,
ɔno hom nse hɔn dɛ, Osiandɛ Jordan nsu no twae wɔ EWURADZE ahyɛmudaka no enyim; aber a ahyɛmudaka no twaa Jordan no, hwɛ, Jordan no nsu no, otwaa koraa: na abo yi na ɔyɛ nkaadze ma Israelmba daa.

Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Josua hyɛe no, na wɔfaa abo duebien wɔ Jordan mu, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Josua no, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no dodow tse; na wɔsoae dze kɔr beebi mbrɛ wɔkɔsoɛe no, na wɔdze guu hɔ.
Na Josua so dze abo duebien sisii Jordan finimfin, wɔ beebi mbrɛ asɔfo a wɔso ahyɛmudaka no dze hɔn anan sisii no: na ɔwɔ hɔ dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na asɔfo a wɔso adaka no gyinaa Jordan mu araa ma okodur dɛ wowiee adze biara a EWURADZE hyɛɛ Josua dɛ ɔnka nkyerɛ ɔman no yɛ, dɛ mbrɛ Moses dze hyɛɛ Josua no nyinara: na ɔman no yɛɛ ntsɛm twae.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔman no nyinara wiee twa no, na EWURADZE n’adakaa no so twae, na asɔfo no kedzii ɔman no enyim.
Na Reubenmba, Gadmba, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw ɔfa no, miae twae kedzii Israelmba no enyim, dɛ mbrɛ Moses kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no:
mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemeduanan a woemia prɛko dɛ wɔrokɔ sa twae kedzii EWURADZE enyim kɔr akono, wɔ Jeriko tɛtɛr mu.
Da no ara na EWURADZE maa Josua do wɔ Israel nyinara enyi do; na wosuroo no, dɛ mbrɛ wosuroo Moses no, wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu.
Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Josua, dɛ,
Hyɛ asɔfo a wɔso dasedaka no, ma womfi Jordan mu mbra.
Dɛm ntsi Josua hyɛɛ asɔfo no, dɛ, Hom mfi Jordan mu mbra.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, asɔfo a wɔso EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no fi Jordan mu fowee, na asɔfo no hɔn anamɔn besii daadze kɛsɛɛ do ara, na Jordan no nsu no sanee kɔr n’anamu, na ɔkɛkataa no nsukɔn nyinara do, dɛ mbrɛ nkan no nna ɔtse no.
Na ɔman no fii Jordan mu fowee wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu da a otsia du no mu, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Gilgal, wɔ Jeriko no boka afamu ɔhe do.
Na abo duebien no a woyiyii no wɔ Jordan mu no, Josua dze hyɛɛ siw wɔ Gilgal.
Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba, dɛ, Sɛ ndaamba bi hom mba bisa hɔn egyanom dɛ, Abo yi ase nye dɛn a,
ɔnodze, hom mma hom mba nhu dɛ, Asaase kɛsɛɛ do na Israel nam twaa Jordan yi.
Na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn weew Jordan mu nsu no wɔ hom enyim, na hom twae ana, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Mbɛw Po (Mbɛw Po) no a ɔwewee no wɔ hɛn enyim, ma yɛtwae ana no:
ama asaase do aman nyinara eehu dɛ EWURADZE n’abasa mu yɛ dzen; ama hom eesuro EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn daa.

Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Amorifo ahemfo a wɔwɔ Jordan egya anee afamu nyinara, nye Keenanfo ahemfo a wɔwɔ po ho no nyinara, tsee mbrɛ EWURADZE sii na ɔweew Jordan no nsu wɔ Israelmba no enyim ma wotwae ana no, hɔn akoma tui, nkyii so nna ahom bi nnyi hɔn mu bio, osian Israelmba no ntsi.
Aber no mu na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, ɔwoara yɛ ɔtwerɛbo asekan, na twitwa Israelmba no twatsia bio ne mprɛnu.
Na Josua noara yɛɛ ɔtwerɛbo asekan, na otwitwaa Israelmba no twatsia wɔ Gibeat Haaralot.

Na dza osian ntsi ma Josua twitwaa twatsia no nye yi: ɔman no a wofi Egypt bae no nyinara a wɔyɛ mbanyin no, mekyerɛ mbarimba akofo no nyinara, wuwuu kwan mu wɔ sar no do, ber a wofi Egypt firii n’ekyir no.
Nna ɔman no a wofiir edzi no nyinara woetwitwa hɔn twatsia: na ɔman no a wofi Egypt firii no a wɔwoo hɔn kwan mu wɔ sar no do nyinara dze, wonntwitwaa hɔn twatsia.

Na Israelmba no nantsewee wɔ sar no do mfe eduanan, kodur dɛ ɔman no nyinara, mekyerɛ mbarimba akofo no a wofi Egypt firii no, hɔn ase kumii, osiandɛ woenntsie EWURADZE ne ndze: woyinom na EWURADZE kaa ntam dɛ ɔnnkɛma woehu asaase a ɔno EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɛn no, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no.
Na hɔn mba no, hɔn a ɔmaa wɔsoɛree hyɛɛ hɔn ananmu no, nna wɔyɛ monomonomfo, osiandɛ woenntwa hɔn twatsia wɔ kwan no mu na hɔn na Josua twitwaa hɔn twatsia no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wowiee ɔman no nyinara twatsia twitwa no, wɔtsenatsenaa hɔn ananmu wɔ nseraban no mu ma wɔtsee apɔw ana.
Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Ndɛ da yi na meyi Egypt enyimguase no efi hom do. Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Gilgal dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na Israelmba no kyeer nsera wɔ Gilgal, na wodzii apaho wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsia duanan no n’ewimbir wɔ Jeriko tɛtɛr mu.
Na wodzii apaho no n’adzekyee no nna wodzii asaase no do eburow dadaw, epitsi tatar nye eburow kyewee.
Na da a wodzii asaase no do eburow dadaw no, adzekyee no ara nna manna no siankae; na Israelmba no ennya manna bio; mbom wodzii Keenan asaase no do ndɔbaa wɔ afe no mu.

Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Josua wɔ Jeriko ho no, ɔmaa n’enyiwa do na ohun banyin bi a ɔatwe n’afona kitsa ne nsamu dɛ ogyina n’enyim tsentsendo: na Josua kɔr ne nkyɛn, na obisaa no dɛ, Ewɔ hɛn afa, anaa ewɔ hɛn atamfo afa?
Na obuaa dɛ, Oho, nnyɛ no mu biara, na mbom dɛ EWURADZE no dɔm safohen panyin no, na afei maba. Na Josua dze n’enyim butuuw famu, na ɔsɔɔr no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Na mo wura ese n’akowaa dɛn?
Na EWURADZE no dɔm safohen panyin no see Josua dɛ, Yiyi wo mpaboa wɔ w’anan; na beebi mbrɛ igyinae no yɛ krɔnkrɔn. Na Josua yɛɛ dɛm.
Na ɔnam Israelmba no ntsi, wɔtoow Jeriko mu twitwiitwi a obi mmfi mu mmpue, na obi nntum mmba mu.
Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Hwɛ, medze Jeriko, nye ne hen, nye ne mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam no nyinara ahyɛ wo nsa.
Na hom nkyin kurow no ho, mbarimba akofo nyinara mbɔ kurow no ho aprɔw prɛko. Yɛ no dɛm nda esia.
Na asɔfo beesuon mfa nguannyin mmbɛn mbɛn esuon ndzi adaka no enyim: Na da a otsia esuon no hom nkyin kurow no ho mpɛn esuon, na asɔfo no nhɛn mbɛn no.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔhɛn oguannyin abɛn no ma ɔkyɛr a, na sɛ hom tse abɛn no ne ndze a, ɔman no nyinara mfa huro kɛse mbɔ ose; na kurow no ho fasu no bodwuruw egu famu dɛfɛɛ, na ɔman no mu obiara ndua n’enyim tsentsendo mfow nkɔ.
Na Josua, Nun ne babanyin no, frɛɛ asɔfo no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma ahyɛmudaka no do, na wɔmma asɔfo beesuon mfa nguannyin mmbɛn mbɛn esuon ndzi EWURADZE n’adakaa no enyim.
Na wɔsee ɔman no dɛ, Hom ntwa mu nkɔbɔ kurow no ho aprɔw, na wɔmma mbarimba a woemia no ntwa mu nkedzi EWURADZE n’adakaa no enyim.
Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm, aber a Josua kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no, asɔfo beesuon no a wɔdze nguannyin mmbɛn mbɛn esuon dzi EWURADZE enyim no twaa mu, na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn no: na EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no toaa hɔn do.
Na mbarimba a woemia no dzii asɔfo a wɔhɛn mbɛn no enyim, na nkyidɔm no dzii adaka no ekyir. Wɔnam rokɔ no nna asɔfo no rehɛn mbɛn no.
Na Josua hyɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, Mma hom mmbɔ ose, mma wɔnntse hom ndze so, mma asɛm bi mmfi hom anomu mmpue, kyerɛ da a mebɛse hom dɛ wɔmbɔ ose no; nna hom mbɔ ose.
Nna ɔmaa EWURADZE n’adakaa no kekyiin kurow no ho, kɔbɔɔ ho aprɔw prɛko: na wɔbaa nseraban no mu, na wɔbɛdaa nseraban no mu.
Na Josua soɛɛr anapaatu, na asɔfo no maa EWURADZE n’adakaa no do.

Na asɔfo beesuon no a wokitsakitsa nguannyin mmbɛn mbɛn esuon no nantsewee dzii EWURADZE n’adakaa no enyim, na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn no. Nna mbarimba a woemia no dzi hɔn enyim; na nkyidɔm no dzi EWURADZE n’adakaa no ekyir, asɔfo no nam rokɔ no nyina nna wɔrehɛn mbɛn no.
Na da a otsia ebien no wokyiin kurow no ho prɛko, na wɔsanee kɔr nseraban no mu: wɔyɛɛ dɛm ara nda esia.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia esuon no, wɔsoɛɛr ahanamakye a enyim rebaabaa no, na wokekyiin kurow no ho dɛmara mpɛn esuon: da no nko ara na wɔbɔɔ kurow no ho aprɔw mpɛn esuon.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a asɔfo no hɛɛn mbɛn no, wɔ aprɔwbɔ a otsia mpɛn esuon no, Josua see ɔman no dɛ, Hom mbɔ ose; na EWURADZE dze kurow no ama hom.

Na kurow no nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, nyɛ adze a EWURADZE dze ne nsa ato do: mbom, ɔbaa huhunyi Rahab nko na ɔnka, ɔno nye hɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ fie no nyinara, osiandɛ ɔdze abɔfo a yɛsomaa hɔn no sumae.
Na hom, hom ho ara na hom nhwɛ no yie wɔ adze a woetu esi hɔ ama ɔsɛɛ no ho, ɔno bɛyɛ na hom afa adze a wɔadom no bi; na hom ayɛ ma Israel nseraban ayɛ ebusudze, na hom ahaw no.
Na dwetɛ, sika, boran nye dadze ndzɛmba nyinara dze, ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma EWURADZE: wɔmfa mbra EWURADZE n’adzekorabea.

Nna ɔman no bɔɔ ose, na asɔfo no hɛɛn mbɛn no: na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔman no tsee abɛn no ndze no, wɔdze huro kɛse bɔɔ ose, na fasu no dwuruwii guu famu dɛfɛɛ, ma ɔman no fowee kɔr kurow no mu, obiara duaa n’enyim tsentsendo, na wɔgyee kurow no.
Na wɔdze afona kunkum dza ɔwɔ kurow no mu nyinara pasapasa, ɔbanyin nye ɔbaa, abofra na ɔpanyin nyina, nye ɔnantwi, nye oguan, nye asoaso.
Na Josua see mbanyin beenu a wɔkɛseraa asaase no dɛ, Hom nkɔ ɔbaa huhunyi no ne fie, na wɔnkɛfa ɔbaa no, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara mfi hɔ mbra, dɛ mbrɛ hom kaa ntam kyerɛɛ no no.
Na mberantsɛ akwanserafo no kɔree, na wɔdze Rahab, nye n’egya, nye ne na, nye no nuanom, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara puei bae; na wokegyaa hɔn wɔ Israel nseraban no ekyir.
Na wɔdze ogya hyeew kurow no, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara: dwetɛ, sika, na boran nye dadze ndzɛmba no ara nko, na wɔdze kɔr EWURADZE ne fie adzekorabea no mu.

Na ɔbaa huhunyi Rahab, na n’egya ne fifo, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara dze, Josua gyee hɔn nkwa; na ɔtsenaa Israel mu araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi; osiandɛ ɔdze abɔfo a Josua somaa hɔn dɛ wɔnkɛsera Jeriko no sumae.
Na Josua dze ntam braa hɔn aber no mu dɛ, Nyimpa a ɔbɔsoɛr abɛkyekyer Jeriko kurow yi, mpaa nka no wɔ EWURADZE enyim: ɔdze n’abakan bɔtow ne fapem, na ɔdze ne ba kaekyir banyin esisi n’ano mbobotsen.
Na EWURADZE dzii Josua n’ekyir; na ne nka tahyee asaase no nyinara do.

Na Israelmba too mbra wɔ adze a woetu esi hɔ ama ɔsɛɛ no no ho: osiandɛ Akan a ofi Juda ebusuakuw mu a ɔyɛ Karmi (Karmi) a n’egya nye Zabdi a ɔno so n’egya nye Zera no, ne babanyin no faa adze a wɔadom no no bi: na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛɛw wɔ Israelmba no do.
Na Josua somaa mbarimba ma wofi Jeriko kɔr Ai a ɔwɔ Bɛt-aven nkyɛn wɔ Bɛtɛl no boka afamu, na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom mfow nkɔ nkɛsera asaase no. Na mbarimba no fowee kɔree kɛseraa Ai.

Na wɔsanee baa Josua hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, Mma mma ɔman no nyinara mmfow nnkɔ; mbom ma mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemebien anaa mpemebiasa mfow nkɔ nkɔbɔ Ai; mma mma ɔman no nyinara mmfona hɔnho nnkefir hɔ: osiandɛ hɔn ho suar.
Nna ɔman no mu mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemebiasa fowee kɔr hɔ: na woguanee wɔ Ai mbarimba no enyim.
Na Ai mbarimba no kunkum hɔn mu mbarimba bɛyɛ eduasa esia: na wotsiiw hɔn dze fi kuropon no ano araa kodur Sebarim, na wokunkum hɔn wɔ nsianee no mu: na ɔman no hɔn akoma tutui, na abagura kaa hɔn.
Na Josua sunsuaan ne ntar mu, na ɔdze n’enyim butuuw famu wɔ EWURADZE n’adakaa no enyim araa ma okodur ewimbir, ɔnoara na Israel mpanyimfo no; na wotuu huntuma guguu hɔn etsifi.
Na Josua see dɛ, Afei, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn ara ntsi na edze ɔman yi etwa Jordan, dɛ edze hɛn rebɛhyɛ Amorifo nsa, ma wɔaama yɛahyew yi? Yehunii a nkyɛ yɛnyɛ foo ntsena Jordan egya noho!
Ao EWURADZE, na menka dɛn, Israel na wɔadan hɔn ekyir ama hɔn atamfo yi!
Na Keenanfo nye asaase no do atsefo no nyinara bɛtse nka, na woetwa hɛn ho ehyia, na woetwa hɛn dzin efi asaase do: na ebɛyɛ dɛn ama wo dzin kɛse no?
Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Soɛr: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze w’enyim ebutuw famu dɛm yi?
Israel ayɛ bɔn; nyew, wɔato m’ahyɛmu a mehyɛɛ hɔn ho mbra no mpo: nyew, wɔafa adze a wɔadom no no so mpo bi; na woewia adze so, na wɔakata do so, na wɔdze akɛhyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn adze so mpo mu.
Dɛm ntsi na Israelmba no nntum nngyina hɔn atamfo enyim no, dan ara na wɔbɛdan hɔn ekyir ama hɔn atamfo, osiandɛ wɔabɛyɛ ebusufo: minnkedzi hom ekyir bio, gyedɛ hom sɛɛ adze a wɔadom no no fi hom mu.

Soɛr, tsew ɔman no ho, na se dɛ, Hom ntsew homho nsie ɔkyena: na mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi, Adze a wɔadom no no bi wɔ wo mu, Israel: irunntum nngyina w’atamfo enyim, gyedɛ hom eyi adze a wɔadom no no efi hom mu ana.

Dɛm ntsi anapa hom mfa no hom ebusuakuw mu ebusuakuw mu ntwe mpin: na ɔmbra dɛ, ebusuakuw a EWURADZE beyi no ntwe mpin ebusua mu ebusua mu; na ebusua a EWURADZE beyi no ntwe mpin no efibobow mu efibobow mu; na ofibobow a EWURADZE beyi no ntwe mpin no nyimpa nkorkor mu.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, nyia adze a wɔadom no no besi no no wɔdze gya bɛhyew no, ɔnoara nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara: osiandɛ ɔato EWURADZE n’ahyɛmu no, na ɔayɛ ebusudze wɔ Israel.
Nna Josua soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔdze Israel twee pinii wɔ ebusuakuw mu ebusuakuw mu; na woyii Juda ebusuakuw no:
na ɔdze Juda ebusua no twee pinii; na oyii Zerafo ebusua no: na ɔdze Zerafo ebusua no twee pinii wɔ nyimpa nkorkor mu; na woyii Zabdi:
na ɔdze ne fibobow twee pinii wɔ nyimpa nkorkor mu: na woyii Akan (Akan), Karmi ne babanyin na Zabdi ne nana no.
Na Josua see Akan (Akan) dɛ, Me babanyin, me kyɛw ara nye yi, fa enyimnyam ma EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na yi no ayɛw; na afei ka dza ayɛ kyerɛ me; mma nnsiw me do.
Na Akan buaa Josua see dɛ, Nokwar mayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na dza mayɛ nye yi:

aber a muhun asadze no mu Babilɔn egugudo fɛɛfɛw bi, nye dwetɛ dwetɛbona ahaenu, nye sika ndamba a ɔtow dwetɛbona eduonum no, nna m’enyi beree, na mefae; na ampa, ɔhyɛ famu wɔ m’asesee no mu, na dwetɛ no hyɛ ase.
Nna Josua somaa abɔfo, na wɔdze mbirika kɔr asese no mu; na, hwɛ, ɔhyɛ famu wɔ n’asesee mu, na dwetɛ no hyɛ ase.
Na woyii no wɔ asese no mu, na wɔdze brɛɛ Josua, nye Israelmba no nyinara; na wɔdze boguu EWURADZE enyim.

Na Josua nye Israel nyinara faa Akan (Achan), Zera ne babanyin no, nye dwetɛ no, egugudo no, sika ndamba no, ne mbabanyin na ne mbabaa, n’anantwi, no nsoasopɔnkɔ, no nguan, n’asesee, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara: na wɔdze hɔn baa Akɔr (Akor) ɔbɔn mu.
Na Josua see no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na afona hɛn yi? EWURADZE bɔfona wo ndɛ da yi. Na Israel nyinara siiw no abo; na wɔdze abo siiw hɔn na wɔdze ogya hyeew hɔn.
Na wɔhɔɔr no do abosiw kɛsenara dze bodu ndɛ da yi: na EWURADZE danee fii n’ebufuw ne hyeehyew no ho. Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin, Akɔr (Akor) ɔbɔn, ase nye ɔhaw ɔbɔn, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Mma nnsuro, nkyii so mma w’abaw mu mmbu: fa akofo no nyinara ka woho, na soɛr, fow kɔ Ai: hwɛ, medze Aihen, nye ne man, nye no kurow, nye n’asaase ahyɛ wo nsa:
Yɛ Ai nye ne hen dɛ mbrɛ eyɛɛ Jeriko nye ne hen no: no mu asadze, nye no mu fiembowa nko, na hom mfa no afonam mma homho: hyɛ ma wɔnkɔ kurow no atsɛwee wɔ n’ekyir.
Nna Josua, nye akofo no nyinara soɛree, dɛ wɔrokɔfow akɔ Ai: na Josua yiyii mbarimba no mpemeduasa, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, na ogyaa hɔn kwan anadwe.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ kurow no atsɛwee, wɔ kurow no n’ekyir: mma hom mmfi kurow no ho nnkɔ ekyirekyir pii, mbom hom nyinara nyɛ krado:
na emi, nye hɔn a wɔka mo ho nyinara bɔtwe epin kurow no: na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wopue ba hɛn do dɛ asɔpɔn a, yebefi hɔn enyim eguan;
na wobefir edzi etsiw hɛn ekodu dɛ yɛbɔtwe hɔn efi kurow no mu; na wɔbɛse dɛ, Wofi hɛn enyim ruguan, dɛ asɔpɔn no; na sɛ yefi hɔn enyim eguan a,
ɔno hom nsoɛr mfi atsɛwee no mu, na hom nkɛfa kurow no: na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze bɛhyɛ hom nsa.
Na ɔmbra dɛ, aber a hom afa kurow no, hom nto kurow no mu gya; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm tse no ara na hom nyɛ: hyɛ, na mahyɛ hom.
Na Josua gyaa hɔn kwan: na wɔkɔr atsɛwee no, na wɔtsenaa Bɛtɛl nye Ai ntamu, wɔ Ai n’anee afamu: na Josua dze ɔdaa nseraban no mu anadwe no.
Na Josua soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔpoon ɔman no hyiae, na ɔnoara nye Israel mpanyimfo no fowee dzii ɔman no enyim kɔr Ai.
Na akofo no a wɔka no ho no fowee, na wɔtwee pinii, na wɔbaa kurow no enyim, na wɔkyeer nsera wɔ Ai kwaamu afamu: nna ɔbɔn bi da ɔno nye Ai ntamu.
Na ɔfaa mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemenum, na ɔdze hɔn kɔr atsɛwee wɔ Bɛtɛl nye Ai ntamu, wɔ kurow no n’anee afamu.
Na wɔtotoo ɔman no ho hyiae, mekyerɛ dɔm no a wɔwɔ kurow no no kwaamu afamu, na hɔn atsɛweefo no a wɔwɔ kurow no n’anee afamu no nyinara; na Josua kɔr ɔbɔn no mu anadwe no ara.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Aihen no hunii no, ɔnye ne man nyinara na kurow no mu mbarimba no yɛɛ ntsɛm soɛɛr ahanamakye, fiir edzi dɛ worikehyia Israel nye hɔn ako, wɔ bea a wɔahyɛ no, wɔ Araba no enyim; nna ɔnodze, onnyim dɛ wɔakɔ no atsɛwee wɔ kurow no ekyir.
Na Josua nye Israel nyinara yɛɛ dɛ gyama Aimba no etutu hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim, na woguanee faa sar no do kwan no do.
Na wɔfrɛɛ nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ kurow no mu nyinara bɔɔ mu dɛ wontsiw hɔn: na wotsiiw Josua, na wɔtwee hɔn fii kurow no mu.
Na ɔbarimba biara annka wɔ Ai anaa Bɛtɛl a oemmpue ennketsiw Israel: na wɔdaan kurow no n’ano gyaa hɔ, na wotsiiw Israel.
Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Tsen peaa no a ɔdze wo nsamu no wɔ Ai do; na medze mebɛhyɛ wo nsa. Na Josua tseen peaa no a ɔdze ne nsamu no wɔ kurow no do.
Na atsɛweefo no soɛree fii hɔn ananmu ntsɛm, na ɔtseen ne nsa ara na wotutuu mbirika kɛhɛɛn kurow no mu, na wɔfae; na wɔyɛɛ har too kurow no mu gya.

Na aber a Ai mbarimba buu hɔn kɔn ekyir no, wohun dɛ, kurow no mu wusiw afow kɔ sor, na woennya ahoɔdzen a wɔdze guan fa ha anaa ha: na nkorɔfo no a woguanee kɔr sar no do no daan hɔnho wɔ hɔn a woritsiw hɔn no do.
Na aber a Josua nye Israel nyinara hun dɛ atsɛweefo no agye kurow no, na kurow no no wusiw afow kɔ sor no, nna wɔsaan hɔn ekyir bio bokunkum Ai mbarimba no.
Na kuw kor no so fiir edzi fii kurow no mu baa hɔn do; ma Aimba no kaa Israel ntamu, binom wɔ afa ha, na binom so wɔ afa ha: na wokunkum hɔn araa ma wɔamma hɔn mu biara annka anaa oemmfi nsa.
Na wɔkyeer Aihen no enyikan, na wɔdze no brɛɛ Josua.

Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Israel wiee Aifo a wɔwɔ akoe mu, wɔ sar no do mbrɛ wotsiiw hɔn no kunkum, na hɔn nyinara totɔr wɔ afona anomu araa kodur dɛ hɔn ase kumii no, Israel nyinara sanee kɔr Ai, na wɔdze afona anomu kɔbɔɔ no.
Na hɔn a wɔtotɔr da no nyinara, mbanyin nye mbaa nyina yɛ mpemduebien.
Na Josua anntwe ne nsa a ɔdze tseen peaa no annsan ekyir araa kodur dɛ ɔsɛɛ Aifo nyinara pasapasa.
Kurow no mu fiembowa nye asadze nko na Israel faa no afonam maa hɔnho, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔdze hyɛɛ Josua no tse.
Nna Josua hyeew Ai, na ɔyɛɛ no siw a ɔwɔ hɔ daa, mekyerɛ amamfo, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.

Na ɔdze Aihen no sɛɛn dua do araa ma okodur ewimbir: na wi kɔtɔree no Josua hyɛe ma wokeyii no fun no fii dua no do, na wɔkɔtowee kyeen kurow no no kuropon ano na wɔhɔɔr abosiw kɛsenara wɔ do, na ɔwɔ hɔ dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Nna Josua sii afɔrmbukyia maa EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, wɔ bepɔw Ebal do,

dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra nwoma no mu, afɔrmbukyia a wɔdze abo a wonntwae a nyimpa biara mmaa dadze biara do wɔ do pɛn sii: na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ do maa EWURADZE, na wokum asomdwee afɔr abowa.
Na ɔkyerɛɛw Moses mbra no no nsusudo wɔ abo no do hɔ, ɔno na ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israelmba enyim no.

Na Israel nyinara, nye hɔn mpanyimfo nye ahwɛdofo, nye hɔn ntsɛmbuafo, gyinaa adaka no n’afa ha, nye n’afa ha, wɔ Levifo asɔfo a wɔso EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no enyim, ɔhɔho nye okuromnyi nyinara: hɔn mu fa wɔ bepɔw Gerizim enyim, na hɔn mu fa so wɔ bepɔw Ebal enyim dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses hyɛɛ dɛ wondzi kan nhyira Israel ɔman no ana no.
Na n’ekyir no ɔkenkaan mbra no mu nsɛm nyinara, nhyira no nye mpaa no, dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra nwoma no mu nyinara tse.
Asɛm biara nnyi dza Moses hyɛe no nyinara mu a Josua annkenkan no wɔ Israel bagua no nyinara, nye mbaa, nye mbofraba, nye ahɔho a wɔnye hɔn nam no enyim.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ahemfo a wɔwɔ Jordan egya, wɔ nkokodo nkurow, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow, nye po kɛse no no mpoano nyinara wɔ Lebanon tsentsendo no, Hitifo, nye Amorifo, Keenanfo, Perizfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo no tsee dza esi no;
wɔpoon hɔnho hyiae, dɛ wɔreyɛ kor, nye Josua na Israel akɔko.
Na aber a Gibeonfo tsee dza Josua dze yɛɛ Jeriko nye Ai no,
hɔn dze, wɔyɛɛ no nyansa mu, na wosii mu kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ gyama wɔyɛ abɔfo, na wɔfaa nkotoku dadaw soasoaa hɔn nsoasopɔnkɔ, nye nsanwoma nkotoku a wɔayɛ dadaw na wɔatsetsew na wɔapempam;
na mpaboa dadaw pokyipokyi a wɔasesa mu hyehyɛɛ hɔn anan, na ntar gow hyehyɛe; nna hɔn edzidzidze mu edziban nyinara atwentwem na wɔabobɔ etur.
Na wosii mu kɔr Josua hɔ wɔ nsera mu wɔ Gilgal, na wɔsee ɔno nye Israelmba no dɛ, Yefi ekyirekyir ɔman bi mu na yɛaba, dɛm ntsi afei hom nye hɛn nyɛ apam.
Na Israelmba no see Hivifo no dɛ, Annyɛ a hɛn mu na hom tse; na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn yɛnye hom ayɛ apam?
Na wɔsee Josua dɛ, Yɛyɛ wo nkowaa. Na Josua bisaa hɔn dɛ, Woananom nye hom? Na hom fi hen bae?
Na wɔsee no dɛ, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne dzin ntsi na wo nkowaa fi ekyirekyir ɔman bi mu aba: na yɛatse ne nka, na dza ɔyɛe wɔ Egypt nyinara,
na dza ɔdze yɛɛ Amorifo ahemfo beenu a wɔwɔ Jordan egya, Hesbonhen Sihon, nye Basanhen Ɔge a ɔwɔ Astarot no nyinara.
Na hɛn mpanyimfo nye hɛn man mu nkorɔfo nyinara kasaa kyerɛɛ hɛn dɛ, Hom mfa ɔkwan do edzidzidze, na wɔnkɔ nkehyia hɔn, na wɔnse hɔn dɛ, Yɛyɛ hom nkowaa: na afei hom nye hɛn nyɛ apam.
Hɛn boodoo yi da a yefiir edzi dɛ yɛreba hom nkyɛn no na yɛfaa no ɔhyew totoo hɛn edzidzidze mu; na afei, hwɛ, atwentwem, na ɔabɔ etur:
na nsanwoma nkotoku yi a yɛhyehyɛɛ no amaama yi, wɔyɛ afofor; na, hwɛ, wɔatsetsew; na hɛn ntar nye hɛn mpaboa yi ayɛ adadaw wɔ ɔkwan no no war a ɔwar dodow ntsi.
Na mbarimba no gyee hɔn edzidzidze no bi, naaso woemmbisa EWURADZE hɔ apam.
Na Josua nye hɔn dzii no asomdwee mu, na ɔnye hɔn yɛɛ apam dɛ ɔbɛma wɔatsena ase: na hɔn mu mbapɔmba no dzidzii nsew kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔnye hɔn wiee apam no yɛ no n’ekyir nda ebiasa, nna wɔtsee dɛ wɔyɛ hɔn manmufo, na wɔtse hɔn mu.
Na Israelmba no tuu kwan, na wokodur hɔn nkurow mu da a otsia ebiasa no. Na hɔn nkurow nye Gibeon, nye Kefira (Kefira), nye Beerot, nye Kiriat-jearim.
Na Israelmba ennkuku hɔn, osiandɛ hɔn mu mbapɔmba no dze EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, edzi nsew akyerɛ hɔn. Na dɔm no nyinara hwinhwinii tsiaa mbapɔmba no.
Na mbapɔmba no nyinara see dɔm no nyinara dɛ, Yɛdze EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, edzi nsew akyerɛ hɔn: dɛm ntsi afei yennyi ho kwan dɛ yɛdze nsa ka hɔn.
Iyi na yɛbɛyɛ hɔn, na yɛama wɔatsena ase; amma osian ntam a yɛaka akyerɛ hɔn no ntsi, ebufuw aammba hɛn do.
Na mbapɔmba no see hɔn dɛ, Wɔmma wɔntsena ase: mbom wɔbɛyɛ nduatwafo nye nsusawfo ama hɛn. Dɛm na mbapɔmba no kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na Josua kɛfrɛɛ hɔn, na obisaa hɔn, dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom adaadaa hɛn, dɛ, Yɛnye hom ntamu twe dodoodow; aber a hom tse hɛn mu yi?
Dɛm ntsi afei wɔapaa hom, na hom nnkegyaa nkowaa yɛ ara da, hom bɛyɛ nduatwafo nye nsusawfo ama me Nyankopɔn fie.

Na wobuaa Josua, na wɔsee dɛ, Osiandɛ wɔkaa no kotoo kyerɛɛ wo nkowaa, mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn sii na ɔhyɛɛ n’akowaa Moses dɛ ɔmfa asaase nyinara mma hom, na ɔnsɛɛ asaase no do atsefo no nyinara mfi hom enyim; dɛm ntsi osian hom ntsi yesuroo dodoodow maa hɛn nkwa, iyi ntsi na yɛayɛ dɛm yi.
Na afei, hwɛ, yɛwɔ wo nsamu: dza ehwɛ a oye na ɔtsen ma wo dɛ edze bɛyɛ hɛn no, yɛ.
Na dɛm na ɔyɛɛ hɔn, na ɔgyee hɔn fii Israelmba nsamu, ma woennkunkum hɔn.
Na da no ara Josua yɛɛ hɔn nduatwafo nye nsusawfo dze maa Israelmba no, nye EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia no, wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi biara. Na dɛm na wɔyɛɛ dze bodu ndɛ da yi.

Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jerusalɛmhen Adoni-zedek tsee mbrɛ Josua sii gyee Ai, na ɔsɛɛ no pasapasa; dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze yɛɛ Jeriko nye ne hen no, dɛmara so na ɔdze yɛɛ Ai nye ne hen; na mbrɛ Gibeonfo sii nye Israel siesiei, na wɔtsenaa hɔn mu no;
wosuroo kɛsenara, osiandɛ Gibeon yɛ kurow kɛse, ɔtse dɛ ahenkurow no bi, na ɔso sen Ai, na no mu mbanyin nyinara yɛ ahoɔdzenfo.
Dɛm ntsi Jerusalɛmhen Adoni-zedek somae ma wɔkɔr Hebronhen Hoham, Jarmuthen Piram, Lakishen Jafia, nye Eglonhen Debir hɔ, dɛ,
Hom mbra me nkyɛn mbɔboa me, ma yenku Gibeon: osiandɛ ɔnye Josua na Israelmba no akɛyɛ asomdwee apam.

Dɛm ntsi Amorifo ahemfo beenum a hɔn nye, Jerusalɛmhen, Hebronhen, Jarmuthen, Lakishen na Eglonhen no, poon hɔnho hyiae, hɔn nye hɔn dɔm nyinara, na wɔfowee kɔree, na wɔkɛkyeer Gibeon do nsera, na wɔyɛɛ no do sa.

Na Gibeonfo no somae ma wɔkɔr Josua nkyɛn wɔ nsera mu wɔ Gilgal, dɛ, Mma nnyi wo nsa mmfi wo nkowaa do; bra hɛn nkyɛn ntsɛm bɛgye hɛn nkwa, na bɔboa hɛn: na Amorifo ahemfo a wɔtsetse nkokodo nkurow mu nyinara apon hɔnho ehyia abɛhyɛ hɛn do.
Nna Josua fi Gilgal fowee kɔree, ɔnoara, ɔnye akofo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn nyinara, nye mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam nyinara.
Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Mma nnsuro hɔn: na meyi hɔn ahyɛ wo nsa; hɔn mu nyimpa biara nnkegyina w’enyim.
Dɛm ntsi Josua baa hɔn do awerɛfir mu; osiandɛ ɔdze anadwe no nyinara fowee fi Gilgal kɔree.
Na EWURADZE kaa hɔn gui wɔ Israel enyim, na ɔdze okum kɛse kunkum hɔn wɔ Gibeon, na wotsiiw hɔn wɔ Bɛt-horon n’afowee ɔkwan no do, na wokunkum hɔn kodur Azeka, nye Makeda.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, woruguan efi Israel enyim, na wɔwɔ Bɛt-horon esianee no, EWURADZE totoow abo akɛse fi sor bobɔɔ hɔn dze kodur Azeka, ma wowuwui: hɔn a wɔdze ɔsorbo no kunkum hɔn no dɔɔ so sen hɔn a Israelmba no dze afona kunkum hɔn.
Nna Josua kasaa kyerɛɛ EWURADZE wɔ da a EWURADZE yii Amorifo mae wɔ Israelmba enyim no na ɔsee dɛ, Iwi, gyina dzinn wɔ Gibeon do; Na ɔwo, Bosoom, wɔ Aijalon ɔbɔn mu.

Na iwi gyinaa dzinn, na bosoom siankae, Kodur dɛ ɔman no tɔɔ hɔn atamfo do wer. Ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw iyi wɔ Jasar nwoma no mu? Na wi siankae wɔ sor finimfin, na ɔannyɛ ntsɛm annkɔtɔ bɛyɛ adzekyeekwansin mu.
Na da biara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ iyi da, dɛ abɛsen anaa dza ɔbɛba a EWURADZE etsie nyimpa ne ndze dɛm: na EWURADZE koe maa Israel.
Na Josua sanee, na Israel nyinara ka no ho, baa nseraban no mu wɔ Gilgal.
Na Amori ahemfo beenum yi guanee, na wɔdze hɔnho kosumaa Makeda ɔbo tu no mu.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Josua dɛ, Ahemfo beenum no woehu hɔn dɛ wosuma Makeda ɔbo tu no mu.
Na Josua see dɛ, Hom mpirew abo akɛse nhin ɔbo tu no ano, na wɔmfa nyimpa ngyina ho ma wɔnweɔn hɔn:
na hom dze mma wonnsianka; hom ntsiw hom atamfo no, na wonku hɔn mu edziekyifo no, mma hom mma hɔn kwan ma wɔnnkɛhɛn nkurow mu: osiandɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn eyi hɔn ahyɛ hom nsa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Josua nye Israelmba no dze okum kɛse pɔtɔɔ wiee hɔn kunkum araa ma wɔhyewee no, na hɔn mu nkaa a wɔkae no guanguanee kɛhɛnhɛɛn nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban no mu no,
nna ɔman no nyinara sanee baa Josua nkyɛn wɔ nseraban no mu wɔ Makeda dwudwoodwo: na obi anntwe ne gyirama annka Israelmba mu obiara da.
Nna Josua see dɛ, Hom mbue ɔbo tu no ano, na hom nyi ahemfo beenum no mfi ɔbo tu no mu mbrɛ me.
Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm, na woyii ahemfo beenum no fii ɔbo tu no mu brɛɛ no, Jerusalɛm, Hebron, Jarmut, Lakis nye Eglon ahemfo no.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔdze ahemfo no brɛɛ Josua no, Josua kɛfrɛɛ Israel mbarimba nyinara, na ɔsee mbarimba akofo a wɔnye no kɔree no hɔn asafohemfo no dɛ, Hom ntwe mpin, mfa hom anan mbesisi hɔn kɔn do.
Na Josua see hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro, mma hom abaw mu nntu so; hom nhyɛ dzen na wonnya akokodur: na dɛm na EWURADZE bɛyɛ hom atamfo a hom nye hɔn ko nyinara.
Na n’ekyir no Josua bobɔɔ hɔn kunkum hɔn, na ɔdze hɔn sensɛɛn ndua do: na wɔsensɛɛn ndua no do araa kodur ewimbir.
Na ɔbaa dɛ witɔree ber no, Josua hyɛe ma woyiyii hɔn fii ndua no do, na wɔkɔtoow hɔn guu ɔbo tu no a wɔdze hɔnho kosumaa mu no mu, na wɔdze abo akɛse hiin ɔbo tu no ano, dze bodu ndɛ da yi ara.

Na Josua gyee Makeda da no ara, na ɔdze afona bɔɔ kurow no, nye ne hen no; na ɔsɛɛ hɔn nyinara nye akra a wɔwɔ mu no pasapasa, oenngyaa obiara ma ɔaannka: na ɔyɛɛ Makedahen no dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Jerikohen no.
Na Josua, nye Israel nyinara twaa mu fi Makeda, kɔr Libna, na wɔnye Libna kɔkoe:
na EWURADZE yii ɔno so, nye ne hen no, hyɛɛ Israel nsa; na ɔdze afona anomu bɔɔ no, nye akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara; na oenngyaa obiara ma ɔaannka wɔ mu; na ɔyɛɛ ne hen no so dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Jerikohen no.
Na Josua, nye Israel nyinara twaa mu fi Libna, kɔr Lakis, na wɔkɛkyeer no do nsera, na wɔnye no koe:
na EWURADZE yii Lakis hyɛɛ Israel nsa, na Josua gyee no da a otsia ebien no, na ɔdze afona bɔɔ no, nye akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Libna no tse nyinara.
Nna Gezerhen Horam fowee bae bɔboaa Lakis; na Josua kum ɔno nye ne man, dze kodur dɛ oenngyaa no biara ma ɔaannka.
Na Josua, nye Israel nyinara twaa mu fi Lakis, kɔr Eglon; na wɔkyeer no do nsera, na wɔnye no koe;
