na wɔgyee no da no ara, na wɔdze afona bɔɔ no, na akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara ɔsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa da no ara, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Lakis no tse nyinara.
Na Josua, nye Israel nyinara fi Eglon fowee kɔr Hebron; na wɔnye no koe:

na wɔgyee, na wɔdze afona bɔɔ no, nye ne hen no, nye no nkurow no nyinara, nye akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara; oenngyaa biara ma ɔaannka, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Eglon no tse nyinara; na ɔsɛɛ Hebron nye akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara pasapasa.
Na Josua, nye Israel nyinara sanee baa Debir; na wɔnye no koe:

na ɔgyee, nye ne hen no, nye no nkurow no nyinara; na wɔdze afona bobɔɔ hɔn, na wɔsɛɛ akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara pasapasa; oenngyaa obiara ma ɔaannka: dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Hebron no, dɛmara so na ɔyɛɛ Debir, nye ne hen; dɛ mbrɛ eso ɔyɛɛ Libna, nye ne hen no.

Nna Josua bɔɔ asaase no nyinara, nkokodo nkurow, nye pomu afamu, ɔbɔnmu nkurow, nye nkokonyiadze, nye hɔn ahemfo nyinara; oenngyaa obiara ma ɔaannka: mbom ɔsɛɛ dza ogu ahom nyinara pasapasa, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no hyɛe no.
Na Josua bobɔɔ hɔn fi Kades-barnea araa kodur Gaza, nye Gosen ɔman no nyinara mu, araa kodur Gibeon.
Na ahemfo yi nyinara nye hɔn asaase no, Josua gyee no aber kor mu, osiandɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, koe maa Israel.
Na Josua, na Israel nyinara ka no ho, sanee baa nseraban no mu wɔ Gilgal.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Hazorhen Jabin tsee no, ɔsomae ma wɔkɔr Madonhen Jobab, Simronhen, nye Aksafhen nkyɛn,
nye ahemfo a wɔwɔ kwaamu afamu wɔ nkokodo nkurow no mu, nye Araba Kinnerot no pomu afamu, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow, nye Dor akoko do wɔ anee afamu,
Keenanfo a wɔwɔ boka nye anee, nye Amorifo, Hitifo, Perizfo, nye Jebusfo a wɔwɔ nkokodo nkurow mu, nye Hivifo a wɔwɔ Hermon ase wɔ Mizpa asaase do no nyinara nkyɛn.
Na wɔnye hɔn dɔm nyinara ka hɔn ho sii mu kɔree, nkurow pii, hɔn dodow tse dɛ mpoano anhwea, nye mpɔnkɔ nye ntseaseanam piigyan.
Na ahemfo yi nyinara kehyiae; na wɔbaa bɛkyeer nsera fakor wɔ Merom nsu no ho, dɛ wɔnye Israel robɔko.
Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Mma onnsian hɔn ntsi ma w’akoma nntu: na ɔkyena siseber yi na mibeyi hɔn nyinara atɔfun ama wɔ Israel enyim: twitwa hɔn mpɔnkɔ anantsir, na fa ogya hyew hɔn ntseaseanam.
Nna Josua, nye nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no nyinara baa hɔn do awerɛfir mu wɔ Merom nsu no ho, na wotui hyɛɛ hɔn do.

Na EWURADZE yii hɔn hyɛɛ Israel nsa, na wokunkum hɔn, na wotsiiw hɔn araa dze kodur Zidon kɛse no, nye Misrepot-maim ho, nye Mizpe ɔbɔn mu boka afamu; na wokunkum hɔn kodur dɛ woenngyaa hɔn mu biara ma ɔaannka.
Na Josua yɛɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ no no: otwitwaa hɔn mpɔnkɔ anantsir, na ɔdze ogya hyeew hɔn ntseaseanam.
Na Josua saan n’ekyir aber no ara mu, na ɔkɛgyee Hazor, na ɔdze afona kum ne hen no: nna nkan no na Hazor na ɔyɛ ahenman no ne tsir.
Na wɔdze afona anomu kunkum akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara, sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa: woenngyaa obiara a ogu ahom wɔ hɔ: na ɔdze gya hyeew Hazor.
Na ahemfo no hɔn nkurow nyinara, nye no mu ahemfo nyinara Josua gyee, na ɔdze afona kunkum hɔn, na ɔsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses hyɛe no.
Na nkurow a wɔdeda hɔn apempe do no dze, Israel annhyew no mu biara, gyedɛ Hazor nko; ɔno na Josua hyeew no.
Na nkurow yi mu asadze nyinara, nye fiembowa no, Israelmba no faa no afonam maa hɔnho, nyimpa biara dze, wɔdze afona kum no, dze kodur dɛ wɔsɛɛ hɔn, na woenngyaa obiara a ogu ahom.
Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ n’akowaa Moses no, dɛmara so na Moses hyɛɛ Josua: na dɛmara so na Josua yɛe; oenngyaa dza EWURADZE dze hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara mu biara a ɔannyɛ.

Nna Josua gyee asaase no nyinara, nkokodo nkurow no, nye pomu afamu nyinara, nye Gosen asaase nyinara, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow no, nye Araba no, nye Israel nkokodo nkurow no, nye ɔnoara so no bɔnmu nkurow no;
ofi bepɔw Halak a ɔfow kɔ Seir ho, mekyerɛ Baal-gad ho wɔ Lebanon ɔbɔn a ɔwɔ bepɔw Hermon ase no: na ɔfaa hɔn ahemfo nyinara, na ɔbobɔɔ hɔn kunkum hɔn.
Josua nye ahemfo no nyinara dzii ako kyɛree.
Kurow bi nnyi hɔ a ɔnye Israelmba yɛɛ nsiesie, gyedɛ Hivifo a wɔtse Gibeon no nko: na wɔkoe gyee ne nyinara.
Na EWURADZE piriim hɔn akoma dɛ wonkehyia Israel wɔ ɔko mu, ama ɔaasɛɛ hɔn pasapasa a worunnhu hɔn mbɔbɔr, na mbom ɔaasɛɛ hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
Na Josua baa aber no mu, na obotwitwaa Anakfo no gui wɔ nkokodo nkurow no mu, wɔ Hebron, Debir, Anab, nye Juda nkokodo nkurow nyinara mu. Josua dze hɔn kaa hɔn nkurow ho sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa.
Woenngyaa Anakfo no mu biara wɔ Israelmba asaase do: Gaza, Gat, nye Ashdod mu nko, na binom kae.
Nna Josua gyee asaase no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses no nyinara; na ɔdze maa Israel dɛ egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nkyekyɛmu tsetsee. Na asaase no so homee fii akodzi mu.
Woyinom nye asaase no do ahemfo a Israelmba no kunkum hɔn, na wɔfaa hɔn asaase wɔ Jordan egya a ɔdze kɔ wipuei no, ofi Arnon ɔbɔnmu dze kodu bepɔw Hermon ho, nye Araba nyinara boka afamu no.
Amorifo hen Sihon a ɔtsenaa Hesbon, na odzii hen fi Aroer a ɔda Arnon ɔbɔn ano, nye kurow a ɔwɔ ɔbɔn no ne finimfin, nye Gilead ɔfa no araa dze kodu esutsen Jabbok ho, Ammonmba he no do;
nye Araba dze kodu Kinnerot po no ho, mekyerɛ Nkyen Epo no ho, boka afamu, Bɛt-jesimot kwan do; nye pomu afamu, wɔ Pisga no nkokonyiadze ase no:
nye Basanhen Ɔge a ofi Refafo nkaa no mu a ɔtsenaa Astarot nye Edrei no ne he do,
na odzii hen wɔ bepɔw Hermon do, nye Saleka, nye Basan nyinara, dze kodu Gersurfo nye Maakatfo he do, nye Gilead ɔfa, wɔ Hesbon hen Sihon he do.
EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses nye Israelmba no kaa hɔn gui: na EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze maa Reubenfo, nye Gadfo, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw ɔfa no dɛ enyadze.

Na woyinom nye asaase no do ahemfo a Josua nye Israelmba no kunkum hɔn wɔ Jordan egya anee afamu, ofi Baal-gad wɔ Lebanon ɔbɔn no araa dze kodu bepɔw Halak a ɔfow kɔ Seir ho no; na Josua dze maa Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw dɛ enyadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyekyɛmu no tsetsee;
wɔ nkokodo nkurow mu, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow mu, nye Araba, nye nkokonyiadze, nye sar no mu, nye Pomu afamu; Hitifo, Amorifo, nye Keenanfo, Perizfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo:
Woyinom nye Jeriko, Ai a ɔwɔ Bɛtɛl ne nkyɛn no,
Jerusalɛm, Hebron,
Jarmut, Lakis,
Eglon, Gezer,
Debir, nye Geder ahemfo.
Binom so nye Horma, Arad,
Libna, Adullam,
Makeda, Bɛtɛl,
Tappua, Hefer,
Afekhen, Lasaron,
Madon nye Hazor ahemfo.
Nkaa no nye Simronmeron, Aksaf,
Taanak, Megiddo,
Kedes, Jokmeam a ɔwɔ Karmel,
Dor a ɔwɔ Dor koko do, Goiim a ɔwɔ Gilgal,
nye Tirza ahemfo. Ahemfo no nyinara wɔyɛ eduasa biako.
Afei nna Josua ayɛ akɔdaa na oedzi mfe ara yie; na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Ayɛ akɔdaa na edzi mfe ara yie, na asaase a aka so dɛ wɔkɛfa no dɔɔ so dodow.
Asaase a aka no so nye yi: Filistiafo mbew no nyinara, nye Gersurfo nyinara;

ofi Sihor a ɔwɔ Egypt n’enyim araa dze kodu Ekron kwaamu afamu he do a wɔkan ka Keenanfo ho: Filistiafo ahemfo beenum no; Gazafo dze, Ashdodfo dze, Ashkelonfo dze, Gatfo dze, Ekronfo dze; nye Avifo so,
wɔ pomu afamu: Keenanfo asaase no nyinara nye Meara a ɔyɛ Zidonfo dze no, dze kodu Afek dze kodu Amorifo he do:
nye Gebalfo asaase, nye Lebanon nyinara, dze kɔ wipuei, fi Baal-gad wɔ bepɔw Hermon ase dze rekɛhɛn Hamat:

hɔn a wɔtse nkokodo nkurow no mu nyinara, ofi Lebanon ho dze kodu Mesrɛfɔt-maim, mekyerɛ Zidonfo nyinara; mara na mubotu hɔn efi Israelmba enyim: na ɔwo dze, kyɛ ara na twe tonto kyɛ ma ɔnyɛ egyapadze mma Israel, dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo yi.
Dɛm ntsi afei kyɛ asaase yi ma ɔnyɛ egyapadze mma ebusuakuw akron no, na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no.
Reubenfo nye Gadfo ka Manaasɛ ɔfa kor no so ho nyaa hɔn egyapadze a Moses dze maa hɔn wɔ Jordan egya boka afamu no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze maa hɔn no ara pɛ;
ofi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn ano, nye kurow no a ɔwɔ ɔbɔn no finimfin, nye Medeba tɛtɛr mu nyinara dze kodu Dibon;
na Amorifo hen Sihon a odzi hen wɔ Hesbon no, no nkurow no nyinara, dze kodu Ammonmba he do;
nye Gilead, nye Gersurfo nye Maakatfo he do, nye bepɔw Hermon nyinara, nye Basan nyinara dze kodu Saleka;
Ɔge a odzii hen wɔ Astarot nye Edrei n’ahenman a ɔwɔ Basan no nyinara (ɔnoara na ɔkae wɔ Refaim nkaa no mu); na woyinom na Moses kum hɔn, gyee hɔn nsaase no.
Naaso Israelmba enntu Gersurfo no, nye Maakatfo no so: mbom Gesur nye Maakat tsenaa Israel mu, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Levi ebusuakuw no nko na ɔamma no egyapadze bi; osiandɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, n’afɔrbɔdze a wɔdze ogya bɔ no na ɔyɛ n’egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no no.
Na Moses dze maa Reubenmba ebusuakuw no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he fi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn no ano, nye kurow a ɔwɔ ɔbɔn no finimfin no, nye Medeba ho tɛtɛr mu no nyinara;
Hesbon, nye no nkurow a ɔwɔ tɛtɛr mu no nyinara; Dibon, nye Bamoth-baal, nye Bɛt-baal-meon;
nye Jahaz, nye Kedemot, nye Mefaat;
nye Kiriataim, nye Sibma, nye Zeret-sahar wɔ ɔbɔn no mu bepɔw do;
nye Bɛt-peor, nye Pisga, nye Bɛt-jesimot;

nye tɛtɛrmu nkurow no nyinara, nye Amorifo hen Sihon a odzii hen wɔ Hesbon no n’ahenman nyinara, ɔno na Moses dze no kaa Midian asafohemfo no ho kum hɔn no, Evi, nye Rekem, nye Zur, nye Hur, nye Reba, Sihon ne mbapɔmba a wɔtsenaa asaase no do no.
Balaam, Beor ne babanyin, ɔsebramunyi no so, Israelmba dze afona kum no foraa hɔn atɔfun nkaa no mu.
Na Reubenmba no hɔn he nye Jordan, nye ne he. Iyi nye Reubenmba no hɔn egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow no nye no nkurobaase.
Na Moses dze maa Gad ebusuakuw no, Gadmba no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he nye Jazer, nye Gilead nkurow no nyinara, na Ammonmba asaase no ne fa, dze kodu Aroer a ɔwɔ Rabaa enyim no;
na ofi Hesbon dze kodu Ramat-mizpe nye Bɛtonim; na ofi Mahanaim dze kodu Debir he do;
nye ɔbɔn no mu, Bɛt-haram, nye Bɛt-nimra, nye Sukɔt, nye Zafon, Hesbonhen Sihon n’ahenman nkaa no, Jordan nye ne he, dze kodu Kinneret po no n’ano noho Jordan egya boka afamu.
Iyi nye Gadmba no hɔn egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow no nye no nkurobaase.
Na Moses dze egyapadze maa Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no: na ɔyɛɛ Manaasɛmba ebusuakuw fa no dze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he fi Mahanaim, Basan nyinara, Basanhen Ɔge n’ahenman nyinara, nye Jair no nkurow a ɔwɔ Basan nyinara, nkurow eduosia:
na Gilead ne fa, nye Astarot, nye Edrei, Ɔge n’ahenman mu nkurow a ɔwɔ Basan no ɔyɛɛ Manaasɛ ne babanyin Makir ne mba no dze, mekyerɛ Makirmba no hɔn fa no a, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Iyi nye egyapadze a Moses kyɛɛ no Moab tɛtɛr mu, Jeriko Jordan egya boka afamu no.
Na Levi ebusuakuw dze, Moses amma hɔn egyapadze bi: osiandɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, nye hɔn egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no.
Na iyi nye egyapadze a Israelmba nyaa no wɔ Keenan asaase do a ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua, nye egyanom efiefi etsitsir no a wɔyɛ Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no kyekyɛe maa hɔn,
nam hɔn egyapadze ho tontotwe do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE nam Moses nsa do hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma ebusuakuw akron, na fa no.
Osiandɛ Moses dze ebusuakuw ebien na fa no hɔn egyapadze ama hɔn wɔ Jordan egya: na Levifo no dze ɔamma hɔn egyapadze bi wɔ hɔn mu.
Na Josefmba yɛ ebusuakuw ebien, Manaasɛ nye Efraim: na Levifo dze, wɔammfa kyɛfa biara amma hɔn wɔ asaase no do, gyedɛ nkurow a wɔtsena mu, nye ne mfikyisaase a wɔdze ma hɔn fiembowa nye hɔn ahodze.
Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no, dɛmara so na Israelmba no yɛe, na wɔkyekyɛɛ asaase no mu.
Nna Judamba twee piin Josua wɔ Gilgal: na Kaleb, Jefune ne babanyin Keniznyi no see no dɛ, Ɔwoara nyim asɛm a EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Nyame nyimpa Moses wɔ mo ho nye wo ho wɔ Kades-barnea.
Aber a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses somaa me fi Kades-barnea dɛ menkɛsera asaase no, nna medzi mfe eduanan; na medze asɛm sanee brɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ m’akoma mu.
Naaso mo nuanom a wɔnye me fowee kɔree no maa ɔman no hɔn akoma tui: na emi dze, medze m’akoma nyinara dzii EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn no ekyir.
Na Moses kaa ntam da no ara dɛ, Ampaara asaase a w’anan etsia do no nyɛ wo mba egyapadze daa, osiandɛ edzi EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn ekyir korakorakora.

Na afei, hwɛ, EWURADZE ama matsena ase, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkae no mfe eduanan enum yi, ofi aber a EWURADZE kaa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ Moses, aber a Israel nam sar no do no: na afei, hwɛ, medzi mfe eduowɔtwe enum ndɛ da yi.
Ndɛ da yi ara mo ho da ho yɛ dzen dɛ mbrɛ metse wɔ da a Moses somaa me no: nkan no mbrɛ m’ahoɔdzen tse no, mekyerɛ seseiara so mbrɛ m’ahoɔdzen tse ara nye no, dze ma ɔko, nye nkɔree nye mbae.

Dɛm ntsi afei fa bepɔw yi a EWURADZE kaa ho asɛm da no mu no ma me; na ɔwoara tsee no wɔ da no mu dɛ Anakfo wɔ hɔ, na nkurow a ɔyɛ akɛse na wɔagyegye ho ban: annyɛ a EWURADZE bedzi m’ekyir ma meetu hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kae no.
Na Josua hyiraa no; na ɔdze Hebron maa Kaleb, Jefune ne babanyin no dɛ n’egyapadze.
Dɛm ntsi Hebron bɛyɛɛ Kaleb, Jefune ne babanyin Keniznyi no, n’egyapadze dze bodu ndɛ da yi; osiandɛ ɔdze n’akoma nyinara dzii EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no n’ekyir.
Asɔpɔn no nkyɛ Hebron ne dzin nye Kiriat-arba; Arba no nye Anakfo mu nyimpa kɛse koraa. Na asaase no do dwee wɔ ɔko ho.
Judamba ebusuakuw kyɛfa, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no si Edom he do, mekyerɛ Zin sar do pomu afamu, wɔ pomu afamu ekyir noho ara.
Na hɔn pomu afamu he no hyɛ ase fi Nkyen Po no n’ano a obu fa pomu afamu noho ara:
na ɔdze nam Akrabbim no mfowee mu pomu afamu, na otwa mu kɔ Zin, na ɔfow kɔ Kades-barnea no pomu afamu, na otwa mu wɔ Hezron ho, na ɔfow kɔ Addar, na ɔdan kɔ Karka:
na otwa mu kɔ Azmon, na ɔdze pue Egypt ɔwora no do; na ɔhe no n’edzifir wɔ po ho: iyi nyɛ hom pomu afamu he.
Na boka afamu he nye Nkyen Po no, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu Jordan ewiei. Na kwaamu afamu he no ofi po no ho wɔ Jordan ewiei:
na ɔhe no fow kɔ Bɛt-hogla, na otwa mu fa Bɛt-araba no kwaamu afamu; na ɔhe no fow kɔ Reuben ne babanyin Bohan ɔbo no ho:

na ɔhe no fi Akor ɔbɔn mu fow kɔ Debir, na ɔdze no dɛmara kɔ kwaamu afamu, dze hwɛ Gilgal a ɔwɔ Adummim mfowee a ɔwɔ esutsen no no pomu afamu no tsentsendo no: na ɔhe no twa mu kɔ En-semes nsu no ho, na n’edzifir wɔ En-rogel:

na ɔhe no fow fa Hinom ne babanyin no bɔnsa no mu dze kodu Jebusfo nkyɛnmu wɔ pomu afamu a ɔnoara nye Jerusalɛm: na ɔhe no fow kɔ bepɔw a ɔda Hinom ɔbɔn no enyim anee afamu a ɔwɔ Refaim ɔbɔn no n’ano noho ara wɔ kwaamu afamu n’etsifi:
na ɔhe no hima fi bepɔw no etsifi kɔ Nefitoa nsu no no nsunyiwa ho, na ɔfow kɔ Efron bepɔw do nkurow no ho; na ɔhe no hima kɔ Baala a ɔnoara nye Kiriat-jearim:
na ɔhe no dze dan fi Baala anee afamu kɔ bepɔw Seir ho, na otwa mu kɔ bepɔw Jearim ne nkyɛnmu wɔ kwaamu afamu a ɔnoara nye Kesalom, na osian kɔ Bɛt-semes, na otwa mu wɔ Timna ho:
na ɔhe no dze pue kɔ Ekron nkyɛnmu kwaamu afamu: na ɔhe no hima kɔ Sikeron, na otwa mu kɔ bepɔw Baala ho, na ɔdze pue wɔ Jabneel; na ɔhe no n’edzifir wɔ po no ho.
Na anee afamu ɔhe no nye po kɛse no, nye ne he. Iyi nye Judamba he a otwa hyia dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na ɔmaa Jefune ba Kaleb kyɛfa wɔ Judamba no mu, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE ne mbrasɛm a ɔdze maa Josua no tse, mekyerɛ Kiriat-arba, Arba no a ɔyɛ Anak n’egya no a ɔnoara nye Hebron.
Na Kaleb tuu Anak ne mbabanyin baasa no fii hɔ, Sesai, nye Ahiman, nye Talmai, Anakmba no.
Na ofi hɔ fowee kɔr Debir a nkan no na ne dzin nye Kiriat-Sefer no do.
Na Kaleb see dɛ, Nyia ɔbɔbɔ Kiriat-sefer, na ɔagye no, ɔno na medze me babaa Aksa bɛma no ayewar.
Na Kaleb no nua Kenaz ne babanyin Otiniel, kɛgyee: na ɔdze ne babaa Aksa maa no ayewar.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a basia no baa ne nkyɛn no, Otiniel nunuu no dɛ ombisa n’egya hɔ haban bi; na aber a Aksa fi n’asoaso do dwirii no; Kaleb bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na erohwehwɛ?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ma me akyɛdze; sɛ edze me esi Pomu afamu asaase do a, nna ma me mbasu so. Na ɔdze etsifi mbasu nye anaafo mbasu no maa no.
Iyi nye Judamba ebusuakuw no hɔn egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na Judamba ebusuakuw no hɔn ano wɔ nkurow a odzi kɔ Edom he do wɔ Pomu afamu no nye Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur;
Kina, Dimona, Adada;
Kedes, Hazor, nye Itnan;
Zif, nye Telem, Bealot;
Hazor-hadata, Keriot-hezron a ɔnoara nye Hazor;
Amam, Sema, Molada.
Bi so nye Hazor-gada, Hesmon, Bɛt-pelet;
Hazor-sual, Beer-seba, Biziotia;
Baala, Iim, Ezem.
Nkurow nkaa no nye Eltolad, Kesil, Horma;
Ziklag, Madmanna, Sansanna;
Lebaot, Silhim, Ain, nye Rimmon: nkurow no nyinara yɛ eduonu akron, ɔnye no nkuraase.
Ɔbɔnmu nkurow no nye Estaol, Zora, Asna;
Zanoa, En-gannim, Tappua, Enam;
Jarmut, Adullam, Soko, Azeka;
Saaraim, Adithaim, Gedera, nye Gederotaim; nkurow duanan ɔnye no nkuraase.
Na nkurow no bi so nye Zenan, Hadasa, Migdal-gad;
Dilan, Mizpe, Jokteel;
Lakis, Bozkat, Eglon;
Kabbon, Lahman, Kitlis;
Gederot, Bɛt-dagon, Naama, nye Makeda; nkurow duesia ɔnye no nkuraase.
Libna, Eter, Asan;
Ifta, Asna, Nezib;
Keila, Akizib nye Maresa; nkurow akron nye no nkuraase.
Ekron, ɔnye no ho nkurow nye no nkuraase:
ofi Ekron araa dze kodu po no ho, dza ɔwɔ Ashdod nkyɛnmu nyinara, ɔnye no nkuraase.
Ashdod, no ho nkurow nye no nkuraase; Gaza, no ho nkurow nye no nkuraase; dze kodu Egypt ɔwora, nye po kɛse no, nye ne he ho.
Nkokodo nkurow no, Samir, Jattir, Soko;
Danna, Kiriat-sanna a ɔnoara nye Debir:
Anab, Estemo, Anim;
Gosen, Holon, Gilo; nkurow dubiako ɔnye no nkuraase.
Arab, Duma, Esan;
Janom, Bɛt-tappua, Afeka;
Humta, nye Kiriat-arba a ɔnoara nye Hebron, nye Zior; nkurow akron ɔnye no nkuraase.
Maon, Karmel, Zif, Juta;
Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoa;
Kain, Gibea, nye Timna; nkurow du ɔnye no nkuraase.
Halhul, Bɛt-zur, Gedor;
Maarat, Bɛt-anot, Eltekon; nkurow esia ɔnye no nkuraase.
Kiriat-baal a ɔnoara nye Kiriat-jearim, nye Rabaa; nkurow ebien nye no nkuraase.
Sar no do nkurow no nye Bɛt-araba, Middin, Sekaka;
Nibsan, Nkyen Kurow no nye Engedi; nkurow esia ɔnye no nkuraase.
Na Jebusfo no dze, nkorɔfo a wɔtse Jerusalɛm no, Judamba enntum enntu hɔn: mbom Jebusfo no wɔnye Judamba no tsenaa Jerusalɛm dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na Josefmba kyɛfa no ɔdze pue fi Jeriko Jordan, wɔ Jeriko nsu ho wɔ boka afamu, mekyerɛ sar no a ɔdze fi Jeriko fow kodua nkokodo nkurow no mu kɔ Bɛtɛl no;
na ɔdze pue fi Bɛtɛl kɔ Luz, na otwa mu kɔ Arkifo he do wɔ Atarot;
na osian anee afamu kɔ Jaflɛtefo he do, dze kodu anaafo Bɛt-horon he do, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu Gezer: na n’edzifir wɔ po no ho.
Iyi nye Josefmba no, Manaasɛ nye Efraim, hɔn egyapadze.
Na Efraimmba no hɔn he, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no nye yi: mekyerɛ hɔn egyapadze ne he wɔ boka afamu nye Atarot-addar, dze kodu etsifi Bɛt-horon;
na ɔhe no dze pue anee afamu wɔ Mikemetat wɔ kwaamu afamu; na ɔhe no dze dan fa boka afamu kɔ Tanaat-siloh, na otwa mu wɔ ho wɔ Janoa no boka afamu;
na ofi Janoa sian kɔ Atarot, nye Naara, na okodu Jeriko, na ɔdze pue Jordan ho.
Ɔhe no fi Tappua nam anee afamu dze kɔ Kana ɔwora no ho; na n’edzifir wɔ po no ho. Iyi nye Efraimmba ebusuakuw egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee;
dze ka nkurow a woyiyii maa Efraimmba no wɔ Manaasɛmba egyapadze mu no ho, nkurow no nyinara nye no nkuraase.
Naaso woenntu Keenanfo a wɔtse Gezer no: mbom Keenanfo no tsenaa Efraim finimfin dze bodu ndɛ da yi, na Efraimfo no hyɛɛ hɔn ma wɔyɛɛ ɔsom edwuma.
Iyi nye Manaasɛ n’ebusuakuw kyɛfa: osiandɛ ɔyɛ Josef n’abakan. Manaasɛ n’abakan Makir, Gilead n’egya no dze, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔsabarimba no ntsi onyaa Gilead nye Basan.

Na kyɛfa no yɛ Manaasɛmba nkaa no dze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee. Iyinom nye Abiezermba, Helekmba, Asrielmba, Sekemmba, Hefermba, nye Semidamba no dze: woyinom nye Josef babanyin Manaasɛ ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na Zelofehad a n’egya nye Hefer a ɔyɛ Manaasɛ ne babanyin Makir ne babanyin no dze, oennya mbabanyin dɛ mbabaa ara nko: na iyinom nye ne mbabaa no hɔn edzin, Mahala, Noa, Hogla, Milka, nye Tirza.

Na wɔbaa ɔsɔfo Eleazar, na Nun babanyin Josua, nye mbapɔmba no enyim, dɛ, EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses dɛ ɔmma hɛn egyapadze wɔ hɛn nuanom mu: dɛm ntsi ɔmaa hɔn egyapadze wɔ hɔn egya no nuanom no mu dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE ne mbrasɛm no tse.
Na nkyekyɛmu du kɔr Manaasɛ afamu, ɔsor Gilead nye Basan asaase a ɔwɔ Jordan egya no;
osiandɛ Manaasɛ mbabaa no nyaa egyapadze wɔ ne mbabanyin no mu: na Gilead asaase no yɛɛ Manaasɛ mbabanyin nkaa no dze.
Na Manaasɛ ne he fi Aser kɔ Mikemetat (Mikmethath) a ɔwɔ Sekem enyim no; na ɔhe no dze nam enyimfa araa kodu Entapuafo ehyiae.
Tappua asaase no yɛ Manaasɛ dze: na Tappua a ɔwɔ Manaasɛ he do no dze ɔyɛ Efraimmba no dze.
Na ɔhe no sian kɔ Kana ɔwora no ho, wɔ ɔwora no no pomu afamu: nkurow yi yɛ Efraim dze wɔ Manaasɛ no nkurow no mu: na Manaasɛ ne he no ɔwɔ ɔwora no no kwaamu afamu, na n’edzifir wɔ po no ho:
pomu afamu no Efraim dze a, na kwaamu afamu no Manaasɛ dze a, na po no nye ne he; na okehyia Aser wɔ kwaamu afamu.

Na Manaasɛ nyae wɔ Isakar nye Aser mu Bɛt-sean nye no ho nkurow, Ibleam nye no ho nkurow, nye hɔn a wɔtse Dor nye no ho nkurow, hɔn a wɔtse En-dor nye no ho nkurow, Taanak nye no ho nkurow, na hɔn a wɔtse Megiddo nye no ho nkurow, mekyerɛ akoko ebiasa no.
Naaso Manaasɛmba enntum enntu hɔn a wɔtsetse nkurow no mu no; na Keenanfo no pɛɛ dɛ wɔtsena asaase no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, Israelmba no ho yɛɛ dzen no, wɔhyɛɛ Keenanfo no ma wɔyɛɛ ɔsom edwuma mu, na mbom woenntu hɔn ase korakora.
Na Josefmba no kaa kyerɛɛ Josua dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze egyapadze kyɛfa kor nye nkyekyɛmu kor pɛ ama me, w’enyiwa tua dɛ meyɛ ɔman kɛse, susuampa dɛ EWURADZE ehyira me araa dze ebodu ber yi?
Na Josua see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ ɔman kɛse a, nna fow kɔ kwaa no mu, na kobu hɔ fa ma woho wɔ Perizfo nye Refafo asaase no do; osiandɛ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no suar dodow ma wo.

Na Josefmba no see dɛ, Nkokodo nkurow no nndɔɔ so mma hɛn: na Keenanfo a wɔtsetse ɔbɔn no n’asaase do nyinara wɔwowɔ dadze ntseaseanam, hɔn a wɔwɔ Bɛt-sean nye no ho nkurow nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Jezreel ɔbɔn no mu nyina.
Na Josua kasaa kyerɛɛ Josef fie, mekyerɛ Efraim nye Manaasɛ, dɛ, Ɔwo yɛ ɔman kɛse, na ewɔ tum kɛse: nnyɛ kyɛfa kor pɛ bi na ibenya:
mbom nkokodo nkurow no nyɛ wodze; osiandɛ ɔyɛ kwaa mpo a, ɔwoara na ibobu, na n’edzifir bɛyɛ wodze: osiandɛ ibotu Keenanfo no, kaansa wɔwowɔ dadze ntseaseanam, na wɔyɛ dzen mpo a.
Na Israelmba no nyinara poon hɔnho kehyiae wɔ Siloh, na wosii ehyiadzibuw no wɔ hɔ: na wɔberɛɛ asaase no adze wɔ hɔn enyim.
Na ɔkaa Israelmba mu ebusuakuw esuon a wonnyae nnkyɛɛ hɔn egyapadze.
Na Josua bisaa Israelmba no dɛ, Hom rotwetwe homho araa ma ekodu aber bɛn ana hom akɔ akɛfa asaase a EWURADZE, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn, dze ama hom no?
Hom ntutu hom mu nyimpa, ebusuakuw nyinara mu baasa baasa: na monsoma hɔn, ma wɔnsoɛr nkekyima asaase no mu, na wɔnkyerɛw no nwoma mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ hɔn egyapadze; na wɔmbra mo hɔ.
Na wɔnkyɛ mu kyɛpɛn esuon: Juda ntsena ne he do wɔ kwaamu afamu.
Na hom nkyerɛw asaase no kyɛpɛn esuon, na hom mfa nkyerɛwee no mbrɛ me ha: na montwe ho tonto mma hom wɔ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim ha.

Na Levifo no dze, wonnyi kyɛpɛn wɔ hom mu; osiandɛ EWURADZE asɔfodzi no nye hɔn egyapadze: na Gad nye Reuben nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no enya hɔn egyapadze wɔ Jordan egya boka afamu a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze maa hɔn no.

Na mbanyin no soɛree, na wɔkɔree: na Josua hyɛɛ hɔn a wɔrokɔ akɛkyerɛw asaase no dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkekyima asaase no mu, na wɔnkyerɛw, na wɔnsan mbra mo hɔ bio, na montwe ho tonto mma hom wɔ EWURADZE enyim ha wɔ Siloh.
Na mbanyin no kɔree koduaduaa asaase no mu, na wɔkyerɛɛw no dɛ mbrɛ nkurow no tsetsee kyɛpɛn esuon wɔ nwoma mu, na wɔbaa Josua hɔ wɔ nsera mu wɔ Siloh.
Na Josua twee ho tonto maa hɔn wɔ Siloh wɔ EWURADZE enyim: na hɔ na Josua kyɛɛ asaase no maa Israelmba no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyekyɛmu tsetsee.
Na Benjaminmba ebusuakuw kyɛfa no baa dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: na hɔn kyɛfa ne he fir edzi wɔ Judamba nye Josefmba ntamu.
Na hɔn he wɔ kwaamu afamu, na ɔfow kodu nkokodo nkurow no mu wɔ anee afamu; na n’edzifir wɔ Bɛt-aven sar do.
Na ɔhe no twa mu fi hɔ kɔ Luz, wɔ Luz ne nkyɛnmu a ɔnoara nye Bɛtɛl, pomu afamu; na ɔhe no dze sian kɔ Atarot-addar, wɔ bepɔw a ɔda anaafo Bɛt-horon no pomu afamu.

Na ɔhe no hima na ɔdze dan kɔ anee afamu pomu afamu, dze fi bepɔw a ɔda Bɛt-horon enyim wɔ pomu afamu: na n’edzifir wɔ Kiriat-baal a ɔnoara nye Kiriat-jearim, Judamba kurow no bi a: anee afamu dze nye yi.
Na pomu afamu dze fi Kiriat-jearim n’ano noho ara, na ɔhe no fir edzi wɔ anee afamu, na ɔdze fir kɔ Nefitoa nsu no no nsunyiwa ho:
na ɔhe no sian kɔ bepɔw a ɔda Hinom babanyin ɔbɔn no a ɔwɔ Refafo ɔbɔn no no kwaamu afamu no n’enyim no n’ano noho ara; na osian kɔ Hinom ɔbɔn mu, wɔ Jebusfo nkyɛnmu pomu afamu, na osian kɔ En-rogel;
na ohima kɔ kwaamu afamu, na opue wɔ En-semes, na ofir edzi kɔ Gelilot a ɔwɔ Adummim mfowee ne tsentsendo; na osian kɔ Reuben babanyin Bohan ɔbo no no ho;
na otwa mu kesi nkyɛnmu wɔ Araba tsentsendo kwaamu afamu; na osian kodu Araba:
na ɔhe no twa mu kɔ Bɛt-hogla nkyɛnmu kwaamu afamu: na ɔhe no n’edzifir wɔ Nkyen Po no no kwaamu afamu ewiei: iyi nye pomu afamu he.
Na Jordan nye ne he wɔ boka afamu. Iyi nye Benjaminmba egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ n’ahe tsetsee dze hyia, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Afei Benjaminmba ebusuakuw nkurow dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no nye Jeriko, Bɛt-hogla, Emek-keziz;
Bɛt-araba, Zemaraim, Bɛtɛl;
Avim, nye Para; Ofra;
Kefar-ammoni, Ofini, nye Geba; nkurow duebien ɔnye no nkuraase:
Nkaa no nye Gibeon, Rama, Beerot;
Mizpe, Kefira, Moza;
Rekem, Irpeel, Tarala;
Zela, Ha-elef, Jebus a ɔnoara nye Jerusalɛm, Gibeat, nye Kiriat; nkurow duanan ɔnye no nkuraase. Iyi nye Benjaminmba no egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na kyɛfa a otsia ebien no bae maa Simeonmba ebusuakuw no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: nye hɔn egyapadze wɔ Judamba egyapadze no mu.
Na dza wonyae yɛɛ hɔn egyapadze nye Beer-seba, anaadɛ Seba, Molada;
Hazar-sual, Bala, Ezem;
Eltolad, Betul, Horma;
Ziklag, Bɛt-makabot, Hazar-susa;
Bɛt-lebaot, nye Saruhen; nkurow duebiasa ɔnye no nkuraase:
Ain, Rimmon, Eter, nye Asan; nkurow anan ɔnye no nkuraase:
nye nkuroba a ɔdeda nkurow yi ho hyia nyinara dze kodu Baalat-beer, Pomu afamu Rama. Iyi nye Simeonmba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Judamba afamu dze no mu na Simeonmba egyapadze fi: osiandɛ Judamba kyɛpɛn no dɔɔ so dodow ma hɔn: dɛm ntsi Simeonmba nyaa egyapadze wɔ hɔn egyapadze no mu.
Na kyɛfa a otsia ebiasa no bae maa Zebulunmba dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: na hɔn egyapadze ne he okodu Sarid:
na hɔn he fow kɔ anee afamu, mekyerɛ Marala, na okodu Dabbeset; dze kodu ɔwora no a ɔwɔ Jokmeam enyim no;
na ɔdze dan fi Sarid boka afamu wɔ wipuei afamu dze kodu Kislɔt-tabor (Kislɔt-tabor) he do: na ofir edzi kɔ Daberat, na ɔfow kɔ Jafia;
na hɔ na ofi kotwa mu wɔ boka afamu dze kɔ Gath-hefer dze kɔ Et-kazin; na ofir edzi wɔ Rimmon a ɔtsen dze kɔ Nea;
na ɔhe no dan fa ho wɔ kwaamu afamu dze kɔ Hannaton: na n’edzifir wɔ Ifta-el ɔbɔn no mu;
nye Katat, Nahalal, Simron, Idala, nye Bɛtlɛhɛm: nkurow duebien nye no nkuraase.
Iyi nye Zebulunmba egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow yi nye no nkuraase.
Kyɛfa a otsia anan no bae maa Isakarmba no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he kodu Jezreel, Kesulɔt, Sunem;
Hafaraim, Sion, Anaharat;
Rabit, Kision, Ebez;
Remet, Engannim, En-hadda, nye Bɛt-pazez;
na ɔhe no dze kodu Tabor, Sahazuma, nye Bɛt-semes; nye hɔn he a n’edzifir wɔ Jordan; nkurow duesia ɔnye no nkuraase.
Iyi nye Isakarmba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow no ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Na kyɛfa a otsia enum no bae maa Asermba ebusuakuw dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he nye Helkat, Hali, Beten, Aksaf;
Allam-melek, Amad nye Misal; na ɔdze kodu Karmel anee afamu, nye Sihor-libnat;
na ɔdze dan wipuei afamu kɔ Bɛt-dagon na okodu Zebulun, nye Ifta-el ɔbɔn mu wɔ kwaamu afamu dze kɔ Bɛt-emek nye Neiel; na ofir edzi kɔ Kabul wɔ bankum afamu,
nye Ebron, Rehob, Hamon, Kana dze kɔ Zidon kɛse;
na ɔhe no dan kɔ Rama, na okodu Taere kurow a wɔagye ho ban no; na ɔsan dan kɔ Hosa; na n’edzifir wɔ Akizib mbew ho po no ho:
Umma so, nye Afek, nye Rehob: nkurow eduonu ebien ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Iyi nye Asermba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow yi ɔnye no nkurobaase.
Kyɛfa a otsia esia no bae maa Naftalimba no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn he fi Zaanannim esudur no ho, nye Adami-nekeb, nye Jabneel dze kɔ Lakum; na n’edzifir wɔ Jordan:
na ɔhe no dan fa anee afamu kɔ Aznoth-tabor, na ɔdze fi hɔ pue Hukok; na okodu Zebulun wɔ pomu afamu, na okodu Aser wɔ anee afamu, na okodu Juda wɔ Jordan wipuei afamu.
Na nkurow a wɔagye ho ban no nye Zidim, Zer, Hama, Rakat, Kinneret;
Adama, Rama, Hazor;
Kedes, Edrei, En-hazor;
Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Bɛt-anat, nye Bɛt-semes; nkurow duakron ɔnye no nkuraase.
Iyi nye Naftalimba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Kyɛfa a otsia esuon no bae maa Danmba ebusuakuw dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
Na hɔn egyapadze he nye Zora, Estaol, Ir-semes;
Saalabbin, Aijalon, Itla;
Elon, Timna, Ekron;
Elteke, Gibeton, Baalat;
Jehud, Bene-berak, Gat-rimmon;
Me-jarkon, nye Rakon, na ɔhe no a ɔwɔ Jopa tsentsendo no.

Na Danmba hɔn he no fir edzi tra hɔn: osiandɛ Danmba no fowee kɔree nye Lesem kɔkoe, na wɔgyee, na wɔdze afona bɔɔ no, na wɔfae, na wɔtsenaa mu, na wɔfrɛɛ Lesem dɛ Dan, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egya Dan ne dzin tse.
Iyi nye Danmba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow yi nye no nkuraase.
Na wowiee asaase no kyɛ dze yɛɛ egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ n’ahe no tsetsee no; na Israelmba no dze egyapadze bi maa Nun ne babanyin Josua wɔ hɔn mu:
dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm tse no na wɔdze kurow a obisae no maa no, mekyerɛ Timnat-sera wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu: na ɔkyekyeer kurow no, na ɔtsenaa mu.

Iyi nye egyapadze a ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua, nye Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu egyanom efiefi etsitsir no, nam tontotwe do kyɛe wɔ Siloh wɔ EWURADZE enyim, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano. Na wowiee asaase no mu kyɛ.
Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Josua dɛ;
Ka kyerɛ Israelmba no dɛ, Hom nyiyi guansumabew nkurow a menam Moses do kaa kyerɛɛ hom no:
na obi a ɔnndze enyidaho na oboku nyimpa bi awerɛfir mu no nguan nkɔ hɔ: na ɔnyɛ hom guansumabew mfi bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no nsa.

Dɛm nyimpa no nguan nkɔ nkurow no kor mu, na onkegyina kurow no n’abotsen ano, na ɔnka n’asɛm wɔ kurow no ne mpanyimfo asomu; na wɔmfa no nkɔ hɔn nkyɛn wɔ kurow no mu, na wɔmma no beebi ma ɔntsena wɔ hɔn mu.
Na sɛ bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no tsiw ba a, ɔno mma wonnyi onyimpakumfo no nnhyɛ ne nsa; osiandɛ okum ne nyɛnko awerɛfir mu, na ɔnntan no dada bi.

Na ɔntsena kurow no mu, nkodu dɛ obegyina amamfo no enyim agye atsɛmbu, nkodu dɛ ɔsɔfopanyin a ɔwɔ do dɛm mber no mu no bowu: na nkyii onyimpakumfo no nsan mbra nankasa no kurow a ofi mu guanee no mu.
Na woyiyii Kades wɔ Galilii wɔ Naftali nkokodo nkurow no mu, nye Sekem wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, nye Kiriat-arba a ɔnoara nye Hebron wɔ Juda nkokodo nkurow no mu.
Na Jeriko Jordan egya boka afamu no, woyii Bezer wɔ sar no do wɔ tɛtɛr no mu fii Reuben ebusuakuw mu, nye Ramot wɔ Gilead fi Gad ebusuakuw mu, nye Golan wɔ Basan fii Manaasɛ ebusuakuw mu.

Iyinom nye nkurow a woyiyii sisii hɔ maa Israelmba nyinara, nye ɔhɔho a ɔabɔsoɛ hɔn mu no, dɛ obiara a oku nyimpa bi wɔ ber a ɔnndze enyidaho no nguan nkɔ hɔ, na oeennwu wɔ bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no nsamu, nkodu dɛ obegyina amamfo no enyim.
Nna Levifo egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no baa ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua, nye Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no hɔ;
na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ Siloh wɔ Keenan asaase do, dɛ, EWURADZE nam Moses nsa do hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma hɛn nkurow ma yɛntsena mu, ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase mma hɛn fiembowa.
Na Israelmba no dze hɔn egyapadze no mu nkurow bi nye no ho mfikyisaase maa Levifo no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm no tse.
Na kyɛfa no bae maa Kohatfo ebusua ebusua, na ɔsɔfo Aaronmba no a wofi Levifo mu no, nam tontotwe do nyae fii Juda, Simeon nye Benjamin ebusuakuw mu nkurow duebiasa.
Na Kohatmba nkaa no nam tontotwe do nyae fii Efraim, Dan, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no mu nkurow du.
Na Gersonmba no nam tontotwe do nyae fii Isakar, Aser, Naftali, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no a ɔwɔ Basan no mu, nkurow duebiasa.
Merarimba dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee nyaa Reuben, Gad, nye Zebulun ebusuakuw mu nkurow duebien.
Na Israelmba no nam tontotwe do dze nkurow yi nye no ho mfikyisaase maa Levifo no dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE nam Moses nsa do hyɛe no.
Na wɔdze Judamba, nye Simeonmba ebusuakuw mu nkurow a wɔabobɔ edzin yi mae:
na ɔwɔ hɔ ma Aaronmba a wofi Kohat ebusua ebusua mu a wɔwɔ Levimba mu no: na hɔndze nye kyɛfa a odzi kan no.
Na wɔdze Kiriat-arba maa hɔn, Arba no a ɔyɛ Anak n’egya no, a ɔnoara nye Hebron no, wɔ Juda nkokodo nkurow no mu, ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase a etwa ho ehyia no.
Na kurow no ho haban, nye no nkuraase no dze, wɔdze maa Jefune babanyin Kaleb dɛ n’enyadze.
Na ɔsɔfo Aaronmba no, wɔdze onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Hebron, nye Libna;
Jattir, Estemoa;
Holon, Debir;
Ain, Juta, na Bɛt-semes nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; ebusuakuw ebien no mu nkurow akron.
Na Benjamin ebusuakuw mu dze nye Gibeon, Geba;
Anathot, na Almon nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Aaronmba, asɔfo no, hɔn nkurow nyinara yɛ nkurow duebiasa nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase.
Na Kohatmba, Levifo no, ebusua ebusua no, mekyerɛ Kohatmba nkaa no, wonyaa hɔn kyɛfa nkurow fi Efraim ebusuakuw mu.
Na wɔdze onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Sekem nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu maa hɔn, nye Gezer;
Kibzaim, Bɛt-horon nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Na Dan ebusuakuw mu dze, Elteke, Gibeton;
Aijalon, nye Gat-rimmon nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no mu dze, Taanak nye Gat-rimmon nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow ebien.
Nkurow a ɔyɛ Kohatmba nkaa no hɔn ebusua ebusua no dze nyinara yɛ du nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase.
Na Gersonmba a wofi Levi ebusua ebusua no mu no, wɔmaa hɔn Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no mu onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Golan wɔ Basan; nye Be-estera nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow ebien.
Na Isakar ebusuakuw mu dze, Kision, Daberat;
Jarmut, nye En-gannim nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Na Aser ebusuakuw mu dze, Misal, Abdon;
Helkat nye Rehob nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase, nkurow anan.
Na Naftali ebusuakuw mu dze, onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Kedes wɔ Galilii, nye ne mfikyisaase, Hamot-dor nye Kartan nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow ebiasa.
Gersonfo nkurow nyinara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee yɛ nkurow duebiasa nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase.
Na Merarimba ebusua ebusua, Levifo nkaa no, wɔmaa hɔn Zebulun ebusuakuw mu, Jokmeam, Karta,
Dimna, nye Nahalal nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Na Reuben ebusuakuw mu dze, Bezer, Jahaz,
Kedemot, nye Mefaat nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
Na Gad ebusuakuw mu dze, onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Ramot wɔ Gilead ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Mahanaim;
Hesbon, nye Jazer nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; ne nyinara yɛ nkurow anan.
Iyi nyinara nye Merarimba nkurow dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, mekyerɛ Levifo ebusua ebusua nkaa no; na hɔn kyɛfa yɛ nkurow duebien.
Levifo nkurow a ɔwɔ Israelmba hɔn enyadze mu nyinara yɛ nkurow eduanan awɔtwe nye no ho mfikyisaase.
Nkurow yi nyinara wowɔ mfikyisaase a abobɔ ho aprɔw: na nkurow yi nyinara mbrɛ ɔtsetsee ara nye no.
Nna EWURADZE dze asaase a ɔkaa ho ntam dɛ ɔdze bɛma hom egyanom no nyinara maa Israel; na wɔfae, na wɔtsenaa do.
Na EWURADZE maa hɔn ahomgye hyiae, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom no nyinara: na hɔn atamfo nyinara mu obiara enntum enngyina hɔn enyim; EWURADZE yii hɔn atamfo nyinara hyɛɛ hɔn nsa.
Asɛm papa biara a EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Israelfo no mu biribiara anntɔ famu: ne nyinara baa mu.
Nna Josua frɛɛ Reubenfo, Gadfo, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no,
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom edzi dza EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze hyɛɛ hom no nyinara do, na hom etsie me ndze wɔ dza mehyɛɛ hom nyinara mu:
hom nndaan hom nuanom nngyaa hɔ nda pii yi dze bodu ndɛ da yi, mbom hom edzi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne mbrasɛm no do.

Na afei EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze ahomgye ama hom nuanom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no: dɛm ntsi afei hom ndzi ndan, na hom nkɔ hom asesee mu wɔ hom kyɛfa asaase a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze maa hom wɔ Jordan egya no.

Yie nko ara na hom nhwɛ ndzi mbrasɛm nye mbra no a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze hyɛɛ hom, dɛ hom ndɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, na hom nnantsew n’akwan nyinara mu, na hom ndzi ne mbransɛm nyinara do, na hom ntakyer no ho, na hom mfa hom akoma nyinara nye hom kra nyinara nsom no no do.
Nna Josua hyiraa hɔn, na ogyaa hɔn kwan: na wosii mu kɔr hɔn asesee mu.

Afei Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa kor no nna Moses ama hɔn egyapadze wɔ Basan: na ɔfa kor no so Josua maa hɔn bi wɔ hɔn nuanom mu wɔ Jordan egya anee afamu. Na aber a Josua rigya hɔn kwan ma wɔaakɔ hɔn asesee mu no, ohyiraa hɔn,
na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Ahonyadze pii, nye fiembowa piigyan, dwetɛ, sika, boran, dadze, na ntar piigyan na hom mfa nsan nkɔ hom asesee mu; na hom nye hom nuanom nkyɛ hom atamfo asadze no.

Na Reubenmba, Gadmba nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no sanee, na wofii Israelmba no nkyɛn wɔ Siloh a ɔwɔ Keenan asaase do sii mu kɔree, dɛ wɔrokɔ Gilead asaase do, wɔ hɔn enyadze asaase a woekenya no do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm a ɔnam Moses nsa do no tse no.
Na aber a wodur Jordan ho mbew a ɔwɔ Keenan asaase do no do no, Reubenmba nye Gadmba nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no sii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, afɔrmbukyia a wɔhwɛ a ɔso a.

Na Israelmba nkaa no tsee dɛ wɔ dɛ, Hwɛ, Reubenmba, Gadmba nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no esi afɔrmbukyia wɔ Keenan asaase enyim tsentsendo, wɔ Jordan ho mbew no do, wɔ afa a ɔyɛ Israelmba afamu dze no do.
Na aber a Israelmba no tsee no, hɔn nyinara poon hɔnho hyiae wɔ Siloh, dɛ wontu hɔn do sa.
Na Israelmba no somaa ɔsɔfo Eleazar babanyin Finehas ma ɔkɔr Reubenmba, Gadmba, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no hɔ, wɔ Gilead asaase do;
na mbapɔmba du ka no ho, Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu egya fie ɔbapɔmba kor; na hɔn nyinara yɛ egyanom efiefi do etsitsir wɔ Israel mpempem no mu.
Na wɔbaa Reubenmba, Gadmba, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no nkyɛn, wɔ Gilead asaase do, na wɔnye hɔn kasaa dɛ,
Mbrɛ EWURADZE no dɔm nyina se nye yi, Ebɛn mfom na hom dze afom Israel Nyankopɔn yi, dɛ ndɛ da yi hom adan efi EWURADZE ekyir dzi, wɔ dɛ hom esi afɔrmbukyia ama homho, dze retsew EWURADZE do etua yi?
Ana Peor emumuyɛ no a ɔdze ɔhaw baa EWURADZE no dɔm do ma mpo ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi ara hɛn ho nntsew wɔ mu no, suar dodoodow ma hɛn,
ma ntsi ndɛ da yi hom adan efi EWURADZE ekyir dzi yi? Na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔnam dɛ hom retsew EWURADZE do etua ndɛ da yi ntsi, ɔkyena no bo bofuw Israelmba no nyina.

Naaso sɛ hom enyadze asaase no ho nntsew a, ɔno hom ntwa mbra EWURADZE enyadze asaase a EWURADZE ntamadan si do no do, na wɔmbɛfa bi wɔ hɛn mu: na mbom mma hom nntsew etua wɔ hɛn do so, dɛ homara so risi afɔrmbukyia aka EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn n’afɔrmbukyia no ho.
Ana nnyɛ Akan, Zera babanyin no, na ɔfomee wɔ adze a wɔadom no no mu, na ebufuw baa Israelmba no nyinara do no bi? Ana Akan no nkotsee na owui wɔ n’emumuyɛ no mu?
Nna Reubenmba, Gadmba nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no buaa Israel mpempem mu etsitsir no dɛ,
EWURADZE, Otumfo Nyankopɔn no, EWURADZE, Otumfo Nyankopɔn no, ɔnoara na onyim, na Israel so bohu; sɛ ɔyɛ etuatsew mu o, sɛ mfom a yɛafom EWURADZE mu o, mma ɔwo nngye hɛn nkwa ndɛ da yi,
dɛ yeesi afɔrmbukyia ama hɛnho dɛ yɛdze bɛdan efi EWURADZE ekyir dzi; anaadɛ yɛbɔbɔ do ɔhyew afɔr anaa edziban afɔr, anaa yɛbɔbɔ do asomdwee okum afɔr a, EWURADZE noara mbisa hɛn;
na sɛ mbom nnyɛ ahwɛyie bi ntsi, na asɛm bi ntsi na yɛayɛ iyi a, dɛ, Daakye bi hom mba bɛka akyerɛ hɛn mba dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom nye EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn wɔ yɛ?
Na EWURADZE dze Jordan ayɛ ɔhe ato hɛn nye hom, Reubenmba nye Gadmba ntamu; hom nnyi kyɛfa wɔ EWURADZE mu: dɛm na hom mba bɛyɛ hɛn mba ma woeegyaa EWURADZE suro.
Dɛm ntsi na yɛsee dɛ, Wɔmma afei yensiesie hɛnho nsi afɔrmbukyia mma hɛnho, nnyɛ ɔhyew afɔr, na nnyɛ okum afɔr so ntsi a:

na mbom dɛ ɔnyɛ dase wɔ hɛn nye hom ntamu, nye hɛn mbasantsen a wobedzi hɛn ekyir no ntamu, na yɛdze hɛn ɔhyew afɔr, na ɔnye hɛn okum afɔr, nye hɛn asomdwee afɔr, ayɛ EWURADZE edwuma no wɔ n’enyim; amma daakye bi hom mba aannse hɛn mba dɛ, Hom nnyi kyɛfa wɔ EWURADZE mu.

Dɛm ntsi na yɛsee dɛ, Ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ daakye bi wɔse hɛn anaa hɛn mbasantsen dɛm a, yɛbɛse dɛ, Hom nhwɛ EWURADZE afɔrmbukyia no ne saso a hɛn egyanom yɛe, nnyɛ ɔhyew afɔr ntsi, na nnyɛ okum afɔr so ntsi; mbom ɔyɛ dase wɔ hɛn nye hom ntamu.

Nyame mpa ngu dɛ yɛbɛtsew etua wɔ EWURADZE do, na yɛadan efi EWURADZE ekyir dzi ndɛ da yi, dɛ yebesi afɔrmbukyia abɔ do ɔhyew afɔr, edziban afɔr, anaa okum afɔr, aka EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia a ɔwɔ ne ntamadan no enyim no ho.
Na aber a ɔsɔfo Finehas, nye Israelmba no mu mbapɔmba no, mekyerɛ mpempem mu etsitsir a wɔka no ho no, tsee nsɛm a Reubenmba nye Gadmba nye Manaasɛmba no kae no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn enyisɔ dɛ.

Na ɔsɔfo Eleazar ne babanyin Finehas see Reubenmba nye Gadmba, nye Manaasɛmba no dɛ, Ndɛ da yi na yeehu dɛ EWURADZE wɔ hom finimfin, osiandɛ hom mmfaa mfom yi mmfoom EWURADZE: afei na hom eyi Israelmba no efi EWURADZE nsamu.
Na ɔsɔfo Eleazar ne babanyin Finehas, nye mbapɔmba no, sanee fi Reubenmba, nye Gadmba no nkyɛn wɔ Gilead asaase do, baa Keenan asaase do, Israelmba no nkyɛn, na wɔbɔbɔɔ hɔn amandzɛɛ.
Na asɛm no yɛɛ Israelmba enyisɔ; na Israelmba hyiraa Nyankopɔn, na wɔannka bio dɛ worutu hɔn do sa, wɔakɛsɛɛ asaase a Reubenmba nye Gadmba tse do no.
Na Reubenmba nye Gadmba frɛɛ afɔrmbukyia no Ed: Na, wɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ hɛn ntamu dase dɛ EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda pii n’ekyir no, wɔ aber a EWURADZE maa Israel ahomgye wɔ hɔn atamfo a woetwa hɔn ho ehyia nyinara nsamu no, nna Josua ayɛ akɔdaa na oedzi mfe pii.
Nna Josua kɛfrɛɛ Israel nyinara, hɔn mpanyimfo nye hɔn etsitsir, nye hɔn atsɛmbuafo nye hɔn ahwɛdofo, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mayɛ akɔdaa na medzi mfe pii:
na hom ehu dza osian hom ntsi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze ayɛ amanaman yi nyinara; na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn no, ɔnoara na ɔako ama hom.

Hom nhwɛ, medze tontotwe akyɛ amanaman a wɔaka yi mu ama hom, dɛ ɔnyɛ egyapadze mma hom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw, ofi Jordan ho, nye amanaman a metwitwa hɔn egu nyinara, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu po kɛse no ho ɔdze kɔ witɔree no.
Na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, no na obosunsun hɔn efi hom enyim, na oetu hɔn efi hom enyi do; na hom afa hɔn asaase dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn kaa kyerɛɛ hom no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nnya akokodur papaara dɛ wɔbɔhwɛ na wɔayɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra nwoma no mu nyinara, dɛ hom nnkɛdan efi ho akɔ enyimfa anaa abankum;
dɛ hom nnkɔkɔ amanaman yi a wɔakeka hom mu yi mu. Nkyii so mma hom mmbɔ hɔn enyame dzin, na mma hom mmfa hɔn nndzi nsew so, nkyii so mma hom nnsom hɔn, na hom mmbobɔ hom mu adze mma hɔn so:
mbom hom ntakyer EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ mbrɛ hom ayɛ dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
Na EWURADZE etu amanaman akɛse a wɔyɛ dzen efi hom enyim: na hom dze, nyimpa bi nngyinaa hom enyim dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
Hom mu nyimpa baako betsiw apem: na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn no, ɔnoara na ɔko ma hom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hom no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie papaara, dɛ hom bɔdɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.

Ɔno dze sɛ hom nam ɔkwan biara do san ekyir, na hom dze homho kɛbata amanaman nkaa yi ho, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔakeka hom mu yi ho, na hom nye hɔn dzi awarwar, na hom kɔ hɔn nkyɛn, na hɔn so ba hom nkyɛn a:

ɔnodze hom nhu ara ampa dɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn rennda ho nntu amanaman yi mmfi hom enyi do; mbom wɔbɛyɛ efir ama hom, nye mpire wɔ hom mfemu, na nsoɛ wɔ hom enyiwa mu, ekodu dɛ hom bɛsɛɛ efi asaase pa yi a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze ama hom yi do.

Na, hwɛ, ndɛ da yi morokɔ adasa nyinara kwan no bi: na hom nyim wɔ hom akoma nyinara mu nye hom akra nyinara mu dɛ asɛm kor nntɔɔ famu wɔ nsɛm pa a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn kae wɔ hom ho no nyinara mu; ne nyinara aba mu ama hom, no mu asɛm kor mpo anntɔ famu.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ nsɛm papa nyinara a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn kaa kyerɛɛ hom no aba hom do no, dɛmara so na EWURADZE dze nsɛm bɔn nyinara bɛba hom do, ekodu dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ hom efi asaase pa yi a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze ama hom yi do.

Sɛ hom to EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ahyɛmu a ɔdze hyɛɛ hom no, na hom kɔ kɔsom enyame fofor na hom bɔ hom mu adze ma hɔn a; ɔno EWURADZE n’ebufuw bɛdzɛw hom do, na ɔasɛɛ hom ntsɛm efi asaase pa no a ɔdze ama hom no do.
Na Josua poon Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara hyiaa Sekem, na ɔkɛfrɛɛ Israel mpanyimfo, nye hɔn etsitsir, nye hɔn ntsɛmbuafo, nye hɔn ahwɛdofo no; na wokehyiae wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na Josua see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Esu no n’egya na tsetseberdo no hom egyanom tsenae, mekyerɛ Tera, Abraham nye Nahor hɔn egya no: na wɔsoom enyame bi.
Na miyii hom egya Abraham fii Esu no n’egya na migyaa no faa Keenan asaase nyinara mu, na memaa n’asefo dɔree, na medze Isaak maa no.
Na medze Jakob nye Esau maa Isaak: na medze bepɔw Seir maa Esau, dɛ ɔmfa; na Jakob nye ne mba no sianee kɔr Egypt.
Na mosomaa Moses nye Aaron, na mehaaw Egypt, dɛ mbrɛ dza meyɛe no wɔ mu no tse no: na n’ekyir no miyii hom puei.
Na miyii hom egyanom fii Egypt: na hom baa po no ho: na Egyptfo dze ntseaseanam, na ɔnye mpɔnkɔdofo tsiiw hom egyanom baa Mbɛw Po no ho.
Na aber a wɔkekaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE no, ɔdze sum hyɛɛ hom nye Egyptfo no ntamu, na ɔdze po no baa hɔn do bɛkataa hɔn do; na hom enyiwa hun dza meyɛe no wɔ Egypt: na hom tsenaa sar no do nda pii.
Na medze hom baa Amorifo a wɔtse Jordan egya no asaase do; na wɔnye hom koe: na medze hɔn hyɛɛ hom nsa, na hom faa hɔn asaase no fae; na mesɛɛ hɔn wɔ hom enyim.
Nna Zipor babanyin, Moabhen no, soɛree nye Israel koe: na ɔsomae ma wokehyiaa Beor babanyin Balaam dɛ ɔmbɛpaa hom:
na mammpɛ dɛ mibetsie Balaam; dɛm ntsi nhyira ara na ohyiraa hom: nna miyii hom fii ne nsamu.
Na hom twaa Jordan, na wɔbaa Jeriko: na Jeriko mbarimba nye hom koe, Amorifo, Perizfo, Keenanfo, Hitifo, Girgasfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo; na miyii hɔn hyɛɛ hom nsa.
Na mosomaa nkotokrodo ma wodzii hom enyim, ma wɔpaam hɔn fii hom enyim, mekyerɛ Amorifo ahemfo beenu no; nnyɛ w’afona a, na nnyɛ w’egyen so a.
Na memaa hom asaase a hom annyɛ do edwuma, nye nkurow a nnyɛ hom bi kyekyeree, na hom tse mu; wenyin nture nye ngodua nture a ɔnnyɛ hom na hom tsetsɛwee naaso hom dzi yi.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nsuro EWURADZE, na hom nsom no turododo nye nokwar mu: na hom ntow enyame a hom egyanom somee wɔ Esu no n’egya, nye Egypt no ngu; na hom nsom EWURADZE.

Na sɛ ɔyɛ hom enyi do dɛ omuo dɛ hom bɔsom EWURADZE a, ɔno ndɛ da yi hom nsan mu nyi nyia hom bɔsom no; sɛ enyame a hom egyanom somee a wɔwɔ Esu no n’egya no o, Amorifo a hom tse hɔn asaase do yi enyame o: na emi nye me fi dze, yɛbɔsom EWURADZE.
Na ɔman no buae na wɔsee dɛ, Nyame mpa ngu dɛ yɛbɔpow EWURADZE, akɔsom enyame bi;

na EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn, ɔnoara nye nyia oyii hɛn nye hɛn egyanom wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom fi no mu, na ɔyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze akɛse no wɔ hɛn enyim mu, na ɔbɔɔ hɛn ho ban wɔ ɔkwan a yɛnam mu no nyinara mu, nye aman a yetwaa mu wɔ hɔn mu no nyinara mu:
na EWURADZE paam aman no nyinara wɔ hɛn enyim, Amorifo a wɔtse asaase no do no mpo: dɛm ntsi hɛn so yɛbɔsom EWURADZE; na ɔno nye hɛn Nyankopɔn.
Na Josua see ɔman no dɛ, Oho, Hom runntum nnsom EWURADZE; osiandɛ ɔyɛ Nyame krɔnkrɔn; ɔyɛ Nyame nyinkufo; ɔremmfa hom mbrato nye hom bɔn so nnkyɛ hom.
Sɛ hom pow EWURADZE, na wɔsom enyame ananaben a, ɔno ɔayɛ hom papa n’ekyir no, ɔbɛdan ayɛ hom bɔn, na ɔahyew hom.
Na ɔman no see Josua dɛ, Dabida; EWURADZE ara na yɛbɔsom no.
Na Josua see ɔman no dɛ, Homara nye hom ho adasefo dɛ hom asan mu afa EWURADZE dɛ hom bɔsom no. Na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛyɛ adasefo.
Dɛm ntsi, ɔsee dɛ, afei hom ntow enyame ananaben a wɔwɔ hom mu no ngu, na hom ndan hom akoma mma EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no.
Na ɔman no see Josua dɛ, EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn na yɛbɔsom no, na ne ndze na yebetsie.
Nna Josua nye ɔman no dzii ahyɛmu da no ara na ɔdze ahyɛdze nye mbra hyɛɛ hɔn wɔ Sekem.
Na Josua kyerɛɛw nsɛm yi wɔ Nyankopɔn ne mbra nwoma no mu: na ɔfaa ɔbo kɛse, na ɔdze sii hɔ wɔ esudur a osi EWURADZE no krɔnkrɔn bea no ho no ase.
Na Josua see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, Wɔnhwɛ o, ɔbo yi bɛyɛ hɛn ɔdasefo: osiandɛ ɔatse EWURADZE ne nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɛn no nyinara: dɛm ntsi ɔnyɛ hom ɔdasefo, amma hom ammpow hom Nyankopɔn.
Nna Josua gyaa ɔman no kwan, ma nyimpa biara kɔr n’egyapadze ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, Josua Nun ne babanyin no, EWURADZE n’akowaa no, wui, nna oedzi mfe ɔha nye du.
Na wosiee no wɔ n’asaase he do wɔ Timnat-sera a ɔwɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu no wɔ bepɔw Gaas no kwaamu afamu.
Na Israel soom EWURADZE Josua ne nda nyinara, nye mpanyimfo a Josua wui gyaa hɔn, na wohun EWURADZE n’edwuma nyinara a ɔyɛe maa Israel no, hɔn nda nyinara mu.
Na Josef mbiew a Israelmba dze fi Egypt bae no wosiee no wɔ Sekem, wɔ asaasetɔw a Jakob tɔɔ no wɔ Sekem n’egya Hamor ne mbabanyin no hɔ maa ndwetɛbona ɔha no mu: na ɔbɛyɛɛ Josefmba no egyapadze.
Na Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar wui; na wosiee no wɔ ne babanyin Finehas koko a wɔdze maa no wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu no do.
Na judua no wu ekyir no, Israelmba bisaa EWURADZE dɛ, Woana na ondzi kan ntu nkɔ Keenanfo do nye hɔn nkɔko mma hɛn?
Na EWURADZE buaa dɛ, Juda ntu nkɔ: hwɛ medze asaase no ahyɛ ne nsa.
Na Juda see no nua Simeon dɛ, Enye me nkɔ me kyɛfa mu, ma yɛnye Keenanfo nkɔko; na mo so menye wo bɔkɔ wo kyɛfa mu. Na Simeon nye no kɔree.
Na Juda tui kɔree: na EWURADZE dze Keenanfo nye Perizfo no hyɛɛ hɔn nsa: na wokum hɔn mu nyimpa mpem du wɔ Bezek.
Na wohun Adoni-bezek wɔ Bezek: na wɔnye no koe, na wokum Keenanfo nye Perizfo no.
Na Adoni-bezek guanee; na wotsiiw no, na kɛkyeer no wotwitwaa ne nsa kokrobetsir na n’anansɔba kokonyin.

Na Adoni-bezek see dɛ Ahemfo eduosuon a hɔn nsa kokrobetsir na hɔn anansɔba kokonyin etwitwa no tasetasee hɔn edziban wɔ mo pon ase: na dza meyɛe no, dɛmara so na Nyankopɔn ama me ho akatua yi. Na wɔdze no baa Jerusalɛm, na hɔ na owui.
Na Judamba no nye Jerusalɛm koe, na wɔgyee, na wɔdze anomu bɔɔ no, na wɔtoo kurow no mu gya.
Na n’ekyir no Judamba no kɔree kɛnyee Keenanfo a wɔtse nkokodo nkurow mu, na Pomu afamu, na ɔbɔnmu nkurow mu no koe.
Na Juda kɔr Keenanfo a wɔtse Hebron no do: nkyɛ nkan no nna Hebron ne dzin nye Kiriat-arba na wɔbɔɔ Sesai, na Ahiman, na Talmai.
Na hɔ na wofi kɔr Debirfo do. Afei Debir nkyɛ nkan no ne dzin nye Kiriat-sefer.
Na Kaleb see dɛ, Nyia ɔbɔbɔ Kiriat-sefer, na ɔbɛgye no medze me babaa Aksa bɛma no awar.
Na Kaleb no nua kuma Kenaz ne babanyin Otiniel kɛgyee; na ɔdze ne babaa Aksa maa no ayewar.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a basia no kɔr ne nkyɛn no, Otiniel dɛfɛdɛfɛɛw no dɛ ombisa n’egya hɔ haban bi; na aber a Aksa fi n’asoaso do dwirii no; Kaleb bisaa no dɛ, Erohwehwɛ ebɛnadze?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ma me akyɛdze; sɛ edze me esi Pomu afamu asaase do a, nna ma me mbasu so ɛ. Na Kaleb dze etsifi mbasu na anaafo mbasu no maa no.
Na Moses n’asew, Kennyi no ne mba no nye Judamba fi nkyiresua kurow no mu fowee kɔr Juda sar a ɔwɔ Arad pomu afamu no do; na wɔkɔree kɛnyee ɔman no tsenae.
Na Juda nye no nua Simeon kɔree, na wokokum Keenanfo a wɔtse Zefat no, na wɔsɛɛ no pasapasa. Na wɔfrɛɛ kurow no ne dzin Horma.
Na Juda kɛgyee Gaza nye ne he, na Ashkelon nye ne he, na Ekron nye ne he.
Na EWURADZE dzii Juda n’ekyir; na otuu nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ nkokodo nkurow mu no; na hɔn a wɔwɔ ɔbɔn no mu no dze, oenntum enntu hɔn, osiandɛ nna wɔwɔ dadze ntseaseanam.
Na wɔdze Hebron maa Kaleb, dɛ mbrɛ Moses kae no: na otuu Anak mbabanyin baasa no fii hɔ.
Naaso Benjaminmba no enntu Jebusfo a wɔtse Jerusalɛm no: mbom Jebusfo no nye Benjaminmba no tsenaa Jerusalɛm araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na judef fi no so fowee kɔr Bɛtɛl do: na EWURADZE dzii hɔn ekyir.
Na judef fi no somae ma wɔkɛseraa Bɛtɛl. Nkan no nkyɛ kurow no ne dzin nye Luz.
Na aserafo no hun banyin bi a ofi kurow no mu epue, na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛserɛ wo, kyerɛ hɛn kurow no mu kwan, na yɛnye wo bedzi no yie.
Na ɔkyerɛɛ hɔn kurow no mu kwan, na wɔdze afona bɔɔ kurow no: mbom banyin no na n’ebusuafo nyinara dze, wogyaa hɔn.
Na banyin no kɔr Hitifo asaase do, na ɔkɛkyekyeer kurow, na ɔtoo no dzin Luz: ɔno nye ne dzin araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi.

Na Manaasɛ enntu nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ Bɛt-sean na no nkuraase, na Taanak a wɔwɔ Dor na no nkuraase, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Ibleam na no nkuraase, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Megiddo na no nkuraase: na Keenanfo no dze, wɔpɛɛ dɛ wɔtsena asaase no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Israel hɔn ho yɛɛ dzen no, wɔhyɛɛ Keenanfo no ma wɔyɛɛ ɔsom edwuma, na mbom woenntu hɔn ase korakora.
Na Efraim enntu Keenanfo a wɔtse Gezer no; na Keenanfo no tsenaa hɔn mu wɔ Gezer.
Zebulun enntu Kitronfo, na Na-halolfo no so; na Keenanfo no tsenaa hɔn mu na Zebulunfo no hyɛɛ hɔn ma wɔbɛyɛɛ ɔman a wɔyɛ ɔsom edwuma.
Aser enntu hɔn a wɔtsetse Ako, anaa hɔn a wɔtsetse Zidon, na Ahlab, na Akizib, na Helba, na Afik, na Rehob:
na Aserfo no tsenaa Keenanfo no mu, asaase no do atsefo no a: osiandɛ woenntu hɔn.

Naftali enntu hɔn a wɔtsetse Bɛt-semes, anaa hɔn a wɔtsetse Bɛt-anat no; mbom ɔtsenaa Keenanfo no mu, asaase no do atsefo no a: naaso hɔn a wɔtsetse Bɛt-semes na Bɛt-anat no bɛyɛɛ ɔman a wɔyɛ ɔsom edwuma wɔ nhyɛ do.
Na Amorifo no kaa Danmba no kɔr nkokodo nkurow no mu: na wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔma hɔn kwan ma wosian ba ɔbɔn no mu:
na Amorifo no pɛɛ dɛ wɔtsena bepɔw Heres do wɔ Aijalon, na Saalbim: naaso judef fi no ne nsa daa hɔn do, ma wɔhyɛɛ hɔn ma wɔbɛyɛɛ ɔman a wɔyɛ ɔsom edwuma wɔ nhyɛ do.
Na Amorifo he no fi Akrabbim mfowee, ofi ɔbotan no ho dze kɔ enyim no ho.

Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe fi Gilgal baa Bokim (Bokim). Na ɔsee dɛ, Mara na memaa hom fi Egypt firii na medze hom aba asaase a mekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom no do, na mesee dɛ, Moronnto menye hom ntamu ahyɛmu no dabiarada:
na mma hom nnye asaase yi do atsefo no nndzi ahyɛmu: hom mbubu hɔn afɔrmbukyia no: naaso hom enntsie me ndze: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ayɛ iyi?
Dɛm ntsi na mo so mesee dɛ, murunntu hɔn mmfi hom enyim; mbom wɔbɛyɛ dɛ nsoɛ wɔ hom mfemu, na hɔn enyame ayɛ efir ama hom.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a EWURADZE no bɔfoe no kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Israelmba no nyinara no, ɔman no maa hɔn ndze do na wosui.
Na wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Bokim ase nye Nyinsuwakyifo: na wɔbɔɔ okum afɔr wɔ hɔ maa EWURADZE.
Afei aber a judua gyaa ɔman no kwan no, Israelmba mu nyimpa biara kɔr n’egyapadze do dɛ ɔrekɛfa asaase no.
Na ɔman no soom EWURADZE judua ne nda nyinara, na mpanyimfo a judua wui gyaa hɔn no a wohun ndwuma akɛse nyinara a EWURADZE yɛe maa Israel no hɔn nda nyinara.
Na judua Nun ne babanyin no, EWURADZE n’akowaa no wui, nna oedzi mfe ɔha nye du.
Na wokesiee no wɔ n’asaase he do wɔ Timnat-heres, wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu, wɔ bepɔw Gaas no kwaamu afamu.
Na ebusuasantsen no nyinara so kɛkaa hɔn egyanom ho wɔ nsamankyir: na afei ebusuasantsen fofor so soɛree dzii hɔn ekyir a nna wonnyim EWURADZE, na dwuma a odzii maa Israel no.
Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na wɔsoom Baalim:

na wɔpoow EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no a oyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do no, na wokedzii enyame fofor a wofi aman a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no hɔn enyame no mu ekyir, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa hɔn, na woyii EWURADZE ebufuw.
Na wɔpoow EWURADZE, na wɔsoom Baal na Astarot.
Na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛɛw Israel do, na oyii hɔn hyɛɛ afowfo a wɔfoow hɔn nsa, na ɔtɔɔn hɔn dze hyɛɛ hɔn atamfo a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no nsa, ma woenntum enngyina hɔn atamfo enyim bio.
Beebiara a wopuei kɔree no, EWURADZE ne nsa nye hɔn dzii no bɔn, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kae no, na dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn no: na hɔn ho hiahiaa hɔn yie.
Naaso EWURADZE maa banodzifo do ma wɔgyee hɔn nkwa fii hɔn a wɔfoom hɔn fae no nsamu.

Iyi nyinara ekyir no, woenntsie hɔn banodzifo no, na wodzii enyame fofor ekyir ndwamanyɛ mu, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa hɔn: ntsɛmara na wɔdanee fii ɔkwan a hɔn egyanom nantseew do tsiee EWURADZE mbransɛm no do; hɔn dze, wɔannyɛ dɛm.

Na sɛ EWURADZE ma banodzifo do ma hɔn a, nna EWURADZE edzi banodzinyi no ekyir, na ɔagye hɔn efi hɔn atamfo no nsamu wɔ banodzinyi no ne nda nyinara mu: na osian hɔn apensi a ɔnam hɔn a wɔhaaw hɔn na woyii hɔn ahomtsew do no ntsi ɔyɛɛ EWURADZE yaw.

Naaso ɔbaa dɛ sɛ banodzinyi no wu a, wɔdan san ekyir, na wɔsɛɛ sen hɔn egyanom, dɛ wokedzi enyame fofor ekyir som hɔn, na wɔbɔ hɔn mu adze ma hɔn; woenngyaa hɔn ndzeyɛɛ no, na woemmfi hɔn akɔnkye kwan do so.
Na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛɛw wɔ Israel do; na ɔsee dɛ, Osiandɛ ɔman yi ato m’ahyɛmu a mehyɛɛ hɔn egyanom, na woenntsie me ndze ntsi;
emi so ɔdzekɔr yi murunntu amanaman a judua wui daan hɔn gyae no mu biara bio:
ma medze hɔn asɔ Israel ahwɛ, kyerɛ dɛ wɔbɔhwɛ EWURADZE no kwan no anantsew do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom hwɛe no, anaa oho.
Nna EWURADZE gyaa amanaman no, ɔammpɛ ntsɛm enntu hɔn; nkyii so oennyi hɔn annhyɛ judua ne nsa.
Na Abimelek n’ekyir no, Tola a ɔyɛ Pua a n’egya nye Dodo ne ba no, na ɔsoɛree bɛgyee Israel. Ɔyɛ Isakarnyi, na ɔtsenaa Samir wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu.
Na odzii Israel enyim mfe eduonu ebiasa, na owui, na wosiee no wɔ Samir.
Na ɔno n’ekyir no Gileadnyi Jair soɛree; na odzii Israel enyim mfe eduonu ebien.
Na ɔwɔ mbabanyin eduasa a wɔtsenatsenaa nsoasopɔnkɔmba eduasa do, na wonyaa nkurow eduasa a wɔfrɛ no Havot-jair dze bodu ndɛ da yi a ɔwɔ Gilead asaase do.
Na Jair wui, na wosiee no wɔ Kamon.

Na Israelmba yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do bio, na wɔsoom Baalim, na Astarot, na Siria enyame, na Zidon enyame, na Moab enyame, na Ammonmba enyame, na Filistiafo enyame; na wɔpoow EWURADZE na wɔannsom no.
Na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Israel do, na ɔtɔɔn hɔn hyɛɛ Filistiafo, na Ammonmba nsa.
Na woyii Israelmba ahomtsew na wɔhaaw hɔn afe noara mu: mfe duawɔtwe na wɔdze haaw Israelmba a wɔwɔ Jordan egya wɔ Amorifo asaase a ɔwɔ Gilead no nyinara do.
Na Ammonmba no botwaa Jordan dɛ wɔnye Juda, na Benjamin, na Efraim fie so rokɔko; na dɛm ntsi Israel no ho hiahiaa no dodoodow.
Na Israelmba no sui frɛɛ EWURADZE, dɛ, Yɛayɛ bɔn etsia wo, dɛ yɛapow hɛn Nyankopɔn, na yɛasom Baalim.
Na EWURADZE see Israelmba no dɛ, Ana manngye hom emmfi Egyptfo, na Amorifo, na Ammonmba, na Filistiafo nsamu?
Zidonfo, na Amalekfo, na Moabfo so haaw hom; na hom sui frɛɛ me, na megyee hom fii hɔn nsamu.
Naaso hom apow me, na wɔakɔsom enyame fofor: dɛm ntsi mennkɛgye hom bio.
Hom nkɔ nkosu mfrɛ enyame a hom asan mu eyiyi hɔn no; wɔmma wɔngye hom wɔ hom ahohiahia aber mu.
Na Israelmba no see EWURADZE dɛ, Yɛayɛ bɔn: biribiara a oye wɔ w’enyi do no fa yɛ hɛn: ɔgye nko na yɛserɛ wo dɛ gye hɛn ndɛ da yi.
Na wɔtotoow enyame ananaben no fii hɔn mu gui, na wɔsoom EWURADZE: na Israel amandzehu no yɛɛ ne kra awerɛhow.
Nna Ammonmba no boaa ano, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Gilead. Na Israelmba no poon hɔnho hyiae, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Mizpa.
Na ɔman no, Gilead etsitsir no, sesee hɔnho nkorkor dɛ, Ɔbarimba mmuana na obedzi kan nye Ammonmba no ako? Ɔno na wɔmma ɔnyɛ otsitsir wɔ Gileadfo nyinara do.
Afei Gileadnyi Jefta yɛ ɔbarimba katakyi a ɔyɛ ndam, na ɔyɛ ɔbaa huhunyi bi ne ba: na n’egya nye Gilead.
Na Gilead ne yer woo mbabanyin maa no, na aber a ne yer ne mbabanyin no nyinii no, wɔpaam Jefta, na wɔsee no dɛ, Mma nndzi adze wɔ hɛn egya fie; osiandɛ ɔsor ɔbaa a ɔwoo wo.
Nna Jefta guanee fii no nuanom nkyɛn, na ɔkɛtsenaa Tob asaase do: na akwasampafo bi boaa hɔn ano kɛkaa Jefta ho, na wɔnye no puei.
Na ɔbaa dɛ n’ekyir mber kakra, nna Ammonmba tuu Israel do sa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ammonmba tuu Israel do sa no, Gilead mpanyimfo sii mu kɔree kɛfaa Jefta wɔ Tob asaase no do;
na wɔsee Jefta dɛ, Bra bɛyɛ hɛn sahen, ma yɛnye Ammonmba nkɔko.
Na Jefta bisaa Gilead mpanyimfo no dɛ, Ana nnyɛ homara na wokyiir me, na wɔpaam me fii m’egya fie no bi a? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na afei a hom wɔ ahohia mu yi dze hom reba me nkyɛn yi?
Na Gilead mpanyimfo no see Jefta dɛ, Dɛm ntsi na afei yɛadan aba wo nkyɛn bio yi, ama enye hɛn aakɔ, ma yɛnye Ammonmba aakɔko, na ɔwoara yɛ hɛn tsitsir wɔ Gileadmba nyinara do.
Na Jefta see Gilead mpanyimfo no dɛ, Sɛ hom dze me san kɔ fie bio ma menye Ammonmba kɔko, na EWURADZE yi hɔn ma wɔ m’enyim a, emi na mebɛyɛ hom mu tsitsir anaa?
Na Gilead mpanyimfo no see Jefta dɛ, EWURADZE nyɛ hɛn ntamu ɔdasefo; ampaara dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse no dɛmara so na yɛbɛyɛ.
Nna Jefta nye Gilead mpanyimfo no sii mu kɔree, na ɔman no yɛɛ no hɔn do tsitsir na hɔn sahen: na Jefta kaa ne nsɛm nyinara wɔ EWURADZE enyim wɔ Mizpa.
Na Jefta tuu abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Ammonmba ɔhen no hɔ, dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ewɔ nye me yɛ, na aba mo do nye m’asaase robɔko yi?
Na Ammonmba ɔhen no buaa Jefta n’abɔfoe no dɛ, Osiandɛ aber a Israel fi Egypt reba no, ɔfaa m’asaase, ofi Ammon araa dze kodu Jabbok, na Jordan do: dɛm ntsi dan asaase no ma me foo.
Na Jefta tuu abɔfo bio ma wɔkɔr Ammonmba no hɔ:
na ɔkɛsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ Jefta se nye yi: Israel ammfa Moab asaase, na Ammonmba asaase so bi:
mbom aber a wofi Egypt bae no, na Israel nantseew sar no do kodur Mbɛw Po no ho, na wɔbaa Kades no;
nna Israel tuu abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Edomhen hɔ, dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma muntwa mu wɔ w’asaase do: na Edomhen no enntsie. Na dɛmara so na ɔsomaa ma wɔkɔr Moabhen no so hɔ: na ɔammpen na Israel tsenaa Kades.

Nna ɔnantseew sar no do, na ɔkɔbɔɔ Edom asaase, na Moab asaase ho aprɔw, na wobopuee Moab asaase no no boka afamu, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Arnon egya no ho; na wɔammba Moab he no mu, osiandɛ Arnon nye Moab he no.
Na Israel somaa abɔfo wɔ Amorifo hen Sihon, Hesbonhen no, hɔ; na Israel see no dɛ, Yɛserɛ wo, ma yentwa mu wɔ w’asaase do nkɔ m’asaase do.
Naaso Sihon ennya pɛ wɔ Israel ho dɛ ɔbɛma woetwa mu wɔ ne he do: na Sihon poon ne man nyinara hyiae, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Jahaz, na wɔnye Israel koe.
Na EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, dze Sihon na ne man nyinara hyɛɛ Israel nsa, na wokunkum hɔn: na Israel faa Amorifo asaase no nyinara, ɔman no mu mba no a.
Na wɔfaa Amorifo he nyinara, ofi Arnon do araa kodu Jabbok do, na ofi sar no do araa kodu Jordan do.
Nna afei a EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, etu Amorifo efi ne man Israel enyim yi, na ɔwo rebɛfa hɔn?
Ana ennkɛfaa dza wo nyame Kemos (Kemos) dze maa wo dɛ fa no ara bi? Dɛm ntsi hɔn a EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn etu hɔn efi hɛn enyim no hɔn na yɛbɛfa.
Na afei ana ɔwo iye ara ma ɔsen Zipor babanyin Balak, Moabhen no a? Ana ɔnye Israel dzii aper pɛn, anaa ɔnye hɔn koo pɛn?
Aber a Israel tsenaa Hesbon na no ho nkurow mu, na Aroer na no ho nkurow mu, na nkurow a ɔwɔ Arnon ho nyinara mu mfe ahaasa no; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom anngye no wɔ aber no mu?
Dɛm ntsi emi mennyɛɛ wo bɔn bi, mbom ɔwo na ereyɛ me bɔn dɛ irutu mo do sa: EWURADZE, Ɔtsɛmbuafo no ɔnyɛ ɔtsɛmbuafo ndɛ da yi wɔ Israelmba na Ammonmba ntamu.
Naaso Ammonmba hen no enntsie Jefta ne nsɛm a ɔdze somaa ma wɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ no no.
Nna EWURADZE no sunsum baa Jefta do, na otwaa mu wɔ Gilead na Manaasɛ, na otwaa mu kɔr Gilead-Mizpe, na ofi Gilead-Mizpe twaa mu kɔr Ammonmba no do.
Na Jefta bɔɔ EWURADZE anohoba, na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ edze Ammonmba no hyɛ me nsa ampa a,
ɔnodze ɔbɛba dɛ, biribiara a obefi me fi mbobow mu ebehyia me aber a meresan efi Ammonmba ho dwudwoodwo no, ɔbɛyɛ EWURADZE dze, na medze no bɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr.
Nna Jefta twaa mu kɔr Ammonmba no do dɛ ɔnye hɔn rokɔko; na EWURADZE dze hɔn hyɛɛ ne nsa.
Na ɔdze okum kɛse paara kunkum hɔn fi Aroer araa dze kodu Minnit, mekyerɛ nkurow eduonu, na edze kodu Abel-keramin. Nna wɔberɛɛ Ammonmba no adze wɔ Israelmba no enyim.
Na Jefta baa ne fie Mizpa, na, hwɛ, ne babaa dze mfuaba na asaw fiir edzi dɛ oribehyia no: na ɔnoara nye ne ba kortoo; onnyi ɔbabanyin anaa ɔbabaa ka no ho.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ohun no no, osunsuaan ne ntar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ebei, me babaa! Abrɛ me adze dodoodow, na ɔwo nye hɔn a wɔfona me no mu baako: osiandɛ mebue m’ano mama EWURADZE, na murunntum nnsan m’ekyir.
Na ne ba no see no dɛ, M’egya, ebue w’ano ama EWURADZE yi dze; yɛ me dɛ mbrɛ efi w’anomu no ara; susuampa dɛ EWURADZE edzi w’atamfo do wer ama wo yi, mekyerɛ Ammonmba no a.
Na ɔsee n’egya dɛ, Ma wɔnyɛ iyi mma me: gyaa me abosoom ebien, ma minsi mu minsian monkɔ mbepɔw do, na emi na m’anyɛnkofo nkegyam me mbaabunyɛ ho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Kɔ. Na ogyaa no kwan abosoom ebien: na osii mu kɔree, ɔno na n’anyɛnkofo, na okegyaam ne mbaabunyɛ ho wɔ mbepɔw do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ abosoom ebien no n’ewiei no, ɔsanee baa n’egya hɔ, ma ɔyɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ n’anohoba a ɔbɔe no tse no ara: na oennhu banyin biara. Na ɔyɛɛ atɔrmuadze wɔ Israel,
dɛ afrenhyia pempem nyinara Israel mbabaa dze su kɛkaa Gileadnyi Jefta ne babaa no afrenhyia mu nda anan.
Na Efraim mbanyin bɔboaa ano, na wotwaa mu kɔr kwaamu afamu; na wɔsee Jefta dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na itwae kɔree kɛnyee Ammonmba koe, na ammfrɛ hɛn na yɛnye wo annkɔ? Yɛdze ogya bɛhyew wo fi egu wo do.
Na Jefta see hɔn dɛ, Emi na me man yɛnye Ammonmba nyaa manso kɛse; na aber a mefrɛɛ hom no, hom anngye me emmfi hɔn nsamu.

Na aber a muhun dɛ hom anngye me no, medze mo nkwa kitsaa me nsamu, na mutwae kɔr Ammonmba do, na EWURADZE dze hɔn hyɛɛ me nsa. Na afei ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na hom afow aba mo do ndɛ da yi, dɛ wɔnye me robɔko yi?
Nna Jefta poon Gilead mbarimba hyiae, na ɔnye Efraim koe: na Gilead mbarimba no kum Efraim, osiandɛ wɔsee dɛ, Hom Gileadfo, hom yɛ eguamfo wɔ Efraim na Manaasɛ mu.
Na Gileadfo twaar Efraimfo kɛgyee Jordan etwaree no: na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ Efraim eguamfo no bi se dɛ, Ma muntwa a, Gilead mbarimba no bisa no dɛ, Ana Efraimnyi nye wo a? Sɛ ɔse dɛ, Oho a;
nna wɔase no dɛ, Afei se dɛ, Shibolet; na sɛ ɔka Sibolet; osiandɛ onntum nnka no yie a; nna wɔakyer no, na woeku no wɔ Jordan etwaree hɔ: na aber no mu Efraim mu nyimpa mpemeduanan ebien totɔree.
Na Jefta dzii Israel enyim mfe esia. Nna Gileadnyi Jefta wui, na wosiee no wɔ Gilead nkurow no kor mu.
Na Jefta n’ekyir no Ibzan a ofi Bɛtlɛhɛm dzii Israel enyim.
Nna ɔwɔ mbabanyin eduasa na mbabaa so eduasa, na ogyaa mbabaa eduasa kwan kɔr awar wɔ mbeambea, na ɔdze mbabaa eduasa fi mbeambea brɛɛ ne mbabanyin no. Na odzii Israel enyim mfe esuon.
Na Ibzan wui, na wosiee no wɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm.
Na ɔno n’ekyir no Zebulunnyi Elon dzii Israel enyim; mfe du.
Na Zebulunnyi Elon wui, na wosiee no wɔ Aijalon wɔ Zebulun asaase do.
Na ɔno n’ekyir no Piratonnyi Hilel ne babanyin Abdon buu Israel atsɛn.
Nna ɔwɔ mbabanyin eduanan na mbabanyin hɔn mbabanyin eduasa a wɔtsenaa asoasopɔnkɔ mba eduosuon do: na odzii Israel enyim mfe awɔtwe.
Na Piratonnyi Hilel ne babanyin Abdon wui, na wosiee no wɔ Piratom wɔ Efraim asaase do, wɔ Amalekfo nkokodo nkurow no mu.
Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dza omuo bio wɔ EWURADZE enyi do; na EWURADZE dze hɔn hyɛɛ Filistiafo nsa mfe eduanan.
Nna banyin bi wɔ hɔ a ofi Zora a ofi Danfo ebusua mu a ne dzin dze Manoa; nna ne yer yɛ ɔbɔnyin.
Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Afei hwɛ, ɔbɔnyin nye wo, na innyi ba: naaso ibenyinsen, na awo babanyin.
Dɛm ntsi afei meserɛ wo, hwɛ yie, na mma nnom wenyin anaa nsa dzendzen bi, na mma nndzi efifidze biara so:
na, hwɛ, ibenyinsen, na awo babanyin; na oyindam bi rennka ne tsir: na abofra no fi yafun mu ara bɛyɛ (Nazirinyi) nyia ɔakam noho ama Nyankopɔn: na ɔno na ɔbɛhyɛ ase agye Israel efi Filistiafo nsamu.
Nna ɔbaa no bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ no kun no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa bi baa me nkyɛn, na n’enyim yɛ dɛ Nyame no bɔfoe enyim, ɔyɛ hu dɛ; na memmbisa no mbrɛ ofi, nkyii so ɔammbɔ ne dzin annkyerɛ me:

na ɔsee me dɛ, Hwɛ, ibenyinsen, na awo babanyin; na afei mma nnom wenyin anaa nsa dzendzen, na mma nndzi efifidzi biara so: na abofra no fi yafun mu araa bɛyɛ nyia ɔakam noho (Nazirinyi) ama Nyankopɔn dze ekodu no wu da.
Nna Manoa totɔe serɛɛ EWURADZE, na ɔsee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE, meserɛ wo ma Nyame nyimpa no a esomaa no no mbra hɛn nkyɛn bio, na ɔmbɛkyerɛ hɛn dza yɛmfa nyɛ abofra a wɔrobɔwo no no.
Na Nyankopɔn tsiee Manoa ne ndze; na Nyame no bɔfoe no baa ɔbaa no nkyɛn bio wɔ aber a ɔtse haban mu no: nna no kun Manoa nnyi ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔbaa no yɛɛ ntsɛm tutuu mbirika kɛkaa kyerɛɛ no kun, na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, banyin no a ɔbaa me nkyɛn daano bi no oebeyi noho akyerɛ me.
Na Manoa soɛree, na odzii ne yer no ekyir, na ɔbaa banyin no nkyɛn, na obisaa no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye banyin no a ekasaa kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mara a.
Na Manoa see dɛ, Afei ma wo nsɛm mbra mu: Abofra no ne nyɛbea bɛyɛ dɛn, na n’edwuma nye dɛn?
Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see Manoa dɛ, Dza mesee ɔbaa no nyinara na ma ɔnhwɛ yie wɔ ho.
Adze biara a ofi wenyindua mu ba no mma onndzi bi, nkyii so mma ɔnnom wenyin anaa nsa dzendzen bi, na mma onndzi efifidze biara so: dza mehyɛɛ no nyinara ma ondzi do.
Na Manoa see EWURADZE no bɔfoe no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma yensianka wo, na yensiesie apɔnkyeba bi mma wo.
Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see Manoa dɛ, Sɛ isianka me mpo a, mirinndzi w’edziban no bi: na sɛ ebɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr a, bɔ ma EWURADZE. Nna Manoa nnyim dɛ ɔyɛ EWURADZE no bɔfoe.
Na Manoa see EWURADZE no bɔfoe no dɛ, Wo dzin dze dɛn, na sɛ wo nsɛm no ba mu a yɛaahyɛ wo enyimnyam.
Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na iribisa me dzin a ɔyɛ nwanwa yi?
Nna Manoa faa apɔnkyeba no kaa edziban afɔr no ho, na ɔdze bɔɔ afɔr wɔ ɔbotan no do maa EWURADZE: nyia ɔyɛ anwanwadze no, na Manoa na ne yer hwɛe.

Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ogyaframee no fi afɔrmbukyia no do rokɔ sor no, EWURADZE no bɔfoe no fowee nam afɔrmbukyia no do ogyaframee no mu kɔr sor na Manoa na ne yer dze hɔn enyi tsiim no do; na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu.
Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no ennyi noho bio annkyerɛ Manoa anaa ne yer. Nna Manoa hun dɛ EWURADZE no bɔfoe a.
Na Manoa see ne yer dɛ, Owu na yerubowuwu, osiandɛ yeehu Nyankopɔn.

Na ne yer no see no dɛ, Sɛ EWURADZE pɛ dɛ oku hɛn a, nkyɛ ɔanngye hɛn nsamu ɔhyew afɔr, na edziban afɔr, nkyii so nkyɛ oennyi iyinom nyinara annkyerɛ hɛn, na so nkyɛ ɔannka ndzɛmba a ɔtse dɛm yi annkyerɛ hɛn aber yi mu.
Na ɔbaa no woo babanyin, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Samson: na abofra no nyinii, na EWURADZE hyiraa no.
Na EWURADZE no sunsum hyɛɛ ase kekaa no wɔ Mahane-dan, wɔ Zora na Estaol ntamu.
Da bi Samson sii mu kɔr Timna, na okohun ɔbaa bi wɔ hɔ a ofi Filistiafo mbabaa no mu.
Na ɔbae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ n’egya na ne na, na ɔsee dɛ, Mekohu ɔbaa bi wɔ Timna a ofi Filistiafo mbabaa no mu: dɛm ntsi afei hom nkɛgye no yer mma me.

Nna n’egya na ne na see no dɛ, Ana ɔbaa biara nnyi wo nuanom mbabaa no mu, anaa mo nkorɔfo nyinara mu, na erokɔ akɔwar wɔ Filistiafo monomonomfo no mu yi? Na Samson see n’egya dɛ, Kɛgye no ma me; na ɔnoara na mepɛ no dodow.
Nna n’egya na ne na dze wonnyim dɛ ofir EWURADZE; osiandɛ ɔhwehwɛɛ ɔkwan bi wɔ Filistiafo no ho. Afei aber no mu na Filistiafo na wɔhyɛ Israel do.
Nna Samson, na n’egya na ne na, sii mu kɔr Timna, na wodur Timna wenyin nture ho: na, hwɛ, gyata eburwa bi pɔɔw no.
Na EWURADZE no sunsum baa no do dzendzenndzen, na ɔtsetseew no mu dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ ɔbɛtsetsew apɔnkyeba mu, nna hwee nndze ne nsamu: na ɔannka dza ɔyɛe no annkyerɛ n’egya anaa ne na.
Na osii mu kɔree, na ɔnye ɔbaa no kɛkasae; na ɔsɔɔ Samson n’enyi dɛ.
Na n’ekyir mber kakra no ɔsanee kɔr dɛ orikehyia no, na ɔmanee dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ gyata fun no: na, hwɛ, ndowa menyamenya, na ewo wɔ gyata honandua no mu.
Na ɔfae kitsaa ne nsamu kɔree, na ɔrokɔ no na oridzi, na okodur n’egya na ne na nkyɛn, na ɔmaa hɔn bi, na wodzii: na ɔannka annkyerɛ hɔn dɛ oyii ewo no wɔ gyata honandua mu.
Na n’egya sii mu kɔr ɔbaa no nkyɛn, na Samson too pon wɔ hɔ; dza nna mbrɛ mberantsɛ no tɔ dɛ wɔyɛ nye yi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wohun no no, wɔdze anyɛnkofo eduasa baa dɛ wɔmbɛka no ho.
Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, Afei wɔmma memma hom abrɔme bi: sɛ hom tum hu ka kyerɛ me wɔ aponto nda esuon yi mu a, ɔno mebɛma hom ndwera ntar eduasa na nkatado asorɔtow eduasa:
na sɛ hom ennhu annka annkyerɛ me a, ɔno hom mma me ndwera ntar eduasa na nkatado asorɔtow eduasa. Na wɔsee no dɛ, Fa w’abrɔme no bra, ma yentsie.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Odzidzifo no mu na edziban fi bae, Na ɔhoɔdzenfo no mu na dɔkɔdɔkɔ fi bae. Na ndaansa na wonntum nnkyerɛ abrɔme no.

Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia esuon no, wɔsee Samson ne yer no dɛ, Daadaa wo kun, ma ɔnkyerɛ hɛn abrɔme no, amma yaammfa ogya annhyew ɔwo na w’egya fi: ana hom behyiaa hɛn aabɔ hɛn epoo anaa? Ɔnntse dɛm bi a?

Na Samson ne yer no sui tɔɔ no do, na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔtan mbom na etan me, na enndɔ me bi: ɔwo edze abrɔme ama me man mba, na ennkaa nnkyerɛɛ me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, m’egya na me na mpo mennkaa nnkyerɛɛ hɔn, na ɔwo na menka nkyerɛ wo anaa?
Na osui tɔɔ no do nda esuon no, aber a hɔn aponto no si do no nyina: na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia esuon no, ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no, osiandɛ ɔhaaw no dodow na ɔbaa no kɛkaa abrɔme no kyerɛɛ ne man mba no.

Na da a otsia esuon no ansaana iwi rotɔ no kurow no mu mba no see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔyɛ dɔkɔdɔkɔ sen ewo? Na ebɛnadze na no ho yɛ dzen sen gyata: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom ammfa me nantwi emmfuntum a, Nkyɛ hom ennhu m’abrɔme no.

Na EWURADZE no sunsum baa no do dzendzenndzen, na osii mu kɔr Ashkelon, na okokunkum hɔn mu mbarimba eduasa, na ɔfaa hɔn asadze, na ɔdze nkatado asorɔtow no maa hɔn a wɔkyerɛɛ abrɔme no. Na n’ebufuw dzɛwee, na osii mu kɔr n’egya fie.
Na Samson ne yer no dze, wɔdze no maa ne nyɛnko a odzii n’ekyir wɔ awar no mu no.
Na iyi ekyir no a ɔkyɛɛr kakra no, ewifua twaber mu no, Samson dze apɔnkyeba kɔree kɔhwɛɛ ne yer; na ɔsee dɛ, Mobɔkɔ me yer nkyɛn wɔ pia mu. Na ɔbaa no n’egya amma no kwan ma ɔannkɔ.
Na n’asew no see dɛ, Emi dze modween dɛ ɔtan na etan no; dɛm ntsi medze no ama wo nyɛnko bi: ana no nua kuma no no ho nnyɛ fɛw nnsen ɔno? Ibotum afa no ahyɛ ananmu.
Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, Afei dze wɔ Filistiafo afamu no, sɛ meyɛ hɔn bɔn bi a, minnkedzi ho so.
Na Samson sii mu kɔree kɛkyeer nsɔ ahaasa, na ɔfaa ngyaabaa, na ɔdaan dua faam dua ho, na ɔdze gyabaa hyɛɛ mu wɔ ndua ebien biara ntamu.
Na aber a ɔsosɔɔ ngyaabaa no ano gya no, ogyaa hɔn ma wɔkɔr Filistiafo eburow kwa mu, na wɔhyeew eburow ekuwekuw na eburow a osisi hɔ no nyina, na ngodua ture so.
Nna Filistiafo no see dɛ, Woana yɛɛ iyi? Na wɔsee dɛ, Timnanyi no n’asew Samson a, osiandɛ ɔagye ne yer, na ɔdze no ama ne nyɛnko bi. Na Filistiafo fowee bae, na wɔdze gya bɛhyeew ɔbaa no na n’egya.
Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom ayɛ iyi mpo a, gyedɛ medzi hom wer ansaana n’ekyir no megyaa.
Na ɔbobɔɔ hɔn ndwonku na aserɛ do kunkum hɔn dwɛɛ: na osianee kɔree kɛtsenaa Etam ɔbotan tokur mu.
Nna Filistiafo no sii mu kɔree, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Juda, na wɔtserɛɛw hɔn mu wɔ Lehi.
Na Juda mbarimba no bisaa dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom aba hɛn do yi? Na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛbae yaabɛkyekyer Samson, yaayɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze ayɛ hɛn no.

Nna Juda mbarimba mpemebiasa sii mu kɔr Etam ɔbotan tokur no mu, na wɔsee Samson dɛ, Ana ɔwo nnyim dɛ Filistiafo na wodzi hɛn do hen? Ebɛnadze na edze ayɛ hɛn yi? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Dza wɔdze yɛɛ me no, dɛmara so na medze ayɛ hɔn.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛaba dɛ yɛrebɛkyekyer wo, ma yɛdze wo aakɛhyɛ Filistiafo nsa. Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, Hom nka ntam nkyerɛ me dɛ homara runntu nnhyɛ mo do.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Dabida na kyekyer ara na yɛbɛkyekyer wo, na yɛdze wo akɛhyɛ hɔn nsa: na oku dze yerunnku wo. Na wɔdze ntampehoma fofor ebien kyekyeer no, na wɔdze no fi ɔbotan no mu bae.

Aber a odur Lehi no, Filistiafo no hyiaa no, na wohuroo no: na EWURADZE no sunsum baa no do dzendzenndzen, na ntampehoma a ɔwɔ n’abasa ho yɛɛ dɛ asaaba a wɔdze gya aka, na ne nkyehoma no fii ne nsa ho gui.
Na ohun asoaso n’adadaw fofor bi, na ɔtseen ne nsa fae, na ɔdze kunkum mbarimba apem.
Na Samson see dɛ, Medze asoaso n’adadaw mehyɛɛ hɔn ekuwekuw, Medze asoaso n’adadaw mekum mbarimba apem.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a owiee kasa no, ɔtoow adadaw no fii ne nsamu kyenee; na bea no wɔfrɛɛ no Ramat-lehi.
Na nsukɔm dzee no dodow, na ɔfrɛɛ EWURADZE, na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔwo nam w’akowaa nsa do edze nkwagye kɛse ama: na afei nsukɔm nku me, ma monkɔtɔ monomonomfo nsamu?
Na Nyankopɔn paa otokur korkorba a ɔwɔ Lehi no mu, na nsu fi mu bae; na ɔnomee no, no sunsum sanee bae, na onyaa nkwa: dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin En-hakkore a ɔwɔ Lehi dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na odzii Israel enyim wɔ Filistiafo nda no mu mfe eduonu.
Nna Samson sii mu kɔr Gaza, na okohun ɔbaa huhunyi bi wɔ hɔ, na ɔkɔr ne nkyɛn.

Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Gazafo no dɛ, Samson aba ha. Na wotwaa no ho hyiae, na wɔtsɛɛw no anadwe no nyinara wɔ kurow no mu kuropon ano, na wɔyɛɛ dzinn anadwe no nyinara, dɛ, Wɔmma ɔnko hɔ na anapa enyim tsetsew a, ɔno yeeku no.

Na Samson dae ma okodur esuom, na osuoo kurow no no kuropon mbobow no, na apondua ebien no mu, na otutui, adaban na dza ɔka ho nyinara, na ɔdze guu no kɔn ho, na ɔsoae dze kɔr bepɔw a ɔwɔ Hebron enyim no etsifi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ n’ekyir no, ɔdɔɔ ɔbaa bi wɔ Sorek ɔbɔn mu a ne dzin dze Delila.

Na Filistiafo ekunyin no fowee baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Daadaa no, na hwɛ adze kor a n’ahoɔdzen kɛse no wɔ mu, na ɔkwan kor a yɛnam mu bɛhyɛ no do, ma yaakyekyer no ahyɛ no amen: na ankor ankor nyinara yɛbɛma wo ndwetɛbona ɔhadubiako.
Na Delila see Samson dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ka adze kor a w’ahoɔdzen kɛse no wɔ mu, na adze kor a wɔdze bɛkyekyer wo ahyɛ wo amen kyerɛ me.
Na Samson see no dɛ, Sɛ wɔdze mpaahoma momon esuon a ɔnnwoe kyekyer me a, ɔnodze mubogura, na mayɛ dɛ nyimpa biara so.
Nna Filistiafo ekunyin no dze mpaahoma momon a ɔnnwowee esuon brɛɛ ɔbaa no, na ɔdze kyekyeer no.
Afei nna ɔwɔ atsɛweefo hyɛ adankyir. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Samson, Filistiafo reba wo do oo. Na ɔtsetseew mpaahoma no, dɛ mbrɛ asaabahoma sɛ ɔka gya a ɔtsetsew no. Dɛm ntsi woennhu n’ahoɔdzen no.
Na Delila see Samson dɛ, Hwɛ, esi me atwetwe, na aka akɔhwisɛm akyerɛ me: afei meserɛ wo, ka dza wɔdze kyekyer wo a ɔbɛyɛ yie kyerɛ me.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ wɔdze ntampehoma fofor ara a wɔmmfaa nnyɛɛ edwuma pɛn kyekyer me a, ɔno na mubogura, na mayɛ dɛ nyimpa biara so.
Nna Delila faa ntampehoma fofor, na ɔdze kyekyeer no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Samson, Filistiafo reba wo do oo. Nna atsɛweefo no hyɛ adankyir. Na ɔtsetseew no wɔ n’abasa ho dɛ asaabahoma bi.

Na Delila see Samson dɛ, Esi me atwetwe ebodu ndɛ da yi, na aka akɔhwisɛm akyerɛ me: ka dza wɔdze kyekyer wo a ɔbɛyɛ yie kyerɛ me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ edze me tsir mpɛsɛw esuon no fora ɔtanwendze no wen a.
Na ɔdze dadzeba no bɔɔ mu, na ɔsee no dɛ, Samson, Filistiafo reba wo do oo. Na ofii ne nda no mu nyanee, na otuu dza wɔawen no mu dadzeba no, na awendze no.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebɛyɛ dɛn ase dɛ modɔ wo, wɔ aber a w’akoma nnyi mo ho yi? Esi me atwetwe mprɛnsa nye yi, na ennkaa adze kor a w’ahoɔdzen kɛse yi wɔ mu no nnkyerɛɛ me.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔbaa no dze ne nsɛm guaan no ho daa daa, na ɔhyɛɛ no no, ɔyɛɛ Samson ne kra ahomtsew dze kɔr owu mu.

Na ɔkaa n’akoma mu asɛm nyinara kyerɛɛ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Oyindam ano nnkaa me tsir da; osiandɛ mifi me na yamu araa na mayɛ (Nazirinyi) nyia ɔakam noho ama Nyankopɔn: sɛ woyi me tsir a, nna m’ahoɔdzen no befi mo ho, na megura, na mayɛ dɛ nyimpa biara so.

Na aber a Delila hun dɛ ɔaka n’akoma mu asɛm nyinara akyerɛ no no, ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛɛ Filistiafo ekunyin no, dɛ, Hom mbra prɛko yi ara, na ɔaka n’akoma mu asɛm nyinara akyerɛ me. Nna Filistiafo ekunyin no baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔdzedze sika no wɔ hɔn nsamu bae.
Na Delila maa ɔdaa n’anankoroma do; na ɔfrɛɛ ɔbanyin bi ma obeyii ne tsir mpɛsɛw esuon no na ɔhyɛɛ ase hyɛɛ no amen, na n’ahoɔdzen no fii no ho kɔree.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Samson, Filistiafo reba wo do oo. Na ofii ne nda no mu nyanee, na ɔsee dɛ, Mubopue dɛ nkan no, na mawosow moho. Naaso nna ɔnodze onnyim dɛ EWURADZE efi ne nkyɛn kɔ.
Na Filistiafo no kyeer no, na wotutuu n’enyiwa: na wɔdze no baa Gaza, na wɔdze boran mpokyerɛ too no; na ɔyaam ewu wɔ adaduafo fi no mu.
Mbom woyii ne tsinhwi no, annkyɛr pii na ne tsinhwi no hyɛɛ ase fuuw bio.
Na Filistiafo ekunyin no poon hɔnho hyiae dɛ wɔrobɔbɔ afɔr kɛse ama hɔn nyame Dagon, na wɔagye hɔn enyi: na wɔsee dɛ, Hɛn nyame dze hɛn tamfo Samson ahyɛ hɛn nsa.
Na aber a ɔman no hun no no, woyii hɔn nyame ayɛw: na wɔsee dɛ, Hɛn nyame dze hɛn tamfo, na hɛn man ne sɛɛfo a oekuku hɛn mu piigyan no, ahyɛ hɛn nsa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a hɔn akoma tɔɔ hɔn yamu no, wɔsee dɛ, Wɔnkɛfrɛ Samson ma yɛngor no ho. Na wɔkɛfrɛɛ Samson wɔ adaduafo fi no mu bae; na wɔgoor no ho: na wɔdze no gyinaa edum no ntamu.
Na Samson see abofra no a ɔdze ne nsamu no dɛ, Gyaa me ma munsusuo edum no a ɔdan no si do no mu, ma montwer ho.
Afei nna dan no mbanyin na mbaa ahyɛ mu ma; na Filistiafo ekunyin no nyinara wɔ hɔ; na nyimpa bɛyɛ mpemebiasa wɔ dan no etsifi a wɔrohwɛ Samson a woridzi no ho fɛw no no.
Na Samson frɛɛ EWURADZE see dɛ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, meserɛ wo, kaa me, na hyɛ me dzen, meserɛ wo, prɛko yi ara, Nyankopɔn, ma mindzi m’enyiwa ebien yi ho wer prɛko wɔ Filistiafo no do.
Na Samson susuoo finimfin edum ebien no a dan no si do no mu, na ɔtweree, ne nsa enyimfa dze kor mu, na n’abankum dze kor so mu.

Na Samson see dɛ, Ma menye Filistiafo no nwu. Na ɔdze n’ahoɔdzen nyinara bɔɔ no mu adze; na dan no bui guu ekunyin na nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ mu no nyinara do. Dɛm ntsi ewufo a okum hɔn wɔ no wu mu no dɔɔ so sen hɔn a okum hɔn wɔ no nkwaber mu.
Nna no nuanom na n’egya fie nyinara sii mu kɔree kɛfaa no, na wɔdze no fowee bae besiee no wɔ Zora na Estaol ntamu wɔ n’egya Manoa n’esiei. Na Samson dzii Israel enyim mfe eduonu.
Nna banyin bi wɔ hɔ a ofi Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu a ne dzin dze Mika.

Na ɔsee ne na dɛ, Dwetɛbona ɔhadubiako no a wɔfaa no wɔ wo nkyɛn no a epaae wɔ ho, na ekasaa ho so wɔ m’asomu no, hwɛ, dwetɛ no wɔ mo hɔ; mara na mefae. Na ne na see dɛ, EWURADZE mma nhyira nka me ba.
