na memfa dɔm no nyinara nsan mbrɛ wo, dɛ mbrɛ ayefor kɔ no kun nkyɛn no: na nyimpa kor pɛr na erohwehwɛ no eku no: na ɔman no nyinara bɛyɛ komm.
Na asɛm no sɔɔ Absalom, na Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara enyi papaara.
Nna Absalom see dɛ, Afei wɔmfrɛ Husai, Arkinyi no so ma mbra, na wɔmma yentsie dza ɔno so wɔ ka.
Na aber a Husai baa Absalom nkyɛn no, Absalom kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Mbrɛ Ahithofel aka nye yi: ana yendzi n’asɛm no do a? Sɛ oho a, wo so kasa.
Na Husai see Absalom dɛ, Apam a Ahithofel dze ama aber yi dze onnye.
Nkyii so Husai see dɛ, Ɔwoara nyim w’egya na ne mbarimba, dɛ wɔyɛ mbarimba akatakyi, na hɔn enyi aber dɛ osisi a woewia ne mba wɔ haban mu: na w’egya so yɛ ɔsabarimba, na ɔnye nkorɔfo no renntsena.
Hwɛ, sisei oekosuma noho wɔ mona bi mu, anaa beebi: na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ hɔn mu binom totɔr asɔpɔn no a, obiara a ɔbɛtse no bɛse dɛ, Ɔkogu esi nkorɔfo a wodzi Absalom ekyir no mu.
Na nyia ɔyɛ ndam a n’akoma tse dɛ gyata akoma no mpo, ɔbɛnan koraa: osiandɛ Israel nyinara nyim dɛ w’egya yɛ ɔbarimba katakyi, na hɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam.
Mbom mususu dɛ wɔmboaboa Israel nyinara ano wɔ wo nkyɛn, ofi Dan araa dze kodu Beer-seba, dɛ mpoano anhwea wɔ dodow mu; na wankasa kɔ akono.
Nna yebopue no do wɔ beebiara mbrɛ wobohu no, na yeedwir no do dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔsu tɔ gu famu: yerinngyaa mma ɔno na mbarimba a wɔka no ho mu baako mpo mma nnka.
Nkyii so ɔtwe noho kɔ kurow bi mu a, ɔno Israel nyinara dze ntampee bɛba kurow no ho, na yɛatwe no akɔ esutsen mu ma ekodu dɛ worunnhu ɔbo kakraba kor mpo wɔ hɔ.

Na Absalom na Israel mbarimba no nyinara see dɛ, Husai, Arkinyi no, n’apam no ye sen Ahithofel n’apam no. Na EWURADZE na ɔahyehyɛ dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ Ahithofel n’apam papa no, ama EWURADZE dze mbusu aaba Absalom do.
Nna Husai see asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar dɛ, Dɛm na dɛm na Ahithofel dze apam Absalom na Israel mpanyimfo no: na dɛm na dɛm na mo so mapam.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nsoma ntsɛm, ma wɔnkɛka nkyerɛ David, dɛ, Mma nntsena sar no do nsutwaree hɔ anadwe yi, na otwa ara na twa kɔ; ɔno bɛyɛ na wɔabɛmen ɔhen, na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no nyinara.
Afei Jonatan na Ahimaaz tsenaa En-rogel ho; na abaawa bi na ɔtɔ dɛ ɔkɛka kyerɛ hɔn; na hɔn so wosi mu kɔ kɛka kyerɛ ɔhen David; osiandɛ nna onnyi dɛ wohu hɔn dɛ wɔaba kurow no mu.
Na abanyimbasiaba bi kohun hɔn, na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ Absalom: ntsi hɔn beenu nyina guaan ntsɛmara kɔree, na wokodur ɔbarimba bi fie wɔ Bahurim, nna ɔwɔ bura bi wɔ ne paado; na wosiaan mu.
Na ɔbaa no a ɔwɔ fie hɔ no faa nkataano no na ɔtserɛɛw mu kataa bura no ano, na ɔdze eburow siwii tserɛtserɛɛw do: na obiara ennhu ho hwee.
Na Absalom no nkowaa no baa ɔbaa no nkyɛn wɔ fie hɔ; na wɔsee dɛ, Hen na Ahimaaz na Jonatan wɔwɔ? Na ɔbaa no see hɔn dɛ, Woetwa ɔwora no kɔ. Na wɔhwehwɛɛ hɔn na woennhu hɔn no, wɔsanee baa Jerusalɛm.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔkɔree no ekyir no, wofii bura no mu puei, na wosii mu kɔree kɛkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen David; na wɔsee David dɛ, Hom nsoɛr, na wonkotwa nsu no ntsɛm: na dɛm na Ahithofel apam etsia hom.
Nna David, na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no nyinara soɛree, na wokotwaa Jordan: na anapa enyimtsetsewee no na hɔn mu baako mpo nnkae a onnyae nnkotwaa Jordan.
Aber a Ahithofel hun dɛ wɔammfa n’apam do no, ɔhyehyɛɛ n’asoaso, na ɔsoɛree kɔr fie wɔ no kurow mu na ɔtotoo ne fie yie, na ɔkɛsɛɛn ne men; na owui, na wosiee no wɔ n’egya n’asamandan mu.
Nna David baa Mahanaim. Na Absalom kotwaa Jordan, ɔnoara na Israel mbarimba a wɔka no ho no nyinara.
Na Absalom dze Amasa hyɛɛ Joab n’ananmu wɔ dɔm no do. Amasa yi yɛ Israelnyi ɔbarimba bi a ne dzin dze Itra ne ba, na ne na nye Nahas ne babaa Abigail, Joab ne na Zeruia no nua no.
Na Israel na Absalom kɛkyeer nsera wɔ Gilead asaase do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a David baa Mahanaim no, Sobi, Nahas ne ba a ofi Ammonmba Rabaa no, na Makir, Ammiel ne ba a ofi Lo-debar, na Barzillai, Gileadnyi a ofi Rogelim no,
dze mpa na mbɛɛsen, dɛtse asɛn, ewifua na atoko, isiam na eburow kyewee, eduwa, na asaduwa, na efan kyenkyenee,
ewo na buter, na nguan na anantwi kyiise, brɛɛ David, na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no, dɛ wondzi: na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔkɔm dze nkorɔfo no, na wɔaberɛ, na nsukɔm so dze hɔn, wɔ sar no do.
Na David kaan nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no, na ɔdze mpem do asafohemfo na ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo sisii hɔn do.

Na David gyaa nkorɔfo no kwan, ɔdze ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor hyɛɛ Joab nsa, na ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor so hyɛɛ Zeruia ne ba Abishai, Joab no nua no nsa, na ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor so hyɛɛ Itai, Gitinyi no nsa. Na ɔhen no see nkorɔfo no dɛ, Ampa emi mara so menye hom rifir edzi akɔ.

Na nkorɔfo no see dɛ, Ɔwo mma mmfir edzi nnkɔ: osiandɛ sɛ yeguan a, wɔronndwen hɛn ho; nkyii so sɛ hɛn mu fa totɔr a, wɔronndwen hɛn ho: naaso ɔwo dze, etse dɛ hɛn mu ɔpedu: dɛm ntsi afei oye dɛ ebɛyɛ krado efi kurow no mu abɔboa hɛn.
Na ɔhen no see hɔn dɛ, Dza oye wɔ hom enyi do no, mebɛyɛ. Na ɔhen no gyinaa kuropon nkyɛn, na ɔman no nyinara puei kɔr no ɔha ɔha mu, na mpem mpem mu.

Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ Joab na Abishai na Itai, dɛ, Hom nye aberantsɛ no ndzi no berɛww wɔ me ntsi, mekyerɛ Absalom a. Na aber a ɔhen no rehyɛ asafohemfo no nyinara mbra wɔ Absalom ho no, nkorɔfo no nyinara tsee.
Na ɔman no fiir edzi kɔr haban mu kehyiaa Israel: na ɔko no wɔkoo no Efraim kwaa mu.
Na David no dɔm no bɔɔ Israel ɔman no gui, na okum kɛse sii hɔ da no, na ɔfaa nyimpa mpemeduonu.
Na ɔko no mu tserɛwee wɔ hɔ kataa asaase no nyinara enyi: na kwaa no sɛɛ nyimpa dodow da no seen hɔn a afona sɛɛ hɔn.

Na Absalom hyiaa David no nkowaa no awerɛfir mu. Nna Absalom tse n’asoasopɔnkɔ do, na asoasopɔnkɔ no dze kɛfaa esudur kɛse bi n’abaw kusuww ase, na ne tsir kɛhyɛɛ esudur no mu, ma wɔmaa no do ma ɔsensɛɛn ɔsor na asaase ntamu; na asoasopɔnkɔ a ɔwɔ n’ase no nam do kɔree.
Na ɔbarimba bi kohunii, na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ Joab see dɛ, Hwɛ, muhun Absalom dɛ ɔsɛn esudur mu.
Na Joab see ɔbarimba no a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no no dɛ, Na, hwɛ, ɔwoara ihunii, na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ammbɔ no hɔ annhwe famu? Nkyɛ mebɛma wo dwetɛbona du na abɔdo.

Na ɔbarimba no see Joab dɛ, Sɛ mibenya dwetɛbona apem mpo wɔ me nsamu a, nkyɛ mennkɛtsen me nsa maka ɔhen ne ba no: na hɛn asomu na ɔhen hyɛɛ ɔwo na Abishai na Itai mbra, dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie ma obiara annka aberantsɛ Absalom no.
Anaaso sɛ mutwa no nkwa ho nkontompɔ a (na asɛm biara nnyi hɔ a osuma ɔhen), ɔnodze nkyɛ ɔwo kor yi ara ebɔtwe woho ekegyina nkyɛn.
Nna Joab see dɛ, Minnkekyinkyim wo ho dɛm. Na ɔfaa mpeaa ebiasa kitsaa ne nsamu, na ɔtowee hwiraa Absalom n’akoma mu, aber a nkwa da ho wɔ no mu wɔ esudur no mu no.
Na mberantsɛ du a wɔso Joab n’akodze no twaa ho hyiae na wɔbobɔɔ Absalom kum no.
Na Joab hɛɛn abɛn, na nkorɔfo no gyaa Israel tsiw sanee: osiandɛ Joab twee nkorɔfo no ekyir.
Na woyii Absalom kɔtoow no kyeen kwaa no mu mona kɛse bi mu, na wɔhyɛɛ abo isiw kɛsenara wɔ no do: na Israel nyinara guanee obiara kɔr n’asesee mu.

Na Absalom tse ase no osii nkaadum bi a ɔwɔ ɔhen no bɔn mu no dze maa noho: na ɔsee dɛ, Minnyi babanyin a wɔdze no bɛkaa me dzin: na ɔdze nankasa ne dzin too dum no: na wɔfrɛɛ no Absalom ne nkaadum, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Nna Ahimaaz, Zadok ba no see dɛ, Afei ma muntu mbirika monkɔbɔ ɔhen amandzɛɛ, mbrɛ EWURADZE esi na oedzi n’atamfo wer ama no.
Na Joab see no dɛ, Mma ɔwo nnyɛ amandzɛɛbɔfo ndɛ da yi, mbom ebɔbɔ amandzɛɛ da bi: na ndɛ da yi dze mma nnkɔbɔ amandzɛɛ, osiandɛ ɔhen ne ba atɔr.
Nna Joab see Kusnyi no dɛ, Kɔ kɛka dza ɔwoara ehu kyerɛ ɔhen. Na Kusnyi no bɔɔ no mu adze maa Joab, na otuu mbirika.

Nna Ahimaaz, Zadok ba no da ho see Joab bio dɛ, Meserɛ wo, dza ɔbɛba biara mbra, ma mo so muntu mbirika memfa Kusnyi no. Na Joab see dɛ, Me ba, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na epɛ dɛ itu mbirika yi, hwɛ no dɛ irinnya akatua bi wɔ amandzɛɛ no ntsi yi?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Dza ɔbɛba biara mbra, mubotu mbirika. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Tu mbirika ɛ. Nna Ahimaaz tuu mbirika dze faa Tɛtɛrmu kwan no do, na ɔkɛpaa Kusnyi no ho.
Na David tse nkuropon ebien no ntamu: na ɔweɔmfo no fowee kɔr kuropon nkurii no do wɔ fadum no ho, na ɔmaa n’enyiwa do, na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi nankotoo dze mbirika.
Na ɔweɔmfo no tseaa mu na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Sɛ nankotoo a nna amandzɛɛ bi wɔ n’anomu. Na ɔdze ba ara, na ɔbɛnee.

Na ɔweɔmfo no hun ɔbarimba kor so dɛ ɔdze mbirika reba: na ɔweɔmfo no tseaa mu frɛɛ abowanohwɛfo no, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔbarimba kor so nankotoo dze mbirika reba. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, ɔno so dze amandzɛɛ reba.
Na ɔweɔmfo no see dɛ, Emi modwen dɛ odzikamfo no ne mbirikatu tse dɛ Ahimaaz, Zadok ba no ne mbirikatu. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Ɔno ɔyɛ nyimpa pa, na ɔdze amandzɛɛ pa reba.

Na Ahimaaz frɛe, na ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, Bɔkɔɔ. Na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ ɔhen no enyim dze n’enyim boom famu, na ɔsee dɛ Nhyira nka EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn a oeyi nyimpa a wɔma hɔn nsa do tsia mo wura ɔhen no ama.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Ana aberantsɛ Absalom no ho ye? Na Ahimaaz buaa dɛ, Aber a Joab rosoma ɔhen n’akowaa no, mekyerɛ mara w’akowaa a, muhun gyigyeegye kɛse bi, na minnyim n’adzeban.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Dan woho, gyina ha. Na ɔdaan noho kegyinaa dzinn.
Na, hwɛ, Kusnyi no bae; na Kusnyi no see dɛ, Mo wura ɔhen, amandzɛɛ nye yi. EWURADZE edzi hɔn a wɔsoɛree tsiaa wo nyinara wer ama wo ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔhen no see Kusnyi no dɛ, Ana aberantsɛ Absalom no ho ye? Na Kusnyi no buaa dɛ, Wɔmma mo wura ɔhen n’atamfo, na hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia wo dɛ wɔbɛyɛ wo bɔn no nyinara, nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ aberantsɛ no ayɛ.

Na ɔhen no ho popoo dodow, na ɔfowee kɔr kuropon no do pia no mu, na osui: na aber a ɔrokɔ no mbrɛ ɔsee nye yi, Me ba Absalom e, me ba e, me ba Absalom e! Ao nkyɛ Nyame mma munwu mma wo, Absalom e, me ba e, me ba e!
Nna wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Joab dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔhen rusu na origyam Absalom.
Na da no konyimdzi no daan dɔm no nyinara nkɔmbɔdzi: na dɔm no tsee no da no dɛ wɔrese dɛ, Ɔhen ridzi yaw ma ne ba.
Na dɔm no wiawiaa hɔnho baa kurow no mu da no, dɛ mbrɛ nkorɔfo a woguan ɔko mu gu hɔn enyim ase no, wiawia hɔnho no.
Na ɔhen no kataa n’enyim, na ɔhen no dze ndze kɛse kekaa mu dɛ, Me ba Absalom e, Absalom e, me ba e, me ba e!
Na Joab baa ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ fie, na ɔsee dɛ, Ndɛ da yi egu wo nkowaa nyinara a ndɛ da yi wɔagye ɔwo na wo mbabanyin, na wo mbabaa, na wo yernom, na wo nwewefo nkwa no enyim ase;

wɔ dɛ ɔwo edɔ hɔn a wɔtan wo, na etan hɔn a wɔdɔ wo. Osiandɛ ɔwo ada no edzi ndɛ da yi, dɛ asafohemfo na nkowaa nnyɛ hwee mma wo: na ndɛ da yi muhu dɛ, sɛ Absalom tsenaa ase, na hɛn nyinara wuwui a, nkyɛ ɔsɔ w’enyi papaara.

Dɛm ntsi afei soɛr, fir edzi, na kɛkasa awerɛkyekyer mu kyerɛ wo nkowaa: na meka EWURADZE dɛ, sɛ emmpue a, ondu mbrɛ adze nsa no nna w’akofo no mu kor mpo nnkaa wo nkyɛn: na ɔno mbom bɛyɛ ɔhaw kɛse ama wo ma ɔasen mbusu a ofitsi wo mberantsɛber dze ebodu sesei aba wo do nyinara.

Nna ɔhen no soɛree, na ɔkɛtsenaa kuropon no mu. Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinara dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔhen no tse kuropon no mu: na ɔman no nyinara baa ɔhen no enyim. Afei na Israel eguanguan, nyimpa biara kɔ n’asesee mu.
Na ɔman no nyinara hamee wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu, dɛ, Ɔhen na oyii hɛn fii hɛn atamfo nsamu, na ɔno na ɔgyee hɛn fii Filistiafo nsamu; na afei Absalom ntsi oeguan efi asaase yi do.
Na Absalom a yɛseraa no hyɛɛ no hen wɔ hɛn do no, ɔatɔr wɔ akono. Dɛm ntsi afei ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom nnka asɛm bi a wɔdze bɛkɛfa ɔhen asan aba yi?

Na ɔhen David tsee Israel nyinara hɔn asɛm yi no, ɔsomae ma wɔkɔr asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar nkyɛn, dɛ, Hom nkasa nkyerɛ Juda mpanyimfo, dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom aka ekyir dɛ wɔdze ɔhen bɛsan akɔ ne fie yi?
Hom nye mo nuanom, hom nye me biew na mo honam: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom aka ekyir dɛ wɔdze ɔhen bɛsan akɔ?
Na hom nse Amasa dɛ, Ana ɔwo nnyɛ me biew na mo honam bi a? Nyankopɔn nyɛ me dɛm, na bi so nka ho, sɛ ɔwo enndzi dɔm no do ɔsafohen wɔ m’enyim daa nyina annhyɛ Joab n’ananmu a.
Na ɔbrɛɛ Juda mbarimba no nyinara hɔn akoma adze, dɛ nyimpa baako n’akoma; ma dɛm ntsi wɔsomae ma wɔkɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn, dɛ, San bra, ɔwo na wo nkowaa nyinara.
Nna ɔhen no sanee, na ɔbaa Jordan do. Na Juda baa Gilgal, dɛ wɔrokɔ ekehyia ɔhen no, na wɔdze ɔhen no etwa Jordan.
Na Simei, Gera ba no, Benjaminnyi a ofi Bahurim no, yɛɛ ntsɛm na ɔnye Juda mbarimba no sianee baa dɛ woribehyia ɔhen David.
Na Benjamin mbarimba apem ka no ho, na Ziba, Saul ne fie akowaa no, na ne mbabanyin duenum na no nkowaa eduonu ka no ho bae; na wotwaa Jordan baa ɔhen no enyim.
Na esutwahɛn twae kɔr dɛ wɔdze rekɛfa ɔhen ne fiefo etwa, na wɔayɛ dza ohia biara. Na Simei, Gera ba no, boom ɔhen no n’enyim famu, aber a otwaa Jordan bae no.
Na ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, Mma mma mo wura mmbu emumuyɛ mma me, nkyii so mma nnkaa dza w’akowaa yɛɛ no nkɔnkɔnsa mu wɔ da a mo wura ɔhen fii Jerusalɛm no, dɛ ɔhen bɛfa ato n’akoma mu.
Osiandɛ w’akowaa nyim dɛ mayɛ bɔn: dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, emi na medzi Josef fi nyinara ne kan maba ndɛ da yi dɛ mirisian mekehyia mo wura ɔhen.
Na Abishai, Zeruia ne ba no, buae see dɛ, Ana worunnku Simei wɔ iyi ntsi, osiandɛ ɔadom nyia EWURADZE asera no no?
Na David see dɛ, Ebɛnadze na mowɔ menye hom yɛ, hom Zeruia mba, dɛ hom bɛyɛ atamfo ama me ndɛ da yi? Ana ndɛ da yi wonku nyimpa wɔ Israel a? Ana minnyim dɛ ndɛ da yi midzi hen wɔ Israel do bi a?
Na ɔhen no see Simei dɛ, Innkowu. Na ɔhen no kaa ntam kyerɛɛ no.

Na Mefiboset, Saul ne ba no, sianee baa dɛ oribehyia ɔhen no; ɔnnyɛɛ n’anan ho yie, nkyii so onnsiesiee n’abɔdwesa ho, na ɔannhor ne ntar so ara ofi da no a ɔhen sii mu kɔree no bodur da a ɔbaa fie asomdwee mu no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔbaa Jerusalɛm dɛ oribehyia ɔhen no, ɔhen see no dɛ, Mefiboset, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ennye me annkɔ?
Na obuaa dɛ, Ao mo wura ɔhen, m’akowaa na ɔdaadaa me: na w’akowaa see dɛ, Mebɛhyehyɛ asoaso, na nkyɛ matsena do, na menye ɔhen akɔ, osiandɛ w’akowaa yɛ ebubua.
Na oebotwir w’akowaa ama mo wura ɔhen; na mo wura ɔhen dze ɔtse dɛ Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe: dɛm ntsi yɛ dza oye wɔ w’enyiwa do.
Osiandɛ m’egya fie nyinara yɛ ewufo ara wɔ mo wura ɔhen enyim: naaso ɔwo dze w’akowaa hyɛɛ hɔn a wodzidzi wankasa wo pon do mu. Dɛm ntsi ebɛn kwan na mowɔ bio dɛ medze mebɛkeka mu afrɛ ɔhen bio?
Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na eda ho kasa wo nsɛm yi ho bio yi? Mese dɛ, Ɔwo na Ziba wɔnkɛkyɛ asaase no mu.
Na Mefiboset see ɔhen dɛ, Mpo, ma ɔmfa ne nyinara, susuampa dɛ mo wura ɔhen aba nankasa ne fie asomdwee mu yi.
Na Barzillai, Gileadnyi no, sianee fi Rogelim bae; na ɔnye ɔhen twaa Jordan, dɛ orikegya no Jordan egya.
Nna Barzillai yɛ nyimpa a oenyin dodow, oedzi mfe eduowɔtwe: na ɔno na ɔbɔɔ ɔhen akɔhoma mber a ɔda Mahanaim no; osiandɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa kɛse dɛ.
Na ɔhen no see Barzillai dɛ, Bra bɛnye me ntwa nkɔ Jerusalɛm, na mobɔhwɛ wo me nkyɛn.
Na Barzillai see ɔhen no dɛ, Mo nkwa mfe mu nda yɛ ahen, na menye ɔhen mfow nkɔ Jerusalɛm yi?

Mowɔ hɔ yi medzi mfe eduowɔtwe: ana mubotum ehu papa na bɔn mu? Ana w’akowaa botum atse dza midzi anaa dza monom? Ana mubotum atse mbarimba adwontofo na mbaa adwontofo ndze bio a? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’akowaa bɛda ho ara ayɛ adzesoa ama mo wura ɔhen yi?
W’akowaa nye ɔhen botwa Jordan akɔ kakra: na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔhen dze dɛm akatua botua me kaw?
Meserɛ wo, ma w’akowaa nsan ekyir bio, ma munkowu wɔ mankasa mo kurow mu, wɔ m’egya na me na nda nkyɛn. Mbom hwɛ, w’akowaa Kimham; ma ɔnye mo wura ɔhen ntwa nkɔ; na dza ehwɛ a oye ma wo no fa yɛ no.
Na ɔhen buaa dɛ, Kimham nye me botwa akɔ, na mebɛyɛ no dza oye wɔ w’enyi do: na biribiara a ebɔhwehwɛ wɔ mo hɔ no, mebɛyɛ ama wo.
Na ɔman no nyinara twaa Jordan, na ɔhen no so twae: na ɔhen no feew Barzillai n’ano, na ohyiraa no; na ɔsanee kɔr nankasa ne tsenabew.
Nna ɔhen no sii mu kɔr Gilgal, na Kimham nye no sii mu kɔree: na Juda ɔman no nyinara, na Israel ɔman no ne fa, na wɔdze ɔhen no twae bae.

Na, hwɛ, Israel mbarimba no nyinara baa ɔhen no nkyɛn, na wɔbɛsee ɔhen no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hɛn nuanom Juda mbarimba ewia wo kɔ, na wɔdze ɔhen, na ne fiefo, na David ne mbarimba a wɔka no ho nyinara etwa Jordan aba yi?
Na Juda mbarimba no nyinara buaa Israel mbarimba no dɛ, Osiandɛ ɔhen yɛ obusuanyi a ɔbɛn hɛn: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bo bofuw wɔ asɛm yi ntsi yi? Ana yeedzi ɔhen ho biribi? Ana ɔama hɛn akyɛdze bi?

Na Israel mbarimba no buaa Juda mbarimba no see dɛ, Yɛwɔ kyɛfa du wɔ ɔhen mu, na eso yɛwɔ David mu ɔkwan sen hom: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bu hɛn enyimtsia, dɛ hɛn apam enndzi kan ammba mu dɛ wɔdze hɛn hen bɛsan aba? Na Juda mbarimba no hɔn nsɛm no yɛɛ dzen seen Israel mbarimba no hɔn nsɛm no.

Na ɔbaa dɛ nna ɔbarimba kwasampanyi bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Seba, a ɔyɛ Benjaminnyi Bikri ne ba: na ɔhɛɛn abɛn see dɛ, Yennyi kyɛpɛn wɔ David mu, nkyii so yennyi egyapadze wɔ Jesse ne ba no mu: Israel e, nyimpa biara nkɔ n’asesee mu oo.
Nna Israel mbarimba no nyinara fii David n’ekyir na wɔkɔree kedzii Seba, Bikri ne ba no n’ekyir: na Juda mbarimba no dze wɔtakyeer hɔn hen ho, fi Jordan do araa baa Jerusalɛm.

Na David baa ne fie wɔ Jerusalɛm; na ɔhen no faa no nwewefo mbaa du no a ogyaa hɔn dɛ wɔnhwɛ fie no, na ɔdze hɔn koguu beebi fofor, na ɔbɔɔ hɔn akɔhoma, na hɔn nkyɛn dze ɔannkɔ. Nna wɔtoow hɔn mu araa ma okodur hɔn wu da, tse dɛ wɔtse ekunayɛ mu.
Nna ɔhen no see Amasa dɛ, Kɛfrɛfrɛ Juda mbarimba no ma me ma wonhyia wɔ ndaansa ntamu, na ɔwoara so bra begyina ha.
Nna Amasa sii mu kɔr dɛ orikehyiahyia Juda mbarimba no ma woeehyia: na ɔkyɛree ma ɔseen aber a wɔdze hyɛɛ no no.

Na David see Abishai dɛ, Afei na Seba, Bikri ne ba no, bɛyɛ hɛn bɔn asen dza Absalom yɛe no: ɔwoara fa wo wura no nkowaa no, na tsiw no, ɔno bɛyɛ na oenya nkurow a wɔagye ho ban mu afa, na oefi nsa eguan efi hɛn enyi do.
Na Joab ne mbarimba no, na Keretfo, na Peletfo, na mbarimba akatakyi no nyinara tui dzii n’ekyir: na wotui fii Jerusalɛm dɛ woritsiw Bikri ne ba Seba.

Aber a wodur ɔbo kɛse no a ɔwɔ Gibeon no ho no, Amasa bae behyiaa hɔn. Nna Joab ɔabɔ n’akontar a ɔhyɛ no do, na ɔno do nna wɔdze abɔdo afona a ɔhyɛ no bɔha mu wɔ do akyekyer n’asen; na orifir edzi no ɔworɔwee tɔɔ famu.
Na Joab see Amasa dɛ, Mo nua, ana wo ho ye? Na Joab dze ne nsa enyimfa suoo Amasa n’abɔdwesa mu dɛ ɔrefew n’ano.
Na Amasa dze ɔannhwɛ afona no a ɔdze Joab ne nsamu no: dɛm ntsi ɔdze wɔɔ ne yafun mu, na otuu no nson guu famu, na ɔammfee no do; na owui. Na Joab na no nua Abishai tsiiw Bikri ne ba Seba.
Na Joab ne mberantsɛ no mu baako gyinaa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Nyia ɔpɛ Joab n’asɛm, na ɔwɔ David afa no, wɔmma ondzi Joab n’ekyir.

Na Amasa yankayankaam no bɔgyaa mu wɔ tsempɔn no mu. Na ɔbarimba no hun dɛ nkorɔfo no nyinara gyinaa hɔ dzinn no, ɔsoaa Amasa fii tsempɔn no mu kɔtoo haban mu, na ohun dɛ obiara a obodu ne nkyɛn no ogyina dzinn ntsi, ɔdze atar kɛkataa no do.
Aber a woyii no fii tsempɔn no do no, nkorɔfo no nyinara kɔree kedzii Joab n’ekyir, dɛ woritsiw Bikri ne ba Seba.
Na ɔdze faa Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu twaa mu kɔr Aber, na Bɛt-maaka, na Berifo nyina mu: na wɔboaboaa ano, na wɔkɔree so kedzii n’ekyir.
Na wɔbae botuaa no wɔ Abel a ɔwɔ Bɛt-maaka, na wɔtotoow kurow no ho pampi, na ogyinaa akoban no ne tsentsendo: na nkorɔfo a wɔka Joab ho nyinara pempeem fasu no, dɛ worudwuruw no egu.
Nna ɔbaa nyansafo bi fii kurow no mu tseaa mu dɛ, Wontsie oo, wontsie oo; meserɛ hom, hom nse Joab dɛ, Twe pin ha ma menye wo nkasa.
Na ɔtwee piin ne nkyɛn; na ɔbaa no see dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Joab a? Na obuaa dɛ, Mara a. Nna ɔsee no dɛ, Tsie w’afonabaa ne nsɛm. Na obuaa dɛ, Miritsie.
Nna ɔkaa dɛ, Tsetseber no wɔtɔ dɛ wɔka no dɛ, bisa na wombisa apam wɔ Abel: na dɛm no nna woetwa asɛm no do.
Modɔm Israel mu hɔn a wɔpɛ asomdwee na nokwar: ɔwo rohwehwɛ asɛɛ Israel mu kurow tsitsir: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na erebɛmen EWURADZE n’egyapadze yi?
Na Joab buae see dɛ, Ɔmpar me, ɔmpar me dɛ mebɛmen anaa mebɛsɛɛ.

Asɛm no nntse dɛm: mbom ɔbarimba bi a ofi Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu a ne dzin dze Seba, Bikri ne ba no, na ɔama ne nsa do etsia ɔhen, mekyerɛ David a: hom nyi no nkotoo mma, na mibefi kurow no ho makɔ. Na ɔbaa no see Joab dɛ, Hwɛ, wɔbɔtow ne tsir akyen fasu no ekyir.

Nna ɔbaa no dze ne nyansaa mu kɔr ɔman no nyinara nkyɛn. Na wotwaa Bikri ne ba Seba ne tsir, na wɔtowee kyeen Joab. Na ɔhɛɛn abɛn, na wofii kurow no ho petsee, nyimpa biara kɔr n’asesee mu. Na Joab sanee baa ɔhen nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalɛm.
Afei Joab nna odzi Israel dɔm nyinara do: na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia, na ɔhwɛ Keretfo na Peletfo do:
na Adoram na ɔhwɛ edwumayɛ tow no do: na Ahilud ne ba Jehosafat na ɔyɛ ɔsɛnkaafo:
na Seva nye ɔkyerɛwfo: na Zadok nye Abiathar nye asɔfo:
nna Ira, Jairnyi no so yɛ David no sɔfoe.
Na ɔkɔm bi baa David aber do mfe ebiasa toaa do; na David kɔr EWURADZE hɔ ebisa. Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Saul ntsi a, na no bɔgya fi no ntsi a, osiandɛ okum Gibeonfo no.

Na ɔhen no frɛɛ Gibeonfo no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ; (na Gibeonfo no wɔnnyɛ Israelmba no mu bi, na mbom Amorifo nkaase no mu bi a; na Israelmba no aka ntam akyerɛ hɔn: na Saul hwehwɛɛ dɛ oku hɔn wɔ no mbɔdzen a ɔbɔ wɔ Israel na Judamba no ho:)
na David see Gibeonfo no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menyɛ memma hom, na ebɛnadze na memfa mempata, ama hom eehyira EWURADZE n’egyapadze?

Na Gibeonfo no see no dɛ, Nnyɛ dwetɛ anaa sikasɛm bi na ɔda hɛn na Saul, anaa ne fi ntamu; nkyii so nnyɛ hɛnara bi na yeruboku Israel mu nyimpa biara. Na David see dɛ, Dza hom bɛse no, ɔnoara na mebɛyɛ ama hom.
Na wɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, ɔbarimba no a ɔhyeew hɛn, na ɔpaam hɛn tsir do, dɛ wɔnsɛɛ hɛn ma hɛn ase nhyew mfi Israel ahe do beebiara no,
ma wonyi ne mbabanyin mu nyimpa beesuon mma hɛn, na yɛnsensɛn hɔn mma EWURADZE, wɔ Saul a EWURADZE saan mu faa no, ne Gibea no mu. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Mibeyi hɔn ama.
Na ɔhen no gyee Saul ne ba Jonatan ne ba Mefiboset nkwa, osian EWURADZE ne ntam a ɔda hɔn ntamu ntsi, dza ɔda David na Saul ne ba Jonatan ntamu no a.

Mbom ɔhen no faa Aia ne babaa Rizpa ne mbabanyin beenu no a ɔwoo hɔn maa Saul no, Armoni na Mefiboset; na Saul ne babaa Mikal ne mbabanyin beenum no a ɔwoo hɔn maa Meholatnyi Adriel, Barzillai ne ba no:

na oyii hɔn hyɛɛ Gibeonfo no nsa, na wɔsɛɛn hɔn bepɔw no do wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na hɔn beesuon no nyinara bɔɔ mu totɔree: na wokum hɔn wɔ twaber nda no mu, nda a odzi kan no mu a, atoko twaber ahyɛse no mu a.

Na Ahia ne babaa Rizpa faa eyitam, na ɔtsɛɛw mu kataa ɔbotan no do maa noho, fi twaber ahyɛse no ara kodur dɛ nsu fi sor guguu hɔn do ana; na ɔamma kwan ma wimu nnoma ammbɛgyegye hɔn do adzekyee, na hamu mbowa so ammba hɔn do adzesaa.
Na wɔkɛkaa dza Aia ne babaa Rizpa, Saul no nwewe no, ayɛ no kyerɛɛ David.

Na David sii mu kɔree kɛgyee Saul ne mbiew na ne ba Jonatan ne mbiew no wɔ Jabes-gileadfo hɔ, hɔn a wokowiaa hɔn wɔ Bɛt-san abɔntsen do mbrɛ Filistiafo no dze hɔn sensɛnee, wɔ da a Filistiafo kum Saul wɔ Gilboa no:
na ɔdze Saul ne mbiew na ne ba Jonatan ne mbiew no fii hɔ bae; na wɔboaboaa hɔn a wɔsensɛɛn hɔn no hɔn mbiew no ano.
Na wosiee Saul na ne ba Jonatan hɔn mbiew no wɔ Benjamin asaase do wɔ Zela, wɔ n’egya Kis n’asamandan mu: na wɔyɛɛ dza ɔhen no hyɛe no nyinara. Na ɔno n’ekyir no Nyankopɔn tsiei maa asaase no.
Na Filistiafo no wɔnye Israel nyaa ko bio; na David na no nkowaa ka no ho sianee kɔree, na wɔnye Filistiafo no kɔkoe: na David tɔɔ bahaw.
Isbi-benob a, ɔyɛ ɔkraban no ne mba no mu bi a ne peaa no dur woker a, ɔtow boran dwetɛbona ahaasa no, na ɔdze afona fofor abɔ ntsi, ɔdween dɛ nkyɛ oboku David.
Na Zeruia ba Abishai boaa no, na ɔbɔɔ Filistianyi no, na okum no. Nna David ne mbarimba no kaa ntam guu no do, dɛ, Mma nnye hɛn mmfir edzi nnkɔ nkɔko bio, amma eenndum Israel kandzea no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ iyi n’ekyir no, wɔnye Filistiafo no nya ɔko bio wɔ Gob; nna Husatnyi Sibekai kum Saf a ɔyɛ ɔkraban no ne mba no mu bi no.
Na wɔnye Filistiafo no nyaa ɔko bio wɔ Gob; na Bɛtlɛhɛmnyi Elhanan, Jaare-oregim ne ba no, okum Gitinyi Goliat a ne peaa no kura tse dɛ ɔtanwemfo n’asadua.
Na ɔko baa bio wɔ Gat, mbrɛ ɔbarimba pankor bi a ɔwɔ nsakum do nsatseaba esia esia, na anansa do anansɔba esia esia ma no dodow yɛ eduonu anan; na ɔno so wɔwoo no maa ɔkraban.
Na aber a orutwitwa Israel mpoa no, David no nua Simei ne ba Jonatan kum no.
Woyinom baa nan yi wɔwowoo hɔn maa akraban no wɔ Gat; na wɔtotɔree wɔ David, na no nkowaa no hɔn nsaano.
Na David kaa ndwom yi mu nsɛm kyerɛɛ EWURADZE wɔ da a EWURADZE yii no fii n’atamfo nyinara nsamu, na Saul nsamu no:
na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE nye mo botan, na m’akoban, na me gyefo, mara medze a;
Mo botantsim Nyankopɔn a, no mu na muguan modɔ; M’akokyɛm, na mo nkwagye ambɛn, m’abantsentsen, na mo guansumabew; M’agyenkwa, ɔwo na egye me fi akakabensɛm mu.
Mubosu afrɛ EWURADZE, ɔno a ɔsɛ dɛ woyi no ayɛw no: Nna wɔbɛgye me efi m’atamfo nsamu.
Na owu asorɛkye twaa mo ho hyiae, Mbusubɔ nsuyirii maa mo bo tui.
Samanadze ahoma brabraa mo ho: Owu ne mfir baa mo do.
M’ahokyer mu musui frɛɛ EWURADZE, Nyew, me Nyankopɔn na mekaa mu frɛɛ no: Na ofi n’asɔrfi mu tsee me ndze, Na me nkekamu kodur n’asomu.
Nna asaase hihimii na ɔwosowee, Ɔsor fapem tutui Na wohihimii, osiandɛ no bo fuwii ntsi.
Wusiw fi n’ahwentokura mu firii, Na ogya fi n’anomu hyeew adze: Ɔmaa biriw sɔe.
Ɔkontoom ɔsor so, na odwirii; Na isum kebikebi dzi n’ananadze.
Na ɔtsena kerub do, na otui: Nyew, wohun no wɔ mframa ntsaban do.
Ɔdze isum yɛɛ asese bɔɔ noho aprɔw, Nsu mboaboano, iwimu mununkum kusuww.
Hyerɛn a odzi n’enyim ntsi Ogyabiriw sɔe.
EWURADZE bobɔɔ mu wɔ sor, Na Ɔsorsornyi no maa wɔtsee ne ndze.
Na ɔtotoow ngyen menaba, na ɔhotsee hɔn; Enyinam, na ɔdze kaa hɔn gui.
Nna epo mu esuka yiyii hɔnho, Wiadze fapem ho dedaa hɔ, Wɔ EWURADZE ne nkaenyim no ntsi, N’ahwentokura mu ehuhuw huuhuw no ntsi.
Ɔsomae fi sor bɛfaa me; Ɔtwee me fii nsu pii mu;
Ɔgyee me fii me tamfo ɔhoɔdzenfo no, Na hɔn a wokyiir me no nsa; osiandɛ wɔyɛɛ dzen dodow maa me.
Wɔbɔtoatoaa me wɔ m’amandzehu da no mu: Na EWURADZE nye me kyirtaafo.
Na ɔdze me so baa mbrɛ ɔtsɛw: Ɔgyee me, osiandɛ n’enyi gyee mo ho.
EWURADZE tuaa me kaw dɛ mbrɛ me tsenenee tse: Dɛ mbrɛ me nsa ho tsew pa na ɔahyɛ me ananmu.
Na mesie EWURADZE n’akwan no, Na mommbɔɔ ehuhubra mimmfii me Nyankopɔn ho.
Na n’atsɛmbu nyinara wɔ m’enyi do: Na n’ahyɛdze so mimmfii ho.
Midzii mu so wɔ n’afamu, Na misiee moho fii m’emumuyɛ ho.
Dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE ahyɛ me ananmu dɛ mbrɛ me tsenenee tse; Dɛ mbrɛ m’ahofir wɔ n’enyiwa mu tse.
Mbɔbɔrhufo na enye no bedzi no mbɔbɔr mu, Nyia odzi mu na enye no bedzi no emudzi mu;
Nyia no ho tsew, na ebɛtsew woho akyerɛ no; Na nyia ɔyɛ nkɔntɔnkye dze ebɛkyea woho akyerɛ no.
Na ɔman amandzehufo no, ɔwo ebɛgye hɔn: Na w’enyi sa nkontompɔfo, ma aabrɛ hɔn adze.
Na ɔwo EWURADZE, na eyɛ me kandzea: Na EWURADZE bɛhyerɛn mo sum mu.
Na ɔwo na medze wo mutu mbirika tsew edɔm mu: Me Nyankopɔn na medze no huruw tra fasu.
Nyankopɔn dze, no kwan dzi mu: EWURADZE n’asɛm wɔasɔ ahwɛ; Ɔyɛ akokyɛm ma hɔn a woguan toa no nyinara.
Na woana nye Nyankopɔn, gyedɛ EWURADZE nko? Na woana yɛ ɔbotan, gyedɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn nko?
Nyankopɔn nye m’akoban dzendzen: Na ɔgye nyia odzi mu no wɔ no kwan mu.
Ɔyɛ ne nan dɛ adoa anan: Na ɔdze me si me mbea sorɔnsorɔm do.
Ɔkyerɛ me nsa akodzi; Ma m’abasa tum kontom boran egyen.
Eso edze wo nkwagye akokyɛm no ama me: Na w’ahobrɛadze ama mayɛ kɛse.
Ɔwo atserɛw m’anamɔn mu wɔ m’ase, Na m’anan mmpatserewee.
Metsiw m’atamfo, na masɛɛ hɔn: Nkyii so mannsan bio dze kodur dɛ wowiee sa.
Na mahyew hɔn, na mabɔ hɔn ehwira mu, ma wonnkotum soɛr; Nyew, wɔatotɔr wɔ m’ananadze.
Na ɔwo na edze ahoɔdzen abɔ me do ama akodzi: Ɔwo abrɛ hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia me no adze ahyɛ m’ase.
Ɔwo na ama m’atamfo so adan hɔn ekyir ama me, Ma metwa hɔn a wɔtan me no egu.
Wɔhwɛe, na ɔgyefo bi nnyi hɔ: Wɔhwɛɛ EWURADZE mpo, na oemmbua hɔn.
Nna moboor hɔn anhweanhwea dɛ famu huntuma, Mitsiatsiaa hɔn do dɛ abɔntsen do dɛtse, na mesaaw hɔn petsee.
Eso ɔwo eyi me efi me man hɔn akokoeko mu; Ɔwo ahwɛ me edze me ayɛ amanaman do tsitsir: Ɔman a minnyim hɔn no wɔbɔsom me.
Ananaben bɛbrɛ hɔnho adze ama me: Wɔtse me nka ara a, wobetsie me.
Ananaben bɛkyenkyen, Na wɔdze ahohim fi hɔn sumabea aba.
EWURADZE tse ase; na nhyira nka mo botantsim no; Na abɔso nye mo nkwagye botan Nyankopɔn no:
Mekyerɛ Nyame a odzi wer ma me no, Na ɔbrɛ aman adze hyɛ m’ase no,
Na ɔdze me efi m’atamfo mu aba: Nyew, ɔwo na ema me do bɔ hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia me no do: Ɔwo na iyi me fi nyimpa kakaben no nsamu.
Dɛm ntsi, EWURADZE, mebɛda wo ase wɔ amanaman mu, Na matow ayɛyindwom ama wo dzin.
Nkwagye kɛse na ɔdze ma ne hen: Na ɔyɛ adɔyɛ ma nyia wɔasera no no, David na n’asefo no daa.
Afei iyinom nye David ne nsɛm a odzi ekyir. Jesse ne ba David, Ɔbarimba a wɔakrɔn no no a, Nyia Jakob ne Nyankopɔn no asera no ngo no a, Israel ɔdwontofo pa no se dɛ:
EWURADZE no sunsum nam mo do kasae, Na n’asɛm duaa me gyirama do.
Israel Nyankopɔn no, Mekyerɛ Israel ɔbotan no, kasaa kyerɛɛ me: Nyia odzi adasa do hen tsenenee mu no, Nyia odzi hen Nyankopɔn no suro mu no a,
Ɔtse dɛ anapa kan, aber a wi rupue, Anapa a mununkum nnyi mu; Ɔtse dɛ dɛ ewia a opue nsutɔree ekyir Na ɔma nkyɛkyɛr nomanoma fifir asaase do no.
Nyew, dɛm na Nyankopɔn esi ehyira me fie; Ɔnye me edzi daa ahyɛmu, Oesiesie ndzɛmba nyinara mu, na oesi no pi: Na mo nkwagye nyinara, na m’apɛdze nyinara nye no, Nyankopɔn bɛma ne nyinara aba mu.
Na emumuyɛfo dze hɔn nyinara bɛyɛ dɛ nsoɛ a wɔrotow egu, Na wonnkotum dze nsa esuo mu:
Na nyimpa a orusuo mu no Ohia dɛ ɔdze dadze anaa peaadua yɛ; Na wɔdze ogya bɛhyew no dwɛɛ wɔ hɔn ananmu hɔ ara.

Iyinom nye mbarimba akatakyi a David nyae no hɔn edzin: Joseb-bassebet, Takemonnyi no, nna odzi asafohemfo no mu tsitsir; ɔnoara so nye Adino, Ezininyi no, na ɔmaa ne peaa do wɔ nyimpa ahaawɔtwe a okum hɔn prɛko do no.

Na ɔno n’ekyir nye Eleazar, Ahohinyi bi ne ba no, mbarimba akatakyi baasa a wɔka David ho wɔ aber a wotwaa Filistiafo a wɔaboaboa ano dɛ wɔrobɔko no mpowa no. Ber a Israel mbarimba no daan hɔn ekyir maa ɔko no,

ɔno na ɔsoɛree gyinae na okunkum Filistiafo no ara ma okodur dɛ ne nsa gyenee, na ne nsa kaa afona no ho: na EWURADZE dzii konyim kɛse da no; na ɔman no sanee kedzii n’ekyir dɛ adze ara nko na wɔrokɔfom.
Na ɔno n’ekyir nye Samma, Agee Hararnyi no ne ba. Na Filistiafo no boaboaa ano yɛɛ dɔm, baa Israelfo do wɔ mbrɛ asaase tɔw bi a asaduwa ayɛ do ma wɔ; na ɔman no guanee fii Filistiafo no enyim.
Na ɔnodze, ogyinaa asaasetɔw no ne finimfin, na ɔperee, na okum Filistiafo no: na EWURADZE dzii konyim kɛse.
Na etsitsir eduasa no mu baasa siaan famu, na wɔbaa David nkyɛn twaber mu wɔ Adullam ɔbo tu no mu; nna Filistiafo dɔm no akyer nsera wɔ Refaim ɔbɔn no mu.
Aber no nna David wɔ itu no mu, na Filistiafo bansifo no so wowɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm aber no mu.
Na David no kɔn dɔe, na ɔsee dɛ, Ao kɛtseankyɛ obi aama me Bɛtlɛhɛm nsubura a ɔwɔ kuropon no ho no mu nsu bi ma maanom!
Na mbarimba akatakyi baasa no bɔe faa Filistiafo dɔm no mu, na wɔkɛsaaw Bɛtlɛhɛm nsubura a ɔwɔ kuropon no ho no mu nsu bi, na wɔfae dze brɛɛ David: na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom, na mbom ohuei gui maa EWURADZE.

Na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔmpar me koraa, EWURADZE, dɛ mebɛyɛ iyi: ana monnom mbarimba a wɔdze hɔn nkwa kitsaa hɔn nsamu sii mu kɔree no hɔn bɔgyaa? Dɛm ntsi ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom. Iyinom na mbarimba akatakyi baasa no yɛe.
Na Zeruia ne ba, Joab no nua Abishai nna ɔyɛ baasa no mu otsitsir. Na ɔmaa ne peaa do wɔ ahaasa do kunkum hɔn, na onyaa dzin wɔ baasa no mu.
Ana ɔnnyɛ onyimnyamfo dodow wɔ baasa no mu bi a? Dɛm ntsi wɔyɛɛ no hɔn safohen: naaso ɔannto asɔpɔn baasa no.
Afei Jehoiada ne ba Benaia, ɔbarimba bi a ɔyɛ ndam a ofi Kabzeel ne ba no yɛɛ akatakyidze, ɔno na okum Moab nyimpa gyatasɛfo beenu: na osianee so kokum gyata wɔ mona bi mu wɔ esukwankyɛbaber mu:

na ɔnoara so kokum Egyptnyi bi, ɔbarimba kokroko bi: nna Egyptnyi no kitsa peaa wɔ ne nsamu; naaso ɔnodze ɔdze poma sianee kɔr ne nkyɛn, na okohwiim peaa no wɔ Egyptnyi no nsamu, na ɔdze nankasa ne peaa no kum no.
Ndzɛmba iyinom na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia yɛe, na onyaa dzin wɔ mbarimba akatakyi baasa no mu.
Ɔyɛɛ onyimnyamfo dodow seen eduasa no, na mbom ɔannto asɔpɔn baasa no. Na David dze no sii n’annkɔbeafo do.
Joab no nua Asahel ɔyɛ eduasa no mu baako; Dodo ne ba Elhanan a ofi Bɛtlɛhɛm;
Harodnyi Samma, Harodnyi Elika;
Paltinyi Helez, Tekoanyi Ikkes ba Ira;
Anathotnyi Abiezer, Husatnyi Mebunnai;
Ahohnyi Zalmon, Netofatnyi Maharai;
Baana ne ba Heleb, Netofatnyi, Ribai a ofi Benjaminmba Gibea ne ba Itai;
Benaia, Piratnyi, Hidai a ofi Gaas nwora mu;
Abialbon, Arbatnyi, Azmavet, Barhumnyi;
Eliaba, Saalbonnyi, Jasenmba, Jonatan;
Samma, Hararnyi, Sarar ne ba Ahiam, Ararinyi;
Elifelet, Ahasbai ne ba, Maakatnyi ne ba, Ahithofel ne ba Eliam Gilonyi;
Hezro Karmelnyi, Paa-rai, Arbinyi;
Natan a ofi Zoba ne ba Igal, Bani, Gadnyi;
Zelek, Ammonnyi, Naharai, Beerotnyi, Joab, Zeruia ne ba, n’akodzesoafo;
Ira, Itrinyi, Gareb, Itrinyi;
Uria, Hitinyi: hɔn nyinara yɛ eduasa esuon.
Na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Israel do bio, na opiapiaa David ma ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Kɔ, kɛkan Israel na Juda.
Na ɔhen no see dɔm no do safohen Joab a ɔka no ho no dɛ, Afei kɔ kekyin wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu, fi Dan araa kodu Beer-seba, na hom nkan ɔman no, ma munhu ɔman no hɔn dodow.
Na Joab see ɔhen no dɛ, Afei EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn nka ɔman no ho dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse biara mbɔho ɔha, na mo wura ɔhen mfa n’enyiwa nhu: na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mo wura ɔhen repɛ dɛm adze yi?
Naaso ɔhen no n’asɛm yɛɛ dzen wɔ Joab do, na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no do. Na Joab na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no fii ɔhen no enyim sii mu kɔr dɛ wɔrekɛkan Israel ɔman no.
Na wokotwaa Jordan, na wɔkɔbɔɔ asese wɔ Aroer, kurow a ɔda Gad ɔbɔn no ne finimfin, na odzi kɔ Jazer no, n’enyimfa:
na nkyii wɔbaa Gilead, na Tatim-hodsi asaase do; na wɔbaa Dan-jaan, na wɔponee sii Zidon,
na wɔbaa Taere akoban no, na Hivifo, na Keenanfo nkurow nyinara mu: na wopuei kɔr Juda epomu afamu, wɔ Beer-seba.
Dɛm ntsi aber a wokyiin asaase no nyinara do wie no, nna wɔbaa Jerusalɛm abosoom akron na adaduonu n’ewiei.
Na Joab dze ɔman no hɔn anobu no dodow no brɛɛ ɔhen no: na Israel mu mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam a wɔtwe afona wɔyɛ mpem ahaawɔtwe; na Juda mbarimba no wɔyɛ mpem ahaenum.
Na David kaan ɔman no n’ekyir no, n’akoma bɔɔ no paa. Na David see EWURADZE dɛ, Mayɛ bɔn kɛsenara wɔ dza mayɛ yi mu: na afei, EWURADZE, meserɛ wo, yi w’akowaa no bɔn kɔ; na mayɛ nkwaseadze dodow.
Na David soɛɛr anapa no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi Gad, David n’adzehunyi no, nkyɛn, dɛ,
Kɔ na kɛka kyerɛ David dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, nsɛm ebiasa na medze risi w’enyim; fa no mu kor, ma menyɛ memma wo.

Nna Gad baa David nkyɛn, na ɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ana mfe esuon kɔm mbra wo do wɔ w’asaase do a? Anaa iboguan wɔ w’atamfo enyim abosoom ebiasa mber a woritsiw wo? Anaa ɔyardɔm mbra w’asaase do ndaansa? Afei hwɛ na hu mbuae kor a memfa mensan menkɛma nyia ɔsomaa me no.
Na David see Gad dɛ, Mo ho akyer me papaara: afei ma yɛnhwe EWURADZE nsamu; na n’ehumbɔbɔr dɔɔ so: na mma mma monnhwe nyimpa nsamu.
Nna EWURADZE maa ɔyardɔm baa Israel do fi anapa araa dze kodur mber a ɔhyɛe no: na ɔman a ofi Dan araa dze kodu n’aponto asefo no, no mu nyimpa mpemeduosuon wuwui.

Na ɔbɔfo no tseen ne nsa wɔ Jerusalɛm do dɛ ɔresɛɛ no no, EWURADZE sesaa n’adwen wɔ mbusu no ho, na ɔsee ɔbɔfo no a ɔsɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, Ayɛ yie; afei gyina wo nsa. Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no wɔ Jebusnyi Arauna n’ewuporowee no ho.

Na David hun ɔbɔfo no a okunkum nkorɔfo no, ɔkaa kyerɛɛ EWURADZE dɛ, Hwɛ, mara na mayɛ bɔn, na mara na metwa nkontompɔ: na nguan yi dze, ebɛnadze na wɔayɛ? Meserɛ wo, ma wo nsa mbra emi na m’egya fi do.
Na Gad baa David nkyɛn da no, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Fow kɔ, na kesi afɔrmbukyia ma EWURADZE wɔ Jebusnyi Arauna n’ewuporowee hɔ.
Na David fowee kɔree dɛ mbrɛ Gad n’asɛm no tse, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛe no.
Na Arauna hwɛe, na ohun ɔhen no na no nkowaa no dɛ wɔreba ne nkyɛn: na Arauna fiir edzi, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ ɔhen no enyim dze n’enyim boom famu.

Na Arauna see dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na mo wura ɔhen reba n’akowaa nkyɛn yi? Na David see dɛ, Morobɔtɔ wo hɔ ewuporowee no mesi afɔrmbukyia, na mabɔ afɔr ama EWURADZE, ma woeesianka yardɔm no efi ɔman no do.
Na Arauna see David dɛ, Wɔmma mo wura ɔhen mfa na ɔmbɔ afɔr dɛ mbrɛ oye wɔ n’enyi do: hwɛ, anantwi a wɔdze bɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr, na ewuporowee ndzɛmba na anantwi ahyehyɛdze a wɔdze bɛyɛ nyina nye yi:
iyi nyinara, mo wura ɔhen, Arauna dze ma ɔhen. Na Arauna see ɔhen no dɛ, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ntsie wo.

Naaso ɔhen no see Arauna dɛ, Oho; mbom ɔtɔ ara na mobɔtɔ no wo hɔ dɛ mbrɛ no bo tse ara: nkyii so morommbɔ ɔhyew afɔr mma EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn a ɔnnsom me hwee. Nna David tɔɔ ewuporowee no na anantwi no maa dwetɛ dwetɛbona eduonum.
Na David sii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ maa EWURADZE, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr na asomdwee afɔr. Nna EWURADZE tsiei maa asaase no, na wosiankaa ɔyardɔm no fii Israel do.
Afei nna ɔhen David ayɛ akɔdaa a oedzi mfe pii; ɔwɔ mu dɛ wɔdze atam kataa no do, naaso no ho annyɛ no hyew.
Dɛm ntsi no nkowaa see no dɛ, Wɔnhwehwɛ ababaawa ɔbaabun bi mbrɛ mo wura ɔhen: na ɔmbɔsom no, na onyiayia no; na ɔnda no bo mu, ma mo wura ɔhen no ho nyɛ no hyew.
Nna wɔkɔhwehwɛɛ akataasia fɛɛfɛw bi wɔ Israel asaase nyinara mu, na wokohun Abisag, Sunamnyi no, na wɔdze no brɛɛ ɔhen no.
Na akataasia no no ho yɛ fɛw dodow; na oyiayiaa ɔhen no, na ɔsoom no; naaso ɔhen no ammfa no ho annka no.
Nna Hagit ba Adonija memaa noho do, dɛ, Mara na mibedzi hen; na ɔhyehyɛɛ ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo, na mbarimba eduonum a wɔyɛ n’abrampɔfo.
Na n’egya annka n’enyim aber biara annse dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ayɛ dɛm yi? Nna ɔno so yɛ nyimpa fɛɛfɛw; nna ɔno nye Absalom n’ekyir ba.
Na ɔnye Zeruia ba Joab, na ɔsɔfo Abiathar na wotuu egyina: na wodzii n’ekyir boaa no.
Na ɔsɔfo Zadok, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan, na Simei, na Rei, na David ne mbarimba akatakyi no dze, wɔannka Adonija ho.

Na Adonija kunkum nguan na anantwi na mbowa a wɔadodɔ seradze wɔ Zohelet ɔbo a ɔwɔ En-rogel nkyɛn no ho; na ɔtoo nsa frɛfrɛɛ no nuanom ɔhen ne mba no nyinara, na ɔhen no nkowaa Juda mbarimba no nyinara:
naaso nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan, na Benaia, na mbarimba akatakyi no, na no nua Solomon dze, ɔammfrɛ hɔn bi.
Nna Natan kaa kyerɛɛ Solomon ne na Bat-seba, dɛ, Ana ɔwo enntsee dɛ Hagit ne ba Adonija ridzi hen a hɛn wura David nnyim ho hwee bi a?
Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, bra, ma memma wo akwankyerɛ, ma edze agye wankasa woho nkwa, na wo ba Solomon nkwa.

Kɔ na kɛhɛn ɔhen David nkyɛn, na se no dɛ, Ana nnyɛ woara, mo wura ɔhen, na ekaa ntam kyerɛɛ w’afonabaa dɛ, Ampaara me ba Solomon ara na obedzi hen wɔ m’ekyir, na ɔnoara na ɔbɛtsena m’ahengua do no bi a? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na afei Adonija ridzi hen yi?
Hwɛ, aber a ɔwo nye ɔhen da ho rekasa wɔ hɔ no, mo so mibedzi w’ekyir maba, na mabɛhyɛ wo nsɛm no ma.
Na Bat-seba kɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ pia mu; na ɔhen no ayɛ akɔdaa dodow; na Abisag, Sunamnyi no soom ɔhen no.
Na Bat-seba bɔɔ no mu adze, na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no enyidzi. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Erohwehwɛ ebɛnadze?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mo wura, ɔwoara dze EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn kaa ntam kyerɛɛ w’afonabaa dɛ, Ampaara wo ba Solomon ara na obedzi hen wɔ w’ekyir, na ɔnoara na ɔbɛtsena m’ahengua do.
Na afei, hwɛ, Adonija ridzi hen; na ɔwo, mo wura ɔhen, nnyim yi:
na oekuku anantwi na mbowa a wɔadɔ seradze na nguan piigyan, na ɔato nsa afrɛfrɛ ɔhen ne mbabanyin no nyinara, na ɔsɔfo Abiathar, na dɔm safohen panyin Joab: naaso w’akowaa Solomon dze ɔammfrɛ no.
Na ɔwo, mo wura ɔhen, na Israel nyinara enyi da wo do dɛ ebɛkyerɛ hɔn nyia ɔbɛtsena w’ahengua do wɔ w’ekyir.
Ɔno ɔbɛba dɛ, aber a mo wura ɔhen nye n’egyanom bɔkɔ akɛda no, wobobu emi na me ba Solomon ndzebɔnyɛfo.
Na, hwɛ, mber a ɔda ho nye ɔhen no rekasa no, nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan bae.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, dɛ, Hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan aba wo hɔ. Na aber a odur ɔhen n’enyim no, ɔbɔɔ no mu adze dze n’enyim boom famu wɔ ɔhen n’enyim.
Natan bisaa dɛ, Mo wura ɔhen, ana ase dɛ, Adonija na ondzi hen wɔ w’ekyir, na ɔno na ɔntsena w’ahengua do a?

Na oesian kɔ ndɛ da yi, na oekuku anantwi na mbowa a wɔadodɔ seradze na nguan piigyan, na ɔato nsa afrɛfrɛ ɔhen ne mbabanyin no, na dɔm asafohemfo mpanyin no, na ɔsɔfo Abiathar; na, hwɛ, woridzidzi na wɔronom wɔ n’enyim, na wɔse dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen Adonija nkwa.
Na emi, mara w’akowaa mpo, na ɔsɔfo Zadok, na Jehoiada ba Benaia, na w’akowaa Solomon dze, oennhyia hɛn.
Ana adze yi mo wura ɔhen na ɔyɛe, na annda no edzi annkyerɛ wo nkowaa nyia ɔbɛtsena mo wura ɔhen n’ahengua do wɔ n’ekyir a?
Nna ɔhen David buaa dɛ, Wɔmfrɛ Bat-seba mma me. Na ɔbaa ɔhen no n’enyim, na obegyinaa ɔhen no enyim.
Na ɔhen kaa ntam see dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE a oyii me kra fii ahohiahia nyinara mu tse ase yi,

ampaara dɛ mbrɛ medze EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, mekaa ntam mekyerɛɛ wo, dɛ, Ampa wo ba Solomon ara na obedzi hen wɔ m’ekyir, na ɔnoara na ɔbɛtsena m’ahengua do wɔ m’ananmu no; nyew, dɛmara na mebɛyɛ no ndɛ da yi.
Nna Bat-seba bɔɔ no mu adze dze n’enyim boom famu, na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no enyidzi na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔmma mo wura ɔhen David ntsena ase daa.
Na ɔhen David see dɛ, Wɔmfrɛ ɔsɔfo Zadok, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia mma me. Na wɔbaa ɔhen no enyim.
Na ɔhen no see hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa hom wura no nkowaa no nka hom ho, na wɔmma me ba Solomon ntsena mankasa m’asoasopɔnkɔ do, na wɔmfa no nkɔ Gihon:
na wɔmma ɔsɔfo Zadok na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan nsera no wɔ hɔ nhyɛ no hen wɔ Israel do: na hom mbɔ abɛn no mu nse dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen Solomon nkwa.
Na nkyii hom ndzi n’ekyir mfow mbra, na ɔmbra mbɛtsena m’ahengua do; na ɔno na ondzi hen wɔ m’ananmu: na mahyɛ no dɛ ɔnyɛ ɔpanyin wɔ Israel na Juda do.
Na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia buaa ɔhen no na ɔsee dɛ, Amen: EWURADZE, mo wura ɔhen ne Nyankopɔn no so nse dɛmara.
Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE nye mo wura ɔhen tsenae no, mekyerɛ dɛmara so na ɔnye Solomon ntsena, na ɔmma n’ahengua nyɛ kɛse nsen mo wura ɔhen David n’ahengua.
Nna ɔsɔfo Zadok, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia, na Keretfo na Peletfo no, sianee kɔree, na wɔmaa Solomon tsenaa ɔhen David n’asoasopɔnkɔ do, na wɔdze no baa Gihon.
Na ɔsɔfo Zadok faa ngo ambɛn no wɔ Buw no mu, na ɔdze bɛseraa Solomon. Na wɔhɛɛn abɛn no; na ɔman no nyinara see dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen Solomon nkwa.
Na ɔman no nyinara dzii n’ekyir fowee bae, na ɔman no hɛɛn ntɛntɛbɛn, na hɔn enyi gyee kɛse, ma hɔn dede no maa asaase wosowee.
Na Adonija na n’aponto asefo no a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyinara tsee wɔ aber a wowiee edzidzi no. Na aber a Joab tsee abɛn no ndze no, obisaa dɛ, Kurow no mu dede yi a ayɛ dɛ abɔ ebutuw yi ase nye dɛn?
Mber a ɔda ho rekasa no, hwɛ, ɔsɔfo Abiathar ne ba Jonatan bae: na Adonija see dɛ, Bra dan mu; na ɔwo yɛ nyimpa a efata, na edze nsɛm pa nam.
Na Jonatan buae see Adonija dɛ, Nokwar hɛn wura ɔhen David ahyɛ Solomon hen:
na ɔhen dze ɔsɔfo Zadok, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia, na Keretfo na Peletfo no aka noho egya no kwan, na wɔama ɔatsena ɔhen n’asoasopɔnkɔ no do:
na ɔsɔfo Zadok na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan asera no ahyɛ no hen wɔ Gihon: na wɔdze enyigye dze fi hɔ afow aba, ma kurow no wosoow bio. Iyi nye dede no a hom atse no.
Na eso Solomon tse ahendzi ahengua no do.

Na nkyii so ɔhen no nkowaa no baa behyiraa hɛn wura ɔhen David, dɛ, Wo Nyankopɔn mma Solomon ne dzin nyɛ yie nsen wo dzin, na ɔmma n’ahengua nyɛ kɛse nsen w’ahengua: na ɔhen bɔɔ no mu adze wɔ mpa no do.
Na eso mbrɛ ɔhen no see nye yi, Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no a ɔama obi atsena m’ahengua do ndɛ da yi, ma mara m’enyiwa ehu.
Na Adonija n’aponto asefo no nyinara suroi, na wɔsoɛrsoɛree na nyimpa biara faa no kwan kɔree.
Na Adonija suroi wɔ Solomon ntsi; na ɔsoɛree kosuoo afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn mu.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Solomon, dɛ, Hwɛ, Adonija suro ɔhen Solomon: na, hwɛ, oekosuo afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn mu, dɛ, Wɔmma ɔhen Solomon ndzi kan nka ntam nkyerɛ me ndɛ da yi dɛ ɔnnkɛfa afona eku n’akowaa.
Na Solomon see dɛ, Sɛ ɔnoara kyerɛ dɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa a ɔfata a, no nhwi bi ronntɔ famu: na sɛ wohu emumuyɛ wɔ no mu dze a, obowu.
Nna ɔhen Solomon somae ma wɔkɛfaa no fii afɔrmbukyia no ho sianee bae. Na ɔbae na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔhen Solomon enyidzi: na Solomon see no dɛ, Kɔ wo fie.
Afei David ne nda bɛɛn dɛ obowu; na ɔhyɛɛ ne ba Solomon, dɛ,
Morokɔ asaase do nkorɔfo nyinara kwan no: dɛm ntsi hyɛ dzen, na yɛ woho ɔbarimba;

na sie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn n’ahwɛdodze no, dɛ ebɛnantsew n’akwan mu, dɛ ibesie n’ahyɛdze, na ne mbransɛm, na n’atsɛmbu, na ne dasesɛm, dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra no mu tse no, ama aayɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ dza eyɛ nyinara mu, na beebiara so a edan woho fa:

ama EWURADZE aama n’asɛm a ɔkae no wɔ mo ho no etsim, dɛ, Sɛ wo mba hwɛ hɔn kwan yie, dɛ wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara na hɔn kra nyinara bɛnantsew m’enyim nokwar mu a, ɔnodze (ɔse dɛ) Israel ahengua do nyimpa rommbɔ wo da.

Nkyii so ɔwoara nyim dza Zeruia ba Joab so dze yɛɛ me, mekyerɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Israel dɔm mu asafohemfo beenu no, Ner ne ba Abner, na Jeter ne ba Amasa a okunkum hɔn na ɔkaa ɔsa mu bɔgya gui wɔ asomdwee ber mu, na ɔdze ɔsa mu bɔgya kekaa n’abɔdo a ɔbɔ n’asen ho, na ne mpaboa a ɔhyɛ n’anan ho no mu.
Dɛm ntsi yɛ no dɛ mbrɛ wo nyansaa tse, na mma mma ne tsigon nnsian nnkɔ adakamona mu asomdwee mu.
Mbom Gileadnyi Barzillai ne mba no na kyerɛ ayamuyie wɔ hɔn do, na ma wɔmfora hɔn a wodzidzi wo pon do no mu. Osiandɛ wɔyɛɛ me ayamuyie wɔ aber a mifii wo nua Absalom enyim muguanee no.

Na afei hwɛ, Benjaminnyi Simei, Gera ne ba no a ofi Bahurim no wɔ wo nkyɛn, ɔno na ɔdze ndom yerɛyerɛw doom me da no a mokɔr Mahanaim no: naaso ekyir no osianee behyiaa me kwan wɔ Jordan do, na medze EWURADZE kaa ntam kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, Emi mara dze meremmfa afona munnku wo.
Dɛm ntsi afei mma ɔmmfa noho tɔtrɔtɔ, na ɔwoara yɛ onyansafo yi, ibohu dza ɔsɛ dɛ edze yɛ no, na ama ne tsigon dze bɔgya eesian akɔ adakamona mu.
Nna afei David kɛkaa n’egyanom ho wɔ nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ David kurow no mu.
Na nda a David dze dzii Israel do hen yɛ mfe eduanan: odzii hen mfe esuon wɔ Hebron, na odzii hen mfe eduasa ebiasa wɔ Jerusalɛm.
Na Solomon tsenaa n’egya David n’ahengua do; na n’ahendzi tsiim dzendzenndzen.
Nna Hagit ne ba Adonija baa Solomon ne na Bat-seba nkyɛn. Na Bat-seba bisaa no dɛ, Eba no asomdwee mu anaa? Na obuaa dɛ, Asomdwee mu a.
Afei Adonija see dɛ, Mowɔ asɛm bi ka kyerɛ wo. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ka ɛ.
Na Adonija see dɛ, Ɔwoara inyim dɛ ahendzi no yɛ medze, na Israel nyinara dze hɔn enyi sii mo do dɛ mara na mibedzi hen: naaso ahendzi no adan, na ɔakɛyɛ mo nua dze: na EWURADZE na ɔama ɔayɛ nedze.
Na afei ebisadze kor pɛ na miribisa no wo hɔ, mma nnkam me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ka ɛ.
Na Adonija see dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ka kyerɛ ɔhen Solomon, (na ɔrennse wo dɛ oho,) ma ɔmfa Sunamnyi Abisag mma me ayewar.
Na Bat-seba see dɛ, Oye; mebɛka akyerɛ ɔhen ama wo.

Dɛm ntsi Bat-seba sii mu kɔr ɔhen Solomon nkyɛn, dɛ ɔrekɛkasa akyerɛ no ama Adonija. Na ɔhen no soɛree kehyiaa no, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze maa no, na ɔkɛtsenaa n’ahengua do, na ɔmaa wɔdze ahengua besii hɔ maa ne na; na ɔtsenaa do wɔ n’enyimfa.
Nna Bat-seba see no dɛ, Ebisadze ketseabaa bi na miribebisa wɔ wo hɔ; mma nnkam me. Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, Me na, bisa ɛ: na merennkam wo.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ma wɔmfa Sunamnyi Abisag mma wo nua Adonija ayewar.
Na ɔhen Solomon buae na ɔsee ne na dɛ, Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na iribisa Sunamnyi Abisag ama Adonija? Bisa ahendzi no so ma no ɛ; na ɔno nye mo nua panyin; bisa ma ɔno, na ɔsɔfo Abiathar, na Zeruia ba Joab.
Nna ɔhen Solomon dze EWURADZE kaa ntam, dɛ, Nyankopɔn nyɛ me dɛm, na bi so nka ho, se Adonija nnkaa asɛm yi nntsiaa nankasa no nkwa a.
Dɛm ntsi afei dɛ EWURADZE a oetsintsim me, na ɔdze me atsena m’egya David n’ahengua do, na ɔdze ama menye m’asefo dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ anohoba no, tse ase yi, ampa woboku Adonija ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔhen Solomon nam Jehoiada ne ba Benaia ne nsa do somae; na okotui hyɛɛ no do, ma owui.

Na ɔhen no see ɔsɔfo Abiathar dɛ, Kɔ wankasa wo haban mu, wɔ Anathot; na efata owu dze naaso murunnku wo, osiandɛ ɔwo na esoaa EWURADZE Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no wɔ m’egya David enyim, na ihun amandze wɔ dza m’egya hun mu amandze no nyinara mu.
Nna Solomon paam Abiathar dɛ ɔnnyɛ ɔsɔfo mma EWURADZE bio; ama ɔaahyɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔkae no wɔ Eli fi ho wɔ Siloh no ma.
Na amandzɛɛ no dur Joab nkyɛn: na kaansa Joab ɔanndan ennkedzi Absalom ekyir mpo a, ɔadan ekedzi Adonija ekyir. Na Joab guanee kɔr EWURADZE no Buw no mu, na okosuoo afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn mu.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen Solomon dɛ, Joab eguan kɔ EWURADZE no Buw no mu, na hwɛ, ɔwɔ afɔrmbukyia no ho. Nna Solomon somaa Jehoiada ne ba Benaia dɛ, Kɔ, kotu hyɛ no do.

Na Benaia kɔr EWURADZE no Buw no mu, na ɔkɛsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, Pue bra. Na ɔsee dɛ, Dabida; mubowu ha ara. Na Benaia dze asɛm brɛɛ ɔhen bio, dɛ, Mbrɛ Joab se nye yi, na mbrɛ oebua me nye yi.
Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, Yɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔase no ara, na tu hyɛ no do, na sie no; ama eeyi bɔgya a Joab kae guu gyan no efi emi na m’egya fie do.

Na EWURADZE mma no bɔgyaa nsan ngu nankasa n’etsifi, osiandɛ otui hyɛɛ mbarimba beenu a wɔtsen na woye sen no no do, na ɔdze afona kunkum hɔn, ber a m’egya David nnyim ho hwee, hɔn nye, Ner ne ba Abner, Israel dɔm mu ɔsafohen, na Jeter ne ba Amasa, Juda dɔm mu ɔsafohen no.
Na hɔn bɔgyaa bɛsan ebogu Joab n’etsifi, na n’asefo etsifi daa: na David, na n’asefo na ne fie, na n’ahengua dze, wobenya EWURADZE hɔ asomdwee daa.
Nna Jehoiada ne ba Benaia sii mu kɔree, na okotui hyɛɛ no do, na okum no, na wokesiee no wɔ nankasa ne fie wɔ sar no do.
Na ɔhen no dze Jehoiada ne ba Benaia hyɛɛ n’ananmu wɔ dɔm no do: na ɔhen no dze ɔsɔfo Zadok hyɛɛ Abiathar n’ananmu.
Na ɔhen no somaa ma wokehyiaa Simei, na ɔsee no dɛ, Si dan ma woho wɔ Jerusalɛm, na tsena hɔ, na mma mmfi hɔ mmpue nnkɔ beebiara.
Na da no ara a ibopue, na ekotwa ɔwora Kidron no, ɔno hu no ampaara dɛ, owu ara na ibowu: wo bɔgyaa bogu wankasa w’etsifi.
Na Simei see ɔhen no dɛ, Asɛm no ye: dɛ mbrɛ mo wura ɔhen ase no, dɛmara so na w’akowaa bɛyɛ. Na Simei tsenaa Jerusalɛm nda pii.
Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe ebiasa ekyir no, Simei no nkowaa mu beenu guanee kɔr Maaka ne ba Akis, Gat hen no nkyɛn. Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Simei, dɛ, Hwɛ, wo nkowaa no wɔ Gat.
Na Simei soɛree, na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’asoaso, na osii mu kɔr Akis nkyɛn wɔ Gat, dɛ ɔrokɔhwehwɛ no nkowaa no: na ɔkɛfaa hɔn fi Gat bae.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Solomon dɛ, Simei efi Jerusalɛm akɔ Gat, na ɔaba bio.

Na ɔhen no somaa ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ Simei, na obisaa no dɛ, Ana mamma ammfa EWURADZE annka ntam, na menndzi wo dase, dɛ, Da no ara a ibopue akɛnantsenantsew beebiara no, ɔno hu no ampaara dɛ, owu ara na ibowu? Na ɔwoara see me dɛ, Asɛm a matse no oye.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enndzi EWURADZE ne ntam, na mbrasɛm a medze hyɛɛ wo no do?
Nkyii so ɔhen no see Simei dɛ, Ɔwoara nyim emumuyɛ nyinara a w’akoma nyim a edze yɛɛ m’egya David no: dɛm ntsi EWURADZE bɛdan w’emumuyɛ no egu wankasa w’etsifi.
Na ɔhen Solomon dze, nhyira bɛka no, na David n’ahengua no betsim wɔ EWURADZE enyim daa.
Nna ɔhen no hyɛɛ Jehoiada ne ba Benaia; na ofiir edzi kokum no. Na ahendzi no tsimii wɔ Solomon ne nsamu.
Na Solomon nye Egypthen Farao yɛɛ asew, na ɔfaa Farao ne babaa waar no, na ɔdze no baa David kurow mu, dze kodur dɛ owiee nankasa ne dan, na EWURADZE ne dan, na Jerusalɛm ho fasu no nyina tow ana.
Naaso mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do ara nko na ɔman no bɔɔ afɔr, osiandɛ ɔdze bodur dɛm ber no, nna wonnsii dan mmaa EWURADZE ne dzin.
Na Solomon dɔɔ EWURADZE, ɔnantseew n’egya David n’ahyɛdze no mu: na mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do ara nko na ɔbɔɔ afɔr na ɔhyeew eduhuam.
Na ɔhen no sii mu kɔr Gibeon dɛ ɔrokɔbɔ afɔr wɔ hɔ; osiandɛ ɔno na ɔyɛ bea sorɔnsorɔm kɛse: ɔhyew afɔr apem na Solomon bɔɔ no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
Gibeon na EWURADZE daa noho edzi kyerɛɛ Solomon wɔ adaaso mu anadwe: na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Bisa dza memfa memma wo.

Na Solomon see dɛ, Ɔwo na akyerɛ w’akowaa m’egya David do ayamuyie kɛse, dɛ mbrɛ ɔnantseew w’enyim nokwar mu, na ndzeyɛtsenenee mu na wo ho akoma mu tsenenee mu; na ɔwo edze ayamuyie kɛse yi esie ama no, dɛ ɔwo ama no ɔba dɛ ɔntsena n’ahengua do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Na afei, EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn, ɔwo na ahyɛ w’akowaa ɔhen ahyɛ m’egya David n’ananmu: na emi dze, meyɛ abofra kakraba; minnyim mbrɛ wodua fir edzi anaa wɔba mu.
Na w’akowaa wɔ wo man a ɔwoara asan mu eyi hɔn no mu, ɔman kɛse a hɔn dodow ntsi wonntum hɔn kan na wommbu ano so.
Dɛm ntsi ma w’akowaa ntseasee akoma ma memfa mumbu wo man atsɛn, na munhu papa na bɔn mu; na woana na obotum ebu wo man kɛse yi atsɛn?
Na kasa no yɛɛ EWURADZE fɛw, dɛ Solomon ebisa adze a ɔtse dɛm.

Na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, Osiandɛ ebisa adze yi, na emmbisa nkwa tsentsen amma woho; nkyii so emmbisa ahonya amma woho, na emmbisa w’atamfo hɔn nkwa so; na mbom ebisa ntseasee a wɔdze hu atsɛmbu mu ama woho ntsi;
hwɛ, mayɛ no dɛ mbrɛ w’ebisadze tse no ara: hwɛ, mama wo nyansa na ntseasee akoma; ma obiara a odzi w’enyim nntse dɛ ɔwo, nkyii so w’ekyir obiara ronnsoɛr a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo.
Na eso medze dza ɔwoara emmbisa so mama wo, ahonya na enyidzi nyina, ma ahemfo mu obiara rennye wo nnsɛ wɔ wo nda nyinara mu.
Na sɛ enantsew m’akwan mu, dɛ idzi m’ahyɛdze na me mbransɛm do, dɛ mbrɛ w’egya David nantsewee no a, ɔno mebɛma wo nda awar.
Na Solomon nyanee, na hwɛ, adaaso a: na ɔbaa Jerusalɛm, na obegyinaa EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no enyim, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr, na ɔbɔɔ asomdwee afɔr, na ɔtoo no nkowaa nyinara pon.
Da bi mbaa beenu a wɔyɛ ehuhufo, dze hɔn asɛm baa ɔhen no hɔ.
Na ɔbaa baako no see dɛ, Ao mo wura, emi na ɔbaa yi yɛtse fie kor mu; na mowoo ɔba wɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ fie no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, mowoe n’ekyir da a otsia ebiasa no, nna ɔbaa yi so woe; na yɛwɔ fakor; ɔhɔho bi nnka hɛn ho wɔ fie no mu, gyedɛ hɛn beenu ara na yɛwɔ fie no mu.
Na ɔbaa yi ne ba wuu anadwe no; osiandɛ ɔdaa no do.
Na ɔsoɛɛr esuom, na ɔbɛfaa me ba wɔ me nkyɛn, mber a w’afonabaa ada, na ɔdze no too no bo mu, na ɔdze ne ba a oewu no too mo bo mu.
Na aber a mosoɛɛr anapa no dɛ merema me ba enumfo no, hwɛ, nna oewu: na mohwɛɛ no yie anapa no, nna hwɛ, nnyɛ me ba a mowoo no no bi a.

Na ɔbaa kor no so see dɛ, Dabida; ɔnnyɛ nokwar na emi me ba nye onyikamfo no, na wo ba nye owufo no. Na oyi se dɛ, Oho; na wo ba nye owufo no, na me ba nye onyikamfo no. Na mbrɛ wɔkasae wɔ ɔhen enyim nye yi.
Nna ɔhen no see dɛ, Oyi se dɛ, Me ba na ɔtse ase yi, na wo ba nye owufo no: na oyi so se dɛ, Dabida; mbom wo ba nye owufo no, na me ba nye onyikamfo no.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Wɔmbrɛ me afona. Na wɔdze afona baa ɔhen no enyim.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Wɔnkyɛ ɔba onyikamfo no mu ebien, wɔmfa ɔfa mma ɔbaako, na wɔmfa ɔfa mma ɔbaako so.

Nna ɔbaa a ɔba onyikamfo no yɛ nedze no kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, osiandɛ no nson burbuur no wɔ ne ba no ho, na ɔsee dɛ, Ao, mo wura, wɔmfa ɔba onyikamfo no mma no, na mma wonnku no ara da. Na ɔbaako no dze ɔsee dɛ, Mma ɔnnyɛ medze eso ɔnnyɛ wodze; wɔnkyɛ mu.
Nna ɔhen no buae dɛ, Wɔmfa ɔba nyikamfo no mma nyia ɔse mma wonnku no no, na mma wonnku no ara da: osiandɛ ɔno nye ne na.
Na Israel nyinara tsee atsɛmbu a ɔhen no bui no; na wosuroo ɔhen no; osiandɛ wohun dɛ Nyankopɔn ne nyansaa wɔ no mu, dɛ obobu atsɛn.
Na ɔhen Solomon dzii Israel nyinara do hen.
Na woyinom nye asafohemfo a onyae; Zadok ne ba Azaria nye ɔsɔfo;
Elihoref na Ahija, Sisa ne mba no, nye akyerɛwfo; Jehosafat, Ahilud ne ba no, nye ɔsɛnkaafo;
na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia na ɔhwɛ dɔm no do; na Zadok na Abiathar nye asɔfo;
na Natan ne ba Azaria na ɔhwɛ ahwɛdofo no do; na Natan ne ba Zabud na ɔyɛ ɔsɔfo, na ɔhen no fotufo;
na Ahishar na ɔhwɛ fidua no do; na Abda ne ba Adoniram na ɔhwɛ ɔtowyi edwuma no do.
Nna Solomon wɔ ahwɛdofo duebien wɔ Israel nyinara do a wɔdze edziban ma ɔhen na ne fidua: nyimpa baako wɔ dɛ ɔma edziban bosoom kor wɔ afrenhyia mu.
Na hɔn edzin nye yi: Ben-hur wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu:
Ben-deker, wɔ Makaz, na Saalbim, na Bɛt-semes, na Elon-beth-hanan:
Ben-hesed, wɔ Aru-bot; ɔno na Soko, na Hefer asaase nyinara dzi wɔ no:
Ben-abinadab, wɔ Dor akoko do nyinara; onyaa Solomon ne babaa Tafat waar no;
Ahilud ne ba Baana, wɔ Taanak na Megiddo, na Bɛt-sean nyinara a ɔwɔ Zaretan ne nkyɛn, wɔ Jezreel ase, ifi Bɛt-sean kodu Abel-mehola, dze kodu Jokmeam egya.
Ben-geber, wɔ Ramot-gilead; ɔno na Manaasɛ ne ba Jair no nkurow a ɔwɔ Gilead no, dzi wɔ no: ɔnoara so na Argob asaase a ɔwɔ Bashan, nkurow akɛse eduosia a no ho wɔ afasu na boran adaban no, yɛ nedze:
Iddo ne ba Ahinadab, wɔ Mahanaim:
Ahimaaz, wɔ Naftali; ɔno so faa Solomon ne babaa Basemat waar no:
Husai ne ba Baana, wɔ Aser na Bealot:
Parua ne ba Jehosafat, wɔ Isakar:
Ela ne ba Simei, wɔ Benjamin:
Uri ne ba Geber, wɔ Gilead asaase do, wɔ Amorifo Sihon na Bashanhen Ɔge ɔman mu; na ɔno nye ɔhwɛdofo kortonoo a ɔwɔ asaase no do.
Juda na Israel wɔdɔɔ so, hɔn dodow tse dɛ mpoano anhwea, wodzidzi na wɔnom na hɔn enyi gye.
Na Solomon dzii hen wɔ ahenman a ofi Esutsen no ho nyinara dze kodu Filistiafo asaase do, na Egypt he do: wɔdze ayɛyɛdze bae, na wɔsoom Solomon wɔ no nkwa nda no nyinara mu.
Na Solomon ne dakor edzidzi ɔyɛ isiam pa etwadze eduasa na eburow isiam etwadze eduosia;
anantwi a wɔadɔ seradze du, na edzidzibea do anantwi eduonu, na nguan ɔha, ɔsor ntorɔm, na ndoa na nwansan, na ntumbowa a wɔadɔ seradze.
Osiandɛ ɔno na ɔwɔ tum wɔ Esutsen no n’afa ha asaase no nyinara do, ofi Tifsa araa dze bodu Gaza, wɔ Esutsen n’afa ha ahemfo nyinara do: na onyaa amandwee wɔ nkyɛnkyɛn nyinara a abɔ no ho aprɔw.
Na Juda na Israel tsenaa no dwudwoodwo, nyimpa biara wɔ no wenyindua ase na n’adɔmbadua ase, ofi Dan araa kodu Beer-seba, wɔ Solomon nda nyinara mu.
Na Solomon wɔ ne ntseaseanam ho mpɔnkɔdan mu mpɔnkɔ mpemeduanan, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemduebien.
Na ahwɛdofo no hwehwɛɛ edziban maa ɔhen Solomon, na hɔn a wɔbaa ɔhen Solomon no pon ho nyinara, nyimpa biara wɔ no bosoom mu: wɔmma hwee nnhia.
Na wɔdze atoko so na efuw a wɔdze ma mpɔnkɔ na mbowa a hɔn ho yɛ har baa beebi mbrɛ ahwɛdofo no wɔwɔ, nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ n’ahwɛdodze tse no ara.
Na Nyankopɔn maa Solomon nyansa na ntseasee dodow mbordo, na akoma a ɔtrɛ, dɛ mpoano anhwea.
Na Solomon ne nyansaa so sen bokamba no nyinara hɔn nyansaa, na Egypt nyansa nyinara.
Nna ɔyɛ nyansafo sen nyimpa nyinara; ɔsen Ezranyi Etan, na Mahol ne mba, Heman, Kalkol, na Darda: na ne nka tahyee amanaman nyinara mu hyiae.
Na obubuu mbɛ mpensa: na no ndwom yɛ apem nye enum.
Na ɔkaa ndua ho asɛm, ofi nkyindur a ɔwɔ Lebanon do araa dze kodu odwonhataw a ofifir fasu mu do: na ɔkaa mbowadoma, na ntumbowa, na nketsembowa, na esunam so ho asɛm.
Na aman nyinara mu nyimpa bi baa dɛ woribetsie Solomon ne nyansaa, wofi asaase do ahemfo a wɔtsee ne nyansaa nka no nyinara nkyɛn bae.
Nna Taerehen Hiram yɛ David no dɔfo daa ntsi ɔtsee dɛ Solomon na wɔasera no ahyɛ no hen wɔ n’egya n’ananmu no, ɔsomaa no nkowaa ma wɔbaa ne nkyɛn.
Na Solomon somaa ma wɔkɔr Hiram nkyɛn, dɛ,
Ɔwoara nyim mbrɛ m’egya David sii na oenntum ennsi dan amma EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn ne dzin, wɔ akokoeko a nna etwa no ho ehyia no ntsi, dze kodur dɛ EWURADZE dze hɔn hyɛɛ n’ananadze.
Na afei EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn ama me ahomgye wɔ afa nyinara; ɔtamfo bi nnyi hɔ, na esian bi so nnyi hɔ.
Na, hwɛ, mesua dɛ miribesi dan ama EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn ne dzin, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ m’egya David no, dɛ, Wo ba a medze no bɛhyɛ w’ananmu atsena w’ahengua do no, na obesi dan ama me dzin.

Dɛm ntsi afei hyɛ ma wontwa nkyindur ndua wɔ Lebanon mma me; na mo nkowaa bɛba abɛka wo nkowaa ho; na mebɛma wo apaabɔdze ma edze aama wo nkowaa dɛ mbrɛ ebɛka nyinara: osiandɛ ɔwoara nyim dɛ obi nnyi hɛn mu a ɔwɔ nduatwa ho nyansa dɛ Zidonfo.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Hiram tsee Solomon ne nsɛm no, odzii dɛw kɛsenara, na ɔsee dɛ, Ndɛ da yi, nhyira nka EWURADZE a ɔama David ɔba nyansafo wɔ ɔman kɛse yi do no.
Na Hiram somaa ma wɔkɔr Solomon nkyɛn, dɛ, Matse nkra a esomaa ma wɔdze baa me nkyɛn no: mebɛyɛ w’apɛdze a ɔwɔ nkyindur ndua, na ɔpepeaa ho no nyinara.

Mo nkowaa dze befi Lebanon do esian aba po ho: na mebɛkyer no mpanta edua po do akɔ bea a ɔwoara ebɛkyerɛ me no, na mama wɔasansan wɔ hɔ, na abɛgye: na wo so ayɛ m’ahwehwɛdze, dɛ ebɛma me fiefo edziban.
Nna Hiram maa Solomon nkyindur ndua na ɔpepeaa dɛ mbrɛ n’ahwehwɛdze tse nyinara.
Na Solomon so maa Hiram ewifua etwadze mpem eduonu dɛ ne fiefo edziban, na ngo krɔnkrɔn etwadze eduonu: dɛm na Solomon dze maa Hiram afrenhyia afrenhyia.
Na EWURADZE maa Solomon nyansa, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ no anohoba no; na asomdwee daa Hiram na Solomon ntamu; na hɔn beenu no bɔɔ mu yɛɛ kor.
Na ɔhen Solomon gyee Israel nyinara hɔ ɔtowyi edwuma; na ɔtowyi edwuma ho nyimpa yɛ mpem eduasa.
Na ɔsomaa hɔn wɔ Lebanon do, nyimpa mpemdu bosoom esiado esiado: bosoom na wodzi wɔ Lebanon do, na abosoom ebien na wodzi wɔ fie: na Adoniram na ɔhwɛ ɔtowyi edwuma no do.
Nna Solomon wɔ ndzesoadzefo mpemeduosuon, na mbepɔw no do nduatwafo mpemeduowɔtwe;
ɔsor Solomon n’ahwɛdofo etsitsir a wɔhwɛ edwuma no do, nyimpa mpemebiasa ahaasa a wɔhwɛ nkorɔfo a wɔyɛ edwuma no do no.
Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ ma wɔpaa abo akɛse, abo a ɔsom bo, dɛ wɔdze abo a wɔasen bɛhyɛ dan no ne fapem.
Na Solomon n’adansifo na Hiram n’adansifo na Gebalfo no sensenee, na wosiesiee ndua na abo dɛ wɔdze besi dan no.

Na ɔbaa dɛ Israelmba fii Egypt bae no n’ekyir afe a otsia ahaanan edwuowɔtwe no mu no, nna Solomon dzii Israel do hen no n’afe a otsia anan nye no, wɔ bosoom Ziv a ɔyɛ bosoom a otsia ebien no mu no, nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ orisi EWURADZE ne dan no.
Na ɔdan a ɔhen Solomon sii maa EWURADZE no, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduasa, na ne tɛtɛr basafa du, na no krɔn basafa duenum.
Na abrandaa a ɔwɔ asɔrfi dan no enyim no, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa du, dɛ mbrɛ ɔdan no ne tɛtɛr no tse no; na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa enum wɔ ɔdan no enyim.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔdan no ho ntokura a atenadwuma tsintsim mu.
Na ɔtotoow ɔdan no ne fasu ho asansansamdo hyiae, twitwaa ɔdan no n’afasu ho hyiae, asɔrfi no na mpiakyir nyina ho: na ɔyɛɛ mpiakyir mpiakyir hyiae:

ase ɔsansansamdo no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebien nye fa, na finimfin dze no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebiasa, na dza otsia ebiasa no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebiasa nye fa: na ɔyɛɛ ɔdan no ne fasu ekyir mbamba hyiae, ma mpuna no annhyɛ ɔdan no n’afasu no mu.
Na ɔdan no, aber a worisi no, wɔdze ɔbo a woesiesie no wɔ abopuei na wɔdze sii: mber a worisi no, wɔanntse bɔbo, anaa ekuma, anaa edwindadze biara nka wɔ ɔdan no ho.
Finimfin mpiakyir no n’abow wɔ ɔdan no n’enyimfa afamu: na wɔfow atwer mpomponee dze kɔ finimfin mpia no mu, na wofi finimfin dze no mu kɔ dza otsia ebiasa no mu.
Nna osii dan no, na owiei; na ɔdze nkyindur mpuna na ntaabow kataa ɔdan no do.
Na osisii asansansamdo no wɔ ɔdan no no ho nyinara, kor no krɔn basafa ebien nye fa: na wɔdze nkyindur mpuna ma osusuoo dan no mu.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Solomon nkyɛn, dɛ,
Ɔwɔ ɔdan yi a irisi ho, sɛ enantsew m’ahyɛdze mu, na eyɛ m’atsɛmbu, na idzi me mbransɛm nyinara do dɛ ebɛnantsew mu a; ɔnodze mebɛma m’asɛm a mekaa mekyerɛɛ w’egya David no etsim ama wo.
Na mebɛtsena Israelmba mu, na monnkɔpow me man Israel.
Nna Solomon sii dan no, na owiei.
Na ɔdze nkyindur ntaabow saam ɔdan no mu afasu no ho; ɔdze ndua kataa no mu afasu, fi dan no ne daadze kodur n’enyi nsamdo mpuna no do: na ɔdze kupresi ntaabow saam dan no ne daadze.
Na ɔdze nkyindur ntaabow sii ɔdan no n’ekyir afamu basafa du fi famu kɛpeem nsamdo mpuna no: mekyerɛ osii dze no mu yɛɛ mpiakyir, mekyerɛ bea krɔnkrɔn no a.
Na ɔdan no, mekyerɛ asɔrfi no a ɔwɔ mpiakyir no enyim no, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu.
Na ɔdan no mu wɔ nkyindur a woedzi no nkukuduuduw na nhyiren a wɔahanhan edwin: ne nyinara nkyindur a; wonnhu ɔbo biara.
Na osiesiee mpiakyir wɔ ɔdan no mu finimfin, dɛ wɔdze EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no besi hɔ.
Na mpiakyir no mu wɔ ɔkwan a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa du, na ne tɛtɛr basafa du, na no krɔn basafa du; na ɔdze sika mapa duraa ho: na ɔdze nkyindur kataa afɔrpon no ho.
Nna Solomon dze sika mapa duraa ɔdan no mu: na ɔdze sika ntweaban dze twaa mpiakyir no enyim; na ɔdze sika duraa ho.
Na ɔdan no nyina ɔdze sika duraa mu araa kodur dɛ wowiee ɔdan no nyinara: nkyii so ɔdze sika duraa afɔrpon a ɔwɔ mpiakyir no ho nyinara.
Na ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ kerubim ebien wɔ mpiakyir no mu, kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa enum.
Na kerub no n’atsaban kor yɛ basafa ebien nye fa; na kerub no n’atsaban kor no so basafa ebien nye fa: ofi atsaban tsir kor ano dze kodu atsaban tsir kor so ano ɔyɛ basafa enum.
Na kerub kor no so yɛ basafa enum: kerubim ebien nyina wɔ nsusui kor na su kor.
Kerub baako no krɔn basafa enum, na kerub baako no so tse dɛmara.

Na ɔdze kerubim no sisii ekyir dan no mu: na kerubim no tserɛtserɛɛw hɔn ntsaban mu, ma ɔbaako n’atsaban ɔka fasu kor, na kerub baako so n’atsaban ɔka fasu kor no so; na hɔn ntsaban no keka enyim wɔ ɔdan no ne finimfin.
Na ɔdze sika duraa kerubim no ho.
Na odzii dan no n’afasu no nyinara ho edwin hyiae, dɛ ɔdze kerubim, na mbɛdua, na nhyiren a wɔahanhan no ehonyi yɛɛ ho, no mu na n’ekyir.
Na ɔdan no ne daadze so ɔdze sika durae, no mu na n’ekyir.
Na ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ mpiakyir ahɛnee no no mbobow: mpondua no etsifi na ne nkyɛnmu ɔyɛ fasu no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor.
Nna ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ mbobow ebien; na odzii do edwin a ɔyɛ kerubim na mbɛdua na nhyiren a wɔahanhan, na ɔdze sika duraa ho; na ɔtserɛɛw sika no mu kataa kerubfo na mbɛdua no do.
Dɛmara so na ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ asɔrfi no n’ahɛnee no mpondua no, wɔ fasu no mu ebupɛn anan mu kor;
na kupresidua mbobow ebien; abow kor wɔ afa ebien a ɔbobɔw, na abow kor no so wɔ afa ebien a ɔbobɔw.
Na odzii ho edwin, kerubfo na mbɛdua na nhyiren a wɔahanhan: na ɔdze sika duraa ho dze kekae tsintsiim nkrukyei no mu.
Na ɔdze abo a wɔasen akyerɛpɛn ebiasa, na nkyindur mpuna akyerɛpɛn kor yɛɛ no mu abangua no.
Afe a otsia anan no mu bosoom Ziv mu, na wɔtoow EWURADZE ne dan no ne fapem.
Na afe a otsia dubiako no mu, bosoom Bul a ɔyɛ bosoom a otsia awɔtwe no mu, na wowiee ɔdan no no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, na mbrɛ ne yɛbea no tse nyinara ho afamu. Mfe esuon nna ɔdze sii.
Solomon dze mfe duebiasa sii nankasa n’ahemfie no wiei.
Na osii Lebanon kwaa dan no; ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonum, na ne tɛtɛr basafa eduonu enum, na no krɔn basafa duenum, ɔwɔ nkyindur edum akyerɛpɛn anan do, nye nkyindur mpuna gu edum no do.
Na wɔdze nkyindur saam sor wɔ mpuna eduanan enum a ogu edum no do no do; kyerɛpɛn kor mu duenum.
Na ntokura akyerɛpɛn ebiasa wɔ hɔ, na tokura hwɛ tokura enyim araa ban ebiasa.
Na mbobow na mpondua no nyinara yɛ nsamdo mpuna atweanan: na tokura hwɛ tokura enyim araa ban ebiasa.
Na ɔyɛɛ edum abrandaa; ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu enum, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa duenum; na abrandaa bi wɔ hɔn enyim, na edum na mpuna durdur wɔ enyim.
Na ɔyɛɛ ahengua abrandaa mbrɛ obobu hɔ atsɛn, mekyerɛ atsɛmbu abrandaa no a: na ɔdze nkyindur kataa do fi famu kodur nsamdo enyi.
Na ne fi mbrɛ ɔtse, dampan kor no a ɔwɔ abrandaa no mu afamu no, ne yɛbea tse dɛmara. Ɔyɛɛ dan so a ɔtse dɛ abrandaa yi maa Farao ne babaa, (nyia Solomon waar no no).
Iyinom nyinara yɛ abo a ɔsom bo, mekyerɛ abo a woetwa woesusu no dɛ wɔdze nseradaa sianee, no mu na n’ekyir, mekyerɛ ofi fapem do kɛpem etsifi, na dɛmara ɔdze fi ekyir afamu kodu pampan kɛse no do.
Na fapem no yɛ abo a ɔsom bo, mekyerɛ abo akɛse a, basafa enum enum abo, na basafa anan anan abo.
Na ɔsor abo a ɔsom bo, mekyerɛ ɔbo a woesusu etwa na nkyindur dua.
Na dampan kɛse a ɔbɔ aprɔw no wɔ abo a wɔasen akyerɛpɛn ebiasa, na nkyindur mpuna kyerɛpɛn kor; tse dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE ne dan no no mu afamu na ɔdan no n’abrandaa no tse.
Na ɔhen Solomon somae ma wɔkɛfaa Hiram fi Taere bae.

Ɔyɛ Naftali ebusuakuw mu ɔbaa okunafo bi ne ba, na n’egya nye ɔbarimba bi a ofi Taere, boran odwimfo a; na nyansa na ntseasee na nyimdzee ahyɛ no ma, dɛ ɔdze dzi boran dwuma nyinara mu edwin. Na ɔbaa ɔhen Solomon nkyɛn, na ɔbɛyɛɛ n’edwuma nyinara.
Na ɔyɛɛ boran edum ebien no, kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa akron; na ahoma basafa esia abɔ no ho aprɔw.
Na ɔyɛɛ boran ntaadotsir ebien dɛ wɔdze sisi edum no etsifi: ntaadotsir kor no krɔn yɛ basafa ebien nye fa, na ntaadotsir kor so no krɔn yɛ basafa ebien nye fa.
Atena a wɔawen no dam dam, na ntweaban kyinkyimii, wɔ ntaadotsir a ɔwɔ edum no etsifi no ho; esuon wɔ ntaadotsir kor ho, na esuon wɔ ntaadotsir kor so ho.
Nna ɔyɛɛ edum no; na ɔyɛɛ pɔmegranate eduaba akyerɛpɛn ebien twaa atenadwuma no kor ho hyiae, dze kataa ntaadotsir no a ɔwɔ edum no etsifi no do: na dɛmara so na ɔyɛe maa ntaadotsir kor no so.
Na ntaadotsir a ɔwɔ abrandaa no mu edum no etsifi no wɔyɛɛ no nsukookoo dwuma, basafa ebien.
Na edum ebien no do so wɔ ntaadotsir, ɔbɛn efur a ɔwɔ atenadwuma no ho no ho: na pɔmegranate eduaba no yɛ ahaenu, akyerɛpɛn akyerɛpɛn bɔ ntaadotsir kor no ho aprɔw.
Na ɔdze edum no sisii asɔrfi no n’abrandaa no ano: na ɔmaa enyimfa dum no do sii, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Jakin: na ɔmaa abankum dum no do sii hɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Boaz.
Na edum no etsifi wɔ nsukookoo dwuma: dɛm na ɔdze wiee edum no edwuma no.
Na ɔyɛɛ ogu po no a ofi ano kɛpem ano yɛ basafa enum no, otwa kɔntɔnkrɔn, na no krɔn yɛ basafa ebien nye fa: na ahoma basafa duenum bɔ ho aprɔw hyia.
Na nkukuduuduw wowɔ n’ano asease dze bɔ no aprɔw hyia, ne tsentsen basafa enum bɔ po no ho aprɔw hyia: nkukuduuduw no a wogui no woguu no akyerɛpɛn ebien.
Ɔtaa anantwi duebien do, ebiasa hwɛ kwaamu afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ anee afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ pomu afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ boka afamu: na po no taa hɔn do wɔ sor, na hɔn ekyir nyinara wɔ no mu afamu.
Na ne peperepee yɛ nsatseama; na n’ano no wɔyɛɛ no dɛ kɔɔpow ano, ɔtse dɛ nsukookoo ne nhyiren a ahan: odzi galɔn mpemdu.
Na ɔyɛɛ boran eguarsɛn ase ndaka du; adaka kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa ebien, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebien, na no krɔn yɛ basafa kor nye fa.
Na mbrɛ eguarsɛn ase ndaka no ne nyɛbea tse nye yi: wɔwowɔ nhyehyɛmu; na nhyehyɛmu no hyehyɛ ngua no ntamu:
na ngyata, anantwi, na kerubfo wowɔ ngua no ntamu nhyehyɛmu no do, na ngyinado bi wɔ ngua no do ɔsor: na ngyata na anantwi no ase wɔ ahaban nkyekyeree a ɔsensɛn hɔ edwuma.
Na adaka biara wɔ boran ntwahonan anan, na boran nhyehyɛmundua: na ne nan anan no wɔ nsusuomunsa: egurasɛn no ase na nsusuomunsa bi a woegu, ka ahaban nkyekyeree ho wɔ ne nkyɛnkyɛn.

Na n’ano wɔ ntaadotsir no no mu na no do afamu yɛ anamɔn kor nye fa: na n’ano yɛ korkorba tse dɛ ngyinado dwuma bi, bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa: na wodzidzii n’ano so edwin, na ne nhyehyɛmu no yɛ etwaanan, ɔnnyɛ nkorkorba.
Na ntwahonan anan no wowɔ nhyehyɛmu ntrɛtraba no ase; na ntwahonan no ne nhyɛmu ndua no hyehyɛ adaka no mu: na ntwahonan kor no krɔn yɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa.
Na ntwahonan no ne nyɛbea tse dɛ tseaseanam ntwahonan nyɛbea: ne nhyɛmu ndua, no ho nsusuomudze, na ne hankra ano, na ne mparba, na ne finimfintu nyinara, wogui.
Na nsusuomunsa anan wowɔ adaka kor no kutuw anan no ho: adaka no ara mu na no nsusuomunsa no wɔ.
Na adaka no n’etsifi no wɔyɛɛ no korkorba a no krɔn yɛ bɛyɛ anamɔn kor hyia: na adaka no n’etsifi na ne nsa na ne nhyehyɛmu ntrɛtraba no a ofi kor no ara mu no wɔ.
Na odzii ne nsa ne ntɛrba, na ne nhyehyɛmu ntrɛtraba no do edwin, kerubfo ngyata na mbɛdua, dɛ mbrɛ kor ne ntamu tse, nye ahaban nkyekyeree bɔ aprɔw.
Ndaka du no mbrɛ ɔyɛe no nye yi: ne nyinara wɔ gubea kor, nsusui kor, na isu kor.
Na ɔyɛɛ boran eguarsɛn du: eguarsɛn kor dzi galɔn ahaanan: na eguarsɛn biara yɛ basafa ebien: na eguarsɛn kor wɔ ndaka du no mu kor biara no do.
Na ɔdze ndaka no sisii, enum wɔ ɔdan no n’enyimfa afamu, na enum so wɔ ɔdan no n’abankum afamu: na ɔdze po no sii ɔdan no ne nyimfa afamu wɔ boka afamu a ɔhwɛ pomu afamu no.
Na Hiram yɛɛ eguarsɛn, na nsofi, na mbɛɛsen no. Nna Hiram wiee edwuma a ɔyɛe maa ɔhen Solomon wɔ EWURADZE ne fi no ho nyinara yɛ:
edum ebien no, na edum no n’etsifi ntaadotsir apɔw ebien no; na ntenadwuma ebien no a wɔdze kataa edum no n’etsifi ntaadotsir apɔw ebien no ho no;
na ntenadwuma ebien no ho pɔmegranate eduaba ahaanan no; pɔmegranate eduaba akyerɛpɛn ebien yɛ atenadwuma kor nedze, dɛ ɔkata ntaadotsir no n’apɔw ebien no a ɔwɔ edum no no do no ho;
na ndaka du no, na ndaka no do eguarsɛn du no;
na po kor no, na po no n’ase anantwi duebien no;
na asɛn, na nsofi, na mbɛɛsen no: mekyerɛ ndzɛmba yi nyinara a Hiram yɛe maa ɔhen Solomon, wɔ EWURADZE ne fi no ho no, yɛ boran a wɔapɔw ho.
Jordan Tɛtɛr no do na ɔhen no gui, wɔ hyirew daadze mu wɔ Sukɔt na Zaretan ntamu.
Na Solomon gyaa ndzɛmba no nyinara ker, osiandɛ ɔso dodow mbordo: woennhu boran no ne nkerii ano.
Na Solomon yɛɛ ndzɛmba no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE ne fie no mu no nyinara: sika afɔrmbukyia no, na ɔpon no a kyerɛpaanoo no si do no, sika;
na nkandzeadua no, enum wɔ enyimfa afamu, na enum so wɔ abankum, mpiakyir no enyim, sika mapa: na nhyiren, na nkandzea, na adaban no, sika;
na mpokuwa, na nsompokuwa, na mbɛɛsen, na ntser, na ogyasɛn no, sika mapa; na no mu afamu ɔdan no, bea krɔnkrɔn ho mbobow, na ɔdan no, mekyerɛ asɔrfi no ho mbobow no ho apontsɛr so sika a.

Na wowiee edwuma a ɔhen Solomon yɛe no wɔ EWURADZE ne fie no ho no nyinara yɛ. Na Solomon dze ndzɛmba a n’egya David tui sii hɔ no, mekyerɛ dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba no bae, na ɔdze besisii EWURADZE fie ndzekoradzebea no mu.

Na Solomon hyiahyiaa Israel mpanyimfo, na ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu etsitsir nyinara, Israelmba egyanom efiefi mbapɔmba no, ma wɔbaa ne nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalɛm, dɛ wɔrekɛfa EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no efi Zion a ɔyɛ David kurow no mu aba.
Na Israel mbarimba no nyinara hyiahyiaa hɔnho behyiaa ɔhen Solomon ne nkyɛn wɔ afahyɛ no ase, wɔ bosoom Etanim a ɔyɛ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu.
Na Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara bae, na asɔfo no bɔsoaa adaka no.
Na wɔdze EWURADZE n’adakaa no, na ehyiadzibuw no, na ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn a ɔwɔ Buw no mu no bae; mekyerɛ iyinom na asɔfo na Levifo no dze bae.
Nna ɔhen Solomon na Israel mpanyimfo no a woebehyia wɔ ne nkyɛn no nyinara dzi adaka no enyim, rukuku nguan na anantwi a osian hɔn dodow ntsi wonntum nkan eso wommbu ano dze robobɔ afɔr.
Na asɔfo no dze EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no besii ne sibew, wɔ ɔdan no ne mpiakyir, bea krɔnkrɔnkrɔn no, mekyerɛ kerubfo no ntsaban ase.
Na kerubfo no atserɛtserɛw hɔn ntsaban mu wɔ adaka no ne sibew no do, na kerubfo no akata adaka no na no ho mpoma no do wɔ sor.
Na mpoma no wowar dodow ma wohu mpoma no n’etsir wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn mpiakyir no enyim; na wonnhu wɔ abowano: na mbrɛ ɔwɔ ara nye no dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Hweeara nnyi adaka no mu gyedɛ abo apon ebien no a Moses dze guu mu wɔ Horeb no, wɔ aber a wofi Egypt asaase do reba no a EWURADZE nye Israelmba dzii ahyɛmu no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a asɔfo no fii bea krɔnkrɔn no do puei no, mununkum bɛhyɛɛ EWURADZE ne dan no ma,
na mununkum no ntsi asɔfo no enntum enngyina annsom: osiandɛ nna EWURADZE n’enyimnyam ahyɛ EWURADZE ne dan no ma.
Nna Solomon kaa dɛ, EWURADZE ase dɛ ɔbɛtsena sum kebii mu.
Ampa mesi ɔdan ayɛ tsenabew ama wo, beebi a ebɛtsena hɔ daa.
Na ɔhen no daan n’enyim, na ohyiraa Israel mboanofo no nyinara: na Israel mboanofo no nyinara gyinagyinaa tsentsen.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔdze n’ano kasaa kyerɛɛ m’egya David, na ɔdze ne nsa ahyɛ no ma, dɛ,

Ofitsi da a medze me man Israel fii Egypt bae no, mannsan mu ennyi kurow bi emmfi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ wonsi dan, ama me dzin aatsena hɔ; mbom mesaan mu miyii David dɛ ɔnhwɛ me man Israel do.
Afei ɔwɔ m’egya David n’akoma mu dɛ obesi dan ama EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ne dzin.
Na EWURADZE see m’egya David dɛ, Susuampa dɛ ɔwɔ w’akoma mu dɛ nkyɛ ibesi dan ama me dzin no, eyɛɛ no yie dɛ ɔwɔ w’akoma mu:
naaso ɔwoara nnkesi dan no; na mbom wo ba a ofi w’asen mu bɛba no, ɔno na obesi dan no ama me dzin.
Na EWURADZE ama n’asɛm a ɔkae no etsim; na masoɛr ahyɛ m’egya David n’ananmu, na metse Israel ahengua do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE bɔɔ anohoba no, na mesi dan no ama EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ne dzin.
Na meyi hɔ beebi ama adaka no a EWURADZE ahyɛmu a ɔnye hɛn egyanom dzii, wɔ aber a ɔdze hɔn fi Egypt asaase do reba no wɔ mu no.
Na Solomon gyinaa EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia no enyim wɔ Israel mboanofo no nyinara enyim, na ɔtserɛɛw ne nsamu wɔ sor:

na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, Onyankopɔn bi nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, wɔ wimu, wɔ sor, anaa asaase do, wɔ famu: ɔwo a isie ahyɛmu na mbɔbɔrhu ma wo nkowaa a wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara nantsew w’enyim:
ɔwo a esie dza ebɔɔ anohoba maa w’akowaa m’egya David no ama no: nyew, ɔwo edze w’ano kae, na edze wo nsa ahyɛ no ma, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.

Dɛm ntsi afei, EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, sie dza abɔ anohoba ama w’akowaa m’egya David no ma no dɛ, Nyimpa a ɔbɛtsena Israel ahengua do rommbɔ wo wɔ m’enyim; sɛ wo mba hwɛ hɔn kwan yie ara, dɛ wɔbɛnantsew m’enyim dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo nantseew m’enyim no a.
Dɛm ntsi afei, Israel Nyankopɔn e, meserɛ wo, ma w’asɛm a ekaa kyerɛɛ w’akowaa m’egya David no ntsim.
Na aso ampa dɛ Nyankopɔn bɛtsena asaase do? Hwɛ, ɔsor na ɔsor mu sor mpo nntum nnkora wo; na akantam ɔdan yi a mesi!
Naaso EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn bu w’akowaa ne mpaabɔ, na no ntotɔserɛ bi, dɛ ibetsie w’akowaa ne nkekamu na ne mpaabɔ, a ɔrobɔ no wɔ w’enyim ndɛ da yi:
dɛ w’enyi bobue wɔ ɔdan yi do adzesaa na adzekyee, mekyerɛ bea a ɔwoara ase dɛ, Me dzin bɛtsena hɔ no do: dɛ ibetsie mpaabɔ a w’akowaa robɔ akyerɛ bea yi do no.
Na tsie w’akowaa, na wo man Israel ntotɔserɛ, aber a wɔrobɔ mpaa kyerɛ bea yi do: nyew, tsie no wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea hɔ; na sɛ etse a, fa kyɛ:
Sɛ nyimpa bi yɛ bɔn tsia ne nyɛnko, na ntam bɛda no do dɛ ɔka, na ɔba bɛka ntam wɔ w’afɔrmbukyia enyim wɔ fie yi mu a:
ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor, na yɛ, na bu wo nkowaa atsɛn, dɛ irubu ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no fɔ, ma no kwan eebua nankasa n’etsifi: na irubu ɔtseneneenyi no bem, ama no dɛ mbrɛ ne ndzeyɛtsenenee tse.
Sɛ wɔka wo man Israel gu wɔ atamfo enyim, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo ntsi; na sɛ wɔsan ba wo nkyɛn bio, na wɔbɔ wo dzin, na wɔbɔ wo mpaa na wɔtotɔ serɛ wo wɔ fie yi mu a:
ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor, na fa wo man Israel hɔn bɔn kyɛ hɔn, na fa hɔn bra asaase a ɔwoara dze maa hɔn egyanom no do bio.
Sɛ wɔtow ɔsor mu, na nsu nntɔ, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo ntsi; sɛ wɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ bea yi do, na wɔbɔ wo dzin, na wɔsan fi hɔn bɔn ho, dɛ ahaw hɔn ntsi a:
ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor, na fa wo nkowaa, na wo man Israel hɔn bɔn kyɛ hɔn, dɛ erekyerɛ hɔn ɔkwan pa a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔfa do; na ma nsu ntɔ ngu w’asaase a ɔwoara dze ama wo man dɛ egyapadze no do.
Sɛ ɔkɔm ba asaase no do, sɛ ɔyardɔm ba, sɛ ohuw anaa ɔpo, mbɛbɛw anaa nkonyinko ba; sɛ hɔn atamfo botua hɔn wɔ nkuropon asaase do; owuyar biara, yarba biara ba a;
mpaabɔ na ntotɔserɛ biara a nyimpa biara, anaa wo man Israel nyinara bɛyɛ a nyimpa biara bohu nankasa n’akoma mu ɔhaw na ɔbɛtrɛ ne nsamu akyerɛ fie yi do no:

ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea hɔ, na fa kyɛ, na yɛ, na ma nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan nyinara tse, nyia ɔwoara nyim n’akoma mu a; (osiandɛ ɔwo, mekyerɛ ɔwoara nkotoo na inyim nyimpa mba nyinara hɔn akoma mu;)
ama woeesuro wo wɔ nda nyinara a wɔdze bɛtsena asaase a ɔwoara edze maa hɛn egyanom no do no.
Nkyii so ɔhɔho a ommfi wo man Israel mu ho dze, sɛ osian wo dzin ntsi ma ofi ekyirekyir man bi mu ba;
(osiandɛ wɔbɛtse wo dzin kɛse no, na wo nsa dzendzen no, na w’abasa a atsen mu no nka;) sɛ ɔba bɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ ɔdan yi do a:

ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea, na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔhɔho no rusu frɛ wo no nyinara: ama asaase do aman nyinara aatse wo dzin, na woeesuro wo, dɛ mbrɛ wo man Israel yɛ, na woeehu dɛ wo dzin na wɔdze frɛ ɔdan yi a mesi yi.
Sɛ wo man fir edzi nye hɔn atamfo kedzi ako wɔ ɔkwan biara a ɔwoara bɔsoma hɔn do, na wɔbɔ EWURADZE mpaa kyerɛ kurow a asan mu eyi, na ɔdan a mesi ama wo dzin yi do a:
ɔno ɔwoara tsie hɔn mpaabɔ na hɔn ntotɔserɛ wɔ ɔsor, na dzi hɔn asɛm ma hɔn.
Sɛ wɔyɛ bɔn tsia wo, (osiandɛ nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ a ɔnnyɛ bɔn,) na wo bo fuw hɔn, na iyi hɔn ma atamfo, ma wɔfa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔ atamfo asaase do ekyirekyir o, nkyɛnkyɛn o;

na afei sɛ hɔnara wɔdwen wɔ asaase a wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmum akɔ do no do, na wɔsan bio, na wɔtotɔ serɛ wo wɔ hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree no hɔn asaase do, dɛ, Yɛayɛ bɔn, na yeetwa nkontompɔ, yeedzi emumuyɛsɛm;

sɛ wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara na hɔn kra nyinara san ba wo nkyɛn wɔ hɔn atamfo a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree no hɔn asaase do, na wɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ hɔn asaase a ɔwoara dze maa hɔn egyanom, kurow a ɔwoara asan mu eyi, na ɔdan a mesi ama wo dzin yi do a:
ɔno ɔwoara tsie hɔn mpaabɔ na hɔn ntotɔserɛ wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea, na dzi hɔn asɛm ma hɔn;
na fa wo man a wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo, na hɔn mbrato a wɔafom wɔ mu etsia wo nyinara kyɛ hɔn; na ma hɔn mbɔbɔrhu wɔ hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree no enyim, nyew, ma wonhu hɔn mbɔbɔr:
osiandɛ wɔyɛ wo man, na w’egyapadze a iyii hɔn wɔ Egypt wɔ dadze fononoo no mu bae:
na ma w’enyiwa nkɔ w’akowaa no ntotɔserɛ, na wo man Israel ntotɔserɛ do dɛ ibetsie hɔn mber biara a wosu frɛ wo no.
Osiandɛ ɔwoara na etseew hɔn fii asaase do aman nyinara mu dɛ wɔyɛ w’egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwoara nam w’akowaa Moses n’abaw do kae no, wɔ aber a edze hɔn egyanom fi Egypt reba no, ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Solomon wiee mpaa ɔbɔ maa EWURADZE na ntotɔserɛ nyinara no, ɔsoɛree fii EWURADZE afɔrmbukyia no enyim, na ogyaa n’anankoroma enyim kosɔw nye ne nsamu trɛ a ɔtrɛɛ kyerɛɛ ɔsor do no.
Na ogyinae, na ɔdze ndze kɛse hyiraa Israel mboanofo no nyinara, dɛ,
Nhyira nka EWURADZE a ɔama ne man Israel ahomgye, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ anohoba no nyinara tse: n’anohoba pa a ɔnam n’akowaa Moses ne nsa do bɔe no nyinara mu asɛm kor mpo annyew.
EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ndzi hɛn ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ odzii hɛn egyanom ekyir no: ma mma onngyaa hɛn, na eso ɔmmpa hɛn:
ama ɔaadan hɛn akoma akɔ no do, dɛ yɛbɛnantsew n’akwan nyinara mu, na yeedzi ne mbransɛm, na n’ahyɛdze, na n’atsɛmbu a ɔdze hyɛɛ hɛn egyanom no do.
