Na ma me nsɛm yi a medze edzi ntotɔserɛ wɔ EWURADZE enyim yi mbɛn EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn adzekyee na adzesaa, ma ondzi n’akowaa n’asɛm, na ne man Israel hɔn asɛm mma hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ da biara dze bɛba:
ama asaase do aman nyinara woeehu dɛ EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn: na obi nnyi hɔ bio.
Dɛm ntsi hom mma hom akoma ndzi mu wɔ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ wɔbɛnantsew n’ahyɛdze mu, na woedzi ne mbransɛm do dɛ ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔhen no, na Israel nyinara ka no ho bɔɔ afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
Na Solomon dze anantwi mpemeduonu ebien, na nguan mpemɔha eduonu, bɔɔ asomdwee afɔr a ɔbɔe maa EWURADZE no. Dɛm na ɔhen no na Israelmba no nyinara dze buee EWURADZE ne fie no.

Da no ara ɔhen no yɛɛ EWURADZE ne dan no enyim dampan no ne finimfin no krɔnkrɔn; na hɔ na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr na edziban afɔr, na asomdwee afɔr ne seradze no: osiandɛ boran afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE enyim no suar dodow dɛ ɔbɛgye ɔhyew afɔr, na asomdwee afɔr ho seradze no.
Nna Solomon hyɛɛ fa no aber no mu, na Israel nyinara ka no ho, mboanofo kɛse, wofi Hamat ahɛnee kodu Egypt ɔwora no ho, wɔ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim nda esuon na nda esuon, mekyerɛ dadu ndaanan.
Da a otsia awɔtwe no ogyaa ɔman no kwan, na wohyiraa ɔhen no, na wɔdze papa nyinara a EWURADZE ayɛ ama n’akowaa David, na ne man Israel no ho enyigye na akoma pa sii mu kɔr hɔn asesee mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Solomon wiee EWURADZE ne fie, na ahemfie no si, na Solomon n’apɛdze a ɔsɔ n’enyi dɛ ɔbɛyɛ nyinara yɛ no,
nna EWURADZE yii noho kyerɛɛ Solomon ne mpɛn ebien, dɛ mbrɛ oyii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ Gibeon no.
Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Matse wo mpaabɔ na wo ntotɔserɛ a ayɛ no wɔ m’enyim no: mayɛ fie a esi yi krɔnkrɔn, dɛ medze me dzin mobɔto hɔ daa; na m’enyiwa na m’akoma atsena hɔ daa nyina.
Na ɔwo dze, sɛ enantsew m’enyim dɛ mbrɛ w’egya David nantsewee no, akomamu tsewee mu, na tsenenee mu, dɛ ebɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza medze ahyɛ wo nyinara tse, na edzi m’ahyɛdze na m’atsɛmbu do a;
ɔno mebɛma w’ahendzi ahengua etsim wɔ Israel do daa; dɛ mbrɛ medze bɔɔ w’egya David anohoba no, dɛ, Israel ahengua do nyimpa rommbɔ wo no.
Mbom sɛ hom san fi m’ekyir, hom anaa hom mba, na woenndzi me mbransɛm na m’ahyɛdze a medze esi hom enyim yi do, na hom kɔ kɔsom enyame fofor, na hom sɔr hɔn a:
ɔno mubotwa Israel efi asaase a medze ama hɔn no do; na fie a mayɛ no krɔnkrɔn ama me dzin yi mobɔtow efi m’enyim akyen; na Israel bɛdan ɔkasabɛbu na fen wɔ aman nyinara mu:
na ɔdan yi krɔn kɔ sor dze, naaso obiara a obotwa mu wɔ ho no, no ho bɔbow no, na ɔabɔ nhwiroma; na wɔase dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na EWURADZE ayɛ asaase yi, na fie yi dɛm yi?

Na wobobua dɛ, Osiandɛ wɔpoow EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn a ɔdze hɔn egyanom fi Egypt asaase do bae no, na wɔkɛtae suoo enyame fofor mu sɔɔr hɔn, na wɔsoom hɔn: dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE dze mbusu yi nyinara aba hɔn do yi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe eduonu no a Solomon dze sisii efie ebien no, mekyerɛ EWURADZE ne fie na ɔhen ne dze no, n’ewiei no,
(afei nna Taerehen Hiram dze nkyindur ndua na ɔpepeaa, na ɔnye sika, dɛ mbrɛ n’apɛdze tse nyinara ama Solomon,) nna ɔhen Solomon maa Hiram nkurow eduonu wɔ Galilii asaase do.
Na Hiram fiir edzi fii Taere dɛ ɔrobɔhwɛ nkurow a Solomon dze ama no no; na wɔannsɔ n’enyi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Mo nua, ebɛn nkurow nye yi na edze ama me yi? Na ɔfrɛɛ no Kabul asaase (asaasebɔn) dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na Hiram somaa ma wɔdze sika dwetsir kɛse ɔha eduonu kɛmaa ɔhen no.
Na iyi nye siantsir a ɔhen Solomon gyegyee ɔtowyi edwuma; dɛ ɔdze besi EWURADZE ne fie, na nankasa ne fi, na Millo, na Jerusalɛm fasu, na Hazor, na Megiddo, na Gezer no.
Nna Egypthen Farao afow akɔ akɛgye Gezer, na ɔdze ogya ahyew no, na oekuku Keenanfo a wɔtse kurow no mu no. Afei ɔdze maa ne babaa a Solomon waar no no, dɛ awar akyɛdze.
Na Solomon kyekyeer Gezer bio, na Bɛt-horon anaafo no,
na Baalat, na Tamar wɔ sar no do, asaase no do,
na adzekora nkurow a Solomon wɔ no nyinara, na ne ntseaseanam nkurow, na no mpɔnkɔdofo nkurow, na dza Solomon pɛ dɛ osi gye n’enyi wɔ Jerusalɛm, na Lebanon, na n’ahendzi asaase no nyinara mu.
Nkorɔfo a wɔkae wɔ Amorifo, na Hitifo, na Perizfo, Hivifo, na Jebusfo mu a wommfi Israelmba mu no dze;
hɔn mba a wɔkaa hɔn ekyir wɔ asaase no do no a Israelmba enntum annsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa no, hɔn na Solomon gyegyee hɔn enyadze ɔtowyi edwuma dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Naaso Israelmba no mu dze, Solomon annyɛ hɔn mu biara ɔtowyifo; mbom hɔn na wɔyɛɛ mbarimba akofo, na ne gyasefo na ne mbapɔmba, na n’asafohemfo, na ne ntseaseanam na no mpɔnkɔdofo do mpanyimfo.
Woyinom nye Solomon n’edwuma do ahwɛdofo mu mpanyin, ahaenum eduonum a wɔhwɛ nkorɔfo a wɔyɛ edwuma no do.
Na Farao babaa no fii David kurow no mu baa ne fi a Solomon sii maa no no mu: nna osii Millo.

Na afrenhyia mu mpɛn ebiasa na Solomon bobɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr na asomdwee afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia a osii maa EWURADZE no do, ɔhyew eduhuam ka ho, wɔ afɔrmbukyia a osi EWURADZE enyim no do. Dɛm na ɔdze wiee ofi no.
Na ɔhen Solomon yɛɛ ahɛn wɔ Ezion-geber a ɔwɔ Elot nkyɛn, wɔ Mbɛw Po no no mpoano, wɔ Edom asaase do.
Na Hiram somaa no nkowaa, apofomba a wɔwɔ po ho nyimdzee, ma wɔkɛkaa Solomon no nkowaa ho wɔ ahɛn no mu.
Na wɔkɔr Ofir, na wɔkɛfaa hɔ sika, dwetɛsika ahaanan eduonu, na wɔdze brɛɛ ɔhen Solomon.
Na aber a Seba ɔhembaa no tsee Solomon ne nka wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin ho no, ɔbaa dɛ ɔdze nsɛmbisa dzendzen robɔsɔ no ahwɛ.
Na ɔnye akadofo kɛsenara baa Jerusalɛm, efumpɔnkɔ a wɔsoso nduhuam, na sika piigyan, na abo a ɔsom bo: na aber a ɔbaa Solomon nkyɛn no, ɔnye no twetwee dza ɔwɔ n’akoma mu nyinara ho nkɔmbɔ.
Na Solomon kyerɛɛ no ne nsɛm nyinara ano: asɛm biara ennsuma ɔhen no a ɔannka annkyerɛ no.
Na aber a Seba ɔhembaa no hun Solomon ne nyansaa nyinara, na fie a oesi,
na no pon do edziban, na no nkowaa ntsenaa mu, na n’asomfo ngyinaa mu, na hɔn ntar, na ne nsahyɛfo, na n’afowee a ɔnam do fow kɔ EWURADZE fie no; noho boow no kɛse.
Na ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, Wo ndwuma na wo nyansaa ho asɛm a metsee no wɔ mankasa m’asaase do no yɛ nokwar.
Naaso manngye nsɛm no enndzi, dze bodur dɛ mebae, na medze m’enyiwa mebohu yi: na hwɛ, wɔannka ne fa mpo annkyerɛ me: wo nyansaa na wo prɔmprɔmyɛ bor wo nka a metsee no do.
Ahomka aka wo nkorɔfo, ahomka aka wo nkowaa yi a wogyinagyina w’enyim daa, na wotsie wo nyansaa no.
Nhyira nka EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔpɛ w’asɛm ma ɔdze wo esi Israel ahengua do: osiandɛ EWURADZE dɔ Israel daa, dɛm ntsi na ɔahyɛ wo ɔhen dɛ yɛ atsɛmbudze na pɛrpɛryɛ.
Na ɔmaa ɔhen no sika dwetsir kɛse ɔha eduonu, na nduhuam burututuitu, na abo a ɔsom bo: nduhuam a ɔdɔɔ so dɛm bi ammba bio a ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ Seba ɔhembaa no dze maa ɔhen Solomon no.
Na Hiram n’ahɛn no so a wɔdze sika fi Ofir bae no, wɔdze almug ndua piigyan na abo a ɔsom bo fi Ofir bae.
Na ɔhen no dze almug ndua no yɛɛ EWURADZE fi no na ɔhen ne fi no ho edum, nsankutsen so na bɛnta asanku maa adwontofo no: dɛm almug ndua yi bi ammba bio, nkyii so woennhu bi araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔhen Solomon maa Seba ɔhembaa no n’apɛdze nyinara, biribiara a obisae no, ɔsor dza ofi ɔhen Solomon nsamu a ɔdze maa no no. Nna odzii ndan, na osii mu kɔr nankasa n’asaase do, ɔno na no nkowaa.
Na afei sika a ɔbaa Solomon hɔ wɔ afe kor mu ne nkerii yɛ sika dwetsir kɛse ahaesia eduosia esia,
ɔsor dza ofi konkosifo hɔ bae, na eguadzifo eguadzi mu, na dza ofi aforaforadɔm ahemfo nyinara hɔ, na aman no mu ambradofo no hɔ.
Na ɔhen Solomon dze sika a wɔabor yɛɛ akyɛm akɛse ahaenu: sika dwetɛbona ahaesia na ɔdze duraa kyɛm kor ho.
Na ɔdze sika a wɔabor yɛɛ akyɛm nkakraba ahaasa; sika pɔɔn ebiasa na ɔdze duraa kyɛm kor ho: na ɔhen no dze koguu Lebanon kwaa dan no mu.
Nkyii so ɔhen no yɛɛ asombɛn ahengua kɛsenara na ɔdze sika mapa duraa ho.
Ahengua no wɔ ntwerba esia, na ahengua no n’etsifi yɛ korkorba wɔ ekyir: na nsa wowɔ afa na afa wɔ atsenaa no ho, na ngyata ebien gyinagyina nsa no ho.
Na ngyata duebien gyinagyina ntwerba esia no do hɔ wɔ afa na afa ha: wɔnnyɛɛ dza ɔtse dɛm bi da wɔ ahenman biara mu.
Na ɔhen Solomon no nkɔɔpow a ɔnom mu nyinara sika dze a, na Lebanon kwaa dan mu nkɔɔpow nyinara sika mapa a: dwetɛ dze biara nnyi mu; wommbu no hwee wɔ Solomon n’aber do.
Nna ɔhen Solomon wɔ Tarsis ahɛn wɔ po do a ɔka Hiram n’ahɛn ho: mfensa biara mu Tarsis ahɛn no ba prɛko, dze sika, na dwetɛ, asombɛn na ndɔpe, na koohaa ba.
Na ɔhen Solomon boor asaase do ahemfo nyinara do wɔ ahonya na nyansa mu.
Na asaase nyinara hwehwɛɛ Solomon n’enyim ehu, dɛ wobetsie ne nyansaa a Nyankopɔn dze ahyɛ n’akoma mu no.
Na hɔn mu nyimpa biara dze n’ayɛyɛdze bae, dwetɛ ndzɛmba, na sika ndzɛmba, na ntar, na ahodze, na nduhuam, mpɔnkɔ, na nsoasopɔnkɔ, afrenhyiadze afrenhyia afrenhyia.
Na Solomon boaboaa ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo ano: na onyaa ntseaseanam apem ahaanan, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemduebien a ɔdze hɔn siesiee ntseaseanam nkurow no mu, na ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalɛm.
Na ɔhen no maa dwetɛ yɛɛ dɛ abo wɔ Jerusalɛm, na ɔmaa nkyindur ndua yɛɛ dɛ ankye ndua a ɔwowɔ abɔnmu nkurow mu, wɔ ɔdodow mu.
Na mpɔnkɔ a Solomon nyae no wɔdze fi Egypt nye Kue bae: na ɔhen n’eguadzifo no kɛgyegyee hɔn ekuwekuw no, kuw kor wɔ no bo do.
Na wɔdze tseaseanam fi Egypt bae bɛgyee dwetɛ dwetɛbona ahaesia, na ɔpɔnkɔ so, dwetɛbona ɔha eduonum: na dɛmara so na wokitsaa bi fiir edzi brɛɛ Hitifo ahemfo nyinara, na Siria ahemfo no.
Afei ɔhen Solomon dɔɔ mbaa ananaben piinara kaa Farao ne babaa no ho, mbaa a wofi Moabfo, Ammonfo, Edomfo, Zidonfo, na Hitifo mu;

wofi amanaman a EWURADZE kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Israelmba dɛ, Mma hom nnkɔ hɔn mu, nkyii so mma hɔn so mmba hom mu: na ampa wɔbɛdan hom akoma ekedzi hɔn enyame ekyir no a: woyinom na Solomon takyeer hɔn ho wɔ ɔdɔ mu.
Na onyaa yernom ahaesuon, ahembaa a, na nponafo ahaasa: na ne yernom daan n’akoma.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Solomon yɛɛ akɔdaa no, ne yernom daan n’akoma kedzii enyame fofor ekyir: na n’akoma enndzi mu wɔ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David n’akoma tse.
Na Solomon kedzii Zidonfo bosom Astoret ekyir, na Ammonfo ekyiwadze Milkɔm ekyir.
Na Solomon yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na oenndzi EWURADZE ekyir ennwie, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David yɛe.
Nna Solomon sii bea sorɔnsorɔm maa Moab ekyiwadze Kemos, wɔ bepɔw a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm enyim no do, na Ammonmba ekyiwadze Molek.
Na dɛm na ɔyɛe maa ne yernom ananaben nyinara a wɔhyeew eduhuam na wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa hɔn abosom no.
Na EWURADZE no bo fuuw Solomon, osiandɛ n’akoma adan efi ɔno EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no a oeyi noho akyerɛ no mpɛn ebien no ho.
Ɔno a ɔahyɛ no asɛm yi ho mbra dɛ mma ɔnnkɔ nnkedzi enyame fofor ekyir no: naaso oenndzi dza EWURADZE hyɛe no do.
Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE see Solomon dɛ, Susuampa dɛ ɔwo ayɛ iyi, na enndzi m’ahyɛmu na m’ahyɛdze a mehyɛɛ wo no do ntsi, ampa mebɛtsew ahendzi no efi wo nsamu, na medze ama w’akowaa.
Naaso wo nda mu dze merennyɛ, osian w’egya David ntsi: na mbom mebɛtsew efi wo ba nsamu.
Naaso merenntsew ahendzi no nyinara; na medze ebusuakuw kor bɛma wo ba, osian m’akowaa David, na Jerusalɛm a masan mu meyi no ntsi.
Na EWURADZE maa ɔtamfo bi soɛree tsiaa Solomon, Edomnyi Hadad a ofi ɔhen n’asefo mu wɔ Edom no a.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a David bɔɔ Edom, na dɔm safohen Joab fowee kɔr dɛ orikesie atɔfo no, na okum Edom mbanyin nyinara;
(na Joab na Israel nyinara tsenaa hɔ abosoom esia, kodur dɛ okuuw ɔbanyin biara ase wɔ Edom;)
naaso Hadad guanee, ɔno na Edomfo bi a wofi n’egya nkowaa mu ka no ho, dɛ wɔrokɔ Egypt; nna Hadad yɛ abofra kakrabaa.
Na wɔsoɛree fii Midian, na wɔbaa Paran: na wɔfaa mbarimba bi wɔ Paran kaa hɔnho, na wɔbaa Egypt, wɔ Egypthen Farao nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔmaa no fie, na ɔhyehyɛɛ edziban maa no, na ɔmaa no asaase.
Na Hadad nyaa enyimnyam kɛse wɔ Farao enyim, ma ɔdze nankasa ne yer no nua, ɔhembaa Tafenes no nua, maa no ayewar.
Na Tafenes no nua no woo ne babanyin Genubat maa no, na Tafenes tsetsee no wɔ Farao fie: na Genubat nye Farao ne mba no bɔɔ mu nyinii.
Na aber a Hadad tsee no wɔ Egypt dɛ David nye n’egyanom akɛda, na dɔm safohen Joab so ewu no, Hadad see Farao dɛ; Gya me kwan ma monkɔ mankasa me man mu.
Nna Farao see no dɛ, Na ebɛnadze na ehia no wɔ me nkyɛn, ma erohwehwɛ dɛ ekɔ wankasa wo man mu yi? Na obuaa dɛ, Nnyɛ biribiara a: naaso ɔkwan ara na gya me ma monkɔ.
Afei so Nyankopɔn maa ɔtamfo kor so soɛree tsiaa no, Eliada ba Rezon a oguanee fii no wura Zobahen Hadadezer nkyɛn no a:
na ɔboaboaa mbarimba ano maa noho, na ɔbɛyɛɛ dɔm do safohen, wɔ aber a David kum hɔn a wofi Zoba no: na wosii mu kɔr Damaskɔs, na wɔkɛtsenaa hɔ, na odzii hen wɔ Damaskɔs.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔtamfo maa Israel wɔ Solomon ne nda nyinara mu, na ɔno so tseetsee hɔn dɛ mbrɛ Hadad yɛe no: na okyiir Israel, na odzii Siria do hen.
Na Nebat ne ba Jeroboam, Efraimnyi bi a ofi Zereda, a ɔyɛ Solomon n’akowaa na ne na ne dzin dze Zerua, ɔbaa okunafo bi no, so maa ne nsa do tsiaa ɔhen no.
Na asɛm a osian ntsi ma ɔmaa ne nsa do tsiaa ɔhen no nye yi: Solomon sii Millo, na osisiiw n’egya David kurow ho etokur.
Na dɛm Jeroboam no ɔyɛ ɔbarimba katakyi a ɔyɛ ndam: na Solomon hun aberantsɛ no dɛ ɔyɛ mbɔdzembɔnyi no, ɔmaa ɔhwɛɛ Josef fie edwuma nyinara do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ mber no mu, aber a Jeroboam fi Jerusalɛm rokɔ no, nkɔnhyɛnyi Silonnyi Ahija hun no wɔ ɔkwan no mu; nna Ahija hyɛ atar fofor; na hɔn beenu nko na wɔwɔ haban no mu.
Na Ahija tae suoo atar fofor a ɔhyɛ no no mu, na ɔtsetseew mu esinesin duebien.
Na ɔsee Jeroboam dɛ, Yi esinesin du woara fa; na mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛtsew ahendzi no efi Solomon ne nsamu, na medze mbusuakuw du ama wo:
(na ɔnodze, obenya ebusuakuw kor, wɔ m’akowaa David ntsi, na Jerusalɛm, kurow a masan mu meyi no wɔ Israel mbusuakuw nyinara mu no ntsi:)

osiandɛ wɔapow me, na wɔakɔsom Zidonfo hɔn bosom Astoret, Moab nyame Kemos, na Ammonmba nyame Milcom; na wɔannantsew m’akwan mu dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ m’enyiwa do, na woedzi m’ahyɛdze na m’atsɛmbu do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David yɛe.
Naaso merenngye ahendzi no nyinara wɔ ne nsamu: na mebɛyɛ no ɔhen wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu wɔ m’akowaa David ntsi, ɔno a mesaan mu miyii no, osiandɛ odzii me mbransɛm na m’ahyɛdze do:
na mbom mebɛgye ahendzi no mefi ne ba nsamu, na medze ama wo, mekyerɛ mbusuakuw du no a.
Na medze ebusuakuw kor mebɛma ne ba no, ama m’akowaa David oeenya kandzea daa wɔ m’enyim, wɔ Jerusalɛm, kurow a masan mu meyi no dɛ medze me dzin mobɔto hɔ no mu.
Na mebɛfa ɔwo, na ibedzi hen dɛ mbrɛ wo kra pɛ nyinara na edzi Israel do hen.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ itsie dza mebɛhyɛ wo nyinara, na enantsew m’akwan do, na eyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ m’enyiwa do, dɛ ibedzi m’ahyɛdze na me mbra do, dɛ mbrɛ m’akowaa David yɛe no a; ɔno mibedzi w’ekyir, na m’akyekyer ofi a otsim ama wo, dɛ mbrɛ mekyekyeree memaa David no, na medze Israel mebɛma wo.
Na iyi ntsi mibehiahia David n’asefo ho, na nnyɛ daa nyina.
Dɛm ntsi Solomon hwehwɛɛ dɛ oku Jeroboam: na Jeroboam soɛree, na oguanee kɔr Egypt, wɔ Egypthen Sisak nkyɛn, na ɔtsenaa Egypt araa ma okodur Solomon no wu mu.
Afei Solomon ho nsɛm nkaa, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na ne nyansaa no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Solomon ho nsɛm nwoma no mu bi a?
Na mber a Solomon dze dzii hen wɔ Israel nyinara do wɔ Jerusalɛm no ɔyɛ mfe eduanan.
Na Solomon kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ n’egya David kurow mu: na ne ba Rehoboam dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Na Rehoboam sii mu kɔr Sekem: osiandɛ Israel nyinara baa Sekem dɛ wɔrebɛhyɛ no ɔhen.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nebat ne ba Jeroboam tsee no, (osiandɛ nna ɔda ho wɔ Egypt, mbrɛ oguanee fii ɔhen Solomon enyim kɔree kɛtsenae no,
na wɔsomae ma wokehyiaa no bae;) nna Jeroboam na Israel dɔm no nyinara bae, na wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ Rehoboam, dɛ,
W’egya yɛɛ hɛn kɔndua durdur: dɛm ntsi afei yɛ w’egya no som dzendzen no, na no kɔndua durdur a ɔdze too hɛn do no, harhar, na yɛnsom wo.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma me ndaansa, na nkyii hom nsan mbra me nkyɛn bio. Na ɔman no twee mu kɔree.
Na ɔhen Rehoboam nye nkɔdaa a wɔsoom n’egya Solomon dɛ apamfo mber a ɔda ho tse ase no, faa apam, dɛ, Afotu bɛn na hom dze rema me dɛ memfa nsan nkobua ɔman yi.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Sɛ ndɛ yi ɔwo eyɛ akowaa ma ɔman yi, na esom hɔn, na ibua hɔn, na eka nsɛm pa kyerɛ hɔn a, ɔno wɔbɛyɛ wo nkowaa daa nyina.
Naaso ɔpoow nkɔdaa no hɔn afotu a wɔdze maa no no, na ɔnye mberantsɛ a wɔnye no nyinii a afei wɔabɛyɛ n’apamfo no no dwenee.
Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Afotu bɛn na hom dze ma, ma yɛdze mbuae aasan akɛma ɔman yi a wɔaka akyerɛ me, dɛ, Yɛ kɔndua a w’egya dze too hɛn do no harhar no?

Na mberantsɛ a wɔnye no nyinii no kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Ka kyerɛ ɔman yi a wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ wo dɛ, W’egya yɛɛ hɛn kɔndua durdur, na ɔwo dze, yɛ no harhar ma hɛn no; dɛ: Me nsatseaba kakraba mpo yɛ dur sen m’egya n’asen.
Na afei sɛ m’egya dze kɔndua durdur soaa hom a, emi so mobɔto hom kɔndua no do: sɛ m’egya dze mpire tseaa hom a, emi dze, medze nyankom nketsebowa mebɛtsea hom.
Nna Jeroboam na ɔman no nyinara baa Rehoboam nkyɛn da a otsia ebiasa no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no kae no, dɛ, Da a otsia ebiasa no, hom nsan mbra me nkyɛn, no.
Na ɔhen no buaa ɔman no ebufuw mu, na ɔpoow nkɔdaa no hɔn apam a wɔdze maa no no;

na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ mberantsɛ no hɔn apam no tse, dɛ, M’egya yɛɛ hom kɔndua durdur, na emi dze mobɔto hom kɔndua do; m’egya dze mpire tseaa hom, na emi dze medze nyankoma nketsebowa mebɛtsea hom.
Na ɔhen no enntsie ɔman no; osiandɛ nna ɔyɛ adze a EWURADZE ahyehyɛ, ama ɔaama ɔno EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Silonnyi Ahija nsa do kaa kyerɛɛ Nebat ba Jeroboam no etsim.

Na aber a Israel nyinara hun dɛ ɔhen no enntsie hɔn no, ɔman no buaa ɔhen no dɛ, Ebɛn kyɛpɛn na yɛwɔ wɔ David mu? Nkyii so yennyi egyapadze wɔ Jesse ne ba no mu: Israel e, hom nkɔ hom asesee mu oo: afei David, hwɛ wankasa wo fie. Nna Israel sii mu kɔr hɔn asesee mu.
Na Israelmba a wɔtsetse Juda nkurow mu no dze, Rehoboam dzii hɔn do hen.
Nna ɔhen Rehoboam somaa Adoram a ɔhwɛ ɔtowyi edwuma do no; na Israel nyinara siiw no abo, ma ɔtɔree. Na ɔhen Rehoboam yɛɛ ntsɛm foow ne tseaseanam dɛ oruguan akɔ Jerusalɛm.
Nna Israel tseew etua wɔ David fi do, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Israel nyinara tsee dɛ Jeroboam fi Egypt asan aba no, nna wɔsomae ma wokehyiaa no ma ɔbaa dɔm no nkyɛn, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen wɔ Israel nyinara do: obiara nnyi hɔ a odzii David fi ekyir, gyedɛ Juda ebusuakuw nko.

Na aber a Rehoboam baa Jerusalɛm no, ɔboaboaa Juda fi nyinara, na Benjamin ebusuakuw ano, nyimpa a wɔasan mu eyi mpemɔha eduowɔtwe a wɔyɛ akofo ano, dɛ ɔnye Israel fi rokɔko, adan ahendzi no ama Solomon ne ba Rehoboam bio.
Na Nyankopɔn n’asɛm baa Nyame nyimpa Semaia nkyɛn, dɛ,
Ka kyerɛ Solomon ne ba Rehoboam, Judahen, na Juda na Benjamin fi nyinara, na ɔman nkaa no, dɛ,

Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma hom mmfow nnkɔ, nkyii so mma wɔnnye hom nuanom Israelmba nnkɔko: nyimpa biara nsan nkɔ ne fie; na asɛm no fir mara. Nna wotsiee EWURADZE n’asɛm no, na wɔsanee kɔr hɔn kwan, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm no tse.
Nna Jeroboam kyekyeer Sekem wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, na ɔtsenaa mu; na ofii hɔ kɔree kɛkyekyeer Penuel.
Na Jeroboam see n’akoma mu dɛ, Annhwɛ a ahendzi no bɛsan akɔ David fie:
wɔ ber a ɔman yi fow kɔ kɔbɔ afɔr wɔ EWURADZE fie wɔ Jerusalɛm no, bɛyɛ nna ɔman yi akoma adan akɔ hɔn wura nkyɛn bio, mekyerɛ Judahen Rehoboam a; na woeku me, na wɔasan akɔ Judahen Rehoboam nkyɛn.
Nna ɔhen no faa apam, na ɔyɛɛ sika anantwimba ebien; na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔdɔɔ so dodow ma hom dɛ hom bɔfow akɔ Jerusalɛm; Israel, hwɛ w’enyame a wɔdze wo fi Egypt asaase do bae nye iyinom.
Na ɔdze kor kesii Bɛtɛl, na ɔdze kor so kesii Dan.
Na asɛm yi maa wɔyɛɛ bɔn: osiandɛ ɔman no kɔree kɔsoom hɔn wɔ Bɛtɛl araa dze kɔr Dan.
Na ɔyɛɛ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do adan, na ɔhyɛɛ ɔman no mu binom a wommfi Levimba mu no asɔfo.

Na Jeroboam hyehyɛɛ afahyɛ wɔ bosoom a otsia awɔtwe no mu wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsia duenum no do, ɔtse dɛ afahyɛ a ɔwɔ Juda no, na ɔfowee kɔr afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn; dɛmara na ɔyɛɛ no wɔ Bɛtɛl, ɔbɔɔ afɔr maa anantwimba a ɔyɛe no: na ɔdze mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo a ɔyɛe no guu Bɛtɛl.

Na ɔfowee kɔr afɔrmbukyia no a ɔyɛe no wɔ Bɛtɛl wɔ bosoom a otsia awɔtwe no mu da a otsia duenum no, mekyerɛ bosoom a ɔbɔɔ nankasa ne tsirmu hyɛe no mu a: na ɔhyehyɛɛ afahyɛ maa Israelmba no, na ɔfowee kɔr afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn dɛ ɔrekɛhyew eduhuam.
Na, hwɛ, Nyame nyimpa bi fi Juda nam EWURADZE n’asɛm do baa Bɛtɛl: nna Jeroboam gyina afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn dɛ ɔrebɛhyew eduhuam.

Na ɔnam EWURADZE n’asɛm do tseatseaa mu tsiaa afɔrmbukyia no, na ɔsee dɛ, Afɔrmbukyia e, afɔrmbukyia e, mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi oo: Hwɛ, wɔbɔwo ɔba bi ama David fie, ne dzin dze Josia; na wo do na wɔdze mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo a wɔhyew wo do eduhuam bɔbɔ afɔr, na wɔahyew nyimpa mbiew wɔ wo do.
Na ɔmaa asɛnkyerɛdze da no ara, dɛ, iyi nye asɛnkyerɛdze a EWURADZE aka no: Hwɛ, afɔrmbukyia no bɛpaa, na nso a ɔwɔ do no ehue egu.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no tsee Nyame nyimpa no n’asɛm a ɔtseatseaa mu tsiaa afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Bɛtɛl no, Jeroboam fi afɔrmbukyia no do tseen ne nsa dɛ, Hom nsuo no mu. Na ne nsa no a ɔtseen no wɔ no do no sireen, ma oenntum anntwe no ekyir ammba noho bio.
Afɔrmbukyia no so paae, na nso no huei fi afɔrmbukyia no do gui dɛ mbrɛ asɛnkyerɛdze a Nyame nyimpa no nam EWURADZE n’asɛm do dze mae no tse no.

Na ɔhen no see Nyame nyimpa no dɛ, Afei serɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn n’adom, na bɔ mpaa ma me, ma me nsa nsan n’ananmu mma me bio. Na Nyame nyimpa no serɛɛ EWURADZE, na ɔhen no ne nsa saan n’ananmu maa no bio, na ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ nkan no ɔtse no ara.
Na ɔhen no see Nyame nyimpa no dɛ, Bɛsen nye me nkɔ fie, na kɔdwedwe woho, na mebɛkyɛ wo adze.
Na Nyame nyimpa no see ɔhen no dɛ, Sɛ ebɛma me wo fi fa mpo a, mennkɛnye wo akɔ, nkyii so mirinndzi edziban na eso moronnom nsu wɔ ha yi:
na dɛm na ɔnam EWURADZE n’asɛm do wɔdze hyɛɛ me, dɛ, Mma nndzi edziban, na so nnom nsu, nkyii so nnsan mmfa ɔkwan a enam do bae no do.
Nna osii ɔkwan fofor do kɔree, na ɔannsan ammfa ɔkwan a ɔnam do baa Bɛtɛl no do.
Afei nkɔnhyɛnyi akɔdaa bi tse Bɛtɛl; na ne mbabanyin no mu baako bae bɛkaa dwuma a Nyame nyimpa no bedzii no wɔ Bɛtɛl da no nyinara kyerɛɛ no: nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, so ɔkaa kyerɛɛ n’egya.
Na hɔn egya bisaa hɔn dɛ, Ɔkwan bɛn do na ɔfae? Afei ne mbabanyin no hun ɔkwan kor a Nyame nyimpa no a ofi Juda bae no dze faa do.
Na ɔsee ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Hom nhyehyɛ asoaso no mma me. Nna wɔhyehyɛɛ asoaso no maa no: na ɔtsenaa do.
Na otsiiw Nyame nyimpa no, na ɔkɔtoo no dɛ ɔtse esudur bi ase: na ɔsee no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Nyame nyimpa a ofi Juda bae no? Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi a.
Nna ɔsee no dɛ, Bɛsen nye me nkɔ fie nkedzidzi.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Murunntum menye wo nnsan, na eso merennye wo nnkɔ: nkyii so mirinndzi edziban na menye wo ronnom nsu so wɔ ha yi:
osiandɛ wɔnam EWURADZE n’asɛm do see me dɛ, Mma nndzi edziban na eso nnom nsu wɔ hɔ, na mma nnsan mmfa ɔkwan a enam do bae no do bio.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi so nkɔnhyɛnyi nye me dɛ ɔwoara; na ɔbɔfo bi nam EWURADZE n’asɛm do kaa kyerɛɛ me dɛ, Fa no san ma ɔnye wo mbra wo fie, ma ombedzidzi na ɔnnom nsu. Na odzii ator kyerɛɛ no.
Nna ɔnye no sanee kɔree, na okedzii edziban wɔ ne fie, na ɔnoom nsu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔtse pon ho no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi no a ɔdze no sanee bae no nkyɛn:

na ɔtseatseaa mu kyerɛɛ Nyame nyimpa no a ofi Juda bae no, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Susuampa dɛ ɔwo ayɛ asoɔdzen wɔ EWURADZE n’anosɛm ho, na enndzi mbrasɛm a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze hyɛɛ wo no do,
na asan aba ebedzi edziban na anom nsu wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔsee wo dɛ, Mma nndzi edziban, na nnom nsu no ntsi; wo fun ronnkɔ w’egyanom hɔn asamandan mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, odzii edziban, na ɔnomee n’ekyir no, ɔhyehyɛɛ asoaso no maa nkɔnhyɛnyi no a ɔkɛsaan no bae no.
Na aber a ɔkɔree no, gyata hyiaa no ɔkwan no mu, na okum no: na no fun daa kwan no mu, na asoaso no gyinaa ho; nna gyata no so gyina fun no ho.
Na, hwɛ, nyimpa twaa mu, na wohun fun no a ɔda ɔkwan no mu, na gyata a ogyina fun no ho no: na wɔbaa bɛkaa no wɔ kurow no mu mbrɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi akɔdaa no tse no.

Na aber a nkɔnhyɛnyi no a ɔdze no sanee fii ɔkwan no do bae no tsee no, ɔsee dɛ, Nyame nyimpa a ɔyɛɛ asoɔdzen wɔ EWURADZE n’anomu asɛm ho no a: dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE eyi no ama gyata no ma ɔatsetsew no ekum no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no no tse no.
Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Hom nhyehyɛ asoaso no mma me. Na wɔhyehyɛɛ no.
Na osii mu kɔree na okohun no fun no dɛ ɔda ɔkwan no mu, na asoaso no na gyata no gyinagyina fun no ho; gyata no enndzi fun no, na eso ɔanntsetsew asoaso no mu.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi no maa Nyame nyimpa no no fun no do, na ɔdze too asoaso no do, na ɔdze no sanee baa nkɔnhyɛnyi akɔdaa no no kurow no mu, dɛ oribegyam no na oesie no.
Na akɔdaa no dze fun no too nankasa n’adakamona mu; na ɔnye ne mbabanyin gyaam no dɛ, Ebei, mo nua!
Na ɔbaa dɛ, osiee no n’ekyir no ɔkaa kyerɛɛ ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Sɛ muwu a, ɔno wonsie me wɔ asamandan a woesie Nyame nyimpa no wɔ mu no mu; wɔmfa me mbiew ngu ne mbiew nkyɛn.
Osiandɛ asɛm a ɔnam EWURADZE n’asɛm do tseatseaa mu tsiaa afɔrmbukyia no wɔ Bɛtɛl na mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm efiefi nyinara a ɔwɔ Samaria nkurow mu no, ɔbɛba mu ampa.

Asɛm yi ekyir no Jeroboam annsan emmfi no kwan bɔn do, na oyii ɔman no nyinara mu binom yɛɛ hɔn mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo bio: obiara a ɔpɛ no, na ɔatsew no ho, ma ɔaayɛ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm no do hɔ asɔfo.
Na asɛm yi bɛyɛɛ bɔn wɔ Jeroboam fie dɛ wobotwa no akyen, na wɔasɛɛ no efi asaase enyi.
Aber no mu no Jeroboam ne ba Abija yaree.
Na Jeroboam see ne yer dɛ, Meserɛ wo, Soɛr, na sakyer woho amma woeennhu wo dɛ eyɛ Jeroboam ne yer: na kɔ Siloh; hwɛ, hɔ na nkɔnhyɛnyi Ahija a ɔkaa no wɔ mo ho dɛ mibedzi hen wɔ ɔman yi do no wɔ.
Na fa boodoo ntɔwmu du, na tatarmba, na ewo pɔr kitsa, na kɔ ne nkyɛn: ɔno na ɔbɛka dza ɔbɛba abofra no do akyerɛ wo.
Na Jeroboam ne yer no yɛɛ dɛm, na ɔsoɛree na osii mu kɔr Siloh, na ɔbaa Ahija ne fie. Afei Ahija no nkɔdaayɛ ntsi n’enyiwa ayɛ kusukusu na onnhu adze.
Na EWURADZE see Ahija dɛ, Hwɛ, Jeroboam ne yer reba wo hɔ ebebisa wo hɔ adze wɔ ne ba ho, na ɔyar: dɛm na dɛm na ka kyerɛ no: na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ ɔba a, obepetuw ayɛ noho dɛ ɔbaa fofor bi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahija tsee n’ananadze nka dɛ ɔaba abow no ano no, ɔsee dɛ, Bra, ɔwo Jeroboam ne yer; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na epetuw ayɛ woho dɛ obi yi? Na wɔdze nsɛm durdur asoma me wo hɔ.
Kɔ, kɛka kyerɛ Jeroboam dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Susuampa dɛ memaa wo do wɔ ɔman no mu, na mehyɛɛ wo ɔpanyin wɔ me man Israel do,
na metseew ahendzi no fii David fie, na medze memaa wo: naaso ɔwo annyɛ dɛ m’akowaa David a odzii me mbransɛm do, na ɔdze n’akoma nyinara dzii m’ekyir, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dza ɔtsen nko wɔ m’enyiwa do no;
na ɔwo ayɛ bɔn asen hɔn a wodzii w’enyim nyinara, na akɔ akɛyɛ enyame fofor, na ehonyi a woegu ama wo ho, dɛ edze riyi me ebufuw, na atow me akyen w’ekyir:

dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, medze mbusu bɛba Jeroboam fi do, na metwa Jeroboam mu abofra banyin biara akyen, Israel mu nyia wɔatow no mu na nyia woegyaa no, na mapra Jeroboam fie sɛsɛɛsɛ, dɛ mbrɛ obi pra efikyir, ma ne nyinara asa koraa.
Nyia ofi Jeroboam mu a obowu wɔ kurow mu no, nkraman bedzi; na nyia obowu wɔ haban mu no wimu ntumbowa bedzi, na EWURADZE na ɔaka yi.
Dɛm ntsi soɛr, kɔ wo fie: na sɛ w’anan si kurow no mu ara a, abofra no bowu.
Na Israel nyinara begyam no, na woesie no: na ɔno nko na ofi Jeroboam mu a ɔbɔkɔ adakamona mu: osiandɛ ɔno no mu na woehu adze pa bi wɔ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, afamu, wɔ Jeroboam fie.
Nkyii so EWURADZE bɛma ɔhen bi do ama noho wɔ Israel a da no obotwa Jeroboam fi akyen: na ebɛnadze a? Seseiara mpo a.

Na EWURADZE bɔbɔ Israel, dɛ mbrɛ ndzɛmbir hihim wɔ nsu mu; na oetutu Israel efi asaase pa a ɔdze maa hɔn egyanom yi do, na ɔabɔ hɔn apetse Esutsen no n’egya; osiandɛ wɔayɛ hɔn Aserim dze eyi EWURADZE ebufuw.
Na osian Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔayɛ na ɔdze ama Israel so ayɛ bɔn no ntsi, obegyaa Israel mu ama.
Na Jeroboam ne yer no soɛree sii mu, na ɔbaa Tirza: na obodur ofi no n’apondua ase dze no do ara nna abofra no wui.
Na Israel nyinara siee no, na wogyaam no; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam n’akowaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Ahija ne nsa do kae no tse no.
Na Jeroboam no ho nsɛm nkaa no, mbrɛ osii dzii ako, na mbrɛ osii dzii hen no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na nda a Jeroboam dze dzii hen yɛ mfe eduonu ebien: na ɔkɔr ne nsamankyir, na ne babanyin Nadab na ɔhyɛɛ n’ananmu dzii hen.

Na Solomon ne ba Rehoboam dzii hen wɔ Juda. Rehoboam hyɛɛ ase dzii hen no, nna oedzi mfe eduanan biako, na odzii hen mfe duesuon wɔ Jerusalɛm, kurow a EWURADZE saan mu yii no wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ ɔdze ne dzin bɔto hɔ no mu: na ne na yɛ Ammonnyi a ne dzin dze Naama.
Na Juda yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do; na wɔdze hɔn bɔn a wɔyɛe no yii EWURADZE nyinkun seen dza hɔn egyanom yɛe no nyinara.
Osiandɛ hɔn so wɔyeyɛɛ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm, na edum, na Aserim, wɔ koko tsentsen biara do, na dua momon biara ase maa hɔnho;
na sodomfo so wɔ asaase no do: wɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ amanaman a EWURADZE tuu hɔn wɔ Israelmba enyim no hɔn ekyiwadze nyinara tse.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔhen Rehoboam n’afe a otsia enum no mu no, Egypthen Sasak fowee baa Jerusalɛm do:
na ɔfaa EWURADZE ne fie akoradze, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze no; ɔfaa ne nyinara kwa dze kɔree: na ɔfaa sika akyɛm a Solomon yɛe no nyinara dze kɔree.
Na ɔhen Rehoboam yɛɛ boran akyɛm dze sisii hɔn ananmu, na ɔdze hyɛɛ abrampɔfo a wɔhwɛ ɔhen no ne fie abowano no do asafohemfo no nsa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, mber dodow biara a ɔhen no kɔ EWURADZE ne fie no abrampɔfo no susuo mu, na wɔdze san besi abrampɔfo pia mu.
Afei Rehoboam no ho nsɛm nkaa, na dza ɔyɛe no nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na akodzi daa Rehoboam na Jeroboam ntamu daa.
Na Rehoboam kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ n’egyanom nkyɛn wɔ David kurow no mu: nna ne na ne dzin dze Naama, Ammonnyi a, na ne babanyin Abijam dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Afei Nebat ne ba ɔhen Jeroboam n’afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu nna Abijam hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Juda do.
Mfe ebiasa na ɔdze dzii hen wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Maaka, Absalom ne babaa a.
Na ɔnantsewee wɔ n’egya no bɔn a ɔyɛe no wɔ n’enyim no nyinara mu: na n’akoma enndzi mu wɔ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn enyim, dɛ n’egya David n’akoma.
Naaso osian David ntsi na EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn maa kandzea wɔ Jerusalɛm, dɛ ɔbɛma ne ba do esi hɔ wɔ n’ekyir, na ɔama Jerusalɛm etsim:
osiandɛ David yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, na oemmfi adze biara a ɔhyɛɛ no no ho ɔanndan ammfa nkyɛn wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu, gyedɛ Hitinyi Uria asɛm no nko mu.
Afei akodzi daa Rehoboam na Jeroboam ntamu wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu.
Na Abijam no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe no nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu a? Na akodzi daa Abijam na Jeroboam ntamu.
Na Abijam kɔr ne nsamankyir; na wosiee no wɔ David kurow no mu: na ne babanyin Asa na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Na Israelhen Jeroboam n’afe a otsia eduonu no mu na Asa hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Juda do.
Na mfe eduanan biako na ɔdze dzii hen wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Maaka, Absalom ne babaa a.
Na Asa yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David yɛe.
Na otutuu sodomfo ndwaman no fii asaase no do, na oyiyii abosom a n’egyanom yɛe no nyinara wɔ hɔ.
Na ne na Maaka so otuu no do dɛ ɔyɛ ɔhembaa, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ ekyiwadze honyi bi maa Asera ntsi; na Asa twaa no honyi no, na ɔkɛhyeew no wɔ ɔwora Kidron do.
Na mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm no dze oennyiyi: naaso Asa n’akoma dzii mu wɔ EWURADZE enyim, ne nda nyinara.
Na ɔdze ndzɛmba a n’egya tui sii hɔ, na ndzɛmba a nankasa tui sii hɔ no baa EWURADZE fie, dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba.
Na akodzi daa Asa na Israelhen Baasha ntamu hɔn nda nyinara.
Na Israelhen Baasha fowee kɔr Juda do, na ɔkɛkyekyeer Rama, dɛ ɔremma kwan ma obiara nndzi ndɔfir wɔ Judahen Asa nkyɛn.

Nna Asa faa dwetɛ na sika a wogyaa no wɔ EWURADZE ne fie akoradze mu nyinara, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze no, na ɔdze hyɛɛ n’akowaa nsa: na ɔhen Asa somaa ma wɔdze kɔr Hezion ba Tabrimon ba Ben-hadad, Siriahen a ɔtse Damaskɔs no nkyɛn, dɛ,
Nkyekyeree bi da emi na ɔwo ntamu, wɔ m’egya na w’egya ntamu: hwɛ, mama wɔdze dwetɛ na sika ayɛyɛdze rebrɛ wo; kɔ, kɛtsetsew ɔwo nye Israelhen Baasha nkyekyeree no mu, ma omfi mo do nkɔ.
Na Ben-hadad tsiee ɔhen Asa, na ɔsomaa no dɔm do asafohemfo no wɔ Israel nkurow no do, na ɔbɔɔ Ijon, na Dan, na Abel-beth-maaka, na Kinnerot nyinara, kaa Naftali asaase nyinara ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Baasha tsee no, ogyaa Rama kyekyer, na ɔkɛtsenaa Tirza.
Nna ɔhen Asa maa wɔbɔɔ dawur wɔ Juda nyinara a woennyi obiara wɔ mu: na wɔkɔsoaa Rama abo, na no ho ndua no a Baasha dze kyekyeree no; na ɔhen Asa dze kyekyeer Benjamin Geba, na Mizpa.

Afei Asa no ho nsɛm nyinara, na ne ndam nyinara, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara na nkurow a ɔkyekyeree no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu a? Na mbom no nkɔdaaber mu no ɔyaar n’anan.
Na Asa kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ n’egyanom nkyɛn wɔ n’egya David kurow no mu: na ne babanyin Jehosafat na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Na Jeroboam ne ba Nadab hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia ebien no mu, na odzii hen wɔ Israel do mfe ebien.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na ɔnantseew n’egya no kwan, na ne ndzeyɛɛ a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no mu.
Na Ahija ne ba Baasha a ofi Isakar fie no paam ne tsir do; na Baasha bɔɔ no wɔ Gibeton a ɔyɛ Filistiafo dze no do; osiandɛ nna Nadab na Israel nyinara worutua Gibeton.
Mekyerɛ Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia ebiasa no mu na Baasha kum no na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.

Na ɔbaa dɛ obedzii hen no ara pɛr, nna ɔtɔr Jeroboam fi nyinara; oenngyaa obiara a ogu ahom amma Jeroboam dze kodur dɛ ɔsɛɛ no pasaa; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam n’akowaa Silohnyi Ahija n’abaw do kae no tse no:
osian Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔyɛe, na ɔdze maa Israel so yɛɛ bɔn no ntsi; osian yi a oyii EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ebufuw no ntsi.
Afei Nadab no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na akodzi daa Asa na Israelhen Baasha ntamu hɔn nda nyinara.
Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia ebiasa no mu na Ahija ne babanyin Baasha hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel nyinara do wɔ Tirza, na odzii hen mfe eduonu anan.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na ɔnantseew Jeroboam no kwan do, na ne ndzeyɛɛ a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no mu.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Hanani ba Jehu nkyɛn tsiaa Baasha, dɛ,
Susuampa dɛ memaa wo do fii huntuma mu, na mehyɛɛ wo ɔpanyin wɔ me man Israel do; na ɔwo anantsew Jeroboam no kwan mu, na ama me man Israel ayɛ bɔn, na wɔdze hɔn bɔn eyi me ebufuw ntsi;
hwɛ, mebɛpra Baasha na ne fi korakora; na mebɛyɛ wo fi dɛ Nebat ne ba Jeroboam ne fi.
Nyia ofi Baasha mu a obowu wɔ kurow mu no nkraman bedzi; na nedze mu nyia obowu wɔ haban mu no, wimu ntumbowa bedzi.
Afei Baasha no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe, na ne ndam, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Baasha kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no Tirza; na ne babanyin Ela na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.

Na nkyii so EWURADZE n’asɛm nam Hanani ne ba, nkɔnhyɛnyi Jehu n’abaw do bae betsiaa Baasha na ne fi, osian mbusu a ɔbɔɔ no wɔ EWURADZE enyi do nyinara ntsi, dɛ ɔdze ne nsaano edwuma yii no ebufuw yɛɛ dɛ Jeroboam ne fi no, na osiandɛ okum no ntsi.
Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia eduonu esia no mu na Baasha ne babanyin Ela hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Tirza, na odzii hen mfe ebien.
Na n’akowaa Zimri a ɔyɛ ne ntseaseanam mu fa do safohen no, paam ne tsir do: na dabi a ɔnodze ɔwɔ Tirza ronom nsa abow wɔ Arza a ɔhwɛ ahemfiefo do wɔ Tirza no ne fie no:
na Zimri kɔr hɔ na ɔkɔwɔɔ no kum no, wɔ Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia eduonu esuon no mu, na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase ridzi hen no, ntsɛmara a ɔtsenaa n’ahengua do no, nna okum Baasha fifo nyinara: oenngyaa no ɔbanyimba kor mpo, n’ebusuafo mu o, ne mfɛfo mu o.
Dɛm na Zimri sɛɛ Baasha fi nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam nkɔnhyɛnyi Jehu do kae tsiaa Baasha no tse no,
wɔ Baasha no bɔn nyinara, na ne ba Ela no bɔn a ɔyɛe, na wɔdze maa Israel so yɛɛ bɔn, dɛ, wɔdze hɔn egyangyandze yii EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn ebufuw no ntsi.
Afei Ela no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia eduonu esuon no mu na Zimri dzii hen nda esuon wɔ Tirza. Afei nna Israelman no akyer Gibeton a ɔyɛ Filistiafo dze no ho nsera.
Na aber a hɔn a wɔakyer nsera no tsee dɛ wɔrese dɛ, Zimri akɔ apam, na eso oeku ɔhen no: dɔm no nyinara dze dɔm do safohen Omri hyɛɛ hen wɔ Israel do da no ara wɔ nsera no mu.
Na Omri fi Gibeton sii mu kɔree, na Israel akofo nyinara ka no ho, na wokotuaa Tirza.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Zimri hun dɛ kurow no wɔagye no, nna osii mu kɔr ɔhen no ne fi aban no mu, na ɔdze ogya hyeew ɔhen no ne fi no guu no do, na owui,
osian no bɔn a ɔyɛe dɛ ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dɛ ɔnantseew Jeroboam kwan mu, na no bɔn a ɔyɛe dze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no mu ntsi.
Afei Zimri no ho nsɛm nkaa no na no nkontompɔ a otwae no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Nna Israelmba no mu paa ekuw ebien: ɔman no mu fa dzii Ginat ne ba Tibni ekyir, dɛ wɔbɛhyɛ no hen: na ɔfa so dzii Omri ekyir.
Na ɔman no a wodzii Omri ekyir no nsa daa ɔman no a wodzii Ginat ne ba Tibni ekyir no do: na Tibni wui, na Omri dzii hen.
Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia eduasa biako no mu na Omri hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do, na odzii hen mfe duebien: mfe esia na ɔdze dzii hen wɔ Tirza.
Na ɔkɔtɔɔ Samaria koko wɔ Semer hɔ maa dwetɛ ndwetɛbona ebien; na ɔkyekyeer koko no do kurow, na ɔdze koko no wura Semer ne dzin frɛɛ kurow a ɔkyekyeree no ne dzin dɛ Samaria.
Na Omri yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na ɔyɛɛ emumuyɛdze seen hɔn a wodzii n’enyim nyinara.
Osiandɛ ɔnantseew Nebat ba Jeroboam no kwan nyinara, na no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel fomee no mu, dɛ wɔdze hɔn egyangyandze yii EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ebufuw.
Afei Omri no ho nsɛm nkaa no, dza ɔyɛe, na ne mbanyinndam a ɔkyerɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Nna Omri kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ Samaria: na ne babanyin Ahab dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Na Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia eduasa awɔtwe no mu Omri ne ba Ahab hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do: na Omri ne ba Ahab dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria mfe eduonu ebien.
Na Omri ne ba Ahab yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyim seen hɔn a wodzii n’enyim nyinara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, dɛ gyama ɔyɛ adze harhar ma no dɛ ɔbɛnantsew Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn mu no ntsi, nna ɔfaa Zidonfo hen Etbaal ne babaa Jezebel ayewar, na osii mu kɔree kɔsoom Baal, na ɔkotoow no.
Na osii afɔrmbukyia maa Baal wɔ Baal fi a osii no wɔ Samaria no mu.
Na Ahab yɛɛ Asera no; na Ahab kɔr do araa dɛ ɔdze beyi EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ebufuw sen Israel ahemfo a wodzii n’enyim nyinara.

Ne nda mu na Bɛtɛlnyi Hiel kyekyeer Jeriko: ɔhweer n’abakan Abiram dze toow ne fapem, na ɔhweer ne ba kaekyir banyin Segub sisii n’ano mbobotsen; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Nun ne ba Josua abaw do kae no tse.
Na Tisbinyi Elija a ofi Gilead amamforafo mu no, see Ahab dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn a migyina n’enyim tse ase yi, ɔbɔsu anaaso nsu ronntɔ mfe yi mu, gyedɛ ɔnam m’asɛm do.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa ne nkyɛn dɛ,
Fi ha fir, na kɔ boka afamu, na fa woho kosuma ɔwora Kerit a ɔwɔ Jordan enyim no ho.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, ebɔnom ɔwora no mu nsu bi: na mahyɛ nkonkoran dɛ wɔnnyɛn wo wɔ hɔ.
Nna osii mu kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm tse: osiandɛ osii mu kɔree kɛtsenaa ɔwora Kerit a ɔwɔ Jordan enyim no ho.
Na nkonkoran no brɛɛ no boodoo na nam anapa, na boodoo na nam ewimbir; na ɔnoom ɔwora no mu nsu bi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔkyɛɛr kakra no, ɔwora no wewee, osiandɛ nna nsu nntɔ asaase no do.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Elija nkyɛn, dɛ,
Soɛr, kɔ Zarefat a ɔyɛ Zidon dze no, na kɛtsena hɔ: hwɛ, mahyɛ ɔbaa kunafo bi wɔ hɔ dɛ ɔmbɔ wo akɔhoma.
Nna ɔsoɛree sii mu kɔr Zarefat; na odur kurow no mu kuropon ano no, hwɛ, ɔbaa kunafo bi wɔ hɔ retaatar mbabaaba: na ɔfrɛɛ no see dɛ, Meserɛ wo, kɛsaw nsu kakra gu kɔɔpow mu brɛ me ma monnom.
Na ɔrokɔ akɛsaw no, ɔfrɛɛ no, na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo, fa boodoo trɔma bi kitsa wo nsamu brɛ me.

Na ɔbaa no see dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn tse ase yi, minnyi tatar biara, gyedɛ isiam nsapuw bi a ɔwɔ barba mu, na ngo kakra a ɔwɔ pɔr mu; na, hwɛ, meretaatar mbabaaba ebien bi, ma maakɔ mekesiesie ama emi na me ba, ma yeedzi na yeewu.
Na Elija see no dɛ, Mma nnsuro; kɔ kɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ase no: mbom dzi kan yɛ bi tatar kakra ma me, na fa brɛ me, na n’ekyir no ayɛ ɔwo na wo ba dze.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi, Isiam barba no ronnhwer, nkyii so ngo pɔr no rennsa, dze ekodu da a EWURADZE bɛma nsu atɔ egu asaase do.
Na ɔbaa no sii mu kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Elija n’asɛm no tse: na ɔnye Elija, na ɔnoara na ne fie dzii no nda pii.
Isiam barba no annhwer, nkyii so ngo pɔr no annsa, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Elija do kae no tse no ara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, nsɛm yi ekyir no, ɔbaa ofiwura no ne babanyin yaree; na ne yarba no mu yɛɛ dzen dodoodow, ma ahom biara annka no mu.
Na ɔsee Elija dɛ, Ɔwo Nyame nyimpa, ebɛnadze na menye wo wɔ yɛ? Ɔwo aba me nkyɛn dɛ edze mo bɔn reba nkaa mu, na eku me ba!
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Fa wo ba no ma me. Na oyii no fii no bo mu, na ɔmaa no do kɔr pia mu, mbrɛ ɔtse no, na ɔdze no kɔtoo nankasa ne mpa do.
Na ɔtseaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE see dɛ, EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn e, ana edze mbusu aba okunafo yi so a mabɔsoɛ ne nkyɛn yi do, dɛ iruboku ne ba?
Na ɔtseen no mu butuuw abofra no do mpɛn ebiasa, na ɔtseaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE see dɛ, EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn e, meserɛ wo, ma abofra yi ne kra mbra no mu bio.
Na EWURADZE tsiee Elija ne ndze: na abofra no ne kra baa no mu bio, na onyaa nkwa.
Na Elija faa abofra no na ɔdze no fi pia no mu sianee baa ɔdan no mu, na ɔdze no maa ne na: na Elija see dɛ, Hwɛ, wo ba enya nkwa.
Na ɔbaa no see Elija dɛ, Afei na mehu dɛ Nyame nyimpa nye wo, na EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔwɔ w’anomu yɛ nokwar.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda pii n’ekyir no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Elija nkyɛn, wɔ afe a otsia ebiasa no mu, dɛ, Kɔ, keyi woho edzi kyerɛ Ahab; na mebɛma nsu atɔ egu asaase do.
Na Elija sii mu kɔr dɛ orikeyi noho edzi akyerɛ Ahab. Na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ Samaria.
Na Ahab frɛɛ Obadia a ɔhwɛ fidua no do no. (Nna Obadia suro EWURADZE dɛ:
na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jezebel rutwitwa EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛfo no egu no, Obadia faa nkɔnhyɛfo ɔha, na ɔdze hɔn eduonum eduonum kosumasumaa ɔbo tu mu, na ɔdze edziban na nsu hwɛɛ hɔn.)
Na Ahab see Obadia dɛ, Kɔ, kekyin asaase no mu, nsubura nyinara, na nwora nyinara ho: bi a yebenya nkyɛkyɛr bi dze agye mpɔnkɔ na nsoasopɔnkɔ no nkwa, ma yɛannhwer mbowa no nyinara.
Nna wɔkyɛɛ asaase no mu maa hɔnho dɛ worikekyin do: Ahab nonko faa ɔkwan kor do, na Obadia nonko so faa ɔkwan kor do.
Na Obadia nam ɔkwan no mu no, hwɛ, Elija nye no hyiae: na ohun no, na ɔdze n’enyim butuuw famu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ana ɔwo mo wura Elija nye no a?
Na obuaa dɛ, Emi nye no: kɔ, kɛka kyerɛ wo wura dɛ, Hwɛ, Elija wɔ ha.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na mayɛ bɔn, ma ɔwo epɛ dɛ iyi w’akowaa hyɛ Ahab nsa, dɛ onku me yi?
Dɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn tse ase yi, ɔman biara, anaa ahenman biara nnyi hɔ a mo wura nnsomae ma wɔnnkɔr hɔ nnkɔhwehwɛɛ wo: na sɛ wɔse dɛ, Onnyi ha a ɔma ahenman no na ɔman no ka ntam dɛ wonnhun wo.
Na afei ɔwo ese dɛ, Kɔ, kɛka kyerɛ wo wura dɛ, Hwɛ, Elija wɔ ha.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ mefi wo nkyɛn mokɔ ara a, nkyɛ EWURADZE no sunsum no ehwim wo akɔ beebi mbrɛ minnyim; na dɛm ntsi sɛ mokɔ kɛka kyerɛ Ahab, na oennhu wo a, oboku me: na emi, w’akowaa dze, mifi me mberantsɛ mu ara na musuro EWURADZE.

Ana wɔnnkaa dza aber a Jezebel rukuku EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛfo no meyɛe no nnkyerɛɛ mo wura, mbrɛ misii na mefaa EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛfo no mu mbarimba ɔha, na medze hɔn eduonum eduonum kosumasumaa ɔbo tu mu, na medze edziban na nsu mohwɛɛ hɔn no?
Na afei ɔwo ese dɛ, Kɔ, kɛka kyerɛ wo wura dɛ, Hwɛ, Elija wɔ ha: na oboku me.
Na Elija see dɛ, Dɛ dɔm EWURADZE a migyina n’enyim tse ase yi, ampa mibeyi moho edzi makyerɛ no ndɛ da yi.
Nna Obadia sii mu kɔree kehyiaa Ahab na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no: na Ahab kɔree kehyiaa Elija.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab hun Elija no, Ahab see no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye no, ɔwo Israel no fonafo nye no?
Na obuaa dɛ, Emi mommfonaa Israel; mbom ɔwoara, na w’egya fie a, wɔ dɛ hom apow EWURADZE ne mbransɛm, na ɔwo ekedzi Baalim ekyir.
Dɛm ntsi afei soma na wɔnkɔboaboa Israel nyinara ano mbrɛ me wɔ bepɔw Karmel do, na Baal nkɔnhyɛfo ahaanan eduonum no, na Asera nkɔnhyɛfo ahaanan a wodzidzi Jezebel no pon do no.
Nna Ahab somae ma wɔkɔr Israelmba no nyinara mu, na wɔkɔboaboaa nkɔnhyɛfo no ano kɔr Karmel bepɔw do.

Na Elija baa ɔman no nyinara nkyɛn, na obisaa dɛ, Hom rigyina adwen ebien ntamu ma ekodu dabɛn? Sɛ EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn a, hom ndzi n’ekyir: sɛ Baal so a, ɔno hom ndzi n’ekyir. Na ɔman no emmbua no asɛm biara.
Nna Elija see ɔman no dɛ, Emi, manko ara nye EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔaka; na Baal nkɔnhyɛfo dze hom yɛ mbarimba ahaanan eduonum.

Dɛm ntsi ma wɔmma hɛn anantwi ebien; na ma wɔnsan mu nyi nantwisaa kor mma hɔnho, na wontwitwa no esinesin, na wɔmfa ngu nyena no do, na mma wɔmmfa gya nngu ase: na mo so mibesiesie nantwisaa kor no, na medze egu nyena no do, na meremmfa gya nngu ase.
Na hom mfrɛ hom nyame ne dzin, na mo so mebɛfrɛ EWURADZE ne dzin: na onyame a ɔdze gya bɛgye do no, wɔmma ɔno nyɛ Nyankopɔn. Na ɔman no nyinara buae see dɛ, Wɔaka no yie.
Na Elija see Baal nkɔnhyɛfo no dɛ, Hom nsan mu nyi nantwisaa kor mma homho, na hom ndzi kan nsiesie no; osiandɛ hom dɔɔ so; na hom mfrɛ hom nyame ne dzin, mbom mma wɔmmfa gya nngu ase.

Na wɔfaa nantwisaa no a wɔdze maa hɔn no, na wosiesiei, na wɔfrɛɛ Baal ne dzin fi anapa araa kodur wigyinae dɛ, Baal e, tsie hɛn. Naaso nna ndze bi nnyi hɔ, na nyia ɔgye do biara so nnyi hɔ. Na wohuruhuruwii kyiin afɔrmbukyia no a wɔyɛe no ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ wigyinae no, Elija sii hɔn atwetwe see dɛ, Hom mfa ndze kɛse ntsea mu: na ɔyɛ nyame; sisei ɔrodwen, anaa oefir edzi, anaa oetu kwan, anaa bi a ɔada, otwar dɛ wonyan no.
Na wɔtseaa mu kɛse, na wɔdze asekan na nkambaa twitwaa hɔnho dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ tse no, kodur dɛ bɔgya sɔɔn hɔn ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wigyinae twaa mu no, wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm araa kodur dɛ ɔrokɔ ewimbir afɔr no bɔber; naaso ndze biara nnyi hɔ, na nyia ɔgye do so nnyi hɔ, na obiara so nnyi hɔ a ɔhwɛ.
Na Elija see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, Hom ntwe mpin me; na ɔman no nyinara twee piin no. Na ɔyɛɛ EWURADZE afɔrmbukyia a ebubu no yie.
Na Elija faa abo duebien, dɛ mbrɛ Jakob ne mba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no dodow tse, ɔno a EWURADZE n’asɛm baa ne nkyɛn dɛ, Israel nye wo dzin no a.
Na ɔdze abo no sii afɔrmbukyia wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin mu; na otwaa ɔka a obedzi aba a wogu etwadze ebien wɔ afɔrmbukyia no ho hyiae.
Na osiesiee nyena no, na otwitwaa nantwisaa no epruw, na wɔdze guu nyena no do. Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mfa nsu nhyehyɛ esuhina anan amaama, na wonhue ngu ɔhyew afɔr, na nyena no do.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nyɛ no mprɛnu; na wɔyɛɛ no mprɛnu. Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nyɛ no mprɛnsa, na wɔyɛɛ no mprɛnsa.
Na nsu no peem afɔrmbukyia no ho hyiae; na ɔdze nsu hyɛɛ ɔka no so ma.

Na ɔbaa dɛ ewimbir afɔr no bɔber mu no, nkɔnhyɛnyi Elija twee pinii, na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, Abraham, Isaak na Israel Nyankopɔn, ndɛ da yi ma wonhu dɛ ɔwoara nye Nyankopɔn wɔ Israel mu, na meyɛ w’akowaa, na mayɛ ndzɛmba yi nyinara wɔ w’asɛm do.
Tsie me, EWURADZE tsie me, ma ɔman yi eehu dɛ ɔwoara, EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn, na ɔwoara adan hɔn akoma asan aba bio.
Nna EWURADZE ne gya dwirii, na ɔbɛhyeew ɔhyew afɔr no, na nyena no, na abo na dɛtse no, na ɔtafeer nsu a ɔwɔ ɔka no mu no.
Na aber a ɔman no nyinara hunii no, wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu: na wɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn; EWURADZE, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn.
Na Elija see hɔn dɛ, Hom nkyer Baal no nkɔnhyɛfo no; mma hom mma hɔn mu kor mpo mmfi nsa. Na wɔkyeer hɔn: na Elija dze hɔn sianee baa ɔwora Kishon ho, na okum hɔn wɔ hɔ.
Na Elija see Ahab dɛ, Fow kɔ, kedzidzi na nom; na matse nsu kɛse nka.
Nna Ahab sii mu kɔr dɛ orikedzidzi na ɔanom. Na Elija sii mu kɔr Karmel n’etsifi; na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ famu, na ɔdze n’enyim hyɛɛ n’anankoroma ntamu.
Na ɔsee n’akowaa dɛ, Afei fow kɔ, kɔhwɛ pomu afamu. Na ɔfowee kɔree kɔhwɛe, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwee nnyi hɔ. Na ɔsee dɛ, Kɔ bio mpɛn esuon.
Na ɔbaa dɛ otsia esuon no, nna ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, mununkum bi fi pomu rosoɛr a osuar dɛ nyimpa ne nsakum. Na ɔsee dɛ, Fow kɔ kɛse Ahab dɛ, Siesie wo tseaseanam, na sian, ma nsu no eennsiw wo kwan.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔkyɛɛr kakraabi no, na mununkum na mframa ebir ɔsor tumm, na nsu kɛse tɔree. Na Ahab tutui kɔr Jezreel.
Na EWURADZE ne nsa baa Elija do; na ɔbɔɔ n’asen do, na otuu mbirika dzii Ahab enyim kodur Jezreel ahɛnee.
Na Ahab kaa dza Elija yɛe no nyinara kyerɛɛ Jezebel, na mbrɛ osii dze afona kum nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara.
Nna Jezebel somaa ɔbɔfo ma ɔkɔr Elija nkyɛn dɛ, Dɛm na enyame no nyɛ me, na bi so nka ho, sɛ ɔkyena sisei na memmaa wo nkwa nnyɛɛ dɛ hɔn mu baako no nkwa a.
Na ohunii no, na no nkwa ntsi, ɔsoɛree sii mu kɔree, na okodur Beer-seba a ɔyɛ Juda dze no, na ogyaa n’akowaa no wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔno noara dze osii mu kɔr sar no do da kor kwan, na ɔkɔree kɛtsenaa ɔsɛsɛ dua bi ase: na ɔserɛe maa noho dɛ nkyɛ onwu; na ɔsee dɛ, Ayɛ yie; afei EWURADZE, yi mo nkwa; na minnye mennsen m’egyanom.
Na ɔdaa famu dae wɔ ɔsɛsɛ dua bi ase; na, hwɛ, ɔbɔfo bi kaa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Soɛr dzidzi.
Na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, tatar a wɔato no wɔ gyansenama do, na nsu kɔɔpow si n’etsifi. Na odzidzii na ɔnomee, na ɔdaa famu bio.
Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no baa bio otsia mpɛn ebien no, bɛkaa no see dɛ, Soɛr dzidzi; na akwantu no war dodow ma wo.
Na ɔsoɛree, dzidzii na ɔnomee, na ɔnantsewee wɔ edziban no n’ahoɔdzen mu kɔr Nyankopɔn ne bepɔw Horeb ho adaduanan, adzekyee na adzesaa.
Na ɔbaa hɔ ɔbo tu bi ho, na ɔsoɛɛ hɔ; na, hwɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, Elija, ereyɛ ebɛnadze wɔ ha?

Na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn ho nyinkun na matwe; osiandɛ Israelmba apow w’ahyɛmu, woedwurudwuruw w’afɔrmbukyia, na wɔdze afona ekuku wo nkɔnhyɛfo: na emi, emi ara nko, na maka; na wɔrohwehwɛ mo so woeeku me.

Na ɔsee dɛ, Pue kɔ, na kegyina bepɔw no do wɔ EWURADZE enyim. Na, hwɛ, EWURADZE botwaa mu, na mframa kɛse dzendzen paapaa mbepɔw mu, na obubuu abotan mu esinesin dzii EWURADZE enyim; naaso nna EWURADZE nnyi mframa no mu: na mframa no ekyir asaasewosow a; na EWURADZE nnyi asaasewosow no mu:
na asaasewosow no ekyir ogya a; na EWURADZE nnyi ogya no mu: na ogya no ekyir ndze bɔkɔɔ bi a.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Elija tsee no, ɔdze n’akatakɔnmu no kataa n’enyim, na opuei kegyinaa ɔbo tu no n’ahɛnee. Na hwɛ, ndze bi baa ne nkyɛn, see dɛ, Elija, ereyɛ ebɛnadze wɔ ha?

Na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn ho nyinkun na matwe; na Israelmba apow w’ahyɛmu, woedwurudwuruw w’afɔrmbukyia, na wɔdze afona ekuku wo nkɔnhyɛfo; na emi, emi ara nko na maka; na wɔrohwehwɛ mo so woeeku me.
Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Kɔ, san fa wo kwan kɔ Damaskɔs sar no do: na sɛ idu a, sera Hazael ngo hyɛ no hen wɔ Siria do:
na sera Nimsi ne babanyin Jehu ngo hyɛ no hen wɔ Israel do: na sera Safat ne babanyin Elisha a ofi Abel-mehola no ngo hyɛ no nkɔnhyɛnyi dzi w’ananmu.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, nyia obefi nsa efi Hazael afona anomu no, Jehu boku no: na nyia obefi nsa efi Jehu afona anomu no Elisha boku no.
Naaso mibegyaa Israel mu mpemesuon ama moho, anankoroma nyinara a wommbui mmaa Baal, na ano biara a ɔmmfeew n’ano.

Nna osii mu fii hɔ kɔree, na okohun Safat ne ba Elisha a ɔdze anantwi mpamho duebien dzi n’enyim rufuntum, na ɔnoara ka dza otsia duebien no ho: na Elija twaa mu kɔr ne nkyɛn na ɔtoow n’akatakɔnmu guu no do.
Na ɔdaan anantwi no gyae, na otuu mbirika dzii Elija ekyir, na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma menkɛfew m’egya na me na ano, na nkyii mimbedzi w’ekyir. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Kɔ bra; na ebɛnadze na medze mayɛ wo?
Na ofii n’ekyir sanee, na ɔkɛfaa anantwi mpamho no, na okum hɔn, na ɔdze anantwi edwumayɛ ndua no noaa nam no, na ɔdze maa nkorɔfo no, na wodzii. Nna ɔsoɛree kedzii Elija ekyir, na ɔsoom no.
Na Siriahen Ben-hadad boaboaa no dɔm nyinara ano: na ahemfo eduasa ebien ka no ho, na mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam: na osii mu kɔree kotuaa Samaria, na ɔnye no koe.
Na ɔsomaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Israelhen Ahab nkyɛn, wɔ kurow no mu, kɛsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ Ben-hadad se nye yi,
Wo dwetɛ na wo sika yɛ medze; wo yernom so na wo mba so a wɔyɛ fɛw no, wɔyɛ me dze.
Na Israelhen no buae see dɛ, Mo wura ɔhen, ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm no tse ara; emi na dza mowɔ nyinara, yɛ wodze.
Na abɔfo no baa bio, bɛsee dɛ, Mbrɛ Ben-hadad ka nye yi, dɛ, Ampa mosomae ma wɔbaa wo nkyɛn, dɛ, Yi wo dwetɛ na wo sika, na wo yernom, na wo mba ma me;
na ɔkyena siseber yi mobɔsoma mo nkowaa wɔ wo nkyɛn, na wɔbɔhwehwɛɛhwɛ wo fie, na wo nkowaa hɔn efiefi; na ɔbɛba dɛ adze biara a ɔyɛ hɔn enyiwa do fɛw no, wɔbɛfa ekitsa hɔn nsamu, na wɔdze akɔ.

Nna Israelhen no frɛɛ asaase no do mpanyimfo no nyinara, na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ hom, hom nhyɛ no nsew, na wɔnhwɛ mbrɛ nyimpa yi esi rohwehwɛ bɔn: osiandɛ ɔsomae ma wɔbaa me nkyɛn bebisaa me yernom, na me mba, na mo dwetɛ, na me sika ho; na mannkam no.
Na mpanyimfo no nyinara na ɔman no nyinara see no dɛ, Mma nntsie, nkyii so mma mmpen.

Dɛm ntsi ɔsee Ben-hadad n’abɔfoe no dɛ, Hom nkɛka nkyerɛ mo wura ɔhen dɛ, Dza ibebisaa no wɔ w’akowaa hɔ asɔpɔn no dze mebɛyɛ: na dɛm adze yi dze merennyɛ. Na abɔfo no sii mu kɔree, na wɔdze asɛm kɛmaa no bio.
Na Ben-hadad somae ma wɔbaa ne nkyɛn, bɛsee dɛ, Enyame no nyɛ me dɛm mma bi so nka ho, sɛ mannsɛɛ Samaria anndan no huntuma a ɔbɔso nkorɔfo a wodzi m’ekyir nyinara nsapuw nsapuw a.
Na Israelhen no buae see dɛ, Hom nkɛka nkyerɛ no dɛ, Mma nyia ogu do roko no nntuw noho dɛ nyia ɔako ewie.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ben-hadad tsee amandzɛɛ yi, wɔ aber a ɔnoara na ahemfo no ronom nsa, wɔ asese mu no, nna ɔsee no nkowaa dɛ, Hom mbaa mpasuar. Na wɔbaa mpasuar wɔ kurow no do.
Na, hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛnyi bi twee piin Israelhen Ahab nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ana ehu nyimpadodow kɛse yi nyinara? Hwɛ, medze hɔn merehyɛ wo nsa ndɛ da yi; na ehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
Na Ahab see dɛ, Ɔnam woana do? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ɔnam amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no do. Nna ɔsee dɛ, Woana na ɔnhyɛ ɔko no ase? Na obuaa dɛ, Ɔwo a.
Na ɔkaan amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no, na wɔyɛ ahaenu eduasa ebien: na hɔn ekyir no ɔman no nyinara, mekyerɛ Israelmba a ɔkanee no nyinara, wɔyɛ mpemesuon.
Na wofir edzi wigyinae. Nna Ben-hadad ronom nsa wɔ asese no mu, ɔno na ahemfo no, ahemfo eduasa ebien a wɔboaboaa no no.
Na amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no dzii kan fiir edzi. Na Ben-hadad somaa akwanserafo na wɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Mbarimba epue fi Samaria reba.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ asomdwee ntsi na woefir edzi a, hom mfa hɔn enyikan; na sɛ ɔko so ntsi na woefir edzi a, hom mfa hɔn enyikan.
Nna amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no dzii kan, na dɔm nkaa no dzii hɔn ekyir fi kurow no mu fiir edzi.
Na hɔn nyinara kunkum hɔn nyimpa biara a wɔnye no koe; na Siriafo no guanguanee, na Israel tsiiw hɔn: na Siriahen Ben-hadad tse pɔnkɔ do nye mpɔnkɔdofo no fii nsa guanee.
Na Israelhen no fiir edzi kokunkum mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam no, na ɔdze oku kɛse kum Siriafo.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi no twee piin Israelhen no na ɔsee no dɛ, Kɔ kɛhyɛ woho dzen, na hyɛ no nsew, na hwɛ dza ereyɛ: osiandɛ afedan no Siriahen no bɔfow aba wo do.
Na Siriahen no no nkowaa see no dɛ, Hɔn nyame yɛ akoko do nyame; dɛm ntsi na hɔn ho yɛ dzen kyɛn hɛn no: na ma yɛnye hɔn nkɔko wɔ tɛtɛr mu, ampaara nkyɛ hɛn ho bɛyɛ dzen asen hɔn.
Na iyi na yɛ; yiyi ahemfo no fi hɔ, nyimpa biara mfi ne tsenabew, na fa asafohemfo hyehyɛ hɔn ananmu;

na kan dɔm a ɔtse dɛ dɔm a ahwer hɔn no ma woho, ɔpɔnkɔ nhyɛ ɔpɔnkɔ ananmu, na tseaseanam nhyɛ tseaseanam ananmu: na yɛnye hɔn bɔko wɔ tɛtɛr mu na ampaara hɛn ho bɛyɛ dzen asen hɔn. Na otsiee hɔn ndze, na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
Na ɔbaa dɛ afedan no mu, Ben-hadad kɛkaan Siriafo no, na osii mu kɔr Afek, dɛ ɔnye Israel rokɔko.
Na wɔkaan Israelmba no so, na wosiesiee hɔnho na wosii mu kɔree kehyiaa hɔn: na Israelmba no kyeer nsera wɔ hɔn enyim tse dɛ mpɔnkyemba ekuw nkakraba ebien; na Siriafo no dze wɔhyɛɛ ɔman no ma.

Na Nyame nyimpa bi twee pinii bɛkaa kyerɛɛ Israelhen no see dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Osiandɛ Siriafo no ase dɛ, EWURADZE yɛ akoko do nyame, na ɔnnyɛ ɔbɔn mu nyame no; dɛm ntsi mibeyi nyimpadodow kɛse yi nyinara mahyɛ wo nsa, na hom ehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
Na wɔkyekyeer nsera, ɔbaako wɔ ɔbaako so ne tsentsendo nda esuon. Na ɔbaa dɛ, da a otsia esuon no wɔdze ɔko no kɔbɔɔ enyim; na Israelmba no kum Siriafo no mu anamɔnmufo mpemɔha da kor mu.
Na nkaa no guanguanee kɔr Afek kurow no mu; na ɔfasu no bui guu nyimpa mpemeduonu esuon a wɔkae no do. Na Ben-hadad guanee, na ɔkɔr kurow no mu, mpiakyir mpia mu.

Na no nkowaa see no dɛ, Hwɛ, afei yɛatse dɛ Israel fie ahemfo no wɔyɛ ahemfo mbɔbɔrhufo: yɛserɛ wo, ma yɛmfa eyitam nkyekyer hɛn asen, na ntampehoma mbobɔ hɛn etsir, na yemfir edzi nkɔ Israelhen nkyɛn: gyangyanbiara ɔbɛgye wo kra nkwa.

Nna wɔdze eyitam kyekyeer hɔn asen, na wɔdze ntampehoma bobɔɔ hɔn etsir, na wɔbaa Israelhen no nkyɛn, bɛsee dɛ, W’akowaa Ben-hadad se dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma mentsena ase. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ana ɔda ho tse ase? Ɔyɛ mo nua.

Afei mbarimba no hyɛɛ no nsew yie, na wɔyɛɛ ntsɛm dɛ wɔregye no dɛ ɔyɛ n’adwen; na wɔsee dɛ, Wo nua Ben-hadad a. Nna ɔsee dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɛfa no mbra. Nna Ben-hadad fiir edzi baa ne nkyɛn; na ɔmaa ɔfowee baa tseaseanam no mu.

Na Ben-hadad see no dɛ, Nkurow a m’egya gyee no wɔ w’egya nsamu no mebɛdan mama; na tsetsew abrɔn ma woho wɔ Damaskɔs, dɛ mbrɛ m’egya yɛe wɔ Samaria no. Na Ahab see dɛ, Emi so medze ahyɛmu yi mibegyaa wo ma akɔ. Nna ɔnye no dzii ahyɛmu, na ogyaa no ma ɔkɔree.
Na ɔbarimba bi a ofi nkɔnhyɛfomba no mu nam EWURADZE n’asɛm do see ne nyɛnko dɛ, Meserɛ wo, bɔ me. Na nyimpa no poow dɛ ɔbɔbɔ no.
Nna ɔsee no dɛ, Osiandɛ enntsie EWURADZE ne ndze ntsi, hwɛ, ifi me nkyɛn isi mu rokɔ ara a, gyata boku wo. Na ofii ne nkyɛn sii mu rokɔ ara, nna gyata hun no, na okum no.
Nna ohun nyimpa fofor so, na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo bɔ me. Na nyimpa no bɔɔ no, ɔbɔɔ no piraa no.
Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi no sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɔtweɔɔn ɔhen no wɔ ɔkwan no mu, na ɔdze n’abɔtsir kyekyeer n’enyim sakyeer noho.

Na aber a ɔhen no rutwa mu no, ɔkaa mu frɛɛ ɔhen no na ɔsee dɛ, W’akowaa fiir edzi kɔr ɔko no ne finimfin; na, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi danee faa nkyɛn, na ɔdze nyimpa bi brɛɛ me, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ nyimpa yi do: sɛ ɔnam kwan biara do ma ɔyera a, ɔnodze wɔdze wo nkwa bɛhyɛ no nkwa ananmu, anaaso ibotua dwetɛ dwetɛbona kor.
Na aber a w’akowaa reyɛ adze wɔ ha na n’enyi nnyi no do no, nna nkɔhwɛ a, ɔkɔ. Na Israelhen no see no dɛ, Mbrɛ w’atsɛmbua nyɛ nye no, ɔwoara ebua.
Na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm yii abɔtsir no wɔ n’enyiwa do; na Israelhen no hun no dɛ ofi nkɔnhyɛfo no mu.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Osiandɛ egyaa nyimpa a mehyira no do ama ɔsɛɛ no ma oefi wo nsa kɔr no, dɛm ntsi wo nkwa bɛhyɛ no nkwa ananmu, na wo man ahyɛ ne man ananmu.
Na Israelhen no sii mu kɔr ne fie dɛ ɔayɛ kusuu na no bo efuw, na ɔbaa Samaria.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nsɛm yi ekyir no, na Jezreelnyi Nabot wɔ wenyin ture bi wɔ Jezreel, wɔ Samariahen Ahab n’ahemfi ho papaapa.

Na Ahab kaa kyerɛɛ Nabot dɛ, Fa wo wenyin ture no ma me, ma memfa menyɛ fan ture, osiandɛ ɔbɛn me fi ho; na mebɛma wo wenyin ture a oye sen no mahyɛ ananmu: anaa, sɛ obeye ama wo a, medze mbrɛ odzi no mebɛma wo wɔ sika mu.
Na Nabot see Ahab dɛ, EWURADZE mma ɔmpar me dɛ, medze m’egyanom hɔn egyapadze mebɛma wo.

Na Ahab baa ne fie dɛ ɔayɛ kusuu na no bo efuw osian asɛm a Jezreelnyi Nabot ɔaka akyerɛ no no ntsi: na ɔsee no dɛ, Meremmfa m’egyanom egyapadze memma wo. Na ɔdaa ne mpa do, na ɔdaan n’enyim kɔr ban ho, na ɔammpɛ dɛ odzidzi.
Na ne yer Jezebel baa ne nkyɛn, na obisaa no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo sunsum abɔm dɛm, na inndzidzi yi?

Na ɔsee no dɛ, Osiandɛ mekasaa kyerɛɛ Jezreelnyi Nabot, na mesee no dɛ, Fa wo wenyin ture no ma me gye sika; anaaso, sɛ epɛ a, mebɛma wo wenyin ture fofor mahyɛ ananmu: na obuaa dɛ, Meremmfa mo wenyin ture memma wo.
Na ne yer Jezebel see no dɛ, Ana nnyɛ ɔwo na ehwɛ Israel ahendzi do a? Soɛr dzidzi, na ma w’akoma ntɔ wo yamu: medze Jezreelnyi Nabot no wenyin ture no mebɛma wo.
Nna ɔdze Ahab ne dzin kyerɛkyerɛɛw nwoma, na ɔdze no nsɔwano dze sosɔɔw ano, na ɔsomasomae ma wɔdze nwoma no kɛmaa mpanyimfo no na ekunyin a wɔwɔ no kurow mu a wɔnye Nabot tse no.
Na ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma no mu dɛ, Hom mbɔ dawur ma wondzi mbuada, na wɔmfa Nabot ndzi tsir wɔ nkorɔfo no mu:
na wɔmfa nyimpa beenu a wɔyɛ asansafo, ngyina n’enyim, na wɔmma wondzi dase ntsia no, dɛ, Ɔwo adom Nyankopɔn na ɔhen. Na nkyii hom mfa no mpue nkesiw no abo ma onwu.

Na no kurow no mu mbarimba no, mekyerɛ mpanyimfo na ekunyin no a wɔtse no kurow no mu no, yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Jezebel somae ma wɔdze kɛmaa hɔn no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma a ɔsomae ma wɔdze kɛmaa hɔn no mu no.
Wɔbɔɔ dawur dɛ wondzi mbuada, na wɔdze Nabot dzii tsir wɔ nkorɔfo no mu.

Na nyimpa beenu no, asansafo no, bae bɛtsenaa n’enyim: na asansafo no dzii dase tsiaa no, mekyerɛ wɔdze tsiaa Nabot, wɔ ɔman no enyim, dɛ, Nabot adom Nyankopɔn na ɔhen. Nna wɔfaa no fii kurow no mu puei, na wokesiiw no abo ma owui.
Nna wɔsomae ma wɔkɔr Jezebel nkyɛn, dɛ, Woesiw Nabot abo, na oewu.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jezebel tsee dɛ woesiw Nabot abo ma oewu no, nna Jezebel see Ahab dɛ, Soɛr, kɛfa Jezreelnyi Nabot no wenyin ture no a ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔdze bɛma wo agye sika no yɛ enyadze; na Nabot nntse ase bio, na oewu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab tsee dɛ Nabot ewu no, nna Ahab soɛree dɛ orisian akɔ Jezreelnyi Nabot no wenyin ture no mu ɔakɛfa ayɛ enyadze.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Tisbinyi Elija nkyɛn, dɛ,
Soɛr, sian kɔ nye Israelhen Ahab a ɔtse Samaria no nkedzi ehyia: hwɛ, ɔwɔ Nabot no wenyin ture no mu, hɔ na oesian kɔ dɛ ɔrekɛfa ayɛ enyadze.

Na ka kyerɛ no, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ana eku, na eso afa ayɛ enyadze? Na ka kyerɛ no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Beebi mbrɛ nkraman tafeer Nabot no bɔgyaa no hɔ na nkraman bɛtafer ɔwo so wo bɔgyaa.
Na Ahab see Elija dɛ, Me tamfo, ana ehu me? Na obuaa dɛ, Mehu wo: osiandɛ atɔn woho dɛ ereyɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do.
Hwɛ, medze mbusu mebɛba wo do, na mapra wo kwakwaakwa, na metwa Ahab mu abofra banyin biara akyen, na Israel mu nyia wɔatow no mu na nyia woegyaa no:
na mebɛyɛ wo fi dɛ Nebat ne ba Jeroboam ne fi, na Ahija ne ba Baasa ne fi, wɔ ebufuw a edze eyi me na ama Israel ayɛ bɔn ntsi.
Na wɔ Jezebel ho so EWURADZE kaa dɛ, Nkraman bedzi Jezebel wɔ Jezreel afasu ho.
Nyia ofi Ahab mu a obowu wɔ kurow mu no, nkraman bedzi; na nyia obowu wɔ haban mu no wimu ntumbowa bedzi.
(Naaso obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ Ahab a ne yer Jezebel hyɛɛ no nkuran ma ɔtɔɔn noho dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do.
Na ɔyɛɛ ekyiwadze dodow dɛ odzii abosom ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ Amorifo a EWURADZE tuu hɔn wɔ Israelmba enyim yɛe no nyinara.)
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab tsee nsɛm no, ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔdze eyitam kataa noho na odzii mbuada, na ɔdaa eyitam mu, na otsiaa dɔndɔn kɔree.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Tisbinyi Elija nkyɛn, dɛ,
Ana ehu mbrɛ Ahab esi na ɔabrɛ noho adze wɔ m’enyim a? Osiandɛ ɔabrɛ noho adze wɔ m’enyim ntsi, meremmfa mbusu no memmba wɔ ne nda mu: na ne ba ne nda mu na medze mbusu no mebɛba ne fi do.
Na Siria na Israel tsenaa hɔ mfe ebiasa a ɔko bi nnyi hɔn ntamu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia ebiasa no mu no, Judahen Jehosafat sianee baa Israelhen do.
Na Israelhen no see no nkowaa dɛ, Ana hom nyim dɛ Ramot-gilead yɛ hɛndze, na yɛayɛ komm na yɛnngye mmfi Siriahen no nsamu yi?
Na ɔsee Jehosafat dɛ, Ana enye me bɔkɔ Ramot-gilead akɔko a? Na Jehosafat see Israelhen no dɛ, Metse dɛ woara, me man tse dɛ wo man, mo mpɔnkɔ tse dɛ wo mpɔnkɔ.
Na Jehosafat see Israelhen no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, bisa EWURADZE n’asɛm ndɛ.
Nna Israelhen no boaboaa nkɔnhyɛfo no ano, mbarimba bɛyɛ ahaanan, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana monkɔ Ramot-gilead nkɔko, anaa mingyaa? Na wɔsee dɛ, Fow kɔ; na EWURADZE dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen nsa.
Na Jehosafat see dɛ, Ana EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛnyi bi so nnyi ha, ma yeebebisa no hɔ adze?

Na Israelhen no see Jehosafat dɛ, Ɔbarimba baako bi da ho wɔ ha a nkyɛ yɛnam no do bebisa EWURADZE hɔ adze, Imla ne ba Mikaia a: na mikyir no; osiandɛ ɔnnhyɛ mo ho nkɔm pa, na bɔn nko. Na Jehosafat see dɛ, Mma mma ɔhen nnse dɛm.
Nna Israelhen no frɛɛ ɔsafohen bi, na ɔsee dɛ, Kɛfa Imla ne ba Mikaia bra ntsɛmara.
Afei Israelhen na Juda hen Jehosafat tsetse hɔn nhengua do nkorkor, hyehyɛ hɔn ahentar, wɔ Samaria kuropon ahɛnee gua do; na nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara rehyɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔn enyim.
Na Kenaana ne ba Zedekia yɛɛ dadze mmbɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Iyinom na edze bosun Siriafo no ara ma wɔahyew.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara hyɛɛ nkɔm dɛm, dɛ, Fow kɔ Ramot-gilead na kɛyɛ yie: na EWURADZE dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen nsa.
Na ɔbɔfo no a ɔkɔr dɛ ɔrekɛfrɛ Mikaia no kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Afei hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛfo no dze ano kor ka nsɛm pa kyerɛ ɔhen: Meserɛ wo, ma w’asɛm nyɛ dɛ hɔn mu baako n’asɛm, na ka dɛ oye.
Na Mikaia see dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase yi, dza EWURADZE bɛse me no, ɔno na mebɛka.
Na aber a ɔbaa ɔhen no nkyɛn no, ɔhen no see no dɛ, Mikaia, ana yɛnkɔ Ramot-gilead nkɔko, anaa yenngyaa? Na obuaa dɛ, Fow kɔ na kɛyɛ yie; na EWURADZE dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen nsa.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Mpɛn ahen ara na menka ntam ngu wo do ma ka dza ɔyɛ nokwar nko wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin mu kyerɛ me?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Muhun Israel nyinara dɛ wɔapetse mbepɔw do, dɛ nguan a wonnyi oguanhwɛfo: na EWURADZE see dɛ, Iyinom wonnyi wura; ma wɔnsan, nyimpa biara nkɔ ne fie asomdwee mu.
Na Israelhen no see Jehosafat dɛ, Ana mannka annkyerɛ wo dɛ, Ɔnnkɛhyɛ mo ho nkɔm pa, dɛ bɔn nko?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm ntsi tsie EWURADZE n’asɛm: Muhun EWURADZE dɛ ɔtse n’ahengua do, na ɔsor dɔm nyinara gyinagyina no ho wɔ n’enyimfa na n’abankum.
Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Woana na ɔbɛdaadaa Ahab, ma ɔaafow akɔ akɔtɔr wɔ Ramot-gilead? Na obi see dɛm; na obi so see dɛm.
Na sunsum bi fiir edzi begyinaa EWURADZE enyim na ɔsee dɛ, Mara mebɛdaadaa no.
Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Edze ebɛnadze? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mibefir edzi, na makɛyɛ sunsum torfo wɔ no nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara anomu. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔwo bɛdaadaa no, na ibedzi nyim so: fir edzi kɔ, na kɛyɛ dɛm.
Dɛm ntsi afei, hwɛ, EWURADZE dze sunsum torfo ahyɛ wo nkɔnhyɛfo yi nyinara anomu; na EWURADZE akasa wo ho bɔn.
Nna Kenaana ne ba Zedekia twee pinii, na ɔbɔɔ Mikaia sotɔr see dɛ, Ebɛn kwan do na EWURADZE no sunsum fii me nkyɛn bɛkaa iyi kyerɛɛ wo?
Na Mikaia see dɛ, Hwɛ da no a ebɔkɔ mpiakyir pia mu dɛ irukosuma woho no na ibohu.
Na Israelhen no see dɛ, Fa Mikaia, na fa no san kɔ kɛma kurow no mu ambrado Amon, na ɔhen ne ba Joas;
na se dɛ, Mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, Hom mfa akowaa yi nto efiadze, na hom mfa ahohiahia edziban na ahohiahia nsu mbɔ no akɔhoma, ma onkodu dɛ mebɛba no asomdwee mu.
Na Mikaia see dɛ, Sɛ ɔwoara esan ba no asomdwee mu ara dze a, nna nnyɛ EWURADZE na ɔnam mo do akasa. Na ɔsee dɛ, Aman, hom nyinara hom ntsie.
Nna Israelhen na Judahen Jehosafat sii mu kɔr Ramot-gilead.
Na Israelhen no see Jehosafat dɛ, Mebɛsakyer moho na makɔ ɔko no mu; na ɔwo dze hyɛ wo ntar. Na Israelhen no sakyeer noho na ɔkɔr ɔko no mu.
Afei Siriahen no ahyɛ ne tseaseanam do asafohemfo eduasa ebien no dɛ, Mma hom nnye kakraba anaa kɛse nnko, gyedɛ Israelhen no nkotsee.
Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no hun Jehosafat no, nna wɔsee dɛ, Ampa, Israelhen no nye no; na wɔdaan hɔnho dɛ wɔnye no rokɔko: na Jehosafat kekaa mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no hun dɛ nnyɛ Israelhen nye no no, nna wogyaa no tsiw saan hɔn ekyir.
Na ɔbarimba bi twee n’egyen mu ntɔgon mu ara, na ɔdze bɔɔ Israelhen no wɔ mbɔtoa mu na akatabo no ntamu: dɛm ntsi ɔsee ne tseaseanamkanyi no dɛ, Dan wo nsa, na fa me fi dɔm yi mu; na mepira dzendzen.
Na ɔko no mu yɛɛ dzen da no: na wosuoo ɔhen no mu gyinaa ne tseaseanam mu wɔ Siriafo enyim, na ɔtɔɔr ewimbir: na bɔgya fi epirakur no mu pemee kɔr tseaseanam no ase.
Na nkekamu bi faa dɔm no mu witɔree ber no, dɛ, Nyimpa biara nkɔ no kurow mu, na nyimpa biara nkɔ ne man mu.
Nna ɔhen no wui, na wɔdze no baa Samaria; na wosiee ɔhen no wɔ Samaria.
Na wɔkɔhohoor tseaseanam no mu wɔ Samaria nsutaae ho; na nkraman tafeer no bɔgyaa; (afei mbaa ehuhufo hohor hɔnho wɔ hɔ;) dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔkae no tse no.
Afei Ahab no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na asombɛn dan a osii, na nkurow a ɔkyekyeree nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Ahab kɔr ne nsamankyir; na ne babanyin Ahazia dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Na Israelhen Ahab n’afe a otsia anan no mu na Asa ne ba Jehosafat hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Juda do.
Jehosafat dzii mfe eduasa enum no nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen; na odzii hen mfe eduonu enum wɔ Jerusalɛm. Na ne na ne dzin dze Azuba, Silhi ne babaa a.

Na ɔnantseew n’egya Asa kwan no nyinara do; ɔanndan emmfi ho, dɛ ɔyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do: naaso oennyi mbea sorɔnsorɔm no emmfi hɔ; ɔman no daa ho bɔɔ afɔr na wɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm no.
Na nsiesie baa Jehosafat nye Israelhen no ntamu.
Afei Jehosafat no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na ne mbanyinndam a ɔkyerɛe, na mbrɛ osii dzii ako no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
Na sodomfo nkaa a wɔkae wɔ n’egya Asa nda no mu no, otuu hɔn fii asaase no do.
Nna ɔhen bi nnyi Edom: na ahyɛnanmu bi na odzi hen.
Jehosafat yɛɛ Tarsis ahɛn dɛ wɔnkɔ Ofir nkɛfa sika: na wɔannkɔ, osiandɛ ahɛn no bobɔe wɔ Ezion-geber.
Nna Ahab ne ba Ahazia see Jehosafat dɛ, Ma mo nkowaa nka wo nkowaa ho nkɔ ahɛn no mu. Na Jehosafat ammpen.
Na Jehosafat kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no kaa n’egyanom ho wɔ n’egya David kurow mu: na ne babanyin Jehoram dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
Judahen Jehosafat n’afe a otsia duesuon no mu na Ahab ne ba Ahazia hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel, na odzii hen mfe ebien wɔ Israel do.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na ɔnantseew n’egya no kwan no do, na ne na no kwan do, na Nebat ne ba Jeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no, no kwan do.
Na ɔsoom Baal, na ɔsɔɔr no, na oyii EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ebufuw, dɛ mbrɛ dza n’egya yɛe no nyinara tse.
Na Ahab no wu ekyir no Moab tseew etua wɔ Israel do.
Na Ahazia nam n’abansor pia a ɔwɔ Samaria n’atenatokura mu bɔhwee famu, na ɔyaree: na otuu abɔfo, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ, wonkebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub no kyerɛ dɛ mobɔbɔ esu wɔ yarba yi mu a.

Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see Tisbinyi Elija dɛ, Soɛr, fow kɔ kehyia Samariahen n’abɔfoe no, na se hɔn dɛ, Ana osiandɛ Nyankopɔn bi nnyi Israel ntsi, na hom rokɔ ekebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub no hɔ adze yi?
Dɛm ntsi afei mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mpa no a afow no rimmfi do nnsian, na owu ara na ibowu. Na Elija sii mu kɔree.
Na abɔfo no sanee baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom asan yi?

Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ɔbarimba bi fowee behyiaa hɛn, na ɔsee hɛn dɛ, Hom nsan nkɔ ɔhen a ɔsomaa hom no nkyɛn bio, na wɔnse no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ana osiandɛ Nyankopɔn bi nnyi Israel ntsi, na asoma dɛ wonkebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub no hɔ adze yi? Dɛm ntsi mpa no a afow no irimmfi do nnsian famu, na owu ara na ibowu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔbarimba a ɔfowee bae behyiaa hom na ɔkaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ hom no tse dɛn?
Na wobuaa no dɛ, ɔyɛ nyimpa a no ho yɛ nhwi nhwi, na nwoma abɔdo bɔ n’asen. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Tisbinyi Elija a.
Nna ɔhen no somaa eduonum do safohen nye n’eduonum no wɔ no hɔ. Na ɔfowee kɔr ne nkyɛn: na, hwɛ, ɔtse koko no n’etsifi. Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, Nyame nyimpa, ɔhen se dɛ, Sian bra.
Na Elija buae see eduonum do ɔsafohen no dɛ, Sɛ Nyame nyimpa nye me a, ogya mfi sor nsian mbɛhyew ɔwo na w’eduonum no. Na ogya fi sor sianee bɛhyeew ɔno na n’eduonum no.
Na ɔsomaa eduonum do safohen fofor so nye n’eduonum wɔ no hɔ bio. Na obuae see no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa, mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, Yɛ ntsɛm sian bra.
Na Elija buae see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ Nyame nyimpa nye me a, ogya mfi sor nsian mbɛhyew ɔwo na w’eduonum no. Na Nyame gya fi sor sianee bɛhyeew ɔno na n’eduonum no.

Na bio ɔsomaa eduonum do safohen a otsia ebiasa nye n’eduonum bio. Na eduonum do ɔsafohen a otsia ebiasa no fowee kɔree, na ɔkɔkotoow n’anankoroma enyim wɔ Elija n’enyim, paa no kyɛw, na ɔsee no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa, meserɛ wo, ma mo nkwa, na wo nkowaa eduonum yi hɔn nkwa nsom bo wɔ w’enyi do.
Hwɛ, ogya fi sor sianee bɛhyeew nkan no eduonum do asafohemfo beenu no nye hɔn eduonum eduonum no: na afei ma mo nkwa nsom bo wɔ w’enyi do.
Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see Elija dɛ, Enye no nsian nkɔ: mma nnsuro no. Na ɔsoɛree, na ɔnye no sianee kɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn.

Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Susuampa dɛ ɔwo asoma abɔfo dɛ wonkebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub hɔ adze no, nna siantsir nye dɛ Nyankopɔn bi nnyi Israel a wokebisa n’asɛm bi a? Dɛm ntsi mpa no a afow no irimmfi do nnsian, na owu ara na ibowu.
Nna owui dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm no a Elija kae no tse. Na osiandɛ onnyi ba ntsi, Joram hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu wɔ Judahen Jehosafat ne ba Jehoram n’afe a otsia ebien no mu.
Afei Ahazia no ho nsɛm nkaa no, dza ɔyɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu a?
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a EWURADZE rebɛfa Elija ehum mu akɔ sor no, Elija nye Elisha fi Gilgal sii mu kɔree.
Na Elija see Elisha dɛ, Meserɛ wo, tsintsim ha; na EWURADZE asoma me wɔ Bɛtɛl. Na Elisha see dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, mirinngya wo hɔ. Na wosii mu kɔr Bɛtɛl.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo mba a wɔwɔ Bɛtɛl no fiir edzi baa Elisha nkyɛn bebisaa no dɛ, Ana inyim dɛ ndɛ EWURADZE rebɛfa wo wura efi wo tsir do akɔ a? Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyew, minyim; hom nyɛ komm.
Na Elija see no dɛ, Elisha, Meserɛ wo, tsintsim ha; na EWURADZE asoma me Jeriko. Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, mirinngya wo hɔ. Nna wɔbaa Jeriko.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo mba a wɔwɔ Jeriko no twee piin Elisha nkyɛn bebisaa no dɛ, Ana inyim dɛ ndɛ EWURADZE rebɛfa wo wura efi wo tsir do akɔ a? Na obuaa dɛ, Nyew, minyim; hom nyɛ komm.
Na Elija see no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, tsintsim ha; na EWURADZE asoma me Jordan do. Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, mirinngya wo hɔ. Na hɔn beenu no sii mu kɔree.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo mba no mu nyimpa eduonum sii mu kɔree kegyinagyinaa hɔn tsentsendo wɔ ekyirekyir: nna hɔn beenu no gyina Jordan ho.
Na Elija faa n’egukɔnmu no, na ɔbobɔwee dze bɔɔ nsu no mu, na ɔpaae kɔr ha na ha, na hɔn beenu no nam asaase kɛsɛɛ do twae.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wotwae no, Elija see Elisha dɛ, Bisa dza menyɛ memma wo, ansaana wɔafa me efi wo nkyɛn akɔ. Na Elisha see dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma wo sunsum kyɛfa mbɔho mbra mo do.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebisa adze a ɔyɛ dzen: naaso sɛ ihu me aber a wɔrefa me efi wo nkyɛn a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛm ama wo; na sɛ annyɛ dɛm a, ɔnnkɛba dɛm.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔda ho ara nam rokɔ, na wɔrekasa no, hwɛ, ogya tseaseanam, na ogya mpɔnkɔ a ɔbɛpaa hɔn beenu nyina ntamu no puei; na Elija nam ehum mu fowee kɔr sor.
Na Elisha hunii, na ɔtseatseaa mu dɛ, M’egya e, m’egya e, Israel ntseaseanam na no mpɔnkɔdofo e! Na oennhu no bio: na osuoo nankasa ne ntar mu, na ɔtsetseew mu esinesin ebien.
Ɔfaa Elija n’egukɔnmu no a ofi no ho gui no so, na ɔsaan n’ekyir begyinaa Jordan nsukɔn do.
Na ɔfaa Elija n’egukɔnmu a ofi no ho gui no, dze bɔɔ nsu no mu, see dɛ, Na EWURADZE, Elija Nyankopɔn no wɔ hen? Na aber a ɔno so bɔɔ nsu no mu no, na ɔpaae kɔr ha na ha: na Elisa twae.
Na aber a nkɔnhyɛfo mba a wɔwɔ Jeriko wɔ ne tsentsendo hun no no, wɔsee dɛ, Elija no sunsum edwir Elisha do. Na wɔbae behyiaa no, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze butuuw famu wɔ n’enyim.

Na wɔsee Elisha dɛ, Afei, hwɛ, mbarimba a wɔyɛ dzen eduonum wɔ wo nkowaa nkyɛn; yɛserɛ wo, ma wɔnkɔ nkɔhwehwɛ wo wura: bɛyɛ na bi a EWURADZE no sunsum no ama no do kɔ dze no akɔto bepɔw bi do, anaa ɔbɔn bi mu. Na ɔsee dɛ, Mma hom nnsoma.
Na aber a wɔhyɛɛ no ara ma ɔyɛɛ no ahomtsew no, ɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoma ɛ. Dɛm ntsi wɔsomaa mbarimba eduonum; na wɔkɔhwehwɛe ara ndaansa, naaso woennhu no.
Na wɔsanee baa ne nkyɛn, mber a otsintsimii wɔ Jeriko no; na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana mannse hom dɛ, Mma hom nnkɔ?
Na kurow no mu mbarimba no see Elisha dɛ, Hwɛ, yɛserɛ wo, kurow yi ne dabea yɛ fɛw, dɛ mbrɛ mo wura hu yi: na nsu no dze onnye, na asaase no so pon mba.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mbrɛ me pɔr fofor, na wɔmfa nkyen ngu mu. Na wɔdze brɛɛ no.
Na ofiir edzi kɔr nsu no no nsunyiwa no ho, na ɔtoow nkyen guu mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Masa nsu yi yarba; owu anaa mbapon bi rimmfi mu mmba bio.
Nna wɔsaa nsu no yarba dze bodu ndɛ da yi, dɛ Elisha n’asɛm a ɔkae no ara.
Na ofii hɔ sii mu kɔr Bɛtɛl: na aber a ɔnam kwan no do rofow akɔ no, mbofra nkakraba fi kurow no mu puei besii no atwetwe see no dɛ, Fow ɛ, otsipaa; fow ɛ, otsipaa.
Na ɔhwɛɛ n’ekyir na ohun hɔn, na ɔdze EWURADZE ne dzin paa hɔn. Na nsisiber beenu fi kwaa no mu bae bɛtsetseew hɔn mu mbofra eduanan ebien.
Na ofii hɔ kɔr bepɔw Karmel do, na ofii hɔ so sanee kɔr Samaria.
Afei Judahen Jehosafat n’afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu na Ahab ne ba Joram hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe duebien.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do; naaso ɔnntse dɛ n’egya, na ɔnntse dɛ ne na: osiandɛ oyii Baal n’edum no a n’egya yɛe no wɔ hɔ.
Mbom ɔdze noho bataa Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho; na oemmfi ho emmfi.
Afei Moabhen Mesha yɛ nguannyɛmfo; nna ɔma Israelhen no nguambaa mpem ɔha ho nhwi, na nguannyin mpem ɔha ho nhwi.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab wui no, na Moabhen no tseew etua wɔ Israelhen no do.
Na no mu no ɔhen Jehoram fiir edzi fii Samaria, na ɔkɛkaan Israel nyinara.

Na ɔkɔree kɔsomae ma wɔkɔr Judahen Jehosafat nkyɛn, dɛ, Moabhen no atsew mo do etua: ana enye me bɔkɔ enye Moab akɔko a? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mobɔkɔ: metse dɛ ɔwoara, me man tse dɛ wo man, mo mpɔnkɔ tse dɛ wo mpɔnkɔ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔkwan bɛn do na yɛbɛfa akɔ? Na obuaa dɛ, Edom sar no do kwan no do a.
Nna Israelhen, na Judahen, na Edomhen no sii mu kɔree: na wokyiin nda esuon kwan: nna nsu bi nnyi hɔ mma dɔm no, na eso mbowa a wodzi hɔn ekyir no.
Na Israelhen no see dɛ, Annyɛ yie! EWURADZE afrɛ ahemfo baasa yi ehyia dɛ oriyi hɛn akɛhyɛ Moab nsa.

Na Jehosafat see dɛ, Ana EWURADZE nkɔnhyɛnyi bi nnyi ha a yebodua no do ebisa EWURADZE hɔ adze? Na Israelhen no no nkowaa no mu baako buae see dɛ, Safat ne ba Elisha a ohuee nsu guu Elija ne nsa do no, na ɔwɔ ha.
Na Jehosafat see dɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm wɔ ne nkyɛn. Nna Israelhen na Jehosafat na Edomhen no sianee kɔr ne nkyɛn.

Na Elisha see Israelhen no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menye wo wɔ yɛ? Kɔ w’egya no nkɔnhyɛfo no, na wo na no nkɔnhyɛfo no nkyɛn. Na Israelhen no see no dɛ, Dabida: osiandɛ EWURADZE afrɛ ahemfo baasa yi ehyia dɛ oriyi hɛn akɛhyɛ Moab nsa.
Na Elisha see dɛ, Dɛ dɔm EWURADZE a migyina n’enyim yi tse ase yi, ampa, sɛ nnyɛ Judahen Jehosafat n’enyim na mohwɛ a, nkyɛ merennkyea m’enyi wɔ wo do, na eso moronnhwɛ wo.
Na afei hom mfa ɔsankubɔfo mbrɛ me. Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔsankubɔfo no robɔ no, nna EWURADZE ne nsa baa no do.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom nyɛ ɔbɔn yi amona amona.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom runnhu mframa, nkyii so hom runnhu nyankom, naaso nsu bɛhyɛ ɔbɔn no ma: na hom anom, hom na hom fiembowa na hom adzesoa mbowa.
Na iyi so yɛ EWURADZE enyi do adze tootooba: obeyi Moabfo no so ahyɛ hom nsa.
Na hom mbɔ kurow biara a wɔagye ho ban, na kurow biara a ɔyɛ fɛw, na wɔntow dua pa biara, na wonsisiw nsunyiwa nyinara, na hom mfa abo nsɛɛ asaase no tɔw pa biara.
Na ɔbaa dɛ anapa, bɛyɛ afɔrbɔber no, na, hwɛ, nsu fii Edom kwan do bae, na nsu hyɛɛ ɔman no ma.
Afei aber a Moabfo nyinara tsee dɛ ahemfo no wɔafow aba dɛ wɔnye hɔn robɔko no, wɔpoon hɔnho boaa ano, hɔn a wobotum emia akodze nyinara, na hɔn a wɔbor dɛm, na wobegyinaa ɔhe do.
Na wɔsoɛɛr anapaatu, na ewia gyegyee nsu no do, na Moabfo no hun nsu no wɔ hɔn enyim tsentsendo dɛ ɔber dɛ bɔgya:
na wɔsee dɛ, Iyi bɔgya a; ampa ahemfo no nye hɔn edzi dɔmpata, na woekuku hɔnho: dɛm ntsi afei, Moab, hom nkɔ asadze no ho ɛ.
Na aber a wodur Israel nseraban ho no, Israelfo no soɛree kunkum Moabfo no, ma woguanee wɔ hɔn enyim: na wɔhoom do kɔr kan wɔ asaase no mu dɛ worukuku Moabfo no.

Na wodwuruuw nkurow no; na nyimpa biara toow no bo kyeen asaasetɔw pa biara do hyɛɛ no ma; na wosisiiw nsunyiwa biara, na wotwitwaa ndua pa no nyinara: kyerɛ Kir-hareset nko na wogyaa n’abo; naaso tsiabotofo no kotwaa ho hyiae, na wɔbɔɔ no.
Na aber a Moabhen hun dɛ ɔko no mu ayɛ dzen dodow ama no no, ɔfaa mbarimba ahaesuon a wɔtwe mfona kaa noho, dɛ ɔretsew mu akɔ Edomhen no nkyɛn: na woenntum.
Nna ɔfaa ne ba panyin a nkyɛ obedzi hen wɔ n’ananmu no, na ɔdze no bɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ fasu no do. Na hu kɛsenara tɔɔ Israel do: na wofii ne nkyɛn kɔree, na wɔsanee baa hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do.
Afei nkɔnhyɛfo mba yernom no mu ɔbaa bi kekaa mu frɛɛ Elisha, dɛ, W’akowaa mo kun no oewu: na ɔwoara inyim dɛ nna w’akowaa suro EWURADZE: na afei ɔdzefirfo no aba rebɛfa me mba beenu akɛyɛ no nkowaa.
Na Elisha see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menyɛ mma wo? Ka kyerɛ me; ebɛnadze na ewɔ no wɔ wo fie? Na ɔsee dɛ, W’afonabaa nnyi adze biara wɔ fie dɛ ngo ehina ara.
Nna ɔsee dɛ, Kɔ, kɛfemfɛm ehina wɔ wo mfɛfo nyinara hɔ, mekyerɛ ehina pan; femfɛm pii.
Na kɔ wo dan mu, kɔtow ɔwo na wo mba abow mu, na huehue ngo no gugu ehina no nyinara mu; na fa dza ɔayɛ ma no sisi nkyɛn.
Na ofii ne nkyɛn kɔree, na ɔkɔtoow ɔno na ne mba no abow mu; wɔdze ehina no brɛɛ no, na ohuehuei.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ehina no yeyɛɛ amaama no, nna ɔsee ne ba dɛ, Fa ehina bi so brɛ me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ehina biara nnyi hɔ bio. Na ngo no twae.
