wɔ n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia ebiasa mu no, ɔtoo pon maa n’asafohemfo nyinara na no nkowaa; Persia na Media etumfo, ekunyin na amansin no mu asafohemfo no, wɔ n’enyim:
Aber no na oyii n’enyimnyam ahendzi mu adzedodow na n’abɔso tumdzi mu enyidzi kyerɛe wɔ nda pii, mekyerɛ ndafua ɔha eduowɔtwe.
Na aber a nda yi soe no, nna ɔhen no too pon dze maa nkorɔfo a wohun hɔn wɔ Susa ahemfie no nyinara, akɛse na nkakraba nyina. Aponto no kɔr do nda esuon, wɔ ɔhen n’ahemfie ture no mu abangua no do.

Hɔ na asaaba ntwamu atam efufuw, na bibir sensɛnee a wɔdze ndwera fɛɛfɛw a ɔberdum ahoma esusuo mu akyekyer dwetɛ nkaba mu, ɔbo fufuw edum ho: sika na dwetɛ adamu egua nsisii na hoabo, abo amemen, na efufuw, na bufua, na etuntum abonsɛwee do.
Na wɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn nsa wɔ sika ndzɛmba no nkɔɔpow mu, na nkɔɔpow asorɔtow pii, nna ɔhen ne nsa no dɔɔ so dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no n’ayamuyie tse.
Na nsanom no wɔyɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no ahyehyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛr; wɔannhyɛ obiara: na dɛm na ɔhen no ahyɛ ne fie mpanyimfo no nyinara dɛ wɔnyɛ; wɔmma nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ obotum.
Ɔhembaa Vasti so too pon dze maa mbaa wɔ ahemfie a ɔyɛ ɔhen Ahasuerus dze no mu.
Da a otsia esuon no a ɔhen no n’akoma nyaa nsa ho enyigye no, ɔhyɛɛ Mehuman, Bizita, Harbona, Bigita, Abagta, Zetar, na Karkas, epiafo beesuon yi a wɔsom wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus enyim no,
dɛ wɔnkɛfa ɔhembaa Vasti mbra ɔhen no enyim wɔ ber a ɔhyɛ ahendzi ho ahenkyɛw no, ma ɔmfa n’ahoɔfɛw mbɛkyerɛ aman na asafohemfo no, osiandɛ no ho yɛ fɛw.
Na ɔhembaa Vasti poow dɛ ɔbɛba dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no nam epiafo no do hyɛɛ no no: dɛm ntsi ɔhen no no bo fuuw dodoodow, na n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ no mu.
Nna ɔhen no bisaa mbarimba mbrahyɛfo a wɔwɔ nyimdzee wɔ mbra na atsɛmbu ho no faa iyi ho, (osiandɛ nna ɔhen no susu n’asɛm a ɔfa mbra ho kyerɛ hɔn a wonyim mbra na atsɛmbusɛm nyinara no.
Hɔn a nna wɔbɛn no wɔ hɔ nye Karsena, Seetar, Ad-matha, Tarsis, Meres, Marsena, na Memukan, Persia na Media mbapɔmba beesuon no a wɔbɛn ɔhen no na wokitsa dzibew wɔ ahendzi no mu no).
Na ɔhen no bisaa dɛ, Ebɛnadze na yendua mbra do mfa nyɛ ɔhembaa Vasti, osiandɛ oenndzi emi ɔhen Ahasuerus m’asɛm a medze somaa epiafo no kɛmaa no no do?
Na Memukan buae wɔ ɔhen na mbapɔmba no enyim, dɛ, Nnyɛ ɔhen nko na ɔhembaa Vasti ayɛ no bɔn, na mbom ɔafom mbapɔmba nyinara, na aman nyinara a wɔwɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’amansin nyinara mu no so.
Osiandɛ ɔhembaa yi ne ndzeyɛe yi bodu mbasiafo nyinara nkyɛn, na wobobu hɔn kunnom enyimtsia osiandɛ wɔbɛka dɛ, Ɔhen Ahasuerus mpo hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa ɔhembaa Vasti mbra n’enyim, naaso ɔammba.
Na ndɛ da yi Persia na Media mbasiafo a wɔwɔ dzibew a wɔatse ɔhembaa no ne ndzeyɛɛ no nka no bɛsese ɔhen ne mbapɔmba nyinara dɛmara. Nna enyimtsiabu na ebufuhyew dodow bɔsoɛr.

Sɛ ɔhen bɛpɛ a, ɔno ɔmma ahendzi mu mbrasɛm mfi no hɔ mpue, na wɔmma wɔnkyerɛw no wɔ Persiafo na Mediafo mbra no mu, amma wɔaanndan no, dɛ mma Vasti mmba ɔhen Ahasuerus n’enyim bio: na wɔmma ɔhen mfa n’ahembaa gyinabew no mma obi so a oye sen no.
Na sɛ ɔhen ne mbra a ɔbɛhyɛ no tahye n’ahendzi kɛse yi nyinara mu a, yernom nyinara bɛma hɔn kunnom enyidzi, akɛse na nkakraba nyina.
Na asɛm no yɛɛ ɔhen no na ne mbapɔmba no enyisɔ; na ɔhen no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Memukan n’asɛm no tse:

osiandɛ ɔsomae ma wɔdze nwoma kɔr ɔhen n’amansin nyinara mu, wɔdze kɔr ɔmansin biara mu dɛ mbrɛ ne kyerɛwee tse, na wɔdze kɔr ɔman biara mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tse, dɛ ɔbarimba biara ndzi nankasa ne fi do panyin.
Nsɛm yi ekyir no, aber a ɔhen Ahasuerus n’ebufuhyew ano dwee no, ɔkaa Vasti na dza ɔyɛe no, na mbra a wɔhyɛɛ tsiaa no no.
Nna ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔsom no no see dɛ, Wɔmma wɔnhwehwɛ mbaabun a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw mma ɔhen:

na wɔmma ɔhen nhyehyɛ ahwɛdofo wɔ ahendzi mu amansin nyinara mu ma wonhyiahyia mbaabun nkakraba a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw nyinara ma wɔmbra Susa ahemfie, mbaa fi no mu, mfa nhyɛ ɔhen ne pianyi Hegai a ɔhwɛ mbasiafo do no ne nsa: na wɔmma wɔmfa hɔn ahosiesie ndzɛmba mma hɔn:
na wɔmma ababaawa a ɔhen bɛpɛ no nyɛ ɔhembaa ndzi Vasti n’ananmu. Na ɔhen no enyisɔ sɔɔ asɛm no; na ɔyɛɛ no dɛm.
Afei Judanyi bi wɔ Susa ahemfie a ne dzin dze Modekai, Benjaminnyi bi a ofi Jair, Simei, na Kish ebusua mu,
wɔfaa no fi Jerusalɛm kaa ndɔmmumfo a wɔfaa hɔn kaa Judahen Jekonia a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar faa hɔn kɔree no ho.

Na ɔtsetsee no wɔfa ne babaa Hadasa, ɔno nye Ester: osiandɛ onnyi egya na ena so, na ababaawa no no bɔbea yɛ fɛw na n’enyim wɔ nyam; na aber a n’egya na ne na wowui no, nna Modekai faa no yɛɛ nankasa ne babaa.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔtsee ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm na n’ahyɛdze no, na wohyiahyiaa mbabaawa pii baa Susa ahemfie, bɛhyɛɛ Hegai nsa no, wɔfaa Ester so baa ɔhen no ne fie, dze no bɛhyɛɛ Hegai, mbaa weɔmfo no nsa.

Na ababaawa no sɔɔ n’enyi, na onyaa no hɔ ayamuyie; na ɔdze n’ahosiesie ndzɛmba, nye akyɛpɛn maa no ntsɛmara, na ɔdze mbabaawa beesuon a wɔfata dɛ wɔdze ma no, fi ɔhen ne fie maa no: na oyii ɔno na ne mbabaawa no kɔr mbaa fi no mu beebi mbrɛ oye dodow.
Nna Ester nnkyerɛɛ ne man na n’ebusuafo so: osiandɛ Modekai abra no dɛ mma ɔnnkyerɛ.
Na da biara Modekai kɛpasapasar mbaa fi no n’abangua no enyim, ama oeehu mbrɛ Ester n’apɔw mu tse, na dza wɔdze no bɛyɛ.

Afei odur ababaawa biara do dɛ ɔkɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus nkyɛn, dɛ mbrɛ mbaa mbra no tse no, abosoom duebien ekyir no na hɔn ahosiesie nda no soe, na wɔdze krɔbɔw dzi abosoom esia, na wɔdze nduhuam na ɔnye mbaa ahosiesie ndzɛmba so dzi abosoom esia so.
Na ababaawa no dze no dɛm ba ɔhen nkyɛn, biribiara a ɔhwehwɛ no wɔdze ma no ma ɔdze fi mbaa fi no mu kɔ ɔhen no fie.

Ewimbir no na ɔkɔ, na anapa no ɔsan kɔ mbaa fi no a otsia ebien no mu, wɔ ɔhen ne pianyi Saasgaz a ɔhwɛ nwewefo do no nsamu: na ɔnnkɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn bio; gyedɛ ɔhen no pɛ n’asɛm na wɔbɔ ne dzin frɛ no.

Afei aber a odur Ester, Modekai n’egya no nua Abihail ne babaa a ɔafa no ayɛ ne babaa no do dɛ ɔbɔkɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn no, oemmbisa hwee gyedɛ dza ɔhen pianyi Hegai, mbaa weɔmfo no hyɛe no. Na Ester nyaa enyimpa wɔ hɔn a wohun no nyinara enyi do.
Nna wɔfaa Ester kɔr ɔhen Ahasuerus nkyɛn wɔ n’ahemfie wɔ bosoom a otsia du no a ɔno nye bosoom Tebeth no mu, wɔ n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia esuon no mu.
Na ɔhen no dɔɔ Ester seen mbaa no nyinara, na onyaa adom na enyimpa wɔ n’enyim seen mbaabun no nyinara; ma ɔdze ahendzi no abɔtsir no bɔɔ ne tsir, na ɔyɛɛ no ɔhembaa dzii Vasti n’ananmu.
Nna ɔhen no too pon kɛsenara maa ne mbapɔmba na no nkowaa nyinara, wɔ Ester ntsi; na ɔmaa amansin no ahomgye, na ɔkyekyɛɛ adze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔno ɔhen n’ayamuyie tse.
Na aber a wohyiahyiaa mbaabun no a otsia ebien no, nna Modekai tse ɔhen no kuropon no mu.
Nna Ester nnyae nnkyerɛɛ n’ebusuafo na ne man so: dɛ mbrɛ Modekai abra no no: osiandɛ Ester dzii Modekai ne mbrasɛm do, dɛ aber a ɔrenyɛn no no.
Nda no mu no, mber a Modekai tse ɔhen no kuropon no mu no, ɔhen n’epiafo no mu beenu, Bigtan na Teres a wofi hɔn a wɔhwɛ abowano no mu no, hɔn bo fuwii, na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wobeyi ɔhen Ahasuerus efi hɔ.
Na Modekai tsee asɛm no, na ɔno na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhembaa Ester; na Ester dze Modekai ne dzin dze kɛkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no.
Na aber a wɔhwehwɛɛ asɛm no mu, na wohun dɛ ɔtse dɛm no, wɔsɛɛn hɔn beenu nyinara wɔ dua do na wɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu wɔ ɔhen no enyim.
Iyinom ekyir no, ɔhen Ahasuerus yɛɛ Agagnyi Haman, Hamedata ba no otsitsir, na ɔmaa no do, na ɔkrɔɔn n’egua seen mbapɔmba a wɔka no ho nyinara.
Nna ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔtse ɔhen no kuropon no mu nyinara wɔbɔ hɔn mu adze, na wɔyɛ Haman enyidzi: osiandɛ dɛm na ɔhen no ahyɛ wɔ no ho. Na Modekai dze, ɔammbɔ no mu adze na ɔannyɛ no enyidzi so.
Nna ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔtse ɔhen no kuropon no mu no, see Modekai dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔwo eto ɔhen ne mbrasɛm yi?
Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no daa daa na onntsie hɔn no, wɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ Haman, dɛ wɔrohwɛ kyerɛ Modekai botum egyina n’asɛm do anaa: osiandɛ nna ɔaka akyerɛ hɔn dɛ ɔyɛ Jewnyi.
Na aber a Haman hun dɛ Modekai mmbɔ no mu adze, na eso ɔnnyɛ no enyidzi no, ebufuw hyɛɛ no ma.
Na obuu no adze kakrabaa dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ Modekai nko, osiandɛ ɔakyerɛ no Modekai ne man: dɛm ntsi Haman hwehwɛɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ Judafo nyinara a wɔwɔ Ahasuerus n’ahenman nyinara mu, mekyerɛ Modekai ne nkorɔfo no.

Na bosoom a odzi kan a ɔno nye bosoom Nisan wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’afe a otsia duebien no mu no, wɔtwee Pur, ɔnye dɛ, tonto, wɔ Haman enyim dabiara, dze hwehwɛ da na bosoom pɔtsee no, na bosoom a otsia duebien no a ɔno nye bosoom Adar no ne da a ɔtɔ do duebiasa do na tonto no sii.

Na Haman see ɔhen Ahasuerus dɛ, Ɔman bi wɔ hɔ a wɔabɔ apetse na wɔatsew hɔnho efi aman mu wɔ w’ahendzi n’amansin nyinara mu; na hɔn mbra yɛ soronko wɔ ɔman biara dze mu; nkyii so wonndzi ɔhen ne mbra do; dɛm ntsi onnye mma ɔhen dɛ ɔbɛma hɔn kwan.
Sɛ ɔhen bɛpɛ a, ɔmma wɔnkyerɛw ma wɔnsɛɛ hɔn: na mibeker dwetɛ talent mpemdu ahyɛ hɔn a wɔhwɛ ɔhen n’edwuma do no nsa, dɛ wɔmfa mbogu ɔhen n’adzekoradze no mu.
Na ɔhen no yii ne mpɛtsea wɔ ne nsa, na ɔdze maa Agagnyi Haman, Hamedata ba no, Jewfo tamfo no.
Na ɔhen no see Haman dɛ, Dwetɛ no wɔdze ama wo, ɔman no so, dɛ yɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ oye wɔ w’enyi do no ara.

Nna wɔfrɛfrɛɛ ɔhen n’akyerɛwfo no wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu, wɔ ne da a otsia duebiasa no mu, na wɔkyerɛɛw no dɛ mbrɛ Haman hyɛe no nyinara dze kɛmaa ɔhen n’amansin do ahwɛfo, na ambradofo a wɔhwɛ ɔmansin biara do, na ɔman biara mu mbapɔmba; ɔmansin biara dɛ mbrɛ ne kyerɛw tse, na ɔman biara, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tse; ɔhen Ahasuerus dzin mu na wɔdze kyerɛwee, na wɔdze ɔhen no ne mpɛtsea sɔɔw ano.

Na wɔdze nwoma no somasomae ma embirikatufo dze kɔr ɔhen n’amansin nyinara mu dɛ, wɔnsɛɛ, wonkuku, na wɔntɔr Jewfo nyinara, mberantsɛ na nkɔdaa nyina, mbofra nkakraba na mbaa so da kor mu, mekyerɛ bosoom a otsia duebien no a ɔno nye bosoom Adar no, ne da a otsia duebiasa no, na wɔmfom hɔn agyapadze mfa.
Kyerɛw no no nsusudo a wɔdze kɛhyɛɛ mbra no wɔ ɔmansin biara mu no, wɔdaa no edzi maa ɔman nyinara, dɛ wonsiesie hɔnho nsie da no.
Embirikatufo no nam ɔhen ne mbrasɛm do fiir edzi ntsɛmara na wɔhyɛɛ mbra no wɔ Susa ahemfie; na ɔhen no na Haman tsenaa ase dɛ wɔrobɔnom nsa; nna Susa kurow no mu dze ayɛ basabasa.
Afei aber a Modekai hun dza aba nyinara no, nna ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔdze eyitam nye nso kataa noho, na ofiir edzi kɔr kurow no ne finimfin, na ɔdze nkekamu dzendzen a ɔyɛ wen sui:
na ɔkɔr ɔhen no no kuropon no enyim mpo: osiandɛ obiara nnyi ho kwan dɛ ofura eyitam dze hɛn ɔhen no no kuropon mu.
Na ɔmansin biara mu beebiara mbrɛ ɔhen ne mbrasɛm no durii no, nkɔmbɔdzi kɛse baa hɔ wɔ Jewfo no mu, na mbuadadzi, na osu, na osukwadwom, na dodowara dedaa eyitam na nso mu.
Na Ester ne mbabaawa na ne mpiafo no bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ no; na ɔhembaa no no werɛ hoow mbordo: na ɔsomaa dɛ wɔmfa atar nkɛhyɛ Modekai, na wonyi eyitam wɔ no ho: naaso ɔanngye.
Nna Ester kɛfrɛɛ Hatihak, ɔhen n’epiafo no mu baako a woeyi no dɛ ɔnhwɛ no no, na ɔsomaa no dɛ ɔnkɔ Modekai nkyɛn.
Nna Hatihak fiir edzi kɔr Modekai nkyɛn wɔ kurow no ne bea tɛtɛr no a ɔwɔ ɔhen no kuropon enyim no do.
Na Modekai kaa dza aba no do nyinara kyerɛɛ no, na sika dodow a Haman abɔ anohoba dɛ osian Jewfo ntsi obeker egu ɔhen n’akoradze mu, ma wɔaasɛɛ hɔn no.

Eso ɔdze mbra no a wɔhyɛɛ no wɔ Susa dɛ wɔnsɛɛ hɔn no ne kyerɛw saso maa no, dɛ ɔmfa nkyerɛ Ester na ɔnka nkyerɛ no; na ɔnhyɛ no dɛ ɔnkɔ ɔhen nkyɛn, nkɔtotɔ nserɛ no na ombisa adze wɔ n’enyim mma ne man.
Na Hatihak bae bɛkaa Modekai ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ Ester.
Nna Ester kasaa kyerɛɛ Hatihak, na ɔmaa no nkra wɔ Modekai nkyɛn, dɛ;

Ɔhen no nkowaa nyinara, na ɔhen n’amansin mu nkorɔfo nyinara, nyim dɛ obiara, ɔbarimba o, ɔbaa o, ɔbɛba ɔhen nkyɛn wɔ fie afamu abanguado a wɔammfrɛ no no, mbra kor pɛr na ɔwɔ hɔ ma no, dɛ wonku no, gyedɛ nyia ɔhen bɛtsen sika ahempoma akyerɛ no dɛ ɔntsena ase no: na wɔmmfrɛɛ me dɛ monkɔ ɔhen nkyɛn adaduasa yi.
Na wɔkɛkaa Ester ne nsɛm no dze kyerɛɛ Modekai.
Nna Modekai hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔmfa mbuae nsan nkɛma Ester dɛ, Mma nsusu wo tsirmu dɛ ɔwo befi mu efi wɔ ahemfie, asen Jewfo no nyinara.

Na sɛ ɔwo imua w’ano koraa wɔ aber yi mu a, ɔnodze mboa na ɔgye bɔsoɛr efi beebi fofor so ama Jewfo, na ɔwo na w’egya fi dze wɔbɛsɛɛ: na woana na onyim dɛ aber a ɔtse dɛm yi ntsi na wo nsa aka ahendzi no?
Nna Ester kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ wonkobua Modekai dɛ,

Kɔ, kɔpon Jewfo a wohu hɔn wɔ Susa nyinara hyia, na hom ndzi mbuada wɔ me ntsi, na mma hom nndzidzi na wɔnnom so ndaansa, adzesaa na adzekyee: emi so na me mbabaawa so bedzi mbuada dɛmara; na medze no dɛm akɔ ɔhen nkyɛn a ɔnnam mbra kwan do: na sɛ muwu a, nna mewu.
Nna Modekai sii mu kɔr no kwan, na ɔkɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ester hyɛɛ no no nyinara.
Afei ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia ebiasa no, nna Ester hyɛɛ ahembaa ntar, na okegyinaa ahemfie fie afamu abanguado, wɔ ɔhen ne dan no ne tsentsendo.

Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no hun ɔhembaa Ester dɛ ogyina abangua no do no, nna onyaa n’enyim enyimnyam: na ɔhen no tseen sika ahempoma a ɔdze ne nsamu no kyerɛɛ Ester. Nna Ester twee pinii, na obosuoo ahempoma no ne tsir.
Na ɔhen no bisaa no dɛ, Ɔhembaa Ester, erohwehwɛ ebɛnadze? W’ebisadze nye dɛn? Na sɛ odu ahendzi no ne fa mpo a, wɔdze bɛma wo.
Na Ester see dɛ, Sɛ oye wɔ ɔhen enyi do a, wɔmma ɔhen na Haman mbra pon a moroto ama no ho ndɛ da yi.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Hom mma Haman mbra ntsɛm, na wɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ Ester aka no. Nna ɔhen no na Haman baa pon a Ester ato no ho.
Na ɔhen no see Ester wɔ nsa aponto no ho dɛ, W’adzeserɛ nye dɛn? Na wɔmfa mma wo: na w’ahwehwɛdze nye dɛn? Odu ahendzi no ne fa mpo a, wɔbɛyɛ.
Nna Ester buae see dɛ, M’adzeserɛ na m’ahwehwɛdze nye dɛ;
sɛ menya ɔhen enyim enyimpa, na sɛ ɔhen pɛ dɛ ɔbɛma m’adzeserɛ, na ɔayɛ m’ahwehwɛdze a, wɔmma ɔhen na Haman mbra pon a morobɔto hɔn no ho, na ɔkyena mebɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen ase no.
Nna da no Haman dze enyigye na akoma pa fiir edzi: na aber a Haman hun Modekai wɔ ɔhen no kuropon no mu, dɛ ɔannsoɛr enngyina, na eso oennhima noho amma no no, nna ebufuw hyɛɛ no ma wɔ Modekai ho.
Naaso Haman konkoom noho do, na osii mu kɔr ne fie, na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛɛ ne mfɛfo na ne yer Zeres ma wɔbae.
Na Haman kaa n’ahonya enyimnyam, na ne mba dodow, na ndzɛmba nyinara a ɔhen no ayɛ no kɛse wɔ mu, na mbrɛ oesi na ɔama no do abɔ mbapɔmba na ɔhen no nkowaa no do no, kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Nkyii so Haman see dɛ, Nyew, ɔhembaa Ester ɔamma nyimpa biara annka ɔhen ho ammba pon a ɔtoe no ho gyedɛ mara; na ɔkyena so oehyia emi na ɔhen wɔ ne nkyɛn.
Naaso iyi nyinara nndɔɔ so mma me, aber tsentsen ara a muhu Jewnyi Modekai no dɛ ɔtse ɔhen no kuropon mu yi.

Nna ne yer Zeres na ne mfɛfo no nyinara see no dɛ, Ma yɛnyɛ mbeamudua a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu enum, na ɔkyena anapa ka kyerɛ ɔhen ma wɔnsɛn Modekai wɔ do: na nkyii ɔwo nye ɔhen nkɔ aponto no ho enyigye mu. Na asɛm no yɛɛ Haman enyisɔ; na ɔmaa wɔyɛɛ dua no.
Anago no ɔhen no ne nda fii no do, na ɔhyeɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mbermunsɛm nkaanwoma no mbra, na wɔkenkaan no wɔ ɔhen no enyim.
Na wohun dɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ Mordecai na ɔbɛkãa Bigthana na Teresh, ɔhen n’epiafo beenu no a wofi hɔn a wɔhwɛ abowano no mu no a wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔdze nsa to ɔhen Ahasuerus do no, ho asɛm no.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ ebɛn enyidzi na kɛseyɛ na wɔdze ayɛ Mordecai wɔ iyi ho? Nna ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔsom no no see dɛ, wɔnnyɛ hwee mma no.
Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Woana na ɔwɔ abangua no do? Afei na Haman aba ɔhen ne fie no ekyir abangua no do, dɛ ɔrebɛkã akyerɛ ɔhen ma wɔaasɛn Mordecai wɔ asɛndua no a oesi ama no no do.
Na ɔhen no nkowaa no see no dɛ, hwɛ, Haman gyina abangua no do. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, wɔmma ɔmbra dan mu.
Nna Haman baa dan mu. Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, ebɛnadze na wɔmfa nyɛ nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no? Afei Haman see wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ, woana mpo na ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi sen mara?
Na Haman see ɔhen no dɛ, nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no,
ma wɔmfa ahentar a ɔhen tɔ dɛ ɔhyɛ no mbra, na ɔpɔnkɔ a ɔhen tɔ dɛ ɔtsena do no a wɔdze ahendzi abɔtsir abɔ ne tsir no,

na ma wɔmfa a tar na ɔpɔnkɔ no nhyɛ ɔhen ne mbapɔmba ekunyin no mu baako ne nsa, ma wɔmfa nhyɛ nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no, na wɔmma ɔntsena ɔpɔnkɔ no do mfa kurow no n’abɔntsen do, na wɔmpaa ndzi n’enyim dɛ, mbrɛ wɔdze bɛyɛ nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no, nye yi oo.
Nna ɔhen no see Haman dɛ, ka woho kɛfa atar na ɔpɔnkɔ no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwoara ase no, na yɛ dɛmara ma Jewnyi Mordecai no a ɔtse ɔhen no kuropon mu no: Mma mma nngyaa dza akã no nyinara mu biara.

Nna Haman faa atar no na ɔpɔnkɔ no, na ɔdze hyehyɛɛ Mordecai, na ɔmaa ɔtsenaa ɔpɔnkɔ do dze faa kurow no n’abɔntsen do, na wɔpaae dzii n’enyim dɛ, mbrɛ wɔdze bɛyɛ nyia ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no nye yi oo.
Na Mordecai sanee baa ɔhen no kuropon no mu bio. Na Haman dze, ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm dze nkɔmbodzi na ne tsir do a wɔakata, kɔr ne fie.

Na Haman kãa dza aba no do no nyinara kyerɛɛ ne yer Zeresh na ne mfɛfo no nyinara. Nna n'enyansafo no na ne yer Zeresh see no dɛ, sɛ Mordecai a ɔwo ahyɛ ase rohwe famu wɔ n’enyim yi, ofi Jewfo asefo mu a, ɔno irunntum nndzi no do nyim, mbom ase ara na ebɔhwe wɔ n’enyim.
Aber a wɔnye no da do rekasa no, nna ɔhen n’epiafo no bae, na wɔpɛɛ ntsɛm dɛ wɔdze Haman bɔkɔ pon no a Esther ato no ho.
Na ɔhen no na Haman baa dɛ wɔnye Ɔhembaa Ester robɔto pon.
Na ɔhen no see Ester da a otsia ebien no mu so, wɔ nsa aponto no ho dɛ, Ɔhembaa Ester, w’adzeserɛ nye dɛn? Na wɔmfa mma wo: na w’ahwehwɛdze nye dɛn? Odu ahendzi yi ne fa mpo a, wɔbɛyɛ.
Nna ɔhembaa Ester buae see dɛ, Ɔhen, sɛ menya w’enyim enyimpa, na sɛ ɔhen pɛ a, ma wɔmfa mo nkwa mma me wɔ adzeserɛ yi do, na me man wɔ adzeserɛ yi do:
na wɔatɔn hɛn, emi na me man, dɛ wɔnsɛɛ hɛn, nkuku hɛn. Na sɛ wɔtontɔɔn hɛn yɛɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa a, nkyɛ mennkɛkasa, naaso ɔtamfo no runntum nnhyɛ ɔhen n’adze a ɔbɛsɛɛ no ananmu.
Nna ɔhen Ahasuerus buae see ɔhembaa Ester dɛ, Woana nye no, na hen na ɔwɔ, na n’akoma ara ahyɛ no mu ma dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛm no?
Na Ester see dɛ, Ɔyɛfo na ɔtamfo bi a, mekyerɛ Haman otsiɔdzennyi yi a. Nna Haman n’akoma tui wɔ ɔhen no na ɔhembaa no enyim.

Na ɔhen no soɛree wɔ n’ebufuw no mu fii nsa aponto no ho, na osii mu kɔr ahemfi ture no mu; na Haman soɛree gyinaa dɛ ɔrepa no nkwa ho kyɛw wɔ ɔhembaa Ester hɔ, osiandɛ ohun dɛ ɔhen no abɔ no ho pɔw bɔn.

Nna ɔhen no sanee fii ahemfie ture no mu baa beebi mbrɛ nsa pon no wɔ no; nna Haman ahwe adamu egua a Ester wɔ do no do. Nna ɔhen no see dɛ, Ana mpo orubotu ahyɛ ɔhembaa do so wɔ m’enyim wɔ ofi yi mu? Aber a asɛm no fii ɔhen no n’anomu puei ara, nna wɔkataa Haman n’enyim.

Nna Harbona, epiafo a wɔwɔ ɔhen no n’enyim no mu baako no, see dɛ, Eso hwɛ, dua a Haman ayɛ ama Modekai a ɔkaa ɔhen no ho asɛmpa no, osi Haman fie, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu enum. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Hom nkɛsɛn no wɔ do.
Nna wɔsɛɛn Haman wɔ dua a oesiesie ama Modekai no do. Nna ɔhen no n’ebufuw ano dwee.
Da no ara na ɔhen Ahasuerus dze Haman, Jewfo tamfo no, ne fie maa ɔhembaa Ester. Na Modekai baa ɔhen no n’enyim; osiandɛ Ester aka mbrɛ ɔnye ne ntamu tse.
Na ɔhen no worɔɔw ne mpɛtsea a ɔgyee no Haman nsamu no, na ɔdze maa Modekai. Na Ester dze Haman ne fie no hyɛɛ Modekai nsa.
Na Ester kasae wɔ ɔhen no n’enyim, na otwae hwee n’ananadze, na ɔdze nyinsuwa totɔe serɛɛ no dɛ onyi Agagnyi Haman no mbusu na ne tsirmpɔw a ɔbɔɔ no wɔ Jewfo no ho no.
Nna ɔhen no tseen sika ahempoma no kyerɛɛ Ester. Nna Ester soɛree, na ogyinaa ɔhen no enyim.

Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ ɔhen pɛ, na sɛ menya n’enyim enyimpa, na asɛm no tsen wɔ ɔhen enyim, na mo so miye wɔ n’enyiwa do a, ɔno ma wɔnkyerɛw nkɛsan nwoma no a Agagnyi Haman, Hamedata ba no, bɔɔ no pɔw a ɔkyerɛɛw dɛ ɔdze rekɛsɛɛ Jewfo a wɔwɔ ɔhen n’amansin no nyinara mu no;
na mebɛyɛ dɛn na metum atsena hɔ mahwɛ mbusu a ɔbɛba me man do? Na mebɛyɛ dɛn na metum atsena hɔ ahwɛ m’ebusuafo hɔn nsɛɛe?
Nna ɔhen Ahasuerus see ɔhembaa Ester na Jewnyi Modekai no dɛ, Hwɛ medze Haman fi ama Ester na ɔnoara so wɔasɛn no wɔ dua no do, ɔnam dɛ ɔdze ne nsa too Jewfo no do ntsi.

Hom so nkyerɛw nkɛma Jewfo no, dɛ mbrɛ homara wɔpɛ, wɔ ɔhen no ne dzin mu, na wɔmfa ɔhen no ne mpɛtsea no nsɔw ano: osiandɛ kyerɛw a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ ɔhen ne dzin mu, na wɔdze ɔhen ne mpɛtsea asɔw ano no, nyimpa biara nndan no.

Nna wɔfrɛfrɛɛ ɔhen n’akyerɛwfo no aber no mu, bosoom a otsia ebiasa no a, ɔno nye bosoom Sivan no, ne da a otsia eduonu ebiasa no mu: na wɔkyerɛɛw no dɛ mbrɛ Modekai hyɛe no nyinara dze kɛmaa Jewfo no, na amansin do ahwɛfo na ambradofo na amansin mu mbapɔmba no a wɔwɔ India dze kodu Etiopia, amansin ɔha eduonu esuon, ɔmansin biara dɛ mbrɛ ne nkyerɛwee tse, na ɔman biara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tse, na Jewfo no so dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyerɛwee na hɔn kasaa tse.

Na ɔdze ɔhen Ahasuerus ne dzin na ɔdze kyerɛwee na ɔdze ɔhen no ne mpɛtsea sɔɔw ano, na ɔdze nwoma no somasomaa embirikatufo a wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do, na wɔtsetse nsoasopɔnkɔ a hɔn ho yɛ har a wɔdze hɔn yɛ ɔhen n’edwuma no a wɔanyɛn hɔn mpɔnkɔban mu do:

no mu na ɔhen no maa Jewfo a wɔwɔ kurow biara mu kwan dɛ wɔmpon hɔnho nhyia, na hɔn nkwa ntsi wongyina hɔ, na wɔnsɛɛ, wonkuku, na wɔmbɔ ɔman na ɔmansin a wobehiahia hɔn ho no, hɔn tum nyinara ngu, hɔn mbofraba na mbaa, wɔmfom hɔn ndzɛmba mfa,
da kor mu wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’amansin nyinara mu, ɔnye dɛ, wɔ bosoom a otsia duebien no a ɔno nye bosoom Adar no, ne da a otsia duebiasa no mu.
Nkyerɛwee no no nsusudo a wɔdze kɛhyɛɛ mbra no wɔ ɔmansin biara mu no, wɔdaa no edzi maa aman nyinara, dɛ Jewfo no nsiesie hɔnho nsie da no ma woeedzi hɔn atamfo wer.
Nna embirikatufo a wɔtsetse asoaso mpɔnkɔ a hɔn ho yɛ har a wɔdze hɔn yɛ ɔhen n’edwuma no do no, wɔnam ɔhen ne mbrasɛm do sii mu kɔree; na mbra no wɔhyɛɛ no wɔ Susa ahemfie.
Na Modekai fiir edzi fii ɔhen no enyim dɛ ɔhyɛ ahentar bibir na fufuw, na ɔnye sika ahenkyɛw kɛse, na ɔnye ndwera fɛɛfɛw na ɔberdum bataker: na Susa kurow no dzii ehurusi na hɔn enyi gyee.
Na Jewfo no nyaa kan na enyigye, na ahosɛpɛw na enyidzi.

Na kurow biara mu, beebiara mbrɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm na no mbra no durii no, Jewfo no nyaa enyigye na ahosɛpɛw, aponto na da pa dzi. Na asaase no do aman no mu nyimpa dodowara bɛyɛɛ Jewfo; osiandɛ Jewfo no ho suro aka hɔn.

Afei bosoom a otsia duebien no a ɔno nye bosoom Adar no, ɔnoara mu da a otsia duebiasa no a ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm na n’ahyɛdze no dur dɛ wodzii do no, da no ara na Jewfo hɔn atamfo no enyi daa kwan dɛ wobedzi hɔn do tum; naaso ɔdaan dɛ Jewfo no mbom na wonyaa hɔn a wɔtaan hɔn no do tum.

Jewfo poon hɔnho hyiaa hɔn nkurow mu, wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’amansin nyinara mu, dɛ wɔrosoɛr etsia hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nsɛɛe no do: na nyimpa biara enntum ennsiw hɔn kwan; osiandɛ hɔn ho suro aka ɔman no nyinara.
Na amansin no mu mbapɔmba, na amansin do ahwɛfo, na ambradofo, na hɔn a wɔyɛ ɔhen n’edwuma no nyinara, boaa Jewfo no; osiandɛ Modekai ho suro aka hɔn.
Na Modekai yɛɛ nyimpa tsitsir wɔ ɔhen no ne fie, na ne nka tahyee amansin no nyinara mu: na ɔbarimba Modekai no kɔr do araa krɔnee.
Na Jewfo no dze afona ano, na oku na ɔsɛɛ dze kaa hɔn atamfo nyinara gya, na wɔyɛɛ hɔn a wɔtan hɔn no dza wɔpɛ.
Na Susa ahemfie mu no Jewfo no kumii na wɔsɛɛ mbarimba ahaenum.
Wokunkum Parsandata, Dalfon, Aspatha,
Porata, Adalia, Aridatha,
Parmasta, Arisai, Aridai, na Vaizata;
a wɔyɛ Jewfo tamfo Hamedata ne ba Haman ne mbambanyin du no so, naaso asadze no dze wɔammfa hɔn nsa annka.
Da no ara hɔn a wokunkum hɔn wɔ Susa ahemfie mu no dodow no wɔdze bɔtoo ɔhen no enyim.

Na ɔhen no see ɔhembaa Ester dɛ, Jewfo no woekuku na wɔasɛɛ mbarimba ahaenu wɔ Susa ahemfi no mu, na Haman ne mbabanyin du; na ebɛnadze so na wɔayɛ no wɔ ɔhen no n’amansin nkaa no mu? Afei w’adzeserɛ nye dɛn? Na wɔmfa mma wo.
Nna Ester see dɛ, Sɛ ɔhen pɛ a, ɔmma wɔmma Jewfo a wɔwɔ Susa no kwan ma ɔkyena so wɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ndɛ da yi mbra no tse, na ma wɔnsensɛn Haman mbabanyin du no wɔ dua do.
Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ dɛ wɔnyɛ no dɛm: na wɔhyɛɛ mbra wɔ Susa; na wɔsensɛn Haman ne mbabanyin du no.
Na Jewfo a wɔwɔ Susa no poon hɔnho hyiae wɔ bosoom Adar ne da a otsia duanan no mu so, na wokunkum mbarimba ahaasa wɔ Susa: naaso asadze no dze, wɔammfa hɔn nsa annka.

Na Jewfo nkaa no a wɔwɔ ɔhen no n’amansin mu no so poon hɔnho hyiae, na hɔn nkwa ntsi wogyinae, na wodzii hɔn atamfo do, na wokunkum hɔn a wokyiir hɔn no mu nyimpa mpemeduosuon enum; naaso asadze no dze, wɔammfa hɔn nsa annka.
Iyi wɔyɛɛ no wɔ bosoom Adar ne da a otsia duebiasa no mu, na ɔnoara ne da a otsia duanan no mu, na wɔgyee hɔn ahom, na wɔyɛɛ no aponto na enyigye da.
Na Jewfo a wɔwɔ Susa no boaa ano hyiae wɔ ne da a otsia duebiasa no, na ne da a otsia duanan no; na da a otsia duenum no na wɔgyee hɔn ahom, na wɔyɛɛ no aponto na enyigye da.
Dɛm ntsi na Jewfo a wɔwɔ nkurobaase no a wɔtsetse nkuroba a wɔammbɔ ho ban no mu no, wɔyɛɛ bosoom Adar ne da a otsia duanan no enyigye na aponto da, na da pa, na da a wɔdze adze kyekyɛ hɔnho nkorkor.
Na Modekai kyerɛɛw nsɛm yi, na ɔsomasomae ma wɔdze nwoma kɛmemaa Jewfo nyinara a wɔwɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’amansin nyinara mu no, hɔn a wɔbɛn na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir nyina,
dɛ ɔdze rehyɛ hɔn dɛ wondzi bosoom Adar ne da a otsia duanan na ɔnoara ne da a otsia duenum no, afrenhyia afrenhyia,

dɛ nda a Jewfo nyaa mu ahomgye wɔ hɔn atamfo nsamu, na bosoom a wɔdanee fii awerɛhow mu kɔr enyigye mu, na ofi nkɔmbɔdzi mu kɔr da pa mu maa hɔn no: dɛ wɔmfa nyɛ aponto na enyigye nda, na wɔnkyekyɛ hɔnho adze na wɔnkyɛ ehiafo so adze.
Na Jewfo no suoo mu dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ Modekai akyerɛw akɛma hɔn no;
osiandɛ Agagnyi Haman, Hamedata ba no, Jewfo no nyinara tamfo no, bɔɔ Jewfo no ho pɔw dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn, na ɔtwee Pur, ɔnye dɛ, tonto, dɛ ɔbɛhyew hɔn, na ɔasɛɛ hɔn;
na aber a asɛm no dur ɔhen no enyim no, nna ɔnam nwoma do hyɛɛ dɛ no pɔw bɔn a ɔbɔɔ no wɔ Jewfo no ho no ɔnsan mbobua nankasa n’etsifi; na dɛ wɔnsɛn ɔno na ne mba wɔ dua do no.
Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ nda yi Purim dɛ mbrɛ Pur dzin no tse no. Na osian nwoma yi mu nsɛm no nyinara, na dza wohun no wɔ asɛm yi mu, na dza aba hɔn do no ntsi,

Jewfo no hyehyɛe, na wɔgyee too hɔn do, na hɔn asefo do, na hɔn a wɔdze hɔnho kɔbɔɔ hɔn ho no nyinara do, dɛ orunntwa mu, dɛ wobedzi nda ebien yi dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kyerɛw, na hɔn mber a wɔahyɛ no tse, afrenhyia biara mu;
na dɛ wɔnkaa nda yi, na wondzi no wɔ mbasantsen biara, ebusua biara, ɔmansin biara, na kurow biara mu, na dɛ Purim nda yi mma ɔmmpa wɔ Jewfo no mu, na ne nkaa so mmbɔ adze wɔ hɔn asefo mu.
Nna ɔhembaa Ester, Abihail ne babaa no, na Jewnyi Modekai, wɔdze tum nyinara kyerɛwee dɛ wɔdze Purim nwoma a otsia ebien yi etsim.
Na ɔsomae ma wɔdze nwoma kɛmemaa Jewfo nyinara, dze kɔr Ahasuerus n’ahendzi amansin ɔha eduonu esuon no mu, wɔdze asomdwee na nokwardzi nsɛm,

dɛ wɔdze rema Purim nda yi etsim wɔ ne mber a wɔahyehyɛ no mu, dɛ mbrɛ Jewnyi Modekai na ɔhembaa Ester ama etsim hɔn mu no, na dɛ mbrɛ wɔama mbuadadzi na hɔn sufrɛ ho asɛm no mu, ama hɔnho na hɔn asefo no.
Na Ester ne mbrasɛm no maa Purim nsɛm yi tsimii; na wɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma no mu.
Na ɔhen Ahasuerus dze asaasetow too asaase no na po mu nsupɔw no do.
Na no tum na ne mbanyindze ho asɛm nyinara, na Modekai n’akɛseyɛ a ɔhen no maa ɔyɛe no no ho asɛm no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Media na Persia ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?

Osiandɛ Jewnyi Modekai no nye nyia otsia ebien a odzi ɔhen Ahasuerus n’ekyir, na ɔyɛ nyimpa kɛse wɔ Jewfo mu, na no nuanom nyimpadodow no penee no; ɔhwehwɛɛ ne man ne yieyɛ, na ɔkaa asomdwee nsɛm kyerɛɛ n’asefo nyinara.
Nna banyin bi wɔ Uz asaase do a ne dzin dze Job; nna odzi mu yie na ɔtsen, nyimpa a osuro Nyankopɔn na okyir bɔn a.
Na ɔwoo mbabanyin beesuon na mbabaa baasa.
N’ahodze so yɛ nguan mpemesuon na efumpɔnkɔ mpemebiasa, na anantwi mpamho ahaenum, na nsoasopɔnkɔber ahaenum, na asomfo piinara; ma dɛm ntsi nna banyin yi yɛ otsitsir wɔ boka mba no nyinara mu.
Nna ɔtɔ dɛ ne mbabanyin no kɔ kɔto pon wɔ ɔbaako biara ne fie wɔ ne kra da mu; na wɔsoma ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛ hɔn nkyerɛbaa baasa no ma wɔba dɛ wɔnye hɔn mbedzidzi na wɔnnom.

Na aber biara sɛ hɔn aponto nda no kɔ aprɔw wie a, nna Job asoma ma wɔakɛtsew hɔnho. Ɔsoɛr ahanamakye, na ɔkɔbɔ hyew afɔr dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nyinara hɔn dodow tse: osiandɛ Job see dɛ, Bi annyɛ a me mba no ayɛ bɔn, na wɔapow Nyankopɔn wɔ hɔn akoma mu. Dɛm na Job yɛɛ no daa.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da bi sor dɔm no bae begyinaa EWURADZE enyim, na Satan so dzi hɔn mu bae.
Na EWURADZE bisaa Satan dɛ, Ehen na ifi reba yi? Nna Satan buaa EWURADZE dɛ, Mifi asaase do akɔnaabadzi na no do apasapasar mu na mereba.
Na EWURADZE see Satan dɛ, Ana ihun m’akowaa Job a? Obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔno wɔ asaase no do, ɔbanyin a odzi mu na ɔtsen, obi a osuro Nyankopɔn na okyir bɔn a.
Nna Satan buaa EWURADZE dɛ, Aso gyan ara na Job suro Nyankopɔn a?
Ana nnyɛ ɔwoara na abɔ ɔno, na ne fi, na dza ɔwɔ nyinara ho ban ehyia bi a? Ɔwo ehyira ne nsaano edwuma do, na n’ahodze adɔɔ so wɔ asaase no do.
Na afei ɔwo dze, tsen wo nsa ka dza ɔwɔ nyinara ɛ, na hwɛ, sɛ ɔnnkɔdom wo ntsɛmara a.
Na EWURADZE see Satan dɛ, Hwɛ, dza ɔwɔ nyinara wɔ wo nsamu; ɔno noara nko no do na mma mmfa wo nsa nnto. Nna Satan fii EWURADZE enyim kɔree.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da bi aber a ne mbabanyin no na ne mbabaa no woridzidzi na wɔronom nsa wɔ hɔn nua panyin no ne fie no,
ɔbɔfo bi baa Job nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, nna Anantwi no rufuntum, na nsoasopɔnkɔ no so ridzidzi wɔ hɔn nkyɛn:
na Sabeafo ebotu ahyɛ hɔn do, na wɔafa hɔn kɔ; nyew, wɔdze afona ekuku mberantsɛ no; na emi mara nkotsee korɛ na mefi nsa dɛ merebɛka akyerɛ wo.

Aber a n’ano da do rekasa no, nna fofor so bae, na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn ne gya fi sor atɔ, na ɔabɛhyew nguan no, na mberantsɛ no, na ɔamen hɔn; na emi mara nkotsee korɛ na mefi nsa dɛ merebɛka akyerɛ wo.

Aber a ɔno so n’ano da do rekasa no, nna fofor so bae, bɛsee dɛ, Kaldeafo abɔ kuw ebiasa, na woebotu ahyɛ efumpɔnkɔ no do, na wɔafa hɔn kɔ, nyew, wɔdze afona ekuku mberantsɛ no; na emi ara nkotsee korɛ na mefi nsa dɛ merebɛka akyerɛ wo.
Aber a n’ano da do rekasa no, nna fofor so bae bɛsee dɛ, Nna wo mbabanyin na wo mbabaa no woridzidzi na wɔronom nsa wɔ hɔn nua panyin no ne fie:
na, hwɛ, mframa kɛse fi sar no do aba abɔbɔ dan no n’etwaanan no, ma ebu egu hɔn do, ma woewuwu; na emi nkotsee korɛ na mefi nsa, dɛ merebɛka akyerɛ wo.
Nna Job soɛree, na ɔtsetseew n’atar mu, oyii ne tsir, na otwae hwee famu, na ɔsɔɔr EWURADZE:
na ɔsee dɛ, Adagyaw na medze fi me na yamu bae, na adagyaw na medze bɛsan akɔ: EWURADZE dze mae, na EWURADZE afa kɔ: nhyira nka EWURADZE ne dzin.
Na iyi nyinara mu no Job annyɛ bɔn dɛ ɔbɔbɔ Nyankopɔn sombo.
Na da bi baa bio a sor dɔm no bae dɛ woribegyina EWURADZE enyim, na Satan so dzi hɔn mu bae dɛ ɔrebɛda noho edzi wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
Na EWURADZE bisaa Satan dɛ, Ehen na ifi reba yi? Na Satan buaa EWURADZE, na ɔsee dɛ, Mifi asaase akɔnaabadzi, na no do apasapasar mu na mereba.

Na EWURADZE see Satan dɛ, Ana ihun m’akowaa Job a? Obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔno wɔ asaase no do, nyimpa a odzi mu na ɔtsen, obi a osuro Nyankopɔn, na okyir bɔn a: na ɔda ho ara dze n’emudzi no mu, kaansa ɔwo Satan enunu me etsia no dɛ mensɛɛ no kwa mpo a.
Na Satan buaa EWURADZE, na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔdze wer per wer, nyew, dza nyimpa wɔ nyinara ogyaa mu dze per no nkwa.
Na afei tsen wo nsa, na ka ne biew na no honam hwɛ ɛ, sɛ ɔnnkɔdom wo ntsɛmara a.
Na EWURADZE see Satan dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔwɔ wo nsamu; ne nkwa nko na gyaa no.
Nna Satan fii EWURADZE enyim kɔree, na ɔdze mpɔmpɔ yayaayaw kɔbobɔɔ Job fi n’ananadze kodu n’etsifi pampamu.
Na ɔfaa tankofɛr bi dɛ ɔdze rotwerɛw noho; nna ɔtse nso mu.
Nna ne yer see no dɛ, Ana eda ho dze w’emudzi mu ara? Dom Nyankopɔn, na wu.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔwo ekasa dɛ mbrɛ mbaa egyangyantwi no mu bi kasa. Ebɛnadze a? Aso yɛngye Nyankopɔn ne nsamu adze pa, na adze bɔn na mma yɛnngye anaa? Iyi nyinara mu no Job ammfa n’anofamfa annyɛ bɔn.

Afei aber a Job n’anyɛnkofo baasa tsee mbusu a aba no do yi nyinara no, nna hɔn mu obiara fi nankasa ne tsenabew bae; Temannyi Elifaz, Suhinyi Bildad na Naamatnyi Zofar; na wobehyiaa dɛ woribegyam no na wɔaakyekye no werɛ.
Na aber a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir na wɔmemaa hɔn enyi do na wohun no, woennhu dɛ ɔno a, na wɔmemaa hɔn ndze do sui; na hɔn mu obiara tsetseew n’atar mu, na wɔtotoow huntuma wɔ sor guguu hɔn etsifi.
Na wɔnye no tsenaa famu hɔ nda esuon, adzekyee na adzesaa, naaso obiara nye no annkasa: osiandɛ wohun dɛ n’amandzehu no so dodow.
Iyi n’ekyir no Job buee n’ano, na ɔdoom ne da.
Na Job see dɛ:
Wɔmma da a wɔwoo me wɔ mu no nhera, Na anadwe a wɔsee dɛ, Woenyinsen babanyin no.
Wɔmma da no nyɛ sum; Mma mma Nyankopɔn mmfi sor mmbisa ekyir kwan, Nkyii so mma kan nnhyerɛn wɔ do.
Wɔmma sum na wu no nwinwin ngye nyɛ hɔnankasa hɔndze; Wɔmma mununkum ntsena do; Wɔmma dza ɔhyɛ adzekyee sum nyinara nyi no hu.
Na adzesaa no dze, wɔmma sum kebii nkitsa no: Mma mma ɔmmfora afrenhyia nda no mu nndzi ehurusi; Mma mma ɔmmba abosoom no dodow mu.
Hwɛ, wɔmma anadwe no nyɛ kɔnn; Mma mma ehurusi ndze mmba mu.
Wɔmma hɔn a wɔdom da wɔndom no, Hɔn a wɔaben dɛ wopusuw dɛnkyɛmnyin no.
Wɔmma adansaber nworaba nhyɛ sum: Wɔmma ɔntweɔn kan, na mma onnya bi; Nkyii so mma onnhu adzekyee n’enyisoatsɛw:
Osiandɛ ɔanntow me na n’awotoa abow no mu, Na ɔammfa awerɛhow ennhuntsa m’enyi so.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mennwu wɔ awotoa mu? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na menngyaa mo sunsum mu aber a mifi yafun mu firii no?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na anankoroma gyee me? Anaa ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na motoo enumfo na munumii?
Na nkyɛ sisei meda hɔ mayɛ komm; Nkyɛ mada; ɔnodze nkyɛ menya ahomgye:
Menye ahemfo na asaase do apamfo a Wɔkyekyer amamfo ma hɔnho no;
Anaa menye mbapɔmba a wɔwɔ sika a, Wɔdze dwetɛ hyehyɛ hɔn efiefi amaama:
Anaa metse dɛ ɔponba a wɔakora no a nkyɛ minnyi hɔ; Dɛ nkɔkowaba a wonnhun kan pɛn?
Hɔ na nyimpa bɔn gyaa haw; Na hɔ na hɔn a wɔaberɛ wɔhom.
Hɔ na adaduafo nyinara hɔn ho dwe hɔn; Wɔnntse bɔmbaanyi ndze.
Hɔ na nkakraba na akɛse wɔ; Na nkowaa dzi hɔnho fi hɔn wura nsamu.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔdze kan ama nyia ɔwɔ awerɛhow mu, Na wɔdze nkwa ama hɔn a hɔn kra mu ayɛ wenwen;
Hɔn a hɔn kɔn dɔ wu, na ɔmmba; Na wɔbɔr hwehwɛ no kyɛn egyapadze a ohuntsa;
Hɔn a hɔn enyi gye mbordo, Na hɔn ho sɛpɛw hɔn, dɛ wobenya adakamona?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔdze kan ama nyimpa a wɔdze no nkwa ehuntsa, Na Nyankopɔn abɔ no ho ban?
Na m’apensi abɛhyɛ m’edziban ananmu, Na mo sufrɛ hue gu dɛ nsu.
Na adze a musuro aba mo do, Na dza n’akoma tu wɔ ho ato me.
Minnya ahodwe, nkyii so mennyɛ komm, nkyii so minnya ahomgye; Mbom ahoguan ara na ɔba.
Nna Temannyi Elifaz buaa Job dɛ,
Sɛ obi pɛ dɛ ɔka asɛm yi ho biribi a, ɔbɛyɛ wo ahomtsew anaa? Naaso meka m’ano to mu a ɔnnyɛ yie.
Hwɛ, ɔwo etu dodowara fo, Na ɔwo ahyɛ nsa a agow dzen.
Wo nsɛm ama nyia ɔrohwe ase egyina, Na ɔwo ahyɛ anankoroma a egura no dzen,
Na afei ɔtoo wo yi dze, ɔwo atɔ bahaw, Enya aka wo yi, na w’akoma etu yi?
Ana nnyɛ wo Nyamesuro nye w’awerɛhyɛmu, Na w’enyidado nye w’akwan a ɔtsen no?
Meserɛ wo, kaa, woana na odzi bem na ɔahera pɛn? Anaa ehen na woetwa atseneneefo egu da?
Dɛ mbrɛ menya nhunii no, hɔn a wofuntum emumuyɛ, Na wodua mbusu no, ɔnoara so na wobu.
Nyankopɔn n’ahomgu ma hɔn ase hyew, Na n’ebufuw mframa ma wɔhyew.
Nyew, dɛ mbrɛ gyata no pɔw, na gyata bɔyafo ne ndze, Na ngyata eburwa hɔn se bubu,
Na afonam bɔ gyata ma ntsi ɔhera, Na gyataber ne mba bɔ apetse no, Dɛmara so na owie emumuyɛfo.
Afei wɔdze asɛm bi baa me nkyɛn nsumaa mu, Na m’aso tsee no ho biribi kakra.
Adwendwen a ofi anadwe enyido adzehu mu, Aber a nda heii atɔ nyimpa do no,
Suro na ahopopo baa mo do a Ɔmaa me mbiew nyinara wosowee.
Nna sunsum twaa mu wɔ m’enyim; Mo ho nhwi soɛree gyinagyinae.
Ogyinaa hɔ komm, naaso mennhu no su; Suban bi gyinagyinaa m’enyi do. Hɔ yɛɛ dzinn, na metsee dɛ ndze bɔkɔɔ bi, rese dɛ,
Ana dasanyi bɛtsen asen Nyankopɔn? Anaa nyimpa ho bɛtsew asen ne yɛfo?
Hwɛ, no nkowaa mpo ɔmmfa werɛ nnhyɛ hɔn mu; Na n’abɔfoe no mpo ohu mfomdo wɔ hɔn mu:
Na afei akantam hɔn a wɔtse dɛtse adan mu a, Hɔn fapem wɔ huntuma mu a, Wɔfetsew hɔn dɛ abowaba?
Wɔwɔ hɔ anapa naaso obodu ewimbir na wɔasɛɛ hɔn: Wɔhera daa na obiara mmbu no hwee.
Ana wɔnntsew hɔn asesehoma wɔ hɔn mu? Wowuwu, naaso nnyɛ nyansa mu bi a.
Afei frɛ ɛ, Job, frɛ, kyerɛkyerɛ obi wɔ hɔ a obobua wo a? Na ahotseweefo mu woana na edze bɔkɔ akɛdan no?
Osiandɛ ehisɛm ku kwasea, Na nyinkuntwe ku kotobonyi.
Muhun kwasea dɛ ɔregye ndwow: Na amonmu ara na modoom ne tsenabew.
Ne mba nye nkwagye ntamu twe, Na wɔpɔtɔw hɔn wɔ kuropon mu, Nkyii so obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔgye hɔn so.
Nyia ɔkɔm dze no bedzi no ndɔbaa, Na nsoɛ mu mpo na obeyi efi, Na efir da hɔ petoo dze ma hɔn ahodze.
Na ahohia mmfi huntuma mu mmpue, Nkyii so fona mmfi famu mmfifir;
Mbom wɔwo nyimpa ma fona, Dɛ mbrɛ gyansenama so tutu fa sor no.
Sɛ emi dze a, nkyɛ mobɔhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn n’ekyir kwan, Na medze m’asɛm ahyɛ ne nsa:
Ɔno a ɔyɛ ndzɛmba akɛse a onnyi nhwehwɛmu; Anwanwadze a onnyi anobu:
Ɔno a ɔma nyankom tɔ gu asaase do, Na ɔma nsu gugu ahaban do:
Na ɔdze ahobrɛadzefo sisi mbrɛ ɔkrɔn; Na hɔn a wodzi awerɛhow no, opegya hɔn kɔ eyiedzi mu.
Ɔno na ɔma enyitseweefo nhyehyɛɛ yɛ kwa, Ma hɔn nsa nntum nnyɛ hɔn esusudze.
Ɔno na ɔkyer enyansafo wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn enyitsew mu; Na osi ndabrabafo apam tsir adze.
Wɔtɔ sum mu ewiaber, Na wɔkeka ewiaketee dɛ anadwe.
Na ɔno na ɔgye nkwa fi afona a ofi hɔn anomu no ano, Mekyerɛ kɔhweaban no fi katakyi no nsamu.
Dɛm ntsi hianyi no wɔ enyidado, Na emumuyɛ mua n’ano.
Hwɛ, homkanyi nye nyimpa a Nyankopɔn ka n’enyim: Dɛm ntsi mma mmbu Otumfo ne ntsea no enyimtsia.
Na ɔtow kam, na ɔkyekyer; Opira, na ne nsa ma ɔsa.
Obeyi wo wɔ ahohia esia mu; Nyew, dza otsia esuon no mu mpo mbusu bi rennka wo.
Ɔkɔm ber mu ɔbɛgye wo efi wu mu; Na akodzi mu so ɔagye wo efi afona ano;
Ɔbɔkora wo efi tɛkyerɛma mpire ano; Nkyii so irunnsuro ɔsɛɛ a ɔreba.
Ebɛserew ɔsɛɛ na kɔm; Nkyii so irunnsuro asaase do mbowadoma.
Na enye haban mu abo bɛyɛ nkyekyeree; Na haban mu mbowadoma nye wo benya asomdwee.
Na ibohu dɛ w’asesee wɔ asomdwee mu; Na ebɛsera wo nguamban, na erennyew hwee.
Ibohu so dɛ w’asefo adɔɔ so, Na wo mbanananom bɛyɛ dɛ asaase do nkyɛkyɛr.
Edze mfe dodow bɔkɔ w’adakamona mu, Dɛ mbrɛ wɔdze ewi efiefi ba wɔ ne ber mu no.
Hwɛ, iyi na yɛahwehwɛ mu ehu, na mbrɛ ɔtse nye yi; Tsie ɛ, na ɔwo so hu fa ma woho.
Nna Job buaa no dɛ,
Ao, kɛtseankyɛ woeeker m’awerɛhow, Na wɔdze m’amandzehu eegu nsɛn mu!
Na afei nkyɛ ɔbɛyɛ dur asen mpoano anhwea: Dɛm ntsi na me nsɛm ayɛ yerɛyerɛw yi.
Osiandɛ Otumfo no n’egyen menaba tuatua mo mu, Mo sunsum ronom no mu bɔr: Nyankopɔn ho hu aba mo do mpasuar.
Ana hamu asoaso paapaa mu aber a ɔwɔ efunoma? Anaa nantwi bobɔ mu su wɔ n’aforafora edziban do?
Anaa edziban tabrabaa wokwetsi nkyen dzi? Anaa dɛw bi wɔ nkyirefuwa mu fufuw mu?
Me kra pow dɛ ɔdze nsa bɛka; Ɔtse dɛ edziban a ɔyɛ nkɔw dze ma me.
Ao, kɛtseankyɛ meenya m’ebisadze; Na nkyɛ Nyankopɔn dze adze a mo kɔn dɔ no aama me.
Sɛ nkyɛ Nyankopɔn bɛpɛ dɛ ɔdwerew me; Na ogyaa ne nsamu, na otwa me kyen mpo a!
Ɔno nkyɛ mibenya awerɛkyekyer dɛ; Nyew, nkyɛ mibedzi ehurusi wɔ yaw a ɔso noho: Dɛ mummbuu Krɔnkrɔnnyi kor no ne nsɛm do.
Naaso m’ahoɔdzen wɔ hen, dɛ medze mobɔtweɔn? Na m’enyidado nye dɛn, dɛ mebɛyɛ ho abotar?
Ana m’ahoɔdzen yɛ abo ahoɔdzen? Anaa mo honam yɛ boran?
Ana nnyɛ mboa bi na minnyi no wɔ mo mu, Na woetu nyansa pa efi mo mu koraa?
Nyia ɔrotɔ bitsi no, ɔsɛ dɛ onya ne nyɛnko nsamu ayamuyie; Mekyerɛ nyia ɔpow Otumfo no no suro no.
Mo nuanom etwa nkontompɔ dɛ ɔwora, Dɛ suka mu nwora a ɔsen twa mu kɔ a
Nsudaa ntsi n’enyi ebir, Na esukwankyɛba suma noho wɔ mu:
Mber a ɔhyew ka no no, ɔhera: Ahohur ber mu ɔsa wɔ n’ananmu.
Akwantsemfo a wodua n’akwan mu dan fa nkyɛn: Wɔkɔ framfram no mu, na wɔhera.
Tema akwantsemfo no hwehwɛe. Seba akwantsemfo ekuwekuw no dze enyi too do.
Hɔn enyi wui dɛ wɔdze hɔn enyi too do; Wokodur hɔ, na hɔn enyim guu ase.
Na dɛmara na hom so hom tse; Hom ehu m’amandzehu yi, naaso hom nnyi tsema biara ma me.
Ana mase dɛ, Hom mma me biribi? Anaa, emi ntsi hom mfa hom ahodze mu bi nkyɛ?
Anaa, hom ngye me mfi ɔyɛfo nsamu? Na, hom mpon me mfi ahyɛdofo nsamu anaa?
Hom nkyerɛkyerɛ me, na mubomua m’ano: Na hom mma munhu dza mafom wɔ mu.
Mbrɛ nsɛm tsenenee dua na ɔyɛ dzen a: Na hom atsɛnyiyi yi dze otwuw ebɛnadze enyim?
Ana hom susu dɛ wobotwuw nsɛm enyim? Osiandɛ nyia n’enyi aber no ne nsɛm tse dɛ mframa.
Nyew, hom twe tonto wɔ egyanka mpo do, Na hom dze hom nyɛnko yɛ eguadze.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom mpɛ dɛ wɔbɛgyen enyi ahwɛ me; Na ampaara mirinndzi ator wɔ hom enyim.
Meserɛ hom, hom nsan, mma mma ntɛnkyew bi mmba; Nyew, hom nsan bio, m’asɛm tsen.
Ana ntɛnkyew bi wɔ me gyirama do? Ana mo nhumu nntum nnhu ebusudze mu?
Ana akodzi bi nnyi hɔ mma dasanyi wɔ asaase do? Na ne nda nntse dɛ paanyi nda bi a?
Dɛ mbrɛ akowaa hwehwɛ nwinwin enyiberdo, Na dɛ mbrɛ paanyi hwɛ n’apaabɔdze kwan no:
Dɛmara so na wɔama menya abosoom gyangyan, Na wɔahyehyɛ berɛ anadwe dze ama me.
Sɛ mekɛda hɔ a, mese dɛ, Aber bɛn na mobɔsoɛr? Na adzesaa mu atwe; Na adafatwitwa fon me dze kodu enyimtsetsewee.
Mo honam fura mbowaba na dɛtse atɔwatɔw; Mo wer twintwam na otuetue fofor.
Me nda ho yɛ har sen ɔwemfo n’akrokroba, Na ɔhwer dɛ enyidado bi nnyi ho.
Ao, kaa dɛ mo nkwa yɛ mframa: M’enyiwa runnhu papa bio.
Nyia ohu me n’enyiwa ronnhwɛ me bio: W’enyiwa bɛba mo do no, nna minnyi hɔ.
Dɛ mbrɛ mununkum sa na ɔhera no, Dɛmara so na nyia osian kɔ samanadze rommfow mmba bio.
Ɔrennsan mmba ne fie bio, Nkyii so wonnkohu no bio wɔ ne tsenabew.
Dɛm ntsi merennka m’ano nnto mu, Mebɛkasa wɔ mo sunsum n’ahoguan mu;
Ana meyɛ po, anaa po mu abowapɔn, Ma ɔwo edze aweɔmfo sisi mo do yi?
Sɛ mese dɛ, Me mpa bɛkyekye mo werɛ, M’adae bɔdwedwe mo nkɔmbɔdzi no a;
Nna ɔwo edze adaaso riyi me hu. Na enam enyido adzehu mu robɔ me piriw:
Ma me kra pɛ menebabɔ, Na wu mbom sen me mbiew.
Mo nkwa afon me; memmpɛ dɛ metsena ase daa; Gyaa me; na me nda yɛ egyangyandze.
Dasanyi nye woana na ɔwo ihuhor no, Na ɔwo edze w’akoma si no do,
Na ɔwo esera no anapa nyinara, Na esɔ no hwɛ aber nyinara?
Ɔwo rinnyi w’enyi mmfi mo do araa ma ekodu dabɛn, Na eso irinngyaa me araa ma ekodu dɛ mamen me ntafi?
Sɛ mayɛ bɔn a, ebɛnadze na mayɛ wo, ɔwo nyimpa weɔmfo? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze me esi hɔ dɛ wo botae, Ma mayɛ adzesoa ama moho yi?
Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na emmfa me mbrato nnkyɛ, na innyi m’emumuyɛ nnkɔ? Na afei mebɛda huntuma mu; Na ɔwo bɔhwehwɛ me enyiberdo, naaso nna minnyi hɔ bio.
Nna Suhinyi Bildad gyee do dɛ,
Aber bɛn na ebɛka iyinom ekodu? Na aber bɛn na w’anomu nsɛm bɛyɛ dɛ mframa dzendzen ekodu?
Ana Nyankopɔn kyeakyea atsɛmbu? Anaa Otumfo no bɛkyea pɛrpɛr.
Sɛ wo mba ayɛ bɔn etsia no, Na oegyaa hɔn ahyɛ hɔn mbrato nsamu a:
Sɛ ɔwoara hwehwɛ Nyankopɔn ekyir kwan enyiberdo, Na edze wo ntotɔserɛ kyerɛ Otumfo no;
Na sɛ wo ho tsew na etsen a; Ampa nkyɛ afei onkekenyan noho ama wo, Na ɔama wo tsenenee tsenabew ayɛ prɔmprɔm anaa?
Na kaansa w’ahyɛse yɛ kakraba mpo a, W’ewiei bɛyɛ kɛsenara.
Meserɛ wo, bisa tsetse mpanyin, Na ma w’enyi mbra dza hɔn egyanom ahwehwɛ mu ehu no do:
(Na hɛn dze, yefi ndeda yi ara, na yennyim hwee, Osiandɛ hɛn nda tse dɛ nwinwin wɔ asaase do:)
Ana nnyɛ hɔn na wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo, na wɔaka akyerɛ wo, Na woeyiyi nsɛm efi hɔn akoma mu?
Ana ntɔn begyina mbrɛ atɛkyɛ nnyi? Ana atsen begyina mbrɛ nsu nnyi?
Mber a ɔda ho wɔ no frɔmfrɔmyɛ mu a wonntwae nnkyenee no mpo, Ɔkyenkyen ansaana efuw biara akyenkyen:
Mbrɛ hɔn a hɔn werɛ fir Nyankopɔn nyinara hɔn akwan tse nye no; Na nyaatwomnyi n’enyidado bɛhera:
N’enyidado botwitwa, Na n’awerɛhyɛmu tse dɛ ananse ntentan.
Ɔbɔtwer ne dan, na orinngyina: Obosuo mu dzen, na ɔronnko hɔ.
Ɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm wɔ ewia enyim, Na n’abaw toto kata no ture do.
No ndwow mantamanta abo kuw ho, Ɔhɛn abo ntamu mpo.
Sɛ wɔsɛɛ no wɔ ne tsenabew a, Ɔno ɔbɛpa no, dɛ, Munnhun wo.
Hwɛ, no kwan ahosɛpɛw nye yi, Na asaase no mu na fofor fi befifir.
Hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ronntow nyimpa a odzi mu nnkyen, Nkyii so orunnsuo ebusuyɛfo no mu nngyina.
Ɔdze serew ara bɛhyɛ w’anomu ma, Na ɔdze osebɔ ahyɛ w’anofamfa mu.
Hɔn a wokyir wo bofura enyito; Na nyimpa bɔn atsenae ronnko hɔ bio.
Nna Job buaa dɛ,
Ampaara, minyim dɛ ɔtse dɛm: Na dasanyi bɛyɛ dɛn atsen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim?
Sɛ ɔpɛ dɛ ɔnye no yiyi ano a, Orunntum mmbua no apem mu kor mpo.
Ɔyɛ nyansafo wɔ akoma mu, na katakyi wɔ ahoɔdzen mu: Woana na ɔasen no kɔn wɔ no do, na oewie yie?
Ɔno na otutu mbepɔw, na wonnyim, Aber a obutuw hɔn wɔ n’ebufuw mu no.
Ɔno na ɔwosow asaase fi ne sibew, Na n’edum ho popo.
Ɔno na ɔhyɛ ewia, ma ommpue; Na ɔsosɔw nworaba ano.
Ɔno nko na ɔtserɛw ɔsor mu, Na otsiatsia po asorɛkye do.
Ɔno na ɔyɛɛ nworaba Ɔbɔɔ nda esuon, Etsekwagyan, na Aberwa na mba, Na pomu afamu mpia no.
Ɔno na ɔyɛ ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔtra nhwehwɛmu; Nyew, ndzɛmba nwanwa a wonntum mmbu ano.
Hwɛ, ɔnam me nkyɛn sen, na munnhu no: Otwa mu kɔ so, na mennhyɛ no nsew.
Hwɛ, okukur afonam no, woana na ɔbɛsan no ekyir? Woana na obotum ase no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ereyɛ yi?
Nyankopɔn ronntwe n’ebufuw nnsan; Rahab aboafo brɛ hɔnho adze wɔ n’ase.
Na burbur ayɛ dɛ emi na mubobua no, Na mibeyiyi me nsɛm dɛ menye no bɛsensan?
Ɔno na sɛ metsen mpo a, nkyɛ murummbua no; Mibedzi ntotɔserɛ akyerɛ me tamfo.
Sɛ mefrɛ na ɔgye me do mpo a; Nkyɛ merenngye nndzi dɛ ɔayɛ aso ama me ndze.
Osiandɛ ɔdze ehum pusuw me, Na ɔma m’epirakur dɔɔ so ara yie.
Ɔremma me kwan ma munngu ahom, Na ɔdze bɔwema ahyɛ me ma tɔ.
Sɛ yɛreka no akatakyi ahoɔdzen do a, hwɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ! Na sɛ atsɛmbu so do a, nkyɛ woana bɛsaman no ama me?
Sɛ metsen mpo a, nkyɛ mankasa m’ano bobu me fɔ: Sɛ midzi mu mpo a, ɔbɛma makyea.
Midzi mu dze, naaso mummbu moho bi, mo nkwa afon me.
Ne nyinara kor; dɛm ntsi na mese dɛ, Ɔsɛɛ nyia odzi mu, na dzebɔnyɛnyi no so.
Sɛ mpire no ku obi awerɛfirmu a, Osi hɔn a wodzi bem hɔn amandzehu atwetwe.
Sɛ asaase kedzi nyimpa bɔn no nsamu a: Ɔno Nyankopɔn na ɔkatakata n’atsɛmbuafo enyi; Sɛ ɔnnyɛ ɔno a, nna woana a?
Afei me nda ho yɛ har sen mbirikatufo: Wotu kɔ, wonnhu papa biara.
Wotwa mu kɔ dɛ ndzɛmbir ahɛn: Dɛ korpɔn a ɔtow fa afonam do.
Sɛ mese dɛ mo werɛ befir m’awerɛhow, Mibegyaa m’enyim botooyɛ, na m’enyim atsew a:
Me yaw nyinara yɛ me hu, Minyim dɛ irummbu me bem.
Na sɛ wobobu me fɔ dze a, Ebɛnadze ntsi na mebɛberɛ gyan yi?
Sɛ medze esukwankyɛba nsu hohor moho, Na meyɛ me nsa ho wansawansa dɛn ara mpo a:
Ɔwo edze me bɔto adɛtsebir amona no mu, Na mankasa me ntar mpo bekyir me.
Na ɔnnyɛ nyimpa dɛ emi, na meebua no, Ma hɛn beenu yeehyia asɛndzii.
Hɛn ntamu sɛntwamunyi bi nnyi hɔ a Ɔdze ne nsa bɔto hɛn beenu nyina do.
Ma onyi n’abaa mfi mo do, Na mma mma no ho hu nnkitsa me:
Nna nkyii nkyɛ mebɛkasa, a murunnsuro no; Naaso munnkotum dɛm yɛ wɔ mankasa m’afamu.
Mo nkwa afon me kra; Mebɛma m’apensi kwan; Mebɛkasa wɔ me kra n’awerɛhow mu.
Mebɛse Nyankopɔn dɛ, Mma mmbu me fɔ; Kyerɛ me adze kor a osian ntsi ma enye me ridzi esi yi.
Ana oye ma wo dɛ ɔwo etseetsee obi, Dɛ ɔwo ibu wo nsaano edwuma enyimtsia, Na ehyerɛn nyimpa bɔn n’apam do?
Ana ɔwo ewɔ honam enyiwa, Anaa ɔwo ehwɛ adze dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa hwɛ?
Ana wo nda tse dɛ dasanyi nda? Anaa wo mfe tse dɛ dasanyi dze,
Ma ɔwo erohwehwɛ m’emumuyɛ ekyir kwan, Na idzi mo bɔn ekyir atwee yi?
Naaso ɔwoara inyim dɛ mennyɛ nyimpa bɔn; Na obi nnyi hɔ a obotum agye efi wo nsamu?
Wo nsa na ɔyɛɛ me na ɔween me nyimpa mu nyina hyiae; Nna ɔwoara resɛɛ me yi.
Meserɛ wo, kaa dɛ ɔwo na eween me dɛ awendɛtse: Na aso edze me bɛba huntuma mu bio?
Ana ɔwoara innhuee me nnguu dɛ numfonsu, Na emma mimmpiw dɛ numfonsudaa?
Ɔwo na edze wer na honam edura mo ho, Na edze mbiew na ntsin ewurawura mo mu.
Ɔwo na adom me nkwa na enyimpa, Na wo nhwɛdo pa no so akora mo sunsum do.
Naaso iyinom na edze siee w’akoma mu; Mehu dɛ iyi na edze etsia me:
Sɛ meyɛ bɔn a, ɔno ɔwoara na ebɔ me nyikam, Na ɔwo rummbu me bem wɔ m’emumuyɛ ho.
Sɛ meyɛ nyimpa bɔn a, mundue; Na sɛ meyɛ tseneneenyi mpo a, meremma me tsir do; Enyimguase ahyɛ me ma Na ɔwoara hwɛ m’amandzehu.
Na sɛ me tsir ma noho do a, ɔwo ibetsiw me dɛ gyata: Na ɔwo asan nye me ebedzi anwanwasɛm.
Ɔwo edze w’adasefo afofor ba mo do, Na ema w’ebufuhyew dɔɔ so wɔ mo do; Nsakyer na akodzi esi m’enyim.
Ebɛnadze ntsi na iyii me fii awotoa mu bae? Ao, sɛ migyaa mo sunsum mu na enyiwa bi ennhu me ɛ.
Kɛtseankyɛ meyɛɛ dɛ mammbabra koraa; Nkyɛ wɔdze me fii yafun mu kɔr adakamona mu.
Ana me nda nnyɛ kakrabaabi bi? Dɛm a sianka, Na gyaa me, ma minnya akomatɔmu kakra,
Ansaana makɔ beebi mbrɛ merennsan mmba, Mekyerɛ sum na wu no nwinwin asaase no do:
Sum kebii asaase a, ɔtse dɛ sum noara; Owu no nwinwin asaase a nhyehyɛɛ biara nnyi hɔ, Na beebi mbrɛ kan no tse dɛ sum kebii no a.
Nna Naamatnyi Zofar gyee do dɛ,
Ana edwen dɛ obiara rinnyi wo nsɛm dodow yi ano? Na aso wɔbɛma nyimpa anobɛrbɛrnyi yi edzi bem?
Ana wo ntuw bɛma nyimpa aka hɔn ano ato mu? Na sɛ ɔwo si atwetwe a, aso nyimpa biara nnkɛhyɛ wo enyito anaa?
Na ɔwo ese dɛ, Me nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ pefee na odzi mu, Na mo ho tsew wɔ Nyankopɔn n’enyiwa mu.
Ao kɛtseankyɛ Nyankopɔn aakasa, Na oebue n’ano wɔ wo do;
Na nkyɛ ɔakyerɛ wo nyansa n’esumasɛm, Dɛ nyansa mapa no mu dɔ yie. Dɛm ntsi hu dɛ Nyankopɔn retsea wo kakraba sen dza ɔfata w’emumuyɛ.
Ana ɔwo ibotum afa nhwehwɛmu do ehu Nyankopɔn? Anaa ɔwo ibotum ehu Otumfo no ewie pɛr?
Ɔkrɔn sen sor; ibotum ebɛnadze yɛ? Ɔdɔ sen samanadze; ebɛnadze na inyim?
No nsusui war sen asaase, Na ɔtserɛw sen po.
Sɛ ɔtsew mu ba, na ɔtow mu, Na ɔfrɛ asɛndzii a, ɔno woana na obotum esiw no kwan?
Na ɔno na onyim nyimpa huhuw: Ohu emumuyɛ so, kaansa ɔnndwen ho mpo a.
Dɛ mbrɛ haban mu asoaso nnkotum adan nyimpa no, Dɛmara so na nyimpa huhuw nnyim nyansa biara.
Sɛ ɔwo ibesiesie w’akoma yie, Na adan wo nsamu akyerɛ no a;
Sɛ emumuyɛ wɔ wo nsamu a, yi kɔ ekyir, Na mma mma ɔbrakyew nntsena w’asesee mu;
Ampa, ɔno na ebɛma w’enyi do dɛ nkekaa biara nnyi ho; Nyew, ibetsim hɔ pintsinn, na innkosuro:
Na wo werɛ befir w’awerɛhow; Ebɛkaa no dɛ esu a oetwa mu kɔ:
Na wo nkwaber bɛhyerɛn dɛ ewiaber; Kaansa sum gye mpo a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛ adzekyee.
Na wo ho bɛyɛ sɔkyee, osiandɛ enyidado wɔ hɔ; Nyew, ebɔhwehwɛ woho ehyia, na agye w’ahom dwudwoodwo.
Eso ɔwo ebɛda, na obiara rinnyi wo hu; Na dodowara bedzi w’enyim ntotɔserɛ.
Na ndzebɔnyɛfo dze, hɔn enyiwa do besiw hɔn, Na wonnkenya kwan biara afa do eguan, Na hɔn enyidado bɛyɛ dɛ ɔkra ne ngyaamu.
Nna Job buaa dɛ,
Nyew, hom nye ɔman no ne ndze! Na sɛ hom wu a, nna nyansa so ewu.
Na mbom mo so mowɔ ntseasee dɛ homara; Monntɔ mu wɔ hom enyim koraa: Nyew, woana na onnyim ndzɛmba a ɔtse dɛm yi?
Metse dɛ obi a ɔyɛ sesɛba wɔ hom enyi do, Nyimpa a ɔfrɛ Nyankopɔn, na ɔgye no do, Nyimpa tsenenee a odzi mu no, ema ɔyɛ sesɛba?
Nyia no ho adwe no no ommbu nyia oruhu amandze no bi wɔ n’adwen mu; Ɔyɛ no dɛ oesiesie ama hɔn a hɔn anan retserew nko.
Edwotwafo asetsena mu yɛ prɔmprɔm; Mpo hɔn a woyi Nyankopɔn ebufuw so tse hɔ komm; Hɔn a hɔn nyame nye hɔn ahoɔdzen no a.
Na afei bisa mbowa, na wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo, Na wimu ntumbowa, na wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo:
Anaa kasa kyerɛ asaase, na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo; Na po mu nam bɛda no edzi akyerɛ wo.
Woana na onnyim wɔ yinom nyinara mu, Dɛ EWURADZE ne nsa na ɔayɛ iyi?
Ɔno ne nsamu na atseasefo nyinara hɔn kra wɔ. Na adasa nyinara hɔn ahom wɔ.
Ana nnyɛ asowa na ɔsɔ asɛm hwɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ adadaw so sɔ n’edziban hwɛ bi a?
Nkɔdaayɛ mu na nyansa wɔ, Na nda tsentsen mu na ntseasee wɔ.
Ɔno no mu na nyansa na tum wɔ, Ɔno na ɔwɔ apam na ntseasee.
Hwɛ, ɔno na odwuruw, na wonntum nntow bio; Ɔno na ɔtow nyimpa mu, na wonntum mmbue.
Hwɛ, ɔno na ɔkam nsu ma ɔwew; Eso, ɔno na ogyaa mu na ɔpram asaase do.
Ɔno no mu na ahoɔdzen na nyansa wɔ; Nyia wɔdaadaa no na ɔdaadaafo no nyina yɛ nedze.
Ɔto apamfo pan dze hɔn kɔ, Na ɔma atsɛmbuafo yɛ nkwasea.
Ɔno na ɔsansan ahemfo nkyehoma, Na ɔdze abɔdo kyekyer hɔn asen.
Ɔto asɔfo pan dze hɔn kɔ, Na obutuw akatakyi.
Ɔno na oyi nokwafo ano kasa kɔ, Na ɔgye mpanyimfo nyimdzee.
Ɔno na ohue enyimtsiabu gu mbapɔmba do, Na ɔsansan ahoɔdzenfo abɔyamu.
Ɔno na oyi adze a no mu dɔ edzi fi sum mu, Na ɔdze wu no nwinwin fir edzi ba kan mu.
Ɔno na ɔma amanaman dɔɔ so, na ɔsɛɛ hɔn: Ɔno na ɔbɔ amanaman mu, na ogya hɔn kɔ.
Ɔno na ɔgye asaase do ɔman mu etsitsir hɔn akoma, Na ɔma wokyin wɔ sar do mbrɛ ɔkwan bi nnyi hɔ.
Wɔkeka wɔ sum a kan nnyi hɔ mu, Na ɔma wokyin dɛ sabokwanyi.
Hwɛ, m’enyiwa ehu iyi nyinara, M’aso atse na ɔatse ase.
Dza hom nyim no, ɔnoara na mo so minyim: Monntɔ mu wɔ hom enyim.
Ampa mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ menye Otumfo no bɛkasa, Na morohwehwɛ dɛ menye Nyankopɔn beyiyi nsɛm ano.
Na hom dze, hom yɛ atorfo mapa, Hom nyinara hom yɛ ayarsafo a wɔnntow bo.
Ao, kɛtseankyɛ hom mua hom ano koraa! Na nkyɛ mbom hom nyansaa nye no.
Afei hom ntsie m’atsɛnyi, Na hom nyɛ aso mma me nyiano.
Ana hom bɛka no dza ɔnntsen mu ama Nyankopɔn, Na hom akasa ndaadaa mu ama no a?
Ana hom bɛgye ne tsir? Na hom aham ama Nyankopɔn anaa?
Ana oye dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɔhwehwɛ hom mu ehu? Anaa dɛ mbrɛ obi daadaa nyimpa no, hom so bɛdaadaa no?
Ɔbɛka hom enyim ampa, Sɛ hom hwɛ nyimpa enyim nsumaa mu a.
Ana n’akɛseyɛ nnkɛma hom akoma etu, Na no ho hu nnkɔtɔ hom do?
Hom akasabɛbu yɛ nso mbɛbusɛm, Hom akoban yɛ awendɛtse akoban.
Hom mmua hom ano, hom ngyaa me, ma menkasa, Na wɔmma dza ɔbɛba mo do mbra.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mebɛfa mo honam etua me se mu, Na mafa mo nkwa ekitsa me nsamu?
Sɛ oruku me mpo a, ɔnoara na mohwɛ: M’akwan ara nko na mebɛper ho wɔ n’enyim.
Iyi so na ɔbɛyɛ mo nkwagye, Dɛ nyia onnsuro Nyame no remmba n’enyim.
Hom ntsie me kasaa enyiberdo, Na wɔmma m’asɛm a mepaa mu ka nkɔ hom asomu.
Afei hwɛ, mahyehyɛ m’asɛm; Minyim dɛ midzi bem.
Woana nye nyia ɔnye me bedzi esi? Na afei mubomua m’ano, na megyaa mo sunsum mu.
Ao, EWURADZE, adze ebien pɛr na meserɛ wo dɛ mma mmfa nnyɛ me, Ɔno na mubotum aba w’enyim:
Twe wo nsa fi mo do kɔ ekyirekyir: Na mma mma wo ho hu nnkitsa me.
Na nkyii frɛ, na mebɛgye wo do: Anaa ma menkasa, na ɔwoara bua me.
M’emumuyɛ na mo bɔn yɛ ahen ara? Ma munhu me mbrato na mo bɔn.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ihuntsa w’enyim, Na ibu me wo tamfo yi?
Ana ebɛtaa ahataw a mframa robɔ no kyin do? Na etsiw eburonan a eguan?
Na ɔwo ekyerɛw nsɛm wenwen dze tsia me, Na ema midzi me mbofrabermu emumuyɛ ho adze:
Ɔwo na edze m’anan so hyehyɛ apo mu, na ehyɛ m’akwan nyinara nsew; Ɔwo na itwa m’ananadze ho he:
Ntsi meresɛɛ dɛ adze prɔwee a ohi, Dɛ atar a mbowaba awewe.
Nyimpa a ɔbaa wo no, Ne nda kumaabi, na ɔfona ma.
Ɔba sor dɛ nhyiren, na wotwa to famu: Oguan so dɛ nwinwin, na ɔnnko hɔ.
Aso obi a ɔtse dɛm yi na ɔwo ibue w’enyiwa wɔ no do, Na edze me kɔ w’enyim atsɛmbu mu yi?
Woana na obotum dze adze a no ho tsew efi dza no ho nntsew mu aba? Oho, obiara runntum.
Osiandɛ ne nda wɔahyɛ ato hɔ, n’abosoom no dodow wɔ wo hɔ, Na ɔwo etwa no he a orunntum nntra;
Yi w’enyi fi no do, ma ɔnhom, Nkodu dɛ obowie ne da dɛ paanyi.
Na dua mpo enyidado wɔ ho, dɛ sɛ wotwa kyen a, ɔbɛfefɛw bio, Na no nkorbata fɔr no remmpa.
Kaansa no ndwow yɛ dadaw wɔ dɛtse mu, Na no dusin wu wɔ famu mpo a:
Ɔnam nsu na hua do ɔbɛfefɛw, Na oeyiyi abaw dɛ dua a wɔatsɛw.
Na nyimpa dze owu na ɔbea hɔ, Nyew, nyimpa gyaa no sunsum mu, na ɔwɔ hen?
Dɛ mbrɛ nsu fi po mu kɔ no, Na esutsen huam, na ɔwew no;
Dɛmara so na nyimpa da hɔ na ɔnnsoɛr: Ɔsor nnyae nntwaa mu yi worinnyan, Na eso worummpusuw hɔn mmfi hɔn nda mu.
Ao, kɛtseankyɛ ɔwoara edze me eehuntsa ekodu samanadze, Nkyɛ ɔwoara edze me eesuma, ekodu dɛ w’ebufuw botwa mu, Nkyɛ ɔwoara aahyɛ me mber, na aakaa me!
Aso nyimpa wu a, ɔbɛtsena ase bio anaa? Dɛm ntsi m’akodzi nda nyinara mobɔtweɔn, Ekodu dɛ me nsakyeree bɛba.
Ɔwo ebɛfrɛ, na emi so magye wo do: Ibenya akɔndɔ wɔ wo nsaano edwuma ho.
Na afei dze ɔwo bɛkan m’anamɔn: Na erenntsɛw mo bɔn.
Wɔasɔw me mbrato ano ahyɛ kotoku mu. Na ɔwo akyekyer m’emumuyɛ ano.
Ampa bepɔw a orutu ahwe ase no, ohi, Na botan twe fi n’ananmu;
Na nsu hi abo; Na ne nyirii hohor famu huntuma kɔ no, Dɛmara so na ɔwo esɛɛ dasanyi n’enyidado;
Idzi no do nyim koraa, na otwa mu kɔ; Ɔwo esakyer n’enyim, na igya no kwan ma ɔkɔ.
Sɛ ne mba ba nya enyimnyam mpo a, onnyim; Na wɔbrɛ hɔn adze so a, onnhu.
Nankasa no honanyaw nko na ɔtse, Na ne kra a ɔwɔ no mu so dzi yaw.
Nna Temannyi Elifaz buaa dɛ,
Ana nyansafo dze nyimdzee gyan bobua, Na ɔdze boka mframa ahyɛ ne yafun ma?
Ana ɔdze kasa a mfaso nnyi ho beyi atsɛn, Anaa asɛnka a orunntum mmfa nnyɛ papa biara?
Nyew, ɔwo etow Nyamesuro kyen, Na isiw mpaabɔ kwan wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na w’ano kyerɛ w’emumuyɛ, Na ɔwo asan mu afa enyitseweefo tɛkyerɛma.
Wankasa w’ano na obu wo fɔ, na nnyɛ emi bi a; Nyew, wankasa w’anofamfa na odzi dase tsia wo.
Ana ɔwo nye nyimpa a wodzii kan woo no? Anaa wɔwoo wo ansaana wɔreyɛ akoko?
Ana atse Nyankopɔn no nsumaa mu egyinatu? Na isianka nyansa dze ma woho yi?
Ebɛnadze na ɔwo inyim a hɛn yennyim? Ebɛnadze na ɔwo etse ase a ohuntsa hɛn?
Hwɛ etsigonfo na nkɔdaa posoposo nyina wɔ hɛn mu a Wɔyɛ mpanyin koraa sen w’egya mpo.
Aso Nyankopɔn n’awerɛkyekyer na asɛm a wɔnye wo ka no bɔkɔɔ no, suar dodow ma wo anaa?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’akoma soa wo kɔ? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ema w’enyiwa bubu pɛrpɛr yi?
Dɛ ɔwo edze w’ebufuw gu Nyankopɔn do, Na ema dɛm nsɛm yi fi w’anomu ba.
Dasanyi nye woana a no ho bɛtsew? Na nyia ɔbaa awo no, dɛ ɔbɛtsen?
Hwɛ, Nyankopɔn mmfa werɛ nnhyɛ n’akrɔnkrɔmfo mpo mu; Nyew, sorsor mpo ho nntsew wɔ n’enyi do.
Na bubur nyia no ho yɛ nkɔw na ɔaprɔw, Nyimpa a ɔanom emumuyɛ dɛ nsu:
Hwɛ mebɛkyerɛ wo, na ɔwo tsie me; Na dza mehu no mebɛka akyerɛ:
Dza enyansafo aka akyerɛ a Ofi hɔn egyanom hɔ, na wɔammfa ennsuma no a;
Hɔn nko na wɔdze asaase no maa hɔn, Na ɔhɔho biara enntwa mu wɔ hɔn mu:
Nyimpa bɔn ne nda nyinara tse dɛ basia a ɔdze yaw ko awoo, Na wɔdze mfe a wɔakan esie ama hyɛdofo.
Ihu ne nka gyegye n’aso mu; Prɔmprɔmyɛ mu na ɔsɛɛfo no bɛba no do:
Ɔnngye nndzi dɛ ɔbɛsan efi sum mu, Na afona da hɔ rotweɔn no:
Okyima hwehwɛ edziban, obisa dɛ, Ɔwɔ henfa? Onyim dɛ sum da bɛn ne nkyɛn:
Ahohia na ahoguan yi no hu; Wodzi no do nyim, dɛ ɔhen a oesiesie noho ama ɔko a ɔyɛ hu:
Osiandɛ ɔatsen ne nsa etsia Nyankopɔn, Na odzi nkontompɔsɛm tsia Otumfo no:
Ɔdze kɔn a ɔasen tutu kɔ no do, Ɔnye n’akyɛm ho apɔwapɔw a no mu yɛ dur no:
Osiandɛ ɔdze ne seradze akata n’enyim, Na ɔayɛ seradze nankum wɔ ne nkyɛnmu:
Na ɔakɛtsena ekurow a woegu do, Efi a nyimpa biara nntsena mu a Ɔaka no dɛ ɔndan efitu mu.
Orinnya noho, nkyii so n’ahodze rinngyina, Nkyii so hɔn nsowee ronnkontom mmba famu.
Orimmfi sum mu mmfi. Ogyaframee bɛma no ndubaa eguan, Na n’anomu mframa bɛpra akɔ.
Mma mma ɔnntwer egyangyandze, nndaadaa noho: Na egyangyandze ara na ɔbɛyɛ n’akatua.
Ɔbɛyɛ hɔ ansaana ne mber aso, Na no dubaa rennyɛ frɔmfrɔm.
Ɔbɔporow n’esikyireamba bun dɛ wenyindua, Na ɔapo ne nhyiren dɛ ngodua.
Na ndabrabafo fɛkuw bɛyɛ abɔnyin, Na gya bɛhyew mboabagye asesee.
Wonyinsen ewurkadze, na wɔwo emumuyɛ, Na hɔn yamu siesie ndaadaa.
Nna Job buaa dɛ,
Matse nsɛm a ɔtsetse dɛm pii: Hom nyinara hom yɛ nkɔmbɔhundzifo.
Aso nsɛm huhuw yi bɔbɔ adze nye yi? Anaa ebɛnadze na ohur wo bo ma ibua?
Mo so mubotum akasa dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ; Sɛ hom wɔ me gyinabew yi mu a, Nkyɛ mubotum ahɔr nsɛm egu hom do, Na mawosow me tsir wɔ hom do.
Nyew, nkyɛ medze m’ano bɛhyɛ hom dzen, Na menam m’anofamfa awerɛkyekyer do ama hom awerɛhow aabotow.
Sɛ mekasa a, m’awerɛhow rommbotow: Na sɛ migyaa so mpo a, ebɛnadze na mibenya efi mu?
Ao, Nyankopɔn, afei dze ama maberɛ: Ɔwo ama me fɛkuw nyinara egu.
Ɔwo edze mpomponee ahyɛ me ma a odzi me dase: Na mo fɔn ayɛ kɛse na, odzi dase wɔ m’enyim.
Nyankopɔn atsetsew me wɔ n’ebufuw mu, na ɔyɛ me enyienyi; Ɔatwɛr ne se egu mo do: Na ɔdze enyitanhwɛ hwɛ me.
Wɔahanhan hɔn anomu wɔ mo do; Wɔabobɔ m’asomu enyimguase mu: Wɔka hɔnho boa ano tsia me.
Nyankopɔn dze me ahyɛ hɔn a wonnyim Nyame nsa, Na ɔatow me akyen ndzebɔnyɛfo nsamu.
Nna mo ho dwe me, naaso Nyankopɔn ebubu mo mu, Nyew, oesuo mo kɔn, na ɔabobɔ me posoposo: Ɔdze me esi hɔ so ayɛ no botae.
N’egyentofo etwa mo ho ehyia, Ɔpaa me nsɛbɛ mu, na onngyaa; Ohue no bɔwema gu famu.
Ɔdwerew me dze dwerew paa dwerew do: Otutu ba mo do dɛ ɔbran katakyi.
Mapam eyitam akata mo wer do, Na medze m’ambɛn ato huntuma mu.
Osu ntsi m’enyim ayɛ nkɔnkɔw, Na owu nwinwin wɔ m’enyisoatsɛw do;
Naaso enyiber bi nnyi me nsamu, Na me mpaabɔ yɛ krɔnkrɔn.
Asaase e, mma nnkata mo bɔgyaa do, Na mma mma mo sufrɛ nnya ahomgyebea.
Seseiara mpo, hwɛ, me dasefo wɔ sor, Na nyia ɔka ma me wɔ mbrɛ ɔkrɔn.
Me mfɛfo si me atwetwe: Na Nyankopɔn na m’enyiwa porow nyinsuwa kyerɛ no;
Ao, nkyɛ obi atotɔ aserɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim ama me, Dɛ nyimpa ba totɔ serɛ wɔ ne nyɛnko enyim:
Na aka mfe kakrabaabi, Mobɔkɔ kwan a merennsan memmba no.
Mo sunsum asa, me nda ahwer, Adakamona wɔ hɔ ma me.
Ampaara atwetwesifo wɔ me nkyɛn, Na m’enyiwa tua hɔn ehiyi.
Afei woara dzi me egyinamu ɛ, ao Nyankopɔn; Na woana na ɔwɔ hɔ a ɔbɛka bi ama me?
Osiandɛ ɔwo eyi hɔn akoma efi ntseasee ho esuma: Dɛm ntsi eremma wonndzi mo do nyim.
Nyia oyi ne mfɛfo ma afonam no, Ne mba enyiwa mpo bofura.
Nyankopɔn ayɛ mo so ɔman akasabɛbu; Na madan obi a wohinahina n’enyi do ntafi.
Awerɛhow ntsi m’enyiwa so ayɛ kusukusu; Na m’akwaa nyinara ayɛ dɛ nwinwin.
Nyimpa a wɔtsen na hɔn ho bɔbow hɔn wɔ yi ho, Na nyia odzi bem no bekenyan noho etsia dabrabanyi.
Naaso tseneneenyi bosuo no kwan mu ara, Na nyia ne nsa ho tsew no benya ahoɔdzen aka ho:
Na hom nsan, hom nyinara, na afei hom mbra: Na murunnhu nyansafo biara wɔ hom mu.
Me nda etwa mu, me tsirmpɔw ebubu, M’akoma mu adwen mpo so.
Wɔdan adzesaa adzekyee: Wɔse dɛ, Kan bɛn sum ho.
Sɛ mobɔhwɛ samanadze kwan dɛ ɔyɛ me fie; Na matow me mpa wɔ sum mu;
Sɛ mebɛse mpɔtɔwee dɛ, Ɔwo nye m’egya; Na nsaamaa dɛ, Ɔwo nye me na, anaa m’akyerɛbaa a;
Na dɛm a m’enyidado wɔ henfa? Ana obi botum ehu m’enyidado?
Oho, obesian nye me akɔ samanadze adaban no mu, Na yɛbɔbɔ mu agye hɛn ahom wɔ huntuma mu.
Nna Suhinyi Bildad buaa dɛ,
Na hom rusuasua nsɛm mfir araa ma ekodu dabɛn? Hom ndwen ho, na n’ekyir no yɛakasa.
Ebɛnadze ntsi na ibu hɛn dɛ mbowa, Na yɛayɛ dɛ akwasampafo wɔ w’enyi do yi?
Ɔwo a etsetsew woho gu wɔ w’ebufuw mu, Aso wɔbɔpow asaase wɔ wo ntsi? Anaa wobotutu abotan efi n’ananmu?
Nyew, dzebɔnyɛnyi ne kandzea bodum, Na ne gyansenama rennhyerɛn.
Kan bɛdan sum wɔ n’asesee mu, Na ne kandzea edum wɔ no do.
N’ahoɔdzen anamɔn bomua, Na nankasa n’apam ahwe no ase.
Na nankasa n’anan dze no akɔtoto eboa mu, Na ɔanantsew wɔ ngor do.
Bɛmba bosuo n’anantsir, Na efir ata esuo no mu.
Wɔdze ahoturoho efir ehuntsa no wɔ famu, Na woesua no apafir wɔ kwan mu.
Ihu bɛhyɛ n’akoma do wɔ beebiara, Na woetsiw no wɔ n’anantsir.
N’ahoɔdzen bɔtɔ bitsi, Na mbusu ayɛ krado ama ne ngyinae.
Obedzi ne nyimpadua n’akwaa no, Nyew, owu n’abakan bedzi n’akwaa.
Wobotu no efi n’asesee a no werɛ hyɛ mu no mu; Na wɔdze no abrɛ hu hen no.
Wɔdze sɔfee bɛtsew ne tsenabew: Na nyia ɔnnyɛ nedze mu bi na ɔbɛtsena n’asesee mu.
No ndwow bɛkyenkyen wɔ ase, Na woetwitwa n’abaw wɔ sor.
Ne nkaa bɛhyew efi asaase do, Na orinnya dzin wɔ abɔntsen do.
Wɔbɛpam no efi kan mu akɔ sum mu, Na wɔatam no efi wiadze.
Onnkenya ba na banana so wɔ ne manmu, Nkyii so onnkenya kyirkafo biara wɔ mbrɛ ɔkɛtsenae no.
Hɔn a wobefi anee no hɔn ho bɔbow hɔn wɔ ne da no ho, Dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wofii boka no nketsenketse kyeer hɔn no.
Ampaara dɛm na abrakyewfo tsenabew tsetsee, Na yi nye nyia onnyim Nyankopɔn no ne gyinabew.
Na Job buaa dɛ,
Hom beyi me kra ahomtsew, Na wɔdze nsɛm ebubu me pasaa araa ma ekodu dabɛn?
Mpɛn ara du nye yi na hom asopa me: Aso hom enyi nnto dɛ hom nye me dzi no wenwen dɛm?
Na sɛ ampaara mpo dɛ mafom a, Mo mfom da mara mo do.
Sɛ ampa dɛ hom bɛmema homho do etsia me, Na hom eyi me m’enyimguase ho atsɛn a:
Ɔno dze hom nhu dɛ Nyankopɔn ebutuw no ama me, Na ɔdze no boa etwa moho ehyia.
Hwɛ, metsea mu dɛ, Akatabansɛm o, naaso wɔnngye me do: Musu mefrɛ mboa, naaso ɔgye bi nnyi hɔ.
Nyankopɔn esi mo kwan do ban ma munntum munntwa mu, Na ɔama sum ahyehyɛ m’atsempɔn do.
Ɔno na ɔapa m’enyimnyam efi mo ho, Na oeyi me tsir abɔtsir.
Ɔno na oebubu m’afa nyina, na minnyi hɔ: Na oetu m’enyidado dɛ dua.
Ɔno na eso ɔama n’ebufuw dzɛw wɔ mo do, Na obu me dɛ n’atamfo no mu bi.
No dɔm horow bɔɔ mu bae, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn kwan baa mo do, Na wɔkyeer nsera bɔɔ m’asesee ho aprɔw.
Ɔno na oeyi mo nuanom efi mo ho akɔ ekyirekyir, Na m’amanyimfo adandan me ananaben koraa.
M’ebusuafo apow me, Na m’anyɛnko berɛbo werɛ efir me.
Hɔn a wɔtsetse me fi mu, na me mbaawa mpo bu me ɔhɔho: Meyɛ nanaben wɔ hɔn enyi do.
Mefrɛ m’akowaa, na ɔnngye me do, Kaansa medze m’ano mepa no kyɛw mpo a.
M’ahomgu mpo adan atantandze ama me yer, Na moho afon me na yamu mba.
Mbofraba nkakraba mpo bu me enyimtsia; Na sɛ mosoɛr a, wɔkasa tsiatsia me.
Me mbanyin apamfo nyinara kyir me kɔkɔɔkɔ: Na hɔn a modɔ hɔn adan hɔnho etsia me.
Me biew afam mo wer na mo honam ho, Na aka ketseketse ma nkyɛ mahwer mo nkwa.
Ao hom me mfɛfo, hom nhu me mbɔbɔr, hom nhu me mbɔbɔr ae; Na Nyankopɔn ne nsa na aka me.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom tsiw me dɛ Nyankopɔn, Na mo honam ara mmee hom yi?
Ao kɛtseankyɛ afei wɔaakyerɛw me nsɛm! Ao ankyɛ wɔdze aahyɛ nwoma mu!
Dɛ nkyɛ wɔdze dadze kyerɛwdze na sumbui Eekrukye no wɔ botan mu ato hɔ daa:
Na emi dze, minyim dɛ mo pomfo tse ase, Na ewiei no, ɔbɛba ebedzi m’asɛm ama me wɔ asaase yi do:
Na mo wer asɛɛ dɛm ekyir no, Mpo mifi mo honam mu mubohu Nyankopɔn.
Ɔno na mobɔhwɛ no ama moho, Na m’enyiwa bohu, na nnyɛ obi fofor a. Ao, mbrɛ me nsɛbɛ si wosow wɔ mo mu a!
Sɛ hom se dɛ, Yebesi dɛn etsiw no, Osiandɛ woehu asɛm no no ndwow wɔ mo mu a;
Ɔno homara so, hom nsuro afona no: Na ebufuhyew na ɔdze afona ne ntsea ba, Ama hom eehu dɛ atsɛmbu bi wɔ hɔ.
Nna Naamatnyi Zofar buaa dɛ,
Dɛm ntsi na m’adwen yɛ me dɛ mumbua wo, Osiandɛ mehaahaa.
Matse nkaenyim a ogu m’enyim ase, Na me ntseasee hyɛ me tsipia dɛ mumbua.
Ana ɔwo innyim iyi a ofi tsetseberdo, Ofitsi dɛ wɔdze nyimpa too asaase do no,
Dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo eyiedzi yɛ tsia, Na ndabrabafo ehurusidzi nnkyɛr?
Kaansa n’akɛseyɛ fow kɔ sor, Na ne tsir kɛka mununkum mpo a;
Ɔbɛsɛɛ korakora dɛ nankasa n’egyanan. Hɔn a woehu no no bebisa dɛ, Ɔwɔ hen?
Obotu akɔ dɛ adaaso, na worunnhu no, Nyew, wobetsiw no dɛ anadwe enyido adzehu.
Enyiwa a ohun no no runnhu no bio; Nkyii so ne tsenabew runnhu no bio.
Ne mba bɔhwehwɛ abɔbɔfo hɔ enyimpa, Na ne nsa eyi n’ahonyadze asan ama.
Ne mberantsɛber mu ahoɔdzen hyɛɛ ne mbiew amaama. Na mbom ɔnye no bɛda wɔ huntuma mu.
Kaansa ndzebɔnyɛ yɛ fenemfenem wɔ n’anomu, Na ɔdze suma ne tɛkyerɛma ase;
Na ɔkora do, na oenngyaa mu ma ɔannkɔ, Na mbom ɔkɔ do ara sie no wɔ n’adadaw mu mpo a;
N’edziban bɛsakyer wɔ no nson mu, Na ɔbɛyɛ nhurutsia bɔwema wɔ no mu.
Ɔamen ahonya, naaso ɔbɛfe egu: Nyankopɔn beyi efi ne yamu akyen.
Obohwiew nhurutsia bɔr: Na ɔpambir tɛkyerɛma boku no.
N’enyi nnkɔbɔ esutsen no do, Ewo na buter nsupemee no.
Dza ɔaberɛ ho no, ɔbɛdan ama, na ɔnnkɛmen: Na onnkedzi n’eguadzi mu mfaso ho ehurusi.
Osiandɛ ɔatseetsee ehiafo na ɔapow hɔn; Na ɔdze enyimpi afa fie bi a nnyɛ ɔno na osii.
Ɔnam dɛ oennhu n’akɔndɔ mu mee ntsi, Ɔronnkora dza n’enyigye wɔ mu mu biribiara do.
Hweeara annka a oenndzi, Dɛm ntsi n’eyiedzi nnketsim.
N’adze dodow mayɛ no mu no, no ho behiahia no: Amandzehu yaayaw bodwir no do.
Ɔahyɛ ne yafun ma ewie no, Nyankopɔn bohue n’ebufuhyew no egu no do, Na ɔatɔ ekutuku dɛ nsu wɔ no do.
Oboguan efi dadze akodze ano, Na boran egyen abɔ no ehwira mu.
Ɔtwe, na ofi ne nyimpadua mu pue: Nyew, n’ano dɛhyɛdɛhyɛ no fi no bɔwema mu pue; Ihu ho nketsenketse kyekyer no.
Sum nyinara wɔdze esie ama n’akoradze: Gya a nyimpa bi nnhuta na ɔbɛmen no; Ɔbɛhyew dza aka wɔ n’asesee mu.
Sor bɛda n’emumuyɛ edzi, Na asaase bɔsoɛr etsia no.
Ne fie ndɔbaa befi hɔ akɔ, N’adze bɛpem akɔ wɔ n’ebufuw da no mu.
Iyi nye nyimpa dzebɔnyɛnyi ne kyɛfa a ofi Nyankopɔn hɔ, Na egyapadze a Nyankopɔn ahyɛ ama no.
Na Job buaa dɛ,
Hom ntsie me kasaa yie; Na wɔmma iyi nyɛ hom awerɛkyekyer.
Hom mma me kwan, ma mo so menkasa; Na sɛ mekasa wie a, afei hom esi atwetwe.
Emi dze, ana nyimpa na midzi mo nkɔmbɔ kyerɛ no? Na bɛyɛ dɛn na m’ahom nnkɛtsew?
Hom ngyen hom enyi nhwɛ me, na hom ho mbow hom, Na hom mfa hom nsa ntoto hom ano.
Sɛ modwen iyi ho mpo a, m’akoma tu, Na nketsenketse kitsa mo honam.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ndzebɔnyɛfo tsena ase, Wɔkye, nyew, na wɔyɛ akatakyi wɔ tumdzi mu yi?
Hɔn mba tsintsim wɔ hɔn enyim ka hɔn ho, Nyew, mekyerɛ hɔn asefo.
Hɔn fie mu dwe, suro bi nnyi mu, Na nkyii so Nyankopɔn ne ntsea bi nnyi hɔn do.
Hɔn nantwinyin wo, na ɔnnyɛ kago, Hɔn nantwiber yɛ awoyie, na ɔmmpon ba.
Wɔdze hɔn mbɔdomaba pue dɛ nguankuw, Na hɔn mbofraba so dzi ehuruhuruw.
Wɔma hɔn ndze do wɔ mpintsin na nsankutsen mu, Na hɔn enyi gye wɔ atɛntɛbɛn ndze ho.
Wodzi hɔn mber wɔ eyiedzi mu, Na wosian kɔ samanadze wɔ asomdwee mu.
Naaso wɔse Nyankopɔn dɛ, Fi hɛn do kɔ; Na yɛronnhwehwɛ w’akwan ho nyimdzee.
Otumfo no nye woana na yɛaasom no? Na sɛ yɛbɔ mpaa ma no a, ebɛn mfaso na yebenya?
Naaso hwɛ, hɔn ndzepa nnyi hɔnara hɔn nsamu: Ntsi ndzebɔnyɛfo apam mpar me.
Mpɛn ahen na ndzebɔnyɛfo kandzea dum, Na mbusu so to hɔn, Na Nyankopɔn kyɛ awerɛhow ma hɔn wɔ n’ebufuw mu?
Mpɛn ahen so na ɔma wɔyɛ dɛ eburonan wɔ mframa enyim, Na dɛ ntsɛw a ehum soa kɔ?
Wɔka dɛ, Nyankopɔn dze ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi n’asotwee to hɔ ma ne mba, Kɛtseankyɛ, ontua ɔnoara kaw, ma onhu.
Ma nankasa n’enyiwa nhu noara ne sɛɛe, Na ma ɔnnom Otumfo no n’ebufuhyew no bi.
Osiandɛ ebɛn adwen na ɔdwen wɔ ne fiemba ho, Aber a woewie ne nda dzi no?
Ana obi bɛkyerɛ Nyankopɔn nyimdzee? Osiandɛ ɔno na obu hɔn a wɔkrɔn atsɛn.
Obi wu wɔ n’ahoɔdzen mu mu, Aber a no ho baa no na n’asomu dwe no koraa no:
Na enumfonsu ahyɛ n’ehina mu amaama, Na ne mbiew mu ehuon yɛ fɔɔfɔɔ no a.
Na obi so wu wɔ ne kra awerɛhow mu, Na ɔnnsɔ ndzepa no bi nnhwɛ da.
Naaso, hɔn nyinara deda pɛr wɔ huntuma mu, Na nsaamaa kata hɔn do.
Hwɛ, minyim hom adwen, Na tsirmpɔw a hom susu no bɔn mu tsia me no.
Hom bisa hom ho dɛ, Bapɔmba no ne fie wɔ henfa seseiara? Na hen na dzebɔnyɛnyi no ne tsenabew no wɔ?
Ana hom mmbisaa hɔn a wɔfa kwan no do no? Ana hom adwendwen hɔn amandzɛɛbɔ ho?
Dɛ wɔakora nyimpa bɔn do efi sɛɛ da no mu? Na woeyi no efi ebufuw da no mu da?
Woana na ɔka n’enyim wɔ ne ndzeyɛɛ ho? Na dza ɔayɛ no, woana na obotua no ho kaw?
Wɔsoa no enyidzi mu kɔ adakamona mu, Na wɔweɔn ne nda no.
Nyimpadɔm dzi n’enyim na n’ekyir kɔ efunsiebea, Na dɛtsetɔw mpo ma no asomdwee.
Ntsi ebɛn kwan do na hom dze nsɛnhun kyekye mo werɛ? Osiandɛ hom nsɛnkaa nyina yɛ atorsɛm.
Nna Temannyi Elifaz buaa dɛ,
Aso nyimpa bi botum edzi mu wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim anaa? Hwɛ, onyimdzefo mpo, odzi mu wɔ narankasa n’enyi do.
Ana ɔyɛ enyigye bi ma Otumfo no, dɛ ɔwo etsen? Anaadɛ ɔyɛ mfaso ma no, dɛ ɔwo ema w’akwan dzi mu?
Ana wo suro a isuro no ntsi na ɔka w’enyim, Na ɔdze wo kɔ atsɛmbu mu yi?
Ana wo ndzeyɛbɔn nnyɛ kɛse dodow? Na nkyii so w’emumuyɛ nnyi ewiei?
Na ɔwo agye wo nua hɔ ahobadze kwa, Na apepa adagyafo hɔn atam.
Ɔwo amma abahatɔfo nsu ma wɔannom, Na ɔwo akam nyia ɔkɔm dze no n’edziban.
Ɔyɛ wo dɛ nyimpa a ɔwɔ tum; Na enyimnyam no na obenya asetsena pa.
Ɔwo na egya mbaa ekunafo kwan ma wɔdze nsapan kɔ, Na ngyanka so ahyɛ hɔn abagura.
Dɛm ntsi na mfir abɔ wo ho aprɔw, Na awerɛfir suro rehaw wo yi.
Ana ɔwo nnhu sum, Na nsu piigyan a ɔkata wo do no?
Ana nnyɛ sor no krɔn mu na Nyankopɔn wɔ, Na ofi hɔ hu nworaba a ɔwɔ sorsor no etsifi.
Na ɔwo ese dɛ, Ebɛnadze na Nyankopɔn nyim? Ana obotum ehu sum kebii mu asɛm ebu ho atsɛn?
Mununkum kusuww no yɛ akataho ma no, na onnhu adze; Na ɔnantsew wɔ sor no kɔntɔnkrɔn mu.
Ana ebɛfa tsetse kwan no do Dza nyimpa bɔn anantsew do no?
Hɔn a wohwiim hɔn kɔree ansaana hɔn ber rudu Na wohuee hɔn fapem gui dɛ esutsen no:
Hɔn a wɔsee Nyankopɔn dɛ, Fi hɛn do kɔ; Na, Ebɛnadze na Otumfo no botum ayɛ ama hɛn no?
Naaso ɔdze ndzepa hyehyɛɛ hɔn efiefi amaama: Mbom emi dze, mennkɛnye ndzebɔnyɛfo afa apam koraa.
Atseneneefo no hu, na hɔn enyi gye; Na hɔn a wodzi bem no sereserew hɔn.
Dɛ, ampaara hɔn a wɔsoɛree tsiaa hɛn no woetwitwa hɔn egu, Na hɔn mu nkaa no gya no ahyew.
Dɛm ntsi, afei fa woho bɔ Nyankopɔn ho ɛ, na wo ho ntɔ wo: Ɔnam iyi do na adzepa bɛba ama wo.
Meserɛ wo, gye n’anomu mbra no, Na fa ne nsɛm sie w’akoma mu.
Sɛ ɔwo esan kɔ Otumfo no nkyɛn a, ɔdze wo besi hɔ; Sɛ nkyɛ ibeyi emumuyɛ efi w’asesee mu akɔ ekyirkyiikyir a.
Na fa w’egyapadze gu huntuma mu, Na wo sika mapa so gu ɔwora mu mbosaabo mu;
Na Otumfo no bɛyɛ w’egyapadze, Na dwetɛ a wɔahoa ho ama wo.
Na ɔno na wo ho bɛsɛpɛw wo wɔ Otumfo no ho, Na ama w’enyi do akyerɛ Nyankopɔn.
Ɔwo bɔbɔ wo mpaa ama no, na obetsie wo; Na ɔwo etua w’anohobadze.
Eso ɔwo ebɔbɔ adze bi ho tsirmpɔw, na ɔbɛyɛ hɔ ama wo; Na ekan bɛhyerɛn w’akwan do.
Na sɛ Nyankopɔn brɛ wo adze a, nna ɔno ahomado ntsi a Osiandɛ nyia ɔbrɛ noho adze no, na ɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Sɛ nyia onndzi bem no mpo ɔgye no a: Nna ɔno, ɔnam w’ahotsewee do ɔbɛgye wo.
Na Job see dɛ,
Ndɛ so mo nkɔmbɔdzi yɛ etuatsew: Me nsa yɛ m’apensi do durdur.
Ao kɛtseankyɛ minyim beebi mbrɛ mubohu no, Na nkyɛ mekodu ne tsenabew:
Ɔno na nkyɛ mubohue m’asɛm egu n’enyim, Na meebisabisa no nsɛm ara yie.
Nkyɛ meehu nsɛm a ɔdze bobua me, Na maatse dza ɔbɛka akyerɛ me no ase.
Ana ɔnye me bɛham wɔ no tum kɛseyɛ no mu? Dabida; mbom ɔbɛyɛ aso ama me.
Hɔ na tseneneenyi nye no beyi atsɛn; Nna mibefi me tsɛmbuafo nsamu korakora.
Hwɛ, mokɔ enyim, na onnyi hɔ; Na ekyir so, na munnhu no:
Abankum, mber a ɔreyɛ edwuma, na mohwɛ no a ɔnnyɛ: Osuma noho wɔ enyimfa, na munntum nnhu no.
Na ɔno onyim kwan a mefa do: Sɛ ɔasɔ me ahwɛ a, nkyɛ mada edzi dɛ sika kɔkɔɔ mapa a wɔdze afa gya mu.
M’anan etsintsim n’anamɔn mu dzendzenndzen: No kwan na mesie, na manndan ammfa nkyɛn.
Mennsaan ekyir mimmfii n’anomu mbrasɛm ho; Mesie n’anomunsɛm na ɔsom mo bo yie.
Na ɔnodze, ɔayɛ n’adwen, na woana na ɔbɛdan no? Na dza ɔpɛ no, ɔnoara na ɔyɛ.
Na ɔno na ɔyɛ dza wɔahyɛ ama no no: Na ndzɛmba a ɔtsetse dɛm pii wɔ ne nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi morofona wɔ n’enyim; Sɛ modwendwen a, m’akoma tu wɔ no ho.
Na Nyankopɔn ama m’akoma etu, Na Otumfo no afona me.
Osiandɛ woenntwa me annkyen wɔ sum no enyim, Nkyii so ɔannkata sum kebii no do wɔ m’enyim.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Otumfo no nnhyɛ ber nntua emumuyɛfo kaw? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hɔn a wonyim no nnhu dɛm ber no?
Binom wɔ hɔ a hɔn dze, wɔtwe asaase he; Wɔfa nguankuw enyimpido, na wɔnyɛn hɔn.
Wɔka egyanka n’asoaso ma ɔkɔ, Wɔgye ɔbaa kunafo ne nantwi ahoba.
Woyi ɔkɔhweaban edzi wɔ kwan mu: Wɔpam asaase do ehiafo kɔ nsumaa mu.
Dɛ mbrɛ sar do hamu nsoasopɔnkɔ pue kɔhwehwɛ edziban no, Dɛmara so na ehiafo no pue kɔhwehwɛ edziban mbɔdzen do ara; Sar no do na wonya edziban ma hɔn mba.
Haban mu na wotwa hɔn mbowa edziban; Na wodzi ndzebɔnyɛfo wenyin ture mu mpɛpɛw.
Anadwe nyinara wodzi adagyaw da dɛ wonnyi adzefuradze, Na wonnyi akataho wɔ awɔw mu.
Mbepɔw do nsutɔree fɔw hɔn, Na wonnyi guansumabew ntsi wɔyɛ ɔbotan etuu.
Binom wɔ hɔ a wɔtsew ngyanka fi enumfo ano, Na wɔgye hianyi hɔ ahobadze:
Ma wɔnenam no adagyaw mu a wonnyi adzefuradze, Wɔasoasoa ewifua efiefi no, naaso wɔda kɔm;
Wɔyɛ ngo wɔ hɔn afasu mu; Wotsiatsia hɔn nsatwer do, naaso wodzi nsukɔm.
Hɔn a wɔda wuso no apensi fow fi kurow no mu. Na epirafo no hɔn akra su frɛ mboa; Naaso Nyankopɔn nnhu no dɛ emumuyɛdze a.
Woyinom na wɔtsew etua wɔ kan no do; Wonnyim n’akwan, Na eso wɔnntsena n’atsempɔn do.
Wudzifo dzi kan soɛr ber a adze asa no, na oku hianyi na kɔhweaban; Na anadwe ɔyɛ dɛ wifo.
Ɔyefafo enyiwa so tweɔn adansaber, Ɔse dɛ, Enyiwa bi nnkohu me: Na ɔdze akataho kata n’enyim.
Sum mu na wobubu adan mu: Naaso obodu enyim kan no, nna wɔatotow hɔnho mbobow mu, Na wɔnnye kan nnyi hwee yɛ.
Na hɔn nyinara anapa yɛ hɔn dɛ wu no nwinwin, Osiandɛ wonyim no mu dza oyi hu.
Wɔyɛ ehur wɔ nsu enyi; Wɔdom hɔn kyɛfa wɔ asaase do: Na obiara nnkɔ wenyin nture no mu.
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyew na nsukɔm nan esukwankyɛba no: Dɛmara so na samanadze dze yɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ bɔn no.
Awotoa werɛ befir hɔn; nsunsuma bedzi hɔn nam; Wɔrennkaa hɔn bio: Na emumuyɛfo bobubu dɛ dua.
Wɔmemen bɔnyin a onnyi ba no: Na wɔnnyɛ ɔbaa kunafo ayamuyie.
Naaso Nyankopɔn dze no tum yi akatakyi fi hɔ: Wotum nya asetsena pa, naaso wonnya nkwa ho enyidado biara.
Nyankopɔn ma hɔn asetsena yɛ dwudwoodwo, na wɔdze hɔnho twer iyi; Na n’enyiwa wɔ hɔn akwan do.
Woehuhor hɔn; naaso mber kakrabaabi na wonnyi hɔ; Nyew, ɔbrɛ hɔn adze, oyi hɔn fi kwan no mu dɛ nyimpa nyinara, Na wotwitwa hɔn gu dɛ eburow mbɛtsem.
Ana ɔnntse dɛm a? Afei woana na ɔbɔbɔ me ɔtor, Na ɔakyerɛ dɛ aba biara nnyi m’asɛm yi mu?
Nna Suhinyi Bildad buaa dɛ,
Tumdzi na suro yɛ Nyankopɔn dze; Ɔno na ɔyɛ asomdwee wɔ ne mbea sorɔnsorɔm mu.
Ana wobotum ebu no dɔm ano? Na woana na ne kan nnsoɛr no do?
Dasanyi besi dɛn atsen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim? Anaa ɔbɛyɛ dɛn ma nyia ɔbaa awo no no no ho bɛtsew?
Hwɛ, bosoom mpo mmpaa hyerɛɛn wɔ n’enyim, Na nworaba so ho nntsew wɔ n’enyi do:
Na akantam dasanyi a ɔyɛ nsaamaa yi! Na nyimpa ba a ɔyɛ abowaba yi!
Na Job see dɛ,
Mbrɛ ɔwo esi na aboa nyia onnyi tum a! Mbrɛ ɔwo esi na agye abasa a onnyi ahoɔdzen nkwa a!
Mbrɛ ɔwo esi na etu nyia onnyim nyansa fo, Na eyi nyimdzee mu a ɔdɔɔ so akyerɛ a!
Na woana na ɔwo aka nsɛm akyerɛ no, Na ebɛn sunsum, na ofi wo mu puei yi?
Hɔn a woewuwu ho popo Wɔ nsu na no mu atsefo no ase.
Samanadze dzi adagyaw wɔ n’enyim, Na ɔsɛɛ nnyi akataho.
Ɔno na ɔtserɛw kwaa mu kata bea kwawee do, Na ɔdze asaase sɛn mbrɛ hwee nnyi.
Ɔno na ɔkyekyer nsu hyɛ no mununkum kebii mu; Na mununkum mmpaae wɔ n’ase.
Omunum ahengua enyim, Na ɔtserɛw no mununkum mu kata ho.
Ɔno na oetwa he wɔ nsu enyi Dze ekodu kan na sum ehyiae.
Ɔsor edum ho popo Na hɔn ho bow hɔn wɔ ne nkaenyim ano.
Ɔno na ɔdze no tum nu po mu, Na ɔnam ne ntseasee do sɛɛ po dɛnkyɛmnyin.
Ɔnam no sunsum do na sor hyehyɛ; Ne nsa na oehwira abowatsena a no ho yɛ har no mu.
Hwɛ, iyinom nye n’akwan n’anoano: Na mbrɛ huhuhuhu a yɛtse no wɔ no ho dua suar a! Na no tum asenaman no dze, woana na obotum atse ase?
Na Job maa n’abɛbusɛm do bio, na ɔsee dɛ,
Dɛ Nyankopɔn a oeyi m’eyiedzi kɔ, Na Otumfo no a oeyi me kra awerɛhow no, tse ase yi;
Na mber dodow a nkwa da ho wɔ mo mu, Na Nyankopɔn nkwahwea wɔ m’ahwentokura mu yi;
Ampaara m’anofamfa rennka nsɛmfun, Nkyii so me tɛkyerɛma nnkɔbɔ ndaadaa dzin.
Nyankopɔn mpa ngu dɛ mubobu hom bem: Mirinnyi m’emudzi mmfi moho araa ma ekodu dɛ mubowu.
Medze me ndzeyɛtsenenee mu dzendzenndzen, na mirinngyaa mu: M’akoma nnsopa me mber tsentsen a metse ase yi.
Wɔmma me tamfo nyɛ dɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi, Wɔmma nyia ɔsoɛr tsia me no nyɛ dɛ brakyewnyi.
Na dabrabanyi n’enyidado nye ebɛnadze, aber a Nyankopɔn etwa no do, Aber a oeyi ne kra kɔ no?
Ana Nyankopɔn betsie no sufrɛ, Aber a ɔfona bɛba no do no?
Ana no ho bɛsɛpɛw no wɔ Otumfo no ho, Na ɔafrɛ Nyankopɔn mber nyinara mu?
Mebɛkyerɛkyerɛ hom wɔ Nyankopɔn nsa do; Dza ɔwɔ Otumfo ho no mirinnsiw do.
Hwɛ, hom nyinara hom ehu; Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ayɛ gyan dɛm yi?
Iyi nye nyimpa dzebɔnyɛnyi ne kyɛpɛn a onya no wɔ Nyankopɔn hɔ, Na ahyɛdofo egyapadze a wonya no wɔ Otumfo no hɔ.
Sɛ ne mba dɔr a, wɔdɔr ma afona; Na ne yafumba no, edziban remmee hɔn.
Hɔn a wofi mu bɛka no wobesie hɔn wɔ owu mu, Na ne mbaa ekunafo runntwa sukwadwom.
Sɛ ɔpra dwetɛ hyɛ kuw dɛ huntuma, Na osiesie ntar dɛ dɛtse mpo a;
Ɔno dze, obesiesie, na mbom ɔtseneneenyi na ɔdze bɛhyɛ, Na nyia odzi bem no na ɔbɛkyɛ dwetɛ no mu.
Osi ne dan dɛ ebubumbaba, Na ɔtse dɛ pata a ɔweɔmfo bɔ.
Ɔkɛda hɔ dɛ ɔdzefo, naaso ɔnnkɔsoɛr dɛm bio; Obobue n’enyiwa no, nna onnyi hɔ.
Ihu fa no dɛ nsu; Anadwe na ehum wia no kɔ.
Boka mframa soa no kɔ, na ofi hɔ kɔ; Na ɔpra no fi ne tsenabew.
Na Nyankopɔn bɔtow egu no do, na ɔrenngye no nkwa: Onya pɛ dɛ oguan fi ne nsamu.
Nkorɔfo bɔbobɔ hɔn nsamu egu no do, Na wɔabobɔ no do nhwiroma etu no efi ne tsenabew akɔ.
Ampaara, mona bi wɔ hɔ a dwetɛ wɔ mu, Na bea bi wɔ hɔ ma sika a wɔhor.
Dadze wotu no wɔ famu, Na boran wɔnan fi ɔbo mu.
Nyimpa tum ma sum no tun twa: Ɔbɔntse araa kodu ekyirekyir Dze hwehwɛ sum kebii na owu no nwinwin mu abo.
Na otu mona kronn kɔ mbrɛ nyimpa biara nntse hɔ; Anamɔn a otwa mu no werɛ fir no; Oefi nyimpa nkyɛn sensɛn ekyirekyir, oridzi adande.
Asaase a edziban fi mu ba no: Ɔdan n’ase ba sor dɛ gya.
N’abo no mu nye hoabo ne dabew, Na ɔwɔ sikamfutuw so wɔ hɔ.
Ɔkwan no anoma edzinam bi nnyi mu, Nkyii so ɔkom enyiwa nnhunii.
Ahantan mbowa nntsiatsiaa do, Na eso gyata bɔyafo nntwa mu hɔ.
Ɔtsen ne nsa ka ɔtwerɛbo botan; Obutuw mbepɔw wɔ no ndwow mu.
Ɔno na otwitwa abotan mu aka; Na n’enyiwa hu adze a ɔsom bo biara.
Ɔno na osisiw esutsen kwan ma ɔnnsosɔw; Na adze a osuma no, ɔno na oyi pue kan mu.
Na nyansa dze, hen na wobohu no? Na ntseasee ananmu so wɔ hen?
Dasanyi nnyim no bo; Nkyii so wonnhu no wɔ atseasefo asaase do.
Bun dɔnkuronn no se dɛ, Onnyi mo mu: Na po so se dɛ, Onnyi me nkyɛn.
Wɔmmfa sika mapa nnya, Nkyii so wonnker dwetɛ mma ne tsibo.
Wɔmmfa Ofir sika nntwa ne tsibo, Wɔmmfa epopobibirbo a ɔsom bo, anaa hoabo nntɔ.
Sika na ahwehwɛ nnye no nnsɛ: Nkyii so wɔmmfa sika mapa n’edwindze nnsesa.
Wɔmmbɔ nankyenema anaa ahwehwɛbo dzin: Nyew, nyansa no bo sen mbota dze.
Etiopia kratsebo nnye no nnsɛ, Nkyii so wɔmmfa sika mapa nntwa ne tsibo.
Nna dɛm a henfa koraa na nyansa fi ba? Na ntseasee ananmu so wɔ henfa?
Osiandɛ wɔdze esuma atseasefo nyinara enyiwa, Na wɔdze akam sor ntumbowa.
Ɔsɛɛ na owu se dɛ, Yɛdze hɛn aso atse ne nka.
Nyankopɔn na ɔtse no kwan ase, Na ɔno na onyim ne tsenabew.
Na ɔno na ɔhwɛ asaase ewiei, Na ohu sor nyina ase:
Aber a ɔhyɛɛ mframa dur too hɔ: Nyew, osusu nsu dɛ mbrɛ no nsusui tse no.
Aber a ɔhyɛɛ nyankom mbra, Na ɔyɛɛ kwan maa senaman n’enyinam no:
Nna ohunii, na ɔdaa no edzi; Otsintsiim no, nyew, na ɔhwehwɛe puei.
Na ɔsee nyimpa dɛ, Hwɛ, dɛ irusuro EWURADZE no, nye nyansa; Na irifi bɔn ho eguan, nye ntseasee.
Na Job maa n’abɛbusɛm do bio, na ɔsee dɛ,
Ao kɛtseankyɛ metse no dɛ nkan no abosoom no mu, Dɛ nda no a Nyankopɔn hwɛɛ mo do wɔ mu no;
