Hɔn dɔ o, hɔn enyitan na hɔn enyiber o, ahera dada; eso wonnyi kyɛfa biara bio ara da wɔ dza wɔyɛ no wɔ wi yi ase no mu.
Kɔ do ara, fa enyigye dzi w’edziban, na fa enyigye akoma nom wo nsa, na Nyankopɔn enyi asɔ wo ndwuma dada.
Ma wo ntar nhoa daa; na mma mma seradze mmpa wo tsirmu.

Enye wo yer a edɔ no no ntsena enyigye mu wɔ w’egyangyandze nkwa nda nyinara a Nyankopɔn dze ama wo wi ase no mu, wɔ w’egyangyandze nda nyinara mu: na ɔno nye wo kyɛfa wɔ nkwa mu, na wo berɛ a eberɛ wɔ wi ase mu.
Biribiara a edze wo nsa bɛka dɛ ereyɛ no, fa w’ahoɔdzen yɛ; osiandɛ edwuma, anaa nhyehyɛɛ, anaa nyimdzee, anaa nyansa biara nnyi adakamona a erokɔ mu no mu.

Medaan moho, na muhun wɔ wi ase, dɛ empiresi nnyɛ ahoɔharfo dze, na dɛ ɔko nnyɛ ahoɔdzenfo dze, nyew, dɛmara na boodoo nnyɛ enyansafo nko dze, na eso enyimpa nnyɛ edwimfo dze; na mber na esian ba hɔn nyinara do.
Bio, nyimpa nnyim ne mber so: dɛ nam a wɔdze eboa saw hɔn, na dɛ nnoma a wɔpa hɔn efir mu no, dɛmara so na wosua adasamba efir wɔ mber bɔn a ɔba hɔn do awerɛfir mu no mu.
Dɛmara so na mehu nyansa wɔ wi ase, na ɔyɛɛ kɛse wɔ m’enyiwa do:
kurow kakraba bi wɔ hɔ, na nyimpa kumaabi na wɔwɔ mu; na ɔhen kɛse bi soɛɛr do, na obotui hyɛɛ do, na ɔtotoow ho abantsentsen akɛse:
afei wohun mu hɔ onyansafo hianyi bi, na ɔnam ne nyansaa do gyee kurow no; naaso nyimpa biara annkaa ohianyi no.
Naaso mese dɛ, Nyansa ye sen ahoɔdzen: kaansa woebu nyimpa hianyi ne nyansaa no enyimtsia, na ne nsɛm so wɔnntse mpo a.
Enyansafo nsɛm a wɔka no komm no, wɔtse no yie sen nyia odzi nkwasea do tum ne nkekamu no.
Nyansa ye sen akondadze: na dzebɔnyɛnyi kor sɛɛ papa pii.
Dɛ mbrɛ nwansema fun ma eduforafo ne seradze yi nka bɔn no: dɛmara so na nkwaseadze kakrabaa bor nyansa na enyidzi do.
Nyimpa nyansafo n’akoma dze no kɔ n’abanyimfa; na ɔkwasea n’akoma dze no kɔ n’abankum.
Mpo sɛ ɔkwasea nantsew kwan biara do a, ne ntseasee bɔ no, na ɔda no ho edzi dɛ ɔkwasea a.
Sɛ otumfo no sunsum soɛr tsia wo a, mma mmfi w’ananmu; na ngyaamu dwedwe mfom pii.
Mbusu bi wɔ hɔ a mehu no wɔ wi ase a ɔtse dɛ mfom a ofi otumfo hɔ ba.
Wɔama nkwaseafo dzibew akɛse akɛse, ma ahonyafo mbom tsetse famu.
Mehu nkowaa a wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do, na ahenmba a wɔnenam dɛ nkowaa wɔ asaase do.
Nyia otu mona no, ɔbɔtɔ mu; na obiara a obubu ban mu no, abowatsena bɔsɔw no.
Obiara a opue abo no, wɔdze bepira no; na nyia ɔpaa ndua no, ɔdze bɔ noho mbusu.
Sɛ dadze n’ano kum, na obiara annsew ano a, ɔnodze ɔwɔ dɛ wɔma no ahoɔdzen kɛse: naaso hu no dɛ nyansa bɛma esi wo yie.
Sɛ abowatsena sɔw ansaana wɔakyer no nkaber a, nna mfaso biara nnyi nkaberkyerfo no ho.
Nyimpa nyansafo n’anomu nsɛm yɛ adom; na ɔkwasea dze, n’anofamfa bɛmen narankasa.
Ɔkwasea ne kasaa ahyɛse yɛ nkwaseasɛm, na n’ewiei no yɛ abɔdam emumuyɛ.
Ɔma n’asɛm so dɔɔ so: naaso nyimpa nnyim dza ɔbɛba; na dza obesi n’ekyir aba no, woana botum aka akyerɛ no?
Ɔkwasea ne berɛ haw no, ntsi onndu no botae ho.
Asaase e, due! Aber a wo hen yɛ abofra, na w’asafohemfo dzidzi anapa!
Asaase e, osiarfo nye wo oo! Ber a wo hen yɛ ekunyin ba, na w’asafohemfo dzidzi ber a ɔsɛ dze nya ahoɔdzen na wɔnnyɛ asabokwafo!
Akwadwer ara ntsi na nkurii pa bɔ mu; na nsamugow na ɔma ɔdan nwin.
Asereserew ntsi na wɔto pon, na nsa ma ɔbra mu enyigye: na sika bua adze nyinara.
Mma nndom ɔhen, mpo wɔ w’adwen mu; na mma nndom obirɛmpɔn wɔ w’adankyir: na wimu anoma dze ndze no bɔkɔ, na dza otuatua ntɛkyerɛ bɔkɔ akɛka asɛm no.
Totow w’edziban gugu nsu enyi: na daakye bi wo nsa bɛka.
Fa bi ma beesuon, nyew, fa ma baawɔtwe mpo; na innyim mbusu kor a ɔbɛba asaase do.
Sɛ nsu hyɛ nsuwusiw ma a, otue gu asaase do; na sɛ dua kɔhwe pomu afamu anaa kwaamu afamu a, beebi a dua no ahwe no, mbrɛ ɔbɛda ara nye no.
Nyia ɔhwɛ mframa enyim no, onnkodua; na nyia ɔhwɛ nsuwusiw no, onnkobu da.
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo innyim mbrɛ mframa no kwan da, anaaso innyim mbrɛ mbiew si nyin wɔ onyinsemfo ne yamu no; dɛmara so mpo na ɔwo innyim Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ adze nyina no n’edwuma.
Dua w’aba anapa, na ewimbir so mma nnyi wo nsa mmfi ho: na ɔwo innyim no mu dza ɔbɛyɛ prɔmprɔm, sɛ iyi o, ɔno o, anaa beenu nyina na wɔbɔbɔ mu ayɛ yie o.
Ampaara dɛ kan yɛ dɛw, na ɔyɛ enyiwa fɛw dɛ obohu ewia.
Nyew, sɛ nyimpa dzi mfe pii a, wɔmma n’enyi ngye ne nyinara mu; naaso wɔmma ɔnkaa sum nda no, na wɔbɔdɔɔ so. Dza ɔbɛba nyinara egyangyandze a.

Aberantsɛ e, ma w’enyi ngye wo mberantsɛber mu oo; na ma w’akoma ntɔ mu wɔ wo mberantsɛber mu, na fa wankasa w’akoma n’akwan do, na dza woara w’enyiwa tua mu: naaso hu dɛ iyi nyinara ntsi Nyankopɔn dze wo bɔkɔ atsɛmbu mu.
Dɛm ntsi yi adwendwen fi w’akoma mu, na ma emumuyɛ mpar wo honam: na mbofraber na mberantsɛber yɛ egyangyandze.
Eso kaa wo Bɔfo wɔ wo mberantsɛber mu, ansaana mbusu da no aba, na mfe a ebɛse dɛ, Minnyi mu enyigye no, edu;
ansaana ewia, na kan, na bosoom, na nworaba ahyehyɛ sum, na nsuwusiw agye nyankom ekyir:
da a fie aweɔmfo ho bɔpopo, na mbarimba ahoɔdzenfo mu bɔkonkom, na ewunyamfo begyaa osiandɛ hɔnho esuar ntsi, na hɔn a wodua atena ntokura mu hwɛ adze no hɔn enyiwa do bɛyɛ kusuww,
na wɔatotow abɔntsen do mbobow no mu; ber a ewuyam ne dede abrɛ adze no. Wɔbɔsoɛr anoma no su ano, na mbaa adwontofo nyinara wɔbɛbrɛ hɔn adze;
nyew, wobosuro dza ɔkrɔn biara, na ehuyi bɛba kwan mu; na almɔnd dua bɔbɔ nhyiren, na abɛbɛw ayɛ adzesoa, na akɔndɔ tun etwa: osiandɛ dasanyi rokɔ ne daa fie, na eyiyɛfo rikyin abrɔn do:
ansaana dwetɛ ahoma bɛtsew, anaa sika toa bɛpaa, na ehina no abɔ nsubura ho, anaa supi hwiir ebubu;
na dɛtse bɛsan akɔ asaase mu dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ ɔtse, na sunsum bɛsan akɔ Nyankopɔn a ɔdze mae no hɔ.
Egyangyandze mu egyangyandze, Ɔsɛnkafo no na ɔse; ne nyinara egyangyandze a.
Na bio so, osiandɛ Ɔsɛnkafo no ɔyɛ onyansafo ntsi, ɔdaa ho ara kyerɛkyerɛɛ ɔman no nyimdzee; nyew, ɔdwendween ho, na ɔpɛnsaa mu, na obubuu mbɛbusɛm pii.
Ɔsɛnkafo no hwehwɛɛ dɛ obohu nsɛm a ɔyɛ enyigye, na dza wɔakyerɛw no tɔɔtsenyɛ mu, mekyerɛ, nokwar nsɛm.
Onyansafo ne nsɛm tse dɛ ɔnantwikafo ndadzepoma; na dɛ mbrɛ mprɛgow a wɔdze etsintsim yie tse no, dɛmara so na nsɛm a ɔkandzifo kor na ɔka no tse.
Na nkyii so bio, me ba, tsie afotu; nwoma pii ne yɛ nnyi ewiei; na nwomasua dodow pii so mu wɔ ɔhaw.
Asɛm no n’ewiei nye yi, ne nyinara wɔatse: suro Nyankopɔn, na dzi ne mbrasɛm do; na iyiara nye dza wɔrohwehwɛ efi nyimpa hɔ.
Na Nyankopɔn dze dwumadzi biara bɛba asɛndzii, ɔnye esumasɛm biara, sɛ oye o, sɛ omuo o.
Ndwom mu ndwom a ɔyɛ Solomon dze.
Ao, nkyɛ edze w’ano afew m’ano: Osiandɛ wo dɔ ye sen nsa.
Wo seradze yɛ huam papa; Wo ho nka tse dɛ eduhuam a woehue egu; Dɛm ntsi na mbaabun dɔ wo no.
Twe me; ma yɛnyɛ no ntsɛm nkɔ: Ɔhen dze me aba ne mpia mu: Yebedzi ehurusi na hɛn enyi agye, Mobɔbɔ wo dɔ dzin asen nsa: Ɔnnyɛ hu dɛ mbaabun dɔ wo.
Mibir dze, naaso mo ho yɛ fɛw, Jerusalɛm mbabaa e, Tse dɛ Kedar asese, Na dɛ mbrɛ Solomon nkatahotam tse.
Mma nnhwɛ me dɛ mibir, osiandɛ ewia ahyew me ntsi. Emi na mbabanyin bo fuuw me, Wɔdze me yɛɛ wenyin nture mu ɔhwɛfo; Na mbom mankasa mo wenyin ture no dze mannhwɛ.
Ɔwo a me kra dɔ wo, ka kyerɛ me, Henfa na enyɛn wo nguan, henfa na ema wɔhom ewiaber? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na menyɛ dɛ nyia wɔakata n’enyim Wɔ w’anyɛnkofo hɔn nguankuw nkyɛn?
Ao, mbaa mu ɔhoɔfɛfo, sɛ ɔwo innyim a, Kɔ, ketsin nguankuw anamɔn no do, Na nyɛn wo nguambaa wɔ nguanhwɛfo ntamadan no nkyɛn.
M’adamfowa e, medze wo ato Farao ne ntseaseanam ɔpɔnkɔ ho.
W’afon yɛ fɛw wɔ tsidwow mu, Wo kɔn yɛ fɛw wɔ ntweaban mu.
Yɛbɛyɛ sika edwindzi ndwowee ama wo a, dwetɛ sisi mu.
Aber a ɔhen tse no pon ho no, Nna me seradzehuam ayɛ huatsee.
Mo dɔfo yɛ eduhuam mɛɛr siaw dze ma me, Ɔda m’enumfo ntamu.
Mo dɔfo tse dɛ nhyiren siaw dze ma me Wɔ Engedi wenyin nture mu.
Hwɛ, mo dɔfo, wo ho yɛ fɛw; wo ho yɛ fɛw ae; W’enyiwamba tse dɛ ebubur dze.
Hwɛ, mo dɔfo, wo ho yɛ fɛw, nyew, wo ho yɛ akɔndɔ: Hɛn dabew so yɛ efuw momon.
Hɛn dan no mpuna yɛ nkyindur ndua, Na hɛn mpar so yɛ pepeaa.
Emi dze, meyɛ Saron nhyiren, Mbɔnsa mu esukookoo.
Mbrɛ esukookoo tse wɔ nsoɛ mu no, Dɛmara so na mo dɔfo tse wɔ mbabaa mu.
Dɛ mbrɛ aperdua tse wɔ haban mu ndua mu no, Dɛmara so na mo dɔfo tse wɔ mbabanyin mu. Medze enyigye kɛse tsenaa no nwinwin ase, Na no nduadzewa yɛɛ m’anomu dɔkɔdɔkɔ.
Ɔdze me baa aponto ase, Na ne frankaa a osi mo do yɛ ɔdɔ.
Hom mfa esikyireamba nsianka me, hom mfa aper nkyekye mo werɛ: Osiandɛ ɔdɔ yarba akyer me.
N’abankum da me tsiadze, Na n’abanyimfa abra me.
Jerusalɛm mbabaa e, hom nka ntam nkyerɛ me Hom mfa nwansan, na ɔtweba a wɔwɔ hamu nka ntam, Dɛ hom nnkopusuw hɛn dɔ, anaa wonnkenyan no, Gyedɛ noara ɔpɛ.
Mo dɔfo ne ndze nye no! Hwɛ, ɔreba, Oruhuruhuruw mbepɔw do, ɔrobɔ nkoko do mpentsenkwa.
Mo dɔfo tse dɛ ɔwansan anaadɛ ɔtweba: Hwɛ, ogyina hɛn fasu ekyir, Ɔhwɛ ntokura mu, Onyinam noho wɔ atenatokura mu.
Mo dɔfo kasae na ɔsee me dɛ, Soɛr, mo dɔfo, me yima, na bra ɛ.
Na, hwɛ, awɔwber etwa mu, Esusow atsew na ɔkɔ;
Nhyiren efifir asaase do; Nnoma adwontober edu, Wɔtse atamram nka wɔ hɛn asaase do;
Adɔmbadua n’aba ebun ebun reber, Na wenyinndua robɔ nhyiren, Woriyi hɔn huam. M’adamfowa e, me yima e, soɛr na bra ɛ.
Ao m’ebubur, ɔwo a ewɔ ɔbotan ne mpaae mu, wɔ bea sorɔnsorɔm no n’ehuntsae mu, Ma munhu w’enyim, ma mentse wo ndze; Na wo ndze yɛ dɛw, na wo ho yɛ fɛw.
Hom nkyekyer nsɔ no mma hɛn, nsɔ nkakraba a wɔsɛɛ wenyin nture no; Na hɛn wenyin nture no abobɔ nhyiren.
Mo dɔfo yɛ medze, na meyɛ nedze: Ɔnyɛn no nguan wɔ nsukookoo mu.
Mo dɔfo, san w’ekyir, na yɛ dɛ ɔwansan anaadɛ ɔtweba a Ɔwɔ Bɛɛta mbepɔw do, Ma onkodu dɛ wi ano bɔdwe, na sunsuma bɛsen akɔ.
Me mpa do anadwe na mohwehwɛɛ nyia me kra dɔɔ no no: Mohwehwɛɛ no, naaso mennhu no.
Mesee dɛ, Afei mobɔsoɛr, na mekekyin kurow no ho, Wɔ abrɔn mu na gua do, Mobɔhwehwɛ nyia me kra dɔ no no: Mohwehwɛɛ no, naaso mennhu no.
Aweɔmfo a wokyin kurow no ho no hun me: Hɔn na mibisaa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom ehu nyia me kra dɔ no no?
Mepaa hɔn ho kakra ara pɛr, Nna muhun nyia me kra dɔ no no: Musuoo no mu dɛ minnkegyaa no ma ɔaakɔ, Ekodu dɛ medze no bodu me na fie, Na nyia onyinseen me no ne pia mu ana.
Jerusalɛm mbabaa e, hom nka ntam nkyerɛ me Hom mfa nwansan na ɔtweba a wɔwɔ hamu nka ntam, Dɛ hom nnkopusuw hɛn dɔ, anaa wonnkenyan no, Gyedɛ noara ɔpɛ.
Woana nye oyi a ofi sar do reba dɛ wusiw fadum, A mɛɛr na krɔbɔw, Na oguadzifo nduhuam ayɛ no ho huatsee yi?
Hwɛ, Solomon n’apakan a; Mbarimba akatakyi eduosia na woetwa ho ehyia, Israel mbarimba akatakyi no mu bi a.
Hɔn nyinara wɔdzedze mfona, na wɔawea asayɛ ho: Nyimpa biara n’afona bɔ n’asen, Wɔ anadwe mu ɔhaw ntsi.
Ɔhen Solomon yɛɛ apakan maa noho, Ɔdze Lebanon ndua yɛe.
Ɔdze dwetɛ yɛɛ ne fadum no, N’ase no so sika a, n’egua no ɔberdum a; Jerusalɛm mbabaa dze anwendze a ɔyɛ fɛw Edura no mu no.
Zion mbabaa e, hom mpue mbɔhwɛ ɔhen Solomon a Ɔbɔ n’abɔtsir a ne na dze bɔɔ ne tsir wɔ n’ayehyia da, Da a n’akoma nyaa enyigye no.
Hwɛ, wo ho yɛ fɛw, mo dɔfo, wo ho yɛ fɛw ae; W’enyiwamba tse dɛ ebubur dze wɔ w’akataenyim n’ekyir: Wo tsinhwi tse dɛ serekye ahoma.
Wo se tse dɛ nguamber kuw a woetwitwa hɔn ho nhwi fofor a Wofi eguaree aba; Hɔn nyinara wɔawowo nta nta, Na hɔn mu biara nndzi awo mba ewu.
W’anofamfa tse dɛ adaaben ahoma, Na w’ano kasa yɛ dɛw: W’asontɔrmu tse dɛ pɔmegranate eduaba fa Wɔ wo nkataenyim n’ekyir.
Wo kɔndua tse dɛ David abantsentsen a woesi ama akodze a Dadze nkataenyim apem sensɛn ho, Ne nyinara akatakyifo hɔn akyɛm a.
W’enumfo ebien tsetse dɛ wansanmba ebien a wɔyɛ ntafo a Wodzidzi nsukookoo mu.
Mobɔkɔ eduhuam mɛɛr bepɔw, Na krɔbɔw koko no do, Ma ekodu dɛ wi ano bɔdwe, na sunsuma bɛsen akɔ.
Wo ho nyinara yɛ fɛw, mo dɔfo; Na dzɛm biara nnyi wo ho.
Ma yemfi Lebanon, m’ayefor, Ma yemfi Lebanon nkɔ: Ma yemfi Amana etsifi, Yemfi Senir na Hermon etsifi, Yemfi ngyata buw no do, Yemfi nsebɔ mbepɔw no do nhwɛ famu.
M’akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor, ɔwo atwe m’akoma, Edze w’enyiwa mu kor atwe m’akoma, Edze wo kɔn mu ntweaban kor.
M’akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor, mbrɛ wo dɔ dua no ho yɛ ahomka a! Mbrɛ wo dɔ dua ye sen nsa a! Na mbrɛ wo seradze ne nka dua yɛ huam sen nduhuam nyinara a!
Ao m’ayefor, w’ano sosɔw dɛ wokyɛm: Ewo na numfonsu wɔ wo tɛkyerɛma ase; Na w’atar no huam tse dɛ Lebanon no huam.
Ture a wɔatow mu nye m’akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor; Nsunyiwa a woesiw ano, nsubura a wɔasɔw ano.
Wo mfefɛwee tse dɛ pɔmegranate ekutu ture a no mu aba som bo; Hɛɛna na seradzehuam ndua,
Seradzehuam na safrɔn, Kalamus na sinamɔn, na krɔbɔw ndua nyinara; Mɛɛr na alɔe, nye nduhuam etsitsir nyinara.
Ɔwo eyɛ nture mu nsunyiwa, Ɔwo eyɛ mbasu, Na esutsen a ofi Lebanon pem.
Kwaamu mframa, nyan; na ɔwo pomu afamu, bra; Bɔ fa mo ture do, ma no mu nduhuam ntu mpetse. Ma mo dɔfo mbra no ture mu, Na ombedzi no nduadzewa a ɔsom bo no bi.

M’akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor, maba wo ture mu oo: Matsetsew eduhuam mɛɛr aka m’eduhuam ho; Medzi mo wokyɛm aka mo wo ho; Manom me nsa aka m’enumfonsu ho. Mfɛfo e, hom ndzidzi oo; Adɔfo e, hom nnom, nyew, hom nnom tosee.
Medae, na m’akoma nyanee: Mo dɔfo a ɔrobɔ mu ne ndze a, dɛ, M’akyerɛbaa, mo dɔfo, m’ebubur, m’adze a idzi mu e, bue me ɛ: Na bɔw atɔ me tsir do ma, Anadwe bɔw ayɛ me mpɛsɛw ma.
Mapɔr m’atar; meyɛ dɛn mehyɛ? Mahohor m’anan ho; meyɛ dɛn mugu ho fi?
Mo dɔfo tseen ne nsa duaa abow no tokura no mu, Na me yamu hyehyee me maa no.
Mosoɛɛr dɛ murukobue mo dɔfo; Na me nsa ho sosɔɔw eduhuam mɛɛr, Na me nsatseaba sosɔɔw eduhuam mɛɛr a ɔanan, Guguu krɔkrɔw n’esuomu no do.
Mubuei maa mo dɔfo; Nna mo dɔfo atwe noho, na ɔkɔ. Ber a ɔkasae no, m’ahom pae: Mohwehwɛɛ no, na mennhu no; Mefrɛfrɛɛ no, naaso ɔanngye me do.
Aweɔmfo a wokyin kurow no ho no hun me, Wɔbobɔɔ me, wopirapiraa me. Afasu no ho ahwɛfo no yii me nkataenyim kɔree.
Ao Jerusalɛm mbabaa, meka ntam gu hom do dɛ sɛ hom hu mo dɔfo no a, Ɔno hom nse no dɛ ɔdɔ yarba abɔ me.
Adze bɛn na wo dɔfo dze sen ɔdɔfo bi, Ɔwo mbaa mu ɔhoɔfɛfo kɛse? Adze bɛn na wo dɔfo dze sen ɔdɔfo bi, Na ɔwo ka ntam gu hɛn do dɛm yi?
Mo dɔfo hoa na ɔber mu, Ɔpedu mu dansewa a.
Ne tsir tse dɛ sika pa mapa, Ne tsir do nhwi fukuww, dukuduku dɛ akonkoran.
N’enyiwamba tse dɛ esutsen ho mbubur; Wɔdze numfonsu ahohor, na woesisi yie.
N’afon tse dɛ nduhuam akɔfi, dɛ nduadzewa dɛɛdɛw a wɔahohɔr isiw. N’anofamfa tse dɛ esukookoo a ɔsosɔw eduhuam mɛɛr nanee.
Ne nsa tse dɛ sika mpɛtsea a wɔdze sikabereebo esisi do: Ne nyimpadua tse dɛ asombɛn edwindzi a wɔdze hoabo edura ho.
No ntwɛr tse dɛ abo fitaa edum a osisi sika pa ngyinado do: No suban tse dɛ Lebanon, fɛfɛɛfɛw dɛ nkyindur ndua.
N’anomu yɛ huam dodow: nyew, no ho nyinara yɛ akɔndɔ. Mo dɔfo no nye yi, na me nyɛnko no nye yi, Ao Jerusalɛm mbabaa.
Henfa na wo dɔfo kɔ, Ɔwo mbaa mu ɔhoɔfɛfo kɛse? Henfa na wo dɔfo etwa noho afa, Ma yɛnye wo nkɔhwehwɛ no?
Mo dɔfo esian kɔ no ture mu, nduhuam akɔfi no mu, Dɛ orikedzidzi wɔ ture mu, na ɔatsetsɛw nsukookoo.
Emi dze meyɛ mo dɔfo nedze, na mo dɔfo so yɛ medze: Ɔnyɛn no nguankuw wɔ nsukookoo no mu.
Ao mo dɔfo, wo ho yɛ fɛw dɛ Tirza, Eyɛ oyima dɛ Jerusalɛm, Wo ho yɛ hu dɛ dɔm a wɔdze mfrankaa.
Dan w’enyiwa kɔ nkyɛn kakra, Osiandɛ ɔato me mpokyerɛ. Wo tsinhwi nahanaha tse dɛ serekye ahoma.
Wo se tse dɛ nguamber a Wofi eguaree aba a Hɔn nyinara wɔawowo nta nta, Na hɔn mu biara nndzi awo mba ewu.
W’asontɔrmu tse dɛ pɔmegranate eduaba fa Wɔ wo nkataenyim no mu.
Ɔhen yernom eduosia, na nwewefo eduowɔtwe, Na mbaabun a wonnyi anobu wɔwɔ hɔ,
Naaso m’ebubur, m’adze a odzi mu dze, ɔda mu fua; Ne na ne ba kor ara nye no; Nyia ɔwoo no no n’adɔnadze nye no. Mbabaa hun no, na wɔfrɛɛ no osiarfo; Nyew, ɔhen yernom na nwewefo so, na wɔkamfoo no.
Woana nye nyia opue dɛ adzekyee, Ɔyɛ fɛw dɛ bosoom, N’enyim tsew dɛ ewia, No ho yɛ hu dɛ dɔm a wɔdze mfrankaa yi?
Misianee kɔr nkatse ture no mu, Dɛ morokɔhwɛ bɔnsa no mu ndua ebun ebun, Dɛ morokɔhwɛ dɛ wenyindua no abɔ nkukuduuduw, Na dɛ pɔmegranate ekutu no abɔ nhyiren a.
Ansaana mara murubohu no, nna me kra dze me esisi Me man mbapɔmba hɔn ntseaseanam mu.
San bra, san bra, ao Sulamnyi; San bra, san bra, ma yɛnhwɛ wo. Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bɔhwɛ Sulamnyi no, Dɛ gyama hom rohwɛ Mahanaim asaw yi?
Ao ɔhen ne babaa, mbrɛ wo mpaboa, mu anamɔntutu dua yɛ fɛw a! W’aserɛ no ntoado tse dɛ edwindzi a Odwimfo pa ne nsa ayɛ.
Wo funuma tse dɛ kɔɔpow korkorba a Nsa mforaforae mmpa mu: Wo yafun tse dɛ ewifua kuw a Wɔdze nsukookoo abɔ ho aprɔw.
W’enumfo ebien tsetse dɛ wansanmba beenu a Wɔyɛ ntafo.
Wo kɔndua tse dɛ asombɛn abantsentsen; W’enyiwamba tse dɛ Hesbon nsutaae a ɔwɔ Bath-rabbim ɔponkɛse ho; Wo hwen tse dɛ Lebanon abantsentsen a Odzi kɔ Damaskɔs afamu no.
Wo tsir a ɔso wo tse dɛ Karmel, Na wo tsir do nhwi tse dɛ adaaben; No do ataku akyer ɔhen no ndɔmmum.
Mbrɛ wo ho dua yɛ fɛw na mbrɛ eyɛ enyisɔ, Ao mo dɔfo, wɔ enyigye enyigye mu a!
Wo pankor yi tse dɛ abɛdua, Na w’enumfo tse dɛ esikyireamba siawsiaw.
Meka dɛ, Mobɔfow abɛdua no, Mebɛtam esuo n’abaw no mu: Ma w’enumfo nyɛ dɛ wenyinamba siawsiaw, Na wo hwen mu hua nyɛ dɛ aper;
Na w’anomu tse dɛ nsa pa a Osian kɔ mo dɔfo yie, Ɔma hɔn a wɔatotɔ nkom buebue hɔn ano.
Meyɛ mo dɔfo nedze, Na n’akɔndɔ gyina mo do.
Mo dɔfo e, bra ma yemfir edzi nkɔ haban mu; Ma yɛnkɛtsena nkurobaadze.
Ma yɛnsoɛr ahanamakye nkɔ we nyin nture mu; Ma yɛnkɔhwɛ dɛ wenyindua no abɔ nkukuduuduw, na ne nhyiren epuepue, Na pɔmegranate ekutu no abɔ nhyiren a: Hɔ na mibeyi mo dɔ ama wo.
Eduaba mandreke no riyi huam, Na hɛn mbobowano ahyɛ nduaba horow nyinara a wɔsom bo ma, afofor na adadaw a Medze esie ama wo, ao mo dɔfo.
Ao kɛtseankyɛ eyɛ mo nuabanyin a Onuum me na n’enumfo ano! Sɛ muhu wo wɔ ehuw mu beebi a, nkyɛ mebɛfew w’ano; Nyew, na nkyɛ obiara nnkobu me enyimtsia.
Nkyɛ medze wo bɛba me na fie, Na akyerɛkyerɛ me adze; Nkyɛ mebɛma anom nsa a eduhuam wɔ mu, Me pɔmegranate nsa no bi.
W’abankum bɛda me tsiadze, Na w’abanyimfa abar me.
Jerusalɛm mbabaa e, hom nka ntam nkyerɛ me Dɛ hom nnkopusuw hɛn dɔ, anaa wonnkenyan no, Gyedɛ noara ɔpɛ.
Woana nye nyia ofir sar do reba, Ɔtwer no dɔfo no bo mu yi? Aperdua no ase na minyaan wo: Hɔ na wo na woo wo, Hɔ na nyia ɔwoo wo no ɔkoo awo.
Fa me si w’akoma do dɛ nsɔwano, dɛ w’abaw do nsɔwano: Na ɔdɔ yɛ dzen dɛ owu; Nyinkun ne tsirmu yɛ dzen dɛ adakamona: N’enyinam yɛ ogya enyinam, Na ɔyɛ gyaframee ara ampa.
Nsu pii nntum nndum ɔdɔ, Nkyii so nsuyirii nntum nnkata do: Sɛ nyimpa dze fie adze nyinara bɛma wɔ ɔdɔ ntsi a, Enyimtsia ara na wobobu no.
Yɛwɔ akyerɛbaa kakraba bi, Na ɔmmbɔɔ enumfo: Ebɛnadze na yɛbɛyɛ ama hɛn akyerɛbaa Wɔ da a wɔbɛba ebebisa no ayewar no mu?
Sɛ nkyɛ ɔyɛ ɔfasu a, Yɛbɔtow no do dwetɛ aban: Na sɛ ɔyɛ abow a, Yɛdze nkyindur ntaabow botwa no ho ehyia.
Emi dze, meyɛ ɔfasu, na m’enumfo tse dɛ no do abantsentsen: Ɔno na meyɛɛ n’enyiwa do dɛ obi a oenya asomdwee.
Solomon nyaa wenyin ture wɔ Baal-hamon; Ɔdze wenyin ture no hyɛɛ ahwɛfo nsa; No mu nduadzewa no ntsi, na ɔwɔ dɛ obiara obiara dze dwetɛbona apem brɛ no.
Mo wenyin ture a ɔyɛ medze no ɔwɔ m’enyim: Ɔwo, Solomon, ibenya apem no, Na hɔn a wɔhwɛ no nduadzewa no do no so wobenya ahaebien.
Ɔwo a etse nture mu, M’anyɛnkofo ritsie wo ndze: Ma mo so mintsie ɛ.
Mo dɔfo, yɛ ntsɛm, Keka woho dɛ ɔwansan anaa ɔtweba Wɔ nduhuam mbepɔw no do.
Iyi nye Amoz ne ba Isaia n’enyido adzehu a ohunii wɔ Juda na Jerusalɛm ho wɔ Juda ahemfo Uzia, Jotam, Ahaz, na Hezekia nda mu no.
Ɔsorsor, hom ntsie, asaase, yɛ aso, na EWURADZE akasa: Manyɛn mba na matsetse hɔn, na hɔn dze wɔatsew mo do etua.
Ɔnantwi nyim no wura, na asoasopɔnkɔ nyim no wura n’edzidzidaka: naaso Israel dze wonnyim, na me man nnyi ntseasee.
Ao, ɔman ndzebɔnyɛfo, nkorɔfo a wɔdze emumuyɛ asoa hɔn, emumuyɛfo asefo, mba a hɔn abrabɔ aprɔw: wɔapow EWURADZE, woebu Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no enyimtsia, wɔapaa hɔnho na wɔasan ekyir.
Wɔnda ho mbɔ hom nyɛ dɛn, dɛ hom da ho ara retsew etua yi? Tsir mu no nyinara yar, na akoma mu no nyinara apa.
Ofitsi ananadze kesi etsifi mpo apɔwmudzen biara nnyi mu, mbom epirakur, na nsoasoae na ekur mpɔtɔwee: wɔnnsaae, eso wɔnnkyekyeree, eso wɔmmfaa ngo nndwedwee no.
Hom kurow ayɛ amamfo; wɔdze gya ahyew hom nkurow; ananaben asɛɛ hom asaase wɔ hom enyim, ɔayɛ amamfo, dɛ ananaben ebutuw no.
Na woegyaa Zion babaa dɛ asese a ɔwɔ wenyin ture mu, dɛ efer ture mu asoɛe, dɛ kurow a woetu do sa.
Sɛ dɔm EWURADZE no enngyaa hɛn nkaa kakraabi a, nkyɛ yɛayɛ dɛ Sodom, nkyɛ yɛayɛ dɛ Gomora.
Hom ntsie EWURADZE asɛm, hom Sodom mpanyimfo! Gomora ɔman e, hom nyɛ aso mma hɛn Nyankopɔn ne nkyerɛkyerɛ.
Hom afɔrbɔdze dodow yɛ dɛn ma me? EWURADZE na ɔse: nguannyin ɔhyew afɔr afon me, na anyɛmbowa seradze adɔ me; minnyi enyigye wɔ anantwi, nguambaa, anaa mpɔnkye bɔgyaa mu.
Sɛ hom ba befir m’enyim a, woana hwehwɛ iyi wɔ hom nsamu, dɛ wobetsiatsia m’abanguado?
Mma hom mmfa ayɛyɛdze hun biara mmba bio; eduhuam nhyewee yɛ me ekyiwadze; bosoom fofor na ahomgyeda, baguabɔ, Munnkotum ahwɛ ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn a emumuyɛ wɔ mu.
Hom abosoom fofor na hom afahyɛ no me kra kyir: ɔyɛ me ɔhaw; na maberɛ no soa.
Na sɛ hom tserɛw hom nsamu a, mibeyi m’enyiwa ehuntsa hom: sɛ hom yi mpaa mpo a, emi dze, mirinntsie: bɔgya ayeyɛ hom nsa amaama.
Hom nhohor homho, hom ntsew homho; hom nyi hom emumuyɛdze no mfi m’enyiwa do; hom ngyaa bɔn yɛ:
Hom nsua papa yɛ; hom nhwehwɛ atsɛmbu, hom ngye nyia wɔhaw no no, hom ndzi mma egyanka, hom ntotɔ nserɛ mma okunafo.
Afei hom mbra ma yɛndwen mbɔ mu ɛ, EWURADZE na ɔse: kaansa hom bɔn tse dɛ adaaben mpo a, ɔbɔhoa dɛ esukwankyɛba; kaansa ɔber dɛ bɔgyaben mpo a, ɔbɛyɛ sakoo dɛ guannhwi.
Sɛ hom pen do na hom yɛ setsie a, hom bedzi asaase no do ndzepa:
na sɛ hom pow na hom tsew etua a, wɔdze afona bɛsɛɛ hom: na emi EWURADZE na maka.
Ɔyɛ dɛn na kurow nokwafo adan edwaman yi! Ɔno a nkyɛ atsɛntsenenee ahyɛ no ma! Ndzeyɛtsenenee tsenaa no mu, na afei dze ewudzifo a.
Wo dwetɛ adan ifi, wo nsa wɔdze nsu afora mu.
Wo man do ahwɛfo yɛ etuatsewfo, na nwuradan anyɛnkofo; hɔn mu biara pɛ mboabagye, na wodzi akatua ekyir: wonndzi mma egyanka, eso okunafo asɛm nndu hɔn enyim.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, dɔm EWURADZE no, Israel Tumfo no a: Aa, mubohue m’ebufuhyew egu m’ahohiahiafo do, na medzi mo wer wɔ m’atamfo do.
Mebɛdan me nsa aba wo do, na medze semina etu wo fi no, mibeyi wo ho nkekaa nyina.
Mebɛdan w’atsɛmbufo ama wo dɛ asɔpɔn no, w’apamfo dɛ ahyɛse no: n’ekyir no wɔbɛfrɛ wo dɛ, Ɔtsenenee kurow, kurow nokwafo.
Wɔdze atsɛmbu bɔpon Zion, na wɔdze tsenenee apon ne mba a wɔasakyer.
Na mbratofo na ndzebɔnyɛfo hɔn sɛɛe bɔbɔ mu aba prɛko, na hɔn a wɔdan EWURADZE gya no wɔbɛhyew hɔn.
Na hɔn enyi bɔto wɔ nsudur a hom hom enyi gyee ho no ho, na hom enyim egu ase wɔ nture a hom asan mu afa no ho.
Na hom bɛyɛ dɛ osudur a n’ahaban apo, na ture a nsu nnyi mu.
Na ɔhoɔdzenfo bɛyɛ dɛ otuw, na n’edwuma ayɛ dɛ ogyansenama, na ebien nyina abɔ mu ahyew, na obi runndum no.
Asɛm a Amoz ne ba Isaia nyae a ɔfa Juda na Jerusalɛm ho.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ nda a odzi ekyir no mu no, mbepɔw a EWURADZE fi si do no, bɔbɔ mbepɔw nyina do, na wɔbɛma no do abɔ akoko nyina do, na amanaman bɛpem aba ho.

Na aman pii bɛba abɛse dɛ, Hom mbra ma yɛnkɔ EWURADZE bepɔw no do, yɛnkɔ Jakob Nyankopɔn no ne fie; ama ɔaakyerɛkyerɛ hɛn n’akwan, ma yɛaanantsew n’atsempɔn mu: na Zion na mbra befi aba, na EWURADZE n’asɛm efi Jerusalɛm.
Na obobu amanaman ntamu atsɛn, na woesi gyinae ama nkorɔfo pii: na wɔdze hɔn mfona abobɔ nsɔw, na wɔdze hɔn mpeaa abobɔ nsɔsɔw: ɔman bi remma afona do nntsia ɔman fofor, eso worunnsua akodzi bio.
Ao Jakob fifo, hom mbra ma yɛnnantsew EWURADZE kan no mu.
Na ɔwo adan wo man egya, Ao Jakob fi, osiandɛ atɔrmuadze a ofi boka ahyɛ hɔn ma, na wɔayɛ ɔsebramufo dɛ Filistiafo, na wɔnye ananamba futuw mu.
Hɔn asaase ayɛ dwetɛ na sika ma; na hɔn akoradze so nnyi ewiei; hɔn asaase ayɛ mpɔnkɔ ma, na hɔn ntseaseanam so nnyi ewiei.
Hɔn asaase so ayɛ abosom ma; wɔsɔr hɔnankasa hɔn nsaano edwuma, dza hɔnankasa hɔn nsatseaba ayɛ no.
Wɔma dasanyi bɔ famu, na wɔbrɛ nyimpa adze: dɛm ntsi mma mmfa nnkyɛ hɔn.
Kɛhɛn ɔbotan mu, na huntsa woho wɔ huntuma mu, fi EWURADZE ho hu no enyim, nye no tumdzi enyimnyam no enyim.
Nyimpa enyiwa a ɔtra no ntɔn no bɛbrɛ adze, na nyimpa n’ahopɔw bɛba famu, na EWURADZE nko ara na wobohuhor no wɔ da no mu.
Na dɔm EWURADZE ne da bi wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛba nkontompɔfo na ahopɔwfo nyina do, na ahomemadonyi biara do;
na ɔbɛba Lebanon nkyindur a ɔwowaree na ɔyɛ kusuww no, na Bashan nsudur nyinara do;
na mbepɔw sorɔnsorɔm nyinara, na akoko a amema do nyinara do;
na abantsentsen biara, na ɔfasu a wɔaban ho biara do;
na Tarsis ahɛn nyinara, na ahwɛdze a ɔyɛ fɛw nyinara do.
Na wɔbɛbrɛ nyimpa n’ekromponsɛm adze, na adasa ahopɔwsɛm bɛba famu; na EWURADZE nko ara na wɔbɔkrɔn no da no mu.
Na abosom botwa mu akɔ koraa.
Na wɔbɛhɛn abotan ntokur mu, na famu etu mu, efi EWURADZE no ho hu ho, na no tumdzi enyimnyam enyim, ber a ɔbɔsoɛr abɔwosow asaase dzendzenndzen no.
Da no mu na nyimpa bɔtow no dwetɛ abosom, na ne sika abosom a wɔyɛe maa no dɛ ɔnsɔr no no akyen, ama nkusi na mpan;
ama wɔaakɛhɛn abotan ntokur na abo mpaapaae mu, efi EWURADZE ho hu ho, na no tumdzi enyimnyam enyim, ber a ɔbɔsoɛr abɔwosow asaase dzendzenndzen no.
Hom ngyaa nyimpa a n’ahom wɔ n’ahwentokura mu no ekyir dzi: na ebɛnadze mu ara na wobu no bi?
Na hwɛ, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no rututu efi Jerusalɛm na Juda nyina, dua a wɔtwer nye dua a wɔdze waw ekyir edziban dze, na nsu dze nyina:
ɔkatakyi, na ɔsabarimba; ɔtsɛmbuafo, na nkɔnhyɛnyi, ɔdzehunyi, na ɔpanyin:
eduonum do safohen, na onyimdzefo, ɔpamfo, na nkongyaayinyi mapa, na nyia onyim nkankye yie no.
Na mebɛma mbanyimbasiaba ayɛ hɔn asafohemfo, na mbɔdomaba edzi hɔn do mpanyin.
Na nkorɔfo bɛhaw hɔnho, oyi na oyi, na obi na ne nyɛnko: akɔkowaba bɛhyehyɛ noho wɔ akɔdaa do, na atsetsekwaa so wɔ onyimnyamfo do.
Da no mu no, sɛ obi suo no nua a ɔwɔ n’egya fie mu, dɛ, Ɔwo ewɔ atar, ntsi bedzi hɛn do panyin, na soa adzesoa durdur yi a:
ɔbɛma ne ndze do, dɛ, Merennyɛ ɔyarsafo; na edziban anaa atar bi nnyi me fie: mma hom nnyɛ me ɔman panyin.
Nyew, Jerusalɛm edwuruw! Na Juda ahwe ase: osiandɛ hɔn gyirama na hɔn nyɛe tsia EWURADZE, wɔdze bu n’enyimnyam no enyimtsia.
Hɔn nyaatwom dzi dase tsia hɔn; na wɔda hɔn bɔn edzi dɛ Sodomfo, wɔmmfa nnsuma. Wondue! Na wɔdze bɔn abrɛ hɔnho.
Hom nka nkyerɛ atseneneefo no dɛ obesi hɔn yie: na wobedzi hɔn nsaanodze.
Omumuyɛnyi ndue! Obowie no mbusu: na ne nsaano akatua na wɔdze bɛma no.
Me man dze, mbofraba nye hɔn ahyɛdofo, na mbaa dzi hɔn do mpanyin. Ao me man, w’akandzifo ma efom, na wɔsɛɛ w’atsempɔn kwan.
EWURADZE egyina ridzi asɛm, oegyina rubu aman atsɛn.
EWURADZE nye me man mu mpanyimfo na no mu asafohemfo bɔkɔ asɛndzii: Homara na hom edzi wenyin ture no; abɔbɔfo asadze wɔ hom efiefi mu.
Ase nye dɛn na hom dwerew me man, na hom hyɛ abɔbɔfo amen yi? EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
EWURADZE see bio dɛ, Osiandɛ Zion mbabaa yɛ ahopɔw, na wɔtoto hɔn kɔn na wɔdeda hɔn enyi ekyir nantsew; na wɔkyeakyea nantsew ma hɔn nansa nkaba gyegye ntsi:
EWURADZE bɛma satwem egu Zion mbabaa etsifi pampamu, na EWURADZE bɛda hɔn adagyaw edzi.
Da no, EWURADZE beyi hɔn anantuadze fɛɛfɛw no, na dza wɔdze ahyehyɛ hɔn etsir no;
asowamuadze, nsakɔnadze, na nkataenyim;
abɔtsir, na anadwe ntweaban, na abɔdo, na nduhuam mpakyiwa, na nsɛbɛ;
mpɛtsea, na hwenmuadze;
afahyɛ ntar, na egugudo, na nkatakɔnmu, na mbɔtɔwa;
nhwehwɛmba, na ndwera pa, akyekyertsir na nkataenyim.
Na bɔnee bɛhyɛ ohuam ananmu; na ntampehoma ahyɛ abɔdo ananmu; na etsipaa ahyɛ takuwa a woesi no yie ananmu; na eyitam abɔdo bɛhyɛ abɔyamu ananmu: na fɛr ahyɛ ahoɔfɛw ananmu.
Wo mbarimba bɔtotɔ afona ano, na w’akatakyi atotɔ ɔsa mu.
Na n’aponkɛse botwa ewuo na oegyam; na ɔbɛda hɔ pan na ɔatsena famu.
Na mbaa beesuon bosuo ɔbarimba baako mu wɔ da no mu, dɛ, Yebedzi hɛnara hɛn edziban, yeefura hɛnara hɛn atam: ma wɔmfa wo dzin nto hɛn do ara: na yi hɛn enyimguase wɔ hɛn do.
Da no mu na EWURADZE no dubaa no bɛyɛ fɛɛfɛw na enyimnyam, na asaase no do aba bɛyɛ abɔso na enyisɔ ama Israel mu hɔn a woefi nsa no.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ nyia wɔgye no wɔ Zion, na nyia ɔka wɔ Jerusalɛm no, wɔbɛfrɛ hɔn krɔnkrɔn, mekyerɛ obiara a wɔakyerɛw ne dzin afora atseasefo mu wɔ Jerusalɛm:
ber a EWURADZE enya ahohor Zion mbabaa ho fi, na ɔdze atsɛmbu sunsum na ɔhyew sunsum ebeyi Jerusalɛm bɔgya efi kurow no mu no.
Na EWURADZE bɛyɛ nsuwusiw na wusiw adzekyee, na ogyaframee hyerɛn anadwe dze akata Zion bepɔw do tsenabea nyina, na n’ehyiadzi nyina do: na enyimnyam no nyina benya nkatado.
Na ɔbɛyɛ ntamadan a ɔma nwin ewiaber fi ɔhyew mu, na ɔayɛ guandɔbea na huntsabea wɔ ehum na nsutɔ mu.
Ma montow mo dɔfo pa ndwom, ɔdɔ ndwom a ɔfa no wenyin ture ho. Mo dɔfo pa nyaa wenyin ture bi wɔ koko do asaaseber bi do.
Otwaa ho nsuka, na ɔtasee mu abo, na ɔtsetsɛɛw mu wenyindua pa, na ɔtoow abantsentsen wɔ mu, na otuu nsatwer so wɔ mu: na n’enyi daa kwan dɛ ɔbɔsow wenyinaba, naaso ɔsoow kwaa mu wenyinaba.
Na afei, hom Jerusalɛmmba, nye Juda mbarimba, meserɛ hom, hom mbu emi na mo wenyin ture ntamu atsɛn.
Ebɛnadze na aka dɛ nkyɛ meyɛ mema mo wenyin ture bio a mennyɛe? M’enyi daa kwan dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɔsow wenyinaba no, ɔsoow kwaa mu wenyinaba.
Na afei, mebɛma hom ehu dza medze bɛyɛ mo wenyin ture no. Mibeyi no ho ban, ma mbowa eedzi; mubobubu no ho ɔfasu ma woeetsiatsia do.
Mobɔto no pan; wonnkotwitwa ho, eso wɔnnkɔdɔw ho; na obofuw nkɔkrɔw na nsoɛ: na mebɛhyɛ nsuwusiw so dɛ mma ɔnntɔ nyankom nngu do.
Dɔm EWURADZE no wenyin ture nye Israel fie, na Juda mbarimba nye no kwa a n’enyi gye ho: na ɔhwɛɛ pɛrpɛryɛ kwan, naaso hwɛ, emimdzi nye yi; ɔhwɛɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee kwan, naaso hwɛ, nkekamu a.
Wondue, hɔn a wɔdze ofi toa ofi do, wɔdze kwa ka kwa ho, kodu dɛ ɔkwan bi nnyi hɔ, na hom nkotsee tsena ase asaase do!
Dɔm EWURADZE aka no m’asomu dɛ, Ampaara, adan pii bɛyɛ afo, dza ɔsosoe na ɔyɛ fɛw, nnkenya obi atsena mu.
Na wenyin ture susuhoma du bɛma wenyin galɔn enum pɛr, na aba kutu kɛse kor bɛma esusudze kor pɛr.
Wondue, hɔn a wɔsoɛr anapahema tu enguan kedzi nsadzen ekyir; na wosi pe anadwe, ma nsa fram hɔn!
Wɔwɔ nsankutsen na bɛntasanku, akasaa, na atɛntɛbɛn, na wenyin nsa, wɔ hɔn aponto ase; naaso wommbu EWURADZE ne ndzeyɛe bi, ne nsaano edwuma so wɔnndwendwen ho.
Dɛm ntsi na me man etu kɔ ndɔmmum, osian nyimdzee a wonnyi ntsi: na ɔkɔm dze hɔn enyimnyamfo, na nsukɔm rehyew hɔn nyimpadodow.
Dɛm ntsi na samanadze atrɛ n’akɔndɔ mu, na ɔahan n’anomu petoo: ma Jerusalɛm enyimnyam, na ne nyimpadodow, n’apɔmpɔmpɛ, na nyia n’enyi gye mu, nyina risian kɔ mu yi.
Na wɔdze nyimpa aba famu, na ɔabrɛ mbarimba adze, na ahopɔwfo enyi aka famu.
Naaso dɔm EWURADZE dze, wohuhor no wɔ pɛrpɛryɛ mu, na Nyankopɔn Krɔnkrɔnnyi no dze, ɔda noho edzi wɔ ndzeyɛtsenenee mu.
Ɔno na nguambaa bedzidzi dɛ hɔn edzidzibea do, na akobɔfo bedzi hɔn a wɔatɔ angoa no hɔn asaasefo no.
Wondue, hɔn a wɔdze egyangyandze hom a twe emumuyɛ, na wɔdze hwiir ntampee twe bɔn:
hɔn a wɔka dɛ, Wɔmma ɔnyɛ no ntsɛm ɛ, ɔnyɛ n’edwuma ntsɛm ma yɛnhwɛ, wɔmma Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no n’apam mbɛn na ɔmbra ma yenhu!
Wondue, hɔn a wɔfrɛ bɔn dɛ papa, na papa dɛ bɔn; hɔn a wɔdze sum yɛ kan, na wɔdze kan yɛ sum; hɔn a wɔdze wenwen yɛ fenemfenem, na fenemfenem yɛ wenwen!
Wondue, hɔn a wɔyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn enyi do enyansafo, na wɔyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn enyi do abadwembafo!
Wondue, hɔn a wɔyɛ akatakyi wɔ nsanom mu, na ahoɔdzenfo wɔ nsadzen no fora mu:
hɔn a wobu omumuyɛnyi bem gye mboaba, na wɔgye ɔtseneneenyi ne nsamu tsenenee!

Dɛm ntsi dɛ mbrɛ ogya tɛkyerɛma dzi mburonan, na gyaframee hyew nkyɛkyɛr guanee no, dɛmara so na hɔn ndwow bɔprɔw, na hɔn nhyiren botu afa sor dɛ huntuma: osiandɛ wɔapow dɔm EWURADZE ne mbra, na woebu Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no n’asɛm enyimtsia.

Dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE n’ebufuw redzɛw ne man do, na ɔatsen ne nsa etsia hɔn, na ɔabɔ hɔn, ma akoko ho ehim, na hɔn efun ayɛ dɛ abɔntsen do wura. Iyi nyinara mu, n’ebufuw nntɔree, na ne nsa da ho ara tsen.
Na ɔbɛma frankaa do ama amanaman a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir, na ɔabɔ nhwiroma afrɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ asaase ano noho no: na, hwɛ, wɔdze ahoɔhar bɛba ntsɛmara.
Hɔn mu obiara mmberɛ, eso obiara mmfintsiw; obiara nntɔ nkom anaa ɔnnda; hɔn asen mu abɔdo rennsan, eso hɔn mpaboa ho ahoma renntsew.
Hɔn egyen menaba ano yɛ hwironhwirom, na hɔn egyen nyinara akonkom; wobobu hɔn mpɔnkɔ ananadze dɛ ɔtwerɛbo, na hɔn nhwiir dɛ ekyinehyia mframa:
Hɔn pɔw bɛyɛ dɛ ogyata dze, wɔbɔpɔw dɛ ngyatafɔr: nyew wɔbɔpɔw, na wɔatɔ afonam, na wɔdze akɔ sɔnn, obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɛgye hɔn.
Na wɔbɔpɔw ahyɛ hɔn do da no dɛ po rowor: na sɛ obi hwɛ asaase a, hwɛ, sum na ahoguan, na kan ahyɛ sum wɔ wimu hɔ.
Afe a ɔhen Uzia wui no, muhun EWURADZE dɛ ɔtse ahengua bi a ɔkrɔn na wɔama do do, na n’atar ekyir ntoado hyɛɛ asɔrfi no ma.
Serafim gyinagyina no do: ɔbaako wɔ ntsaban esia; ɔdze ebien kata n’enyim, na ɔdze ebien kata n’anan ho, na ɔdze ebien tu.
Na ɔbaako tseaa mu kyerɛɛ ɔbaako dɛ, Krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, Krɔnkrɔn nye dɔm EWURADZE: asaase nyina ahyɛ n’enyimnyam ma.
Na apondua no ase wosowee wɔ nyia ɔtseaa mu no ne ndze ntsi, na wusiw hyɛɛ ofi no ma.
Nna mesee dɛ, Mundue! Na mewu ara nye no; osiandɛ meyɛ nyimpa a m’ano ho nntsew, na metse ɔman a hɔn ano ho nntsew mu: na m’enyiwa ehu Ɔhen, dɔm EWURADZE no.
Nna Serafim no mu ɔbaako tui baa me nkyɛn, okitsa ogyansenama a ɔdze ɔdabaa kɛfae wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do:
na ɔdze kaa m’ano, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, iyi aka w’ano; na woeyi w’emumuyɛ no kɔ, na wɔapo wo ho bɔn.
Nna metsee EWURADZE ne ndze dɛ ɔrese dɛ, Woana na mobɔsoma no, na woana na ɔbɔkɔ ama hɛn? Nna mesee dɛ, Emi nye yi; soma me ɛ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Kɔ, kɛse ɔman yi dɛ, Ɔtse ara nna hom ntse, na mma hom nntse ase; na ohu ara nna hom nhu, na mma hom nnhu mu.

Ma ɔman yi n’akoma mpirim, na ma hɔn asowa nyɛ durdur, muamua hɔn enyiwa; amma wɔaammfa hɔn enyiwa ennhu, na wɔaammfa hɔn asowa so anntse, na hɔn akoma anntse ase; na wɔaannsakyer, ma wɔaannsa hɔn yarba.
Nna mesee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE, onkodu dabɛn? Na obuaa dɛ, Onkodu dɛ nkurow no ayɛ afoafo a obiara nntse mu, efiefi ayeyɛ efitɔw a nyimpa nntsetse mu, na asaase no ayɛ afo koraa,
na EWURADZE aka nyimpa akɔ ekyirkyiikyir, na mbea a wɔadan egya no adɔɔ so wɔ asaase no do.
Na sɛ ebupɛn du mu kor ka wɔ mu mpo a, wɔbɛsan asɛɛ no bio: dɛ odupɔn na osudur a no dusin si hɔ, ber a wɔatow ato famu no, dɛmara so na n’asefo krɔnkrɔn no yɛ no dusin.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Uzia ba Jotam, ne ba Ahaz, Judahen no n’aber do, na Siriahen Rezin, na Remalia ba Peka Israelhen no fowee kɔr Jerusalɛm dɛ wɔnye no rokɔko; naaso woenntum no.
Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ David fie dɛ, Siria abɔbɔ Efraim mu, na ɔno nye ne man akoma tuu kɛsenara, na hɔnho wosowee dɛ mbrɛ kwaa mu ndua wosow wɔ mframa enyim no.
Nna EWURADZE see Isaia dɛ, Afei si mu kɔ kehyia Ahaz, ɔwo, na wo ba Sear-jasub, wɔ etsifi nsutaae no ano a ɔwɔ ɔtanhofo kwa tsempɔn mu no;
na se no dɛ, Hwɛ yie, na yɛ komm; mma nnsuro, eso mma w’akoma nntu, wɔ ngyantsia ebien a opun wusiw yi no ndua ebien no ntsi, wɔ Rezin na Siria na Remalia ba no hɔn ebufuhyew no ntsi.
Osiandɛ Siria apam wo do mbusu, Efraim so, ɔnye Remalia ba no, dɛ,
Hom mma yɛnkɔ Juda do, na yɛnkɛhaw no, na yembubu mu mfa, na yɛnhyɛ Tabeel ba no hen wɔ mu:
mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi, Orinngyina, eso ɔremmba mu.
Osiandɛ Siria tsir nye Damaskɔs, na Damaskɔs tsir nye Rezin: Na obodu mfe eduosia enum no nna woebubu Efraim posoposo a ɔnnkɛyɛ ɔman bi bio,
na Efraim tsir nye Samaria, na Samaria tsir nye Remalia ba no. Sɛ hom renngye nndzi a, ampaara hom rinntsintsim.
Na EWURADZE kasaa bio kyerɛɛ Ahaz, dɛ,
Bisa EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn hɔ asɛnkyerɛdze bi; sɛ osian kɔ samanadze bun mu o, ɔkrɔn kɔ sor o.
Na Ahaz see dɛ, Mirimmbisa, eso moronnsɔ EWURADZE nnhwɛ.
Na Isaia see dɛ, David fi, afei hom ntsie, aso osuar ma hom dɛ hom haw nyimpa, na afei hom bɛhaw emi Nyankopɔn so yi?
Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE nankasa bɛma hom asɛnkyerɛdze. Hwɛ, akataasia no benyinsen awo ɔbabanyin, na wɔato no dzin Immanuel, a asekyerɛ nye: Nyankopɔn nye hɛn wɔ hɔ.
Numfonsu na ewo na obedzi, ber a ohu dɛ ɔpow bɔn, na ɔsan mu yi papa no.
Na ansaana abofra no bohu dɛ ɔpow bɔn na ɔsan mu yi papa no, wɔbɛpa asaase no a hɔn isuro hɔn ahemfo beenu no egya.
EWURADZE dze nda bi bɛba ɔwo, na wo man, na w’egya fi do a ofitsi nda a Efraim tsewee fii Juda ho no ɔmmbaa da; mekyerɛ Asiriahen no.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no, EWURADZE bɔbɔ nhwiroma afrɛ wansema a ɔwɔ Egypt nsutsen ano noho no, na adowa a ɔwɔ Asiria asaase do no.
Na wɔbɛba, na hɔn nyina abɛgyegye bɔnsa a osian kuronn no mu, nye abotan mpaapaae mu, na nsoɛ nyina do, na nhaban nyina do.
Da no na EWURADZE dze oyindam a wɔabɔ no paa wɔ esuegya noho no a ɔno ɔnye Asiriahen no beyi tsir nye anan ho nhwi, na oeyi abɔdwesa so.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no obi bɛnyɛn ɔnantwiburwa na nguan ebien bi;
na ɔbɛba dɛ, numfonsu dodow a wɔbɛma no ntsi, obedzi numfonsudaa: na numfonsudaa nye ewo na obiara a ɔaka ɔman no mu no bedzi.
Na da no mu no ɔbɛba dɛ, beebiara mbrɛ nkyɛ wenyinndua apem a odzi ndwetɛbona apem wɔ, bɛdan nkɔkrɔw nye nsoɛ ara nko.
Egyen menaba nye egyen na wɔdze bɛba hɔ.
Na akoko a nkyɛ wɔdze asɔw dɔw do nyina no, ennkɔkɔ hɔ bio, wɔ nkɔkrɔw ɔnye nsoɛ ho hu ntsi, na wobegya anantwi akɔ do, na nguan etsiatsia do.
Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Fa kyerɛwpon kɛse, na fa ɔdasanyi ne nsaano kyerɛw do dɛ, Maher-salal-has-baz;
na mebɛma adasefo anokwafo edzi me dase, ɔsɔfo Uria, na Jeberekia ba Zekaria.
Na mokɔr nkɔnhyɛnyibaa no ho na onyinsenii woo ɔbabanyin. Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, To no dzin Maher-salal-has-baz,
osiandɛ ansaana abofra no bohu mbrɛ wosi ka, M’egya, anaa Me na no, Asiriahen bɔsoa Damaskɔs ahonya na Samaria asadze edzi n’enyim akɔ.
Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ me bio dɛ,
Susuampa dɛ ɔman yi apow Siloa nsu a ɔpem nyaa, na hɔn ho asɛpɛw Rezin nye Remalia ba no ho yi;
dɛm ntsi, afei, hwɛ, EWURADZE dze esutsen no mu nsu a ɔyɛ dzen na ɔdɔɔ so no reba hɔn do, Asiriahen nye n’enyimnyam nyina, na ɔbɛba abɔfow n’esuka nyina na ɔatra n’esukɔn nyina do;
na ɔbɛpram akɔ Juda do, na oeyir etwa mu akɔ; obodu kɔn ho mpo; na n’atsaban mu han bɛhyɛ w’asaase ne tɛtɛr nyina ma, Ao Immanuel.
Aman, hom nka homho mbɔ mu, na wɔbɔdwerew hom; ekyirekyir asaasedofo nyina, hom nyɛ aso: hom nsiesie homho mma ɔko, na wɔbɔdwerew hom ara.
Hom mbɔ mu nkɔ apam, na ɔbɛyɛ kwa; hom nka dza hom pɛ, naaso orinngyina: osiandɛ Onyankopɔn nye hɛn wɔ hɔ.
Na EWURADZE dze tum kɛse kasaa dɛm kyerɛɛ me, na ɔbɔɔ me kɔkɔ, dɛ mma mennantsew ɔman yi no kwan do, dɛ,
Mma hom mmfrɛ dza ɔman yi frɛ no Tsirdo apam nyina dɛ Tsirdo apam a; eso mma hom nnsuro dza wosuro, eso mma hom akoma nntu.
Dɔm EWURADZE no, ɔno na hom mbu no krɔnkrɔn; na ɔno na ɔnyɛ hom suro, na ɔnyɛ hom akomatu.
Na ɔbɛyɛ krɔnkrɔnbea ama hom, na ɔayɛ fintsiw bo, na patatsir botan ama Israel efiefi ebien nyina, na ɔayɛ apafir na efir ama hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm nyina.
Na dodowara befintsiw do, na wɔahwehwe ase, na woebubu, na wɔatotɔ efir mu, ma wɔaakyekyer hɔn.
Ɔwoara kyekyer dase no, sɔw nkyerɛkyerɛ no ano wɔ m’esuafo mu.
Na emi dze, mobɔtweɔn EWURADZE a ɔdze n’enyim suma Jakob fi, na mahwɛ no kwan.
Hwɛ, emi ɔnye mba a EWURADZE dze ama me yɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze wɔ Israel mu, ofi dɔm EWURADZE a ɔtse Zion bepɔw do no hɔ.
Na sɛ wɔse hom dɛ, Hom mbisa asamamfrɛfo nye esumamfo a wosu twɔtwɔw na wɔyɛ huhuhuhu no a: aso onntwar dɛ ɔman bi wobisa hɔn Nyame hɔ adze? Aso wombisa atseasefo ho asɛm wɔ ewufo hɔ?
Hom ndzi mbra no nye adasesɛm no do! Sɛ wɔannkasa dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse yi a, ɔnodze adzekyee bi nnyi hɔ ma hɔn.
Na wobodua mu etwa mu, na adzen hɔn, na ɔkɔm adze hɔn: na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔkɔm nya dze hɔn a, hɔn ahom bɛtsew hɔn, na wɔadom hɔn hen na hɔn Nyankopɔn, na wɔaama hɔn enyi akyerɛ sor.
Na wɔbɔhwɛ famu so, na hwɛ, ahokyer nye sum nye ahoguan kusuwwyɛ nye yi; na wobosun hɔn egu sum kebii no mu.
Na kusuwwyɛ no ronnko hɔ mma nyia ɔwɔ ahoguan mu no. Mber a odzi kan no, oemmbu Zebulun asaase na Naftali asaase bi, na ekyirii dze ɔahyɛ no enyimnyam, po kwan do, Jordan egya, amanaman Galilii.
Ɔman a wɔnantseew sum mu no, woehu kan kɛse, hɔn a wɔtsenaa owu sunsuma asaase do no, kan ahyerɛn hɔn do.
Ɔwo ama ɔman no adɔr, ɔwo ama hɔn enyigye adɔɔ so: hɔn enyi gye w’enyim dɛ otwaber mu enyigye, dɛ mbrɛ adasa dzi ehurusi ber a wɔrekyɛ asadze.
Na n’adzesoa kɔndua no, na ne batsir poma no, ne hyɛdofo abaa no, ɔwo ebubu mu dɛ Media da no.
Na ɔkofo n’akodze a ɔwɔ gyigyeegye no mu nyina, na ntar a wɔdze efuntamfuntam bɔgya mu, ɔbɛyɛ adze a wɔhyew, ɔnye ogya nyena.
Na wɔawo ɔba ama hɛn, wɔama hɛn ɔbabanyin; na ahendzi no bɛda ne batsir do: na wɔbɛfrɛ ne dzin Ɔpamfo Nwanwanyi, Onyankopɔn Katakyi, Ɔdomankoma Egya, Asomdwee Hen.

Na n’ahendzi na n’asomdwee ne trɛ nnkodu ewiei, wɔ David ahengua do na n’ahendzi do, dɛ obetsim no, na ɔdze atsɛmbu na tsenenee awowaw no ofitsi ndɛ dze ekesi mbersantsen. Dɔm EWURADZE no mbɔdzembɔ bɛyɛ yi.
EWURADZE dze asɛm bi kraa Jakob, na oebodwir Israel do.
Na ɔman no nyinara bohu, Efraim na Samariafo a wɔka wɔ nkontompɔ na hɔn akokodur mu dɛ,
Ntaayaa egu famu, na yɛdze abo a wɔasen besi: wɔatotow ankye ndua, na yɛdze nkyindur bɛhyɛ ananmu.
Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE bɛma Rezin ahohiahiafo do ahyɛ no do, na oekenyan n’atamfo.
Siriafo dzi boka, na Filistiafo dzi anee, wɔdze anomu petoo bɛmen Israel. Iyi nyinara mu n’ebufuw nntɔree, na ne nsa da ho ara tsen.
Naaso ɔman no nnsanee mmbaa nyia ɔbɔɔ hɔn no nkyɛn, eso wɔnnhwehwɛɛ dɔm EWURADZE n’ekyir kwan.
Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE botwa efi Israel mu da kor tsir na dua, berɛw na mbɛw.
Ɔpanyin na onyimnyamfo nye tsir no, na nkɔnhyɛnyi kyerɛkyerɛnyi torfo no, nye dua no.
Hɔn a wodzi ɔman yi enyim no ma wɔfom; na hɔn akwankyerɛ no sɛɛ hɔn.

Dɛm ntsi, EWURADZE rinnya hɔn mberantsɛ ho enyigye, eso onnyi ehumbɔbɔr ma hɔn ngyanka nye hɔn ekunafo: na obiara tsia Nyankopɔn, na ɔyɛ emumuyɛdze na ano biara ka nkwaseasɛm. Iyi nyina mu n’ebufuw nntɔree, na ne nsa da ho ara wɔ sor.
Na emumuyɛ hyew dɛ ogya; ɔmen nkɔkrɔw ɔnye nsoɛ: ampaara, ɔsɔ wɔ kwaa mu adɔtɔ mu, na opun wusiw kumbɔɔ fow kɔ sor.
Dɔm EWURADZE n’ebufuw do na asaase no ahyew tumm no: na ɔman no so ayɛ dɛ ogya nyena; obiara mmfa no nua ho nkyɛ no.
Wohwim fi enyimfa dzi, naaso ɔkɔm dze hɔn; Wodzidzi wɔ bankum, naaso wɔmmee: na wɔwewe hɔnara hɔn nsa ho nam.
Manaasɛ we Efraim, na Efraim we Manaasɛ: na hɔn beenu soɛr hyɛ Juda do. Iyi nyina mu n’ebufuw nntɔree na ne nsa da ho ara wɔ sor.
Wondue, hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ mbrakyew, na akyerɛwfo a wɔkyerɛw dza ɔkyea;
dɛ wɔredan ohianyi efi pɛrpɛryɛ ho, na woeehwim me man abɔbɔfo hɔn ndzinoa, na ekunafo aayɛ hɔn asadze, na wɔdze ngyanka aayɛ hɔn afonam!
Hom bɛyɛ dɛn wɔ ɔsera da no mu, na ɔsɛɛ a ofi ekyirekyir reba no mu? Woana hɔ na hom boguan akɛgye mboa? Na henfa na hom bɛdan hom enyimnyam egya?
Adaduafo ase nko ara na wɔbɔbɔ hɔn mu adze, na wɔahwehwe atɔfo ase. Naaso iyi nyina mu n’ebufuw nntɔree, na ne nsa da ho ara wɔ sor.
Asiria, due, m’ebufuw abaa, wo nsamu poma nye m’ebufuhyew!
Mobɔsoma no ɔman a wonnyim Nyankopɔn mu, m’ebufuw man no ho na mebɛhyɛ no mbra, dɛ ɔnkɔfow asadze, na ɔnkɛfa afonam, na onketsiatsia hɔn do dɛ abrɔn mu dɛtse.
Naaso ɔnndwen dɛm, eso n’akoma nnsusu dɛm; dza ɔwɔ n’akoma mu nye dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ, na oetwitwa amanaman a wɔdɔɔ so egu.
Na ɔka dɛ, Ana m’asafohen nnyɛ ahemfo bi a?
Aso Kalno nntse dɛ Karkemis bi a? Na Hamat nntse dɛ Arpad? Aso Samaria nntse dɛ Damaskɔs bi a?
Dɛ mbrɛ me nsa aka abosom ahendzi no a hɔn ehonyi a woegu kyɛn Jerusalɛm na Samaria dze no;
aso nnyɛ dza medze ayɛ Samaria nye n’abosom no, ara so na medze bɛyɛ Jerusalɛm nye n’abosom bi a?
Dɛm ntsi ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ EWURADZE wie n’edwuma nyina yɛ wɔ bepɔw Zion nye Jerusalɛm do a, mebɛtsea Asiriahen n’akomadzen no, nye n’ahomemado no.

Osiandɛ ɔaka dɛ, Me nsamu ahoɔdzen na medze ayɛ na ɔnye me nyansaa so, osiandɛ meyɛ ɔbadwembafo: na matwe aman no hɔn ahe no, na mafom hɔn akoradze, na mesun hɔn a wɔtsetse nhengua do egu dɛ ɔkakaben:
na me nsa aka amanaman ahonya no dɛ berɛbuw; na dɛ mbrɛ wɔtase nkyirefuwa a wɔadan egya no, dɛmara na matase asaase nyina: na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɔɔ atsaban mu, eso ɔhaan anomu, anaaso osuu twɔtwɔw.
Aso ekuma bɛhyehyɛ noho wɔ nyia ɔdze twa adze no do? Anaa seradaa bɛhyehyɛ noho wɔ nyia ɔtwetwe no do? Dɛ gyama abaa bi him nyia ɔma do no do, anaadɛ poma bɛma nyia ɔnnyɛ dua no no do.
Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, bɛma ɔfɔn aba n’abran do; na ɔasɔ n’enyimnyam ase ogya a ɔredzɛw.
Na Israel kan no bɛdan ogya, na ne Krɔnkrɔnnyi no adan gyaframee: na ɔbɛhyew na ɔaamen no nsoɛ nye no nkɔkrɔw nyina da kor.
Ɔbɛma no kwaa nye no mfuwa enyimnyam asa, ofitsi ɔkra do kesi nyimpadua do: na ɔayɛ dɛ aber a frankaakitsafo rotɔ bitsi.
No kwaa mu ndua nkaa no bosuar, ma abofra mpo eetum akan.
Na ɔbɛba da no mu dɛ, Israel nkaa no nye Jakob fi mu hɔn a woefi nsa no nnkɔtwer nyia ɔbobɔɔ hɔn no bio: na wɔbɔtwer EWURADZE, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no nokwar mu.
Nkaa no bɛsan aba, Jakob nkaa no bɛba Onyame katakyi no nkyɛn.
Na kaansa wo man Israel tse dɛ mpoano anhwea mpo, a, nkaa ara na wɔbɛsan aba: wɔahyɛ ɔhyew a ɔbɛpram ndzeyɛtsenenee do.
Na ndzɛmba ewiei a wɔahyɛ na EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, dze bɛba asaase nyina mu.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, se nye yi, Ao me man a etse Zion, mma nnsuro Asiria: kaansa abaa na ɔdze bɔhwe wo, na ɔama no poma do wɔ wo do, dɛ Egypt dze no mpo a.
Na aka kakrabaabi na ebufuhyew no abɔ adze, na n’ebufuw adan ayɛ hɔn sɛɛe.
Na dɔm EWURADZE behim mpirebi wɔ no do, dɛ Midian ekumii wɔ Oreb botan do no: na n’abaa bɛkyerɛ po no do, ɔama do dɛ Egypt dze no.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ n’adzesoa beyi efi wo batsir do, na kɔndua efi wo kɔn ho, na kɔndua no asɛɛ wɔ seradze no ntsi.
Ɔaba Aiat, oetwa mu wɔ Migron, ɔdze ne ndzɛmba rugu Mikmas:
wɔafa akoko ntamu; wɔakɔsoɛ Geba: Rama ho popo; Saul Gibea eguan.
Galim babaa, ma wo ndze do tsea mu! Laisa e, tsie ɛ! Anathot e, ma mbuae!
Madmena ayɛ oguamfo; Gebim atsefo aboa hɔn ano ruguan.
Ndɛ da yi ara wobesianka Nob: ɔbɔwosow ne nsa atsen Zion babaa ne bepɔw no do, Jerusalɛm koko no a.
Hwɛ, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, dze hu bɛpempan ndubaa no: na ndupɔn atsentsen no wɔbɔtotow ato famu, na dza wɔwowaree no abrɛ adze.
Na ɔdze dadze etwitwa kwaa mu adɔtɔ, na Lebanon nam ɔkatakyi nsa do ahwe ase.
Na mfɛwee bi befi Jesse dusin no mu afɛw, na odubaa efi no ndwow mu efir asow aba:
na EWURADZE no sunsum bodwir no do, nyansa nye ntseasee sunsum, apam nye ahoɔdzen sunsum, na nyimdzee ɔnye EWURADZE suro sunsum;
na EWURADZE ho suro mu na ɔbɛfa n’enyika: Na onnkedzi dza n’enyiwa hu no ekyir ebu atsɛn, eso onnkedzi dza n’asowa tse no ekyir aka enyim:
tsenenee mbom na ɔdze bobu ɔbɔbɔfo atsɛn, na ɔdze atsɛntsenenee aka enyim wɔ asaase no do abrɛfo no ntsi: na ɔdze n’anomu abaa abobɔ asaase no, na ɔdze n’anomu ahom eku omumuyɛnyi.
Na ndzeyɛtsenenee bɛyɛ n’asen abɔdo, na nokwardzi ayɛ n’abɔyamu.
Na pataku nye eguambaa bɛtsena, na ɔsebɔ nye apɔnkyeba ada hɔ; na nantwiba a ɔadɔ seradze nye ogyataba atsena fakor; na abɔdomaba ahwɛ hɔn do.
Na ɔnantwiber nye osisi bedzidzi, na hɔn mba abɔ mu ada fakor: na ogyata bɔwe efuw dɛ ɔnantwi.
Na enumfoanoba bɔgor ehurutsia tu ano, na ɔba a oetwa enumfo dze ne nsa ato ɔkyerben no bɔn mu.
Wɔnnkɛyɛ bɔn eso wɔnnkɛsɛɛ wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn nyina do: na EWURADZE ho nyimdzee bɛhyɛ asaase ma, dɛ mbrɛ esu kata po do.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ Jesse ndwow no besi hɔ dɛ frankaa ama aman no, n’ekyir kwan na amanaman bɔhwehwɛ; na n’ahomgyebea bɛyɛ enyimnyam.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ, EWURADZE dze ne nsa bosuo mu bio ne mprɛnu agye ne man nkaa wɔaka no efi Asiria na Egypt, na Patros, na Kus, na Elam, na Sinar, na Hamat, na po mu nsupruw no mu.
Obesi frankaa ama amanaman, na ɔapon Israel tokyemfo no aboa ano, na ɔatase Judafo a wɔapetse no efi asaase mfɛndzanan mu aboa ano.
Efraim n’enyitan so befi hɔ akɔ, na wobotwa hɔn a wohiahia Juda ho no efi hɔ: Efraim n’enyi nnkɛber Juda, na Juda so nnkehiahia Efraim ho.
Mbom wobotu ekesi Filistiafo kɔn ho wɔ anee; na wɔbɔbɔ mu akɔfom bokamba no. Wɔdze hɔn nsa bɔto Edom nye Moabmba do; na Ammonmba ayɛ setsie ama hɔn.
Na EWURADZE bɔwew Egypt po mu nsu korakora; na ɔdze ne hyew mframa bɔpopo ne nsa ho egu Esutsen no do, na ɔbɔbɔ no ma ɔadan nsubansuba esuon, ma nkorɔfo dze nsokota eedua mu wesee.
Na ɔtsempɔn bi bɛda hɔ efi Asiria ama me man nkaa a wɔaka no; dɛ mbrɛ ɔdaa hɔ maa Israel wɔ da a ofii Egypt asaase do bae no.
Na da no ebɛse dɛ, ao Ewuradze, medze ndaase mebɛma wo; na kaansa wo bo fuuw me a, w’ebufuw no adan kɔ, na ekyekye mo werɛ.
Hwɛ, Nyame nye mo nkwagye; mobɔtwer, na munnkosuro: Na Ewuradze Jehoyah nye m’ahoɔdzen nye mo ndwom: Na ɔno na ɔabɛyɛ mo nkwagye.
Dɛm ntsi enyigye na hom dze bɔtow nsu efi nkwagye bura no mu.
Na da no hom bɛkã dɛ, hom nda Ewuradze ase, hom mbɔ ne dzin, hom mbɔ ne nyɛe dawur nkyerɛ aman, hom mbɔ dzin dɛ wɔama ne dzin do.
Hom ntow ndwom mma Ewuradze; na ɔayɛ adze kyɛnee: Hom mma wonhu yi wɔ asaase nyina.
Keka mu na bɔ ose, ɔwo a etse Zion: Na Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi a ɔtse wo mu no ɔsõ.
Babilɔn ho nkɔnhyɛ a Amoz ba Isaia hunii.
Hom nsi frankaa wɔ bepɔw petee no do, hom mma hom ndze do mma hɔn, hom nyam nsa mma hɔn ama wɔaakɛhɛn ekunyin mbobotsen no mu.
Mahyɛ mo nkorɔfo a woetu hɔn esi nkyɛn no, nyew, mafrɛ me mbarimba akatakyi, mekyerɛ hɔn a wodzi mo tumdzi mu ehurusi no, dɛ wontu hɔn a m’ebufuw aba hɔn do no do sa.
Tsie dede wɔ mbepɔw no do dɛ gyama ɔman kɛse bi dze! Tsie ahendzi horow ne gyigyeegye, amanaman a wɔaboa ano hɔn dede a! Dɔm EWURADZE rotwe no dɔm roboa hɔn ano akɔ ɔko.
Wofi ekyirekyir asaase do, na wimu n’ewiei noho reba, EWURADZE, na n’ebufuhyew akodze no a, dɛ ɔrebɛsɛɛ asaase no nyina.
Hom ntwa ewuo; na EWURADZE da no abɛn; ɔbɛba dɛ ɔsɛɛ a ofi Otumfo no hɔ.
Dɛm ntsi nsa nyina mu bɔgow, na nyimpa akoma biara anan:
na hɔn bo botu; nketsenketse nye awerɛhow bekitsa hɔn; ɔyaw bɛba hɔn do dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo: obiara dze hu bɔhwɛ ne nyɛnko enyim; na hɔn enyim bɛyɛ gyaframee enyim.
Hwɛ, EWURADZE ne da no reba, etsirmɔdzen a ebufuw nye ebufuhyew ka ho; dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ asaase no afo, na ɔasɛɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo efi mu.
Na ɔsor nworaba ɔnye hɔn nworaba ekuwekuw nnkɛma hɔn kan: ewia bɛhyɛ sum wɔ ne mfirii mu, na bosoom so nnkɛma ne kan ahyerɛn.
Na mebɛtsea wiadze wɔ hɔn bɔn ntsi, na emumuyɛfo wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi; na mama ntsɛntsɛnnyi ne ntsɛn abɔ adze, na mama ahokyerɛfo hɔn ahokyerɛ abrɛ adze.
Mebɛma nyimpa ho ayɛ na asen sika mapa, ɔdasanyi bɛsen Ofir sikakɔkɔɔ mpɔkowa mpo.
Dɛm ntsi mebɛma ɔsorsor apopo, na wɔawosow asaase efi ne sibea, wɔ dɔm EWURADZE n’ebufuw no mu, na n’ebufuhyew da no mu.
Na dɛ ɔwansan a woritsiw no, anaa nguan a obi mmboa hɔn ano no, obiara bɛdan no ho akɔ no nkorɔfo nkyɛn, na woeguanguan akokɔ hɔn asaase do.
Obiara a wobohu no wobohwira no mu; na obiara a wɔbɛkyer no no, ɔbɔtɔ afona ano.
Woboposow hɔn mbɔtowaba so wɔ hɔn enyim; wɔbɔfow hɔn efi na wɔabobɔ hɔn yernom adapaa.
Hwɛ, murubohuenyan Mediafo etsia hɔn, hɔn a wonnkobu dwetɛ bi, na sika so wonnkenya mu enyigye.
Hɔn ngyen bɛtsetsew mberantsɛ mu esinesin, na worinnya tsimbɔbɔr mma yafun mu aba; na wonkenya ayamuhyehye ama mbofraba.
Na Babilɔn, ahendzi horow mu onyimnyamfo, Kaldeafo hɔn ahopɔw n’ahoɔfɛw no, ɔbɛyɛ dɛ Sodom nye Gomora ber a Nyankopɔn butuuw hɔn no.
Wɔrenntsena mu ara da, eso ebusuasantsen kesi ebusuasantsen renntsena hɔ: Arabnyi biara nnkɔbɔ asese wɔ hɔ; eso nguanhwɛfo nnkɛma hɔn nguankuw ebutubutuw hɔ.
Sar do mbowa abɔyafo mbom na wɔbɛdeda hɔ, na mpatu ebusufo bɛhyehyɛ hɔn adan amaama; na nsohor bɛtsena hɔ, na haban mu mpɔnkye asaw wɔ hɔ.
Na mpataku bosu wɔ hɔn aban mu, na sardo nkraman so, wɔ hɔn ahemfi fɛɛfɛw no mu: na ne ber abɛn dɛ ɔbɛba, na ɔnnkɛkyɛr ne ba no koraa.
Na EWURADZE benya ayamuhyehye wɔ Jakob ho, na ɔasan mu eyi Israel bio, na ɔdze hɔn esi hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do; na ɔnanaben dze noho abɔ hɔn ho, na wɔatakyer Jakob fi ho.
Na aman no bɛfa hɔn, na wɔdze hɔn aba hɔn tsenabea, na Israel fie afa hɔn ayɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa wɔ EWURADZE asaase no do, na wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmumfafo no ndɔmmum; na wɔahom hɔn ahyɛdofo do.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da a EWURADZE bɛma wo ahomgye efi wo yaw, wo fona, na wo nhyɛsom dzendzen a wɔdze wo kɔr mu no mu no,
edze bɛ yi bobu Babilɔnhen, na ase dɛ, Mbrɛ ɔhyɛdofo esi egyaa a! Sika kurow no edua abɔ adze a!
EWURADZE ebubu omumuyɛnyi n’abaa, na mpanyindzifo ahempoma so;
nyia ɔdze ebufuw bobɔɔ aman bobɔ a onngyaa da, na ɔdze ebufuw hoom amanaman do hyɛɛ hɔn amen a obi ennsianka no.
Asaase nyina adwe, na ɔayɛ dzinn: wɔtow ehurusi ndwom.
Nyew, ɔpepeaa so nya wo ho enyigye, na Lebanon nkyindur ndua ka dɛ, Ofitsi dɛ wɔdze wo too famu yi, ɔtowfo biara mmfowee mmbaa hɛn do.
Samanadze efi ase akeka noho dɛ oribehyia wo mbae kwan; okenyan ewufo ma wo; hɔn a nkyɛ wɔyɛ asaase do etsitsir nyinara no a; ɔama amanaman ahemfo nyinara asoɛrsoɛr efifi hɔn nhengua do.
Hɔn nyinara bɛgye do na wɔaka akyerɛ wo dɛ, Ɔwoara so na egura dɛ hɛn yi? Ayɛ dɛ hɛnara so pɛr yi?
Wɔabrɛ w’akɛseyɛ adze akɔ samanadze, na wo mbɛntasanku dede no; wɔasɛw nsaamaa mpa dɛ wɔ w’ase, na nsaamaa nye w’akatado.
Mbrɛ edua na ifi sor ahwe ase a, Ao Adzekyee Nworaba, Anapa ba! Mbrɛ woedua etwa wo ato famu a, ɔwo a ebrɛɛ amanaman adze no!
Na ekae wɔ w’akoma mu dɛ, Mobɔfow makɔ sor, Nyankopɔn no nworaba etsifi, mebɛma m’ahengua do atra; na matsena mboanofo bepɔw no do wɔ kwaamu afamu etsifi ano noho tɔnn.
Mobɔfow matra nsuwusiw n’etsifi no ho ara; mebɛyɛ moho dɛ Abɔso no.
Naaso wɔabrɛ wo adze akɔ samanadze ekodu mona no n’ase noho ara.
Hɔn a wohu wo bɔhwɛ wo kann Wɔbɔdwen wo ho dɛ, Aso nyimpa no a ɔmaa asaase wosowee, na ɔmaa ahendzi hihimii no nye yi;
nyia ɔmaa wiadze yi yɛɛ dɛ sar, na obutuuw no mu nkurow; na oenngyaa n’adaduafo ma wɔaannkɔ fie nye yi?
Amanaman ahemfo nyinara deda enyimnyam mu, obiara deda nankasa n’adakamona mu.
Na ɔwo dze, wɔatow wo efi w’asamandan mu akyen, dɛ odubaa a wɔapow, dɛ atɔfo a afona ehwirahwira hɔn mu na woesian kɔ mona no n’abo ho na wɔakata wo do; dɛ fun a ɔnamɔn etsiatsia do.
Wɔnnkɛfa wo aka hɔn ho wɔ efunsie mu, osiandɛ asɛɛ w’asaase, ekuku wo mamba. Emumuyɛfo asefo edzin dze, mma wɔmmbɔ no dabiarada bio.
Hom nsiesie ekumii mma mba no wɔ hɔn egyanom emumuyɛ ntsi; ama wɔaannsoɛr ammfa asaase no enndzi do, na wɔaammfa nkurow annhyɛ wiadze mu ma.
Na mobɔsoɛr etsia hɔn, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse. Na metwa dzin na hɔn a wɔaka, mba na asefo nyinara efi Babilɔn.
Na mebɛyɛ no nkɔtɔkɔ tsenabew, na nsu ntaataae so, na medze ɔsɛɛ mena mapra no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Dɔm EWURADZE aka ntam, Ampaara, dɛ mbrɛ madwendwen ho no, dɛmara no ɔbɛba mu, na dɛ mbrɛ mobɔɔ tsirmpɔw no, dɛmara na obegyina:
dɛ mubobubu Asirianyi no wɔ m’asaase do, na medze m’anamɔn etsiatsia no do wɔ me mbepɔw do; nna no kɔndua befi hɔn do akɔ, na n’adzesoa efi hɔn abatsir.
Iyi nye tsirmpɔw a wɔabɔ ɔfa asaase nyina ho; na iyi nye nsa a wɔatsen no wɔ amanaman nyina do.
Na dɔm EWURADZE abɔ tsirmpɔw, na woana botum ama ayɛ gyan? Na ɔatsen ne nsa, na woana na ɔbɔpon mu?
Afe a ɔhen Ahaz wui no mu, na atsɛmbusɛm yi bae.
Mma nndzi ehurusi, ɔwo Filistia nyina, dɛ abaa a ɔhwee wo no ebu ntsi: na ɔwɔ no ndwow mu na ɔkyerben befir aba, na n’aba bɛyɛ dɛ ogya abowatsena a otu.
Na ɔbɔbɔfo n’abakan bedzidzi, na ohianyi ada hɔ dwudwoodwo: na medze ɔkɔm boku wo ndwow, na wo nkaasefo so wobokuku hɔn.
Abobokɛse e, twa ewuo; kurow e, keka mu; ɔwo Filistia nyina ma w’akoma ntu; na wusiw fi kwaamu afamu reba, na no dɔm mu obiara nnkegyina ekyir.
Ebɛn asɛm na wɔdze bobua amanaman asomafo no? Dɛ EWURADZE dze Zion etsim hɔ, na no mu na ne man mu amandzehufo benya guandɔbew.
Moab ho atsɛmbusɛm. Ɔnam dɛ anadwe da kor na wɔasɛɛ Ar ntsi, Moab abɔ; na anadwe da kor na wɔasɛɛ Kir ntsi, Moab abɔ.
Dibonmba afow kɔ, wɔkɔ nsorɔnsorɔmbea no do rukosu: Moab rutwa ewuo rutwa gu Nebo na Medeba do: hɔn nyinara hɔn etsifi apepa, abɔdwesa biara woetwitwa.
Wofurafura eyitam wɔ abrɔn mu: hɔn adan etsifi, na hɔn eguabirim, obiara rutwa ewuo, rusu pii.
Na Hesbon na Eleale rekeka mu; wɔtse hɔn ndze ara kodu Jahaz mpo: dɛm ntsi na Moab akofo rekeka mu dzendzen; ne kra ho him wɔ no mu.
M’akoma keka mu ma Moab; n’ekunyin guan kɔ Zoar, wɔkɔ Eglath-selisiya: na Luhit afowee no, na wɔdze osu fow; na Horonaim kwan mu na wɔma ɔsɛɛ ewuotwa do.
Na Nimrim esu bɛyɛ kwawee: na sar no eguan, na mfunoma no asa, na ha momon biara nnyi hɔ.
Dɛm ntsi adze pii a woenya, na dza wɔapɛ esie, na wɔbɔsoa akɔ wɔdze bɔkɔ esukɔnndua no wora no ho.
Na nkeka mu afow kɔ, abɔ Moab he do aprɔw ehyia; na ewuotwa no du Eglaim, na ewuotwa no du Beer-elim.
Na Dimon esu ayɛ bɔgya ma: na medze bi so bɛka Dimon ho, ogyata bɔtɔ nyia ofi Moab boguan, ɔnye asaase no do nkaa no do.
Wɔdze nguambaa fi Sela nam sar do afamu akɛma, asaase no do hwɛdofo no wɔ Zion babaa bepɔw no do.
Dɛ nnoma a worikyin, ɔnye berɛbuw a wɔahotse mu, dɛm na Moab mbabaa bɛyɛ wɔ Arnon esutwae.
Ma apam, bua atsɛn; yɛ wo nwinwin dɛ anadwe wɔ ewiaber ketee: fa hɔn a wɔapam hɔn huntsa; mma nnkyerɛ ɔkobɔfo do kwan.
Ma Moab atokyemfo no ntsena wo nkyɛn; yɛ huntsabea ma hɔn wɔ ɔsɛɛfo no enyim. Sɛ ɔpempensifo no fi hɔ na ɔsɛɛ bɔ adze, na ahyɛdofo sa wɔ asaase no do a,
nna wobetsim ahengua bi wɔ mbɔbɔrhu mu, na obi atsena do wɔ nokwar mu wɔ David ntamadan mu nyia obu atsɛn, na ɔhwehwɛ atsɛmbu, na ɔpɛ ntsɛm yɛ tsenenee.
Yɛatse Moab horan a ɔahoran dodow no nka; n’ahopɔw, no nkontompɔ, na n’ebufuw; naaso n’ahohyehyɛ yɛ gyan.
Dɛm ntsi ma Moab ntwa ewuo, obiara ntwa ewuo mma Moab: Kir-hareset esikyireamba tatar ntsi hom bɛka mmɔn dɛ wɔabobɔ hom pasaa.
Na Hesbon mfuwa akyenkyen, na Sibma wenyindua no so; amanaman ewuranom no ebubu n’abaw fɛɛfɛw no; ɔtserɛw kodu Jazer mpo, ɔtserɛwee kɔr sar no do, na okotwaa mu wɔ po do.
Dɛm ntsi medze Jazer osu bosu, Sibma wenyindua: medze me nyinsuwa bogugu wo do nsu, Ao Hesbon, na Eleale: wo nduaba nye wo twaber do na ɔko mu nkekamu no abɔhwe.

Na woeyi enyigye efi hɔ, na dɛw no efi nhabamber no mu; na adwontow biara nnyi wenyin nture no mu anaa ehurusi dede biara nnkɛba hɔ: na okyifo biara nnkekyi wenyin wɔ nsakyimona mu; mama esikyireambatsew dede abɔ adze.
Iyi ntsi me kra si nkrum dɛ sanku ndze wɔ Moab ho, na m’akoma so wɔ Kir-heres ho.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ Moab yi noho edzi, sɛ ɔberɛ wɔ sorɔnsorɔmbea hɔ, na ɔba no krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ beyi mpaa a, orinndzi nyim.
Iyi nye asɛm a EWURADZE kae wɔ Moab ho aber a ɔabɛsen.
Na afei dze EWURADZE se dɛ, Mfe ebiasa mu, dɛ ɔpaanyi mfe no, na Moab nye ne nyimpadodow pii no nyinara hɔn enyimnyam bɛyɛ gyan; na hɔn a wɔbɛka no bɛyɛ ketseabaa a wonnyi ahom biara.
Aa, ntsaban worakaworaka asaase a ɔwɔ Etiopia nsutsen egya no ho:

nyia otu ahembɔfo nam po do, a wɔtsetse ndzɛm ahɛn mu wɔ nsu enyi! Hom nkɔ, abɔfo a hom ho yɛ har, hom nkɔ ɔman a wɔyɛ apankor trontrom no nkyɛn, nkorɔfo a mbɛnee na ekyirekyir suro hɔn no nkyɛn; ɔman bi a wɔwɔ tum na wɔka nkorɔfo hyɛ a nsutsen etwitwa hɔn asaase mu no!
Hom wiadzemba nyinara, hom asaase do atsefo, sɛ wosi frankaa wɔ mbepɔw do a, hom nhwɛ; na sɛ wɔbɔ akasamu mu a, hom ntsie.
Na dza EWURADZE aka akyerɛ me nye yi, Mebɛyɛ komm, na mahwɛ wɔ me tsenabea; dɛ ewiaber ketee mu ɔhyew, dɛ ɔbɔsu nsuwusiw wɔ otwaber hyew mu.
Na otwaber nnyae nndurii na nkukuduuduw apaa, na nhyiren adan wenyinaba a ɔregyegye no, ɔdze adar botwitwa nsasar no egu, na ndubaa a ɔatsentsen no etwitwa mu egu.
Wobegya ne nyinara hɔ ama mbepɔw do nnoma edzinam, ɔnye asaase do mbowa, na nnoma edzinam bedzi ɔpɛber wɔ do, na asaase mbowa nyinara edzi do awɔwber.

Ber no mu wɔdze akyɛdze bɛbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE; wɔdze fi nkorɔfo apankor trontrom no, nkorɔfo a mbɛnee na ekyirekyir nyinara suro hɔn, ɔman a wɔwɔ tum na wɔka nkorɔfo hyɛ a nsutsen etwitwa hɔn asaase mu no mu no, bɛba dɔm EWURADZE ne dzin tsenabea, bepɔw Zion no do.
Egypt ho atsɛmbusɛm nye yi. Hwɛ, EWURADZE tse nsuwusiw a ano yɛ har do nam, na ɔreba Egypt: Egypt abosom botutu wɔ n’enyim, na Egyptfo akoma anan wɔ hɔn mu.
Na mibekenyan Egyptfo etsia Egyptfo: wɔnye hɔnho bɔkoko, obiara nye no nua, na obiara nye ne nyɛnko; kurow nye kurow, na ahenman nye ahenman.
Na Egypt no sunsum bɔtɔ pan wɔ no mu; na mebɛsɛɛ n’egyinatu; wobɔkɔ ebisa wɔ ebisatsirfo, asamamfrɛfo, na abayifo nkyɛn.
Na mibeyi Egyptfo ahyɛ owura tsiɔdzennyi bi nsa; na ɔhen a no ho yɛ hu edzi hɔn do tum, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, na ɔse.
Na po mu nsu bohuam, na esutsen no bɛsa na ɔawew.
Na nsutsen no bɔbɔn; na Egypt nwora bɔtwe na wɔawewew; na ndzɛmbir nye atsen no bɛkyenkyen.
Kwawee bɛba Nael ho, nye Nael no kɔn do efuw do, dza woedua no wɔ Nael ho nyina boguan, ahotse efi hɔ na wonnkohu bio.
Na apofo so bɛka mmɔn na woedzi nkɔmbɔ, nyew, hɔn a wɔtotow Nael mu nyina; na hɔn a wogu nsu no enyi eboa so, wɔbɛyeyɛ samoo.
Nkyii so asaabaserɛwfo na hɔn a wɔwen ndwera enyi bɔto.
Na n’edum nyina bobubu esinesin, na apaadzifo nyina werɛ bɔhow.
Zoan banodzifo yɛ nkwasea koraa; Farao n’apamfo mu enyansafo hɔn apam adan mbowasɛm. Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom se Farao dɛ, Meyɛ onyansafo ba, tsetse ahemfo ba?
Henfa koraa na afei w’enyansafo wɔ? Afei ma wɔnka nkyerɛ wo ɛ ma wonhu; tsirmpɔw a dɔm EWURADZE abɔ no wɔ Egypt ho.
Zoan banodzifo adan nkwasea, na Memfis banodzifo adwen efura mu; na hɔn a wɔyɛ no mbusuakuw kutuwdo bo no, wɔama Egypt atɔ dɔnsuar.
EWURADZE dze basabasayɛ sunsum afora Egypt mu: na wɔama Egypt atɔ ntentan wɔ n’edwuma biara mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsabokwafo tɔ ntentan wɔ ne fe mu.
Eso biribiara remmba mma Egypt a ɔpanyin anaa ekumaba, berɛw anaa mbɛw bɛyɛ.
Da no mu Egypt bɛyɛ dɛ mbaa; na no ho bɔpopo na oesuro wɔ dɔm EWURADZE ne nsahim a obehim no wɔ do ntsi.
Na Juda asaase bɛyɛ Egypt hu, obiara a wɔbɔ ne dzin kyerɛ no bosuro, wɔ dɔm EWURADZE ne tsirmpɔw a ɔabɔ etsia no ntsi.
Da no mu nkurow enum bɛba Egypt asaase do a wɔkasa Keenan kasa, na wɔka ntam kyerɛ dɔm EWURADZE; wɔbɛfrɛ kor Ewia kurow.
Da no mu afɔrmbukyia besi Egypt finimfin ama EWURADZE, na nkyindur ndua besi ne he do ama EWURADZE.
Na ɔbɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze nye dase ama dɔm EWURADZE wɔ Egypt asaase do, na sɛ wosu kyerɛ EWURADZE wɔ ahyɛdofo no ntsi a, ɔdze ɔgyefo nye twitwagyefo bɛbrɛ hɔn, na ɔabɛgye hɔn.
Na EWURADZE beyi noho akyerɛ Egypt, na Egyptfo bohu EWURADZE wɔ da no mu; nyew, wɔdze afɔr nye ayɛyɛdze bɔsom no, na wɔabɔ EWURADZE anohoba, na wɔayɛ.
Na EWURADZE bɔbɔ Egypt, ɔbɔbɔ hɔn na ɔayɛ hɔn edur; na wɔbɛsan aba EWURADZE nkyɛn, na obetsie hɔn ntotɔserɛ na ɔayɛ hɔn edur.
Da no mu ɔtsempɔn kwan bɛda hɔ fi Egypt akɔ Asiria, na Asirianyi aba Egypt, na Egyptnyi akɔ Asiria; na Egyptfo nye Asiriafo abɔ mu asom.
Da no mu na Israel bɛka Egypt nye Asiria ho, na ebiasa yi ayɛ nhyira wɔ asaase finimfin:
osiandɛ dɔm EWURADZE ehyira hɔn, dɛ, Nhyira nka me man Egypt, na me nsaano edwuma Asiria, na m’egyapadze Israel.

Da no mu Egypt bɛyɛ dɛ mbaa; na no ho bɔpopo na oesuro wɔ dɔm EWURADZE ne nsahim a obehim no wɔ do ntsi.
Na Juda asaase bɛyɛ Egypt hu, obiara a wɔbɔ ne dzin kyerɛ no bosuro, wɔ dɔm EWURADZE ne tsirmpɔw a ɔabɔ etsia no ntsi.
Da no mu nkurow enum bɛba Egypt asaase do a wɔkasa Keenan kasa, na wɔka ntam kyerɛ dɔm EWURADZE; wɔbɛfrɛ kor Ewia kurow.

Na ɔbɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze nye dase ama dɔm EWURADZE wɔ Egypt asaase do, na sɛ wosu kyerɛ EWURADZE wɔ ahyɛdofo no ntsi a, ɔdze ɔgyefo nye twitwagyefo bɛbrɛ hɔn, na ɔabɛgye hɔn.
Na EWURADZE beyi noho akyerɛ Egypt, na Egyptfo bohu EWURADZE wɔ da no mu; nyew, wɔdze afɔr nye ayɛyɛdze bɔsom no, na wɔabɔ EWURADZE anohoba, na wɔayɛ.

Da no mu ɔtsempɔn kwan bɛda hɔ fi Egypt akɔ Asiria, na Asirianyi aba Egypt, na Egyptnyi akɔ Asiria; na Egyptfo nye Asiriafo abɔ mu asom.
Da no mu na Israel bɛka Egypt nye Asiria ho, na ebiasa yi ayɛ nhyira wɔ asaase finimfin:
osiandɛ dɔm EWURADZE ehyira hɔn, dɛ, Nhyira nka me man Egypt, na me nsaano edwuma Asiria, na m’egyapadze Israel.
Afe a Tartan baa Ashdod, ber a Asiriahen Sargon somaa no, na ɔnye Ashdod bɔkoe na ɔfae no;
ber no mu nna EWURADZE nam Amoz ba Isaia do kaa dɛ, Kɔ, kɛpa eyitam no fi w’asen mu, na san mpaboa no fi w’anan. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm dze adagyaw nye anamɔnkwaa nantsewee.
Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ m’akowaa Isaia nam adagyaw nye anamɔnkwaa mfe ebiasa ma ɔaayɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ɔnye anwanwadze ama Egypt na Etiopia yi;
dɛmara na Asiriahen bɛka Egyptfo ndɔmmumfo na Etiopiafo amantufo akɔ, mbofra na mpanyin, adagyaw mu na anamɔnkwaafo a hɔn etun deda hɔ, ama Egypt enyi aato.
Na hɔn bo botu na hɔn enyi ato, wɔ hɔn enyidado Etiopia ho, na hɔn enyimnyam Egypt ho.
Na nsuano kuromnyi no bɛka wɔ da no mu dɛ, Hwɛ, mbrɛ hɛn enyidado a yeguanee kɔdɔɔ hɔ dɛ wɔnkɛgye hɛn mfi Asiriahen nsamu tse nye yi: na hɛn dze, yɛyɛ dɛn fi nsa?
Po ho sar do atsɛmbusɛm. Dɛ ekyinehyia mframa a ofi Negeb robɔ ba no, ofi sar no do ba, ofi asaase a ɔyɛ hu do.
Enyido adzehu a ɔyɛ awerɛhow na woeyi akyerɛ me; ɔfomfafo rofom fa, na ɔsɛɛfo no resɛɛ. Elam ee, fow kɔ; Media ee, kɔ no ntuae; apensi a ɔdze abɔbɔ dze nyina mama aba ewiei.
Dɛm ntsi na m’asen mu guan me yerɛyerɛw; ɔkyem aka me, dɛ ɔbaa awokofo kyem; ɔyɛ me yaw ma menntse asɛm; mabɔ hu ara ma munnhu adze.
M’akoma tow pɛmpɛm, suro eyi mo hu: ewimbir kan a mo kɔn dɔe no adan ahopopo ama me.
Wɔto pon, wɔsɛw nkuntu mpa, wodzidzi na wɔnom. Banodzifo ee, hom nsoɛr, hom nsera kyɛm no ho.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE aka akyerɛ me nye yi, Kɔ, fa ɔweɔmfo kegyina hɔ; ma ɔnka dza ohu nkyerɛ:
na sɛ ohu dɔm, mpɔnkɔdofo beenu beenu, nsoasopɔnkɔ dɔm na efumpɔnkɔ dɔm a, ɔnkyɛn n’aso pɛnn ara ntsie.
Na ɔweɔmfo no bɔɔ mu dɛ ogyata dɛ; Ao, EWURADZE, migyina aweɔnee aban do daa adzekyee, na misi m’atsɛwee anadwe nyina:
na hwɛ, nyimpa dɔm reba, mpɔnkɔdofo beenu beenu. Na obuae see dɛ, Babilɔn ahwe ase, ɔahwe ase; na n’abosom ehonyi a woegu nyina ebubu egu famu.
Ao ɔwo m’aporowee, na m’aporoweebea do eburow: dza matse wɔ dɔm EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn no anomu no na maka makyerɛ hom yi.
Duma ho atsɛmbusɛm. Obi fi Seir refrɛ se me dɛ, Ɔweɔmfo, anadwe ber bɛn nye yi? Ɔweɔmfo, anadwe ber bɛn nye yi?
Ɔweɔmfo no see dɛ, Orudu anapa, na adzesaa so reba; sɛ hom bebisa a, hom mbisa: hom nsan, hom mbra.
Arabia ho atsɛmbusɛm. Kwaa a ɔwɔ Arabia no mu na hom bɔsoɛ, Ao, Dedanfo akwantufo kuw.
Obi a osukɔm dze no no, brɛ no nsu; Tema asaase do atsefo ee, hom mfa edziban mbehyia eguamfo no.
Osiandɛ mfona ano na wofi guanee, afona a wɔatwe a, egyen a wɔapon, na ɔko dzendzen ano a.
Na dza EWURADZE aka akyerɛ me nye yi, Afe kor mu, dɛ ɔpaanyi mfe, na Kedar enyimnyam nyina apa:
na egyentofo hɔn dodow nkaa no, Kedarmba akatakyi no, hɔn ho bosuar: na EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔaka.
Enyido adzehu bɔnsa no ho atsɛmbusɛm. Ebɛnadze yɛ hom na hom afow yi, hom nyinara kɔ adantsifi koraa yi?
Ɔwo a esebɔ ahyɛ wo ma, weɔɔweɔɔyɛ kurow, ahosɛpɛw man; w’atɔfoe wɔanntotɔ afona ano, eso woennwuwu wɔ akono.
Wo tumdzifo nyina bɔɔ mu guanguanee kɔree, nnyɛ egyentofo kyekyeer hɔn: hɔn a wohun hɔn no nyina wɔkyekyeer hɔn, kaansa woguanee kɔr ekyirekyir mpo a.
Dɛm ntsi na mesee dɛ, Hom nyi hom enyi mfi mo do, ma munsu wenwennwen; mma hom mmper nnkyekye mo werɛ, wɔ me man ne babaa ne sɛɛe no ho.
EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, ahyɛ da bi; ɔyɛ ɔkogu, na ntsiatsiado, na enyibɔ da wɔ enyido adzehu bɔnsa no do; ɔfasu no ndwuruwii na mbepɔw ho sufrɛ.
Na Elam kitsaa egyen kotoku, ɔnye ntseaseanammufo na mpɔnkɔdofo; na Kir maa kyɛm no ho daa hɔ.
Ntseaseanam yɛɛ wo mbɔnsa fɛfɛɛfɛw mu amaama, na mpɔnkɔdofo totoo nkuropon no ano.
Na oeyi Juda akataho no efi hɔ; da no ehwɛɛ akodze a ɔwɔ kwaa mu fi no mu no.
Na hom hun David kurow no ne mpaapaae no, dɛ wɔayɛ pii: na hom boaboaa ase nsutaae no no nsu ano.
Na hom kaan Jerusalɛm adan, na hom bubuu adan no dɛ hom dze rowowaw afasu no.
Hom yɛɛ korabea so wɔ afasu ebien no ntamu dze maa nsutaae dadaw no no nsu; naaso hom annhwɛ onyia no a ɔyɛɛ adze yi, eso hom emmbu nyia a ɔhyehyɛɛ no dadaada no bi.
Na da no mu, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, maa osu, na ewuotwa, etsipra, na eyitamfura bae:
naaso hwɛ, hom dze enyigye na ahosɛpɛw, anantwi menetwa na nguankum, namdzi nye nsanom. Hom kaa dɛ, hom mma yendzidzi nnom, na ɔkyena na yeewuwu.
Na dɔm EWURADZE yii me asotsiw dɛ, Ampaara wɔnnkɛfa emumuyɛ yi akyɛ hom ma ekodu dɛ hom bowuwu, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, na ɔse.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, se nye yi, Kɔ fotosamfo Sebna yi a odzi ofi no do no nkyɛn kɛse dɛ,
Ereyɛ dɛn wɔ ha na woana na ewɔ no wɔ ha, na etwa asamandan wɔ ha yi? Irutwa asamandan wɔ sor, na irututu tsenabea ama wo ho wɔ botan mu yi?
Hwɛ, EWURADZE bɔtow wo akyen enyiberdo dɛ ɔkatakyi, nyew, ɔbɛkata wo do munum.
Ampaara ɔbɛdandan wo atow wo sor dɛ etɔw akyen ekyirekyir asaase do; hɔ na ibowu, na hɔ na w’enyimnyam ntseaseanam bɔkɔ, ɔwo a eyɛ wo wura fie enyimguase.
Na mubosun wo efi wo dzibew, na wobodwuruw wo efi wo gyinabea.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mebɛfrɛ m’akowaa Eliakim, Hilkia ba no:
na medze w’atar no ahyɛ no, na medze w’abɔdo emia no, na medze w’ahendzi mpanyindzi ahyɛ ne nsa: na ɔayɛ egya ama Jerusalɛmfo, na Juda fi.
Na medze David fie saafee bɔto ne batsir; na obobue, na obiara nnkɔtow mu; na ɔbɔtow mu, na obiara nnkobue.
Na mebɛpaa no do dɛ prɛgow a ɔwɔ mbrɛ hɔ yɛ dzen, na ɔbɛyɛ enyimnyam ahengua ama n’egya fie.
Na wɔdze n’egya fie enyimnyam nyina bɛsensɛn no do, n’asefo nye hɔn a wofi no mu nyina, kɔɔpow kakraba biara, ofi kukuwa do kesi asahina do.
Da no mu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, prɛgow a wɔdze bɔɔ mbrɛ hɔ yɛ dzen no bɔhɔr; na woetwa ma ɔatɔ famu, na adzesoa a ɔsensɛn do no atsew atɔ; na EWURADZE na ɔaka.
Taere ho atsɛmbusɛm. Tarsis ahɛn ee, hom ntwa ewuo; osiandɛ wɔayɛ Taere afo ma ofi nnyi mu bio, obi nnhɛn mu bio; wofi Kittim asaase do eyi akyerɛ hɔn.
Hom mpoanofo, hom ntaa dzinn; hom Sidon eguadzifo a hom twa po no wɔama hom ahyɛ ma.
Hom faa esu akɛse do hom ndzinoa nye Sihor aba, na Nael ho ndɔbaa; hom yɛɛ amanaman eguadzifo.
Ao Sidon, ma w’enyi nto, na po akasa, po mu abankɛse no, akasa dɛ, Monnkoo awoo, na monnwoo mba, eso mennyɛɛn mberantsɛ, na eso menntsetsee mbaabun.
Sɛ asɛm no kodu Egypt a, wobedzi yaw wɔ Taere ntsi.
Hom ntwa nkɔ Tarsis; ao hom mpoanofo, hom ntwa ewuo.
Ana hom enyigye kurow a ofi tsetse bɔbɔɔ adze no, na n’anan dze no dɔɔ mu kɔr ekyirekyir kɛtsenae no nye yi?
Woana abɔ tsirmpɔw yi etsia Taere, ahenkyɛwmafo kurow a n’eguadzifo yɛ mbapɔmba, na n’abatafo yɛ asaase do enyimnyamfo no?
Dɔm EWURADZE a, ɔabɔ ne tsirmpɔw dɛ obogu enyimnyam ahopɔw nyina ho fi, na ɔdze asaase do enyimnyamfo nyina aba enyimguase mu.
Bu do fa w’asaase do dɛ esutsen Nael, Ao Tarsis babaa; bambɔ biara nnyi hɔ bio.
Ɔatsen ne nsa wɔ po do, ɔawosow nhenman: EWURADZE ahyɛ Keenan ho mbra, dɛ wɔnsɛɛ n’aban kɛse.
Ɔaka dɛ, Innkedzi ehurusi bio, ɔwo Zidon ba ɔbaabun a wɔahyɛ wo do: soɛr, kotwa mu kɔ Kittim; na hɔ so mpo irinnya ahomgye.
Hwɛ, Kaldeafo asaase; ɔman yi wonnyi hɔ bio; Asirianyi no kyekyeree maa sar do mbowa: wosisii hɔn abantsentsen, wodwuruuw n’ahemfi; ɔmaa ɔyɛɛ amamfo.
Hom ntwa ewuo, Ao Tarsis ahɛn, na ɔasɛɛ hom akoban.
Da bi bɛba dɛ werɛ befir Taere mfe eduosuon, tse dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen kor ne nda tse: na mfe eduosuon n’ewiei no wɔbɛyɛ Taere tse dɛ dza ɔwɔ edwaman no no ndwom mu no.
Fa sanku kyin kurow no mu, edwaman a werɛ efir wo. Bɔ sanku dɛɛdɛw, tow ndwom pii, ama wɔaakaa wo.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, mfe eduosuon n’ewiei no, EWURADZE bɛba abɛsera Taere, na ɔasan enya n’apaadze, na ɔnye wiadze ahendzi horow a ɔwɔ asaase enyi nyina agor ndwamangor.
Na n’eguadze nye n’apaadze bɛyɛ krɔnkrɔndze ama EWURADZE: wɔnnkɛfa esie korakora, eso worinntsia; na n’eguadze bɛyɛ hɔn a wɔtse EWURADZE enyim no dze, na woedzi amee, na wɔayɛ efuradze a ɔkyɛr.
Hwɛ, EWURADZE bɛyɛ asaase no pan, na ɔama ɔayɛ afo na ɔadan no ebutuw, na ɔabɔ no do atsefo no apetse.

Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔman no tse no, mbrɛ ɔsɔfo tse ara nye no; mbrɛ akowaa tse no, mbrɛ no wura tse ara nye no; mbrɛ afonabaa tse no, mbrɛ no wuraba tse ara nye no; mbrɛ ɔtɔfo tse no, mbrɛ ɔtɔmfo tse ara nye no; mbrɛ ɔdzefɛmfo tse no, mbrɛ ɔdzefirfo tse ara nye no; mbrɛ nsihogyefo tse no, mbrɛ nsihomafo tse ara nye no.
Wɔbɔto asaase no no pan koraa na wɔafa no afo koraa: na EWURADZE na ɔakasa yi.
Asaase reka mmɔn, na oenyam, wiadze abotow na oenyam, wimu na asaase nyina enyinyam.
Asaase so asɛɛ wɔ no do mba ase; osiandɛ woetsiatsia mbra no do, wɔasakyer ahyɛdze no, wɔato daa ahyɛmu no.
Dɛm ntsi na ndom no amen asaase no; na no do atsefo woebu hɔn fɔ: dɛm ntsi na asaase no do atsefo no ahyew, na woegya nyimpa kakrabaabi yi.
Nsa fofor ridzi mmɔn, wenyindua enyam, akomamu enyigyefo risi nkrum.
Mpintsin ehurusidzi egyaa, ahosɛpɛwfo dede abɔ adze, sanku enyigye egyaa.
Wɔnnkɛfa adwontow anom nsa; nsa dzendzen bɛyɛ wen ama hɔn a wɔnom.
Woedwuruw asakrabutuw kurow no: wɔatow ofi biara mu, amma obiara aannkɔ mu.
Osu wɔ mbɔntsen do wɔ wenyin ntsi; enyigye nyina ahyɛ sum, asaase no do ehurusidzi etu kɔ.
Kurow no mu dza ɔaka nye amamfoyɛ, wɔdze ɔsɛɛ abɔ kuropon no.
Na dɛm na ɔbɛba asaase do wɔ aman mu, dɛ mbrɛ wɔwosow ngodua no, dɛ wenyin abatsew ekyir mpɛpɛwdzi.
Na wɔbɛma hɔn ndze do abɔ ose: EWURADZE akɛseyɛ ntsi wofi atɔe bɛtseatsea mu.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhyɛ EWURADZE enyimnyam wɔ boka, mekyerɛ EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn ne dzin no, wɔ po nsupruw mu.
Ofi asaase ano noho na yɛatse ndwom, ɔtseneneenyi n’enyimnyam no. Naaso meka dɛ, Morofɔn, morofɔn, mundue! Nkontompɔtwafo etwa nkontompɔ; nyew, nkontompɔtwafo etwa nkontompɔ paara.
Osuro, mona no, na efir no, da wo do, ɔwo asaase do mba.
Nyia oboguan osuro no ntsi no, ɔbɔtɔ mona no mu; na nyia obefi mona no mu epue no, efir no bɛpa no. Na woebuebue ɔsor ntokura na asaase fapem rihihim.
Asaase edwuruw koraa, asaase anan krɔngyenn, asaase ehim mbordo.
Asaase bɔto ntentan dɛ ɔsabofo, na oehimahima dɛ suaba; ne mbrato bɛyɛ no do dur, na ɔahwe ase a, ɔronnsoɛr bio.
Ɔbɛba dɛ, da no mu no, EWURADZE bɛtsea sor dɔm wɔ sor, na asaase ahemfo wɔ famu.
Na wɔaboaboa hɔn ano, dɛ mbrɛ wɔboaboa mpokyerɛfo ano wɔ mona no mu, na wɔatow hɔn efiadze mu, na nda pii ekyir no wɔakɔ akɛsera hɔn.
Ɔno na bosoom enyim bogu ase, na ewia enyi ato; osiandɛ dɔm EWURADZE bedzi hen wɔ Zion bepɔw do, na Jerusalɛm, na ne tsetsefo enyim enyimnyam mu.
EWURADZE, ɔwo nye me Nyankopɔn; mubohuhor wo, mibeyi wo dzin ayɛw; na ɔwo na ayɛ anwanwadze, nhyehyɛɛ dadaw, osi pi na ɔyɛ nokwar.
Na ɔwo na ayɛ kurow no ndamfo; kurow a wɔbɔ ho ban ayɛ kurofo, ananaben aban nnyɛ kurow bi; wɔronntow dabiarada.
Dɛm ntsi aman a wɔyɛ dzen bɛhyɛ wo enyimnyam, amanaman a hɔn ho yɛ hu kurow no bosuro wo.
Osiandɛ ɔwo ayɛ akoban ama ɔbɔbɔnyi, akoban ama ohianyi wɔ n’ahohia mu, ehum ano guandɔbew, ɔhyew mu nwinwin, osiandɛ etsiɔdzemfo no ehuhuw tse dɛ ehum a ɔhwe fasu.
Ɔwo brɛɛ ananaben dedeedeyɛ no adze dɛ ɔhyew wɔ bea kwawee do; wɔbrɛɛ etsiɔdzemfo no adwontow adze dɛ ɔhyew wɔ nsuwusiw nwinwin ase.
Bepɔw yi do na dɔm EWURADZE bɔto aman nyina pon: edziban a angoa wɔ mu, wenyin a ɔagyen atɔ mu, angoadze a ehuor ma, wenyin a ɔagyen atɔ mu a wɔasɔn do krɔnn.
Na bepɔw yi do na ɔbɛsɛɛ akatado a ɔkata aman nyina do no enyim; na akataenyim a wɔatserɛw no amanaman nyina do no.
Ɔamen owu daa; na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn bɛpepa enyiwa nyina ho nyinsuwa; na oeyi ne man ahorohoraa efi asaase nyina do akɔ: na EWURADZE na ɔaka.
Na wɔbɛka wɔ da no mu dɛ, Hwɛ, hɛn Nyankopɔn nye yi; yɛatweɔn no, ama ɔaagye hɛn nkwa: EWURADZE nye yi; yɛatweɔn no, hɛn enyi bɛgye na yeedzi ehurusi wɔ no nkwagye no mu.
Na bepɔw yi do na EWURADZE nsa bɛda, na wobetsiatsia Moab do wɔ n’afamu, dɛ mbrɛ wotsiatsia nkyɛkyɛr do wɔ suminado.
Na ɔbɛtserɛw ne nsamu wɔ hɔn finimfin, dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔrobor tserɛw ne nsamu bor: na ɔbɛbrɛ no nkontompɔ no adze ɔnye ne nsaano edwin no nyina.
Na w’aban dzendzen afasu a ɔkrɔn no ɔbɛbrɛ no adze, edwuruw no, na ɔama aka famu, ma adan huntuma mpo.
Da no na wɔbɔtow ndwom yi wɔ Juda asaase do dɛ: Yɛwɔ kurow a ɔyɛ dzen; obetsintsim nkwagye dɛ afasu na ntuae ban.
Hom mbuebue aponkɛse no, ama ɔman tsenenee a odzi nokwar no aahɛn mu.
Nyia n’adwen etsim wo do no, ebɔkora no asomdwee a odzi mu mu: osiandɛ ɔdze no werɛ hyɛ wo mu.
Hom ntwer EWURADZE daa daa: na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn mu na ɔdomankoma ɔbotantsim wɔ.
Ɔdze hɔn a wɔtsetse sor, kurow a ɔkrɔn no, aba daadze: ɔbrɛ no adze, ɔbrɛ no adze kɛka famu; nyew, ɔma ɔka huntuma mpo.
Anan tsiatsia do, ɔbɔbɔfo anan a, ohianyi anamɔn no a.
Ɔtseneneenyi no kwan yɛ tɔɔtsen; ɔwo na eyɛ atseneneefo kwantsempɔn tɔɔtsen.
Ɛhɛɛ, w’atsɛmbu kwan do, EWURADZE, na yɛahwɛ wo kwan: hɛn kra akɔndɔ gyina wo dzin ne nkaae do.
Me kra fe wo anadwe; nyew, mo sunsum a ɔwɔ mo mu hwehwɛ wo enyiberdo: na sɛ w’atsɛmbu ba asaase do a, wiadzemba bosua ndzeyɛtsenenee.
Wɔyɛ omumuyɛnyi yie dɛn ara a, onnsua ndzeyɛtsenenee; tɔɔtsenyɛ asaase do na odzi afomfonsɛm, na onnhu EWURADZE no tumdzi.
Ao EWURADZE, ama wo nsa do, naaso wonnhu. Ma wonhu wo mbɔdzembɔ wɔ wo man ho, na hɔn enyi ato: Nyew, ma ogya nhyew w’atamfo.
Ao EWURADZE, ɔwoara bɛhyehyɛ asomdwee ama hɛn: na ɔwoara na edzi hɛn dwuma nyinara so ama hɛn.
Ao EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn, ewuranom bi so edzi hɛn do tum aka wo ho; naaso ɔwo nko wo dzin na yɛbɔ.
Woewuwu, wɔnnkɛtsena ase; wɔadan nsamamfo, wɔnnkɔsoɛr: osiandɛ asera hɔn na asɛɛ hɔn, na apepa hɔn ho nkaa nyina koraa.
Naaso ama ɔman no adɔr, EWURADZE, ama ɔman no adɔr; wɔahyɛ wo enyimnyam: ɔwo atserɛw asaase no n’ahe nyinara mu.
Ao EWURADZE, ahohia mu na wɔhwehwɛɛ wo, wo ntsea baa hɔn do no, na wɔworaa mpaabɔ.
Dɛ mbrɛ ɔpemfo a ɔrebɛn n’awoo dzi yaw na ɔkeka mu wɔ n’awoko mu no; mbrɛ yɛayɛ wɔ w’enyim ara nye no, Ao EWURADZE.
Yeenyinsen, yeedzi yaw, ɔyɛ dɛ yɛawo mframa; yɛannyɛ ɔgye bi ho edwuma wɔ asaase do; eso wiadze mu mba nnhwehwee ase.
W’ewufo bɛtsena ase; hɔn efun bɔsoɛr. Hom a hom tse huntuma mu e, hom nyan na hom ntow ehurusi ndwom. Na wo bɔsu yɛ kan bɔsu, na asaase do ewufo do na ebɔtɔ egu.
Me man, hom mbra, hom mbɛhɛn hom adankyir mu, na hom ntotow homho mbobow mu: hom nhuntsa ber kakra, ma onkodu dɛ ebufuhyew no botwa mu akɔ.
Na hwɛ, EWURADZE fi ne tsebea rifir edzi abɛtsea asaase do mba wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi: asaase so bɛda no bɔgyaa edzi, na ɔrennkata n’atɔfoe do bio.
Da no mu na EWURADZE dze n’afona kɛse dzendzen ndam ndam no bɛtsea dɛnkyɛmnyin, dɛm ɔwɔ ɔhoɔharfo no, na dɛm ɔwɔ mpomponee no; na oeku esu mu abowapɔn a ɔwɔ po mu no.
Da no mu: Nsa wenyin ture, hom ntow ho ndwom.
Emi mara EWURADZE na mohwɛ do; mugugu do nsu aber nyina: mohwɛ do adzekyee na adzesaa amma biribiara aansɛɛ no.
Ebufuhyew nnyi mo mu: sɛ nkyɛ nkɔkrɔw na nsoɛ na wɔnye me ridzi esi wɔ akono a, nkyɛ mobɔbɔ afa hɔn do; na mahyew hɔn nyina.
Annyɛ dɛm a wɔmma wonsuo me bambɔ mu, na ɔnye me nsiesie; nyew, ɔnye me nsiesie.
Nda a ɔreba no mu, Jakob bɛgye ndwow; Israel bɔbɔ nhyiren abɔ nkukuduuduw: na wɔdze aba ahyɛ wiadze enyi ma.
Ana ɔabɔ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ hɔn a wɔbɔɔ no no? Anaadɛ aso woeku no dɛ hɔn a okunkum hɔn no hɔn kum no?
Hɔn mbrato ho na ehwɛɛ nye hɔn dzii; ɔdze aahow dzendzen eyi hɔn efi hɔ wɔ boka mframa da no mu.

Dɛm ntsi iyi na wɔdze bɔhor Jakob ne mbrato; na no bɔnyi no ho aba nyina nye yi; aber a oenya ayɛ afɔrmbukyia abo no nyina dɛ kaadowbo a wɔabor efurufuruw, ma hɔn abosom Aserim na ewia ehonyi no ronnsoɛr bio no.
Na kurow a wɔagye ho ban no ada mpan, ayɛ tsenabea a woetu do na wɔadan egya dɛ sar do; hɔ na nantwiba no bedzidzi, na hɔ na wɔbɛpempan n’abaw no pasaa.

Sɛ no ndubaa no guan a, wobobu akyen; mbasiafo bɛba abɛfa akɔsɔ gya, osiandɛ wɔyɛ ɔman a wonnyi ntseasee; dɛm ntsi nyia ɔyɛɛ hɔn no ne yamu rennhyehye no mma hɔn, na nyia ɔween hɔn no runnhu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
Na ɔbɛba da no mu dɛ EWURADZE bɔporow n’aba efi Esutsen no ne yir ho ekesi Egypt ɔwora no ho, na wɔatase hom nkorkor, ao Israelmba.

Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ wɔbɔbɔ akasamu kɛse bi mu; na hɔn a aka dɛ nkyɛ wɔhera wɔ Asiria asaase do, na hɔn a woeyi hɔn tokyen wɔ Egypt asaase do no aba; na wɔbɔsɔr EWURADZE wɔ bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do wɔ Jerusalɛm.
Efraim asabokwafo ahopɔw abɔtsir ndue, na n’ahoɔfɛw enyimnyam nhyiren a ɔromonsom no a ɔwɔ hɔn a nsa ato hɔn ntentan wɔ hɔn angoa bɔnsa no etsifi no!
Hwɛ, EWURADZE wɔ ahoɔdzenfo na ɔkatakyi bi; ɔtse dɛ ɔsorbo a orugu, ehum a ɔsɛɛ adze, na obodwiriw egu famu ahoɔdzen do dɛ nsutɔr dzendzen, dɛ esu a oeyir apram do.
Efraim asabokwafo ahopɔw abɔtsir no wobetsiatsia do wɔ ananadze:
na n’ahoɔfɛw enyimnyam nhyiren a amonsom a ɔwɔ angoa bɔnsa no etsifi no, ɔbɛyɛ dɛ adɔmba a odzi kan ber ansaana ɔpɛber edur a obiara a ohu no, odzi ne nsa ka ara a, na oewie dzi.
Da no mu na dɔm EWURADZE bɛyɛ enyimnyam abɔtsir na ahoɔfɛw ahenkyɛw ama ne man nkaa no:
ɔnye atsɛmbu sunsum ama onyia no a ɔatsena rubu atsɛn no, na ahoɔdzen ama hɔn a wopia ɔko fi kuropon ano san no.

Na woyinom so wɔnam nsa do ato ntentan, wɔnam nsadzen do wɔatɔ dɔnsuar; ɔsɔfo na nkɔnhyɛnyi nam nsadzen do ato ntentan, nsa amen hɔn, nsadzen ama wɔatɔ dɔnsuar, wɔfom wɔ enyido adzehu mu, wofintsiw wɔ atsɛmbu mu.
Na fe nye fi ayeyɛ edzidzipon nyina do ma, ma bea biara do nntsew.
Woana na ɔbɛkyerɛ no nyimdzee? Na woana na ɔbɛma ɔatse amandzɛɛ no ase? Hɔn a woetwa hɔn enumfo, na wɔatsew hɔn efi numfo ano no anaa?
Na ahyɛdze tsia ahyɛdze, ahyɛdze tsia ahyɛdze; mbra tsia mbra, mbra tsia mbra; ha kakra, hɔ kakra.
Dabida, mbom apɔtɔfo kasaa nye ananaben gyirama na EWURADZE dze bɛkasa akyerɛ ɔman yi.
Hɔn a ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ahomgye nye yi, hom mma nyia ɔaberɛ ahomgye; na ahotɔ nye yi: naaso wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie no.

Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE asɛm bɛyɛ hɔn dɛ; ahyɛdze a otsia ahyɛdze, ahyɛdze tsia ahyɛdze; mbra a otsia mbra, mbra a otsia mbra; ha kakra, hɔ kakra; ma wɔaakɔ na woeekotutu ahwe hɔn ekyir, na woeebubu, na wɔaatotɔ mfir mu, na wɔaakyer hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie EWURADZE asɛm, hom atwetwesifo a hom dzi ɔman yi a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm do mpanyin:
