N’enyiber emumuyɛ ntsi na mo bo fuwii na mobɔɔ no, muhuntsaa m’enyim na mo bo fuwii: naaso ɔdaa ho ara nantseew akɔnkyew mu wɔ n’akoma no kwan mu.
Mehu ne ndzeyɛɛ, naaso mebɛsa no yarba: mibegya no kwan so, na madan awerɛkyekyer ama no, na medze nsɛm a ɔyɛ dɛw ahyɛ no nkɔmbɔdzifo ano.
Asomdwee, asomdwee, nka nyia ɔwɔ ekyirekyir na nyia ɔbɛn, EWURADZE na ɔse; na mebɛsa no yarba.
Naaso emumuyɛfo tse dɛ po a ɔapram; osiandɛ ɔda a ɔnnda, na n’esu puw dɛtsebir na nwura gu.
Asomdwee bi nnyi hɔ ma emumuyɛfo, me Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Tsea mu, mma nnkam do, ma wo ndze do dɛ akasamu, na ka me man hɔn mbrato kyerɛ hɔn, na ka Jakob fifo hɔn bɔn kyerɛ hɔn.
Naaso wɔhwehwɛ me daa daa, na wɔpɛ dɛ wohu m’akwan: dɛ gyama ɔman bi a wɔyɛɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee, na wɔanndan hɔn Nyankopɔn nhyehyɛɛ enngya, wobisa mo hɔ atsɛntsenenee, wɔpɛ dɛ wopinkyɛn Nyankopɔn.
Ebɛnadze ntsi na yeedzi mbuada, na ɔwo innhu? Yeehiahia hɛn kra ho, na ɔwo mmfa nnyɛ hwee yi? Hwɛ, hom mbuadadzi da no mu, hom nya homankasa hom enyigye, na hom tseetsee hom edwumayɛfo.
Hwɛ, mansotwe na etutuwpɛ ntsi na hom dzi mbuada, na hom awowɔ emumuyɛ ekutuku: nnyɛ hom ndɛ mbuadadzi yi na ɔbɛma wɔaatse hom ndze wɔ sor.

Aso iyi nye mbuada a masan mu meyi no? Aso da a nyimpa hiahia ne kra ho nye yi? Aso ɔno nye dɛ ɔbɔbɔ ne tsir adze dɛ mbɛw, na ɔdze eyitam na nso asɛw n’ananadze? Aso ebɛfrɛ iyi dɛ mbuadadzi, na da a ɔsɔ EWURADZE enyi?
Ana nnyɛ iyi nye mbuadadzi a masan mu meyi? Dɛ hom bɛsansan emumuyɛ apɔw no, wɔapopɔr kɔndua nhoma no, na wɔama hɔn a wɔatseetsee hɔn no wɔaafa hɔnho edzi akɔ, na hom eebubu kɔndua nyina mu?
Ana nnyɛ ɔno nye dɛ ibubu w’edziban ma nyia ɔkɔm dze no, na dɛ edze abɔbɔfo a woeyi hɔn tokyen no ba wo fie? Sɛ ihu ɔdagyanyi a, ekata no ho; na dɛ emmfa woho nnhuntsa woara wo busuanyi.
Ɔno na wo kan bɛgyegye dɛ adzekyee, na w’ayarsa efifir ntsɛm: na wo tsenenee bedzi w’enyim; EWURADZE n’enyimnyam bɔbɔ wo nkyidɔm.
Ɔno na ebɛfrɛ, na EWURADZE bɛgye do; ebɛtsea mu, na ɔbɛse dɛ, Emi nye yi oo. Sɛ iyi kɔndua no, nsatseaba ne tsen, na ehuhukasa fi wo mu;
na sɛ edze dza wo kra no kɔn dɔ ma nyia ɔkɔm dze no, na ma ɔkra a oruhu amandze mee a; nna wo kan bopue wɔ sum mu, na wo kusuww ayɛ dɛ ewiaber ketee:
na EWURADZE begya wo kwan daa, na ɔama wo kra amee wɔ mbrɛ hɔ yɛ kwawee, na ɔama wo mbiew ayɛ dzen; na ebɛyɛ dɛ ture a woegugu mu nsu, na dɛ mbasu a no nsu nntwe.
Na hɔn a wobefi wo mu no bɛkyekyer tsetse ekurofo no: na wɔbɛfrɛ wo Osiw etu, Nyia ɔsesɛw akwan a wɔtsena mu.

Sɛ iyi w’anan fi ahomgyeda no ho, na annyɛ wo pɛ ho edwuma wɔ me da krɔnkrɔn no mu; na efrɛ ahomgyeda no enyigyedze, na EWURADZE n’akrɔnkrɔndze no dɛ enyimnyamdze; na idzi no nyi, na annyɛ woara wo kwan do adze, na annhwehwɛ woara w’enyigye, na annka woara wo nsɛm a:
ɔno na ebɛgye w’enyi wɔ EWURADZE mu; na mama anantsew asaase nsorɔnsorɔmbea do; na mama edzi w’egya Jakob n’egyapadze: na EWURADZE ano na ɔaka.
Hwɛ, EWURADZE ne basa nntwaa tsia, dɛ onntum nkwa gye; eso n’asomu nnyɛ dzen, dɛ ɔnntse asɛm:
na mbom hom emumuyɛ na apaa hom nye hom Nyankopɔn ntamu, na hom bɔn na oehuntsa n’enyi efi hom do, ma onnketsie.
Na bɔgya egu hom nsa ho fi, na emumuyɛ ehura hom nsatseaba ho; hom anofamfa aka atorsɛm, hom tɛkyerɛma hwinhwin ehuhusɛm.
Obiara nnsaman tsenenee mu, na obiara nndzi n’asɛm wɔ nokwar mu: wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛ egyangyandze mu, na wɔka atorsɛm; wonyinsen ewurkadze, na wɔwo emumuyɛ.
Wosuow akyerben nkyirefuwa, na wɔwen ananse ntentan: nyia odzi hɔn nkyirefuwa bi no, owu, na dza wɔbobɔ no, ɔpaa ehurutsia.
Hɔn ntentan no renndan atar, eso wɔremmfa hɔn ndwuma nnkata hɔnho: hɔn ndwuma yɛ emumuyɛ ndwuma, na akakabensɛm wɔ hɔn nsamu.
Hɔn anan tutu mbirika kɔ mbusu mu, na wɔyɛ ntsɛm kɛka nyia onndzi fɔ no bɔgyaa gu: hɔn adwen yɛ emumuyɛ adwen; amamfoyɛ na ɔsɛɛ wɔ akwan mu.
Asomdwee ɔtsempɔn no dze wonnyim; na atsɛmbu biara nnyi hɔn nkɔree mu: wɔabɔ hɔn akwan akyewakyew; obiara a ɔfa mu no onnyim asomdwee.
Dɛm ntsi na atsɛmbu nye hɛn ntamu atwe, eso ndzeyɛtsenenee nnto hɛn: yɛhwɛ kan kwan, na hwɛ, sum nye yi; ɔhyerɛn so, na mbom yɛnam sunkamm mu.
Yɛkeka ban ho dɛ ofurafo, nyew, yɛkeka dɛ hɔn a wonnyi enyiwa: yefintsiw ewiaber ketee dɛ wantawanta ber mu; yɛayɛ dɛ ewufo wɔ hɔn a wɔyɛ atwɛntwɛmfo mu.
Hɛn nyinara yɛpopɔw dɛ nsisi, na yɛka mmɔn pii dɛ mbubur: yɛhwɛ atsɛmbu kwan, naaso bi nnyi hɔ; nkwagye so, na ɔnye hɛn ntamu atwe koraa.
Na hɛn mbrato adɔɔ so pii wɔ w’enyim, na hɛn bɔn gye dase tsia hɛn: osiandɛ hɛn mbrato wɔ hɛn nkyɛn, na hɛn emumuyɛ dze, yenyim:
wɔ mbrato na EWURADZE do nkontompɔtwa mu, na ɔsan a yɛasan efi hɛn Nyankopɔn n’ekyirdzi mu, nhyɛdo na etuatsew ne ka, atorsɛm a yɛadwendwen ho na yeefi akoma mu aka.
Na wɔadan atsɛmbu asan ekyir, na ndzeyɛtsenenee ekegyina ekyirekyir noho: osiandɛ nokwar ahwe ase wɔ abɔntsen do, na tɔɔtsenyɛ nntum nnhɛn mu.
Nyew, nokwar asa; na nyia otwa noho fi mbusu ho no, ɔyɛ noho afonam: na EWURADZE hunii, na ɔannyɛ no abodwe dɛ atsɛmbu bi nnyi hɔ.
Na ohun dɛ nyimpa biara nnyi hɔ, na ɔyɛɛ no nwanwa dɛ odzimafo bi nnyi hɔ: dɛm ntsi nankasa ne basa na ɔdze nkwagye brɛɛ no; na ne ndzeyɛtsenenee no, osuoo no mu gyinae.
Na ɔdze ndzeyɛtsenenee hyɛɛ dɛ akatabo, na nkwagye kyɛw so ne tsir; na ɔhyɛɛ awerdzi ntar dɛ akataho, na ɔhyɛɛ mbɔdzembɔ dɛ atar egugudo.
Mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ tse no, dɛmara na ɔbɛhyɛ hɔn ananmu, ɔdze ebufuhyew ama n’ahohiahiafo, akatua a ɔsɛ ama n’atamfo; nsuano aman no so ɔdze akatua a ɔfata bɛma hɔn.
Dɛm no bɛma wofi anee esuro EWURADZE ne dzin, na wofi wipuei esuro n’enyimnyam: na ɔbɛba dɛ esutsen a ɔrepem yaayaa a EWURADZE n’ehum ripia no.
Na ɔpomfo bɛba Zion, na hɔn a wɔsan fi mbrato ho wɔ Jakob mu no nkyɛn, EWURADZE na ɔse.

Na emi dze, menye hɔn ntamu ahyɛmu no nye yi, EWURADZE na ɔse: mo sunsum a ɔwɔ wo do, na me nsɛm a medze mahyɛ w’ano no rimmfi w’anomu, anaa w’asefo hɔn asefo so anomu, ofitsi ndɛ dze kesi daa, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Soɛr, hyerɛn; na wo kan aba, na EWURADZE n’enyimnyam asoɛr wo do.
Na, hwɛ, sum bɛkata asaase do, na sum kebii akata aman do: na EWURADZE befir wo do, na n’enyimnyam woehu no wo do.
Na amanaman bɛba wo kan ho, na ahemfo aba wo mfirii ne hyerɛn ho.
Ma w’enyi do bɔ aprɔw, na hwɛ; hɔn nyinara wɔboa hɔn ano, wɔba wo nkyɛn: wo mbabanyin fi ekyirekyir bɛba, na wo mbabaa so woetutur hɔn abaw mu.
Ɔno na ibohu na w’enyim atsew, na w’akoma behihim na ɔayɛ kɛse; osiandɛ po mu ndzepa bɛdan aba wo hɔ, amanaman ahonya bɛba wo hɔ.
Efumpɔnkɔ menyamenya bɛkata wo do, Midian na Efa efumpɔnkɔfɔr; hɔn nyinara wofi Seba bɛba. Wɔdze sika na nduhuam, na wɔbɔbɔ EWURADZE n’ayɛyi dawur.
Kedar mbowa ekuwekuw nyina bɔboa ano aba wo nkyɛn, Nebaiot nguannyin bɔsom wo; wɔbɔfow aba m’afɔrmbukyia no do enyisɔ mu, na mahyɛ m’enyimnyam fi no enyimnyam.
Woananom nye woyi a wotu dɛ nsuwusiw, na dɛ mbubur a wɔrokɔ hɔn ntokura mu yi?

Ampaara nsuano aman bɔtweɔn me, na Tarsis ahɛn dzi kan, dɛ wɔdze wo mbabanyin fi ekyirekyir reba, hɔn dwetɛ na hɔn sika ka hɔn ho, wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne dzin ntsi, na Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ntsi, osiandɛ ɔno na ɔahyɛ wo enyimnyam.
Na ananaben bɔtow w’afasu, na hɔn ahemfo bɔsom wo: na m’ebufuw mu na mobɔɔ wo, na m’enyimpa mu na mehu wo mbɔbɔr.
W’aponkɛse so bɛda hɔ daa; wɔronntotow mu adzekyee na adzesaa; ama adasa wɔdze amanaman ahonya aabrɛ wo, na wɔaaka hɔn ahemfo aka hɔn ho aba.
Na ɔman na ahenman biara a ɔnnkɔsom wo no, ɔbɛhera; nyew, amanaman no bɔbɔ huntuhuntu.
Lebanon n’enyimnyam bɛba wo hɔ, ɔpepeaa, ɔsɛsɛw, na ɔpapaa dua bɔbɔ mu, dze abɛyɛ mo krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ fɛɛfɛw, na maahyɛ m’anan tsiabea no enyimnyam.

Na hɔn a wohiahiaa wo ho no hɔn mbabanyin dze akotokotow bɛba wo nkyɛn; na hɔn a wobuu wo enyimtsia nyinara dze hɔn enyim bobom w’ananadze; na wɔbɛfrɛ wo EWURADZE no kuropɔn, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ne Zion.
Susuampaara dɛ wɔadan wo egya na woekyir wo, na nyimpa biara ammfa wo mu ntsi, mebɛyɛ wo otsitsir daa, na mayɛ mbasantsen pii hɔn enyigye.
Eso ebɔnom amanaman numfonsu, na enum ahemfo hɔn enumfo: na ibohu dɛ emi EWURADZE nye w’agyenkwa, na wo pomfo, Jakob ne Katakyi no.

Boran ananmu na medze sika bɛba abɛhyɛ, na dadze ananmu na medze dwetɛ bɛba abɛhyɛ, na dua ananmu na medze boran mebɛhyɛ, na abo ananmu medze dadze bɛhyɛ: eso mebɛma asomdwee ayɛ w’ahwɛdofo, na ndzeyɛtsenenee ayɛ wo bɔmbafo.
Wɔnnkɛtse akatabansɛm nka wɔ w’asesee mu bio, amambɔe anaa ɔsɛɛ nka wɔ w’ahe do; na ebɛfrɛ w’afasu Nkwagye, na w’aponkɛse Ayɛyi.
Ewia nnkɛyɛ wo kan adzekyee bio; eso bosoom nnkɛyɛ ɔhyerɛn ahyerɛn ama wo: na EWURADZE bɛyɛ ɔdomankoma kan ama wo, na wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ w’enyimnyam.
W’ewia ronntɔ bio, eso wo bosoom ronntwe noho: na EWURADZE bɛyɛ wo domankoma kan, na wo nkɔmbɔdzi da abɔ adze.
Wo man so nyinara bɛyɛ atseneneefo, wobenya asaase no edzi afebɔɔ; me ntsetsɛwee mu dubaa, me nsaano edwuma, ama wɔaahyɛ me enyimnyam.
Kakraba no bɛdan apem, na dza osuar no adan ɔman dzendzen: emi EWURADZE na mebɛyɛ no ntsɛm wɔ ne ber mu.

EWURADZE no sunsum wɔ mo do; osiandɛ EWURADZE asera me dɛ menka nsɛmpa no menkyerɛ abɔbɔfo; ɔasoma me dɛ membɛkyekyer hɔn a hɔn akoma ebubu, mombɔbɔ fahodzi dawur nkyerɛ ndɔmmumfo, na efiadze no mbuei nkyerɛ hɔn a wɔakyekyer hɔn;
mombɔbɔ EWURADZE n’enyisɔ afe no, na hɛn Nyankopɔn n’awerdzi da no dawur; dɛ menkyekye hɔn a wodzi nkɔmbɔ nyinara werɛ;

dɛ menhyehyɛ mma hɔn a wodzi nkɔmbɔ wɔ Zion, memma hɔn abɔtsir nhyɛ nso ananmu, enyigye ngo nhyɛ nkɔmbɔdzi ananmu, ayɛyi atar nhyɛ awerɛhow sunsum ananmu; ama wɔaafrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛtsenenee ndua, EWURADZE n’atsɛndua, ma wɔaahyɛ no enyimnyam.
Na wɔbɛkyekyer tsetse amamfo no, wɔamema nkan no amamfo no do egyinagyina, na wɔayeyɛ nkurow a egugu, mbasantsen pii amamfo no yie.
Na ahɔho begyina na wɔanyɛn hom mbowakuw, na amamforafo ayɛ hom ekuafo na hom wenyin ntureahwɛfo.
Na hom dze, wɔbɛfrɛ hom EWURADZE asɔfoe: adasa bɛfrɛ hom hɛn Nyankopɔn n’asomfo: hom bedzi amanaman ahonya, na hɔn enyimnyam mu na hom bɛhyehyɛ homho.
Hom benya mbɔho ahyɛ hom enyito no ananmu; na wobedzi ehurusi wɔ hɔn kyɛfa mu ahyɛ hɔn enyimguase ananmu: dɛm ntsi wobenya mbɔho wɔ hɔn asaase no do: ɔdomankoma dɛw bɛyɛ hɔndze.
Na emi EWURADZE modɔ atsɛmbu, mikyir edwotwadze a emumuyɛ ka ho; na medze hɔn akatua mebɛma hɔn nokwar mu, na menye hɔn edzi ɔdomankoma ahyɛmu.
Na wobohu hɔn asefo wɔ amanaman mu, na hɔn mba wɔ aman mu: hɔn a hɔn enyi bɔ hɔn do nyinara bohu dɛ hɔn nye asefo a EWURADZE ehyira hɔn.

Mibedzi ehurusi kɛse wɔ EWURADZE mu, me kra enyi bɛgye me Nyankopɔn mu; osiandɛ ɔdze nkwagye ntar ahyɛ me, ɔdze tsenenee bataker ewuna me, dɛ mbrɛ ayeforkun dze abɔtsir bɔ, na dɛ mbrɛ ayefor dze n’edwindze hyehyɛ.
Na dɛ mbrɛ asaase dze no nkukuduuduw pue, na dɛ mbrɛ ture ma dza woedua no wɔ mu no fifir no; dɛmara so na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn bɛma tsenenee na ayɛyi efifir wɔ amanaman nyinara enyim.
Zion ntsi mennkɛka m’ano ato mu, na Jerusalɛm ntsi mennkɛgye m’ahom, ekodu dɛ ne tsenenee befir edzi dɛ kan hyɛnhyɛn, na no nkwagye dɛ kandzea a ɔdzɛw.
Na amanaman bohu wo tsenenee, na ahemfo nyinara ehu w’enyimnyam: na wɔbɔto wo dzin fofor bi a EWURADZE n’ano bɔbɔ dzin.
Ebɛyɛ ahoɔfɛw abɔtsir wɔ EWURADZE nsamu so, na ahenkyɛw wɔ wo Nyankopɔn nsamu.

Wɔnnkɛda ho bio afrɛ wo Nyia wɔapow no; eso w’asaase wɔnnkɛfrɛ no Amamfo bio: na mbom wɔbɛfrɛ wo dɛ: M’enyisɔ wɔ wo mu, na w’asaase so dɛ Ɔwarfo: osiandɛ EWURADZE wɔ wo ho enyigye, na wɔbɔwar w’asaase no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ aberantsɛ war ɔbaabun no, dɛmara so na wo mbabanyin bɔwar wo: na mbrɛ ayeforkun no ho sɛpɛw no ayefor ho no, dɛmara so na wo Nyankopɔn no ho bɛsɛpɛw no wo ho.
Jerusalɛm e, mesisi aweɔmfo wɔ w’afasu do; wɔrennka hɔn ano nnto mu adzekyee anaa adzesaa: hom a hom yɛ akaakaafo ma EWURADZE, mma hom nngye hom ahom,
na mma hom mma no ahomgye, ma onkodu dɛ obetsim Jerusalɛm, na ɔama ɔayɛ ayɛyi wɔ asaase do.
EWURADZE dze n’abanyimfa na n’ahoɔdzen basa aka ntam dɛ, Ampaara mennkɛfa w’eburow ama w’atamfo dɛ edziban bio: na ahɔho nnkɔnom wo wenyin a aberɛ ho no bio:
na hɔn a wɔdze ahyɛ san do no na wobedzi eyi EWURADZE ayɛw; na hɔn a wɔatsew no na wɔbɔnom no wɔ mo krɔnkrɔnbea abangua do.
Hom ndua mu, hom ndua aponkɛse no mu; hom mbɔ ɔman no hɔn kwan no; hom nsiesie, hom nsiesie do nyɛ no ɔtsempɔn; hom ntase mu abo no, hom mma frankaa do mma aman no.
Hwɛ, EWURADZE abɔ dawur edu asaase ewiei noho dɛ, Hom nse Zion babaa dɛ, Hwɛ, wo nkwagye reba; hwɛ ɔdze n’akatua nam, na n’ahyɛnanmu dzi n’enyim.
Na wɔbɛfrɛ hɔn Ɔman krɔnkrɔn, Hɔn a EWURADZE apon hɔn: na wɔbɛfrɛ wo Nyia wɔahwehwɛ no ehu no, Kurow a wɔmmpow no.
Woana nye oyi a ofi Edom reba a ɔhyɛ Bozra bɔgyaben ntar yi? Oyi a ɔyɛ onyimnyamfo wɔ n’afadze mu, na ɔrekyea wɔ n’ahoɔdzen akɛseyɛ mu yi? Emi a mekasa ndzeyɛtsenenee mu a, otumfo a ɔgye nkwa a.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’afadze aber dɛm, na wo ntar ayɛ dɛ nyia otsiatsia wenyintwer mu nedze yi?

Mo nko ara na metsiatsia wenyintwer no do; na aman no mu nyimpa biara nnka mo ho: nyew, mitsiatsiaa hɔn do wɔ m’ebufuw mu, na misiiw hɔn wɔ m’ebufuhyew mu; na hɔn mu bɔgya abɔ apetse me ntar mu, na wɔama m’efuradze nyinara mu ayɛ nkekaa.
Na awerdzi da baa m’akoma mu, na mo nkorɔfo a mapon hɔn no hɔn afe no aba.
Na mohwɛe, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔboa; na ɔyɛɛ me nwanwa dɛ obi nnyi hɔ a osuo mu gyina: dɛm ntsi mankasa m’abasa na ɔdze nkwagye brɛɛ me; na m’ebufuhyew na osuoo mo mu gyinae.
Na mitsiatsiaa aman no do wɔ m’ebufuw mu, na memaa wɔbobowee wɔ m’ebufuhyew mu, na muhuee hɔn mu bɔgya muguu asaase do.

Mobɔbɔ EWURADZE n’adɔyɛdze, na EWURADZE n’ayɛyi dzin, dɛ mbrɛ dza EWURADZE dze ama hɛn nyinara tse; na yieyɛ kɛse a ɔdze ayɛ Israel fifo a ɔdze ama hɔn dɛ mbrɛ no mbɔbɔrhu tse, na dɛ mbrɛ n’adɔyɛ no dodow tse.
Na ɔkaa dɛ, Ampaara, wɔyɛ me man, mba a worunntwa ator: ntsi na ɔbɛyɛɛ hɔn agyenkwa no.
Hɔn ahohia nyinara mu no ho hiaa no bi, na n’enyim ɔbɔfo no gyee hɔn nkwa: no dɔ na ne tsimbɔbɔr mu na ɔpoon hɔn; na otuur hɔn, na ɔsoaa hɔn tsetsenda no nyinara mu.
Naaso hɔn dze, wɔtseew etua, na wɔhoow no sunsum krɔnkrɔn no werɛ: dɛm ntsi na ɔdanee bɛyɛɛ hɔn tamfo, na noara ɔnye hɔn dzii ako.
Nna ɔkaa tsetsenda no, na n’akowaa Moses, Nyia ɔdze no mbowakuw ahwɛfo no fii po mu bae no wɔ hen? Nyia ɔdze no sunsum krɔnkrɔn no hyɛɛ hɔn finimfin no wɔ hen?
Nyia ɔmaa n’enyimnyam basa dzii Moses n’abanyimfa kɔree no, na ɔpaa nsu no mu wɔ hɔn enyim dze gyee ɔdomankoma dzin maa noho no?
Nyia ɔgyee hɔn duaa ebun no mu, dɛ pɔnkɔ nam sar do, na woemmfintsiw no?
Dɛ anantwi a wosiansian kɔ bɔnsa mu, na EWURADZE no sunsum maa wɔhomee: dɛmara so na igyaa wo man kwan, dze gyee enyimnyam dzin maa woho.
Fi sor hwɛ famu, na fi wo krɔnkrɔnyɛ na w’enyimnyam tsenabea hɔ hwɛ: wo mbɔdzembɔ na w’akatakyidze no wɔ henfa? W’ehumbɔbɔr na w’ayamuhyehye no woesianka no wɔ mo do.
Na ɔwoara nye hɛn egya, kaansa Abraham nnyim hɛn, na Israel nngye hɛn nnto mu mpo a: EWURADZE, ɔwoara nye hɛn egya; hɛn pomfo nye wo dzin fir tsetseetse.
Ao EWURADZE, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ema yɛfom fi w’akwan do na ipirim hɛn akoma fi wo suro ho? Wo nkowaa, w’egyapadze mbusuakuw no ntsi, san bra.
Wo man krɔnkrɔn nyaa no mber ketseabaa bi: hɛn ahohiahiafo etsiatsia wo krɔnkrɔnbea no do.
Yɛabɛyɛ dɛ hɔn a inndzii hɔn do tum da; dɛ hɔn a wɔammfa wo dzin ammfrɛ hɔn no.
Ao, kɛtseankyɛ esunsuan ɔsorsor mu, na esian famu, ma mbepɔw apem asen wɔ w’enyim;
dɛ mbrɛ ogya ma mbabaaba dzɛw, na ogya no ma esu hur: ama w’atamfo eehu wo dzin, na amanaman ho aapopo wɔ w’enyim!
Ber a eyɛɛ ndzɛmba huhuhuhu a hɛn enyi annda kwan no, ɔwo isianee, mbepɔw wosowee wɔ w’enyim.
Ofi tsetse adasa nntsee, aso mmbɔɔ do, enyiwa so nnhun Nyankopɔn bi ka wo ho a odzi dwuma ma nyia ɔtweɔn no no.
Ɔwo na ihyia nyia ɔdze enyigye yɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee, hɔn a wɔkaa wo wɔ w’akwan mu: hwɛ, ɔwo wo bo fuwii, na hɛn yɛyɛɛ bɔn: bɔn mu na yɛatsena dadaada yi, na aso wɔbɛgye hɛn nkwa?
Na hɛn nyinara ayeyɛ dɛ obi a no ho egu fi, na hɛn tsenenee nyinara tse dɛ atar fi pɔtɔɔ: na hɛn nyinara yɛpa dɛ ahataw; na hɛn emumuyɛ soa hɛn kɔ dɛ mframa.
Na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɔ wo dzin, anaa okenyan noho a obosuo wo mu: na ɔwo eyi w’enyim ehuntsa hɛn, na enam hɛn emumuyɛ do ama yɛahyew.
Naaso, ao EWURADZE, ɔwoara nye hɛn egya; awendɛtse no nye hɛn, na ɔwemfo no nye woara; na hɛn nyinara yɛyɛ wo nsaano edwuma.
Ao EWURADZE, mma wo bo mmfuw pii, eso mma nnkaa emumuyɛ daa: to enyi hwɛ, yɛtotɔ serɛ wo, hɛn nyinara yɛyɛ wo man.
Wo nkurow krɔnkrɔn no adan sar, Jerusalɛm adan amamfo.
Hɛn fi krɔnkrɔn fɛɛfɛw mbrɛ hɛn egyanom yii wo ayɛw wɔ mu no, wɔdze ogya ahyew no; na hɛn afɛɛfɛdze nyinara ayɛ amamfo.
Ao EWURADZE, aso iyinom ntsi ebɛkam woho? Aso ebɛyɛ komm, na ahaw hɛn kɛse pii?
Meyɛɛ krado tweɔɔn hɔn a woemmbisa m’ekyir kwan; hɔn a wɔannhwehwɛ me no meyɛɛ krado dɛ nkyɛ wobohu me: mesee hɔn a wɔammfa me dzin ammfrɛ hɔn no dɛ, Emi nye yi, emi nye yi.
Matserɛw m’abaw mu adzekyee nyina ama ɔman etuatsewfo hɔn a wɔnantsew ɔkwan bɔn do dzi hɔnankasa hɔn adwen ekyir;
ɔman a woyi me ehi wɔ m’enyim daa nyina, wɔbobɔ okum afɔr wɔ nture mu, na wɔhyew nduhuam wɔ ntaayaa do;
hɔn a wɔtsenatsena nda mu, wɔdeda asamandan mu; wodzi mprekonam, na ekyiwadze nkwan wɔ hɔn asɛn mu;
wɔka dɛ, Tsew woho gyina, mma mmbɛn me nkyɛn, na mo ho tsew sen wo: iyinom yɛ wusiw wɔ m’ahwen mu, ogya a ɔdzɛw adzekyee nyina.
Hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ m’enyim: murummua m’ano, na mbom mebɛhyɛ ananmu, nyew, mebɛhyɛ ananmu egu hɔn bo mu,

homara hom emumuyɛ na hom egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ ka ho, dɛ wɔahyew nduhuam wɔ mbepɔw do, na wɔaka mo ho asɛm bɔn wɔ akoko do, EWURADZE na ɔse: dɛm ntsi mibedzi kan mesusu hɔn kan edwuma ho akatua egu hɔn akoko mu.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Dɛ mbrɛ wohu nsa fofor wɔ wenyinaba siaw mu, na obi ka dɛ, Mma nnsɛɛ no, na nhyira wɔ mu no: dɛmara so na mebɛyɛ wɔ mo nkowaa ntsi, amma mannsɛɛ hɔn nyinara.
Na medze asefo befi Jakob mu aba, na me mbepɔw adzedzinyi efi Juda aba: na me mpamufo benya edzi, na mo nkowaa bɛtsena hɔ.
Na Saron bɛyɛ nguamban na Akor bɔnsa ayɛ anantwikuw dabea, ama me man a wɔhwehwɛɛ m’ekyir kwan no.
Na hom a hom dan EWURADZE gya, hom werɛ fir me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn, hom to pon ma Isiar, na hom hyɛ aforafora nsa ma Nkrabea;
mebɛhyɛ hom ama afona, na hom nyinara bɔkotow ama oku: osiandɛ mefrɛe no, hom emmbua; mekasae no, hom anntse; na mbom hom yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ m’enyi do, na hom saan mu yii dza minnyi enyigye wɔ mu.

Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi, Hwɛ, mo nkowaa bedzidzi, naaso hom dze, ɔkɔm bɛdze hom: mo nkowaa bɔnom, naaso hom dze, nsukɔm bɛdze hom: hwɛ, mo nkowaa bedzi ehurusi, naaso hom dze hom enyi bɔtɔ:
hwɛ, mo nkowaa bɔtow ndwom wɔ akoma mu enyigye ntsi, naaso hom dze, hom bɛkeka mu wɔ akoma mu awerɛhow ntsi, na hom aka mmɔn wɔ sunsum n’ahomtsew ntsi.
Na hom begyaa hom dzin ma aayɛ ndom ama me mpamufo, na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn boku wo; na ɔbɔto no nkowaa dzin fofor:

ama nyia ohyira noho wɔ asaase do no, oeehyira noho wɔ nokwar Nyankopɔn mu; na nyia ɔka ntam wɔ asaase do no, ɔdze nokwar Nyankopɔn aka ntam; osiandɛ werɛ efir nkan no fona no, na osiandɛ oehuntsa efi m’enyi do.
Na, hwɛ, morobɔ ɔsorsor fofor na asaase fofor: na nkan no ndzɛmba no wɔrennkaa, eso wɔremmfa mmba adwen mu bio.
Na mbom hom nnya ahomka na hom ndzi ehurusi daa daa wɔ dza morobɔ no ntsi: na, hwɛ, morobɔ Jerusalɛm ma aayɛ ehurusi, na no mu mba ma aayɛ enyigye.
Na mibedzi ehurusi wɔ Jerusalɛm ho, na m’enyi agye wɔ me man ho: na wɔnnkɛtse osu ne nka wɔ no mu bio, anaa nkekamu nka.
Ofitsi hɔ dze kɔ no, abɔtoaba a ne nda suar, anaa akɔdaa a onnwiee ne nda dzi remmba hɔ bio: na abofra edzi mfe ɔha ana oewu, na ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi a odzi mfe ɔha no bɛyɛ obusunyi.
Na wobesisi adan, na wɔatsenatsena mu; na wɔatsɛw wenyin nture, na woedzi no mu aba.
Wonnkesi, na obi atsena mu; wɔnnkɛtsɛw, na obi edzi: na mbrɛ dua ne nda tse no, mbrɛ me man hɔn nda bɛyɛ ara nye no, na me mpamufo bedzi hɔn nsaano edwuma akyɛr.
Wɔnnkɛberɛ kwa, eso wɔronnwo mba mma mbusu; na wɔyɛ EWURADZE n’esiarfo hɔn asefo, na hɔn mba ka hɔn ho.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, ansaana wɔrefrɛ no, nna magye do; na wɔda do rekasa no, nna matse.
Ɔpataku na eguambaa bedzidzi fakor, na ogyata awe efuw dɛ ɔnantwi: na huntuma na ɔbɛyɛ abowatsena n’edziban. Wɔnnkɛyɛ obi bɔn, eso wɔrennsɛɛ wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn nyina do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ɔsor yɛ m’ahengua, na asaase yɛ m’ananadzegua: ɔdan a ɔtse dɛn na hom besi ama me, na henfa na ɔbɛyɛ m’ahomgyebea?

Na ndzɛmba iyinom nyinara me nsa na ɔayɛ, na mbrɛ ndzɛmba iyinom nyinara yɛe bae nye no, EWURADZE na ɔse: naaso nyimpa a mobɔhwɛ no nye oyi, mekyerɛ onyia no a ɔyɛ ɔbɔbɔfo na sunsum a ɔabobɔ, na no ho popo wɔ m’asɛm ntsi no.

Nyia oku ɔnantwi ɔtse dɛ nyia oku nyimpa ara so; nyia oku eguambaa bɔ afɔr no, ɔtse dɛ nyia obu kraman no kɔn mu; nyia ɔbɔ edziban afɔr no, ɔtse dɛ nyia ɔbɔ preko bɔgyaa afɔr; nyia ɔhyew eduhuam no, ɔtse dɛ nyia ohyira ohonyi: nyew, hɔn nyinara asan mu eyiyi hɔnankasa hɔn akwan, na hɔn kra enyi gye hɔn ekyiwadze mu;

emi so mebɛsan mu meyi hɔn ndaadaa, na medze hɔn suro aba hɔn do; osiandɛ mefrɛe a, obi anngye do; mekasae a, wɔanntse: na mbom wɔyɛɛ dza ɔyɛ mbusu wɔ m’enyi do, na wɔsaan mu yii dza minnyi mu enyigye.

Hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm, hom a hom ho popo wɔ n’asɛm ho: Hom nuanom a wɔtan hom, wɔtow hom kyen wɔ me dzin ntsi no, wɔka dɛ, Wɔnhyɛ EWURADZE enyimnyam, ma yenhu hom enyigye; na hɔn dze, hɔn enyi bɔto.
Dede weɔɔ fi kurow no mu, dede fi asɔrdan no mu, EWURADZE a otua n’atamfo hɔn ndzeyɛɛ do kaw no ne ndze a.
Onnyae nnkyemee no, ɔwoe; awooyaw nnyae nnkaa no no, nna ɔawo ɔbabanyin.
Woana atse iyi bi da? Woana ehu iyinom bi pɛn? Aso wɔkyem wo asaase da kor? Aso wɔwo ɔman prɛko? Naaso Zion dze, ɔkyemee ara, nna ɔwoo ne mba.
Aso emi, medze bɛba awotoa ano, na meremma wɔnnwo? EWURADZE na ɔse. Aso emi a mema wɔwo no, mibesiw awotoa ano? Wo Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Hom nye Jerusalɛm ndzi ehurusi, na hom ho nsɛpɛw hom wɔ no ho, hom a hom dɔ no nyinara: hom nye no ndzi ehurusi wɔ enyigye ntsi, hom a hom dzi no ho nkɔmbɔ nyinara:
ama hom eenum n’awerɛkyekye enumfo no amee; ama hom dze enyigye aanom efi n’enyimnyam mbordo no mu.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛtsen asomdwee ama no dɛ esutsen, na amanaman enyimnyam no dɛ ɔworaba a oeyir, na hom bɔnom bi; wobotur hom nkyɛmfa mu, na wɔagyegye hom anankoroma do.
Dɛ obi a ne na kyekye no werɛ no, dɛmara na mebɛkyekye hom werɛ; na hom werɛ bɛkyekye wɔ Jerusalɛm.
Na hom bohu, na hom akoma edzi ehurusi, no hom mbiew bowuna dɛ ahaban fɔr: na wobohu EWURADZE ne nsa wɔ no nkowaa afamu, na obenya n’atamfo ho ebufuhyew.
Na, hwɛ, EWURADZE dze ogya bɛba, na ne ntseaseanam bɛyɛ dɛ ekyinehyia mframa; dɛ ommbobu n’ebufuw ama wɔ ebufuhyew mu, na ne nkaenyim wɔ ogyaframee mu.
Na EWURADZE dze ogya na afona na ɔnye adasa nyinara bedzi: na EWURADZE n’atɔfoe bɔdɔɔ so.
Hɔn a wɔtsew hɔnho na woguar hɔnho dɛ wɔbɔkɔ nture mu a, wodzi ɔbaako a odzi finimfin no n’ekyir, woridzi prekonam, na ekyiwadze, na okura no; wɔbɔbɔ mu aba ewiei, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na minyim hɔn ndwuma na hɔn adwen: mber reba a mobɔboaboa amanaman na kasa horow nyinara ano; na wɔbɛba, na woebohu m’enyimnyam.

Na medze asɛnkyerɛdze besi hɔn mu, na masoma hɔn mu hɔn a wobefi nsa no akɔ amanaman no hɔ, Tarsis, Put na Lud a wɔkontom egyen no, Tubal na Javan, nsuano aman a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir a wɔnntsee me nka, eso wonnhun m’enyimnyam no; na wɔbɛka m’enyimnyam akyerɛ wɔ amanaman mu.

Na wɔdze hom nuanom nyinara befi amanaman nyinara mu aba dɛ ayɛyɛdze ama EWURADZE, wɔ mpɔnkɔ do, na ntseaseanam mu, na nsako mu, na nsoasopɔnkɔ do, na mbowa a hɔn ho yɛ har do, aba me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn Jerusalɛm do, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba dze hɔn ayɛyɛdze wɔ kɔɔpow a no ho tsew mu ba EWURADZE fie.
Na hɔn mu binom so na mebɛfa ayɛ asɔfo Levifo, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na dɛ mbrɛ ɔsorsor afofor na asaase fofor a mebɛyɛ no, bɛka wɔ m’enyim no, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛmara so na hom asefo na hom dzin bɛka.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ ofi bosoom fofor kor do kodu kor so do, na ofi ahomgyeda kor do kodu kor so do no, nyimpa nyinara bɛba abɔsɔr wɔ m’enyim, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na wobefir edzi akɔ akɔhwɛ nyimpa a wɔato mbra etsia me no hɔn efun: na hɔn abowaba nnkowu, eso hɔn gya nnkodum; na wɔbɛyɛ ekyiwadze ama adasa nyinara.
Hilkia ne ba Jeremia a ofi asɔfo a wɔwɔ Anathot wɔ Benjamin asaase do no mu no ne nsɛm nye yi.
Ɔno na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa no hɔ wɔ Amon ne ba Josia a nna ɔyɛ Judahen no, ne nda no mu, wɔ n’ahendzi afe a otsia duebiasa no mu.

Na ɔbae so wɔ Josia ne ba Jehoiakim, Judahen no, ne nda mu, dze kesii Josia ne ba Zedekia, Judahen no, n’afe a otsia duebien no n’ewiei; dze kodur ɔsoakɔr a wɔsoaa Jerusalɛm kɔr ndɔmmum wɔ bosoom a otsia enum no mu.
Afei EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
Ansaana moween wo yafun mu no, nna minyim wo, na ansaana irifi awotoa mu efir no, nna metseew wo ho; mehyɛɛ wo nkɔnhyɛnyi maa amanaman.
Nna mesee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn! Hwɛ, minnyim kasa: osiandɛ meyɛ abofra.
Naaso EWURADZE see me dɛ, Mma nnse dɛ, Meyɛ abofra: na obiara a mobɔsoma wo no hɔ no, ebɔkɔ, na biribiara a mebɛhyɛ wo no, ebɛka.
Mma onnsian hɔn ntsi mma innsuro: na mowɔ wo nkyɛn dɛ mibeyi wo, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Nna EWURADZE tseen ne nsa dze kaa m’ano; na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Hwɛ, medze me nsɛm ahyɛ w’ano:
hwɛ, ndɛ da yi medze wo esi amanaman do na ahendzi do, dɛ tutu na bubu gu famu, sɛɛ na butuw; si, na tsɛw.
EWURADZE n’asɛm baa me nkyɛn dɛ, Jeremia, ihu ebɛnadze? Na mubuaa dɛ, Muhu almɔnd dua bi n’abaw.
Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, Ehu no yie: na moroweɔn m’asɛm na mayɛ.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ otsia mpɛn ebien, dɛ, Ihu ebɛnadze? Na mesee dɛ, Muhu dadzesɛn a oruhur na n’enyim fi kwaamu afamu.
Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, Kwaamu afamu na mbusu befir etue aba asaase no do atsefo nyinara do.
Na, hwɛ, mebɛfrɛ kwaamu ahendzi ebusua ebusua nyinara, EWURADZE na ɔse; na wɔbɛba na hɔn mu biara dze n’ahengua ebesi Jerusalɛm aponkɛse ano, ɔnye n’afasu nyinara ho ehyia, na Juda nkurow nyina.
Na mubobua m’atsɛn etsia hɔn wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ nyina ntsi; wɔ dɛ wɔapow emi, na wɔahyew nduhuam ama abosom afofor bi, na wɔasɔr hɔnankasa hɔn nsaano edwuma.
Dɛm ntsi ɔwo dze bɔ w’asen do, na soɛr na ka dza mahyɛ wo nyinara kyerɛ hɔn: mma wo bo nntu wɔ hɔn enyim, mma maamma wo bo enntu wɔ hɔn enyim.
Na, hwɛ, ndɛ da yi mayɛ wo akoban kurow na dadze fadum, na boran afasu etsia asaase no nyina, Juda ahemfo, hɔn mbapɔmba, hɔn asɔfoe, na asaase no do nkorɔfo.
Na wɔnye wo bedzi ako; naaso wonnkotum wo: osiandɛ menye wo nam, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ mebɛgye wo.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
Kɔ, kɛpaa mu wɔ Jerusalɛm asomu dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mekaa wo mbofrabermu adɔyɛ nye w’ayeforber mu dɔ no ma wo; mbrɛ idzii m’ekyir wɔ sar no do, asaase a nna wonnduaa do adze no.
Israel yɛɛ adze krɔnkrɔn maa EWURADZE, no ndɔbaa mu nduadzewakan no: hɔn a wɔmemen no no nyinara wobuu hɔn fɔ; mbusu baa hɔn do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Jakob fifo, na Israel fie mu mbusua nyinara, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm:
mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ɔbrakyew bɛn na hom egyanom hunii wɔ mo mu, ma wofii me nkyɛn kɔr ekyirekyir, na wokedzii egyangyandze ekyir, ma wɔyɛɛ gyan yi?

Eso wɔannse dɛ, EWURADZE a ɔdze hɛn fii Egypt asaase do bae no wɔ henfa; ɔno a ɔgyee hɛn duaa sar no do, nsar pradada, na amona asaase do, kwaweeyɛ nye owu sunsuma asaase do, asaase a obi nnduaa mu, na nyimpa biara nntsenaa do no?
Na medze hom baa asaaseber do, dɛ hom ndzi no do aba na no do ndzepa; na mbom hom baa mu no, hom guu m’asaase ho fi, na hom yɛɛ m’egyapadze ekyiwadze.
Asɔfo no annse dɛ, EWURADZE wɔ henfa? Na hɔn a mbra no dze hɔn nsamu no ennhu me: na ahwɛdofo no so fomee tsiaa me, na nkɔnhyɛfo no nam Baal do hyɛɛ nkɔm, na wokedzii ndzɛmba a ɔnnyɛ mfaso bi ekyir.
Dɛm ntsi menye hom bedzi esi, EWURADZE na ɔse, na menye hom mba hɔn mba so medzi esi.
Na hom ntwa mu nkɔ Kittim esupruw do nkɔhwɛ; na hom nsoma nkɔ Kedar nkɔhwehwɛ mu kofekofe; na hom nhwɛ kyerɛ dɛ adze a ɔtse dɛm yi bi aba pɛn ana.
Aso ɔman bi asesa hɔn abosom a mpo wɔnnyɛ abosom bi no? Naaso me man dze, wɔdze hɔn enyimnyam asesa dza mfaso biara nnyi ho.
Ɔsorsor e, hom mma yi nyɛ hom nwanwa, na ahodwuruw nkitsa hom, nketsenketse nkyer hom dzendzenndzen, EWURADZE na ɔse,
osiandɛ me man abɔ mbusu ebien: wɔapow me emi a meyɛ nkwa nsu no nsunyiwa no, na woetutu mbura ama hɔnho, mbura mpaapaae a nsu nngyina mu.
Ana Israel yɛ akowaa anaa ɔdɔnkɔnyi ba? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔayɛ afonam yi?
Ngyatafɔr apɔw no, na wɔabobɔ hɔn ndze mu; wɔama n’asaase ayɛ amamfo; na wɔahyehyew no nkurow, dɛ obi nntse mu.
Memfis nye Tapanhes mba so epuepue wo tsir.
Aso nnyɛ ɔwoara na akɛfa iyi aba wo do, dɛ apow EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, aber a origya wo kwan no.
Na afei ebɛnadze na enya wɔ Egypt nkɔree mu, dɛ erokɔnom Nael nsu? Anaadɛ ebɛnadze na enya wɔ Asiria mu, dɛ ebɔnom Eufrates esutsen no n’esu?

Woara w’emumuyɛ bɛtsea wo, na ɔwoara w’ekyirsan botwuw w’enyim; dɛm ntsi hu na hwɛ dɛ ɔyɛ ebusudze nye adze wenwen, dɛ apow EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, na dɛ mo ho suro nnyi wo mu, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na ofir tsetse na ibubuu wo kɔndua mu, na etsetseew wo nkyehoma mu; na ɔwo ekaa dɛ, Monnkɔsom. Koko sorɔnsorɔm biara do na dua ebun ebun biara ase na ebɔɔ wo mu adze dɛ edwaman.
Naaso nna matsɛw wo wenyindua soronko, aba pa turododo. Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na adan amanandze wenyindua n’aba ahoma ahoma ama me yi?
Na kaansa edze ehyɛ guar, na efa semina pii mpo a, w’emumuyɛ no dze ne nsensanee da ho wɔ m’enyim, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Ebɛyɛ dɛn etum aka dɛ, Mo ho nnguu fi, minnkedzii Baal pii ekyir? Hwɛ wo kwan wɔ bɔnsa no mu, hu dza ayɛ: eyɛ efumpɔnkɔ ɔhoɔharfo a ɔwonawona wɔ n’akwan do;
hamu asoaso a ɔakokwaa sar do a ɔto mfar wɔ n’akɔndɔ hyeehyew mu; n’aber du a, woana besianka no? Hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ no nyinara nnkɛberɛ hɔnho; no bosoom mu na wɔdze bohu no.
Siw wo nan kwan ma no ho annda hɔ, na wo meneba so ma nsukɔm anndze wo: naaso ɔwo esee dɛ, Dabida! Apa ho koraa: osiandɛ madɔ ananaben, na hɔn ekyir na mibedzi.
Dɛ mbrɛ owifo wɔkyer no a, n’enyi to no, dɛmara so na Israelmba hɔn enyi ato; hɔn, hɔn ahemfo, hɔn mbapɔmba, hɔn asɔfoe, nye hɔn nkɔnhyɛfo a
wɔse dusin dɛ, Ɔwo nye m’egya; na ɔbo dɛ, Ɔwo na awo me no: na hɔn ekyir na wɔadandan ama me, na nnyɛ hɔn enyim a: naaso hɔn fonaber mu dze wɔse dɛ, Soɛr na gye hɛn nkwa.
W’abosom a ayɛ ama woho no wɔ henfa? Ma wɔnsoɛr ɛ, sɛ wobotum agye wo nkwa wɔ wo fonaber mu a: na, Juda e, w’abosom hɔn dodow tse dɛ wo nkurow dodow ano.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom hwinhwin tsia me yi? Hom nyinara afomfom etsia me, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Ɔkwa ara nna mabobɔ hom mba; wɔammfa mu esuadze biara: homankasa hom afona na ɔamemen hom nkɔnhyɛfo dɛ ogyata a ɔsɛɛ adze.
Mbasantsen, hom nhwɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm, Aso madan sar ama Israel? Anaa sumpɔrwa asaase? Ebɛnadze ntsi na me man se dɛ, Yɛatsew ahoma; yɛnnkɛba wo nkyɛn ara bio yi?
Aso ɔbɛyɛ dɛ ababaawa no werɛ befir n’ahyehyɛdze, anaa ayefor no werɛ befir n’efuradze? Naaso me man dze, hɔn werɛ efir me nda pii a wɔkan a ɔnnyɛ.
Mbrɛ isiesie wo kwan kɔhwehwɛ ɔdɔ a! Dɛm ntsi mbaa emumuyɛfo mpo akyerɛkyerɛ hɔn wo kwan.
Eso w’atar ano na wohu abɔbɔfo a wodzi bem hɔn akra bɔgyaa; nnyɛ dɛ ihun hɔn dɛ worububu adan mu, naaso yinom nyinara ekyir no,
ese dɛ, Midzi bem; ampaara n’ebufuw adan efi mo do. Hwɛ, medze wo bɛba asɛndzii, osiandɛ ese dɛ, Mennyɛɛ bɔn.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebɔ awonama pii dɛm dɛ ebɛsesa wo kwan? Egypt bɛma w’enyi ato, dɛ mbrɛ ato Asiria maa w’enyi toe no.
Hɔ so na ibefir edzi akɔ, dɛ wo nsa bɔ w’etsifi: osiandɛ EWURADZE apow w’awerɛhyɛmu, na innkowie yie wɔ hɔn mu.

Wɔ dɛ, Sɛ banyin gyaa ne yer, na ɔbaa no fi ne nkyɛn kɔ, na ɔkɛyɛ banyin fofor bi so dze a, aso banyin no bɛsan akɔ ne nkyɛn bio? Aso nkyɛ asaase no ho nnkogu fi pɔtɔɔ? Na ɔwo enye nwewefo pii agor ndwamangor; na ebɛsan aba mo hɔ bio, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Ma w’enyi do kɔ mpampaa pataa no do, na hwɛ; henfa na wɔnye wo nndaa wɔ hɔ? Akwan nkyɛn na atsena atweɔn w’adɔfo, dɛ Arabianyi wɔ sar no do; na edze wo ndwamandze nye w’emumuyɛ egu asaase no ho fi.
Dɛm ntsi na wɔatwe esusow nsu asɛn, na ɔbɛsɛ nsu so nntɔree; naaso w’enyim tse dɛ basia edwaman ne dze, na nnyim enyito.
Aso ntseaa mu mfrɛɛ me dɛ, M’egya, ɔwoara nye me mbofrabermu gyafo.
Aso ɔbɛfa ebufuw daa? Aso ɔdze bɛhyɛ no mu daa? Hwɛ, dɛm na akasa, naaso ayɛ ebusudze biara a epɛ.
Nkyii so EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ me wɔ ɔhen Josia ne nda no mu dɛ, Ana ehu dza okyirsamfo Israel ayɛ yi? Ɔakɔ bepɔw sorɔnsorɔm biara do, nye dua ebun ebun biara ase akɔgor ndwamangor.
Na ɔyɛɛ iyinom nyinara ekyir no, mesee dɛ, Ɔbɛsan aba me nkyɛn ara: naaso ɔnodze ɔannsan: na n’akyerɛbaa ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Juda so hunii.
Ohun dɛ osian awar a okyirsannyi Israel ato no ntsi, na megyaa no awar na mama no awarko nwoma no, naaso na n’akyerɛbaa ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Juda ennsuro; na mbom no so kɔree kɔgoor ndwamangor.
Na ɔbaa dɛ osian no ndwamangor ne nka ntsi, na asaase no ho guu fi, na ɔnye abo nye ndusin too awar.
Naaso na iyinom nyinara n’ekyir yi, n’akyerɛbaa ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Juda mmfaa n’akoma nyina nnsanee mmbaa mo hɔ, na mbom akɔhwi mu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Ekyirsannyi Israel akyerɛ noho dɛ ɔtsen kyɛn ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Juda.
Kɔ, kɔbɔ nsɛm yi dawur kyerɛ kwaamufo, se dɛ, Ekyirsannyi Israel e, san bra o, EWURADZE na ɔse; moronnhwɛ wo ebufuw mu: na meyɛ ehumbɔbɔr, EWURADZE na ɔse, mo bo nnkofuw daa.
Hu w’emumuyɛ nko ara, dɛ ato mbra etsia EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, na akyeakyea wo kwan ekefir ananaben hɔ wɔ dua ebun ebun biara n’ase, na hom enntsie me ndze, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Mba ekyirsamfo e, hom nsan mbra o, EWURADZE na ɔse; osiandɛ meyɛ hom wura: na mebɛfa hom ɔbaako efi kurow bi mu, na beenu efi ebusua bi mu, na medze hom aba Zion.
Mebɛma hom nguanhwɛfo dɛ mbrɛ m’akoma pɛ a wɔdze nyimdzee nye ntseasee bɛnyɛn hom.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hom dɔɔ so na hom dɔr asaase no do wɔ nda no mu a, EWURADZE na ɔse, ɔno wɔnnkɛkaa bio dɛ, EWURADZE ahyɛmudzi adaka; eso ɔremmba adwen mu: eso wɔrennkaa; eso wɔronnhwehwɛ no; eso wɔrennyɛ bi bio.
Aber no wɔbɛfrɛ Jerusalɛm dɛ EWURADZE ahengua; na amanaman nyinara bɔboa ano wɔ ne nkyɛn, ama EWURADZE ne dzin wɔ Jerusalɛm; eso worinndzi hɔn akoma bɔn ne ntsintsiman ekyir bio.
Nda no mu no Juda ebusua nye Israel ebusua bɛnantsew, na wɔabɔ mu efi kwaamu afamu asaase no do aba asaase a medze maa hom egyanom dɛ egyapadze no do.
Na mesee dɛ, Minsi dɛn memfa wo mfora mba mu, ma memma wo asaase a ɔyɛ fɛw, amanaman dɔm egyapadze fɛfɛɛfɛw no? Na modween dɛ hom bɛfrɛ me, M’egya, na hom rennsan mmfi m’ekyir dzi mu.
Ampaara dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaa twa nkontompɔ fi no kun nkyɛn no, mbrɛ hom so etwa me nkontompɔ ara nye no, Israel ebusua, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Wɔtse ndze bi wɔ mpampaa pataa no do, Israelmba hɔn osu na ntotɔserɛ; wɔ dɛ wɔakyea hɔn kwan, hɔn werɛ efir EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn.
Mba ekyirsamfo e, hom nsan mbra o, na mebɛyɛ hom ekyirsan no edur. Hwɛ, yɛaba wo hɔ; na ɔwo nye EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn.
Ampaara akoko do mboa ho enyidado yɛ ɔkwa, mbepɔw do weɔɔweɔɔyɛ no yɛ gyan: ampaara EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn mu na Israel nkwagye wɔ.
Na enyitodze amen hɛn egyanom berɛ a ofir hɛn mbofrase no; hɔn nguankuw nye hɔn anantwikuw, hɔn mbabanyin nye hɔn mbabaa.

Wɔmma yɛndeda famu wɔ hɛn enyito mu, na wɔmma hɛn enyimguase nkata hɛn do: na yɛayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn, hɛn nye hɛn egyanom, ofitsi hɛn mbofrase dze besi ndɛ da yi mpo: na yenntsie EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ne ndze.
Israel ee, sɛ ebɛsan w’ekyir a, EWURADZE na ɔse, me nkyɛn na san bra: na sɛ ibeyi w’ekyiwadze efi m’enyi do a, na sɛ w’adwen nnkehihim a,
sɛ ebɛka ntam, wɔ nokwar, atsɛmbu, nye ndzeyɛtsenenee mu dɛ, EWURADZE tse ase yi; nna amanaman bɛyɛ esiarfo wɔ no mu, na wɔahyehyɛ hɔnho wɔ no mu.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se Judamba nye Jerusalɛmmba nye yi, Hom ndɔw hom epe, na mma hom nndua wɔ nsoɛ mu.
Judamba nye Jerusalɛmmba, hom ntwitwa hom ho twatsia mma EWURADZE, na hom nyiyi hom akoma ho wer no: amma m’ebufuw eemmfir dɛ ogya ammbɛhyew mbrɛ obi nntum nndum no, osian hom mbusu ndzeyɛɛ no ntsi.

Hom mpaa mu nka wɔ Juda, hom mfa ntahye wɔ Jerusalɛm; na hom nse dɛ, Hom mbɔ akasamu no mu wɔ asaase no do: hom ntsea mu dzendzen na hom nse dɛ, Hom mboa hom ano na yɛnkɔ nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban no mu.
Hom nsi frankaa nkyerɛ Zion do; hom mbɔ hom ho eguaa, mma hom nngyina: na medze mbusu fi kwaamu afamu reba, ɔnye ɔsɛɛ kɛse.
Ogyata efi no dɔtɔ mu epue, amanaman ɔsɛɛfo bi oesi no kwan mu, oetu efi ne tsenabea; dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ w’asaase amamfo, na wo nkurow ayɛ ekurofo a obi nntse mu.
Iyi ntsi hom mfa eyitam mbɔ hom ho do, hom ntwa sukwadwom, na hom ntwa ewuo: na EWURADZE n’ebufuw hyeehyew no nndanee mmfii hɛn do.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ ɔhen n’akoma bɛhera, ɔnye mbapɔmba akoma; na asɔfo ho bɔbow hɔn, na nkɔnhyɛfo no ayɛ hɔn nwanwa.
Nna mesee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn! Ampaara ɔwo adaadaa ɔman yi nye Jerusalɛm dodow dɛ, Hom benya asomdwee: naaso afona ato ɔkra.
Ber no mu wɔbɛse ɔman yi nye Jerusalɛm dɛ, Mframa hyeehyew befi sar do mpampaa do abɛfa me man ne babaa do, nnyɛ dɛ orubohuw anaa ɔrebɛtsew ho;
ehum a ɔyɛ dzen kyɛn dɛm fi hɔ no ara botu ama me: afei na mo so mebɛka atsɛmbu etsia hɔn.
Hwɛ, ɔbɔfow aba dɛ nsuwusiw, na ne ntseaseanam ayɛ dɛ ekyinehyia mframa: no mpɔnkɔ ho yɛ har sen nkɔr. Yendue! Na wɔafa hɛn afo.
Jerusalɛm ee, hohor w’akoma ho fi emumuyɛ mu, ma wɔaagye wo nkwa. Ehuhudwen bɛtsena wo mu akyɛr ahen ara nko?
Ndze bi tsea mu fi Dan, na ɔdze mbusu fi Efraim akoko do tahye.
Hom nka nkyerɛ amanaman dɛ wɔreba; hom mma wɔntse no Jerusalɛm, dɛ wɔrema hɔn ndze do wɔ Juda nkurow do.
Wɔakyer no ho etwa ehyia dɛ mfuwa ahwɛdofo; osiandɛ ɔatsew mo do etua, EWURADZE na ɔse.
W’akwan nye wo nyɛe na wɔatwetwe ndzɛmba iyinom ama wo; w’emumuyɛ nye iyi; ampaara ɔyɛ wen, ampaara odu w’akoma ho.
Me yamu o, ao me yamu! Meretse yaw! Ao m’akoma yɛ me yaw, m’akoma reper mo mu: munntum mmua m’ano; osiandɛ me kra atse akasamu no ne ndze, ɔko ho gyegyeegye no.
Ɔsɛɛ bɔtɔ ɔsɛɛ do; wɔafa asaase no nyina afo: awerɛfir mu ara nna wɔafa me ntamadan afo, nye me nkataho amon mu.
Dabɛn na munhu frankaa no, na mentse akasamu no ne ndze nkodu?
Osiandɛ me man yɛ nkwasea, wonnyim me; wɔyɛ mbatam, na wonnyi ntseasee: wɔyɛ enyansafo wɔ emumuyɛ ho, na papayɛ ho dze, wonnyi nyimdzee biara.
Mohwɛɛ asaase, na hwɛ, ayɛ afoafo nye pan: na ɔsorsor so, na wonnyi kan bi.
Mohwɛɛ mbepɔw, na hwɛ, wɔrowosow, na akoko nyinara rihihim dzi akɔnaaba.
Mohwɛe, na, hwɛ, nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ, na wimu nnoma nyinara etutu kɔ.
Mohwɛe, na, hwɛ, asaaseber adandan sar, na no mu nkurow nyinara edwurudwuruw wɔ EWURADZE enyim nye n’ebufuw enyim.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Asaase no nyinara bɛyɛ amamfo; naaso murunnwie no korakora.
Iyi ntsi na asaase bedzi mbɔɔ, na ɔsor ebir wɔ wimu: osiandɛ emi na maka, emi na mesua, na minngyaa mu, eso mennkɛsan efi ho.
Kurow no nyinara ruguan wɔ mpɔnkɔdofo nye egyentofo hɔn dede ntsi; wɔhɛnhɛn adɔtɔ mu, na wɔfofow abotan: kurow biara wɔadan egya, na nyimpa biara nntsena mu.
Na ɔwo, ɔwo a wɔafa wo afo a, Ekyerɛ dɛn na ifura ɔdaaben, na edze sika ahodze hyehyɛ woho, na edze dubir hohɔr w’enyiwa yi? Eyɛ woho fɛɛfɛw kwa; w’adɔfo bu wo enyimtsia, wɔhwehwɛ wo nkwa.
Na matse ndze bi a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo nedze, ahoguan a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrowo abakan nedze, Zion babaa ne ndze a origyam, ɔtserɛw ne nsamu dɛ, Afei mundue! Me kra rotɔ bitsi wɔ ewudzifo enyim!

Hom ntutu mbirika ndzi akɔnaaba wɔ Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu, na afei hom nhwɛ, na hom nhu! Hom nhwehwɛ n’abɔntsen do, kyerɛ dɛ hom bohu nyimpa bi, dɛ obi wɔ hɔ a odzi atsɛntsenenee, na ɔhwehwɛ nokwardzi; ama medze aakyɛ Jerusalɛm.
Ɔwɔ mu dɛ wɔka dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase yi; naaso ntanhun ara na wɔka.
Ao EWURADZE, aso w’enyi nndzi nokwar ekyir bi a? Ɔwo abobɔ hɔn, naaso annyɛ hɔn yaw, ɔwo ahyew hɔn, naaso wɔapow ntsea: wɔayeyɛ hɔn enyim dzendzenndzen sen ɔbotan, wɔapow dɛ wɔbɛsan.
Nna mesee dɛ, Woyinom yɛ abɔbɔfo ara, wɔyɛ nkwasea; na wonnyim EWURADZE no kwan, anaa hɔn Nyankopɔn ne mbra no.
Ma monkɔ nyimpa akɛse no nkyɛn, na menkɛkasa nkyerɛ hɔn; osiandɛ wonyim EWURADZE no kwan no, nye hɔn Nyankopɔn ne mbra no. Naaso woyinom nyinara ayɛ kor ebubu kɔndua no, na wɔatsetsew nkyehoma no.

Dɛm ntsi ogyata fi kwaa mu bokuku hɔn, sar do pataku bɛba abɛsɛɛ hɔn. Ɔsebɔ bɛtsɛw hɔn nkurow ho, obiara a ofi mu hɔ fir no, wɔbɛtsetsew no esinesin: osiandɛ hɔn mbrato ayɛ dodow, na hɔn ekyirsan adɔɔ so.
Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na medze bɛkyɛ wo? Wo mba adan me egya, na wɔakɛka hɔn a wɔnnyɛ abosom hɔn ntam: memaa wodzidzii mee no, wɔtotoo awar, na wɔboaboaa hɔn ano ekuwekuw kɔr ndwaman efiefi mu.
Wɔtsetse dɛ mpɔnkɔnyin a wɔameemee anapa: obiara robɔ no hwen mu dzi ne nyɛnko ne yer ekyir.
Aso mennkɛtsea hɔn wɔ ndzɛmba yinom ntsi? EWURADZE na ɔse. Aso me kra nnkedzi wer wɔ ɔman a ɔtse dɛm yi do?
Hom mfow n’afasu na hom nsɛɛ; mbom mma hom nnwie no korakora: hom mpempan n’abaw: osiandɛ wɔnnyɛ EWURADZE dze.
Na Israel nye Juda mba etwa me nkontompɔ yerɛyerɛw, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Wɔapa EWURADZE na wɔase dɛ, Nnyɛ ɔno bi a; eso mbusu bi nnkɛba hɛn do; eso yennkohu afona anaa ɔkɔm.
na nkɔnhyɛfo no nnyɛ hwee dɛ mframa ara, osiandɛ asɛm no nnyi hɔn mu: na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ama hɔn nye no.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi, Osiandɛ hom ka dɛm asɛm yi ntsi, hwɛ, mebɛma me nsɛm ayɛ ogya wɔ w’anomu, na mayɛ ɔman yi nyena, na ɔahyew hɔn.
Hwɛ, medze ɔman bi fir ekyirekyir bɛba hom do, Ao Israel fifo, EWURADZE na ɔse: ɔmantsimadze a, tsetse man a, ɔman a hɔn kasaa innyim, na dza wɔka so enntse ase a.
Hɔn egyen kotoku yɛ asamandan a n’ano da hɔ, hɔn nyinara yɛ mbarimba akatakyi.

Na wobedzi wo ndɔbaa, na w’edziban na wobedzi wo mbabanyin nye wo mbabaa: wobedzi wo nguan nye w’anantwi; wobedzi wo wenyinndua nye w’adɔmbandua: wɔdze afona bɔdwerew wo nkurow a wɔaban ho a edze wo werɛ twer no no.
Naaso nda no mu mpo, EWURADZE na ɔse, Murunnwie wo yɛ koraa.

Na sɛ wo nkorɔfo no se dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ayɛ hɛn dɛm ndzɛmba yinom nyina a? Ɔno na wo so se dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ hom adan me egya, na wɔakɔsom anana abosom wɔ hom asaase do no, dɛmara na hom bɔsom ananafo so wɔ ɔman bi a ɔnnyɛ homdze mu.
Hom nka iyi nkyerɛ Jakob fie, na hom mfa ntahye wɔ Juda, dɛ,
Hom ntsie yi, ɔman kwasea a wonnyi ntseasee; wɔwɔ enyiwa, naaso wonnhu adze: wɔwɔ asowa, naaso wɔnntse asɛm.

Aso hom nnsuro me? EWURADZE na ɔse; aso hom ho mmpopo wɔ m’enyim? Emi a medze anhwea mabɔ po n’ano ban, dɛ daa ɔhe a onntum nntra; na kaansa n’asorɛkye bu mpo a, onnkotum atra, na sɛ wɔyɛ hurututuutu mpo a, wonntum nntra.
Na ɔman yi dze, wɔwɔ etuatsew nye mansotwe akoma; wɔatsew etua na wɔkɔ.
Eso wɔnnka wɔ hɔn akoma mu dɛ, Afei wɔmma yensuro EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ɔno a ɔma nsu, esusow nye ɔbɛsɛ nyina tɔ wɔ ne ber mu; na ɔkora adapɛn a wɔahyɛ ama otwaber no do ma hɛn.
Hom emumuyɛ na ɔama ndzɛmba yinom adandan, na hom bɔn ama ndzepa abɔ hom.
Na wohu emumuyɛfo wɔ me man mu: wɔweɔn, dɛ mbrɛ efirsuafo tsɛw; wosua efir, wɔpa nyimpa.
Tse dɛ nnoma a wɔahyɛ buw mu ma no, mbrɛ nsisi ahyehyɛ hɔn efi ma ara nye no: dɛm ntsi na wɔayeyɛ akɛse na woenyinya hɔnho no.
Wɔadodɔ angoa, wɔayɛ senasena: nyew, wɔtra do wɔ emumuyɛ dze mu; wonndzi asɛm wɔ pɛrpɛryɛ mu, wonndzi ngyanka asɛm, ma onnwie yie; na ohianyi ne ndzinoa so wɔmmfa mma no.
Aso munnkotua hɔn iyinom ho kaw? EWURADZE na ɔse: aso me kra nnkedzi wer wɔ ɔman a ɔtse dɛm yi do?
Anwanwadze na adze a ɔyɛ hu aba asaase yi do;
nkɔnhyɛfo no hyɛ nkɔm akɔhwi mu, na asɔfo nam hɔn ahodze do dzi tum; na me man so pɛ no dɛmara: na n’ewiei no hom bɛyɛ dɛn?
Benjaminmba, hom mbɔ homho eguaa mfi Jerusalɛm mu! Hom nhɛn akasamu no wɔ Tekoa, na hom nsi frankaa no wɔ Bɛt-hakerem do: na mbusu fi kwaamu afamu rupue, ɔnye ɔsɛɛ kɛse.
Zion babaa, ɔhoɔfɛfo no, mubotwa no akyen.
Nguanhwɛfo dze hɔn mbowakuw bɛba ne nkyɛn; na wɔabobɔ hɔn asesee wɔ no ho ehyia; hɔn nyinara wobedzidzi wɔ hɔn ananmu.
Hom nkyer no do sa; hom nsoɛr, na yɛmfow nkɔ ewiaber. Yendue! Na adze resa, ewimbir sunsuma mu atwe.
Hom nsoɛr, na yɛmfow nkɔ anadwe, na yɛnkɛsɛɛ n’ahemfie.
Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom ntow no ndua ngu famu, na hom nhɔr Jerusalɛm ho pempe: kurow a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔkɛsera no nye yi; nhyɛdo ara nko na ɔwɔ no mu.
Dɛ mbrɛ bura bi puw no nsu ba no, mbrɛ opuw n’emumuyɛ ba ara nye no: wɔtse akakabensɛm nye afofa nka wɔ no mu; ɔyar nye pirakur wɔ m’enyim daa.
Jerusalɛm, ma wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ wo, amma me kra aanntwe emmfi wo ho: amma maannyɛ wo amamfo, asaase a wɔnntsena do.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, wobedzi Israel nkaa ho mpɛpɛw kofee dɛ wenyindua ho: dan wo nsa bio kɔ mbirefi no mu dɛ wenyinabatsewnyi.
Woananom na menkasa na mombɔ hɔn kɔkɔ, ma wontsie? Hwɛ, hɔn asowa wonntwaa no twatsia, na wonntum nnkyɛn aso nntsie: hwɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm adan atwetwesidze bi ama hɔn; wonnyi enyigye biara wɔ mu.
Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE n’ebufuhyew ahyɛ me ma, mesuo mu aberɛ. Hom nhue ngu mbofra no do wɔ ɔbrɔn mu, na mberantsɛ a wɔaboa ano ehyia no do: na wɔbɛkyer okun nye ne yer so, akɔdaa ɔnye nyia oedzi mfe pii.
Na hɔn efi bɛdandan binom dze, hɔn nhaban nye hɔn yernom nyinara: na mebɛtsen me nsa aka asaase no do mba no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na ofi hɔn mu ekumaba do kesi hɔn mu ɔkɛse mpo do, hɔn nyina dze hɔnho ama enyiber; na ofi nkɔnhyɛnyi do kesi ɔsɔfo mpo do, hɔn nyina twa nkontompɔ.
Wɔayɛ me man ne pira no edur biarabiara, na wɔka dɛ, Asomdwee, asomdwee; ber a asomdwee biara nnyi hɔ.
Aso hɔn enyi too ber a wɔyɛɛ ekyiwadze no? Dabida, hɔn enyi annto koraa, eso wɔammfɛr. Dɛm ntsi na wɔbɔtotɔ wɔ hɔn a wɔtotɔ mu; ber a mobɔtwe hɔn aso no, wobosun hɔn egu famu, EWURADZE na ɔse.

Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom ngyinagyina atsempɔn mu, na hom nhwɛ, na hom mbisa akwan dadaw no, mbrɛ ɔkwan pa no wɔ, na hom nnantsew mu, na hom benya ahomgye ama hom akra: naaso hɔn dze wɔsee dɛ, Yɛrennantsew mu.
Na misisii hom do aweɔmfo, dɛ, Hom ntsie akasamu no ne ndze no; naaso hɔn dze wɔsee dɛ, Yennketsie.
Dɛm ntsi amanaman e, hom ntsie, na mboanofo, hom nhu dza ɔrebɛyɛ hɔn.
Asaase e, tsie: hwɛ, medze mbusu bɛba ɔman yi do, mekyerɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ do aba no, osiandɛ wɔannyɛ aso amma me nsɛm, na me mbra dze, wɔapow.
Ebɛnadze na eduhuam a ofi Seba nye adɔkɔdɔkɔdze a ofi ekyirekyir asaase do no, yɛ ma me? Hom hyew afɔr nnsɔ m’enyi, na hom kum afɔr nnyɛ me fɛw.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze fintsidua mobɔto ɔman yi enyim: ama woeefintsifintsiw do egyanom nye mba nyina; na ɔmanyimfo nye ne nyɛnko nyina bowuwu.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, ɔman fi kwaamu afamu asaase do reba: na wobekenyan ɔman kɛse bi efi asaase etsiwa mu no ho.
Wokurakura egyen ɔnye mpeaa; wɔyɛ etsiɔdzenfo, na wonnyi ehumbɔbɔr; hɔn ndze wor dɛ po, wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do; hɔn mu biara abɔ n’asen do dɛ nyimpa a ɔrokɔ akono, dɛ wɔreba wo do, O Zion babaa.
Yɛatse ne nka; hɛn abaw agow: ahokyer ekitsa hɛn, na yaw a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo nedze.
Mma mmfir edzi nnkɔ haban mu, eso mma nnantsew kwan no mu; na ɔtamfo no kitsa afona wɔ hɔ, na hu kɛse etwa ehyia.
Me man ɔbɔbɔfo e, fa eyitam bɔ woho do, na yankayankam nso mu: twa sukwadwom dɛ edze rema ɔba kor; sukwadwom wenwen a, osiandɛ awerɛfir mu ara na ɔsɛɛfo no bɛba hɛn do.
Mayɛ wo abantsentsen nye akoban wɔ me man mu; ama eehu na aasɔ hɔn kwan ahwɛ.
Hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ etuatsewfo ehiyifo a wɔkasakasa sɛɛ nkorɔfo edzin; boran nye dadze na wɔyɛ: hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ ndzeyɛbɔn.
Afa no bɔ hyehyeehyew; sumbui no rehyew wɔ gya mu: gyan ara na wɔda ho nan; osiandɛ wonnyiyii emumuyɛfo no nnkɔree.
Adasa bɛfrɛ hɔn dwetɛ a wɔapow, osiandɛ EWURADZE apow hɔn.
Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
Gyina EWURADZE fie ɔponkɛse no mu, na bɔ asɛm yi dawur wɔ hɔ, na se dɛ, Hom Judafo nyinara a hom hɛn ɔponkɛse yi mu dɛ wɔrobɔsɔr EWURADZE, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ɔse nye yi, Hom nsakyer hom akwan nye hom ndzeyɛɛ, na mebɛma hom atsena bea yi do ha.
Mma hom nntwer atorsɛm, dɛ, EWURADZE n’asɔrdan, EWURADZE n’asɔrdan, EWURADZE n’asɔrdan nye yinom.
Na sɛ hom sakyer hom akwan nye hom ndzeyɛɛ koraa; sɛ hom bu nyimpa nye ne nyɛnko ntamu atsɛn nokwarmu;
sɛ hom anntseetsee hɔho, egyanka, nye kunafo, na hom annka onndzi fɔ bɔgyaa enngu wɔ bea yi do, eso hom ennkedzi abosom afofor bi ekyir annyɛ homankasa homho bɔn a,
ɔno na mebɛma hom atsena bea yi do, asaase a medze maa hom egyanom, ofir tsetse kesi daa no.
Hom nhwɛ, hom twer atorsɛm a ɔnnyɛ mfaso bi no.
Aso hom bowia adze, edzi ewu, ato awar, na hom aka ntanhun, na hom ahyew eduhuam ama Baal na hom edzi abosom a hom nnyim hɔn no ekyir,
na hom aba ebegyina m’enyim wɔ ofi yi a wɔdze me dzin ato no yi mu na hom ase dɛ, Wɔagye hɛn nkwa: ama hom aayɛ ekyiwadze yinom nyinara?
Aso ofi a wɔdze me dzin ato no yi adan edwotwafo tu wɔ hom enyiwa mu? Hwɛ, emi mara mehu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na afei hom nkɔ me bea a ɔwɔ Siloh a memaa wɔkyerɛɛw me dzin wɔ hɔ asɔpɔn no, na hom nkɔhwɛ dza medze yɛɛ no wɔ me man Israel emumuyɛ ntsi.
Na afei osiandɛ hom ayɛ dɛm ndzeyɛɛ yinom nyina ntsi, EWURADZE na ɔse, na mekasaa kyerɛɛ hom, mosoɛɛr ahema mekasae, naaso hom enntsie; na mefrɛɛ hom, naaso hom anngye do:
dɛm ntsi na mebɛyɛ ofi a wɔdze me dzin ato no a hom dze hom werɛ twer no, ɔnye bea a medze maa hom nye hom egyanom no, dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ Siloh.
Na mobɔtow hom efi m’enyim akyen, dɛ mbrɛ matow hom nuanom, mekyerɛ Efraim asefo nyinara, akyen no.
Dɛm ntsi mma nnsɔr mma ɔman yi, eso mma mmpegya osu anaa mpaabɔ wɔ hɔn ntsi, eso mma nndzi nkotoserɛ nnkyerɛ me: osiandɛ mirinntsie wo.
Ana innhu dza wɔreyɛ no Juda nkurow nye Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu?
Mbofra tase nyena, na egyanom kua gya, na mbaa fetsew mbɔr, dɛ wɔreyɛ tatar ama ɔsor hembaa, na woehue ɔnom afɔr ama abosom afofor bi, ama wɔdze eeyi me ebufuw.
Aso emi na woyi me ebufuw? EWURADZE na ɔse; aso wonnyi hɔnankasa hɔnho ebufuw, dze gu hɔnankasa hɔn enyim ase?
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Hwɛ, m’ebufuw na m’ebufuhyew bohue egu bea yi do, nyimpa, abowa, na haban mu ndua, na daadze eduaba do; na ɔbɛdzɛw, na orunndum.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi: Hom mfa hom ɔhyew afɔr nka hom okum afɔr ho, na hom ndzi nam.
Na mannkasa annkyerɛ hom egyanom, eso mannhyɛ hɔn mbra da no a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase no do no, wɔ ɔhyew afɔr na okum afɔr ho:
na mbra a mehyɛɛ hɔn nye iyi, dɛ, Hom ntsie me ndze, na mebɛyɛ hom Nyankopɔn, na hom so ayɛ me man: na hom nnantsew ɔkwan a mahyɛ hom nyina mu, ama eesi hom yie.
Naaso woenntsie, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn aso adze, na mbom wɔnantseew hɔnankasa hɔn akoma bɔn n’egyinatu na ne ntsintsiman do, na wɔsaan ekyir na wɔannkɔ kan.
Ofitsi, da a hom egyanom fiir Egypt asaase do bae dze bodu ndɛ, masoma mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara aba hom nkyɛn, dabiara mosoɛr ahanamakye na mosoma hɔn:
naaso woenntsie me, eso wɔannkyɛn aso, na mbom wɔsorowee mbordo: wɔyɛɛ bɔn seen hɔn egyanom.
Ntsi ɔwo na ebɛka nsɛm yinom nyinara akyerɛ hɔn; naaso wonnketsie; ebɛfrɛ hɔn so; na wɔnnkɛgye wo do.
Na ebɛka akyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Woyi nye ɔman a woenntsie EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn ne ndze, eso wɔanngye ntsea: nokwar asa, na oetu efi hɔn anomu.
Jerusalɛm, pra wo tsinhwi gu, na twa ewuo wɔ mpampaa pataa do; osiandɛ EWURADZE apow mbasantsen a wɔhyɛɛ no ebufuw no na ɔadan hɔn egya.
Na Judamba ayɛ dza omuo wɔ m’enyim, EWURADZE na ɔse: wɔdze hɔn ekyiwadze esisi ofi a wɔdze me dzin ato do no mu, dze egu ho fi.
Na woesi Tofet a ɔwɔ Hinom ba no bɔnsa no mu nsorɔnsorɔmbea, dɛ wɔbɛhyew hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa wɔ gya mu; dza nnyɛ emi na mehyɛe, eso ɔmmbaa m’adwen mu.
Dɛm ntsi hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔremmfrɛ no Tofet bio, anaa Hinom ba no bɔnsa, na mbom Okum bɔnsa: na wobesie efun wɔ Tofet ara ma ekodu dɛ wonnya siebea bio.
Na ɔman yi hɔn efun bɛyɛ edziban ama ɔsor nnoma, nye asaase mbowa: na obiara remmpam hɔn.
Nna mebɛma ahosɛpɛw ndze na enyigye ndze, ayeforkun ndze na ayefor ndze, abɔ adze wɔ Juda nkurow, na Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu: na asaase no bɛdan amamfo.
Aber no, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔbɛsaw Juda ahemfo hɔn mbiew, na ne mbapɔmba hɔn mbiew, na asɔfo hɔn mbiew, na nkɔnhyɛfo hɔn mbiew, na hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm hɔn mbiew, efi hɔn ndakamona no mu aba:

na wɔahata hɔn wɔ ewia, na bosoom, na wimu ndzɛmba nyina a wɔdɔ hɔn, na wɔsom hɔn, na wodzi hɔn ekyir, na wɔhwehwɛ hɔn, na wɔsɔr hɔn no, enyim: wɔrennka hɔn mmboa ano, eso worummfua hɔn; wɔbɛyɛ efikyir wɔ asaase enyi.
Na ebusua bɔn yi mu nkaa a wɔbɛka no nyinara bɛsan mu eyi owu asen nkwa; hɔn a wɔbɛka no wɔ mbea a metwuw hɔn adze akɔ mu nyinara, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Nkyii so ebɛka akyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Aso obi hwe ase a ɔnnsoɛr bio? Aso obi bɔfom kwan a ɔnnkɛsan n’ekyir?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Jerusalɛm man yi asan ekyir wɔ daa ekyirsan mu yi? Wɔtakyer ndaadaa ho, wɔpow dɛ wɔbɛsan.
Mekyɛɛn aso na metsiee, naaso wɔannkasa tsenenee mu: nyimpa biara nnu noho wɔ n’emumuyɛ ho, dɛ, Ebɛnadze na mayɛ yi? Obiara dan noho fa noara no kwan do, dɛ pɔnkɔ a ɔrobɔ twitwi kɔ akono.
Nyew, ɔkompɛtɛ a ɔwɔ wimu mpo onyim ne hyɛber; na atamram na akyemfowa na nantwinoma hyɛ hɔn baber nsew; naaso me man dze, wonnyim EWURADZE n’ahyɛdze.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ka dɛ, Yɛyɛ enyansafo, na EWURADZE ne mbra wɔ hɛn hɔ, wɔ ber nokwar nye yi, akyerɛwfo ator akyerɛwdze no wɔama wɔayɛ atorsɛm.
Enyansafo no enyi bɔto, wɔbɔbɔ hu na wɔakyer hɔn: dɛ, wɔapow EWURADZE n’asɛm yi; ebɛn nyansa na ɔwɔ hɔn mu?

Dɛm ntsi medze hɔn yernom bɛma binom, na medze hɔn nhaban bɛma hɔn a wobenya edzi: osiandɛ hɔn mu biara ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do mpo wɔdze hɔnho ama enyiber, ofi nkɔnhyɛnyi do kesi ɔsɔfo do mpo, obiara dzi akɔhwisɛm.
Na wɔayɛ me man ne pira no edur biara biara, dɛ, Asomdwee, asomdwee; ber a asomdwee biara nnyi hɔ.
Wɔyɛɛ enyitodze, wɔyɛɛ ekyiwadze, Naaso hɔn enyi annto, dabida, hɔn enyi annto koraa, eso wɔammfɛr. Dɛm ntsi na wɔbɔtotɔ hɔn a wɔtotɔ mu: hɔn asotweber no mu wobosun hɔn egu famu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Mebɛma wɔasa koraa, EWURADZE na ɔse: aba remmba wenyindua do, eso adɔmba remmba adɔmbadua do, na ahataw no mpo bɔpo; na ndzɛmba a medze ama hɔn no befi hɔn nsa akɔ.

Ebɛnadze ntsi na yɛtsetse hɔ dzindzinn yi? Hom mboa hom ano ma yɛnkɔ nkurow a wɔagye ho ban no mu, na yenkowuwu wɔ hɔ: osiandɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn eyi hɛn ama owu, na ɔama hɛn ewudur nsu dɛ yɛnnom, osiandɛ yɛayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE.
Yɛhwɛɛ asomdwee kwan, naaso papa biara ammba; na ɔyarsaber kwan, naaso hwɛ ehubɔ ara nko!
Wɔtse no mpɔnkɔ hwen mu huuhuuyɛ fi Dan: n’abran no hɔn su ne dede ntsi, asaase no nyinara ho popo. Wɔba, na wɔbɛmemen asaase no na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, nkurow no na hɔn a wɔtse mu nyina.
Hwɛ, morosoma nwɔ, akyerben a wonntum hɔn dwedwe, aba hom mu; na wɔbɛkeka hom, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Ao, m’enyigye efi mo mu, awerɛhow ekitsa me! M’akoma atɔ bitsi wɔ mo mu.

Tsie, me man ne nkekamu ndze ɔda mu fitsi ekyirekyir asaase do no: Aso EWURADZE nnyi Zion? Ana ne Hen nnyi no mu? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔdze hɔn ehonyi a woesian, na ananadze egyangyandze eyi me ebufuw yi?
Otwaber etwa mu, ɔhyewber asa, na hɛn dze, wɔnngyee hɛn nkwa.
Me man ne pira ntsi emi so mepira: mayɛ kusuww; ahobow ekitsa me.
Aso edur bi nnyi Gilead? Ana onunsinnyi bi nnyi hɔ? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na me man nnyaa n’apɔwmudzen yi?
Ao, sɛ me tsir yɛɛ esuesu, na m’enyiwa yɛɛ nyinsuwa nsunyiwa a, nkyɛ mubosu me man n’atɔfoe no adzekyee na adzesaa!
Ao, nkyɛ meenya akwantsemfo asoɛe wɔ sar do ɛ; nkyɛ mebɛdan me man egya, na mefi hɔn nkyɛn akɔ! Na hɔn nyinara yɛ awartofo, nkontompɔfo mboanofo a.
Wɔkontom hɔn tɛkyerɛma dɛ egyen; Wɔagye ntsin wɔ asaase no do wɔ atorsɛm mu, na nnyɛ nokwar mu bi a; na wofi mbusu mu kɔ mbusu mu, na wonnyim me, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hom mu biara nhwɛ yie wɔ ne nyɛnko ho, na mma hom nntwer nua biara: na nua biara bedzi emim pasaa, na nyɛnko biara akasakasa asɛɛ nkorɔfo edzin.
Na hɔn nyinara bɛdaadaa hɔn amanyimfo, na obiara nnka nokwar; wɔakyerɛkyerɛ hɔn tɛkyerɛma atorsɛm dzi; wɔberɛ hɔnho wɔ emumuyɛ ne yɛ ho.
Wo tsenabea wɔ ndaadaa finimfin; ndaadaa ntsi na wɔpow dɛ wobohu me, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛnan hɔn, na masɔ hɔn ahwɛ; na mebɛyɛ no dɛn koraa wɔ me man ho?
Hɔn tɛkyerɛma yɛ ewudzi egyen menaba; ɔkasa ndaadaa: obi dze n’ano kasa asomdwee mu kyerɛ ne nyɛnko, naaso n’akoma mu dze, nna ɔretsɛw no.
Aso monnkɔtwe hɔn aso wɔ ndzɛmba yinom ntsi? EWURADZE na ɔse: aso me kra rinndzi wer wɔ dɛm man yi do?
Mbepɔw no ntsi mubotue osu na sukwadwom, na sar do dzidzibea ntsi, metwa ewuo, osiandɛ wɔahyew ma obi nndua hɔ; eso adasa nntse anantwi ndze; wimuwimu noho nnoma na mbowa nyinara eguanguan, na wɔkɔ.
Na mebɛyɛ Jerusalɛm amamfo, nsɔ tsenabea; na mebɛma Juda nkurow ayɛ nkurofo a obiara nntse mu.
Woana nye onyansafo, ma ɔaatse iyi ase? Woana nye nyia EWURADZE n’ano akasa akyerɛ no, ma ɔaaka akyerɛ? Ebɛnadze ntsi na asaase no asɛɛ na ɔahyew dɛ sar, ma obiara nndua do yi?
Na EWURADZE se dɛ, Osiandɛ wɔadan me mbra a medze sii hom enyim no egya, na woenntsie me ndze, eso wɔannantsew mu;
na mbom woekedzi hɔnankasa hɔn akoma ne ntsintsiman ekyir, na Baalim a hɔn egyanom kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn no ekyir ntsi:
mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze ɔbɔwen mebɛnyɛn hɔn, ɔman yi ara, na mama hɔn ɔbɔwema nsu ma wɔaanom.
Mobɔbɔ hɔn so apetse amanaman a hɔn anaa hɔn egyanom nnyim hɔn mu: na mebɛma afona aka hɔn do, ekodu dɛ mama wɔasa.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom ndwendwen ho, na hom mfrɛ mbaa a wonyim su ma wɔmbra; na hom nsoma ma wɔnkɛfrɛ mbaa enyansafo ma wɔmbra:
na wɔnyɛ ntsɛm ntu sukwadwom mma hɛn, ma hɛn enyiwa nwora nyinsuwa, na hɛn enyisoatsɛw mporow nsu.
Na yɛatse sukwadwom ndze fi Zion dɛ, Mbrɛ woedua asɛɛ hɛn afa a! Hɛn enyim egu ase koraa, osiandɛ yɛadan asaase no egya, osiandɛ woedwuruw hɛn tsenabew egu famu.
Hom mbaa, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm, na hom mma n’anosɛm nkɔ hom asomu, na hom nkyerɛkyerɛ mbabaa sukwadwom, na obiara nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nyɛnko ewuotwa.
Na owu afow aba hɛn ntokura mu, ɔahɛn hɛn nhemfie; dɛ obotwa mbofra efi abrɔn do, na mberantsɛ efi abɔntsen do.
Kasa! Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Adasa efun bogugu dɛ mfuwa pradada do efikyir, na dɛ eburotwafo ekyir ekuwekuw na obiara nnkɔboaboa ano.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma onyansafo nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ ne nyansaa mu, eso mma ɔhoɔdzenfo nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ n’ahoɔdzen mu, na ɔhonyafo nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ n’ahonya mu:

na mbom nyia ɔhyehyɛ noho no, ɔnhyehyɛ noho wɔ iyi mu, dɛ ɔtse me ase, na onyim me, dɛ emi nye EWURADZE a meyɛ adɔyɛ, atsɛmbu, na tsenenee wɔ asaase do: na ndzɛmba iyinom mu na m’enyigye wɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hwɛ, nda bi reba, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ mebɛba abɛtsea hɔn a wɔyɛ twatsiafo wɔ hɔn monomonomyɛ mu;
Egypt, na Juda, na Edom, na Ammonmba, na Moab, na hɔn a woetwitwa ntakuwa a wɔtsetse sar do: na amanaman nyinara yɛ monomonomfo, na Israel fifo nyinara yɛ akoma mu monomonomfo.
Israelmba, hom ntsie nsɛm a EWURADZE ka kyerɛ hom:
mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma hom nsuansua amanaman hɔn kwan no, na mma hom bo nntutu, wɔ ɔsor nsɛnkyerɛdze ho; na amanaman na hɔn bo tutu wɔ ho.
Na amanaman no hɔn atɔrmuadze yɛ egyangyandze: na obi twa dua wɔ kwaa mu, odwimfo ne nsaano edwuma a wɔdze ekuma yɛe.
Wɔdze dwetɛ na sika hyehyɛ no; wɔdze mprɛgow na nhamɛr bobɔ mu, amma oeennhihim.
Wɔtse dɛ kakaa bi a wɔayɛ esi efɛr kwa mu, na wonntum nnkasa: otwar dɛ wɔsoa hɔn, osiandɛ wonntum nnantsew. Mma nnsuro hɔn, na wonntum mmbɔ mbusu, eso papayɛ bi nnyi hɔn mu.
EWURADZE, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo; ɔwo na eyɛ ɔkɛse, na wo dzin so so wɔ tum mu.
Amanaman Hen, woana na onnkosuro wo? Ɔwo na ɔyɛ wodze: susuampaara dɛ amanaman enyansafo nyinara mu na hɔn ahendzi nyinara mu, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo.
Na wɔyɛ mbowadze na nkwaseadze prɛko: na ehonyi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ dze, ɔtse dɛ duasin ara a.
Dwetɛ a wɔabor no trɛtrɛ fi Tarsis ba, na sika a ofi Ufaz, ɔyɛ odwimfo na sikadwimfo ne nsaano edwuma; bibir na ɔberdum nye hɔn efuradze; ne nyinara edwimfo enyansafo edwuma a.
Naaso EWURADZE nye nokwar Nyankopɔn; ɔno nye Nyankopɔn tseasefo na ɔdomankoma hen no. No bo fuw a, asaase wosow, na amanaman nntum n’ebufuhyew enyim gyina.
Iyi na hom nka nkyerɛ hɔn: Abosom a nnyɛ hɔn bi na wɔyɛɛ ɔsor na asaase no, wɔbɛsɛɛ efi asaase do, na ɔsorsor ase.
Ɔno na ɔdze no tum ayɛ asaase, ɔno na ɔdze ne nyansaa etsintsim wiadze, na ɔdze ne ntseasee atserɛw ɔsorsor mu.
Sɛ ɔbɔ ne ndze mu a, esuesu no weɔɔyɛ ba ɔsorsor, na ɔma ehubɔhubɔw tu fi asaase ano fa sor; ɔno na ɔyɛ enyinam na nyankom, na ɔdze mframa fi n’adzekorabea ba.
Nyimpa biara adan kwasea na onnyim dze; sikadwinnyi biara no honyi a woesian hyɛ no enyito: na no honyi a woegu no yɛ ator, na ahom biara nnyi hɔn mu.
Wɔyɛ egyangyandze, ndaadaa edwuma a: hɔn asotweber mu no wɔbɛsɛɛ.
Jakob ne kyɛfa no dze ɔnntse dɛ iyinom; na ɔno nye adze nyinara ne hyehyɛfo; na Israel nye n’egyapadze ebusuakuw: dɔm EWURADZE nye ne dzin.
Ɔwo a etse kurow a woetua no mu, boaboa w’ahodze ano fi asaase no do.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mobɔtow asaase no do nkorɔfo no tsiabo akyerɛkyerɛ dɛm aber yi mu, na meguan hɔn ho, ma wɔaatse no yie.
Mundue wɔ me pira ntsi! Me pirakur yɛ yaayaw; naaso mesee dɛ, Ampaara iyi nye me yaw, na otwar dɛ mosɔw.
Me ntamadan asɛɛ, na me ntampehoma nyinara atsetsew: me mba efi me nkyɛn kɔ, na wonnyi hɔ: obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtserɛw me ntamadan mu bio, na ɔasese me ntamadan ho nkataho no.
Na nguanhwɛfo no adan nkwasea, na wommbisa EWURADZE ekyir kwan: dɛm ntsi na ennsi hɔn yie, na hɔn mbowakuw nyinara apetse yi.
Tsie dedeedeyɛ bi, hwɛ ɔreba, na asakrabutuw kɛse bi a ofi kwaamu afamu asaase do, dɛ ɔrebɛma Juda nkurow ayɛ nkurofo, mpataku tsenabea.
Ao EWURADZE, minyim dɛ ɔdasanyi no kwan nnyi nankasa ne nsamu: onnyi ɔdasanyi a ɔnam ne nsamu mbrɛ obodua etutu n’anamɔn.
EWURADZE, tsea me, na mbom wɔ pɛrpɛryɛ mu a; nnyɛ ebufuw mu a, amma maannsɛɛ.
Hue w’ebufuhyew gu aman a wonnyim wo no do, na mbusua a wɔmmbɔ wo dzin no do: osiandɛ wɔamen Jakob, nyew, wɔamen no seranseram, na wɔama ne tsenabea ayɛ amamfo.
Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
Hom ntsie ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm no, na hom nka nkyerɛ Juda mbarimba na Jerusalɛmfo.
Se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Mpaa nka nyimpa a onntsie ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm a
mehyɛɛ hom egyanom wɔ da a miyii hɔn Egypt asaase do, fii dadze fononoo no mu, dɛ, Hom ntsie me ndze, na hom nyɛ, dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ hom nyinara: ɔno na hom bɛyɛ me man, na emi so mayɛ hom Nyankopɔn:
ama maama ntam a mekaa kyerɛɛ hom egyanom no etsim, dɛ mebɛma hɔn asaase bi a numfonsu na ewo pem wɔ do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi. Nna mubuae see dɛ, Ɔnyɛ hɔ, EWURADZE.
Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Bɔ nsɛm yi nyinara dawur wɔ Juda nkurow mu, na Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu, dɛ, Hom ntsie ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm no, na hom nyɛ.
Na mepaa mu kaa no enyiberdo ara kyerɛɛ hom egyanom wɔ da a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do, dze besi ndɛ, morosoɛr ahanamakye merepaa mu mereka, dɛ, Hom ntsie me ndze.
Naaso woenntsie, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn asowa adze, na mbom obiara nantseew n’emumuyɛ akoma ne ntsintsiman mu: dɛm ntsi medze ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm a mehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnyɛ, na wɔannyɛ no, nyinara baa hɔn do.
Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Woehu tsirdo apam bi wɔ Juda mbarimba, na Jerusalɛmfo mu.
Wɔasan ekyir akɔ hɔn nananom a wɔpoow dɛ wobetsie me nsɛm no hɔn emumuyɛ ho; na woekedzi enyame afofor ekyir rokɔsom hɔn: Israelfo na Judafo ato m’ahyɛmu a menye hɔn egyanom dzii no.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze mbusu bɛba hɔn do a worunntum mmfi nsa; na wobosu afrɛ me, naaso mirinntsie hɔn.
Ɔno na Juda nkurow na Jerusalɛmfo bɔkɔ ekosu afrɛ enyame a wɔhyew nduhuam ma hɔn no: naaso wɔnnkɛgye hɔn nkwa koraa wɔ hɔn fona ber no mu.

Na Juda, mbrɛ wo nkurow hɔn dodow ano si no, mbrɛ w’enyame dodow ano so si ara nye no; na mbrɛ Jerusalɛm abrɔn hɔn dodow ano si no, na hom esisi afɔrmbukyia ama enyitodze no, afɔrmbukyia a wɔhyew do nduhuam ma Baal no a.
Dɛm ntsi mma nnsɔr mma ɔman yi, eso mma mmpegya osu anaa mpaabɔ wɔ hɔn ntsi: osiandɛ mirinntsie hɔn wɔ ber a wobosu afrɛ me wɔ ɔfona ntsi no.
Ebɛnadze na mo dɔfo wɔ yɛ wɔ me fie, ber a ɔnye dodowara ayɛ ehuhudze yi? Aso mbowa afɔrbɔ botum apa wo mbusu? Ana afei ibotum edzi ehurusi?
EWURADZE too wo dzin dɛ, Ngodua ebun ebun a aba pa ama ɔayɛ fɛɛfɛw; ɔdze weɔɔyɛ kɛse ne dede ekua gya wɔ do, na n’abaw ebubu.
Na dɔm EWURADZE a ɔtsɛɛw wo no, ɔakasa mbusu etsia wo, osian mbusu a Israelmba na Judamba abobɔ ama hɔnho wɔ dɛ wɔahyehyew nduhuam ama Baal dze eyi me ebufuw no ntsi.
EWURADZE na ɔmaa me ho nyimdzee, na muhunii: nna ekyerɛɛ me hɔn ndzeyɛɛ.

Na meyɛɛ dɛ eguambaa brɛfo a wɔdze no rokɔ ekumii. Nna minnyim dɛ saa wɔdze ritsia me wɔadwendwen mo ho adwen, dɛ, Hom mma yɛnsɛɛ dua no na no do aba, na hom mma yentwa no mfi atseasefo asaase do, amma wɔaannkaa ne dzin bio.
Naaso, Ao dɔm EWURADZE, ɔwo a ibu atsɛn tsenenee, na esɔ adwen na akoma hwɛ, ma munhu w’awerdzi wɔ hɔn do: na ɔwo na medze m’asɛm abrɛ wo.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se wɔ Anathot mbarimba a wɔrohwehwɛ wo nkwa na wɔka dɛ, Mma nnhyɛ nkɔm wɔ EWURADZE dzin mu, ɔno ibowu wɔ hɛn nsaano no ho nye dɛ:
mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛtsea hɔn: mberantsɛ no bowuwu wɔ afona ano; ɔkɔm bokuku hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa;
na nkaa bi nnkɛka ama hɔn: na medze mbusu bɛba Anathot mbarimba do, mekyerɛ hɔn asotwe afe no mu.
EWURADZE, sɛ mobɔ wo sombo a, bem ara na ibedzi: naaso menye wo beyi atsɛn ara. Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na emumuyɛfo kwan yɛ prɔmprɔm? Ɔyɛ dɛn na hɔn a wotwa nkontompɔ nyinara hɔn ho dwe hɔn yi?
Ɔwoara na atsɛw hɔn, nyew, wɔagye ndwow; wonyin, na wɔsow aba; ɔwo ebɛn hɔn ano, naaso enye hɔn akoma ntamu twe.
Naaso ɔwo, EWURADZE, inyim me; ɔwo ihu me, na esɔ m’akoma hwɛ wɔ wo ho: twetwe hɔn pue dɛ nguan a wɔdze hɔn rokɔ ekumii, na siesie hɔn ma okum da no.
Onkodu dabɛn na asaase no ngyam, na asaase nyinara do nhaban nkyenkyen? Hɔn a wɔtse mu no hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi mbowa na nnoma asa; osiandɛ wɔsee dɛ, Onnhu hɛn, wɔ dza yɛyɛ ho.
Sɛ enye anamɔnmufo etutu mbirika, na wɔama aberɛ a, ebɛyɛ dɛn afei etum enye mpɔnkɔ esi empire? Na kaansa asomdwee asaase do mpo ehwe ase a, ɔnodze ebɛyɛ dɛn wɔ Jordan ne yir mu?
Na wo nuanom, na w’egya fie mpo hɔnara mpo woetwa wo nkontompɔ; hɔnara mpo wɔatseatsea mu edzi w’ekyir: kaansa wɔkasa dɔkɔdɔkɔ kyerɛ wo mpo a, mma nngye hɔn nndzi.
Madan me fie egya, matow m’egyapadze akyen; medze dza me kra no dɔ pa ara ahyɛ n’atamfo nsa.
M’egyapadze adan me dɛ kwaa mu ogyata: ɔabɔ ne ndze mu etsia me; dɛm ntsi matan no.
Aso m’egyapadze adan me anoma edzinam ntokowa ntokowa? Aso nnoma edzinam etwa ayer me? Hom nkɔ nkɔboa hamu mbowadoma nyinara ano, na hom mfa hɔn mbra ma wombedzi ne nam.
Nguanhwɛfo pii asɛɛ mo wenyin ture na woetsiatsia me kyɛfa do, wɔama me kyɛfa fɛɛfɛw no ayɛ sar pradada.
Wɔayɛ no amamfo; orusu kyerɛ me, dɛ ɔayɛ afoafo, asaase no nyina ayɛ amamfo, naaso obiara nndween ho da wɔ n’akoma mu.
Sar pradadaada nyina do, adzesɛɛfo aba; na EWURADZE n’afona no ridzi nam fi asaase no ne tsir pem tsir: ɔdasanyi biara nnya asomdwee.
Woegu ewifua, na woetwa nsoɛ; wɔafona hɔnho, naaso woennya mu hwee. Hom enyiwa bɔto hom ndɔbaa ho, osian EWURADZE n’ebufuhyew ntsi.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se wɔ nyimpa emumuyɛfo nyinara a wɔdze hɔn nsa ka egyapadze a medze ama me man Israel dɛ wondzi do no ho nye yi: Hwɛ, mubotutu hɔn efi hɔn asaase no do, na metutu Judamba efi hɔn mu.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ metu hɔn ewie ekyir no, mebɛsan ebohu hɔn mbɔbɔr; na medze hɔn bɛsan aba obiara n’egyapadze mu, na obiara n’asaase do.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔdze mbɔdzen sua me man hɔn akwan, dɛ wɔka me dzin ho ntam, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase yi; dɛ mbrɛ mpo wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me man ma wɔkaa Baal ntam no a; ɔnodze wɔdze hɔn besisi me man finimfin.
Na sɛ woenntsie a, ɔnodze mubotutu ɔman no, mubotutu na masɛɛ no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE see me nye yi, Kɔ, na kɔtɔ ndwera pa abɔdo, na fa bɔ w’asen, na mma mmfa nnka nsu.
Nna motɔɔ abɔdo dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm tse, na medze bɔɔ m’asen.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ otsia ebien no dɛ,
Fa abɔdo a atɔ abɔ w’asen no, na soɛr, kɔ Eufrates ho, na fa kosuma ɔbotan no no tokur bi mu.
Nna mokɔree, na medze kosumaa Eufrates ho, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ me no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda pii ekyir no, EWURADZE see me dɛ, Soɛr, si mu kɔ Eufrates ho, na keyi abɔdo a mehyɛɛ wo dɛ fa kosuma hɔ no fi hɔ.
Nna mokɔr Eufrates ho, mokɔree, na miyii abɔdo no fii beebi mbrɛ medze sumae no: na, hwɛ, abɔdo no esuw, onnye mma hwee.
Nna EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Dɛm yi ara na mibesi masɛɛ Juda ne ntsɛn, na Jerusalɛm ne ntsɛn beberebe no.
Ɔman bɔn yi a wɔpow dɛ wobetsie me nsɛm, wɔnantsew hɔn akoma ne ntsintsiman mu na woekedzi enyame afofor ekyir, dɛ wɔrokɔsom hɔn, na wɔasɔr hɔn no, wɔbɛyɛ dɛ abɔdo yi ara a onnye mma hwee no.

Na dɛ mbrɛ abɔdo fam nyimpa n’asen no, dɛmara na mama Israelmba nyina na Judamba nyina afam mo ho nye no, EWURADZE na ɔse; ama wɔaayɛ me ɔman, na dzin, na ayɛyi, na enyimnyam: naaso wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie.
Dɛm ntsi ka asɛm yi kyerɛ hɔn: Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi, Nsatoa biara wɔbɛhyɛ no nsa ma: na wɔbɛse wo dɛ, Ana innyim dɛ nsatoa biara wɔbɛhyɛ no nsa ma?
Ɔno na wo so se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛma asaase yi do mba nyinara, mekyerɛ ahemfo a wɔtsetse David akɔngua do, na asɔfo, na nkɔnhyɛfo, na Jerusalɛmmba nyinara wɔabobow nsa.
Na medze hɔn besisi hɔnho nkorkor, egyanom a wonnyi mba mpo, EWURADZE na ɔse: munnkohu mbɔbɔr, eso mennkɛkam do, eso minnkenya ayamuhyehye dɛ mennkɛsɛɛ hɔn.
Hom ntsie, na hom nyɛ aso; mma hom nnyɛ ntsɛntsɛn, na EWURADZE akasa.
Hom mfa enyimnyam mma EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn no, ansaana sum agye, ansaana hom anan efintsiw mbepɔw no do ewimbir; na ber a hom rohwehwɛ kan no, ɔdan no owu sunsuma, na ɔyɛ no sum kebikebi.
Naaso sɛ hom rinntsie a, me kra bosu nsumaa mu wɔ hom ntsɛn ntsi; na m’enyiwa bosu kɛse, na oekyi nyinsuwa pii, osiandɛ wɔafa EWURADZE no nguankuw no ndɔmmum.
Se ɔhen nye ɔhen ne na dɛ, Hom mbrɛ hom ho adze bɔkɔɔ: na hom enyimnyam abɔtsir no efi hom tsir ho egu famu.
Wɔatotow pomu afamu nkurow no mu, na obi nnyi hɔ a obuebue: woetu Juda manmu nyina ndɔmmum kɔ; woetu no kɔ ndɔmmum korakora.
Hom mma hom enyi do, na hom nhwɛ hɔn a wofi kwaamu afamu reba: wo mbowakuw a wɔdze kyɛɛ wo no wɔ hen, mekyerɛ, wo mbowakuw fɛɛfɛw no a?
Sɛ ɔdze hɔn a ɔwoara akyerɛkyerɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnyɛ w’aboafo no dzi wo do panyin a, ebɛn asɛm na ebɛka? Aso yaw nnkekitsa wo dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo?
Na sɛ ibisa wo ho dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ndzɛmba iyinom aba mo do a? W’emumuyɛ ne kɛse ntsi wɔada w’asetar ho edzi, na w’anantsir ruhu amandze.
Aso Etiopianyi botum asakyer no wer, anaa ɔsebɔ bɛsesa no ho nsisii? Ɔno na hom a mbusubɔ akokwa hom yi hom botum ayɛ papa.
Dɛm ntsi na mobɔbɔ hɔn apetse dɛ ntsɛw a sar do mframa ma otu kɔ.
Iyi nye w’afamudze, wo kyɛfa a mesusu ama wo, EWURADZE na ɔse; osiandɛ wo werɛ efir me, na edze woho atwer atorsɛm.
Dɛm ntsi emi mara so mibeyi w’asetar ebua w’enyim na w’enyito bɛda edzi.
Mehu w’ekyiwadze, mekyerɛ w’awarto na wo hwenmubɔ, wo ndwamangor n’atantandze, wɔ haban mu akoko do. Jerusalɛm e due! Onkodu dabɛn na wo ho bɛtsew?
Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, Kaansa Moses na Samuel begyina m’enyim mpo a, nkyɛ m’adwen nnkɔtɔ akɔ ɔman yi do; hom nyi hɔn edzi mfi m’enyim, na wɔmma womfi hɔ nkɔ.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔse wo dɛ, Henfa na yemfir edzi ɔno ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hɔn a wɔfata owu no, wɔnkɔ owu mu; na hɔn a wɔfata afona ano no, wɔnkɔ afona ano; na hɔn a wɔfata ɔkɔm no, wɔnkɔ ɔkɔm mu; na hɔn a wɔfata ndɔmmum no, wɔnkɔ ndɔmmum mu.
Na ndzɛmba horow anan na mebɛma wɔaba hɔn do, EWURADZE na ɔse: afona a wɔdze boku hɔn, na nkraman a wɔbɛtsetsew hɔn mu, na wimu nnoma, na asaase mbowa a wɔbɛmemen na wɔasɛɛ hɔn.
Na mebɛma woedzi hɔn akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do ahendzi horow nyina mu, osian dza Judahen Hezekia ne ba Manaasɛ yɛe wɔ Jerusalɛm ntsi.
Na woana benya tsema ama wo, ao Jerusalɛm, anaa woana bedzi wo nkɔmbɔ? Woana bɛman nkyɛn ekebisa wo yieyɛ?
Ɔwo apow me, EWURADZE na ɔse, na w’ekyir ara na eresan: dɛm ntsi na matsen me nsa wɔ wo do, na masɛɛ wo; maberɛ na mbɔbɔrhu.
Na medze nhuwdo adze mehuw hɔn do wɔ asaase no n’aponkɛse no mu; magye hɔn nsamu mba, na masɛɛ me man; osiandɛ wɔnnsanee mmfii hɔn akwan do.
Hɔn ekunafo adɔɔ so ama me asen mpoano anhwea: medze ɔsɛɛfo bi aba mberantsɛ no hɔn na do ewiaber ketee: mama ahoguan na hu atɔ no do awerɛfir mu.

Ɔbaa a ɔawo esuon no, oegura; oegyaa no sunsum mu; no wi atɔ ber a adzekyee da ho wɔ do no; n’enyi ato na n’enyim egu ase: na hɔn mu nkaase no medze hɔn bɛma afona wɔ hɔn atamfo enyim, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Me na, mundue, dɛ awo me ɔko nyimpa na mansotwe nyimpa dze ama adasa nyinara! Mommbɔɔ bosa minnsii apempem, eso obi mmbɔɔ me bosa nnsii apempem; naaso hɔn mu obiara biara dom me.
EWURADZE see dɛ, Ampaara mebɛma ɔtamfo no akotow aserɛ wo wɔ mbusu ber na ahohia ber mu.
Aso obi tum bu dadze, mekyerɛ dadze a ofir kwaamu afamu, na boran mu?
Mebɛma wɔafom w’akoradze na wonnkotua kaw, wɔ wo bɔn nyinara ntsi, wɔ w’ahe nyinara do mpo.
Na mebɛma asom w’atamfo wɔ asaase a innyim no do; osiandɛ ogya bi asɔ wɔ m’ebufuw mu a ɔbɛdzɛw wɔ hom do.
Ao EWURADZE, ɔwoara inyim; kaa me, na bɛsera me, na bɔtɔ m’ahohiahiafo wer ma me; mma mmfa me nnkɔ wɔ wo penkyɛr mu: hu dɛ ɔwo ntsi na masɔw ahorbahyɛ.
Wohun wo nsɛm, na midzii; na wo nsɛm yɛɛ me enyigye na m’akoma n’ehurusi: osiandɛ, wo dzin na wɔdze frɛ me, Ao, dɔm EWURADZE Nyankopɔn.
Manntsena hɔn a wɔregye hɔn enyi, anaa wodzii ehurusi hɔn bagua mu: osian wo nsa ntsi mankotsee metsenae; osiandɛ ɔwo edze ebufuhyew ahyɛ me ma.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na me yaw wɔ hɔ daa, na me pirakur ayɛ koannkɔ a ɔpow dɛ wɔyɛ no edur yi? Aso ampaara dɛ ɔwo ebɛyɛ ndaadaa ɔwora, dɛ esu a ɔwew ama me?

Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Sɛ esan w’ekyir a, ɔno na medze wo bɛba bio, ma aabɔsom me; na sɛ iyi dza ɔsom bo fi dza ɔyɛ huhuw no mu a, ebɛyɛ dɛ m’ano. Hɔn na wɔbɛsan aba wo nkyɛn, na nnyɛ ɔwo na ebɛsan akɔ hɔn nkyɛn.
Na medze wo besi hɔ ama ɔman yi; dɛ boran afasu a wɔabɔ ho ban na wɔnye wo bedzi ako, naaso worunntum nnka wo nngu; na mowɔ wo nkyɛn dɛ meregye wo nkwa na meyi wo, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na mibeyi wo efi omumuyɛnyi no ne nsamu, na mapon wo efi etsiɔdzemfo no nsamu.
Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, Kaansa Moses na Samuel begyina m’enyim mpo a, nkyɛ m’adwen nnkɔtɔ akɔ ɔman yi do; hom nyi hɔn edzi mfi m’enyim, na wɔmma womfi hɔ nkɔ.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔse wo dɛ, Henfa na yemfir edzi ɔno ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hɔn a wɔfata owu no, wɔnkɔ owu mu; na hɔn a wɔfata afona ano no, wɔnkɔ afona ano; na hɔn a wɔfata ɔkɔm no, wɔnkɔ ɔkɔm mu; na hɔn a wɔfata ndɔmmum no, wɔnkɔ ndɔmmum mu.
Na ndzɛmba horow anan na mebɛma wɔaba hɔn do, EWURADZE na ɔse: afona a wɔdze boku hɔn, na nkraman a wɔbɛtsetsew hɔn mu, na wimu nnoma, na asaase mbowa a wɔbɛmemen na wɔasɛɛ hɔn.
Na mebɛma woedzi hɔn akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do ahendzi horow nyina mu, osian dza Judahen Hezekia ne ba Manaasɛ yɛe wɔ Jerusalɛm ntsi.
Na woana benya tsema ama wo, ao Jerusalɛm, anaa woana bedzi wo nkɔmbɔ? Woana bɛman nkyɛn ekebisa wo yieyɛ?
Ɔwo apow me, EWURADZE na ɔse, na w’ekyir ara na eresan: dɛm ntsi na matsen me nsa wɔ wo do, na masɛɛ wo; maberɛ na mbɔbɔrhu.
Na medze nhuwdo adze mehuw hɔn do wɔ asaase no n’aponkɛse no mu; magye hɔn nsamu mba, na masɛɛ me man; osiandɛ wɔnnsanee mmfii hɔn akwan do.
Hɔn ekunafo adɔɔ so ama me asen mpoano anhwea: medze ɔsɛɛfo bi aba mberantsɛ no hɔn na do ewiaber ketee: mama ahoguan na hu atɔ no do awerɛfir mu.

Ɔbaa a ɔawo esuon no, oegura; oegyaa no sunsum mu; no wi atɔ ber a adzekyee da ho wɔ do no; n’enyi ato na n’enyim egu ase: na hɔn mu nkaase no medze hɔn bɛma afona wɔ hɔn atamfo enyim, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Me na, mundue, dɛ awo me ɔko nyimpa na mansotwe nyimpa dze ama adasa nyinara! Mommbɔɔ bosa minnsii apempem, eso obi mmbɔɔ me bosa nnsii apempem; naaso hɔn mu obiara biara dom me.
EWURADZE see dɛ, Ampaara mebɛma ɔtamfo no akotow aserɛ wo wɔ mbusu ber na ahohia ber mu.
Aso obi tum bu dadze, mekyerɛ dadze a ofir kwaamu afamu, na boran mu?
Mebɛma wɔafom w’akoradze na wonnkotua kaw, wɔ wo bɔn nyinara ntsi, wɔ w’ahe nyinara do mpo.
Na mebɛma asom w’atamfo wɔ asaase a innyim no do; osiandɛ ogya bi asɔ wɔ m’ebufuw mu a ɔbɛdzɛw wɔ hom do.
Ao EWURADZE, ɔwoara inyim; kaa me, na bɛsera me, na bɔtɔ m’ahohiahiafo wer ma me; mma mmfa me nnkɔ wɔ wo penkyɛr mu: hu dɛ ɔwo ntsi na masɔw ahorbahyɛ.
Wohun wo nsɛm, na midzii; na wo nsɛm yɛɛ me enyigye na m’akoma n’ehurusi: osiandɛ, wo dzin na wɔdze frɛ me, Ao, dɔm EWURADZE Nyankopɔn.
Manntsena hɔn a wɔregye hɔn enyi, anaa wodzii ehurusi hɔn bagua mu: osian wo nsa ntsi mankotsee metsenae; osiandɛ ɔwo edze ebufuhyew ahyɛ me ma.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na me yaw wɔ hɔ daa, na me pirakur ayɛ koannkɔ a ɔpow dɛ wɔyɛ no edur yi? Aso ampaara dɛ ɔwo ebɛyɛ ndaadaa ɔwora, dɛ esu a ɔwew ama me?

Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Sɛ esan w’ekyir a, ɔno na medze wo bɛba bio, ma aabɔsom me; na sɛ iyi dza ɔsom bo fi dza ɔyɛ huhuw no mu a, ebɛyɛ dɛ m’ano. Hɔn na wɔbɛsan aba wo nkyɛn, na nnyɛ ɔwo na ebɛsan akɔ hɔn nkyɛn.
Na medze wo besi hɔ ama ɔman yi; dɛ boran afasu a wɔabɔ ho ban na wɔnye wo bedzi ako, naaso worunntum nnka wo nngu; na mowɔ wo nkyɛn dɛ meregye wo nkwa na meyi wo, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na mibeyi wo efi omumuyɛnyi no ne nsamu, na mapon wo efi etsiɔdzemfo no nsamu.
EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ so, dɛ,
Mma nnwar yer, eso mma nnya mbabanyin na mbabaa wɔ bea yi do ha.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se wɔ mbabanyin na mbabaa a wɔwo hɔn wɔ bea yi do ho, na hɔn nanom a wɔwo hɔn, na hɔn egyanom a wɔwo hɔn wɔ asaase yi do ho no nye yi:
Wobowuwu awerɛhow wu; wonnkosu hɔn, eso wonnkesie hɔn; wɔbɛyɛ dɛ efikyir wɔ daadze enyi; na afona na ɔkɔm bɛhyew hɔn; na hɔn efun bɛyɛ edziban ama ɔsor nnoma, na asaase mbowa.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma hom nnkɔ eyiadze, eso mma hom nnkosu, eso mma hom nnkegyam hɔn: osiandɛ meyi m’asomdwee efi ɔman yi ho kɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse, mpo m’adɔyɛ na m’ayamuhyehye.
Akɛse na nkakraba nyinara bowuwu wɔ asaase yi do: worinnsie hɔn, eso nyimpa runnsu hɔn, eso wɔrommbɔ hɔnho akam, eso wɔremmpa hɔn etsir mma hɔn:
eso wɔrennkyɛ edziban mmema hɔn eyiyɛ mu mmfa nnkyekye hɔn werɛ wɔ ewufo no ntsi, eso wɔremma hɔn awerɛkyekyer kɔɔpow dɛ wɔnnom wɔ hɔn egya na hɔn na ho.
Na mma nnye hɔn nnkɔ aponto fi mu nnkɛnye hɔn nntsena ase nndzidzi na nnom.
Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛma ahosɛpɛw ndze, na enyigye ndze, okumfor ndze na ayefor ndze egyaa, wɔ bea yi do ha, wɔ hom enyiwa do na hom ber yi mu.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ iyi nsɛm yinom nyinara kyerɛ ɔman yi, na wobisa wo dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na EWURADZE aka mbusu kɛse yi nyina egu hɛn do yi, na hɛn emumuyɛ nye dɛn? Hɛn bɔn a yɛayɛ etsia EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn enye dɛn a?
Ɔno dze se hɔn dɛ, Osiandɛ hom egyanom adan me egya, EWURADZE na ɔse, na woekedzi abosom afofor bi ekyir, na wɔasom hɔn, na wɔakotow hɔn, na wɔadan me egya, na woenndzi me mbra do;
na hom so abɔ mbusu asen hom egyanom; na, hwɛ, hom mu obiara dzi nankasa n’akoma bɔn ne ntsintsiman ekyir, ma dɛm ntsi na hom mma me aso:
dɛm ntsi na mobɔtow hom efi asaase yi do ekogu asaase bi a hom na hom egyanom nnyim do; na hɔ na hom bɔsom abosom afofor adzekyee na adzesaa; osiandɛ merennyɛ adom biara mma hom.
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda bi reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔnnkɛse bio dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE a oyii Israelmba fii Egypt asaase no do tse ase yi;
na mbom, dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE a oyii Israelmba fii kwaamu afamu asaase do, na aman a ɔpaam hɔn kɔr hɔ nyina do, tse ase yi: na medze hɔn bɛba asaase a medze maa hɔn egyanom no do bio.
Hwɛ, mobɔsoma ekehyia apofo pii, EWURADZE na ɔse, na wobonu hɔn; na n’ekyir no masoma ekehyia abɔmbɔfo pii, ma wɔbɔtwe hɔn efi bepɔw biara na koko biara do, na abotan mu etu mu.
Osiandɛ m’enyi wɔ hɔn akwan nyinara do: wonnsuma wɔ m’enyi do, eso wommbuabua hɔn emumuyɛ do wɔ m’enyiwa do.
Na mibedzi kan metua hɔn emumuyɛ na hɔn bɔn kaw mbɔho: osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn atantandze n’efun egu m’asaase ho fi, na wɔdze hɔn ekyiwadze ahyɛ m’egyapadze do ma.

Ao EWURADZE, m’ahoɔdzen, na m’akoban, na mo guandɔbea wɔ ahohia da mu, ɔwo na amanaman fi asaase ano bɛba wo nkyɛn abɛse dɛ, Hɛn egyanom ennya ewungyadze biara dɛ atorsɛm nko, mekyerɛ egyangyandze na ndzɛmba a mfaso bi nnyi mu.
Aso dasanyi bɛyɛ enyame bi ama noho? Iyinom nyina nnyɛ enyame bi!
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, mebɛma woehu, prɛko yi ara dze mebɛma woehu me nsa na m’ahoɔdzen; na wobohu dɛ me dzin dze EWURADZE.
Juda no bɔn wɔdze dadze kyerɛwdze na dɛnkyɛmbo hwintsi akyerɛw: woekrukye no wɔ hɔn akoma pon, na hɔn afɔrmbukyia mmbɛn do;
ber a hɔn mba ka hɔn afɔrmbukyia na hɔn Aserim a ɔwowɔ ndua ebun ebun ase wɔ akoko sorɔnsorɔm do no.
Me bepɔw a ewɔ wiramu, medze w’ahodze na w’akoradze nyina bɛma ma wɔaafom afa, na wo nsorɔnsorɔmbea no, wɔ bɔn ntsi, wɔ w’ahe nyinara do.
Na ɔwo, ɔwoara wo mu no, ibegyaa egyapadze a medze maa wo no mu ato hɔ; na mebɛma akɔsom w’atamfo wɔ asaase a innyim no do: osiandɛ hom asɔ gya wɔ m’ebufuw mu a ɔbɛdzɛw daa.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Ndom nka ɔdasanyi biara a ɔtwer ɔdasanyi, na ɔdze ɔhonam yɛ n’akodadze, na n’akoma twe fi EWURADZE ho.
Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ sar do duaba, na sɛ yie ba a orunnhu. Ɔbɛtsena mbea a ayɛ kɛsɛɛ no do wɔ sar no do, nkyen asaase a obi nntse do.
Osiarfo nye nyimpa a ɔdze noho twer EWURADZE, na EWURADZE yɛ n’enyidado.
Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ dua a wɔatsɛw no wɔ nsu ho, na ɔtsentsen no ndwow kɔ esutsen no nkyɛn, na sɛ ɔhyew ba a, ɔnnyɛ no hu, na mbom n’ahaban bɛyɛ ebun ebun, na nsuna afe nnkɛyɛ no asɛm, eso orinngyaa aba sow.
Akoma yɛ ɔdaadaafo kyɛn adze nyina, na ɔyɛ otsiɔdzennyi kɛse, woana botum atse no ase?
Emi mara EWURADZE na mosɔ adwen hwɛ na mohwehwɛ akoma mu, ama maama obiara, dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan tse, dɛ mbrɛ ne ndzeyɛe n’aba tse.
