Fa no, na hwɛ no yie, na mma nnyɛ no bɔn biara; na dza ɔbɛse wo nyina yɛ ma no.
Nna aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan, na Nebusaziban, Rab-saris, na Nergal-sarezer, Rab-mag, na Babilɔnhen n’asafohen etsitsir no nyinara wɔsomae;
wɔsomae ma wɔkɛfaa Jeremia fii aweɔmfo abangua no mu bae, na wɔdze no hyɛɛ Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia nsa, dɛ ɔmfa no nkɔ fie: nna ɔkɛtsenaa no nkorɔfo no mu.
Afei Jeremia da ho da efiadze wɔ aweɔmfo abangua no no mu no, nna EWURADZE n’asɛm baa no hɔ dɛ,
Kɔ, na kɛse Etiopianyi Ebed-melek, dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ase nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛma me nsɛm aba mu wɔ kurow yi do ayɛ mbusu, na nnyɛ papa bi a; na ɔbɛba mu wɔ w’enyim da no.
Na da no mebɛgye wo, EWURADZE na ɔse: na wɔremmfa wo nnhyɛ mbarimba a isuro hɔn no nsa.
Na nkwa na mebɛgye wo, na eronntɔ afona ano, na wo nkwa bɛyɛ afonam ama wo: osiandɛ ɔwo edze wo werɛ atwer me, EWURADZE na ɔse.

Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, aber a aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan gyaa no wɔ Rama n’ekyir no, ber a ɔfaa no dɛ ɔda nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu wɔ Jerusalɛm na Juda ndɔmmumfo a wɔdze hɔn rokɔ Babilɔn ndɔmmum no mu no.
Na aweɔmfo safohen no faa Jeremia, na ɔsee no dɛ, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn na ɔkaa mbusu yi baa bea yi do:
na EWURADZE na ɔama aba mu, na ɔayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔkae no; osiandɛ hom ayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE, na hom enntsie ne ndze, dɛm ntsi na adze yi aba hom do yi.

Na afei, hwɛ, Masan wo ndɛ da yi efi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a ɔda wo nsa no mu. Sɛ ehwɛ na oye ma wo dɛ enye me bɔkɔ Babilɔn a, bra, na mobɔhwɛ wo yie; na sɛ ehwɛ na omuo ma wo dɛ enye me bɔkɔ Babilɔn a, ma ɔnka: hwɛ, asaase no nyina da w’enyim; beebiara a ehwɛ a oye na ɔyɛ ahomka ma wo dɛ ebɔkɔ no, kɔ hɔ.

Na onnyae nnsanee no, ɔsee dɛ, San mbɔ na kɔ Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia a Babilɔnhen ahyɛ no ambrado wɔ Juda nkurow do no, na kɛtsena ne nkyɛn wɔ ɔman no mu: anaa kɔ beebiara a ehwɛ a ibenya ahomka dɛ ebɔkɔ no. Nna aweɔmfo safohen no maa no akwantu mu edziban na ahyɛdze, na ogyaa no kwan.
Nna Jeremia kɔr Ahikam ba Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mizpa, na ɔkɛtsenaa ne nkyɛn wɔ ɔman a wɔaka asaase no do no mu.

Afei ber a dɔm no hɔn asafohen a wɔwɔ nhaban mu no, mekyerɛ hɔn na hɔn mbarimba no, wɔtsee dɛ Babilɔnhen ahyɛ Ahikam ba Gedalia ambrado wɔ asaase no do, na ɔdze mbarimba, na mbaa, na mbofraba, na asaase no do akɔhweaban a wɔammfa hɔn ndɔmmum annkɔ Babilɔn no mu bi ahyɛ n’ase no;
nna wɔbaa Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mizpa, mekyerɛ Netania ba Ismael, na Karea mba Johanan na Jonatan, na Tanhumet ba Seraia, na Netofanyi Efai ne mba, na Maakanyi ne ba Jezania, hɔn na hɔn mbarimba.
Na Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia kaa ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn na hɔn mbarimba no, dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro dɛ hom bɔsom Kaldeafo no: na hom ntsena asaase no do, na hom nsom Babilɔnhen no, na obesi hom yie.

Emi dze, hwɛ, Mebɛtsena Mizpa megyina Kaldeafo a wɔbɛba hɛn nkyɛn no enyim: na hom dze, hom mboaboa nsa na ɔpɛber nduadzewa na ngo ano, na hom mfa ngugu hom ndzɛmba mu, na hom ntsenatsena hom nkurow a hom afefa no mu.

Dɛmara so na Judafo a wɔwɔ Moab, na Ammonmba mu, na Edom, na hɔn a wɔwɔ asaase no nyina do nyinara, wɔtsee dɛ Babilɔnhen egya Juda nkaa, na dɛ ɔdze Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia edzi hɔn do ɔpanyin no;
nna Judafo no nyina sanee fii mbea a wɔpaam hɔn kɔree no do bae, na wɔbaa Juda asaase do, wɔ Gedalia nkyɛn, wɔ Mizpa, na wɔboaboaa nsa na ɔpɛber nduadzewa piigyan ara ano.
Nkyii so Karea na Johanan, na dɔm a wɔwɔ haban mu n’asafohen no, wɔbaa Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mizpa,
na wɔsee no dɛ, Ana inyim dɛ Ammonmba hɔn hen Baalis asoma Netania ba Ismael dɛ omboku wo? Na Ahikam ba Gedalia anngye hɔn enndzi.

Nna Karea ba Johanan see Gedalia wɔ Mizpa wɔ nsumaa mu, dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma monkɔ, na munkoku Netania ba Ismael, na nyimpa biara runnhu: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na oboku wo, ma Judafo a wɔaboa ano aba wo nkyɛn no nyinara mbɔ mpetse, na Juda nkaa no nhera?
Na Ahikam ba Gedalia see Karea ba Johanan, dɛ, Mma nnyɛ dɛm adze yi: na atorsɛm na eka no Ismael ho yi.

Afei ɔbaa dɛ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu, Elisama ba Netania ne ba Ismael, a ofi ɔhen asefo, na ɔhen n’etsitsir no mu no, na mbarimba du a wɔka no ho no, baa Ahikam ba Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mizpa: na Mizpa hɔ na wɔbɔɔ mu dzidzii.
Nna Netania ba Ismael, na mbarimba du a wɔka no ho no soɛree, na wɔdze afona twitwaa Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia, na wokum nyia Babilɔnhen hyɛɛ no ambrado wɔ asaase no do no.
Ismael so kunkum Jewfo a wɔnye Gedalia wɔ Mizpa nyina, na Kaldeafo a wohun hɔn wɔ hɔ no, mbarimba akofo no a.
Na ɔbaa dɛ oeku Gedalia ekyir ndaenu no a obiara nntsee no,

mbarimba bi eduowɔtwe fi Sekem, Siloh, na Samaria bae a woeyiyi hɔn abɔdwesa na woesunsuan hɔn ntar mu, na wɔatotow hɔnho akam, na edziban afɔr na nduhuam kitsakitsa hɔn nsamu, dɛ wɔdze reba EWURADZE fie.
Na Netania ba Ismael fiir edzi fii Mizpa kehyiaa hɔn kwan, ɔrokɔ nyina nna orusu: na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔnye hɔn hyiae no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mbra Ahikam ba Gedalia nkyɛn.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔbaa kurow no ne finimfin no, Netania ba Ismael, ɔnoara na mbarimba a wɔka no ho no kunkum hɔn, na wɔtoow hɔn guu mona no mu.
Na hɔn mu mbarimba du see dɛ, Mma nnku hɛn: na yɛwɔ edzidzidze suma haban mu, ewifua na atoko, na ngo, na ewo. Nna ogyaae, na oennku hɔn ammfora hɔn nuanom no.

Afei mona a Ismael toow hɔn a okunkum hɔn kaa Gedalia ho hɔn efun guu mu no, (ɔnoara nye dza ɔhen Asa tui wɔ Israelhen Baasha ho suro ntsi no) na Netania ba Ismael dze hɔn a wokunkum hɔn no hɔn efun hyɛɛ no ma.

Nna Ismael faa ɔman nkaa a wɔwɔ Mizpa no nyinara kɔr ndɔmmum, mekyerɛ ɔhen ne mbabaa no, na nkorɔfo a wɔkaa Mizpa aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan dze hyɛɛ Ahikam ba Gedalia n’ase no nyina Netania ba Ismael soaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree, na osii mu dɛ orukotwa mu akɔ Ammonmba no nkyɛn.
Na Karea ba Johanan, na dɔm asafohemfo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyina, wɔtsee mbusu nyina a Netania ba Ismael abɔ no,
nna wɔfaa mbarimba no nyina, na wɔkɔr dɛ wɔnye Netania ba Ismael rokɔko, na wɔkɔtoo no wɔ esu kɛse a ɔwɔ Gibeon no ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nkorɔfo nyina a wɔwɔ Ismael nkyɛn no hun Karea ba Johanan, na dɔm asafohemfo nyina a wɔka no ho no, hɔn enyi gyee.
Nna nkorɔfo a Ismael soaa hɔn ndɔmmum fii Mizpa kɔree no, wɔdandaan hɔnho, na wɔsensanee, na wɔkɔr Karea ba Johanan nkyɛn.
Na Netania ba Ismael nye mbarimba baawɔtwe fii Karea nsa kɔr Ammonmba no nkyɛn.

Nna Karea ba Johanan na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no nyina faa ɔman no nkaa no nyina a ɔkɛgyee hɔn fii Netania ba Ismael a okum Ahikam ba Gedalia wɔ Mizpa no nsamu no: mbarimba akofo, na mbaa, na mbofraba, na epiafo a ɔdze hɔn fi Gideon sanee bae no:
na wosii mu kɔree, na wɔkɛtsenaa Gerut Kimham a ɔwɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm no, dɛ wɔnkɛhɛn Egypt,
wɔ Kaldeafo no ntsi: osiandɛ wosuroo hɔn, wɔ dɛ Netania ba Ismael eku Ahikam ba Gedalia a Babilɔnhen hyɛɛ no ambrado wɔ asaase no do ntsi.
Nna dɔm no mu asafohen no nyinara na Karea ba Johanan, na Hosaia ba Jezania, na ɔman no nyinara, ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do, twee bɛnee,

bɛsee nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia dɛ, Yɛserɛ wo, ma hɛn nkotoserɛ yi nsɔ w’enyi na yi EWURADZE, wo Nyankopɔn mpaa ma hɛn, nkaa yi nyinara; na hɛn nye kakraabi a yɛaka wɔ pii no mu, dɛ mbrɛ w’enyiwa tua hɛn yi:
ama EWURADZE, wo Nyankopɔn aakyerɛ hɛn kwan kor a yɛnnantsew mu, na adze kor a yɛnyɛ.

Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia see hɔn dɛ, Matse hom asɛm: hwɛ, mibeyi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn mpaa dɛ mbrɛ hom aka yi; na ɔbɛba dɛ asɛm biara a EWURADZE dze bobua hom no, mebɛpaa mu aka akyerɛ hom; mirinnsiw hom biribiara do.
Nna wɔsee Jeremia dɛ, EWURADZE nyɛ nokwar dasefo turododo wɔ hɛn ntamu, sɛ yɛannyɛ dɛ mbrɛ asɛm nyina a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze bɔsoma wo wɔ hɛn nkyɛn no tse a.
Sɛ oye o, sɛ omuo o, yebetsie EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn a yɛasoma wo ne nkyɛn no ndze: ama sɛ yetsie EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ne ndze a oeesi hɛn yie.
Na ɔbaa dɛ dadu soe ekyir no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia hɔ.
Nna ɔfrɛɛ Karea ba Johanan, na dɔm no mu asafohen a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyina, na ɔman no nyinara, ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do,
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn a hom somaa me ne nkyɛn dɛ memfa hom nkotoserɛ nkɔto n’enyim no, ɔse nye yi:
Sɛ hom bɛda ho atsena asaase yi do a, ɔnodze mibesi hom, na murunndwuruw hom nngu famu, na matsɛw hom, na menntutu hom ase: na menu moho wɔ mbusu a mabɔ hom no ntsi.
Mma hom nnsuro Babilɔnhen a hom suro no no; mma hom nnsuro no, EWURADZE na ɔse: na mowɔ hom nkyɛn dɛ mebɛgye hom nkwa, na meyi hom efi ne nsamu.
Na mibenya mbɔbɔrhu ama hom, na oehu hom mbɔbɔr, na ɔama hom asan akɔ homankasa hom asaase do.
Na sɛ hom ka dɛ, Yɛrenntsena asaase yi do; ma dɛm no hom enntsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne ndze;
dɛ, Oho; na yɛbɔkɔ Egypt asaase do, mbrɛ yennkohu asayɛ, eso yɛnnkɛtse akasamu ne ndze, eso yennkedzi edzibankɔm; na yɛatsena hɔ a;
ɔnodze afei, Juda nkaasefo, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm: mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Sɛ hom dze si hom enyi do pɛpɛɛpɛ dɛ Egypt ara na hom bɔkɔ akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ a:
ɔnodze ɔbɛba dɛ, afona a hom suro no bɔto hom Egypt asaase do hɔ, na ɔkɔm a hom suro no betsiw hom dzendzenndzen wɔ Egypt hɔ; na hɔ na hom bowuwu.

Dɛm na ɔbɛyɛ hɔn mbarimba nyinara a wɔdze esi hɔn enyi do pɛpɛɛpɛ dɛ Egypt ara na wɔbɔkɔ akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ no nye yi; wobowuwu afona, na ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm ano: na hɔn mu biara rennka anaa oefi mbusu a medze bɛba hɔn do no mu.

Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Dɛ mbrɛ m’ebufuw na m’ebufuhyew ehue egu Jerusalɛm mba do no, dɛmara so na, sɛ ekɛhɛn Egypt a, m’ebufuhyew bohue egu hom do: na hom bɛyɛ ekyiwadze, na ahobowdze, na ndom, na ahorohoraadze; na hom nnkohu bea yi bio.
Juda nkaasefo, EWURADZE aka wɔ hom do dɛ, Mma hom nnkɔ Egypt: hom nhu no kotoo dɛ medzi hom dase ndɛ da yi.

Na hom adaadaa homankasa hom akra; osiandɛ hom somaa me EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne nkyɛn, dɛ, Yi EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn mpaa ma hɛn; na dza EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn bɛse nyina, dɛmara na ka kyerɛ hɛn, na yɛbɛyɛ:
na ndɛ da yi mapaa mu aka akyerɛ hom; na hom enntsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne ndze, wɔ dza ɔdze somaa me hom nkyɛn no mu biara mu.
Dɛm ntsi afei hom nhu no ampaara dɛ hom bowuwu afona, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm ano, wɔ bea a hom kɔn dɔ dɛ hom bɛyɛ hɔ amamforafo no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Jeremia kaa ɔman no nyina hɔn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ne nsɛm a hɔn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn dze somaa no hɔn nkyɛn no nyina wiei no, mekyerɛ nsɛm yi nyina no,
Hosaia ba Azaria, na Karea ba Johanan, na ahopɔwfo no nyina kasaa kyerɛɛ Jeremia, dɛ, Eka atorsɛm: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn no ɔnnsomaa wo dɛ bɛse dɛ, Mma hom nnkɔ Egypt nnkɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ;
na Neria ba Baruk na opiapia wo tsia hɛn, ma oeyi hɛn ahyɛ Kaldeafo nsa, ma woeekuku hɛn, na wɔaasoa hɛn ndɔmmum akɔ Babilɔn.
Na Karea ba Johanan, na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no nyina, na ɔman no nyina, woenntsie EWURADZE ne ndze dɛ wɔbɛtsena Juda asaase do.
Na Karea ba Johanan, na dɔm no mu asafohen no nyina wɔfaa Juda nkaase nyina a wɔasan efi amanaman a wɔpaam hɔn kɔr hɔ nyina mu abɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ Juda;
mbarimba, na mbaa, na mbofraba, na ɔhen ne mbabaa no, na nyimpa biara a aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan daan no gyaa Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia ne nkyɛn no, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia, na Neria ba Baruk;
na wɔbaa Egypt asaase do; na woenntsie EWURADZE ne ndze: na wɔbaa Tapanhes mpo.
Nna EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Jeremia nkyɛn wɔ Tapanhes, dɛ,
Fa abo akɛse wɔ wo nsamu, na fa hyehyɛ ntaayaa nsɛwee a ɔwɔ Farao fie abowano wɔ Tapanhes no mu, wɔ Juda mbarimba no enyim;

na se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hwɛ, mobɔsoma akɛfa Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar m’akowaa no, na medze n’akɔngua esi abo a medze ahyehyɛ ha yi do; na ɔaheran n’akatamanso do wɔ do.
Na ɔbɛba abɔbɔ Egypt asaase; hɔn a wɔsɛ owu no, wobowu, na hɔn a wɔsɛ ndɔmmum kɔ no, wɔakɔ ndɔmmum, na hɔn a wɔsɛ afona no, afona aka hɔn.
Na mobɔsɔ gya wɔ Egypt abosom efi mu, na ɔbɛhyew hɔn, na ɔasoa hɔn akɔ ndɔmmum: na ɔdze Egypt asaase bofura dɛ mbrɛ oguanhwɛfo dze n’atar hyɛ; na ofi hɔ befir edzi asomdwee mu.
Obobu Bɛt-semes a ɔwɔ Egypt asaase do no n’edum no; na ɔdze gya ahyew Egypt abosom efi no nyina.
Asɛm a ɔbaa Jeremia hɔ wɔ Jewfo nyina a wɔtse Egypt asaase do a wɔtsetse Migidɔl, na Tapanhes, na Nof, na Patros asaase do no ho, dɛ,
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hom ehu mbusu a medze maba Jerusalɛm do nyina, na Juda nkurow nyinara do; na, hwɛ, ndɛ da yi wɔayeyɛ amamfo, na nyimpa biara nntse do;
osian hɔn emumuyɛ a wɔayɛ dze eyi me ebufuw ntsi, wɔ dɛ wɔkɔree kɛhyeew nduhuam, na wɔkɔsoom abosom afofor a hom nnyim hɔn ntsi, hɔn o, hom o, hom egyanom o.
Naaso mosomaa mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara baa hom nkyɛn, mosoɛɛr ahema na mosomaa hɔn, dɛ, Ao, mma hom nnyɛ ekyiwadze a mikyir no.
Na woenntsie, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn aso adze dɛ wɔbɛsan efi hɔn emumuyɛ ho, dɛ wɔnnkɛhyew nduhuam ama abosom afofor.
Dɛm ntsi na m’ebufuhyew na m’ebufuw huei gui, na ɔdzɛwee wɔ Juda nkurow na Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu; ma ayeyɛ ekurofo na amamfo, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.

Dɛm ntsi afei mbrɛ EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bɔ mbusu yi tsia homankasa hom akra, dɛ hom botwitwa hom mu ɔbarimba na ɔbaa, abɔdomaba na enumfoanoba efi Juda mu, dɛ mma wonngyaa hom nkaa bi;

wɔ dɛ hom dze hom nsaano edwuma yi me ebufuw, dɛ hom rehyew nduhuam ama abosom afofor wɔ Egypt asaase a hom akɔ do akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ no do; ama woeekuruw hom ase, na hom aayɛ ndom na ahorohoraadze wɔ asaase do amanaman nyinara mu?
Ana hom werɛ efir hom egyanom emumuyɛ na Juda ahemfo emumuyɛ, na hɔn yernom emumuyɛ, homankasa hom emumuyɛ, na hom yernom emumuyɛ a wɔyɛɛ no Juda asaase do, na Jerusalɛm abrɔn no mu?
Wɔmmbrɛɛ hɔnho adze ara dze bodu ndɛ da yi mpo, eso wonnsuroi, eso wɔnnantseew me mbra, anaa m’ahyɛdze a medze mesi hom enyim, na hom egyanom enyim.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze m’enyi bɛsa hom do, ma aayɛ hom mbusu, mekyerɛ dɛ wobokuruw Juda nyinara ase.

Na mebɛfa Juda nkaase a wɔdze esi hɔn enyim dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Egypt asaase do akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ no, na hɔn nyinara wɔasa: Egypt asaase do na wɔbɔtotɔ; wɔbɛhyew wɔ afona na ɔkɔm ano; wobowuwu, ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do, wɔ afona na ɔkɔm ano: na wɔbɛyɛ ekyiwadze, na ahobowdze, na ndom, na ahorohoraa.
Na mebɛtsea hɔn a wɔtse Egypt asaase do no, dɛ mbrɛ medze afona, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm matsea Jerusalɛm no:
na Juda nkaase a wɔkɔ Egypt aakɛyɛ hɔ amamforafo, no mu obi rimmfi nsa anaaso ɔnnka, dɛ wɔbɛsan aba Juda asaase a hom enya akɔndɔ dɛ hom bɛtsena do: na obiara rennsan, gyedɛ hɔn a wobefi nsa no.

Nna mbarimba no a wonyim dɛ hɔn yernom hyeew eduhuam maa abosom afofor bi no, na mbaa a wogyinagyina nkyɛn no nyina, kuw kɛse pa a, mekyerɛ nkorɔfo a wɔtse Egypt asaase do, wɔ Patros no nyina, wobuaa Jeremia, dɛ,
Ɔfa asɛm a aka akyerɛ hɛn wɔ EWURADZE dzin mu no dze, yerinntsie wo.

Na mbom ɔyɛ ara na yɛbɛyɛ asɛm biara a oefi hɛn anomu efir, dɛ yɛbɛhyew eduhuam ama ɔsor ɔhembaa no, na yɛabɔ ɔnom afɔr ama no, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn na hɛn egyanom, hɛn ahemfo na mbapɔmba, yɛayɛ wɔ Juda nkurow mu, na Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu: na ber no na yenyaa edziban bafuu, na yedzii yie, na yeennhu mbusu biara.
Na ofitsi ber a yegyaa dɛ yɛhyew eduhuam ma ɔsor ɔhembaa, na yɛbɔ ɔnom afɔr ma no no, adze nyina abɔ hɛn, na yeewie sa wɔ afona na ɔkɔm ano.
Na yɛhyeew eduhuam maa ɔsor ɔhembaa, na yɛbɔɔ ɔnom afɔr maa no no, aso yɛyɛɛ tatar maa no dɛ yɛdze rosɔr no, na yekwetsir hɛn kunnom bɔɔ ɔnom afɔr maa no?
Nna Jeremia see ɔman no nyina, mbarimba, na mbaa, mekyerɛ nkorɔfo a wobuaa no no nyina, dɛ,
Eduhuam a hom na hom egyanom, hom ahemfo na hom mbapɔmba, na asaase no do nkorɔfo, hom hyewee wɔ Juda nkurow, na Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu no, aso EWURADZE annkaa, na ɔammba n’adwen mu a?
Ma dɛm no EWURADZE enntum annsɔw bio, osian hom emumuyɛ, na ekyiwadze a hom ayɛ no ntsi; dɛm ntsi na hom asaase adan amamfo, na ahobowdze, na ndom a obiara nnyi mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.

Osiandɛ hom ahyew eduhuam, na osiandɛ hom ayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE, na hom enntsie EWURADZE ne ndze, eso wɔannantsew ne mbra, na n’ahyɛdze, na n’adasesɛm do ntsi; dɛm ntsi na mbusu yi ato hom dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
Bio so Jeremia see ɔman no nyina, na mbaa no nyina dɛ, Juda a hom wɔ Egypt asaase do nyina, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm:

mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, dɛ: Hom na hom yernom dze hom ano aka, na hom dze hom nsa ahyɛ no ma, dɛ, Ɔba ara na yɛbɛma hɛn nsuaa a yesuae no aba mu, dɛ yɛbɛhyew eduhuam ama ɔsor ɔhembaa no, na yɛabɔ ɔnom afɔr ama no: hom mma hom nsuaa ntsim, na hom mma hom nsuaa mbra mu ɛ.

Dɛm ntsi hom Judafo a hom tse Egypt asaase do nyina, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm: Hwɛ, maka me dzin kɛse no ho ntam, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ wɔnnkɔbɔ me dzin bio wɔ Judanyi biara anomu wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do, dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn tse ase yi:
Hwɛ, moroweɔn hɔn wɔ mbusu ho, na nnyɛ papa a: na Juda mbarimba a wɔwɔ Egypt asaase do nyinara bɛhyew afona na ɔkɔm ano, dze ekodu dɛ woewie sa.
Na hɔn a wofi afona nsa no, wɔbɛsan efi Egypt asaase do, hɔn dodow kumaabi, na Juda nkaa a wɔkɔ Egypt asaase do akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ no nyina, wobohu nyia n’asɛm begyina, sɛ medze o, hɔndze o.
Na iyi bɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ama hom, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ mebɛtsea hom bea yi do ha, ama hom eehu dɛ me nsɛm begyina ara ampa ayɛ mbusu etsia hom:
mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze Egypthen Farao Hofra bɛhyɛ n’atamfo nsa; dɛ mbrɛ medze Judahen Zedekia mehyɛɛ ne tamfo, na nyia ɔhwehwɛɛ no nkwa, Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar no, ne nsa no.
Asɛm a nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia kaa kyerɛɛ Neria ba Baruk, ber a ɔkyerɛɛw nsɛm yi fii Jeremia anomu hyɛɛ nwoma mu wɔ Josia ba Jehoiakim n’afe a otsia anan no mu, dɛ,
Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ka kyerɛ ɔwo, Baruk, nye yi:
Eka dɛ, Afei mundue! Na EWURADZE dze awerɛhow aka me yaw ho; maberɛ na m’apensi, na minnya ahomgye biara.
Dɛm na ka kyerɛ no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, dza mesi no, mubodwuruw, na dza matsɛw no, metutu; na iyi besi asaase no nyinara do.
Na erohwehwɛ ndzɛmba akɛse ama woho anaa? Mma nnhwehwɛ: na, hwɛ, medze mbusu bɛba adasamba nyinara do, EWURADZE na ɔse: na medze mo nkwa bɛma wo ayɛ afonam wɔ mbea a erokɔ do nyinara do.
EWURADZE asɛm a ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia hɔ wɔ amanaman ho:
Egypt dze: wɔ Egypthen Farao Neko no dɔm a wɔwɔ esutsen Eufrates ho wɔ Karkemis a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar bɔɔ no wɔ Josia ba Jehoiakim, Judahen no, n’afe a otsia anan no mu no ho.
Hom nkra nkataenyim na kyɛm, na hom ntwe mbɛn akono.
Hom nhyehyɛ mpɔnkɔ no, na hom ntsenatsena do! Hom nsoa hom dadzekyɛw ngyinagyina hɔ; hom mpɔw hom mpeaa no ho, hom nhyehyɛ hom dadzentar.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na muhu dɛ hɔn bo etutu yi? Wɔadan hɔn ekyir; wɔabɔ hɔn akatakyi no egu, na woeguan ntsɛntsɛm. Wommbu hɔn kɔn ekyir: hu wɔ mbea nyina, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Ɔhoɔharfo nntum nnguan nnkɔ, eso ɔkatakyi mmfi nsa; kwaamu afamu esutsen Eufrates ho na woefintsiw na wɔahwehwe ase.
Woana na ɔasoɛr noho yi dɛ Nael a n’esu bu asorɛkye begyabegya dɛ nsutsen yi?
Egypt asoɛr dɛ Nael, dɛ nsutsen a n’esu rubu asorɛkye begyabegya: na ɔse, Mibeyir, mebɛkata asaase no do; mebɛsɛɛ kurow no na no mu mba no.
Mpɔnkɔ e, hom mbɔ mfa mu; na ntseaseanam e, hom mbɔ kyirdidi! Hom mma akatakyi mfir edzi: Kus na Put a wokurakura kyɛm; na Ludfo a wokurakura egyen, na wɔkontokontom no.

Na da no yɛ EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, ne da, awerdzi da a, ama oeedzi n’atamfo wer: na afona bedzidzi amee, na ɔanom hɔn bɔgyaa ɔabow: na EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, wɔ okum afɔr bi wɔ kwaa mu asaase do wɔ esutsen Eufrates ho.
Egypt ne babaa ɔbaabun e, fow kɔ Gilead kɛgye edur! Eyɛ edur pii kwa; ɔyarsa biara nnyi hɔ ma wo.
Amanaman atse w’enyimguase, na wo nkekamu ahyɛ asaase ma tɔ: na ɔkatakyi asoasoa ɔkatakyi do, hɔn beenu no abɔ mu ahwe ase.
Asɛm a EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia, mbrɛ Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar bɛba abɔbɔ Egypt asaase no.
Hom mpaa mu nka no Egypt, na hom mfa ntahye Migidɔl, hom ntahye no Nof na Tapanhes: hom nka dɛ, Gyina kan, na siesie woho; na afona no bedzidzi etwa wo ho ehyia.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’ahoɔdzenfo wɔapra hɔn kɔ yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’anantwi enngyina? Osiandɛ EWURADZE paam hɔn kɔree.
Ɔmaa pii fintsifintsiwii, nyew, wɔhwehwee ase dedaa hɔnho do: na wɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoɛr ma yɛnsan nkɔ hɛn nkorɔfo, na hɛn awobea no do hɔ, mfi afona a ɔrehyɛ hɛn no ano.
Wɔkekaa mu wɔ hɔ dɛ, Egypthen Farao yɛ dede ara kwa; ɔama hyɛber no etwa mu asen.
Metse ase yi, Ɔhen a ne dzin dze dɔm EWURADZE no na ɔse, ampaara mbrɛ Tabor tse wɔ mbepɔw mu, na mbrɛ Karmel tse wɔ po ho no, dɛmara na no so bɛba.
Ɔwo babaa a etse Egypt, siesie woho kɔ ndɔmmum mu: na Nof bɛdan amamfo, na wɔahyew a, obi renntsena do bio.
Egypt yɛ ɔnantwiber a no ho yɛ fɛw; na ɔsɛɛ fi kwaamu afamu aba no do.
N’apaafo so a wɔtse no mu no, wɔtse dɛ nantwibuw mu anantwimba; na hɔn so wɔadandan hɔnho na wɔabɔ mu eguanguan, woenngyina: osiandɛ hɔn mbusu da, hɔn sera ber no, aba hɔn do.
Ne ndze bɛgyegye dɛ ɔwɔ dze; osiandɛ n’atamfo nam reba, na wɔdze nkuma aba no do, dɛ nduatowfo.
Wobobu no kwaa, EWURADZE na ɔse, naaso worunntum nnhwehwɛ mu; osiandɛ wɔdɔɔ so sen mbɛbɛw, na wɔkan hɔn dodow a ɔnnyɛ.
Wɔbɛma Egypt babaa n’enyi ato; wobeyi no ahyɛ kwaa mu ɔman no nsa.
Dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse dɛ: Hwɛ mebɛtsea Amon a ɔwɔ No, na Farao, na Egypt ɔnye n’abosom, na n’ahemfo; mekyerɛ Farao na hɔn a wɔtwer no no:
na mibeyi hɔn mahyɛ hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nkwa no nsa, na Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar nsa, na n’akowaa nsa: na n’ekyir no wɔbɛtsena do dɛ tsetse nda no, EWURADZE na ɔse.

Na ɔwo m’akowaa Jakob, mma nnsuro, na Israel so, mma wo bo nntu: na, hwɛ, mebɛgye wo nkwa mefi ekyirekyir, na w’asefo efi ndɔmmum asaase do: na Jakob bɛsan, na ɔbɛtsena ase dwudwoodwo, na obiara remma onnsuro.

M’akowaa Jakob, mma nnsuro, EWURADZE na ɔse; na mowɔ wo nkyɛn: na mebɛma amanaman a mabɔ hɔn apetse do no woewie sa, naaso ɔwo dze, meremma innwie sa; na mbom mebɛtsea wo dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata, na meremma emmfa woho tɔtrɔtɔ ara da.
EWURADZE asɛm a ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia hɔ wɔ Filistiafo ho ansaana Farao robɔ Gaza.

Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, esu rema noho do efi kwaamu afamu, na ɔabɛyɛ ɔwora a oeyir, na ɔaseram asaase no na dza ɔwɔ mu nyina do, kurow no na hɔn a wɔtse mu do: na nyimpa bɛkeka mu, na hɔn a wɔtse asaase no do no nyina abɔ mbubuw.
Na mpɔnkɔ hɔn ntɔtse a osisi famu pipi no ne gyegye, ne ntseaseanam ne nkyirdidi, no nhwiir no kurduduyɛ ntsi, egyanom nndan hɔn enyi nnhwɛ hɔn mba wɔ hɔn nsa a agow ntsi;
osian da a ɔreba no ntsi, ɔreba abɛsɛɛ Filistiafo nyina, ebotwitwa Taere na Sidon ɔboafo a ɔaka biara efi hɔ: osiandɛ EWURADZE resɛɛ Filistiafo, Kaftor nsupruw mu hɔn a wɔaka no.
Etsipaa aba Gaza do; Ashkelon ataa dzinn na hɔn bɔnsa mu nkaa no asɛɛ pasaa: ebɔtotow woho akam ekesi dabɛn?
Ao, EWURADZE n’afona! Onkodu dabɛn ara na ayɛ komm? Fa woho kɛhyɛ wo bɔha mu; gye w’ahom, na taa dzinn.
Ibesi dɛn ayɛ komm, ber a EWURADZE dze asodzi bi ahyɛ wo nsa yi? Ashkelon, na mpoano hɔ na ɔahyɛ dɛ ɔmbra.
Moab dze, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Nebo ndue, osiandɛ wɔabɔ no! Woegu Kiriataim n’enyim ase, wɔagye: woegu aban dzendzen no n’enyim ase na wɔadwerew no.
Nkamfo nnyi hɔ bio mma Moab; woetu no ho egyina bɔn wɔ Hesbon dɛ, Hom mbra, ma yentwa no nkyen mma ɔaannyɛ ɔman bio. Madmen, ɔwo so wɔbɛma ayɛ foo; afona betsiw wo.
Nkekamu ndze fi Horonaim, afofa na ɔsɛɛ kɛse!
Wɔasɛɛ Moab; no nkɔkowaba rekeka mu.
Na Luhit afowee na wɔdze osu araa bɔfow akɔ sor; na Horonaim esianee na wɔatse ɔsɛɛ ne nkekamu ho mbubuwbɔ.
Hom nguanguan, hom ngye hom akra nkwa, na hom nyɛ dɛ sar do asoaso.
Na osiandɛ ɔwo atwer wo ndwuma na w’akoradze ntsi, wo so wɔbɛfa wo: na Kemos bɔkɔ ndɔmmum, n’asɔfoe na n’asafohen ka ho.
Na afofanyi no bɛba kurow biara do, na kurow biara rimmfi nsa; bɔnsa so bɛhera, na asaase taae asɛɛ; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka no.
Hom mma Moab nkaadum, na ɔsɛɛ ara na wɔbɛsɛɛ no: no nkurow bɛyɛ amamfo, na obiara nnkɛtsena mu.
Ndom nka nyia ɔyɛ EWURADZE n’edwuma akwadwer mu, na ndom nka nyia osianka n’afona fi bɔgya mu.

Moab atsena ase ahodwe mu fi ne mbofraber mu, na ɔagyen ataa n’ase dɛ wenyin, na wonnhuee no mmfii adze kor mu nnkɔr adze kor mu, eso ɔnnkɔr ndɔmmum da: dɛm ntsi na ne dɛw aka no mu, na no huam so nnsakyeree.
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, mobɔsoma hɔn a wohue gu ma wɔaaba no do, ma woeehue no egu, na wɔaabobɔ hɔn mbɔdambɔ no.
Na Moab n’enyi bɔto Kemos ho, dɛ mbrɛ Israel fifo hɔn enyi too hɔn awerɛhyɛmu Bɛtɛl ho no.
Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom se dɛ, Yɛyɛ akatakyi na akofo a yebotum ɔko no?
Nyia ɔbɔɔ Moab na no nkurow no afow kɔ mu, na ne mberantsɛ a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no esian kɔ ekumii, ɔhen a ne dzin dze dɔm EWURADZE no na ɔse.
Moab no mbusu abɛn reba, na n’amandzehu reba ntsɛntsɛm.
Hom a hom abɔ no ho aprɔw nyina, hom ngyam no, na hom a hom nyim ne dzin nyina; hom nse dɛ, Nhwɛ, mbrɛ poma a ɔyɛ dzen, na enyimnyam abaa no, edua ebu a!
Ɔwo babaa a etse Dibon, fi w’enyimnyam mu sian, na tsena nsukɔm mu, na nyia ɔfa Moab afo no aba wo do, ɔasɛɛ w’aban dzendzen no.
Hom a hom tse Aroer e, kegyina akwan nkyɛn, na tsɛw: bisa nyia oruguan, na nyia oefi nsa no; se dɛ, Wɔyɛ no dɛn?
Woegu Moab n’enyim ase; osiandɛ woedwuruw no egu famu: hom mbɔ mbubuw na hom nkekamu; hom nka wɔ Arnon dɛ, Moab abɔ.
Na atsɛmbu aba asaase taae no do; ɔaba Holon, Jahza, Mefaat;
Dibon, Nebo, Bɛt-diblathaim;
Kiriataim, Bɛt-gamul, Bɛt-meon;
Keriot, na Bozra, na Moab asaase do nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir, na dza wɔbɛn nyina do.
Woetwa Moab n’ambɛn, na woebu n’abasa, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hom mma ɔmbow nsa; osiandɛ okunkoon noho wɔ EWURADZE do: na Moab bɛyankayankam ne fe mu, na ɔno so wɔdze no esi atwetwe.
Na aso Israel annyɛ atwetwe amma wo? Aso wohun no ewifo mu? Na ɔwo eka no ho asɛm ara apem a, ewosow wo tsir.
Ao Moab mba e, hom ndan nkurow no ngya, na hom ntsena abotan do. Hom nyɛ dɛ ebubur a ɔyɛ no buw wɔ itu no ano no.
Yɛatse Moab n’ahokyerɛ, dɛ ɔkyerɛ no ho dodow; n’ahomemado, na no nkontompɔ, na n’ahopɔw, na n’akoma ne ntsɛn.
Minyim n’enyiansɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ ne nyinara gyan; n’ahohyehyɛ enntum hwee yɛ.
Dɛm ntsi nna mobɔ Moab ho mbubuw; nyew, mebɛkeka mu wɔ Moab nyina ho: na Kir-heres mbarimba ntsi wobedzi nkɔmbɔ.
Ao Sibma wenyindua, medze dza ɔkyɛn Jazer no su na mubosu wo: w’abaw atra po ekodu Jazer po ho mpo: wo hyewber nduadzewa na wo wenyin nduadzewa do na ɔsɛɛfo no ebotu ahyɛ.
Na woeyi enyigye na dɛw efi mfuwa prɔmprɔm na Moab asaase no do; na mama wenyin asa wɔ wenyinntwer no mu: obiara mmfa esebɔ ntsiatsia do; esebɔ no rennyɛ enyigye esebɔ bi.
Ofi Hesbon nkekamu no do dze kesi Eleale mpo, dze kesi Jahaz mpo, na wɔama hɔn ndze do, ofi Zoar dze kesi Horonaim mpo, dze kesi Eglath-selisiya: na Nimrim esuesu bɛdan asaase kɛsɛɛ.
Bio so mebɛma nyia ɔbɔ afɔr wɔ no mu sorɔnsorɔmbea, na nyia ɔhyew nduhuam ma n’abosom no abɔ adze wɔ Moab.
Dɛm ntsi m’akoma gyegye ma Moab dɛ atɛntɛbɛn, na m’akoma gyegye dɛ atɛntɛbɛn ma Kir-heres mbarimba: dɛm ntsi adze pii a woenya no ahera.
Ne tsir nyina apepa, na n’abɔdwesa nyina ekukuw: nsa nyina ho ayɛ akam akam, na eyitam sisi asen.
Moab adan nyina etsifi na n’abrɔn do sukwadwom wɔ mbea nyina: na mabɔ Moab dɛ senaba a enyigye nnyi mu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Mbrɛ woesi edwuruw no a! Mbrɛ wodua bɔ mbubuw a! Mbrɛ Moab edua dze enyito adan n’ekyir a! Dɛm na Moab bɛyɛ atwetwesi na akomatu ama hɔn a wɔabɔ no ho aprɔw nyina.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, obotu dɛ ɔkɔr, na ɔatserɛw ne ntsaban mu aba Moab do.
Keriot wɔagye, na wɔakɔ n’akoban no ntuae. Da no mu, Moab mbarimba akatakyi hɔn akoma bɛyɛ dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo n’akoma.
Na wɔbɛsɛɛ Moab ma ɔrennyɛ ɔman bio, osiandɛ oekunkon noho wɔ EWURADZE do.
Moab mba e, suro, na mona, na efir, aba wo do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Nyia obefi suro enyim eguan no ɔbɔkɔtɔ mona no mu; na nyia ɔbɔfow efi mona no mu no, efir no bɛpa no: osiandɛ medze asotwe bɛba ɔno noara Moab no do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hɔn a woguanee a wonnyi ahoɔdzen no gyinagyina Hesbon nwinwin ase: na gya fir Hesbon efir edzi, na gyaframee fi Sihon ne finimfin, na ɔahyew Moab no kutuwdo, na weɔɔweɔɔyɛfo no hɔn etsifi pampamu.
Moab, due! Kemos man abɔ: na wɔafa wo mbabanyin no ndɔmmum, na wɔdze wo mbabaa kɔ ndɔmmumkɔ.
Naaso medze Moab befi ndɔmmum asan aba wɔ nda a odzi ekyir no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse. Iyi nye Moab do atsɛmbu.
Dza ɔfa Ammonmba ho. Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Aso Israel nnyi mbabanyin? Aso onnyi owuodzi? Afei ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Malkam enya Gad, na no nkorɔfo tsenatsena no nkurow mu yi?

Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, mebɛma wɔatse ɔko na esebɔ ndze etsia Rabaa a ɔyɛ Ammonmba dze no; na ɔbɛdan amamfo isiw, na wɔdze ogya ahyew ne mbabaa; nna Israel bɛpam hɔn a wɔpaam no no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hesbon e, bɔ mbubuw, na Ai asɛɛ! Rabaa mbabaa, hom nkeka mu, hom mfura eyitam: hom ntwa sukwadwom, na hom ndzi akɔnaaba wɔ mban mu; na Milkɔm bɔkɔ ndɔmmum, n’asɔfoe na n’asafohemfo nyina.
Ɔbabaa ekyirsannyi, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ehyehyɛ woho wɔ w’ahoɔdzen mu, w’ahoɔdzen a ɔrokɔ famu no mu? Ɔwo a edze wo werɛ hyɛɛ w’egyapadze mu, dɛ, Woana bɛba mo do?
Hwɛ, medze hu fi hɔn a woetwa wo ho ehyia nyina nkyɛn mebɛba wo do, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse; na wɔbɔbɔ hom apetse, hom mu nyimpa biara akɔ n’enyim, a obiara nnkɔboaboa eguamfo no ano.
Na n’ekyir no medze Ammonmba no befi ndɔmmum asan aba, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Edom dze. Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Aso nyansa nnyi Teman bio? Aso apam ahera abadwembafo? Aso hɔn nyansaa etu ayew?
Hom nguan, hom nsan ekyir, hom ntsena mbrɛ ɔdɔ, Ao Dedanfo! Na medze Esau no mbusu mebɛba no do ber a medze n’asotwe bɛba no do no!
Sɛ wenyin abatsewfo mpo na wɔbaa wo do a, aso nkyɛ wonnkegya wenyinaba mpɛpɛw bi? Sɛ ewifo baa anadwe a, nkyɛ hɔn mpo wɔnnkɛsɛɛ ara ekodu dza ɔbɔso hɔn?
Naaso emi dze, mama Esau no ho ada hɔ, mama no sumabea ada edzi; na orunntum nnsuma noho. N’asefo asɛɛ, na no nuanom, na n’efisamenafo, na onnyi hɔ.
Dan wo ngyanka mba no gya, mobɔkora hɔn do enyikan; na ma w’ekunafo mfa hɔn werɛ ntwer me.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, sɛ hɔn a wɔmmfata dɛ wɔbɔnom kɔɔpow no mu no mpo wɔbɔnom ara ampa a; nna aso ɔwo na ebɛfa woho edzi sɔnn? Ennkɛfa woho edzi sɔnn, na ɔnom ara na ebɔnom.
Na maka moho ntam, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ Bozra bɛdan ahobowdze, atwetwesidze, amamfo, na ndom, na no nkurow nyinara bɛyɛ amamfo daa.
Matse amandzɛɛ bi wɔ EWURADZE nkyɛn, na wɔasoma ahembɔfo wɔ amanaman mu, dɛ, Hom mboa hom ano, na hom mbra no do, na hom nsoɛr mbra akono.
Na, hwɛ, mebɛyɛ wo amanaman mu aketseaba, na adasa mu nyia woebu no enyimtsia.

Na w’etsiɔdzendze, w’akoma ne ntsɛn adaadaa wo, ɔwo a etse ɔbotan ne mpaapaae mu, ɔwo a akoko a ɔkrɔn kitsa wo nsamu: kaansa eyɛ wo buw wɔ ɔsorsor dɛ ɔkɔr mpo a, medze wo befi hɔ esi famu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na Edom bɛdan ahobowdze: obiara a otwa mu wɔ ho no no ho bɔbow no, na ɔabɔ no mu ayardɔm nyina ho nhwiroma.
Dɛ mbrɛ Sodom na Gomora na nkurow a wɔdeda ho no hɔn mbutuwii tse no, EWURADZE na ɔse, dasanyi biara renntsena hɔ, eso ɔdasanyi ne ba biara rennyɛ ɔmamforanyi wɔ hɔ.

Hwɛ, ɔbɔfow aba dɛ gyata fi Jordan ne ntsɛn no mu aba tsenabea a ɔyɛ dzen no do: na mebɛma oefi ne nkyɛn eguan awerɛfir mu; na obiara a wɔsan mu yi no no, ɔnoara na medze no besi no do: na woana na ɔtse dɛ emi? Woana bɛhyɛ me ber? Woana nye oguanhwɛfo a obotum m’enyim gyina?

Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie EWURADZE n’apam a ɔrepam wɔ Edom ho; na ne tsirmpɔw a ɔabɔ wɔ Teman atsefo ho: Ampaara, wobotwuw hɔn adze akɔ dɛ nguankuw mu nkakraba mpo; ampaara ɔbɛma hɔn tsenabea ayɛ amamfo aka hɔn ho.
Hɔn asehwe ne dede ntsi, asaase no popo; nkekamu heei wɔ hɔ a wɔtse ne nka wɔ Mbɛw Po no ho.
Hwɛ, ɔbɔfow aba na oetu dɛ ɔkɔr, na ɔatserɛw ne ntsaban mu wɔ Bozra do: na da no Edom mbarimba akatakyi hɔn akoma bɛyɛ dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo n’akoma.
Damaskɔs dze. Hamat n’enyi ato, na Arpad; osiandɛ wɔatse nsɛmbɔn, suro ekitsa hɔn: po do ayɛ begyabegya; wonntum nntaa dzinn.
Damaskɔs ayɛ mberɛw, ɔadan noho ruguan, na ahopopo ekitsa no: ahoguan na awerɛhow ekitsa no, dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo.
Ayɛyi kurow no, m’enyigye kurow no, mbrɛ oesi adan no egya?
Dɛm ntsi ne mberantsɛ bɔtotɔ wɔ n’abrɔn no mu, na woetwitwa n’asambarimba nyinara egu wɔ da no mu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na mobɔsɔ gya wɔ Damaskɔs fasu no mu, na ɔahyew Ben-hadad n’ahemfi no.
Kedar, na Hazor n’ahenman a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar bɔɔ no no ho dze. Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hom nsoɛr, hom nkɔ Kedar, na hom nkɛsɛɛ bokamba no.
Hom mfa hɔn asesee na hɔn nguankuw; hom nsoa hɔn ntwamuatam, na hɔn ndzepa, na hɔn efumpɔnkɔ mma hom ho: na hom ntseatsea mu dɛ, Hu etwa hɛnho nyina ehyia.
Ao Hazormba e, hom nguan, hom nkyin nkɔ ekyirekyir, hom nkosuma mbrɛ hɔ dɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse. Osiandɛ Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar akɔ hom tsir do apam na ɔabɔ hom ho tsirmpɔw bi.
Hom nsoɛr, hom nsoɛr nkɔ ɔman a hɔn ho adwe hɔn a wɔtse hɔ dwudwoodwo no do, EWURADZE na ɔse; hɔn a wonnyi mbobotsen na adaban a hɔn nko ara na wɔtse no.
Na hɔn efumpɔnkɔ bɛyɛ asadze, na hɔn anantwi dodow ayɛ afonam: na mobɔbɔ hɔn a woetwitwa ntakuwa no ma apetse mframa nyina mu; na medze hɔn mbusu befi mbea nyina aba hɔn do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na Hazor bɛyɛ mpataku tsenabea, amamfo daa: ɔdasanyi biara renntsena hɔ, eso ɔdasanyi ne ba biara rennyɛ ɔhɔho wɔ mu.
Iyi nye EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia hɔ wɔ Elam ho wɔ Judahen Zedekia n’ahendzi ahyɛse no.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, mubobubu Elam egyen, hɔn tum ne tsitsir mu.
Na medze mframa anan mibefi ɔsor mfɛndzanan maba Elam do, na mabɔ hɔn apetse mframa anan no mu nyinara; na ɔman biara nnyi hɔ a Elam tokyemfo no wonnkodu hɔ.

Na mebɛma Elam hɔn akoma etu hɔn atamfo, na hɔn a wɔrohwehwɛ hɔn nkwa no enyim: na medze mbusu mebɛba hɔn do, mekyerɛ m’ebufuw hyeehyew no a, EWURADZE na ɔse; na mebɛma afona etsiw hɔn ekodu dɛ mewie hɔn sa:
na medze m’ahengua mibesi Elam, na masɛɛ ɔhen na mbapɔmba mefi hɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ nda a odzi ekyir no mu no, medze Elam befi ndɔmmum asan aba, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Asɛm a EWURADZE nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia do kaa tsiaa Babilɔn wɔ Kaldeafo asaase ho no.

Hom mpaa mu nka wɔ amanaman mu na hom mfa ntahye, na hom nsi frankaa; hom mfa ntahye, na mma hom nnsiw do: hom nse dɛ, Wɔafa Babilɔn, woegu Bel n’enyim ase, Merodak no bo etu; woegu n’ehonyi enyim ase, n’abosom akoma etutu.
Na ɔman bi fii kwaamu afamu rutu no do ɔsa a wɔbɛma n’asaase ayɛ amamfo, na obiara renntsena do: woeguanguan, wɔkɔ, nyimpa na mbowa nyina.
Nda no mu na aber no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse, Israelmba bɛba, hɔn na Judamba nyina; wɔdze osu botu hɔn kwan wɔakɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn.
Wɔbɛdan hɔn enyim akyerɛ Zion do, woebisa ekyir kwan, dɛ, Hom mbra mfa homho mbɔbɔ EWURADZE ho, wɔ daa ahyɛmudzi a werɛ rimmfir no mu.
Me man ayɛ nguan a wɔayew: hɔn nguanhwɛfo ama wɔatotɔ gon, na wɔama wɔafomfom kwan wɔ mbepɔw no do: woefi bepɔw do kɔ koko do, hɔn werɛ efir hɔn ahomgyebea.
Hɔn a wɔtoo hɔn nyina amemen hɔn: na hɔn atamfo see dɛ, Yɛmmfom, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE, pɛrpɛr tsenabea, mekyerɛ EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom enyidado no.
Hom nguan mfi Babilɔn finimfin, na hom mfir edzi mfi Kaldeafo asaase do nkɔ, na hom nyɛ dɛ mpɔnkyenyin a wodzi nguankuw enyim.

Na, hwɛ, mibekenyan amanaman akɛse mboanofo ma wofi kwaamu afamu asaase do aba Babilɔn do; na wobotwa no ho mpasuar; na nkyii wɔbɛfa kurow no: hɔn egyen menaba tse dɛ ɔbarimba katakyi nedze; no mu biara nnsan ekyir kwa.
Na Kaldea bɛyɛ afonam: hɔn a wɔfa no afo nyinara bɛmee, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hom a hom foom m’egyapadze fae, kaansa hom enyi agye, na hom ridzi ehurusi, kaansa hom adodɔ seradze dɛ nantwifɔr a ɔroporow eburow, na hom su dɛ mpɔnkɔ abran mpo a;
hom na n’enyi bɔto papaara; nyia ɔwoo hom no n’enyim bogu ase. Hwɛ, ɔbɛyɛ amanaman mu ekyirkafo, sar, asaase kɛsɛɛ, na sar pradada.
Osian EWURADZE n’ebufuw ntsi wɔrenntsena do, na ɔbɛyɛ amamfo koraa: obiara a otwa mu wɔ Babilɔn no no ho bɔbow no, na ɔabɔ nhwiroma wɔ n’amandzehu nyinara ntsi.
Hom a hom kontom egyen nyinara, hom mbaa mpasuar ntwa nhyia Babilɔn ho; hom ntotow mbobɔ no, mma hom nnkam hom egyen menaba do: na ɔayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE.
Hom mbɔ ose ngu no do ntwa nhyia; ɔdze noho ama; n’aban ahwehwe ase, n’afasu edwuruw; na EWURADZE n’awerdzi nye no; hom ndzi no wer; dɛ mbrɛ ɔayɛ no, hom so nyɛ no bi.

Hom ntwa duafo no mfi Babilɔn, na nyia osuo kantankrankye no mu wɔ twaber mu no: ahyɛdo afona no ho suro ntsi, hɔn mu biara bɛdan noho akɔ no nkorɔfo hɔ, na hɔn mu obiara eguan akɔ nankasa n’asaase do.
Israel yɛ nguantsen a wɔabɔ apetse; ngyata no apam no kɔ; asɔpɔn no Asiriahen bɛtsetseew no mu; na ekyirii Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar yi bobubuu ne mbiew mu.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛtsea Babilɔnhen na n’asaase, dɛ mbrɛ matsea Asiriahen yi.
Na medze Israel bɛsan aba n’edzidzibea, na oedzidzi wɔ Karmel na Basan, na ne kra amee wɔ Efraim akoko do na Gilead.
Nda no mu, na aber no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔbɔhwehwɛ Israel emumuyɛ ekyir kwan, na worinnya bi; na Juda no bɔn so, na wonnkohu: na medze befir hɔn a mebɛdan hɔn megya dɛ nkaasefo no.
Tu Merataim asaase no do sa, ɔnoara no do a, na Pekod atsefo no do: kuku na sɛɛ nkaasefo no korakora, EWURADZE na ɔse, na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo nyinara.
Ɔko ne dede gyegye asaase no do, na ɔsɛɛ kɛse so dze.
Mbrɛ woetwitwa na woebubu asaase nyina hamɛr no mu esinesin a! Mbrɛ Babilɔn edua adan amamfo wɔ amanaman mu a!
Babilɔn, mesua wo efir na wɔapa wo so, na ɔwoara ennhu: woehu wo, na wɔakyer wo so, osiandɛ enye EWURADZE edzi aperper.
EWURADZE ebua n’akoradze dan na woeyi n’ebufuhyew akodze epue: osiandɛ EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, wɔ dwuma bi dzi wɔ Kaldeafo asaase do.
Hom mfir mfɛndzanan mbra no do, hom mbuebue n’eburosan no: hom ntutu no ngu dɛ efiefi, na hom nsɛɛ no huntuhuntu: mma hom mma no mu biribi nnka.
Hom nkuku n’anantwinyin nyina; hom mma wɔnsan nkɔ ekumii. Wondue! Osiandɛ hɔn da edu, hɔn asotweber no a.
Hom ntsie hɔn a woguan na wofi nsa fi Babilɔn asaase do, dɛ wɔrekɛpaa mu aka EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn n’awerdzi, n’asɔrfi ho awerdzi akyerɛ no hɔn ndze.

Hom mfrɛ egyentofo no nyinara nkɔtoatoa Babilɔn, hɔn a wɔkontom egyen no nyinara; hom mbɔ nseraban ntwa no ho nhyia; mma hom mma no mu obiara mmfi nsa: hom nsusu n’edwuma do nhyɛ no ananmu; dɛ mbrɛ ɔno ɔayɛ nyinara no, hom so nyɛ no bi: osiandɛ ɔayɛ EWURADZE no do nkontompɔ, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no do a.
Dɛm ntsi na ne mberantsɛ bɔtotɔ n’abrɔn do, na wɔbɛma ne mbarimba akofo nyinara wɔayɛ foo wɔ da no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hwɛ, ɔwo ɔkontompɔnyi, menye wo enya, EWURADZE, dɔm Ewuradze no na ɔse: osiandɛ wo da no edu, ber a medze bɔtwe w’aso no a.
Na ɔkontompɔnyi no befintsiw na ɔahwe ase, na obiara remma no do: na mubokua gya wɔ no kurow no mu, na ɔahyew dza abɔ no ho aprɔw nyinara.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: wɔatseetsee Israelmba na Juda prɛko: na hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum nyina dzedze hɔn mu dzen; wɔpow dɛ wɔbɛma wɔakɔ.
Hɔn pomfo yɛ dzen; ne dzin dze dɔm EWURADZE: obedzi hɔn asɛm kofekofe ama hɔn, na ɔama asaase no ahomgye, na ɔahyɛ Babilɔnfo no ahomtsew.
Afona wɔ Kaldeafo do, EWURADZE na ɔse, na Babilɔnfo no do, na n’asafohen na n’enyansafo no do.
Afona wɔ ahohyehyɛfo no do, na wɔbɛyɛ akwasampafo! Afona wɔ hɔn mbarimba akatakyi no do, na hɔn akoma botutu.
Afona wɔ hɔn mpɔnkɔ na hɔn ntseaseanam do, na aforaforafo a wɔwɔ no mu no nyina do, ama wɔaayɛ dɛ mbaa: afona wɔ n’akoradze do, ama woeewia.
Weseeyɛ wɔ n’esu do, na wɔbɔwewew: osiandɛ ɔyɛ ehonyi a woesian asaase, na wɔabobɔ adam wɔ abosom ho.
Dɛm ntsi sar do mbowa abɔyafo wɔnye mpataku bɛtsena wɔ hɔ, na nsohor bɛtsena mu: na wɔrenntsena do bio dabiarada; eso wɔrenntsena do bio ofi ebusuasantsen kɛpem ebusuasantsen.
Dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn butuuw Sodom na Gomora na hɔn ho nkurow no, EWURADZE na ɔse; dɛmara so na nyimpa biara renntsena hɔ, eso nyimpa biara rennyɛ ɔmamforanyi wɔ hɔ.
Hwɛ, ɔman bi fi kwaamu afamu reba; na wobekenyan ɔman kɛse, na ahemfo pii efi asaase ne mfɛndzanan noho.
Wokurakura egyen na peaa; hɔn tsir yɛ dzen, na wonnyi ehumbɔbɔr; hɔn ndze wor dɛ po, na wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do; obiara etwa mpasuar, dɛ ɔbarimba a ɔrokɔ akono wɔ wo do, Ao Babilɔn babaa!
Babilɔnhen atse hɔn nka, na n’abaw egura: nketsenketse akyer no, na yaw a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔwɔ awoko mu.

Hwɛ, ɔbɔfow dɛ gyata fi Jordan ne ntsɛn no mu abɛtsena bea a ɔyɛ dzen no do, na mebɛma woeguan efi me nkyɛn awerɛfir mu; na obiara a wɔasan mu eyi no no, ɔno na medze no besi no do: na woana na ɔtse dɛ emi? Woana na ɔbɛhyɛ me mber? Woana nye oguanhwɛfo no a obegyina m’enyim no?

Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie EWURADZE n’apam a ɔapam etsia Babilɔn no; na ne tsirmpɔw a ɔabɔ etsia Kaldeafo asaase no: Ampaara wobotwuw hɔn adze akɔ, mekyerɛ nguankuw mu nkakraba no; ampaara ɔbɛma hɔn tsenabea ayɛ amamfo ama hɔn.
Babilɔn ne gye ne dede ntsi, asaase wosow, na wɔtse nkekamu no wɔ amanaman mu.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, mobɔbɔ ɔsɛɛ mframa aba Babilɔn do, na hɔn a wɔtse Leb-kamai do.
Na mobɔsoma ahɔho akɔ Babilɔn, na woekohuw no. Wɔbɔto n’asaase no pan: na ɔfona da no mu wobotwa no ho ehyia etsia no.
Mma egyentonyi no nnkontom n’egyen, na mma ɔmmema noho do wɔ ne dadzetar no mu: na mma hom nngyaa ne mberantsɛ no; hom nsɛɛ no dɔm nyinara huntuhuntu.
Na wɔbɔtotɔ ahwehwe ase wɔ Kaldeafo asaase do, na woeehwirahwira hɔn mu wɔ n’abrɔn mu.
Na Israel anaa Juda hɔn Nyankopɔn, dɔm EWURADZE no, ɔnndaan hɔn nngyaae; kaansa afɔdzi ahyɛ hɔn asaase do ma etsia Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no mpo a.
Hom nguan mfi Babilɔn mu, na nyimpa biara ngye noho nkwa; mma wonntwa hom nkyen wɔ n’emumuyɛ mu; na EWURADZE n’awerdziber nye no; obotua no n’ahyɛnanmu kaw no.
Nna Babilɔn yɛ sika kɔɔpow wɔ EWURADZE nsamu a ɔmaa asaase nyinara bowee: amanaman anom ne nsa bi; dɛm ntsi na amanaman abobɔ adam.
Babilɔn ahwe ase awerɛfir mu asɛɛ: hom ntwa ewuo mma no; hom mfa ne yaw n’ano edur mbra, bi a wɔsa no yarba a ɔbɛyɛ yie.
Nkyɛ yɛresa Babilɔn yarba, naaso annsa. Hom ndan no ngya, na hom mma hɛn mu biara nkɔ nankasa no kurow mu: osiandɛ n’atsɛmbu edu ɔsor, na wɔama do ekodu wimu wimu mpo.
EWURADZE eyi hɛn tsenenee edzi: hom mbra, ma yɛnkɛka EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn n’edwuma nkyerɛ wɔ Zion.
Hom nsew egyen menaba no ano; hom nsuo akokyɛm no mu dzen: EWURADZE ekenyan Media ahemfo hɔn sunsum; osiandɛ wɔabɔ Babilɔn ho tsirmpɔw dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no: na EWURADZE n’awerdzi, n’asɔrfi ho awerdzi nye no.
Hom nsi frankaa ntsia Babilɔn afasu, hom mma aweɔn mu nyɛ dzen, hom mfa aweɔmfo nsisi, hom nsiesie atsɛwfo: na EWURADZE ahyehyɛ wɔ ne tsirmu, na eso ɔayɛ dza ɔkae wɔ Babilɔnfo ho no.
Ao ɔwo a etse esu pii do, w’akoradze dɔɔ so, w’ewiei aba, w’enyikaber esusudze no a.
Dɔm EWURADZE aka noho ntam, dɛ, Ampaara medze nyimpa mebɛhyɛ wo ma, dɛ mbɛbɛw; na wɔabɔ wo do ose.
Ɔno na ɔdze no tum ayɛ asaase, ɔno na ɔdze ne nyansaa etsintsim wiadze, na ɔdze ne ntseasee atserɛw ɔsorsor mu.
Sɛ ɔbɔ ne ndze mu a, esu no weɔɔyɛ ba ɔsorsor, na ɔma ehubɔhubɔw tu fi asaase ano fa sor; ɔno na ɔyɛ enyinam na nyankom, na ɔdze mframa fi n’adzekorabea ba.
Nyimpa biara abɛyɛ dɛ abowa na onnyim dze; osikadwinnyi biara ne sianhonyi hyɛ no enyito: na no guhonyi yɛ ator, na ahom biara nnyi hɔn mu.
Wɔyɛ egyangyandze, ndaadaa dwuma a: hɔn asotweber mu wɔbɛhera.
Jakob ne kyɛfa nntse dɛ iyinom; na ɔno nye adze nyinara ne yɛfo; na Israel nye n’egyapadze ebusuakuw; dɔm EWURADZE nye ne dzin.
Ɔwo nye m’ekuma na m’akondadze; ɔwo na medze mubobubu amanaman mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mebɛsɛɛ ahendzi;
na medze ɔwo mubobubu pɔnkɔ na nyia ɔtse no do no mu esinesin;

na medze ɔwo mubobubu tseaseanam na nyia ɔtse mu no mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu ɔbanyin na ɔbaa mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu akɔdaa na abofra mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu aberantsɛ na ababaawa no mu esinesin;
na medze ɔwo mubobubu oguanhwɛfo na no nguankuw no mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu ɔnantwi na ne mpamho no mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu ambradofo na amampanyin no mu esinesin.
Na mubotua Babilɔn na Kaldeafo no nyinara kaw wɔ hɔn mbusu a wɔabɔ no hom enyim wɔ Zion no nyinara ho, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hwɛ, menye wo enya, bepɔw sɛɛfo, EWURADZE na ɔse, ɔwo esɛɛ asaase nyinara: na mebɛtsen me nsa wɔ wo do, na mepirepirew wo mefi abotan no do, na mayɛ wo bepɔw hyewee.
Na wɔremmfa wo mu ɔbo bi nnto kutuwdo, anaa ɔbo bi nnto fapem; na ebɛyɛ amamfo daa, EWURADZE na ɔse.

Hom nsi frankaa wɔ asaase no do, hom nhɛn akasamu no wɔ amanaman mu, hom nsiesie amanaman nkyer no ho sa, hom nhyia Ararat, Minni, na Askenaz ahendzi nyinara mbra no do; hom nhyɛ ɔsahen mbra no do; hom mfa mpɔnkɔ mbra dɛ mbɛbɛw wirikyee.
Hom nsiesie amanaman ntu no do ɔsa, Media ahemfo hɔn ambradofo, na hɔn amampanyin nyinara, na no tumdzi asaase no nyinara.
Na asaase no ho popo na ɔtseetsee: osiandɛ EWURADZE ne tsirmpɔw a ɔwɔ Babilɔn do no osi pi, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ Babilɔn amamfo a obiara nnyi mu.
Babilɔn akatakyi no woegyaa ko, wɔaka hɔn akoban no mu; hɔn ahoɔdzen apa; wɔayɛ dɛ mbasiafo; wɔato ne tsenabea mu ogya; woebubu n’adaban mu.
Mbirikatufo baako botu mbirika ekehyia ɔbaako so, na ɔbɔfo baako ekehyia ɔbaako so akɔbɔ amandzɛɛ akyerɛ Babilɔnhen dɛ wɔagye no kurow no wɔ mbea nyinara:
na wɔagye etwae no, na wɔdze ogya ahyew ndzɛmbir no, na mbarimba akofo no bo etutu.
Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Babilɔn babaa tse dɛ ewuporoweebea ber a wotsiatsia do no; aka mber kakra, ma twaber edu ama no.
Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar awe me, ɔadwerew me, ɔayɛ me dɛ kyɛnse pan, ɔamen me dɛ nsu mu abowapɔn ɔdze m’akɔndɔdze ahyɛ ne yafun ma; oepuw me egu.
Nyia a ɔtse Zion bɛka dɛ, Etsirmɔdzendze a wɔdze ayɛ emi na mo honam no ɔmbra Babilɔn do; na Jerusalɛm bɛka dɛ, Mo bɔgyaa ngu Kaldeafo do.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, mibedzi w’asɛm ama wo, na medzi wer ama wo; na mobɔwew no po, na mama no nsunyiwa ayɛ wesee.
Na Babilɔn bɛdan amamfo, mpataku tsenabea, ahobowdze, na asesardze a obiara nntse mu.
Hɔn nyinara bɔbobɔ mu awor dɛ ngyatafɔr; wɔbɔpɔw dɛ ngyatamba.
Sɛ hɔn ho hyehye hɔn a, mobɔto hɔn pon, na mama wɔabobow, na woedzi ehurusi, na wɔada daa nda prɛko, na wonnkenyan, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Medze hɔn besian dɛ nguambaa akɔ ekumii, dɛ nguannyin ɔnye mpɔnkyenyin.
Mbrɛ woedua agye Sesak a! Mbrɛ asaase nyina ayɛyi no wɔafa no mprase a! Mbrɛ Babilɔn edua adan amamfo wɔ amanaman mu a!
Po abɛseram Babilɔn do: n’asorɛkye dodow akɛtaa no do.
No nkurow adan afo, asaase kɛsɛɛ, na sar, asaase a ɔdasanyi biara nntsena do, eso nyimpa ne ba biara nntwa mu wɔ hɔ.
Na mubobu atsɛn megu Bel do wɔ Babilɔn, na meyi dza ɔamemen no mefi n’anomu epue; na amanaman nnkɔbɔ mu apem akɔ ne nkyɛn ara bio: nyew, Babilɔn ɔfasu ahwe ase!
Me man, hom mfi no mu mfir, na hom mu nyimpa biara ngye noho mfi EWURADZE n’ebufuhyew mu.

Eso mma hom akoma nntu, eso mma hom nnsuro wɔ akwansosɛm a hom bɛtse wɔ asaase no do no ho; na akwansosɛm kor bɛba afe kor mu, na n’ekyir afe kor so mu akwansosɛm, na akatabansɛm aba asaase no do, nyia odzi tum oetsia nyia odzi tum.
Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a mubobubu atsɛn egu Babilɔn sianhonyi do, na n’asaase no nyina n’enyi bɔto; na n’atɔfoe nyina bɔhwehwe ase wɔ ne finimfin.
Nna enyigye ntsi ɔsor na asaase, na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara bɔtow Babilɔn ho ndwom; na afofafo befi kwaamu afamu aba no do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Dɛ mbrɛ Babilɔn maa Israel atɔfo hwehwee ase no, dɛmara so Babilɔn na asaase nyina hɔn atɔfoe bɔhwehwe ase wɔ hɔ.
Hom a hom efi afona anomu, hom nduom, na mma hom nngyina komm; hom mfi ekyirekyir nkaa EWURADZE, na hom mma Jerusalɛm mbra hom adwen mu.
Hɛn enyi ato, osiandɛ yɛatse ahorbahyɛ nka; enyimguase akata hɛn enyim: osiandɛ ananaben aba EWURADZE ne fie krɔnkrɔnmbea no do.
Ɔno ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, mubobu ne sianhonyi nyina atsɛn; na epirafo besi nkrum wɔ n’asaase nyina do.
Sɛ Babilɔn fow kɔ sor mpo, na ɔkyekyer n’ahoɔdzen sorɔnsorɔmbea no akoban mpo a me nkyɛn ara na afofafo befir aba no do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Nkekamu a ofi Babilɔn, na ɔsɛɛ kɛse a ofi Kaldeafo asaase do ne ndze na ɔda mu no!
Osiandɛ EWURADZE refa Babilɔn afo, na ɔma no mu ndze kɛse no sɛɛ fi mu; na hɔn asorɛkye wor dɛ esu pii na hɔn ndze gyegye huoo:
na afofanyi no aba no do, Babilɔn do a, na wɔafa ne mbarimba akatakyi no, woebubu hɔn ngyen mu esinesin: na EWURADZE yɛ ahyɛnanmu Nyankopɔn, tua ara na obotua hɔn kaw.
Na mebɛma n’asafohen na n’enyansafo, n’ambradofo na n’amampanyin na n’akatakyi no wɔabobow; na wɔbɛda daa nda prɛko, na wonnkenyan, Ɔhen a ne dzin dze dɔm EWURADZE no na ɔse.

Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Babilɔn afasu atɛtɛr no, wobodwuruw no pasaa, na wɔdze ogya ahyew no mbobotsen atsentsen no; na ɔman no bɛberɛ ama egyangyandze, na amanaman no aberɛ ama ogya; na wɔbɔtɔ bahaw.
Asɛm a nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia dze hyɛɛ Maseia ba Neria ne ba Seraia, ber a ɔnye Judahen Zedekia kɔr Babilɔn wɔ n’ahendzi afe a otsia anan no mu nye yi. Afei na Seraia yɛ gyaasehen.
Na Jeremia kyerɛɛw mbusu a ɔbɛba Babilɔn do nyina hyɛɛ nwoma mu, mekyerɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Babilɔn ho yi nyina.
Na Jeremia see Seraia, dɛ, Sɛ idu Babilɔn a, ɔno hwɛ na kenkan nsɛm yi nyina,
na se dɛ, EWURADZE, ɔwo na akasa bea yi ho dɛ ibotwa no akyen, amma obiara aanntsena mu, nyimpa o, abowa o, na mbom dɛ ɔnyɛ amamfo ara daa.
Na ɔmbra dɛ sɛ iwie nwoma yi kenkan a, fa ɔbo kyekyer ho, na tow kyen Eufrates mu:
na ka dɛ, Dɛm na Babilɔn bɔdɔ, na onnkopue bio wɔ mbusu a medze mebɛba do no ntsi: na wɔbɔtɔ bahaw. Mbrɛ Jeremia nsɛm yi pem nye ha.
Zedekia bedzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu biako; na odzii hen mfe dubiako wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na dzin dze Hamutal, Jeremia a ofi Libna ne babaa a.
Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ Jehoiakim yɛe no nyinara.
Na ɔnam EWURADZE n’ebufuw do na ɔbaa dɛm wɔ Jerusalɛm na Juda, dze bodur dɛ ɔtoow hɔn fii n’enyim kyenee: na Zedekia tseew Babilɔnhen no do etua.
Na ɔbaa dɛ n’ahendzi afe a otsia akron no mu no, bosoom a otsia du no, nna Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar botuaa Jerusalɛm, ɔno na no dɔm nyinara, na wɔkyeer do nsera; na wɔtoow aban bɔɔ ho aprɔw tsiaa no.
Nna wotuaa kurow no kodur ɔhen Zedekia n’afe a otsia dubiako no.
Bosoom a otsia anan no mu, bosoom no ne nda akron no mu no, ɔkɔm yɛɛ dzendzenndzen wɔ kurow no mu ara, ma wonnyaa edziban biara mma asaase no do nkorɔfo no.

Nna wotuetuee kurow no ho, na mbarimba akofo no nyina guanguanee fii kurow no mu anadwe dze faa afasu ebien no ntamu, abobow kɛse no a ɔwɔ ɔhen no ture no ho no kɔree; (afei na Kaldeafo etwa kurow no ho ehyia:) na wɔdze faa Araba kwan no do kɔree.
Na Kaldeafo dɔm no tsiiw ɔhen no, na wɔkɔtoo Zedekia wɔ Jeriko tɛtɛr mu; na no dɔm nyina fii ne nkyɛn petsee.
Nna wɔkyeer ɔhen no, na wɔdze no kɛmaa Babilɔnhen wɔ Ribla a ɔwɔ Hamat asaase do no; na obuaa no atsɛn.
Na Babilɔnhen kum Zedekia ne mbabanyin no wɔ n’enyim: okunkum Juda asafohen nyinara so wɔ Ribla.
Na otutuu Zedekia n’enyiwa; na Babilɔnhen dze no too mpokyerɛ mu, na ɔdze no kɔr Babilɔn, na ɔdze no too efiadze kodur dɛ owui.

Afei bosoom a otsia enum no mu no, bosoom no ne dadu a ɔyɛ ɔhen Nebukadenezar, Babilɔnhen no n’afe a otsia duakron no mu no, aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan a ogyina Babilɔnhen no n’enyim no, ɔbaa Jerusalɛm:
na ɔhyeew EWURADZE ne fi na ɔhen no ne fi; na Jerusalɛm efi nyinara, ofi kɛse biara mpo na ɔdze ogya hyeew no.
Na Kaldeafo dɔm a wɔka aweɔmfo safohen no ho nyinara dwuruuw Jerusalɛm afasu no nyina hyiae.
Nna aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan soaa ɔman no mu ehiafo neminemi no bi kɔr ndɔmmum, na ɔman no mu nkaa a wɔkaa kurow no mu, na awaefo a wɔwaae kɔr Babilɔnhen nkyɛn na nyimpadodow no mu nkaa no.
Na aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan daan asaase no mu ehiafo neminemi no bi gyae dɛ wɔnyɛ wenyin tureahwɛfo na ekuafo.
Na boran edum no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE fie no, na ngyinado na boran po a ɔwɔ EWURADZE fie no, Kaldeafo no bubuu mu esinesin, na wɔsoaa boran a ɔwɔ ho no nyina kɔr Babilɔn.
Nsenaba so, na nsofi, na edumgya, na mbɛɛsen, na ntser, na boran nkɔɔpow a wɔdze som nyina, wɔfae kɔree.
Na nkɔɔpow, na ogya asɛn, na mbɛɛsen, na nsenaba, na nkandzeadua, na ntser, na nkɔɔpow; dza ɔyɛ sika dze no, wɔ sika mu, dza ɔyɛ dwetɛ dze no, wɔ dwetɛ mu, na aweɔmfo safohen no fae kɔree.
Edum ebien, po kor no, na boran anantwi duebien a ɔwɔ ngyinado no a ɔhen Solomon yɛe maa EWURADZE fi no n’ase no: nkɔɔpow yinom nyinara no boran no woenntum ennker.
Na ɔyɛ edum no dze, nkyindur ndua kor no krɔn yɛ basafa akron; na ahoma basafa esia twa ho hyia; na ne peperepee nsatseaba anan: na tu da mu.

Na ne tsir no boran a; na tsir kor no krɔn yɛ basafa ebien na fa, na atena na pɔmegranate eduaba wɔ tsir no ho hyia, ne nyinara boran a: na nkyindur ndua a otsia ebien no, no ho wɔ dɛmara bi, na pɔmegranate eduaba so.
Na pɔmegranate ekutu eduokron esia wɔ afa na afa; na pɔmegranate ekutu a ɔwɔ atena no ho hyia nyina yɛ ɔha.
Na aweɔmfo safohen no faa ɔsɔfopanyin Seraia, na ɔsɔfo edziekyir Zefania, na abowanoahwɛfo baasa:

na kurow no mu na ɔfaa ɔpanyin a wɔdze no sii mbarimba akofo no do; na hɔn a wohun ɔhen no enyim, beesuon a wohun hɔn wɔ kurow no mu no; na ɔsahen ne kyerɛwnyi a ɔpon asaase no do nkorɔfo kɔ ɔsa; na asaase no do nkorɔfo no mu mbarimba eduosia a wohun hɔn kurow no mu no.
Na aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan faa hɔn, dze hɔn kɛmaa Babilɔnhen wɔ Ribla.
Na Babilɔnhen bobɔɔ hɔn, na okunkum hɔn wɔ Ribla a ɔwɔ Hamat asaase do no do. Dɛm na wɔfaa Juda ndɔmmum fii n’asaase do kɔree.
Nkorɔfo a Nebukadenezar soaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree no nye woyinom: afe a otsia esuon no mu Judafo mpensa eduonu ebiasa:
Nebukadenezar n’afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu no ɔsoaa nyimpa ahaawɔtwe eduasa ebien ndɔmmum fii Jerusalɛm:
Nebukadenezar n’afe a otsia eduonu ebiasa no mu na aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan soaa Judafo ahaesuon eduanan enum ndɔmmum kɔree: nyimpa nyinara wɔyɛ mpemanan ahaesia.

Na ɔbaa dɛ Judahen Jehoiakin no ndɔmmumkɔ afe a otsia eduasa esuon no mu, bosoom a otsia duebien no mu, bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu enum no mu, na Babilɔnhen Evil-merodak, n’ahendzi afe a odzi kan no mu, ɔmaa Judahen Jehoiakin ne tsir do, na oyii no fii efiadze puei;
na ɔnye no kasaa kasa pa, na ɔmaa n’akɔngua kyɛɛn ahemfo a wɔnye no wɔ Babilɔn no hɔn akɔngua.
Na ɔsesaa n’efiadzenda atar no, na odzidzii wɔ n’enyim daa no nkwa nda nyinara.
Na ɔyɛ n’akɔhomabɔdze no, wɔdze ne daa akɔhomabɔdze no maa no fii Babilɔnhen no ne nkyɛn, da biara n’afamudze wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu, dze kodur no wu da.
Ao, kurow a nkyɛ no mu mba dɔɔ so no mbrɛ oedua ayɛ bɔɔ a! Mbrɛ oedua ayɛ dɛ kunafo a, ɔno a nkyɛ ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ amanaman mu! Nyia nkyɛ ɔyɛ ɔhembaa wɔ amantɔw mu no, Mbrɛ oedua adan ɔsomfo a!
Osu ara na osu anadwe, na ne nyinsuwa eguar no. N’adɔfo nyinara mu no, onnya obiara a ɔkyekye no werɛ: ne mfɛfo nyinara etwitwa no nkontompɔ, wɔadan n’atamfo.
Juda etu kɔ ndɔmmum mu wɔ amandzehu mu, na ɔsom kɛse da no do; Ndɛ ɔtse amanamamfo mu, na onnya ahomgyebea biara. Hɔn a wɔtaa no do no nyinara akɔto no dɛ oehin mu ahar mu.
Zion n’akwan rutwa ewuo, osiandɛ obi mmba nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn no ase; No mbobokɛse nyinara mu ayɛ bɔɔ, n’asɔfoe risi nkrum: Ne nkataasia werɛ ahow, na noara so ayɛ no wenwen.
N’ahohiahiafo abɛyɛ banodzifo, n’atamfo ayɛ prɔmprɔm; Na EWURADZE ahyɛ no awerɛhow, wɔ ne mbrato dodow ntsi: Ne mba nkakramba edzi atamfo enyim kɔ ndɔmmum mu.
Zion babaa n’akɛseyɛ no, ne nyinara efi no ho kɔ. Ne mbapɔmba ayɛ dɛ ntwe a wonnya edzidzibea, woguan hɔn etsiwfo enyim kɔ a wonnyi ahoɔdzen.

Jerusalɛm n’awerɛhow na n’amandzehu nda no mu no, ɔkaa dza ɔsom no bo nyinara a ɔwɔ hɔ fir tsetse nda mu no: Ber a ne man kɔtɔɔ atamfo nsamu, na obiara ammboa no no, atamfo no dzii dɛw, na wosii n’amamfoyɛ ho atwetwe.
Jerusalɛm ayɛ bɔn kɛsekɛse; dɛm ntsi ɔayɛ atwetwesidze. Hɔn a wodzii no nyi nyinara no, wommbu no bi, osiandɛ woehu n’adagyaw. Nyew, osi nkrum, na ɔdan n’enyim kɔ nkyɛn.
Ne fi kekaa n’asetar mu; ɔanndwen ne daakye ho; dɛm ntsi na ɔabrɛ adze nwionn no; a onnyi ɔwerɛkyekyefo biara no. O EWURADZE, hwɛ m’amandzehu; osiandɛ ɔtamfo no edzi konyim.
Ahohiahianyi no atserɛw ne nsamu akata dza ɔsom no bo nyinara do; Mpo oehu dɛ amanamamfo ahɛn no krɔnkrɔnbea, Nyew, hɔn a ehyɛɛ hɔn ho mbra dɛ mma wɔnnhɛn wo mboanofo mu no a.
Ne man nyinara si nkrum, ber a wɔrohwehwɛ edziban; Wɔdze dza ɔsom hɔn bo amema agye edziban a wɔdze bɔdwedwe ɔkra: EWURADZE e, hwɛ, na hu; mbrɛ mo ho esi ayɛ nkɔw.
Hom a hom rutwa mu sen nyina, aso ɔnnyɛ hom asɛm bi? Hom nhwɛ, na hom nhu kyerɛ dɛ yaw bi wɔ hɔ a ɔtse dɛ me yaw a aka me a EWURADZE dze ahow mo werɛ wɔ n’ebufuhyew da mu yi.
Ofir ɔsor na ɔasoma ogya, na ahɛnhɛn me mbiew mu, na oedzidzi mu: Oesua m’anan efir, ɔasan me ekyir; Ɔama mayɛ kyirpaanyi na matɔ bitsi adzekyee nyina.
Ɔdze ne nsa akyekyer me mbrato ayɛ no kɔndua no; Wɔdze hɔn atoatoa mu, woedu mo kɔn ho; ɔama m’ahoɔdzen apa. EWURADZE eyi me ahyɛ hɔn a munntum hɔn enyim gyina nsa.
EWURADZE ammfa m’akatakyi a wɔtse mo mu no annyɛ hwee; Ɔafrɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn etsia me dɛ wɔmbɔdwerew me mberantsɛ: EWURADZE etsiatsia Juda babaa ɔbaabun no do dɛ mbrɛ wotsiatsia wenyintwer mu.
Ndzɛmba yinom ntsi na musu; m’enyiwa kyi nyinsuwa gu famu; Osiandɛ ɔwerɛkyekyefo a ɔbɔdwedwe me kra no, ɔnye me ntamu atwe: Me mba ayɛ ekyirpaafo, osiandɛ ɔtamfo no edzi nyim.
Zion tserɛw ne nsamu; naaso obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔkyekye no werɛ; EWURADZE ahyɛ wɔ Jakob ho dɛ, hɔn a wɔabɔ no ho aprɔw nyinara wɔnnyɛ n’atamfo: Jerusalɛm adan efifidze wɔ hɔn mu.
EWURADZE dzi bem; osiandɛ emi matsew ne mbrasɛm do etua: naaso aman nyina hom ntsie, na hom nhu me yaw: me nkataasia na me mberantsɛ kɔ; wɔkɔ ndɔmmum mu.
Mefrɛfrɛɛ mo nwewefo, naaso wɔdaadaa me: M’asɔfoe na me mpanyimfo gyaagyaa hɔn sunsum mu wɔ kurow no mu, ber a wɔrohwehwɛ edziban ekenyan hɔn ahoɔdzen no.
EWURADZE, hwɛ; mowɔ ahokyer mu; mo nson mu hyehye me; M’akoma etwa noho wɔ mo mu; osiandɛ matsew etua kɛsekɛse ntsi. Guado ɛ, afona ruhwinhwim kɔ, fie so ɛ, owu dɛmara.
Wɔtsee mbrɛ misii sii nkrum; naaso obi nnyi hɔ a ɔkyekye mo werɛ. M’atamfo nyina atse mo fona; ɔyɛ hɔn dɛw dɛ ɔwo na ayɛ: Ebɛma da a aka ato hɔ no edu, na hɔn so wɔayɛ dɛ emi.
Ma hɔn emumuyɛ nyina mbra w’enyim; Na yɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ edze ayɛ me osian me mbrato nyinara ntsi. Na mo nkrumsi adɔɔ so, na m’akoma atɔ bitsi.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE edua dze fua akata Zion babaa do wɔ n’ebufuw mu a! Ofi sor atow Israel n’ahoɔfɛw akyen asaase do, Na ɔnnkaa n’ananadzegua wɔ n’ebufuw da no mu.
EWURADZE asɛɛ Jakob ne ntsenabea nyina, na oennhu no mbɔbɔr; N’ebufuhyew mu no oedwuruw Juda babaa n’aban dzendzen egu famu; na oegu ahendzi no na mu mbapɔmba no ho fi.
Oetwa Israel ahoɔdzen nyina egu wɔ n’ebufuhyew mu; Ɔatwe ne nsa nyimfa ekyir efi hɔnho wɔ ɔtamfo no enyim: Na ɔahyew Jakob dɛ gyaframee a ɔhyew bɔ aprɔw.
Ɔakontom n’egyen dɛ ɔtamfo, ɔdze ne nsa nyimfa egyina dɛ ahohiahianyi, Na oekuku hɔn a yɛdze hɔn hoahoaa hɛnho nyina: Oehue n’ebufuhyew egu dɛ ogya, wɔ Zion babaa n’asesee mu.
EWURADZE adan dɛ ɔtamfo, ɔamen Israel; Ɔamemen n’ahemfi nyinara, ɔasɛɛ n’akoban so: Na ɔama babaa Juda no nkɔmbɔdzi na sukwadwom adɔɔ so.
Oebubu ne ntamadan mu, dɛ gyama ture bi; Ɔasɛɛ n’eguabɔbea: EWURADZE etwa nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn na ahomgyeda mu wɔ Zion. Na n’ebufuw ne hyeehyew no mu oebu ɔhen no na ɔsɔfo no enyimtsia.
EWURADZE atow n’afɔrmbukyia akyen, na no krɔnkrɔnbea ho ayɛ no mfon, Ɔdze n’ahemfie afasu no ahyɛ ɔtamfo no nsa; Wɔyɛɛ dede wɔ EWURADZE fie, dɛ afahyɛ da mu.
EWURADZE esua ne tsir mu dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ Zion babaa n’afasu; Ɔatwe ahoma no mu, ɔnntwee ne nsa ekyir nngyaa dɛ ɔresɛɛ adze: Na ɔama pampi na fasu etwa sukwadwom; wɔabɔ mu afomfɔn.
No mbobokɛse no amem famu; ɔasɛɛ n’adaban no na oebubu mu. Ne hen na ne mbapɔmba wɔ amanaman mu mbra nnyi hɔ bio; Nyew, no nkɔnhyɛfo nnya EWURADZE hɔ enyido adzehu.
Zion babaa ne mpanyimfo tsetse famu, wɔayeyɛ konkomm; Woetu huntuma egugu hɔn etsifi, wɔdze eyitam esisi hɔn asen: Jerusalɛm mbaabun esisi hɔn etsir adze.
Nyinsuwa ama m’enyiwa resa, mo nson mu hyehye me, Me mberɛbo ehue egu famu, wɔ me man ne babaa ne sɛɛe ntsi; Osiandɛ mbofra nkakraba na enumfoanomba atotɔ bitsi wɔ kurow n’abrɔn no mu.
Wobisa hɔn nanom dɛ, Henfa na eburow na wenyin wɔ? Ber a wɔatotɔ bitsi dɛ epirafo wɔ kurow n’abrɔn no mu, Ber a woehue hɔn kra egu hɔn nanom hɔn bo mu.
Ebɛn dase na mindzi nkyerɛ wo? Jerusalɛm babaa, ebɛnadze na memfa ntoto wo ho? Zion babaa baabun, ebɛnadze na memma ɔnye wo nsɛ, mfa nkyekye wo werɛ? Na wo pira so dɛ po: woana botum ayɛ wo edur?
Wo nkɔnhyɛfo ehu egyangyandze na nkwaseasɛm ho enyido adzehu ama wo; Na wɔannda w’emumuyɛ edzi, dɛ wɔdze wo ndɔmmumkɔ bɛsan aba; Na mbom ator na nkɔnhyɛsɛm a ɔma efom na wohunii kyerɛɛ wo.
Hɔn a wotwa mu sen nyina bɔ hɔn nsamu gu wo do; Wɔsesar Jerusalɛm babaa na wɔwosow hɔn tsir gu no do, dɛ: Aso iyi nye kurow a adasamba frɛ no Ahoɔfɛw a oedzi mu, Asaase nyina enyigye no?
W’atamfo nyina ahanhan hɔn anomu wɔ wo do; Wɔsesar na wɔtwɛr hɔn se; wɔka dɛ, Yɛamemen no! Nyew, da a yɛhwɛɛ no kwan no nye yi; yeenya, yeehu.
EWURADZE ayɛ dza osusui no; Ɔama n’asɛm aba mu pɛpɛɛpɛr dza ɔhyɛe wɔ tsetse nda mu no; Oedwuruw egu famu, oennya ehumbɔbɔr: Na ɔama ɔtamfo edzi wo eduwa; Ɔama w’ahohiahiafo ahoɔdzen do.
Hɔn akoma kekaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE: Ao Zion babaa ne fasu! Ma nyinsuwa mpem dɛ esutsen adzekyee na anadwe; Mma nngye w’ahom, mma mma w’enyiwa nnda.
Soɛr, keka mu wɔ anadwe, wɔ adasu n’ahyɛse; Hue w’akoma dɛ nsu gu wɔ EWURADZE n’enyim: Ma wo nsa do kyerɛ no do wɔ wo mbofra nkakraba no hɔn nkwa ntsi, Ɔkɔm ntsi wɔtotɔ bitsi wɔ abrɔn biara etsifi.
EWURADZE e, hwɛ, na hu nyia ayɛ no dɛm yi! Aso mbaa bedzi hɔn yafumba, mboframba a hɔnara wɔawo hɔn no? Aso woboku ɔsɔfo na nkɔnhyɛnyi wɔ EWURADZE no krɔnkrɔnbea?
Aberantsɛ na akɔdaa wɔdeda famu wɔ abrɔn mu; Me nkataasia na me mberantsɛ atotɔ afona anomu: Ekuku hɔn w’ebufuw da no mu; eku, na ennhu mbɔbɔr.
Ɔwo afrɛ m’atamfo wɔ mbea nyina dɛ gyama afahyɛ da bi, Na obiara nnyi hɔ a ofii nsa anaa ɔkae wɔ EWURADZE n’ebufuw da no mu: Hɔn a magyegye hɔn na manyɛn hɔn no, me tamfo ama wɔasa.
Emi nye nyimpa a mehu amandze wɔ n’ebufuw abaa no ano.
Ɔapam me dze me kɔ sum mu mbrɛ kan biara nnyi.
Emi mara nko mo do na ɔdandan ne nsa, ɔdze tsia me adzekyee nyina.
Ɔama mo honam na mo wer ayɛ dadaw; oebubu me mbiew.
Ɔatow esiw me kwan, na ɔdze bɔwema na ɔyaw etwa mo ho ehyia.
Ɔama matsena mbea a ɔyɛ sum mu, dɛ hɔn a woewuwu akyɛr.
Ɔagye mo ho ban, na munntum mummpue; ɔama mo nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no ayɛ dur.
Kaansa musu frɛ mboa mpo a, osiw me mpaabɔ kwan.
Ɔdze abo a woetwa ato m’atsempɔn mu fasu, ɔakyeakyea m’akwan.
Ɔayɛ dɛ osisi a ɔretsɛw me, dɛ ogyata a ɔhyɛ nsumaa mu.
Ɔadan m’akwan akɔ nkyɛn, na ɔatsetsew mo mu esinesin; ɔama mayɛ pasaa.
Ɔakontom n’egyen, na ɔdze me esi hɔ dɛ botae ama egyen menaba.
Ɔama n’egyen kotoku mu egyen menaba ahɛn me nsɛbɛ mu.
Madan ɔsesɛba ama me man nyina; na hɔn atwetwesi ndwom adzekyee nyina.
Ɔdze wenwen ahyɛ me ma, ɔama bɔwen afon me.
Eso ɔdze mbosaabo ebubu me se, ɔdze nso akata mo do.
Na ɔwo eyi me kra efi asomdwee ho kɔ ekyirekyir; mo werɛ fir prɔmprɔmyɛ.
Na mesee dɛ, M’enyimnyam asa, na dza m’enyi da kwan wɔ EWURADZE hɔ no.
Mekaa m’amandzehu na m’awerɛhow a, ɔyɛ ɔbɔwen na ɔbɔwema ma me.
Me kra da ho ara kaa, na ɔabrɛ adze wɔ mo mu.
Naaso iyi na mekaakaa mo ho wɔ ho, dɛm ntsi na mowɔ enyidado yi.
EWURADZE no dɔ a otsim ntsi na yɛnnhyewee yi, na n’ehumbɔbɔr no tun nntwa da.
Wɔyɛ fofor anapa biara; wo nokwardzi so.
EWURADZE nye me kyɛfa, me kra na ɔse; dɛm ntsi m’enyi da no do.
EWURADZE ye dze ma hɔn a wɔtweɔn no no, dze ma ɔkra a ɔhwehwɛ n’ekyir kwan no.
Oye ma ɔdasanyi dɛ n’enyi bɛda do na ɔayɛ komm atweɔn EWURADZE no nkwagye.
Oye ma ɔdasanyi dɛ ɔsoa no kɔndua wɔ ne mbofrabermu.
Sɛ EWURADZE dze to no do a, ma no nko ntsena hɔ na ɔnyɛ komm.
Ma ɔmfa n’ano mbutuw huntuma mu; sɛ bi a enyidado bi bɛba a.
Ma ɔmfa n’afon mma nyia ɔbɔ mu no; ma ahorba nhyɛ no ma tɔ.
Na EWURADZE nnkɔtow akyen ara afebɔɔ.
Na kaansa ɔhyɛ awerɛhow mpo a, ne yamu bɛhyehye no wɔ no mbɔbɔrhu dodow ntsi.
Na ɔnnyɛ ne pɛ dɛ obehiahia ho ɔpɛdo, eso dɛ obeyi adasamba awerɛhow.
Sɛ wɔdwerew asaase do adaduafo nyina wɔ ananadze,
sɛ wɔdan ɔdasanyi ne ndzinoa to nkyɛn wɔ Ɔsorsornyi no enyim,
sɛ wɔdan ɔdasanyi n’asɛm enyi a, aso EWURADZE nnhu a?
Woana na ɔka ma ɔba mu, ber a EWURADZE nnhyɛe no?
Ana nnyɛ Ɔsorsornyi no n’anomu na mbusu na siar fir ba?
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na nyimpa tseasenyi nhwinhwin, wɔ no bɔn ho ntsea ho?
Wɔmma yɛnhwehwɛ hɛn akwan mu na yɛmpa mu, na yɛnsan nkɔ EWURADZE hɔ.
Wɔmma yɛmmema hɛn akoma ɔnye hɛn nsa do mma Nyankopɔn wɔ sorsor.
Hɛn na yɛato mbra na yɛatsew etua; na ɔwo emmfae nnkyɛe.
Edze ebufuw akata woho na etsiw hɛn; ekuku a ennhu mbɔbɔr.
Edze nsuwusiw akata woho, amma hɛn mpaabɔ biara eennhwira mu.
Ɔwo ayɛ hɛn nwurabanwuraba na ntɔmpamu wɔ aman finimfin.
Hɛn atamfo nyinara ahanhan hɔn anomu petopetoo wɔ hɛn do.
Suro na mona abɛda hɛn do, amamfo na ɔsɛɛ.
M’enyiwa kyi nyinsuwa esutsen gu famu, wɔ me man ne babaa ne sɛɛe ntsi.
M’enyiwa wora nsu gu famu, na onngyaa, ɔnntow mu,
ekodu dɛ EWURADZE bɔbɔ ne tsir adze na oefi ɔsor ahwɛ.
M’enyiwa hyɛ me awerɛhow, wɔ mo kurow ne mbabaa nyinara ntsi.
Hɔn a wɔyɛ m’atamfo kwa no, woetsiw me dɛ anoma.
Woetwa mo nkwa do wɔ mona efiadze no mu, na woesun ɔbo ato mo do.
Esu no praam me tsir do; mesee dɛ, Woetwa me akyen.
Ao EWURADZE, mifi mona no n’ase noho noho na mobɔɔ wo dzin.
Ɔwo itsiee me ndze, mma nnsiw w’aso wɔ me nkrumsi do, mbom ma me ahomgye.
Ɔwo twee pinii wɔ da a mefrɛɛ wo no: na esee dɛ, Mma nnsuro.
EWURADZE, ɔwo edzi me kra n’asɛm ama no; ɔwo apon me kra.
EWURADZE, ɔwoara ehu mfom a wɔdze afom me; bua m’atsɛn ma me.
Ɔwo ehu hɔn enyitan nyina, na hɔn tsirmpɔw nyina a wɔbɔ wɔ mo ho no.
EWURADZE, ɔwoara atse hɔn ahorba, na hɔn tsirmpɔw nyina a wɔdze tsia me no.
Hɔn a wɔtaa mo do no hɔn huhuhuhu na ehwinhwin, soɛr tsia me adzekyee nyina.
Hwɛ, hɔn asetsena na hɔn soɛr; emi nye hɔn atwetwesi ndwom.
EWURADZE, ɔwoara ma hɔn ahyɛnanmu akatua, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nsaano edwuma tse.
Ma hɔn akoma atseetsee, ma wo mpaamba nka hɔn.
Tsiw hɔn ebufuw mu, na sɛɛ hɔn fi EWURADZE no sorsor no ase.
Mbrɛ sikakɔkɔɔ enyi edua ebisiw a! Mbrɛ sika mapa twann edua asakyer a! Krɔnkrɔnbea abo no woehue egugu abrɔn biara ne tsir.
Zionmba a wɔsom bo a wɔdze hɔn to sika mapa ho no, Mbrɛ woedua ebu hɔn dɛ dɛtse nsenaba, ɔwemfo ne nsaano edwuma a!
Nsɔ mpo wɔtwe enumfo, wɔma hɔn mba wonum: naaso me man adan otsirmɔdzennyi, dɛ sar do nsohor.
Akɔkowaba ne tɛkyerɛma fam n’anomu wɔ nsukɔm ntsi: Mbofra nkakraba bisa edziban, naaso nyimpa biara mmbu bi mma hɔn.
Hɔn a wodzii adɔkɔdɔkɔdze ayeyɛ pasapasaa wɔ abrɔn mu: Hɔn a wɔnyɛɛn hɔn serdaa mu no wɔyɛ nsumina etuu.
Na me man n’emumuyɛ ayɛ kɛse asen Sodom no bɔn, Ɔno a wobutuuw no amonmu, a nnyɛ nsa biara na ɔyɛe.
N’ekunyin ho tsew sen esukwankyɛba, wɔhoa sen enumfonsu. Hɔn honamenyi ber mu sen nankyenema, hɔn ho senasena dɛ hoabo.
Afei dze hɔn enyim bir sen gyabiriw; wohu hɔn abrɔn mu a, wonnhu hɔn: Hɔn honanwer femfam hɔn mbiew ho; ɔakyenkyen, ɔayɛ dɛ dua.
Hɔn a wɔtotɔ afona ano no woye sen hɔn a ɔkɔm kuku hɔn; woyinom hɔn ahom apa, wɔayeyɛ nkamfenkamfe, wɔ haban mu nduadzewa a abɔ hɔn no ntsi.
Mbaa a wɔyɛ ehumbɔbɔr no hɔn nsa anoa hɔnankasa hɔn mba; wɔdaan hɔn edziban wɔ me man ne sɛɛe ntsi.
EWURADZE ewie n’ebufuhyew fa, oehue n’ebufuw dzendzen no egu; Na oekua ogya bi wɔ Zion a ɔamemen ne mfapem no.
Asaase do ahemfo anngye enndzi, wɔnye wiadze mba nyinara so, Dɛ ɔhohiahianyi na ɔtamfo bɛba abɛhɛn Jerusalɛm mbobokɛse mu.
No nkɔnhyɛfo hɔn bɔn, na n’asɔfoe hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi a, na wɔaka atseneneefo bɔgyaa egu wɔ ne finimfin.
Wɔkekaa dɛ enyifurafo wɔ abrɔn mu, bɔgya egu hɔn ho fi, ma dɛm ntsi adasa nntum nnka hɔn ntar.

Wɔtseaa mu kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom mfi hɔ, Hom a hom ho egu fi! Hom mfi hɔ, hom mfi hɔ, mma hom mmfa hom nsa nnka biribiara: Aber a woguanee kekyinkyinii no, adasa kae wɔ amanaman mu dɛ, Wɔnnkɛyɛ amamforafora wɔ ha bio.
EWURADZE n’ebufuw apaapaa hɔn mu; ɔnnkɛda ho ebu hɔn bi bio: woemmbu asɔfo no bi, mpanyimfo no so ennya hɔn enyim enyimpa.
Hɛn enyiwa da ho bu dɛ ɔrohwɛ hɛn mboa kwan ara gyan: hɛn aweɔn mu yɛaweɔn ama ɔman bi a onnkotum nkwa gye.
Wɔtwee hɛn anamɔn, ma yenntum nnkɔ hɛn abrɔn mu: Hɛn ewiei abɛn, hɛn nda aso; osiandɛ hɛn ewiei aba.
Hɛn etsiwfo hɔn ho yɛ har sen ɔsor nkɔr: Wotsiiw hɛn mbepɔw do, wɔtsɛɛw hɛn sar do.
Hɛn ahwentokura mu ahom, nyia EWURADZE asera no no, wɔkyeer no wɔ hɔn amona mu; ɔno na yɛkae wɔ no ho dɛ, No nwin ase na yebenya nkwa wɔ amanaman mu.
Edom babaa a etse Uz asaase do, dzi ehurusi na ma w’enyi ngye: Kɔɔpow no botwa mu aba wo so wo hɔ; ebɔbow, na wɔato wo pan.
Zion babaa, w’emumuyɛ ho ntsea no aba ewiei. Ɔrennda ho nnsoa wo nnkɔ ndɔmmum mu: mbom, Edom babaa, obotua wo w’emumuyɛ ho kaw; ɔbɛda wo bɔn edzi.
EWURADZE, kaa dza aba hɛn do: Hwɛ, na hu hɛn enyimguase.
Wɔadan hɛn egyapadze ama ahɔho, Hɛn efi ama ananaben.
Yɛayɛ enyisaba na ngyanka, Hɛn nanom ayɛ dɛ ekunafo.
Yeetua sika anom hɛnankasa hɛn nsu; Wɔdze hɛn nyena atɔn hɛn.
Hɛn etsiwfo dze hɛn kɔn ekyir: Yɛaberɛ, na yeennya ahomgye.
Yɛdze hɛn nsa ama Egyptfo, Na Asiriafo, ma yeenya edziban amee.
Hɛn egyanom ayɛ bɔn, na wonnyi hɔ; Na hɛn dze, yɛasoa hɔn emumuyɛ.
Nkowaa dzi hɛn do tum: Obi nnyi hɔ a ɔgye hɛn fi hɔn nsamu.
Hɛn nkwa kitsakitsa hɛn nsamu na yɛkɛfa hɛn edziban, wɔ sar do afona no ntsi.
Hɛn wer ahyew tumm dɛ fononoo wɔ ɔkɔm ne gyaframee ntsi.
Woguu Zion mbaa enyim ase, Juda nkurow mu mbabun no.
Wɔkyekyeer mbapɔmba nsa sensɛnee: Wɔannhwɛ mpanyimfo enyim emmbu hɔn bi.
Hɔn mberantsɛ soaa ewuyambo, Na mbofra fintsiwii wɔ nyena nkyekyeree ase.
Mpanyimfo egyaa abobotsen ano ba, Mberantsɛ egyaa hɔn sanku bɔ.
Hɛn akoma n’enyigye abɔ adze; Hɛn asaw adan nkɔmbɔdzi.
Abɔtsir no efi hɛn tsir egu: Yendue, osiandɛ yɛayɛ bɔn!
Iyi ntsi na hɛn akoma atɔ bitsi; Ndzɛmba yinom ntsi na hɛn enyiwa ayɛ kusukusu;
Zion bepɔw a ayɛ amamfo ntsi; Nsɔ nenam do.
EWURADZE, ɔwoara na etse hɔ daa; W’ahengua fir ebusuasantsen kodu ebusuasantsen.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo werɛ fir hɛn daa, Na epa hɛn mber tsentsen dɛm yi?
EWURADZE, san hɛn bra wo nkyɛn na yɛbɛsan; Yɛ hɛn nda fofor dɛ tsetse dze no,
Anaa ɔwo apow hɛn koraa, na wo bo efuw hɛn dodoodow?
Afei ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia eduasa no mu no, bosoom a otsia anan no mu da a otsia enum no, ber a mowɔ ndɔmmumfo mu wɔ Kebar esutsen ho no, na ɔsorsor buebuei, na muhun Nyankopɔn ho enyido adzehu.
Bosoom no mu da a otsia enum a ɔyɛ ɔhen Jehoiakin no ndɔmmumkɔ afe a otsia enum mu no,
EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Buzi ba, ɔsɔfo Ezekiel hɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ Kaldeafo asaase a ɔwɔ Kebar esutsen ho; na EWURADZE ne nsa baa no do wɔ hɔ.

Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, ehum kɛse bi tui fi kwaamu afamu bae, nsuwusiw kɛse nye gya a ɔabobɔw noho hyɛ mu, na ɔhyerɛn bi etwa no ho ehyia. Na gya no ne finimfin no, biribi a enyi tse dɛ sika na dwetɛ mforae hyerɛn wɔ hɔ.
Na no mu na abɔdze enyikan baanan bi saso fi puei. Na mbrɛ hɔn hwɛbea tse nye yi; wɔwɔ dasanyi ne saso.
Na obiara wɔ enyim anan, na hɔn mu biara wɔ ntsaban anan.
Na hɔn anansa yɛ tromm; na hɔn ananadze tse dɛ nantwiba n’ananadze: na wɔyeyɛɛ hyenhyerɛnn dɛ ayewa a wɔapɔw ho.
Na wɔwɔ nyimpa nsa wɔ hɔn ntsaban ase wɔ hɔn afa anan: na hɔn baanan no wowɔ enyim na hɔn ntsaban dɛm;
hɔn ntsaban toatoa mu; wɔnam a, wonntwa hɔnho; hɔn mu biara nam n’enyim tsenn.
Hɔn enyim ne saso mbrɛ ɔtse nye yi; hɔn baanan no nyina wowɔ nyimpa enyim; wɔ hɔn enyim, na wɔwɔ gyata enyim wɔ enyimfa afamu; wɔwɔ nantwi enyim wɔ abankum afamu; na wɔwɔ ɔkɔr enyim so wɔ hɔn ekyir.
Wɔatserɛw hɔn ntsaban mu hwɛ ɔsor afamu; obiara ne ntsaban ebien ebien toatoa mu, na ebien ebien katakata hɔn nyimpadua ho.
Na hɔn mu biara nam n’enyim tsenn: mbrɛ sunsum rokɔ, na wɔkɔ; wɔnam a wonntwa hɔnho.
Na abɔdze enyikan ne saso dze, hɔn hwɛbea tse dɛ gyabiriw a ɔdzɛw, dɛ mbrɛ ogya atsɛn no hwɛbea tse; ɔkɔ sor ba ase wɔ abɔdze enyikan no ntamu: na gya no dzɛw huoo, na enyinam fi gya no mu.
Na abɔdze enyikan no tutuu mbirika dzii akɔnaaba tse dɛ enyinam ne nyinamee.
Na morohwɛ abɔdze enyikan no, hwɛ, hwiir kor si asaase no do wɔ abɔdze enyikan no nkyɛn, enyim anan no mu biara nedze kor.
Nhwiir no na hɔn nyɛbea tse dɛ sikabereebo enyi: na baanan no nyina hɔn saso kor: na hɔn hwɛbea na nyɛbea tse dɛ hwiir a ɔhyɛ hwiir mu.
Wɔnam a, wɔnam hɔn afa anan no do: wɔnam a, wonntwa hɔnho.
Na hɔn ho nhankra no dze, wɔkrɔn ma ɔyɛ hu; na baanan no nhankra no ayeyɛ enyiwa enyiwa abɔ ho aprɔw.
Na sɛ abɔdze enyikan no rokɔ a, nhwiir no dzi hɔn nkyɛn: na sɛ wɔma abɔdze enyikan no do fi famu a, nhwiir no so mema do.
Beebiara a sunsum no rokɔ no, wɔkɔ; hɔ ara na sunsum no wɔ dɛ ɔkɔ: na nhwiir no mema do wɔ hɔn nkyɛnmu; na abɔdze enyikan no no sunsum wɔ nhwiir no mu.
Sɛ hɔn wɔkɔ a, woyinom so wɔkɔ; na sɛ wogyina a, nna woyinom so woegyina; na sɛ wɔma hɔn do fi famu a, nhwiir no mema do wɔ hɔn nkyɛn: osiandɛ abɔdze enyikan no no sunsum wɔ nhwiir no mu.
Na abɔdze enyikan no n’etsifi wɔ wimu ne saso, ɔtse dɛ ahwehwɛbo a ɔyɛ hu n’enyi, wɔatserɛw mu akatakata hɔn etsifi.
Na hɔn ntsaban tsen tsenn dzi mbɔenyim wɔ wimu no ase: hɔn mu biara wɔ ebien a ɔkata ne nyimpadua afa ha, na hɔn mu biara so wɔ ebien a ɔkata ne nyimpadua afa ha so.
Na sɛ wɔrokɔ a, metse hɔn ntsaban ne dede a ɔtse dɛ esu akɛse dede, ɔtse dɛ Otumfo no ne ndze dede weɔɔ a ɔtse dɛ dɔm ne dede: sɛ wogyina a, wogyaagyaa hɔn ntsaban mu.
Na ndze bi fi wimu a ɔwɔ hɔn etsifi no mu: sɛ wogyina a, wogyaagyaa hɔn ntsaban mu.
Na wimu a ɔwɔ hɔn etsifi no do wɔ ahengua saso wɔ hɔ a ɔtse dɛ hoabo no hwɛbea: na ahengua no ne saso no do na saso a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a ɔtse do wɔ sor no hwɛbea no wɔ.

Na muhun dɛ ɔtse dɛ sika na dwetɛ mforaa enyi, ɔtse dɛ gya a ɔwɔ no mu bɔ no aprɔw no hwɛbea, ɔnam mbrɛ n’asen na mbrɛ ɔdze fa no sor no tse no ntsi; na mbrɛ n’asen na ɔdze fa no ase no no hwɛbea tse no, muhun dɛ ɔtse dɛ ogya, na hyerɛn etwa no ho ehyia.

Dɛ mbrɛ nyankontɔn a ɔwɔ nsuwusiw mu wɔ nsutɔ da mu tse no, mbrɛ ɔhyerɛn a etwa noho ehyia no no hwɛbea tse ara nye no. Iyi nye EWURADZE n’enyimnyam no hwɛbea no ne saso. Na muhunii no, medze m’enyim bɔɔ famu, na metsee obi a ɔrekasa ne ndze.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, gyina wo nan do, ma menye wo nkasa.
Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ me no, sunsum no bɛhɛɛn mo mu, na ɔmaa migyinaa me nan do; na metsee nyia ɔrekasa kyerɛ me no.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, Morosoma wo Israelmba nkyɛn, amanaman etuatsewfo a wɔatsew mo do etua no nkyɛn: hɔn na hɔn egyanom afom me, dze ebodu ndɛ da yi ara mpo.
Na mba no yɛ enyiammbɔho na akomadzen; morosoma wo hɔn nkyɛn: na akɛse hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi.
Na hɔn dze, sɛ wotsie o, sɛ woenntsie o, (osiandɛ wɔyɛ etuatsew fi,) wobohu ara dɛ saa nkɔnhyɛnyi bi aba hɔn mu.

Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba dze, mma nnsuro hɔn, eso mma nnsuro hɔn nsɛm, kaansa nkɔkrɔw na nsoɛ wɔ wo nkyɛn, na etse nyankomaketsembowa mu ara mpo a: mma nnsuro hɔn nsɛm, eso mma wo bo nntu wɔ hɔn enyim, kaansa wɔyɛ etuatsew fi mpo a.
Na kɛka me nsɛm kyerɛ hɔn, sɛ wotsie o, sɛ woenntsie o: na wɔyɛ etuatsewfo dodow.
Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba dze, tsie dza meka kyerɛ wo yi; mma nnyɛ etuatsewnyi dɛ etuatsew fie no: bue w’anomu, na dzi dza medze rema wo yi.
Na mohwɛe no, nna hwɛ, wɔatsen nsa bi wɔ mo do; na, hwɛ, nwoma mbobɔwee bi wɔ mu;
na ɔtserɛɛw mu wɔ m’enyim; na wɔakyerɛw no mu na n’ekyir: na wɔakyerɛw sukwadwom, na apensi, na mbusu wɔ mu.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, dzi dza ihu no; dzi nwoma mbobɔwee yi, na kɔ, kɛkasa kyerɛ Israel fifo.
Nna mubuee m’anomu, na ɔmaa midzii nwoma mbobɔwee no.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, dzi nwoma mbobɔwee a medze rema wo yi, na fa hyɛ wo nson ma. Nna midzii; na ne dɛw yɛɛ dɛ ewo wɔ m’anomu.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, si mu, kɔ Israel fifo nkyɛn, na kɛka me nsɛm yi kyerɛ hɔn.
Na nnyɛ ɔman a hɔn kasaa yɛ ananakasa, na hɔn kasaa yɛ dzen, na wɔasoma wo hɔn nkyɛn, na mbom Israel fifo a;
nnyɛ aman pii a hɔn kasaa yɛ ananakasa, na hɔn kasaa yɛ dzen a enntse hɔn nsɛm ase no bi a. Ampaara sɛ mosomaa wo hɔn nkyɛn a, nkyɛ wobetsie wo.
Na Israel fifo dze, worinntsie wo; osiandɛ worinntsie me; na Israel fifo nyina hɔn momapɔw do ayɛ dzen na hɔn akoma epirim.
Hwɛ, mayɛ w’enyim dzendzen wɔ hɔn enyim, na wo momapɔw do dzendzen wɔ hɔn mmomapɔw do.
Dɛ dɛnkyɛmbo a ɔyɛ dzen sen twerɛbo na mayɛ wo momapɔw: mma nnsuro hɔn, eso mma hɔn enyim nntu wo bo, kaansa wɔyɛ etuatsew fi mpo a.
Bio so ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, me nsɛm a mebɛka akyerɛ wo nyina gye no w’akoma mu, na fa w’asowa tsie.
Na si mu, kɔ ndɔmmumkɔfo no nkyɛn, wo man ne mba no nkyɛn, na kɛkasa kyerɛ hɔn, na se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi; sɛ wobetsie o, sɛ wonnketsie o.
Nna sunsum no maa me do, ma metsee twiradada kɛse bi wɔ m’ekyir, dɛ, Nhyira mfi ne bea do nka EWURADZE n’enyimnyam.
Na metsee abɔdze enyikan no ne ntsaban ne dede ber a wotwutwuuw ho no, na nhwiir a ɔwɔ hɔn nkyɛnmu no ne dede, mekyerɛ twiradada kɛse bi ne dede no a.
Nna sunsum no maa me do, na ɔdze me kɔree: na mokɔr no wenwen mu, wɔ mo sunsum ne hyew mu, na EWURADZE ne nsa yɛɛ dzen wɔ mo do.
Nna mebaa Tel-abib ndɔmmumkɔfo a wɔtsetse esutsen Kebar ho no nkyɛn, na mbrɛ wɔtse no; na medze ahobow tsenaa hɔn mu hɔ ndaesuon.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ndaesuon no wiei no, EWURADZE asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
Onyimpa ba, mayɛ wo ɔweɔmfo ama Israel fifo: dɛm ntsi tsie m’anomu asɛm, na bɔ hɔn kɔkɔ ma me.

Sɛ mese mumuyɛnyi dɛ, Owu ara na ibowu; na ɔwo ammbɔ no kɔkɔ, na annkasa dɛ erobɔ mumuyɛnyi no kɔkɔ efi n’emumuyɛ kwan no ho, dze agye ne kra nkwa a; mumuyɛnyi kor noara bowu n’emumuyɛ mu; na no bɔgyaa no dze, mobɔhwehwɛ no wɔ wo nsamu.
Naaso sɛ ebɔ mumuyɛnyi no kɔkɔ, na ɔanndan emmfi n’emumuyɛ ho, anaa n’emumuyɛ kwan ho a, obowu noara n’emumuyɛ mu; na ɔwo dze na agye wo kra.

Bio, sɛ tseneneenyi san fi ne ndzeyɛtsenenee ho, na ɔyɛ emumuyɛ, na medze fintsidua to n’enyim a, obowu: osiandɛ ɔwo ammbɔ no kɔkɔ ntsi, obowu no bɔn mu na ne ndzeyɛtsenenee a ɔayɛ no, wɔnnkɛkaa; na no bɔgyaa dze, mobɔhwehwɛ no wɔ wo nsamu.
Naaso sɛ ɔwo ebɔ tseneneenyi kɔkɔ dɛ mma tseneneenyi nnyɛ bɔn, na ɔannyɛ bɔn a, obenya nkwa ara ampa, osiandɛ otsiee kɔkɔbɔ; na ɔwo agye wo kra.
Na EWURADZE nsa baa mo do wɔ hɔ; na ɔsee me dɛ, Soɛr, fir edzi kɔ tɛtɛr no mu, na menye wo nkasa wɔ hɔ.
Nna mosoɛree, na mifiir edzi kɔr tɛtɛr no mu: na, hwɛ, EWURADZE n’enyimnyam gyina hɔ, dɛ enyimnyam a muhunii wɔ esutsen Kebar ho no: na medze m’enyim butuuw famu.
Nna sunsum no bɛhɛɛn mo mu, na ɔdze me gyinaa me nan do; na ɔnye me kasae, na ɔsee me dɛ, Kɔ, kɔtow woho abow mu wɔ wo fie.
Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba dze, hwɛ, wɔdze nkyehoma bogu wo do, na wɔdze akyekyer wo, na irimmfir edzi nnkɔ hɔn mu:
na mebɛma wo tɛkyerɛma afam w’anomu, na atɔ mum, na annyɛ kasanyimfo amma hɔn: na wɔyɛ etuatsew fi.
Na sɛ menye wo kasa a, mubobue w’ano, na ase hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Nyia otsie no, ma ontsie; na nyia onntsie no, mma onntsie: na wɔyɛ etuatsew fi.
Ɔwo so, onyimpa ba, fa ntaayaa, na fa to w’enyim, na sensan kurow wɔ do, Jerusalɛm a:
na kɔ ho ntuae, na tow ho aban, na hɔr ho pempe; kyer ho nsera so hyia, na fa afasubu ndadzefir sisi ho hyia.
Na ɔwoara fa dadzesɛn, na fa si dadze fasu wɔ ɔwo na kurow no ntamu: na fa w’enyi si do, na wɔbɔkɔ no ntuae, na akɔ no ntuae. Iyi bɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛdze ama Israel fifo.
Bio so, da w’abankum do, na fa Israel fi emumuyɛ to do: nda dodow a ebɛda do no, ebɔsoa hɔn emumuyɛ.
Na mahyɛ hɔn emumuyɛ mfe no dɛ ɔnyɛ nda dodow mma wo, mekyerɛ nda ahaasa eduokron: mbrɛ ebɔsoa Israel fi emumuyɛ nye no.
Na bio, sɛ iwie iyinom yɛ a, da w’enyimfa do, na asoa Juda fi emumuyɛ: adaduanan, da kor afe kor, na mahyɛ ama wo.
Na fa w’enyi si Jerusalɛm ntuae no do, wo nsa ho nda hɔ; na hyɛ nkɔm gu no do.
Na, hwɛ, medze nkyehoma bogu wo do, na irunntwa adafa, dze ekodu dɛ ewie wo ntuae nda no ana.
Na woara fa ewifua pa, na atoko, na eduwa, na asaduwa, na ewifua, na ewi, na fa hyɛ ɔsan kor mu, na fa yɛ edziban; nda dodow a edze bɛda w’afa no, mekyerɛ nda ahaasa eduokron, na ibedzi.
Na w’edziban a ibedzi no ne nkerii bɛyɛ dwetɛbona eduonu da kor: ofi ber to ber na dzi.
Na nom nsu a woesusu no susutoa nkyɛmu esia mu kor: ofi ber to ber na nom.
Na dzi no dɛ atoko tatar, na fa egyanan a ofi nyimpa mu no to hɔn enyim.
Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Dɛmara so na Israelmba bedzi hɔn edziban a ɔyɛ nkɔw, wɔ amanaman a mebɛpam hɔn makɔ hɔ no mu.
Nna mesee dɛ, Ao, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn! Hwɛ, me kra ho nnguu fi: na ofitsi me mbafose besi sesei minndzii dza noara oewu, anaa mbowa atsetse no da; eso nam a wokyir bi nnkɔr m’anomu pɛn.
Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Hwɛ, medze nantwibin mahyɛ wo nyimpa efikyir ananmu, na esiesie w’edziban wɔ do.
Bio so, ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, hwɛ, mubobu edziban dua mu wɔ Jerusalɛm: na wobedzi edziban nkerii do, na nhwɛyie mu; na wɔbɔnom nsu nsusui do, na ahobow mu:
ama woeehia edziban na nsu, na hɔn ho abow hɔn, ɔbaako wɔ ɔbaako ho, na wɔaafomfɔn wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ mu.
Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, fa afona ndam ndam, dɛ oyifo ne yindam kitsa, na fa twerɛw wo tsir na wo bɔdwesa: na fa nsɛn ker nhwi no, na kyɛ mu.

Fa gya hyew nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor wɔ kurow no finimfin, ber a ntuae nda no ewie du no; na fa nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor so, na fa afona bobɔ ho hyia; na fa nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor so petse mframa mu, na mobɔtwe afona edzi hɔn ekyir.
Na fa mu kumaabi, na fa kyekyer w’atar ano.
Na fa iyinom mu bi bio, na tow gu gya no mu, na hyew no wɔ gya no mu; no mu na gya befir aba Israel fifo nyina mu.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Jerusalɛm nye yi: medze no esi amanaman finimfin, na nkurow nkurow etwa no ho ehyia.
Na ɔatsew me ntsɛmbu do etua wɔ dɛ ɔayɛ emumuyɛ asen amanaman no, na m’ahyɛdze so do asen nkurow nkurow a etwa no ho ehyia no: na wɔapow m’atsɛmbudze, na m’ahyɛdze dze, wɔannantsew mu.
