Hom ntu mbuadadzi nsi nkyɛn, hom mfrɛ baguabɔ krɔnkrɔn, hom mboa mpanyimfo na asaase no do atsefo nyina ano mbra EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn fie, na hom nsu ntɔ EWURADZE do.
Ao da no a! Na EWURADZE ne da no abɛn, na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔsɛɛ a ofi otumfo no ne nkyɛn.
Ana wonntwaa edziban mmfii hɛn enyim, ana enyigye na ahosɛpɛw mmfii hɛn Nyankopɔn fie?
Aba aprɔw n’akɔfi ase; mputu adeda apanapan, asan ebubu; osiandɛ eburow akyenkyen.
Mbrɛ mbowa dua si apen a! Anyɛmbowakuw reberɛ, osiandɛ wonnyi edzidzibea; ɛhɛɛ, nguankuw ruhu amandze.
Ao EWURADZE, ɔwo na musu frɛ wo: na ogya ahyew sar do edzidzimbea, na ogyaframee ahyew hamu ndua nyinara.
Nyew, hambowa rehaahaw kyerɛ wo: osiandɛ nsu nwora nyina awewew, na ogya ahyew sar do edzidzimbea.
Hom mbɔ akasamu no mu wɔ Zion, na hom mbɔ ehuu wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do; hom mma asaase no do atsefo nyina ho mpopo: osiandɛ EWURADZE da no rudu, na ɔabɛn;
sum na kusuww da, fua na sum kebii da, dɛ ahanamakye a ayerɛw mbepɔw do; ɔman bi a ɔso na no ho yɛ dzen a ne saso mmbaa da a, eso n’ekyir bi remmba, dze ekesi mbasantsen pii mfe do mpo.
Ogya hyew dzi hɔn enyim; ogyaframee dzɛw dzi hɔn ekyir: hɔn enyim asaase tse dɛ Eden ture, na hɔn ekyir dze, sar huntuhuntu a; nyew, obi mmfi hɔn nsa.
Hɔn hwɛbea tse dɛ mpɔnkɔ hɔn hwɛbea; na wotu mbirika dɛ mpɔnkɔdofo.
Wohuruhuruw dɛ ntseaseanam kyirdidi wɔ mbepɔw do, dɛ gyaframee a ɔrehyew mburonan hurududuudu, dɛ dɔm a hɔn ho yɛ dzen a wɔatoto hɔn wɔ akono.
Aman ho guan hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim: na enyim nyina atotow.
Wotu mbirika dɛ mbarimba akatakyi; wɔfow afasu dɛ akombarimba; na wɔtsen fa hɔn akwan do, na wɔnntsew hɔn santsen mu.
Eso ɔbaako nnsun ne nyɛnko; hɔn nyina nenam hɔn mpasuar do: wɔbɔ hwira akodze mu a, wonnhuenyan.
Wɔyɛ kurow no mu menyamenya; wotutu afasu do mbirika; wɔfow kɔ efi mu; wɔnam ntokura mu hɛn mu dɛ owifo.
Asaase wosow wɔ hɔn enyim; ɔsor hihim: ewia na bosoom hyɛ sum, na nworaba yi hɔn hyerɛn fi hɔ:
na EWURADZE ma ne ndze do wɔ no dɔm enyim; na ne nseraban so dɛ; na nyia odzi n’asɛm ekyir no no ho yɛ dzen: na EWURADZE da no so na ɔyɛ hu dɛ; na woana botum enyim gyina?
Naaso seseiara mpo, EWURADZE na ɔse, hom mfa hom akoma nyina, na akɔnkyen, na osu, na ewuotwa nsan mbra me nkyɛn:
na hom nsunsuan hom akoma mu, na nnyɛ hom ntar a, na hom ndan mbra EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn nkyɛn: na ɔyɛ ɔdomfo, na mbɔbɔrhufo, ɔfa ebufuw nyaa, na n’adɔyɛ so, na ɔsakyer n’adwen wɔ mbusu ho.
Woana nyim dɛ ɔrennsan nnsakyer n’adwen, na onngya nhyira wɔ n’ekyir a, ɔyɛ edziban afɔr na ɔnom afɔr a wɔdze bɛma EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn?
Hom mbɔ akasamu no mu wɔ Zion, hom ntu akɔnkyen nsi nkyɛn, hom mfrɛ ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn:
hom mboa ɔman no ano, hom ntsew mboanofo no ho, hom nhyira nkɔdaa, hom mboa mbofraba ano, na enumfoanomba: hom mma ayeforkun mfi ne pia mu mpue, na ayefor mfi n’adankyir.

Hom mma asɔfo no, EWURADZE asomfo no, nsu wɔ nkrandaa na afɔrmbukyia no ntamu, na hom mma wɔnse dɛ, Kam wo man, ao EWURADZE, na mma mmfa w’egyapadze mma ahorohoraa, amma amanaman eenndzi hɔn do tum. Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔka no aman mu dɛ, Hɔn Nyankopɔn no wɔ hen?
Nna afei EWURADZE twee n’asaase ho nyinkun, na ohun ne man mbɔbɔr.
Na EWURADZE buae see ne man dɛ, Hwɛ, merebrɛ hom eburow, nsa, na ngo, na mama hom amee: na merennhyɛ hom ahorohoraa wɔ amanaman mu bio.

Na mibeyi kwaamu afamu dɔm no efi hom nkyɛn akɔ, na meetwuw hɔn adze akɔ asaase kwawee na amamfo do, na hɔn twafo dɔm no akɔ boka afamu po no mu, na hɔn nkyidɔm akɔ anee afamu po no ho; na hɔn bɔnee bɛyɛ kɛse, na hɔn nyaanyan so akɔ sor, osiandɛ woedzi bɔn dodow.
Asaase e, mma nnsuro, w’enyi ngye na dzi ehurusi; osiandɛ EWURADZE ayɛ ndzɛmba akɛse.
Hambowa, mma hom akoma nntu; na sar do mfunoma refefɛw, na dua rosow n’aba, adɔmbadua na wenyindua riyi hɔn ahoɔdzen ma.
Zionmba, hom enyi ngye, na hom ndzi ehurusi wɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn mu: na ɔrema hom esusow nsu wɔ tsenenee mu, na ɔrema nsu atɔ ama hom, esusow na ɔbɛsɛ nsu, wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu.
Na ewifua bɛhyɛ poroweebea amaama, na nsa na ngo bɛyɛ nkorbaa amaama ebu do.
Na mebɛhyɛ hom mfe a mbɛbɛw, nkonyinko, na esa, na efuse, mo dɔm a mosomaa hɔn baa hom do no dzii no, ananmu.
Na hom bedzidzi bafuu na hom amee, na hom eyi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a ɔnye hom edzi no nwanwa mu no ne dzin ayɛw: na me man n’enyim runngu ase dabiarada.
Na hom bohu dɛ mowɔ Israel finimfin, na dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, na obi nnyi hɔ bio: na me man enyim runngu ase dabiarada.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ n’ekyir no, mubohue mo sunsum egu adasa nyina do; na hom mbabanyin na hom mbabaa bɛhyɛ nkɔm, na hom nkɔdaa asoso adaa, hom mberantsɛ ehuhu enyido adze:
na eso hom nkowaa na hom mfonabaa do na mubohue mo sunsum egu wɔ nda no mu.
Na mebɛkyerɛ anwanwadze wɔ sor na asaase, bɔgya, na ogya wusiw kumbɔɔ.
Ewia bɛdan sum, na bosoom adan bɔgya ansaana EWURADZE ne da kɛse a ɔyɛ hu no aba.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ obiara a ɔbɔbɔ EWURADZE ne dzin no, wɔbɛgye no nkwa: na Zion bepɔw do na Jerusalɛm na dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka no, hɔn a wobefi nsa nye hɔn a EWURADZE refrɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn a wɔaka no mu no bɛtsena.
Na, hwɛ, nda na ber no mu a medze Juda na Jerusalɛm ndɔmmum bɛsan aba bio no,
mobɔboa amanaman nyina ano, na medze hɔn aba Jehosafat bɔnsa no mu; na menye hɔn edzi asɛm wɔ me man na m’egyapadze Israel ntsi, dɛ wɔabɔ hɔn apetse amanaman, na wɔakyɛ m’asaase mu.
Na wɔatwe me man ho tonto: na wɔdze abanyimbasiaba apɛ edwaman, na wɔatɔn akataasia agye nsa anom.
Hom reyɛ me dɛn, ao Taere, na Zidon, na Filistia amantɔw nyina? Ana hom bɛyɛ biribi ahyɛ me ananmu? Na sɛ hom yɛ biribi hyɛ me ananmu a, ɔhardo ntsɛmara na mebɛdan hom ahyɛnanmu no egu hom etsifi.
Osiandɛ hom afa mo dwetɛ na me sika, na hom dze m’afɛɛfɛdze papa no nyina kɔ hom asɔrdan no mu;
hom atɔn Judamba so na Jerusalɛm mba ama Griikfo mba, ama hom eeyi hɔn efi hɔn he do akɔ ekyirekyir:
hwɛ, mibekenyan hɔn efi mbrɛ hom tontɔɔn hɔn kɔree no, na madan hom ahyɛnanmu no ebua homankasa hom etsifi;
na mobɔtɔn hom mbabanyin na hom mbabaa ahyɛ Judamba nsa, na wɔbɔtɔn hɔn ama Seba mba, ɔman a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir; EWURADZE na ɔaka.
Hom mbɔ yi dawur wɔ amanaman mu; hom nkyer ɔsa: hom nkenyan mbarimba akatakyi no; hom mma akofo nyina ntwe mbɛn, wɔmfow mbra.
Hom mfa hom nsɔw mbobɔ mfona, na hom mfa hom ndar mbobɔ mpeaa: onyia ɔyɛ mberɛw nka dɛ, Meyɛ dzen.
Hom nyɛ ntsɛm mbra, hom amanaman a woetwa ehyia nyina, na hom mboa hom ano mbehyia. Ao EWURADZE, hɔ na ma w’akatakyi no wonsian mbra.
Amanaman nkenyan hɔnho, na wontu mbra Jehosafat bɔnsa no mu: na hɔ na mebɛtsena ase mebu amanaman a woetwa ehyia nyinara atsɛn.
Hom mfa kantankrankye no nto mu, na ekuadze no aber: hom mbra, hom mbetsiatsia; na nsatwer no ayɛ ma, nkorbaa no ebubu do; na hɔn emumuyɛ adɔɔ so.
Nyimpa mpempem mu mpempem wɔ atsɛmbu bɔnsa no mu. Na EWURADZE ne da no abɛn wɔ atsɛmbu bɔnsa no mu.
Ewia na bosoom ahyɛ sum; na nworaba egyaa hyerɛn.
Na EWURADZE befi Zion apɔw, na oefi Jerusalɛm ama ne ndze do; na ɔsorsor na asaase awosow: na EWURADZE bɛyɛ guansumabea ama ne man, na akoban ama Israelmba.
Ɔno na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a metse Zion, me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do no: nna Jerusalɛm bɛyɛ krɔnkrɔnbea, na ananaben biara runntwa mu wɔ hɔ bio.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mbepɔw bɔsosɔw nsa fenemfenem, na akoko no do apem numfonsu, na nsu ebu Juda nworaba nyina do; na nsunyiwa befi EWURADZE fie apem akɔfɔw Sittim bɔnsa no.
Egypt bɛyɛ amamfo, na Edom ayɛ sar kwawee, wɔ etsirmɔdzendze a wɔdze yɛɛ Judamba ntsi, na dɛ wɔaka bɔgya a odzi bem egu wɔ hɔn asaase do ntsi.
Na Juda dze, ɔbɛtsena hɔ daa, na Jerusalɛm fi mbasantsen ekesi mbasantsen.
Na mobɔtɔ hɔn bɔgyaa do wer a monntɔe no: na EWURADZE bɛtsena Zion.
Iyi nye dza Amos a ɔwɔ Tekoa nguanhwɛfo mu no hunii wɔ Israel ho wɔ Judahen Uzia ber do, na Israelhen Jeroboam a ɔyɛ Joas ne ba no ber do, mfe ebien ansaana asaasewosow no reba no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE fi Zion bɔpɔw, na oefi Jerusalɛm ama ne ndze do; na nguanhwɛfo no hɔn nguandzidzibea bedzi awerɛhow, na Karmel etsifi etwintwam.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Damaskɔs n’emumuyɛ ntaataado ntsi, merenndan ne ntsea no; osiandɛ wɔdze dadze ewuporow adze adwerew Gilead:
na mobɔto Hazael fie mu gya, na ɔahyew Ben-hadad ahemfie.
Na mubobubu Damaskɔs adaban, na metwa hɔn a wɔtse Aven bɔnsa mu no efi hɔ, na nyia okitsa ahempoma no efi Bɛt-eden: na Siriaman bɔkɔ ndɔmmum mu wɔ Kir, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Gaza n’emumuyɛ ntaataado ntsi, merenndan ne ntsea no; osiandɛ wɔfaa ɔman no nyinara ndɔmmum, dɛ wɔdze hɔn rekɛhyɛ Edom nsa:
na mobɔto Gaza ɔfasu mu gya, na ɔahyew n’ahemfi no:
na mubotwa hɔn a wɔtse Ashdod no efi hɔ, na nyia okitsa ahempoma no efi Ashkelon: na madan me nsa etsia Ekron, na Filistiafo nkaa no ase ahyew, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Taere n’emumuyɛ ntaataado ntsi, merenndan ne ntsea no; osiandɛ woyii ɔman no nyinara hyɛɛ Edom nsa, na wɔannkaa enuanom ahyɛmudzi no:
na mobɔto Taere ɔfasu mu gya, na ɔahyew n’ahemfi no.

Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Edom n’emumuyɛ ntaataado ntsi, merenndan ne ntsea no; osiandɛ ɔdze afona tsiiw no nua, na ɔtoow ayamuhyehye nyina gui, na n’ebufuw tsetseew adze mu daa, na odzii n’abohur ekyir daa:
na mobɔto Teman mu gya, na ɔahyew Bozra ahemfi no.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Ammonmba hɔn mbrato ntaataado ntsi, merenndan ne ntsea no; osiandɛ wɔapaapaa Gilead enyinsemfo mu, ma wɔdze aatrɛ hɔn he mu:
na mobɔto Rabaa ɔfasu mu gya, na ɔahyew n’ahemfi no, wɔbɛtse ɔko mu gyegyeegye, na ɔko no bɛyɛ dzen dɛ ehum wɔ ekyinehyia mframa da mu:
na hɔn hen bɔkɔ ndɔmmum, ɔno na n’asafohemfo bɔbɔ mu akɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Moab n’emumuyɛ ntaataado ntsi, merenndan ne ntsea no; osiandɛ ɔhyeew Edomhen ne mbiew dɛ kaadow:
na mobɔto Moab mu gya, na ɔahyew Keriot ahemfi no; na Moab dze weɔɔweɔɔyɛ, na esebɔ, na akasamu ne ndze bowu:
na mubotwa no mu atsɛmbufo efi hɔ, na mekuku n’asafohemfo nyina aka no ho, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Juda n’emumuyɛ do ntaataa ntsi, merenndan ne ntsea no; osiandɛ wɔapow EWURADZE ne mbra, na woenndzi n’ahyɛdze do, na hɔn atorsɛm a hɔn egyanom dzii ekyir no ama wɔafomfom:
na mobɔto mu Juda gya, na ɔahyew Jerusalɛm ahemfi no.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Israel n’emumuyɛ ntaataado ntsi, merenndan ne ntsea no; osiandɛ wɔatɔn ɔtseneneenyi agye dwɛɛtɛɛ, na mpaboa ntsi, wɔatɔn ohianyi:
hɔn a hɔn enyi ber ohianyi n’etsifi huntuma kakra no mpo, na wɔkyea ɔbrɛfo no kwan: na banyin na n’egya kɔ akataasia kor ho, dze gu me dzin krɔnkrɔn no ho fi:
na wɔda ahoba tam do wɔ afɔrmbukyia nkyɛnmu, na wɔnom hɔn a wɔabɔ hɔn kaw no nsa wɔ hɔn Nyankopɔn fie.
Naaso mesɛɛ hɔn enyim Amorinyi a ne tsentsen tse dɛ odum atsentsen, na no ho yɛ dzen dɛ esudur no, na mesɛɛ no nduadzewa wɔ sor, na no ndwow so wɔ ase.
Eso emi na medze hom fii Egypt asaase do firii, na midzii hom enyim mfe eduanan wɔ sar no do, dɛ wɔmfa Amorinyi n’asaase no.
Na memaa hom mba binom do hyɛɛ hɔn nkɔnhyɛfo, na hom mberantsɛ no binom meyɛɛ hɔn Nazirifo. Ao Israelmba, aso nnyɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ara bi nye no? EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na mbom hom maa Nazirifo nsa ma wɔnomee; na hom hyɛɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no dɛ, Mma hom nnhyɛ nkɔm.
Hwɛ, mobɔhom hom do wɔ hom bea hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ hwiir a efiefi ahyɛ no ma no ɔhom adze do.
Na enguantu bɔbɔ ahoɔharfo, na ɔhoɔdzennyi rennhyɛ n’ahoɔdzen mu dzen, eso ɔkatakyi runntum noho gye:
eso nyia okitsa egyen no rinngyina; na nyia n’anan ho yɛ har no renngye noho: eso nyia ɔtse pɔnkɔ do no ɔrenngye noho:
na nyia ɔwɔ akokodur wɔ akatakyi no mu no mpo no, ɔdze adagyaw boguan wɔ da no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Israelmba e, hom ntsie asɛm bi a EWURADZE aka wɔ hom ho, hom ahom yɛ ebusua kɛse a miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do bae no dɛ,
Hom nko ara na minyim hom wɔ asaase do mbusua nyina mu: dɛm ntsi na medze hom emumuyɛ nyina bɛba ebogu hom do no.
Aso beenu botum abɔ mu anantsew a hɔn adwen nnsaa anaa?
Aso gyata bɔpɔw kwaa mu, ber a onnyaa afonam biara? Ana ogyatafɔr bɛma ne ndze do wɔ no bɔn mu, ber a ɔnnkyeer biribiara?
Aso anoma bi bɔtɔ efir mu wɔ asaase do mbrɛ wonnsuaa efir bi wɔ hɔ mmaa no? Aso efir bohuan efi famu, ber a ɔmmpaa hweeara?
Aso wɔbɔbɔ akasamu mu akɔ kurow mu, na ɔman no bo nnkotu? Aso mbusu bɛba kurow bi do, a nnyɛ EWURADZE na ɔmaa no bae?
Ampaara dɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn rennyɛ biribi, gyedɛ oeyi n’esumasɛm akyerɛ no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no ansaana.
Gyata apɔw, woana na onnkosuro? EWURADZE Nyankopɔn akasa, woana na ɔnnkɛhyɛ nkɔm?
Hom mbɔ no dawur wɔ Ashdod ahemfie, na Egypt asaase do ahemfie, na hom nse dɛ, Hom mboa hom ano wɔ Samaria mbepɔw do, na hom nhwɛ no mu weɔɔweɔɔyɛ pii no, na nhyɛdo a ɔwɔ mu no.
Na wonnyim dza ɔtsen yɛ, EWURADZE na ɔse, hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ hɔn ahemfie enyimpidze na ewifodze amaama.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Ahohiahianyi bi bɛba ebotwa asaase no ho ehyia: na ɔdze w’ahoɔdzen efi wo ho ahwe famu, na wɔafa w’ahemfi no afo.

Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Dɛ mbrɛ sɛ oguanhwɛfo hwim abowa fi gyata anomu a ne nsa ka anan ebien, anaa asowasin bi no; dɛmara so na wobohwim Israelmba a wɔtsetse Samaria mu no tse dɛ adamu ne fa bi na mpadotam sin bi.
Hom ntsie na hom ndzi Jakob fie dase, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, dɔm EWURADZE, na ɔse.
Na da a medze Israel mbrato ho asotwe bɛba no do no, mebɛsɛɛ Bɛtɛl afɔrmbukyia so, na woetwitwa afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn, na ɔahwe ase.
Na mobɔbɔ awɔwber fi aka ɔhyewber fi ho; na asombɛn efi no bɛsɛɛ, na efi akɛse pii no aba ewiei, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hom ntsie asɛm yi, hom Basan anantwiber a hom wɔ Samaria bepɔw do a hom hyɛ abɔbɔfo, hom dwerew ehiafo, na hom se hɔn wuranom dɛ, Hom mfa mbra ma yɛnnom.
EWURADZE Nyankopɔn aka no krɔnkrɔnyɛ ho ntam, dɛ, hwɛ, nda bɛba hom do a wɔdze dadze kɔtɔkorba bɔtwe hom akɔ, na wɔdze apofo nkwaba atwe hom nkaase so.
Na hom bodua ban ntokur mu epue, obiara afa n’enyim tsenn; na hom atow homho egu Harmon, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hom mbra Bɛtɛl, mbɔto mbra; hom mbra Gilgal, mbɛma mbrato ndɔɔ so; na hom mfa hom kum afɔr mbra anapa anapa, na hom ebupɛn du du ndaansa ndaansa;
na hom mfa mbɔr kawee nhyew ndaase afɔr, na hom nhyɛ ayamuyi ayɛyɛdze na hom mfa ntahye: na iyi na hom pɛ, ao hom Israelmba, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Na emi so memaa hom se kwawee wɔ hom nkurow nyina mu, na edziban ho hia wɔ hom mbeambea nyina: naaso hom nnsanee mmbaa me nkyɛn, EWURADZE na ɔse.

Na emi so makam hom nsutɔ ber a nkyɛ aka abosoom ebiasa na otwaber edu no: na motɔɔ nsu guu kurow kor do, na mamma bi anntɔ enngu kurow kor so do: nsu tɔree guu kwaa bi do, na kwaa a nsu anntɔ enngu do no, ɔhyewee.
Dɛm ntsi nkurow ebien anaa ebiasa wonawonae kɔr kurow kor do kɔnoom nsu na wɔammee: naaso hom nnsanee mmbaa me nkyɛn EWURADZE na ɔse.
Medze ohuw na ɔpo mabɔ hom: hom nture na hom wenyin nture na hom adɔmbandua na hom ngondua dodow no mbɛbɛw awe: naaso hom nnsanee mmbaa me nkyɛn, EWURADZE na ɔse.

Medze ɔyardɔm a ɔtse dɛ Egypt dze no aba hom mu: medze afona ekuku hom mberantsɛ, na masoa hom mpɔnkɔ kɔ; na mama hom nseraban mu bɔnee asoɛr adɔ hom ahwen mu mpo: naaso hom nnsanee mmbaa me nkyɛn, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Mebutuw hom mu binom, dɛ mbrɛ mubutuuw Sodom na Gomora, na hom yɛɛ dɛ gyantsia a woetu efi gya mu: naaso hom nnsanee mmbaa me nkyɛn: EWURADZE na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi, Israel e, mbrɛ medze bɛyɛ wo nye yi oo: osiandɛ mebɛyɛ wo dɛm ntsi, siesie woho hyia wo Nyankopɔn.
Na, hwɛ, nyia ɔhyehyɛ mbepɔw, na ɔbɔ mframa, na ɔkyerɛ nyimpa dza ɔwɔ n’adwen mu, ɔno a ɔyɛ adzekyee sum, na otsiatsia asaase no sorɔnsorɔmbea do no; EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn, nye ne dzin.
Ao Israelmba, hom ntsie asɛm bi a mema do dɛ kwadwom wɔ hom ho.
Israel baabun ahwe ase; ɔronnsoɛr bio: wɔatow no akyen wɔ n’asaase do; obi nnyi hɔ a ɔma no do.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Kurow a ɔdze apem tui no, ɔbɛka no ɔha, na dza ɔdze ɔha tui no, ɔbɛka no du, dze ama Israelmba.
Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se Israelmba nye yi, Hom nhwehwɛ me, ama hom eenya nkwa:
na mma nnhwehwɛ Bɛtɛl, eso mma hom nnhɛn Gilgal, na mma hom nntwa mu nnkɔ Beer-seba: na ndɔmmum ara na Gilgal bɔkɔ, na Bɛtɛl bɛyɛ gyan.
Hom nhwehwɛ EWURADZE, na hom enya nkwa; amma oeemmpue dɛ gya wɔ Josef fi mu na ɔaannhyew osiandɛ obi nnyi hɔ a obodum no wɔ Bɛtɛl:
hom a hom dan atsɛmbu bɔwen, na hom dze tsenenee hwehwe famu;
hwehwɛ onyia no a ɔyɛ nworaba a bi nye Aberwa na mba na Etsekwagyan, na ɔdan sum kebii adzekyee, na ɔma adzekyee hyɛ anadwe sum; ɔno a ɔfrɛ po nsu, na ohue gu asaase enyi no; EWURADZE nye ne dzin;
ɔno a ɔma ɔsɛɛ pue awora ba ɔhoɔdzennyi do, na ɔma ɔsɛɛ ba abankɛse do no.
Wɔtan nyia ɔka enyim wɔ abobokɛse mu, na wokyir nyia ɔkasa tɔɔtsen.
Dɛm ntsi susuampaara dɛ hom tsiatsia ɔbɔbɔfo do, na hom gye no hɔ apempem ewifua ntsi: hom esisi abo twae adan, naaso hom renntsena mu; hom atsetsɛw wenyin nture fɛɛfɛw, na hom ronnom mu nsa.
Na minyim mbrɛ hom mbrato dua dɔɔ so, na mbrɛ hom bɔn dua yɛ dzen; hom a hom hiahia ɔtseneneenyi ho, hom gye mboaba, na hom kyea ehiafo asɛm wɔ kuropɔn mu (asɛndzii).
Dɛm ntsi ɔbadwembanyi no bɛyɛ komm wɔ dɛm ber no mu; osiandɛ ɔyɛ ber bɔn.
Hom nhwehwɛ papa, na nnyɛ bɔn a, ama hom eenya nkwa: nna EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn no, nye hom bɛtsena dɛ mbrɛ hom ka no.
Hom ntan bɔn, na hom ndɔ papa, na hom ntsintsim atsɛmbu wɔ asɛndzii: na bi a EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn no, bohu Josef nkaase no mbɔbɔr.

Dɛm ntsi Jehova, dɔm Nyankopɔn, EWURADZE no, mbrɛ ɔse nye yi: Ewuotwa bɛba abɔntsen nyinara do; na wɔbɛka wɔ abrɔn nyinara mu dɛ, Ebei! Ebei! Na wɔbɛfrɛ okuafo ma oedzi nkɔmbɔ, na abefo ma woetwa ewuo.
Na ewuotwa bɛba wenyin nture nyina mu: osiandɛ mubotwa mu edua wo mu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hom a hom afe EWURADZE ne da no, hom ndue! Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom repɛ EWURADZE ne da no? Hwɛ ɔyɛ sum o, na nnyɛ kan bi a.
Ɔtse dɛ nyimpa bi ruguan gyata, na osisi ehyia no anaa ɔaba fie dze ne nsa akɔtwer ban, na ɔwɔ aka no.
Aso EWURADZE ne da no nnyɛ sum na ɔbɛyɛ, na nnyɛ kan o? Sum katoo a hyerɛn biara nnyi mu a.
Mikyir, na mopow hom afahyɛ nda no, na mirinnya enyigye biara wɔ hom ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn no mu.
Nyew, sɛ hom dze hom ɔhyew afɔr na edziban afɔr brɛ me mpo a, m’enyi ronnsɔ: eso murummbu hom mbowa a wɔadɔ seradze no ho asomdwee afɔr no bi.
Fa w’adwontow ne dede no fi mo do; na mirinntsie w’asanku ne dɛɛdɛw no.
Mbom hom mma atsɛmbu mpem mbra dɛ nsu, na ndzeyɛtsenenee mbra dɛ nsu pramee.
Ao Israelmba, ana hom na wɔdze okum afɔr na ayɛyɛdze brɛɛ me wɔ sar no do mfe eduanan no?
Ɛhɛɛ, hom asoa hom hen Sakut na hom ehonyi Kiun, ɔbosom a hom yɛe maa hom ho no nworaba.
Dɛm ntsi na mebɛma hom akɔ ndɔmmum atra Damaskɔs, EWURADZE a ne dzin dze dɔm Nyankopɔn no, na ɔse.
Wondue, hɔn a wɔtse dwudwoodwo wɔ Zion, na hɔn a wɔayɛ sɔkyee wɔ Samaria bepɔw do, amanaman etsitsir mu dansewa a Israelfo kɔ hɔn nkyɛn no!
Hom mbɛsen nkɔ Kalne nkɔhwɛ, na hom mfi hɔ nkɔ Hamat kɛse: na nkyii hom nsian nkɔ Filistiafo Gat: aso woye kyɛn ahendzi yinom? Anaa aso hɔn he so kyɛn hom he?
Hom a hom tu mbusu da no kɔ ekyirekyir, na hom ma emimdzi egua no twe bɛn;
wɔdeda asombɛn mpa do, na wɔtsen hɔnho bebew n’adamu egua do, na wɔwe nguambaa no fi nguankuw no mu, na wɔwe anantwimba fi anantwiban mu;
hɔn a wɔtow enyihaw ndwom yi sanku ano; hɔn a wɔbɔ hɔn tsirmu hyehyɛ sanku ho adze ma hɔnho dɛ David;
hɔn a wɔnom nsa wɔ ndweraa mu, na wɔdze nduhuam tsitsir sera hɔnho; na mbom Josef ahohia no dze ɔnnyɛ hɔn awerɛhow.
Dɛm ntsi afei wɔnye hɔn a wodzi kan kɔ ndɔmmum no bɔkɔ ndɔmmum mu, na hɔn a wɔtsentseen hɔn mu bebeew hɔ no hɔn nsagua etwa mu.
EWURADZE Nyankopɔn aka no ho ntam, EWURADZE dɔm Nyankopɔn no na ɔse: Mikyir Jakob n’ahopɔw no, na metan n’ahemfi no: dɛm ntsi mibeyi kurow no na dza ɔwɔ mu nyina ama.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ ɔka nyimpa du wɔ fie kor mu a, wobowuwu.

Na sɛ obi no busuanyi bi, nyia ɔhyew no no, sɛ ɔma no do dɛ ɔdze ne mbiew rifi fie hɔ, na obisa nyia ɔwɔ fie no ne mpiakyir mu no dɛ: Ana obi da ho nye wo wɔ hɔ a? Nna ɔbɛse no dɛ, Oho ɔasa. Na ɔno so bɛse dɛ, Ka w’ano to mu; na yɛrommbɔ EWURADZE dzin.
Na, hwɛ, EWURADZE ahyɛ, na wɔdze ntokur ntokur bɔbɔ fi kɛse no, na wɔdze mpaapaae abɔ ofi kakraba no.
Aso mpɔnkɔ botu mbirika wɔ abotan do? Ana obi dze anantwi bofuntum hɔ? Nna hom adan atsɛmbu bɔwema, na hom adan tsenenee no nsowee bɔwen yi?
Hom a hom gye hom enyi wɔ Lo-debar (adze huhuw) ho, na hom se dɛ, Ana nnyɛ hɛn ahoɔdzen na yɛdze agye Karnaim (mmbɛn) ama hɛnho?
Na, hwɛ, ao Israel fi, mebɛma ɔman bi do etsia hom, EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn no na ɔse; na wofi Hamat ahɛnee behiahia hom ho araa ekodu ɔwora Araba ho.
Dɛm na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn dze kyerɛɛ me: na, hwɛ ɔyɛɛ mbɛbɛw wɔ ekyir mfuwii no ne fifir ahyɛse; ɔhen no ndɔwee n’ekyir mfuwii a.
Na ɔbaa dɛ wowiee asaase no do efuw nyina dzi no, nna mesee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, mokotow meserɛ wo, fa kyɛ: Jakob bɛyɛ dɛn egyina, osiandɛ osuar.
Na EWURADZE sesaa n’adwen wɔ iyi ho: Ɔremmba no dɛm, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Dɛm na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn dze kyerɛɛ me: na, hwɛ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn frɛɛ ogya dze buu atsɛn; na ɔmeen bun dɔnkuronn no, na nkyɛ ɔrepɛ amen asaase no koraa.
Nna mesee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, gyaa, mokotow meserɛ wo: Jakob bɛyɛ dɛn egyina? osiandɛ osuar.
EWURADZE sesaa n’adwen wɔ iyi so ho. Iyi so remmba no dɛm, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Ɔkyerɛɛ me fofor so: na, hwɛ, EWURADZE gyina ɔfasu a wɔdze promo towee no do, na promo kitsa ne nsamu.
Na EWURADZE bisaa me dɛ, Amos, ebɛnadze na ihu yi? Na mesee dɛ, Promo a. Nna EWURADZE see dɛ, Hwɛ, medze promo mibesi me man Israel finimfin; merennda ho mmpa hɔn ho bio:
na Isaak sorɔnsorɔmbea bɛyɛ afoafo, na Israel krɔnkrɔnmbea bɛdeda apanapan; na medze afona bɔsoɛr Jeroboam fi do.
Nna Bɛtɛl ɔsɔfo Amazia somae kɔr Israelhen Jeroboam nkyɛn, dɛ, Amos apam wo tsir do wɔ Israel fi finimfin: asaase no nntum nnsoa n’asɛm nyina.
Na mbrɛ Amos ka nye yi, Jeroboam bowu afona ano, na wɔdze Israel befi n’asaase do akɔ ndɔmmum mu ara ampa.
Eso Amazia see Amos dɛ, Ao ɔdzehufo, bɔ wo ho eguaa kɔ Juda asaase do, na kedzidzi wɔ hɔ, na hyɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔ:
na mma nnda ho nnhyɛ nkɔm bio wɔ Bɛtɛl: na ɔyɛ ɔhen no no krɔnkrɔnbea, na ɔyɛ ahemfi so.
Nna Amos buae see Amazia dɛ, Mennyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi, eso mennyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi ba; mbom meyɛ mbowahwɛfo, na nyia osiesie adɔmba ndua ho:
na EWURADZE bɛfaa me fii nguan no ekyirdzi, na Ɔsee me dɛ, Kɔ, kɛhyɛ me man Israel nkɔm.
Dɛm ntsi afei tsie EWURADZE n’asɛm: Ɔwo eka dɛ, Mma nnhyɛ nkɔm nntsia Israel, na mma w’asɛm nnsosɔw nngu Isaak fi do;

dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Wo yer bɛyɛ edwaman wɔ kurow no mu, na wo mbabanyin na wo mbabaa atotɔ afona ano, na wɔdze susuhoma akyɛ w’asaase; na wankasa so bowu wɔ asaase fifi do, na wɔbɛfa Israel efi n’asaase do akɔ ndɔmmum mu ara ampa.
Dɛm na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn dze kyerɛɛ me: na, hwɛ, ɔpɛber mu eduaba kɛntsɛn ma.
Na obisaa me dɛ, Amos, ebɛnadze na ihu yi? Na mesee dɛ, Ɔpɛber eduaba kɛntsɛn ma. Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, Ewiei no aba me man Israel do; merennda ho mmpa hɔn ho bio.
Na asɔrfi mu ndwom bɛdan ewuotwa wɔ da no mu, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse: efun bɔdɔɔ so; wɔnam dzinn bɔtotow hɔn egugu mbea nyina.
Hom ntsie yi, hom a hom repɛ ehiafo amemen hɔn, na wɔama abɔbɔfo asa asaase no do,
na hom bisa dɛ, Dabɛn na bosoom fofor no bɔkɔ, ma yaatɔn eburow? Na ahomgyeda no, ma yeetue ewifua ano? Na yaayɛ efa ketseaba, na dwetɛbona kɛse, na yɛdze akɔhwi nsɛn eesisi
ama yɛdze dwɛɛtɛɛ aatɔ ɔbɔbɔfo, na yɛdze mpaboa ha na ha, atɔ ohianyi, na yaatɔn ewifua ntɔmpamu no.
EWURADZE aka Jakob n’ahopɔw ho ntam, dɛ, Ampaara mo werɛ rimmfir hɔn ndwuma no mu biara da.
Aso asaase no nnkɔwosow wɔ iyi ntsi, ma obiara a ɔtse do edzi nkɔmbɔ? Ɛhɛɛ, obeyir dɛ Esutsen Nael; na wɔbɔfon no na ɔatwe bio, dɛ Egypt Esutsen.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, dɛ mebɛma wi atɔ ewiaber, na mahyɛ asaase do sum adzekyee petee.
Na mebɛdan hom afahyɛ nkɔmbɔdzi, na hom ndwom nyina ewuotwa; na mebɛma eyitam akyekyer asen nyina, na etsipaa aba tsir nyina do; na mebɛma ɔayɛ dɛ bakor ho ewuotwa, na n’ewiei ayɛ dɛ da a ɔyɛ wen.
Hwɛ, nda reba, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, dɛ mebɛma ɔkɔm aba asaase no do, nnyɛ edzibankɔm, anaa nsukɔm, na EWURADZE n’asɛntsie ho kɔm a.
Na wobekyima fi po ho ekesi po ho, na wofi kwaamu afamu ekesi boka afamu; wobedzi akɔnaaba dɛ wɔrohwehwɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm ekyir kwan, na worunnhu.
Da no mu no mbaabun fɛɛfɛw na mberantsɛ bɔtotɔ bitsi wɔ nsukɔm ntsi.
Hɔn a wɔka Samaria bɔn ne ntam, na wɔse dɛ, Ao Dan, dɛ wo nyame tse ase yi; na dɛ Beer-seba nyame tse ase yi; hɔn mpo wɔbɔtɔr, na wɔronnsoɛr bio ara da.

Muhun EWURADZE dɛ ogyina afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn: na ɔsee dɛ, Bɔ etsifi apɔw no ma mpondua no nwosow: na bubu gu hɔn nyina etsifi; na medze afona bokuku hɔn a wɔbɛka ekyir no; hɔn mu kor mpo runnguan, na hɔn mu kor mpo rimmfi nsa.
Sɛ wɔbɔr kɔ samanadze a, me nsa bɛfa hɔn efi hɔ aba; na sɛ wɔfow kɔ sor a, medze hɔn befi hɔ esian.
Na sɛ wokosuma hɔnho wɔ Bepɔw Karmel etsifi a, mobɔkɔ hɔn atwee akɛfa hɔn efi hɔ; na sɛ wofi m’enyim kosuma po ase a, mebɛhyɛ ɔwɔ ma oefi hɔ akeka hɔn.
Na sɛ wɔkɔ hɔn atamfo enyim ndɔmmum a, mebɛhyɛ ma afona efi hɔ ekuku hɔn: na medze m’enyi betsim hɔn do wɔ mbusu ntsi, na nnyɛ papa bi a.
Na EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn no, nye nyia ɔka asaase ma ɔnan, ma hɔn a wɔtse do nyina dzi nkɔmbɔ; na ne nyina beyir dɛ Esutsen Nael; na ɔatwe bio dɛ Egypt Esutsen no;
ɔno na osi ne mpia wɔ sor, na ɔato ne samandan ase wɔ asaase; ɔno a ɔfrɛ po mu nsu na ohue gu asaase enyi; EWURADZE nye ne dzin.
Ao Israelmba, ana hom nnyɛ me dɛ Etiopiafo mba? Ana nnyɛ emi na medze Israel fii Egypt asaase no do, na Filistiafo fii Kaftor, na Siriafo fii Kir?
Hwɛ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn enyi sa ahendzi bɔn no, na mebɛsɛɛ no efi asaase enyi; gyedɛ Jakob fiefo nko na merennsɛɛ hɔn korakora, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na, hwɛ, mebɛhyɛ ma wɔaapo Israel do wɔ amanaman nyina mu, dɛ mbrɛ wɔpo ewu do wɔ mpododze mu, naaso ewifua kakraabi ronntɔ famu.
Me man mu ndzebɔnyɛfo nyina bowu afona anomu, hɔn a wɔka dɛ, Mbusu ronnto hɛn, eso orunntwar hɛn ano no.
Da no mu na mebɛma David ntamadan a egura no do egyina, na mesisiw no ntokur no; na mama n’afasin no do, na matow no dɛ tsetse nda no:
ama wɔaafa Edom nkaa no ayɛ hɔndze, na amanaman a wɔdze me dzin frɛ hɔn no nyina, EWURADZE a ɔyɛ iyi nyina no na ɔse.
Hwɛ, nda reba, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ nyia ofuntum bɔto nyia otwa, na nyia otsiatsia wenyinaba do bɔto nyia ɔpe aba; na mbepɔw bɔsosɔw nsa fenemfenem, na akoko nyinara anan.
Na medze me man Israel no befi ndɔmmum asan aba, na wɔbɛkyekyer ekurow afoafo no, na wɔatsenatsena mu; na wɔbɛtsetsɛw wenyin nture, na wɔanom ne nsa no bi; wɔbɛyɛ nture so, na woedzi mu aba.
Na mebɛtsetsɛw hɔn wɔ hɔn asaase do, na wonnkotutu hɔn efi hɔn asaase a medze ama hɔn no do, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
Obadia n’enyido adzehu nye yi. Dza EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ka wɔ Edom ho nye yi. Yɛatse EWURADZE n’anosɛm, dɛ wɔasoma ahembɔfo kɔ amanaman mu, dɛ, Hom nsoɛr, na yentu nkɛhyɛ Edom do nye no nko.
EWURADZE se Edom dɛ, hwɛ, mayɛ wo kakraba wɔ amanaman mu: na woebu wo enyimtsia papaara.
W’akoma no nkontompɔ adaadaa wo, ao ɔwo a etse abotan ntokur mu a wo tsenabea krɔn; ɔwo a eka no w’akoma mu dɛ, Woana botum dze me edwir famu?
Kaansa efow kɔ mbrɛ ɔkrɔn dɛ ɔkɔr, na sɛ edze nworaba ntamu kɛyɛ wo tsenabew mpo a, medze wo befi hɔ edwir, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Sɛ ewifo anaa edwotwafo baa wo do anadwe a, aso nkyɛ wonnkowia wo na woegya wo ase kakra? Sɛ wenyinaba tsetsewfo baa wo do bɛtsetseew w’aba a, aso nkyɛ wonnkegya aba a wodzi no mpɛpɛw?
Na ɔwo Esau dze, hwɛ mbrɛ woedua aprapra wo ndzɛmba ase na wɔasesaw w’akoradze a edze sumae no a! Ampaara, ɔayɛ wo pasapasa.
W’apambuafo nyina esunsun wo araa ekodu ɔhe do: nyimpa a wɔnye wo tse asomdwee mu no adaadaa wo, na woedzi wo do nyim; hɔn a wɔnye wo dzidzi esua w’ase efir; naaso ɔwo dze, innyim.
Aso nnyɛ da no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse, na mebɛsɛɛ enyansafo efi Edom, na ntseasee fi Esau bepɔw do?
Na Teman e, w’akatakyi bo botu araa, ma ekodu dɛ woboku obiara efi Esau bepɔw do.
W’etsiɔdzendze a edze yɛɛ wo nua Jakob ntsi, enyito bɛkata wo do, na woetwa wo akyen daa.
Wɔ Da no a igyinaa nkyɛn, ma ananaben soaa n’ahodze kɔree, na ahɔho kɛhɛɛn no mbobokɛse mu, na wɔtwee Jerusalɛm ho tonto no mu no, nna ɔwoara so yɛɛ dɛ hɔn mu baako.
Nkyɛ onnyi dɛ edan w’ekyir ma wo nua wɔ n’ahokyer da no mu; na inndzi Judamba eduwa dɛ hɔn atamfo sɛɛ hɔn ntsi; eso nkyɛ onnyi dɛ isi hɔn atwetwe wɔ hɔn ahohia da no mu.

Nkyɛ mma nnhɛn me man n’abobokɛse mu wɔ hɔn mbusu da no mu; ɛhɛɛ, nkyɛ onnyi dɛ edze enyigye hwɛ hɔn ahohia wɔ hɔn mbusu da no mu, eso nkyɛ mma hom mmfa hom nsa nnto hɔn ahodze do wɔ hɔn mbusu da no mu.
Onnyi dɛ nkyɛ igyina nkwanta do twitwa ne nyimpa a wofii nsa no; na nkyɛ mma nnyi no dɔm a wɔaka no mma wɔ ahokyer da no mu.
Na EWURADZE ne da no abɛn wɔ amanaman nyina do: Edom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo ayɛ no dɛmara na wɔdze bɛyɛ wo; wo ndzeyɛɛ bɛsan ebobua woara w’etsifi.

Na dɛ mbrɛ amandzehu boow me man Juda dɛ nsa wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do no, dɛmara so na ɔbɔbow amanaman nyina daa, ɛhɛɛ, wobehyia dza ɔkyɛn dɛm mpo, na amandzehu no bɛmen hɔn araa ma hɔn ase ahyew koraa.
Na Zion bepɔw do hɔ na hɔn a woefi nsa bɛtsena, na ɔbɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn; na Jakob fie bɛsan afa hɔn enyadze no edzi.
Na Jakob fie bɛyɛ ogya, na Josef fie ayɛ ogyaframee, naaso Esau fie dze, ɔbɛyɛ dɛ mburonan, na wɔbɛhyew wɔ hɔn mu, na wɔamemen hɔn: na obiara rennka mma Esau fie; EWURADZE na ɔaka.
Na Pomu afamufo no bɛfa Esau bepɔw no ayɛ egyapadze; na ɔbɔnmufo no bɛfa Filistiafo dze: na wɔbɛfa Samaria asaase na Efraim asaase edzi do: na Benjamin bɛfa Gilead edzi do.
Na Israelmba dɔm yi ndɔmmumfo no bɛfa dza ɔyɛ Keenanfo dze no dze ekesi Zarefat; na Jerusalɛm ndɔmmumfo a wɔwɔ Sefarad no bɛfa Pomu afamu nkurow no edzi do.
Na agyefo bɔfow aba Zion bepɔw do na woebedzi Esau bepɔw no do; na ahendzi no bɛyɛ EWURADZE nankasa dze.
Afei EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Amittai ba Jona hɔ, dɛ,
Soɛr, kɔ Ninive, kurow kɛse no mu, na kɔbɔ no dawur kyerɛ hɔn dɛ: hɔn emumuyɛ afow aba m’enyim.
Na Jona soɛɛr dɛ oruguan efi EWURADZE enyim akɔ Tarsis; na ɔkɔr Jopa, na ohun hɛn bi a ɔrokɔ Tarsis: nna otuaa kaw na ɔfowee, dɛ oruguan efi EWURADZE enyim nye hɔn akɔ Tarsis.
Na EWURADZE maa aahow kɛsenara bɔe wɔ po no do, na ehum dzendzen tui wɔ po no do, na hɛn no yɛɛ dɛ ɔrobobɔ.
Nna asarfo no suroi, na obiara tseatseaa mu frɛfrɛɛ no bosom; na wɔtotoow hɛn no mu eguadze guguu po mu, ama aayɛ har ama hɔn. Nna Jona dze, oesian akɔ hɛn no n’ase noho beebi; na ɔakɛda heii.
Nna hɛnwura no baa ne nkyɛn, na obisaa no dɛ, Ɔdafo a ada, wo nda yi ase nye dɛn? Soɛr, su frɛ wo nyame, bi a wo nyame no bɔdwen hɛn do, amma yaanntɔr wɔ po yi do.
Nna wɔsesee hɔnho, dɛ, Hom mbra ma yɛntwe tonto, na yenhu nyia osian ne ntsi ma mbusu yi aba hɛn do. Na wɔtwee tonto, na tonto no bɔɔ Jona.
Nna wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛserɛ wo ara, kyerɛ hɛn nyia osian ne ntsi ma mbusu yi aba hɛn do; eyɛ ebɛn edwuma na ifi hen bae? Ifi ɔman bɛn mu na wo nkyir nye hen?
Na obuaa hɔn dɛ, Meyɛ Hebriwnyi; na mosɔr EWURADZE, ɔsor Nyankopɔn no a ɔyɛɛ po na asaase wewew no.
Nna suro kɛsenara kaa nyimpa no, na wɔsee no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ayɛ yi? Nna nyimpa no nyim dɛ ofi EWURADZE enyim guanee, osiandɛ nna ɔaka akyerɛ hɔn.
Na wobisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na yɛnyɛ wo, ma po yi n’ano ndwe mma hɛn? Osiandɛ nna po no da ho ara hur tutuutu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma mo do, na hom ntow me nkyen po no mu; nna po no ano bɔdwe ama hom: na minyim dɛ emi ntsi na ehum kɛse yi aba hom do.
Naaso nyimpa no kwaan dzendzen dɛ wɔresan ebodwir asaase wewew do; na woenntum: osiandɛ po no kɔr do araa huur tutuutu hyiaa hɔn.

Dɛm ntsi wɔkekaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE, na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛserɛ wo, EWURADZE, yɛserɛ wo, mma mma yɛnntɔr wɔ nyimpa yi no nkwa ntsi, na afei so mma mmfa bɔgya a onndzi fɔ ho so nnto hɛn do: osiandɛ ɔwo, EWURADZE, na ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ epɛ.
Nna wɔmaa Jona do na wɔtoow no kyeen po no mu: na po no gyaa ne begyabegya yɛ.
Nna nyimpa no suroo EWURADZE papaara; na wɔbɔɔ okum afɔr maa EWURADZE, na wɔbobɔɔ anohoba.
Nna EWURADZE esiesie nam kɛse bi dɛ ɔmmen Jona; na Jona dzii nam no ne yamu ndaansa, adzekyee nye adzesaa.
Nna Jona fi nam no ne yamu bɔɔ mpaa maa EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Mifi m’ahohia mu musui frɛɛ EWURADZE, Na ɔgyee mo do; Mifi samanadze no bun mu tseaa mu, Na ɔwo tsee me ndze.
Na ɔwo toow me kyeen bun mu, wɔ po n’akoma mu, Na esuyirii twaa mo ho hyiae; W’asorɛkye na w’eminiminim nyina bui faa mo do.
Na mekaa dɛ, Wɔatow me efi w’enyim akyen; Naaso mokɔbɔ do mahwɛ w’asɔrdan krɔnkrɔn no no kwan do.
Esu no twaa mo ho hyiae, bodur ɔkra ho mpo; Bun no twaa mo ho hankra sii; Po mu efuw brabraa me tsir.
Misianee kɔr mbepɔw ase tɔnn; Mekɛhɛɛn asamanadze na woguu me mpokyerɛ wɔ n’efiadze. Naaso ɔwo eyi me efi mona mu, ao EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn.
Me kra tɔɔ bitsi wɔ mo mu no, mekaa EWURADZE: Na me mpaabɔ dur wo nkyɛn, nyew, wɔ w’asɔrdan krɔnkrɔn mu.
Hɔn a hɔn enyi sɔ ator ehuhudze no Wɔpow hɔnara hɔn ADOM.
Na emi dze, medze ndaase ndze bɔbɔ wo okum afɔr; Mubotua dza medze abɔ anohoba no. Osiandɛ ɔwo EWURADZE, wo hɔ na nkwagye fi.
Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ nam no, ma ɔkɛfee Jona too asaase wewew do.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Jona hɔ a otsia mprɛnu, dɛ,
Soɛr, kɔ Ninive, kurow kɛse no mu, na kɔbɔ asɛm a mereka akyerɛ wo yi dawur kyerɛ hɔn.
Na Jona soɛree, na ɔkɔr Ninive, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm no tse. Nna Ninive yɛ kurow kɛsenara a wɔnantsew no ndaansa twa.
Na Jona hyɛɛ ase hɛɛn kurow no mu dze da kor nantsewee, na ɔbɔɔ dawur see dɛ, Aka adaduanan, nna Ninive ebutuw.
Na Ninive gyee Nyankopɔn dzii; na wɔbɔɔ mbuadadzi ho dawur, na wofurafuraa eyitam fi hɔn mu akɛse do kesi nkakraba do mpo.
Na aber a asɛm no kodur Ninive ɔhen asomu no, ɔsoɛree fii n’ahengua do, na oyii n’ahentar gui, na ofuraa eyitam, na ɔtsenaa nso mu.
Na ɔmaa wɔbɔɔ dawur tahyee Ninive wɔ ɔhen na n’etsitsir no hɔn dzin mu, dɛ, Mma nyimpa anaa mbowa, anantwi anaa nguan, mmfa hwee nnka hɔn ano: mma wɔnnkɔ edzidzi, eso mma wɔnnom nsu:
na mbom womfurafura eyitam, nyimpa na mbowa nyina, na wɔnkeka mu dzendzenndzen mfrɛ Nyankopɔn; ɛhɛɛ, hɔn nyina nsan mfi hɔn kwan bɔn ho, na emimdzi a ɔwɔ hɔn nsamu no ho.
Sɛ bi a Nyankopɔn bɛsesa n’adwen wɔ dza oesusu dɛ ɔbɛyɛ no ho, na ɔadan efi n’ebufuhyew ho, na ɔannsɛɛ hɛn a, woana nyim?
Na Nyankopɔn hun hɔn ndzeyɛɛ dɛ wɔasan efi hɔn kwan bɔn no do; na ɔsesaa n’adwen nuu noho wɔ mbusu a ɔkaa dɛ ɔdze bɔbɔ hɔn no ho; na ɔannyɛ.
Na dɛm asɛm yi annyɛ Jona dɛw koraa, na no bo fuwii.

Na obisaa EWURADZE dɛ, Ao EWURADZE, meserɛ wo, nnyɛ m’asɛm a mowɔ mo kurow mu no mekae ara nye yi? Dɛm yi ara ntsi na meyɛɛ har muguaan dɛ morokɔ Tarsis no: osiandɛ minyim dɛ ɔwo eyɛ Nyame ɔdomfo, na mbɔbɔrhufo a efa ebufuw nyaa, na w’adɔyɛ so, na esesa w’adwen wɔ mbusu ho.
Dɛm ntsi afei, ao EWURADZE, mototɔ serɛ wo, gye mo nkwa fi me nsamu, na oye ma me dɛ mubowu kyɛn dɛ mebɛtsena ase.
Na EWURADZE bisaa no dɛ, Aso oye dɛ wo bo efuw?
Nna Jona fii kurow no mu kɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa kurow no no boka afamu, na ɔbɔɔ asese maa noho wɔ hɔ, na ɔtsenaa no nwin ase hɔ, ma eekodu dɛ obohu dza ɔbɛba kurow no do.
Na EWURADZE siesiee gyedua, na ɔmaa onyinii bɛkataa Jona do, ama ɔaagye nwin wɔ n’etsifi, na oeeyi no efi n’atseetsee asetsena no mu. Na Jona n’enyi gyee kɛse wɔ gyedua no ntsi.
Na n’adzekyee a wi rupue no, Nyankopɔn siesiee abowaba na ɔtoow gyedua no mu ma ɔkyenkyenee.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wipuei no, Nyankopɔn siesiee boka mframa a n’ano yɛ hyew; na ewia sii Jona n’etsifi, ma ɔtɔɔ akɔtɔmborɔnsa, na ɔserɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ onwu, na ɔsee dɛ, Oye ma me dɛ mubowu kyɛn dɛ mebɛtsena ase.
Nna Nyankopɔn bisaa Jona dɛ, Aso oye dɛ wo bo efuw wɔ efer no ntsi? Na ɔsee dɛ, oye dɛ mo bo fuw dze kɔ owu mu mpo.
Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Ɔwo edzi yaw wɔ gyedua a ennyɛɛ ho edwuma bi, eso nnyɛ ɔwo na emaa onyinii ho; ɔbaa anadwe da kor, na ɔsɛɛ anadwe da kor:
na emi na Ninive, kurow kɛse a no mu nyimpa bɔbor mpem ɔha eduonu a wonntum nnhu hɔn nsa nyimfa anaa hɔn bankum; na anyɛmbowa pii so no, mma munnhu no mbɔbɔr anaa?
Iyi nye EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔbaa Morasnyi Mika hɔ wɔ Juda ahemfo Jotam, Ahaz na Hezekia ber mu, a ɔfa Samaria na Jerusalɛm ho no.
Aman, hom nyina hom ntsie; asaase na dza ɔwɔ mu nyina, hom nkyɛn aso; na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ndzi dase ntsia hom; EWURADZE a ofi n’asɔrdan krɔnkrɔn mu no.
Na, hwɛ, EWURADZE fi ne tsenabea epue, na obesian, na oebetsiatsia asaase nsorɔnsorɔmbea do.
Na mbepɔw bɛnan wɔ n’ase, na mbɔnsa bɛpaapaa, dɛ mbrɛ hua nan wɔ gya enyim, dɛ nsu a woehue egu mbrɛ hɔ sian.
Iyi nyina Jakob mbrato ntsi a, na Israel fi ne ndzebɔn ntsi a. Jakob mbrato nye dɛn? Ana nnyɛ Samaria a? Na ebɛnadze nye Juda nsorɔnsorɔmbea? Ana nnyɛ Jerusalɛm a?
Dɛm ntsi mebɛyɛ Samaria dɛ hamu abokuw, na dɛ wenyin ture ntsetsɛweebea: na mubohue n’abo no egu bɔnsa no mu, na meyi ne fapem ato gua.
Na n’ehonyi a oegu nyina wobobubu no pɔsɔpɔsɔ, na wɔdze gya ahyew n’apɛdze nyina, na mayɛ n’abosom nyina afoafo: osiandɛ edwaman apɛdze na ɔdze aboa ano, na edwaman apɛdze na ɔbɛsan akɛyɛ.
Iyi ntsi na mubosu na metwa ewuo, na mibedzi kwatserkwa na adagyaw: mubosu dɛ mpataku, na medzi nkɔmbɔ dɛ nsohor.
Na n’epirakur ayɛ koannkɔ: na oebodu Juda; oebodu me man abobokɛse ano, edu Jerusalɛm.
Mma hom nnka no wɔ Gat, mma hom nnsu koraa: Bɛt-leafra na hom mfa homho mpirepirew huntuma mu.
Safir ɔtsefo e, twa mu kɔ wɔ adagyaw na enyito mu oo: Zaanan ɔtsefo mmpuei mmbae. Bɛt-ezel ewuotwa bɛma hom egyinae abɔ hom.
Na Marot ɔtsefo rotweɔn mber pa ahomtsew mu: osiandɛ mbusu fi EWURADZE hɔ aba Jerusalɛm abobokɛse mu.
Lakis ɔtsefo e, fa tseaseanam no se pɔnkɔ ɔhoɔharfo no oo: ɔno nye Zion babaa no bɔn ahyɛse; osiandɛ wohun Israel mbrato no wɔ wo mu.
Dɛm ntsi ebɛma Moresɛt-gat nkradzi akyɛdze: Akizib efi bɛyɛ ndaadaadze ama Israel ahemfo.
Maresa ɔtsefo e, medze nyia ɔbɛfa wo ayɛ enyadze no bɛba wo do oo: Israel enyimnyam bɛba araa ebodu Adullam.
Yɛ etsipaa, na yi wo ho nhwi wɔ mba a edɔ hɔn ntsi: ma w’etsipaa ntserɛw dɛ ɔpɛtɛkwaakye dze; osiandɛ ɔafa hɔn efi wo nkyɛn kɔ ndɔmmum.
Wondue! Hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ emumuyɛ wɔ tsirmu na wɔyɛ mbusu ho edwuma wɔ hɔn mpa do! Enyim rebɛtsetsew ara nye yi nna wɔayɛ, osiandɛ ɔwɔ hɔn nsa no tum mu.
Na hɔn enyi ber akwa, na wohwinhwim; na wɔfefa efi: na wosi nyimpa na ne fi apempem, mekyerɛ nyimpa na n’egyapadze.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, morodwendwen ebusua yi ho mbusu a hom runntum nnyi hom kɔn mmfi mu, eso hom runntum nnkyea ahopɔw mu; na ɔyɛ ber bɔn.
Da no mu na wobobu hom ho bɛ, na woetwa ewuo yaayaw, na wɔase dɛ, Wɔasɛɛ hɛn koraa: ɔasakyer me man kyɛfa: mbrɛ odua yi fi hɛn nkyɛn a! Etuatsewfo na ɔkyɛ hɛn akwa ma hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi innkenya obi a ɔtow susuhoma wɔ wo kyɛfa do wɔ EWURADZE mboanofo no mu.
Mma hom nnhyɛ nkɔm, mbrɛ wɔkeka nye yi. Mma nnkɛsa dɛm: iyinom nnkɛba mu.
Ao Jakob fi, aso wɔbɛka no dɛ, Aso EWURADZE no sunsum nnyi penkyɛr? Aso yinom nye ne nyɛe? Aso me nsɛm mmfa nyia ɔnantsew tɔɔtsen no nnsi yie?
Na aso ndaansa yi mu yi, me man asoɛr dɛ ɔtamfo: hom yi egugudo no fi hɔn a wɔnam dwudwoodwo dɛ wɔmmpɛ ko bi ako no hɔn ntar do.
Hom apam me man mu mbaa efi hɔn adan fɛɛfɛw no mu; hom apa m’enyimnyam efi hɔn mbɔtowaba ho koraa.
Hom nsoɛr, na hom nkɔ; na nnyɛ hom ahomgyebea bi nye ha: osian efifidze a ɔdze ɔsɛɛ yerɛyerɛw ba no ntsi.
Sɛ obi a ɔnam akɔhwi sunsum mu dzi ator dɛ, Mebɛhyɛ wo wenyin na nsadzen ho nkɔm a; ɔnoara na ɔbɛyɛ ɔman yi nkɔnhyɛnyi.
Ao Jakob, mobɔboa wodze nyina ano ampaara; ampaara mibehyiahyia Israel nkaa no; mebɛka hɔn abɔ mu dɛ nguan: dɛ mbowakuw a wɔwɔ hɔn nguan edzidzibea mu, nna nyimpa no dodow no ntsi, wɔbɛyɛ dede weɔɔ.
Otwafo no bedzi hɔn enyim kan: wobotwa mu abɛsen akɔ abobokɛse no ano, na woedua mu epue: na hɔn hen bɛsen edzi hɔn enyim, na EWURADZE dzi hɔn kan.
Nna mesee dɛ, Hom ntsie, meserɛ hom, hom Jakob etsitsir, na Israel fie mpanyimfo: aso ɔnnyɛ hom asɛm dɛ hom bohu atsɛmbu?
Hom a hom kyir papa, na hom dɔ bɔn; hom a hom gua hɔn wer fi hɔn ho, na hɔn nam fi hɔn mbiew ho;
hom a hom dzi me man hɔn nam so; na hom pɔr hɔn wer fi hɔn ho, na hom bubu hɔn mbiew: na hom bɔ no epruw dɛ kutu mu adze, na dɛ nam a ɔwɔ dadzesɛn mu.
Ɔno na wobosu afrɛ EWURADZE, na ɔnnkɛgye hɔn do: ɛhɛɛ, ɔdze n’enyim bosuma hɔn ber no, dɛ mbrɛ wɔayɛ emumuyɛ wɔ hɔn nyɛe mu no.
Dɛm na EWURADZE ka tsia nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔma me man fom no; na wɔdze hɔn se ka na wɔtseatsea mu dɛ, Asomdwee oo; na obiara a ɔnnhyɛ hɔn anomu no, wɔkyer no ho ɔsa mpo:
Dɛm ntsi adze bɛsa hom, dɛ hom nnkenya enyido adzehu; na sum bodwir hom, dɛ hom nnkɛhyɛ nkɔm; na wi bɔtɔ nkɔnhyɛfo no do, na adzekyee bɛyɛ katoo wɔ hɔn do.
Na adzehufo enyi bɔto, na nkɔnhyɛfo enyim egu ase; ɛhɛɛ, hɔn nyinara bomuamua hɔn ano: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn mbuae bi nnyi hɔ.
Na emi dze, tum nam EWURADZE no sunsum do ahyɛ me ma ara ampa, na atsɛmbu, na mbanyinndam, dɛ menda Jakob ne mbrato, na Israel no bɔn edzi nkyerɛ hɔn.
Hom ntsie iyi, meserɛ hom, hom Jakob fie etsitsir, na Israel fie mpanyimfo, hom a hom kyir atsɛmbu, na hom kyea asɛntsenenee.
Wɔdze bɔgya kyekyer Zion, na wɔdze emumuyɛ kyekyer Jerusalɛm.

No mu etsitsir no bu atsɛn gye akatua, na no mu asɔfo kyerɛkyerɛ gye apaadze, na no mu nkɔnhyɛfo hyɛ nkɔm gye sika: naaso wɔdze hɔnho twer EWURADZE, na wɔse dɛ, Ana nnyɛ EWURADZE na ɔwɔ hɛn ntamu yi bi? Mbusu biara remmba hɛn do.
Dɛm ntsi wobofuntum Zion dɛ kwa wɔ hom ntsi, na Jerusalɛm ayɛ ekurofo, na fie mbepɔw no ayɛ dɛ kwaa mu nsorɔnsorɔmbea.
Na ekyir nda no mu no ɔbɛba dɛ EWURADZE fie bepɔw no wɔdze betsim mbepɔw no etsifi, na wɔama no do abɔ akoko nyina do; na aman bɛpem aba mu.

Na amanaman pii bɔkɔ akɛse dɛ, Hom mbra ma yɛnkɔ EWURADZE bepɔw no do, yɛnkɔ Jakob ne Nyankopɔn fie; na ɔbɛkyerɛ hɛn no kwan, na yɛanantsew n’atsempɔn mu: na Zion na mbra no befi aba, na EWURADZE n’asɛm efi Jerusalɛm.

Na obobua aman pii mu atsɛn, na ɔaka aman akɛse a ɔwɔ ekyirekyir no enyim; na wɔdze hɔn mfona bɔbobɔ nsɔw, na wɔdze hɔn mpeaa abobɔ ndar: ɔman bi remma afona do nntsia ɔman bi, eso worunnsua akodzi bio.
Na wɔbɛtsenatsena nyimpa biara wɔ no wenyindua na n’adɔmbadua ase; na obi rinnyi hɔn hu: na dɔm EWURADZE noara na ɔaka.
Na aman nyina bɛnantsew hɔn bosom dzin mu nkorkor, na hɛn dze, yɛbɛnantsew EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ne dzin mu daa daa.
Da no mu no, EWURADZE na ɔse, mobɔboa osiifo no ano, na mehyia hɔn a wɔapam hɔn no, na hɔn a mehiahia hɔn ho no;
na mebɛma osiifo no ayɛ nkaase, na hɔn a wɔapam hɔn kɔ ekyirekyir no ayɛ ɔman kɛse: na EWURADZE bedzi hɔn do hen wɔ Zion bepɔw do, ofi ndɛ kesi daa.
Na ɔwo, Zion babaa no kokoe, ayɛ dɛ oguanhwɛfo abantsentsen, wo nkyɛn na tumdzi a odzi kan no bɛba, Jerusalɛm babaa n’ahendzi no bɛba.
Na afei wɔyɛ no dɛn na etseatsea mu dzendzen yi? Ana ɔhen bi nnyi wo mu, ana wo pamfo ahera, na ogyam ekitsa wo dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo yi?
Ao Zion babaa, ko awoo na kyem, dɛ ɔbaa roko awoo: na afei ibefi kurow no mu epue, na akɛtsena haban mu, na ekodu Babilɔn mpo; hɔ na wobeyi wo, hɔ na EWURADZE bɛgye wo efi w’atamfo nsamu.
Na afei amanaman pii asoɛr etsia wo, na wɔka dɛ, Wɔmma no ho ngu fi, na hɛn enyiwa nhu n’apɛdze wɔ Zion do.
Na wonnyim EWURADZE n’adwen, eso wɔnntse n’apam ase: na ɔaboa hɔn ano dɛ efiefi a wɔdze rokɔ ewuporoweebea.
Ao Zion babaa, soɛr porow: na mebɛyɛ w’ambɛn dadze, na mayɛ wo ntɔtse boran: na ibobubu aman pii pɔsɔpɔsɔ: na ibehyira hɔn ahonyadze do ama EWURADZE, na hɔn ahodze ama asaase nyina Wura no.
Ao Zion babaa, afei boa dɔmtukuw ano: ɔaka hɛn ehin mu ehyia: wɔdze abaa bobɔ Israel tsɛmbuafo nyepi.
Na ɔwo, Bɛtlɛhɛm Efrata, wo a isuar dɛ ebɔfora Israel mpempem mu, wo mu na obi befir ama me, na oebedzi panyin wɔ Israel do; no mpuei fir tsetse, ofir ɔdomankoma.
Dɛm ntsi obeyi hɔn ama, ekodu ber a ɔwokofo no bɔwo: nna no nuanom nkaase no bɛsan aba Israelmba nkyɛn.
Na obegyina hɔ, na ɔanyɛn no nguankuw no wɔ EWURADZE n’ahoɔdzen mu, wɔ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn no ne dzin tumdzi mu: na wɔbɛtsena hɔ; osiandɛ ɔbɛyɛ kɛse ekesi asaase ewiei.
Na nyimpa yi na ɔbɛyɛ hɛn asomdwee: na sɛ Asirianyi ba hɛn asaase do, na otsiatsia hɛn ahemfi mu a, nna yɛbɛhyehyɛ nguanhwɛfo beesuon na nyimpa etsitsir baawɔtwe etsia no.
Na wɔdze afona bɛyɛ Asiria na Nimrod nsaase no amamfo wɔ no mbobokɛse ano: na ɔbɛgye hɛn efi Asirianyi no nsamu, ber a Asirianyi no bɛba hɛn asaase do, na oebetsiatsia hɛn he do no.
Na Jakob ne nkaase no ɔbɛyɛ dɛ ɔbɔsu a ofi EWURADZE hɔ wɔ amanaman pii mu, dɛ nkyɛkyɛr do nsupetsema a ɔnnhwɛ nyimpa bi kwan, eso ɔnntweɔn adasamba.
Na Jakob ne nkaase no bɛyɛ wɔ amanaman mu, wɔ aman pii mu, dɛ gyata wɔ hambowa mu, dɛ gyatafɔr wɔ nguan ekuwekuw mu: ɔno a sɛ ɔhɛn mu a, otsiatsia do, na ɔtsetsew mu esinesin, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔgye.
Ma wo nsa mma do wɔ w’ahohiahiafo do, na ma w’atamfo nyina tun ntwa.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no mu no, EWURADZE na ɔse, mubotwa wo mpɔnkɔ efi wo finimfin, na masɛɛ wo ntseaseanam:
na mubotwitwa w’asaase do nkurow no egu, na medwuruw w’aban dzendzen nyina:
na mubotwitwa wo mbɔnsansɛm efi wo nsamu; na innkenya sebramufo bio:
na mubotwitwa ehonyi a egu na w’abosondum efi wo finimfin; na ennkɔkotow asɔr wo nsaano edwuma bio.
Na mubotwitwa w’abosompɔw a wɔfrɛ no Asera no efi wo finimfin: na masɛɛ wo nkurow.
Na mobɔtɔ amanaman a woenntsie me no do wer wɔ ebufuw na ebufuwhyew mu.
Afei hom ntsie dza EWURADZE se ɛ: Soɛr, bɔ wo nkuro wɔ mbepɔw enyim, na ma nkoko no ntse wo ndze.
Hom mbepɔw, hom ntsie EWURADZE no nkurobɔ, na hom asaase mfapem a wɔwɔ hɔ daa no: na EWURADZE nye ne man enya ham, na ɔnye Israel beyi atsɛn.
Ao me man, mayɛ wo dɛn, na mafona wo ebɛnadze mu? Dzi dase tsia me ɛ.
Na emi na medze wo fii Egypt asaase do bae, na mopoon wo fii nkowaayɛ fi no mu; na mosomaa Moses, Aaron, na Miriam dzii w’enyim.
Ao me man, kaa egyina a Moabhen Balak tui, na dza Beor ba Balaam dze buaa no; kaa ofitsi Sittim kodu Gilgal, ama hom eehu EWURADZE ne ndzeyɛtsenenee.
Ebɛnadze na memfa mbra EWURADZE enyim, na mombɔkotow ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn no? Aso memfa ɔhyew afɔr, nye anantwimba a woedzi afe kor mbra?
Aso EWURADZE n’enyi bɔsɔ nguannyin mpempem, anaa ngo esutsen mpem du du? Aso memfa m’abakan mma wɔ me mbrato ntsi, mo honam mu aba memma wɔ me kra no bɔn ntsi?
Ao onyimpa, wɔakyerɛ wo dza oye; na ebɛnadze bio na EWURADZE rohwehwɛ no wo hɔ, dɛ ebɛyɛ tsenenee na ebɔdɔ mbɔbɔrhu ara, na enye wo Nyankopɔn bɛnantsew ahobrɛadze mu?
EWURADZE ne ndze refrɛ kurow no, na hɔn a wosuro no no yɛ enyansafo: hom nnyɛ aso mma ntsea no, na nyia ɔahyɛ no.
Aso emumuyɛ akoradze wɔ emumuyɛ fi no mu, na esusudze a ɔnnso a ɔyɛ ekyiwadze no.
Aso mubobu nyia emumuyɛ nsɛn na foto a nsisi abrambo wɔ mu wɔ ne nsamu no bem anaa?
Osiandɛ emimdzi ahyɛ no mu ahonyafo no amaama, na no mu atsefo no aka atorsɛm, na hɔn gyirama daadaa wɔ hɔn anomu.
Dɛm ntsi na mepira wo pira dzen; wo bɔn ntsi na mayɛ wo afoafo.
Ɔwo ibedzidzi, na eremmee; na ebɛtse kɔm yerɛyerɛɛyerɛw: ibeyi, na ennkɛfa no tɔtrɔtɔ akɔ; na dza edze bɔkɔ no, medze bɛma afona.
Ibodua, na innkobu: ibetsiatsia ngoaba do, na ennkɛsera woho ngo; na ebɛtsetsew wenyinaba, naaso eronnom nsa no bi.
Osiandɛ edzi Omri ahyɛdze na Ahab fifo nyɛe nyina do, na enantsew hɔn apam mu: mebɛma aayɛ amamfo, na wo mu atsefo so aayɛ asesardze; na aasoa me man n’enyimguase.
Adze ayɛ me! Mayɛ dɛ ɔpɛber eduaba a wɔatsew, dɛ wenyinaba a woedzi no mpɛpɛw: siaw a wodzi biara nnyi hɔ; mo kɔn adɔ adɔmba abakan beree.
Onyamesuronyi ayew asaase do, na obiara nntsen wɔ adasamba mu: hɔn nyina tsetsɛw bɔgya; hɔn mu nyimpa biara sua no nua efir.
Hɔn nsa ebien nyina gu emumuyɛdze do dɛ wɔreyɛ no mbɔdzen do; safohen bisa mboaba, na tsɛmbuafo ayɛ krado regye mboaba; na nyimpa kɛse no, ɔka ne kra no mbusupɛ: mbrɛ wɔbɔ mu wen nye yi.
Hɔn mu dza oye kyɛn biara tse dɛ ohwirom: tɔɔtsenyɛnyi biara a ɔkyɛn no, omuo sen nsoɛban: w’aweɔmfo da no, wo sera da no, aba; afei na hɔn basabasayɛ bɛba.
Mma mmfa wo werɛ nntwer obiara, mma mmfa wo werɛ nnhyɛ ɔnyɛnko berɛbo mu: weɔn w’ano wɔ ɔbaa a ɔda wo bo mu no mpo ho.
Na ɔbabanyin sesar n’egya, ɔbabaa soɛr tsia ne na na asew soɛr tsia n’asew; na nyimpa n’atamfo nye nankasa ne fienyimpa.
Na emi dze, EWURADZE na mobɔhwɛ no kwan; mobɔtweɔn mo nkwagye Nyankopɔn: minyim dɛ me Nyankopɔn betsie me.
Ao me tamfo, mma nndzi me eduwa: sɛ mohwe ase a, mobɔsoɛr; na sɛ metse sum mu a, EWURADZE bɛyɛ kan ama me.
Mobɔsoa EWURADZE n’ebufuhyew no, osiandɛ mayɛ bɔn etsia no; ekodu dɛ obedzi m’asɛm ama me, na oebua me atsɛn: ɔdze me bɛba kan mu, na mahwɛ ne tsenenee no.
Nna me tamfo bohu, na enyito akata no do; ɔno a ɔsee me dɛ, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn no wɔ henfa no? M’enyiwa bohu no; afei na wobetsiatsia no do dɛ abrɔn mu dɛtse.
Da a wɔdze tow w’afasu no reba! Da no mu na w’ahe no bɔkɔ ekyirekyir.
Da no mu na wobefi Asiria na Egypt nkurow mu ebodu wo nkyɛn, na woefi Egypt araa ekodu Esutsen no ho, na wofi po ho akɔ po ho, na wofi bepɔw ho akɔ bepɔw ho.
Naaso asaase no bɛyɛ amamfo osian no mu atsefo no ntsi, wɔ hɔn nyɛe no nsowee ntsi.
Fa wo poma nyɛn wo man, w’egyapadze mbowakuw a wɔabɔ apetse wɔ Karmel etsifi no: ma wondzidzi wɔ Basan na Gilead dɛ tsetse nda no mu.
Mebɛma oehu anwanwadze dɛ nda a ifii Egypt bae no.
Amanaman bohu na hɔn enyi ato hɔn mbanyindze nyina ho: wɔdze hɔn nsa botuatua hɔn ano, hɔn aso besisiw.
Wɔbɛtafer huntuma dɛ abowatsena; dɛ asaase mbowa a wɔtsen famu, na wɔdze ahohim befi hɔn dabew aba: wɔdze suro bɛba EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na wɔabɔ hu wɔ wo ntsi.
Woana na ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, Nyankopɔn a edze emumuyɛ kyɛ, na epa w’egyapadze nkaa no hɔn mbrato ho? Innsie w’ebufuw daa, osiandɛ mbɔbɔrhu na epɛ.
Ebɛsan ebenya hɛn ho ayamuhyehye; edze w’ananadze betsiatsia hɛn emumuyɛ do: na ɔwo ebɔtow hɛn bɔn nyina egu po bun mu.
Ɔwo edze nokwar no bɛma Jakob, na edze mbɔbɔrhu ama Abraham, dɛ mbrɛ ekaa ntam kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom wɔ tsetse nda mu no.
Elkosnyi Nahum n’enyido adzehu nwoma a ɔfa Ninive atsɛmbu ho.
Nyankopɔn yɛ EWURADZE nyinkufo a odzi wer a; ampaara, EWURADZE dzi wer na ebufuw tum hyɛ no ma; EWURADZE tɔ n’ahohiahiafo do wer, na n’ebufuw tsim hɔ ma n’atamfo.
EWURADZE fa ebufuw nyaa, na no tum so, na orummbu fɔdzinyi bem ara da: EWURADZE no kwan wɔ ekyinehyia mframa na ehum mu, na nsuwusiw yɛ n’ananadze huntuma.
Ɔka po enyim ma ɔwew; na ɔma esutsen nyina memem: Basan na Karmel twintwam, na Lebanon nhyiren kyenkyen.
Mbepɔw wosow n’enyim, na akoko nan; na asaase wosow wɔ n’enyim, ɛhɛɛ, wiadze, na hɔn a wɔtse mu nyina mpo.
Woana botum n’ebufuhyew enyim gyina? Na woana na ɔbɔsoɛr etsia n’ebufuw kuntann no mu tsena? N’enyiber ehue dɛ gya, na obubu abotan mu esinesin.
EWURADZE ye, ɔyɛ guandɔbew wɔ ahohia da mu; na onyim hɔn a wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛ no mu no.
Na n’atamfo dze, ɔdze nsupramee bɛsɛɛ hɔn pasaa, na obetsiw hɔn araa akɔ sum mu.
Atamfo e! Ebɛnadze na hom dwendwen tsia EWURADZE yi? Obowie hom korakoraa na hom ronnsoɛr nntsia no mpɛn ebien.
Na sɛ hom ayɛ dɛ nsoɛ kantankantan, na hom afɔw takaa wɔ hom nsanom mu mpo a, wɔbɛhyew hom koraa dɛ mburonan guanee.
Ɔwo Ninive wo mu na obi a osusu EWURADZE ho mbusu, na ɔpam emumuyɛ apam fi epue.

Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Sɛ hom ayeyɛ petsepetsee, na hom dɔɔ so mpo a, dɛmara so na wobotwitwa hom egu, na hom etwa mu akɔ. Ao Juda, kaansa mehiahia wo ho dɛnara mpo a, afei dze, mirinnhiahia wo ho bio.
Na afei mubobubu Ninive kɔndua no mu efi wo do, na matsetsew wo nkyehoma mu.
Na ɔwo Ninive, EWURADZE ahyɛ wo ho mbra, dɛ wo dzin bɛyew efi asaase do: mubotwitwa ehonyi a asen na egu nyina efi w’abosondan mu; mobɔbɔ wo da; osiandɛ hom adan atantandze.
Hom nhwɛ, hɔn a wɔdze nsɛmpa ba hɔn anamɔn wɔ mbepɔw no do, hɔn a wɔdze asomdwee tahye no a! Ao Juda, dzi wo ndapɔn, ma w’anohobadze: na omumuyɛfo no remmfa wo mu bio; woetwa no akyen koraa.
Ɔwo Ninive, gyina yie, kora w’akoradze do, sera kwan no do, mia w’asen mu, hyɛ w’ahoɔdzen mu dzen papaara osiandɛ nyia obubu mu pɔsɔpɔsɔ no rofow aba wo do.
Na EWURADZE dze Jakob ne kɛseyɛ reba bio, dɛ Israel kɛseyɛ: ɔno a atopamfo ato no pan, na wɔasɛɛ ne wenyindua abaw no.
N’akatakyi kyɛm ho aber, no dɔm mbarimba efurafura serdaa: ntseaseanam fram dadzegya wɔ n’ahosiesie da no mu, na wɔwosow mpeaa no ma ɔyɛ hu.
Ne ntseaseanam no abobɔ adam wɔ abrɔn mu, wɔsesɛ ho wɔ nguabɔ mu; hɔn hwɛbea tse dɛ ngyatsɛn, na woguan dɛ enyinam.
Ɔka mu frɛ n’akofo etsitsir: wofintsiw hɔn nantsew mu; wɔyɛ har kɔ ne fasu no ho, na wosiesie akatabo no.
Naaso woebuebue esutsen ano mbobokɛse no dada, na ahemfi no edwuruw.
Wɔaka no ahyɛ, wɔada n’adagyaw edzi, wɔasoa no kɔ, na ne mbaawa dze mborɔnoma ndze si nkrum, wɔnyan hɔn akoko.
Na Ninive dze, ɔtse dɛ nsutaae fi ne tsetseberdo: naaso woguan; wɔkeka mu dɛ, Hom ngyina, hom ngyina; naaso obiara annhwɛ n’ekyir.
Hom mfom sika, hom mfom dwetɛ: na n’akoradze na n’adanmudze fɛɛfɛw no dɔɔ so papaapa.
Ao Ninive! Hwɛ mbrɛ esi atɔ, ayɛ hahoo, na ayɛ amamfo a: w’akoma anan, w’anankoroma sesɛ ho, na w’asen nyina mu guan wo, na w’enyim na atow fitaa yi.
Wo ngyata bɔn no wɔ henfa, na ngyatafɔr no hɔn edzidzibea no, mbrɛ nkyɛ ogyatanyin na ogyataber, na ogyataba nantsew, na obi nnyi hɔn hu no?
Ogyata tsetseew dza ɔso ne mba mu esinesin, na okunsakunsae maa n’aber no, na ɔdze afonam hyɛɛ n’etu ma, na ɔdze ntsetsewee hyɛɛ n’abɔn ma.
Hwɛ, menye wo enya, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, na mebɛhyew wo ntseaseanam wɔ wusiw mu, na afona bedzi wo ngyatafɔr: na mubotwitwa w’afonam efi asaase do, na wɔrenntse w’abɔfoe ndze bio.
Due, bɔgya kurow! Ɔwo a nsɛmfun na epoobɔsɛm ahyɛ wo ma; na ewudzi so mmpa wo mu da.
Apɔnkɔbaa ne gyegyee, na ntseaseanam anan ne kyirdidi; mpɔnkɔ hɔn kwam kwam tutu, na ntseaseanam hɔn ehuruhuruw da no edzi dɛ;
ɔpɔnkɔdofo dze rokɔbɔ enyi, na afona rinyinam, na peaa reyerɛyerɛw; na atɔfo pii, na efun kuw kɛsenara a efun no wonnhu ewiei; na wofintsifintsiw hɔn efun no do mpo.
Iyi nyina fir Ninive, edwaman fɛɛfɛw, abayifo wuraba no, no ndwamansɛm dodow ntsi, ɔno a ɔdze ndwamansɛm tɔn amanaman, na ɔdze n’abayisɛm tɔn mbusua.
Hwɛ, menye wo enya, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, na mebɛpa w’asetam egu w’etsifi, na mama amanaman ehu w’adagyaw, na ahenman ehu w’ahoto.
Na mobɔtow fi tantanntan egu wo do, na mama adan atantandze, na medze wo esi hɔ dɛ ahwɛdze.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ hɔn a wɔhwɛ wo nyina befi wo nkyɛn eguan, na wɔase dɛ, Ninive ayɛ ekurofo: woana na obosu ama no? Henfa na mobɔhwehwɛ ɔwerɛkyekyefo ama wo?
Aso ɔwo iye sen No-amon a osi esutsen ntamu a esu etwa no ho ehyia no; na po yɛ ne ban na n’afasu no?
Etiopia na Egypt nye n’ahoɔdzen, a nna hɔn tum nnyi mbanano; na Put na Lubim so nye n’aboafo.
Naaso wɔdze no kɔree, wɔfaa no kɔr ndɔmmum: hɔn mbɔtowaba so wɔdze hɔn abobɔ abrɔn nyina do ekuku hɔn: na wɔtwee n’enyimnyamfo ho tonto, na ne nyimpa etsitsir nyina woguguu mpokyerɛ mu.
Ɔwo so ahoguan bɔbow wo, ibosuma, na ɔwo so bɔhwehwɛ guansumabew wɔ ɔtamfo no ntsi.
W’abankɛse nyinara bɛyɛ dɛ adɔmbandua no do wɔ adɔmbakan beree: sɛ wɔwosow a, ɔtsetsew totɔ odzifo no n’anomu.
Hwɛ, wo akofo ayɛ mbaa wɔ wo mu; woebuebue w’asaase no mbobokɛse no pataa ama w’atamfo: na gya ahyew w’abokɛse ekyir adaban.
Sesaw nsu sie ntuae no, miamia w’abankɛse no mu: tsia dɛtse, na wɔw kaadow dɛtse, ma ntayaa fononoo no nyɛ dzen.
Hɔ na gya bɛmen wo; afona botwa wo akyen, ɔbɛmen wo dɛ mbrɛ nkonyinko memen dza wohu biara: na kaansa ema wo dodow yɛ pii dɛ nkonyinko, anaadɛ mbɛbɛw mpo a.
Ama w’eguadzifo adɔɔ so asen ɔsor nworaba; naaso tse dɛ nkonyinko no, wɔfa wo afo, na wotu kɔ.
Wo dɔm a wɔbobɔ abɔtsir tse dɛ mbɛbɛw, na w’asafohemfo tse dɛ mbɛbɛw mintsimintsi a wɔsensam ban ho wɔ awɔw da mu, na sɛ ewia fir a, wotu kɔ, na wonnhu fakor a wɔkɔ.
Ao Asiriahen, w’aweɔmfo atotɔ nkom: w’akofo regye hɔn ahom: wɔabɔ wo man apetse mbepɔw do, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔboaboa hɔn ano.
Wo kur no nnyi mbotowee; wo pirakur no yɛ dzen: hɔn a wɔtse wo nka nyina bɔ hɔn nsamu gu wo do; osiandɛ woana koraa do na emmfaa wo daadaa emumuyɛ no nkɔree?
Iyi nye nsɛm a EWURADZE yii kyerɛɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Habakuk.
Ao EWURADZE, menkeka mu ma onkodu dabɛn, ana ɔwo etsie me? Musu frɛ wo wɔ enyimpisɛm ntsi, naaso ɔwo enngye mo do.
Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ema muhu emumuyɛ, na ɔbrakyew rokɔ do pii na ennyɛ ho hwee yi? Ɔsɛɛ na emimdzi wɔ m’enyim: na aperper wɔ hɔ, na mansotwe so soɛr.
Dɛm ntsi mbra no mu atow, na atsɛntsenenee nnyi hɔ bio: na omumuyɛfo twa ɔtseneneenyi ho hyia; dɛm ntsi sɛ atsɛmbu ba a, nna ɔakyea.
Hom nhwɛ amanaman mu, na hom nhu, na hom ho mbow hom bow paara: na mibedzi dwuma bi wɔ hom nda mu a, sɛ wɔka kyerɛ hom mpo a, hom renngye nndzi.
Na, hwɛ, muruhuenyan Kaldeafo, ɔman ayamuɔwemfo horopohoropofo a wɔnantsew asaase no ne tɛtɛr mu dɛ wɔrekɛfa tsenambea a ɔnnyɛ hɔndze edzi do.
Hɔn ho yɛ ahomtsew dɛ; na hɔn ho yɛ hu so yie: ahomemadofo a wɔyɛ dza hɔnara wɔpɛ a.
Hɔn mpɔnkɔ so ho yɛ har sen nsebɔ, na wɔyɛ abɔyafo sen anadwe mpataku; na hɔn mpɔnkɔdofo twetwe hɔn mu kɔ kan: nyew, hɔn mpɔnkɔdofo fi ekyirekyir; na wotu dɛ ɔkɔr a ɔrepɛ ntsɛm akɛmemen adze.
Hɔn nyinara reba ebedzi emim; hɔn enyi do hyehyeehyew dɛ boka mframa; na wɔsesaw ndɔmmumfo dɛ anhwea.
Ɛhɛɛ, hɔn dze wosi ahemfo atwetwe, na asafohemfo ho yɛ hɔn serew: wɔserew akoban biara; na wɔhɔr dɛtse pempe, na wɔfa.
Na wobotwa mu dɛ mframa, na wɔasen akɔ, na oekedzi so: mekyerɛ hɔn a hɔn bosom nye hɔn ahoɔdzen no.

Ao EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn, mo Krɔnkrɔnnyi, ana nnyɛ ɔwo na ifi tsetsentserdee no? Ao EWURADZE, nnkɛma yeewuwu osiandɛ atsɛmbu ara na ahyɛ Kaldeafo dɛ wombu hɛn; na ao ɔbotan, hɛn ntsea ara ntsi na edze etsim hɔ.
Ɔwo a w’enyiwa yɛ krɔnkrɔn a inntum nnhwɛ ndzebɔn ne nyɛe, na eso inntum nnhwɛ ɔbrakyew, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ehwɛ hɔn a wotwa nkontompɔ, na nnka hwee ber a omumuyɛnyi remen nyimpa a ɔtsen sen no no?
Na afei ayɛ nyimpa dɛ po mu nam, dɛ aweaweambowa a obi nndzi hɔn do panyin.
Dɛm ntsi wɔdze nkwaba twe hɔn nyina, na wɔdze no eboa fa hɔn, na wɔboaboa hɔn twuwii mu; na wodzi ehurusi na hɔn enyi gye.
Ne dɛm ntsi omumuyɛnyi no bɔ okum afɔr ma no boa, na ɔhyew huam ma no twuwii; osiandɛ hɔn na wɔma ne kyɛfa tɔ angoa, na n’edziban yɛ pii.
Aso dɛm ntsi ɔnto no boa pan, na ɔnkɔ do ara nkuku amanaman daa a onnya ayamuhyehye biara?
Mibegyina m’aweɔmbea do, na medze moho esi abantsentsen no do, na matsɛw ahwɛ dza EWURADZE nye me bɛka, na dza mubobua wɔ ho.
Na EWURADZE buaa me, na ɔsee dɛ, Kyerɛw enyido adzehu, na ma ɔnyɛ pefee wɔ abopon do, ama nyia ɔdze mbirika mpo oeenya no akenkan yie.
Na enyido adzehu no bɛba wɔ ber a wɔahyɛ no mu na ɔregye kwan aba mu, na orinndzi ator da: sɛ ɔkyɛr mpo a, tweɔn, na ɔbɛba ampaara, orinnkyinkyim.
Hwɛ, omumuyɛnyi no ne kra ahoran, ɔnntsen wɔ no mu: na ɔtseneneenyi dze, ɔnam no nokwardzi do benya nkwa.

Kaldeafo tse dɛ asabokwafo, na wɔyɛ nyimpa ahokyerɛfo a wonnyi abodwee; hɔn na wɔtserɛw hɔn akɔndɔ mu dɛ asamanadze, na wɔtse dɛ owu, wɔmmee da. Wɔfa amanaman ndɔmmum ba hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔfom aman nyina fa.
Hwɛ, ber reba a hɔn ndɔmmumfo no besi hɔn atwetwe na woedzi hɔn nkasaetwuw, dɛ, Nyia ɔdze nsisi fom dza ɔnnyɛ nedze no, ondue! W’epoobɔ yi bɔkɔ do ara ekodu dabɛn?
Aso hɔn a wɔdzedze wo akaw no nkɔsoɛr awerɛfir mu, na hɔn a aka hɔn ahyɛ no nkenyan ma ɔwo abɛdan hɔn asadze?
Ɔnam dɛ afa amanaman pii afo ntsi, ɔwoso aman mu nkaa no nyina bɛfa wo afo; na osian nyimpa bɔgyaa aka egu, na ewurkadze a ayɛ wɔ asaase, na kurow no na no mu atsefo nyina do ntsi.
Onyia no a onya mfaso bɔn ma ne fi, dɛ ɔdze ne berɛbuw risi sorsor, ama woeeyi no efi mbusu nsa no, ondue!
Ɔwo enye enyito etu egyina ama wo fie, dɛ etwitwa aman pii egu na ayɛ wo kra bɔn.
Na ɔbo befi woara wo fasu no ho bɛtsea mu, na mpuna efi ndua no mu agye do.
Nyia ɔdze bɔgya kyekyer kurow, na ɔdze emumuyɛ tsintsim kuropɔn no, ondue!
Hwɛ, ana ommfir dɔm EWURADZE na aman yɛ edwuma berɛ ma ogya, na amanaman fona hɔnho ma egyangyandze?
Na afei dze, EWURADZE n’enyimnyam ho nyimdzee bɛhyɛ asaase ma, dɛ mbrɛ esu kata po do.
Nyia ɔma ne nyɛnko anondze, wɔ adwe bɔn kwan do no, na ɔma ɔbow, na ɔhwɛ n’adagyaw no, ondue!
Enyito ahyɛ wo ma sen enyimnyam: ɔwo so nom, na yɛ dɛ monomonomnyi: hwɛ EWURADZE n’abanyimfa kɔɔpow no bɛdan aba wo do, na enyimguase tantan bɛkata w’enyimnyam do.
Na ɔwo Babilɔn, ewurkadze a edze yɛɛ Lebanon, na mbowa hɔn sɛɛe a ɔmaa wɔbɔɔ piriw; na adasa hɔn bɔgyaa a ekae gui, ewurkadze a edze ayɛ asaase no, na no mu atsefo no nyina no bobua w’etsifi.
Sɛ odwimfo sen ohonyi a, mfaso bɛn na onya? Wɔyɛ ehonyi a woegu na ator akyerɛkyerɛfo, osiandɛ sɛ odwimfo yɛ abosom mmum a, ɔdze no werɛ twer noara n’edwindze a ɔayɛ.
Nyia ɔse dua dɛ, Nyan; na ɔse ɔbo mmum dɛ, Soɛr, no, ondue! Aso iyi botum akyerɛkyerɛ? Hwɛ, wɔdze sika na dwetɛ egu ho, naaso ahom biara nnyi no mu koraa.
Na EWURADZE dze ɔwɔ n’asɔrfi krɔnkrɔn no mu: wɔmma asaase nyina ntaa dzinn wɔ n’enyim.
Nkɔnhyɛnyi Habakuk ne mpaabɔ, wɔ Shigionoth do.
Ao EWURADZE, matse wo nka, na mesuro: Ao EWURADZE, nyan w’edwuma wɔ hɛn mber yi mu, Dɛm mber yi mu na ma wonhu; W’ebufuw mu kaa mbɔbɔrhu.
Onyankopɔn fi Teman bae, Na Ɔkrɔnkrɔnnyi no fi Paran bepɔw do. N’enyimnyam kataa sorsor, Na asaase yɛɛ n’ayɛyi ma.
Na ne hyerɛn tse dɛ ewia; Na nsenamba fi ne nsamu sesae: Na hɔ nye n’ahoɔdzen no nsumae.
Ɔyardɔm dzi n’enyim, Na atseetsee yarba dzi n’ananadze.
Ogyinae, na osusuu asaase; Ɔhwɛe, na ɔmaa amanaman wosowee. Na ɔdomankoma mbepɔw hwetsee, Tsetse akoko bɔɔ hɔn mu adze; N’akwan tse dɛ tsetse dze.
Muhun Kushan asese wɔ ahohia mu: Midian asaase ho ntwamutam no popoe.
Aso EWURADZE no bo fuuw esutsen no? Aso w’ebufuw dzɛɛw esutsen no do, Anaa po na wo bo huur no do, Ber a etsenaa wo mpɔnkɔ do, krado Wo nkwagye ntseaseanam do no?
Eyɛɛ w’egyen krado; Na ekaa ntam wɔ w’egyen menaba no ntowee ho. Epaapaa esutsen totoo asaase mu.
Mbepɔw hun wo, na wosuroi; Nsu n’ehum twaa mu senee: Bun maa ne ndze do, Na ɔmaa ne nsa do wɔ sor.
Ewia na bosoom gyinagyinaa hɔn tsenabea; Wɔ w’egyen menaba a wɔnenamee ne kan ntsi, Wɔ wo peaa nyinam nyinam ne hyerɛn ntsi.
Ebufuhyew mu na etsenee faa asaase no do, Abohur mu na eposee amanaman.
Ɔwo ipuei wɔ wo man no nkwagye ntsi, Wɔ wo nyia wɔasera no no nkwagye ntsi; Ɔwo ipirapiraa mumuyɛnyi no fi n’etsifi, Epaa no ho tam fi n’ananadze kodur n’etsifi mpo.
Edze nankasa n’apɔtsimbaa hwiraa n’akofo tsir: Wɔbaa dɛ ekyinehyia mframa dɛ wɔrobɔbɔ me apetse: Hɔn ehurusi nye dɛ wɔbɛmemen ɔbɔbɔfo nsumaa mu.
Ɔwo edze wo mpɔnkɔ etsiatsia po do, Esu akɛse a ahohɔr no do.

Metsee, na me yafun wosowee, M’anofamfa hiim biribiriw wɔ ndze no ntsi; Ɔprɔw hɛɛn me mbiew mu, na mo ho wosowee wɔ me tsenabea: Naaso mebɛyɛ dzinn matweɔn, Asotwe a ɔreba ɔman a wɔdze dɔm kukuankoma botuaa hɛn no do no.
Na kaansa adɔmbadua remmpaa nhyiren, Eso wenyindua ronnsow aba a; Na ngodua ne berɛ yɛ gyan, Na nhaban mma edziban; Na nguan tun twa wɔ nguamban mu, Na anantwi bi nnyi anantwiban mu mpo a:
Emi dze, mibedzi ehurusi wɔ EWURADZE mu, Mo ho bɛsɛpɛw me wɔ mo nkwagye Nyankopɔn mu.
EWURADZE Nyankopɔn no, nye m’ahoɔdzen, Na ɔma m’anan yɛ dɛ adoa dze, Na ɔbɛma manantsew mo nsorɔnsorɔmbea. Iyi wɔdze kɛmaa Ɔdwontofo Panyin no, wɔ m’ahoma asanku do.
EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔbaa Hezekia ne ba Amaria, ne ba Gedalia, ne ba Kusi, ne ba Zefania hɔ, wɔ Judahen Josia, Amon ne ba no, n’aber do.
Mebɛpra adze nyina efi asaase enyi akɔ koraa, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Mebɛpra nyimpa na mbowa akɔ; mebɛpra sor ntumbowa, na po mu nam, na fintsidua aka emumuyɛfo ho akɔ; na mubotwa nyimpa efi asaase enyi egu, EWURADZE na ɔse.

Na mebɛtsen me nsa wɔ Juda do, na Jerusalɛm atsefo nyina do; na mubotwa Baal ne nkaa biara efi bea yi do. Na mebɛpepa hɔn abosomfo asɔfo na EWURADZE n’asɔfoe a wɔapow no no nyinara edzin efi asaase do;
nye hɔn a wɔkotow sɔr wimu ndzɛmba wɔ adan etsifi. Mebɛsɛɛ hɔn so a wɔkeka emi EWURADZE me dzin ho ntam na wɔsan so keka Milcam ho ntam no,
na hɔn so a wɔasan efi m’ekyir; na hɔn a wɔnnhwehwɛ emi EWURADZE, na eso wommbisa m’ekyir kwan no.
Yɛ dzinn wɔ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn enyim: na EWURADZE ne da no abɛn: na EWURADZE esiesie okum afɔr, ɔatsew hɔn a ɔafrɛ hɔn no ho.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ EWURADZE no kum afɔr da no mu no mebɛtsea asafohemfo no, na ahenmba no, na hɔn a wɔhyɛ ananaben ntar nyina.
Na da no mu mebɛtsea hɔn a wohuruw tra abowano, na wɔdze enyimpisɛm na ndaadaa hyɛ hɔn wura ne fi ma no.
Na da no mu no, EWURADZE na ɔse, osu ne dede fi Nam Abotsen no ano aba, na ewuotwa efi kurofa a otsia ebien no mu, na ɔsɛɛ kɛse efi akoko no do aba.
Hom ntwa ewuo, hom a hom tse Maktes, osiandɛ eguadzifo no nyina ennwie yie: hɔn a wɔsoaa hɔn dwetɛ no nyina woetwitwa hɔn egu.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ ber no mu dɛ medze nkandzea mobɔhwehwɛ Jerusalɛm mu; na mebɛtsea nyimpa a woegyaa hɔnho ama bɔn na wɔka wɔ hɔn akoma mu dɛ, EWURADZE rennka ho hwee no.
Na wɔbɛfa hɔn ahonyadze afo, na hɔn efi atɔ pan: ɛhɛɛ, wobesisi adan, na wɔrenntsena mu: na wɔbɛtsetsɛw wenyin nture, na wɔronnom mu nsa.
EWURADZE ne da kɛse no abɛn, abɛn, na ɔrepɛ ntsɛm dɛ, EWURADZE ne da no ne ndze no yɛ nwen dɛ; ɔkatakyi rekeka mu wɔ hɔ yayaayaw.
Da no yɛ ebufuw da, ɔfona na ahoguan da, ɔsɛɛ na amamfoyɛ da, sum na kusuwwyɛ da, nsuwusiw na sum kebii da,
akasamu na ehubɔ da a ɔreba nkuropɔn a wɔagye ho ban na aban atsentsen do.
Na medze ahoguan bɛba nyimpa do, ma wɔaanantsew dɛ efurafo, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE: na wobohue hɔn bɔgyaa egu dɛ huntuma, na wɔatow hɔn honam so egu dɛ sumina.

Eso hɔn sika na hɔn dwetɛ runntum nngye hɔn wɔ EWURADZE n’ebufuw da no mu; na ne nyinkun gya no bɛmen asaase no nyina: na odwuruw, ɛhɛɛ, odwuruw a ɔyɛ hu, na ɔdze bodwuruw hɔn a wɔtse asaase no do nyina.
Hom nka hom ho mboa ano, ɛhɛɛ, hom mboa hom ho ano, ao ɔman a hom nnyi enyito;
ansaana mbusu da no aba, ansaana da no asen dɛ ntsɛw, ansaana EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzendzen no aba hom do, nyew, ansaana EWURADZE n’ebufuw da no aba hom do.
Hom nhwehwɛ Ewuradze, hom asaase do ahobrɛadzefo nyina a hom ayɛ n’atsɛmbudze; hom nhwehwɛ tsenenee, hom nhwehwɛ ɔdwe: bi a wɔdze hom bosuma wɔ EWURADZE n’ebufuw da no mu.
Na wɔbɛdan Gaza egya, na Ashkelon ayɛ ekurofo: wobeyi Ashdod edzi ewiaber ketee, na woetutu Ekron ase.
Ndom nka nsuanofo, Keretfo man no! Ao Keenan, Filistiafo asaase, EWURADZE n’asɛm tsia hom: mebɛsɛɛ wo ara ma ɔtsefo biara nnkɛka.
Na nsuano bɛyɛ mbowa dzidzibea a nguanhwɛfo nsuaba na nguankuw nguamban wowɔ mu.
Na nsuano no bɛyɛ Juda fi nkaa no dze; wɔbɛnyɛn hɔn nguankuw no wɔ do: wobobutubutuw Ashkelon efi mu ewimbir; na EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn bɛsera hɔn, na ɔdze hɔn ndɔmmumkɔ no asan aba.
Matse Moab nsopa, na Ammonmba yeyaw a wɔdze asopa me man, na wɔamema hɔnho do ahyɛ hɔn he do.

Dɛm ntsi metse ase yi, dɔm EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔse, Ampaara Moab bɛyɛ dɛ Sodom, na Ammonmba ayɛ dɛ Gomora nsason sisibea, na nkyen mona, na daa amamfoyɛ: mo nkorɔfo nkaase bɛfa hɔn afo, na me man nkaa so edzi hɔn do.
Hɔn nkontompɔ ntsi na wobenya iyi, osiandɛ wɔasopa dɔm EWURADZE ne man na wɔamema hɔnho do etsia hɔn.
EWURADZE no ho bɛyɛ hu ama hɔn: osiandɛ ɔbɛma asaase do abosom nyina asa; na adasa bɔsom ɔno, obiara fi ne tsenabea, amanaman nsupruw nyina mpo.
Hom Etiopiafo so, hom bɔtotɔr m’afona ano.
Na ɔbɛtsen ne nsa wɔ kwaamu afamu, na ɔasɛɛ Asiria; na ɔbɛma Ninive ayɛ amamfo, na ɔawow kɛsɛɛ dɛ sar do.

Na mbowakuw bobutubutuw mu, amanaman mbowadoma nyinara: nantwinoma na kɔtɔkɔ bɛtsena n’edum etsifi: hɔn ndze bɔtow ndwom wɔ ntokura mu; amamfoyɛ bɛba hɔn mbobow ano: na ɔama kyindur ndua edwin ho ada hɔ.

Iyi nye kurow a odzii ehurusi a ɔtsenaa dɛ ɔmmfa hwee nnyɛ hwee no, na ɔsee wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ, Emi mara a, na obi nnyi hɔ ka mo ho no. Hwɛ mbrɛ oesi adan amamfo, mbowa ebutuwii a! Obiara a otwa mu wɔ hɔ no, ɔbɛsesar, na ɔawosow ne tsir.
Due, etuatsew kurow a no ho egu fi, nhyɛdo kurow no!
Oenntsie EWURADZE ndze; ɔanngye ntsea; ɔammfa no werɛ annhyɛ EWURADZE mu; na ɔanntwe ammbɛn ne Nyankopɔn.
N’asafohemfo yɛ ngyata a wɔpɔw wɔ no mu; n’atsɛmbuafo yɛ ewimbir mpataku; wonngya biribi ma ɔnnka mma adzekyee.
No nkɔnhyɛfo yɛ ahopɔwfo, ndabrabafo ara nko: n’asɔfoe egu krɔnkrɔn bea no ho fi na, woedzi mbra no emim koraa.
EWURADZE a ɔwɔ no mu no ɔtsen; ɔrennyɛ emumuyɛ; daa n’atsɛmbu da edzi pefee, onngyaa da; naaso nyia ɔnntsen dze, onnyim enyito.
Metwitwa amanaman egu, hɔn akoban ayeyɛ afoafo; mama hɔn abrɔn atotɔ pan, ma obi nntwa mu wɔ do: wɔasɛɛ hɔn nkurow, ma nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ, ɔtsefo bi nnyi do.
Mekaa dɛ, suro mara, gye ntsea; na worunntwa wo tsenabea nnkyen, dɛ mbrɛ dza mahyɛ wɔ wo ho nyina tse: naaso wɔsoɛr ahema na wɔsɛɛ wo ndzeyɛɛ nyina.

Dɛm ntsi hom ntweɔn me, EWURADZE na ɔse, nkodu da a mobɔsoɛr aba afonam do: na mo sua nye dɛ mibehyia amanaman ano, na mehyia ahenman, dɛ mubohue m’ebufuw egu hɔn do, m’ebufuhyew dzendzen nyina; na me nyinkun gya no bɛmen asaase no nyina.
Ɔno na mebɛma aman no ano krɔnkrɔn, ama hɔn nyinara wɔaabɔ EWURADZE ne dzin, dɛ wɔdze koryɛ bɔsom no.
Etiopia esutsen egya na mo nkorɔfo a wɔapetse no fi dze ayɛyɛdze bɛba.
Da no mu na mibeyi w’enyimguase ndzeyɛɛ a edze ato me mbra no nyina efi hɔ: na ber no mu no na mibeyi hɔn a wɔdze wo hyehyɛ hɔnho no efi wo mu, na ennkɛda ho etuw woho wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do.
Na mibegya amandzehufo na abɔbɔfo wɔ wo mu, na wɔdze hɔn werɛ bɛhyɛ EWURADZE ne dzin mu.
Na Israel nkaa nnkɛyɛ emumuyɛ, eso worinndzi atorsɛm; eso worunnhu ndaadaa gyirama wɔ hɔn anomu: na wɔbɛnyɛn hɔnho na woebutubutuw hɔ, na obi rinnyi hɔn hu.
Ao Zion babaa, tow ndwom; ao Israel, bɔ ose; ao Jerusalɛm babaa, ma w’enyi ngye na fa w’akoma nyina dzi ehurusi.
EWURADZE eyi w’atsɛmbu kɔ, ɔatow w’atamfo akyen: Israelhen EWURADZE no, wɔ wo finimfin: erennda ho nnsuro mbusu bio.
Da no mu no wɔbɛse Jerusalɛm dɛ, Mma nnsuro: ao Zion, mma w’abaw mu mmbu.
EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn wɔ wo finimfin, ɔkatakyi a ɔbɛgye nkwa no a: ɔdze enyigye bedzi wo ho ehurusi, ɔdze dɔ bɛyɛ wo fofor, ɔdze ndwom bɔbɔ wo ho ose.
Mobɔboaboa hom ano na na hom asan ebedzi afahyɛ a hom dzii ho awerɛhow no bio, amma hom anntseetsee bio.

Hwɛ, ber no menye hɔn a wohiahia wo ho no nyina bedzi: na mebɛgye osiifo no nkwa, na matase hɔn a wɔapam hɔn no; na mebɛhyɛ hɔn enyimnyam na mama hɔn dzin, hɔn a hɔn enyimguase aba asaase nyina do no a.

Ber no mu na medze hom bɛba, na ber no mu na mobɔboa hom ano: na mebɛma hom enya dzin na enyimnyam wɔ asaase do aman nyinara mu, ber a medze hom ndɔmmumfo bɛsan aba bio no, na hom dze hom enyiwa bohu. EWURADZE na ɔse.

Ɔhen Darius n’afe a otsia ebien no mu bosoom a otsia esia no ne, da a odzi kan no, EWURADZE n’asɛm nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Hagai do baa Juda ambrado Zerubabel, a ɔyɛ Sealtiel ne ba, na Jehozadak ne ba ɔsɔfopanyin Josua hɔ, dɛ,
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE kasa se nye yi, dɛ, Ɔman yi ka dɛ, Onndur ber a yɛba besi EWURADZE fi.
Nna EWURADZE n’asɛm nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Hagai do bae, dɛ,
Aso hom dze, ber edu ama hom dɛ hom tsena hom efi a wɔasesɛw enyi mu, ber a ofi yi adan afo yi?
Dɛm ntsi afei mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Hom ndwendwen dza ɔrokɔ do wɔ hom asetsena mu yi ho yie.

Hom edua pii, naaso kakrabaabi na hom nya fi mu; hom dzidzi, naaso hom mmee; hom nom nsa, naaso ɔnnso hom; hom furafura atam, naaso hom ho nnyɛ hom hyew; na nyia onya akatua no gye akatua no gu foto ntokurntokur mu.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Afei hom ndwendwen hom akwan ho yie;
na hom mfow mbepɔw no nkɛfa ndua mbesi dan no: na ɔbɛyɛ me fɛw na mahyɛ mo ho enyimnyam wɔ mu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hom hwɛɛ pii kwan, na hwɛ, obowiee ketseabaa bi; na hom dze baa fie no, muhuwii guu do. Ebɛnadze ntsi a? Dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse. Osian me fi a ɔadan afo, na hom dze hom esiesie hom efiefi ntsi.
Dɛm ntsi hom ntsi na ɔsor esianka dɛ ɔbɔsu nntɔ, na asaase esianka no ndɔbaa.
Na mefrɛɛ kwaweeyɛ mebaa asaase do, na mbepɔw do, na eburow do, na nsa do, na ngo do, na dza asaase dze ba do, na nyimpa do, na anyɛmbowa do, na nsaano edwuma nyina do.

Nna Sealtiel ba Zerubabel, na ɔsɔfopanyin Josua a ɔyɛ, Jehozadak ba no, wɔnye ɔman ne nkaa no nyina, wotsiee EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn ne ndze, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Hagai ne nsɛm no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn somaa no no; na ɔman no suroi wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
Nna Hagai, EWURADZE bɔfoe no, bɔɔ EWURADZE n’amandzɛɛ no kyerɛɛ ɔman no, dɛ, Mowɔ hom nkyɛn, EWURADZE na ɔse.

Na EWURADZE kenyaan Sealtiel ba Zerubabel, Juda ambrado no no sunsum, na ɔsɔfopanyin Josua, Jehozadak ba no, no sunsum na ɔman nkaa no nyina hɔn sunsum; na wɔbɛyɛɛ edwuma wɔ dɔm EWURADZE, hɔn Nyankopɔn fie,
wɔ bosoom a otsia esia no ne da a otsia eduonu anan no mu, wɔ ɔhen Darius n’afe a otsia ebien no mu.
Bosoom a otsia esuon no, bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu biako no, EWURADZE n’asɛm nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Hagai do baa dɛ,
Afei kasa kyerɛ Sealtiel ba Zerubabel, Juda ambrado no, na ɔsɔfopanyin Josua, Jehozadak ba no, na ɔman ne nkaa no, dɛ,
Woana aka wɔ hom mu a ohun dan yi wɔ n’enyimnyam a odzi kan no mu? Na hom hu no dɛn sesei? Aso ɔnnka hwee nnkyerɛ hom?

Naaso afei, Zerubabel e, hyɛ dzen, EWURADZE na ɔse; na ɔsɔfopanyin Josua, Jehozadak ba e, hyɛ dzen; na hom asaase do nkorɔfo nyina, hom nhyɛ dzen, na hom nyɛ edwuma no, EWURADZE na ɔse: na mowɔ hom nkyɛn, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse,
ɔnam ahyɛmu a menye hom dzii wɔ, ber a hom fii Egypt bae no, na mo sunsum a ɔtse hom mu no ntsi: mma hom nnsuro.
Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE ka nye yi: Bio, ɔnnkɛkyɛr biara, ma maawosow ɔsorsor, na asaase, na po, na asaasewewew;
na mobɔwosow amanaman nyina, na amanaman nyina akoradze bɛba mo hɔ na medze enyimnyam bɛhyɛ fie yi ma, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Sika yɛ medze, na dwetɛ so yɛ medze, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Enyimnyam a fie yi benya no ekyir yi no bɔso asen nkan no dze no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse: na fie yi mu na mebɛma asomdwee, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Bosoom a otsia akron no mu da a otsia eduonu anan wɔ Darius n’afe a otsia ebien no mu no, na EWURADZE n’asɛm nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Hagai do bae, dɛ,
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: afei bisa asɔfo no wɔ mbra no ho, dɛ,
Ana sɛ obi dze nam krɔnkrɔn hyɛ n’atar mu, na sɛ ɔdze n’atar no kɛka paanoo, anaa ɔsɛnmu edziban, anaa nsa, anaa ngo, anaa edziban biara a, aso ɔbɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn? Na asɔfo no buae see dɛ, Oho.
Nna Hagai bisaa dɛ, Sɛ obi a fun ama no ho ekum kɛka iyinom a, no ho kum? Na asɔfo no buae see dɛ, Nyew, no ho ekum.
Nna Hagai buae see dɛ, Mbrɛ nkorɔfo yi tse nye no, na mbrɛ ɔman yi tse wɔ m’enyim nye no, mbrɛ hɔn nsaano edwuma nyina tse nye no; na dza wɔdze bɔ afɔr wɔ hɔ no no ho ekum, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na afei, meserɛ hom, hom nhwɛ dza ofi ndɛ rokɔ yi ɔbɛba; ber wonnyae mmfaa ɔbo nntoo ɔbo do wɔ EWURADZE asɔrfi mu no owiee hom dɛn?
Dɛm nda no, sɛ obi baa esusudze ekuw eduonu ho a, nna du pɛ na onyae; sɛ obi baa nsatwer ho rebɛsaw etwadze eduonum a, nna eduonu pɛ.
Medze ohuw na ɔpo na ɔsorbo mobɔɔ hom wɔ hom nsaano edwuma nyina mu; naaso hom annsan ammba me nkyɛn, EWURADZE na ɔse.

Hom ndwendwen ho, ao, hom ndwendwen mber a abɛsen kɔ no ho. Aso nna aba bi da ho wɔ ɔsan do? Mekyerɛ wenyindua, adɔmbadua, pɔmegranate ekutu, na ngodua aba. Afei hom nhwɛ ofi ndɛ rokɔ, hom mfa ntoto ofi bosoom a otsia akron no ne da a otsia eduonu anan a wɔtoow EWURADZE asɔrdan no ne fapem wɔ mu no ho. Hom hu no dɛn? Ofitsi dɛm da yi do no na mebɛhyɛ ase ehyira hom.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Hagai hɔ ne mpɛn ebien wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu anan no mu, dɛ,
Kasa kyerɛ Zerubabel, Juda ambrado no, dɛ, Mobɔwosow ɔsorsor na asaase:
na mubobutuw ahenman ahengua, na masɛɛ amanaman ahendzi n’ahoɔdzen; na mubobutuw ntseaseanam, na hɔn a wɔtsetse mu no; na mpɔnkɔ na hɔn do atsefo bɔhwehwe ase, obiara bɔtɔ no nua afona anomu.
Da no mu no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, mebɛfa ɔwo, ao Zerubabel, m’akowaa, Sealtiel ba, EWURADZE na ɔse, na mayɛ wo dɛ nsɔwanodze: na ɔwo na masan mu meyi wo, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Darius n’afe a otsia ebien no mu bosoom a otsia awɔtwe no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Iddo ba Berekia ne ba Zekaria, nkɔnhyɛnyi no hɔ dɛ,
EWURADZE no bo efuw hom egyanom dodow.
Dɛm ntsi se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Hom nsan mbra me nkyɛn, na mebɛsan aba hom nkyɛn, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.

Mma hom nnyɛ dɛ hom egyanom a nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii kan no paa mu kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn, dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Afei hom nsan mfi hom akwan bɔn, na hom ndzeyɛɛ bɔn no ho: na wɔanntse, eso wɔannyɛ aso amma me no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hom egyanom no, wɔwɔ hen? Na nkɔnhyɛfo no, aso wɔda ho tse ase anaa?

Na me nsɛm nye m’ahyɛdze a medze hyɛɛ mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no, aso annto hom egyanom? Na wɔsanee, na wɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE dween dɛ ɔdze bɛyɛ hɛn, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn akwan, na hɛn ndzeyɛɛ tse no, dɛmara na ɔnye hɛn edzi yi.
Bosoom a otsia dubiako no a ɔyɛ Sebat bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu anan no, Darius afe a otsia ebien no mu, nna EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Iddo ba Berekia, ne ba Zekaria, nkɔnhyɛnyi no hɔ, dɛ,
Minyaa oyikyerɛ anadwe, na hwɛ, nyimpa a ɔtse ɔpɔnkɔ memen do, na ogyina mɛtlendua a ɔwɔ ɔbɔn mu no ntamu; na mpɔnkɔ amemen, ntokowa ntokowa na efufuw dzi n’ekyir.
Nna mibisaa dɛ, Ao mo wura, na iyinom ebɛnadze a? Na ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no see me dɛ, Mebɛkyerɛ wo iyinom hɔn adzeban.
Na nyimpa a ogyina mɛtlendua no ntamu no buae see dɛ, Woyinom nye hɔn a EWURADZE asoma dɛ wɔnnantsew ndzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do no.
Na wobuaa EWURADZE no bɔfoe a ogyina mɛtlendua no ntamu no see dɛ, Yɛanantsew edzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do, na, hwɛ, asaase nyina tse hɔ komm, dwudwoodwo.
Nna EWURADZE no bɔfoe no bisaa dɛ, Ao dɔm EWURADZE, onkodu dabɛn na wo yamu rennhyehye wo wɔ Jerusalɛm na Juda nkurow a w’ebufuhyew asoɛr hɔn do mfe eduosuon yi ho?
Na EWURADZE buaa ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no nsɛm pa a ɔyɛ awerɛkyekyer nsɛm.
Nna ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no see me dɛ, Paa mu ka dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Nyinkuntwe kɛse na medze motwe no Jerusalɛm na Zion ho.
Na mo bo efuw amanaman a hɔn ho adwe hɔn no dodow: na mo bo fuuw kakraabi, na hɔnara wɔboae ma ahohia no yɛɛ kɛse.
Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Medze ehumbɔbɔr na madan m’enyi akyerɛ Jerusalɛm; wobesi me dan wɔ mu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse. Na wɔbɔtwe susuhoma mu wɔ Jerusalɛm.
Paa mu bio, dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Mo nkurow no prɔmprɔmyɛ bobu do; na EWURADZE bɛda ho akyekye Zion no werɛ, na ɔada ho ara asan mu eyi Jerusalɛm.
Na memaa m’enyi do na muhun mmbɛn anan.
Na mibisaa ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no dɛ, Iyinom yɛ ebɛnadze? Na obuaa me dɛ, Iyinom nye mmbɛn a abɔ Juda, Israel, na Jerusalɛm apetse no.
Na EWURADZE kyerɛɛ me atomfo baanan.

Nna mibisaa dɛ, Ebɛnadze na atomfo yi bae bɛyɛe? Na obuae see dɛ, Iyinom nye mmbɛn a wɔbɔɔ Juda petsee, ma nyimpa bi amma ne tsir do no: na atomfo yi aba rebɛka hɔn ahyɛ, na woetutu amanaman a wɔmaa hɔn mmbɛn do tsiaa Juda asaase dze bɔɔ hɔn petsee no hɔn mmbɛn.
Na memaa m’enyi do mohwɛe, na muhun nyimpa a susuhoma kitsa ne nsamu.
Nna mibisaa no dɛ, Erokɔ hen? Na ɔsee me dɛ, Murukosusu Jerusalɛm mahwɛ ne tɛtɛr, na ne tsentsen.
Na, hwɛ, ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no fiir edzi, na ɔbɔfo fofor fiir edzi kehyiaa no,
na ɔsee no dɛ, Tutu mbirika, kɛka kyerɛ aberantsɛ yi, dɛ, Jerusalɛm wɔbɛtsena mu dɛ nkuroba a wonnyi afasu, ɔnam nyimpa na anyɛmbowa dodow a wɔwɔ mu ntsi.
Na emi, EWURADZE na mese, mara na mebɛyɛ gya fasu mabɔ no ho aprɔw, na mayɛ enyimnyam wɔ ne finimfin.
Ao o, ao o, guan fi kwaamu afamu asaase no do, EWURADZE na ɔse: na matserɛw hom mu dɛ sor mframa anan no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Ao o, Zion, guan, ɔwo a enye Babilɔn babaa tse.
Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: M’enyimnyam ntsi na masoma wo amanaman a wɔfaa hom afo no nkyɛn: na nyia ɔka hom no, ɔka emi EWURADZE m’enyi kyiresua.
Na, hwɛ, mobɔwosow me nsa egu hɔn do, na wɔayɛ afodze ama hɔn a wɔsoom hɔn no: na obiara bohu dɛ dɔm EWURADZE na ɔasoma me.
Ao Zion babaa, tow ndwom na dzi ehurusi: na, hwɛ, mereba, na mabɛtsena wo finimfin, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na amanaman pii dze hɔnho bɔbɔ EWURADZE ho wɔ da no mu, na wɔayɛ me man: na mebɛtsena wo mu, na ehu dɛ dɔm EWURADZE na ɔasoma me wo nkyɛn.
Na EWURADZE bɛfa Juda edzi do dɛ ne kyɛfa wɔ asaase krɔnkrɔn no do, na ɔada ho asan mu eyi Jerusalɛm.
Adasa nyina, hom ntaa dzinn wɔ EWURADZE enyim: na ɔasoɛr wɔ ne tsenabea krɔnkrɔn hɔ.
Na ɔkyerɛɛ me Josua, ɔsɔfopanyin no, dɛ ogyina EWURADZE no bɔfoe no enyim, na Satan gyina n’abanyimfa rotoatoa no.
Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see Satan dɛ, Satan e, EWURADZE ntwuw w’enyim; nyew, EWURADZE a ɔasan mu eyi Jerusalɛm no ontwuw w’enyim. Aso dɛm banyin yi nntse dɛ gyantsia a woehwim efi gya mu?
Nna Josua hyɛ ntar fi, na ogyina ɔbɔfo no enyim.
Na ɔbɔfo no kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn a wogyinagyina n’enyim no, dɛ, Hom nyi ntar fi no mfi no ho. Na ɔsee Josua dɛ, Hwɛ, mama w’emumuyɛ efi wo ho kɔ, na mebɛhyɛ wo ebirɛmpɔn ntar.
Nna mesee dɛ, Hom mfa asɔfokyɛw a ɔyɛ fɛw nsoa ne tsir. Nna wɔdze asɔfokyɛw a ɔyɛ fɛw soaa ne tsir, na wɔhyɛɛ no ntar; nna EWURADZE bɔfoe no gyina hɔ.
Na EWURADZE bɔfoe no see Josua dɛ,
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Sɛ ebɛnantsew m’akwan do, na esie m’ahyɛdze a, ɔno na wo so ebɔhwɛ me fie nsɛm do, na aweɔn m’abangua so, na mama enya hɔn a wogyina ha yi ntamu beebi egyina.
Ao ɔsɔfopanyin Josua, ɔwo na wo mfɛfo a wɔtsetse w’enyim, afei hom ntsie; na wɔyɛ nyimpa a wɔyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze: na, hwɛ, medze m’akowaa, Abaw no, bopue aba.
Na hwɛ, ɔbo a medze ato Josua enyim no; enyiwa esuon wɔ ɔbo kor do: hwɛ, mubokrukye no nkrukyei no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, na mibeyi asaase no n’emumuyɛ da kor.
Da no mu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, hom mu nyimpa biara bɛfrɛfrɛ ne nyɛnko aba wenyindua na adɔmbadua ase.
Na ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no baa bio, na obenyaan me dɛ nyimpa a woenyan no efi ne nda mu.
Na obisaa me dɛ, Ihu ebɛnadze? Na mubuaa dɛ, Muhu kandzeadua a ne nyina yɛ sika, na no ngotoa taa n’etsifi, na ne nkandzea esuon no wowɔ do; ndodobɛn esuon wɔ nkandzea a wɔwɔ n’etsifi no do nkorkor:
na ngondua ebien sisi ne nkyɛnmu, kor si ngotoa no n’enyimfa, na kor so si n’abankum.
Na mibisaa ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no, dɛ, Mo wura, iyinom ebɛnadze a?
