Nna ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no buae see me dɛ, Aso innyim iyinom n’adzeban? Na mesee dɛ, Mo wura, oho.
Nna obuae see me dɛ, Iyi nye EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔbaa Zerubabel hɔ, dɛ, Ɔnnam w’ahoɔdzen do, ɔnnam wo tum do, mbom ɔnam mo sunsum do, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Ao bepɔw kɛse, woana nye wo? Ebɛdan asaase tɛtɛr wɔ Zerubabel enyim: na ɔdze etsifi bo no bopue aba abɔbɔ do ose dɛ, Adom, adom mbra do.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa me nkyɛn bio dɛ,
Zerubabel ne nsa na ɔatow fie yi fapem; na ne nsa na obowie so; na ɔwo ehu dɛ dɔm EWURADZE na ɔasoma me wo nkyɛn.

Na kaansa wobuu edwuma yi n’ahyɛse kakrabaa yi enyimtsia mpo a, ber a wobohu promo no wɔ Zerubabel ne nsamu no, hɔn enyi bɛgye na wobedzi ehurusi. Nkandzeadua esuon a ihunii no yɛ EWURADZE n’enyiwa; wokyin dzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do.
Nna mubuae, na mibisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze nye ngondua ebien yi a wosisi kandzeadua no n’enyimfa na n’abankum yi?
Na mibisaa no bio dɛ, Ebɛn ngondua abaw ebien nye iyinom yi a wɔwɔ sika ano ebien a ohue sika ngo fa mu yi?
Na obuaa me see dɛ, Aso innyim iyinom hɔn adzeban? Na mesee dɛ, Mo wura, oho.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Iyinom nye nyimpa beenu a wɔasera hɔn ngo a wogyinagyina asaase nyina EWURADZE nkyɛn no.
Nna memaa m’enyi do bio, na muhun nwoma mbobɔwee a ɔnenam wimu.
Na obisaa me dɛ, Ihu ebɛnadze? Na mubuaa dɛ, Muhu nwoma mbobɔwee a ɔnenam wimu; ne tsentsen yɛ basafa enum, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebien na fa.
Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Iyi nye ndom a opue kɔ asaase nyina enyi no: na obiara a owia adze no wɔbɔpo no wɔ afa kor dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse; na obiara a ɔka ntanhun no wɔbɔpo no wɔ afa kor so dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse.
Mebɛma oepue akɔ, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, na ɔakɛhɛn owifo no fie, na nyia ɔdze me dzin ka ntanhun no fie: na ɔbɛtsena ne fi mu, na ɔahyew ɔno nye no ndua na n’abo.
Nna ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no puei, na ɔsee me dɛ, Afei ma w’enyi do, na hwɛ adzekor a orupue yi.
Na mibisaa dɛ, Ebɛnadze a? Na ɔsee me dɛ, Iyi nye efa esusudze a orupue no. Ɔkaa bio so dɛ, Iyi nye hɔn hwɛbea wɔ asaase nyina do:
(na hwɛ, wɔmaa sumbui talent kor do:) na iyi nye ɔbaa a ɔtse efa esusudze no mu no.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Emumuyɛ nye yi; na ɔtoow no kyeen efa esusudze no mu: na ɔtoow sumbui durdur no hin ano.
Nna memaa m’enyi do, na muhun mbaa beenu dɛ oepue na mframa wɔ hɔn ntsaban mu; na hɔn ntsaban tse dɛ ɔkompɛtɛ ne ntsaban: na wɔmaa efa esusudze no do wɔ asaase na sor ntamu.
Nna mibisaa ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no dɛ, Iyinom dze efa efa esusudze no rokɔ hen?
Na ɔsee me dɛ, Wɔdze rokɔ ekesi dan ama no wɔ Sinar asaase do: na sɛ wowie siesie a, wɔdze no besi ne bea no do wɔ hɔ.
Na memaa m’enyi do bio, na mohwɛe, na muhun, ntseaseanam anan a wofi mbepɔw ebien ntamu reba; na mbepɔw no yɛ boran mbepɔw.
Tseaseanam a odzi kan no, mpɔnkɔ memen wɔ mu; na tseaseanam a otsia ebien no, mpɔnkɔ tuntum wɔ mu;
na tseaseanam a otsia ebiasa no, mpɔnkɔ fitaa wɔ mu; na dza otsia anan no, mpɔnkɔ wonawona ahoɔdzenfo wɔ mu.
Nna mibisaa ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no dɛ, Mo wura, iyinom yɛ ebɛnadze?
Na ɔbɔfo no buae see me dɛ, Iyinom nye sor mframa anan a wofir edzi fi asaase nyina EWURADZE n’enyim no.
Tseaseanam a mpɔnkɔ tuntum wɔ mu no puei kɔr kwaamu afamu asaase do, na efufuw no fiir edzi dzii hɔn ekyir; na wonawona no puei kɔr pomu afamu asaase do.
Na ahoɔdzenfo no puei no, hɔnho peer hɔn dɛ wokekyin dzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mfi ha nkɔ nkekyin ndzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do. Nna wokekyinii dzii akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do.
Nna ɔbɔɔ mu kasaa kyerɛɛ me, dɛ, Hwɛ, hɔn a wɔkɔ kwaamu afamu asaase do no wɔama mo sunsum ho asan no wɔ kwaamu afamu asaase do.
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,

Gye sika na dwetɛ fi Heldai, Tobija na Jedaia a wofi Babilɔn ndɔmmum aba no hɔ, na da no ara kɔ Zefania ba Josia a ɔno so fi Babilɔn bae no ne fie; na fa yɛ abɔtsir na fa bɔ ɔsɔfopanyin Josua, Jehozada ba no ne tsir;
na ka kyerɛ no, dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE kasa se nye yi, dɛ, Hwɛ, banyin bi a ne dzin dze Abaw no; na ɔbɛfefɛw wɔ n’ananmu, na oesi EWURADZE n’asɔrdan no:
ɔnoara na obesi EWURADZE n’asɔrdan no; na ɔbɔsoa enyimnyam no, na ɔatsena n’ahengua do edzi hen; na ɔbɛyɛ ɔsɔfo wɔ n’ahengua do: na asomdwee ahyɛmu no bɛtsena hɔn beenu ntamu.
Na abɔtsir no bɛyɛ nkaadze ama Helem, na Tobija, na Jedaia, na Zefania ba Hen, wɔ EWURADZE asɔrdan no mu.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir no bɛba ebesi EWURADZE asɔrdan no bi, na hom ehu dɛ dɔm EWURADZE na ɔasoma me hom hɔ. Na sɛ hom dze mbɔdzembɔ tsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne ndze a, iyi bɛba mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔhen Darius n’ahendzi afe a otsia anan mu no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Zekaria hɔ wɔ bosoom a otsia akron a ɔno nye Kislev no, ne da a otsia anan mu no.
Nna Bɛtɛlfo asoma Sarezer na Regem-melek, na hɔn nyimpa aba dɛ wɔmbɔkotow nserɛ EWURADZE n’enyimpa,
na wombisa dɔm EWURADZE ne fie asɔfo no na nkɔnhyɛfo no, dɛ, Aso munsu wɔ bosoom a otsia enum no mu, na menkyen kɔm, dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ no wɔ mfe pii mu yi?
Nna dɔm EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
Ka kyerɛ asaase no do man nyina, na asɔfo no na bisa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom yɛɛ akɔnkyen dzii awerɛhow wɔ bosoom a otsia enum na esuon mu mfe eduosuon yi no, hom kyeen kɔm yi maa emi mara anaa?
Na sɛ hom dzidzi, na hom nom a, hom nndzi mma homankasa homho, na hom nnom mma homankasa homho anaa?

Aso nnyɛ nsɛm yi na EWURADZE nam nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii kan no do tseaa mu wɔ ber a Jerusalɛm da ho wɔ hɔ na hom tse mu no, na ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm a no nkurow etwa no ho ehyia, na wɔtse Pomu afamu na ɔbɔn mu no?
Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Zekaria hɔ, dɛ,
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE aka nye yi, dɛ, Hom mbu nokwar atsɛn, na nyimpa biara nkyerɛ mbɔbɔrhu na ayamuhyehye wɔ no nua do:
na mma hom nntseetsee okunafo na egyankaba, ɔnana na ɔbɔbɔfo; na mma hom mu biara mmfa no nua ho adwembɔn.
Naaso wɔammpen dɛ wobetsie, na wɔkoakoaa hɔn mbatsir, na wosisiiw hɔn aso, amma wɔaanntse.
Nyew, wɔyɛɛ hɔn akoma dɛ dɛnkyɛmbo, amma wɔaanntse mbra no, na nsɛm a dɔm EWURADZE nam no sunsum do maa nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii kan no bɛkae no: dɛm ntsi na ebufuw kɛse fiir dɔm EWURADZE hɔ bae no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ emi mefrɛɛ hɔn na woenntsie no, dɛmara na hɔn so wɔbɛtsea mu afrɛ me na mirinntsie, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse;
na medze ekyinehyia mframa bɔɔ hɔn petsee amanaman nyina a wonnyim hɔn no mu. Dɛm na asaase no bɛyɛɛ amamfo wɔ hɔn ekyir, dɛ obiara ammfa do annsan: osiandɛ wɔmaa asaase fɛɛfɛw no yɛɛ afo.
Na dɔm EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Motwe Zion ho nyinkun kɛse, na enyiber kɛse na medze twe no ho nyinkun.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Meresan aba Zion nkyɛn, na mebɛtsena Jerusalɛm mu: na wɔbɛfrɛ Jerusalɛm Nokwar kurow no; na dɔm EWURADZE ne bepɔw no, Bepɔw krɔnkrɔn.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Nkɔdaa na mberwa bɛda ho atsenatsena Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu, na onyin dodow ntsi, nyimpa biara bekitsa poma wɔ ne nsamu.
Na mbanyimbasiaba na nkataasia bɛhyɛ kurow no n’abrɔn no amaama, na woedzi agor wɔ abrɔn no mu.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Sɛ ɔyɛ ɔman yi ne nkaa no nwanwa wɔ nda no mu a, aso ɔbɛyɛ nwanwa wɔ emi so m’enyi do anaa? Dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛgye me man nkwa efi boka asaase no do, na anee asaase no do:
na medze hɔn aba, na wɔabɛtsena Jerusalɛm mu; na wɔbɛyɛ me man, na emi so mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn, wɔ nokwar na tsenenee mu.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: hom nhyehyɛ hom nsamu dzen, hom a hom tse nsɛm yi wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo anomu wɔ nda yi mu, hɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ da no a wɔtoow dɔm EWURADZE ne fi fapem no, dɛ worisi asɔrdan no.

Na ansaana da no reba no, na apaabɔ ho akatua nnyi hɔ mma nyimpa bi, eso apaabɔ nnyi hɔ mma abowa; eso asomdwee biara nnyi hɔ mma nyia opue anaa nyia ɔba mu osian ɔhohiahiafo no ntsi: na memaa nyimpa nyina obiara nye ne nyɛnko dzii esi.
Na afei dze mennkɛyɛ dɛ nkan no ama ɔman yi nkaa no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na asomdwee aba bɛba hɔ; wenyindua bɔsow n’aba, na asaase ama no ndɔbaa, na sorsor bɔtɔ no bɔsu; na mebɛma ɔman yi ne nkaa no enya ndzɛmba yinom nyina edzi.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛɛ ndom wɔ amanaman mu no, ao Juda fifo na Israel fifo, dɛmara na mebɛgye hom nkwa, na hom ayɛ nhyira: mma hom nnsuro, na mbom hom nhyehyɛ hom nsamu dzen.
Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Dɛ mbrɛ modween dɛ mebɛyɛ hom bɔn wɔ ber a hom egyanom yii me ebufuw no na mannsesa m’adwen no;
dɛmara so bio na madwen nda yi mu dɛ mebɛyɛ Jerusalɛm na Juda fi yie: mma hom nnsuro.
Iyinom nye ndzɛmba a hom nyɛ; Hom mu nyimpa biara nkasa nokwar nkyerɛ ne nyɛnko; hom mbua nokwar na asomdwee atsɛn wɔ hom mbobokɛse mu:
na mma hom mu obiara nndwen n’akoma mu bɔn wɔ ne nyɛnko ho; na mma hom mmpɛ ator ntanka: na iyinom nyina yɛ ndzɛmba a mikyir, EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na dɔm EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Bosoom a otsia anan, enum esuon na du no mu akɔnkyen no, bɛyɛ enyigye na ahosɛpɛw, na ahotɔ afahyɛ ama Juda fi; dɛm ntsi hom ndɔ nokwar na asomdwee.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Ɔbɛba no dɛmara, dɛ aman, na nkurow pii mu atsefo bɛba:
na kurow kor mu atsefo bɔkɔ kor so mu akɛse dɛ, Hom mma yɛnkɔ ntsɛmara nkɔtotɔ nserɛ EWURADZE n’enyimpa, na yɛnhwehwɛ dɔm EWURADZE n’ekyir kwan: na mara so morokɔ.
Nyew, aman pii na amanaman a wɔyɛ dzen bɛba abɔhwehwɛ dɔm EWURADZE n’ekyir kwan wɔ Jerusalɛm, na wɔatotɔ aserɛ EWURADZE n’enyimpa.
Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Nda no mu na ɔbɛba dɛ mbanyin du a wofi amanaman kasaa nyina mu bosusuo Jewnyi baako n’atar ano, dɛ, Yɛnye hom bɔkɔ, osiandɛ yɛatse dɛ Nyankopɔn nye hom wɔ hɔ.
Iyi nye EWURADZE n’asɛm: EWURADZE n’atsɛmbu bɛtsena Hadrak asaase do na Damaskɔs mu. Na nnyɛ Israel mbusuakuw nko na wɔyɛ EWURADZE dze, na Aram nkuropɔn so yɛ nedze.
Na dɛmara so ɔbɛyɛ Hamat so a ɔtoa do no; na Taere na Zidon so, kaansa wɔdwen dɛ wonyim nyansa papaapa mpo a.
Na Taere sii akoban maa noho, na otsiaa dwetɛ dɛ huntuma, na sika mapa dɛ abrɔn mu dɛtse.
Na hwɛ, EWURADZE bɛma efi ne nsa, na ɔabɔ no tum a ɔwɔ po mu no; na ogya ahyew nankasa.
Ashkelon bohu, na oesuro; Gaza so, na ayɛ no yayaayaw; na Ekron, na ɔahyɛ n’enyisun enyito: na Gaza nnkenya ɔhen biara, na Ashkelon so wɔrenntsena mu bio.
Na amamforafo bɛtsena Ashdod, na metwa Filistiafo ahopɔw do.
Na mibeyi no bɔgyanam efi n’anomu, na n’ekyiwadze no efi ne se mu; na no so bɛyɛ nkaa ama hɛn Nyankopɔn: na ɔayɛ dɛ Juda mbusuakuw no mu bi, na Ekron ayɛ dɛ Jebusnyi.
Na mobɔbɔ nsera ehyia me fi ho wɔ dɔm no enyim, na obi enntwa mu annkɔ anaa annsan ammba: na ahohiahiafo biara enntwa mu ammfa hɔn mu bio: na afei dze, marankasa na mobɔhwɛ me man do.
Dzi ehurusi kɛse, ao Zion babaa; bɔ ose, ao Jerusalɛm babaa: hwɛ, wo hen reba wo nkyɛn: ɔtsen, na ɔwɔ nkwagye; ɔdwe na ɔtse asoaso do, asoaso a ɔyɛ asoasopɔnkɔber ne ba do.

Na mubotwa ntseaseanam efi Efraim, na pɔnkɔ efi Jerusalɛm, na woetwa akodzi egyen so; na ɔbɛka asomdwee nsɛm akyerɛ amanaman: na n’ahendzi befi po ho ekesi po ho, na efi Esutsen no ho ekesi asaase ano noho.
Na ɔwo so, w’ahyɛmudzi bɔgyaa no ntsi meyi w’adaduafo efi mona a nsu nnyi mu no mu.
Hom nsan mbra akoban no mu, hom enyidado adaduafo: ndɛ mpo meka kyerɛ hom dɛ mubobu no mbɔho ama hom.
Na makom Juda ama moho, medze Efraim ahyɛ egyen no mu; na mibekenyan wo mbabanyin, ao Zion, medze etsia wo mbabanyin, ao Griis, na mebɛyɛ wo dɛ ɔkatakyi afona.
Na wobohu EWURADZE wɔ hɔn do, na n’egyen menaba befir edzi dɛ enyinam: na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn bɛhɛn akasamu no, na ɔdze pomu afamu ekyinehyia mframa epue.
Dɔm EWURADZE botwitwa agye hɔn; na woedzidzi, na woetsiatsia tseabo do; na wɔanom, na nsa ntsi wɔayɛ weɔɔweɔɔ: na wɔbɛhyɛ hɔn amaama dɛ ndweraa, dɛ afɔrmbukyia no aduodoo.
Na da no EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn no bɛgye hɔn nkwa dɛ ne man nguankuw: na wɔbɛyɛ abɔtsir ho abo a wɔama do wɔ asaase no do.
Na mbrɛ ne yie na n’ahoɔfɛw dua yɛ kɛse a! Edziban bɛma mberantsɛ no ayɛ prɔmprɔm, na nsa so ama mbabaawa no ayɛ dɛmara.
Hom mbisa EWURADZE, EWURADZE a ɔma asenaman paapaa no hɔ nsu wɔ ɔbɛsɛber; na ɔbɛma nsu atɔ berdzedzeedze ama hom, na hom nyina enyinya sar mu mfunoma.

Na terafim, ebusua ehonyi no, aka nsɛngyan, na nkɔnhyɛfo no ehu atorsɛm; na adaasofo ka akɔhwisɛm, wɔdze nsɛnhun kyekye werɛ kwa: dɛm ntsi ɔman no fa hɔn kwan dɛ nguan, hɔn ho hiahia hɔn, osiandɛ guanhwɛfo bi nnyi hɔ.
Mo bo efuw nguanhwɛfo no, na mebɛtsea dɛm mpɔnkyenyin no: na dɔm EWURADZE abɛsera no nguankuw Juda fi no, na ɔdze hɔn bɛyɛ n’enyimnyam pɔnkɔ wɔ ɔsa mu.
No mu na kutuwdo bo, prɛgow, akodzi egyen na apempensifo nyina bɔbɔ mu fi aba.
Na wɔbɛyɛ dɛ akatakyi a wotsiatsia abrɔn mu dɛtse do wɔ ɔko no mu; na wɔbɔko osiandɛ EWURADZE nye hɔn wɔ hɔ; na hɔn a wɔtse pɔnkɔ do no enyim bogu ase.
Na mebɛhyɛ Juda fi dzen, na magye Josef fi nkwa, na medze hɔn asan aba, na mehu hɔn mbɔbɔr; na wɔbɛyɛ dɛ gyama manntow hɔn annkyen: na emi nye EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn, na mibetsie hɔn.
Na Efraim bɛyɛ dɛ ɔkatakyi, na hɔn akoma edzi ehurusi dɛ gyama nsa ntsi a: ɛhɛɛ, hɔn mba bohu, na woedzi ehurusi; hɔn akoma enyi bɛgye EWURADZE mu.
Mobɔbɔ nhwiroma afrɛ hɔn, na maboa hɔn ano; osiandɛ mapon hɔn: na wɔbɔdɔr dɛ mbrɛ wɔadɔr yi.
Na mubodua hɔn amanaman mu; na wɔbɛkaa me wɔ ekyirekyir nkurow mu: na wɔnye hɔn mba benya nkwa, na wɔasan aba.
Medze hɔn befi Egypt asaase so do aba bio, na maboa hɔn ano efi Asiria; na medze hɔn bɛba Gilead na Lebanon asaase do; na wonnkenya kwan ama hɔn mpo.
Na wobodua ahohia po no mu, na ɔabobɔ po asorɛkye no, na Nael mu ebun nyina awewew: na Asiria no nkontompɔ no abrɛ adze, na Egypt ahempoma no eefi hɔ akɔ.
Na mebɛhyɛ hɔn dzen wɔ EWURADZE mu; na wɔbɛnantsew afow esian wɔ EWURADZE dzin mu.
Ao Lebanon, buebue wo mbobow, ma gya nhyew wo odum ndua.
Ao kupresidua, twa ewuo, na odum ahwe ase, osiandɛ enyimnyamfo no asɛɛ: ao hom Basan nsudur, hom ntwa ewuo, na kwaa dzendzen no aba famu.
Nguanhwɛfo ewuotwa ne gyegyee nye no! Na hɔn enyimnyam asɛɛ: ngyatafɔr pɔw ne gyegyee nye no osiandɛ Jordan ahohyehyɛ asɛɛ.
Mbrɛ EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Hom nnyɛn okum nguankuw no a
hɔn a wɔtɔ hɔn no, woku hɔn, na wonndzi so; na hɔn a wɔtɔn hɔn no ka dɛ, Nhyira nka EWURADZE, na menya moho: na hɔnankasa hɔn ahwɛfo no nnhu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
Na merennda ho nnya asaase no do atsefo no ho tsimbɔbɔr bio, EWURADZE na ɔse: na, hwɛ, mibeyi obiara ahyɛ ne nyɛnko nsa, na ne hen nsa: na wɔbɔbobɔ asaase no, mirinnyi hɔn mmfi hɔn nsamu.
Nna menyɛɛn okum nguankuw no, nguankuw no mu dza wɔyɛ mbɔbɔr no. Na mefaa mpoma ebien; mefrɛɛ kor Enyimpa, na mefrɛɛ kor so Nkabɔmu; na menyɛɛn nguankuw no.
Na mutwaa nguanhwɛfo baasa no kyenee wɔ bosoom kor mu; osiandɛ hɔn ho foon me kra, na mo so mo ho foon hɔn kra.
Nna mesee dɛ, Merennyɛn hom: dza oruwu no, ma onwu; na dza wotwa no kyen no, wontwa no nkyen; na hɔn a aka no, obiara ndzi ne nyɛnko ne nam.
Na mefaa mo poma Enyimpa no na mutwaa mu, dɛ moroto m’ahyɛmu a menye aman nyina edzi no.
Na wɔtoo no da no ara: na nguankuw no mu abɔbɔfo a wɔhwɛɛ me no wohun dɛ ɔyɛ EWURADZE asɛm ampa.
Na mesee hɔn dɛ, Sɛ oye wɔ hom adwen mu a, hom mma me m’apaabɔdze; na sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, hom mma ɔnka. Nna wokeer m’akatua ndwetɛbona eduasa maa me.
Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Tow gu adzekorabea, enyimnyam bo a woetwa no me tsir no. Na mefaa ndwetɛbona eduasa no, na motowee guu adzekorabea, wɔ EWURADZE fie.
Na mutwaa mo poma kor no, Nkabɔmu no mu, ama maasɛɛ Juda na Israel ntamu enuayɛ no.
Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Nkyii so bio fa guanhwɛfo kwasea no n’edwindadze no.

Na, hwɛ, mebɛma guanhwɛfo bi do wɔ asaase do a ɔrennsera hɔn a woetwa hɔn akyen no, eso ɔronnhwehwɛ hɔn a wɔapetse no, na ɔrennsa dza ebubu no yarba; eso ɔrennyɛn dza ɔtse apɔw no, na mbom obedzi dza adɔ angoa ne nam, na ɔapaapaa no n’anansa mu esinesin.
Oguanhwɛfo gyangyan a ɔdan nguan no gya no, ondue! Afona bɛba n’abasa do, na n’enyiwa nyimfa do: ne basa bɛkyenkyen, na n’enyiwa nyimfa efura kusuww.
EWURADZE atsɛmbusɛm a ɔfa Israel ho. Mbrɛ EWURADZE a ɔtserɛw sorsor mu, na ɔto asaase fapem, na ɔbɔ nyimpa no sunsum wɔ no mu no, se nye yi:
Hwɛ, mebɛyɛ Jerusalɛm ntentan kɔɔpow ama aman a etwa ehyia ho nyina, na Jerusalɛm no ntuae no bɛka Juda so.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mebɛyɛ Jerusalɛm ɔbo durdur mama aman nyina; hɔn a wɔdze bɔsoa hɔnho nyina bepirapira; na asaase do amanaman nyina bɔboa hɔn ano aba no do.
Da no mu no, EWURADZE na ɔse, medze ahobow mobɔbɔ mpɔnkɔ nyina, na medze abɔdam abɔ hɔn do atsefo: na mubobue m’enyi wɔ Juda fi do, na medze enyifura abɔ aman no mpɔnkɔ nyina.
Na Juda ebusuakuw bɛse wɔ hɔn akoma mu dɛ, Jerusalɛm atsefo hɔn ahoɔdzen wɔ dɔm EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn no mu.

Da no mu na mebɛyɛ Juda ebusuakuw dɛ gyasɛn wɔ nyena mu na gyatsɛn wɔ efiefi mu; na wɔahyew aman a etwa ho ehyia no wɔ bankum na nyimfa: na Jerusalɛm bɛda ho atsena ne tsenabea bio, wɔ Jerusalɛm hɔ ara.
EWURADZE so bedzi kan agye Juda asese nkwa, amma David fie enyimnyam na Jerusalɛm atsefo hɔn enyimnyam aammema hɔnho do ammbɔ Juda do.
Da no mu no EWURADZE botwitwa agye Jerusalɛm atsefo; na nyia ɔyɛ mberɛw wɔ hɔn mu wɔ da no mu no ayɛ dɛ David; na David fie bɛyɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn, dɛ EWURADZE bɔfoe a odzi hɔn enyim.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mobɔhwehwɛ amanaman a wɔbaa Jerusalɛm do nyina masɛɛ hɔn.
Na mubohue adom na ntotɔserɛ sunsum egu David fi na Jerusalɛm atsefo do; na wɔbɔhwɛ ɔno a wɔwɔɔ no peaa no: na woesu no, dɛ mbrɛ obi su ne ba kor, na woegyam no, dɛ mbrɛ obi gyam n’abakan.
Da no mu no, ewuotwa kɛse bɛba Jerusalɛm, dɛ Hadadrim-mon ewuotwa wɔ Megiddon bɔnsa mu.
Na asaase no botwa ewuo, ebusua biara no nko; David fie ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko; Natan fie ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko;
Levi fie ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko; Simei ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko;
ebusua ebusua a aka no nyina, ebusua biara nko, na hɔn yernom nko.
Da no mu no wobobue nsunyiwa ama David fi na Jerusalɛm atsefo, ɔnam hɔn bɔn na ahonamfi ntsi.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, mubotwa abosom no edzin efi asaase no do, na wɔrennkaa hɔn bio: na eso mebɛma nkɔnhyɛfo no na sunsum fi no efi asaase no do efi.

Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ obi da ho hyɛ nkɔm a, nna n’egya na ne na a wɔwoo no no wɔbɛse no dɛ, Efata owu; osiandɛ eka atorsɛm wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin mu: na sɛ ɔkɔ do hyɛ nkɔm a, n’egya na ne na a wɔwoo no no, wɔbɔwɔ no nkrantsee.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ, sɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no mu biara hyɛ nkɔm a, n’enyi bɔto wɔ noara n’enyido adzehu no mu; eso wɔnnkɛhyɛ nhwi egugudo dze esisi bio:
na mbom ɔbɛka dɛ, Mennyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi bi, meyɛ okuafo; na mayɛ kuadwuma fitsi mo mbofrabermu.
Na sɛ obi bisa no dɛ, Na wo nsa ntamu epirakur yi ɛ? Ɔno na obobua dɛ, Dza wɔdze piraa me wɔ m’adɔfo fie no a.
Afona e, soɛr hyɛ mo guanhwɛfo no do ɛ, na ɔbanyin a ɔyɛ mo ho nyimpa no do ɛ, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse: bɔ guanhwɛfo no, ma nguan no mpetse; na mebɛdan me nsa etsia nkakraba no.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ asaase nyina do, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ, no mu nkyekyɛmu ebien wobotwitwa, na woewuwu; na dza otsia ebiasa no, wobegya no wɔ mu.

Na medze nkyekyɛmu a otsia ebiasa no mubodua gya mu aba, na mahoa hɔn ho dɛ mbrɛ wɔhoa dwetɛ ho, na mahwɛ hɔn mu dɛ mbrɛ wɔhwɛ sika mu: wɔbɛfrɛ me dzin, na emi so metsie hɔn: mebɛse dɛ, Me man nye hɔn; na hɔn so wɔase dɛ, EWURADZE nye me Nyankopɔn.
Hwɛ, EWURADZE ne da reba a wɔbɛkyɛ w’asadze mu wɔ wo finimfin.

Na mobɔboa amanaman nyina ano aba Jerusalɛm do nye no abɔko; na wɔbɛfa kurow no, na wɔafom efiefi no, na wɔatoto mbaa no mbɔndar: na kurow no fa botu akɔ ndɔmmum mu, na ɔman no nkaase no dze worunntwitwa hɔn mmfi kurow no mu.
Nna EWURADZE bopue, na ɔnye amanaman no akɔko, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkoe wɔ nkoda mu no.

Na da no, n’anan besisi Ngo bepɔw no a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm tsentsendo wɔ boka afamu no do, na Ngo bepɔw no bɛpaa ebien wɔ ne finimfin fi boka afamu dze ekesi anee afamu, na ɔayɛ bɔnsa kɛsenara; na bepɔw no ne fa bɔtwe akɔ kwaamu afamu, na ne fa so atwe akɔ pomu afamu.

Na hom boguanguan afa me mbepɔw no no bɔnsaa no mu; na me bepɔw no no bɔnsaa no bodu Azel: ɛhɛɛ, hom boguanguan, dɛ mbrɛ hom guanguanee wɔ asaasewosow enyim wɔ Judahen Uzia nda mu no: na EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn bɛba, na akrɔnkrɔmfo nyina bɛka wo ho.
Na da no, ɔbɛba dɛ awɔw yayaayaw biara nnkɛba:
na adzekyee so bɛyɛ kor a EWURADZE na onyim; ɔnnyɛ adzekyee, na ɔnnyɛ adzesaa so: na ɔbɛba dɛ ewimbir no na kan bɛba.
Na da no, ɔbɛba dɛ nkwa nsu befi Jerusalɛm apem; no mu fa akɔ boka afamu po no mu, na no mu fa so akɔ anee afamu po no mu: ɔpɛber na awɔwber mu na ɔbɛba.
Na EWURADZE bedzi hen wɔ asaase no nyina do: da no mu na EWURADZE bɛda noho edzi dɛ EWURADZE kor no ara, na ne dzin so yɛ soronko.

Asaase no nyina bɛdan dɛ Araba, efi Geba ekesi Rimmon wɔ Jerusalɛm pomu afamu; na ɔbɔkrɔn, na ɔatsena ne tsenabea, dze efi Benjamin abobokɛse no ano dze ekesi odzi kan no ho, dze ekesi kutuwdo abobokɛse no ano, na efi Hananel abantsentsen no ho dze ekesi ɔhen ne nsatwer no ho.
Na nyimpa bɛtsena mu, na ndom biara remmba hɔ bio; na mbom Jerusalɛm bɛtsena dwudwoodwo.

Na ɔyardɔm a EWURADZE dze bɔbɔ amanaman a woetu Jerusalɛm do sa no nyina nye iyi: ber a wogyinagyina hɔn anan do no, hɔn honam bɔprɔw, na hɔn enyiwa so aprɔw wɔ hɔn etu mu, na hɔn tɛkyerɛma aprɔw wɔ hɔn anomu.
Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ weɔɔweɔɔyɛ kɛse fi EWURADZE hɔ bɛba hɔn mu; na hɔn mu obiara bosuo ne nyɛnko ne nsamu, na ne nsa ama do etsia ne nyɛnko nsa.
Na Juda so nye Jerusalɛm bɔko; na wɔbɔboaboa amanaman a etwa ehyia nyina hɔn ahonya ano, sika, na dwetɛ na ntar pii.
Na ɔpɔnkɔ, asoasopɔnkɔ, efupɔnkɔ, na asoaso, na mbowa a wɔwɔ nsera mu no hɔn yardɔm bɛyɛ dɛ yardɔm yi ara.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ, amanaman a wotuu Jerusalɛm do sa no nyinara mu dza aka no nyinara bɔfow aba, afrenhyia afrenhyia abɔkotow asɔr Ɔhen, dɔm EWURADZE no, na wɔahyɛ ntamadan afahyɛ no.
Na ɔbɛba dɛ asaase do mbusua nyinara mu hɔn a wɔnnkɔfow aba Jerusalɛm abɔkotow asɔr Ɔhen, dɔm EWURADZE no, nsu ronntɔ hɔn do.
Na sɛ Egypt ebusua ammfow annkɔ ammba a, ɔronntɔ hɔn do; yardɔm a EWURADZE dze bɔbɔ amanaman a wɔnnkɔfow aba abɛhyɛ ntamadan afahyɛ no ɔbɛba hɔ.
Iyi bɛyɛ Egypt na amanaman a wɔnnkɔfow aba abɛhyɛ ntamadan afahyɛ no nyinara hɔn ntsea.
Da no mu no, wɔbɛkyerɛw no wɔ mpɔnkɔ ndɔndɔmba do dɛ, KRƆNKRƆN MA EWURADZE na EWURADZE fie nkutu bɛyɛ dɛ afɔrmbukyia enyim ndweraa.

Ɛhɛɛ, nkutu a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm na Juda mu nyina bɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn ama dɔm EWURADZE: na hɔn a wɔbɔ okum afɔr nyina bɛba abɛfa mu bi akɔnoa adze wɔ mu: na da no mu no Keenannyi biara renntsena dɔm EWURADZE fie bio.
EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Malaki do baa Israel hɔ nye iyi.
Madɔ hom, EWURADZE na ɔse. Naaso hom ka dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na adɔ hɛn? Ana nnyɛ Jakob no nua nye Esau? EWURADZE na ɔse: naaso modɔɔ Jakob;
na Esau dze mikyiir no, na memaa ne mbepɔw yɛɛ afo, na medze n’egyapadze maa sar do mpataku.

Sɛ Edom ka dɛ, Wɔabɔ hɛn apetse, naaso yɛbɛsan akɛkyekyer mbeambea a ayeyɛ afoafo no a; mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE so se nye yi, wɔbɛkyekyer, na emi so mubodwuruw egu famu: kɛpem dɛ adasa bɛfrɛ hɔn dɛ, Emumuyɛ man, na Ɔman a EWURADZE afa hɔn ho ebufuw daapem.
Na hom enyiwa bohu, na hom aka dɛ, EWURADZE yɛ Okokroko mpo tra Israel ahe do.

Ɔba dzi n’egya nyi, na akowaa dzi no wura nyi: sɛ egya nye me a, nna m’enyidzii wɔ hen? Na sɛ owura nye me a, mo ho suro wɔ hen? Dɔm EWURADZE na ɔka kyerɛ hom asɔfo a wobu me dzin enyimtsia no. Na hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛn mu na yebu wo dzin enyimtsia?
Hom dze paanoo a no ho ekum brɛ me wɔ m’afɔrmbukyia do. Na hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na yeegu wo ho fi? Wɔ dɛ hom ka dɛ, EWURADZE n’edzidzipon no woebu no enyimtsia.

Na sɛ hom dze abowa nyitɔr ba bɔbɔ afɔr a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn bi! Na sɛ hom dze mbowa mpakye na ayarfo ba bɔbɔ afɔr a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn bi! Afei dze fa kɛma w’ambrado; dɛ n’enyi bɔsɔ wo a? Anaaso mpo dɛ ɔbɔhwɛ w’enyim a? Dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na afei, hom ntotɔ nserɛ EWURADZE n’enyimpa, ma ɔmbɔdom hɛn ɛ: na sɛ hom nsamu na iyi fi a, aso ɔbɔhwɛ hom mu obiara enyim? Dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Kɛtseankyɛ obi wɔ hom mu a ɔbɔtotow mbobow no mu, amma hom aannsɔ m’afɔrmbukyia do ogya kwa! M’enyi nnsɔ hom hwee, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, eso merenngye hom nsamu ayɛyɛdze biara.

Na ofitsi wipuei dze kesi no tɔree mpo, me dzin yɛ kɛse wɔ Amanaman mu; na wɔhyew eduhuam bɔ afɔr ma me dzin wɔ mbeambea nyina, na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze a no ho tsew ba: na me dzin yɛ kɛse wɔ Amanaman mu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na hom dze, hom gu ho fi, wɔ dɛ hom ka dɛ, EWURADZE n’edzidzipon no ho ekum, na no do aba, n’edziban no, hom bu no enyimtsia.

Hom ka so dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔhaw bɛn nye yi! Na hom tweetwee gu do, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse; na afei so hom dze dza wɔdze enyimpi fae, na mbowa mpakye na ayarfo no ba; dɛm na hom dze hom ayɛyɛdze ba. Aso mebɛgye iyi wɔ hom nsamu? EWURADZE na ɔse.

Na ndom nka nyia ɔwɔ onyin wɔ no nguankuw mu, na ɔdze bɔ anohoba, naaso osisi na ɔdze dza odzi dzɛm bɔ EWURADZE okum afɔr no: na ɔhen kɛse nye me, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, na me dzin yɛ hu wɔ Amanaman mu.
Na afei, hom asɔfo so, mbrasɛm yi homdze a.

Sɛ hom enntsie, na sɛ hom ammfa annto akoma mu, dɛ hom dze enyimnyam bɛma me dzin a, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, ɔnodze, mobɔsoma ndom aba hom do, na madom hom nhyira: nyew, madom hom dada, osiandɛ hom mmfa m’asɛm nnto hom akoma mu.
Hwɛ, mubotwuw hom asefo no enyim wɔ hom ntsi, na matow egyanan apetse hom enyim, mekyerɛ hom kum afɔr egyanan no; na wɔbɛsesaw hom aka ho akɔ.
Na hom bohu dɛ emi na masoma mbrasɛm yi abrɛ hom, ama m’ahyɛmu aako Levi nkyɛn, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
M’ahyɛmu a menye no dzii no yɛ nkwa na asomdwee; na medze maa no ama oeesuro, na ampa osuroo me, na me dzin ho yɛɛ no hu.
Nokwar mbra no daa n’anomu, na woennhu ɔbrakyewsɛm biara wɔ n’anomu; ɔnye me nantseew asomdwee na tɔɔtsenyɛ mu, na ɔdaan dodowara fii emumuyɛ ho.
Na otwar dɛ ɔsɔfo n’ano sie nyimdzee, odzi mbra do, na ɔyɛ nhwɛdo pa ma afofor: osiandɛ ɔno nye dɔm EWURADZE no bɔfoe.
Naaso hom aman efi kwan no mu; hom ama dodowara efintsiw mbra no mu; hom asɛɛ Levi ahyɛmu no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi na mo so mama hom ayɛ enyimguasefo na nkɔhweaban wɔ aman nyina enyim, dɛ mbrɛ hom nndzi m’akwan do, na hom ahwɛ nyimpa enyim wɔ mbra no mu ara no.
Ana nnyɛ egya kor na hɛn nyina yɛwɔ? Ana nnyɛ Nyankopɔn kor na ɔbɔɔ hɛn nyina? Ɔyɛ dɛn na hɛn mu obiara twa no nua nkontompɔ, yɛdze gu hɛn egyanom ahyɛmu ho fi yi?
Juda etwa nkontompɔ, na wɔayɛ ekyiwadze wɔ Israel na Jerusalɛm; osiandɛ Juda ehura EWURADZE no krɔnkrɔnbea a ɔdɔ no no ho, na ɔawar anana bosom ne babaa.
EWURADZE botwa ɔbanyin a onyim naaso ɔhyɛ da ara yɛ iyi no efi Jakob asese mu, na ɔapow n’ayɛyɛdze a ɔdze brɛ dɔm EWURADZE no.
Na iyi so bio na hom yɛ: hom dze nyinsuwa kata EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia no do, osu na nkrumsi, ma dɛm ntsi ommbu ayɛyɛdze no bi bio, eso ɔmmfa ɔpɛ pa bi nngye no wɔ hom nsamu.
Naaso hom ka dɛ, Ase nye dɛn? Ase nye dɛ EWURADZE ayɛ ɔwo na wo mberantsɛber mu yer no ntamu dasefo, ɔno na etwa no nkontompɔ, naaso ɔno nye wo kafo, na w’ahyɛmudzi yer.
Ana Nyankopɔn annyɛ hom kor a no su wɔ hom mu? Ebɛnadze ntsi a? Dɛ hom bɔwo mba a wɔyɛ Nyamesurofo. Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie wɔ hom sunsum ho, na mma obiara nntwa ne mberantsɛber mu yer nkontompɔ.
Na emi mikyir awargu, EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔse, na nyia ɔdze emimdzi kata n’atar do, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse: dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie wɔ hom sunsum ho, amma hom eenntwa nkontompɔ.

Hom dze hom nsɛm ama EWURADZE aberɛ. Naaso hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na yɛama ɔaberɛ? Dɛ hom ka dɛ, Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔn no, oye wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na hɔn ho yɛ no enyigye. Na hom bisa so dɛ, Atsɛmbu Nyankopɔn no, ɔwɔ hen?
Hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe, na obesiesie kwan edzi m’enyim: na EWURADZE a hom rohwehwɛ no no, ɔbɛba n’asɔrfi mu awora; ɛhɛɛ, ahyɛmu no ho bɔfo a hom enyi gye no ho no, hwɛ, ɔreba, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na woana botum egyina ne mbae da no enyim? Na sɛ opue a, woana botum egyina? Osiandɛ ɔtse dɛ namfo gya, na ɔtanhofo semina:
na ɔbɛtsena ase dɛ dwetɛ namfo na yiyimufo, na ɔbɛtsew Levimba ho, na ɔapɔw hɔn ho dɛ sika na dwetɛ; na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze bɛma EWURADZE wɔ tsenenee mu.
Nna Juda na Jerusalɛm ayɛyɛdze bɔsɔ EWURADZE enyi dɛ kan nda no, na tsetse mfe no.

Na mebɛbɛn hom ebobu atsɛn; na mebɛyɛ ɔdasefo a no ho yɛ har etsia abayifo, na awartofo, na ntanhunkafo; na hɔn a wodzi ɔpaanyi emim wɔ n’apaadze mu, na wosisi okunafo, na egyankaba, na wɔbɔ ɔhɔho enyi fi ne ndzinoa ho, na wonnsuro me no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na emi EWURADZE mennsakyer; dɛm ntsi na hom, Jakob mba, hom nnsae no.
Ofitsi hom egyanom nda do na hom adan efi m’ahyɛdze ho, na hom enndzi do. Hom nsan mbra me nkyɛn, na mebɛsan aba hom nkyɛn, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse. Na hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na yɛnsan?
Aso nyimpa bowia Nyame n’adze? Naaso hom wia me. Na hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na yewia wo? Ebupɛn du na ayɛyɛdze mu a.
Wɔdze ndom adom hom; osiandɛ hom wia me, ɔman yi nyinara a.

Hom mfa ebupɛn du no nyina mbra adzekoradan no mu, ma edziban mbra me fie, na hom mfa yi nsɔ me nhwɛ, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ munnkobue sor ntokura ama hom, na mehue nhyira ama hom a hom rinnya bea a ɔso a wɔdze bɛgye a.
Na mubotwuw ɔsɛɛfo no enyim wɔ hom ntsi, na ɔnnkɛsɛɛ hom asaase do nduadzewa; eso hom wenyindua nnkɔpo no nsowee egu famu ansaana ne ber edu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Na amanaman nyina bɛfrɛ hom ahomkafo: osiandɛ hom bɛyɛ enyika asaase, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hom akasa dzendzen etsia me, EWURADZE na ɔse. Naaso hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na yɛakasa etsia wo?
Hom aka dɛ, Nyamesom yɛ kwa: na ebɛn mfaso na ɔyɛ dɛ yeedzi n’ahyɛdze do, na yɛanantsew wɔ nnuho mu wɔ dɔm EWURADZE enyim?
Na afei yɛfrɛ ɔhopɔwnyi dɛ ɔhomkanyi; ɛhɛɛ, hɔn a wɔyɛ emumuyɛ no esi hɔn yie; nyew, mpo wɔsɔ Nyankopɔn hwɛ, na wofi mu fir so.
Nna hɔn a wosuroo EWURADZE no kasaa kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔnho: na EWURADZE kyɛɛn aso, na otsiei, na wɔkyerɛɛw nkaa nwoma wɔ n’enyim maa hɔn a wosuroo EWURADZE, na wɔdwendween ne dzin ho no.
Na wɔbɛyɛ medze, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔ da a mebɛyɛ yi no mu, mekyerɛ m’akoradze soronko; na mobɔfofɔw hɔn dɛ mbrɛ obi fofɔw ne ba a ɔsom no yie no.
Ɔno na hom bɛsan ebohu sorbi a ɔda tseneneenyi na mumuyɛnyi ntamu, nyia ɔsom Nyankopɔn na nyia ɔnnsom no no ntamu.
Hwɛ, da no reba, ɔrehyew dɛ fononoo mu gya; na ahopɔwfo nyina, nye emumuyɛfo nyina bɛyɛ dɛ mburonan: na da a ɔreba no bɛhyew hɔn, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ orinngya hɔn ndwow anaa abaw biara.
Na hom a hom suro me dzin no dze, ndzeyɛtsenenee ewia dze ayarsa wɔ ne ntsaban mu bopue ama hom; na hom bopue, na hom ehuruhuruw dɛ nantwiban mu anantwifɔr.
Na hom betsiatsia emumuyɛfo do; na wɔbɛyɛ nso wɔ hom ananadze wɔ da a mebɛyɛ yi no mu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
Hom nkaa m’akowaa Moses mbra a mehyɛɛ no wɔ Horeb maa Israel nyinara no, mekyerɛ ahyɛdze na atsɛmbudze no.
Hwɛ, mobɔsoma nkɔnhyɛnyi Elija abrɛ hom ansaana EWURADZE ne da kɛse a ɔyɛ hu no edu.
Na ɔbɛdandan egyanom hɔn akoma aba mba do, na mba hɔn akoma aba hɔn egyanom do; amma maammfa ndom ammbɔbɔ asaase no.
Jesus Kraest, David ne ba, Abraham ne ba no n’ebusuasantsen nwoma.
Abraham woo Isaak, na Isaak woo Jakob; na Jakob so woo Juda nye no nuanom;
na Juda nye Tamar woo Perez nye Zera; na Perez woo Hezron; na Hezron woo Ram;
na Ram woo Amminadab; na Amminadab woo Nahshon; na Nahshon woo Salmon;
Salmon nye Rahab woo Boaz; na Boaz nye Rut woo Obed; na Obed woo Jesse;
na Jesse woo Ɔhen David. Na David nye nyia nkyɛ ɔyɛ Uria yer no woo Solomon;
na Solomon woo Rehoboam; na Rehoboam woo Abija; na Abija woo Asa;
Asa woo Jehosafat; na Jehosafat woo Joram; na Joram woo Uzia;
na Uzia woo Jotam; na Jotam woo Ahaz; na Ahaz woo Hezekia;
na Hezekia woo Manaasɛ; na Manaasɛ woo Amon; na Amon woo Josia;
na Josia woo Jekonia nye no nuanom wɔ aber wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔr Babilɔn no.
Na Babilɔn ndɔmmumkɔ ber no ekyir no, Jekonia woo Sealtiel; na Sealtiel woo Zerubabel;
na Zerubabel woo Abiud; Abiud woo Eliakim; na Eliakim woo Azor;
Azor so woo Sadok; na Sadok woo Akim; na Akim woo Eliud;
Eliud woo Eleazar; na Eleazar woo Matan; na Matan woo Jakob;
na Jakob woo Josef, Mary a ɔwoo nyia wɔfrɛ no Kraest no no kun no.

Afei ebusuasantsen a ofi Abraham do besi David do nyina yɛ ebusuasantsen duanan; na ofi David do besi Babilɔn ndɔmmumkɔ ber no do yɛ ebusuasantsen duanan; na ofi Babilɔn ndɔmmumkɔ ber no do besi Kraest no do yɛ ebusuasantsen duanan.
Na mbrɛ Jesus Kraest n’awoo tse nye yi: ber a wɔdze ne na Mary maa Josef dɛ n’esiwayer, na wonnyae nnhyiaa mu no, wohun no dɛ onyinsen dza ofi Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu no.
Na no kun Josef yɛ nyimpa tsenenee, na ɔmmpɛ dɛ ogu n’enyim ase bagua mu ntsi, ɔdween dɛ obegyaa no wɔ nsumaa mu.
Na aber a ɔrodwen yinom ho no, hwɛ, Ewuradze bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ adaaso mu see dɛ, Josef, David ba, mma nnsuro dɛ ebɛfa wo yer Mary aba wo nkyɛn; na dza onyinsen no fi Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu.
Na ɔbɔwo babanyin, na ato no dzin Jesus, osiandɛ ɔno na ɔbɛgye ne man efi hɔn bɔn mu.
Na yinom nyina ayɛ hɔ, ma dza Ewuradze nam nkɔnhyɛnyi no do kae no aaba mu dɛ,
Hwɛ, ɔbaabun benyinsen, na ɔawo babanyin, Na wɔbɔto no dzin Immanuel, (a ne nkyerɛase nye dɛ, Onyame nye hɛn wɔ hɔ.)
Na Josef fii nda mu nyanee no, ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ bɔfo no hyɛɛ no no, na ɔkɛfaa ne yer baa ne nkyɛn;
na ɔnnye no ennhyia mu araa dze kodur dɛ ɔwoo babanyin: na ɔtoo no dzin Jesus.
Na ber a wɔwoo Jesus wɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm wɔ Judea, wɔ Ɔhen Herod aber do no, hwɛ, enyansafo bi fi boka baa Jerusalɛm bebisaa dɛ,
Hen na nyia wɔawo no Jewfo Hen no wɔ? Na yehun no woraba wɔ boka, na yɛaba dɛ yɛrobɔkotow no.
Na Ɔhen Herod tsee no, n’akoma tui, na Jerusalɛm nyina so dɛmara.
Na ohyiaa ɔman no asɔfompanyin nye akyerɛwfo nyina no, obisabisaa hɔn fakor a wɔbɔwo Kraest no.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Wɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm wɔ Judea, na dɛm na nkɔnhyɛnyi no akyerɛw dɛ,
Ɔwo, Bɛtlɛhɛm, Juda asaase, Ampaara ennyɛ kumaba wɔ Juda asafohen no mu: Na ɔwo wo mu na ambrado befi aba; Ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ me man Israel no guanhwɛfo.
Na Herod frɛɛ enyansafo no wɔ nsumaa mu no, obisaa hɔn ber a woraba no puei no ara yie.
Na ɔsomaa hɔn Bɛtlɛhɛm dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɔhwehwɛ abofraba no ho asɛm yie, na sɛ hom hu no a, hom mbɛka nkyerɛ me, ma mo so membra mombɔkotow no bi.
Na hɔn dze, wotsiee ɔhen no no, wosii mu kɔree; na hwɛ, woraba a wohunii wɔ boka no dzii hɔn enyim kodur dɛ okegyinaa mbrɛ abofraba no wɔ no etsifi.
Na wohun woraba no, wodzii dɛw kɛse pa ara.
Na wɔbaa dan no mu bohun abofraba no ɔnye ne na Mary, na wɔkotowee sɔɔr no, na wobuee hɔn akoradze kyɛɛ no adze, sika nye krɔbɔw nye eduhuam mɛɛr.
Na woyii kyerɛɛ hɔn adaaso mu dɛ mma wɔnnsan nnkɔ Herod nkyɛn bio no, wɔfaa kwan fofor bi do sanee kɔr hɔn kurow mu.

Na wofiir hɔ kɔree no, hwɛ, Ewuradze no bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ Josef adaaso mu see no dɛ, Soɛr, fa abofraba no nye ne na guan kɔ Egypt, na tsena hɔ kodu dɛ mebɛse wo: na Herod robɔhwehwɛ abofraba no eku no.
Na ɔsoɛree no, ɔfaa abofraba no nye ne na anadwe, na osii mu kɔr Egypt,
na ɔwɔ hɔ araa dze kodur Herod no wu, ma dza Ewuradze nam nkɔnhyɛnyi no do kae no aaba mu dɛ, Mafrɛ me ba efi Egypt.

Na Herod hun dɛ enyansafo no edzi no ho fɛw no, no bo fuuw kɛsenara, na ɔsomae ma wokokum mbofra nyina a wɔwɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm nye no ntoaado nyina a woedzi mfe ebien nye hɔn a wonnyae nndzii, dɛ mbrɛ mber a obisaa enyansafo no yie no wɔkyerɛɛ no.
Nna dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia kae no baa mu dɛ,
Wɔtsee ndze bi wɔ Rama, Osu nye ewuotwa kɛse, Rakel rusu ne mba, Na ɔmmpɛ dɛ wɔkyekye no werɛ, osiandɛ wonnyi hɔ.
Na Herod wui no, hwɛ, EWURADZE no bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ Josef adaaso mu wɔ Egypt see no dɛ,
Soɛr, fa abofraba no nye ne na kɔ Israel asaase do, na hɔn a nna wɔrohwehwɛ abofraba no eku no no, ewu.
Nna ɔsoɛree faa abofraba no nye ne na na ɔbaa Israel asaase do.
Na ɔtsee dɛ Arkelaus ridzi hen wɔ Judea wɔ n’egya Herod ananmu no, osuroo dɛ ɔbɔkɔ hɔ, na woyii kyerɛɛ no adaaso mu no, ɔmaan Galilii afamu,
na ɔbɛtsenaa kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Nazarɛt mu, ma dza nkɔnhyɛfo no kae no aaba mu dɛ, Wɔbɛfrɛ no Nazarɛtnyi.
Na nda no mu no John Onumanyi no bae bɛkaa asɛm wɔ Judea sar do,
na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nnu homho, na ɔsor ahenman no abɛn.
Na oyi nye nyia nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia kaa no ho asɛm dɛ, Obi ne ndze retsea mu wɔ sar no do dɛ, Hom nsiesie Ewuradze no kwan, Hom mma n’atsempɔn ntsentsen no.
Nna John fura efupɔnkɔnhwi tam, na nwoma abɔdo bɔ n’asen, na n’edziban nye mbɛbɛw na kwaa mu wo.
Na Jerusalɛm nye Judea nyina nye asaase a abɔ Jordan ho aprɔw nyina puei kɔr no hɔ
kɛkaa hɔn bɔn, na onumaa hɔn wɔ esutsen Jordan mu.
Na ohun Farisiifo nye Sadusiifo no mu pii dɛ wɔreba n’enuma ho no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nhurutsia mba! Woana tuee hom aso dɛ hom nguan mfi ebufuw a ɔreba no ho?
Na afei hom nsow aba a ɔkyerɛ nnuho:
na mma hom nnsusu nnka wɔ hom mu dɛ, Hɛn dze, hɛn egya nye Abraham: na mese hom dɛ, Nyankopɔn botum dɛ onyan mba fi abo yi mu ma Abraham.
Na afei so wɔdze ekuma no ato ndua no ndwow ho dada, dɛ dua biara a ɔnnsow aba pa no wobotwa no ato gya mu.
Emi dze, munuma hom nsu mu kɔ nnuho mu, na nyia odzi m’ekyir reba no ɔkrɔn kyɛn me, no nsokota mpo mennsɛ dɛ mikitsa: ɔno na obonuma hom wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, na gya mu;
ɔno na no nhuwdo apaawa adze kitsa ne nsamu, na ɔbɛpra ne famu hɔ kofee, na ɔaboaboa n’ewifua ano ekogu san do, na ntsɛw no ɔdze gya a onndum ahyew.
Nna Jesus fii Galilii baa John hɔ wɔ Jordan dɛ onnuma no.
Na John dze, nkyɛ orisiw no kwan dɛ, Emi na mihia dɛ ɔwo inuma me, na ɔwo ereba mo hɔ yi?
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Sesei dze, ma ho kwan, na ɔnam iyi do na yɛhyɛ tsenenee nyina ma. Nna ɔpeen do maa no.
Na wonumaa Jesus wiei ma ofii nsu no mu no, hwɛ, ntsɛmara sor buei maa no, na ohun dɛ Nyankopɔn no Sunsum risian tse dɛ ebubur ba no do;
na hwɛ, ndze bi fi sor kaa dɛ, Oyi nye mo Dɔba a ɔsɔ m’enyi.
Nna Sunsum no dze Jesus kɔr sar no do ma abɔnsam no kɔsɔɔ no hwɛe.
Na odzii mbuada adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa, na ekyir no ɔkɔm dzee no.
Na ɔsɔhwɛfo no baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, kasa ma abo yi ndan paanoo.
Na obuae see dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Nnyɛ paanoo nko bi na nyimpa nam do bɛtsena ase, na asɛm biara a ofi Nyankopɔn anomu so.
Nna abɔnsam faa no kɔr kurow krɔnkrɔn no mu, na ɔdze no kesii asɔrfi ne bea sorɔnsorɔm no do,
na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, tow woho kyen famu: na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Ɔbɛhyɛ n’abɔfoe mbra wɔ wo ho, Na wɔdze hɔn nsa bɔsɔw wo, amma aammfa wo nan ammpem ɔbo.
Jesus see no dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw bio dɛ, Mma nnsɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ.
Na abɔnsam faa no bio kɔr kokwaa tsentsenntsen bi do, na ɔkyerɛɛ no wiadze ahenman nyina nye no mu enyimnyam.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Yinom nyina na medze mebɛma wo, sɛ ebɔkotow asɔr me a.
Nna Jesus see no dɛ, Fi ha fi, Satan: na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Sɔr Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na no nko na som no.
Nna abɔnsam no gyaa no hɔ; na hwɛ, abɔfo bae bɔsoom no.
Na Jesus tsee dɛ woeyi John ama no, ɔtwee noho kɔr Galilii;
na ofii Nazarɛt no, ɔbae bɛtsenaa Karpernaum a ɔwɔ mpoano wɔ Zebulun nye Naftali ntoaado no;
ma dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia kae no aaba mu dɛ,
Zebulun asaase! Naftali asaase! Po kwan do, Jordan egya, Amanamamfo Galilii,
Ɔman a wɔtse sum mu Ehu kan kɛse, Na hɔn a wɔtse owu asaase sunkamm do no, kan epue ama hɔn.
Ofitsi dɛm aber no Jesus hyɛɛ n’asɛnka ase na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nnu homho, na ɔsor ahenman no abɛn.
Na ɔnenam Galilii po ho no, ohun enuanom beenu, Simon a wɔfrɛ no Peter, nye no nua Andrew dɛ wɔrotow eboa wɔ po mu; osiandɛ wɔyɛ afarfo.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mbedzi m’ekyir, na mebɛyɛ hom nyimpa enufo.
Na ntsɛmara wɔdaan eboa no gyae na wobedzii n’ekyir.
Na ofii hɔ kɔr n’enyim no, ohun enuanom beenu so, Zebedee ne ba James nye no nua John a wɔnye hɔn egya Zebedee wɔ hɛn mu resa hɔn mboa; na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn.
Na ntsɛmara wɔdaan hɛn no nye hɔn egya gyae, na wokedzii n’ekyir.
Na Jesus kekyimaa Galilii nyina kyerɛkyerɛe wɔ nhyiamudan mu; na ɔkaa ahenman no ho asɛmpa no, na ɔsaa nyarba nyina nye ahoɔmberɛw nyina wɔ ɔman no mu.
Na no ho asɛm tahyee kɔr Siria nyina; na wɔdze hɔn a wɔyar nyina a nyarba nye amandzehu horow ekitsa hɔn, nye hɔn a mbɔnsam afa hɔn, nye hɔn a wotwa ehim, nye mbubuifo brɛɛ no, ma ɔsaa hɔn yarba.
Na nyimpadodow pii a wofi Galilii nye Dekapolis nye Jerusalɛm nye Judea nye Jordan egya kaa no do.
Na ohun nyimpadodow no, ɔkɔr koko no do, na ɔtsenaa ase no, n’esuafo baa ne nkyɛn.
Na obuee n’ano kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ:
Nhyira aka sunsum mu ehiafo, na hɔn na ɔsor ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
Nhyira aka hɔn a hɔn werɛ ahow, na hɔn na wɔbɛkyekye hɔn werɛ.
Nhyira aka abrɛfo, na hɔn na wobenya asaase no edzi do.
Nhyira aka hɔn a tsenenee ho ɔkɔm nye nsukɔm dze hɔn, na hɔn na wɔbɛma wɔamee.
Nhyira aka mbɔbɔrhufo, na hɔn na wobohu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
Nhyira aka hɔn a hɔn akoma mu tsew, na hɔn na wobohu Nyankopɔn.
Nhyira aka esiesiefo, na hɔn na wɔbɛfrɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn mba.
Nhyira aka hɔn a tsenenee ntsi wɔahaw hɔn, na hɔn na ɔsor ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
Nhyira aka hom ber a wɔbɛyaw hom, na wɔahaw hom, na wɔaka nsɛmbɔn nyina ato hom do akɔhwi mu, wɔ me ntsi.
Hom ndzi dɛw na hom ho nsɛpɛw hom, na hom akatua so wɔ sor; na dɛmara na wɔhaaw nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii hom kan no.
Hom nye asaase do nkyen; na sɛ nkyen no ayew ne dɛw a, wɔdze ebɛnadze bɛhyɛ no nkyen? Onnye mma hwee bio, na mbom wɔtow gu ma nyimpa tsiatsia do.
Hom nye wiadze kan no. Kurow a ɔda koko do nntum nnsuma.
Eso wɔnnsɔ kandzea mmfa nnsi kuruw ase; na wɔdze si kandzeadua do, ma ɔhyerɛn ma hɔn a wɔwɔ fie nyina.
Ne dɛm ntsi, hom mma hom kan no nhyerɛn wɔ nyimpa enyim, ama woeehu hom ndwuma pa na wɔaahyɛ hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no enyimnyam.
Mma hom nndwen dɛ mebae dɛ merebɛsɛɛ mbra no anaa nkɔnhyɛfo no: dabida, mammbɛsɛɛ, mbom mebɛhyɛɛ ma.
Na nokwar mese hom dɛ, Sor nye asaase nnyae nntwaa mu yi, akyerɛwdze kor anaadɛ nsensanee kor mpo nnkefi mbra no ho etwa mu, gyedɛ ne nyina ahyɛ ma ana.

Dɛm ntsi obiara a ɔbɔto mbransɛm nketseaba yi mu kor, na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ nyimpa dɛm no, wɔbɛfrɛ no aketseaba wɔ sor ahenman no mu; na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ no, ɔno na wɔbɛfrɛ no ɔkɛse wɔ sor ahenman no mu.
Na mese hom dɛ gyedɛ hom tsenenee kyɛn Akyerɛwfo no nye Farisiifo no hɔn tsenenee, ɔno hom nnkɛhɛn sor ahenman no mu da.
Hom atse dɛ wɔkaa kyerɛɛ tsetsefo no dɛ, Mma nndzi ewu, na obiara a obedzi ewu no, obedzi fɔ wɔ atsɛmbu no mu;

na emi dze mese hom dɛ, Obiara a no bo fuw no nua gyan, obedzi atsɛmbu no mu fɔ; na obiara a ɔbɛse no nua, Raka, obedzi fɔ wɔ mpanyimfo bagua mu; na obiara a ɔbɛse, Ɔkwasea no, obedzi fɔ akɔ amandzehu kurow mu gya no mu.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ edze w’ayɛyɛdze ba afɔrmbukyia no ho, na sɛ ekaa wɔ hɔ dɛ wo nua wɔ wo ho asɛm bi a,
gyaa w’ayɛyɛdze wɔ afɔrmbukyia no enyim hɔ, na dzi kan kɔ nye wo nua nkɔbɔ mu, ana aba abɛma w’ayɛyɛdze.
Enye wo tamfo mbɔ mu ntsɛm ber a enye no wɔ kwan mu no; amma da bi wo tamfo eennyi wo annhyɛ ɔtsɛmbuafo nsa, na ɔtsɛmbuafo no eennyi wo annhyɛ ɔsomfo nsa, ma wɔaammfa wo annkɔto efiadze.
Nokwar mese wo dɛ, Innkefi hɔ gyedɛ etua kapɛrba biara a aka ekyir no ana.
Hom atse dɛ wɔkaa dɛ, Mma nnto awar;
na emi dze mese hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔhwɛ ɔbaa dɛ no kɔn dɔ no no, ɔafa no dada wɔ n’akoma mu.
Na sɛ w’enyiwa nyimfa to wo fintsidua a, tu na tow fi woho kyen: na oye ma wo dɛ wo nyimpadua ne fa kor bɛsɛɛ na wɔammfa wo nyimpadua nyina annkɔto amandzehu kurow mu.
Na sɛ wo nsa nyimfa to wo fintsidua a, twa na tow fi woho kyen: na oye ma wo dɛ ebɔhwer wo nyimpadua ho beebi na wo nyimpadua nyina nnkɔkɔ amandzehu kurow mu.
Wɔkae so dɛ, Obiara a obegyaa ne yer awar no, ma ɔmma no awargu no ho krataa;
naaso emi dze, mese hom dɛ, Obiara a obegyaa ne yer, ber a basia no mmbɔɔ edwaman no, ɔma basia no to awar; na obiara a ɔbɔwar nyia woegyaa no no, ɔto awar.
Bio hom atse dɛ wɔkaa kyerɛɛ tsetsefo no dɛ, Mma nnka ntanhun, na fa w’atanyi ma Ewuradze;
na emi dze, mese hom dɛ, Mma hom nnka ntam koraa: mma hom nnka ɔsor, osiandɛ ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn n’ahengua;
mma hom nnka asaase, osiandɛ ɔyɛ n’ananadzegua; mma hom nnka Jerusalɛm, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔhen kɛse no kurow.
Eso mma mmfa wo tsir nnka ntam, osiandɛ irunntum nnyɛ nhwi kor fufuw anaa tuntum.
Na hom mma hom Nyew, nyɛ Nyew; na hom Oho, nnyɛ Oho; osiandɛ biribi a ɔkyɛn yinom fi bɔn mu.
Hom atse dɛ wɔkaa dɛ, Enyiwa nsi enyiwa ananmu, na ese nsi ese ananmu;
naaso emi dze, mese hom dɛ, Mma hom nye ɔbɔnfo no nndzi esi; mbom sɛ obi bɔ wo sotɔr wɔ w’enyimfa a, dan bankum no so ma no;
na sɛ obi pɛ dɛ ɔnye wo dzi asɛm, na ɔgye w’asetar a, ma ɔmfa wo nkatado no so;
na obiara a ɔbɛhyɛ wo dɛ enye no nkɔ ɔkwansin kor no, enye no nkɔ ebien.
Nyia ɔserɛ wo no, ma no; nyia ɔpɛ dɛ ɔfɛm wɔ wo hɔ no, mma nndan woho mmfi no ho.
Hom atse dɛ wɔkaa dɛ, Dɔ wo nyɛnko na tan wo tamfo;
naaso emi dze, mese hom dɛ, Hom ndɔ hom atamfo, na hom nsɔr mma hɔn a wɔhaw hom;
ama hom aayɛ hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no ne mba: na ɔma n’ewia fir wɔ nyimpa bɔn nye nyimpa pa do, na ɔtɔ nsu gu hɔn a wɔtsen nye hɔn a wɔnntsen do.
Na sɛ hom dɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ hom a, ebɛn akatua na hom nya? Ana atowgyefo no so nnyɛ dɛmara?
Na sɛ hom kyia hom nuanom nko a, ebɛnadze na hom ayɛ abor do? Ana amanamamfo no so nnyɛ dɛmara?
Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi mu, dɛ mbrɛ hom sor Egya no dzi mu.
Hom nhwɛ yie, mma hom aannyɛ hom tsenenee wɔ nyimpa enyim dɛ wonhu: ɔyɛ dɛm a, hom nnyi akatua wɔ hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ ereyɛ adɔyɛ a, mma nnhɛn totorobɛnto wɔ w’enyim dɛ mbrɛ ndabrabafo no yɛ wɔ nhyiamudan nye abrɔn mu no, ama woeenya nyimpa hɔ enyimnyam. Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Woenya hɔn akatua dada.
Na sɛ ereyɛ adɔyɛ a, mma wo nsa bankum nnhu dza wo nsa nyimfa reyɛ;
ama w’adɔyɛ aaka nsumaa mu, na w’Egya a ohu nsumaa mu no obotua wo kaw wɔ gua do.
Na sɛ hom rosɔr a, mma hom nnyɛ dɛ ndabrabafo no; osiandɛ wɔpɛ dɛ wogyina nhyiamudan mu nye abɔntsen ntoaado sɔr, ama nyimpa eehu. Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Woenya hɔn akatua dada.
Na ɔwo dze, sɛ erosɔr a, hɛn wo pia mu, na atow w’abow mu no, sɔr ma w’Egya a ɔwɔ nsumaa mu no, na w’Egya a ohu nsumaa mu no obotua wo kaw wɔ gua do.
Na hom rosɔr a, mma hom nnyɛ kasafow ara gyan, dɛ amanamamfo no: osiandɛ wɔdwen dɛ wobetsie hɔn wɔ hɔn kasa dodow ntsi.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nyɛ dɛ hɔn: osiandɛ hom Egya nyim ndzɛmba a ohia hom ansaana hom ribisa no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nsɔr dɛm: Hɛn Egya a ewɔ sor, wo dzin ho ntsew,
w’ahendzi mbra, wɔnyɛ wo pɛ wɔ asaase do dɛ mbrɛ wɔyɛ no wɔ sor.
Ma hɛn, hɛn daa daa edziban ndɛ.
Na fa hɛn mfom kyɛ hɛn, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn so yɛdze kyɛ hɔn a wɔfom hɛn no.
Na mma mmfa hɛn nnkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu, na yi hɛn fi mbusu mu. [Na ɔwo na ahendzi, nye tum nye enyimnyam yɛ wodze daa. Amen]
Na sɛ hom dze nyimpa hɔn mfom kyɛ hɔn a, hom sor Egya so dze bɛkyɛ hom.
Na sɛ hom ammfa nyimpa hɔn mfom annkyɛ hɔn a, hom Egya so remmfa hom mfom nnkyɛ hom.
Na eso sɛ hom ridzi mbuada a, mma hom nnyɛ dɛ ndabrabafo no mmunamuna hom enyim: na wɔsɛɛ hɔn enyim ma nyimpa eehu dɛ woridzi mbuada. Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Woenya hɔn akatua.
Na ɔwo dze, sɛ idzi mbuada a, sera wo tsirmu na hohor w’enyim;
amma eennyi woho annkyerɛ nyimpa dɛ iridzi mbuada, na mbom wɔ w’Egya a ɔwɔ nsumaa mu no enyim, na w’Egya a ohu nsumaa mu no ɔbɛma wo akatua.
Mma hom mmpɛ akoradze nngu asaase do, mbrɛ nkakraka nye nkandar sɛɛ no, na ewifo bubu mu kowia;
na hom mpɛ akoradze ngu sor, mbrɛ nkakraka nye nkandar nnsɛɛ no, na ewifo mmbubu mu nnkowia:
na mbrɛ w’akoradze wɔ no, hɔ na w’akoma so wɔ.
Nyimpadua ne kandzea nye enyiwa: dɛm ntsi sɛ w’enyiwa yɛ kor a, wo nyimpadua nyina bɛyɛ kann.
Na sɛ w’enyiwa muo a, wo nyimpadua nyina bɛyɛ kusuww. Na sɛ kan a ɔwɔ wo mu no yɛ sum a, sum no ne kɛse tse dɛn!
Obiara nntum nnsom ewuranom beenu; osiandɛ obekyir baako na ɔadɔ baako, anaadɛ obedzi baako nyi na oebu ɔbaako enyimtsia. Hom runntum nnsom Nyankopɔn nye ahonyadze.

Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Mma hom nndwendwen hom nkwa ho, dɛ ebɛnadze na hom bedzi anaa ebɛnadze na hom bɔnom, anaaso hom nyimpadua ho, dɛ ebɛnadze na hom bofura. Ana nkwa nnkyɛn edziban, anaa nyimpadua nnkyɛn efuradze?
Hom nhwɛ wimu nnoma dɛ wonndua na wommbu, eso wɔmmboaboa ano nnhyɛ san do; naaso hom sor Egya nyɛn hɔn. Ana hom nnsom bo pii nnkyɛn hɔn?
Na hom mu woana na ɔdwendwen a, obotum dze basafa kor ato ne tsentsen do?
Na ɔyɛ dɛn na hom dwendwen wɔ efuradze ho? Hom nhwɛ nsua haban mu nsukookoo mbrɛ wonyin: wɔnnyɛ edwuma, eso wɔnntow asaaba:
naaso mese hom dɛ Solomon n’enyimnyam nyina mu mpo ɔannkeka noho dɛ yinom mu kor.
Na sɛ Nyankopɔn ma haban mu efuw a ɔwɔ ha ndɛ na ɔkyena wɔdze gu fononoo mu efuradze dɛm a, ɔnnkɛyɛ dza ɔkyɛn yi pii ama hom, hom a hom gyedzi suar?
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nndwendwen dɛ, ebɛnadze na yebedzi? Anaa, Ebɛnadze na yɛbɔnom, anaa, ebɛnadze na yebofura?
Na dɛm ndzɛmba yi nyina na amanamamfo hwehwɛ; na hom sor Egya nyim dɛ yinom nyina hia hom.
Na hom ndzi kan nhwehwɛ n’ahenman nye ne tsenenee, na wɔdze yinom nyina bɛka hom ho.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nndwendwen ɔkyena ho; na ɔkyena bɔdwendwen nankasa no ho. Da kor no mu bɔn dɔɔ so ma da no.
Mma hom mmbu atsɛn, ma wommbu hom atsɛn.
Na atsɛmbu kor a hom dze bobu no, wɔdze bobu hom; na esusudze kor a hom dze susu no, wɔdze bosusu ama hom.
Na ɔyɛ dɛn na ehwɛ duaba a ɔwɔ wo nua enyiwa mu, na enndwen mpuna a ɔwɔ wankasa w’enyiwa mu ho?
Anaaso ebɛyɛ dɛn ase wo nua dɛ, Ma minyi duaba mfi w’enyiwa mu, na hwɛ, mpuna wɔ wankasa w’enyiwa mu?
Ɔwo dabrabanyi, dzi kan yi mpuna fi wankasa w’enyiwa mu: nna ibohu yie eyi duaba no efi wo nua enyiwa mu.
Mma hom mmfa dza no ho tsew no mma nkraman, eso mma hom nntow hom ahondze pa nngu mpreko enyim, amma wɔaammfa hɔn anan enntsiatsia do, na wɔaannsan bio ammbɛtsetsew hom mu.
Hom mbisa na wɔbɛma hom; hom nhwehwɛ na hom bohu; hom mbɔ mu na wobobue hom:
na obiara a obisa no onya; na nyia ɔhwehwɛ no ohu; na nyia ɔbɔ mu no wobobue no.
Anaaso hom mu woana, na sɛ ne ba bisa no paanoo a, ɔbɛma no ɔbo?
Anaaso sɛ obisa no esunam a, ɔbɛma no ɔwɔ?
Na sɛ hom a hom muo yi nyim mbrɛ hom dze akyɛdze pa ma hom mba a, mpɛn ahen ara na hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no nnkɛfa ndzɛmba pa ama hɔn a wobisa no?
Dɛm ntsi adze biara a hom pɛ dɛ nyimpa yɛ ma hom no, hom nyɛ dɛmara so mma hɔn; na iyi nye mbra no nye nkɔnhyɛfo no.
Hom nhɛn abow tseaba no mu, na abow a ɔtsɛw, na ɔkwan a ɔyɛ tɛtɛr nye dza wɔdze kɔ ɔsɛɛ mu, na piinara wɔ hɔ a wɔfa mu.
Na abow a ɔyɛ tseaba na ɔkwan a ɔyɛ heaheaba nye dza wɔdze kɔ nkwa mu, na kumaabi na wohu.
Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo ho, na wɔba hom nkyɛn wɔ nguannwoma akataho mu, na hɔn mu dze, wɔyɛ mpataku edzifodzepɛfo.
Hɔn aba na hom dze bohu hɔn. Ana nyimpa tsetsew wenyinaba wɔ nsoɛ do, anaaso adɔmba wɔ kɔkrɔ do?
Dɛmara na dua pa ɔsow aba pa; na dua a ɔaprɔw dze, ɔsow aba bɔn.
Dua pa nntum nnsow aba bɔn, na eso dua a ɔaprɔw nntum nnsow aba pa.
Dua biara a ɔnnsow aba pa no, wotwa, na wɔtow kyen gya mu.
Dɛm ntsi hom dze hɔn aba bohu hɔn.
Nnyɛ obiara a ɔse me dɛ, Ewuradze, Ewuradze, na ɔbɔkɔ sor ahenman no mu; na nyia ɔbɛyɛ m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no ne pɛ a.
Da no mu no dodowara bɛse me dɛ, Ewuradze, Ewuradze, ana yɛammfa wo dzin annhyɛ nkɔm, na yɛammfa wo dzin enntu mbɔnsam, na yɛammfa wo dzin annyɛ tum ndwuma pii?
Na aber no, mebɛpaa mu maka akyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Minnyim hom da: hom mfi me nkyɛn nkɔ, hom a hom yɛ emumuyɛ.
Dɛm ntsi obiara a otsie me nsɛm yi na ɔyɛ no, wɔdze no bosusu badwembanyi a osii ne dan wɔ ɔbotan do no.
Na nsu tɔree, na nsuyirii bae, na ehum tui, ma wɔboor dan no na ɔannhwe ase, osiandɛ wɔtoo ne fapem wɔ ɔbotan do.
Na obiara a otsie me nsɛm yi na ɔnnyɛ no, wɔdze no bosusu kotobonyi a osii ne dan wɔ anhwea do no ho.
Na nsu tɔree, na nsuyirii bae, na ehum tui boor dan no, na ɔhwee ase, na n’asehwe no so.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus wiee nsɛm yi no, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ nyimpadodow no ahobow;
osiandɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ nyia ɔwɔ tum, na ɔnntse dɛ akyerɛwfo no.
Na ofii koko no do sianee no, nyimpadodow pii kaa no do.
Na ɔkwatanyi bi bae bɔkotoow no see dɛ, Mo wura, sɛ epɛ a, ibotum dɛ ema mo ho san.
Na ɔtseen ne nsa dze kaa no see dɛ, Mepɛ, wo ho nsan. Na ntsɛmara na kwata no fii no ho.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Hwɛ na aannka annkyerɛ obiara, mbom san kɔ, fa woho kɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no, na kɛma ayɛyɛdze a Moses hyɛe no fa yɛ dasedzi ma hɔn.
Na ɔkɛhɛɛn Karpernaum no, ɔhamupanyin bi baa ne nkyɛn bɛserɛɛ no see no dɛ,
Mo wura, m’akowaa da fie yar mbubui retseetsee dodow.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Mebɛba mabɛsa no yarba.
Na ɔhamupanyin no buae see dɛ, Mo wura, mennsɛ dɛ ebɛhɛn me hatsɛw ase; na ka asɛm no nko, na m’akowaa ho bɛsan no.
Na mo so meyɛ nyimpa a mowɔ tum ase, na mowɔ nsordaafo wɔ m’ase, na mese yi dɛ, Kɔ a, ɔkɔ; na mese obi so dɛ, Bra a, ɔba; na mese m’akowaa dɛ, Yɛ iyi a, ɔyɛ.
Na Jesus tsee no, ɔyɛɛ no nwanwa, na ɔsee hɔn a wɔka no do no dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Israel mu mpo munnhun gyedzi a ɔtse dɛm yi bi pɛn.
Na mese hom dɛ dodowara befi boka nye anee aba, na wɔnye Abraham nye Isaak nye Jakob abɛtsena ase wɔ sor ahenman no mu;
ber a ahenman no ne mba no dze wɔbɔtow hɔn egu ekyirekyir sum no mu: mbrɛ osu nye asetwɛr wɔ no.
Na Jesus see ɔhamupanyin no dɛ, Kɔ, na dɛ mbrɛ agye edzi yi, ɔnyɛ dɛmara mma wo. Na dɔn no ara mu akowaa no tsee apɔw.
Na Jesus baa Peter fie no, ohun n’asew basia dɛ ɔda hɔ yar papu.
Na osuoo ne nsa mu na papu no fii no do; na ɔsoɛree na ɔsoom no.
Na odur ewimbir no, wɔdze pii a mbɔnsam afa hɔn brɛɛ no; na ɔdze n’asɛm tuu esunsum no, na ɔsaa hɔn a wɔyar nyina yarba,
ama dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia kae no aaba mu dɛ, Ɔno na ɔfaa hɛn ahoɔmberɛw, na ɔsoaa hɛn nyarba.
Na Jesus hun nyimpadodow pii wɔ no ho no, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔnkɔ esuegya no ho.
Na Ɔkyerɛwfo bi bae bɛsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛnyi, beebiara a ebɔkɔ no, mebɛka wo do.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Nsɔ wɔ etu, na wimu nnoma wɔ mberɛbuw, na nyimpa Ba no dze, onnyi mbrɛ ɔdze ne tsir to.
Na n’esuafo mu bi so see no dɛ, Mo wura, ma me kwan ma monkɔ minkesie m’egya ana.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ka mo do, na ma ewufo nsie hɔnara hɔn ewufo.
Na ɔkɔr hɛn mu no, n’esuafo no kaa no do.
Na hwɛ, ehum kɛse tui wɔ po no mu, na asorɛkye kataa hɛn no do, nna ɔno dze, ɔada.
Na wɔbae benyaan no see dɛ, Owura, gye hɛn, yɛrehera.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom yɛ ehufo, hom a hom gyedzi suar? Nna ɔsoɛree na ɔbraa mframa nye po no, na ɔtaa dzinn.
Na ɔyɛɛ nyimpa no nwanwa na wɔsee dɛ, Ebɛn nyimpa nye yi a mframa na po mpo wotsie no yi?
Na odur esuegya no ho wɔ Gadarafo asaase do no, nyimpa beenu bi a mbɔnsam afa hɔn behyiaa no kwan; wofi abodan mu na wɔyɛ abɔyafo mbordo dɛ, ma ntsi obi nntum nntwa mu wɔ kwan no do.
Na hwɛ, wɔtseaa mu see dɛ, Yɛnye wo wɔ ebɛn yɛ, ɔwo, Nyankopɔn Ba? Ana ebaa ha dɛ erebɛhaw hɛn ansaana ber no edu?
Na ofi hɔn nkyɛn kɔ ekyir kakra no, mprekokuw kɛse bi wɔ hɔ ridzidzi.
Na mbɔnsam no serɛɛ no dɛ, Sɛ itu hɛn a, soma hɛn mprekokuw no mu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ. Na wopuei sii mu kɔr mpreko no mu; na hwɛ, mprekokuw no nyina faa twitwi kesiaan ɔbo kronn no koguguu po no mu, na wowuwui wɔ nsu no mu.
Na hɔn a wɔrenyɛn hɔn no guanee kɔr kurow no mu kɛkaa ne nyina nye dza ɔbaa hɔn a mbɔnsam afa hɔn no do no ho asɛm.
Na kurow no nyina fiir edzi behyiaa Jesus, na wohun no no, wɔserɛɛ no dɛ omfi hɔn ntoaado nkɔ.
Na ɔkɔr hɛn mu, na otwae baa nankasa no kurow mu.
Na hwɛ, wɔdze mbubuinyi a ɔda mpa do brɛɛ no; na Jesus hun hɔn gyedzi no, ɔsee mbubuinyi no dɛ, ɔba, hyɛ dzen, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo.
Na hwɛ, kyerɛwfo no binom sesee wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, oyi ɔkã ebususɛm.
Na Jesus hun hɔn adwen no, ɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom rodwen dza omuo wɔ hom akoma mu yi?
Na mmuana na ɔyɛ mberɛw kɛse, ebɛse dɛ, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo, anaa ebɛse dɛ, soɛr na nantsew, a?
Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma hom ehu dɛ nyimpa Ba no wɔ tum wɔ asaase do dɛ ɔdze bɔn kyɛ a, (nna ɔsee mbubuinyi no dɛ) soɛr, fa wo mpa na kɔ wo fie.
Na ɔsoɛree na osii mu kor ne fie.
Na nyimpadodow no hunii no, wosuroi, na woyii Nyankopɔn a ɔdze dɛm tum ama nyimpa no ayɛw.
Na ɔresen no, ohun nyimpa bi a wɔfrɛ no Matthew dɛ ɔtse atowgye, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ka mo do. Na ɔsoɛree kaa no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔtse edzidzi wɔ ne fie; na hwɛ, atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo pii nye Jesus nye n’esuafo bɛtsenatsenaa hɔ.
Na Phariseefo no hunii no, wɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom kyerɛkyerɛfo nye atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo dzidzi yi?
Na ɔtsee no, ɔsee dɛ, hɔn a wɔtse hɔn apɔw mu no, wonnhia oduyɛfo, na mbom hɔn a wɔyar no a.
Na hom nkɔ nkosūa iyi ase: Mepɛ ehumbɔbɔr, na nnyɛ afɔrbɔ a. Mammbɛfrɛ atseneneefo, ha mbom ndzebɔnyɛfo a.
Nna John n’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na yɛnye Phariseefo no yɛtɔ dɛ yedzi mbuada, na w’esuafo dze, wonndzi mbuada yi?
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ayeforpia mu mba no, aber a ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn, wobotum edzi nkɔmbɔ anaa? Na nda no bɛba a wobeyi ayeforkun no efi hɔn nkyɛn, na nkyii wobedzi mbuada.
Obi mmfa tam fofor sin nntaa atar dadaw mu: Dɛm no, dza wɔdze taa mu no yi fi atar no mu, na ntsewee no yɛ kɛse.
Na wɔmmfa wenyin fofor nngu nwomantoa dadaw mu: Dɛm no, nwomantoa no paa, na wenyin no hue gu, ma toa no so sɛɛ; na wɔdze wenyin fofor gu toa fofor mu, ma ebien nyina ayɛ yie.
Na ɔrekã yinom kyerɛ hɔn no, hwɛ, ɔpanyin bi bae bɔkotoow no see dɛ, me babaa ewu sesei; na bra bɛfa wo nsa to no do, na obenya nkwa.
Na Jesus soɛree kaa no do, na n’esuafo no so dɛmara.
Na hwɛ, ɔbaa bi a ɔyar bɔgyaagu mfe duebien bae bedzii n’ekyir kãa n’atar ano ndwow:
na ɔsee wɔ no mu dɛ, sɛ mekã n’atar nko ara a, mo ho bɛyɛ me dzen.
Na Jesus daan noho no, na ohun no no, ɔsee dɛ, Babaa, hyɛ dzen, wo gyedzi agye wo. Na ofitsi dɔn no ara mu na ɔbaa no no ho yɛɛ no dzen.
Na Jesus hɛɛn ɔpanyin ne fie, na ohun atɛntɛbɛnhɛmfo nye nyimpadodow a wɔreyɛ dedeede no,
ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom ntwe homho, na akataasiaba no nnwui, na ɔada. Na wɔsereew no twee.
Na woyii nyimpadodow no edzi no, ɔkɔr dan mu na okosuoo ne nsa mu, na akataasiaba no soɛree.
Na iyi ho asɛm tahyee asaase nyina do.
Na Jesus fi hɔ rokɔ no, enyifurafo beenu kaa no do tsēaa mu see dɛ, David ba, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
Na odur fi no mu no, enyifurafo no baa ne nkyɛn, na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, ana hom gye dzi dɛ mubotum ayɛ yi? Wɔsee no dɛ, nyew, Owura.
Nna ɔkãa hɔn enyiwa see dɛ, mbrɛ hom gyedzi tse no, ɔnyɛ dɛmara mma hom.
Na hɔn enyiwa buebuei. Na Jesus braa hɔn dzendzenndzen dɛ, Hom nhwɛ mma obiara eennhu.
Na hɔndze, wofii hɔ no, wɔdze ne nka kɛtahyee wɔ asaase nyina do.
Na worifir edzi no, hwɛ, wɔdze mmura a abɔnsam afa no brɛɛ no.
Na otuu abɔnsam no, mmura no kasae. Na ɔyɛɛ nyimpadodow no nwanwa, na wɔsee dɛ, wonnhun dɛm yi bi pɛn wɔ Israel.
Na Phariseefo no dze, wɔsee dɛ, Mbɔnsam hɔn panyin do na ɔnam tu mbɔnsam no.
Na Jesus kekyiin nkurow nye nkurobaase nyina mu kyerɛkyerɛe wɔ hɔn nhyiamudan mu, na ɔkãa ahenman no ne nsɛmpa no ho asɛm, na ɔsaa nyarba nyina nye ahoɔmberɛw nyina.
Na ohun nyimpadodow no, ne yamu hyehyee no maa hɔn, osiandɛ wɔahaw na wɔapetse dɛ nguan a wonnyi guanhwɛfo.
Na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Otwa-edwuma no dɔɔ sõ ampa, na edwumayɛfo no dze wosuar.
Dɛm ntsi hom nserɛ otwa-edwuma no wura ma ɔnsoma edwumayɛfo mbra no twa-edwuma no mu.
Na ɔfrɛɛ n’esuafo duebien no baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔmaa hɔn tum wɔ esunsum fi do, dɛ wontu hɔn, na wɔnsa nyarba nyina, nye ahoɔmberɛw nyina.
Na esuafo duebien no hɔn edzin nye yinom: dza odzi kan no, Simon a wɔfrɛ no Peter, nye no nua Andrew; James, Zebedee ba no, nye no nua John;
Filip nye Bartholomew; Tomas nye Matthew towgyenyi no; James, Alfaeus ba no, nye Tadeus;
Simon Kanannyi, nye Judas Iskariot a oyii no mae no so.
Duebien yi na Jesus somaa hɔn, na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnkɔ amanaman kwan no mu, eso mma hom nnhɛn Samariafo kurow biara mu:
na mbom hom nkɔ Israel fie nguan a wɔayew no nkyɛn.
Na hom kɔ a, hom nkɛka dɛ, Ɔsor ahenman no abɛn.
Hom nsa ayarfo yarba, hom nnyan ewufo, hom mma akwatafo ho nsan, hom ntu mbɔnsam: hom enya no kwa: hom mfa mma kwa.
Mma hom mmfa sika, anaa dwɛɛtɛɛ, anaa kɔɔber nngu hom abɔdo mu;
mma hom mmfa bɔtɔ, anaa sorntar ebien, anaa nsokota, anaa poma: osiandɛ ɔfata odwumayɛnyi dɛ odzidzi.
Na kurow anaa ekurobaase biara a hom bɛhɛn mu no, hom nhwehwɛ nyia ɔsɛ wɔ hɔ; na hɔ na hom ntsena nkodu dɛ hom befi hɔ akɔ.
Na sɛ hom rehɛn ofi no mu a, hom nkyia.
Na sɛ ɔyɛ fie a ɔfata a, hom asomdwee nka no, na sɛ ɔmmfata a, hom asomdwee nsan mbra hom hɔ.
Na obiara a ɔnnkɛgye hom anaa onnketsie hom asɛm no, hom fi ofi anaa kurow no mu rokɔ a, hom mporoporow hom ananadze huntuma.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ atsɛmbu da no mu dza ɔbɛba dɛm kurow no do no bɛsen dza ɔbaa Sodom nye Gomora do no.
Hwɛ, mosoma hom dɛ nguan wɔ mpataku finimfin: dɛm ntsi hom nyɛ enyansafo dɛ nwɔ, na hom nyɛ krɔnn dɛ mbubur.
Na hom nhwɛ yie wɔ nyimpa ho; osiandɛ wobeyi hom akɔ mpanyimfo bagua mu, na wɔaka hom mpire wɔ hɔn nhyiamudan mu;
na eso wɔdze hom bɔkɔ ambradofo nye ahemfo enyim wɔ me ntsi, dze eedzi dase ama hɔn nye amanaman.
Na sɛ woyi hom ma a, mma hom nndwendwen mbrɛ hom bɛyɛ, anaa dza hom bɛka, na wɔdze dza hom bɛka bɛma hom dɔn no ara mu.
Na nnyɛ hom na hom kasa, na hom Egya no Sunsum na ɔkasa wɔ hom mu.
Na nua beyi nua ama owu, egya beyi ba ama; na mba bɔsoɛr wɔ awofo do na wɔama woeku hɔn.
Na nyimpa nyina bɛtan hom wɔ me dzin ntsi: na nyia ɔbɛtsena mu ekodu ewiei no, ɔno na wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Na sɛ wɔtseetsee hom wɔ kurow yi mu a, hom nguan nkɔ fofor mu; na nokwar mese hom dɛ, Hom nnkowie Israel nkurow nyina do kɔ ansaana Nyimpa Ba no aba.
Osuanyi nnkyɛn ne kyerɛkyerɛfo, na akowaa nnkyɛn no wura.
Ɔdɔɔ so ma osuanyi dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛ ne Kyerɛkyerɛfo, na akowaa dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛ no wura. Na sɛ wɔafrɛ ofiwura no Beelzebul a, ebɛn edzin ara na wɔnnkɛfa afrɛ ne fifo!
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nnsuro hɔn: na biribi do nnkatae a worinnyi no edzi, na onnhuntae a worunnhu.
Dza meka kyerɛ hom wɔ sum mu no, hom nka no kan mu; na dza hom tse no asomu no, hom mpaa mu nka no adan etsifi.
Na mma hom nnsuro hɔn a woku nyimpadua no, na ɔkra dze, wonntum nnku no: na mbom hom nsuro nyia obotum asɛɛ ɔkra nye nyimpadua nyina wɔ amandzehu kurow mu.
Ana wɔnntɔn nsorɔm ebien nngye pɛsewa? Naaso hɔn mu kor mpo nnkokwetsir hom Egya ahwe famu.
Na hom tsinhwi mpo wɔakan ne nyina.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nnsuro: na hom som bo kyɛn nsorɔm pii.
Dɛm ntsi obiara a ɔbɔbɔ me dzin wɔ nyimpa enyim no, ɔno na mo so mobobɔ ne dzin wɔ m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor n’enyim.
Na obiara a ɔbɛpa me wɔ nyimpa enyim no, ɔno na mo so mebɛpa no m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor n’enyim.
Mma hom nndwen dɛ mebae mobɔsomaa asomdwee wɔ asaase do: mammba mammbɔsoma asomdwee, na mbom nkrantsee a.
Na mebae mebɛpaapaa mu ma banyin nye n’egya eenya, babaa nye ne na eenya, asew basia nye n’asewbaa eenya:
na nyimpa n’atamfo bɛyɛ ne fifo.
Nyia ɔdɔ egya anaa na kyɛn me no, ɔmmfata me; na nyia ɔdɔ babanyin anaa babaa kyɛn me no, ɔmmfata me.
Na nyia ɔmmfa ne mbeamudua na ɔnnka mo do no, ɔmmfata me.
Nyia ɔdɔ no nkwa no, ɔbɛyew no; na nyia ɔyew no nkwa wɔ me ntsi no, obohu.
Nyia ɔgye hom no, ɔgye me; na nyia ɔgye me no, ɔgye nyia ɔsomaa me no.
Nyia ɔgye nkɔnhyɛnyi wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi dzin mu no, obenya nkɔnhyɛnyi akatua; na nyia ɔgye ɔtseneneenyi wɔ ɔtseneneenyi dzin mu no, obenya ɔtseneneenyi akatua.
Na obiara a ɔbɛma nketseaba yi mu baako nsunwin kɔɔpow ma mpo wɔ osuanyi dzin mu no, nokwar mese hom dɛ n’akatua rommbɔ no.
Na Jesus wiee n’esuafo duebien no kasakyerɛ no, ofii hɔ dɛ ɔrekɛkyerɛkyerɛ na ɔakɛka asɛm wɔ hɔn nkurow mu.
Na John tsee Kraest no ndwuma wɔ efiadze no, ɔsomaa n’esuafo no kebisaa no dɛ,
Ana ɔwo nye nyia ɔreba no, anaa yɛnhwɛ nyimpa fofor bi so kwan?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɛka dza hom ehu na hom atse yi nkyerɛ John:
enyifurafo hu adze, mbubua nantsew, akwatafo ho san, etsitsifo tse asɛm, ewufo nyan, na wɔka asɛmpa no kyerɛ ehiafo.
Na nhyira aka nyia mennyɛ fintsidua mma no.
Na John n’esuafo no rokɔ no, Jesus hyɛɛ ase kaa John ho asɛm kyerɛɛ nyimpadodow no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom kɔr sar no do kɔhwɛe? Ndzɛmbir a mframa rihim no a?
Na ebɛnadze na hom puei kɔhwɛe? Nyimpa a ofura serekye tam a? Hwɛ, hɔn a wofura serekye tam wɔ ahemfo fie.
Na ebɛnadze koraa na hom kɔree kɔhwɛe? Ana dɛ hom bohu nkɔnhyɛnyi a? Nyew, mese hom dɛ nyia ɔkyɛn nkɔnhyɛnyi mpo a.
Oyi nye nyia wɔakyerɛw no ho asɛm dɛ, Hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe ma oeedzi w’enyim kan a Obesiesie wo kwan a ɔda w’enyim no.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, hɔn a mbaa awo hɔn nyina mu biara mmpuei a ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn John Onumanyi no; naaso nyia ɔyɛ aketseaba wɔ sor ahenman mu no yɛ kɛse kyɛn no.
Na ofitsi dɛ John Onumanyi no bae dze bodu ndɛ sor ahenman no gye enyiber, na hɔn a hɔn enyi aber no fa no enyiɔdzen do.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo nyina nye mbra no hyɛɛ nkɔm bɛpeem John do.
Na sɛ hom pɛ dɛ hom gye to mu a, oyi nye Elija a ɔreba no.
Nyia ɔwɔ aso a ɔdze tsie no ma ontsie.
Na ebɛnadze na medze ɔsantsen yi mobɔto ho? Ɔtse dɛ mbofraba a wɔtsenatsena gua do, na wɔrefrɛfrɛ hɔn anyɛnkofo, se dɛ,
Yɛahɛn atɛntɛbɛn ama hom, na hom annsaw; yeetwa ewuo na hom werɛ annhow.
Na John bae, onndzidzi eso ɔnnom, na wɔse dɛ, Ɔwɔ abɔnsam.
Nyimpa Ba no bae, odzidzi na ɔnom, wɔse dɛ, Hwɛ, nyimpa tumfur, nsahweam, atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo nyɛnko. Naaso nyansa no ndwuma bu no bem.
Nna ɔhyɛɛ ase twuuw nkurow a ɔyɛɛ no tum ndwuma pii wɔ mu no enyim, osiandɛ woennu hɔnho.
Korazin, due! Bɛtsaeda, due! Osiandɛ sɛ tum ndwuma a wɔyɛe wɔ hom mu yi, wɔyɛɛ no wɔ Taere nye Sidon mu a, nkyɛ wonuu hɔnho dada wɔ eyitam nye nso mu.
Na mese hom dɛ atsɛmbu da no mu ɔbɛfanyim Taere nye Sidon akyɛn hom.
Na ɔwo, Karpernaum, wɔbɛma wo do akɔ sor anaa? Hwɛ, wɔbɛbrɛ wo adze akɔ samanadze; osiandɛ tum ndwuma a wɔyɛe wɔ wo mu yi, sɛ wɔyɛɛ no wɔ Sodom a, nkyɛ wɔtse hɔ bodu ndɛ.
Na mese hom dɛ atsɛmbuda no ɔbɛfanyim Sodom akyɛn wo.
Na aber no mu, Jesus buae see dɛ, Miyi wo ayɛw, Egya, sor nye asaase Wura, dɛ edze ndzɛmba yi esuma enyansafo nye abadwembafo, na eyi akyerɛ nkɔkowaba.
Nyew, Egya, dɛm na ɔsɔɔ w’enyi.
M’Egya dze ndzɛmba nyina ahyɛ me nsa; na obiara nnyim Ɔba no, gyedɛ Egya no; eso obiara nnyim Egya no gyedɛ Ɔba no, na nyia Ɔba no pɛ dɛ oyi no kyerɛ no.
Hom nyina hom mbra mo hɔ, hom a hom reyɛ edwuma berɛ na wɔasoa hom dza ɔyɛ dur, na mebɛma hom ahomgye.
Hom mfa mo kɔndua nto hom do, na hom nsua me, osiandɛ modwe na mebrɛ moho adze wɔ akoma mu; na hom benya ahomgye ama hom akra.
Na mo kɔndua yɛ mberɛw, na m’adzesoa yɛ har.
Na aber no mu Jesus koduaa eburow kwa mu ahomgyeda; na ɔkɔm dzee n’esuafo no, wɔhyɛɛ ase pempaan eburow mbɛtsem no wee.
Na Farisiifo no hunii no, wɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, w’esuafo no reyɛ dza ɔmmfa mbra mu ahomgyeda.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan dza David yɛe aber a ɔkɔm dzee ɔno nye hɔn a wɔka no ho no?
Mbrɛ ɔkɛhɛɛn Nyankopɔn fie na okedzii kyerɛpaanoo a ɔmmfa mbra mu dɛ odzi, anaa hɔn a wɔka no ho no, gyedɛ asɔfo no ara nko no?
Anaaso hom nnkenkanee wɔ mbra no mu, mbrɛ ahomgyeda no mu asɔfo no wɔto ahomgyeda wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na wonndzi fɔ?
Na mese hom dɛ nyia ɔkyɛn asɔrfi no wɔ ha.
Na sɛ hom tsee kasa yi ase a, dɛ, Mepɛ ehumbɔbɔr na nnyɛ afɔrbɔ a, nkyɛ hom emmbu hɔn a wonndzi fɔ no fɔ.
Na nyimpa Ba no yɛ ahomgyeda no so no wura.
Na ofii hɔ kɔree, na ɔkɔr hɔn nhyiamudan no mu;
na hwɛ, nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ne nsa adwe. Na wobisaa no see dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ wɔsa yarba ahomgyeda? Ama woeetum aatoa no.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mu nyimpa bɛn, na sɛ ɔwɔ oguan kor, na sɛ ɔkɔtɔ mona mu ahomgyeda a, onnkosuo no mu na ɔama no do?
Ebɛnadze a? Ana nyimpa nsom bo nkyɛn oguan a? Dɛm ntsi ɔfa mbra mu dɛ wɔyɛ papa ahomgyeda.
Nna ɔsee nyimpa no dɛ, Tsen wo nsa. Na ɔtsenee; na ɔsanee yɛɛ mu dɛ kor no.
Na Farisiifo no puei, na wɔkɛfaa apam wɔ no ho, mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ asɛɛ no.
Na Jesus hunii no, ɔtwee noho fii hɔ, na dodowara kaa no do, na ɔsaa hɔn nyina yarba,
na ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wonnyi no nnkyerɛ:
ma dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia kae no aaba mu dɛ,
Hwɛ, mo somfo a meyi no, Mo dɔfo a me kra enyiwa sɔ no: Medze mo Sunsum bogu no do, Na ɔaka atsɛmbu akyerɛ amanaman.
Ɔnnkɛper, eso ɔnnkɛtsea mu; Eso obiara nnkɛtse ne ndze wɔ abɔntsen do.
Ndzɛmbir a ɔakonkon no onnkobu, Na asaaba a opun wusiw onnkodum no, Dze ekesi dɛ ɔbɛma atsɛmbu akɔ konyim mu.
Na ne dzin mu na amanaman dze hɔn werɛ bɛhyɛ.
Nna wɔdze obi a abɔnsam afa no a ɔyɛ onyifurafo nye mmum brɛɛ no: na ɔsaa no yarba, na mmum no kasae na ohun adze.
Na nyimpadodow no nyina ho boow hɔn, na wɔsee dɛ, Ana oyi nye David ba no?
Na Farisiifo no tsee no, wɔsee dɛ, Oyi nntum nntu mbɔnsam gyedɛ ɔnam mbɔnsam panyin Beelzebul do.
Na ohun hɔn adwen no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ahenman biara nye noho dzi mpaapaamu a, ɔyɛ amamfo, na kurow anaa fi biara a ɔnye noho dzi mpaapaamu no orinngyina:
na sɛ Satan tu Satan a, nna ɔnye noho edzi mpaapaamu: ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na n’ahenman egyina?
Na sɛ emi menam Beelzebul do tu mbɔnsam a, woana do na hom mba nam tu hɔn? Dɛm ntsi hɔn na wɔbɛyɛ hom atsɛmbuafo.
Na sɛ menam Nyankopɔn Sunsum do tu mbɔnsam a, nna Nyankopɔn ahenman enya aba hom nkyɛn.
Anaadɛ, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na obi botum akɔ ɔkatakyi bi ne fie akɔfow n’efidze, gyedɛ odzi kan kyekyer ɔkatakyi no, ansaana ɔafow ne fie.
Nyia ɔnnka mo ho no, na ɔnye me enya; nyia ɔnye me mmboaboa ano no, ɔhotse gu.
Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Bɔn biara, ɔnye ebususɛm biara, wɔdze bɛkyɛ nyimpa, na ebususɛm a otsia Sunsum no dze, wɔnnkɛfa akyɛ nyimpa.
Na obiara a ɔbɛka asɛm etsia nyimpa Ba no, wɔdze bɛkyɛ no, na obiara a ɔbɛka asɛm etsia Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no, wɔnnkɛfa akyɛ no wɔ wiadze ha, nye wiadze a ɔreba no mu.
Hom mma dua no nyɛ yie, na n’aba so nyɛ yie; anaadɛ hom mma dua no mprɔw, na n’aba so mprɔw: osiandɛ dua wɔdze n’aba hu no.
Nhurutsia mba, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na hom muo yi, hom bɛka nsɛm pa? Na dza ebu do wɔ akoma mu no na ano ka.
Nyimpa pa fi ne ndzepa korabea na oyi ndzepa fi ba; na nyimpa bɔn fi ne ndzɛmba bɔn korabea na oyi dza omuo fi ba.
Na mese hom dɛ nsɛngyan biara a nyimpa bɛka no wobobu ho nkontaa wɔ atsɛmbu da mu.
Osiandɛ wo nsɛm do na wɔnam bobu wo bem; na wo nsɛm do na wɔnam bobu wo fɔ.
Nna Akyerɛwfo no nye Farisiifo no mu binom buae see dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yɛpɛ dɛ yehu wo hɔ asɛnkyerɛdze.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ɔsantsen bɔn nye awartofo rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na wɔremma hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze biara dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jona asɛnkyerɛdze no:
na dɛ mbrɛ Jona dzii ndaansa adzekyee nye adzesaa wɔ bonso yamu no, dɛmara na nyimpa Ba no bedzi ndaansa adzekyee nye adzesaa wɔ asaase tsirmu.
Ninive mbarimba nye ɔsantsen yi bɔsoɛr wɔ atsɛmbu no mu, na woebu hɔn fɔ; osiandɛ wonuu hɔnho wɔ Jona n’asɛnka ase, na hwɛ, nyia ɔsen Jona wɔ ha.
Pomu afamu ɔhembaa nye ɔsantsen yi bɔsoɛr wɔ atsɛmbu no mu, na oebu hɔn fɔ: osiandɛ ofii asaase ano noho bae betsiee Solomon ne nyansaa, na hwɛ, nyia ɔsen Solomon wɔ ha.
Na sunsum fi, sɛ ofi nyimpa mu fir a, okekyin wewew do hwehwɛ ahomgye na onnya bi.
Nna ɔse dɛ, Mebɛsan akɔ me fie a mifii mu bae no mu, na ɔba a, ɔto no pan, wɔaprapra mu na wɔahyehyɛ mu.
Nna ɔkɔ kɛfa esunsum esuon fofor a womuo sen nankasa ka no ho, na wɔbɛhɛn mu tsena hɔ: na nyimpa no n’ekyir asetsena yɛ bɔn sen nkan no dze; dɛmara na ɔbɛyɛ ama ɔsantsen bɔn yi.
Na ɔda do rekasa kyerɛ nyimpadodow no, hwɛ, ne na nye no nuanom begyinaa abow enyim hwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔnye no kasa.
Na obi see no dɛ, Hwɛ, wo na ɔnye wo nuanom gyina abow enyim rohwehwɛ nye wo akasa.
Na obuae see nyia ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no no dɛ, Woana nye me na, na woananom nye mo nuanom?
Na ɔtseen ne nsa wɔ n’esuafo no do see dɛ, Hwɛ, me na nye mo nuanom.
Na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no ne pɛ no, ɔno nye mo nua, nye m’akyerɛbaa, nye me na.
Da no ara Jesus fiir fie kɛtsenaa mpoano.
Na nyimpadodow pii behyiaa ne nkyɛn, ma dɛm ntsi ɔkɔr hɛn mu kɛtsenaa ase wɔ mu; na nyimpadodow no nyina gyinagyinaa mpoano.
Na ɔkaa ndzɛmba pii kyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ mbɛbu mu see dɛ, Hwɛ, oduafo no kɔree kɛpee aba;
na ɔrepe aba no, bi koguu kwan nkyɛn na nnoma bae bɔsosɔwee;
na bi koguu abosam do mbrɛ oennya dɛtse pii; na ntsɛmara na ofirii, osiandɛ oennya dɛtse a ɔdɔ;
na ewia soɛree no, onyinyamee na osiandɛ onnyi ndwow ntsi ɔkyenkyenee.
Na bi so koguu nsoɛ mu, na ofifirii ara na nsoɛ no miaa no.
Na bi so koguu asaase pa mu, na ɔsoow aba, bi ɔha, bi eduosia, bi eduasa.
Nyia ɔwɔ aso no, ma ontsie.
N’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na ekasa kyerɛ hɔn mbɛbu mu yi?
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Hom dze, wɔdze ama hom dɛ hom nhu sor ahenman no mu esumasɛm, na hɔn dze, wɔmmfae mmaa hɔn.
Na obiara a ɔwɔ no, na wɔbɛma no na oenya mbordo, na obiara a onnyi no, dza ɔwɔ mpo wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
Dɛm ntsi na mekasa kyerɛ hɔn mbɛbu mu, osiandɛ wɔhwɛ a wonnhu, wɔtse a wonntsie, eso wɔnntse ase.
Na hɔn mu na Isaia nkɔnhyɛ no aba mu dɛ, Tse dze, hom bɛtse naaso hom nnkɛtse ase; Na hwɛ dze, hom bɔhwɛ naaso hom nnkohu.

Na ɔman yi hɔn akoma epirim, Na hɔn aso esisiw dɛ wɔbɛtse Na woemuamua hɔn enyiwa Amma aber bi wɔaammfa hɔn enyiwa ennhu, Na wɔaammfa hɔn aso anntse, Na wɔaammfa hɔn akoma anntse ase, Na wɔaannsakyer Amma maannsa hɔn yarba.
Na nhyira aka hom enyiwa dɛ wohu, nye hom asowa dɛ wɔtse.
Na nokwar mese hom dɛ nkɔnhyɛfo nye atseneneefo pii pɛɛ dɛ wohu dza hom hu yi, naaso woennhu, na wɔtse dza hom tse yi, naaso wɔanntse.
Afei hom ntsie oduafo no ne bɛ no.
Sɛ obiara tse ahenman no no ho asɛm, na ɔnntse ase a, ɔbɔn no ba bɛfa dza wɔpee no n’akoma mu no kɔ. Oyi nye dza wɔpee no wɔ kwan nkyɛn no.
Na dza wɔpee no abosam do no, ɔnye nyia otsie asɛm no, na ntsɛmara ɔdze dɛw gye;
na onnyi ndwow wɔ no mu, na ɔwɔ hɔ ma ɔkyɛr kakra, sɛ abɛbrɛsɛ anaa ahohia soɛr wɔ asɛm no ntsi a, ntsɛmara na ato no fintsidua.
Na dza wɔpee no nsoɛ mu no, nye nyia otsie asɛm no, na wiadze yi mu akɔdadwen nye ahonya ndaadaa mia asɛm no, ma ɔnnsow aba.
Na dza wɔpee no asaase pa mu no, ɔnye nyia otsie asɛm no, na ɔtse ase; ɔno so na ɔsow aba, bi ɔha, bi eduosia, bi eduasa.
Obuu bɛ fofor so kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Sor ahenman no tse dɛ nyimpa a oduaa aba pa wɔ no kwa mu;
na nyimpa dedae no, ne tamfo bae boduaa nworahaban so wɔ ewifua pa no mu, na ɔkɔree.
Na oyii ahaban na ɔsoow aba no, nna nworahaban no so daa edzi.
Na ofiwura no nkowaa bae bɛsee no dɛ, Yewura, ana ammpe aba pa wɔ wo kwa no mu? Na nworahaban yi so fi hen?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔtamfo na ɔayɛ yi. Na nkowaa no see no dɛ, Ana epɛ dɛ yɛkɔ kɔboaboa ano?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Oho: bɛyɛ na hom roboaboa nworahaban no ano no, hom etutu ewifua no so aka ho.
Hom mma n’ebien nyina nnyin nkesi twaber no; na twaber no mebɛse etwafo no dɛ, Hom ndzi kan mboaboa nwora no ano, na hom nkyekyer no efiefi ma wɔnhyew no, na hom mboaboa ewifua no ano nkɔ me san do.
Obuu bɛ fofor so kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Sor ahenman no tse dɛ sinape abafua a nyimpa fae koduaa no kwa mu;
ɔno na osuar kyɛn aba nyina; na sɛ onyin a, ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn nhaban nyina na ɔyɛ dua, ma wimu nnoma bɛgyegye n’abaw do.
Obuu bɛ fofor so see hɔn dɛ, Sor ahenman no tse dɛ mbɔrkaw a ɔbaa fae sumaa mbɔr korbaa ebiasa mu dze kesii dɛ ne nyina kawee.
Yinom nyina Jesus kaa kyerɛɛ nyimpadodow no wɔ mbɛbu mu, na oennkwetsi bɛ annkasa annkyerɛ hɔn;
ma dza nkɔnhyɛnyi no kae no aaba mu dɛ, Mubobue m’ano wɔ mbɛbu mu; Mebɛpaa mu maka nsɛm a ohuntsa fi wiadze ahyɛse.
Nna Jesus gyaa nyimpadodow no kwan na ɔbaa fie. Na n’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, Kyerɛ hɛn kwa mu nwora no ho bɛ no ase.
Na obuae see dɛ, Nyia oduaa aba pa no nye nyimpa Ba;
kwa no nye wiadze; aba pa no nye ahenman no ne mba; nwora no nye ɔbɔn no ne mba;
ɔtamfo a oduaa hɔn nye abɔnsam; twaber nye wiadze n’ewiei; na etwafo no nye abɔfo no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ wɔboaboa nwora no ano wɔhyew no wɔ gya mu no, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔ wiadze n’ewiei nye no.
Nyimpa Ba no bɔsoma n’abɔfoe na wɔakɔboaboa dza ɔto fintsidua nyina ano efi n’ahenman mu; nye hɔn a wɔyɛ emumuyɛ nyina,
na wɔatow hɔn egu gya fononoo mu: hɔ na osu nye asetwɛr wɔ.
Ɔno na atseneneefo bɛhyerɛn dɛ ewia wɔ hɔn Egya ahenman mu. Nyia ɔwɔ aso no, ma ontsie.
Sor ahenman no tse dɛ akoradze a wɔdze sumaa haban mu a nyimpa hunii no, ɔdze huntsae, na no ho dɛw ntsi ɔkɔree kɔtɔɔn dza ɔwɔ nyina na ɔtɔɔ haban no.
Bio, sor ahenman no tse dɛ batanyi a ɔrohwehwɛ ahondze pa;
na ohun ahondze kor a no bo so no, ɔkɔree kɔtɔɔn dza ɔwɔ nyina na ɔkɔtɔe.
Bio, sor ahenman no tse dɛ eboa a wɔtowee guu po mu a obumaa nam ahorow nyina bi;
na ɔyɛɛ ma no, wotwuwii baa mpoano na wɔtsenaa famu, na wɔboaboaa papa no ano guu mbirefi mu, na wɔtoow dza omuo no gui.
Mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔ wiadze ewiei nye no; abɔfo bɛba abɛpa nyimpa bɔn efi atseneneefo mu,
na wɔatow hɔn egu ogya fononoo mu; hɔ na osu nye asetwɛr wɔ.
Hom atse yinom nyina ase? Wobuaa no dɛ, Nyew.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm ntsi kyerɛwnyi a wɔayɛ no osuanyi ama sor ahenman no ɔtse dɛ ofiwura a ofi n’adzekorabea yi ndzɛmba afofor nye adadaw pue.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus wiee mbɛ yi bu no, ofii hɔ kɔree.
Na ɔkɔr nankasa no kurow mu no, ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn nhyiamudan mu, ma hɔn ho boow hɔn na wɔsee dɛ, Oyi nyaa nyansa nye tum ndwuma yi wɔ hen?
Ana nnyɛ dwimfo no ne ba nye yi? Ana ne na wɔmmfrɛ no Mary, na no nuanom nye James, Josef, Simon, nye Judas?
Na nnyɛ ne nkyerɛbaa nyina na wɔnye hɛn wɔ ha yi? Na afei oyi nyaa ndzɛmba yinom nyina wɔ hen?
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn fintsidua. Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi nnhwer enyidzi gyedɛ nankasa no kurow mu, nye nankasa ne fie.
Na gyedzi a wonnyi ntsi ɔannyɛ tum ndwuma pii wɔ hɔ.
Aber no mu no, ɔmansinhen Herod tsee Jesus ne nka,
na ɔsee n’asomfo no dɛ, Iyi dze, John Onumanyi no a: oenyan no efi ewufo mu; dɛm ntsi na tum ndwuma yi da edzi wɔ no mu yi.
Ansaana no nna Herod no nua Filip ne yer Herodias ntsi, Herod akyer John akyekyer no akɔto efiadze.
Ne siantsir nye dɛ John see no dɛ, Innyi ho kwan dɛ ewar basia no.
Ɔpɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ oku no naaso osuroo ɔman no, osiandɛ wobuu John dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi.
Na wodzii Herod n’awoda no, Herodias ne babaa bae bɛsawee wɔ hɔn enyim, na ɔsɔɔ Herod n’enyi.
Ɔno do na ɔdze ntam bɔɔ no anohoba dɛ ɔbɛma no biribiara a obebisa.
Na ne na kaa hyɛɛ ne ntsirmu no, ɔsee dɛ, Fa John Onumanyi no ne tsir to prɛtse mu ma me ha.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no yaw; naaso ne ntam nye hɔn a wɔnye no tse edzidzi no ntsi, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma no:
na ɔsomae ma wokotwaa John ne tsir wɔ efiadze.
Na wɔdze ne tsir too prɛtse mu bae, na wɔdze maa akataasia no, na ɔdze kɛmaa ne na.
Na n’esuafo no bae bɛfaa no fun no kesiei, na wɔkɔree kɛkaa kyerɛɛ Jesus.
Na Jesus tsee no, ɔtwee noho fii hɔ nam hɛn mu kɔr sar do nkyɛn beebi, na nyimpadodow no tsee no, wofii nkurow mu nam daadze tsiiw no.
Na odwirii no, ohun nyimpadodow pii, na ne yamu hyehyee no maa hɔn, na ɔsaa hɔn ayarfo yarba.
Na odur ewimbir no, n’esuafo baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Ha yi sar do a, na adze so resa: gya nyimpadodow yi kwan, ma wɔnkɔ nkuraase nkɔtɔ edziban mma hɔnho.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Onnhia dɛ wɔkɔ beebiara: homara hom mma hɔn biribi ma wondzi.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛwɔ paanoo enum nye esunam ebien pɛ wɔ ha.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mfa mbrɛ me ha.

Na ɔhyɛɛ nyimpadodow no dɛ wɔntsenatsena mpɔnkɔfuw no do, na ɔfaa paanoo enum no, nye esunam ebien no, na ɔhwɛɛ sor no, ohyiraa do, na obubui, na ɔdze paanoo no maa n’esuafo no, na n’esuafo no dze maa nyimpadodow no.
Na hɔn nyina dzidzii mee; na wɔtasee mporoporoba a ɔkae no, nkɛntsɛn duebien amaama.
Na hɔn a wodzidzii no, sɛ wɔannkan mbaa nye mbofraba annka ho a, wɔbɛyɛ mpemenum.
Na ntsɛmara opiapiaa n’esuafo no dɛ wɔnkɔ hɛn mu na wondzi n’enyim kan wɔ esuegya noho, ma ongya nyimpadodow no kwan.
Na ogyaa nyimpadodow no kwan no, ɔkɔr koko no do nkyɛn beebi kɔsɔree; na odur ewimbir no nna noara nko na ɔwɔ hɔ.
Nna aber yi mu no, hɛn no wɔ po finimfin, na asorɛkye rubu bɔ no; na mframa so esi hɔn enyim.
Na ahanamakye ndɔnnan rokɔ no, ɔnantseew po enyi baa hɔn nkyɛn.
Na wohun dɛ ɔrenantsew po enyi no, hɔn akoma tui, na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔsaman a, na wɔdze hu kekaa mu.
Na ntsɛmara ɔnye hɔn kasae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhyɛ dzen: mara a, mma hom nnsuro.
Na Peter buaa no see dɛ, Ewuradze, sɛ woara a, hyɛ me ma membra wo nkyɛn wɔ nsu no do.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Bra. Na Peter fii hɛn no mu sii, na ɔnantseew nsu no do dɛ ɔrokɔ Jesus nkyɛn.
Na ohun mframa no, osuroi; na ɔhyɛɛ ase rodɔ no, ɔkaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze, gye me.
Na ntsɛmara Jesus too ne nsa suoo no mu, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔwo a wo gyedzi suar, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na egyee kyim?
Na wɔbaa hɛn no mu no, mframa no gyaae.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ hɛn no mu no kotoow no dɛ, Ampa, Nyankopɔn Ba nye wo.
Na wotwae no, wɔbaa Genesaret asaase do.
Na nyimpa a wɔwɔ hɔ no hun no no, wɔsomae ma wɔkɔr nkurow a etwa ehyia nyina mu, na wɔdze hɔn a wɔyaryar nyina brɛɛ no,
na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmma wɔnka n’atar no ara nko mpo: na dodow a wɔkaa no no, hɔn ho yɛɛ hɔn dzen.
Nna Farisiifo nye kyerɛwfo a wofi Jerusalɛm baa Jesus nkyɛn bebisaa no dɛ,
Ɔyɛ dɛn na w’esuafo fom mpanyimfo atsetsesɛm do? Dɛ wɔnnhohor hɔn nsa ho ana woedzidzi yi?
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom so hom atsetsesɛm ntsi hom fom Nyankopɔn mbrasɛm do?
Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ dɛ, Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi, na, Obiara a ɔhyɛ egya anaa na ahorba no, owu na ma onwu.
Na hom dze, hom se dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɛse n’egya anaa ne na dɛ, Dza nkyɛ edze benya mo ho mfaso yɛ akyɛdze ma Nyankopɔn,
nna onnyi dɛ odzi n’egya nyi. Na hom atsetsesɛm ntsi hom amma Nyankopɔn mbra no enntsim.
Ndabrabafo, Isaia hyɛɛ hom ho nkɔm yie dɛ ɔse,
Ɔman yi dze hɔn anofamfa dzi me nyi, Naaso hɔn akoma dze, ɔnye me ntamu twe kɛse;
Na wɔsɔr me gyan, Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɔyɛ nyimpa ahyɛdze.
Na Jesus frɛɛ nyimpadodow no baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ntsie na hom ntse ase:
Nnyɛ dza ɔkɔ anomu na ogu nyimpa ho fi, na mbom dza ofi anomu ba no na ogu nyimpa ho fi.
Nna n’esuafo no bae bɛsee no dɛ, Inyim dɛ Farisiifo no tsee asɛm yi no, ayɛ hɔn fintsidua?
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Dua biara a m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no anntsɛw no, wobotu.
Hom ngyaa hɔn: wɔyɛ akwankyerɛfo enyifurafo. Na sɛ onyifurafo kyerɛ onyifurafo kwan a, hɔn beenu nyina bɔtɔ mona mu.
Na Peter buae see no dɛ, Kyerɛ hɛn bɛ yi ase.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ana hom so nnyae nnyaa ntseasee?
Ana hom nnhu dɛ biribiara a ɔhɛn anomu no ɔkɔ yafun mu, na woyi gu tsea mu?
Na dza ofi anomu ba no, ofi akoma mu, na ɔno na ogu nyimpa ho fi.
Na akoma mu na adwembɔn fi ba, ewudzi, awarto, ndwamanyɛ, adzewia, dasewia, ebususɛm:
yinom nye ndzɛmba a ogu nyimpa ho fi; na edze nsa a wɔannhohor ho bedzidzi dze, onngu nyimpa ho fi.
Na Jesus twee noho fii hɔ kɔr Taere nye Sidon afamu.
Na hwɛ, Keenannyi ɔbaa fi ntoaado hɔ bae bɛkaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr: na abɔnsam rehaw me babaa papa.
Na oemmbua no asɛm biara. Na n’esuafo no bae bɛserɛɛ no dɛ, Gya no kwan ma ɔnkɔ, na ɔrekeka mu dzi hɛn ekyir.
