Na obuae see dɛ, Wɔannsoma me obiara hɔ dɛ Israel fie nguan a wɔayew no nko hɔ.
Na ɔbae bɔkotoow no see dɛ, Ewuradze, boa me.
Na obuae see dɛ, Ɔnnsɛ dɛ wɔfa mba edziban tow ma nkramanmba.
Na ɔbaa no see dɛ, Mo wura, nyew: naaso nkramanmba no dzi mporoporoba a ofi hɔn wuranom pon do gu no bi.
Nna Jesus buae see no dɛ, Ɔbaa, wo gyedzi so: ɔnyɛ hɔ mma wo dɛ mbrɛ epɛ. Na ofi dɔn no ara mu ne babaa no ho yɛɛ no dzen.
Na Jesus fii hɔ baa Galilii po ho, na ɔkɔr koko do kɛtsenaa ase wɔ hɔ.
Na nyimpadodow pii baa ne nkyɛn a wɔdze mbubua, enyifurafo, mmum, mpakye, nye binom pii; na wɔdze hɔn boguu n’ananadze na ɔsaa hɔn yarba:
ma ɔyɛɛ nyimpadodow no nwanwa dɛ mmum rekasa, mpakye ridzi mu, mbubua renantsew, na enyifurafo ruhu adze; na wɔhyɛɛ Israel Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.

Na Jesus frɛɛ n’esuafo see hɔn dɛ, Me yamu hyehye me ma nyimpadodow yi, osiandɛ wɔatsena me nkyɛn ndaansa yi na wonnyi biribi a wodzi; na memmpɛ dɛ migya hɔn kwan ma wɔdze kɔm kɔ, bɛyɛ na wɔakɔtɔ bitsi wɔ kwan mu.
Na n’esuafo no see no dɛ, Henfa na yebenya paanoo a ɔbɛmee nyimpadodow pii yi wɔ sar do ha?
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Paanoo ahen na hom wɔ? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Esuon, nye esunam nketsenketse kakraabi.
Na ɔhyɛɛ nyimpadodow no dɛ wɔntsenatsena famu;
na ɔfaa paanoo esuon no, nye esunam no; na ɔdaa ase, na obubui, na ɔdze maa esuafo no, na esuafo no so dze maa nyimpadodow no.
Na hɔn nyina dzidzii mee; na wɔtasee mporoporoba a ɔkae no, mbirefi esuon amaama.
Na hɔn a wodzidzii no, wɔyɛ mpemanan a wɔnnkan mbaa nye mbofraba nnka ho.
Na ogyaa nyimpadodow no kwan, na ɔfoow hɛn baa Magadan ntoaado.
Farisiifo nye Sadusiifo bi bae bɔsɔɔ Jesus hwɛe bisaa no dɛ ɔnkyerɛ hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze a ofi sor.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Odu ewimbir a, hom ka dɛ, Wimu bɛtsew, osiandɛ sor aber.
Na anapa hom se dɛ, Ndɛ ehum botu, osiandɛ sor ayɛ kowioo na oemuna. Hom tum hwɛ wimu kyerɛ dza obesi, na mber ho nsɛnkyerɛdze dze, hom nntum nnkyerɛ ase.
Ɔsantsen bɔn a wonndzi nokwar rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na wɔremma hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze bi dɛ Jona dze no. Na ogyaa hɔn hɔ kɔree.
Na esuafo no dur esuegya noho no, nna hɔn werɛ efir dɛ wɔfa paanoo.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ, na hom nhwɛ yie wɔ Farisiifo nye Sadusiifo mbɔrkaw no ho.
Na wosusui wɔ hɔn tsirmu dɛ, Yɛammfa paanoo ntsi a.
Na Jesus hunii no, ɔsee dɛ, Hom a hom gyedzi suar, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom susu se wɔ hom mu dɛ osiandɛ hom ammfa paanoo ntsi a?
Ana hom nnyae nnhunii, anaa hom nnkaa nyimpa mpemenum paanoo enum no, nye nkɛntsɛn dodow a hom fae no?
Anaadɛ mpemanan paanoo esuon no, nye mbirefi dodow a hom fae no?
Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom nnhu dɛ nnyɛ paanoo ho asɛm bi na mereka? Na hom nhwɛ yie wɔ Farisiifo nye Sadusiifo mbɔrkaw ho.
Nna wohun dɛ ɔannse hɔn dɛ wɔnhwɛ yie wɔ paanoo mbɔrkaw ho, na Farisiifo nye Sadusiifo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho a.
Na Jesus dur Kaesarea Filipi afamu no, obisaa n’esuafo dɛ, Nyimpa se dɛ nyimpa Ba no nye woana?
Na wɔsee dɛ, Binom se John Onumanyi no a; binom se Elija a; na binom so se Jeremia anaa nkɔnhyɛfo no mu baako a.
Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Na hom dze, hom se dɛ woana nye me?
Na Simon Peter buae see dɛ, Ɔwo nye Kraest no, Nyankopɔn tseasefo no ne Ba no.
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Nhyira aka wo, Simon, Jona ba; na nnyɛ honam nye bɔgya na woeyi akyerɛ wo, na m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no a.
Na mo so mese wo dɛ, Ɔwo nye Peter, na ɔbotan yi do na medze m’asɔr besi; na samanadze aponkɛse rinndzi do nyim.
Medze sor ahenman ne nsaafee mebɛma wo: na biribiara a ebɛkyekyer wɔ asaase do no, wɔbɛkyekyer wɔ sor; na biribiara a ebɛsan wɔ asaase do no, wɔbɛsan wɔ sor.
Nna ɔbraa n’esuafo no dɛ mma wɔnnka nnkyerɛ obiara dɛ ɔno nye Kraest no.
Na ofitsi aber no na Jesus hyɛɛ ase kyerɛɛ n’esuafo dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ ɔkɔ Jerusalɛm, na okohu amandze pii wɔ mpanyimfo nye asɔfompanyin, nye kyerɛwfo nsa, na woeku no, na da a otsia ebiasa no ɔasoɛr.
Na Peter dze no kɔr nkyɛn, na ɔhyɛɛ ase twuuw n’enyim, dɛ, Wɔmma ɔmpar wo, Ewuradze: iyi remmba wo do da.
Na ɔdaan noho see Peter dɛ, Fi mo do, Satan: eyɛ fintsidua ma me; osiandɛ enndwen Nyankopɔn dze, na edwen nyimpa dze.
Nna Jesus see n’esuafo no dɛ, Sɛ obi pɛ dɛ odzi m’ekyir a, ma ɔmpa noho, na ompegya ne mbeamudua na ɔnka mo do.
Na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔgye no nkwa no, ɔbɛyew no, na obiara a emi ntsi ɔbɛyew no nkwa no, obohu.
Na sɛ nyimpa nya wiadze nyina ma ntsi ɔhwer no nkwa a, ebɛn mfaso na obenya? Anaa ebɛnadze na nyimpa bɛma dze asesa no nkwa?
Na nyimpa Ba no dze n’Egya n’enyimnyam nye n’abɔfoe bɛba; na aber no na obotua nyimpa nyina kaw dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ tse.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Hɔn a wogyina ha yi, binom wɔ hɔ a wɔronnsɔ owu nnhwɛ ansaana woehu nyimpa Ba dɛ ɔreba wɔ n’ahendzi mu.
Nda esia ekyir no Jesus faa Peter nye James nye no nua John, na ɔdze hɔn kɔr nkyɛn wɔ kokwaa tsentsen bi do;
na ɔsakyeree wɔ hɔn enyim, na n’enyim hyerɛɛn dɛ ewia, na n’atar yɛɛ fitaa dɛ kan.
Na hwɛ, Elija nye Moses puee hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔnye Jesus kasae.
Na Peter see Jesus dɛ, Ewuradze, oye ma hɛn dɛ yɛtsena ha, na sɛ epɛ a, mobɔbɔ asese ebiasa, ɔwo wodze kor, Moses dze kor, Elija dze kor.
Na n’ano da do rekasa no, hwɛ, mununkum hyɛnn bɛkataa hɔn do, na ndze bi fi mununkum no mu see dɛ, Oyi nye mo Dɔba a ɔsɔ m’enyi: hom ntsie no.
Na esuafo no tsee no, wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu, na wosuroo pii.
Na Jesus bae dze ne nsa bɛkaa hɔn na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoɛr, mma hom nnsuro.
Na wɔmemaa hɔn enyiwa do no, woennhu obiara dɛ Jesus nko.
Na wofi kokwaa no do risian no, Jesus braa hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnka dza hom ehu yi nnkyerɛ obiara, gyedɛ nyimpa Ba no asoɛr efi ewufo mu ana.
Na n’esuafo no bisaa no see dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na Akyerɛwfo no ka dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ Elija dzi kan ba?
Na obuae see dɛ, Elija dze, odzi kan ba ampa, na obesiesie ndzɛmba nyina:
na mese hom dɛ Elija aba dada, na woennhu no anngye no, na wɔyɛɛ no dza wɔpɛe nyina. Dɛmara na nyimpa Ba no so bohu hɔn nsa mu amandze.
Nna esuafo no hun dɛ ɔreka John Onumanyi no no ho asɛm.
Na wɔbaa nyimpadodow no nkyɛn no, nyimpa bi baa no hɔ bɔkotoow no see dɛ,
Ewuradze, hu me babanyin mbɔbɔr, na otwa ehim na ohu amandze bɔn, na ɔtɔ dɛ ɔhwe gya mu, na ɔtɔ dɛ ɔhwe nsu mu.
Na medze no brɛɛ w’esuafo, na woenntum annsa no yarba.
Na Jesus buae see dɛ, Ao ɔsantsen a hom nnyi gyedzi na hom akyea, menye hom ntsena nkodu dabɛn? Minsie hom ho abotar nkodu dabɛn? Hom mfa no mbrɛ me ha.
Na Jesus bɔɔ no ham, na abɔnsam no fii no mu firii; na ofitsi dɔn no ara mu na abofra no ne yarba gyaae.
Nna esuafo no baa Jesus hɔ wɔ nkyɛn, na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na yeenntum enntu no?

Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom gyedzi suar ntsi a: na nokwar mese hom dɛ, Sɛ hom wɔ gyedzi a ɔtse dɛ sinape abafua a, nkyɛ hom bɛse kokwaa yi dɛ, Tutu fi ha kɔ noho, na nkyɛ obotutu, na nkyɛ biribiara ronnso hom yɛ.
(Naaso iyi ne saso mmfir edzi, gyedɛ ɔnam mpaabɔ ɔnye mbuadadzi do.)
Na worikyinkyin Galilii no, Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Woribeyi Nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ nyimpa nsa;
na woboku no, na da a otsia ebiasa no obenyan. Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn awerɛhow pii.
Na wɔbaa Karpernaum no, hɔn a wɔgyegye asɔrdan ho tow no baa Peter nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, Ana hom kyerɛkyerɛnyi no nntua asɔrdan ho tow no?
Obuaa dɛ, Otua. Na ɔbaa fie no, Jesus dzii kan bisaa no dɛ, Simon, edwen dɛn? Asaase do ahemfo no woananom hɔ na wɔgyegye amandze anaa tow? Hɔn mba hɔ anaa anana hɔ a?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Anana hɔ no, Jesus see no dɛ, Ɔno dze na mba no fa hɔnho dzi.
Naaso mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma yɛnnkɔfom hɔn ntsi, kɔ mpoano kɔtow nkwaba, na fa nam a obedzi kan aba no, na ibue n’anomu a, ibohu sika wɔ mu: fa kotua ma emi na ɔwo.
Aber no ara mu na esuafo no baa Jesus hɔ bebisaa dɛ, Woana na ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ sor ahenman no mu?
Na ɔfrɛɛ abofraba bi baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔdze no gyinaa hɔn finimfin,
na ɔsee dɛ, Mese hom nokwar mu dɛ, gyedɛ hom dan na hom yɛ dɛ mbofraba, ɔno hom runntum nnhɛn Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu da.
Dɛm ntsi, obiara a ɔbɛbrɛ noho adze dɛ abofraba yi no, ɔnoara na ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ sor ahenman no mu.
Na obiara a ɔbɛgye abofraba a ɔtse dɛm yi kor wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔgye emi mara.
Sɛ hom mu obiara to mbofra nkakraba a wɔgye me dzi yi mu baako fintsidua a, oye ma no dɛ wɔdze ewuyambo kɛse sɛn no kɔn mu, na wɔkɔtow no kyen nsu mu wɔ po bun mu.
Fintsiduato ntsi wiadze ndue! Na otwar dɛ fintsiduato ba, na nyimpa a fintsidua nam no do ba no, ndue!

Na sɛ wo nsa anaa wo nan to wo fintsidua a, twa, na tow fi woho kyen: oye ma wo dɛ edze abasin anaa anansin bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ wo nsa ebien nye w’anan ebien, na wɔbɔtow wo akyen onnyiewiei gya mu.
Na sɛ w’enyiwa to wo fintsidua a, tu, na tow fi woho kyen. Oye ma wo dɛ edze enyiwa kor bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ enyiwa ebien na wɔbɔtow wo akyen ogya amandzehu kurow mu.
Hom nhwɛ yie mma hom eemmbu nkakraba yi mu baako enyimtsia, na mese hom dɛ ɔsor noho hɔn abɔfoe hwɛ m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no enyim daa.
(Na nyimpa Ba no bae dɛ ɔrebɛgye dza ayew no nkwa.)
Hom dwen dɛn? Sɛ nyimpa bi wɔ nguan ɔha, na hɔn mu baako tɔ gon a, ana onngyaa eduokron akron no hɔ, na ɔnnkɔ nkokwaa do nnkɔhwehwɛ dza ɔayew no?
Na sɛ ɔba dɛ ohu no a, nokwar mese hom dɛ odzi dɛw wɔ no ho kyɛn eduokron akron no a wɔanntɔ gon no.
Dɛmara na ɔnnyɛ hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor ne pɛ dɛ nkakraba yi mu baako bɛyew.
Na sɛ wo nua fom wo a, kɔ na keyi no atsɛn wɔ ɔwo nye ɔno nko ntamu: sɛ otsie wo a, enya wo nua.
Na sɛ oenntsie wo a, fa kor anaa ebien ka woho, ama nyimpa beenu anaa baasa aayɛ asɛm no ho adasefo.
Na sɛ ɔpow dɛ obetsie hɔn a, kɛka kyerɛ asɔr no, na sɛ ɔpow dɛ obetsie asɔr so a, bu no dɛ amanamamfo mu baako nye towgyenyi.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Biribiara a hom bɛkyekyer wɔ asaase do no, wɔbɛkyekyer no wɔ sor; na biribiara a hom bɛsan wɔ asaase do no, wɔbɛsan no wɔ sor.
Bio, mese hom dɛ, Sɛ hom mu beenu yɛ anokor wɔ asaase do wɔ biribi a wobebisa ho a, m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor bɛyɛ ama hɔn.
Na mbrɛ beenu anaa baasa ehyia wɔ me dzin mu no, nna mowɔ hɔn finimfin.
Nna Peter bae bɛsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, mpɛn ahen na mo nua fom me a, memfa nkyɛ no? Onkodu mpɛn esuon anaa?
Jesus see no dɛ, Mennse wo dɛ onkodu mpɛn esuon, na mpɛn eduosuon mbɔho esuon.
Dɛm ntsi sor ahenman no tse dɛ ɔhen bi a ɔpɛɛ dɛ ɔnye no nkowaa bu nkontaa.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ase rubu no, wɔdze baako a ɔmaa no talent mpemdu brɛɛ no.
Na osiandɛ onnyi dza ɔdze botua ntsi, no wura hyɛɛ dɛ wɔntɔn ɔno, nye ne yer, nye ne mba, nye dza ɔwɔ nyina mfa ntua kaw.
Dɛm ntsi akowaa no hwee daadze wɔ n’enyim, na ɔtotɔɔe serɛɛ no dɛ, Mo wura, nya abotar wɔ mo ho, na mubotua wo ne nyina.
Na akowaa no wura ne yamu hyehyee no, na ogyaa no, na ɔdze kaw no kyɛɛ no.
Na akowaa noara fiir edzi kohun no wura no nkowaa no mu baako a ɔdze no kaw kakraabi denare ɔha; na osuoo no mu, na ɔtɔɔr ne meneba dɛ, Tua dza edze me.
Na akowaa no hwee daadze wɔ n’enyim na ɔserɛɛ no dɛ, Nya abotar wɔ mo ho, na mubotua wo.
Na ɔno dze, ɔammpen, na ɔkɔree dze no kɔtoo efiadze dɛ onkodu dɛ obotua dza ɔdze no no.
Na no wura no nkowaa no hun dza esi no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn yaw dɛ, na wɔkɔree kɛkaa dza esi no nyina kyerɛɛ hɔn wura.
Na no wura frɛɛ no see no dɛ, Akowaa bɔn, medze wo kaw no nyina kyɛɛ wo osiandɛ eserɛɛ me ntsi:
ana ɔnnsɛ wo so dɛ nkyɛ ihu wo nyɛnko akowaa no mbɔbɔr, dɛ mbrɛ muhun wo mbɔbɔr no?
Na no wura no bo fuwii, na oyii no maa ahohiahiafo dɛ wɔntseetsee no araa nkodu dɛ obotua ne kaw no nyinara.
Dɛmara na mo sor Egya bɛyɛ hom, sɛ hom emmfi hom akoma mu ammfa obiara no nua no bɔn annkyɛ no a.
Na Jesus wiee nsɛm yi ka no, osii mu fii Galilii na ɔbaa Judea ntoaado wɔ Jordan egya;
na nyimpadodow pii kaa no do, na ɔsaa hɔn yarba wɔ hɔ.
Farisiifo bi baa ne nkyɛn bɔsɔɔ no hwɛe see no dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ obi gyina asɛm biara do gyaa ne yer awar?
Na obuae see dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan dɛ nyia ahyɛse no ɔbɔɔ hɔn no yɛɛ hɔn ɔbanyin nye ɔbaa,
na ɔsee dɛ, Iyi ntsi na ɔbanyin begya n’egya nye ne na hɔ, na ɔdze noho akɛbata ne yer ho; na hɔn beenu ayɛ honankor?
Dɛm no na wɔnnda ho nnyɛ beenu bio, na wɔyɛ honankor. Ntsi dza Nyankopɔn dze abɔ mu no, mma nyimpa nntsew mu.
Wɔsee no dɛ, Na ɔyɛ dɛn na Moses hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma ɔbaa no awargyaa krataa na wongyaa no yi?
Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom akoma dzen ntsi na Moses maa hom kwan dɛ hom ngyaa hom yernom, na ofi ahyɛse no dze nna ɔnntse dɛm.
Na mese hom dɛ, Obiara a obegyaa ne yer, na nnyɛ ndwamanyɛ ntsi, na ɔbɔwar fofor no, ɔato awar.
Esuafo no see no dɛ, Sɛ dɛm na ɔbanyin nye ne yer ntamu asɛm tse dze a, nna onnye dɛ wɔwar.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nnyɛ nyimpa nyina na wobotum agye asɛm yi, gyedɛ hɔn a wɔdze ama hɔn no.
Binom wɔ hɔ a wɔwoo hɔn fii hɔn na yamu dɛ mma wɔnnwar; na binom so wɔ hɔ a nyimpa yɛɛ hɔn ma wɔnnwar; na binom so wɔ hɔ a sor ahendzi no ntsi wɔnnwar. Nyia obotum agye no, ma ɔngye.
Nna wɔdze mbofraba brɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa ngu hɔn do, na ɔmbɔ mpaa mma hɔn; naaso esuafo no kasaa hɔn a wɔdze hɔn bae no enyim.
Na Jesus see dɛ, Hom mma mbofraba no kwan ma wɔmbra me nkyɛn, mma hom nnsiw hɔn kwan, na woyinom dɛm na sor ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
Na ɔdze ne nsa guu hɔn do no, ofii hɔ kɔree.
Na hwɛ, obi bae bɛsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ebɛn adzepa na menyɛ ama meenya onnyiewiei nkwa?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ibisa me papa ho asɛm? Baako pɛ na ɔyɛ papa; na sɛ epɛ dɛ ekɔ nkwa mu a, dzi mbransɛm no do.
Obisaa Jesus dɛ, Dza ɔwɔ hen a? Jesus see no dɛ, Mma nndzi ewu, Mma nnto awar, Mma nnwia adze, Mma nndzi dasewia,
Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi, na, Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa woho.
Aberantsɛ no see no dɛ, Iyi nyina medzi do: aka me ebɛnadze bio?
Jesus see no dɛ, Sɛ epɛ dɛ idzi mu a, kɔ kɔtɔn dza ewɔ, na fa kyɛ ehiafo, na ibenya akoradze wɔ sor, na afei bra bɛka mo do.
Na aberantsɛ no tsee asɛm no, ɔdze yaw kɔree, osiandɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa a ɔwɔ ahonyadze pii.
Na Jesus see n’esuafo no dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔyɛ dzen ma ɔhonyanyi dɛ ɔbɔkɔ sor ahenman no mu.
Na bio mese hom dɛ ɔyɛ mberɛw ma efupɔnkɔ dɛ obodua doroba enyiwa mu kyɛn dɛ ɔhonyanyi bɔkɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
Na esuafo no tsee no, hɔn ho boow hɔn pii, na wɔsee dɛ, Dɛm a nna woana koraa na wobotum agye no nkwa?
Na Jesus hwɛɛ hɔn see dɛ, Nyimpa afamu na iyi nntum dɛm yɛ, na Nyankopɔn afamu dze, adze biara nnso no yɛ.
Nna Peter buae see no dɛ, Hwɛ, yeegyaa ndzɛmba nyina na yɛabɛka wo do: ebɛnadze na yebenya?

Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ hom a hom ebedzi m’ekyir yi, wiadze fofor no mu a nyimpa Ba no bɛtsena n’enyimnyam ahengua do no, hom so hom bɛtsena nhengua duebien do ebu Israel ebusuakuw duebien no atsɛn.
Na obiara a oegyaa fie, anaa enuanom, anaa nkyerɛbaa, anaa egya, anaa na, anaa mba, anaa nsaase, wɔ me dzin ntsi, obenya mbɔho mpɛn ɔha, na oenya onnyiewiei nkwa ayɛ nedze.
Na edzikamfo pii bedzi ekyir na ekyidzifo so pii bedzi kan.
Ɔsor ahenman no tse dɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ asaasewura a opuee anapaatu dɛ ɔrokɔbɔ edwumafo paa akɔ no wenyin ture mu.
Na ɔnye edwumayɛfo no dzii ano da kor akatua no, ɔmaa wɔkɔr no wenyin ture mu.
Na opuei bɛyɛ dɛ anapa ndɔnkron no, na okohun binom dɛ wogyinagyina gua do enyihaw mu;
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom so hom nkɔ wenyin ture no mu, na dza ɔsɛ no mebɛma hom. Na wɔkɔree.
Ɔkɔr bio bɛyɛ ewiaber duebien nye ndɔnebiasa no mu kɛyɛɛ dɛmara.
Na bɛyɛ ewimbir ndɔnnum mu no, ofiir edzi kohun binom dɛ wogyinagyina hɔ, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na adzekyee yi nyina hom gyinagyina ha enyihaw mu yi?
Wɔsee no dɛ, osiandɛ obiara mmbɔɔ hɛn paa. Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom so hom nkɔ wenyin ture no mu.
Na odur ewimbir no, wenyin ture no wura see ɔhwɛdofo no dɛ, Frɛ edwumayɛfo no, na ma hɔn hɔn apaabɔdze, hyɛ ase fi hɔn a wodzii ekyir no do kesi hɔn a wodzii kan no do.
Na hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ewimbir ndɔnnum no bae no, hɔn nyina nyaa da kor akatua nkorkor.
Na edzikamfo no bae no, wosusuu dɛ wobenya kɛse; na hɔn so hɔn mu biara nyaa dakor akatua nkorkor.
Na hɔn nsa kae no, wohwinhwinii tsiaa asaasewura no
dɛ, Ekyirfo yi dze, dɔnhwer kor pɛ na wɔyɛɛ edwuma, na ama wɔnye hɛn a adzekyee yi ne berɛ nye ne hyew adzen hɛn yi agye akatua pɛr.
Na obuae see hɔn mu baako dɛ, Nyɛnko, mennyɛɛ wo bɔn bi: ana menye wo enndzi ano da kor akatua?
Fa wodze na kɔ; mepɛ dɛ mema ekyidzifo yi dɛ mbrɛ memaa woara.
Ana minnyi ho kwan dɛ medze mankasa m’adze yɛ dza mepɛ? Me yamu ye ntsi ɔyɛ wo ehi anaa?
Mbrɛ ekyidzifo bedzi kan, na Edzikamfo edzi ekyir ara nye no. (Na wɔafrɛ pii, naaso kakraabi na woeyi hɔn.)
Na Jesus rofow akɔ Jerusalɛm no, ɔfaa esuafo duebien no nko kɔr nkyɛn na ɔsee hɔn wɔ kwan no mu dɛ,
Hwɛ, yɛrofow akɔ Jerusalɛm, na wobeyi nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no nsa, na woebu no fɔ dɛ wonku no,
na woeyi no ama amanamamfo dɛ wonsi no atwetwe na wɔnka no mpire, na wɔmbɔ no mbeamudua mu; naaso da a otsia ebiasa no obenyan.
Nna Zebedee mba no hɔn na nye ne mba baa ne nkyɛn bɔkotoow no, na ɔserɛɛ no hɔ biribi.
Na obisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na epɛ? Ɔsee no dɛ, Hyɛ ma me mba beenu yi, baako aatsena w’enyimfa, na baako aatsena w’abankum, wɔ w’ahenman no mu.
Na Jesus buae see dɛ, Hom nnyim dza hom reserɛ yi: ana hom botum anom kɔɔpow a morobɔnom no? (Anaa enuma a wɔdze rubonuma me no hom botum ma wɔdze enuma hom?) Wɔsee no dɛ, Yebotum.
Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mo kɔɔpow dze, hom bɔnom, (m’enuma no, wɔdze bonuma hom): naaso m’enyimfa nye m’abankum tsena dze, ɔnnyɛ medze dɛ medze bɛma; na wɔdze bɛma hɔn a m’Egya esiesie ama hɔn.
Na du no tsee no, wonyaa ebufuw wɔ enuanom beenu no ho.
Na Jesus frɛɛ hɔn baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nyim dɛ amanaman ahemfo no, wodzi hɔn do wura, na hɔn mu akɛse dzi hɔn do tum.
Na ɔrennyɛ dɛm wɔ hom mu: na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔbɛyɛ kɛse wɔ hom mu no, ɔbɛyɛ hom somfo;
na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ odzi hom mu kan no, ɔbɛyɛ hom akowaa:
dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa Ba no so ɔammba dɛ wɔnsom no, na mbom dɛ ɔbɔsomee, ama ɔdze no nkwa aayɛ apondze ama dodowara no.
Na wofi Jeriko rokɔ no, nyimpadodow pii kaa no do.
Na hwɛ, enyifurafo beenu bi a wɔtse kwan nkyɛn no tsee dɛ Jesus rutwa mu no, wɔtseatseaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze, David ba, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
Na nyimpadodow no braa hɔn dɛ wɔnka hɔn ano nto mu; na mbom wɔtseatseaa mu kɛse see dɛ, Ewuradze, David ba, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
Na Jesus gyinae, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn, na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom pɛ dɛ meyɛ ma hom?
Wobuaa no dɛ, Ewuradze, nkyɛ hɛn enyiwa eebue.
Na Jesus ne yamu hyehyee no wɔ hɔn ho, na ɔdze ne nsa kaa hɔn enyiwa, na hɔ no ara wohun adze na wɔkaa no do.
Na wɔbɛɛn Jerusalɛm, na wodur Bɛtfage, wɔ Ngo Bepɔw no ho no, Jesus somaa esuafo beenu
see hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ ekuroba a ɔda hom enyim no mu, na ntsɛmara hom bohu asoasopɔnkɔ a wɔamontan no, nye ne ba: hom nsan hɔn na hom mfa mbrɛ me.
Na sɛ obiara se hom biribi a, hom nse dɛ, Ewuradze wɔ hɔn ho hia, na ntsɛmara ɔbɛma wɔdze aba.
Na wɔyɛɛ yinom ma dza nkɔnhyɛnyi no kae no aaba mu dɛ,
Hom nse Zion babaa, Hwɛ, wo hen reba wo nkyɛn: Ɔdwe, na ɔtse asoasopɔnkɔ do, nye asoasopɔnkɔ a ɔsoa adze ne ba do.
Na esuafo no kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Jesus hyɛɛ hɔn no,
na wɔdze asoasopɔnkɔ no nye ne ba no bae, na wɔdze hɔn ntar guu hɔn do, na ɔtsenaa do.
Na nyimpadodow pii dze hɔn ntar sesɛɛw kwan no mu, na binom twitwaa ndubaa sesɛɛw kwan no mu.
Na nyimpadodow a wodzi enyim no, na hɔn a wodzi ekyir no tseaa mu see dɛ, Hosanna, David ba no! Nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze dzin mu reba no! Hosanna wɔ sorsor!
Na odur Jerusalɛm no, kurow no nyina bɔɔ twitwi bisabisaa dɛ, Iyi woana a?
Na nyimpadodow no see dɛ, Oyi nye Jesus, nkɔnhyɛnyi a ofi Nazarɛt a ɔwɔ Galilii no.
Na Jesus kɔr Nyankopɔn asɔrfi no mu, na ɔkɛpaam hɔn a wɔtɔn nye hɔn a wɔtɔ wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na obutuuw sikasesafo hɔn apon nye hɔn a wɔtɔn mbubur no hɔn ngua;
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Wɔbɛfrɛ me fi asɔryɛbea: na hom dze, hom reyɛ no edwotwafo tu.
Na enyifurafo nye mpakye baa no hɔ wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na ɔsaa hɔn yarba.
Na asɔfompanyin nye akyerɛwfo no hun anwanwadze a ɔyɛe no, ɔnye mbofraba a wɔretseatsea mu wɔ asɔrfi no mu dɛ, Hosanna, David ba no, wonyaa ebufuw pii,
na wɔsee no dɛ, Etse dza yinom reka yi? Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Nyew: ana hom nnkenkaan pɛn dɛ, Nkɔkowaba nye numfoanomba anomu, na ɔwo esiesie ayɛyi ama woho anaa?
Na ogyaa hɔn hɔ, na ofii kurow no mu kɔr Bɛtani kɛtsenaa hɔ.
Na anapa no a ɔresan aba kurow no mu no, ɔkɔm dzee no.
Na ohun adɔmbadua wɔ kwan no do no, ɔbaa ho naaso oennhu biribiara wɔ do dɛ ahaban nko; na ɔsee no dɛ, Mma aba nnsow wo do dabiarada. Na amonmu hɔ ara adɔmbadua no kyenkyenee.
Na esuafo no hunii no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa, na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na amonmu ha yi ara adɔmbadua yi akyenkyen yi?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Sɛ hom wɔ gyedzi, na hom nnyɛ ekyingye a, nkyɛ nnyɛ adɔmbadua dze yi nko na hom bɛyɛ, na mpo sɛ hom se koko yi dɛ, Tutu na kɔhwe po mu, a, nkyɛ ɔbɛyɛ.
Na biribiara a hom bebisa no mpaabɔ mu, na hom gye dzi no, hom nsa bɛka.
Na ɔbaa asɔrfi mu, na ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no, asɔfompanyin nye ɔman mpanyimfo no baa ne nkyɛn bebisaa no dɛ, Ebɛn tum na enam do yɛ ndzɛmba yi, na woana maa wo tum yi?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Mo so mibebisa hom asɛm kor a sɛ hom kyerɛ me ano a, mo so mebɛkyerɛ hom tum kor a medze meyɛ yinom.
John enuma no, ofi hen? Ofi sor anaa ofi nyimpa? Na wosusui wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, Sɛ yɛka dɛ, Ofi sor, a, ɔbɛse hɛn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom anngye enndzi?
Na sɛ yɛka dɛ, Ofi nyimpa, a, yesuro nyimpadodow no: osiandɛ hɔn nyina bu John nkɔnhyɛnyi.
Na wobuaa Jesus see dɛ, Yennyim. Na no so see hɔn dɛ, Mo so merennka tum kor a medze yɛ yinom mennkyerɛ hom.
Hom dwen iyi ho dɛn? Nyimpa bi wɔ mba beenu; na ɔbaa nyia odzi kan no hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, Ɔba, ndɛ kɔ kɛyɛ mo wenyin ture mu edwuma.
Na obuae see dɛ, Moronnkɔ, na n’ekyir no onuu noho na ɔkɔree.
Na ɔbaa nyia otsia ebien no hɔ bɛsee no dɛmara. Na obuae see dɛ, Mo wura, mobɔkɔ, naaso ɔannkɔ.
Hɔn beenu yi mu woana na ɔyɛɛ n’egya ne pɛ? Wɔsee dɛ, Nyia odzi kan no a. Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Meka no nokwar mu dɛ, towgyefo nye ndwaman ridzi hom enyim akɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
Na John nam tsenenee kwan mu baa hom nkyɛn, na hom anngye no enndzi: na towgyefo nye ndwaman gyee no dzii: na hom dze, hom hunii no hom ammfe homho ekyir dɛ hom bɛgye no edzi.
Hom ntsie bɛ fofor so: asaasewura bi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛɛ wenyin ture, na ɔgyee ho ban hyiae, na otuu wenyintwer, na ɔtoow abantsentsen wɔ mu, na ɔdze fɛɛm ekuafo bi, na ɔdɔɔ mu kɔr beebi.
Na eduaba no ne ber durii no, ɔsomaa no nkowaa wɔ ekuafo no nkyɛn dɛ wɔnkɛgye n’eduaba no.
Na ekuafo no kyeer no nkowaa no, na wɔhwee bi, na wokum bi, na wosiiw bi abo.
Bio, ɔsomaa nkowaa fofor a wɔdɔɔ so kyɛn nkan dze no; na wɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛmara.
Na n’ekyir no, ɔsomaa ne babanyin wɔ hɔn hɔ, na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔbɛfɛr me ba.
Naaso ekuafo no hun babanyin no, wɔsesee wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, Nyia a odzi adze no nye yi: hom mbra ma yenku no, na yɛmfa n’egyapadze no.
Na wɔkyeer no, na wɔtoow no fii wenyin ture mu hɔ kyenee, na wokum no.
Dɛm ntsi aber a wenyin ture no wura bɛba, ebɛnadze na ɔbɛyɛ ekuafo no?
Wɔsee no dɛ, Ɔbɛsɛɛ nyimpa bɔn no pasaa, na ɔdze no wenyin ture no afɛm ekuafo fofor a wɔdze eduaba no bɛma no wɔ n’aber mu.
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan kyerɛwsɛm no mu pɛn dɛ, Ɔbo a adantofo powee no, Ɔnoara na ɔabɛyɛ kutuwdo bo; Iyi Ewuradze na ɔayɛ, Na ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ hɛn enyiwa do?
Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Nyankopɔn ahenman no, wɔbɛgye efi hom nsamu dze akɛma ɔman a wɔdze mu eduaba bɛba.
Na obiara a ɔbɔhwe ɔbo yi do no obobubu, na obiara a ɔbo no bɔhwe no do no, ɔbɔdwow no dɛ isiam.
Na asɔfompanyin nye Farisiifo no tsee ne mbɛ no, wohun dɛ ɔkaa hɔn ho asɛm.
Na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔkyer no no, wosuroo nyimpadodow no, osiandɛ nna wobu no nkɔnhyɛnyi.
Na Jesus buae kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn mbɛbu mu bio dɛ,
Ɔsor ahenman no tse dɛ ɔhen bi a ohyiaa ayefor maa ne babanyin,
na ɔsomaa no nkowaa dɛ wɔnkɛfrɛ hɔn a wohyiaa hɔn ayefor ase no: na wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔba.
Bio ɔsomaa nkowaa afofor dɛ wɔnkɛka nkyerɛ hɔn a woehyia hɔn no dɛ, Hwɛ, mesiesie m’edziban, meku m’anantwi nye m’anyɛmbowa, na woewie adze nyinara yɛ: hom mbra ayefor ase.
Na wɔammfa annyɛ hwee, na wɔkɔr hɔn beebi: obi kɔr no kwa mu, obi so kɔr n’eguadzi ho:
na nkaa no kyeer nkowaa no hyɛɛ hɔn fɛr, na wokum hɔn.
Na ɔhen no bo fuwii, na ɔsomaa no dɔm ma wɔkɛsɛɛ ewudzifo no, na wɔhyeew hɔn kurow.
Nna ɔsee no nkowaa no dɛ, Woewie ayefor pon no siesie dze, naaso hɔn a wokehyiaa hɔn no ammfata hɔn.
Dɛm ntsi hom nkɔ atsempɔn nkwanta do na dodowara a hom bohu hɔn no, hom mfrɛ hɔn mbra ayefor ase.
Na nkowaa no fiir edzi kɔr atsempɔn do, na wɔkɔboaboaa dodowara a wohun hɔn no ano, papa nye bɔn nyina, ma edzidzifo hyɛɛ ayefor no ase ma.
Na ɔhen no baa mu bɔhwɛɛ hɔn a wɔtse edzidzii no, ohun nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ɔnnhyɛ ayeforhyia atar;
na obisaa no dɛ, Awɛ, eyɛɛ dɛn baa mu ha, na ennhyɛ ayeforhyia atar yi? Na ɔtɔɔ mmum.
Nna ɔhen no see asomfo no dɛ, Hom nkyekyer ne nsa nye n’anan na hom mfa no nkɔ nkɔtow no nkyen ekyirekyir sum no mu: hɔ na osu nye asetwɛr wɔ.
Osiandɛ wɔafrɛ pii, naaso kakraabi na woeyi hɔn.
Nna Farisiifo no kɔree kɛfaa apam, mbrɛ wobesi esua no efir wɔ kasa mu.
Na wɔsomaa hɔn esuafo ɔnye Herod akadofo wɔ no hɔ, na wɔsee dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yenyim dɛ eyɛ nokwafo, na ekyerɛkyerɛ Nyankopɔn kwan no wɔ nokwar mu, na innsuro nyimpa biara; eso ennhwɛ nyimpa enyim.
Dɛm ntsi ka kyerɛ hɛn: Edwen dɛn? Ɔfa mbra mu dɛ yɛma Kaesar ntoboa anaa oho?
Na Jesus hun hɔn emumuyɛ no, ɔsee dɛ, Ndabrabafo, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom rosɔ me hwɛ yi?
Hom mfa towsika no mbɛkyerɛ me. Na wɔdze sika denare brɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Woana no mfonyi nye n’akyerɛwee nye yi?
Wɔsee dɛ, Kaesar dze a. Nna ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ntsi hom ndan dza ɔyɛ Kaesar dze mma Kaesar, na dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn dze mma Nyankopɔn.
Na wɔtsee no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa, na wogyaa no hɔ kɔree.
Da no ara na Sadusiifo a wɔka dɛ wunyan nnyi hɔ no bae bebisaa no dɛ,
Kyerɛkyerɛfo, Moses see dɛ, Sɛ obi wu, na sɛ onnyi mba a, no nua nwar ne yer, na ɔnwo mba mma no nua.
Na enuanom beesuon tsenaa hɛn nkyɛn ha; na nyia odzii kan no waree, na owui, na onnyi mba no ɔdaan ne yer gyaa no nua;
nyia otsia ebien no nye ebiasa no yɛɛ dɛm ara, bodur nyia otsia esuon no do.
Na ne nyina ekyir no, ɔbaa no so wui.
Dɛm ntsi wunyan no mu, beesuon no mu woana na ɔbɛyɛ ne yer? Osiandɛ hɔn nyina waar no.
Na Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Hom fom, osiandɛ hom nnyim kyerɛwsɛm no nye Nyankopɔn no tum so.
Na wunyan no mu, wɔnnwar eso wɔmma awar, na wɔtse dɛ Nyankopɔn abɔfoe wɔ sor.
Na ewufo hɔn nyan ho dze, ana hom nnkenkaan dza Nyankopɔn kae no dɛ,
Emi nye Abraham Nyankopɔn, Isaak Nyankopɔn, Jakob Nyankopɔn no? Ɔnnyɛ ewufo Nyankopɔn na atseasefo Nyankopɔn a.
Na nyimpadodow no tsee no, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no yɛɛ hɔn ahobow.
Na Farisiifo no tsee dɛ oemua Sadusiifo no ano no, wodzii ehyia.
Na hɔn mu baako a ɔyɛ mbrakyerɛfo sɔɔ no hwɛe bisaa no dɛ,
Kyerɛkyerɛfo, Mbra no mu asɛnkɛse nye dza ɔwɔ hen?
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ w’akoma nyina mu, nye wo kra nyina mu, nye w’adwen nyina mu.
Iyi nye mbra no mu asɛm a odzi kan, na ɔso.
Na dza otsia ebien no a ɔtse dɛ ɔno no nye dɛ, Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa woho.
Mbransɛm ebien yi do na mbra nye nkɔnhyɛfo no nyina gyinae.
Na Farisiifo no boaa ano no, Jesus bisaa hɔn dɛ,
Hom dwen Kraest no ho dɛn? Woana ba nye no? Wɔsee no dɛ, David a.
Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Dɛm a ɔyɛ dɛn na David nam Sunsum mu frɛ no Ewuradze, ber a ɔkaa dɛ,
Ewuradze see m’Ewuradze dɛ, Tsena m’abanyimfa Kodu dɛ medze w’atamfo bogu w’ananadze?
Na sɛ David frɛ no Ewuradze a, ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔyɛ ne ba?
Na obiara enntum amma no mbuae biara, na ofitsi da no obiara ennsi no bo dɛ obebisa no asɛm bio.
Nna Jesus kasaa kyerɛɛ nyimpadodow no nye n’esuafo dɛ,
Kyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo no tse Moses egua do:
dɛm ntsi adze nyina a wɔbɛhyɛ hom no, hom ndzi do, na hom nyɛ: mbom mma hom nnyɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ bi: osiandɛ hɔn dze, wɔka naaso wɔnnyɛ.
Na wɔkyekyer ndzesoadze durdur a no soa yɛ yaw na wɔdze to nyimpa kɔn ho, na hɔn dze, wɔmmpɛ dɛ wɔdze hɔn nsatseaba mpo suo mu.
Na hɔn ndwuma nyina wɔyɛ ama nyimpa eehu: wɔyɛ dza wɔkyerɛw nyamesɛm hyɛ mu bobɔ hɔn enyim no atɛtɛr, na woyi hɔn ntar ano ndwow akɛse,
na wɔpɛ mpanyin tsenabea wɔ edzidzi ase, nye mpanyin ngua wɔ nhyiamudan mu
nye gua do nkyiakyia, na dɛ nyimpa bɛfrɛ hɔn Rabae (Kyerɛkyerɛfo).
Na hom dze, mma wɔmmfrɛ hom Rabae; na ɔbaako na ɔyɛ hom kyerɛkyerɛfo, na hom nyina yɛ enuanom.
Na mma hom mmfrɛ obi hom egya wɔ asaase do: na ɔbaako nye hom Egya, ɔno nye nyia ɔwɔ sor no.
Eso mma wɔmmfrɛ hom akwankyerɛfo: na ɔbaako nye hom kwankyerɛfo, ɔnye Kraest no.
Na nyia ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ hom mu no, ɔbɛyɛ hom somfo.
Na obiara a ɔbɛma noho do no, wɔbɛbrɛ no adze, na obiara a ɔbɛbrɛ noho adze no, wɔbɛma no do.
Hom ndue! Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Na hom tow ɔsor ahenman mu wɔ nyimpa enyim, naaso homankasa hom nnkɔ mu, eso hɔn a wɔrokɔ mu no hom mma hɔn kwan mma wɔnnkɔ mu.
(Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Hom na hom bɔ ekunafo epoo, na hom petuw bɔ mpaa atsentsen kyerɛ: dɛm ntsi hom benya afɔdzi kɛse.)
Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Dɛ hom bɔ po ho nye asaase do aprɔw kɛyɛ nyimpa baako hom fɛkuwnyi; na sɛ ɔyɛ dɛm a, hom ma ɔyɛ amandzehu kurow mu ba mbɔho ebien kyɛn homankasa.
Hom ndue! Enyifurafo akwankyerɛfo a hom se dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɛka asɔrfi no ntam no nnyɛ hwee; na obiara a ɔbɛka sika a ɔwɔ asɔrfi no mu no ho ntam dze, ɔda no do.
Nkwasea nye enyifurafo! No mu dza ɔwɔ hen na ɔso, sika no anaa asɔrfi no a ɔtsew sika no ho no a?
Na obiara a ɔbɛka afɔrmbukyia no ntam no, ɔnnyɛ hwee; na obiara a ɔbɛka ayɛyɛdze a ɔwɔ do ho ntam no, ɔda no do.
Enyifurafo! Dza ɔwɔ hen na ɔso? Ayɛyɛdze no anaa afɔrmbukyia a ɔtsew ayɛyɛdze no ho no a.
Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔka afɔrmbukyia no ntam no, ɔka ɔno nye dza ɔwɔ do no nyina.
Na nyia ɔka asɔrfi ntam no, ɔka ɔno nye nyia ɔtse mu no.
Na nyia ɔka ɔsor ntam no, ɔka Nyankopɔn n’ahengua nye nyia ɔtse do no.

Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Na hom yi eme nye nunum nye mprɛgowamba mpo ho ebupɛn du du ma, naaso hom egyaa mbra no mu dza ɔsom bo yie no a ɔyɛ atsɛmbu, ehumbɔbɔr nye gyedzi no; iyi na ɔsɛ dɛ hom yɛ, ber a hom nndan nkaa no so nngya.
Enyifurafo akwankyerɛfo a hom sɔn ntonton do, naaso hom men efupɔnkɔ!
Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Hom twuw nkɔɔpow nye mprɛtse ekyir, naaso no mu dze, apempensi nye edzifodze ahyɛ ma.
Farisiinyi onyifurafo, dzi kan twuw kɔɔpow nye prɛtse mu, ama n’ekyir so eefir.
Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Na hom tse dɛ nda a wɔahoa ho, na n’ekyir pue fɛfɛɛfɛw, na no mu dze efun mbiew ɔnye fi nyina ahyɛ ma.
Dɛmara so naaso hom yɛ dɛ nyimpa tsenenee wɔ nyimpa enyim na hom mu dze, ndabraba nye emumuyɛ nyina ahyɛ ma.
Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Osiandɛ hom tow nkɔnhyɛfo nda do, na hom hyehyɛ nyimpa tsenenee abodan no,
na hom ka dɛ, Sɛ yɛwɔ hɛn egyanom aber do a, nkyɛ yɛnye hɔn ammbɔ mu wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo no bɔgyaa ho.
Iyi ntsi hom dzi homho dase dɛ hɔn a wokum nkɔnhyɛfo no hɔn mba nye hom.
Ntsi hom nhyɛ hom egyanom etwadze no ma.
Hom mbowatsena, nhurutsia mba! Hom bɛyɛ dɛn eguan efi amandzehu kurow atsɛmbu no mu?

Dɛm ntsi hwɛ, morosoma nkɔnhyɛfo nye enyansafo nye Akyerɛwfo wɔ hom hɔ, na hom boku hɔn mu bi, na hom abɔ hɔn mbeamudua mu; na hɔn mu bi so hom bɛka hɔn mpire wɔ hom nhyiamudan mu, na hom atseetsee hɔn efi kurow mu akɔ kurow mu;
ma bɔgya tsenenee a wɔaka egu asaase yi do nyina eegu hom do, ofitsi tseneneenyi Abel bɔgyaa do kesi Barakia ba Zekaria a hom kum no wɔ asɔrdan nye afɔrmbukyia no ntamu no bɔgyaa do.
Mese hom nokwar mu dɛ, Yinom nyina bɛba ɔsantsen yi do.

Ao! Jerusalɛm, Jerusalɛm, ɔwo a iku nkɔnhyɛfo no, na isiw hɔn a wɔasoma hɔn wo nkyɛn abo, mpɛn ahen na mepɛɛ dɛ moboaboa wo mba ano, dɛ mbrɛ akokɔtan boaboa ne mba ano wɔ ne ntsaban ase, naaso hom ammpɛ!
Hwɛ, woegyaa wo fie ato hɔ pan ama hom.
Na mese hom dɛ, Ofitsi sesei yi hom runnhu me ara dze akɛpem dɛ hom bɛse dɛ, Nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze ne dzin mu reba no.
Na Jesus fiir edzi fii asɔrfi no mu kɔree, na n’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛkyerɛɛ no asɔrfi no aban no.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnhu yinom nyina? Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Wonnkegya ɔbo kor a ɔda kor do wɔ ha a wonnkodwuruw egu famu.
Na ɔko Ngo Bepɔw no do no, n’esuafo baa ne nkyɛn nsumaa mu bɛsee no dɛ, Kyerɛ hɛn aber a yinom bɛyɛ hɔ, na wo mbae nye wiadze ewiei ho asɛnkyerɛdze bɛyɛ dɛn?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie amma obi aanndaadaa hom.
Na dodowara bɛba wɔ me dzin mu dɛ, Emi nye Kraest no, na wɔadaadaa pii.
Na hom bɛtse ko nye akosɛm nka: hom nhwɛ, mma hom akoma nntu, na otwar dɛ yinom nyina ba, naaso ewiei no nnyae nndurii.
Na ɔman bɔsoɛr ɔman do, na ahenman bɔsoɛr ahenman do; na ɔkɔm nye asaasewosow bɛba mbeambea.
Na yinom nyina nye awoko ahyɛse.
Nna wobeyi hom ama ahohiahia na woeku hom, na amanaman nyina bɛtan hom wɔ me dzin ntsi.
Ɔno na ɔbɔto dodowara fintsidua, na wobeyiyi hɔnho ama, na wɔatentan hɔnho.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo pii bɔsoɛr na wɔadaadaa dodowara.
Na osiandɛ emumuyɛ bɔdɔɔ so ntsi, dodowara hɔn dɔ bɛyɛ mberɛw.
Na nyia obetsim ekodu ewiei no, ɔno na wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Na ahenman ho asɛmpa yi, wɔbɛka wɔ wiadze nyina dze edzi amanaman nyina dase; na nkyii ewiei no bɛba.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom hu amambɔe ekyiwadze a Daniel nkɔnhyɛnyi kaa ho asɛm no, dɛ ogyina krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ a (ma nyia ɔrekenkan no ntse ase)
ɔno na hɔn a wɔwɔ Judea nguan nkɔ nkokwaa do:
mma nyimpa a ɔwɔ dan etsifi nnsian mmbɛfa biribi mmfi ne dan mu;
na nyia ɔwɔ haban mu, mma ɔnnsan n’ekyir bio mmbɛfa ne nkatado.
Na hɔn a wɔafa efur, nye hɔn a wɔma numfo wɔ nda no mu ndue!
Na hom nsɔr ma hom eguanguanber no aammba awɔwber mu, anaa ahomgyeda;
na aber no ahohiahia kɛse a ofitsi wiadze ahyɛse dze bodu aber no ɔmmba da, eso ɔremmba da, nna ɔbɛba.
Na sɛ woenntwa nda no do tsia a, nkyɛ honam biara nnkenya nkwa; na mpamufo ntsi wobotwa nda no do tsia.
Na aber no sɛ obiara se hom dɛ, Hwɛ, Kraest no wɔ ha, anaaso, Ɔwɔ ha a, mma hom nngye nndzi.
Na Kraest atorfo nye nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo bɔsoɛr na wɔakyerɛ asɛnkyerɛdze akɛse nye anwanwadze, ma sɛ annhwɛ a mpamufo no mpo wɔbɛdaadaa hɔn.
Hwɛ, maka akyerɛ hom ansaana edu.
Dɛm ntsi, sɛ wɔse hom dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔwɔ sar no do a, mma hom mmpue nnkɔ, Hwɛ, ɔwɔ adankyir a, mma hom nngye nndzi.
Na dɛ mbrɛ enyinam nyinam fi boka, na ɔhyerɛn kɔ anee no, mbrɛ nyimpa Ba no ne mbae so bɛyɛ ara nye no.
Na beebiara mbrɛ fun wɔ no, hɔ na mpɛtɛ bɔboaboa hɔn ano.
Na ntsɛmara, nda no mu ahohia no ekyir no, ewia bɛhyɛ sum, na bosoom nnkɛma ne kan, na nworaba fi sor bɔtotɔ, na sor etum bɔwosow:
na ɔno na nyimpa Ba no n’asɛnkyerɛdze bopue wimu, na wiadze mbusuakuw nyina bɔkɔ ahohia kɛse mu, na wobohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔreba wɔ sor nsuwusiw do, wɔ tumdzi nye enyimnyam kɛse mu.
Na ɔdze totorobɛnto a ne ndze so bɔsoma n’abɔfoe, ma wɔaabɔboaboa hɔn a wɔapa mu eyi hɔn no ano efi mbrɛ mframa anan no fi ba no, efi sor ano kor akɛpem afa kor so.
Hom nsua adɔmbadua ho bɛ no: sɛ n’abaw yɛ momon, na oriyi ahaban a, nna hom nyim dɛ ɔhyewber abɛn;
dɛmara na hom so sɛ hom hu dɛ yinom nyina yɛ hɔ a, hom nhu dɛ abɛn na edu abowano.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Mbasantsen yi nnkotwa mu akɔ gyedɛ yinom nyina ayɛ hɔ ansaana.
Ɔsor nye asaase botwa mu akɔ naaso me nsɛm dze, orunntwa mu da.
Na da no nye dɔn no obiara nnyim: nnyɛ abɔfo a wɔwɔ sor no, nnyɛ Ɔba no so, na Egya no nko a.
Na dɛ mbrɛ Noa nda no yɛe no, mbrɛ nyimpa Ba no ne mbae so bɛyɛ ara nye no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ nda no a odzi nsuyirii no kan no, wodzidzii, na wɔnomee, wɔwaree, na wɔmaa awar dze kodur da a Noa kɛhyɛɛ hɛn adaka no mu no,
na woennhu araa dze kodur dɛ nsuyirii no bae bɛfaa hɔn nyinara kɔree no, mbrɛ nyimpa Ba no ne mbae so bɛyɛ ara nye no.
Ɔno na nyimpa beenu wɔ haban mu a, wɔbɛfa baako na woegya kor no.
Mbaa beenu bɛyam wɔ ewuyambo do, na wɔbɛfa baako na woegya kor no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nweɔn, osiandɛ hom nnyim dɔn kor a hom wura bɛba.
Na hom nhu yi dɛ, sɛ ofiwura no nyim dasu kor a owifo no bɛba a, nkyɛ ɔweɔnee, na ɔamma woemmbobubu ne dan mu annkɔ mu.
Dɛm ntsi hom so hom nyɛ krado, osiandɛ dɔn a hom enyi nnda mu na nyimpa Ba no reba.
Afei woana nye akowaa nokwafo nye nyansafo a no wura dze no esi ne fikuw do, dɛ ɔmma hɔn edziban wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu?
Nhyira aka akowaa no a, sɛ no wura ba a, obohu no dɛ ɔreyɛ dɛm,
Nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔdze no besi n’adze a ɔwɔ nyina do.
Na sɛ akowaa bɔn se n’akoma mu dɛ, Mo wura rikyim ne ba;
na sɛ ɔhyɛ ase bobɔ no nwurankowaa, na sɛ ɔnye asabokwafo dzidzi na ɔnom a,
akowaa no wura bɛba da a ɔnnhwɛ no kwan, nye dɔn a onnyim mu,
na oetwa no mu ebien, na ɔama ɔnye ndabrabafo edzi afora; hɔ na osu nye asetwɛr wɔ.
Nna wɔdze sor ahenman no bɔto mbaabun du a wɔfaa hɔn nkandzea dɛ worikehyia ayeforkun kwan no ho.
Na hɔn mu beenum yɛɛ mbadwemba, na beenum dze, wɔannyɛ mbadwemba.
Na hɔn a wɔannyɛ mbadwemba no, wɔfaa hɔn nkandzea no, wɔammfa ngo annka ho;
na mbadwemba no faa ngo guu hɔn ntoa mu kaa hɔn nkandzea no ho.
Na ayeforkun no kyɛree no, hɔn nyina totɔɔ nkom na wɔdedae.
Na esuom no, wɔtseaa mu dɛ, Hwɛ, ayeforkun no reba o! Hom nkɔ nkehyia no.
Nna mbaabun no nyina soɛree na wɔkekaa hɔn nkandzea.
Na hɔn a wɔannyɛ mbadwemba no see mbadwemba no dɛ, Hom mma hɛn hom ngo no bi, na hɛn nkandzea rudundum.
Na mbadwemba no buaa dɛ, Oho, bɛyɛ na ɔronnso hɛn nye hom; na mbom hom nkɔ hɔn a wɔtɔn no hɔ nkɔtɔ homdze.
Na wɔkɔree rokɔtɔ no, ayeforkun no bae, na hɔn a wɔayɛ krado no nye no kɔr ayefor ase, na wɔtoow abow no mu.
Na ekyir no na mbaabun nkaa no so bae bɛsee dɛ, Owura, owura, bue hɛn.
Na ɔno dze, obuaa hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, minnyim hom.
Dɛm ntsi hom nweɔn, na hom nnyim da no anaa dɔn no, (a Nyimpa ba no bɛba.)
Na ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a ɔrodɔ mu akɔ beebi a ɔfrɛɛ no nkowaa, na ɔdze n’adze a ɔwɔ hyɛɛ hɔn nsa.
Na ɔmaa baako talent enum, ɔbaako so ebien, na ɔbaako so kor, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nyina hɔn tum tse, na ɔkɔree.
Na ntsɛmara nyia onyaa talent enum no kɔree, na ɔdze kedzii gua, na onyaa ho talent enum so.
Dɛmara so na nyia onyaa ebien no, onyaa ho ebien so.
Na nyia onyaa kor no, ɔkɔree kɔbɔɔr daadze, na ɔdze no wura ne sika no sumae.
Na ɔkyɛree kyɛree no, nkowaa no hɔn wura no bae, na ɔnye hɔn bobuu nkontaa.
Na nyia onyaa talent enum no bae dze talent enum ka ho baa dɛ, Mo wura, edze talent enum hyɛɛ me nsa: hwɛ, menya ho talent enum aka ho.
No wura see no dɛ, Mbo! Akowaa pa nye nokwafo, edzi ndzɛmba kumaabi ho nokwar: medze wo besi ndzɛmba pii do: kɔ wo wura dɛw mu.
Na nyia onyaa talent ebien no so bae, na ɔsee dɛ, Mo wura, edze talent ebien hyɛɛ me nsa: hwɛ, menya ho talent ebien aka ho.
No wura see no dɛ, Mbo! Akowaa pa nye nokwafo, edzi ndzɛmba kumaabi ho nokwar, medze wo besi ndzɛmba pii do: kɔ wo wura dɛw mu.
Na nyia onyaa talent kor no so bae bɛsee dɛ, Mo wura, minyim wo dɛ eyɛ nyimpa a eyɛ dzen a itwa wɔ mbrɛ innduae, na eboaboa ano wɔ mbrɛ emmfae mmpetsee;
na musuroi, na mokɔree, na medze wo talent no kosumaa daadze: hwɛ, w’adze nye yi.
Na no wura buae see no dɛ, Akowaa bɔn nye kwadwefo, inyim dɛ mutwa wɔ mbrɛ munnduae, na moboaboa ano wɔ mbrɛ memmfae mmpetsee:
dɛm ntsi nkyɛ ɔsɛ wo dɛ edze me sika kɛma sikasesafo, na meba a, mabɛgye m’adze nye no ho nsiho.
Dɛm ntsi, hom ngye talent no wɔ ne nsamu, na hom mfa mma nyia ɔwɔ talent du no.
Osiandɛ obiara a ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no na oenya mbordo; na nyia onnyi no, dza ɔwɔ no mpo, wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
Na akowaa a no ho nnyi mfaso no dze, hom ntow no nkyen ekyirekyir sum no mu: hɔ na osu nye asetwɛr wɔ.
Na aber a nyimpa Ba no bɛba wɔ n’enyimnyam mu, na n’abɔfoe no nyina ka no ho no, nna ɔbɛtsena n’enyimnyam ahengua no do;
na wɔbɔboaboa amanaman nyina ano wɔ n’enyim, na ɔbɛpaapaa hɔn mu dɛ mbrɛ oguanhwɛfo paapaa nguan nye mpɔnkye mu;
na ɔdze nguan no begyina n’enyimfa, na ɔdze mpɔnkye no egyina n’abankum.
Nna Ɔhen no bɛse hɔn a wɔwɔ n’enyimfa no dɛ, Hom mbra, hom a m’Egya ehyira hom, hom mbɛfa ahenman a wofitsi wiadze ahyɛse siesiei maa hom no ntsena mu:
osiandɛ ɔkɔm dzee me, na hom maa me edziban; nsukɔm dzee me, na hom maa me anondze; meyɛɛ hɔho, na hom faa me kɔr fie;
midzii adagyaw, na hom furaa me tam; meyaree, na hom bɔhwɛɛ me; medaa efiadze na hom baa me nkyɛn.
Ɔno na atsenenee no bobua ase no dɛ, Ewuradze, dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ ɔkɔm dze wo, na yɛmaa wo edziban, anaa nsukɔm dze wo, na yɛmaa wo anondze?
Dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ eyɛ hɔho na yɛfaa wo kɔr fie, anaa idzi adagyaw, na yefuraa wo tam?
Anaa dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ eyar anaa eda efiadze, na yɛbaa wo nkyɛn?
Na Ɔhen no bobua ase hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Susuampa dɛ hom ayɛ ama mo nuanom nketseaba yi mu kor no, hom ayɛ ama me.
Ɔno na ɔbɛse hɔn a wɔwɔ bankum no so dɛ, Hom a wɔadom hom, hom mfi me nkyɛn nkɔ onnyiewiei gya a woesiesie ama abɔnsam nye n’abɔfoe no no mu.
Osiandɛ ɔkɔm dzee me, na hom amma me edziban; nsukɔm dzee me, na hom amma me anondze;
meyɛɛ hɔho, na hom ammfa me annkɔ fie; midzii adagyaw, na hom emmfura me tam; meyaree na medaa efiadze, na hom ammbɔhwɛ me.
Ɔno na hɔn so bobua ase dɛ, Ewuradze, dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ ɔkɔm dze wo, anaa nsukɔm dze wo, anaa eyɛ hɔho, anaa idzi adagyaw, anaa eyar, anaa eda efiadze, na yɛannsom wo?
Ɔno na obobua hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Susuampa dɛ hom annyɛ amma hom nuanom nketseaba yi mu kor no, hom annyɛ amma me.
Na yinom bɔkɔ onnyiewiei amandzehu no mu, na atsenenee no bɔkɔ onnyiewiei nkwa no mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus wiee nsɛm yi nyina ka no, ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ,
Hom nyim dɛ aka nda ebien ma apaho no edu, na woribeyi nyimpa Ba no ama, ma wɔaabɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Nna asɔfompanyin nye ɔman mpanyimfo no kehyiaa ɔsɔfopanyin a wɔfrɛ no Kaiafas n’aban mu,
na wotuu egyina wɔ mbrɛ wɔnam nyansa mu bɛkyer Jesus eku no ho.
na wɔsee dɛ, Nnyɛ afahyɛ mu bi a, amma wentwiwentwi aammba ɔman no mu.
Na ber a Jesus wɔ Bɛtani wɔ Simon kwatanyi no ne fie no,
ɔbaa bi a ɔdze ngohuam a ɔsom bo alabastron toa ma baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔtse edzidzi no, obohuei guu n’etsifi.
Na esuafo no hunii no, wonyaa ebufuw na wɔsee dɛ, Adzesɛɛ a ɔtse dɛm yi ase nye dɛn?
Nkyɛ wɔbɔtɔn ngohuam yi agye sika pii na wɔdze akyɛ ehiafo.
Na Jesus tsee no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rehaw ɔbaa no? Na ɔayɛ edwuma pa wɔ mo ho.
Na hom wɔ ehiafo wɔ hom nkyɛn daa; na emi dze, hom nnyi me daa.
Na dɛ oehue ngohuam yi egu me nyimpadua do yi, ɔayɛ ama me nsiei.
Meka no nokwar kyerɛ hom dɛ, Beebiara a wɔbɛka asɛmpa yi wɔ wiadze nyina mu no, dza ɔbaa yi ayɛ so wɔbɛka dze ayɛ ne nkaa.
Nna duebien no mu kor a wɔfrɛ no Judas Iskariot no kɔr asɔfompanyin no hɔ,
na ɔkɛsee hɔn dɛ, Hom bɛma me ebɛnadze ma meeyi no ama hom? Na wokeer ndwetɛbona eduasa maa no.
Na ofitsi aber no, ɔhwehwɛɛ mbrɛ obenya kwan eyi no ama.
Na epitsi afahyɛ da a odzi kan no, esuafo no baa Jesus nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Hen na epɛ dɛ yesiesie ma ikedzi apaho no?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nkɔ kurow no mu osimesi no hɔ, na hom nkɛse no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo no se, Me ber abɛn: wo fie na menye m’esuafo bedzi apaho no.
Na esuafo no kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Jesus hyɛɛ hɔn no na wosiesiee apaho no.
Na odur ewimbir no, ɔnye esuafo duebien no bɛtsenaa edzidzii.
Na woridzidzi no, ɔsee dɛ, Ampa, mese hom dɛ, Hom mu baako beyi me ama.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn awerɛhow pii, na wɔhyɛɛ ase see no nkorkor dɛ, Ewuradze, ana emi a?
Na obuae see dɛ, Nyia ɔnye me to nsa wɔ ɔsɛn no mu no, ɔnoara na obeyi me ama.
Na nyimpa Ba no rokɔ, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ no ho: mbom nyimpa a wɔnam no do beyi nyimpa Ba no ama no ndue! Sɛ wɔannwo dɛm nyimpa no a, nkyɛ oye ma no.
Na Judas a oriyi no ama no buae see dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ana emi a? Ɔsee no dɛ, Aka.
Na woridzidzi no, Jesus faa paanoo na ohyiraa do na obubui, na ɔdze maa n’esuafo no na ɔsee dɛ, Hom ngye ndzi: iyi nye me nyimpadua.
Na ɔfaa kɔɔpow, na ɔdaa ase, na ɔdze maa hɔn dɛ, Hom nyinara nnom bi:
na iyi nye mo bɔgyaa a ɔyɛ ahyɛmu no dze a dodowara ntsi woruhue egu ama bɔnfakyɛ.
Na mese hom dɛ, Ofitsi ndɛ, moronnom wenyinaba yi bio dze ekesi da no a menye hom bɔnom no fofor wɔ m’Egya n’ahenman no mu no.
Na wɔtoow ndwom no, wopuei kɔr Ngo Bepɔw no do.
Nna Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Mo ho bɛyɛ hom nyina fintsidua anadwe yi: na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Mobɔbɔ oguanhwɛfo no, na kuw no mu nguan nyina abɔ apetse.
Naaso me nyan ekyir no mibedzi hom enyim akɔ Galilii.
Na Peter buae see no dɛ, Sɛ wo ho bɛyɛ hɔn nyina fintsidua a, emi dze, ɔnnkɛyɛ me fintsidua.
Jesus see no dɛ, Meka kyerɛ wo wɔ nokwar mu dɛ, Anadwe yi, ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn no, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa.
Peter see no dɛ, Sɛ menye wo bowu mpo a, meremmpa wo da; na dɛmara na hɔn nyina so kae.
Nna Jesus nye hɔn baa beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Getsemane, na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Hom ntsena ha ma monkɔ noho monkɔsɔr.
Na ɔfaa Peter nye Zebedee mba beenu no kaa no ho, na no werɛ hyɛɛ ase howee, na ɔbɔmee.
Nna ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Awerɛhow ahyɛ me kra no do dze kɔ owu mu: hom ntsena ha na hom nye me nweɔn.
Na ɔkɔr enyim kakra na ɔdze n’enyim kobutuwii, na ɔbɔɔ mpaa dɛ, Egya, sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, ma kɔɔpow yi mpa mo ho nkɔ: naaso nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ mepɛ bi a, na mbrɛ ɔwo epɛ a.
Na ɔbaa esuafo no nkyɛn, na obohun dɛ wɔdeda, na ɔsee Peter dɛ, Aso hom enntum nye me annweɔn dɔnhwer kor mpo?
Hom nweɔn na hom nsɔr, mma hom aannkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu: sunsum pɛ dze, na honam yɛ mberɛw.
Bio, ɔkɔr ne mpɛn ebien kɔsɔɔr dɛ, M’Egya, sɛ kɔɔpow yi nnkɛpa mo ho akɔ gyedɛ monom a, wo pɛ nyɛ hɔ.
Na ɔbae no, obohun dɛ wɔadeda bio, osiandɛ hɔn enyiwa akom.
Na ogyaa hɔn hɔ kɔr bio kɔsɔɔr ne mprɛnsa kaa asɛm kor no ara.
Nna ɔbaa esuafo no nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Na hom da ho da regye hom ahom? Hwɛ, dɔn no abɛn, na Nyimpa Ba no, woeyi no ahyɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo nsa.
Hom nsoɛr ma yɛnkɔ: hwɛ, nyia oriyi me ama no abɛn.
Na ɔda do rekasa no, hwɛ, Judas a ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako no, bae, na nyimpadodow pii a wɔdzedze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa fi asɔfompanyin nye ɔman mu mpanyimfo no hɔ ka no ho.
Na nyia oyii no mae no maa hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ, Nyia mebɛfew n’ano no, ɔno nye no: hom nkyer no.
Na ntsɛmara ɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn na ɔsee dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, o! Na ɔfeew n’ano.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Damfo, yɛ dza ɔnam do ma aba. Nna wɔbae dze hɔn nsa bosusuoo no mu, na wɔkyekyeer no.
Na hwɛ, hɔn a wɔnye Jesus nam no mu baako tseen ne nsa twee ne nkrantsee, na ɔdze bɔɔ ɔsɔfopanyin no n’akowaa n’aso twae.
Nna Jesus see no dɛ, Fa wo nkrantsee hyɛ ne hyɛbea bio, na hɔn a wɔtwe nkrantsee nyina, nkrantsee anomu na wɔbɔtotɔr.
Ana edwen dɛ murunntum mennserɛ m’Egya ma mprɛmprɛ ara ɔnnsoma abɔfo a wɔbɔbor asafokuw duebien?
Nna dɛm a, kyerɛwnsɛm no bɛyɛ dɛn aba mu dɛ otwar dɛ ɔyɛ dɛm?
Dɔn no ara mu na Jesus see nyimpadodow no dɛ, Ana hom firii baa mo do dɛ owifo do, na hom dze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa rebɛkyer me yi? Daa nna metse asɔrfi mu rekyerɛkyerɛ no, hom annkyer me.
Na yinom nyina yɛe ma nkɔnhyɛfo no kyerɛwnsɛm no aaba mu. Nna esuafo no nyina gyaa no hɔ, na woguanee.
Na hɔn a wɔkyeer Jesus no dze no kɔr Kaiafas ɔsɔfopanyin no nkyɛn, mbrɛ kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no ehyia.
Na Peter dzii n’ekyir wɔ ekyirekyir dze kodur ɔsɔfopanyin n’abanguado, na ɔkɛhɛɛn mu nye asomfo no kɛtsenaa hɔ dɛ ɔrohwɛ dza obesi.
Na asɔfompanyin nye baguafo no nyina hwehwɛɛ Jesus ho dasekrum dze eku no:
na adasetorfo pii bae naaso woennya bi. Na ekyir no beenu bae.
Na wɔsee dɛ, Oyi kaa dɛ, Mubotum medwuruw Nyankopɔn asɔrdan no na mesi no ndaansa.
Na ɔsɔfopanyin no gyinae na ɔsee no dɛ, Irummbua bi? Ebɛnadze na yinom ridzi dase tsia wo yi?
Na Jesus muaa n’ano. Na ɔsɔfopanyin no see no dɛ, Meka tsease Nyankopɔn dɛ sɛ ɔwo nye Kraest no, Nyankopɔn ba no a, ka kyerɛ hɛn.
Jesus see no dɛ, Aka: eso mese wo dɛ, Ofi ndɛ hom bohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔtse tum no nsa nyimfa, na ɔreba wɔ sor nsuwusiw do.
Nna ɔsɔfopanyin no sunsuaan n’atar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔaka ebususɛm: ebɛn hia na ohia hɛn adasefo bio? Hwɛ, afei hom atse ebususɛm no:
hom dwen dɛn? Wobuae see dɛ Ɔsɛ owu.
Nna wohinaa n’enyi do ntafi, na wɔbobɔɔ no ekutuku, na binom so bobɔɔ no asotɔr dɛ,
Kraest, kyerɛ hɛn! Woana na ɔbɔɔ wo?
Nna Peter dze, ɔtse abangua no do hɔ; na abaawa bi baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, Ɔwo so enye Jesus Galiliinyi no nam.
Na ɔsanee wɔ hɔn nyina enyim dɛ, Minnyim dza ereka yi.
Na ofiir edzi kɔr paado no, abaawa bi so hun no, na ɔsee hɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ no dɛ, Oyi so nye Jesus Nazarɛtnyi no nam.
Na bio ɔdze ntanka saan dɛ, Minnyim nyimpa no.
Na ɔkyɛɛr kakra no hɔn a wogyina hɔ no bae bɛsee Peter dɛ, Ampa dɛ ifi hɔn mu, na wo kasaa yi wo edzi.
Nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii nsew na ɔkekaa ntam dɛ, Minnyim nyimpa no. Na ntsɛmara na akokɔ bɔnee.
Na Peter kaa Jesus n’asɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn no, na apa me mprɛnsa. Na ofiir edzi, na okosuu yayaayaw.
Na adze kyee no, asɔfompanyin nye ɔman mpanyimfo no nyina faa Jesus ho apam dɛ woboku no.
Na wɔkyekyeer no dze no kɔree kɛhyɛɛ ambrado Pilate nsa.
Nna Judas a oyii no mae no, ohun dɛ woebu no fɔ no, onuu no ho, na ɔdze ndwetɛbona eduasa no brɛɛ asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no dɛ,
Mayɛ bɔn dɛ meyi bɔgya a onndzi fɔ ama. Na wobuaa dɛ, Ɔfa hɛn ho bɛn? Woara w’asɛm a.
Na ɔtoow ndwetɛbona no guu asɔrdan no mu, na osii mu kɔree kɛsɛɛn ne men.
Na asɔfompanyin no faa ndwetɛbona no na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔmmfa mbra mu dɛ wɔdze to ayɛyɛdze adaka no mu, osiandɛ ɔyɛ bɔgya ho sika.
Na wɔfaa apam, na wɔdze kɛgyee ɔwemfo asaase no, ama woeesie ahɔho wɔ mu.
Dɛm ntsi asaase no, wɔfrɛ no bɔgya asaase dze bodu ndɛ.
Nna dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia kae no baa mu dɛ, Na wɔfaa ndwetɛbona eduasa no, nyia wodzii ne tsir bo no no bo a Israelmba mu binom twae no,
na wɔdze gyee ɔwemfo asaase no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ me no.
Na Jesus gyinaa ambrado no enyim; na ambrado no bisaa no dɛ, Ana Jewfo Hen nye wo a? Na Jesus see no dɛ, Aka.
Na asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no toatoaa no, naaso oemmbua hwee.
Nna Pilate see no dɛ, Ana enntse ndzɛmba pii a woridzi ho dase tsia wo yi?
Naaso oemmbua no wɔ asɛm kor mpo ho, ma ɔyɛɛ ambrado no nwanwa kɛse.
Nna afahyɛ du a, ambrado no tɔ dɛ ogyaa daduanyi kor a wɔpɛ ma nyimpadodow no.
Nna wɔwɔ daduanyi bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Barabbas.
Dɛm ntsi wobehyiae no, Pilate bisaa hɔn dɛ, Woana na hom pɛ dɛ migyaa no ma hom? Barabbas anaa Jesus a wɔfrɛ no Kraest no a?
Nna onyim dɛ enyitan ntsi na woyii no mae.
Na ɔtse atsɛmbu egua do no, ne yer somaa obi wɔ ne nkyɛn dɛ, Mma ennye nyimpa tsenenee no nndzi asɛm bi, na ɔno ntsi mehu amandze pii wɔ adaaso mu ndɛ.
Na asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no wee guu nyimpadodow no aso mu dɛ wombisa Barabbas, na wonku Jesus.
Na ambrado no bisaa hɔn dɛ, Hɔn beenu yi mu woana na hom pɛ dɛ migyaa no ma hom? Wɔsee dɛ, Barabbas a.
Pilate see hɔn dɛ, Na Jesus a wɔfrɛ no Kraest no, menyɛ no dɛn? Hɔn nyina see dɛ, Ma wɔmbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛn bɔn na ɔayɛ? Na wɔtseatseaa mu mbordo dɛ, Ma wɔmbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na Pilate hun dɛ onntum nnyɛ ho hwee, na mbom wentwiwentwi reba no, ɔfaa nsu hohoor ne nsa ho wɔ nyimpadodow no enyim see dɛ, Minndzi so wɔ nyimpa tsenenee yi no bɔgyaa ho: homara hom asɛm.
Na ɔman no nyina buae see dɛ, No bɔgyaa ngu hɛn nye hɛn mba etsifi.
Nna ogyaa Barabbas maa hɔn, na Jesus dze, ɔkaa no mpire no, oyii no mae dɛ wɔnkɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Nna ambrado no no nsordaafo no faa Jesus kɔr ambrado aban mu hɔ, na wohyiahyiaa nsordaafokuw no nyina baa ne nkyɛn.
Na wɔpɔɔr n’atar, na wɔdze atar memen hyɛɛ no,
na wɔween nsoɛ katraka dze hyɛɛ ne tsir, na wɔdze ndzɛmbir hyɛɛ ne nsa nyimfa mu, na wobuu ntwɛr wɔ n’enyim, na wosii no atwetwe dɛ, Jewfo Hen, o!
Wohinahinaa ntafi guu no do, na wɔgyee ndzɛmbir no na wɔdze bɔɔ n’etsifi.
Na wowiee no atwetwe si no, wɔpɔɔr atar no wɔ no ho, na wɔdze nankasa n’atar hyɛɛ no, na wɔdze no kɔree dɛ wɔrokɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na worupue akɔ no, wohun Sirenenyi bi a ne dzin dze Simon: ɔno na wɔhyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnsoa ne mbeamudua no nye hɔn nkɔ.
Na wokodur beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Golgota, ɔnye dɛ Tsikwankora Bea no,
wɔmaa no wenyin a wɔdze bɔwema afora mu dɛ ɔnnom; na ɔkaa n’ano no ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom.
Na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no, wɔtwee tonto kyɛɛ n’atar; (ama dza nkɔnhyɛnyi no kae no aba mu dɛ, Na wɔkyɛɛ m’atar mu maa hɔn ho, na wɔtwee me ntar ho tonto.)
na wɔtsenatsenaa ase weɔɔn no wɔ hɔ.
Na wɔdze n’ewusi a wɔkyerɛwee no faam n’etsifi dɛ, OYI NYE JESUS JEWFO HEN NO.
Na wɔbɔɔ edwotwafo beenu mbeamudua mu kaa no ho, ɔbaako wɔ n’enyimfa, ɔbaako wɔ n’abankum.
Na hɔn a worutwa mu no dzii no nsɛmbɔn, na wɔwosowosoow hɔn tsir
see dɛ, Ɔwo a idwuruw asɔrdan no na isi no ndaansa, gye woho; sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba no a, fi mbeamudua ho si famu ɛ!
Dɛmara so na asɔfompanyin no nye kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no sii no atwetwe see dɛ,
Oyi gyee binom: naaso onntum nngye nankasa noho. Ɔno nye Israel Hen no: wɔmma omfi mbeamudua no ho nsi famu, na yɛbɛgye no edzi.
Nyew, ɔdze noho atwer Nyankopɔn: sɛ Nyankopɔn pɛ a, wɔmma ɔngye no, osiandɛ ɔnoara see dɛ, Nyankopɔn Ba nye me.
Dɛmara na edwotwafo no a wɔbɔɔ hɔn nye no mbeamudua mu no so yaaw no.
Na ofi bɛyɛ ewiaber duebien ber no, sum hyɛɛ asaase nyina do kesii ndɔnebiasa ber no.
Na bɛyɛ ndɔnebiasa no, Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu dɛ, Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani? Ɔno nye dɛ, Me Nyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn na apa me yi?
Na hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ binom tsee no, wɔsee dɛ, Oyi refrɛ Elija.
Na ntsɛmara hɔn mu baako tuu mbirika kɛfaa posaa dze kɔbɔɔ wenyin yerɛyerɛw mu, na ɔdze tuaa ndzɛmbir ano maa no dɛ ɔnnom.
Na nkaa no see dɛ, Gyaa ma yɛnhwɛ dɛ Elija bɛba abɛgye no anaa.
Na Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu bio no, ogyaa no sunsum mu.
Na hwɛ, asɔrdan no mu ntwamutam no tseew ebien fi sor besii ase, na asaase wosowee, na abotan paapaae,
na ahotseweefo a wɔadeda dodowara hɔn efun nyanyanee,
na wofi nda no mu puepuei wɔ ne nyan no ekyir no, wɔkɔr kurow krɔnkrɔn no mu keyii hɔnho kyerɛɛ dodowara.
Na ɔhamupanyin no nye hɔn a wɔka no ho roweɔn Jesus no hun asaasewosow no nye ndzɛmba a ɔyɛe no, wosuroo pii na wɔsee dɛ, Ampaara, Nyankopɔn Ba nye yi.
Na mbaa dodowara wɔ hɔ a wogyinaa ekyir hwɛe, woyinom na wɔkaa Jesus do fiir Galilii na wɔsoom no;
na Mary Magdalene, nye James nye Joses hɔn na Mary, nye Zebedee mba no hɔn na ka hɔn ho.
Na odur ewimbir no, ɔhonyanyi bi a ofi Arimatea a wɔfrɛ no Josef a noara so yɛ Jesus no suanyi bae;
ɔno na ɔkɔr Pilate hɔ kɛserɛɛ Jesus no fun. Nna Pilate hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma no.
Na Josef faa fun no dze bobɔɔw ndwera a n’enyi tsew mu,
Na ɔdze too nankasa ne nda fofor a otwaa no ɔbotan mu no mu, na opireew ɔbo kɛse hiin nda no ano, na ɔkɔree.
Nna Mary Magdalene nye Mary baako no so wɔ hɔ, na wɔtsenatsena nda no enyim.
Na adze kyee a ɔyɛ da a odzi Ahosiesieda no ekyir no, asɔfompanyin nye Farisiifo no behyiae wɔ Pilate nkyɛn
bɛsee dɛ, Hɛn wura, yɛkaa dɛ ɔdaadaafo no tse ase no, ɔkaa dɛ, Ndaansa ekyir mibenyan.
Dɛm ntsi ka ma wɔnkɛhyɛ nda no nsew nkodu da a otsia ebiasa no, amma n’esuafo aammba emmbowia no, na wɔaannse ɔman no dɛ, Oenyan efi ewufo mu; ɔno ekyir nsɛmansɛma no bɛsen kan dze no koraa.
Pilate see hɔn dɛ, Hom wɔ aweɔmfo: hom nkɔ nkɛhyɛ no nsew dɛ mbrɛ hom botum.
Na wɔkɔree, na wɔkɛhyɛɛ nda no nsew: wɔsɔɔw ɔbo no ano, nna aweɔmfo no ka hɔn ho.
Ahomgyeda no twaa mu, na da a odzi dapɛn no kan no enyim retsetsew no, Mary Magdalene nye Mary baako no baa dɛ wɔrobɔhwɛ nda no.
Na hwɛ, asaase wosoow kɛse papaapa, na Ewuradze bɔfoe fi sor sianee na ɔbae bepireew ɔbo no fii nda no ano, na ɔtsenaa do.
Na no ho tse dɛ enyinam, na n’efuradze hoa dɛ esukwankyɛba.
Na no ho hu ntsi hɔn a wɔroweɔn no ho popoe, na wɔyɛɛ dɛ ewufo.
Na ɔbɔfo no buae see mbaa no dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro, na minyim dɛ hom rohwehwɛ Jesus a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no.
Onnyi ha: na ɔasoɛr dɛ mbrɛ ɔkae no: hom mbra mbɔhwɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze dae.
Na hom nkɔ ntsɛm nkɛka nkyerɛ n’esuafo no dɛ, Ɔasoɛr efi ewufo mu; na hwɛ, oedzi hom enyim kɔ Galilii: hɔ na hom bohu no; hwɛ, maka akyerɛ hom.
Na wofiir edzi ntsɛm fii nda no ho dze suro nye dɛw kɛse tutuu mbirika dɛ wɔrekɛka akyerɛ n’esuafo no.
Na hwɛ, Jesus hyiaa hɔn see hɔn dɛ, Mema hom mbo na yɛ o! Na wɔbaa bosusuoo n’anan mu, na wɔkotoow no.
Nna Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro; hom nkɔ nkɛka nkyerɛ mo nuanom dɛ wɔnkɔ Galilii, na hɔ na wobohu me.
Na wɔrokɔ no, hwɛ, aweɔmfo no mu binom baa kurow no mu bɛkaa nsɛm a esi no nyina kyerɛɛ asɔfompanyin no.
Na wɔnye mpanyimfo no hyiae na wɔfaa apam no, wɔmaa nsordaafo no sika kɛse,
na wɔsee dɛ, Hom nka dɛ, Anadwe a yɛdae no nna n’esuafo bae bowiaa no.
Na sɛ iyi du ambrado asomu a, yebotu n’aso esuma, na yɛamma annyɛ hom do asɛm.
Na wɔgyee sika no, na wɔkɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn no; na asɛm yi tahyee wɔ Jewfo mu dze bodu ndɛ.
Na esuafo dubiako no sii mu kɔr Galilii, wɔ kokwaa a Jesus kyerɛɛ hɔn no do.
Na wohun no no, wɔkotoow no; na binom gyee ekyingye.
Na Jesus bɛkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Wɔdze sor nye asaase do tum nyina ama me.
Dɛm ntsi hom nkɔ nkɛyɛ amanaman nyina m’esuafo, na hom nnuma hɔn nhyɛ Egya, nye Ɔba, nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn dzin mu;
na hom nkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn dɛ wondzi dza mahyɛ hom nyina do: na hwɛ, menye hom wɔ hɔ daa, dze kesi wiadze ewiei.
Jesus Kraest, [Nyankopɔn Ba] no, ne nsɛmpa no ahyɛse.
Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia mu dɛ, Hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe ma oeedzi w’enyim kan, Obesiesie wo kwan mu;
Obi ne ndze retsea mu wɔ sar no do dɛ, Hom nsiesie Ewuradze no kwan, Hom mma n’atsempɔn ntsentsen;
John bae bonumae wɔ sar no do na ɔpaa mu kaa nnuho enuma a ɔdze kɔ bɔnfakyɛ mu no ho asɛm.
Na Judea man nyina, na Jerusalɛmfo nyina puee kɔr no hɔ kɛkaa hɔn bɔn, na onumaa hɔn wɔ Esutsen Jordan mu.
Nna John fura efupɔnkɔnhwi tam na nwoma abɔdo bɔ n’asen, na odzi mbɛbɛw na kwaa mu ewo.
Na ɔpaa mu kaa dɛ, Obi a no ho yɛ dzen kyɛn me dzi m’ekyir reba a no nsokota ho ahoma mpo mennsɛ dɛ mobɔkotow masan.
Emi dze, munumaa hom nsu mu, na ɔno, dze, obonuma hom wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu no Jesus fii Galilii Nazarɛt bae, na John numaa no wɔ Esutsen Jordan mu.
Na ntsɛmara a ofi nsu no mu reba no, ohun dɛ sor apaa ebien na Sunsum no tse dɛ ebubur risian ba no do:
na ndze bi fii sor baa dɛ, Ɔwo nye mo Dɔba a esɔ m’enyi.
Na amonmu hɔ ara na Sunsum no faa no ɔhardo kɔr sar no do.
Na odzii sar no do hɔ adaduanan, ma Satan sɔɔ no hwɛe; nna ɔnye hambowa wɔ hɔ; na abɔfo no soom no.
Na afei woyii John mae no ekyir no, Jesus baa Galilii bɛkaa Nyankopɔn ho asɛmpa no, na ɔsee dɛ,
Aber no aso na Nyankopɔn ahenman no abɛn: hom nnu homho, na hom ngye asɛmpa no ndzi.
Na ɔnenam Galilii po ho no, ohun Simon nye Simon no nua Andrew dɛ wɔrotow eboa wɔ po mu, osiandɛ wɔyɛ apofo.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom mbedzi m’ekyir na mebɛma hom ayɛ nyimpa enufo.
Na ntsɛmara wɔdaan eboa no gyaae na wobedzii n’ekyir.
Na ɔkɔr enyim kakra no, ohun James, Zebedee ne ba no, ɔnye no nua John a hɔn so wɔwɔ hɛn mu resa hɔn mboa.
Na ntsɛmara ɔfrɛɛ hɔn; na wɔdaan hɔn egya Zebedee nye apaafo no gyaa hɛn no mu, na wokedzii n’ekyir.
Na wɔkɔr Karpernaum; na ntsɛmara ahomgyeda no ɔkɛhɛɛn nhyiamudan no mu kɛkyerɛkyerɛe.
Na ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ hɔn ahobow, osiandɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ nyia ɔwɔ tum, na ɔnntse dɛ kyerɛwfo no.
Ber no ara mu no, nna nyimpa bi wɔ nhyiamudan no mu a ɔwɔ sunsum fi;
na ɔtseaa mu see dɛ, Ebɛnadze na yɛnye wo wɔ yɛ, Jesus Nazarɛtnyi? Ana ebae dɛ erebɛsɛɛ hɛn? Minyim wo nyimpa ban, Nyankopɔn no Hotseweenyi no a.
Na Jesus bɔɔ no ham dɛ, Ka w’ano to mu, na fi no mu fi!
Na sunsum fi no twaa no hwee hɔ na ɔkaa mu kɛse fii no mu firii.
Na hɔn nyina ho boow hɔn ara ma wobisabisaa hɔnho dɛ, Ebɛnadze nye yi? Nkyerɛkyerɛ fofor bɛn a! Ɔdze tum hyɛ esunsum fi mpo, na wotsie n’asɛm.
Na ntsɛmara ne nka tahyee ɔman a etwa Galilii ho nyina mu.
Na ntsɛmara wofii nhyiamudan no mu firii no wɔbaa Simon nye Andrew fie, wɔnye James nye John.
Nna Simon n’asew da hɔ yar papu; na ntsɛmara wɔkaa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no;
na Jesus kosuoo ne nsamu maa no do; na papu no fii no do, na ɔhyɛɛ ase soom hɔn.
Na ewimbir a ewia kɔtɔree no wɔdze hɔn a wɔyaryar na hɔn a mbɔnsam afa hɔn nyina brɛɛ no.
Na kurow no nyina behyiaa mu wɔ abow no ano.
Na ɔsaa dodowara a wɔwɔ nyarba horow no yarba, na otuu mbɔnsam pii; na ɔamma mbɔnsam no kwan dɛ wɔnkasa, osiandɛ wonyim no.
Na anapaatu, ansaana adze rebɛkye no, ɔsoɛree na opuei kɔr sar bi do, na ɔkɔbɔɔ mpaa wɔ hɔ.
Na Simon nye hɔn a wɔka no ho no, tsiiw no;
na wohun no na wɔsee no dɛ, Nyimpa nyina rohwehwɛ wo.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma yɛnkɔ nkurow nkaa no so mu, ama maakɛka asɛm no wɔ hɔ so, osiandɛ iyi ntsi na mebae.
Na ɔkɔr hɔn nhyiamudan a ɔwɔ Galilii nyina mu kɛkaa asɛm no, na otuu mbɔnsam.
Na kwatanyi bi baa no hɔ bɛserɛɛ no, bɔkotoow no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ epɛ a, ibotum dɛ ema mo ho san.
Na Jesus ne yamu hyehyee no maa no, na ɔtseen ne nsa dze kaa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Mepɛ, wo ho nsan wo.
Na ntsɛmara na kwata no fii no ho, ma no ho sanee.
Na Jesus braa no dzendzenndzen, na ɔmaa ofii hɔ ntsɛmara, na ɔsee no dɛ,
Hwɛ ma aannka biribi annkyerɛ obiara; na san kɔ, fa woho kɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no, na w’ahosan ntsi kotua dza Moses hyɛe no fa yɛ dase ma hɔn.
Na ɔno dze, ɔdze kɛtahyee pii, na ɔmaa asɛm no trɛe, ma dɛm ntsi Jesus enntum annkɔ kurow bi mu petee bio, mbom sar do hɔ beebi na ɔtsenae; na wofii mbea nyina baa ne nkyɛn.
Nda kakra bi ekyir no, ɔkɔr Karpernaum bio, na wɔtsee dɛ ɔwɔ fie.
Na dodowara behyiaa mu, ma nna wonnya kwan bio mma hɔn, nnyɛ abowano hɔ mpo; na ɔkaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔdze mbubuinyi a nyimpa baanan so no baa no hɔ.
Na ɔnam nyimpadodow no ntsi na wonnya kwan nntwe mmbɛn no no, wɔkɛpaa dan a ɔwɔ mu no etsifi; na wotuu mu tu na wɔdze kɛtɛ a mbubuinyi no da do no duaa mu gyaagyaa mu sii famu.
Na Jesus hun hɔn gyedzi no, ɔsee mbubuinyi no dɛ, Ɔba, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo.
Nna kyerɛwfo no binom tsetse hɔ, na wɔdwendween hɔn akoma mu dɛ,
Ɔyɛ dɛn na oyi kasa dɛm yi? Ebususɛm na ɔka: woana botum dze bɔn akyɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn nkotsee?
Na ntsɛmara Jesus hun wɔ no sunsum mu dɛ wɔrodwendwen dɛm wɔ hɔn akoma mu no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rodwendwen dɛm wɔ hom akoma mu yi?
Dza ɔwɔ hen na ɔyɛ mberɛw kɛse, dɛ ebɛse mbubuinyi no dɛ, Wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo, anaa ebɛse dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo kɛtɛ, na nantsew, a?
Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma hom ehu dɛ nyimpa Ba no wɔ tum wɔ asaase do dɛ ɔdze bɔn kyɛ ntsi, ɔsee mbubuinyi no dɛ,
Mese wo dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo kɛtɛ na kɔ wo fie.
Na ɔsoɛree, na ntsɛmara ɔfaa kɛtɛ no, na osii mu wɔ hɔn nyina enyim kɔree. Na ɔmaa hɔn nyina ho boow hɔn, na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam dɛ, Yennhun dɛm adze yi bi da.
Na opuee bio kɔr mpoano; na nyimpadodow no nyina kɔr no hɔ, na ɔhyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na ɔresen no ohun Alfaeus ne ba Levi dɛ ɔtse atowgyebea, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ka mo do. Na ɔsoɛree kaa no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔtse edzidzi wɔ ne fie no; atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo pii nye Jesus na n’esuafo bɛtsenatsenaa hɔ: nna hɔn a wɔka no do no dɔɔ so.
Na akyerɛwfo a wofi Farisiifo no mu no hun dɛ ɔnye ndzebɔnyɛfo nye atowgyefo ridzidzi no, wobisaa n’esuafo no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔnye atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo dzidzi nom yi?
Na Jesus tsee no ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hɔn a wɔtse apɔw no, wonnhia oduyɛfo, na mbom hɔn a wɔyar no a: mammbɛfrɛ atseneneefo, na mbom ndzebɔnyɛfo a.
Nna John n’esuafo nye Farisiifo no ridzi mbuada: na binom bae bebisaa no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na John n’esuafo nye Farisiifo hɔn esuafo no wodzi mbuada, na w’esuafo dze, wonndzi mbuada yi?
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ayeforpia mu mba no, aber a ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn no, aso wobotum edzi mbuada anaa? Aber tsentsen biara a wɔwɔ ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn no, worunntum nndzi mbuada.
Na nda bɛba a wobeyi ayeforkun no efi hɔn nkyɛn, na da no mu nkyii wobedzi mbuada.
Obi mmfa tam fofor sin nntaa atar dadaw mu: dɛm no, dza wɔdze taa mu no yi fi mu, fofor no fi dadaw no mu, na ntsewee no yɛ kɛse.
Na obi mmfa wenyin fofor nngu nwomantoa dadaw mu; dɛm no, wenyin no bɛpaa nwomantoa no, na wenyin no asɛɛ, ɔnye nwomantoa no so: na wenyin fofor dze, wɔdze gu nwomantoa fofor mu.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus kɛfaa eburow kwa mu ahomgyeda bi; na n’esuafo no nam rokɔ no, wɔhyɛɛ ase pempaan eburow mbɛtsem no bi.
Na Farisiifo no see no dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔreyɛ dza ɔmmfa mbra mu wɔ ahomgyeda mu yi?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan dza David yɛe wɔ aber a ohiaa no, na ɔkɔm dzee ɔnoara na hɔn a wɔka no ho no, pɛn anaa?
Mbrɛ ɔkɛhɛɛn Nyankopɔn ne fie, aber a Abiathar yɛ ɔsɔfopanyin no, na okedzii kyerɛpaanoo a ɔmmfa mbra mu dɛ obiara dzi, gyedɛ asɔfo no nko, na ɔmaa hɔn a wɔka no ho no so bi no?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nyimpa ntsi na wɔyɛɛ ahomgyeda, na nnyɛ ahomgyeda ntsi na wɔyɛɛ nyimpa:
dɛm ntsi nyimpa Ba no yɛ ahomgyeda no so mpo no wura.
Na ɔkɛhɛɛn nhyiamudan no mu bio; na nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ne nsa adwedwe.
Na wɔtsɛɛw no hwɛɛ dɛ ɔbɛyɛ no edur ahomgyeda no, ama wɔaatoa no.
Na ɔsee nyimpa no a ne nsa adwedwe no dɛ, Soɛr gyina finimfin.
Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ ahomgyeda wɔbɛyɛ dza oye, anaa wɔbɛyɛ dza omuo? Wɔbɛgye nkwa, anaa woboku a?
Na womuaa hɔn ano. Na ɔhwɛɛ hɔn hyiae ebufuw do, na hɔn akoma dzen ntsi ɔyɛɛ no yaw no, ɔsee nyimpa no dɛ, Tsen wo nsa. Na ɔtsenee; na ne nsa no sanee dzii mu.
Na Farisiifo no puei, na ntsɛmara wɔnye Herod akadofo kɛfaa apam wɔ mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ asɛɛ no ho.
Na Jesus nye n’esuafo no twee hɔnho kɔr mpoano; na nyimpadodow pii fii Galilii kaa no do;
na wofi Judea, Jerusalɛm, Idumea, na Jordan egya, na Taere nye Sidon nkyɛn, nyimpadodow pii a wɔtsee ndzɛmba akɛse pii a ɔyɛe no, na wɔbaa ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ n’esuafo no dɛ wɔnyɛ hɛn kakraba bi krado ntweɔn no wɔ nyimpadodow no ntsi, amma wɔaannkyer no do;
ɔnam dɛ ɔsaa pii yarba ntsi, dodowara a mbusu horow aba hɔn do no bɛkyeer no do dɛ worubosusuo no mu.
Na esunsum fi so, sɛ wohu no a, wotwa hwe n’enyim, na wɔka mu dɛ, Ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn Ba no.
Na Jesus braa hɔn ketsee dɛ mma wonnyi no nnkyerɛ.
Na ɔkɔr koko do, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn a noara rohwehwɛ hɔn no, na wɔkɔr ne nkyɛn.
Na oyii duebien, dɛ wɔnye no bɛtsena,
na dɛ ɔbɔsoma hɔn ama wɔaakɛka asɛm no na woeenya tum dze etu mbɔnsam.
Na Simon ɔtoo no dzin Peter,
na Zebedee ba James, nye James no nua John; na ɔtoo hɔn dzin Boanerges, ɔno nye dɛ Senaman Mba;
nye Andrew, nye Filip, nye Bartholomew, nye Matthew, nye Tomas, nye Alfaeus ba James, nye Tadeus,
nye Keenannyi Simon, nye Judas Iskariot a ɔno na oyii no mae no.
Na ɔbaa fie; na nyimpadodow no behyiaa bio, ma dɛm ntsi woenntum enndzidzi mpo.
Na n’ebusuafo no tsee no, wofiir edzi dɛ wɔrobɔtwe no akɔ, osiandɛ nna binom reka dɛ, N’adwen mu aka.
Na kyerɛwfo no a wofi Jerusalɛm bae no see dɛ, Ɔwɔ Beelzebul, na mbɔnsam hɔn panyin do na ɔnam tu mbɔnsam no.
Na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn baa ne nkyɛn no, obubuu mbɛ see hɔn dɛ, Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na Satan botum etu Satan?
Na sɛ ahenman nye no ho dzi mpaapaamu a, ahenman no nntum nngyina.
Na sɛ ofi nye no ho dzi mpaapaamu a, ofi no runntum nngyina.
Na sɛ Satan asoɛr nankasa no do na oedzi mpaapaamu a, onnkotum egyina, nna n’ewiei edu.
Na obi nntum nnkɔ ɔkatakyi bi ne fie nnkotu nhyɛ n’efidze do mfom mfa, gyedɛ odzi kan kyekyer ɔkatakyi no, ansaana ɔafom ne fie.
Mereka akyerɛ hom pefee dɛ, Bɔn nyina wɔdze bɛkyɛ nyimpa mba, nye ebususɛm a wɔbɛka nyina;
naaso nyia ɔbɛka ebususɛm etsia Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no dze, orinnya fakyɛ da, na onnyiewiei afɔdzi da no do:
osiandɛ wɔsee dɛ, Ɔwɔ sunsum fi.
Na ne na nye no nuanom bae begyinaa abow no enyim somae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ no.
Nna nyimpadodow tsetse ne nkyɛn, na wɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, wo na nye wo nuanom gyina abow enyim rohwehwɛ wo.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Woana nye me na nye mo nuanom?
Na ɔtoo n’enyi hwɛɛ hɔn a wɔtsetse ne nkyɛn hyiae no, ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, me na nye mo nuanom.
Na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ne pɛ no, ɔno nye mo nua, nye m’akyerɛbaa, nye me na.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ase bio kyerɛkyerɛe wɔ mpoano. Na nyimpadodow pii behyiaa ne nkyɛn, ma dɛm ntsi ɔkɔr hɛn mu kɛtsenaa ase wɔ po enyi, nna nyimpadodow no nyina wɔ mpoano wɔ daadze.
Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn ndzɛmba pii wɔ abɛbu mu, na ɔsee hɔn wɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dɛ,
Hom ntsie: hwɛ, oduafo no kɔree koguu aba;
na orugu no, ɔbaa dɛ bi koguu kwan nkyɛn na nnoma bae bɔsosɔwee.
Na bi koguu abosamdo mbrɛ oennya dɛtse pii; na ntsɛmara na ofirii, osiandɛ oennya dɛtse a no mu dɔ;
na ewia puei no, ɔhyewee, na osiandɛ onnyi ndwow ntsi ɔkyenkyenee.
Na bi so koguu nsoɛ mu, na nsoɛ no nyinii, na omiaa no, ma ɔannsow aba.
Na bi so koguu asaase pa mu, na ɔsoow aba a onyinii na ɔdɔɔ so; na ɔsoow bi eduasa, bi eduosia, bi ɔha.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyia ɔwɔ aso a wɔdze tsie no, ma ontsie.
Na ɔkaa no nko no, hɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no wɔnye duebien no bisaa no mbɛ no ase.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom na wɔdze Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu esumasɛm ama hom; na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir no dze, wɔkyerɛ hɔn ne nyina mbɛbu mu,
ama wɔhwɛ a, wɔaahwɛ ara a wonnkohu mu, na wɔtse a wɔaatse, naaso wɔnnkɛtse ase, amma wɔaannsakyer na wɔaammfa hɔn bɔn annkyɛ hɔn.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nnyim bɛ yi? Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na hom ehu mbɛ nyina ase?
Oduafo no gu asɛm no.
Na iyinom nye hɔn a wɔwɔ kwan nkyɛn no, wɔ mbrɛ wogu asɛm no; na wɔatse no, Satan ba ntsɛmara beyi asɛm no a wogui wɔ hɔn mu no.
Na iyinom so nye hɔn a wogu hɔn abosam do no; hɔn a wɔtse asɛm no a, ntsɛmara wɔdze dɛw gye;
naaso wonnyi ndwow wɔ hɔn mu, na wɔwɔ hɔ ber tsiaa bi ntsi, sɛ abɛbrɛsɛ anaa ahohia soɛr wɔ asɛm no ntsi a, ntsɛmara na ato hɔn fintsidua.
Iyinom nye hɔn a wogu hɔn nsoɛ mu no, hɔn a wɔatse asɛm no,
na wiadze yi mu akɔdadwen nye ahonya ndaadaa nye ndzɛmba nkaa no ho akɔndɔ kɔ hɔn mu, na omia asɛm no, ma ntsi ɔnnsow aba.
Na iyinom nye hɔn a wogu hɔn asaase pa mu no, hɔn a wɔtse asɛm no na wɔgye na wɔsow aba, bi eduasa, bi eduosia, na bi so ɔha.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana wɔdze kandzea ba dɛ wɔdze besi kuruw ase anaa mpa ase? Nnyɛ dɛ wɔdze besi kandzeadua do bi?
Na biribi nnsuma gyedɛ woribeyi akyerɛ, na woennhuntsa biribi gyedɛ ɔrebɛda gua.
Sɛ obi wɔ aso a wɔdze tsie a, ma ontsie.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ dza hom tse no yie: esusudze kor a hom dze susu no, wɔdze bosusu ama hom, na wɔdze bi bɛka hom ho.
Na nyia ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no, na nyia onnyi no, dza ɔwɔ no mpo wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman tse nye yi, dɛ nyimpa bogu aba wɔ famu;
na ɔbɛda na obenyan adzesaa nye adzekyee, na aba no befifir na oenyin, na onnyim mbrɛ ɔyɛe.
Na asaase nankasa na ɔsow aba, ahaban no dzi kan, na nkyii ɔayɛ bɛtsem, na nkyii ɔayɛ eburow wɔ bɛtsem no mu.
Na sɛ aba no ber a, ntsɛmara na ɔdze kantankrankye ato mu, osiandɛ twaber edu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze na yɛdze bɔto Nyankopɔn ahenman ho? Anaadɛ ebɛn bɛ na yɛdze bɛkyerɛ?
Ɔtse dɛ sinape abafua a wodua no famu a osuar kyɛn aba a ɔwɔ asaase do nyina;
naaso sɛ wodua a, onyin yɛ kɛse kyɛn nhaban nyina, na ɔtoto abaw akɛse, ma wimu nnoma tum yɛ hɔn mberɛbuw wɔ no nwin mu.
Na mbɛ a ɔtsetse dɛm yi pii na ɔdze kaa asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ wobotum etsie.
Na ɔannkasa annkyerɛ hɔn a ɔannka no abɛbu mu, na ɔka hɔn nko a, ɔkyerɛ n’esuafo no ndzɛmba nyina ase.
Dɛm da no ara, odur ewimbir no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma yentwa nkɔ esuegya noho.
Na wogyaa nyimpadodow no kwan no, wɔkɔr hɛmba a Jesus wɔ mu no mu. Nna ahɛn nkakraba bi so ka ho.
Na mframa kɛse bɔɔ huu, na asorɛkye bui bɔhwee hɛn no mu, ma nna ɔreyɛ ayɛ ma.
Nna Jesus dze, ɔwɔ hɛntu ada wɔ sundze do; na wonyaan no na wɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔnnyɛ wo asɛm dɛ yɛremem?
Na onyanee no, ɔbraa mframa no, na ɔsee po no dɛ, Taa dzinn! Na mframa no dwee, na ɔyɛɛ dzinn koraa.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom yɛ ehufo dɛm yi? Ana hom da ho nnyi gyedzi?
Na wosuroo pii, na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Woana nye yi a mframa na po mpo wotsie n’asɛm yi?
Na wɔbaa po no n’egya wɔ Gerasafo asaase do.
Na ofii hɛn no mu no, ntsɛmara na nyimpa bi a ɔwɔ sunsum fi fiir abodan mu wɔ esiei behyiaa no:
ɔno na ɔdze abodan mu ayɛ ne tsenabew; na obiara nntum mmfa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mpo nnkyekyer no bio,
mber pii na wɔdze mpokyerɛ nye nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn akyekyer no, na ɔatsetsew nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no mu, ebubu mpokyerɛ no mu, na obiara nnyi ahoɔdzen dɛ ɔbɔdwedwe no.
Na dabaa adzekyee nye adzesaa nyina nna ɔwɔ abodan mu nye nkokwaa do, ɔretseatsea mu, na ɔdze abo rutwitwa noho.
Na ohun Jesus wɔ ekyirekyir no, otutuu mbirika kɔkotoow no;
na ɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu see dɛ, Menye wo wɔ ebɛn yɛ, Jesus, Ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn Ba? Meka Nyankopɔn dɛ mma nnhaw me!
Osiandɛ nna Jesus ase no dɛ, Sunsum fi, fi nyimpa no mu!
Na Jesus bisaa no dɛ, Wo dzin dze dɛn? Na ɔsee no dɛ, Me dzin dze Legyin, osiandɛ yɛdɔɔ so.
Na ɔserɛɛ no pii dɛ mma ɔmmpam hɔn mmfi asaase no do.
Nna mprekokuw kɛse bi wɔ kokwaa ne nkyɛn a woridzidzi.
Na wɔserɛɛ no see dɛ, Soma hɛn mpreko no mu, ma yɛnkɔ hɔn mu.
Na ɔmaa hɔn kwan. Na esunsum fi no fiir edzi kɛhɛɛn mpreko no mu, na okuw no nyina faa twitwi kesiaan ɔbo kronn no koguguu po no mu, wɔbɛyɛ mpemebien, na wɔtseetsee wui wɔ po no mu.
Na hɔn a wɔrenyɛn mpreko no guanee na wɔkɛkae wɔ kurow no mu na no nkwaado. Na wopuei bɔhwɛɛ adze kor a aba no.
Na wɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn no, wobohun nyia mbɔnsam faa no no dɛ ɔtse hɔ hyɛ atar, na n’adwen mu atsew no, mekyerɛ nyia a onyaa Legyin no a; na wosuroi.
Na hɔn a wohunii no kaa mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ nyia mbɔnsam faa no nye mpreko no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn.
Na wɔhyɛɛ ase serɛɛ Jesus dɛ omfi hɔn apaamu hɔ nkɔ.
Na ɔrokɔ hɛn no mu no, nyimpa a nkan no mbɔnsam faa no no serɛɛ no dɛ ɔnye no bɛtsena.
Naaso Jesus amma no kwan, na ɔsee no dɛ, Kɔ wo fie wɔ w’ebusuafo nkyɛn kɛka ndzɛmba akɛse a Ewuradze ayɛ ama wo, na mbrɛ oesi ehu wo mbɔbɔr no.
Na osii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛhyɛɛ ase kaa ndzɛmba akɛse a Jesus yɛe maa no no wɔ Dekapolis, na ɔyɛɛ nyimpa nyina nwanwa.
Na Jesus nam hɛn no mu twae baa esuegya bio no, nyimpadodow pii behyiaa no ho: nna ɔwɔ mpoano.
Na nhyiamudan mu mpanyimfo no mu baako a ne dzin dze Jairus bae; na ohun no no, ɔhwee n’ananadze,
na ɔserɛɛ no pii dɛ, Me babaa kakraba ruwu: meserɛ wo, bra bɛfa wo nsa to no do, ma no ho nyɛ no dzen na onnya nkwa.
Na ɔnye no kɔree, na nyimpadodow pii kaa no do, na wɔkyeer no do.
Na ɔbaa bi a oenya bɔgyaagu mfe duebien,
na oehu amandze pii wɔ eduyɛfo pii nsa, na ɔahwer dza ɔwɔ nyina, na ɔnnyɛ yie biara, na mbom sor araa na yarba no kɔ no,
tsee Jesus ne nka no, obedzii n’ekyir nyimpadodow no mu dze ne nsa bɛkaa n’atar;
osiandɛ ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ meka n’atar nko mpo a, mo ho bɛyɛ me dzen.
Na ntsɛmara no bɔgya bura wewee, na ɔtsee wɔ no honam mu dɛ woeyi no mbusu no kɔ.
Na ntsɛmara Jesus hun wɔ no mu dɛ ahoɔdzen a ɔwɔ no mu no bi efi mu no, ɔdaan noho wɔ nyimpadodow no mu see dɛ, Woana dze ne nsa kaa m’atar?
Na n’esuafo no see no dɛ, Ehu dɛ nyimpadodow no akyer wo do, na afei iribisa dɛ, Woana dze ne nsa kaa me yi ɛ?
Na ɔtoo n’enyi aprɔw dɛ obohu nyia ɔyɛɛ dɛm adze no.
Na ɔbaa no, onyim dza wɔayɛ wɔ no mu no, dze suro nye ahopopo bae botwae hwee n’enyim na ɔkaa nokwar no nyina kyerɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Babaa, wo gyedzi agye wo: kɔ asomdwee mu, na wo ho nyɛ wo dzen mfi wo mbusu mu.
Na Jesus da ho rekasa no, binom fi nhyiamudan mu panyin no ne fie bae bɛsee dɛ, Wo babaa no ewu: eda ho ara rehaw Kyerɛkyerɛfo no ayɛ dɛn?
Na Jesus tsee asɛm a wɔreka no, ɔsee nhyiamudan mu panyin no dɛ, Mma nnsuro, na gye dzi ara.
Na ɔamma obiara kwan ma oeenndzi n’ekyir, gyedɛ Peter nye James nye John, James no nua no.
Na wɔbaa nhyiamudan mu panyin no ne fie; na Jesus hun dɛ hɔ ayɛ gyigyeegye, na nkorɔfo rusu na wɔreka mmɔn.
Ɔkɛhɛɛn hɔ no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ dede na hom rusu yi? Abofra no nnwui, na ɔada.
Na hɔn dze, wɔsereew no twee. Na Jesus yii hɔn nyina edzi no, ɔfaa abofraba no n’egya nye ne na na ɔnye hɔn a wɔka no ho no kɔr mbrɛ abofraba no wɔ.
Na osuoo abofraba no ne nsamu, na ɔsee dɛ, Talita, kumi: ne nkyerɛase nye dɛ, Akataasia, mese wo dɛ, Nyan.
Na ntsɛmara na akataasia no soɛree na ɔnantsewee: (nna oedzi mfe duebien.) Na ntsɛmara hɔn ho boow hɔn kɛse.
Na ɔbraa hɔn ketsee dɛ mma wɔnnka ma obiara nntse, na ɔsee dɛ wɔmma abofra no biribi ma ondzi.
Na Jesus fii hɔ kɔree, na ɔbaa nankasa no kurow mu, na n’esuafo no dzii n’ekyir.

Na ahomgyeda no durii no, ɔhyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛe wɔ nhyiamudan no mu, na nyimpadodow no tsiee no no, hɔn ho boow hɔn dɛ, Henfa na oyi nyaa dɛm ndzeyɛɛ yi? Ebɛn nyansa nye dza wɔdze ama no yi, na ebɛn tum ndwuma nye dza ɔdze ne nsa ayɛ yi?
Ana nnyɛ odwimfo no a ɔyɛ Mary ne ba no, James nye Judas nye Simon hɔn nua no nye yi bi? Ana nnyɛ ne nkyerɛbaa na wɔwɔ hɛn nkyɛn ha yi? Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn fintsidua.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Enyidzi mmbɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi gyedɛ nankasa no kurow mu, nye n’ebusuafo mu, nye nankasa ne fie.
Na oenntum annyɛ tum edwuma biara wɔ hɔ, gyedɛ ayarfo kumaabi a ɔdze ne nsa too hɔn do yɛɛ hɔn edur.
Na gyedzi a wonnyi yɛɛ no nwanwa. Nna okekyiin nkurobaase kyerɛkyerɛe.
Na ɔfrɛɛ duebien no, na ɔhyɛɛ ase somaa hɔn beenu beenu, na ɔmaa hɔn tum wɔ esunsum fi do;
na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mma wɔmmfa biribiara nntu kwan, gyedɛ poma nko: mma wɔmmfa edziban anaa kotoku, anaa sika wɔ hɔn abɔdo mu;
na wɔnhyɛ mpaboa, na mma wɔnnhyɛ ntar ebien.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Beebiara mbrɛ hom bɛhɛn fi biara mu no, hom ntsena hɔ nkodu dɛ hom befi hɔ akɔ.
Na kurow biara a ɔnnkɛgye hom no, na wonnketsie hom wɔ mu no, hom fi hɔ rokɔ a, hom mporoporow hom ananadze huntuma ngye dase ntsia hɔn.
Na wɔkɔree kɛpae mu kaa dɛ wonnu hɔnho.
Na wotuu mbɔnsam pii na wɔdze ngo seraa ayarfo pii saa hɔn yarba.
Na Ɔhen Herod tsee, osiandɛ Jesus ne dzin tahyee: na ɔsee dɛ, John Onumanyi no enyan efi ewufo mu: dɛm ntsi na tum ndzɛmba yi reyɛ no mu edwuma no.
Na binom see dɛ, Elija a; na binom so see dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi a, tse dɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no mu baako.
Na Herod tsee no, ɔsee dɛ, John a mutwaa ne tsir no enyan bio.
Nna Herod nankasa asoma ma woekosuo John mu akyer no akɔto efiadze, wɔ no nua Filip yer Herodias ntsi: osiandɛ nna Herod awar no.
Na John see Herod dɛ, Ɔmmfa mbra mu mma wo dɛ ebɔwar wo nua ne yer.
Na Herodias kyekyeer no hyɛɛ ne yamu, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ oku no, naaso oenntum:
osiandɛ Herod suroo John, nna onyim dɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa tsenenee nye krɔnkrɔn ntsi, ɔbɔɔ no ho ban. Sɛ oritsie no a, no ho hyehye no dodow, naaso ɔdze dɛw tsiee no.
Na da bi a Herod ridzi n’awoda no, ɔtoo pon maa n’ekunyin nye n’asafohen nye Galilii mpanyimfo;
na Herodias ne babaa bae bɛsawee ma ɔsɔɔ Herod nye hɔn a wɔtse edzidzi no enyiwa: na ɔhen no see akataasia no dɛ, Bisa me biribiara a epɛ, na medze bɛma wo.
Na ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Biribiara a ibebisa me no, medze bɛma wo dze ekesi m’ahenman ne fa.
Na ɔkɔree kɛsee ne na dɛ, Mimbisa ebɛnadze? Na ne na see dɛ, John Onumanyi no ne tsir.
Na ntsɛmara ɔyɛɛ har baa ɔhen ne nkyɛn, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Mepɛ dɛ edze John Onumanyi no ne tsir to prɛtse mu ma me seseiara.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no yaw dodoodow, na osian ne ntam nye hɔn a wɔnye no tse edzidzi no ntsi, ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔbɛka oho akyerɛ no.
Na ntsɛmara ɔhen no somaa ɔbrafo hyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnkɛfa tsir no mbra; na ɔkɔree kotwaa John ne tsir wɔ efiadze,
na ɔdze ne tsir no too prɛtse mu bae, na ɔdze maa akataasia no, na akataasia no dze kɛmaa ne na.
Na n’esuafo no tsee no, wɔbae bɛfaa no fun na wɔdze kɔtoo nda bi mu.
Na asomafo no boaa hɔn ano baa Jesus nkyɛn na wɔbɛkaa dza wɔayɛ nye dza wɔakyerɛkyerɛ nyina kyerɛɛ no.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Homankasa hom mbra sar do nkyɛn beebi, na hom mbɔhom kakra. Osiandɛ nna dodowara reba rokɔ ma wonnya adagyer nndzidzi mpo.
Na wosii mu nam hɛn mu kɔr sar do beebi.
Na nyimpa pii hun dɛ worisi mu, na wonyim hɔn no, wofi nkurow nyina mu tutuu mbirika nam daadze kɔr hɔ, na wotwaar hɔn ano.
Na ɔbaa daadze no, ohun nyimpadodow pii na ne yamu hyehyee no maa hɔn osiandɛ wɔtse dɛ nguan a wonnyi ɔhwɛfo; na ɔhyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn ndzɛmba pii.
Na adze rebɛsa no, n’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, Ha yɛ sar do, na adze so resa;
gyaa hɔn ma wɔnkɔ nkuroba nye nkuraase a etwa ehyia yi mu nkɔtɔ biribi ndzi.
Na Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Homara hom mma hɔn biribi ma wondzi. Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ana yɛnkɔtɔ paanoo sika denare ahaenu mfa mma hɔn ma wondzi?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom wɔ paanoo ahen? Hom nkɔhwɛ. Na wɔkɔhwɛe no wɔsee dɛ, Enum, nye esunam ebien.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔmma hɔn nyinara ntsenatsena ekuw ekuw wɔ efuw momon no do.
Na wɔtsenatsenaa akyerɛpɛn akyerɛpɛn, ɔha, ɔha, nye eduonum, eduonum.
Na ɔfaa paanoo enum no, nye esunam ebien no, na ɔhwɛɛ sor no, ohyiraa do, na obubuu paanoo no, na ɔdze maa n’esuafo no dɛ wɔmfa ntoto hɔn enyim; na ɔkyɛɛ esunam ebien no mu maa hɔn nyinara.
Na hɔn nyina dzidzii na wɔmee.
Na wɔtasee mporoporoba nkɛntsɛn duebien nye esunam no so bi.
Na hɔn a wodzii paanoo no, wɔyɛ mbarimba mpemenum.
Na ntsɛmara opiapiaa n’esuafo no dɛ wɔnkɔ hɛn mu na wondzi n’enyim kan wɔ esuegya noho wɔ Bɛtsaeda, ma ɔno nhwɛ, ngya nyimpadodow no kwan.
Na ɔkraa hɔn no, osii mu kɔr kokwaa do kɔsɔree.
Na odur anafua no, nna hɛn no wɔ po finimfin, na no nko wɔ daadze.
Na ohun dɛ wɔrofona akwan, osiandɛ mframa esi hɔn enyim no, bɛyɛ anafua dasu a otsia anan no mu no ɔnantseew po enyi baa hɔn nkyɛn, na ɔyɛɛ dɛ ɔrepɛ apa hɔn ho;
na hɔn dze, wohun dɛ ɔrenantsew po enyi no, wɔdween dɛ saman a, na wɔkekaa mu,
osiandɛ hɔn nyina hun no ma hɔn akoma tui. Na ntsɛmara ɔnye hɔn kasae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhyɛ dzen: mara a, mma hom nnsuro.
Na ɔkɔr hɔn nkyɛn wɔ hɛn no mu, na mframa no gyaae. Na hɔn ho boow hɔn dodoodow koraa,
osiandɛ wɔanntse paanoo no ho asɛm no ase, nna hɔn akoma epirim.
Na wotwae no, wɔbaa Genesaret asaase do na wodwirii.
Na wofii hɛn mu no, ntsɛmara na wohun no,
na wotutuu mbirika kekyiin asaase nyina mu, na wɔhyɛɛ ase soaa hɔn a wɔyar wɔ nkɛtɛ do baa beebiara a wɔtsee dɛ ɔwɔ no.

Na beebiara a ɔkɔree, nkurobaase anaa nkurow anaa nkuroba mu o, wɔdze ayarfo totoo gua do, na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmma wɔmfa hɔn nsa nka n’atar ano ndwow nko kɛkɛ; na dodow a wɔkaa no no, hɔn ho yɛɛ hɔn dzen.
Na Farisiifo no nye kyerɛwfo bi a wofi Jerusalɛm bae behyiaa ne nkyɛn,
na wohun dɛ n’esuafo no bi dze nsa a ho nntsew, ɔno nye dɛ nsa a wɔannhohor ho, ridzidzi.
(Na Farisiifo no nye Jewfo nyina, sɛ wɔannhohor hɔn nsa ho yie a, wonndzidzi, na wokitsa mpanyimfo atsetsesɛm no mu;
na sɛ wofi gua do ba, na wɔannhohor hɔnho a, wonndzidzi, na ndzɛmba pii ka ho a wɔagye dɛ wobosuo mu, nkɔɔpow nye nhina nye nyewasɛn ho hohor.)
Na Farisiifo no nye kyerɛwfo no bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na w’esuafo nnantsew mpanyimfo atsetsesɛm no do, na wɔdze nsa a ho nntsew dzidzi yi?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Isaia hyɛɛ hom ndabrabafo ho nkɔm yie dɛ (dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no), Ɔman yi dze hɔn anofamfa dzi me nyi, Na hɔn akoma dze, ɔnye me ntamu twe kɛse;
Na wɔsɔr me gyan, Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɔyɛ nyimpa ahyɛdze.
Hom egya Nyankopɔn ne mbra hɔ: na hom esuo nyimpa atsetsesɛm mu.
