Na ɔkɔr do see hɔn dɛ, Hom pow Nyankopɔn ne mbra no papaara pi, ama hom eedzi hom atsetsesɛm do.
Na Moses kaa dɛ, Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi, na, Obiara a ɔhyɛ egya anaa na ahorba no, owu na onwu;
naaso hom dze, hom se dɛ, Sɛ nyimpa bi se n’egya anaa ne na dɛ, biribiara a nkyɛ edze benya mo ho mfaso no yɛ Korban (ɔnye dɛ, Akyɛdze a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn dze) a,
ɔno hom mma no kwan dɛ mma ɔnnyɛ biribi mma n’egya anaa ne na bio:
ɔnam hom atsetsesɛm a hom dze bae no do, hom amma Nyankopɔn asɛm enntsim; na ndzɛmba a ɔtse dɛm pii na hom yɛ.
Na ɔfrɛɛ nyimpadodow no baa ne nkyɛn bio no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nyina ntsie me na hom ntse ase:
biribiara nnyi nyimpa ho a ɔkɔ no mu a obotum egu no ho fi; na dza ofi nyimpa mu ba no, ɔno na ogu nyimpa ho fi.
Sɛ obiara wɔ aso a wɔdze tsie a, wɔmma ontsie.
Na ofii nyimpadodow no nkyɛn kɔr fie no, n’esuafo no bisaa no bɛ no ase.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom so nnyi ntseasee dɛm? Ana hom nnhu dɛ biribiara a ofi nyimpa ho kɔ no mu no, onntum nngu no ho fi,
osiandɛ ɔnnkɔ n’akoma mu, na mbom ɔkɔ yafun mu, na okeyi gu egyanan mu. [Ɔkaa yi dze tseew edziban nyina ho.]
Na ɔsee dɛ, Dza ofi nyimpa no mu ba no, ɔno na ogu ho fi.
Na nyimpa akoma mu, na adwembɔn fi ba, ndwamanyɛ,
adzewia, ewudzi, ayefasɛm, enyiber, emumuyɛ, nsisi, atantanbra, enyibɔn, ebususɛm, ntsɛn, nkwaseasɛm:
ndzebɔn yinom nyina fi mu na ɔba na ogu nyimpa ho fi.
Na ɔsoɛree fii hɔ kɔr Taere nye Sidon ntoaado. Na ɔkɔr fi bi mu, na ɔammpɛ dɛ obiara tse, naaso oenntum ennsuma.
Na ntsɛmara ɔbaa bi a ne babaa kakraba wɔ sunsum fi tsee ne nka no, ɔbae bɔhwee n’ananadze.
Na ɔbaa no yɛ Griiknyi, na n’awoo mu ɔyɛ Sirofonisianyi; na ɔserɛɛ no dɛ ontu sunsum fi no mfi ne babaa no mu.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ma mba no mmee ansaana, na ɔnnsɛ dɛ wɔfa mba edziban tow ma mbɔdɔm.
Na obuae see no dɛ, Mo wura, ɔyɛ nokwar dze; naaso pon ase mbɔdɔm no, wodzi mba hɔn mporoporoba no bi.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Asɛm a aka yi ntsi kɔ: sunsum fi no efi wo babaa no mu.
Na osii mu kɔr ne fie no, ohun dɛ abofraba no da mpa do, na sunsum fi no efi no mu kɔ.
Na ofii Taere ntoaado bio koduaa Sidon mu dze faa Dekapolis ntoaado ne finimfin baa Galilii po ho.
Na wɔdze otsitsifo a ɔpo dodow brɛɛ no, na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nto no do.
Na ɔdze no fii nyimpadodow no mu kɔr nkyɛn na ɔdze ne nsatseaba hyɛɛ n’asowa mu, na ɔtoo ntafi dze kaa ne tɛkyerɛma,
na ɔhwɛɛ sor sii nkrum see no dɛ, Efaata, ase nye dɛ, Bue.
Na n’aso buebuei na ne tɛkyerɛma ase ahoma sanee, na ɔkasaa yie.
Na ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnka nnkyerɛ obiara; na mpɛn dodow a ɔbraa hɔn no, mpɛn dodow a wɔdze tahyee kɛse nye no.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn ahobow mbordo, na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔayɛ ndzɛmba nyina yie: ɔma tsitsifo tse asɛm na ɔma mmum kasa.
Dɛm mber no mu no, ɔbaa dɛ nyimpadodow no dɔɔ so bio na wonnyi biribi a wodzi no, Jesus frɛɛ n’esuafo no see hɔn dɛ,
Me yamu hyehye me ma nyimpadodow yi, osiandɛ wɔatsena me nkyɛn ndaansa yi na wonnyi biribi a woridzi;
sɛ migya hɔn kwan ma wɔdze kɔm kɔ fie a, wɔbɔtotɔ bitsi wɔ kwan mu, osiandɛ hɔn mu binom fi ekyirekyir bae.
Na n’esuafo no buaa no dɛ, Henfa na nyimpa benya paanoo a ɔdze bɛmee yinom wɔ sar yi do ha?
Na Jesus bisaa hɔn dɛ, Paanoo ahen na hom wɔ? Na wɔsee dɛ, Esuon.
Na ɔhyɛɛ nyimpadodow no dɛ wɔntsena famu, na ɔfaa paanoo esuon no, na ɔdaa ase no, obubui, na ɔdze maa n’esuafo no dɛ wɔmfa ntoto hɔn enyim; na wɔdze totoo nyimpadodow no enyim.
Nna wɔwɔ esunam kakraba bi, na ohyiraa do na ɔkaa dɛ wɔmfa no so ntoto hɔn enyim.
Na wodzidzii mee, na wɔtasee mporoporoba a ɔkae no nkɛntsɛn esuon.
Nna nyimpa no bɛyɛ mpemanan. Na Jesus gyaa hɔn kwan.
Na ntsɛmara ɔnye n’esuafo no kɔr hɛn mu na ɔbaa Dalmanuta afamu.
Na Farisiifo no bae, na wɔhyɛɛ ase nye no yiyii nsɛm ano, hwehwɛɛ asɛnkyerɛdze bi a ofi sor, dze sɔɔ no hwɛe.
Na osii nkrum kɛse wɔ no sunsum mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na ɔsantsen yi rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze yi? Mereka no nokwar mu kyerɛ hom dɛ, Wɔremmfa asɛnkyerɛdze biara mma ɔsantsen yi.
Na ogyaa hɔn hɔ, na ɔtsenaa hɛn mu bio kɔr esuegya noho.
Na hɔn werɛ fiir dɛ wɔbɛfa paanoo, nna wonnyi biribi wɔ hɛn no mu wɔ hɔn nkyɛn dɛ paanoo kor pɛ.
Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ Farisiifo mbɔrkaw nye Herod no mbɔrkaw ho.
Na wosusui sesee hɔnho dɛ, Gyama yennyi paanoo ntsi a.
Na Jesus hunii no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom susu dɛ osiandɛ hom nnyi paanoo ntsi a? Ana hom nnyae nnhunii, eso hom nntse ase? Hom akoma epirim anaa?
Ana hom wɔ enyiwa naaso hom nnhu adze? Na hom wɔ aso na hom nntse? Ana hom nnkaa?
Mububuu paanoo enum maa mpemenum no, mporoporoba nkɛntsɛnma ahen na hom tasee? Nna wɔsee no dɛ, Duebien.
Na esuon no so a memaa mpemanan no, mporoporoba mbirefi ma ahen na hom tasee? Na wɔsee dɛ, Esuon.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom da ho nntse ase?
Na wɔbaa Bɛtsaeda; na wɔdze onyifurafo bi brɛɛ no, na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nka no.
Na osuoo onyifurafo no ne nsamu dze no fii ekuroba no mu; na ɔtoo ntafi guu n’enyiwa do, na ɔdze ne nsa too no do no, obisaa no dɛ, Ihu adze anaa?
Na ɔmaa n’enyiwa do, na ɔsee dɛ, Muhu nyimpa, na muhu hɔn tse dɛ ndua nenam.
Nkyii ɔdze ne nsa guu n’enyiwa do bio, ma ɔhwɛɛ n’enyim tɔɔtsenn, na no ho sanee, na ohun adze nyina krɔnn.
Na ɔmaa ɔkɔr ne fie see no dɛ, Mma nnkɔ ekuroba no mu hɔ mpo.
Na Jesus nye n’esuafo no fii hɔ kɔr Kaesarea Filipi nkuroba no mu; na obisaa n’esuafo no wɔ kwan mu dɛ, Nyimpa se dɛ woana nye me?
Na wobuae see no dɛ, John Onumanyi no a, na binom se, Elija a; binom so se, Nkɔnhyɛfo no mu baako a.
Na Jesus noara bisaa hɔn dɛ, Na hom dze, hom se dɛ woana nye me? Peter buae see no dɛ, Ɔwo nye Kraest no.
Na ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnka no ho asɛm nnkyerɛ obiara.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ ɔsɛ nyimpa Ba no dɛ obohu amandze pii, na mpanyimfo nye asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no apow no, na woeku no, na ne ndaansa ɔasoɛr.
Na ɔkaa asɛm no petee. Na Peter suoo no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ ase twuuw n’enyim.
Na ɔno dze, ɔdaan noho hwɛɛ n’esuafo no no, otwuuw Peter n’enyim see dɛ, Fi mo do, Satan: na enndwen Nyankopɔn dze, na nyimpa dze na edwen.
Na ɔfrɛɛ nyimpadodow no nye n’esuafo no so baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Sɛ obi pɛ dɛ odzi m’ekyir a, ma ɔmpa noho ekyir, na ompegya ne mbeamudua na ɔnka mo do.
Na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔgye ne kra nkwa no, ɔbɛyew no, na obiara a emi nye asɛmpa no ntsi ne nkwa befi ne nsa no, wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Na sɛ nyimpa nya wiadze nyina ma ntsi ɔhwer no nkwa a, ebɛn mfaso na obenya?
Na ebɛnadze na nyimpa bɛma dze asesa no nkwa?
Osiandɛ obiara a n’enyi bɔto emi nye me nsɛm ho wɔ awartofo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo santsen yi mu no, ɔno so na nyimpa Ba no n’enyi bɔto no ho, ber a ɔnye n’abɔfoe krɔnkrɔn bɛba wɔ n’egya n’enyimnyam mu no.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Hɔn a wogyina ha yi, binom wɔ hɔ a wɔronnsɔ owu nnhwɛ ansaana woehu Nyankopɔn n’ahenman no dɛ ɔdze tum aba.
Na ndaesia ekyir no, Jesus faa Peter nye James nye John, na ɔdze hɔn nko kɔr nkyɛn wɔ kokwaa tsentsen bi do; na ɔsakyeree wɔ hɔn enyim;
na n’atar hyerɛɛn fitafita, dɛ mbrɛ asaase yi do ɔtanhofo biara nnkotum ahoa no dɛm.
Na Elija nye Moses puee hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔnye Jesus kasae.
Na Peter buae see Jesus dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, oye ma hɛn dɛ yɛtsena ha, na ma yɛmbɔ asese ebiasa, wodze kor, Moses dze kor, Elija dze kor.
Nna onnhu dza ɔnka, osiandɛ nna suro kɛse aka hɔn.
Na mununkum bi bɛkataa hɔn do, na ndze fii mununkum no mu baa dɛ, Oyi nye mo Dɔba no: hom ntsie no.
Na amonmu hɔ ara wɔtotoo hɔn enyiwa, naaso woennhu nyimpa biara dɛ Jesus nko, nye hɔnara.
Na wofi kokwaa do risian no, ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnka dza wohunii no nnkyerɛ obiara, gyedɛ nyimpa Ba no asoɛr efi ewufo mu ana.
Na wosuoo asɛm no mu, na wobisabisaa hɔnho dɛ ewufo mu soɛr no ase nye dɛn.
Na wobisaa no see dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na kyerɛwfo no ka dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ Elija idzi kan ba?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Elija dze, obedzi kan aba ampa, na ɔaabɔtoto ndzɛmba nyina yie: na ebɛnadze ntsi na wɔakyerɛw no nyimpa Ba no ho dɛ obohu amandze pii naaso wonnkobu no hwee?
Na mese hom dɛ Elija aba dada, na eso wɔayɛ no dza wɔpɛ nyina, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ no ho.
Na wodur esuafo no nkyɛn no, wohun nyimpadodow pii wɔ hɔn ho, na kyerɛwfo dɛ wɔnye hɔn riyiyi asɛm ano.
Na ntsɛmara nyimpadodow no nyina hun Jesus no, hɔn ho dwiriiw hɔn, na wotutuu mbirika bae bekyiaa no.
Na Jesus bisaa hɔn dɛ, Ebɛn asɛm na hom nye hɔn riyiyi ano yi?
Na nyimpadodow no mu baako buaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, medze me babanyin brɛɛ wo, osiandɛ ɔwɔ mmum sunsum;
na beebiara a osuo no mu no, ɔtsetsew noho gu, na n’ano twa ehur, na ɔtwɛr ne se, na ɔkyenkyen: na mesee w’esuafo no dɛ wontu no, naaso woenntum.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ao santsen a hom nnyi gyedzi, menye hom ntsena nkodu dabɛn? Hom mfa no mbrɛ me.
Na wɔdze no brɛɛ Jesus; na ohun Jesus no, ntsɛmara na sunsum no twaa no ehim, na ɔhwee daadze ma opirepirewii, na n’ano twaa ehur.
Na Jesus bisaa n’egya dɛ, Iyi yɛɛ no mber dodow bɛn nye yi? Na ɔsee dɛ, Ofi no mbofraber mu;
na mpɛn pii na ɔaka no ato gya, nye nsu mu, dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no; na sɛ ibotum ayɛ ho biribi a, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr na boa hɛn.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Sɛ ibotum a! Nyia ɔgye dzi no, ndzɛmba nyina botum ayɛ hɔ ama no.
Na ntsɛmara abofra no n’egya tseaa mu see dɛ, Megye midzi: boa me wɔ m’ekyingye gye ho.
Na Jesus hun dɛ nyimpadodow dze enguan reba no, ɔbɔɔ sunsum fi no ham see no dɛ, Ɔwo, sunsum mmum nye tsitsifo, mara mehyɛ wo dɛ fi no mu fi, na mma nnkɔ no mu bio.
Na ɔkaa mu na otwaa no ehim pii no, ofii no mu firii; na ɔbɛyɛɛ dɛ owufo, ma dodowara see dɛ, Oewu.
Na Jesus suoo ne nsamu maa no do, na ɔsoɛree.
Na Jesus baa fie no, n’esuafo no bisaa no nsumaa mu dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na yeenntum enntu no yi?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Iyi ne saso nntum nndua biribiara do mmpue gyedɛ mpaabɔ [na akɔnkyen] do.
Na wofii hɔ kotwaa mu wɔ Galilii, na ɔammpɛ dɛ obiara tse.
Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ n’esuafo no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Woriyi nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ nyimpa nsa, na woboku no; na woku no a ne ndaansa no ɔbɔsoɛr bio.
Na hɔn dze, wɔanntse asɛm no ase, naaso wosuroo dɛ wobebisa no.
Na wɔbaa Karpernaum; na ɔwɔ fie no, obisaa hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom dwendween ho wɔ kwan mu no?
Na womuaa hɔn ano: osiandɛ wɔadwendwen wɔ hɔn mu wɔ kwan mu dɛ woana na ɔyɛ kɛse.
Na ɔtsenaa ase no, ɔfrɛɛ duebien no see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ obi pɛ kan edzi a, obedzi hom nyina ekyir na ɔbɛyɛ hom nyina somfo.
Na ɔfaa abofraba sii hɔn finimfin, na ɔyɛɛ no etuu, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ,
Obiara a ɔbɛgye dɛm mbofraba yi mu baako wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔgye emi mara, na obiara a ɔgye me no, nnyɛ emi na ɔgye, na nyia ɔsomaa me no a.
Na John see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yehun obi dɛ ɔdze wo dzin rutu mbɔnsam, na yesiiw no kwan, ɔnam dɛ ɔnnka hɛn ho ntsi.
Na Jesus see dɛ, Mma hom nnsiw no kwan, osiandɛ obi nnyi hɔ a ɔdze me dzin bɛyɛ tum edwuma bi na obotum egu mo ho fi hɔ no ara.
Nyia onntsia hɛn no, ɔwɔ hɛn afa.
Na obiara a ɔbɛma hom nsu kɔɔpow ma hom aanom wɔ me dzin mu, dɛ hom yɛ Kraest dze ntsi no, nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔnnkɛyew n’akatua.
Na obiara a ɔbɔto nkakraba a wɔgye me dzi yi mu baako fintsidua no, oye ma no dɛ wɔdze ewuyambo kɛse sɛn no kɔn mu na wɔdze no kɔto po mu.
Na sɛ wo nsa na ɔto wo fintsidua a, twa: oye ma wo dɛ edze abasin bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ wo nsa ebien dze bɔkɔ amandzehu kurow mu, wɔ gya a orunndum da no mu.
[Hɔ na hɔn abowaba nnwu, na gya no nndum.]
Na sɛ wo nan na ɔto wo fintsidua a, twa: oye ma wo dɛ edze anansin bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ w’anan ebien na wɔdze wo bɔkɔto amandzehu kurow mu.
[Hɔ na hɔn abowaba nnwu, na gya no nndum.]
Na sɛ w’enyiwa na ɔto wo fintsidua a, tu: oye ma wo dɛ edze enyi kor bɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ enyiwa ebien na wɔdze wo bɔkɔto amandzehu kurow mu;
hɔ na abowaba nnwu, na gya no onndum.
Na wɔdze gya bɛhyɛ nyimpa nyina nkyen. [Wɔdze nkyen bɔto afɔrbɔdze nyina mu.]
Nkyen ye: na sɛ nkyen ayew dza ɔma ɔyɛ nkyen mapa a, hom dze ebɛnadze bɔto mu? Hom nnya nkyen wɔ homara hom mu, na hom nye homho homho ntsena asomdwee mu.
Na Jesus soɛree fii hɔ baa Judea nye Jordan afamu; na nyimpadodow boaboaa ano wɔ ne nkyɛn bio, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ ɔyɛ no, ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn bio.
Na Farisiifo bi baa ne nkyɛn bebisaa no asɛm dze sɔɔ no hwɛɛ dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ ɔbanyin begyaa ne yer awar?
Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Moses hyɛɛ hom dɛn?
Na wɔsee dɛ, Moses maa kwan dɛ wɔnkyerɛw awargyaa nwoma mma no, na wongyaa no.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom akoma dzen ntsi na ɔkyerɛɛw mbrasɛm yi maa hom.
Naaso ofitsi abɔdze ahyɛse no, ɔbanyin na ɔbaa na ɔyɛɛ hɔn.
Iyi ntsi na ɔbanyin begya n’egya nye ne na hɔ, na ɔdze noho akɔbɔ ne yer ho;
na hɔn beenu ayɛ honankor; dɛm no nna wɔnnda ho nnyɛ beenu bio, na wɔyɛ honankor.
Dɛm ntsi dza Nyankopɔn dze abɔ mu no, mma nyimpa nntsew mu.
Na ɔwɔ fie no, n’esuafo no bisaa no wɔ asɛm kor yi ara ho bio.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nyimpa biara a obegyaa ne yer na ɔawar fofor no, ɔato awar wɔ ɔbaa no afamu;
na sɛ ɔbaa no so gyaa no kun na ɔwar fofor a, ɔto awar.
Na binom dze mbofraba brɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nka hɔn; na n’esuafo no twuuw hɔn enyim.
Na Jesus hunii no, onyaa ebufuw, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma mbofraba no kwan ma wɔmbra me nkyɛn, na mma hom nnsiw hɔn kwan, na woyinom dɛm na Nyankopɔn ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
Meka no nokwar kyerɛ hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔnnkɛgye Nyankopɔn ahenman no dɛ abofraba no, ɔnnkɔkɔ mu da.
Na ɔyɛɛ mbofra no etuu, na ɔdze ne nsa guu hɔn do dze hyiraa hɔn.
Na Jesus fi hɔ sii kwan no mu no, obi tutuu mbirika bɔkotoow no, na obisaa Jesus dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo pa, ebɛnadze na menyɛ ama meenya onnyiewiei nkwa ayɛ medze?
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na efrɛ me papa? Obiara nnyɛ papa gyedɛ baako: ɔno nye Nyankopɔn.
Inyim mbrasɛm no, Mma nndzi ewu, Mma nnto awar, Mma nnwia adze, Mma nngye dasewia, Mma nnsisi, Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yinom nyinara mifitsi mo mbofraber mu na midzii do.
Na Jesus hwɛɛ no no, ɔdɔɔ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Aka wo adze kor: kɔ, kɔtɔn dza ewɔ nyina fa kyɛ ehiafo, na ibenya akoradze wɔ sor, na bra bɛka mo do.
Na asɛm no ntsi nyimpa no munae, na ɔdze yaw kɔree: osiandɛ nna ɔyɛ nyimpa a ɔwɔ ahonyadze pii.
Na Jesus too n’enyi hwɛɛ hɔn hyiae, na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Ebɛn dzen na ɔyɛ ma hɔn a wɔwɔ ahonya dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman mu!
Na asɛm no yɛɛ esuafo no ahobow. Na Jesus buae see hɔn bio dɛ, Mbofra, ebɛn dzen na ɔyɛ ma hɔn [a wɔtwer ahonya] dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman mu!
Na ɔyɛ mberɛw ma efupɔnkɔ dɛ obodua doroba enyiwa mu kyɛn dɛ ɔhonyanyi bɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman mu.
Na hɔn ho boow hɔn mbordo, na wɔsee no dɛ, Dɛm a nna woana koraa na wobotum agye no nkwa?
Na Jesus hwɛɛ hɔn see dɛ, Nyimpa afamu na iyi nntum nnyɛ dɛm, na nnyɛ Nyankopɔn afamu a: na Nyankopɔn afamu dze, adze biara nnso no yɛ.
Na Peter hyɛɛ ase see no dɛ, Hwɛ, yeegya ndzɛmba nyinara na yɛabɛka wo do.
Jesus see dɛ, Mereka no nokwar mu akyerɛ hom dɛ, Obiara nnyi hɔ a oegya fie, anaa enuanom, anaa nkyerɛbaa, anaa na, anaa egya, anaa mba, anaa nsaase wɔ emi nye asɛmpa no ntsi,
na onnkenya ho mbɔho mpɛn ɔha wɔ ber yi mu, efie, nye enuanom, nye nkyerɛbaa, nye nanom, nye mba, nye nsaase, ɔnye ayakayakadze; na wiadze a ɔreba no mu onnyiewiei nkwa.
Na Edzikamfo pii bedzi ekyir, na ekyidzifo so pii bedzi kan.
Nna wɔnam kwan mu rokɔ Jerusalɛm; na Jesus dzi hɔn enyim kan, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn ahobow; na hɔn a wodzi n’ekyir no suroi. Na ɔfaa duebien no bio na ɔhyɛɛ ase kaa ndzɛmba a ɔbɛba no do no kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
Hwɛ, yɛrokɔ Jerusalɛm; na wobeyi Nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no nsa, na woebu no fɔ ama owu, na woeyi no ama amanamamfo;
na wobesi no atwetwe, na wɔatoto ntafi egu no do, na wɔaka no mpire, na woeku no; naaso ne ndaansa mu ɔbɔsoɛr.
Na James nye John, Zebedee mba no, baa no hɔ bɛsee dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yɛpɛ dɛ biribiara a yɛbɛserɛ wo no eyɛ ma hɛn.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom pɛ dɛ meyɛ mema hom?
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ma hɛn mu baako ntsena w’enyimfa, na baako so ntsena w’abankum wɔ w’enyimnyam mu.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom nnyim dza hom reserɛ yi: ana hom botum anom kɔɔpow a monom no, anaa wɔdze enuma a wɔdze numa me no enuma hom?
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yebotum. Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Kɔɔpow a monom no dze, hom bɔnom ampa, na enuma a wɔdze numa me no, wɔdze bonuma hom;
na m’enyimfa nye m’abankum tsena dze, ɔnnyɛ medze dɛ medze bɛma: na wɔdze bɛma hɔn a woesiesie ama hɔn.
Na du no tsee no wɔhyɛɛ ase nyaa ebufuw wɔ James nye John ho.
Na Jesus frɛɛ hɔn baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nyim dɛ hɔn a wobu hɔn dɛ wodzi amanaman do, wodzi hɔn do wura, na hɔn mu akɛse no dzi hɔn do tum.
Naaso onnyi dɛ ɔba dɛm wɔ hom mu: na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔkɛse wɔ hom mu no, ɔbɛyɛ hom somfo;
na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ odzi hom mu kan no, ɔbɛyɛ hom nyina hom akowaa.
Na nyimpa Ba no so, ɔammba dɛ wɔnnsom no, mbom ɔbɔsomee, ama ɔdze no nkwa aayɛ werdam ama dodowara.
Na wodur Jeriko; na ɔnye n’esuafo no nye nyimpadodow pii rifi Jeriko akɔ no, nna Timeɔs ne ba Bartimeɔs a ɔyɛ onyifurafo na ɔserɛserɛ adze no, tse kwan nkyɛn.
Na ɔtsee dɛ ɔyɛ Jesus Nazarɛtnyi no no, ɔhyɛɛ ase tseatseaa mu dɛ, Jesus, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr.
Na dodowara braa no dɛ ommua n’ano; na mbom ɔtseaa mu kɛse dɛ, Ɔwo, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr.
Na Jesus gyinae, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mfrɛ no. Na wɔfrɛɛ onyifurafo no see no dɛ, Ka w’akoma to wo yamu: soɛr, ɔrefrɛ wo.
Na ɔtoow ne tam gui, na ɔsoɛɛr putupruw, na ɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn.
Na Jesus bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na epɛ dɛ meyɛ ma wo? Na onyifurafo no see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, nkyɛ meehu adze bio.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Kɔ, wo gyedzi agye wo. Na ntsɛmara ohun adze, na ɔkaa Jesus do wɔ kwan no mu.
Na wɔbɛɛn Jerusalɛm wɔ Bɛtfage nye Bɛtani, wɔ Ngo Bepɔw ho no, ɔsomaa n’esuafo no mu beenu,
na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ ekuroba a ɔda hom enyim no mu: na hom du hɔ ara pɛr a, hom bohu asoasopɔnkɔba bi a wɔamontan no a nyimpa biara nntsenaa do da: hom nsan no mfa no mbra.
Na sɛ obi bisa hom dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ yi a, hom nse dɛ, Ewuradze wɔ no ho hia, na ntsɛmara ɔbɛma wɔdze no aba ha.
Na wɔkɔree no wokohun asoasopɔnkɔba no dɛ wɔamontan no abow ho, wɔ abɔntsen petee mu, na wɔsaan no.
Hɔn a nna wogyina hɔ no bi bisaa dɛ, Hom resan asoasopɔnkɔba no ayɛ dɛn?
Na wobuaa hɔn dɛ mbrɛ Jesus see hɔn no ara; na wɔmaa hɔn kwan.
Na wɔdze asoasopɔnkɔba no brɛɛ Jesus, na wɔtoow hɔn ntar guu no do; na ɔtsenaa no do.
Na dodowara dze hɔn ntar sesɛɛw kwan mu; na binom so dze ndubaa a woetwitwa wɔ efuw mu.
Na hɔn a wodzii enyim no, na hɔn so a wodzii ekyir no tseaa mu dɛ, Hosanna! Nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze dzin mu reba no!
Nhyira nye hɛn egya David ahendzi a ɔreba no! Hosanna wɔ sorsor!
Na ɔkɛhɛɛn Jerusalɛm no, ɔkɔr asɔrfi no mu; na ɔahwɛ ndzɛmba nyina ewie, na adze resa no, ɔnye duebien no fii hɔ kɔr Bɛtani.
Na adze kyee a wofi Bɛtani reba no, ɔkɔm dzee Jesus.
Na ohun adɔmbadua bi wɔ ekyirekyir dɛ ahaban wɔ do no, ɔkɔr hɔ dɛ bi a nkyɛ obohu biribi wɔ do, naaso odur hɔ no oennhu biribiara dɛ ahaban nko: osiandɛ nna adɔmba ber nndurii.
Na Jesus see adɔmbadua no dɛ, Mma obi nndzi wo do eduaba bio da. Na n’esuafo no tsee.
Na wodur Jerusalɛm; na ɔkɔr asɔrfi no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ ase paam hɔn a wɔtɔn nye hɔn a wɔtɔ wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na obutuuw sikasesafo hɔn apon nye hɔn a wɔtɔn mbubur no hɔn ngua;
na ɔamma kwan amma obiara aannsoa adze ammfa asɔrfi no mu.
Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛe see hɔn dɛ, Ana wɔnnkyerɛw no dɛ, Wɔbɛfrɛ me fi asɔryɛbea ama amanaman nyinara? Naaso hom dze, hom ayɛ no edwotwafo tu.
Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no tsee, na wɔhwehwɛɛ mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ asɛɛ no: na wosuroo no, osiandɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ nyimpadodow nyina ahobow.
Na adzesae no, Jesus nye n’esuafo no fii kurow no mu hɔ.
Na anapa no a wɔresen no, wohun adɔmbadua no dɛ ofitsi no ndwow akyenkyen.
Na Peter kaae na ɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, hwɛ, adɔmbadua a edoom no no akyenkyen.
Na Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Hom nya gyedzi wɔ Nyankopɔn mu.
Na nokwar mese hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɛse kokwaa yi dɛ, Tutu na kɔhwe po mu, na ɔnnyɛ ekyingye wɔ n’akoma mu, na ɔbɛgye edzi dɛ dza ɔrese no ɔreyɛ hɔ no, ɔbɛyɛ hɔ ama no.
Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Biribiara a hom sɔr bisa no, hom ngye ndzi dɛ hom enya na hom benya.
Na sɛ hom gyina hɔ rosɔr, na sɛ hom nye obi wɔ asɛm bi a, hom mfa nkyɛ, ama hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no so dze hom mfom aakyɛ hom.
[Na sɛ hom ammfa annkyɛ a, hom egya a ɔwɔ sor no so nnkɛfa hom mfom akyɛ hom.]
Na wɔbaa Jerusalɛm bio; na ɔnenam asɔrfi no mu no, asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no baa ne nkyɛn,
na wobisaa no dɛ, Ebɛn tum na edze yɛ ndzɛmba yi, anaa woana na ɔmaa wo tum dɛ yɛ yinom?
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Mibebisa hom asɛm kor, na hom mbua me, na mebɛkyerɛ hom tum kor a medze yɛ yinom:
John enuma no, ofir sor anaa ofir nyimpa? Hom mbua me.
Na wɔdwendween ho wɔ hɔn ntamu dɛ, Sɛ yɛka dɛ, Ofir sor a, ɔbɛse dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom anngye no enndzi?
Anaa yɛnka dɛ, Ofir nyimpa? Nna wosuro nkorɔfo no, osiandɛ hɔn nyina buu John dɛ ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi ampa.
Ntsi wobuaa Jesus see no dɛ, Yennyim. Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Mo so mennkɛkyerɛ hom tum kor a medze yɛ yinom.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ase kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn abɛbu mu dɛ, Nyimpa bi yɛɛ wenyin ture, na ɔgyee ho ban hyiae, na otuu wenyintwer, na ɔtoow abantsentsen wɔ mu, na ɔdze fɛɛm ekuafo bi, na ɔdɔɔ mu kɔr beebi.
Na ber durii no, ɔsomaa akowaa bi wɔ ekuafo no hɔ dɛ ɔnkɛgye wenyin ture eduaba no bi wɔ ekuafo no hɔ mbra.
Na ekuafo no kyeer no hwee no, na wɔmaa ɔdze nsapan kɔree.
Na bio ɔsomaa akowaa fofor wɔ hɔn hɔ, na wɔbobɔɔ ne tsir pirapiraa no, na woguu n’enyim ase.
Na ɔsanee somaa ɔfofor so; na ɔno dze, wokum no, nna afofor pii so: wɔhwee binom na wokum binom.
Nna ɔwɔ obi so wɔ hɔ a ɔno yɛ no dɔba; na ekyir no ɔsomaa ɔno so wɔ hɔn hɔ, na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔbɛfɛr me ba.
Na ekuafo no dze, wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Odziadzenyi no nye yi: hom mbra ma yenku no, na egyapadze no bɛyɛ hɛndze.
Na wɔkyeer no kum no, na wɔtoow no fii wenyin ture mu hɔ kyenee.
Dɛm a nna ebɛnadze na wenyin ture no wura bɛyɛ? Ɔbɛba abɛsɛɛ ekuafo no, na ɔdze wenyin ture no ama afofor.
Ana hom nnkenkaan kyerɛw yi pɛn dɛ, Ɔbo a adantofo powee no, Ɔnoara na, ɔabɛyɛ kutuwdo bo;
Iyi Ewuradze na Ɔayɛ, Na ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ hɛn enyiwa do?
Na wɔpɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ wɔkyer no; osiandɛ wohun dɛ bɛ yi a obui no tsia hɔn; naaso wosuroo nyimpadodow no ntsi wogyaa no hɔ kɔree.
Na wɔsomaa Farisiifo nye Herod akadofo no mu bi dɛ wonkodua ne kasaa do mfa nsun no efir nkyer no.

Na wɔbae no wɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yenyim dɛ eyɛ nokwafo, na ennyɛ nyimpa enyim nhwehwɛmu; eso innsuro nyimpa enyim asɛnka, na ekyerɛkyerɛ Nyankopɔn no kwan no wɔ nokwar mu. Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ yɛyi ntoboa ma Kaesar anaa oho?
Yɛmma anaa mma yɛmma? Na ohun hɔn ndabraba no ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rosɔ me ahwɛ yi? Hom mfa sika denare mbrɛ me ma monhwɛ.
Na wɔdze bae. Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Woana no mfonyi nye akyerɛw nye yi? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Kaesar dze a.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa dza ɔyɛ Kaesar dze mma Kaesar, na dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn dze mma Nyankopɔn. Na no ho yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa dodow.
Na Sadusiifo so bi a wɔka dɛ wunyan nnyi hɔ no baa ne nkyɛn; na wobisaa no dɛ,
Kyerɛkyerɛfo, Moses kyerɛwee maa hɛn dɛ, Sɛ obi no nua wu na ogya ne yer, na oenngya mba a, no nua nwar ne yer no na ɔnwo mba mma no nua.
Na enuanom beesuon wɔ hɔ: na nyia odzi kan no waar yer, na owui no, oenngya mba;
na nyia otsia ebien no waar no, na owui, na no so enngya mba; nyia otsia ebiasa no dɛmara;
na beesuon no enngya mba. Ne nyina ekyir no, ɔbaa no so wui.
Na wunyan no mu, hɔn mu woana na ɔbɛyɛ ne yer? Osiandɛ beesuon no awar no.
Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ana nnyɛ yi ntsi na hom fom yi, dɛ hom nnyim kyerɛwsɛm no nye Nyankopɔn no tum no so?
Na wɔsoɛr fi ewufo mu a, wɔnnwar eso wɔmma awar, na wɔtse dɛ abɔfo a wɔwɔ sor.
Na ewufo ho no dze, dɛ wobenyan no, ana hom nnkenkaan no wɔ Moses nwoma no mu, mbrɛ Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ no wɔ Haban no mu dɛ, Emi nye Abraham Nyankopɔn, Isaak Nyankopɔn, Jakob Nyankopɔn?
Ampaara, nnyɛ ewufo Nyankopɔn, mbom enyikamfo Nyankopɔn a: dɛm ntsi hom fom pii.
Na kyerɛwfo no mu baako bae bɛtsee dɛ woribisabisa nsɛm no, na ohun dɛ Jesus ebua hɔn yie no, obisaa no dɛ, Mbransɛm no nyina dza ɔwɔ hen na odzi kan?
Jesus buaa dɛ, Dza odzi kan no nye dɛ, Israel, tsie: Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze kor:
na dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ w’akoma nyina mu nye wo kra nyina mu, nye w’adwen nyina mu, nye w’ahoɔdzen nyina mu.
Na dza otsia ebien no nye yi: Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa wo ho. Mbrasɛm biara nnyi hɔ a ɔso kyɛn yinom.
Na kyerɛwnyi no see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ampa aka no yie dɛ Nyankopɔn yɛ kor; na obi nnyi hɔ dɛ ɔno nko.
Na dɛ ebɔdɔ no wɔ w’akoma nyina mu, nye wo ntseasee nyina mu, nye w’ahoɔdzen nyina mu, na ebɔdɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa wo ho no, kyɛn hyew afɔr, nye afɔrbɔ nyina koraa.
Na Jesus hun dɛ oebua nyansa mu no, ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔwo na Nyankopɔn n’ahenman no ntamu nntwe. Na obiara ennsi no bo dɛ obebisa no asɛm bi bio.
Na Jesus rekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔrfi no mu no, obisaa dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na kyerɛwfo no ka dɛ Kraest no yɛ David ba?
Na David nankasa nam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu ka dɛ, Ewuradze see m’Ewuradze dɛ, Tsena m’abanyimfa Kodu dɛ medze w’atamfo mebɛyɛ w’ananadzegua.
Dɛm ntsi David noara frɛ no Ewuradze; na ofi hen bɛyɛɛ ne ba? Nna nyimpadodow nyina dze enyigye tsiee no.
Na ɔkae wɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ akyerɛwfo a wɔpɛ ntar atsentsen mu nantsew, nye gua do nkyiakyia;
ɔnye mpanyin gua wɔ nhyiamudan mu, nye mpanyin tsenabea wɔ edzidzi ase ho:
hɔn na wɔbɔ ekunafo epoo, na wopetuw bɔ mpaa atsentsen kyerɛ: mese, woyinom benya afɔbu kɛsenara.
Na ɔtsenaa ase wɔ sikakorabea no ne tsentsendo na ɔhwɛɛ mbrɛ nyimpadodow no sii dze sika guu sikakorabea no mu; na dodow a wɔyɛ ahonyafo no dze pii guu mu.
Na ɔbaa kunafo hianyi bi so bae bɔtoow mpɛsewamba ebien a wɔbɛyɛ pɛsewa kor guu mu.
Na Jesus frɛɛ n’esuafo see hɔn dɛ, Meka no nokwar mu kyerɛ hom dɛ, okunafo hianyi yi dze pii ebogu mu akyɛn hɔn a wɔdze bi ebogu sikakorabea no mu no nyina:
osiandɛ hɔn nyina dza wɔwɔ ma abor hɔn do no, nna wɔdze bi ebogu mu, na oyi dze, ofi ne hia mu dze dza ɔwɔ nyina, n’asetsena nyina na ɔdze ebogu mu.
Na orifi asɔrfi mu no, n’esuafo no mu baako see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, hwɛ, abo akɛse bi nye aban akɛse bi so!
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ehu aban akɛse yi? Wonnkegya ɔbo kor a ɔda kor do a wonnkodwuruw egu famu.
Na ɔtse Ngo Bepɔw no do wɔ asɔrfi tsentsendo no, Peter, James, John nye Andrew bisaa no nsumaa mu dɛ,
Kyerɛ hɛn aber a iyinom bɛyɛ hɔ: na sɛ iyinom nyina rebɛba mu a, n’asɛnkyerɛdze nye dɛn?
Na Jesus hyɛɛ ase see hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie amma obi aanndaadaa hom.
Na dodowara bɛba wɔ me dzin mu dɛ, Emi nye no, na wɔadaadaa pii.
Na sɛ hom tse ko nye akosɛm a, mma hom akoma nntu: na otwar dɛ ɔba, na ewiei no nnyae nndurii.
Na ɔman bɔsoɛr ɔman do, na ahenman bɔsoɛr ahenman do; na asaasewosow bɛba mbeambea, na ɔkɔm bɛba: iyinom dze, awoko no ahyɛse ara a.
Na hom nhwɛ homho yie: na wobeyi hom akɔ mpanyimfo bagua mu, na wɔahwe hom wɔ nhyiamudan mu, na hom egyina ambradofo nye ahemfo enyim wɔ me ntsi, dze edzi dase akyerɛ hɔn.
Na asɛmpa no, otwar dɛ wɔka kyerɛ amanaman nyina ansaana.
Na sɛ wɔdze hom rokɔ ekeyi hom ama a, mma hom nndwendwen dza hom bɛka ho ansaana: na biribi a wɔdze bɛma hom dɔn no mu no, ɔnoara na hom nka: osiandɛ nnyɛ hom na hom kasa, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no a.
Na nua beyi nua ama owu, egya beyi ɔba ama; na mba bɔsoɛr wɔ awofo do na wɔama woeku hɔn.
Na nyimpa nyina bɛtan hom wɔ me dzin ntsi; na nyia ɔbɛtsena mu ekodu ewiei no, ɔno na wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Na sɛ hom hu amambɔe ekyiwadze no dɛ ogyina mbrɛ ɔnnsɛ a (ma nyia ɔrekenkan no ntse ase dɛ ogyina hɔ ma ohonyi no), ɔno na hɔn a wɔwɔ Judea no nguan nkɔ nkokwaa do;
na mma nyimpa a ɔwɔ dan etsifi nnsian mmba dan mu, na eso mma ɔnnhɛn mu nnkɛfa biribi wɔ ne dan mu;
na mma nyia ɔwɔ haban mu no nnsan n’ekyir bio mmbɛfa ne nkatado.
Na hɔn a wɔafa efur nye hɔn a wɔma numfo wɔ nda no mu ndue!
Na hom nsɔr ma iyinom aammba awɔwber mu.
Na nda no mu bɛba ahohiahia kɛse a ofitsi Nyankopɔn ne wiadze mbɔe ahyɛse araa bodu aber no ɔmmbaa dɛm da, eso bi remmba da.
Na sɛ Ewuradze enntwa nda no do tsia a, nkyɛ honam biara nnkenya nkwa, na ne mpamufo a ɔpaa hɔn no ntsi oetwa nda no do tsia.
Na aber no sɛ obiara se hom dɛ, Hwɛ, Kraest no wɔ ha, anaaso, Hwɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ no a, mma hom nngye nndzi,
na Kraest atorfo, nye nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo bɔsoɛr na wɔakyerɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze a sɛ anhwɛ a, wɔdze bɛdaadaa mpamufo no mpo.
Na hom dze, hom nhwɛ yie: osiandɛ medzi kan aka ne nyina akyerɛ hom.
Na dɛm ahohiahia nda no ekyir no, ewia bɛhyɛ sum, na bosoom nnkɛma ne kan,
na nworaba fi sor bɔtotɔ, na sor etum bɔwosow.
Ɔno na wobohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔreba wɔ nsuwusiw do, wɔ tum nye enyimnyam kɛse mu.
Na ɔno na ɔbɔsoma n’abɔfoe ma wɔaakɔboaboa ne mpamufo no ano efi mframa anan no mu, ofi asaase ano kesi sor ano.
Hom nsua adɔmbadua no ho bɛ no: sɛ n’abaw yɛ momon, na oriyi ahaban a, nna hom nyim dɛ ɔhyewber abɛn;
dɛmara na hom so sɛ hom hu dɛ yinom yɛ hɔ a, hom nhu dɛ abɛn, edu abowano.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Mbasantsen yi nnkotwa mu akɔ gyedɛ yinom nyina ayɛ hɔ ansaana.
Ɔsor nye asaase botwa mu akɔ na me nsɛm dze, wonnkotwa mu akɔ da.
Na da no nye dɔn no dze obiara nnyim: abɔfo a wɔwɔ sor no so nnyim, Ɔba no so nnyim, gyedɛ Egya no nko.
Hom nhwɛ yie, hom nweɔn na hom mbɔ mpaa, na hom nnyim da pɔtsee a ber no bodu.
Ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a ɔrodɔ mu a ogyaa ne fi, na ɔmaa no nkowaa tum, na ɔmaa hɔn nyina hɔn edwuma nkorkor, na ɔhyɛɛ abowanohwɛfo no dɛ ɔnweɔn.
Dɛm ntsi hom nweɔn, na hom nnyim dɔn kor a ofiwura bɛba: adansaber o, esuom o, akokɔbɔnee o, anapahema o;
amma ɔaammba awerɛfir mu emmbohu hom dɛ hom deda.
Na dza meka kyerɛ hom yi, meka kyerɛ nyimpa nyina so dɛ, Hom nweɔn.
Nna aka nda ebien ma apaho nye epitsi afahyɛ no edu; na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no hwehwɛɛ mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ nam nyansa mu akyer Jesus na woeku no:
na wɔsee dɛ, Nnyɛ afahyɛ mu bi a, amma wentwiwentwi aammba ɔman no mu.
Na ɔwɔ Bɛtani Simon kwatanyi no fie, na ɔtse edzidzi no, ɔbaa bi baa hɔ a ɔdze alabastron toa a nard ngohuam a ɔsom bo wɔ mu; na ɔbɔɔ toa no na ohuei guu n’etsifi.
Na binom wɔ hɔ a wonyaa ebufuw wɔ hɔn mu, na wɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na wɔresɛɛ ngohuam yi?
Nkyɛ wobotum atɔn ngohuam yi agye bɔbor sika denare ahaasa na wɔdze ama ehiafo. Na wohwinhwinii tsiaa no.
Na Jesus see dɛ, Hom ngyaa no; ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rehaw no? Ɔayɛ edwuma pa wɔ mo ho.
Na hom wɔ ehiafo wɔ hom nkyɛn daa, na aber biara a hom pɛ, hom botum ayɛ hɔn yie, na emi dze, hom nnyi me daa.
Ɔayɛ dza obotum: oedzi kan abɛsera me nyimpadua akɔ sie mu.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Beebiara a wɔbɛka asɛmpa yi wɔ wiadze nyina mu no, dza ɔbaa yi ayɛ so wɔbɛka dze ayɛ ne nkaa.
Na Judas Iskariot a ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako fii hɔ kɔr asɔfompanyin no nkyɛn dɛ obeyi Jesus ama hɔn.
Na wɔtsee no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛw, na wɔbɔɔ anohoba dɛ wɔbɛma no sika. Na ɔhwehwɛɛ mbrɛ obesi eyi no ama wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu.
Na epitsi da a odzi kan a woku apahoguan no, n’esuafo no see no dɛ, Hen na epɛ dɛ yekesiesie ma ikedzi apaho no?
Na ɔsomaa n’esuafo no mu beenu, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ kurow no mu, na nyimpa bi a ɔso nsuhina behyia hom: hom nka no do;
na beebiara a ɔbɛhɛn no hom nse ofiwura no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo no se, M’ahɔhodan a menye m’esuafo bedzi mu apaho no wɔ hen?
Na ɔnoara ɔbɛkyerɛ hom sordan kɛse bi a wɔahyehyɛ mu, na woesiesie mu; hɔ na hom nsiesie mma hɛn.
Na esuafo no sii mu kɔree, na wɔbaa kurow no mu na wobohun dɛ mbrɛ ɔsee hɔn no, na wosiesiee apaho no.
Na odur ewimbir no, ɔnye duebien no bae.
Na wɔtwetwer hɔ ridzidzi no, Jesus see dɛ, Ampa mese hom dɛ, Hom mu baako a ɔnye me dzidzi na obeyi me ama.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn awerɛhow na wɔhyɛɛ ase nkorkor bisaa no dɛ, Ana emi a?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Duebien no mu baako a ɔnye me to nsa wɔ ɔsɛn no mu no a.
Na nyimpa Ba no rokɔ, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ no ho; naaso nyimpa a wɔnam no do beyi nyimpa Ba no ama no ndue! Sɛ wɔannwo dɛm nyimpa no a, nkyɛ oye ma no.
Na woridzidzi no, ɔfaa paanoo na ohyiraa do na obubui, na ɔdze maa hɔn; na ɔsee dɛ, Hom ngye: iyi nye me nyimpadua.
Na ɔfaa kɔɔpow na ɔdaa ase no, ɔdze maa hɔn ma hɔn nyina nomee.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Iyi nye mo bɔgyaa a ɔyɛ ahyɛmu no a dodowara ntsi woruhue egu no.
Nokwar mese hom dɛ, moronnom wenyinaba no bi bio, dze ekodu da a mobɔnom no fofor wɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
Na wɔtoow ndwom no, wofiir edzi kɔr Ngo Bepɔw no do.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Wɔbɔto hom nyina fintsidua: na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Mobɔbɔ oguanhwɛfo no, na nguan no abɔ apetse.
Naaso mo wusoɛr ekyir no mibedzi hom enyim akɔ Galilii.
Na Peter see no dɛ, Sɛ wɔbɔto hɔn nyina fintsidua mpo a, nnyɛ emi a.
Na Jesus see no dɛ, Nokwar mese wo dɛ, Ndɛ anadwe yi, ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn mprɛnu no, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa.
Na Peter dze, mbom ɔkaa no enyiberdo dɛ, Sɛ menye wo bowu mpo a, meremmpa wo da; na dɛmara na hɔn nyina so kae.
Na wodur beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Getsemane; na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Hom ntsena ha ma monkɔsɔr.
Na ɔfaa Peter nye James nye John kaa noho, na ɔhyɛɛ ase bɔɔ hu na ɔbɔmee.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Awerɛhow ahyɛ me kra do dze kɔ owu mu: hom ntsena ha, na hom nweɔn.
Na ɔkɔr enyim kakra, na ɔkɔhwee famu na ɔsɔɔr dɛ, sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, dɔn no mpa no ho nkɔ.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Aba, Egya! Adze biara nnso wo yɛ: yi kɔɔpow yi pa mo ho; naaso nnyɛ dza mepɛ bi a, na dza ɔwo epɛ a.
Na ɔbae bohun dɛ wɔdeda, na ɔsee Peter dɛ, Simon, ana ada? Ana enntum annweɔn dɔnhwer kor mpo?
Hom nweɔn na hom nsɔr, amma hom aannkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu: sunsum no pɛ dze, naaso honam yɛ mberɛw.
Na osii mu kɔr bio, na ɔkɔsɔree kaa asɛm kor no ara.
Na ɔsanee bae bohun hɔn dɛ wɔdeda bio, na hɔn enyiwa akom; na woennya mbuae bi amma no.
Na ɔbaa ne mpɛn ebiasa, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nda dza aka yi, na hom nhom. Ayɛ yie! Dɔn no edu; hwɛ, woriyi nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo nsa.
Hom nsoɛr ma yɛnkɔ; hwɛ, nyia oriyi me ama no abɛn.
Na hɔnara, ɔda do rekasa no, Judas a ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako bae, na nyimpadodow a wɔdzedze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa fi asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no hɔ ka no ho.
Na nyia oyii no mae no maa hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ, Nyia mebɛfew n’ano no, nye ɔno: hom nkyer no na hom nsuo no mu yie mfa no nkɔ.
Na odur hɔ no, ntsɛmara na ɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn na ɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, na ɔfeew n’ano.
Na wɔdze hɔn nsa susuoo no mu na wɔkyekyeer no.
Na hɔn a wogyinagyina hɔ no mu baako twee ne krantsee bɔɔ ɔsɔfopanyin n’akowaa twaa n’aso.
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom firii baa mo do dɛ hom reba owifo do, na hom dze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa rebɛkyer me yi?
Daa mowɔ hom nkyɛn wɔ asɔrfi mu kyerɛkyerɛe no, hom annkyer me; na dɛ kyerɛwsɛm no bɛba mu ntsi a.
Na esuafo no nyinara gyaa no hɔ, na woguanee.
Na aberantsɛ baako bi kaa no do a nna oetu ndwera akata n’adagyaw do; na wɔkyeer no;
na ogyaa ndwera no hɔ na ɔdze adagyaw guanee.
Na wɔdze Jesus kɔr ɔsɔfopanyin no hɔ; na asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo nye kyerɛwfo no nyina behyiaa ne nkyɛn.
Na Peter dzii n’ekyir wɔ ekyirekyir dze kodur ɔsɔfopanyin n’abanguado, na ɔnye asomfo no kɛtsenaa hɔ too gya.
Na asɔfompanyin nye baguafo no nyina hwehwɛɛ dɛ wobenya Jesus ho dase bi dze eeku no; naaso woennya bi.
Na dodowara gyee no ho dasewia, na hɔn dasee annsaa.
Na binom soɛree gyee no ho dasewia dɛ,
Yɛtsee dɛ ɔsee dɛ, Mubodwuruw asɔrdan a wɔdze nsa ayɛ yi na ndaansa mu matow bi a wɔammfa nsa annyɛ.
Na dɛm no mpo so hɔn dasee annsaa.
Na ɔsɔfopanyin no gyinaa finimfin na obisaa Jesus dɛ, Immbua bi? Ebɛnadze na yinom regye wo ho dase yi?
Na omuaa n’ano, na oemmbua bi. Na ɔsɔfopanyin no bisaa no bio dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Kraest no, nyia woehyira no no ne Ba no?
Na Jesus see dɛ, Emi nye no: na hom bohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔtse tum no abanyimfa, na ɔreba wɔ sor nsuwusiw mu.
Na ɔsɔfopanyin no sunsuaan n’atar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛn hia na ohia hɛn adasefo bio?
Hom atse ebususɛm no: hom dwen dɛn? Na hɔn nyinara buu no fɔ dɛ ɔsɛ owu.
Na binom hyɛɛ ase hinaa ntafi guu no do, na wɔkataa n’enyi, na wɔbobɔɔ no ekutuku, na wɔsee no dɛ, Hyɛ nkɔm! Na asomfo no bobɔɔ no asotɔr.
Na Peter wɔ ase wɔ abangua no do hɔ no, ɔsɔfopanyin ne mbaawa no mu baako bae,
na ohun Peter dɛ ɔroto gya no, ɔhwɛɛ no dzinn na ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔwo so nye Nazarɛtnyi Jesus nam.
Na ɔsaan dɛ, Minnyim no, eso menntse dza ereka yi ase mpo. Na ofiir edzi kɔr paado; na akokɔ bɔnee.
Na abaawa no hun no na ɔhyɛɛ ase see hɔn a wogyina hɔ no dɛ, Oyi so fi hɔn mu.
Na ɔsaan bio. Na ɔkyɛɛr kakra no, hɔn a wogyina hɔ no see Peter bio dɛ, Ampa dɛ ifi hɔn mu, osiandɛ eyɛ Galiliinyi.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii nsew na ɔkekaa ntam dɛ, Minnyim nyimpa yi a hom reka no ho asɛm yi.
Na ntsɛmara na akokɔ bɔɔn ne mpɛn ebien. Na Peter kaa asɛm no a Jesus kaa kyerɛɛ no no dɛ, Ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn mprɛnu no, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa. Na ɔhyɛɛ ase sui.
Na adze kyee ara nna asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no nye kyerɛwfo nye baguafo no nyina kɔr apam, na wɔkyekyeer Jesus dze no kɔree kɛhyɛɛ Pilate nsa.
Na Pilate bisaa no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Jewfo Hen no? Na Jesus buaa no see dɛ, Ɔwoara na aka.
Na asɔfompanyin no toatoaa no pii.
Na Pilate bisaa no bio see dɛ, Ana irummbua hwee? Hwɛ ndzɛmba pii a wɔdze toatoa wo yi.
Naaso Jesus emmbua hwee bio, na ɔyɛɛ Pilate nwanwa.
Nna afahyɛ du a, ɔtɔ dɛ Pilate gyaa daduanyi kor biara a wɔbɛserɛ no ma hɔn.
Nna woegu nyimpa bi a wɔfrɛ no Barabbas nye hɔn a wɔka no ho a wɔtseew etua na wɔnam etuatsew no do dzii ewu no mpokyerɛ.
Na nyimpadodow no kɔr Pilate hɔ hyɛɛ ase serɛɛ no dɛ ɔnyɛ mma hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ ɔyɛ no.
Na Pilate buaa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom pɛ dɛ migyaa Jewfo Hen no mema hom?
Na ohun dɛ enyitan ntsi na asɔfompanyin no yii no mae.
Na asɔfompanyin no hyɛɛ nyimpadodow no tsipia dɛ mbom ongyaa Barabbas mma hɔn.
Na Pilate buae see hɔn bio dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom pɛ dɛ meyɛ nyia hom frɛ no Jewfo Hen no?
Na wɔtseaa mu bio dɛ, Bɔ no mbeamudua mu!
Na Pilate see hɔn dɛ, Ebɛn bɔn na ɔayɛ? Na wɔtseatseaa mu mbordo dɛ, Bɔ no mbeamudua mu!
Na Pilate pɛɛ dɛ ɔma nyimpadodow no abodwee no, ogyaa Barabbas maa hɔn, na Jesus dze, ɔkaa no mpire no, oyii no mae dɛ wɔnkɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na nsordaafo no dze no kɔr abangua no a ɔyɛ Ambrado Aban no do; na wɔfrɛfrɛɛ nsordaafokuw no nyina boaa ano.
Na wɔdze tam memen furaa no, na wɔbɔɔ nsoɛ katraka soaa no;
na wɔhyɛɛ ase kyiakyiaa no dɛ, Jewfo Hen nye yi o!
Na wɔdze ndzɛmbir bɔɔ n’etsifi, na wohinahinaa ntafi guu no do, na wobuu ntwɛr sɔɔr no.
Na wosii no atwetwe wiei no woyii tam memen no wɔ no ho, na wɔdze nankasa n’atar hyɛɛ no, na wɔdze no kɔr dɛ wɔrokɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na wɔhyɛɛ Simon Sirenenyi bi a ofi kwaa mu rutwa mu, Alɛksandar nye Rufus hɔn egya no, dɛ ɔnsoa ne mbeamudua no.
Na wɔdze no kɔr beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Golgota a ne nkyerɛase nye Tsikwankora Bea.
Na wɔmaa no wenyin a wɔdze eduhuam mɛɛr afora mu, naaso ɔannom.
Na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu, na wɔkyɛɛ n’atar mu, twee tonto hwehwɛɛ dza obiara bɛfa.
Na anapa ndɔnkron no mu na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu.
Na wɔkyerɛɛw dza wogyinaa do buu no fɔ no wɔ n’etsifi dɛ JEWFO HEN.
Na wɔbɔɔ edwotwafo beenu mbeamudua mu kaa no ho, ɔbaako wɔ n’enyimfa, na ɔbaako wɔ n’abankum.
[Na kyerɛw no a ɔka dɛ, Wɔkaan no foraa emumuyɛfo no, baa mu.]
Na hɔn a worutwa mu no, kaa ebususɛm tsiaa no na wɔwosowosoow hɔn tsir dɛ, Ɛhɛɛ! Ɔwo a idwuruw asɔrdan no na etow no ndaansa mu,
gye woho fi mbeamudua yi ho si famu ɛ!
Dɛmara so na asɔfompanyin no nye akyerɛwfo no sii no atwetwe dɛ, Ɔgyee binom: naaso onntum nngye nankasa noho.
Afei wɔmma Kraest no, Israel Hen no, mfi mbeamudua no ho nsi famu, ma yenhu na yɛngye ndzi ɛ. Na hɔn a wɔbɔɔ hɔn mbeamudua mu kaa no ho no so yaaw no bi.
Na ewiaber duebien durii no, sum hyɛɛ asaase no nyina do kodur ndɔnebiasa no.
Na ndɔnebiasa no mu no, Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu dɛ, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani? Ne nkyerɛase nye dɛ, Me Nyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn na apa me yi?
Na hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ binom tsee no, wɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔrefrɛ Elija.
Na baako tuu mbirika dze sapɔw kɔbɔɔ wenyin yerɛyerɛw mu, dze tuaa ndzɛmbir ano maa no dɛ ɔnnom, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom ngyaa ma yɛnhwɛ dɛ Elija bɛba ebeyi no anaa.
Na Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu no, ogyaa no sunsum mu.
Na asɔrdan no mu ntwamutam no tseew ebien fii sor besii ase.
Na ɔhamupanyin a ogyinaa hɔ wɔ ne tsentsendo no, ohun dɛ oegyaa no sunsum mu dɛm no, ɔsee dɛ, Ampaara, nyimpa yi Nyankopɔn Ba a.
Na mbaa bi so wɔ hɔ a wofi ekyir hwɛe: hɔn mu binom nye Mary Magdalene, Mary, James kuma nye Josef hɔn na, nye Salome;
na hɔn so na ɔwɔ Galilii no, wɔkaa no do na wɔsoom no, wɔnye mbaa pii a wɔnye no baa Jerusalɛm.
Na odur ewimbir no, nna ɔyɛ Ahosiesieda, ɔnye da a odzi ahomgyeda no enyim ntsi no,
Josef a ofi Arimatea, baguanyi nyimnyamfo a ɔno so rohwɛ Nyankopɔn ahenman kwan no bae, na osii no bo kɔr Pilate hɔ kɛserɛɛ Jesus no fun no.
Na ɔyɛɛ Pilate nwanwa dɛ oewu dada; na ɔfrɛɛ ɔhamupanyin no bisaa no dɛ owui akyɛr anaa.
Na ɔtsee no wɔ ɔhamupanyin no hɔ no, ɔdze fun no kyɛɛ Josef.
Na ɔtɔɔ ndwera bi, na oyii no dze no kyekyeer ndwera no mu, na ɔdze no too nda a woetwa no ɔbotan bi mu no mu, na opireew ɔbo hiin nda no ano.
Na Mary Magdalene nye Mary, Joses ne na, hwɛɛ mbrɛ wɔdze no toe.
Na ahomgyeda no twaa mu no, Mary Magdalene nye James ne na Mary nye Salome, tɔɔ nduhuam dɛ wɔdze rokɔ akɛsera no.
Na da a odzi dapɛn no kan no n’anapatutuitu na wɔkɔr nda no do, nna ewia epue.
Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Woana bepirew ɔbo no efi nda no ano ama hɛn?
Na wɔtoo hɔn enyi no wohun dɛ woepirew ɔbo no efi hɔ: osiandɛ ɔso kɛsenara.
Na wɔhɛɛn nda no mu no, wohun aberantsɛ bi a ɔtse nyimfa hyɛ atar fufuw tsentsen, na wɔbɔɔ hu.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom mmbɔ hu: hom rohwehwɛ Jesus Nazarɛtnyi a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no; Ɔasoɛr: onnyi ha. Hwɛ mbrɛ wɔdze no toe!
Na hom nkɔ nkɛka nkyerɛ n’esuafo no, ɔnye Peter, dɛ, Oedzi hom enyim kɔ Galilii: hɔ na hom bohu no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsee hom no.
Na wofiir edzi fiir nda no ho guanee, na ahopopo nye ahobow kaa hɔn, na wɔannka hwee annkyerɛ obiara, osiandɛ wosuroi.
[Na ɔsoɛɛr da a odzi dapɛn no kan no anapatutuitu no, odzii kan yii noho kyerɛɛ Mary Magdalene a otuu mbɔnsam esuon fii no mu no.
Na ɔkɔree kɛkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔnye no tsenae a woridzi nkɔmbɔ na worusu no.
Na hɔn dze wɔtsee dɛ ɔtse ase na oehu no no, wɔanngye enndzi.
Na n’ekyir no woyii no wɔ suban fofor mu kyerɛɛ hɔn mu beenu a wɔnam rokɔ ekuraase;
na hɔn so kɔree kɛkaa kyerɛɛ nkaa no; na wɔanngye hɔn so enndzi.
N’ekyir no a dubiako no tse edzidzi no, woyii no kyerɛɛ hɔn, na otwuuw hɔn enyim wɔ hɔn ekyingye nye hɔn akoma dzen ntsi, osiandɛ wɔanngye hɔn a wohun no dɛ ɔasoɛr no enndzi.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ wiadze nyinara nkɛka asɛmpa no nkyerɛ abɔdze nyina.
Nyia ɔgye dzi na wonuma no no, obenya nkwa, na nyia ɔnngye nndzi no, wobobu no fɔ.
Na nsɛnkyerɛdze yi bɛka hɔn a wɔgye dzi do: wɔnam me dzin do botu mbɔnsam; wɔbɛkasa kasa fofor;
wɔbɛma nwɔ do, na sɛ wɔnom bɔr biara a, ɔrennyɛ hɔn hwee; wɔdze hɔn nsa bogu ayarfo do na hɔn ho ayɛ hɔn dzen.
Na afei Ewuradze Jesus kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn ekyir no, wɔfaa no kɔr sor, na ɔkɛtsenaa Nyankopɔn abanyimfa.
Na hɔn dze, wofii hɔ kɔree kɛkaa asɛm no wɔ mbea nyina, Ewuradze nye hɔn yɛɛ edwuma, na ɔdze nsɛnkyerɛdze hyɛɛ asɛm no dzen.] Amen.
Ɔnam dɛ dodowara dze ato hɔn do dɛ wɔbɛkyerɛw ndzɛmba a aba mu wɔ hɛn mu no esiado esiado,
dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a ahyɛse no wɔdze hɔn enyiwa hunii na wɔyɛɛ asɛm no ho asomfo no dze abrɛ hɛn no ntsi;
Onyimnyamfo Kɛse Teofilus, mohwɛ a oye ma mo so dɛ mahwehwɛ ne nyina mu pɛpɛɛpɛ fitsi ahyɛse yi, mekyerɛw no esiado esiado brɛ wo,
ama eehu nsɛm a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ wo no no mu nokwar.
Judea ɔhen Herod n’aber do no, nna ɔsɔfo bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Zekaria a ofi Abija no kuw mu; na ne yer nye Aaron ne mbabaa no mu bi a wɔfrɛ no Elizabet.
Nna hɔn beenu nyina yɛ atseneneefo wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim, na wodzii Ewuradze ne mbransɛm ɔnye n’ahyɛdze no nyina do, dɛ asɛm biara ho nnyi,
mbom nna wonnyi ba, osiandɛ nna Elizabet yɛ ɔbɔnyin, na afei hɔn beenu nyina so enyinyin papaapa.
Da bi nna esi n’asɔfokuw do dɛ wɔyɛ edwuma wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim,
na dɛ mbrɛ asɔfo dwuma no ne nhyehyɛɛ tse no, wɔtwee tonto yii no dɛ ɔnkɔ Ewuradze asɔrdan no mu nkɛhyew eduhuam.
Na ber a ɔrehyew eduhuam no, nna ɔman no nyimpadodow nyina gyina abowano rosɔr.
Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe begyinaa eduhuam afɔrmbukyia no nyimfa yii noho kyerɛɛ no.
Na Zekaria hun no no, n’akoma tui, na hu kaa no.
Na bɔfo no see no dɛ, Mma nnsuro, Zekaria, na wɔatse wo nkotoserɛ, na wo yer Elizabet bɔwo babanyin ama wo, na ato no dzin John.
Na ibenya dɛw nye enyigye, na nyimpa dodowara bedzi n’awoo ho dɛw.
Na ɔbɛyɛ kɛse wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na ɔnnkɔnom wenyin anaaso nsa biara, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bɛhyɛ no ma fi ne na ne yamu mpo.
Na ɔbɛdan Israelmba dodowara aba Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn hɔ.
Na ɔnam Elija no sunsum nye no tum mu bedzi n’enyim akɛdan egyanom hɔn akoma aba hɔn mba ho, nye asoɔdzenfo aba tseneneefo hɔn nyimdzee mu, na oesiesie ɔman a wɔaboaboa hɔnho ama Ewuradze.
Na Zekaria see bɔfo no dɛ, Mubodua dɛn mehu yi? Osiandɛ meyɛ akɔdaa na me yer so edzi mfe pii.
Na bɔfo no buae see no dɛ, Emi nye Gabriel a migyina Nyankopɔn enyim, na wɔasoma me dɛ membɛkasa nkyerɛ wo, na menka wo nsɛmpa yi.
Na hwɛ, ebɔtɔ mmum, na irunntum nnkasa dze akɛpem da a yinom bɛyɛ hɔ, osiandɛ anngye me nsɛm a ɔbɛba mu wɔ n’aber do no enndzi.
Na ɔyɛɛ nkorɔfo a wɔrotweɔn Zekaria no nwanwa dɛ ɔakyɛr dɛm wɔ asɔrdan no mu.
Na opuei no, oenntum annkasa annkyerɛ hɔn; na wohun dɛ oekenya enyido adzehu bi wɔ asɔrdan mu hɔ; na ɔnodze, ɔkɔr do araa dze ne nsa yɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze osiandɛ nna ɔda ho araa tɔ mmum.
Na ɔbaa dɛ no som nda wiee du no, osii mu kɔr nankasa ne fie.
Na nda no ekyir no ne yer Elizabet nyinsenii na osumaa noho abosoom enum see dɛ,
Dza Ewuradze ayɛ me, wɔ nda a ɔabɔhwɛ me dɛ obeyi m’enyimguase wɔ nyimpa mu no, nye yi.
Na bosoom a otsia esia no mu no, Nyankopɔn somaa ɔbɔfo Gabriel wɔ Galilii kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Nazarɛt,
wɔ ɔbaabun bi a wɔdze no ama ɔbanyin bi a wɔfrɛ no Josef a ofi David ebusua mu no awar no hɔ; na ɔbaabun no ne dzin dze Mary.
Na ɔbaa no hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, Ei, ɔwo a wɔadom wo kɛse, dzi dɛw! Ewuradze dzi w’ekyir.
Na n’akoma tui wɔ kasa no ho, na ɔdwendween ne tsir mu dɛ ebɛn nkyia na iyi bɛyɛ.
Na ɔbɔfo no see no dɛ, Mary, mma nnsuro, na enya Nyankopɔn enyim adom.
Na hwɛ, ibenyinsen, na awo babanyin na ato no dzin JESUS.
Ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ kɛse, na wɔbɛfrɛ no nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no ne Ba; na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze n’egya David ahengua no bɛma no,
na obedzi Jakob fi do hen daapem, na n’ahendzi nnkɔbɔ adze da.
Na Mary see ɔbɔfo no dɛ, Minnyim banyin yi, yinom besi dɛn aba mu?
Na bɔfo no buae see no dɛ, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bɛba wo do, na nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no n’ahoɔdzen bɛkata wo do; dɛm ntsi so adze krɔnkrɔn a wɔbɔwo no no, wɔbɛfrɛ no Nyankopɔn Ba.
Na hwɛ, wo busuanyi Elizabet so enyinsen babanyin wɔ ne mberwaber mu, na nyia wɔfrɛ no ɔbɔnyin no, n’abosoom esia nye yi.
Na Nyankopɔn afamu dze, biribiara nnyi hɔ a onntum nnyɛ hɔ.
Na Mary see dɛ, Hwɛ, Ewuradze afonabaa nye me: ɔnyɛ hɔ mma me dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm se. Na bɔfo no fii ne nkyɛn kɔree.
Na nda no mu ara Mary soɛɛr ntsɛntsɛm kɔr Juda nkokodo nkurow no bi mu;
na ɔkɛhɛɛn Zekaria fie kekyiaa Elizabet.
Na ɔbaa dɛ Elizabet tsee Mary ne nkyia no, ɔba no huruuw ne yamu; na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn hyɛɛ Elizabet ma,
na ɔdze ndze kɛse kasae see dɛ, Nhyira aka wo wɔ mbasiafo mu, na nhyira aka wo yamu aba.
Na iyi fi hen ba mo hɔ, dɛ m’Ewuradze ne na bɛba me nkyɛn?
Na hwɛ, ntsɛmara a wo nkyia twaa m’asomu no, na abofra no dze dɛw huruhuruwii wɔ mo mu.
Na nhyira aka nyia ɔagye edzi: na dza Ewuradze ama wɔabɛka akyerɛ no no bɛba mu.
Na Mary see dɛ: Me kra tonton Ewuradze,
Na mo sunsum dzi dɛw wɔ me Nyankopɔn m’Agyenkwa no mu.
Osiandɛ ɔabɔhwɛ n’afonabaa wɔ ne mbrɛadze asetsena mu: Na hwɛ, ofitsi ndɛ ebusuasantsen nyina bɛfrɛ me osiarfo.
Osiandɛ Otumfo ayɛ adze kɛse ama me; na Ne dzin nye krɔnkrɔn.
Na n’ehumbɔbɔr wɔ hɔn a wosuro no do fi ebusuasantsen do kɛpem ebusuasantsen.
Ɔdze ne basa akyerɛ ahoɔdzen, Ɔapansam nkontompɔfo wɔ hɔn akoma adwen mu.
Oetu etumfo efi hɔn nhengua do, Na ɔama hɔn a wɔbrɛ adze no do.
Ɔdze ndzepa amee hɔn a ɔkɔm dze hɔn, na oegya ahonyafo kwan wɔ yafumpan mu.
Oesuo n’akowaa Israel mu dɛ ɔdze bɛkaa n’ehumbɔbɔr,
dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom no, ama Abraham nye n’asefo daa.
Na Mary nye Elizabet tsenaa bɛyɛ abosoom ebiasa, na ɔsanee kɔr noara ne fie.
Na Elizabet n’aber a ɔdze bɔwo durii, na ɔwoo babanyin.
Na no sɔnmufo nye n’ebusuafo tsee ehumbɔbɔr kɛse a Ewuradze dze ehu no, na wɔnye no dzii dɛw.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaawɔtwe soe no, wɔbaa dɛ worubotwa abofra no twatsia, na wɔpɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ wɔbɛfrɛ no Zekaria, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya ne dzin tse,
naaso ne na buae see dɛ, Oho, na wɔbɛfrɛ no John.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, Obiara nnyi w’ebusua mu a ne dzin dze dɛm.
Na wɔdze nsa bisaa n’egya dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ dɛ wɔfrɛ no.
Na obisaa kyerɛwpon kyerɛɛw do dɛ, Ne dzin nye John. Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina nwanwa.
Na n’ano nye ne tɛkyerɛma buee amonmu hɔ ara, na ɔkasae yii Nyankopɔn ayɛw.
Na hu kaa hɔn a wɔtsetse hɔn nkyɛn nyina, na nsɛm yi nyina wɔkekae wɔ Judea nkokodo nkurow nyina mu.
Na hɔn a wɔtsee nyina dze too hɔn akoma mu dɛ, Abofra bɛn na oyi bɛyɛ? Osiandɛ Ewuradze ne nsa wɔ no do.
Na n’egya Zekaria dze, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bɛhyɛɛ no ma na ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm dɛ,
Nhyira nka Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn; Osiandɛ ɔabɔhwɛ no nkorɔfo na ɔapon hɔn,
Na ɔama nkwagye ambɛn do ama hɛn Wɔ n’akowaa David fie,
dɛ mbrɛ ɔnam no nkɔnhyɛfo krɔnkrɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ fi tsetse no hɔn ano do kae no,
dɛ wɔngye hɛn mfi hɛn atamfo nye hɔn a wokyir hɛn nyina nsamu;
Dɛ ɔbɛyɛ ehumbɔbɔr ama hɛn egyanom, na ɔakaa n’ahyɛmu krɔnkrɔn no;
ntam a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɛn egya Abraham,
dɛ ɔbɛma woeyi hɛn efi hɛn atamfo nsamu, na yɛasom no dɛ hu nnyi mu,
wɔ ahotsewee nye tsenenee mu wɔ n’enyim hɛn nkwa nda nyina.
Na ɔwo abofra yi, wɔbɛfrɛ wo nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no nkɔnhyɛnyi: Osiandɛ ibedzi Ewuradze n’enyim kan ekesiesie n’akwan mu,
dze nkwagye ho nyimdzee akɛma no nkorɔfo wɔ hɔn bɔnfakyɛ mu a
ofi hɛn Nyankopɔn n’ayamuhyehye mbɔbɔrhu no mu, a ɔnam do ma adzekyee a ofi sor abɔhwɛ hɛn no,
dɛ ɔbɛhyerɛn ama hɔn a wɔtsetse sum mu nye owu no sunsuma ase; na wɔatsentsen hɛn anan akɔ asomdwee kwan no do.
Na abofra no nyinii, na ɔyɛɛ dzen wɔ sunsum mu; na ɔtsenaa sar no do kodur da a ɔdze noho kɛkyerɛɛ Israel.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu no, mbra bi fii Kaesar Augustus hɔ baa dɛ wɔnkan wiadze nyina nkyerɛw hɔn edzin.
Iyi nye ɔkankyerɛw asɔpɔn no a wɔyɛɛ no ber a Kerinius dzi Siria ambrado no.
Na nyimpa nyina kɔr hɔnara hɔn nkurow mu dɛ wɔnkyerɛw hɔn dzin.
Na Josef so fii Galilii, wɔ Nazarɛt kurow no mu, kɔr Judea, David kurow a wɔfrɛ no Bɛtlɛhɛm no mu, osiandɛ ofi David fie nye n’ebusua mu ntsi,
ama wɔaakan ɔno nye n’esiyer Mary a ne yafun no enyin no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔwɔ hɔ no, ne nda a ɔsɛ dɛ ɔdze wo durii.
Na ɔwoo n’abakan banyimba, na ɔdze adasoe kyekyeer no ho, na ɔdze no too mbowa edzidzidaka mu, osiandɛ ɔkwan nnyi ahɔhodan no mu ma hɔn.
Nna nguanhwɛfo bi wɔ ɔman no ara mu, da haban mu roweɔn hɔn nguankuw anadwe.
Na Ewuradze bɔfoe begyinaa hɔn nkyɛn, na Ewuradze n’enyimnyam hyerɛnee bɔɔ hɔn ho aprɔw, na hu kaa hɔn kɛse.
Na ɔbɔfo no see hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro; na hwɛ, mebrɛ hom nsɛmpa a ɔyɛ dɛw kɛse a ɔbɛyɛ aman nyina dze,
na ndɛ wɔawo Agyenkwa ama hom wɔ David kurow mu, ɔno nye Kraest Ewuradze.
Na iyi nye hom asɛnkyerɛdze: hom bohu abofra bi dɛ ɔkyekyer adasoe mu da mbowa edzidzidaka mu.
Na awerɛfir mu ara ɔsor dɔm pii bɛkaa ɔbɔfo no ho yii Nyankopɔn ayɛw see dɛ,
Enyimnyam nka Nyankopɔn wɔ sorsor, Na asomdwee nka nyimpa a wɔsɔ n’enyi wɔ asaase do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ abɔfo no fii hɔn nkyɛn kɔr sor no, nguanhwɛfo no sesee hɔnho dɛ, Hom mma yɛnkɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm nkɔhwɛ dza ɔaba a Ewuradze eyi akyerɛ hɛn yi.
Na wɔbaa ntsɛntsɛm, na wobohun Mary nye Josef nye abofra no dɛ ɔda mbowa edzidzidaka mu.
Na wobohun no no, wɔkaa asɛm a wɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ abofra no ho no ma ɔtahyee.
Na hɔn a wɔtsee nyina, dza nguanhwɛfo no kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa.
Na Mary dze, ɔdze nsɛm yi nyina siei, na ɔdween ho wɔ n’akoma mu.
Na nguanhwɛfo no sanee kɔree kɛhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam na woyii no ayɛw wɔ dza wɔtsee na wokohunii dɛ mbrɛ wɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn nyina tse no.
Na ndaawɔtwe durii a worubotwa no twatsia no, wɔtoo no dzin JESUS, dɛ mbrɛ bɔfo no dze too no ana woribenyinsen no yafun mu no.
Na hɔn ahoguar da no durii dɛ mbrɛ Moses mbra se no, wɔdze no kɔr Jerusalɛm dɛ wɔdze no rekɛkyɛ Ewuradze,
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no Ewuradze ne mbra mu dɛ, Banyimba biara a obobue awotoa ano no, wɔbɛfrɛ no krɔnkrɔn ama Ewuradze,
na wɔakɔbɔ afɔr dɛ mbrɛ wɔkaa no Ewuradze mbra no mu no, Ntamram ebien, anaadɛ mbuburmba ebien.
Na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi wɔ Jerusalɛm a ne dzin dze Simeon; na ɔyɛ nyimpa nyamesuronyi a ɔtsen, ɔrotweɔn Israel awerɛkyekyer, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn wɔ no do.
Na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn yii kyerɛɛ no dɛ onnkohu wu gyedɛ oehu Ewuradze ne Kraest no ana.
Na Sunsum no dze no baa asɔrdan no mu: ber a abofra Jesus n’awofo dze no baa dɛ wɔrebɛyɛ mbrɛ mbra no n’atɔrmuadze tse ama no no.
Nna Simeon faa no too n’abaw mu, yii Nyankopɔn ayɛw na afei ɔkaa dɛ,
Ewuradze, nkyii gya w’akowaa kwan asomdwee mu, dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm se;
Osiandɛ m’enyiwa ehu wo nkwagye a
Esiesie wɔ amanaman nyina enyim;
Ɔkandzea a ɔbɛma amanamamfo do atsew, Na wo man Israel enyimnyam.
Na ɔyɛɛ abofra no n’egya nye ne na nwanwa wɔ dza wɔkaa no wɔ no ho no ho;
na Simeon hyiraa hɔn, na ɔsee ne na Mary dɛ, Hwɛ, oyi na wɔdze no esi hɔ ama Israel mu dodowara hɔn asehwe nye hɔn soɛr, ɔnye asɛnkyerɛdze a wɔbɛkasa etsia no;
ama akoma dodowara mu adwen aada edzi, na ɔwoara so nkrantsee bohwira w’akoma mu.
Nna Anna, ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi bi a ɔyɛ Fanuel babaa a ofir Aser ebusuakuw mu wɔ hɔ: oenyin, na ɔwaar ne nkataasiaber mu nye no kun tsenaa mfe esuon,
na ɔayɛ okunafo bɛyɛ mfe eduowɔtwe anan, na ɔammpa asɔrdan mu da, na ɔdze akɔnkyen nye mpaabɔ som Nyankopɔn adzekyee nye adzesaa.
Na dɔn no ara mu, no so bae beyii Nyankopɔn ayɛw, na ɔkaa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔrotweɔn dɛ wɔbɔpon Jerusalɛm no nyina.
Na wowiee dza Ewuradze mbra se nyina yɛ no, wɔsanee kɔr hɔnankasa hɔn kurow Nazarɛt a ɔwɔ Galilii mu.
Na abofra no nyinii, na ɔyɛɛ ndam, na nyansa hyɛɛ no ma, na Nyankopɔn adom wɔ no do.
Na n’awofo no kɔr Jerusalɛm afe nyina wɔ apaho afahyɛ no mu.
Na odzii mfe duebien no, wɔkɔr Jerusalɛm dɛ mbrɛ afahyɛ n’atɔrmuadze tse,
na wodzii nda no wiei na wɔresan akɔ no, abofra Jesus no kaa ekyir wɔ Jerusalɛm a nna n’egya nye ne na dze, wonnyim;
na wosusuu dɛ ɔafora dɔm no mu ntsi, wɔnantseew dakor kwansin na wɔkɔhwehwɛɛ no wɔ hɔn ebusuafo nye hɔn amanyimfo mu;
na woennhu no no, wɔsanee kɔr Jerusalɛm kɔhwehwɛɛ no.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaansa durii no, wokohun no wɔ asɔrfi no mu dɛ ɔtse akyerɛkyerɛfo no finimfin, oritsie hɔn na oribisabisa hɔn nsɛm;
na hɔn a wotsiee no nyina, ne ntseasee nye ne mbuae yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa.
Na wohun no no, hɔn ho boow hɔn, na ne na see no dɛ, Ɔba, na ɔyɛ dɛn na enye hɛn edzi no dɛm yi? Hwɛ, w’egya nye emi dze yaw na ahwehwɛ wo.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom hwehwɛɛ me ayɛ dɛn? Ana hom nnyim dɛ otwar dɛ metsena m’Egya fie?
Na hɔn dze, wɔanntse asɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no ase.
Na ɔnye hɔn sii mu kɔr Nazarɛt, na ɔbrɛɛ noho adze maa hɔn; na ne na dze, ɔdze nsɛm yi nyina siei wɔ n’akoma mu.
Na Jesus nyinii wɔ nyansa nye honandua mu, na onyaa enyimpa wɔ Nyankopɔn nye nyimpa enyim.

Na Tiberius Kaesar dzi adze, n’afe duenum no mu, na Pontius Pilate dzi Judea ambrado, na Herod dzii Galilii ɔmansinhen, na no nua Filip dzi ɔmansinhen wɔ Iturea nye Trakonitis asaase do, na Lisanias dzi Abilene ɔmansinhen,
na Annas nye Kaiafas dzi asɔfompanyin no, Nyankopɔn asɛm baa Zekaria ne ba John hɔ wɔ sar no do.
Na ɔbaa asaase a abɔ Jordan ho aprɔw nyina, na ɔpaa mu kaa nnuho enuma a ɔdze kɔ bɔnfakyɛ mu no ho asɛm,
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia ne nsɛm nwoma mu dɛ, Obi ne ndze retsea mu wɔ sar no do dɛ, Hom nsiesie Ewuradze no kwan, Hom ntsentsen n’atsempɔn.
Wɔbɛhyɛ mbɔnsa nyina amaama, Mbepɔw nye nkokwaa nyina wɔbɛbrɛ no adze; dza akyeakyea nyina bɛtsentsen, Na akwan a ɔyɛ kekakeka ayɛ trontrom.
Na nyimpa nyina bohu Nyankopɔn no nkwagye.
Na obisaa nyimpadodow a woepue aba dɛ onnuma hɔn no dɛ, Nhurutsia mba! Woana tuu hom fo dɛ hom nguan mfi ebufuw a ɔreba no ho?
Na afei hom nsow aba a ɔfata nnuho na mma hom nnhyɛ ase nnka wɔ hom mu dɛ, Hɛn dze, hɛn egya nye Abraham: na mese hom dɛ Nyankopɔn botum dɛ onyan mba fi abo yi mu ma Abraham.
Na afei so dze, wɔdze abɔndua no ato ndua no ndwow ho dada, dɛ dua biara a ɔnnsow aba pa no wobotwa no ato gya mu.
Na nyimpadodow no bisaa no dɛ, Na yɛnyɛ dɛn?
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Nyia ɔwɔ sorntar ebien, wɔmma ɔmma nyimpa a onnyi bi no bi; na nyia ɔwɔ edziban so, wɔmma ɔnyɛ dɛmara.
Na atowgyefo bi baa dɛ onnuma hɔn, na wobisaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yɛnyɛ dɛn?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nngye mma ɔnnkyɛn dza wɔahyɛ ato hɔ.
Na asogyafo bi so bisaa no dɛ, Hɛn so yɛnyɛ dɛn? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnyɛ obiara heihei, eso mma hom nntoatoa obiara gyan, na hom mma hom akatua nsɔ hom enyi.
Na ɔman no hɔn enyiwa daa kwan, na hɔn nyina susui wɔ hɔn akoma mu wɔ John ho dɛ gyama ɔno nye Kraest no,
John buae see hɔn nyina dɛ, Emi dze, munuma hom nsu mu; na nyia no ho yɛ dzen kyɛn me no reba a no nsokota ho ahoma mpo, mennsɛ dɛ mesan: ɔno na obonuma hom wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, na gya mu;
ɔno na no nhuwdo apaawa kitsa ne nsamu, dɛ ɔrebɛpra ne famu hɔ kofee, na ɔaboaboa n’ewifua ano ekogu san do, na ntsɛw no ɔdze gya a onndum ahyew.
Na ndzɛmba pii ka ho wɔ n’afotu mu a ɔdze kaa nsɛmpa kyerɛɛ nkorɔfo no.
Naaso ɔmansinhen Herod a nna ɔnam no nua ne yer Herodias, nye emumuyɛ bi so a ɔno Herod ayɛ ma John etwuw n’enyim ntsi no,
dze ne nyina kaa ho na ɔdze John too efiadze.
Na aber a ogu do runuma nkorɔfo nyina no, Jesus so bae ma wonumaa no, na ɔrobɔ mpaa no, sor buei,
na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn sianee wɔ honam subea mu, tse dɛ ebubur baa no do, na ndze bi fi sor bae dɛ, Ɔwo nye mo Dɔba a esɔ m’enyi.
Jesus hyɛɛ n’edwuma ase no nna oedzi bɛyɛ mfe eduasa; na, (dɛ mbrɛ nkorɔfo dwenee no,) ɔyɛ Josef a Heli woo no no ne ba, na Heli so n’egya nye
Mattat a n’egyanom santsen nye; Levi, Melki, Janai, Josef,
Matatias, Amos, Nahum, Esli, Naggai,
Maat, Matatias, Semein, Josek, Joda,
Joanan, Resa, Zerubabel, Sealtiel, Neri,
Melki, Addi, Kosam, Elmadam, Er,
Jesus, Eliezer, Jorim, Mattat, Levi,
Simeon, Judas, Josef, Jonam, Eliakim,
Melea, Menna, Mataata, Natan, David,
Jesse, Obed, Boaz, Salmon, Nahshon,
Amminadab, Arni, Hezron, Perez, Juda,
Jakob, Isaak, Abraham, Tera, Nahor,
Serug, Reu, Peleg, Eber, Sela,
Kainan, Arfakad, Sem, Noa, Lamek,
Metusela, Enok, Jared, Mahalaleel, Kainan,
Enos, Set, na Adam a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn ne ba no.
Jesus a nna Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ no ma no, sanee fii Jordan ho, na Sunsum no dze no duaduaa sar no do adaduanan,
na abɔnsam sɔɔ no hwɛe. Na nda no mu no oenndzi hwee; na owiei no, ɔkɔm dzee no.
Na abɔnsam see no dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, hyɛ ɔbo yi ma ɔndan paanoo.
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Nnyɛ paanoo nko bi na nyimpa nam do bɛtsena ase.
Na ɔdze no kɔr beebi a ɔkrɔn kɛkyerɛɛ no wiadze ahenman nyina prɛko pɛr.
Na abɔnsam see no dɛ, Ɔwo na medze tum yi nyina nye no mu enyimnyam bɛma wo: osiandɛ wɔdze ahyɛ me nsa, na obi a mepɛ no, medze mema no.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ ebɔsɔr wɔ m’enyim a, ne nyina bɛyɛ wodze.
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Sɔr Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na no nko na som no.
Na ɔdze no kɔr Jerusalɛm, dze no kesii asɔrfi ne bea sorɔnsorɔm no do, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, tow woho fi ha kyen famu:
na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Ɔbɛhyɛ n’abɔfoe mbra wɔ wo ho, dɛ wɔmbɔ wo ho ban,
na, Wɔbɔsoa wo hɔn nsamu, Amma aammfa wo nan ammpem ɔbo da.
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Wɔaka dɛ, Mma nnsɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ.
Na abɔnsam wiee no nsɔhwɛ nyina no, ogyaa no hɔ kakra.
Na Jesus nam Sunsum n’ahoɔdzen mu sanee baa Galilii, na ne nka tahyee nkurow a woetwa ehyia nyina mu.
Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn nhyiamudan no mu, na hɔn nyina hyɛɛ no enyimnyam.
Na ɔbaa Nazarɛt, mbrɛ wɔtsetsee no no, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ ɔyɛ no, ɔkɔr nhyiamudan no mu ahomgyeda no, na ɔsoɛree gyinaa dɛ ɔrebɛkenkan.
Na wɔdze nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia no nwoma no maa no, Na ɔtserɛɛw nwoma no mu, na ohun bea a wɔakyerɛw no hɔ dɛ,
Ewuradze no Sunsum wɔ mo do, osiandɛ ɔasera me ngo dɛ membɛka nsɛmpa nkyerɛ ehiafo. Ɔasoma me dɛ membɛpaa ɔgye mma ndɔmmumfo, na mumbue enyifurafo enyi, na membɛgye hɔn a wɔretseetsee hɔn no,
na membɛda afe a Ewuradze n’enyimpa bɛba no nkorɔfo do no edzi.
Na ɔbobɔɔw nwoma no, na ɔdze maa ɔsomfo no, na ɔtsenaa ase; na hɔn a wɔwɔ nhyiamudan mu hɔ nyina, hɔn enyiwa tsiim no do.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ase kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Ndɛ na kyerɛw yi aba mu wɔ hom asowa mu.
Na hɔn nyina dzii no dase, na adom nsɛm a ofii n’anomu no yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa; na wɔsee dɛ, Ana nnyɛ Josef ba no nye yi?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ampaara, hom dze bɛ yi bobu me: Ɔsafo, sa woho yarba: biribiara a yɛatse dɛ wɔyɛe wɔ Karpernaum no, yɛ no wankasa wo kurow mu ha so.
Na ɔsee dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi biara, wɔmmpɛ no noara no kurow mu.
Na meka no nokwar kyerɛ hom dɛ, Elija n’aber do a wɔtoow ɔsor mu mfensa abosoom esia no na ɔkɔm kɛsenara sii asaase nyina do no, nna ekunafo pii wɔ Israel;
naaso wɔannsoma Elija wɔ hɔn mu biara hɔ, gyedɛ Sidon kurow Zarefat mu, wɔ ɔbaa kunafo bi hɔ.
Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Elisha n’aber do no, nna akwatafo pii wɔ Israel; na wɔamma hɔn mu biara ho annsan, gyedɛ Sirianyi Naaman.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ nhyiamudan no mu nyina, wɔtsee dɛm asɛm yi no, ebufuw hyɛɛ hɔn ma;
na wɔsoɛree sunsuun no fii kurow no mu, dze no kɔr koko a hɔn kurow no si do no no kɔn do, dɛ wɔrokɔwɔ no akɔmfo.
Na ɔno dze, ɔnam hɔn finimfin kɔree.
Na ɔkɔr Galilii kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Karpernaum mu. Nna ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ hɔn fa ahomgyeda no ho;
na ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ hɔn ahobow, osiandɛ n’asɛm dze tum nam.
Na nyimpa bi wɔ nhyiamudan no mu a ɔwɔ sunsum fi, na ɔdze ndze kɛse kaa mu dɛ
Aa! Ebɛnadze na yɛnye wo wɔ yɛ, Jesus Nazarɛtnyi? Ana ebae dɛ erebɛsɛɛ hɛn? Minyim wo nyimpaban, Nyankopɔn no Hotseweenyi no.
Na Jesus bɔɔ no ham see dɛ, Ka w’ano to mu, na fi no mu fi. Na abɔnsam no twaa no hwee hɔn finimfin no, nna ofii no mu firii, a ɔannyɛ no hwee.
Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina ahobow, na wɔkekaa kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔnho dɛ, Ebɛn asɛm nye yi, dɛɔdze tum nye ahoɔdzen hyɛ esunsum fi ma wotu kɔ?
Na no ho asɛm tahyee aman a woetwa ehyia hɔ no nkurow nyina mu.
Na ɔsoɛree fii nhyiamudan no mu baa Simon fie. Nna papu kɛse aka Simon n’asew, na wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ no.
Na okegyinaa no do tseaa yarba no, ma ofii no do, na ɔsoɛɛr ntsɛmara soom hɔn.
Na wi rokɔtɔ no, hɔn a wɔwɔ ayarfo a yarba horow rehaw hɔn nyina dze hɔn brɛɛ no, ma ɔdze ne nsa too hɔn nyina do nkorkor yɛɛ hɔn edur.
Na mbɔnsam so fii dodowara mu firii, na wɔkaa mu kɛse see dɛ, Ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn Ba no. Na ɔbɔɔ hɔn ham, na ɔamma hɔn kwan dɛ wɔnkasa, osiandɛ wonyim dɛ ɔno nye Kraest no.
Na adze kyee no, osii mu kɔr sar bi do, na nyimpadodow no hwehwɛɛ no, na wokodur ne nkyɛn no, wosiankaa no dɛ mma ommfi hɔn nkyɛn nnkɔ.
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Otwar dɛ meka Nyankopɔn ahenman ho nsɛmpa kyerɛ nkurow bi so, osiandɛ iyi ntsi na wɔsomaa me.
Na ɔkɛkaa asɛm no wɔ Judea nhyiamudan mu.
Ber bi a nna Jesus gyina Genesaret nsutaae ho, na nyimpadɔm akyer no do dɛ woribetsie Nyankopɔn n’asɛm no;
ohun ahɛn ebien dɛ wogyinagyina nsutaae no do: na afarfo no efi mu rokɔhor hɔn mboa.
Na ɔkɔr hɛn no kor a ɔyɛ Simon dze no no mu, na ɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔnkwan mfi daadze kakra. Na ɔtsenaa ase na ofi hɛn no mu kyerɛkyerɛɛ nyimpadodow no.
Na ogyaa kasa no, ɔsee Simon dɛ, Kwan kɔ mbrɛ ɔdɔ, na hom nkɔtow hom mboa mfa nam.
Na Simon buae see dɛ, Yewura, yɛayɛ edwuma anafua yi nyina, a yeennya hwee; naaso w’asɛm ntsi mobɔtow eboa no.
Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm no, wɔpaa nam pii, ma nkyɛ hɔn mboa retsetsew.
Na wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ afarfo bi a wɔwɔ hɛn kor no mu dɛ wɔmbra mbɔboa hɔn. Na wɔbae bɛhyɛɛ ahɛn ebien nyina amaama, ma nkyɛ wɔreyɛ esiw mpo.
Na Simon Peter hunii no, ɔhwee Jesus n’ananadze see dɛ, Ao Ewuradze, fi me nkyɛn kɔ, na meyɛ nyimpa dzebɔnyɛnyi.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔno nye hɔn a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ nyina ahobow, wɔ nam dodow a wɔfae no ntsi;
na dɛm ara so na ɔyɛɛ James nye John, Zebedee mba no a wɔnye Simon yɛ apofo no. Na Jesus see Simon dɛ, Mma nnsuro: na ofitsi ndɛ ibonu nyimpa.
Na wɔdze hɔn ahɛn bodwiir daadze no, wɔdaan ne nyina gyae, na wɔkaa no do.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔwɔ nkurow no mu kor mu no, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi a kwata ayɛ no ho ma baa hɔ; na ohun Jesus no, ɔdze n’enyim butuuw famu, na ɔserɛɛ no see dɛ, Mo wura, sɛ epɛ a, ibotum dɛ ema mo ho san.
Na ɔtseen ne nsa dze kaa no see dɛ, Mepɛ, wo ho nsan. Na ntsɛmara na kwata no fii no ho.
Na ɔbraa no dɛ: mma nnka nnkyerɛ obiara; kɔ, fa woho kɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no, na w’ahosan ntsi kotua dza Moses hyɛe no fa yɛ dase ma hɔn.
Na afei dze ne nka tahyee mbordo, na nyimpadodow pii behyiaa dɛ woribetsie no, na ɔasa hɔn nyarbanyarba.
Na ɔtwee noho kɔr sar no do kɔsɔree.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da bi ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no, nna Farisiifo nye mbra no n’akyerɛkyerɛfo a wofi Galilii, Judea nye Jerusalɛm nkurow nyina mu aba tsetse hɔ; na Ewuradze n’ahoɔdzen wɔ no do dɛ ɔdze bɛsa yarba.
Na hwɛ, mbanyin bi dze nyimpa bi a ɔyar mbubui da mpa do bae, na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wobenya kwan dze no abɔto n’enyim.
Na woennya kwan a wɔdze no bodua mu aba wɔ nyimpadodow no ntsi no, wɔkɔr dan no etsifi, na wɔdze no duaa dan no nkurii no mu wɔ ne mpa do besii finimfin wɔ Jesus n’enyim.
Na ohun hɔn gyedzi no, ɔsee dɛ, Nyimpa, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo.
Na akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo no hyɛɛ ase dwendween dɛ, Na woana nye yi a ɔreka ebususɛm yi? Woana botum dze bɔn akyɛ gyedɛ Nyankopɔn nko?
Na Jesus hun hɔn adwendwen no, obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom rodwendwen wɔ hom akoma mu yi?
Dza ɔwɔ hen na ɔyɛ mberɛw kɛse, dɛ ebɛse dɛ, Wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo; anaa ebɛse dɛ, Soɛr na nantsew a?
Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma hom ehu dɛ nyimpa Ba no wɔ tum wɔ asaase do dɛ ɔdze bɔn kyɛ no ntsi, (ɔkaa kyerɛɛ nyia ɔyar mbubui no dɛ,) Mese wo dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo mpa na kɔ wo fie.
Na, ntsɛmara ɔsoɛree wɔ hɔn enyim na ɔfaa dza ɔda do no, na osii mu kɔr ne fie, a ɔrehyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Na ahobow kaa hɔn nyina, na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam; na hu kɛse kaa hɔn ma wɔkaa dɛ, Yeehu anwanwadze ndɛ.
Na iyi ekyir no, opuei na okohun towgyenyi bi a ne dzin dze Levi, dɛ ɔtse atowgyebea, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ka mo do.
Na ɔdaan biribiara gyae, na ɔsoɛree kaa no do.
Na Levi too no pon kɛsenara wɔ ne fie; na atowgyefo nye nkorɔfo bi, nyimpadodow kɛsenara, nye hɔn bɛtsenatsenaa ho.
Na Farisiifo nye hɔn akyerɛwfo no hwinhwinii kyerɛɛ n’esuafo no see dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom nye atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo dzidzi nom yi?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Hɔn a wɔtse hɔn apɔw mu no, wonnhia oduyɛfo, na mbom hɔn a wɔyar no a.
Mammbɛfrɛ atseneneefo, na mbom ndzebɔnyɛfo, dɛ wonnu hɔnho.
Na wɔsee no dɛ, John n’esuafo no dze, wɔtɔ dɛ wodzi mbuada pii, na wɔyɛ nkotoserɛ, na Farisiifo so dɛmara; naaso wodze yi dze, wodzidzi na wɔnom.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Aso hom botum ama ayefor asefo no edzi mbuada aber a ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn no?
Na nda no bɛba, na sɛ woyi ayeforkun no fi hɔn nkyɛn a, ɔno na nda no mu wobedzi mbuada.
Na obuu bɛ yi so kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Obi nntsew tam fofor sin nntaa atar dadaw mu: dɛm no, fofor no dze ɔbɛtsew, osiandɛ sin fofor a ɔdze taa mu no nye dadaw no nnkɛsaa.
Na obi mmfa wenyin fofor nngu nwomatoa dadaw mu: dɛm no, wenyin fofor no bɛpaa nwomatoa no, na obohue egu, na nwomatoa no so bɛsɛɛ.
Na wenyin fofor dze, ɔsɛ dɛ wɔdze gu ntoa fofor mu.
Na obiara nnom wenyin dadaw nwie na ɔnnhwehwɛ fofor. Dza ɔka nye dɛ, Dadaw no ara ye.
Na ɔbaa dɛ okoduaa eburow kwa mu ahomgyeda, na n’esuafo no pempaan eburow mbɛtsem no bi posae wɔ hɔn nsamu wee.
Na Farisiifo no mu binom see dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ dza ɔmmfa kwan mu dɛ wɔyɛ no ahomgyeda yi?
Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan iyi mpo, dza David, aber a ɔkɔm dzee ɔnoara na hɔn a wɔka no ho no, ɔyɛe no?
Mbrɛ ɔkɛhɛɛn Nyankopɔn fie, na ɔkɛfaa kyerɛpaanoo no dzii, na ɔmaa hɔn a wɔka no ho no so bi wɔ ber a ɔmmfa mbra mu dɛ obiara dzi gyedɛ asɔfo no nkotsee no?
Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nyimpa Ba no yɛ ahomgyeda no no wura.
Na ɔbaa dɛ ahomgyeda kor bi so mu, ɔkɔr nhyiamudan mu kɛkyerɛkyerɛe; na nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ne nsa nyimfa adwe.
Na akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo no tsɛɛw no dɛ ɔbɛyɛ edur ahomgyeda no, ama woeenya biribi akɔtoa no.
Na ɔno dze, nna onyim hɔn adwen, ntsi ɔsee nyimpa a ne nsa adwe no dɛ, Soɛr gyina finimfin. Na ɔsoɛree gyinae.
Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Miribisa hom asɛm, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ ahomgyeda wɔbɛyɛ dza oye, anaa wɔbɛyɛ omuo? Wɔbɛgye nkwa, anaa wɔbɛsɛɛ?
Na ɔhwɛɛ hɔn nyina hyiae, na ɔsee no dɛ, Tsen wo nsa. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm, na ne nsa no sanee yɛɛ mu.
Na ebufuhyew hyɛɛ hɔn nyina ma, na wotutuu egyina wɔ adze a wɔdze bɛyɛ Jesus ho.
Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu no, ɔkɔr koko bi do kɔsɔree; na ɔsɔɔr anafua no nyina bɔɔ mpaa kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn.
Na adze kyee no, ɔfrɛɛ n’esuafo no, na ɔpaa hɔn mu duebien a ɔfrɛɛ hɔn asomafo no.
Simon a ɔtoo no Peter, nye no nua Andrew, James, John, Filip nye Bartholomew,
Matthew, Tomas, Alfaeus ba James, Simon a wɔfrɛ no Zealot no,
nye James ne ba Judas, nye Judas Iskariot a oyii no mae no.

Na ɔnye hɔn sianee begyinaa beebi a hɔ taa, nye n’esuafo kuw kɛse no nye ɔman no mu nyimpadodow pii a wofi Judea nyina, Jerusalɛm, Taere nye Sidon mpoano a wɔbae betsiee no no, na wɔbɔhwehwɛɛ ayarsa no;
na hɔn a esunsum fi rehaw hɔn no, na ɔsaa hɔn nyina yarba.
Na nyimpadodow no nyina hwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔdze hɔn nsa bɛka no, osiandɛ tum fii no mu bae bɛsaa hɔn nyina yarba.
Na ɔmaa n’enyi do wɔ n’esuafo no do, na ɔsee dɛ, Nhyira aka hom ehiafo, na hom na Nyankopɔn ahenman no yɛ hom dze.
Nhyira aka hom a ɔkɔm dze hom sesei yi, na wɔbɛma hom amee. Nhyira aka hom a hom rusu sesei yi, na hom bɛserew.
Nhyira aka hom ber a nyimpa bekyir hom, na woeyi hom edzi efi mu, na wɔayaw hom, na wɔatow hom dzin akyen dɛ dzin bɔn wɔ nyimpa Ba no ntsi.
Da no hom ndzi dɛw, na hom ndzi ehurusi: na hwɛ, hom akatua so wɔ sor: na dɛmara na hɔn egyanom dze yɛɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no.
Na hom ahonyafo, hom ndue! Osiandɛ hom enya hom awerɛkyekyer dada.
Hom a hom amee sesei yi, hom ndue! Na ɔkɔm bɛdze hom. Hom a hom serew sesei yi, hom ndue! Na hom bedzi nkɔmbɔ na hom esu.
Aber a nyimpa nyina ka hom ho asɛm pa no, hom ndue! Na dɛmara na hɔn egyanom yɛe maa nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo no.
Na meka kyerɛ hom a hom ritsie yi dɛ, Hom ndɔ hom atamfo, hom nyɛ hɔn a wɔtan hom yie,
hom nhyira hɔn a wɔdom hom, na hom nsɔr mma hɔn a wɔbɔ hom adapaa.
Na nyia ɔbɔ w’aso fakor mu no, dan fakor so ma no; na nyia ɔfa wo nkatado no, mma nnsiw no w’asetar ho kwan.
Obiara a ɔserɛ wo no, ma no; na nyia ɔfa w’adze no, mma mmbisa no bio.
Na dza hom pɛ dɛ nyimpa yɛ ma hom no, hom so nyɛ dɛmara mma hɔn.
Na sɛ hom dɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ hom a, ebɛn ndaase na hom nya? Na ndzebɔnyɛfo mpo dɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ hɔn.
Na sɛ hom yɛ yie ma hɔn a wɔyɛ hom yie a, ebɛn ndaase na hom nya? Na ndzebɔnyɛfo so yɛ dɛmara.
Na sɛ hom dze fɛm hɔn a hom enyi da do dɛ hom nsa bɛka efi hɔn hɔ bio a, ebɛn ndaase na hom nya? Ndzebɔnyɛfo so dze fɛm ndzebɔnyɛfo dɛ hɔn nsa bɛka no bio.
Na mbom hom ndɔ hom atamfo, hom nyɛ papa, na hom mfa mfɛm dɛ hom enyi nnda biribi do, na hom akatua bɔdɔɔ so, na hom ayɛ nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no ne mba, osiandɛ ɔnodze, ɔyɛ adɔyɛ ma etsiafo nye emumuyɛfo.
Hom nyɛ mbɔbɔrhufo, dɛ mbrɛ hom Egya so yɛ mbɔbɔrhunyi no.
Mma hom mmbu atsɛn, na wonnkobu hom atsɛn; mma hom mmbu fɔ, na wonnkobu hom fɔ; hom mfa nkyɛ, na wɔdze akyɛ hom;
hom mma, na wɔama hom: esusudze pa a wɔahohom do na wɔawosow no ma ebu do na wɔdze bogu hom bo mu; na esusudze kor a hom dze susu no, wɔdze bosusu ama hom bio.
Na obuu hɔn bɛ so dɛ, Ana onyifurafo botum akyerɛ onyifurafo kwan? Hɔn beenu nyina nnkɔtɔ mona mu anaa?
Osuanyi nnkyɛn ne kyerɛkyerɛfo, na obiara a oedzi mu no bɛyɛ dɛ ne kyerɛkyerɛfo.
Na ɔyɛ dɛn na ehwɛ duaba a ɔwɔ wo nua enyiwa mu, na ennhwɛ mpuna a ɔwɔ woara w’enyiwa mu no?

Anaadɛ ebɛyɛ dɛn etum ase wo nua dɛ, Onua, ma minyi duaba a ɔwɔ w’enyiwa mu, na wankasa w’enyiwa mu mpuna dze innhu? Ɔwo dabrabanyi, dzi kan yi mpuna fi wankasa w’enyiwa mu: nna ibohu no yie eyi duaba a ɔwɔ wo nua enyiwa mu no.
Dua pa biara nnyi hɔ a ɔsow aba prɔwee na dua prɔwee so nnyi hɔ a ɔsow aba pa.
Na dua biara wɔdze n’aba hu no. Na nyimpa nntsetsew adɔmba wɔ nsoɛ do, na eso wɔnntsetsew wenyinaba wɔ kɔkrɔw do.
Nyimpa pa fi n’akoma mu ndzepa korabea na oyi adze pa pue, na nyimpa bɔn fi ne ndzɛmba bɔn korabea na oyi dza omuo pue: na ofi dza abor do wɔ akoma mu no na ano ka.
Na ɔyɛ dɛn na hom frɛ me Ewuradze, Ewuradze, naaso hom nnyɛ dza mese?
Obiara a ɔba mo hɔ, na otsie m’asɛm, na ɔyɛ no, mebɛkyerɛ hom nyia ɔnye no sɛ:
ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a osii dan, na otui ma ɔdɔe, na ɔtoo fapem wɔ ɔbotan do; na nsu yirii no, esutsen pemee boor dan no, naaso oenntum annwosow no, osiandɛ woesi no yie.
Na nyia otsie na ɔnnyɛ no, ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a osii dan wɔ asaase enyi, na onnyi fapem; ɔno na nsu yirii faa ho no, ɔhwee ase ntsɛmara, na dan no sɛɛe koraa.
Na owiee ne nsɛm no nyina ka wɔ nkorɔfo no asomu no, ɔkɛhɛɛn Karpernaum.
Nna asogyafo do ɔhamupanyin bi n’akowaa a ɔsom no bo kɛse yar ma ɔreyɛ ewu.
Na ɔtsee Jesus ne nka no, ɔsomaa Jewfo mpanyin bi wɔ no hɔ kɛserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmbra mbɛgye n’akowaa no nkwa.
Na wɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn no wɔserɛɛ no enyiberdo see dɛ, Ɔsɛ dɛ ebɛyɛ dɛm adze yi ma no:
osiandɛ ɔdɔ hɛn man, na ɔnoara na osii hɛn nhyiamudan yi.
Na Jesus nye hɔn kɔree. Na ɔrebɛn fie no ho no, ɔhamupanyin no somaa n’anyɛnkofo bi wɔ no hɔ kɛsee no dɛ, Mo wura, mma nnhaw woho: na mennsɛ dɛ ebɛhɛn me hatsɛw ase;
iyi ntsi na memmbu moho dɛ mesɛ dɛ meba wo nkyɛn no; dɛm ntsi ɔwo kasa ara, na m’akowaa no bɛtse apɔw.
Na mo so meyɛ nyimpa a wɔdze me ahyɛ tum ase, na mowɔ nsordaafo wɔ m’ase, na mese yi dɛ, Kɔ a, ɔkɔ; na mese obi so, Bra a, ɔba, na mese m’akowaa dɛ, Yɛ yi a, ɔyɛ.
Na Jesus tsee yinom no, no ho yɛɛ no nwanwa, na ɔsee nyimpadodow a wodzi n’ekyir no dɛ, Mese hom dɛ, Israel mu mpo munnhun gyedzi a ɔtse dɛm yi bi pɛn.
Na hɔn a wɔsomaa hɔn no sanee kɔr fie kohun akowaa no dɛ no ho ayɛ no dzen.
Na ɔbaa dɛ annkyɛr biara na ɔkɔr kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Nain mu; na n’esuafo no nye nyimpadodow pii nye no kɔree.
Na ɔbɛɛn kurow no n’abobow ekyir no, nna wɔso bi a oewu a ɔyɛ ne na ne ba kortsee, rupue, na ɔbaa no yɛ okunafo; na nyimpadodow pii fi kurow no mu ka no ho.
Na Ewuradze hun basia no, ne yamu hyehyee no maa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Mma nnsu.
Na ɔdze ne nsa kɛkaa fundaka no, na hɔn a wɔso no no gyinae; Na ɔsee dɛ, Aberantsɛ, mese wo dɛ, Soɛr.
Na nyia oewu no soɛree, na ɔhyɛɛ ase kasae. Na ɔdze no hyɛɛ ne na nsa.
Na hu kaa hɔn nyina; na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam see dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi kɛse asoɛr wɔ hɛn mu, na, Nyankopɔn abɔhwɛ ne man.
Na no ho asɛm tahyee Judea nyina, nye asaase a etwa ho ehyia nyina mu.
Na John n’esuafo kɛkaa yinom nyina ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no.
Na John frɛɛ n’esuafo mu beenu, na ɔsomaa hɔn Ewuradze hɔ kebisaa no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye nyia ɔreba no, anaa yɛrotweɔn obi so?
Na mbarimba no baa ne nkyɛn no, wɔsee dɛ, John Onumanyi no asoma hɛn wo hɔ dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye nyia ɔreba no, anaa yɛrotweɔn obi so?
Na dɔnhwer kor no ara mu ɔsaa dodowara hɔn nyarba, na oyii hɔn haw nye esunsum fi fii hɔn do, na ɔmaa enyifurafo pii hun adze.
Na obuaa hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɛka dza hom ehu na hom atse yi nkyerɛ John, dɛ enyifurafo hu adze, mbubuafo nantsew, akwatafo ho san, etsitsifo tse asɛm, ewufo nyan, na wɔka asɛmpa kyerɛ ehiafo.
Na nyia mennkɛyɛ no fintsidua no, nhyira aka no.
Na John n’abɔfoe no kɔree no, ɔhyɛɛ ase bisaa nyimpadodow no wɔ John ho dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom kɔr sar no do kɔhwɛe? Ndzɛmbir a mframa rihim no a?
Na ebɛnadze na hom puei kɔhwɛe? Nyimpa a ofura tam papa a? Hwɛ, hɔn a wofura atam hyerɛpɛɛ, na wɔyɛ anomu dɛw no, wɔwɔ ahemfie.
Na ebɛnadze na hom puei kɔhwɛe? Nkɔnhyɛnyi a? Nyew, mese hom dɛ, nyia ɔkyɛn nkɔnhyɛnyi mpo a.
Oyi nye nyia wɔakyerɛw no ho dɛ, Hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe ma oeedzi w’enyim kan a Obesiesie wo kwan edzi w’enyim.
Mese hom dɛ, hɔn a mbaa awo hɔn nyina mu biara mmpuei a ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn John: naaso nyia ɔyɛ aketseaba koraa wɔ sor ahenman no mu no yɛ kɛse kyɛn no.
(Na nkorɔfo a wɔtsee nyina nye atowgyefo no, gyee Nyankopɔn no ndwuma no too mu na wɔdze John n’enuma no numaa hɔn.
Naaso Farisiifo nye mbrakyerɛfo no dze, wɔpoow Nyankopɔn n’apam maa hɔnho, osiandɛ wɔamma oennuma hɔn.)
Dɛm ntsi ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na medze ndɛ mber yi mu nyimpa bɔto ho, na wɔtse dɛ ebɛnadze mpo?
Wɔtse dɛ mbofraba a wɔtsenatsena gua do, na wɔrefrɛfrɛ hɔnho se dɛ, Yɛahɛn atɛntɛbɛn ama hom, na hom annsaw; yeetwa ewuo na hom ennsu.
John Onumanyi no aba, onndzidzi, ɔnnom nsa, na hom se dɛ, Ɔwɔ sunsum bɔn.
Nyimpa Ba no aba, odzidzi na ɔnom, na hom se dɛ, Hwɛ, nyimpa tumfur, nsahweam, atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo nyɛnko!
Naaso nyansa ne mba bu no bem.
Na Farisiifo no mu kor serɛɛ no dɛ ɔnye no nkedzidzi, na ɔkɔr Farisiinyi no ne fie kɛtsenaa edziban ho.
Na ɔbaa bi a ɔwɔ kurow no mu a ɔyɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi; tsee dɛ oridzidzi wɔ Farisiinyi no ne fie no, ɔdze ngohuam alabasta toaba ma bae,
na obegyinaa n’ekyir wɔ n’anan ho sui, na ɔhyɛɛ ase dze ne nyinsuwa fɔɔw n’anan ho, na ɔdze ne tsinhwi pepae, na ɔfeew n’anan ho, na ɔdze ngohuam seraa ho.
Na Farisiinyi a ohyiaa no edzidzi no hunii no, ɔkae wɔ ne tsirmu dɛ, Sɛ oyi yɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi a, nkyɛ obohu onyia kor a, anaa ɔbaa kor a ɔdze ne nsa aka no yi, dɛ ɔyɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi.
Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Simon, mowɔ asɛm bi ka kyerɛ wo. Na ɔsee dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ka.
Bosabɔnyi bi wɔ akafo beenu: baako dze sika denare ahaenum, baako so dze eduonum.
Na wonnya bi nntua no, ɔdze kyɛɛ hɔn beenu nyina kwa. Dɛm ntsi hɔn mu woana bɔdɔ no dodow?
Simon buae see dɛ, Mususu dɛ, nyia ɔdze dodow kyɛɛ no no a. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebua atsɛn pa.
Na ɔdaan n’enyiwa wɔ ɔbaa no do see Simon dɛ, Ehu ɔbaa yi? Mebaa wo fie no, ɔwo amma me me nan ho nsu; naaso ɔnodze, ɔdze ne nyinsuwa afɔw me nan ho, na ɔdze ne tsinhwi apepa.
Ɔwo ammfew m’ano, naaso ɔno dze, ofitsi dɛ mebaa ha yi, onngyaa me nan ho few.
Ɔwo ammfa ngo annsera me tsirmu, naaso ɔno dze, ɔdze ngohuam asera me nan ho mpo.
Dɛm ntsi mese wo dɛ no bɔn a ɔdɔɔ so no, wɔdze akyɛ no, osiandɛ no dɔ dɔɔ so; na nyia wɔdze kumaabi akyɛ no, ɔdɔ kumaabi.
Na ɔsee no dɛ, Wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo.
Na hɔn a wɔnye no tse edzidzi no hyɛɛ ase kae wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, Woana nye oyi a ɔdze bɔn so kyɛ yi?
Na ɔsee ɔbaa no dɛ, Wo gyedzi agye wo: kɔ asomdwee mu.
Na yinom ekyir no, ɔbaa dɛ annkyɛr biara na okoduaduaa nkurow mu nye nkuraase kɛkaa Nyankopɔn n’ahenman no ho asɛmpa no kyerɛe; nna duebien no ka no ho,
nye mbaa bi so a woetu hɔn esunsum bɔn na wɔasa hɔn ahoɔmberɛw yarba: Mary a wɔfrɛ no Magdalene a mbɔnsam esuon efi no mu no,
nye Joana, Herod no somfo panyin Kusa ne yer no, nye Susanna, nye dodowara so a wɔdze hɔn ahodze bi soom no no.
Na nyimpadodow pii boaa ano, na hɔn a wofii nkurow nyina mu baa ne nkyɛn no, obuu hɔn bɛ dɛ,
Ogufo no kɔree koguu n’aba: na ɔrotow petse no, bi koguu kwan nkyɛn, na wotsiatsiaa do, na wimu nnoma bɔsosɔwee.
Bi so koguu ɔbotan do, na ofifirii no, ɔkyenkyenee, osiandɛ onnyi fawin ntsi.
Na bi so koguu nsoɛ finimfin, na nsoɛ no nye no fifirii, na omiaa no.
Bi so koguu asaase pa do, na ofifirii na ɔsoow aba mbɔho ɔha. Na ɔkaa yinom no, ɔtseaa mu dɛ, Nyia ɔwɔ aso a wɔdze tsie no, ma ontsie.
Na n’esuafo no bisaa no dɛ bɛ yi n’ase nye dɛn?
Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom dze, wɔdze ama hom dɛ hom nhu Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu esumasɛm; na nkaa no dze, wɔdze ma hɔn mbɛbu mu, ama wɔhwɛ a, woeennhu, na wɔtse a, wɔaanntse ase.
Na bɛ no n’asekyerɛ nye yi: aba no nye Nyankopɔn n’asɛm no.
Hɔn a wɔwɔ kwan nkyɛn no nye hɔn a woetsie; na abɔnsam ba, na obeyi asɛm no fi hɔn akoma mu, ma wɔaanngye enndzi na wɔaanngye hɔn nkwa.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ ɔbotan do nye hɔn a wotsie a, wɔdze dɛw gye asɛm no; na yinom wonnyi ndwow, na wɔgye dzi ma ɔkyɛr kakra, na nsɔhwɛber ba a nna wɔhwe ase.
Na dza okoguu nsoɛ mu no, yinom nye hɔn a woetsie na wɔrokɔ no, ɔbra yi mu akɔdadwen nye ahonya nye enyigyedze mia hɔn, ma wɔnnsow aba ma ɔmmber yie.
Na dza ɔwɔ asaase pa mu no, yinom nye hɔn a wɔdze akoma pa a oye etsie asɛm no, wɔdze sie, na wɔnam abotar mu sow aba.
Obi nnsɔ kandzea na ɔmmfa kuruw mmbua do, anaa ɔmmfa nnsi mpa ase; na ɔdze si kandzeadua do, ma hɔn a wɔkɔ mu hɔ eehu ne kan.
Na biribi nnsuma a wonnkeyi no edzi, na onnhunta a wonnkohu na ɔnnkɛda gua.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie mbrɛ hom dua tsie; na obiara a ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no, na obiara a onnyi no, dza osusu dɛ ɔwɔ mpo wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
Na ne na nye no nuanom baa ne nkyɛn, na woenntum ammbɛn no wɔ nyimpadodow no ntsi.
Na wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Wo na nye wo nuanom gyina abow enyim rohwehwɛ ehu wo.
Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Me na nye mo nuanom nye woyi a wotsie Nyankopɔn asɛm na wɔyɛ.
Na ɔbaa dɛ da bi ɔnye n’esuafo no kɔr hɛmba mu, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma yentwa nkɔ esuegya no ho, na wɔkwanee kɔree.
Na wɔrokɔ no ɔdae; na mframa kɛse bɔɔ huu baa esu no do, na nkyɛ nsu rehyɛ hɔn hɛmba no ma, nna wɔwɔ amandzehu mu.
Na wɔdze nkekamu baa ne nkyɛn benyaan no see dɛ, Owura, Owura, yɛrehera! Na onyanee no, ɔbraa mframa no nye nsu no ne begyabegya no, na ogyaae, na hɔ taa dzinn.
Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Hom gyedzi wɔ hen? Na wosuroi, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa, na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Woana nye yi a ɔhyɛ mframa nye nsu mpo ma wotsie no yi?
Na wodur Gerasafo asaase do a ɔwɔ Galilii tsentsendo.
Na ofii hɛmba mu kɔr daadze no, ɔbarimba bi a ɔwɔ sunsum fi puei fi kurow no mu behyiaa no: na mber pii nna ɔnnhyɛ atar, ɔnntsena fie biara mu, na mbom abodan mu wɔ esiei na ɔtse.
Na ohun Jesus no, ɔkaa mu, na ɔhwee n’enyim daadze, na ɔdze ndze kɛse see dɛ, Menye wo wɔ ebɛn yɛ, Jesus, Ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn Ba? Meserɛ wo dɛ mma nnhaw me.

Osiandɛ nna Jesus aka akyerɛ sunsum fi no dɛ omfi nyimpa no mu. (Osiandɛ mber pii ɔkyer no, na wɔdze nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn nye mpokyerɛ to no weɔn no; naaso obubu dza wɔdze kyekyer no no mu, na sunsum no pam no kɔ sar do.)
Na Jesus bisaa no dɛ, Wo dzin dze dɛn? Na ɔsee dɛ, Legyin, osiandɛ mbɔnsam pii ahɛn no mu.
Na esunsum bɔn no serɛɛ no dɛ mma ɔnnhyɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnkɔ bun no mu.
