dze kɛma Nyankopɔn asɔr a ɔwɔ Korinte, wɔ hɔn a wɔatsew hɔn ho wɔ Kraest Jesus mu afrɛ hɔn dɛ wɔmbɛyɛ ahotseweefo, nye hɔn a wɔbɔ yɛnye hɔn nyina Ewuradze Jesus Kraest dzin wɔ mbea nyina no.
Adom nye asomdwee a ofi hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest no nka hom.
Meda me Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom ho, wɔ Nyankopɔn adom a wɔdze adom hom wɔ Kraest Jesus mu ntsi,
dɛ adze nyina mu wɔama hom enya hom ho wɔ no mu, wɔ kasahom nye nyimdzee nyina mu,
dɛ mbrɛ Kraest ho dasedzi no etsim wɔ hom mu no;
ama hom annka ekyir wɔ adom akyɛdze biara mu; ber a hom rotweɔn hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne nyikyerɛ no:
ɔno so na ɔbɛma hom etsim ekodu ewiei amma woeennhu mfom bi wɔ hom ho wɔ Ewuradze Jesus Kraest da no mu.
Nyankopɔn a wɔnam no do afrɛ hom aba ne Ba hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest anyɛnkoyɛ mu no, ɔyɛ nokwafo.
Afei, enuanom, menam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne dzin do meserɛ hom dɛ hom nyina nka asɛnkor, na mma mpaapaamu mmba hom mu, na mbom hom nyina ndzi mu wɔ adwen kor nye tsirmsɛm kor mu.
Na, mo nuanom, hɔn a wofi Kloe fie ebeyi me hom ho asotsiw dɛ wentwiwentwi wɔ hom mu.
Dza mekyerɛ nye yi, hom nyina keka dɛ, Emi dze, meyɛ Paul dze, Emi dze, meyɛ Apollos dze, Emi dze, meyɛ Siifas dze, Emi dze, meyɛ Kraest dze.
Ana wɔapaapaa Kraest mu? Ana Paul na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu maa hom? Anaa Paul dzin mu na wonumaa hom hyɛe?
Meda Nyankopɔn ase dɛ mennuma hom mu bi gyedɛ dɛ Krispus nye Gaius,
amma obi aannka dɛ wonumaa hom hyɛɛ mankasa me dzin mu.
(Ɛhɛɛ, mekaa dɛ munumaa Stefanas fiefo: na nkaa no dze, sɛ munumaa bi dze a, ɔno minnyim.)
Na nnyɛ dɛ Kraest somaa me dɛ mumbonuma ara bi, na mbom dɛ membɛka asɛmpa no, nnyɛ dɛ ɔkasanyansa mu ara bi, amma Kraest mbeamudua no aannyɛ kwa.
Na mbeamudua no ho asɛm no yɛ nkwaseasɛm ma hɔn a wɔrehera, na hɛn a wɔregye hɛn nkwa no dze, ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn no tum ma hɛn.
Osiandɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Mebɛsɛɛ enyansafo nyansaa, Na enyimdzefo nyimdzee no meyi no tokyen.
Onyansafo wɔ hen? Ɔkyerɛwfo wɔ hen? Wiadze yi mu okyingyefo wɔ hen? Ana Nyankopɔn nndaan wiadze nyansaa nkwaseasɛm bi?
Na Nyankopɔn nyansaa mu no, wiadze ammfa nyansa do ennhu Nyankopɔn no, ɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn enyi dɛ ɔnam asɛnka no nkwaseasɛm no do bɛgye hɔn a wɔgye dzi nkwa.
Osiandɛ Jewfo rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na Griikfo dze, wɔhwehwɛ nyansa;
na hɛn dze, yɛka Kraest a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu ho asɛm, dza ɔyɛ fintsidua ma Jewfo, na nkwaseasɛm ma amanamamfo no.
Na hɔn a wɔafrɛ hɔn no dze, Jewfo o, Griikfo o, Kraest yɛ Nyankopɔn no tum na Nyankopɔn ne nyansaa ma hɔn.
Osiandɛ dza ɔyɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn nkwaseadze yi yɛ nyansa kyɛn nyimpa ne nyansaa, na Nyankopɔn n’adze a ɔyɛ mberɛw yɛ dzen kyɛn nyimpa dze.
Na, enuanom, hom nhwɛ hom frɛ no ara mpo ɛ, dɛ hom nnyɛ honam afamu enyansafo pii, nnyɛ etumfo pii, nnyɛ adehye pii:
na wiadze nkwaseadze na Nyankopɔn apa dɛ ɔdze bɛhyɛ enyansafo enyito, na wiadze mu dza ɔyɛ mberɛw na Nyankopɔn apa dɛ ɔdze bɛhyɛ dza ɔyɛ dzen enyito;
na wiadze mu dza onnyi dzin, nye dza wommbu no hwee na Nyankopɔn apa, ndzɛmba a onnyi hɔ mpo, dɛ ɔdze bɛma dza ɔwɔ hɔ ayɛ kwa;
amma honam biara aannhyehyɛ noho wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na Nyankopɔn mu na ofi na hom wɔ Kraest Jesus mu, ɔno na wofi Nyankopɔn mu ayɛ no nyansa nye tsenenee, nye ahotsew, nye ɔgye ama hɛn:
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Nyia ɔhyehyɛ noho, wɔmma ɔnhyehyɛ noho wɔ Ewuradze mu no.
Na emi dze, enuanom, mebaa hom nkyɛn no, mammfa kasa nye nyansa kyɛnee bɛkaa hom Nyankopɔn esumasɛm no.
Na mobɔɔ me tsirmu pɔw dɛ nkyɛ munnkohu biribi wɔ hom mu, gyedɛ Jesus Kraest a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no.
Na emi dze, mberɛwyɛ, nye osuro, nye ahopopo pii mu na menye hom tsenae.
Na m’asɛm nye m’asɛnka enndua enyansasɛm ndɛfɛdɛfɛw mu, na mbom ɔnam Sunsum ne nyikyerɛ nye tum mu,
amma hom gyedzi eenngyina nyimpa nyansaa mu, na mbom egyina Nyankopɔn tum mu.
Naaso yɛka nyansa wɔ hɔn a wodzi mu no mu, na nnyɛ nyansa a ɔyɛ wiadze yi dze, anaaso wiadze etumfo a wɔrebɛyɛ gyan dze a:
Na mbom yɛka Nyankopɔn nyansaa wɔ esumasɛm mu, nyansa a ohuntae a Nyankopɔn hyɛe too hɔ maa hɛn enyimnyam ansaana wɔrobɔbɔ wiadze no;
ɔno na wiadze yi mu etumfo mu obiara ennhu: sɛ wohunii a nkyɛ wɔammbɔ enyimnyam Ewuradze no mbeamudua mu;
na mbom dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Dza enyiwa nnhunii na aso nntsee, Na ɔannhɛn nyimpa akoma mu, Ndzɛmba a Nyankopɔn esiesie ama hɔn a wɔdɔ no.
Na hɛn dze, Nyankopɔn nam Sunsum no do eyi akyerɛ hɛn: na Sunsum no pɛɛpɛw adze nyina mu, Nyankopɔn adze a no mu dɔ mu mpo.
Na nyimpa mu woana na onyim dza ɔwɔ nyimpa mu, gyedɛ nyimpa noara no sunsum a ɔwɔ no mu? Dɛmara na obi nnyim Nyankopɔn dze, gyedɛ Nyankopɔn no Sunsum no.
Na hɛn dze, nnyɛ wiadze sunsum na yenyae na mbom sunsum a ofi Nyankopɔn mu a, ama yeehu dza Nyankopɔn dze adom hɛn no.
Ndzɛmba yi so na yɛka, nnyɛ nsɛm a nyimpa nyansaa kyerɛkyerɛ mu, na mbom nsɛm a Sunsum kyerɛkyerɛ mu a: yɛdze sunsum adze to sunsum adze ho.
Na nyia ɔyɛ honam mu nyimpa nntum nngye dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn Sunsum no ne ndzɛmba, osiandɛ ɔyɛ nkwaseasɛm ma no, na onntum nnhu mu, osiandɛ wohu no sunsum mu.
Na nyia ɔyɛ sunsum mu nyimpa dze, obu adze nyina atsɛn, na nankasa dze, obi mmbu no atsɛn.
Na woana na oehu Ewuradze n’adwen, dɛ ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ no? Na hɛn dze, yɛwɔ Kraest n’adwen.
Na mo so, enuanom, menntum annkasa annkyerɛ hom dɛ sunsum mu mba na mbom dɛ honam mu mba, dɛ Kraest mu nkɔkowaba.
Numfonsu na medze maa hom na hom nomee, na nnyɛ edziban bi a: na hom nnyae nntumii: eso seseiara hom nntum,
osiandɛ hom da ho yɛ honam mu nyimpa. Mbrɛ nyinkun nye wentwiwentwi wɔ hom mu yi, ana hom nnyɛ honam mu nyimpa, na nnyɛ nyimpamu bra na hom robɔ yi?
Na sɛ obi se dɛ, Emi dze, meyɛ Paul dze, na obi so se dɛ, Emi dze, meyɛ Apollos dze a, nna nnyɛ honammufo nye hom anaa?
Na Apollos nye woana? Na Paul nye woana? Wɔyɛ asomfo a hom nam hɔn do gyee dzii, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze dze maa hɔn mu biara.
Emi na muduae, Apollos na oguguu do nsu naaso Nyankopɔn na ɔmaa ndɔbaa no.
Dɛm ntsi nnyɛ nyia odua na ɔyɛ biribi, eso nnyɛ nyia ogugu do nsu a, na Nyankopɔn a ɔma ndɔbaa no a.
Na nyia odua nye nyia ogugu do nsu yɛ kor, na hɔn mu biara benya nankasa n’akatua dɛ mbrɛ nankasa n’edwuma tse.
Na hɛn dze, yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn no nkowaa a yɛnye no reyɛ edwuma; na hom so yɛ Nyankopɔn ne haban, Nyankopɔn ne dan.
Dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn adom a ɔdze adom me tse, dɛ ɔdantofo panyin nyansafo, motoo fapem, na obi so rotow do. Na wɔmma obiara nhwɛ yie mbrɛ odua tow do.
Na fapem fofor biara dze, obiara runntum nnto nnka dza wɔato no ho, ɔno nye Jesus Kraest.
Na sɛ obiara dze sika, dwetɛ, aboɔdzen abo, dua, sar, nye mburonan tow fapem no do a;
obiara n’edwuma bɛda edzi: na da no beyi ato gua, osiandɛ wɔnam ogya do beyi akyerɛ, na ogya no ara bɔsɔ obiara n’edwuma ahwɛ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse biara.
Sɛ obiara n’edwuma a ɔatow wɔ do no tum gyina a, obenya akatua.
Sɛ obiara n’edwuma hyew a, onnkenya hwee, na nankasa dze wɔbɛgye no nkwa, naaso ɔbɛyɛ dɛ oduaa ogya mu.
Ana hom nnyim dɛ hom yɛ Nyankopɔn asɔrfi, na Nyankopɔn Sunsum no tse hom mu?
Sɛ obiara sɛɛ Nyankopɔn asɔrfi a, ɔno so Nyankopɔn bɛsɛɛ no: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn asɔrfi ho tsew, na ɔno nye homara.
Mma obi nndaadaa noho. Sɛ obiara susu dɛ ɔyɛ hom mu nyansafo wɔ wiadze yi mu a, wɔmma ɔnyɛ kwasea ama ɔaayɛ nyansafo.
Na wiadze yi nyansaa yɛ nkwaseasɛm wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim. Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ɔno na ɔkyer enyansafo wɔ hɔn enyitsew mu;
na bio, Nyankopɔn nyim enyansafo adwendwen dɛ ɔyɛ adwendwen hun.
Dɛm ntsi mma obi nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ nyimpa mu. Na adze nyina yɛ homdze;
Paul o, Apollos o, Siifas o, wiadze o, nkwa o, owu o, dza ɔwɔ hɔ sesei o, dza ɔrebɛba o; ne nyina yɛ homdze;
Na hom yɛ Kraest dze, na Kraest so yɛ Nyankopɔn dze.
Dɛm na hom mma nyimpa mbu hɛn, dɛ Kraest asomfo nye Nyankopɔn esumasɛm do ahwɛfo.
Na, afei, dza wɔhwehwɛ no ɔhwɛfo ho nye dɛ wohu no ɔnokwafo.
Na emi dze, ɔyɛ me asɛm ketseaba bi dɛ hom anaa nyimpa abaguafo bobu me atsɛn: mankasa mpo mummbu moho atsɛn.
Na mankasa minnyim biribi tsia mo ho, naaso minndzi bem wɔ iyi mu: nyia obu me atsɛn nye Ewuradze.

Dɛm ntsi mma hom nntwar ber ano mmbu biribi ho atsɛn, ma onkodu dɛ Ewuradze bɛba, ɔno na ɔdze sum mu dza osuma nyina bɛba kan mu, na oeyi akoma mu apam edzi: nna obiara benya n’ayɛyi efi Nyankopɔn hɔ.
Nsɛm yi, enuanom, madan ama mankasa moho nye Apollos ma hom eesua wɔ hɛn ho dɛ mma hom nntra dza wɔakyerɛw no, amma ɔbaako ntsi obi aannhoran enntsia ɔbaako.
Na woana na ɔma eyɛ dansewa fi afofor mu? Na ebɛnadze na ewɔ a wɔammfa amma wo? Na sɛ inyae a, ɔyɛ dɛn na ehyehyɛ woho dɛ gyama ennya?
Hom ewie mee dada; nyew, hom enya hom ho dada; hom ekwetsir hɛn edzi hen: nkyɛ mepɛ dɛ hom dzi hen ampa, ama hɛn so yɛnnye hom eedzi.
Na mususu dɛ Nyankopɔn dze hɛn asomafo edzi ekyir, dɛ hɔn a woeyi hɔn ama owu; osiandɛ yɛayɛ ahwɛdze ama wiadze nye abɔfo nye nyimpa.
Yɛyɛ nkwasea wɔ Kraest ntsi, na hom dze, hom yɛ enyansafo wɔ Kraest mu; yɛyɛ mberɛw, na hom dze, hom yɛ dzen; hom dze, wɔdze enyidzi ma hom, na hɛn dze, wommbu hɛn hwee.
Ɔdze bodu sesei dɔn yi mu ɔkɔm nye nsukɔm nyina dze hɛn, yedzi adagyaw, wɔbɔ hɛn ekutuku, yennyi beebi tse;
na yɛberɛ dze hɛnara hɛn nsa yɛ edwuma; wɔyaw hɛn a, yehyira; wɔhaw hɛn a, yɛpen do;
wɔsɛɛ hɛn dzin a, yɛka abodweesɛm kyerɛ hɔn; yɛayɛ dɛ wiadze fi, nyimpa mu ntɔmpamu dze ebodu ndɛ.
Nnyɛ dɛ merebɛhyɛ hom fɛr ntsi na merekyerɛw iyi, na mbom dɛ murubotu hom fo dɛ mba a modɔ hɔn a.
Na sɛ hom wɔ akwankyerɛfo pedu wɔ Kraest mu mpo a, hom nnyi egyanom pii: na emi na menam asɛmpa no do mowoo hom wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
Dɛm ntsi meserɛ hom, hom nsuasua me.
Iyi ntsi na masoma Timoti a ɔyɛ me ba dɔfo nye nokwafo wɔ Ewuradze mu no wɔ hom nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔbɛkaa hom m’akwan a ɔwɔ Kraest mu, dɛ mbrɛ mekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔrasɔr nyina mu, wɔ mbeambea nyina no.
Na wosusu dɛ gyama meremmba hom nkyɛn ntsi na binom rohoran no.
Na sɛ Ewuradze pɛ a, mebɛba hom nkyɛn ntsɛmara, na mubohu hɔn a wɔahoran no hɔn tum, na nnyɛ hɔn nsɛm a.
Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ahendzi nnyi kasa mu ara gyan, na mbom tum mu.
Dza ɔwɔ hen na hom pɛ? Memfa abaa mbra hom do, anaa memfa ɔdɔ nye ɔdwe sunsum?
Wɔka no ampaara dɛ ndwamanyɛ wɔ hom mu, ndwamanyɛ a onnyi amanamamfo mpo mu, dɛ obi bɛfa n’egya yer.
Na hom ahoran, na mbom hom enndzi awerɛhow, ama woeeyi nyia ɔayɛ dɛm adze yi wɔ hom mu.
Na emi dze, minnyi hɔ wɔ honam mu sosoampa, naaso mowɔ hɔ wɔ sunsum mu, ntsi, mebu atsɛn dada dɛ gyama mowɔ hɔ, wɔ nyia ɔyɛɛ dɛm adze no ho,
wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus dzin mu, dɛ sɛ hom nye mo sunsum hyia mu, na hɛn Ewuradze Jesus no tum ka ho a,
mibeyi onyia no ahyɛ Satan nsa ma honam no aasɛɛ, ma bi a wɔaagye sunsum no nkwa wɔ Ewuradze Jesus da no mu.
Hom ahohyehyɛ nnye. Ana hom nnyim dɛ mbɔrkaw kakra kaw mbɔr no nyina?
Dɛm ntsi hom nyi mbɔrkaw dadaw no, ama hom aayɛ mbɔr fofor, dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ epitsi, osiandɛ woeku hɛn apahoguan Kraest so.
Dɛm ntsi hom mma yɛnhyɛ fa, nnyɛ dɛ yedzi mbɔrkaw dadaw bi a, eso nnyɛ dɛ yedzi nyitan nye emumuyɛ mbɔrkaw bi a, na mbom dɛ yedzi motooyɛ nye nokwar epitsi a.
Mekyerɛɛw no mo nwoma no mu brɛɛ hom dɛ mma hom nnye ndwaman mmforafora;
na nnyɛ wiadze yi ndwaman, anaadɛ enyiberfo nye apempensifo, anaa abosonsɔrfo bi koraa; ɔnodze na nkyɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom fi wiadze.

Afei dze, mekyerɛw hom dɛ mma hom nye hɔn nndzi afora, sɛ obiara a wɔfrɛ no onua yɛ edwaman anaa onyiberfo, anaa ɔbosonsɔrnyi, anaa ntokwapɛfo, anaa ɔsabokwanyi, anaa ɔpempensinyi a, dɛm nyimpa no dze, mma hom nye no nndzidzi mpo.
Na ɔfa mo ho bɛn dɛ mubobu hɔn a wommfi mu no atsɛn? Ana nnyɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ mu no na hom bu hɔn atsɛn?
Na hɔn a wonnyi mu no dze, Nyankopɔn na obu hɔn atsɛn. Hom nyi nyimpa bɔn no mfi hom mu.
Aso hom mu bi nye ne nyɛnko nya asɛm bi a onnsi no bo mfa no nkɔ hɔn a wɔnntsen no enyim asɛndzii, a nnyɛ ahotseweefo no enyim a?
Ana hom nnyim dɛ ahotseweefo no na wobobu wiadze atsɛn? Na sɛ hom na hom bobu wiadze atsɛn a, ana hom nnsɛ dɛ hom dzi nsɛm nkakraba?
Ana hom nnyim dɛ yebobu abɔfo atsɛn? Na ankantam abrabɔ yi mu ndzɛmba?
Na sɛ hom wɔ abrabɔ yi mu ndzɛmba ho asɛm a, hɔn a wommbu hɔn bi wɔ asɔr mu na hom dze hɔn yɛ abaguafo anaa?
Meka yi dze hyɛ hom enyito. Ana mbrɛ ɔtse nye dɛ onyansafo bi nnyi hom mu a obotum ebu nua nye nua ntamu atsɛn,
nna onua nye nua yi atsɛn wɔ hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi mpo no enyim yi?
Esintɔ enya aba hom mu dada dɛ hom dze homho kokɔ mbra mu. Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom mma wonndzi hom emim mbom? Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom mma wonnsisi hom mbom?
Na mbom homankasa hom dzi emim na hom sisi, na hom dze yi yɛ hom nuanom mpo.
Ana hom nnyim dɛ hɔn a wɔnntsen innkenya Nyankopɔn ahenman no ayɛ hɔndze? Mma wɔnndaadaa hom: ndwaman, nye abosonsɔrfo, nye awartofo, mbanyin asansabrafo, nye mbarimba a wɔnye hɔnho da,
nye ewifo, nye enyiberfo, nye asabokwafo, nye ntokwapɛfo, nye apempensifo rinnya Nyankopɔn ahenman no.
Na nkyɛ mbrɛ hom mu bi tse nye no; na afei wɔatsew hom ho, na afei woebu hom bem wɔ Ewuradze Jesus Kraest dzin mu, na hɛn Nyankopɔn Sunsum no mu.
Mowɔ adze nyina ho kwan, naaso nnyɛ adze nyina na ɔfata; mowɔ adze nyina ho kwan, naaso memma biribi nnhyɛ mo do.
Edziban yɛ yafun dze, na yafun yɛ edziban dze, naaso Nyankopɔn bɛma ebien nyina ayɛ kwa. Na nyimpadua nnyi hɔ mma ndwamanyɛ, mbom ɔwɔ hɔ ma Ewuradze, na Ewuradze wɔ hɔ ma nyimpadua;
na Nyankopɔn nyaan Ewuradze, na ɔnam no tum do benyan hɛn so bi.
Ana hom nnyim dɛ hom nyimpadua yɛ Kraest ho mfafakuwa? Aso memfa Kraest ho mfafakuwa menyɛ no edwaman dze? Atserkwa!
Ana hom nnyim dɛ nyia ɔdze noho bɔ edwaman ho no, na ɔnye no ayɛ nyimpadua kor? Na ɔse, Hɔn beenu bɛyɛ honankor.
Na nyia ɔdze noho bɔ Ewuradze ho no nye no yɛ sunsum kor.
Hom nguan ndwamanyɛ. Bɔn biara a nyimpa yɛ nnyi ne nyimpadua mu, na nyia ɔyɛ edwaman no ɔyɛ nankasa ne nyimpadua bɔn.
Anaaso hom nnyim dɛ hom nyimpadua yɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a ɔwɔ hom mu a hom enya no Nyankopɔn hɔ no n’asɔrfi? Na hom nnyɛ homankasa hom dze:
osiandɛ wɔtɔɔ hom aboɔdzen: dɛm ntsi hom nhyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ hom nyimpadua mu.
Na dza ɔfa nsɛm a hom kyerɛwee brɛɛ me dɛ, Oye ma ɔbanyin dɛ ɔmmfa noho nnka ɔbaa no ho dze,
nkyɛ oye naaso ndwamanyɛ ntsi, hom mma ɔbanyin biara nnya nankasa ne yer, na ɔbaa biara nnya nankasa no kun.
Wɔmma okun no nyɛ n’asɛdze mma ɔyer no dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ, na ɔyer no so nnyɛ dza ɔsɛ dɛmara so mma okun no.
Ɔyer no nnyi nankasa ne nyimpadua do tum, na mbom okun no a, na dɛmara so na okun no nnyi nankasa ne nyimpadua do tum, na mbom ɔyer no a.
Mma hom mmfa homho nnkam homho, gyedɛ hom yɛ anokor wɔ mber bi, ama hom eenya asɔr no ho adagyer, na hom aasan ebehyia mu bio, amma hom ho a hom nntum nnsie ntsi, Satan aannsɔ hom annhwɛ.
Na iyi meka no ɔkwanma afamu, na nnyɛ nhyɛdo bi a.
Na mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ nyimpa nyina yɛ dɛ mbrɛ metse yi; naaso obiara wɔ n’adom akyɛdze fi Nyankopɔn hɔ: obi wɔ no dɛm, obi so wɔ no dɛm.
Na meka kyerɛ esigyafo nye ekunafo dɛ, Oye ma hɔn dɛ wɔtsena hɔ dɛ emi.
Na sɛ wonnyi ahohyɛdo a, wɔnwar: na awar ye kyɛn dɛ ibenya akɔndɔ bɔn.
Na awarfo dze, mehyɛ hɔn, nnyɛ emi a, na mbom Ewuradze a, dɛ mma ɔbaa nngyaa no kun,
(na sɛ ogyaa no a, ondzi sigyaw; annyɛ dɛm a, ɔnye no kun nkɔbɔ mu); na mma okun so nngyaa ne yer.
Na nkaa no dze, emi na meka, na nnyɛ Ewuradze a, dɛ, Sɛ onua bi wɔ yer a ɔnnyɛ gyedzinyi, na sɛ ɔbaa no pen dɛ ɔnye no tsena a, mma ɔnngyaa no.
Na ɔbaa so a ɔwɔ kun a ɔnngye nndzi no, na sɛ okun no pen dɛ ɔnye no tsena a, mma ɔnngyaa no.
Na okun a ɔnngye nndzi no ho tsew ɔyer no mu, na ɔyer a ɔnngye nndzi no ho tsew okun no mu: ɔnntse dɛm a, nna hom mba ho wɔ fi, na afei dze hɔn ho tsew.
Na sɛ nyia ɔnngye nndzi pɛ dɛ ogyaa kɔ a, ma ongyaa; onua kor no, anaa akyerɛbaa kor no wɔnnkyekyer no wɔ dɛm asɛm yi mu: na asomdwee mu na Nyankopɔn afrɛ hɛn.
Na ɔyer, bi a sɛ ebɛgye wo kun nkwa a, ana inyim? Anaaso okun, sɛ ebɛgye wo yer nkwa a, ɔwo inyim anaa?
Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akyekyɛ ama obiara no, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn afrɛ obiara no, dɛmara na ɔmbɔ ne bra; na mbrɛ mehyehyɛ no wɔ asɔr nyina mu nye no.
Sɛ wɔfrɛɛ obi na ɔyɛ twatsianyi a, mma ɔnndan monomonomnyi; sɛ wɔfrɛɛ obi na ɔyɛ monomonomnyi a, mma wonntwa no twatsia.
Twatsiatwa nnyɛ hwee, na monomonomyɛ so nnyɛ hwee, na mbom Nyankopɔn ahyɛdze ne ndzido na ohia.
Ɔfrɛ kor a wɔfrɛɛ obi wɔ mu no, wɔmma ɔntsena mu.
Wɔfrɛɛ wo na eyɛ akowaa a, mma ɔnnyɛ wo asɛm, na sɛ ibotum enya wo fahodzi a, ɔno yɛ no dɛm.
Na nyia wɔfrɛɛ no Ewuradze mu na ɔyɛ akowaa no, ɔyɛ Ewuradze ne dehyee; dɛmara so na ɔdehye a wɔfrɛɛ no no, ɔyɛ Kraest Jesus akowaa.
Wɔdze bo tɔɔ hom: mma hom nnyɛ nyimpa nkowaa.
Enuanom, biribiara a wɔafrɛ obi wɔ mu no, ɔnoara mu na ɔnye Nyankopɔn ntsena.
Na hɔn a wɔnnwaree ho dze, minnyi Ewuradze hɔ ahyɛdze bi, na meka m’adwen dɛ nyia oenya Ewuradze hɔ ehumbɔbɔr dɛ ondzi nokwar.
Na dza mususu dɛ oye nye dɛ sesei ahohia yi ntsi oye ma nyimpa dɛ ɔtsena hɔ dɛmara.
Edze wo ho abata ɔyer ho anaa? Mma nnhwehwɛ dɛ ebɛsan. Ɔyer bi mmbata wo ho anaa? Mma nnhwehwɛ ɔyer.
Na sɛ awar mpo a, ennyɛ bɔn, na sɛ ɔbaabun war a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn; naaso dɛm nkorɔfo no benya ɔhaw wɔ honam mu, na emi dze, mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ motwe hom fi ɔhaw no ho.
Na iyi na meka enuanom, dɛ woetwa mber no tsia, ntsi afei hɔn a wɔwɔ yernom nyɛ dɛ wonnyi bi;
na hɔn a wosu no nyɛ dɛ wonnsu, na hɔn a hɔn enyi agye nyɛ dɛ hɔn enyi nngye, na hɔn a wɔtɔ nyɛ dɛ wonnyi hwee,
na hɔn a wɔdze wiadze ayɛ hɔndze, nnyɛ dɛ wɔmmfa nnyɛ nnhwee; osiandɛ wiadze no su rutwa mu.
Na mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ hom nnkɛyɛ dadwen. Osigyanyi yɛ Ewuradze ndzɛmba ho dadwen, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ asɔ Ewuradze enyi;
na ɔwarfo dze, ɔyɛ wiadze ndzɛmba ho dadwen, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ asɔ ne yer enyi.

Na sorbi da ɔbaawarfo nye ɔbaabun ntamu: ɔbaa sigyanyi yɛ dadwen wɔ Ewuradze ndzɛmba ho, ama no ho aatsew wɔ nyimpadua nye sunsum so mu; na ɔbaawarfo dze, ɔyɛ dadwen wɔ wiadze ndzɛmba ho, mbrɛ ɔbɔsɔ no kun enyi.
Homankasa hom yie ntsi na meka yi, nnyɛ dɛ merehyɛ hom, na mbom fɛw a ɔbɛyɛ, na ɔsom a hom bɔsom Ewuradze enyim dɛ biribi nnyɛ hom basabasa ntsi a.
Na sɛ obi dwen dɛ ne ndzeyɛɛ wɔ ne baabun a ɔaso awar do mmfata, na sɛ ohia so a, wɔmma ɔnyɛ dza ɔpɛ; ɔnnyɛ bɔn, wɔmma wɔnwar.
Na nyia ogyina n’akoma mu pintsinn, na ahohia bi nnda no do, na ɔwɔ nankasa ne pɛ do tum, na oesua n’akoma mu dɛ ɔbɛma ne baabun atsena hɔ no, ɔmmfomee.
Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔwar n’esiwayer no yɛ no yie, na nyia ɔmmfa no mma awar no bɛyɛ yie asen no.
Ber tsentsen a ɔbaa no kun tse ase no wɔakyekyer no, na sɛ no kun ka beebi a, nna odzi noho dɛ ɔwar obiara a ɔpɛ, mbom Ewuradze mu nko na ɔnyɛ.
Na sɛ ɔtsena hɔ dɛmara a, iyi na ɔyɛ nhyira ma no, mbrɛ m’adwen tse nye no: na mususu dɛ mo so mowɔ Nyankopɔn Sunsum no.
Na abosom afɔrbɔdze ho dze, yenyim dɛ hɛn nyina wowɔ nyimdzee: nyimdzee dze ahomemado ba, naaso ɔdɔ dze ntowdo ba.
Sɛ obi susu dɛ onyim biribi a, onnyae nnhunii dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ ohu;
na sɛ obi dɔ Nyankopɔn a, ɔno na Nyankopɔn nyim no.
Na abosom afɔrbɔdze ne dzi ho dze, hɛn dze, yenyim dɛ ɔbosom nnyɛ hwee wɔ wiadze mu, na eso nyame bi nnyi hɔ dɛ ɔbaako no ara.
Na kaansa ɔsor o, asaase o, dza wɔfrɛ hɔn enyame pii wɔ hɔ, dɛ enyame pii nye ewuranom pii wɔ hɔ no a,
hɛn dze, Nyame kor na yɛwɔ, Egya no a adze nyina fir no mu, na hɛn so yɛwɔ hɔ ma no, nye Ewuradze kor, Jesus Kraest a adze nyina nam no do, na hɛn so yɛnam no do no.
Naaso dɛm nyimdzee yi nnyi nyimpa nyina mu, ma ntsi binom dze hɔn ntɔyɛɛ wɔ abosonsɛm ho no dzi no dɛ abosom afɔrbɔdze, na dɛ hɔn tsibowa yɛ mberɛw ntsi, fi ka hɔn.
Na edziban nnkamfo hɛn mma Nyankopɔn, na nnyɛ dɛ sɛ yedzi a na yɛhyɛ ma, anaa yenndzi a, na yɛtɔ sin bi.
Na hom nhwɛ yie, ama no ho kwan a hom wɔ no aannyɛ fintsidua amma hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw no.
Na sɛ obi hu ɔwo a ewɔ nyimdzee dɛ etse edzidzii wɔ abosondan mu, na sɛ ne tsibowa yɛ mberɛw a, ana ennkɛma oenya ngyinado ekedzi abosom afɔrbɔdze a?
Nna ɔnam wo nyimdzee do na onua a ɔyɛ mberɛw a Kraest wui maa no no reyew.
Na sɛ hom yɛ enuanom no bɔn dɛm pirapira hɔn tsibowa a ɔyɛ mberɛw no a, nna Kraest na hom reyɛ no bɔn.
Dɛm ntsi, sɛ nam ne dzi ma mo nua fintsiw a, ɔno minnkedzi ara da, na maamma mo nua emmfintsiw.
Ana menndze moho a? Ana mennyɛ ɔsomafo a? Ana munnhun hɛn Ewuradze Jesus a? Ana nnyɛ hom nye m’edwuma wɔ Ewuradze mu a?
Sɛ mennyɛ ɔsomafo mma binom a, hom dze meyɛ ma hom, na m’asomafoyɛ ne nsɔwano nye hom wɔ Ewuradze mu.
Me nyiano a miyi kyerɛ hɔn a wɔpɛnsapɛnsa mo dwumadzi mu nye iyi.
Ana yennyi ho kwan dɛ yedzidzi na yɛnom?
Ana yennyi ho kwan dɛ yɛdze ɔyer a ɔyɛ gyedzinyi nantsew, dɛ asomafo nkaa no, nye Ewuradze no nuanom no, nye Siifas?
Anaaso emi nye Barnabas nko na yennyi ho kwan dɛ yegyaa dwumadzi anaa?
Sordaanyi woana na ɔbɔ nankasa ne kaw kɔ sa? Woana na ɔyɛ wenyin ture na onndzi n’aba bi? Anaaso woana na ɔnyɛn anyɛmbowa na ɔnnom anyɛmbowa hɔn numfonsu bi?
Ana meka yi nyimpa afamu a, na mbra no so nnka dɛm?
Na wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra no mu dɛ, Mma nnkyekyer nantwi a ɔporow eburow no ano. Aso anantwi no na hɔn ho hia Nyankopɔn,
anaa hɛn ntsi ara na ɔka dɛm? Ɛhɛɛ, hɛn ntsi na wɔkyerɛwee, osiandɛ nyia ofuntum asaase no, ɔsɛ dɛ ofuntum enyidado mu, na nyia ɔporow eburow no yɛ no enyidado mu dɛ obenya mu bi.
Sɛ yeduaa sunsum ndzɛmba maa hom a, ana ɔyɛ adze a ɔso biara dɛ yebobu hom honam mu ndzɛmba?
Sɛ binom enya hom ho kwan yi bi a, ana nnyɛ hɛn mbom a? Naaso yɛammfa kwan a ɔtse dɛm yi do, na mbom yɛsɔw adze nyina, amma yeennsiw Kraest asɛmpa no kwan.
Ana hom nnyim dɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ asɔr ho edwuma no dzi asɔrdan mu adze no bi? Na dɛ hɔn a wɔsom afɔrmbukyia ho no nye afɔrmbukyia no nya hɔn kyɛpɛn?
Dɛmara so na Ewuradze hyɛɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔka asɛmpa no ndzidzi asɛmpa no ho.
Na emi dze, mennyɛɛ yinom mu biara; eso mennkyerɛw yi dɛ wɔnyɛ dɛm mma me; na oye ma me dɛ mubowu mbom, kyɛn dɛ obiara bɛma m’ahohyehyɛ ayɛ kwa.
Na sɛ meka asɛmpa no a, minnyi biribi a medze hyehyɛ moho: na ehiasɛm da mo do, na sɛ mannka asɛmpa no a, nkyɛ mundue!
Na sɛ meyɛ yi mankasa me pɛ do a, mowɔ akatua, sɛ eso mannyɛ no mankasa me pɛ do mpo a, wɔdze ofihwɛ edwuma ahyɛ me nsa.
Na afei m’akatua nye dza ɔwɔ hen? Ɔno nye dɛ sɛ meka asɛmpa no a, mma memmfa akabɔ nnka asɛmpa no ho, amma maammfa asɛmpa no ho kwan a mowɔ annyɛ adze ntrado.
Na kaansa midzi moho do wɔ nyimpa nyina afamu mpo a, medze moho yɛɛ akowaa maa nyimpa nyina, ama me nsa aaka dodowara.
Meyɛɛ Jewnyi maa Jewfo ama meenya Jewfo; hɔn a wɔwɔ mbra no ase no, dɛ nyia ɔwɔ mbra no ase, (minnyi mbra no ase dze,) naaso meyɛɛ moho dɛ nyia ɔwɔ mbra no ase ama meenya hɔn a wɔwɔ mbra no ase:
na hɔn a wonnyi mbra no ase no, meyɛɛ dɛ minnyi mbra no ase maa hɔn, (nnyɛ dɛ minnyi mbra ase wɔ Nyankopɔn afamu, na mbom mowɔ mbra ase wɔ Kraest afamu) ama meenya hɔn a wonnyi mbra no ase no.
Hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw no, meyɛɛ dɛ nyia ɔyɛ mberɛw maa hɔn, ama meenya hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw. Mayɛ moho adze nyina ama nyimpa nyina, ama menam akwan nyina mu maagye binom nkwa.
Na iyi nyina asɛmpa no ntsi na meyɛ, ama meenya ho bi.
Ana hom nnyim dɛ hɔn a wosi empire wɔ mbirikatu mu no, hɔn nyina tu dze, naaso ɔbaako na onya empiresi abadobɔdze no a? Dɛmara na hom so ntu mbirika, ama hom so hom eenya abadobɔdze no.
Na obiara a ɔreper edzi nkonyim wɔ empiresi mu no, ɔhyɛ noho do wɔ adze nyina mu; hɔn dze wɔyɛ ma woeenya abɔtsir a ɔsɛɛ, na hɛn dze dza ɔnnsɛɛ a.
Dɛm ntsi emi dze, mbirika a mutu yi, munntu no gyan bi, ekutuku a motow yi, monntow no dɛ dza morotow gu mframa mu ara gyan.
Mbom mehyɛ mo honam amen, na midzi no nya, ama maka asɛmpa akyerɛ binom ekyir no, woeennyi mankasa so tokyen.
Na, enuanom, memmpɛ dɛ medze sie hom dɛ hɛn egyanom nyina hyɛɛ mununkum no ase, na hɔn nyina duaa po no mu,
na wonumaa hɔn nyina hyɛɛ Moses mu wɔ mununkum no nye po no mu,
na hɔn nyina dzii sunsum edziban kor no ara bi,
na hɔn nyina noom sunsum nsu kor no ara bi; na wɔnomee fii sunsum botan a ɔkaa hɔn do: na ɔbotan no nye Kraest.
Naaso hɔn mu piinara Nyankopɔn enyi annsɔ hɔn; na wodwuruuw hɔn sar no do.
Wɔdze iyinom yɛɛ mfatoho maa hɛn, ama hɛn kɔn aanndɔ ndzebɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kɔn dɔe.
Na mma hom nnyɛ abosonsɔrfo dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom yɛe, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ɔman no tsenaa ase dzidzii, nomee, na wɔsoɛree goree.
Eso mma hom mma yɛmmbɔ ndwamambra dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom yɛe, na mpem eduonu ebiasa totɔr da kor.
Eso mma yɛnnsɔ Kraest nnhwɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom sɔɔ no hwɛe, na nwɔ kunkum hɔn.
Eso mma hom nnhwinhwin, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom hwinhwinii, na ɔsɛɛfo sɛɛ hɔn no.
Na yinom nyina yɛɛ hɔn wɔ mfatoho ntsi, na wɔkyerɛwee dze tuu hɛn a mber no ewiei ato hɛn yi fo.
Dɛm ntsi ma nyia ɔdwen dɛ ogyina hɔ no nhwɛ yie mma ɔaannhwe ase.

Nsɔhwɛ bi nntoo hom dɛ dza nyimpa tum gyina enyim no ara, na Nyankopɔn yɛ ɔnokwafo a ɔremma wɔnnsɔ hom nnhwɛ nnkyɛn dza hom botum egyina ano, na mbom ɔdze ɔkwan bɛka nsɔhwɛ no ho a wɔnam mu fi nsa, ama hom eetum egyina enyim.
Dɛm ntsi, m’adɔfo, hom nguan abosonsɔr.
Mekasa kyerɛ hom dɛ enyansafo: hom mbu dza meka ho atsɛn.
Nhyira kɔɔpow a yehyira do no, nnyɛ Kraest bɔgyaa nkitahodzi anaa? Paanoo a yebubu no, nnyɛ Kraest nyimpadua nkitahodzi anaa?
Ɔnam dɛ ɔyɛ paanoo kor ntsi, hɛn a yɛdɔɔ so no yɛ nyimpadua kor; na hɛn nyina yedzi paanoo kor no ara bi.
Hom nhwɛ honam afamu Israel; ana hɔn a wodzi afɔrbɔdze no nye afɔrmbukyia no nndzi nkitaho?
Ebɛn asɛm na mereka yi? Dɛ adze a wɔdze abɔ afɔr ama abosom yɛ biribi, anaa dɛ ɔbosom yɛ biribi?
Oho, na mbom dɛ dza amanamamfo dze bɔ afɔr no, wɔbɔ ma mbɔnsam, na nnyɛ Nyankopɔn bi a: na memmpɛ dɛ hom nye mbɔnsam dzi nkitaho.
Hom runntum nnom Ewuradze kɔɔpow mu nye mbɔnsam kɔɔpow mu; hom runntum nndzidzi Ewuradze pon do na hom nndzidzi mbɔnsam pon so do.
Ana Ewuradze na yɛrehyɛ no ma ɔatwe nyinkun anaa? Hɛn ho yɛ dzen sen no anaa?
Kwan da adze nyina ho, na nnyɛ adze nyina na ɔfata; kwan da adze nyina ho, na nnyɛ adze nyina na ɔma ntowdo.
Mma obiara nnhwehwɛ nankasa nedze, na mbom ɔnhwehwɛ ne nyɛnko dze.
Biribiara a wɔtɔn no nangua do no hom ndzi, na mma hom mmbisabisa mu wɔ tsibowa ntsi:
na asaase nye no mu adze nyina yɛ Ewuradze dze.
Sɛ hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi mu bi to nsa frɛ hom edzidzi na hom pɛ dɛ hom kɔ a, dza wɔdze besisi hom enyim nyina hom ndzi, mma hom mmbisabisa mu wɔ hom tsibowa ntsi.
Na sɛ obi se hom dɛ, Iyi yɛ adze a wɔdze abɔ afɔr ama abosom a, mma hom nndzi, wɔ nyia ɔkyerɛe no ntsi, nye tsibowa ntsi:
medɛ tsibowa a, nnyɛ wodze, na onyia no nedze na mekyerɛ; na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔdze obi ne tsibowa bobu m’ahofadzi atsɛn?
Na sɛ medze ndaase dzi bi a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɔbɔ me dzin bɔn wɔ dza meda ho ase ntsi?
Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom ridzidzi o, hom ronom o, hom reyɛ biribi o, hom nyɛ ne nyina mma Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Hom nyɛ nyimpa a fintsidua nnyi hɔn mu mma Jewfo nye Griikfo nye Nyankopɔn asɔrmba:
dɛ mbrɛ mo so mosɔ nyimpa nyina enyi wɔ adze nyina mu, monnhwehwɛ mankasa me mfaso, na mbom dza ɔyɛ nyimpa pii dze, ama bi a woennya nkwa.
Hom nsuasua me, dɛ mbrɛ mo so musuasua Kraest no.
Afei miyi hom ayɛw dɛ hom kaa me adze nyina mu, na hom da ho dze atsetsesɛm no mu, dɛ mbrɛ medze hyɛɛ hom nsa no ara.
Na mepɛ dɛ hom hu dɛ ɔbarimba biara ne tsir nye Kraest, na ɔbaa ne tsir nye ɔbarimba, na Kraest ne tsir nye Nyankopɔn.
Ɔbarimba biara a ɔrosɔr, anaa ɔrehyɛ nkɔm, na ɔakata ne tsir no, ɔhyɛ ne tsir fɛr.
Na ɔbaa biara a ɔrosɔr, anaa ɔrehyɛ nkɔm, na ɔannkata ne tsir no, ɔhyɛ ne tsir fɛr, na ɔtse dɛ nyia ɔapra ne tsir no ara.
Na sɛ ɔannkata ne tsir a, ma ɔmpra ne tsir so; na sɛ ɔyɛ enyito ma ɔbaa dɛ oyi anaa ɔpra ne tsir a, ɔnodze ma ɔnkata ne tsir.
Na ɔbarimba dze, ɔnnsɛ dɛ ɔkata ne tsir, osiandɛ ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn no honyi nye n’enyimnyam, na ɔbaa dze ɔyɛ ɔbarimba n’enyimnyam.
Na nnyɛ ɔbarimba na ofi ɔbaa mu, na mbom ɔbaa na ofi ɔbarimba mu;
eso nnyɛ ɔbaa ntsi na wɔbɔɔ ɔbarimba, na mbom ɔbarimba ntsi na wɔbɔɔ ɔbaa.
Iyi ntsi na ɔsɛ dɛ ɔbaa nya dza ɔkyerɛ tumdzi wɔ ne tsir do, wɔ abɔfo no ntsi.
Naaso Ewuradze mu dze, ɔbarimba nnkwetsir ɔbaa, na ɔbaa so nnkwetsir ɔbarimba:
na dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaa fi ɔbarimba mu no, mbrɛ ɔbarimba so nam ɔbaa do ba nye no; na adze nyina fi Nyankopɔn mu.
Homankasa mbu hom mu atsɛn; ana oye dɛ ɔbaa dze tsir a ɔannkata do yɛ asɔr ma Nyankopɔn?
Ana ɔbrasu ara mpo nnkyerɛkyerɛ hom dɛ sɛ ɔbarimba sie tsir kusuww a, ɔyɛ enyimguase ma no a?
Na sɛ ɔbaa dze osie tsir kusuww a, ɔyɛ enyimnyam ma no, osiandɛ wɔdze ne tsinhwi maa no dɛ akatado.
Na sɛ obi pɛ dɛ odzi ntokwano a, hɛn dze, yɛnnyɛ dɛm adze no, na Nyankopɔn asɔrasɔr so nnyɛ dɛm.
Na dza medze rehyɛ hom yi, mirinnyi hom ayɛw, osiandɛ hom nnhyia mu wɔ papa ntsi, na mbom bɔn ntsi a.
Dza odzi kan nye dɛ metse dɛ sɛ hom hyia mu wɔ asɔr mu a, mpaapaamu wɔ hom mu; na megye no mu bi midzi.
Oye dɛ fɛkuwbɔ horow ba hom mu, ama hɔn a wɔgye hɔn to mu no aada edzi wɔ hom mu.
Na sɛ hom behyia fakor a, nnyɛ Ewuradze edzidzi na hom dzi no:
na hom ridzidzi a, ɔbaako dzi kan dzi nankasa n’edziban, na obi ɔkɔm dze no, na obi abow.
Ebɛnadze ntsi a? Ana hom nnyi efi a hom dzidzi mu? Anaa nnyɛ Nyankopɔn asɔr na hom bu no enyimtsia, na hom hyɛ hɔn a wonnyi bi enyito? Mense hom dɛn? Minyi hom ayɛw wɔ yi mu anaa? Mirinnyi hom ayɛw.
Na emi dze, minyaa Ewuradze nsamu dza medze memaa hom no dɛ: Ewuradze Jesus anadwe no a woyii no mae no, ɔfaa paanoo;
na ɔdaa ase no, obubui, na ɔsee dɛ, Me nyimpadua a wɔdze ama hom nye yi: hom nyɛ iyi mfa nyɛ me nkaa.
Dɛmara so na edzidzi ekyir no ɔfaa kɔɔpow no see dɛ, Kɔɔpow yi nye ahyɛmu fofor no wɔ mo bɔgyaa mu: hom nyɛ iyi mber biara a hom bɔnom no mfa nyɛ me nkaa.
Na mber biara a hom dzi paanoo yi, na hom nom kɔɔpow yi, hom bɔ Ewuradze wu no ho dawur dze kesi dɛ ɔbɛba.
Dɛm ntsi obiara a obedzi paanoo yi, anaa ɔbɔnom Ewuradze kɔɔpow yi dɛ mbrɛ ɔnnsɛ no, obedzi Ewuradze nyimpadua nye no bɔgyaa ho fɔ.
Na ma nyimpa nsɔ noho nhwɛ, na ondua dɛm ndzi paanoo no bi, na ɔnnom kɔɔpow no bi.
Na nyia odzi na ɔnom no, odzi na ɔnom dze atsɛmbu ba nankasa noho do, osiandɛ oemmbu Ewuradze nyimpadua bi yie.
Iyi ntsi na hom mu pii ayɛ mberɛw na wɔyaryar, na piinara so adeda.
Na sɛ yeebu hɛnankasa hɛnho yie a, nkyɛ wommbuu hɛn atsɛn.
Na sɛ wobu hɛn atsɛn a, Ewuradze tsea hɛn amma woeemmbu yɛnye wiadze fɔ.
Dɛm ntsi, mo nuanom, sɛ hom behyia mu ribedzidzi a, hom ntwentweɔn homho.
Na sɛ ɔkɔm dze bi a, wɔmma ondzidzi fie, mma hom eemmbehyia mu emmbenya atsɛmbu. Na nkaa no dze, sɛ meba a, mebɛka ho asɛm yie.
Na dza ɔfa no sunsum mu nsɛm ho no dze, enuanom, memmpɛ dɛ biribiara bosuma hom.
Hom nyim dɛ nkan no a hom yɛ abosonsɔrfo no, hom maa wogyaa hom kɔr abosom mmum nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi merema hom ehu dɛ obiara a ɔnam Nyankopɔn Sunsum mu kasa no, ɔmmfrɛ Jesus ebusudze; na obiara nntum nnka dɛ Jesus nye Ewuradze gyedɛ ɔnam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu.
Na adom akyɛdze horow wɔ hɔ, na Sunsum kor no ara a.
Na ɔsom horow wɔ hɔ, na Ewuradze kor no ara a.
Na dwumadzi horow wɔ hɔ, na Nyankopɔn kor no ara na ɔyɛ adze nyina wɔ hɔn nyina mu.
Naaso wɔdze Sunsum edziyi no ma hɔn nyina nkorkor, na aayɛ hɔn mfaso.
Na wɔnam Sunsum mu ama obi enyansasɛm, obi so nyimdzeesɛm, dɛ mbrɛ Sunsum kor no ara tse:
obi so gyedzi, wɔ Sunsum kor no ara mu; obi so yarsa akyɛdze wɔ Sunsum kor no ara mu;
obi so etumdzeyɛ; obi so nkɔnhyɛ; obi so esunsum mu nhumu; obi so kasa horow; obi so kasa horow nkyerɛasee:
na yinom nyina Sunsum kor no ara na ɔyɛ, na ɔkyekyɛ ma hɔn nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ.
Na dɛ mbrɛ nyimpadua yɛ kor, na ɔwɔ mfafakuwa pii, na nyimpadua ne mfafakuwa no nyina dɔɔ so dze, naaso wɔyɛ nyimpadua kor no, mbrɛ Kraest so tse nye no.
Na hɛn nyina so, Jewfo o, Griikfo o, nkowaa o, adehye o, woenuma hɛn Sunsum kor mu aba nyimpadua kor mu; na wɔama hɛn nyina anom Sunsum kor no ara bi.
Na nyimpadua nnyɛ fafakuwa kor, na pii.
Sɛ anan se dɛ, Mennyɛ nsa ntsi mennyɛ nyimpadua ho bi a, nna nnyɛ iyi ntsi na ɔma ɔnnyɛ nyimpadua ho bi.
Na sɛ aso se dɛ, Mennyɛ enyiwa ntsi mennyɛ nyimpadua ho bi a, nna nnyɛ yi ntsi na ɔma ɔnnyɛ nyimpadua ho bi.
Na sɛ nyimpadua nyina yɛ enyiwa a, ɔtse no wɔ hen? Ne nyina yɛ ɔtse a, ohua no wɔ hen?
Na afei Nyankopɔn dze mfafakuwa esisi nyimpa ho nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ.
Na sɛ hɔn nyina yɛ fafakuwa kor a, nyimpadua no wɔ hen?
Na afei mfafakuwa dɔɔ so dze, naaso nyimpadua no yɛ kor.
Na enyiwa nntum nnse nsa dɛ, Minnyi wo ho hia; anaaso bio, tsir nntum nnse anan dɛ, Minnyi wo ho hia.
Na mbom nyimpadua ho mfafakuwa a wɔyɛ dɛ wɔyɛ mberɛw dodow no hɔn na hɔn ho hia;
na nyimpadua ho bi a yɛdwen dɛ ɔnnsɛ enyidzi pii no na yɛhyɛ no enyidzi pii; na dza ɔnnyɛ fɛw wɔ hɛn ho no na ɔwɔ ahomka pii;
na dza ɔyɛ fɛw wɔ hɛn ho no nnhia dɛm: na Nyankopɔn dze nyimpadua no atoatoa mu, na mfafakuwa a wɔka bi no ɔama hɔn enyidzi pii;
amma mpaapaamu aammba nyimpadua no mu, na mbom mfafakuwa no eenya ndwendwenho kor no ara ama hɔnho nkorkor.
Na sɛ fafakuwa kor hu amandze a, mfafakuwa no nyina hu bi; na eso wɔhyɛ fafakuwa kor enyimnyam a, mfafakuwa no nyina nye no dzi dɛw.
Na afei hom yɛ Kraest nyimpadua no nye no ho mfafakuwa nkorkor.
Na Nyankopɔn dze binom esisi asɔr no mu: dza odzi kan asomafo, otsia ebien nkɔnhyɛfo, otsia ebiasa akyerɛkyerɛfo, nkyii etumdzeyɛ, na nkyii yarsa akyɛdze, mboa, mpanyindzi nye ɔkasa ahorow.
Ana hɔn nyina yɛ asomafo? Hɔn nyina yɛ nkɔnhyɛfo? Hɔn nyina yɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo? Hɔn nyina yɛ etumdzeyɛfo?
Hɔn nyina wɔ yarsa akyɛdze? Hɔn nyina kasa kasa horow? Hɔn nyina kyerɛ ase?
Mbom hom mper akyɛdze tsitsir no ho, na afei merekyerɛ hom kwan a oye kyɛn biribiara.
Sɛ medze nyimpa nye abɔfo tɛkyerɛma mekasa, na minnyi ɔdɔ a, mayɛ dɛ ayewa a ɔgyegye nye akasaa a ɔwosow.
Na sɛ mowɔ nkɔnhyɛ akyɛdze, na minyim esumasɛm nyina nye nyimdzee nyina, na sɛ mowɔ gyedzi nyina ma mututu mbepɔw mpo, na minnyi ɔdɔ a, mennsɛ hwee.
Na sɛ medze m’ahodze nyina mema ehiafo, na sɛ medze me nyimpadua ma dɛ wɔnhyew, na sɛ minnyi ɔdɔ a, minnya ho hwee.
Ɔdɔ pen kyɛr, ne yamu ye; ɔdɔ nnyɛ ahoɔyaw, ɔdɔ nnyɛ ahohyehyɛ, ɔnnhoran;
ɔnnyɛ noho dza ɔmmfata, ɔnnhwehwɛ nankasa nedze, no bo nnhaw no, ommbu bɔn ho akontaa;
onndzi dɛw wɔ dza ɔnntsen ho, mbom odzi nokwar no mu ehurusi;
ɔsoa adze nyina; ɔgye adze nyina dzi; onya adze nyina ho enyidado, na ɔsɔw adze nyina so.
Ɔdɔ mmbɔ adze da: na nkɔnhyɛnsɛm dze, wobogu no; ɔkasa horow dze, wobegyaa; nyimdzee dze, wobogu no.
Na yenyim fa na fa, na yɛhyɛ nkɔm fa na fa:
na sɛ dza odzi mu no nya ba a, nna wobogu dza ɔyɛ fa na fa no.
Meyɛ abofra no, mekasaa dɛ abofra, modween dɛ abofra, metsee adze ase dɛ abofra; na mebɛyɛɛ panyin yi, medze mbofrasɛm nyina egu nkyɛn.
Na sesei dze yɛnam ahwehwɛ mu hu adze wɔ abɛbu mu, na ndaamba dze yebohu enyim na enyim: sesei dze minyim fa na fa, na ndaamba dze mubohu no dɛ mbrɛ woehu mo so.
Na afei gyedzi, enyidado, ɔdɔ, ebiasa yi na ɔwɔ hɔ daa; na hɔn mu kɛse nye ɔdɔ.
Hom nhwehwɛ ɔdɔ ekyir kwan, na hom mbɔ mbɔdzen so wɔ sunsum mu ndzɛmba ho, na ne kɛse no nye dɛ hom bɛhyɛ nkɔm.
Na nyia ɔka kasa bi no, ɔnnkasa nnkyerɛ nyimpa, mbom ɔdze kyerɛ Nyankopɔn; na obi nntse ase, na sunsum mu na ɔka esumasɛm.
Na nyia ɔhyɛ nkɔm no, ɔka ntowdo nye afotu nye awerɛkyekyer nsɛm kyerɛ nyimpa.
Nyia ɔka kasa bi no, ɔtow nankasa noho do, na nyia ɔhyɛ nkɔm no ɔma asɔr no nya ntowdo.
Mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ hom nyina ka kasa horow dze, naaso oye dɛ hom bɛhyɛ nkɔm: osiandɛ nyia ɔhyɛ nkɔm so sen nyia ɔka kasa horow, gyedɛ ɔkyerɛ ase ama asɔr no eenya ntowdo.
Na afei, enuanom, sɛ meba hom nkyɛn mebɛkasa kasa horow, na sɛ mannkasa annkyerɛ hom wɔ nyikyerɛ mu, anaa nyimdzee mu, anaa nkɔnhyɛ mu, anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ mu a, mfaso bɛn na mebɛyɛ ama hom?
Na ndzɛmba a wonnyi nkwa mpo, dɛ atɛntɛbɛn anaa nsanku, sɛ wɔanngyegye ndze horow a, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn ehu dza wɔrehɛn anaa dza wɔrobɔ?
Na sɛ totorobɛnto no annhɛn yie a, woana besiesie noho akɔ akono?
Dɛmara na hom so, sɛ hom ammfa hom tɛkyerɛma annka asɛm a wɔtse ase a, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn atse dza hom ka? Hom bɛyɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔkasa gu mframa mu.
Annyɛ a, ndze horow pii wɔ wiadze, naaso no mu biara nnyi hɔ a onnyi nkyerɛase.
Na sɛ menntse kasa no ase a, mubobu nyia ɔkasa no dɛ ɔpɔtɔnyi, na nyia ɔkasa no so ebu me dɛ ɔpɔtɔnyi.
Dɛmara na hom so robɔ sunsum mu nsɛm ho mbɔdzen yi, hom nhwehwɛ dɛ hom bɔbor do ama asɔr no ntowdo.
Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔka kasa bi no ɔmbɔ mpaa dɛ ɔbɛkyerɛ ase.
Na sɛ mosɔr wɔ kasa bi mu a, mo sunsum sɔr dze, naaso m’adwen dze ɔnntse ase.
Nna ɔtse dɛn nye no? Medze sunsum no bɔsɔr, na medze adwen so asɔr; medze sunsum bɔtow ndwom, na medze adwen so atow ndwom.
Na sɛ edze sunsum hyira a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na nyia ɔnntse ase no bɛse Amen wɔ wo ndaase no ekyir, ber a onnyim dza aka no?
Na ɔwo dze eda ase yie dze, na ɔnodze onnya ntowdo biara.
Meda Nyankopɔn ase dɛ meka ɔkasa horow sen hom nyina:
naaso, asɔr mu dze, mepɛ dɛ medze me ntseasee ka nsɛmfua enum ama maakyerɛkyerɛ binom so, kyɛn dɛ mebɛka nsɛm mpemdu wɔ ɔkasa bi mu.
Enuanom, mma hom nnyɛ mbofra wɔ adwen mu, na mbom bɔn mu na hom nyɛ mbofraba, na adwen mu dze hom nyɛ dɛ hɔn a woewie nyin.
Na wɔakyerɛw no mbra no mu dɛ, Medze ananaben gyirama, nye ananaben ano na mebɛkasa akyerɛ ɔman yi, na iyi so mpo na wonnketsie me, Ewuradze na ɔse.
Dɛm ntsi kasa horow nnyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze mma hɔn a wɔgye dzi, na mbom ɔdze ma hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi; na nkɔnhyɛ dze, ɔnnyɛ hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi dze, na mbom hɔn a wɔgye dzi a.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ asɔr nyina behyia, na hɔn nyina ka kasa horow, na sɛ nyimpa bi a wonnyim ho bi, na wɔnngye nndzi ba mu a, wɔnnkɛse dɛ hom egyingyim anaa?
Na sɛ hɔn nyina hyɛ nkɔm, na sɛ obi a ɔnngye nndzi anaa onnyim ho bi ba mu a, dza hom nyina reka no bɛka ne tsibowa ebu no atsɛn,
na n’akoma mu esumasɛm bɛda edzi, na ɔdze n’enyim bobutuw famu asɔr Nyankopɔn aka dɛ, Nyankopɔn wɔ hom mu ampa.
Nna, enuanom, ɔtse dɛm yi yɛbɛyɛ no dɛn? Sɛ hom behyia mu a, hom mu biara wɔ ndwom, wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ, wɔ nyikyerɛsɛm, wɔ kasa bi, wɔ nkyerɛasee bi. Hom mma wɔnyɛ adze nyina mma ntowdo.
Sɛ obi ka kasa bi a, wɔnyɛ beenu, na ɔtra dɛm a, baasa, na wondzi esiado, na ɔbaako nkyerɛ ase:
na sɛ asekyerɛnyi nnyi hɔ a, ommua n’ano wɔ asɔr no mu, na ɔnkasa nkyerɛ nankasa noho nye Nyankopɔn.
Na nkɔnhyɛfo no dze, beenu anaa baasa nkasa, na nkaa no nker nsɛm no.
Na sɛ woyi biribi kyerɛ obi a ɔtse nkyɛn a, nyia odzi kan no mmua n’ano.
Na hom nyina botum ahyɛ nkɔm nkorkor, na hom nyina eesua na hom nyina aafa mu afotu;
na nkɔnhyɛfo hɔn esunsum no hyɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no ase;
osiandɛ Nyankopɔn nnyɛ sakasaka Nyankopɔn, na mbom ɔyɛ asomdwee dze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse wɔ ahotseweefo asɔr nyina mu.
Hom mma mbaa no mmua hɔn ano wɔ asɔrasɔr mu, na wɔmmaa hɔn kwan dɛ wɔkasa, na mbom wɔmbrɛ hɔnho adze dɛ mbrɛ mbra no so se.
Na sɛ wɔpɛ biribi esua a, wombisa hɔnankasa hɔn kunnom wɔ fie, osiandɛ ɔyɛ enyito ma ɔbaa dɛ ɔbɛkasa wɔ asɔr mu.
Wɔyɛ no dɛn? Hom mu na Nyankopɔn asɛm firii kɔree? Ana hom nkotsee na ɔbaa hom hɔ?
Sɛ obi dwen noho dɛ ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi anaa sunsummunyi a, onhu dza merekyerɛw hom yi dɛ ɔyɛ Ewuradze ahyɛdze.
Na sɛ obi nnyim adze a, mma onnhu dze so.
Dɛm ntsi, mo nuanom, hom mbɔ mbɔdzen nhwehwɛ nkɔnhyɛ akyɛdze, na mma hom nnsiw kasa horow mu kasa kwan.
Na hom mma wɔnyɛ adze nyina fɛfɛɛfɛw esiado esiado.
Na afei, enuanom, merema hom ehu asɛmpa no a mekaa kyerɛɛ hom, na hom so gyee, na hom kitsa mu so,
ɔnam do so na hom nya nkwa, sɛ hom suo asɛmpa no ara mekaa kyerɛɛ hom no mu dzen a, gyedɛ hom gyee dzii kwa.
Na nsɛm a odzi kan a mo so minyae a medze hyɛɛ hom nsa nye dɛ hɛn bɔn ntsi na Kraest wui dɛ mbrɛ kyerɛwnsɛm no se;
na dɛ wosiee no, na ne ndaansa no wonyaan no dɛ mbrɛ kyerɛwnsɛm no se;
na dɛ oyii noho kyerɛɛ Siifas, na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ duebien no;
na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ enuanom bɔbor ahaenum prɛko a hɔn mu piinara tsetse hɔ sesei, na binom adeda;
na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ James; na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ asomafo no nyina;
na hɔn nyinara ekyir, na oyii noho kyerɛɛ mo so a metse dɛ obi a wɔwo no ber a ɔnnsoe mu.
Na emi nye asomafo no mu ekumaba a mennsɛ dɛ wɔfrɛ me ɔsomafo mpo, osiandɛ mihiahiaa Nyankopɔn asɔr ho.
Naaso ɔnam Nyankopɔn adom do na metse dɛ mbrɛ metse yi, na n’adom a ɔdze doom me no annyɛ gyan: na mbom mayɛ edwuma pii asen hɔn nyina, naaso nnyɛ emi a, na mbom Nyankopɔn adom a ɔnye me nam no a.
Ntsi sɛ emi o, hɔn o, dza yɛpaa mu ka nye yi, na dza hom gyee dzii nye yi.
Na sɛ wɔka no Kraest ho dɛ oenyan efi ewufo mu a, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom mu binom ka dɛ ewufosoɛr bi nnyi?
Na sɛ ewufosoɛr bi nnyi hɔ a, nna Kraest so nnyanee:
na sɛ Kraest nnyanee a, nna hɛn asɛnka yɛ gyan, na hom gyedzi so yɛ gyan.
Nyew, nna wobohu hɛn so dɛ yɛgye dasewia ma Nyankopɔn, osiandɛ yedzi Nyankopɔn dase dɛ oenyan Kraest, na sɛ ewufo nnyan dze a, nna oennyaan ɔno so.
Na sɛ ewufo nnyan a, nna Kraest so nnyanee;
na sɛ Kraest nnyanee so a, nna hom gyedzi yɛ kwa, hom da ho wɔ hom bɔn mu.
Nna eso hɔn a wɔadeda wɔ Kraest mu no ahera.
Sɛ nkwa yi mu nko na yeenya enyidado wɔ Kraest mu a, nna nyimpa nyina mu abɔbɔfo nye hɛn.
Na afei Kraest enyan efi ewufo mu ayɛ hɔn a wɔadeda mu eduaba kan.
Na mbrɛ owu nam nyimpa do bae no, nyimpa na ewufosoɛr so nam no do bae.
Na dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nyina wu wɔ Adam mu no, dɛmara so na hɔn nyina benya nkwa wɔ Kraest mu.
Na obiara wɔ nankasa ne kyɛpɛn do: Kraest nye eduaba kan, na nkyii hɔn a wɔyɛ Kraest dze, wɔ ne ba mu.
Nna nkyii ewiei no reba a ɔdze ahendzi no bɛhyɛ Nyankopɔn nye Egya no nsa, ber a ɔama mpanyindzi nye tumdzi nye ahoɔdzen nyina ayɛ kwa.
Na otwar dɛ odzi hen kodu dɛ ɔdze n’atamfo nyina bogu n’ananadze.
Na ɔtamfo a odzi ekyir a ɔbɛma ɔayɛ kwa, nye owu.
Na ɔdze adze nyina egu n’ananadze. Na sɛ ɔka dɛ ɔdze adze nyina egu n’ananadze a, no mu da hɔ pefee dɛ nyia ɔdze adze nyina guu n’ananadze no nnka ho bi.
Na sɛ onya dze ndzɛmba nyina gu n’ananadze a, nna Ɔba no nankasa so dze noho bɛhyɛ nyia ɔdze adze nyina guu n’ananadze no n’ase, na Nyankopɔn aayɛ adze nyina mu adze nyina.
Ɔnntse dɛm a, hɔn a wonuma hɔn ma ewufo no, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn? Sɛ ewufo nnyan koraa a, ɔyɛ dɛn na wonuma hɔn ma ewufo?
Ɔyɛ dɛn na hɛn so yɛdze hɛn ho to amandze mu dɔnhwer nyina yi?
Enuanom, meka hom ho ahohyehyɛ a mowɔ wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Kraest Jesus mu dɛ muwu daa.
Sɛ nyimpa afamu nko na menye mbowa koe wɔ Efeso a, ɔyɛ me ebɛn mfaso? Na sɛ ewufo nnyan a, hom mma yendzidzi na yɛnnom, na ɔkyena na yeewu.
Mma wɔnndaadaa hom: fɛkuw bɔn sɛɛ ɔbra pa.
Hom mma hom enyi nda hɔ tsenenee mu, na mma hom nnyɛ bɔn; na binom nnyi Nyankopɔn ho nyimdzee: meka yi dze hyɛ hom enyito.
Na bi a obi bɛse dɛ, Ewufo dua dɛn nyan? Na nyimpadua so bɛn na wɔdze bɛba?
Ɔkwasea, dza idua no nnya nkwa, gyedɛ owu ansaana,
na dza idua no nnyɛ dua a ɔbɛba no na idua, na eburofua ara kwa, bi a ewifua anaa nkaa no mu bi a;
na Nyankopɔn na ɔma no dua kor a ɔpɛ, na ɔma aba biara nankasa no dua.
Nnyɛ nam nyina na ɔyɛ nam kor: ɔsor nyimpa nam, ɔsor mbowa dze, ɔsor anoma dze, ɔsor esunam dze.
Sor abɔdze so wɔ hɔ, na famu abɔdze wɔ hɔ: na ɔsor sor dze no n’enyimnyam, na ɔsor famu dze no nedze.
Ewia enyimnyam nko, bosoom dze nko, nworaba dze nko: na ɔsosor nworaba enyimnyam nkorkor.
Mbrɛ ewufo mu soɛr so tse nye no. Wodua no prɔwee mu: wonyan no dza ɔmmprɔw mu;
wodua no enyimguase mu: wonyan no enyimnyam mu; wodua no mberɛw mu: wonyan no ahoɔdzen mu;
wodua no ɔkra nyimpadua: wonyan no sunsum nyimpadua. Sɛ ɔkra nyimpadua wɔ hɔ a, nna sunsum dze so wɔ hɔ.
Dɛmara so na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Adam a odzi kan no bɛyɛɛ ɔkra tseasefo: na Adam a odzi ekyir no bɛyɛɛ sunsum a ɔma nkwa.
Naaso nnyɛ sunsum dze no na odzi kan, na mbom ɔkra dze no a, na nkyii sunsum dze no reba.
Nyimpa a odzi kan no fi famu yɛ famunyi: nyimpa a otsia ebien no fi sor.
Mbrɛ famunyi no tse, mbrɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ famufo so tse nye no: na mbrɛ ɔsornyi no tse no, mbrɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ ɔsorfo tse nye no.
Na mbrɛ yɛahyɛ famunyi no suban no, mbrɛ yɛbɛhyɛ ɔsornyi no so suban nye no.
Enuanom, dza meka nye dɛ honam nye bɔgya runntum nnya Nyankopɔn ahenman no; na eso dza ɔprɔw rinnya dza ɔmmprɔw no.
Hwɛ, mereka hom esumasɛm: nnyɛ hɛn nyina na yɛbɛdeda, na wɔbɛsakyer hɛn nyina
amonmu ara, ntsɛmara, wɔ ekyir abɛntoa no mu: na wɔbɛhɛn abɛntoa no, na ewufo no benyan dɛ wɔmmprɔw da, na hɛn dze, yɛbɛsakyer.
Na dza ɔprɔw yi otwar dɛ ɔhyɛ dza ɔmmprɔw, na dza owu yi otwar dɛ ɔhyɛ dza onnwu.
Na sɛ dza ɔprɔw yi nya hyɛ dza ɔmmprɔw, na dza owu yi nya hyɛ dza onnwu a, nna asɛm a wɔakyerɛw no bɛba mu dɛ, Owu, wɔamen no konyim mu.
Owu, wo konyim wɔ hen? Owu, wo hwirom wɔ hen?
Owu hwirom nye bɔn, na bɔn tum nye mbra no:
na ndaase nka Nyankopɔn a ɔnam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest do ma hɛn konyimdzi.
Dɛm ntsi, mo nuanom adɔfo, hom ntsintsim, mma hom nnhinhim, hom mbor do wɔ Ewuradze edwuma mu daa, osiandɛ hom nyim dɛ hom berɛ nnkɛyɛ gyan wɔ Ewuradze mu.
Na ntoboa a wɔdze kɛma ahotseweefo no ho dze, dɛ mbrɛ mehyehyɛɛ no asɔrasɔr a ɔwɔ Galatia mu no, dɛmara na hom so nyɛ.
Dapɛn mu da a odzi kan no, hom nyina ntsiatsia ngu hom nkyɛn nkorkor, dɛ mbrɛ obiara esi no yie, ama minya ba a, wɔaanngyegye tow no.
Na sɛ mubodu a, hɔn a hom dze nwoma bɛkyerɛ dɛ wɔfata dɛm edwuma no, mobɔsoma hɔn dze hom akyɛdze no akɔ Jerusalɛm;
na sɛ ɔsɛ dɛ mo so mokɔ a, menye hɔn bɔkɔ.
Na mikesi Masidonia a, mebɛba hom nkyɛn; osiandɛ Masidonia na mirikesi.
Na hom nkyɛn na annyɛ a mebɛtsena menye hom edzi awɔwber mpo, na beebiara a mobɔkɔ no hom eegya me kwan.
Na afei dze memmpɛ dɛ sɛ murutwa mu nko a na mubohu hom; na sɛ Ewuradze ma ho kwan a, m’enyi da dɛ mebɛkyɛr hom nkyɛn kakra.
Na mebɛkyɛr Efeso ekodu Pentekost da no:
osiandɛ woebue abow a wodua mu dzi dwuma ama me, na mbom atamfo a wɔwɔ ho no dɔɔ so.
Na sɛ Timoti ba a, hom nhwɛ ma ɔaammfa hu nye hom anntsena: osiandɛ ɔyɛ Ewuradze edwuma no bi dɛ mbrɛ mo so meyɛ.
Dɛm ntsi mma obi mmbu no enyimtsia. Na hom ngya no kwan asomdwee mu ma ɔmbra me nkyɛn: na morotweɔn ɔno nye enuanom no.
Na onua Apollos ho dze, meserɛɛ no pii dɛ ɔnye enuanom no mbra hom nkyɛn, na ɔannyɛ ne pɛ koraa dɛ ɔbɛba sesei; na onya mu kwan a, ɔbɛba.
Hom nweɔn, hom ngyina gyedzi no mu pintsinn, hom nyɛ dɛ mbarimba, hom nyɛ dzen.
Hom nyɛ hom adze nyina wɔ ɔdɔ mu.
Na meserɛ hom, enuanom, hom nyim Stefanas fiemba, dɛ wɔyɛ Akaia edwuma no mu aba a odzi kan, na dɛ wɔdze hɔnho ama a wɔrosom ahotseweefo no,
dɛ hom so mbrɛ homho adze mma dɛm nkorɔfo no, nye obiara a ɔboa wɔ edwuma no mu na ɔberɛ.
Na m’enyi gye wɔ Stefanas nye Fotunatus nye Akaikus hɔn mbaa no ho, na dza aka hom afamu no wɔabɛyɛ ama me.
Na wɔabɔdwedwe mo sunsum nye homdze: hom ndzi hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no nyi yie.
Asia asɔrasɔr kyiakyia hom. Akwila nye Priska kyia hom pii wɔ Ewuradze mu, nye asɔr a ɔwɔ hɔn fie no.
Enuanom nyina kyia hom. Hom mfa mfewano krɔnkrɔn nkyiakyia homho.
Emi Paul me nsaano nkyia nye yi.
Sɛ obi nndɔ Ewuradze a, wɔmma ɔnyɛ ebusudze. Maranata. (Ewuradze, bra!)
Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom nka hom.
Mo dɔ nka hom nyina wɔ Kraest Jesus mu. Amen.
Paul a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ do yɛ Kraest Jesus ɔsomafo, nye onua Timoti, dze kɛma Nyankopɔn asɔr a ɔwɔ Korinte, nye ahotseweefo a wɔwɔ Akaia nyina:
Adom nye asomdwee a ofir hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nka hom.
Nhyira nka hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne Nyankopɔn nye n’Egya a ɔyɛ ehumbɔbɔr Egya nye awerɛkyekyer nyina Nyankopɔn a
ɔkyekye hɛn werɛ wɔ hɛn ahohia nyina mu, ama yeetum edua awerɛkyekyer a Nyankopɔn dze kyekye hɛn werɛ no do akyekye hɔn a wɔwɔ ahohia biara mu so werɛ.
Na dɛ mbrɛ Kraest n’amandzehu kɛsenara ba hɛn do no, dɛmara na hɛn awerɛkyekyer so nam Kraest mu bu do.
Na sɛ wohiahia hɛn ho a, ɔyɛ awerɛkyekyer na nkwagye ma hom; ɔno na ɔyɛ edwuma abotar mu wɔ amandze kor no ara a hɛn so yehu mu;
na hɛn enyidado a ɔwɔ hom ho no tsim, osiandɛ yenyim dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ amandzehu no mu fafafo no, mbrɛ hom yɛ awerɛkyekyer no mu bi so nye no.
Na, enuanom, yɛmmpɛ dɛ yesiw hom hɛn ahohia a ɔbaa hɛn do wɔ Asia no do, dɛ ɔhyɛɛ hɛn do mbordo traa hɛn ahoɔdzen, ma hɛn enyi fii hɛn nkwa do mpo:
na hɛnankasa yɛtsee hɛn owu ne mfar wɔ hɛn mu, amma yaammfa hɛn werɛ anntwer hɛnho, na mbom yɛdze atwer Nyankopɔn a onyan ewufo no.
Ɔno na oyii hɛn fii dɛm owu kɛse yi mu, na ɔda ho yi hɛn, na yɛwɔ enyidado dɛ ɔbɛda ho eyi hɛn;
hom so dze hom nkotoserɛ roboa hɛn bi a, ma akyɛdze a wɔnam dodow do dze ama hɛn no ntsi, nyimpa pii aada ase ama hɛn.
Na hɛn ahohyehyɛ nye yi, hɛn tsibowa ne dasedzi, dɛ Nyankopɔn krɔnkrɔnyɛ nye botooyɛ mu, nnyɛ honam mu nyansa mu, na mbom Nyankopɔn adom mu, na yɛnam bɔɔ hɛn bra wɔ wiadze, nkanka wɔ hom ntamu.
Na yɛnnkyerɛw biribi mmbrɛ hom kyɛn dza hom kenkan na hom tse ase, na m’enyi da do dɛ hom bɛtse ase dze ekesi ewiei;
dɛ mbrɛ so hom tse hɛn ase fa na fa dɛ yɛyɛ hom ahohyehyɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hom so yɛ hɛndze wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus da no mu.
Na dɛm awerɛhyɛmu yi mu na mepɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ mebɛba hom nkyɛn ana, ama hom eenya adom mbɔho,
na mabɛfa hom nkyɛn akɔ Masidonia, na mefi Masidonia aba hom nkyɛn bio, na hom eegya me kwan ma maakɔ Judea.
Dɛm ntsi mobɔɔ me tsirmu dɛm no, midzii adwenharsɛm anaa? Anaa me tsirmu a mobɔ no, mobɔ no honam mu na m’asɛm kor no ara ayɛ nyew, nyew, nye oho, oho anaa?
Na dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn yɛ nokwafo no, hɛn asɛm a yɛka kyerɛ hom nnyɛ nyew nye oho.
Na Nyankopɔn ba Jesus Kraest a yɛbɛkaa no ho asɛm wɔ hom mu no, emi nye Silvanus nye Timoti, ɔnnyɛ nyew nye oho, na no mu mbom na nyew no wɔ.
Na Nyankopɔn abɔ anohoba dodow dɛn ara a, no mu na nyew wɔ, na iyi ntsi na no mu na Amen wɔ, ma wɔnam hɛn do hyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Na nyia oetsim hɛn nye hom wɔ Kraest mu, na ɔasera hɛn, nye Nyankopɔn no:
ɔno so na ɔasɔw hɛn ano, na ɔama hɛn Sunsum no ne nsewhyɛ wɔ hɛn akoma mu.
Na mefrɛ Nyankopɔn dɛ ombedzi me kra dase dɛ memmpɛ dɛ mohow hom werɛ ntsi na mammba Korinte bio no.
Nnyɛ dɛ yɛyɛ hom gyedzi do ahyɛdofo, na mbom yɛyɛ hom enyigye aboafo: osiandɛ gyedzi na hom dze tsim.
Na mobɔɔ me tsirmu pɔw dɛ meremmfa awerɛhow mmba hom nkyɛn bio.
Na sɛ mohow hom werɛ a, woana na ɔma m’enyi gye, dɛ nyia mohow no werɛ no ara?
Na merekyerɛw hom iyi ara amma meba a meemmbenya awerɛhow wɔ hɔn a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔma me enyigye no ho, na mo werɛ wɔ hom nyina mu dɛ m’enyigye yɛ hom nyina so hom enyigye.
Na mifi akoma mu ahohiahia nye ahoguan pii mu, menam nyinsuwa pii mu kyerɛɛw hom, nnyɛ dɛ hom werɛ nhow bi a, na mbom ama hom eehu ɔdɔ a modɔ hom mbordo no.
Na sɛ obi ahyɛ awerɛhow a, nnyɛ emi na ɔahow mo werɛ na n’afa bi mu ɔahow hom nyina hom werɛ (amma maannsoa hom dza ɔyɛ dur dodow).
Na nkaenyim a dodow no dze aka nyimpa no enyim no dɔɔ so ma no,
ma afei mbom ɔsɛ dɛ hom dze kyɛ no na hom kyekye no werɛ, aannyɛ a nna hom ama obi a ɔtse dɛm no n’awerɛhow dodow amen no.
Dɛm ntsi meserɛ hom, hom mma hom dɔ nsi pi mma no.
Na iyi ntsi na mekyerɛwee, ama meenya hom ho dase papa dɛ hom yɛ setsie wɔ adze nyina mu.
Onyia a hom dze biribi kyɛ no no, mo so medze kyɛ no, na sɛ medze biribi akyɛ a, hom ntsi na medze akyɛ wɔ Kraest enyim;
amma Satan eenndzi hɛn enyim annkɛyɛ biribi: osiandɛ yenyim mbrɛ n’akwan tse.
Ber a mebaa Troas wɔ Kraest asɛmpa no ntsi no, Ewuradze buee abow maa me,
naaso mennya mo sunsum mu enyigye, osiandɛ mennhu mo nua Titus wɔ hɔ; na mekraa hɔn fii hɔ kɔr Masidonia.
Na ndaase nka Nyankopɔn a ɔdze hɛn to no nkonyimsantsen wɔ Kraest mu daa no, na ɔnam hɛn do yi ne nyimdzee ho nka huam kyerɛ wɔ mbea nyina no.
Na yɛyɛ Kraest Jesus ne nka huam ma Nyankopɔn ma hɔn a wɔregye hɔn nkwa nye hɔn a wɔrehera nyina:
binom, yɛyɛ owu ho hua dze kɔ owu mu ma hɔn; na binom so, yɛyɛ nkwa ho hua dze kɔ nkwa mu ma hɔn. Na woana na ɔfata yinom?
Na hɛn dze, yɛnntse dɛ pii a wɔdze Nyankopɔn asɛm yɛ eguadzi, na mbom ofi nokwardzi mu, ofi Nyankopɔn mu, na yɛkasa wɔ Kraest mu wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Ana iyi kyerɛ dɛ yɛahyɛ ase bio riyi hɛnho ayɛw anaa? Anaa yehia nkamfo nwoma a yɛdze brɛ hom, anaa ofi hom nkyɛn ba, dɛ mbrɛ binom hia no a?
Hom nye hɛn nwoma a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ hɛn akoma mu a nyimpa nyina hu na wɔkenkan;
na hom da edzi dɛ hom yɛ Kraest Jesus nwoma a ɔnam hɛn som do a wɔammfa dubir, na mbom wɔdze Nyankopɔn tseasefo no Sunsum kyerɛwee, nnyɛ abopon do, na mbom nyimpa n’akomapon do a.
Na dɛm awerɛhyɛmu yi na yɛnam Kraest do enya no Nyankopɔn afamu;
nnyɛ dɛ hɛnara na yɛso yɛ, dɛ yebu biribi dɛ ofi hɛnankasa hɛn mu; na mbom hɛn emudzi no fi Nyankopɔn;
ɔno so na ɔama yetum yɛ ahyɛmu fofor no ho asomfo, nnyɛ nkyerɛwee ho dze bi a, na mbom sunsum dze a: na nkyerɛwee dze ɔma owu, na sunsum na ɔma nkwa.
Na sɛ owu som a wɔkyerɛwee krukyee no wɔ abo do no nyaa enyimnyam, ma Israelmba enntum anngyen enyi annhwɛ Moses enyim wɔ n’enyim enyimnyam a orutwa mu ntsi a,
ɔbɛyɛ dɛn koraa na sunsum som no rinnya enyimnyam?
Na sɛ afɔbu som no yɛ enyimnyam a, mpɛn ahen na tsenenee som no mbom bor do pii wɔ enyimnyam mu?
Mpo dza wɔahyɛ no enyimnyam no nnyi enyimnyam wɔ iyi afamu, osian enyimnyam no a ɔkyɛn no ntsi.
Na sɛ dza otwa mu no mpo nam enyimnyam mu a, nna dza otsim hɔ no dze ɔwɔ enyimnyam pii.
Na yɛwɔ dɛm enyidado ntsi, yɛyɛ ɔkasa mu ndam pii,
na yɛnnyɛ dɛ Moses a ɔdze nkataenyim kataa n’enyim ma Israelmba eenntum anngyen hɔn enyi annhwɛ enyimnyam a orutwa mu no n’ewiei:
Na mbom wofuraa hɔn adwen, na mpo, ɔdze bodu ndɛ nkataenyim kor no ara da ho wɔ ahyɛmu dadaw no ne kenkan do a wonnya nnyii, osiandɛ Kraest mu (nko) na woyi.
Na ɔdze bodu ndɛ yi ara mpo, sɛ aber biara wɔkenkan Moses nwoma no a, nkataenyim da ho wɔ hɔn akoma do.
Na sɛ aber biara wɔdan ba Ewuradze nkyɛn a, woyi nkataenyim no.
Na afei Ewuradze nye Sunsum no, na mbrɛ Ewuradze Sunsum wɔ na fahodzi wɔ.

Na hɛn nyina, yɛdze enyim a wɔnnkataa do rekyerɛ Ewuradze enyimnyam no dɛ yɛrohwɛ ahwehwɛ mu, wɔsakyer hɛn kɔ subea kor no ara bi mu, fi enyimnyam mu kɔ enyimnyam mu, na iyi fi Ewuradze no sunsum no ara.
Dɛm ntsi, dɛ ɔnam Nyankopɔn n’ehumbɔbɔr do na wɔdze ɔsom a ɔtse dɛm ahyɛ hɛn nsa yi, yɛmmpa abaw:

na mbom yɛapow enyimguase ndzɛmba a yɛdze suma no, yɛmmbɔ hɛn bra akɔhwi mu, eso yɛmmfa ndaadaa mmfora Nyankopɔn asɛm mu, na nokwar no ara na yɛnam do petee dze yi hɛnho kyerɛ nyimpa nyina wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na sɛ hɛn asɛmpa no do kata a, ɔkata wɔ hɔn a wɔrehera no mu,
hɔn mu na wiadze yi nyame efura hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi no adwen, amma woeennhu Kraest a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn suban no n’asɛmpa enyimnyam ne kan no.
Na nnyɛ hɛn ho asɛm na yɛka, na mbom Kraest Jesus a, dɛ Ewuradze, na hɛnankasa so dze, dɛ Jesus ntsi yɛyɛ hom nkowaa.
Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔkaa dɛ kan mfi sum mu nhyerɛn no na ɔahyerɛn wɔ hɛn akoma mu dɛ ɔrema Nyankopɔn enyimnyam a ɔwɔ Jesus Kraest enyim no no ho nyimdzee no ne kan no.
Na yɛwɔ akoradze yi wɔ dɛtse nkɔɔpow mu, ama tum no ne kɛseyɛ a ɔtra do no eefir Nyankopɔn na emmfir hɛn:
wofi mbeambea hiahia hɛn ho, na wɔmmem hɛn; hɛn ho kyer hɛn, na hɛn enyidado mmpa;
wɔtaa hɛn do, na eso wɔmmpa hɛn ekyir; woekruw hɛn ahwe ase, na eso wɔnnsɛɛ hɛn:
daa yɛso Jesus no wu wɔ hɛn nyimpadua mu nam, ama Jesus no nkwa so aada edzi wɔ hɛn nyimpadua mu.
Na hɛn a yɛtse ase yi, woyi hɛn ma owu daa, ama Jesus no nkwa so aada edzi wɔ hɛn wu honam yi mu.
Dɛm ntsi owu dzi dwuma wɔ hɛn mu, na nkwa so dzi dwuma wɔ hom mu.
Na yɛwɔ gyedzi sunsum kor no ara, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Megyee dzii ntsi na mekasae yi, hɛn so yɛgye dzi na ne ntsi so yɛkasa;
na yenyim dɛ nyia onyaan Ewuradze Jesus no, obenyan hɛn so nye Jesus, na oeyi hɛn nye hom akyerɛ.
Na iyi nyina hom ntsi a, na adom no aadɔɔ so edua nyimpa pii do ama ndaase a ɔbor do aaka Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Dɛm ntsi yɛmmpa abaw. Kaansa hɛn nyimpadua a enyiwa hu yi roprɔw mpo a, hɛn nyimpasu a enyi nnhu no dan fofor daa daa.
Na hɛn sesei ahohia harhar yi, risiesie onnyiewiei enyimnyam a ɔso bor do koraa ama hɛn,
ber a yɛnnhwɛ ndzɛmba a wohu, na mbom yɛhwɛ dza wonnhu no: osiandɛ ndzɛmba a wohu no nnkyɛr na etwa mu, na dza wonnhu no na onnyi ewiei.
Na yenyim dɛ sɛ wonya gura hɛn asaase ntamadan fi yi a, yɛwɔ ofi a ofir Nyankopɔn, ɔdan a wɔammfa nsa ennsi, a ɔwɔ hɔ daa, wɔ sor.
Na iyi mu so na yesi nkrum na hɛn enyi gyina dɛ wɔdze hɛn fie a ofi sor no so bɛhyɛ hɛn.
Sɛ ɔba dɛ yenya hyɛ a, wonnkohu hɛn dɛ yedzi adagyaw.
Na hɛn a yɛtsetse ntamadan yi mu no, yesi nkrum na ɔhyɛ hɛn do: nnyɛ dɛ yɛpɛ dɛ wɔpa hɛn ho tam bi a, na mbom dɛ yɛbɛhyɛ so egu do a, ama nkwa aamen dza owu.
Na nyia oesiesie hɛn ama iyiara nye Nyankopɔn a ɔnoara ama hɛn Sunsum no ne nsewhyɛ no.
Na yɛwɔ akokodur daa, na yenyim dɛ yɛtse fie wɔ nyimpadua no mu yi, yɛadɔ mu efi Ewuradze nkyɛn
na yɛnantsew gyedzi mu, na nnyɛ dza enyi tua mu a;
medɛ, yɛwɔ dɛm awerɛhyɛmu yi, na yɛpɛ dɛ yɛdɔ mu fi nyimpadua fie yi mu, na yɛkɔ fie wɔ Ewuradze nkyɛn.
Dɛm ntsi na yɛbɔ mbɔdzen dɛ yɛwɔ nyimpadua fie o, yɛwɔ ndɔmu o, yɛbɔsɔ n’enyi.
Na otwar dɛ wɔdze hɛn pue Kraest atsɛmbu egua no enyim hɔ, ama obiara eenya dza ɔayɛ no nyimpadua yi mu no, dɛ ɔyɛ papa o, bɔn o.
Na yenyim Ewuradze ho suro ntsi, yɛbɔ mbɔdzen dɛ yɛbɛma nyimpa ehu no dɛm, na Nyankopɔn dze, yɛada edzi ama no, na m’enyi da do dɛ yɛada edzi ama hom tsibowa so.
Na yennyi hɛnho ayɛw nnkyerɛ hom bio, na mbom yɛrema hom dza hom nam do bɛhyehyɛ homho wɔ hɛn afamu, na hom eenya biribi ebua hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ hɔnho enyiwado, na nnyɛ akoma mu no.
Na sɛ yeegyim mpo a, yeegyim ama Nyankopɔn, na sɛ hɛn enyi da hɔ a, ɔda ma hom.
Na Kraest dɔ kenyan hɛn, osiandɛ yebu no dɛ, sɛ ɔbaako wui maa hɔn nyina, nna hɔn nyina wui;
na owui maa hɔn nyina ma hɔn a wɔtse ase aannda ho anntsena ase amma hɔnankasa hɔnho, na mbom wɔaatsena ase ama nyia osiaan hɔn ntsi owui na ɔsoɛɛr bio no.
Dɛm ntsi ofir ndɛ yennyim obiara wɔ honam afamu, na sɛ yeehu Kraest wɔ honam afamu mpo a, afei dze yennyim no dɛm bio.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ obi wɔ Kraest mu a, ɔyɛ abɔdze fofor: ndzɛmba adadaw no etwa mu, na hwɛ, ndzɛmba nyina ayɛ fofor.
Na iyi nyina fir Nyankopɔn a ɔnam Kraest do aka hɛn nye nankasa noho abɔ mu, na ɔdze nkabɔmu som dwumadzi no ama hɛn no;
ɔno nye dɛ Nyankopɔn nam Kraest mu kaa wiadze nye nankasa bɔɔ mu, na oemmbu hɔn mfom enngu hɔn do, na ɔdze nkabɔmu som ho dwumadzi no ahyɛ hɛn nsa.
Dɛm ntsi yɛyɛ ananmusifo ma Kraest, ɔno nye dɛ Nyankopɔn nam hɛn do rototɔ serɛ hom: yegyina Kraest ananmu serɛ hom dɛ, Hom nye Nyankopɔn nka mbɔ mu.
Na nyia onnyim bɔn no, ɔyɛɛ no ɔbɔn maa hɛn, ama wɔaayɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn tsenenee wɔ no mu.
Dɛ yɛyɛ nkorɔfo a yɛnye no bɔ mu yɛ edwuma yi, yɛtotɔ serɛ hom dɛ mma hom nngye Nyankopɔn adom no kwa,
na Nyankopɔn ka dɛ, Ber a ɔsɛ mu na mitsiee wo, Na nkwagye da no moboaa wo: hwɛ, sesei nye ber a ɔsɛ; na sesei nye nkwagye da no!
Yɛmmpɛ dɛ yɛto obiara fintsidua biara wɔ biribiara a yɛyɛ mu, amma woeennhu mfom bi wɔ hɛn som no ho;
na mbom adze nyina mu hom mma yɛnda hɛnho edzi dɛ Nyankopɔn asomfo, wɔ abotar pii mu, wɔ ahohia mu, wɔ ahokyer mu, wɔ ahomtsew mu,
ɔhwe mu, efiadzenda mu, etutuw mu, ndwumadzen mu, epesi mu, mbuadadzi mu,
ahotsew mu, nyimdzee mu, penkyɛr mu, ayamuyie mu, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, ɔdɔ a ndabraba nnyi mu mu,
nokwasɛm no mu, Nyankopɔn tum mu, tsenenee akodze mu wɔ bankum nye nyimfa,
wɔ enyimnyam nye enyimguase mu, wɔ atsenka bɔn nye atsenka pa mu; dɛ esisifo naaso anokwafo;
dɛ hɔn a wonnyim hɔn, naaso wonyim hɔn yie; dɛ hɔn a woruwu, na hwɛ, yɛtse ase; dɛ hɔn a wɔtsea hɔn, naaso wonnku hɛn;
dɛ awerɛhofo naaso hɛn enyi gye daa; dɛ ehiafo naaso yɛma pii nya hɔnho; dɛ wonnyi hwee, naaso yɛwɔ adze nyina.
O Korintefo, yɛakasa pefee akyerɛ hom, yeebue hɛn akoma mu ama hom.
Nnyɛ hɛn mu na hom kyer, na mbom homankasa hom akɔndɔ mu na hom kyer.
Na hom so mekasa kyerɛ hom dɛ mbofra, hom mbue hom akoma mu mma hɛn dɛ mbrɛ yɛayɛ yi.
Mma hom nnye hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi nnya nkitahodzi kor: na nkitahodzi bɛn na tsenenee nye emumuyɛ wɔ? Anaa anyɛnkoyɛ bɛn na kan nye sum wɔ?
Na ebɛn fɛkuwbɔ na Kraest nye Belial wɔ? Anaa kyɛfa bɛn na gyedzinyi nye dza ɔnngye nndzi wɔ?

Na edziesie bɛn na Nyankopɔn asɔrfi nye abosom wɔ? Na hɛn dze, yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn tseasefo n’asɔrfi; dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn aka dɛ, Mebɛtsena hɔn mu, na manantsew hɔn mu, na mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn, na hɔn so ayɛ me man.
Dɛm ntsi Hom mfi hɔn mu mbra na hom ntsew homho, Ewuradze na ɔse, Amma hom annka efifidze; Na mebɛgye hom,
Na mayɛ Egya ama hom, Na hom ayɛ me mbabanyin nye mbabaa, Ewuradze Tumfo na ɔse.
Yɛwɔ dɛm anohoba yi ntsi, adɔfo, hom mma yɛnhohor hɛnho mfi honam nye sunsum mu fi nyina ho, na yenwie krɔnkrɔnyɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn ho suro mu.
Hom mbue hom akoma mu mma hɛn: yɛannyɛ obiara bɔn, yɛannsɛɛ obiara, yeennsisi obiara.
Mennka yi mmbu hom fɔ, na maka dada dɛ, yewu o, yɛtse ase o, hom wɔ hɛn akoma mu.
Medze hom tuw kɛse, mowɔ hom mu awerɛhyɛmu so, awerɛkyekyer ahyɛ me ma, wɔ hɛn ahohia nyina mu no, me dɛw bu do pii.
Na yɛbaa Masidonia mpo, hɛn honam ennya ahomgye bi, na wohiahiaa hɛn ho afa nyina: ɔko etwa hɛn ho ehyia na suro ahyɛ hɛn mu ma.
Naaso nyia ɔkyekye abrɛfo werɛ no nye Nyankopɔn, ɔnam Titus ne mbae do kyekyee hɛn werɛ:
na nnyɛ ne mbae nko, na awerɛkyekyer a no werɛ kyekyee wɔ hom mu so; ɔkaa mbrɛ hom esi afe me nye hom nkɔmbɔdzi nye hom mbɔdzembɔ a ɔwɔ mo ho kyerɛɛ me maa m’enyi gyee pii.
Na sɛ medze nwoma bɔhoow hom werɛ a, munnu moho, sɛ munuu moho mpo a; na muhu dɛ nwoma no, sɛ mber tsiabaa bi mpo a, ɔhoow hom werɛ.
Na afei dze, midzi dɛw, nnyɛ dɛ hom werɛ howee ntsi a, na dɛ hom werɛ howee kɔr nnuho mu; na hom werɛ hoow Nyankopɔn kwan do, amma hom aannhwer hɛn ho biribi.
Na Nyankopɔn kwan do awerɛhow dze, ɔyɛ nnuho a wɔdze kɔ nkwagye mu a wonnu ho wɔ ho, na wiadze awerɛhow dze, ɔma owu.

Na hwɛ, hom werɛ a ɔhoow Nyankopɔn do yi ara, ebɛn nhwɛyie na ɔayɛ wɔ hom mu, ebɛn anoyi, ebɛn ebufuwyi, ebɛn ehubɔ, ebɛn fe, ebɛn mbɔdzembɔ, ebɛn awerdzi! Adze nyina mu hom kyerɛɛ dɛ hom ho tsew wɔ asɛm no mu.
Na sɛ mekyerɛwee brɛɛ hom a, nnyɛ nyia ɔyɛɛ bɔn no ntsi a, eso nnyɛ nyia wɔyɛɛ no bɔn no ntsi a, na mbom ɔno nye dɛ hom nhwɛyie a hom hwɛ hɛn ho bɛda edzi ama hom wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Dɛm ntsi hɛn werɛ akyekye, na hɛn awerɛkyekyer mu hɛn enyi gyee mbordo wɔ Titus n’enyigye no ho, osiandɛ hom nyina adwedwe no sunsum.
Osiandɛ sɛ medze hom hyehyɛɛ moho kyerɛɛ no a, m’enyi annto, na mbom, mbrɛ yɛkaa asɛm nyina kyerɛɛ hom nokwar mu no, dɛmara na hɛn ahohyehyɛ a yɛhyehyɛɛ hɛnho wɔ Titus enyim ayɛ nokwar.
Na n’akoma wɔ hom do pii, dɛ ɔkaa hom nyina hom setsie, mbrɛ hom dze hu nye ahopopo gyee no no.
Midzi dɛw dɛ adze nyina mu no mowɔ hom mu awerɛhyɛmu.
Na eso enuanom, yɛma hom ehu Nyankopɔn adom a ɔdze adom Masidonia asɔrasɔr:
mbrɛ hɔn ahohia nsɔhwɛ kɛse mu hɔn dɛw mbordo nye hɔn hia dodow no buu do kyerɛɛ hɔn ayamuyie ahonya.
Na midzi hɔn ho dase dɛ wɔmaa dɛ mbrɛ wobotum, mpo dza ɔtra hɔn ahoɔdzen, a ofi hɔnara hɔn pɛ mu,
na wɔtotɔe serɛɛ pii dɛ wobenya kyɛfa wɔ hɔn som a wɔdze som ahotseweefo no wɔ adɔyɛ ho;
na nnyɛ dɛ iyi yɛ biribi a hɛn enyi daa do a, na mbom wɔnam Nyankopɔn ne pɛ do dzii kan dze hɔnankasa hɔnho maa Ewuradze, na afei wɔdze hɔnho maa hɛn so.
Na iyi ntsi yɛserɛɛ Titus dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ ase kan no, onwie adɔyɛ yi dɛmara wɔ hom so mu.
Na dɛ mbrɛ hom bor do wɔ adze nyina mu no, gyedzi, nye asɛm, nye nyimdzee, nye mbɔdzembɔ, nye hom dɔ a ɔwɔ hɛn do no, hom nhwɛ dɛ hom bɔbor do wɔ adom yi so mu.
Na mennka yi wɔ nhyɛ do, na mbom medze binom mbɔdzembɔ rosɔ hom dɔ no nokwar ahwɛ.
Na hom nyim hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest n’adom, dɛ ɔyɛ ɔhonyanyi, naaso hom ntsi ɔbɛyɛɛ ohianyi, ama hom nam ne hia do aayɛ ahonyafo.
Na m’adwen na mekyerɛ wɔ iyi mu, dɛ iyi na ɔfata hom, nnyɛ nyɛe nko bi, na ɔpɛ mu so, hom dzii kan hyɛɛ ase mfeda.
Na afei hom nwie ne nyɛɛ no so, dɛ mbrɛ hom ayɛ krado wɔ ɔpɛ mu, no wie so aayɛ dɛmara, dɛ mbrɛ hom botum.
Na sɛ ɔpɛ mu dze obi yɛ krado a, enyisɔ wɔ mu dɛ mbrɛ obi wɔ, na nnyɛ mbrɛ onnyi bi a.
Na mennka yi ama binom ho aadwe hɔn, na hom dze hom ho eeguan hom,
na dɛ ɔnyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛr ntsi a; ama dɛm ber yi mu hom mbordo no aakɔhwɛ hɔn hia, na hɔn so hɔn mbordo aabɔhwɛ hom hia, na aayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛr:
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Onyia ɔtasee pii ennya ma aammbor no do, na nyia ɔtasee kakrabaa so, ennhia no hwee.
Na ndaase nka Nyankopɔn a ɔdze hom ho mbɔdzembɔ kor yi ara ahyɛ Titus n’akoma mu.
Na otsiee hɛn afotu dze, naaso noara no mbɔdzembɔ kyɛn dɛm ntsi, ɔnam nankasa ne pɛ do baa hom nkyɛn.
Na yɛsomaa ɔno nye onua no a ne nkamfo wɔ asɛmpa no mu atahye wɔ asɔr nyina mu no;
na nnyɛ dɛm nko, ɔno na asɔrmba no eyi no dɛ ɔnye hɛn nnantsew wɔ adɔyɛ yi a yɛrosom ho yi mfa nkyerɛ Ewuradze n’enyimnyam nye hɛnara so hɛn mbɔdzembɔ kɛse no:
na yɛda hɛnho do amma obi eennya hɛn ho asɛm bi wɔ adze dodow a yɛrosom ho yi ho:
na yɛdwen dza ɔyɛ enyidzi ho sie, nnyɛ Nyankopɔn enyim nko, na mbom nyimpa enyim so.
Na yɛasoma hɛn nua a yeenya no nhunii dɛ ɔbɔ mbɔdzen wɔ ndzɛmba pii mu, na afei osian awerɛhyɛmu kɛse a oenya no hom mu ntsi, ɔbɔ mbɔdzen bor do.
Titus ho a, ɔyɛ me nyɛnko nye me nyɛnko dwumadzifo ma hom; hɛn nuanom ho a, wɔyɛ asɔr asomafo, Kraest enyimnyam.
Dɛm ntsi hom nyi hom dɔ nye ahohyehyɛ a yɛhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ hom ho ne dasee nkyerɛ hɔn wɔ asɔrasɔr enyim.
Na ahotseweefo som no ho dze, onnhia dɛ mekyerɛw mebrɛ hom;
osiandɛ minyim hom mbɔdzembɔ a medze hyehyɛ moho kyerɛ Masidoniafo, dɛ Akaia siesiee hɔnho afrenhyia nye yi, na hom mbɔdzembɔ yi ekenyan hɔn mu piinara.
Na masoma enuanom no, ama hɛn ahohyehyɛ a ɔwɔ hom ho aannyɛ kwa wɔ iyi afamu, na dɛ mbrɛ mekaa no, hom eesiesie homho;
na bi a Masidoniafo bi nye hɛn bɛba, na sɛ wɔbɔto hom dɛ hom nnsiesiee homho a, hɛn (yɛnnka dɛ hom), hɛn enyi aannto wɔ dɛm ahohyehyɛ yi mu.
Dɛm ntsi modween dɛ ohia dɛ meserɛ enuanom no dɛ wondzi kan wɔ hom nkyɛn mbɔboaboa hom akyɛdze a wɔabɔ hom nkaa esie no ano ngu hɔ, na ɔaada hɔ dɛ akyɛdze na nnyɛ epoobɔdze.
Na dza meka nye dɛ, Nyia odua no kyenkyen mu no, obobu no kyenkyen mu, na nyia odua no bafuu no obobu no bafuu.
Dɛ mbrɛ obiara esusu wɔ n’akoma mu, nnyɛ amemenemfe do, anaa nhyɛ do no ɔmma; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn dɔ nyia ɔtsew n’enyim dze ma.
Na Nyankopɔn botum dɛ ɔma adom nyina bor do ma hom na adze nyina mu nye daa nyina hom eenya dza ɔdɔɔ so nyina, ama hom aabor do wɔ edwuma pa nyina mu:
dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ɔtow petse, ɔdze ma ehiafo; Ne tsenenee tsim hɔ daa.
Na nyia ɔdze aba ma oduafo, na ɔma paanoo dɛ edziban no, ɔbɛma hom aba a hom dua no adɔɔ so, na ɔama hom tsenenee eduaba adɔr;
na hom eenya hom ho wɔ ayamuyie nyina mu, dza ɔnam hɛn do yɛ ndaase ho edwuma ma Nyankopɔn no.
Osiandɛ baguasom yi no som dze, nnyɛ dɛ wɔdze kɛhyɛ ahotseweefo no sintɔ ma nko, na ɔnam ndaase pii do bu do so ma Nyankopɔn;
na ɔnam ɔsom yi no nsɔhwɛ do wɔhyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ setsie a hom ka dɛ hom wɔ ma Kraest asɛmpa no, na ayamuyie ntoboa a hom yi boa hɔn nye nyimpa nyina ntsi;
na hɔn so woyi mpaa ma hom na wɔfe hom wɔ Nyankopɔn adom a ɔbor do wɔ hom do ntsi.
Ndaase nka Nyankopɔn wɔ n’akyɛdze a yenntum nnsusu no ntsi.
Afei emi mara Paul menam Kraest no dwe nye ne tsema do meserɛ hom, emi a mowɔ hom nkyɛn a mebrɛ moho adze wɔ hom enyim, na minnyi hom nkyɛn a, meyɛ dzendzenndzen no.
Mepa hom kyɛw ara, mma hom nnyɛ ma meba hom nkyɛn a, mannyɛ ndam wɔ hom do; ndam a mususu dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ meyɛ wɔ hɔn a wobu hɛn dɛ yɛnam honam afamu no do no.
Na kaansa yɛnam honam mu a, yɛnnyɛ ɔsa wɔ honam mu
osiandɛ akodze a yɛdze ko no nnyɛ honam dze, na mbom ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn tum akodze a wɔdze dwuruw akoban; yedwuruw adwen;
nye adze a ɔkrɔn biara a wɔma do tsia Nyankopɔn nyimdzee, na yɛfa adwen nyina ndɔmmum yɛ setsie ma Kraest;
na yeesiesie hɛnho dɛ, sɛ hom setsie wie pɛyɛ a, yɛbɔtɔ asoɔdzen nyina do wer.
Hom nhwɛ dza ɔda hom enyi do. Sɛ obi dze no werɛ twer nankasa noho dɛ ɔyɛ Kraest dze a, wɔmma onsusu iyi so wɔ nankasa no mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔno yɛ Kraest dze no, mbrɛ hɛn so yɛyɛ Kraest dze ara nye no.
Na sɛ mehyehyɛ moho mbordo wɔ tum a Ewuradze dze maa hɛn wɔ hom ntowdo na nnyɛ hom nsɛe ntsi no ho mpo a, m’enyi ronnto.
Memmpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ dɛ gyama medze nwoma rupuw hom bi.
Osiandɛ wɔse, No nwoma dze no mu yɛ dur, na okitsa tum ara yie, naaso sɛ ɔwɔ hɛn ntamu dze a, ɔyɛ mberɛw, na ne kasaa so ahoɔdzen biara nnyi mu.
Wɔmma onyia no nsusu dɛ, mbrɛ yennyi hɔ a yɛtse wɔ nwoma mu wɔ nsɛm mu no, yɛwɔ hɔ so a mbrɛ yɛtse wɔ nyɛe mu ara nye no.
Na yennsi hɛn bo mmfa hɛn ho mmfora, anaa yɛmmfa hɛnho nnto hɔn a wɔkamfo hɔnankasa hɔnho no ho; na hɔn dze, wɔdze hɔnho bu hɔnho, na wɔdze hɔnho toto hɔnankasa hɔnho ntsi, wonnyim nyansa.
Na hɛn dze, yɛrennhyehyɛ hɛnho ntra do, na mbom dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn no susudua esusu ama hɛn kɛpem no, dɛm esusudze yi odu hom nkyɛn.
Na yɛnntwe hɛn mu nntra do dɛ gyama yenndu hom nkyɛn, osiandɛ yɛdze Kraest asɛmpa no ebodu hom nkyɛn mpo.
Na yɛnnhyehyɛ hɛnho nntra do wɔ binom edwuma mu, na mbom yɛwɔ enyidado dɛ, sɛ hom gyedzi nyin a, wɔbɛyɛ hɛn kɛse mbordo wɔ hom mu dɛ mbrɛ hɛn susudua kɛpem,
na yɛakɛka asɛmpa no wɔ mbeambea a ɔwɔ hom ekyir noho, na yɛannhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ mbrɛ obi no dwumadzi pem wɔ dza woewie yɛ dada no ho.
Na nyia ɔhyehyɛ noho, ma ɔnhyehyɛ noho wɔ Ewuradze mu:
na nnyɛ nyia ɔkamfo noho na wɔapen no no, mbom nyia Ewuradze kamfo no no a.
Ao, nkyɛ hom eesie abotar etsie me nkwaseasɛm kakra ae! Nyew, hom nya mo ho abotar.
Na medze Nyankopɔn ho nyinkun twe hom ho nyinkun, dɛ magye hom awar ama ɔbarimba baako, dɛ medze hom dɛ ɔbaabun krɔnn rekɛma Kraest.
Na musuro dɛ bɛyɛ na oedua biribi do dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ no dze enyitsew daadaa Eve no, dɛmara so na wɔasɛɛ hom adwen efi nokwardzi nye krɔnnyɛ a hom wɔ wɔ Kraest afamu no ho.
Na sɛ nyia ɔba no ka Jesus fofor bi ho asɛm a yɛnnkae, anaa hom nya sunsum fofor bi a hom nnyae, anaa asɛmpa fofor bi a hom nngyee a, ɔnodze hom suo mu ntsɛm.
Na mubu dɛ mennka asomafo etsitsir no ekyir wɔ biribiara mu.
Kaansa meyɛ mberɛw wɔ kasa mu a, mennyɛ dɛm wɔ nyimdzee mu, na adze nyina mu yɛada iyi edzi wɔ nyimpa nyina mu wɔ hom afamu.
Anaa bɔn na mayɛ dɛ mabrɛ moho adze ma wɔaama hom do, osiandɛ mebɛkaa hom Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no kwa?
Mefaa asɔr binom hɔ adze dɛ akatua dɛ medze robɔsom hom;

na mowɔ hom nkyɛn na adze hiaa me no, mannyɛ adzesoa amma obi, na dza ohiaa me no, enuanom a wofi Masidonia bae no maa me nsa kae; na adze nyina mu mohwɛɛ moho dɛ mennkɛyɛ adzesoa ama hom, na dɛmara so na mobɔhwɛ.
Kraest no nokwar wɔ mo mu yi, obiara rinnsiw me kwan wɔ ahohyehyɛ yi ho wɔ Akaiaman no mu hɔ.
Ebɛnadze ntsi a? Dɛ monndɔ hom ntsi a? Nyankopɔn na onyim.
Na dza meyɛ no, mebɛyɛ, na maamma hɔn a wɔrohwehwɛ mo ho kwan no ennya kwan, na woeehu hɔn wɔ dza wɔdze hyehyɛ hɔnho no mu dɛ hɛnara.
Na dɛm nyimpa no, wɔyɛ asomafo atorfo, ndaadaa dwumadzifo, wɔdandan hɔnho Kraest asomafo.
Na ɔnnyɛ nwanwa, osiandɛ Satan mpo dan noho dɛ kan bɔfo.
Dɛm ntsi ɔnnyɛ adze kɛse bi dɛ n’asomfo so bɛdan hɔnho dɛ tsenenee asomfo: hɔn na hɔn ewiei bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndwuma tse.
Meka bio dɛ, Mma obi mmbu me ɔkwasea, na sɛ ɔtse dɛm mpo a, hom ngye me dɛ ɔkwasea, na mo so menhyehyɛ moho kakra.
Dza meka no, mennka no Ewuradze tum mu, na mbom ɔtse dɛ nkwaseasɛm, wɔ ahohyehyɛ mu.
Ɔnam dɛ piinara hyehyɛ hɔnho wɔ honam afamu ntsi, mo so mebɛhyehyɛ moho bi.
Na hom dze enyigye gye nkwasea, hom a hom yɛ enyitseweefo.
Sɛ obi dze hom ba nkowaasom ase, sɛ ɔmen hom, sɛ ɔfa hom, sɛ ɔma noho do, sɛ ɔbɔ hom enyi do a, hom pen do ma no.
Meka no enyimguase mu, dɛ gyama hɛn dze yɛyɛ mberɛw, naaso dza obi dze tuw no (merekasa dɛ mbrɛ aba biara nnyi mu), mo so medze tuw.
Wɔyɛ Hebriwfo? Mo so meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Israelfo? Mo so meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Abraham asefo? Mo so meyɛ bi.
Wɔyɛ Kraest asomfo? Merekasa dɛ ɔbɔdamfo, meyɛ no somfo kyɛn hɔn; ndwumadzen mu a, mbordo; efiadzenda mu a, mbordo; ɔhwe mu a, ntrado; owu mu a, mpɛn pii.
Jewfo nsamu mpɛn enum na magye mbaa eduanan a woyi do kor.
Wɔkaa me mpire mprɛnsa, wosiiw me abo prɛko, me hɛn abɔ wɔ po do mprɛnsa, medzi bun mu adzekyee nye adzesaa;
akwantu pii mu, esutsen mu esian, edwotwafo nsamu esian, amanyimfo nsamu esian, amanamamfo nsamu esian, kurow mu esian, wiramu esian, po mu esian, enuanom atorfo mu esian;
edwumayɛ nye ɔberɛ, epesi pii mu, ɔkɔm nye nsukɔm mu, akɔnkyen pii mu, awɔw nye adagyaw mu.
Iyinom nyina da nkyɛn a, dza ɔhyɛ mo do daa daa nye asɔrasɔr no nyina ho kɔdaannda.
Woana na ɔyɛ mberɛw na mennyɛ bi? Woana na wɔato no fintsidua na ɔnnhyehye me?
Sɛ ɔsɛ dɛ mehyehyɛ moho a, dza medze bɛhyehyɛ moho nye dza ɔkyerɛ me mberɛwyɛ.
Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus ne Nyankopɔn nye n’Egya a wohyira no afebɔɔ no, nyim dɛ minndzi ator.
Damaskɔs, ɔhen Aretas n’ambrado weɔɔn Damaskɔsfo kurow no dɛ ɔrepɛ me akyer me;
na wɔdze me too birefi mu duaa tokura mu gyaagyaa me ban ho sii famu, na mifii ne nsa.
Mfaso biara nnyi ho mpo a ohia dɛ mehyehyɛ moho naaso mebɛka Ewuradze enyido adzehu nye nyikyerɛ no.
Minyim nyimpa bi wɔ Kraest mu a mfe duanan nye yi wohwiim no kɔr ɔsor a otsia ebiasa no, (dɛm nyimpa no sɛ ɔwɔ honam mu o, onnyi honam mu o, minnyim, Nyankopɔn na onyim).
Na minyim dɛm nyimpa no (sɛ ɔwɔ honam mu o, okwetsir honam o, minnyim, Nyankopɔn na onyim),
dɛ wohwiim no kɔr Paradise, na ɔkɛtsee nsɛm a wɔnnka a nyimpa biara nnyi ho kwan dɛ ɔka.
Dɛm nyimpa no afamu na mebɛhyehyɛ moho, na mankasa m’afamu dze a, merennhyehyɛ moho, gyedɛ me mberɛwyɛ mu.
Na sɛ mepɛ dɛ mehyehyɛ moho mpo a, nkyɛ mennkɛyɛ kwasea, na mebɛkasa nokwar; naaso migyaa yɛ, ama obi eemmbu me annkyɛn mbrɛ ohu me dɛ metse, anaa ɔtse wɔ m’anomu.
Na nyikyerɛ ntrado no ntsi amma maamma moho do anntra do, wɔmaa me honam mu nsoɛ, Satan no bɔfoe, dɛ ɔbobɔ me ekutuku, amma maamma moho do anntra do.
Na iyi ntsi meserɛɛ Ewuradze mpɛn ebiasa dɛ ɔmma omfi mo do.
Na ɔsee me dɛ, M’adom dɔɔ so ma wo: na m’ahoɔdzen dzi mu wɔ wo mberɛwyɛ mu. Dɛm ntsi medze enyigye pii hyehyɛ moho mbom wɔ me mberɛwyɛ mu, ama Kraest ahoɔdzen aabɔsoɛ mo do.
Dɛm ntsi minya enyigye wɔ mberɛwyɛ mu, enyimguase mu, ahokyer mu, ntanenyi mu, ahomtsew mu, wɔ Kraest ntsi: na meyɛ mberɛw a, nna mbom meyɛ dzen.
Ana meyɛ kwasea? Nna homara na hom ahyɛ me ma mayɛ. Na emi dze, hom mbom na nkyɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom kamfo me, osiandɛ sɛ mennsɛ hwee mpo a, woyinom a wɔyɛ asomafo ara ma ɔbor do yi nnkyɛn me wɔ biribiara mu.
Ampaara medze abotar daa ɔsomafo nsɛnkyerɛdze edzi wɔ hom mu; iyinom nye: nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze nye tum ndwuma.
Na ebɛnadze mu na hom tɔɔ sin kyɛɛn asɔr nkaa no, gyama mankasa mannyɛ adzesoa amma hom no a? Nna hom mfa mo mfom yi nkyɛ me ɛ!

Hwɛ, iyi nye mpɛn ebiasa a mesiesie moho reba hom nkyɛn, na meremmbɛyɛ adzesoa ama hom: na nnyɛ hom adze na morohwehwɛ, na mbom homankasa a: na nnyɛ mba na ɔsɛ dɛ wɔkora ma awofo, na awofo mbom na ɔsɛ dɛ wɔkora ma mba;
na emi dze, medze enyigye pii mobɔhwer adze, na mama wɔahwer me ama hom akra. Sɛ modɔ hom mbordo dɛm a, iyi ntsi na hom dɔ me dɔ a osuar yi?
Na bi a ɔwɔ mu dɛm: mannyɛ adzesoa amma hom, naaso meyɛ onyitsewfo ntsi medze nyansa mekyeer hom.
Aso menam hɔn a mosomaa hɔn no bi do medzi hom emim anaa?
Meserɛɛ Titus, na mosomaa onua kaa no ho. Ana Titus bedzii hom emim bi? Ana nnyɛ Sunsum kor no ara mu na yɛnantsewee? Nnyɛ anamɔn kor no ara mu anaa?
Mber yi nyina hom dwen dɛ yeriyi hɛn ano akyerɛ hom. Yɛkasa Kraest mu wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim. Na, adɔfo, iyi nyina homankasa hom kankɔ ntsi a.
Na musuro dɛ bɛyɛ na meba a, mammbɔto hom dɛ mbrɛ mepɛ, na hom so ennhu me dɛ mbrɛ hom pɛ; bɛyɛ na bi a aperper, nyinkun, ebufuw, mpaapaamu, nsekubɔ, awasawasa, ɔhoran, etutuw wɔ hom mu;
bɛyɛ so bio na meba a, Nyankopɔn abrɛbrɛ me adze wɔ hom afamu, ama meegyam piinara a wɔyɛɛ bɔn nkan no, na wonnuu hɔnho wɔ hɔn efifidze nye ndwamanyɛ, nye ahoɔdɛw a wɔyɛɛ no ho no.
Mpɛn ebiasa nye yi a mereba hom nkyɛn. Adasefo beenu anaa baasa anomu na asɛm biara begyina.

Maka ana, na mereka no bio: mbrɛ mpɛn ebien a mowɔ hom nkyɛn mekae no, dɛmara na sesei a minnyi hom nkyɛn yi meka kyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛɛ bɔn nkan no, nye hɔn a wɔaka no nyina dɛ, sɛ meba bio a, minnkegyaa hom;
osiandɛ hom rohwehwɛ Kraest a ɔkasa mo mu no ho biribi ehu, ɔno na ɔnnyɛ mberɛw wɔ hom afamu, na mbom ɔyɛ tumfo wɔ hom mu:
na ɔnam mberɛw mu na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu dze, naaso ɔnam Nyankopɔn tum do tse ase. Na hɛn so yɛyɛ mberɛw wɔ no mu dze, naaso ɔnam Nyankopɔn tum do yɛnye no bɛtsena ase wɔ hom ntsi.
Hom mpɛnsampɛnsa hom mu nhwɛ dɛ hom wɔ gyedzi no mu anaa; hom nsɔ homho nhwɛ. Anaa hom nnyim dɛ Jesus Kraest tse hom mu? Gyedɛ gyama hom mmfora.
Na m’enyi da do dɛ hom bohu dɛ hɛn dze, yɛnnyɛ nyimpa a wɔmmfora.
Na yɛbɔ mpaa kyerɛ Nyankopɔn dɛ mma hom nnyɛ bɔn bi: nnyɛ dɛ ama woeehu hɛn dɛ yɛfora, na mbom ama hom aayɛ dza ɔyɛ fɛw, na hɛn dze, yaayɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔfora mpo.
Na yenntum nnyɛ hwee nntsia nokwar no, na mbom yɛyɛ ma nokwar no.
Na sɛ yɛyɛ mberɛw ma hom yɛ dzen a, yedzi dɛw; iyiara so ntsi na yɛbɔ mpaa, hom emudzi a.
Iyiara ntsi na minnyi hom nkyɛn yi mekyerɛw iyi mebrɛ hom, na sɛ meba a, menye hom eemmbedzi no wenwennwen, dɛ mbrɛ tum a Ewuradze dze maa me wɔ ntowdo na nnyɛ ɔsɛɛ bi ntsi no tse.
Dza medze wie nye dɛ, enuanom, hom ndzi dɛw; hom ndzi mu; hom werɛ nkyekyer; hom nyɛ adwenkor; hom ntsena asomdwee mu; na ɔdɔ nye asomdwee Nyankopɔn nye hom bɛtsena.
Hom mfa mfewano krɔnkrɔn nkyiakyia homho.
Ahotseweefo no nyina kyiakyia hom.
Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom, Nyankopɔn no dɔ, nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn anyɛnkoyɛ nka hom nyina.
Paul, ɔsomafo a ommfi nyimpa, eso ɔnnam nyimpa do na mbom ɔnam Jesus Kraest nye Nyankopɔn Egya a onyaan Kraest fii ewufo mu no do no,
nye enuanom nyina a wɔwɔ me nkyɛn, dze kɛma asɔrasɔr a wɔwɔ Galatia nyina:
Adom nye asomdwee a ofi Nyankopɔn Egya, nye hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nka hom.
Ɔno a hɛn bɔn ntsi ɔdze noho mae, ama oeeyi hɛn efi sesei bɔn wiadze yi mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn ne pɛ tse,
ɔno na enyimnyam nka no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
Ɔyɛ me ahobow dɛ hom redan homho ntsɛm dɛm efi nyia ɔfrɛɛ hom wɔ Kraest Jesus adom mu no ho akɔ asɛmpa fofor bi mu a
ɔnnyɛ asɛmpa fofor biara so, mbom binom wɔ hɔ a wɔretseetsee hom, na wɔrepɛ akyea Kraest asɛmpa no.
Na sɛ mpo hɛn anaa abɔfo bi fi sor bɛka hom asɛmpa fofor bi ka dza yɛaka akyerɛ hom no ho a, wɔmma mbusu nka no.
Dɛ mbrɛ yeedzi kan aka no, dɛmara na misi do bio, sɛ obi bɛka hom asɛmpa fofor bi ka dza hom agye no ho a, mbusu nka no.
Na afei nyimpa na morohwehwɛ enyimpa efi no hɔ anaa Nyankopɔn a? Anaa morohwehwɛ dɛ mosɔ nyimpa enyi? Sɛ meda ho mosɔ nyimpa enyi a, nkyɛ mennyɛ Kraest akowaa.
Enuanom, mepɛ dɛ hom hu dɛ asɛmpa no a meka no nnyɛ nyimpa dze.
Na manngye no nyimpa hɔ, eso wɔannkyerɛkyerɛ me, na mbom ɔnam Jesus Kraest ne nyikyerɛ do na minyae.
Hom atse nkan no m’abrabɔ wɔ Jewfo som no mu, mbrɛ misii tseetsee Nyankopɔn asɔr no mbordo, na mobɔɔ mbɔdzen dɛ mebɛsɛɛ no no.
Na mokɔr kan wɔ Jewfo som mu kyɛɛn m’etsipɛmfo dodowara, wɔ mankasa me man mu, na mobɔɔ m’egyanom atsetsesɛm ho mbɔdzen pii ma mpo ɔtraa do.
Naaso ber a ɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn a ɔsaan mu yii me sii nkyɛn ansaana wɔrowo me no n’enyi, na ɔnam n’adom do frɛɛ me no,
dɛ obeyi ne ba akyerɛ wɔ mo mu, ama maakɛka no ho asɛmpa akyerɛ amanamamfo no, ntsɛmara menye honam nye bɔgya enntu egyina:
eso mannkɔ Jerusalɛm wɔ hɔn a wodzii me kan yɛɛ asomafo no nkyɛn, na mokɔr Arabia na mebaa Damaskɔs bio.
Na mfe ebiasa ekyir no, mokɔr Jerusalɛm kohun Peter n’enyim, na midzii ne nkyɛn dadu ndaenum.
Na asomafo nkaa no dze, mennhu hɔn mu biara dɛ Ewuradze no nua James.
Dza merekyerɛw hom yi, Nyankopɔn enyim, minndzi ator.
N’ekyir na mebaa Siria nye Silisia afamu.
Nna Kraest n’asɔrasɔr a wɔwɔ Judea no nnhun m’enyim da:
na tse ara nna wɔatse dɛ, Nyia nkan no ɔtseetsee hɛn no, afei dze ɔreka gyedzi a ɔpeer dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no no ho asɛm papa.
Na emi ntsi, wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
Na mfe duanan ekyir no, mokɔr Jerusalɛm bio, emi nye Barnabas, na mefaa Titus so kaa hɛn ho.
Na menam nyikyerɛ a minyae do mokɔree: medze asɛmpa no a mekaa no amanaman mu no too hɔn enyim, (nye hɔn a wɔwɔ dzin wɔ hɔn mu no nsumaa mu), amma m’edwuma a mayɛ na dza mugu do reyɛ no aannyɛ kwa.
Na Titus a ɔka mo ho a ɔyɛ Griiknyi no mpo, wɔannhyɛ no dɛ ontwa twatsia.
Na enuanom atorfo a wɔaba hɛn mu no, hɔn a wowiawiaa hɔnho baa mu dɛ wɔrebɛsɛɛ hɛn adehyedzi a yɛwɔ no Kraest mu, na wɔdze hɛn aaba nkowaasom mu no:
hɔn dze, yɛammbrɛ hɛnho adze amma hɔn kwan dɔnhwer kor mpo, ama asɛmpa no no nokwar no aatsena hɔ wɔ hom afamu.
Na hɔn a wobu hɔn dɛ wɔyɛ etsitsir no (sɛ wɔtse dɛn ara mpo a, ɔmmfa mo ho hwee, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ nyimpa enyim) dɛm nkorɔfo a wɔse wɔwɔ dzin yi ammfa biribiara ammboa me:
na mbom wohun dɛ wɔdze monomonomfo mu asɛmpaka ahyɛ me nsa, dɛ mbrɛ wɔdze twatsiafo mu dze ama Peter;
(na nyia ɔnam Peter do yɛɛ edwuma maa twatsiafo mu asomafosom no, ɔnam mo so do yɛɛ edwuma maa amanamamfo no);

na wohun adom a wɔdze adom me no, James, Sefaas, nye John a wobuu hɔn dɛ wɔyɛ fadum no, tseen anyɛnkoyɛ nsa nyimfa maa emi nye Barnabas, dɛ hɛn yɛnkɔ amanamamfo hɔ, na hɔn so wɔnkɔ hɔn woetwa hɔn twatsia no hɔ,
mbom dza wɔdze too hɛn adwen do ara nye dɛ daa yɛnkaa abɔbɔfo; na ɔno so ara mpo nye adze a nna osi m’enyi do pɛpɛɛpɛ dɛ mebɛyɛ.
Mbom aber a Sefaas baa Antiok no, mekasaa n’enyim osiandɛ ɔdaa edzi pefee dɛ ɔafom.
Na ansaana binom a wofi James hɔ rebɛba no, nna ɔnye amanamamfo no dzidzii, na wɔbae no, ɔtwee noho tseew noho fii hɔn nkyɛn, amma hɔn a wofi twatsiafo mu no eenya biribi enntsia no.
Na Jewfo nkaa no so nye no yɛɛ dɛm ndabraba no, na hɔn ndabraba no twee Barnabas so kɛkaa hɔn ho.

Na muhun dɛ wɔrennantsew tɔɔtsen dɛ mbrɛ asɛmpa no nokwar no tse no, mekaa kyerɛɛ Peter wɔ hɔn nyina enyim dɛ, Sɛ ɔwo a eyɛ Jewnyi ebɔ wo bra dɛ amanamannyi na ennyɛ dɛ Jewnyi a, ɔyɛ dɛn na ehyɛ amanamamfo dɛ wɔnyɛ dɛ Jewfo?
Hɛn dze, yefi hɛn awoo mu yɛ Jewfo, na yɛnnyɛ amanaman mu ndzebɔnyɛfo bi naaso,

nyim dɛ wonndua mbra ndwuma do na wobu nyimpa bem, na mbom ɔnam Jesus Kraest gyedzi mu no, hɛn mpo yɛgyee Jesus Kraest dzii, ma wɔnam Kraest mu gyedzi do eebu hɛn bem, na nnyɛ mbra ndwuma mu a, osiandɛ worunndua mbra ndwuma do mbu nyimpa biara bem.
Na yɛrohwehwɛ dɛ wobu hɛn bem wɔ Kraest mu yi, na wohu hɛn dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo a, nna Kraest yɛ ndzeyɛɛbɔn somfo anaa? Atserkwa!
Na sɛ motow dza mudwuruwii no bio a, nna mekyerɛ moho dɛ mbratonyi.
Na emi dze, ɔnam mbra do muwui maa mbra, ama maatsena ase ama Nyankopɔn.
Wɔabɔ emi nye Kraest mbeamudua mu; naaso metse ase; na nnyɛ emi a, na Kraest na ɔtse mo mu: na ase a metse wɔ honam mu yi, metse no Nyankopɔn Ba a ɔdɔɔ me na ɔdze noho maa me no ne gyedzi mu.
