Memma Nyankopɔn n’adom no nnyɛ kwa: na sɛ mbra no na obu hɛn bem dze a, nna Kraest no wu no ayɛ gyan.
O Galatiafo adwenmuharfo! Woana ara tumii daadaa hom dɛm? Hom ampaara a wɔdze Jesus Kraest a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no esi hom enyim pɔkyee akyerɛ mo no nye yi?
Dza mepɛ dɛ metse fi hom anomu ara nye dɛ, Ana hom nam mbra ndwuma no do nyaa Sunsum no, anaa hom nam gyedzi asɛm a hom tsee no do?
Ana hom yɛ adwenhar dɛm a? Hom hyɛɛ ase wɔ Sunsum mu a, afei ɔyɛ dɛn na hom ruwie no honam mu yi?
Ntsi hom ehu amandze pii yi gyan? Aso ampa dɛ enya ayɛ gyan a?
Ana nyia ɔdze Sunsum no ma hom, na ɔyɛ tum ndwuma wɔ hom mu no, ɔnam mbra ndwuma do na ɔyɛ, anaa ɔnam gyedzi asɛmpa a hom tsee no do?
Na dɛ mbrɛ Abraham gyee Nyankopɔn dzii, na wobuu no tsenenee maa no no,
dɛmara so na hom nhu dɛ hɔn a wɔgye dzi no, hɔnara nye Abraham asefo.
Na kyerɛwsɛm no dzii kan hun dɛ Nyankopɔn nam gyedzi do bobu amanaman bem ntsi, kyerɛwsɛm dzii kan kaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ Abraham dɛ, Wo mu na wobehyira amanaman nyina.
Dɛm ntsi hɔn a wofi gyedzi mu no woehyira hɔn aka gyedzinyi Abraham ho.
Na dodow a wɔdze hɔnho to mbra ndwuma do no, wɔwɔ ndom ase, na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ndom aka obiara a ɔnnkɔ do ntsena dza ɔwɔ mbra nwoma no nyina mu, na ɔnnyɛ no.
Na ɔyɛ pefee dɛ, mbra mu dze, obi nndzi bem wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim; osiandɛ, Ɔtseneneenyi nam gyedzi do bɛtsena ase.
Ɔwɔ mu dɛ mbra mmfi gyedzi mu, naaso, Nyia ɔyɛ dza mbra no hwehwɛ no nam mu benya nkwa.
Kraest poon hɛn fii mbra no no ndom mu, osiandɛ wɔdze no yɛɛ ndom maa hɛn: na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ndom aka obiara a ɔsɛn dua do:
ama Abraham ne nhyira no nam Kraest Jesus do aaba amanamamfo no do, na ɔnam gyedzi do hɛn nsa aaka Sunsum a wɔdze bɔɔ anohoba no.
Enuanom, medze dza yehu no daa reyɛ mfatoho: Nyimpa ne samansew a wɔasɔw ano mpo, obi nntum nnsesa no, eso ɔmmfa bi nnka ho.
Afei, Abraham nye n’asenyi na wɔbɔɔ hɔn anohoba no. Anohoba no nnka dɛ, Nye w’asefo, dɛ gyama wɔyɛ pii; na mbom ɔka dɛ, Nye w’asenyi; iyi kyerɛ dɛ ɔbaako, na ɔno nye Kraest.
Na dza mese nye dɛ, Ahyɛmu a Nyankopɔn dzii kan hyɛɛ no dzen (siee Kraest mu) no, mbra no a n’ekyir mfe ahaanan eduasa ansaana ɔbae no, nntum nntu nngu, ma anohoba no nnyɛ gyan.
Na sɛ egyapadze no fi mbra mu a, nna ommfi anohoba mu bio: na Abraham dze, Nyankopɔn nam anohoba no do dze kyɛɛ no.
Nna dɛm a mbra no nye dza ɔwɔ hen? Mbrato ntsi na wɔdze kaa ho dze kesii dɛ asenyi no a wɔdze anohoba no bɔɔ no no bɛba; na wɔnam abɔfo do hyɛe wɔ ntamugyinafo nsamu.
Na ntamugyinafo nnyɛ ɔbaako, na Nyankopɔn dze ɔyɛ ɔbaako.
Nna mbra no tsia Nyankopɔn anohoba no anaa? Atserkwa, oho! Na sɛ wɔhyɛɛ mbra bi a obotum ama nkwa a, nkyɛ tsenenee nam mbra do.
Na kyerɛwsɛm no apata adze nyina ahyɛ bɔn ase, ama anohoba no a ɔnam Kraest mu gyedzi do no, wɔdze aama hɔn a wɔgye dzi.
Na ansaana gyedzi rebɛba no, wɔdze hɛn siee mbra no mu weɔn hɛn, maa gyedzi a wɔrebɛda no edzi akyerɛ no.
Dɛm ntsi, nna mbra no yɛ hɛn kyerɛfo ara dze hɛn ba Kraest nkyɛn, ama wɔnam gyedzi do eebu hɛn bem.
Na nkyii gyedzi enya aba yi, yɛnnda ho nnhyɛ ɔkyerɛfo no ase bio.
Na hom nyina nam gyedzi do yɛ Nyankopɔn mba wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
Na hom mu dodow a woenuma hɔn akɔ Kraest mu no wɔahyɛ Kraest,
Jewnyi anaa Griiknyi nnyi beebi, akowaa anaa ɔdehye nnyi beebi, ɔbarimba anaa ɔbaa nnyi beebi: na hom nyina ayɛ kor wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
Na sɛ hom yɛ Kraest dze a, na hom yɛ Abraham asefo, na hom nam anohoba no do yɛ adzedzifo.
Dza mekyerɛ nye dɛ, nyia odzi adze no (obi a woegya no egyapadze no) yɛ abofra yi, kaansa ɔno nye ndzɛmba no nyina wura mpo a, ɔnnsor ɔno nye akowaa;
na ɔhyɛ ahwɛdofo nye efihwɛfo ase, dze kesi dɛ mber a egya no ahyɛ no bɔso.
Dɛmara so na hɛn so yɛyɛ mbofra no, yɛyɛɛ nkowaa wɔ wiadze sunsum mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ no ase:
na aber no durii no, Nyankopɔn somaa ne Ba a ɔbaa woo no no, nyia wɔwoo no mbra ase no,
dɛ ɔmbɔpon hɔn a wɔwɔ mbra no ase no, ama wɔaafa hɛn ayɛ mba.
Na osiandɛ hom yɛ mba ntsi, Nyankopɔn asoma ne Ba no Sunsum aba hom akoma mu a ɔtsea mu dɛ, Abba, Egya.
Dɛm ntsi ennda ho nnyɛ akowaa na eyɛ ɔba, na sɛ eyɛ ɔba dze a, nna enam Nyankopɔn do yɛ odziadzenyi.
Naaso ber no, nna hom nnyim Nyankopɔn ntsi, hom kɔr nkowaasom mu ma hɔn a hɔn su mu wɔnnyɛ nyame no.
Na afei hom ebohu Nyankopɔn, anaa mpo dɛ Nyankopɔn ehu hom yi, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom dan bio kɔ sunsum mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɔyɛ mberɛw na wodzi hia no ho? Ana hom pɛ dɛ hom kɔ nkowaasom mu ma hɔn bio?
Hom dzi nda, nye abosoom, nye mber, nye mfrenhyia.
Musuro wɔ hom ho dɛ bi a maberɛ moho ama hom kwa.
Enuanom, meserɛ hom, hom nyɛ dɛ emi, osiandɛ mo so metse dɛ hom. Hom annyɛ me bɔn bi:
na hom nyim dɛ honam mberɛw do na mekaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ hom nkan no:
na dza ɔyɛɛ hom nsɔhwɛ wɔ mo honam mu no, hom emmbu me enyimtsia, eso hom ennkyir me, na mbom hom gyee me dɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoe, nyew, dɛ Kraest Jesus mpo.
Na afei hom enyigye no wɔ hen? Osiandɛ mara midzi hom dase dɛ sɛ nna wɔyɛ na ɔyɛ yie a, nkyɛ hom tutuu hom enyiwa mpo maa me.
Na afei ɔnam dɛ meka nokwar no kyerɛ hom ntsi, madan hom tamfo anaa?
Ɔbɛyɛ dɛ binom bɔ hom ho mbɔdzen hwehwɛ hom, naaso nnyɛ hom yieyɛ bi mu a, na pɛ na wɔrepɛ esiw hom kwan, ama hom aaper ahwehwɛ hɔn.
Na oye dɛ nkyɛ wɔbɔ hom yieyɛ ho mbɔdzen daa, na nnyɛ ber a menye hom wɔ hɔ nko.
Ao, me mba nkakraba a moroko hom awo bio ekesi dɛ wobowie Kraest suban yɛ wɔ hom mu,
nyew, mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ mowɔ hom nkyɛn sesei, ama maasakyer mbrɛ mudua yɛ m’adze, osiandɛ me tsirmu yɛ me konsee wɔ hom ho.
Hom a hom rohwehwɛ mbra no ase akɛhyɛ, hom nka nkyerɛ me, hom nntse dza mbra no ka anaa?
Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ Abraham woo mbabanyin beenu, ɔbaako yɛ afonabaa ba na ɔbaako yɛ ɔdehye ba.
Na nyia ɔyɛ afonabaa ba no, wɔwoo no honam do, na ɔdehye ba no dze, wɔnam anohoba no do na wɔwoo no.
Na nsɛm no yɛ ntotoho ara: na mbaa beenu yi yɛ ahyɛmu ahorow ebien no, ɔbaako fi bepɔw Sinai do woo mba guu nkowaasom mu, ɔno nye Hagar.
Na iyi nye Hagar, bepɔw Sinai ne dzin a ɔwɔ Arabia no, na ɔno gyina hɔ ma ndɛ Jerusalɛm yi: na ɔno nye ne mba wɔ nkowaasom mu.
Na Jerusalɛm a ɔwɔ sor no dze, odzi noho do, ɔno nye hɛn nyina hɛn na.
Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ɔbɔnyin a ennwoo, dzi dɛw; Ɔwo a ennko awoo, bɔ ose na tseatsea mu: Osiandɛ nyia onnyi bi no ne mba adɔɔ so akyɛn nyia ɔwɔ kun nedze.
Na hɛn dze, enuanom, dɛ mbrɛ Isaak tse no, yɛyɛ anohoba no mba.
Na dɛ mbrɛ ber no, nyia wɔwoo no honam do no taan nyia wɔwoo no Sunsum do no enyi no, mbrɛ ɔtse seseiara so nye no.
Naaso kyerɛwsɛm no se dɛn? Pam afonabaa no nye ne ba no, na afonabaa ba no rennye ɔdehye ba no rinndzi adze.
Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, yɛnnyɛ afonabaa mba, na mbom yɛyɛ ɔdehye no mba.
Adehyedzi mu na Kraest ama yɛagye hɛnho; dɛm ntsi hom ngyina pintsinn, na mma hom mma kwan ma wɔnnyɛ hom nkowaa bio.
Hwɛ, emi Paul mese hom dɛ, sɛ hom ma homho kwan ma wotwa hom twatsia a, nna Kraest nnyɛ hom mfaso bi.
Na mitsi mu bio kyerɛ obiara a ɔgye twatsiatwa no dɛ, ɔyɛ kafonyi, otwar dɛ odzi mbra no nyina do.
Hom a hom pɛ dɛ wobu hom bem wɔ mbra no mu no, wɔatsew hom efi Kraest mu; hom efi adom no ho ahwe ase.
Na hɛn dze, yɛnam Sunsum mu dua gyedzi do tweɔn tsenenee enyidado no.
Na Kraest Jesus mu dze, nnyɛ twatsiatwa, anaa monomonomyɛ, na ɔyɛ biribi, na mbom gyedzi a ɔnam ɔdɔ do yɛ edwuma a.
Hom tutuu mbirika yie, na woana na oesiw hom kwan dɛ mma hom nntsie nokwar no.
Dɛm adwen nsakyeree yi dze, ommfi nyia ɔfrɛɛ hom no.
Mbɔrkaw kakra na ɔkaw mbɔr nyina.
Mowɔ awerɛhyɛmu wɔ hom ho wɔ Ewuradze mu dɛ hom ronndwen biribi fofor bi: na nyia ɔretan hom enyi no, woana nye no ara a, obenya n’atsɛmbu.
Na emi dze, enuanom, sɛ meda ho ka twatsiasɛm a, nkyɛ ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔda ho tseetsee me yi? Ɔno dze nna mbeamudua no ho fintsidua no aba ewiei.
Sɛ ɔka mo nko a, nkyɛ hɔn a wɔma hom adwen mu yɛ hom basabasa no edzi hɔnara hɔn ho ewu.
Na hom dze, enuanom, wɔafrɛ hom ama adehyedzi, na adehyedzi no mma hom kwan ma hom nnhyɛ honam apɛdze ma, na mbom hom ndua ɔdɔ do nsonsom homho.
Na mbra no nyina ahyɛ ma wɔ asɛm kor mu, ɔno nye yi; Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa woho.
Na sɛ hom keka, na hom memen homho nkorkor a, hom nhwɛ yie amma hom aannsɛɛ homho.
Na mese, Hom nnantsew Sunsum mu, na mma hom nnhyɛ honam akɔndɔ ma.
Na honam kɔn dɔ tsia Sunsum, na Sunsum tsia honam, na ndzɛmba ebien yi nnka, amma hom aannyɛ ndzɛmba a hom pɛ.
Na sɛ Sunsum no kyerɛ hom kwan a, nna hom nnyi mbra no ase.
Na honam su ndwuma no da edzi pefee, ɔno nye yinom: ndwamanyɛ, efifidze, ahoɔdɛw,
abosonsɔr, abayisɛm, ɔtan, mansotwe, ahoɔyaw, ebufuw, nyinkuntwe, mpaapaamu, ekuwbɔbɔn,
enyitan, asabow, asakasakagor, nye dza ɔtsetse dɛm a meka kyerɛ hom kotoo, dɛ mbrɛ maka akyerɛ hom dada no, dɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba no rinnya Nyankopɔn ahendzi no.
Na Sunsum no aba nye ɔdɔ, dɛw, asomdwee, penkyɛr, ayamuyie, papayɛ, gyedzi,
ɔdwe, ahohyɛdo; mbra bi nnyi hɔ tsia yinom.
Na hɔn a wɔyɛ Kraest Jesus dze no, wɔabɔ honam nhyɛdodze nye n’akɔndɔ nyina mbeamudua mu.
Sɛ yɛtse ase wɔ Sunsum mu a, hom mma yɛnnantsew Sunsum mu so.
Mma yɛnnyɛ enyimnyampɛ hun nnyiyi hɛnho ebufuw, nntentan hɛnho.
Enuanom, sɛ mfom bɔto obi awerɛfir mu a, hom a hom yɛ sunsummufo no mfa tsema ndan nyia ɔafom no. Na hwɛ woho yie, amma wɔaannsɔ wo so annhwɛ.
Hom nsoasoa hom mu kor biara n’adzesoa, na dɛm no hom ahyɛ Kraest mbra ma.
Na sɛ obi bu noho dɛ ɔyɛ obi, wɔ aber kor a ɔnnyɛ obiara a, ɔdaadaa noara noho.
Na hom mma obiara nsɔ nankasa n’edwuma nhwɛ, nna obenya noara no ho biribi dze ahyehyɛ noho, na nnyɛ obi ho a.
Osiandɛ obiara bɔsoa nankasa n’adzesoa.
Hom mma nyia wɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no asɛm no mu no mmema nyia ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no no wɔ ndzepa nyina mu.
Mma hom nndaadaa homho; Onyankopɔn wonnsi no atwetwe; dza nyimpa dua no, ɔnoara na obobu.
Na nyia odua ma nankasa no honam no, ofi honam mu bobu prɔwee, na nyia odua ma Sunsum no fi Sunsum mu bobu onnyiewiei nkwa.
Mma hom mma yɛmmberɛ wɔ papayɛ mu, na sɛ yɛanntɔ bahaw a, yebobu no ne ber ano.
Dɛm ntsi, sɛ yenya ber a ɔsɛ a, hom mma yɛnyɛ papa mma nyimpa nyina, nkanka hɔn a wɔyɛ gyedzi fifo no.
Hom nhwɛ akyerɛw akɛse a medze mankasa me nsa akyerɛw rebrɛ hom no.
Dodow a wɔpɛ dɛ hɔn enyim ba nyam wɔ honam mu no, hɔn na wɔhyɛ hom dɛ hom ntwa twatsia, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma wɔnnkɛtseetsee hɔn wɔ Kraest mbeamudua ho ara ntsi a.
Na hɔn a wɔagye twatsiatwa no mpo hɔnankasa nndzi mbra no do, na wɔrohwehwɛ dɛ hom twa twatsia, na wɔdze hom aahyehyɛ hɔnho.
Na emi dze, ɔmmpar me dɛ mebɛhyehyɛ moho, gyedɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest mbeamudua no mu, ɔno do na wɔnam abɔ wiadze mbeamudua mu ama me, na wɔabɔ mo so mbeamudua mu ama wiadze.
Na nnyɛ twatsiatwa anaa monomonomyɛ na ɔyɛ biribi, na mbom abɔdze fofor a.
Na dodow a wodzi dɛm nhyehyɛɛ yi do no, asomdwee nye mbɔbɔrhu mbra hɔn nye Nyankopɔn ne Israel no do.
Ofi ndɛ kɔ yi, mma obi nntseetsee me: osiandɛ mowɔ Jesus n’akam wɔ me nyimpadua ho.
Enuanom, hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom nka hom sunsum. Amen.
Paul a ɔnam Nyankopɔn ne pɛ do yɛ Kraest Jesus no somafo dze nwoma yi kɛma ahotseweefo a wɔwɔ Efeso a wɔyɛ Kraest Jesus mu agyedzifo no.
Adom nye asomdwee a ofi Nyankopɔn hɛn Egya nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest no nka hom.
Nhyira nka hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne Nyankopɔn nye n’egya a ɔdze sunsum mu nhyira nyina ehyira hɛn wɔ sorsor wɔ Kraest Jesus mu:
dɛ mbrɛ ɔnam ɔdɔ mu yii hɛn wɔ Kraest mu ansaana wɔrehyɛ wiadze ase, dɛ yɛnyɛ ahotseweefo nye hɔn a wonndzi dzɛm biara wɔ n’enyim no.
Oyii hɛn too hɔ dɛ ɔnam Jesus Kraest do bɛfa hɛn abayɛ ama noho dɛ mbrɛ ne pɛ enyisɔ tse,
ama woeeyi n’adom a ɔdze adom hɛn no Dɔba no mu no n’enyimnyam ayɛw.
Ɔnoara no mu na yɛnam no bɔgyaa do enya hɛn pon yi, mekyerɛ mfom mu fakyɛ a ɔnam n’adom ahonya do a.
Ɔama abor do ama hɛn wɔ nyansa nye nyimdzee nyina mu,
na oeyi ne pɛ n’esumasɛm akyerɛ hɛn dɛ mbrɛ n’enyisɔ a osusui wɔ ne tsirmu no tse.
Dɛ mber no aso pɛpɛɛpɛr a wɔbɛka ndzɛmba nyina abɔ mu kor wɔ Kraest mu, ɔyɛ ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ sorsor na asaase do nyinara.
Ɔno Kraest no ara so mu na hɛn so yeenya egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔnam ne pɛ apam do yɛ ndzɛmba nyina no, nam ne tsirmpɔw do hyehyɛe too hɔ;
dɛ hɛn a hɛn enyi daa Kraest do kan no mbɛyɛ n’enyimnyam ho ayɛyi.
No mu so, na hom tsee nokwar asɛm no a ɔyɛ hom nkwagye ho asɛmpa no. Ɔnoara mu so na hom gyee dzii no, wɔdze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a wɔbɔɔ ho anohoba no a
ɔyɛ hɛn kyɛfa ho nsewhyɛdze no asɔw hom ano. Iyi nye ɔgye a ɔdze agye hɔn a wɔyɛ nankasa nedze no ama n’enyimnyam ayɛyi no.
Dɛm ntsi, mo so metsee Ewuradze Jesus mu gyedzi a ɔwɔ hom mu, nye ɔdɔ a hom dze dɔ ahotseweefo nyina no,
minngyaa dɛ meda ase wɔ hom ntsi, na mekaa hom wɔ me mpaabɔ mu.
Mobɔ mpaa dɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne Nyankopɔn no, enyimnyam Egya no, ɔmma hom nyansa nye nyikyerɛ sunsum wɔ no ho nyimdzee mu;
dɛ hom adwen enyi ntsew, na hom nhu ne frɛ no ho enyidado no, nye n’egyapadze enyimnyam ahonya wɔ ahotseweefo no mu.
Afei so, ɔmma hom nhu no tum kɛseyɛ mbordo a ɔwɔ hɛn a yɛgye dzi no do, dɛ mbrɛ no tum ahoɔdzen ndzeyɛe a
ɔdze yɛɛ adze wɔ Kraest mu nyaan no fii ewufo mu no tse. Ɔdze no tsenaa n’enyimfa wɔ sorsor,
wɔ mpanyindzi, nye tumdzi, nye ahoɔdzen, nye ahendzi nyina do, nye dzin a wɔbɔ nyina do, nnyɛ wiadze mber yi mu nko, na mbom dza ɔreba no so mu.
Ɔabrɛ adze nyina adze aba n’ananadze, na ɔdze no ayɛ adze nyina do tsir ama asɔr no a
ɔyɛ ne nyimpadua no, nyia ɔhyɛ adze nyina ma wɔ ndzɛmba nyina mu no n’amayɛ mu.
Na hom so a nkyɛ hom yɛ ewufo wɔ hom mfom nye ndzebɔn a,
nkan no hom nantseew mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔfa wiadze yi mber ho, dɛ mbrɛ wimu tum panyin no tse, sunsum a ɔyɛ edwuma sesei wɔ hɔn a wɔyɛ asoɔdzen no mu.
Nkyɛ hɛn nyina so tse hɔn mu bɔ hɛn bra wɔ honam akɔndɔ mu, na yɛyɛɛ dza honam nye adwen pɛ, na yɛnam hɛn awosu mu yɛɛ nkorɔfo a Nyankopɔn ebufuw wɔ hɔn do dɛ hɔn a wɔaka no so:
naaso Nyankopɔn a n’ehumbɔbɔr dɔɔ so no, nam no dɔ kɛse a ɔdze dɔɔ hɛn
wɔ ber a nna yɛyɛ ewufo wɔ mfom mu no, ama yɛnye Kraest enya nkwa; (adom do na wɔnam agye hom nkwa.)
Oenyan hɛn aka no ho, na ɔama yɛnye no atsena sorsor hɔ wɔ Kraest Jesus mu;
ama mbersantsen a ɔreba no mu oeeyi n’adom ahonya mbordo no akyerɛ, wɔ ayamuyie a ɔayɛ hɛn wɔ Kraest Jesus mu no.
Na adom na wɔdze nam gyedzi do agye hom nkwa; na ommfi homankasa, ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛdze a:
ommfi ndwuma mu, amma obiara aannhyehyɛ noho.
Na yɛyɛ n’edwinsa a ɔbɔɔ hɛn Kraest Jesus mu maa ndwuma pa a Nyankopɔn siesiei too hɔ dɛ yɛnnantsew mu no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nkaa dɛ, hom a nkyɛ nkan no hom yɛ Amanamamfo wɔ honam mu, ma hɔn a wɔfrɛ hɔnho Twatsiatwafo, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔdze nsa ara gyan twa no honam mu no frɛ hom Monomonomfo no.

Hom nkaa bio dɛ ber no, nna hom nnyi Kraest nkyɛn, na hom yɛ ananaben a hom mmfora Israel amamba, na hom yɛ ahɔho wɔ anohoba ahyɛmu horow no ho, nna hom nnyi enyidado, eso hom nnyi Nyankopɔn bi wɔ wiadze.
Na afei dze, hom wɔ Kraest Jesus mu, ma Kraest bɔgya no dze hom a nkyɛ hom wɔ ekyirekyir no abɛn.
Na ɔnoara ankasa nye hɛn asomdwee, ɔno a ɔayɛ ebien yi adze kor, na nankasa no honam nyimpadua mu oedwuruw fasu a otwa hɛn ntamu yɛ hɛn atamfo no egu famu.
Oegu mbra no mu ahyɛdze nye nhyehyɛɛ no nyina, na ɔdze hɔn beenu nyina abɔ nyimpa fofor kor wɔ nankasa no mu, ma asomdwee aba;
na ɔnam ne mbeamudua no do aka ebien nyina abɔ mu ayɛ nyimpadua kor ama Nyankopɔn, na ɔdze mbeamudua kor yi ara so eku nyitan nyina.
Na ɔbae bɛkaa asomdwee ho nsɛmpa kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir, nye hɔn a wɔbɛn:
na ɔnam no mu na hɛn beenu nyina nam Sunsum kor mu enya kwan wɔ Egya no nkyɛn.
Na afei hom nnyɛ ahɔho nye amamforafo bio, mbom hom yɛ ahotseweefo na kuromamfo nye Nyankopɔn fiemba;
wɔdze hom esi asomafo nye nkɔnhyɛfo no fapem do a Kraest Jesus nankasa nye kutuwdo bo tsitsir.
No mu na dza woesi no nyina keka si enyim a, orinyin akɛyɛ Nyankopɔn asɔrdan krɔnkrɔn wɔ Ewuradze mu.
Ɔnoara so no mu na worisi hom so ayɛ hom Nyankopɔn ne tsenabea wɔ Sunsum mu.
Iyi ntsi na emi Paul, meyɛ Kraest Jesus daduanyi ma hom amanamamfo,
ɔbɛyɛ dɛ hom atse ofihwɛ edwuma a hom ntsi wɔdze ama me no ho asɛm,
mbrɛ wɔnam nyikyerɛ do yii esumasɛm no kyerɛɛ me, dɛ mbrɛ makyerɛw no nsɛm tsiabaa bi mu abrɛ hom no.
Ɔno na, sɛ hom kenkan a, hom dze bohu me ntseasee a ɔwɔ Kraest esumasɛm no mu a
mbersantsen bi mu wɔamma nyimpa mba ennhu, dɛ mbrɛ afei woeyi akyerɛ n’asomafo nye nkɔnhyɛfo krɔnkrɔn wɔ Sunsum mu no.
Ɔno nye dɛ amanamamfo so bɛyɛ adzedzifo bi, nye nyimpadua kor no ara bi, na wɔnam asɛmpa no do eenya kyɛfa wɔ anohoba no ho bi, wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
Ɔno no ho ɔsomfo na mebɛyɛe, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn adom akyɛdze a wɔdze akyɛ hɛn no tum edwumayɛ tse no.
Emi a musuar sen ahotseweefo nyina no na wɔdze adom yi adom me, dɛ menka Kraest ahonya a onnyi nhwehwɛmu no ho asɛm nkyerɛ amanamamfo;
na memma nyimpa nyina nhu esumasɛm no ho dwumadzi a ofi tsetseetse nyina oesuma wɔ Nyankopɔn a ɔbɔɔ ndzɛmba nyina no mu no.
Ama afei ɔnam asɔr no do ama mpanyindzi nye etum horow a wɔwɔ sor hɔ eehu Nyankopɔn nyansaa horow pii no,
dɛ mbrɛ tsetse tsirmpɔw a ɔbɔe wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Kraest Jesus mu no tse.
No mu na yɛnam no ho gyedzi do enya ndamyɛ nye kwan wɔ awerɛhyɛmu mu.
Dɛm ntsi meserɛ dɛ mma hom abaw mu mmbu wɔ amandze a hom ntsi muruhu no ho, osiandɛ iyi yɛ hom enyimnyam.
Iyi ntsi na mubu ntwɛr wɔ Egya no enyim,
ɔno a wofi no mu na egyamba a wɔwɔ sor nye asaase nyina no nya hɔn dzin.
Dɛ mbrɛ n’enyimnyam ahonya tse no, ɔmma hom ndua no Sunsum do nnya tum mu ahoɔdzen wɔ hom mu nyimpasu no mu.
Ɔmma Kraest ndua gyedzi do ntsena hom akoma mu; ama sɛ hom gye ndwow na hom tsintsim wɔ dɔ mu a,
hom eenya ahoɔdzen nye ahotseweefo no nyina eehu Kraest no dɔ no ne tɛtɛr, ne tsentsen, no krɔn no nye no bun no.
Nyew, nkyɛ hom eehu Kraest no dɔ a ɔbor ntseasee nyina do no, na Nyankopɔn amayɛ nyina aahyɛ hom ma.
Na afei, onyia no a otum dɛ ɔyɛ ma ɔtra mbordo kyɛn adze nyina a yebisa anaa yɛdwen, dɛ mbrɛ tum a ɔyɛ hɛn mu edwuma no tse,
ɔno na enyimnyam nka no asɔr no mu, nye Kraest mu, nkɔ mbersantsen mfesantsen nyina mu. Amen.
Dɛm ntsi, emi a meyɛ Ewuradze ne daduanyi no, mutu hom fo dɛ hom nnantsew dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata ɔfrɛ a wɔdze afrɛ hom,
wɔ ahobrɛadze nye ɔdwe nyina mu, nye penkyɛr. Hom mfa ɔdɔ mboaboa homho,
na hom mbɔ mbɔdzen mfa asomdwee nsuo koryɛ a Sunsum no dze ma hom no mu.
Na hom yɛ nyimpadua kor nye Sunsum kor, dɛ mbrɛ wɔafrɛ hom wɔ hom frɛ enyidado kor mu;
Ewuradze kor, gyedzi kor, enuma kor,
hɛn nyina hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Egya kor a ɔbɔ hɛn nyina do, ɔnam hɛn nyina mu, na ɔwɔ hɛn nyina mu no.
Na wɔdze adom adom hɛn nyina nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ Kraest akyɛdze nsusui tse.
Dɛm ntsi ɔse, Ɔfowee kɔr sor no, ɔfaa ndɔmmum nara kɔr ndɔmmum, Na ɔmaa nyimpa akyɛdze.
(Na sɛ ɔka dɛ, Ɔfowee kɔr sor a, nna nnyɛ dza ɔrekyerɛ ara nye dɛ, osianee so kɔr asaase ase?
Ampaara, nyia osianee no, ɔnoara so nye nyia ɔfowee bɔɔ ɔsorsor nyina do, ama ɔaahyɛ ndzɛmba nyina ma.)
Na ɔama binom ayɛ asomafo, binom nkɔnhyɛfo, binom asɛmpakafo, binom ahwɛfo nye akyerɛkyerɛfo;
dɛ ahotseweefo bedzi mu wɔ ɔsom edwuma ho ntsi, dɛ ɔdze bɔtow Kraest nyimpadua no ntsi:
ma ekodu dɛ hɛn nyina yebodu Nyankopɔn Ba no ho gyedzi nye no ho nyimdzee mu koryɛ mu, ayɛ nyimpa a oewie nyin, yeedu Kraest amayɛ esusudze no pɛn do;
amma yaannda ho annyɛ mbofraba a nkyerɛkyerɛ mframa biara tum bɔ hɛn begyabegya dze hɛn dzi akɔnaaba wɔ mbradatofo a wɔdze enyitsew na ndaadaa dzɛfɛdzɛfɛw nyimpa no.
Mbom yeedzi nokwar wɔ dɔ mu, na yeenyin ndzɛmba nyinara mu akɔto Kraest a ɔyɛ hɛn tsir no;
ofi no mu, na nyimpadua no nyina, ɔnam dza akwaa nyina dze ma no do, atoatoa mu na akoakoa mu ayɛ kor, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu biara n’adzeyɛ nsusui tse no, nyimpadua no nyina nyin nya no ho esiyie wɔ dɔ mu.
Dɛm ntsi, meka iyi, na misi do wɔ Ewuradze ne dzin mu, dɛ mma hom nnantsew bio dɛ mbrɛ amanamamfo nantsew wɔ adwenhun mu no,
sum ahyɛ hɔn adwen mu, wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn nkwa no ho ananaben, osian nkwaseasɛm a ɔwɔ hɔn mu, nye hɔn akoma a epirim ntsi;
hɔn enyi nnto hwee ntsi, wɔdze hɔnho ama enyimguasebra, na wɔyɛ efifidze nyina enyiberdo.
Na hom dze, nnyɛ dɛm na hom suaa no Kraest hɔ;
sɛ ɔtse dɛm ampa dɛ hom atse no ho asɛm, na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ hom dɛ mbrɛ Kraest mu nokwar no tse no a:
hom nyi hom abrabɔ dadaw no nngu, nyimpa dadaw no a ɔroprɔw wɔ ndaadaa akɔndɔ mu no a;
na mbom hom nyɛ fofor wɔ hom adwen sunsum mu,
na hom nhyɛ nyimpa fofor no a wɔabɔ no Nyankopɔn do wɔ tsenenee nye ahotsew mu no.
Dɛm ntsi hom nyi atorsɛm ngu, na obiara nkasa nokwar nkyerɛ ne nyɛnko; osiandɛ yɛyeyɛ akwaa ma hɛnho nkorkor.
Ma hom bo mfuw na mma hom nnyɛ bɔn. Mma wi nntɔ hom ebufuw do:
eso mma hom mma abɔnsam kwan.
Mma owifo nnwia adze bio: na mbom ɔmbɔ mbɔdzen mfa ne nsa nyɛ edwuma pa, ama oeenya dza ɔdze bɛkyɛ nyia oehia.
Mma kasa fun biara mmfi hom anomu, na mbom dza oye ma ntowdo a ohia a ɔdze adom bɛma hɔn a wɔtse.
Na mma hom nnhow Nyankopɔn no Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a wɔdze asɔw hom ano ama ɔgye da no no werɛ.
Hom mma wonyi anoɔwen nyina, nye akomabɔn, nye ebufuw, nye ndzebɔ, nye etwitwanantsir nye adwembɔn nyina mfi hom mu:
na hom nkyerɛ ayamuyie nye ayamuhyehye mma homho nkorkor; hom mfa nkyekyɛ homho dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn so dze akyɛ hom wɔ Kraest mu.
Dɛm ntsi hom nsuasua Nyankopɔn, dɛ hom yɛ ne mba a ɔdɔ hom;
na hom nnantsew ɔdɔ mu, dɛ mbrɛ Kraest so dɔɔ hom, na ɔdze noho mae maa hɛn, dɛ ayɛyɛdze nye afɔrbɔdze a otu nka huahuam ma Nyankopɔn no.
Dɛ hom yɛ ahotseweefo yi, mma wɔmmbɔ ndwamansɛm anaa efifidze anaa enyiber dzin mpo wɔ hom mu.
Mma hom mma ɔbra a ɔmmfata, anaa kasafi, anaa fɛwdzi a ɔnnyɛ mfaso mmpue hom mu: na mbom hom nda Nyankopɔn ase.
Na hom nhu iyi pefee dɛ edwaman biara, obiara a ɔyɛ efifidze anaa onyiberfo (ɔno nye dɛ ɔbosonsɔrnyi) nnyi egyapadze wɔ Kraest nye Nyankopɔn ahendzi no mu.
Mma obi mmfa nsɛnhun nndaadaa hom: na dɛm ndzɛmba yi ntsi na Nyankopɔn ebufuw reba hɔn wɔyɛ asoɔdzen no do.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nye hɔn nnya anyɛnkofa biara:
na nkan no nkyɛ hom yɛ sum, na afei dze, hom yɛ kan wɔ Ewuradze mu; dɛm ntsi hom nnantsew dɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ kan:
(osiandɛ kan no n’aba wɔ papayɛ nye tsenenee nye nokwar nyina mu),
hom nsɔ dza ɔsɔ Ewuradze enyi yie nhwɛ;
na mma hom nnye sum edwuma a ɔnnsow aba no nnyɛ nyɛnko, na mbom hom ntsia;
na dza wɔyɛ no nsumaa mu no ɔyɛ enyito dɛ wɔbɔ dzin mpo.
Na ndzɛmba biara a kan no da no edzi no bɛyɛ kan ma wohu.
Dɛm ntsi ɔse, Nyan, ɔwo a ada! Soɛr fi ewufo mu, na Kraest bɛhyerɛn wo do.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie mbrɛ hom si nantsew, nnyɛ dɛ nkwasea na mbom dɛ enyansafo;
hom mfa mber a hom nya no ndzi dwuma pa, osiandɛ mber no yɛ mber bɔn.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom nnyɛ nkwasea, na mbom hom nhu dza Ewuradze pɛ.
Eso mma hom mmbow nsa; osiandɛ ɔno na ɔdze sakasakayɛ ba, na mbom hom mma Sunsum no nhyɛ hom ma;
ber a hom dze nsankudwom, ayɛyindwom nye sunsum mu ndwom rekasa kyerɛ homho no, na hom mfa hom akoma ntow ndwom enyigye mu mma Ewuradze.
Adze nyina mu no, hom nda Nyankopɔn Egya no ase daa wɔ Jesus Kraest dzin mu.
Hom mfa Kraest mu suro mbrɛ homho adze mmema homho nkorkor.
Yernom, hom mbrɛ homho adze mma homankasa hom kunnom dɛ hom dze ma Ewuradze.
Na okun no yɛ yer no ne tsir dɛ mbrɛ Kraest so yɛ asɔr no ne tsir, ɔno a ɔyɛ ne nyimpadua n’agyenkwa no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ asɔr brɛ noho adze ma Kraest no, dɛmara na yernom so nyɛ mma hɔn kunnom wɔ adze nyina mu.
Kunnom, hom ndɔ hom yernom dɛ mbrɛ Kraest so dɔɔ asɔr no, na ɔdze no nkwa too hɔ maa no no:
ama ɔayɛ no krɔnkrɔn, dɛ ɔdze nsuguar no atsew ho wɔ asɛm no mu,
ama oeetu asɔr no esi hɔ ama nankasa noho, dɛ enyimnyam asɔr a onnyi nkekaa anaa mpomponee, anaa biribiara a ɔtse dɛm, na mbom ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn na onndzii dzɛm.
Dɛmara na ɔsɛ dɛ kunnom dɔ hɔnankasa hɔn yernom, dɛ hɔnankasa hɔn honam. Nyia ɔdɔ nankasa ne yer no, ɔdɔ nankasa noho:
osiandɛ obiara nntan nankasa no honam pɛn, na mbom ɔnyɛn no na ɔhwɛ no yie, dɛ mbrɛ Kraest so yɛ ma asɔr no;
na yɛyɛ ne nyimpadua ho akwaa.
Iyi ntsi na banyin begya n’egya nye ne na hɔ, na ɔdze noho akɛbata ne yer ho, na hɔn beenu no ayɛ honankor.
Esumasɛm yi so: na emi dze maka no Kraest nye asɔr no ho.
Na hom so, obiara ndɔ nankasa ne yer dɛ mbrɛ ɔdɔ nankasa noho, na ɔyer so ondzi no kun nyi.
Mba, hom ntsie hom awofo wɔ Ewuradze mu: na iyi na ɔtsen.
Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi (ɔno nye mbra a odzi kan a anohoba ka ho),
ama eesi wo yie, na wo nda awar wɔ asaase do.
Na hom egyanom, mma hom nnhyɛ hom mba ebufuw; mbom hom ntsetse hɔn wɔ Ewuradze setsie nye kasakyerɛ mu.
Nkowaa, hom mfa suro nye ahopopo nye akomakor ntsie hom honam afamu ewuranom asɛm, dɛ hom yɛ ma Ewuradze;
nnyɛ enyiwado som a, dɛ hɔn a wɔsɔ nyimpa enyi, na mbom dɛ Kraest nkowaa a wofi akoma mu reyɛ Nyankopɔn ne pɛ;
na wɔdze ɔpɛ pa rosom dɛ wɔdze rema Ewuradze na nnyɛ nyimpa a:
na hom nyim dɛ papa a obiara bɛyɛ no, ɔdehye o, akowaa o, ɔnoara ho akatua na obenya no wɔ Ewuradze hɔ.
Hom, ewuranom, hom nyɛ dɛmara mma hom nkowaa, na hom ngyaa mpuwbɔ; na hom nyim dɛ hɔn wura nye hom wura wɔ sor, na ɔno, nyimpa enyimhwɛ biara nnyi n’afamu.
Dza medze wie nye dɛ, hom nyɛ dzen wɔ Ewuradze nye no tum ahoɔdzen no mu.
Hom nhyɛ Nyankopɔn akodze no nyina, ama hom eetum egyina abɔnsam ndaadaa no enyim.
Osiandɛ nnyɛ yɛnye honam nye bɔgya na enya ntokwadzi, na yɛnye mpanyindzi, tumdzi, nye wiadze yi sum mu etumfo, nye emumuyɛ esunsum a wɔwɔ sorsor no.
Dɛm ntsi, hom mfa Nyankopɔn akodze no nyina mmia, ama hom eetum egyina wɔ da bɔn no mu, na hom ewie akodzi yi nyina no, hom eetum egyina hom anan do.
Dɛm ntsi, hom ngyina hɔ dɛ hom dze nokwar abɔ hom asen, na hom ahyɛ tsenenee akatabo no,
na hom dze asomdwee asɛmpa no ho ahosiesie ahyehyɛ hom anan;
na no korakoraa no, hom nkitsa gyedzi kokyɛm no a hom dze botum edum ɔbɔn no n’egyen ndua a ogya wɔ ano no.
Na hom mfa nkwagye dadzekyɛw no, nye Sunsum afona a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm no:
na hom mfa mpaabɔ nye nkotoserɛ nyina nsɔr aber nyina wɔ Sunsum mu. Na hom iyi ara ntsi, hom mbɔ mbɔdzen nweɔn, ntotɔ nserɛ mma ahotseweefo no nyina,
nye mo so, dɛ sɛ mubue m’ano a, Nyankopɔn mma me ɔkasahom ma memfa ndam nka asɛmpa no nda no mu esumasɛm no edzi,
ɔno ho ɔsomafo na meyɛ wɔ mpokyerɛ mu yi, ama maakasa ndam do wɔ mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ mekasa.
Na afei, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma hom ehu mo ho asɛm no, onua dɔfo nye Ewuradze mu somfo nokwafo, Tikikus, bɛka ne nyina akyerɛ hom:
ɔno na iyiara ntsi masoma no hom nkyɛn, ma hom eehu mbrɛ hɛn asetsena mu tse, na ɔaaka hom akoma ato hom yamu.
Asomdwee nye ɔdɔ, nye gyedzi a ofir Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest no, nka enuanom no.
Adom nka hɔn a wɔdze ɔdɔ a odzi mu dɔ Ewuradze Jesus Kraest no nyina.
Paul nye Timoti, Kraest Jesus no nkowaa, dze krataa yi kɛma Kraest Jesus mu ahotseweefo nyina a wɔwɔ Filipi, nye hɔn mu ahwɛfo nye asomfo:
Adom nye asomdwee a ofi Nyankopɔn Egya no, nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nka hom.
Mekaa hom aber biara a, meda me Nyankopɔn ase,
na aber biara medze enyigye sɔr ma hom nyina,
wɔ hom nkitahodzi a hom wɔ no asɛmpa no ne tserɛw ho ofitsi da a odzi kan no dze bodu sesei.
Mowɔ awerɛhyɛmu wɔ iyi mu dɛ nyia ɔhyɛɛ edwuma pa ase wɔ hom mu no ɔbɛma oedzi mu dze ekodu Kraest Jesus da no.

Ɔtsen ma me dɛ modwen dɛm wɔ hom ho, osiandɛ hom da m’akoma do, na hom nyina nye me wɔ kyɛfa wɔ Nyankopɔn n’adom no mu, wɔ mo mpokyerɛ mu nye mber a migyinaa pintsinn twitwae gyee asɛmpa no na mepae mu kaa no.
Na Nyankopɔn nye me dasefo dɛ Kraest Jesus n’ayamuhyehye na tsema na medze afe hom nyina.
Na iyi nna mobɔ ho mpaa dɛ hom nkɔ do ara mbor do wɔ nyimdzee nye nhumu nyina mu;
ama hom eetum ehu ndzɛmba ahorow a oye nyina, na hom aayɛ krɔnn dɛ mfom bi nnyi hom ho dze ekodu Kraest da no;
na hom asow tsenenee aba a ɔnam Jesus Kraest do ba no ama Nyakopɔn n’enyimnyam nye n’ayɛyi.
Na enuanom, mepɛ dɛ hom hu dɛ, dza aba mo do no aba wɔ asɛmpa no ne kankɔ ntsi;
ama mo mpokyerɛ no aada edzi wɔ ambrado abanmufo nye hɔn a wɔaka no nyina enyim;
ama enuanom no pii nam mo mpokyerɛ no do eenya awerɛhyɛmu ayɛ ndam mbordo, ama sɛ wɔka Nyankopɔn asɛm no a, worunnsuro.
Ɔwɔ mu dɛ binom, nyitan nye mansotwe ntsi na wɔka Kraest ho asɛm; naaso binom wɔ hɔ a wɔdze pɛ pa ka.
Iyinom fi ɔdɔ mu ka asɛm no, osiandɛ wonyim dɛ wɔdze me esi hɔ dɛ menkasa mma asɛmpa no:
nkaa no dze wɔfi mansotwe mu ka Kraest ho asɛm, nnyɛ nokwar mu bi a, mbom hɔn adwen nye dɛ wɔbɛma mo ho ehiahia me ber a meda mpokyerɛ mu no.
Nna ɔyɛɛ dɛn? Akwan nyina mu no, sɛ mpetuwyɛ mu o, sɛ nokwar mu o, Kraest ho asɛm ara nna wɔka; na iyi mu nna midzi dɛw kɛse. Nyew, mobɔkɔ do so ara edzi dɛw no,
osiandɛ minyim dɛ ɔnam hom mpaabɔ nye Jesus Kraest no Sunsum do iyi bɛdan mo nkwagye.
Ɔyɛ m’enyisun nye m’enyidado dɛ m’enyim runngu ase wɔ biribiara mu, mbom me ndamyɛ kɛse ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse daa no, seseiara so, sɛ nkwa mu o, owu mu o, wɔbɛkamfo Kraest wɔ me nyimpadua mu.
Na emi dze, ase a metse yi Kraest a, na owu so yɛ me mfaso.
Naaso sɛ honam mu atsena yi na ɔbɛma m’edwuma akɔ do dze a, nna ɔno dze, munnhu no mu dza memfa.
Na mehin adze ebien yi ntamu; mo kɔn dɔ dɛ mututu ha nye Kraest kɛtsena, ɔno na nkyɛ oye koraa,
naaso honam mu asetsena no so hia pii ɔnam hom ntsi.
Na mowɔ dɛm awerɛhyɛmu yi, minyim dɛ mebɛtsena ase na menye hom nyina atsena, wɔ hom kankɔ nye hom gyedzi mu dɛw ntsi;
ama hom aahyehyɛ homho mbordo wɔ Kraest Jesus mu wɔ emi ntsi, osiandɛ mebɛba hom nkyɛn bio;

mbom hom abrabɔ ara na hom mma ɔnyɛ dza ɔfata Kraest asɛmpa no, ama sɛ meba mubohu hom o, sɛ minnyi hɔ o, maatse hom asetsena ho asɛm dɛ hom gyina pintsinn wɔ sunsum kor mu, na hom dze adwen kor aabɔ mu edzi aper ama asɛmpa no mu gyedzi no;
na mma hom mma atamfo no nnyi hom hu wɔ biribiara mu: ɔno nna ɔyɛ ɔsɛɛ ho asɛnkyerɛdze ma hɔn, na hom dze ɔyɛ nkwagye adze ma hom, na iyi no fi Nyankopɔn;
osiandɛ wɔdze adom hom wɔ Kraest ntsi, nnyɛ dɛ hom gye no dzi nko, na mbom dɛ hom hu amandze so wɔ ne ntsi;
na hom enya akodzi kor no ara a hom hun no wɔ mo mu no, na seseiara so hom da ho ara tse fa mo ho no.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ Kraest mu nkuranhyɛ bi, ɔdɔ awerɛkyekyer bi, Sunsum anyɛnkoyɛ bi, eso ayamuhyehye nye tsimbɔbɔr bi wɔ hɔ a,
hom nhyɛ me dɛw ma dɛ hom bɔdwen adze kor, enya ɔdɔ kor, adwensaa kor na adwen kor.
Mma hom nnyɛ biribi mansotwe do, anaa enyimnyam hun do, na mbom obiara mfa ahobrɛadze adwen do mbu ne nyɛnko nkyɛn nankasa noho;
mma obiara nnhwɛ no nko n’adze, na mbom ɔnhwɛ obinom so dze bi.
Hom nnya adwen a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no bi wɔ hom mu;
ɔno a dɛ ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn subea, naaso oenngyina do ketsee araa dɛ ɔnye Nyankopɔn yɛ pɛr,
mbom ɔtoo no ho pan, faa akowaa tsebea too no do ma wɔwoo no dɛ nyimpa. Na wohun no nyimpa su mu no,
ɔbrɛɛ noho adze na ɔyɛɛ setsie araa kesii owu mu, nyew, mbeamudua do wu no mpo.
Dɛm ntsi so nna Nyankopɔn ama no do kɛsekɛse na ɔama no dzin bi dzin a ɔbɔ dzin biara do:
dɛ, Jesus dzin mu no, anankoroma nyina bɔkotow, wɔ ɔsor, asaase nye asaasease;
na tɛkyerɛma nyina apaa mu aka dɛ Jesus Kraest nye Ewuradze dze ahyɛ Nyankopɔn Egya no enyimnyam.
Dɛm ntsi, m’adɔfo, dɛ mbrɛ daa hom yɛ setsie, nnyɛ ber a mowɔ hom nkyɛn nko, na mbom afei a minnyi hom nkyɛn yi kɛse, hom mfa suro nye ahopopo nyɛ homankasa hom nkwagye ho edwuma nwie;
na Nyankopɔn nna ɔyɛ hom mu edwuma ma hom nya pɛ na hom yɛ edwuma a ɔfata nankasa n’enyisɔ.
Mma hom mmfa ehwinhwin nye nyiyiano nyɛ dza hom yɛ biara,
ama hom aayɛ nyimpa a asɛm bi nnyi hom ho, na hom ho sɔnn, Nyankopɔn ne mba a nkekae bi nnyi hɔn ho, a wɔtse mbasantsen kɔntɔnkye nkyeakyeae mu, na hɔn mu na hom hyerɛn dɛ nkandzea wɔ wiadze mu.
Sɛ hom suo nkwasɛm no mu yie a, nna meenya dza medze bɛhyehyɛ moho wɔ Kraest da no mu, dɛ menntutu mbirika gyan eso mammberɛ kwa.
Ɛhɛɛ, sɛ mpo wohue me gu dɛ afɔrbɔ wɔ hom gyedzi som ho a, midzi dɛw, na menye hom nyina dzi ehurusi:
dɛmara na hom so ndzi dɛw na hom nye me ndzi ehurusi.
Na m’enyi da do wɔ Ewuradze Jesus mu dɛ mobɔsoma Timoti wɔ hom nkyɛn ntsɛmara, ama metse hom asetsena mu nsɛm a, mo ho aatɔ me.
Na minnyi obiara ɔtse dɛ ɔno a ɔbɔdwen hom asetsena ho yie bi.
Na hɔn nyina hwehwɛ hɔnankasa hɔndze, na nnyɛ dza ɔyɛ Kraest Jesus dze bi a.
Na hom nyim mbrɛ osi na ɔnye me som wɔ asɛmpa no afamu dɛ mbrɛ ɔba nye egya tse ara.
Ɔno na m’enyi da no do dɛ sɛ minya hu mbrɛ m’asɛm yi bowie me ara pɛr a, mobɔsoma no ntsɛmara:
na medze mo werɛ ahyɛ Ewuradze mu dɛ ɔnnkɛkyɛr biara na mankasa so maba.
Naaso muhun dɛ ohia dɛ mosoma Epafroditus a ɔyɛ mo nua nye me nyɛnko dwumayɛfo, nye me nyɛnko sordaanyi, nye hom somafo, nye me hia ho somfo no, wɔ hom nkyɛn;
osiandɛ ɔfee hom nyina, na ɔhaw no pii dɛ hom tsee dɛ ɔyar.
Nyew, ɔyaree bɛɛn owu dze, naaso Nyankopɔn hun no mbɔbɔr, na nnyɛ no nko, na emi so bi, amma meennya awerɛhow ammbɔ awerɛhow do.
Dɛm ntsi na mabɔ mbɔdzen ara asoma no, ama hom hu no bio a, hom eedzi dɛw, na mo so m’awerɛhow do eehuan.
Dɛm ntsi hom mfa dɛw nyina ngye no wɔ Ewuradze mu, na hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no hom nsuo hɔn mu wɔ enyidzi mu:
osiandɛ Kraest n’edwuma ntsi na ɔbɛɛn owu, na otuu no ho sii hɔ, dɛ ɔbɛma dza aka wɔ hom afamu wɔ mo ho som mu no ahyɛ ma.
Afei dza odzi ekyir a medze sɔw do nye dɛ, mo nuanom, hom ndzi dɛw wɔ Ewuradze mu. Sɛ mekyerɛw asɛm kor no ara brɛ hom bio a, ɔnnhaw me, na hom afamu so, ɔma hom tsim.
Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ mbɔdɔm no ho, hom nhwɛ yie wɔ edwumayɛfo bɔn no ho, hom nhwɛ yie wɔ twatsiatwafo no ho;
na twatsiatwafo no ara nye hɛn a yɛnam Nyankopɔn Sunsum do som, na yɛhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ Kraest Jesus mu, na yɛmmfa hɛn werɛ nnhyɛ honam mu ndzɛmba mu no.
Nkyɛ mara so mowɔ biribi wɔ honam mu a medze mo werɛ hyɛ mu: na sɛ nyimpa biara bu dɛ ɔwɔ honam mu biribi a ɔdze no werɛ bɛhyɛ mu a, emi mbom na mowɔ no mbordo:
hwɛ, wotwaa me twatsia da a otsia awɔtwe no, mifi Israel asefo mu, mifi Benjamin ebusuakuw mu, Hebriwfo mu Hebriwnyi; mbra no afamu a, meyɛ Farisiinyi;
mbɔdzembɔ afamu a, metaan asɔr no araa yie; mbra mu tsenenee afamu a, minndzi fɔ.
Naaso, dza ɔyɛɛ mfaso maa me no, Kraest ntsi mubuu no ahwerdze.

Nyew, ampaara meda ho mubu ne nyina ahwerdze wɔ m’Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ho nyimdzee kɛse no ntsi. Ne ntsi so nna mubu ndzɛmba nyina ahwerdze, na mubu ne nyina dɛ sumina do wura ama meenya Kraest ayɛ me mfaso,
na woeehu me wɔ no mu dɛ minnyi mankasa me tsenenee bi a ofi mbra no mu, na mbom dza ɔnam Kraest ho gyedzi do a, tsenenee a ofi Nyankopɔn hɔ, na ɔnam gyedzi do ba no:
ama nkyɛ meehu no yie, nye no wusoɛr tum no, na meenya kyɛfa wɔ n’amandzehu no mu, na ɔaama mayɛ dɛ ɔno wɔ no wu no mu;
kyerɛkyerɛ me nsa bɛka wusoɛr no a.
Nnyɛ dɛ me nsa enya aka, anaa menya medzi mu dada: na mbom mepem kɔ m’enyim ara dɛ bi a me nsa bɛka dza ɔnam do ma Kraest Jesus so ne nsa aka me no.
Enuanom, mummbu moho dɛ me nsa enya aka, na mbom adze kor na meyɛ, mo werɛ fir dɛm ndzɛmba adadaw no nyina, na motwe mo mu kɔ enyim dze no ho,
mepem kɔ kan dɛ mubodu botae no ho, ama meekenya Nyankopɔn no sor frɛ a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no no konyim akyɛdze no.
Dɛm ntsi, hom mma hɛn mu dodow a yeedzi mu no ndwen dɛm, na sɛ hom dwen biribi fofor bi a, ɔnoara na Nyankopɔn beyi akyerɛ hom:
na mbom dza yeedu ho dada no, noara so do na hom mma yendua nnantsew.
Enuanom, hom nsua me, na hom nhyɛ hɔn a wɔnantsew dɛ mbrɛ hom enya hɛn ayɛ fasusu no nsew.
Na dodowara wɔ hɔ a maka hom hɔn nantsewee ho asɛm, na seseiara so medze nyinsuwa reka kyerɛ hom, dɛ wɔyɛ Kraest ne mbeamudua no ho atamfo:
hɔn ewiei nye ɔsɛɛ, hɔn nyame nye yafun, hɔn ahohyehyɛ wɔ hɔn enyito mu, na hɔn adwen tsim asaase do ndzɛmba nko do.
Na hɛn dze, hɛn mantsimadze wɔ sor; na ofi hɔ na hɛn enyi da Ewuradze Jesus Kraest kwan.
Ɔno nna ɔbɛsakyer hɛn ahobrɛadze nyimpadua no ma aasɛ n’enyimnyam nyimpadua, dɛ mbrɛ tum ndzeyɛɛ a ɔdze tum brɛ ndzɛmba nyina adze hyɛ n’ase no tse.
Dɛm ntsi, mo nuanom adɔfo a mafe hom, hom a hom yɛ me dɛw nye m’ahenkyɛw, hom ngyina pintsinn dɛm wɔ Ewuradze mu, m’adɔfo.
Mutu Euodia fo, na mutu Senteke so fo, dɛ wɔnyɛ adwenkor wɔ Ewuradze mu.
Na meserɛ wo so, ɔnyɛnko kɔnduahyɛfo nokwafo, boa mbaa dɛm yi a wɔnye me yɛɛ edwuma wɔ asɛmpa no mu no, nye Klement so nye m’anyɛnkofo edwumayɛfo a hɔn dzin wɔ nkwa nwoma no mu no.
Hom ndzi dɛw wɔ Ewuradze mu daa! Misi do bio dɛ, Hom ndzi dɛw!
Hom mma nyimpa nyina nhu dɛ hom wɔ abodwekyɛr. Ewuradze abɛn.
Mma hom nnyɛ dadwen wɔ biribiara ho, na adze nyina mu hom mfa mpaabɔ nye nkotoserɛ nye ndaase mma hom ebisadze ndu Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na Nyankopɔn n’asomdwee a ɔtra ntseasee nyina no, ɔbɔweɔn hom akoma nye hom adwen wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
Na nkaa no, enuanom, dza ɔyɛ nokwar, dza ɔyɛ enyidzi, dza ɔtsen, dza no ho tsew, dza ɔyɛ fɛw, dza ɔwɔ dzin pa biara, sɛ ɔbra pa bi wɔ hɔ a, anaa ayɛyi bi so wɔ hɔ a, hom ndwen dɛm ndzɛmba yi ho.
Dza hom suae, na hom gyee, na hom tsee, na hom hunii wɔ mo mu no, ɔno ara na hom nyɛ, na asomdwee Nyankopɔn no nye hom bɛtsena.
Midzi dɛw kɛse so wɔ Ewuradze mu dɛ hom asan rodwendwen mo ho bio; ɔyɛ nokwar dɛ hom dwen mo ho dada, na adagyer bi na hom ennya ammfa annkyerɛ.
Nnyɛ dɛ ohia ntsi na mereka dɛm, na emi dze, mesua dɛ asetsena biara a mowɔ mu no, mema mo bo dwe mo ho.
Ahokyer mu asetsena a, minyim mu tsena, na minyim ahonya so dze mu tsena. Mesua adze biara nye adze nyina ho kwan a mefa do gyina enyim, ɔmee nye ɔkɔm, ahonya nye ohia.
Mutum adze nyina yɛ wɔ nyia ɔhyɛ me dzen no mu.
Naaso hom yɛɛ no yie dɛ hom bɔboaa me wɔ m’ahohia mu.
Na hom Filipifo, homankasa so nyim dɛ, asɛmpa no n’ahyɛse mu a, mifii Masidonia kɔree no, asɔr biara nye me enndzi nkitaho wɔ ɔma nye ɔgye ho dɛ hom nko;
na Tesalonika mpo hom somaa prɛko na bio so ma bɔhwɛɛ me hia.
Nnyɛ dɛ morohwehwɛ akyɛdze ntsi a, na mbom morohwehwɛ aba a ɔbɔdɔɔ so ama hom nkontaabu.
Na menya adze nyina ma atra do: mayɛ ma, osiandɛ me nsa kaa dza hom dze faa Epafroditus do monaa me no, ɔyɛ ohuam a ɔyɛ dɛw, afɔrbɔ a wɔgye a ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi papa bi.
Na me Nyankopɔn bɛma hom dza hom hia nyina, dɛ mbrɛ n’ahonya wɔ enyimnyam mu tse, wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
Afei hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn na enyimnyam nka no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
Hom nkyia ahotseweefo no nyina nkorkor wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
Ahotseweefo no nyina kyiakyia hom, nkanka hɔn a wofi Kaesar fie no.
Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom nka hom sunsum.
Paul a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ do yɛ Kraest Jesus somafo, nye hɛn nua Timoti,
dze krataa yi kɛma enuanom ahotseweefo nye agyedzifo wɔ Kraest mu a wɔwɔ Kolosae: Adom nye asomdwee a ofi hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn hɔ nka hom.
Daa yɛbɔ mpaa ma hom a, yɛdze ndaase ma Nyankopɔn, hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest n’Egya no,
osiandɛ yɛatse hom gyedzi a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu, nye ɔdɔ a hom dze dɔ ahotseweefo no nyina,
osian enyidado a ɔda hɔ ma hom wɔ sor no; iyi na hom nam asɛmpa no mu nokwasɛm do edzi kan atse.
Ɔno na aba hom hɔ dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ wiadze nyina so; rosow aba na ɔrodɔɔ so dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse wɔ hom so hom mu, ofitsi da a hom tsee na hom hun Nyankopɔn adom no nokwar mu no.
dɛ mbrɛ hom suaa no wɔ hɛn ewurakowaa dɔfo Epafras a ɔyɛ Kraest no somfo nokwafo wɔ hɛn afamu no nkyɛn,
ɔno so na oebeyi hom dɔ a ɔwɔ Sunsum no mu akyerɛ hɛn.
Iyi ntsi na hɛn so ofitsi da no a yɛtsee no yenngyaa dɛ yɛbɔ mpaa, na yɛserɛ ma hom, dɛ ne pɛ ho nyimdzee nhyɛ hom ma, wɔ sunsum mu nyansa nye ntseasee nyina mu;
ama hom aanantsew dɛ ɔfata Ewuradze na ɔsɔ enyi koraa, na hom aasow edwuma pa nyina mu aba, na hom eenyin wɔ Nyankopɔn ho nyimdzee mu.
Na wɔdze tum nyina aahyɛ hom dzen, dɛ mbrɛ ahoɔdzen a ɔwɔ n’enyimnyam tumdzi no mu no tse, dze aakɔ abotar, nye penkyɛr nye dɛw nyina mu;
ama hom aada Egya no ase, ɔno a ɔama yɛafata dɛ yɛnye ahotseweefo a wɔwɔ kan mu no nya kyɛfa wɔ hɔn egyapadze mu no.
Ɔno na oyii hɛn fii sum no tum no ase, na oebetsintsim hɛn wɔ no Dɔba no n’ahenman mu;
no mu na yeenya ɔpon nye bɔnfakyɛ.
Ɔnoara na ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn a wonntum nnhu no no ne saso, nye abɔdze nyina farbae;
osiandɛ no mu na wɔbɔɔ adze nyina, dza ɔwɔ sor nye dza ɔwɔ asaase do, dza wohu nye dza wonnhu, ahendzi o, wuradzi o, mpanyindzi o, tumdzi o, adze nyina wɔnam no do bɔe, na wɔbɔe maa no:
na ɔnoara na ɔyɛ adze nyina mu kandzifo, na no mu na adze nyina abɔ mu etsim.
Na ɔno nye nyimpadua a ɔyɛ asɔr no ne tsir: ɔno nye ahyɛse, ewufonyan mu farbae: ma adze nyina mu ɔaayɛ ɔkandzifo,
osiandɛ ɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn enyi dɛ n’amayɛ nyina ntsena no mu;
na ɔnam no do aka ɔnoara ankasa nye ndzɛmba nyina abɔ mu koraa, ɔno nye dɛ, ɔnam ne mbeamudua bɔgyaa no do ayɛ asomdwee, mese, ɔnam no do aka ndzɛmba nyina abɔ mu, dɛ ɔyɛ asaase dze o, ɔsor dze o.
Na hom so a nkyɛ mber a abɛsen no, nna hom yɛ etuatsewfo nye atamfo wɔ hom adwen mu, nye ndwuma bɔn mu no,
afei ɔnam owu do aka ɔno nye hom abɔ mu wɔ no honam nyimpadua no mu, dɛ ɔdze hom besi hɔ dɛ nyimpa krɔnkrɔn a wonndzii dzɛm na asɛm nnyi hom ho wɔ n’enyim;

sɛ hom bɛtsena gyedzi no mu, egyina hom fapem do, etsintsim, na wɔanntwe hom emmfi asɛmpa no ho enyidado a hom tsee na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ abɔdze nyina a wɔwɔ wiadze yi mu no, a emi Paul meyɛ ho ɔsomfo no mu dze a.
Afei midzi dɛw wɔ amandze a muruhu wɔ hom ntsi no mu, na mo so m’afamu mehyɛ Kraest amandzehu a aka no ma wɔ mo honam mu wɔ ne nyimpadua a ɔyɛ n’asɔr no ntsi;
ɔno ho na wɔayɛ me ɔsomfo, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ofihwɛ edwuma no tse, dza ɔdze ama me wɔ hom afamu, dɛ mehyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm no ma.
Nyew, esumasɛm a ofitsi mbersantsen nye mbasantsen nyina mu osumae no afei dze woebeyi akyerɛ n’ahotseweefo no a
Nyankopɔn pɛ dɛ ɔma wohu esumasɛm yi ho enyimnyam ahonya wɔ amanaman mu, a ɔno nye Kraest a ɔwɔ hom mu no ho enyimnyam enyidado no.
Ɔno na yɛbɔ no dawur, yetu nyimpa nyina fo na yɛkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn wɔ nyansa nyina mu, dɛ yɛdze obiara bopue dɛ wodzi mu wɔ Kraest mu.
Ɔno ho so na meyɛ edwuma berɛ, na meper, dɛ mbrɛ n’ahoɔdzen a ɔyɛ mo mu edwuma no tum no tse.
Na mepɛ dɛ hom hu aper dzendzen a miridzi no wɔ hom nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Laodikea, nye hɔn a wonnhun m’enyim wɔ honam mu no nyina ho;
dɛ wɔmma hɔn akoma ntɔ hɔn yamu, wɔntoatoa mu kor wɔ ɔdɔ mu, nnya ntseasee a woesi no tadua ahonya nyina, ama woeehu Nyankopɔn esumasɛm no a ɔno nye Kraest no mu.
Ɔno no mu na wɔdze nyansa nye nyimdzee ahonyadze nyina esie.
Na mereka iyi amma obi aammfa adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm annto hom brada.
Na kaansa minnyi hɔ honam mu a, menye hom wɔ hɔ wɔ sunsum mu, miridzi dɛw na morohwɛ hom nhyehyɛɛ nyɛbea, nye hom gyedzi a ɔwɔ Kraest mu mbrɛ osi tsim.
Dɛm ntsi dɛ mbrɛ hom gyee Kraest Jesus Ewuradze no, hom nnantsew no mu dɛmara:
hom ngye ndwow, osiandɛ wɔdze hom esi no mu, na hom ntsim wɔ gyedzi mu dɛ mbrɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hom no, na hom mbor do wɔ ndaase mu.
Hom nhwɛ yie mma obi aammfa nyansapɛ nye ndaadaa hun a ɔnam nyimpa tsetsesɛm, nye wiadze esunsum mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ do, na mbom ɔnnam Kraest mu, ammbɛfa hom ndɔmmum:
osiandɛ Kraest mu na Nyame ankasa n’amayɛ no tse wɔ nyimpadua no mu,
na ɔno a ɔyɛ mpanyindzi nye tumdzi nyina hɔn tsir no mu na hom ayɛ ma.
Ɔnoara so mu na woetwa hom twatsia a wɔnndze nsa twae, na dza ɔwɔ hom nyimpadua mu a woyi gu no, woeyi wɔ Kraest twatsiatwa mu:
na dɛ woesie ɔno nye hom wɔ enuma mu, no mu so na hom so nye no asoɛr ɔnam gyedzi a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn a onyaan no fii ewufo mu no no tum adwuma do.
Na hom a nkyɛ hom ewu osian hom mfom nye hom honam a wonntwaa no twatsia ntsi, hom na ɔama hom nye no enya nkwa, dɛ ɔdze hɛn mfom nyina akyɛ hɛn;
na ɔapepa ahyɛdze no mu nkyerɛwee a otsia hɛn no, na ɔdze akɔbɔ mbeamudua no ho eyi no wɔ kwan mu.
Oyi na otuu mpanyindzi nye tumdzi gui no, oyii hɔn kyerɛe wɔ baguamu na odzii hɔn do konyim wɔ mu.
Dɛm ntsi mma obi mmbu hom atsɛn wɔ edziban anaa anondze mu, anaa afahyɛ da, anaa bosoom fofor, anaa ahomgyeda afamu:
osiandɛ wɔyɛ ndzɛmba a ɔbɛba no ho mfonyi bi ara, na papa no ara dze, ɔno nye Kraest.
Hom mma obi nndua enyido ahobrɛadze nye abɔfosom do mma hom mbɔdzembɔ akyɛdze mmbɔ hom, dɛ ɔtsena ndzɛmba a onnhu mu, na ɔhoran kwa wɔ no honam adwen mu,
naaso onnsuo tsir no a ofi mu na nyimpadua no nyina nam akwaa nye ntsin biara do nya edziban na ɔtoatoa mu nyin wɔ nyin a ofi Nyankopɔn mu no mu.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom nye Kraest wui fi wiadze sunsum mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ ho a, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom dze ahyɛdze no to hom do, dɛ hom da ho tse wiadze, dɛ,
Mma mmfa nsa nnsuo mu, mma nnsɔ nnhwɛ, mma mmfa wo nsa nnka?
Dɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ yi nyina yɛ dza ɔkyerɛ ndzɛmbahun wɔ nyimpa ahyɛdze nye nkyerɛkyerɛ afamu.
Dza ndzɛmba yi yɛ ara nye dɛ wɔrekyerɛ nyansa wɔ enyidosom nye ahobrɛadzehun nye etsiɔdzen a wɔyɛ tsia honam; a ɔmmfa mfaso biara mmba, na mbom ne nyinara yɛ dza ɔhyɛ honam akɔndɔ ma.
Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom enya nye Kraest asoɛr a, hom nhwehwɛ dza ɔwɔ sor beebi a Kraest tse no, wɔ Nyankopɔn abanyimfa no.
Hom mfa hom adwen ngyina dza ɔwɔ sor do, na nnyɛ dza ɔwɔ asaase do a.
Na hom wui, na wɔdze hom nkwa aka Kraest ho esuma Nyankopɔn mu.
Na ber a hom nkwa a ɔyɛ Kraest bɛda edzi no, hom so nye no bopue enyimnyam mu.
Dɛm ntsi hom nku wiadze akɔndɔ a ɔwɔ hom mfafakuwa mu no; ndwamansɛm, efifidze, akɔndɔ nhyɛdo, akɔndɔ bɔn nye enyiber a no so yɛ abosonsɔr.
Iyinom ntsi na Nyankopɔn ebufuw ba (seanntse mba do);
dza nkan no a hom tse mu no hom nantseew mu no.
Na afei so hom nyi yinom nyina ngu; ebufuw, ebufuhyew, akomadzen, etutuwpɛ, enyimguasesɛm mfi hom anomu:
mma hom nndzidzi ator nnkyerɛkyerɛ homho, osiandɛ hom eyi nyimpa dadaw no nye ne ndzeyɛe no egu;
na hom ahyɛ nyimpa fofor a wɔayɛ no fofor aba nyimdzee mapa mu, a ogyina nyia ɔbɔɔ no no ne saso do no;
mbrɛ Griiknyi nye Jewnyi, twatsiatwa nye monomonomyɛ, pɔtɔfo nye Sitianyi, akowaa nye ɔdehye, bi nnyi hɔ, na mbom Kraest nye adze nyina wɔ hɔn nyina mu no.
Dɛm ntsi hom a hom yɛ hɔn a Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hom, ahotseweefo nye adɔfo no, hom nhyɛ ayamuhyehye, tsimbɔbɔr, ayamuyie, ahobrɛadze, ɔdwe nye penkyɛr.
Sɛ obi wɔ obi ho asɛm bi a, hom ntsetse mma homho, na hom mfa nkyekyɛ homho nkorkor; dɛ mbrɛ Kraest dze akyɛ hom no, dɛmara na hom so nyɛ:
na iyinom nyina do no hom nhyɛ ɔdɔ a ɔma ndzɛmba nyina wie pɛyɛ no.
Na hom mma Kraest asomdwee no ndzi hen wɔ hom akoma mu, ɔno so na wɔafrɛ hom aba ho, wɔ nyimpadua kor mu. Na mma hom nnyɛ etsiafo.

Hom mma Kraest n’asɛm no ntsena hom mu pii, na hom mfa nsankundwom, nye ayɛyindwom, nye sunsum mu ndwom nkyerɛkyerɛ, na hom nkasa nkyerɛ homho nkorkor ntow ndwom adom do wɔ hom akoma mu mma Nyankopɔn.
Na biribiara a hom yɛ no, kasa mu o, ndzeyɛe mu o, hom nyɛ ne nyina wɔ Ewuradze Jesus dzin mu, na hom ndua no do nda Nyankopɔn Egya no ase.
Yernom, hom mbrɛ homho adze mma hom kunnom, dɛm na ɔsɛ wɔ Ewuradze mu.
Kunnom, hom ndɔ hom yernom na mma hom nnyɛ hɔn yerɛyerɛw.
Mba, hom ntsie hom awofo asɛm wɔ adze nyina mu na iyi na ɔsɔ enyi wɔ Ewuradze mu.
Egyanom, mma hom nnyɛ hom mba heihei amma hɔn abaw mu aanngow.
Nkowaa, hom ntsie hom honam afamu ewuranom asɛm wɔ adze nyina mu; nnyɛ enyiwadosom mu, dɛ hom rosɔ nyimpa enyi, na mbom akoma kor mu, dɛ hom suro Ewuradze:
na biribiara a hom yɛ no, hom mfi akoma mu nyɛ edwuma dɛ hom yɛ ma Ewuradze, na nnyɛ nyimpa;
osiandɛ hom nyim dɛ Ewuradze hɔ na hom benya egyapadze akatua no, osiandɛ Ewuradze Kraest na hom som no.
Na nyia ɔyɛ dza ɔnntsen no, dza ɔnntsen a ɔayɛ no ara na obenya bio: na nyimpa enyimhwɛ bi nnyi hɔ.
Ewuranom, hom mfa dza ɔtsen na ɔfa kwan mu mma hom nkowaa, osiandɛ hom so wɔ owura wɔ sor.
Hom nkura asɔryɛ mu dzen ara, na hom mfa ndaase nweɔn wɔ mu;
na hom mbɔ mpaa mma hɛn so, ma Nyankopɔn mbue asɛm no ano mma hɛn; ma yɛnka Kraest esumasɛm a osian ntsi ma meda nkyehoma mu no;
ama meeyi ato gua dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ me dɛ mekasa.
Hom nnantsew nyansa mu wɔ hɔn a wɔwɔ nkyɛn no afamu, na mma hom nsɛɛ hom ber kwa.
Hom mma hom kasaa nyɛ dza adom nkyen wɔ mu daa, ama hom eehu dza ɔsɛ dɛ hom dze bua obiara.
Mo ho nsɛm nyina dze, Tikikus, onua dɔfo a ɔyɛ ɔsomfo nokwafo nye m’ewurakowaa wɔ Ewuradze mu no bɛka akyerɛ hom.
Ɔno na iyiara ntsi masoma no hom nkyɛn, ama hom eehu hɛn asetsena mu, na ɔaaka hom akoma ato hom yamu.
Onɛsimɔs, onua nokwafo dɔfo a ofi hom mu no ka no ho: hɔn na wɔbɛma hom ehu ha nsɛm nyina.
Aristarkus a ɔyɛ me nyɛnko mpokyerɛnyi no kyia hom, nye Mark, Barnabas n’awɔfase a hom enya no ho nkra dada dɛ, (sɛ ɔba hom nkyɛn a, hom ngye no no;)
nye Jesus a wɔfrɛ no Justus no kyia hom. Woyinom nko nye hɔn a wofi twatsiatwa mu nye me ayɛ edwuma wɔ Nyankopɔn ahendzi no ho; na wɔakyekye mo werɛ pii.
Kraest n’akowaa Epafras a ofi hom mu no kyia hom, odzi aper ma hom daa wɔ mpaabɔ mu, dɛ hom ngyina hɔ pi, na hom nhyɛ ma wɔ Nyankopɔn ne pɛ nyina mu.
Na midzi no dase dɛ ɔbɔɔ mbɔdzen pii maa hom nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Laodikea nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Hierapolis.
Luke, oduyɛfo dɔfo no, nye Demas kyia hom.
Hom nkyia enuanom a wɔwɔ Laodikea nye Nimfas nye asɔr a ɔwɔ ne fie no.
Na sɛ wɔkenkan nwoma yi wɔ hom mu wie a, hom mma wɔnkɛkenkan no Laodikea asɔr mu so, na hom so nkenkan dza ofi Laodikea no.
Na hom nse Arkipus dɛ, Hwɛ ɔsom a wo nsa aka no Ewuradze mu no yie, na aayɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛr.
Nkyia a emi mara Paul medze me nsa kyerɛwee nye yi. Hom nkaa mo mpokyerɛ no. Adom nka hom nyina.
Paul nye Silvanus nye Timoti dze kɛma Tesalonika asɔr a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn Egya no nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest mu no: Adom nye asomdwee nka hom.
Yɛda Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom nyina ntsi, yɛbɔ hom dzin wɔ hɛn asɔryɛ mu;
na daa yɛkaa hom gyedzi ndwuma nye hom dɔ mbɔdzembɔ, nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest mu enyidado ho abotar, wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Egya no enyim;
na, enuanom a Nyankopɔn adɔ hom, yenyim ɔsan a ɔasan mu eyi hom,
osiandɛ hɛn asɛmpa no ammba hom nkyɛn dɛ kasa ara kwa, na mbom ɔbae wɔ tum mu, nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, nye ntseasee pii mu; dɛ mbrɛ hom nyim hɛn nyimpa ban a yɛdaa no edzi dɛ yɛyɛ wɔ hom afamu no.
Na hom so suaa hɛn nye Ewuradze, dze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ne dɛw no gyee asɛm no wɔ ahohia pii mu;
na hom bɛyɛɛ fasusu maa hɔn a wɔgye dzi nyina wɔ Masidonia nye Akaia nyina.
Na ofi hom mu na Nyankopɔn n’asɛm no apetse, nnyɛ Masidonia nye Akaia nko, na mbom mbea nyina so hom gyedzi a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn afamu ekodu hɔ, ma onnhia dɛ yɛka ho asɛm bi mpo.
Na hɔnara ka hɛn ho asɛm kyerɛ kwan kor a yenyae wɔ hom mu, na mbrɛ hom danee fii ehonyisom ho baa Nyankopɔn hɔ, dɛ hom robɔsom Nyankopɔn tseasefo nokwafo no,
na hom atweɔn ne Ba a onyaan no fii ewufo mu no efi sor, mekyerɛ Jesus a ɔgye hɛn fi ebufuw a ɔreba no mu no.
Enuanom, homankasa nyim dɛ hom nkyɛn a yɛbae no annyɛ gyan:
na yeedzi kan ehu amandze pii na wɔabɔ hɛn adapaa, wɔ Filipi dɛ mbrɛ hom nyim no, naaso yɛyɛɛ ndam wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn mu dɛ yɛbɛka Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no akyerɛ hom wɔ ɔko pii mu.
Na hɛn afotusɛm mmfi mfom anaadɛ efifidze, anaa ndaadaa mu:
na dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ebu hɛn bi dɛ ɔdze asɛmpa no ahyɛ hɛn nsa no, dɛmara na yɛkasa; nnyɛ dɛ yɛsɔ nyimpa enyi, na mbom Nyankopɔn a ɔsɔ adze nyina hwɛ no a.
Na dɛ mbrɛ hom nyim, na Nyankopɔn nye hɛn dasefo no; yɛannka adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm da eso yɛammfa asɛm bi annkata hɛn enyiber do,
eso yɛannhwehwɛ nyimpa enyimnyam wɔ hom anaa binom hɔ,
nkyɛ ɔfata dɛ yɛyɛ Kraest asomfo yi, yebisa biribi fi hom hɔ, mbom yɛyɛɛ abrɛfo wɔ hom mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔbagyegyefo bi nyɛn nankasa ne mba:
na ɔnam dɛ yɛdɔ hom dodoodow ntsi, yɛpɛɛ dɛ nnyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no nko na yɛbɛkyɛ ama hom, na hɛnankasa hɛn akra so mpo, osiandɛ hom ho hiaa hɛn dodow.
Na enuanom, hom kaa hɛn mbɔdzembɔ nye fona: na yɛyɛɛ edwuma adzesaa nye adzekyee, amma yaannyɛ adzesoadze amma hom mu biara, na yɛdze kaa Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ hom.
Hom na Nyankopɔn nye adasefo, mbrɛ yeduae bɔɔ hɛn bra, dɛ afɔbu biara nnyi mu, krɔnkrɔn mu, tsenenee mu, maa hom a hom gye dzi no,
dɛ hom nyim mbrɛ yetutuu hom fo nkorkor dɛ egya nye mba, na yɛhyɛɛ hom dzen, na yedzii dase,
dɛ hom nnantsew dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔafrɛ hom akɔ n’ahendzi nye n’enyimnyam mu no.

Iyi so ntsi, yɛkɔ do ara da Nyankopɔn ase, osiandɛ hom gyee Nyankopɔn asɛm no wɔ hɛn hɔ no, hom anngye no dɛ nyimpa asɛm, na mbom dɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm, na dɛmara so na ɔtse ampa, iyi ara so na ɔyɛ hom a hom gye dzi no mu edwuma.
Na hom, enuanom, yɛɛ Nyankopɔn asɔr a ɔwɔ Judea wɔ Kraest Jesus mu no esuafo: osiandɛ hom so hun homankasa hom mamfoo nsamu amandze dɛmara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn so hunii wɔ Judafo nsamu;
hɔn na wokum Ewuradze Jesus nye nkɔnhyɛfo no, na wɔapempam hɛn, na wɔnnsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi, na wotsia nyimpa nyina;
wɔbra hɛn dɛ mma yɛnnkasa nnkyerɛ amanamamfo mma wonnya nkwa; ama wɔaama hɔn bɔn ayɛ ma daa: naaso ebufuw no enya aba hɔn do ewie.
Na hɛn dze, enuanom, woyii hɛn fii hom nkyɛn mber kakraabi wɔ enyido na nnyɛ akoma mu no, mbrɛ yeduae fee hom a, na yɛbɔɔ mbɔdzen pii dɛ yebohu hom enyim bio:
osiandɛ yɛpɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ yɛba hom nkyɛn, mankasa Paul, prɛko nye mpɛn ebien; na abɔnsam siiw hɛn kwan.
Na ebɛnadze nye hɛn enyidado, anaadɛ enyigye, anaadɛ ahohyehyɛ abɔtsir? Ana nnyɛ homara wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Kraest enyim wɔ ne ba mu?
Nyew, hom nye hɛn enyimnyam nye hɛn enyigye.
Dɛm ntsi yenntum nnhyɛ hɛn ho do bio no, yɛdween dɛ oye dɛ wogya hɛn nko ekyir wɔ Atens;
na yɛsomaa Timoti a ɔyɛ hɛn nua nye nyɛnkodwumayɛnyi ma Nyankopɔn wɔ Kraest asɛmpa no mu no dɛ ɔmbɛhyɛ hom dzen, na ɔnkyekye hom werɛ wɔ gyedzi no ho;
amma amandzehu yi eennhihim obiara; na homankasa nyim dɛ woeyi hɛn ato hɔ ama dɛm.
Na yɛwɔ hom nkyɛn no yɛkaa kyerɛɛ hom siee dɛ yebohu amandze; dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaa mu, na hom nyim no.
Iyi ntsi na mo so munntum nnhyɛ moho do bio no, mosomae ma meehu hom gyedzi amma bi a ɔgyegyefo no aanngyegye hom na hɛn mbɔdzembɔ aannyɛ kwa.

Na afei Timoti fi hom nkyɛn baa hɛn nkyɛn bɛkaa hom gyedzi nye hom dɔ ho nsɛm pa kyerɛɛ hɛn. Na ɔkaa dɛ hom kaa hɛn yie daa, na hom pɛ dɛ hom hu hɛn dɛ mbrɛ hɛn so yɛafe hom na yɛpɛ dɛ yehu hom no kyerɛɛ hɛn.
Iyi ntsi enuanom, hɛn werɛ kyekye wɔ hom nyina ho, wɔ hɛn amandzehu nye hɛn ahohia nyina mu, wɔ hom gyedzi ntsi.
Na afei sɛ hom gyina pintsinn wɔ Ewuradze mu a, yeenya nkwa.
Na hom ho ndaase bɛn na yebotum ada Nyankopɔn bio, wɔ dɛw nyina a yedzi wɔ hom ntsi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim;
dɛ adzesaa nye adzekyee yɛreserɛ pii dɛ yembohu hom enyim ma yaabɛhyɛ dza aka wɔ hom gyedzi mu no ma?
Na hɛn Nyankopɔn a ɔnoara nye Egya no, nye hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ntsen hɛn kwan mbra hom nkyɛn.
Na Ewuradze mma hom ndɔɔ so na hom mbor do wɔ dɔ mu mma homho nkorkor, nye nyimpa nyina, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn so yɛyɛ ma hom no;
na ɔaahyɛ hom akoma dzen, dɛ afɔbu nnyi mu, krɔnkrɔnyɛ mu wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Egya no enyim, wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nye n’ahotseweefo hɔn ba mu.
Ewiei no, enuanom, yɛserɛ hom na yetu hom fo wɔ Ewuradze Jesus mu dɛ, mbrɛ hom nyaa no hɛn hɔ mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom nantsew na hom sɔ Nyankopɔn enyi no, dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ yi ara, dɛmara na hom mbor do pii.
Na homankasa hom nyim ahyɛdze a yɛnam Ewuradze Jesus do hyɛɛ hom no.
Na iyi nye Nyankopɔn ne pɛ, dɛ hom ahotsew ntsi, hom nyi homho mfi ndwamansɛm ho;
dɛ hom mu biara bohu mbrɛ obesi nye ne yer atsena wɔ ahotsew nye enyidzi mu.
Nnyɛ akɔndɔ nhyɛdo mu dɛ amanamamfo a wonnyim Nyankopɔn;
amma obiara eemmbu do ennkesisi no nua wɔ asɛm no mu, osiandɛ Ewuradze nye yinom nyina ho werdzifo, dɛ mbrɛ yɛbɔɔ hom nkaa nkan no, na yedzii ho dase no.
Na Nyankopɔn ammfrɛ hɛn annkɔ efifidze mu, na mbom ahotsew mu a.
Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔpow iyi no, nnyɛ nyimpa bi na ɔpow no, na Nyankopɔn a ɔdze no Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ama hom no a.
Na enuadɔ ho dze, onnhia hom dɛ obi kyerɛw brɛ hom; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn akyerɛkyerɛ homankasa dɛ hom ndodɔ homho.
Na ampa so hom yɛ no wɔ enuanom a wɔwɔ Masidonia nyina ho. Naaso enuanom, yetu hom fo, dɛ hom mbor do pii;
na hom mbɔ mbɔdzen nyɛ komm na hom nyɛ homankasa hom adze, na hom mfa hom nsa nyɛ edwuma, dɛ mbrɛ yɛhyɛɛ hom no;
na hom aanantsew dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata wɔ hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir no enyim, na biribi eennhia hom.
Enuanom, wɔ hɔn a wɔadeda no ho dze, yɛmmpɛ dɛ yɛdze asɛm bi sie hom amma hom eenndzi awerɛhow dɛ nkaa no a wonnyi enyidado no.
Na sɛ yɛgye dzi dɛ Jesus wui na ɔsoɛɛr bio a, dɛmara so na Nyankopɔn dze hɔn a wɔadeda wɔ Jesus mu bɛka no ho aba.
Na iyi dze, yɛnam Ewuradze asɛm do ka kyerɛ hom dɛ, hɛn a yɛtse ase, na yɛretsena ase ekodu Ewuradze ne mbae mu no, yennkotwar hɔn a wɔadeda no ano.
Osiandɛ Ewuradze nankasa dze frɛ kɛse, nye bɔfopanyin no ne ndze, nye Nyankopɔn akasamu no fi sor besian, na Kraest mu ewufo bedzi kan asoɛr;
ansaana wɔaabɛfa hɛn a yɛtsetse ase na yɛaka no aka hɔn ho wɔ nsuwusiw no mu ma yeekehyia Ewuradze wɔ wimu, na dɛm na yɛnye Ewuradze bɛtsena daa.
Dɛm ntsi hom mfa nsɛm yi nkyekyekye hom werɛ nkorkor.
Na nda no nye mber no ho dze, enuanom, onnhia hom dɛ wɔkyerɛw biribi brɛ hom.
Osiandɛ homankasa nyim pefee dɛ Ewuradze ne da no bɛba dɛ mbrɛ owifo ba anadwe.
Na ber a wɔrese dɛ, Asomdwee nye ahotɔ no, nna awerɛfir sɛɛ bɛba hɔn do dɛ mbrɛ awoko ba ɔbaa a onyinsen do; na wonnkefi nsa.
Na hom dze, enuanom, hom nnyi sum mu, nna da no abɔto hom dɛ owifo.
Hom nyina yɛ kan mba nye adzekyee mba; yɛnnyɛ adzesaa anaa sum mba.
Dɛm ntsi mma hom mma yɛnndeda dɛ nkaa no, na mbom hom mma yɛnweɔn na hɛn enyi nda hɔ.
Na hɔn a wɔda da anadwe; na hɔn a wɔbow bow anadwe.
Na hɛn dze, yɛyɛ adzekyee mba ntsi, hom mma hɛn enyi nda hɔ, yɛnhyɛ gyedzi nye ɔdɔ dɛ akatabo, nye nkwagye ho enyidado no dɛ dadzekyɛw.
Na Nyankopɔn ennyi hɛn annto hɔ amma ebufuw, na mbom dɛ yebenya nkwagye a ɔnam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest do.
Ɔno na owui maa hɛn ama sɛ yɛtse ase o, yewu o, yɛnye no nyina aatsena ase.
Dɛm ntsi hom nhyɛ hom ho nkuran nkorkor, na hom mboa hom ho nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ hom reyɛ yi ara.
Na yɛserɛ hom, enuanom, dɛ hom ndzi hɔn a wɔyɛ hom mu edwuma no nyi, na wodzi hom do mpanyin wɔ Ewuradze mu, na wɔkasa kyerɛ hom no.
Hom mfa ɔdɔ mbu hɔn papaapa, osian hɔn edwuma no ntsi. Hom ntsena asomdwee mu.
Na yetu hom fo so, enuanom, dɛ hom nkasa nkyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ basabasa, hom nkyekye hɔn a hɔn akoma apa werɛ, hom nwowaw hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw, na hom nyɛ penkyɛr wɔ nyimpa nyina afamu.
Hom nhwɛ mma obi ammfa bɔn enntua obi bɔn kaw; na mbom hom ndzi dza oye ekyir daa, wɔ hom ho nkorkor nye nyimpa nyina afamu.
Hom enyi ngye daa;
mma hom nngyaa mpaabɔ da;
adze nyina mu hom nda ase: na iyi nye Nyankopɔn ne pɛ wɔ Kraest Jesus mu wɔ hom ho.
Mma hom nndum Sunsum no;
mma hom mmbu nkɔnhyɛsɛm enyimtsia;
mbom hom nsɔ adze nyina nhwɛ; hom nsuo dza oye mu dzen;
hom ntwe homho mfi bɔn biara ho.
Na ɔno asomdwee Nyankopɔn nankasa nsan hom ho koraa, na ɔnkora hom sunsum nye kra nye nyimpadua do dɛ asɛm bi nnyi ho wɔ Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne ba mu.
Ɔnokwafo nye nyia ɔafrɛ hom no, na ɔnoara so na ɔbɛyɛ.
Enuanom, hom mbɔ mpaa mma hɛn.
Hom mfa etuwyɛ krɔnkrɔn nkyiakyia enuanom nyina.
Medze Ewuradze no tum hyɛ hom dɛ hom nkenkan nwoma yi nkyerɛ enuanom no nyina.
Ewuradze Jesus Kraest n’adom nka hom.
Paul nye Silvanus nye Timoti dze kɛma Tesalonika asɔrasɔr a wɔwɔ hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest mu no;
adom nye asomdwee a ofir Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest hɔ nka hom.
Enuanom, ɔsɛ hɛn dɛ yɛda Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata, osiandɛ hom gyedzi rinyin mbordo, na dɔ a hom nyina dze dodɔ homho nkorkor no adɔɔ so;
na ɔma hɛnankasa so yɛhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ hom mu wɔ Nyankopɔn asɔrasɔr mu wɔ hom abotar nye gyedzi a ɔwɔ hom ahohia nye amandzehu a hom rosɔw nyina mu ntsi;
ɔno na ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn atsɛn tsenenee sɛnkyerɛdze a ɔda gua, ama woeebu hom dɛ hom sɛ Nyankopɔn ahendzi a hom ruhu ho amandze no.
Osiandɛ ɔtsen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ ɔdze ahohia tua hɔn a wohiahia hom ho no kaw,
na hom a worihiahia hom ho dze, ɔma hom nye hɛn ahomgye, wɔ da bi a Ewuradze Jesus Kraest beyi noho efi sor, nye no tum abɔfo,
wɔ gyaframee mu, na oebotua hɔn a wonnyim Nyankopɔn na wonntsie hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest asɛmpa no kaw.
Hɔn na wobenya akatua bɔn, ɔsɛɛ a onnyi ewiei, efi Ewuradze enyim, nye n’ahoɔdzen enyimnyam no ho,
ber a ɔbɛba ma wɔaahyɛ no enyimnyam wɔ n’ahotseweefo mu, na wɔaahwɛ no dɛ anwanwadze wɔ hɔn a wɔgye dzi nyina mu, osiandɛ wɔagye hɛn dasee a yedzii no wɔ hom mu no edzi wɔ da no mu.
Dɛm ntsi so na yɛsɔr ma hom daa dɛ, hɛn Nyankopɔn mbu hom dɛ hom sɛ hom frɛ, na ɔmma n’ayamuyie enyisɔ, nye gyedzi edwuma no nyɛ ma wɔ hom mu;
na wɔaahyɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus dzin enyimnyam wɔ hom mu, nye hom so wɔ no mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest n’adom tse.
Afei enuanom, ɔfa hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne mbae no, na dɛ yɛbɔboa ano ehyia ne nkyɛn dze, yɛkotow serɛ hom dɛ,
mma hom mma wonndua sunsum anaa asɛm, anaa nwoma bi a ɔwɔ dɛ ofi hɛn hɔ do nndan hom adwen ntsɛm, anaa nntu hom akoma dɛ gyama Kraest da no enya edu.
Mma obiara nndaadaa hom wɔ biribiara ho, osiandɛ da no nnkɛba, gyedɛ gyedzi ho asehwe no aba ana, na woeyi omumuyɛnyi no edzi, mekyerɛ, ɔsɛɛ ba no a.
Ɔhoran noho, ɔmema noho do tsia dza wɔfrɛ no onyame biara, anaa dza wɔsɔr no nyina, ma ɔtsena Nyankopɔn asɔrdan mu dze noho kyerɛ dɛ ɔno nye Nyankopɔn no.
Ana hom nkaa dɛ mowɔ hom nkyɛn no mekaa yinom nyina kyerɛɛ hom?
Na afei hom nyim dza osiw kwan, ama woeeyi no akyerɛ wɔ nankasa n’aber do.
Na mbrato esumasɛm no enya reyɛ edwuma, na obi na orisiw kwan ma ekodu dɛ wobeyi no hɔ.
Nna nkyii wobeyi nyia onndzi mbra biara do no akyerɛ, ɔno na Ewuradze Jesus dze n’anomu ehubɔw boku no, na ɔdze ne mbae no mpuei bɛma ɔaasɛɛ.
Ɔno ne mbae no ɔnam abɔnsam edwuma do ba, wɔ tum nye nsɛnkyerɛdze nye ator anwanwadze nyina mu,
nye dza ɔnntsen ndaadaa nyina mu ma hɔn a wɔreyew no, osiandɛ wɔapow dɛ wɔbɔdɔ nokwar ma wɔaagye hɔn nkwa.
Iyi ntsi na Nyankopɔn soma ndaadaa dwumadzi ba hɔn mu ama wɔaagye atorsɛm edzi:
na woeebu hɔn a wɔanngye nokwar no enndzi na mbom hɔn enyi sɔɔ dza ɔnntsen no nyina atsɛn.
Na hɛn dze, ɔsɛ hɛn dɛ yɛda Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom ntsi, enuanom a Ewuradze dɔ hom, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn fi ahyɛse yii hom kɔr nkwagye mu wɔ Sunsum ahosan nye nokwar gyedzi a
ɔnam hɛn asɛmpa no do afrɛ hom aba mu, ma hom eenya Kraest Jesus enyimnyam no.
Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, hom ngyina pintsinn na hom nsuo atsetsesɛm a yɛnam asɛm anaa nwoma do kyerɛkyerɛɛ hom no mu.
Afei hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nankasa nye Egya Nyankopɔn a ɔdɔɔ hɛn na ɔmaa hɛn onnyiewiei awerɛkyekyer nye enyidado pa a ɔnam adom do no,
ɔnka hom akoma nto mu na ontsintsim hom wɔ asɛm nye edwuma pa nyina mu.
Dza aka no, enuanom, hom mbɔ mpaa mma hɛn, ama Ewuradze n’asɛm no atserɛw ntsɛntsɛm na wɔahyɛ no enyimnyam wɔ beebiara dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse wɔ hom nkyɛn no;
na wɔngye hɛn mfi nyimpabɔnfo nye emumuyɛfo nsamu, osiandɛ nnyɛ nyimpa nyina na wɔwɔ gyedzi no.
Na Ewuradze yɛ ɔnokwafo, ɔbɛma hom etsim, na ɔakora hom do wɔ omumuyɛnyi no ho.
Na yɛwɔ Ewuradze mu awerɛhyɛmu wɔ hom ho dɛ hom reyɛ dza yɛakyerɛ hom no, eso hom bɔkɔ do ayɛ.
Na Ewuradze ngya hom akoma nkɔ Nyankopɔn ho dɔ nye penkyɛr a Kraest dze ma no mu.
Afei yɛhyɛ hom, enuanom, wɔ Jesus Kraest dzin mu, dɛ hom ntwe homho mfi onua biara a ɔnantsew basabasa, na onndzi tsetse nkyerɛkyerɛ a yɛdze maa hom no do ho.
Na homankasa hom nyim dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom suasua hɛn; osiandɛ yɛannyɛ akwadwer wɔ hom mu;
eso yenndzi obiara nsamu edziban kwa, na mbom mbɔdzembɔ mu nye ɔberɛ mu na yɛyɛɛ edwuma adzekyee nye adzesaa, amma yaannyɛ adzesoadze amma hom mu biara:
nnyɛ dɛ yennyi ho kwan bi a, na mbom ama yɛdze hɛnho aayɛ fasusu ma hom esua hɛn.
Na yɛwɔ hom nkyɛn no, yɛhyɛɛ hom dɛ, Sɛ obi mmpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ edwuma a, na eso mma onndzidzi.
Na yɛtse dɛ binom wɔ hɔ a wɔnantsew basabasa wɔ hom mu, wɔnnyɛ edwuma na mbom wɔyɛ apɛsɛmedzifo.
Na hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no, yɛhyɛ hɔn na yetu hɔn fo wɔ Ewuradze Jesus mu dɛ wɔnyɛ foo nyɛ edwuma na wondzi hɔnankasa hɔn edziban.
Na hom dze, enuanom, mma hom mmberɛ wɔ papayɛ mu.
Na sɛ obi enntsie hɛn asɛm a ɔwɔ nwoma yi mu no a, hom nhyɛ no nsew na mma hom nnye no mmbɔ fɛkuw, na n’enyi nto.
Naaso mma hom mmbu no ɔtamfo, mbom hom ntu no fo dɛ onua.
Na afei asomdwee Ewuradze nankasa mma hom asomdwee daa wɔ adze nyina mu. Ewuradze nye hom nyina ntsena.
Emi Paul me nkyia a medze mankasa me nsa akyerɛw no nye yi. Iyi nye m’ahyɛnsewdze wɔ krataa biara a mekyerɛw ho, kwan a mefa do kyerɛw nye yi.
Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom nka hom nyinara.
Paul, Kraest Jesus somafo, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn Agyenkwa Nyame nye hɛn enyidado Kraest Jesus n’ahyɛdze tse;
dze kɛma Timoti, mo nokwar ba wɔ gyedzi mu; Adom, mbɔbɔrhu nye asomdwee mfi Egya Nyankopɔn nye Kraest Jesus hɛn Ewuradze hɔ nka wo.
Dɛ mbrɛ morokɔ Masidonia a meserɛɛ wo dɛ tsena Efeso na eetu binom fo, amma wɔaamma nkyerɛkyerɛ fofor bi,
na eso woeenntsie anansesɛm nye nananom edzin a wɔkan a wonnwie da a ɔdze nsɛmbisa ba kyɛn Nyankopɔn ne fihwɛ a ɔwɔ gyedzi mu no; dɛmara so na meyɛ no sesei.
Na ahyɛdze no no botae nye ɔdɔ a ofi akoma a no mu tsew mu nye tsibowa pa nye nokwar gyedzi mu no.
Ɔno na binom apaa efi ho akɔ nsɛnhun mu;
wɔpɛ dɛ wɔyɛ mbrakyerɛfo, naaso wɔnntse dza hɔnara wɔka no ase, na dza wɔhom do dzendzen ka ho asɛm no so wonnyim n’adzeban.
Na hɛn dze, yenyim dɛ mbra no, sɛ obi dzi do nokwar mu a, oye,

dɛ yenyim dɛ mbra wɔnnhyɛ nnto hɔ mma ɔtseneneenyi, na mbom wɔhyɛe maa mbratofo nye asoɔdzenfo, hɔn a wonnsuro Nyankopɔn, nye ndzebɔnyɛfo, hɔn a hɔn ho nntsew, nye hɔn a hɔn ho egu fi, hɔn a woku hɔn egyanom nye hɔn nanom, nye nyimpakumfo nyina,
ndwaman, hɔn a wɔnye mbarimba deda, edwotwafo, atorfo, ntamtofo, ɔnye biribiara a otsia nkyerɛkyerɛ pa no;
dɛ mbrɛ Osiarfo Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam asɛmpa a wɔdze hyɛɛ me nsa no tse.
Na meda Kraest Jesus, hɛn Ewuradze a ɔhyɛɛ me dzen no dɛ oebu me nokwafo dze me ahyɛ ɔsom no mu no ase;
emi a nkyɛ nkan no meyɛ busuyɛnyi nye ɔhonankanyi nye ɔbofo, naaso minyaa ehumbɔbɔr; osiandɛ minnyim na meyɛe wɔ ekyingye mu;
na hɛn Ewuradze n’adom dɔɔ so mbordo maa me na ɔmaa me gyedzi nye dɔ a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no.
Ɔyɛ nokwasɛm a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔgye pen koraa, dɛ Kraest Jesus baa wiadze bɛgyee ndzebɔnyɛfo nkwa; hɔn mu otsitsir nye emi;
na eso iyi ntsi na minyaa ehumbɔbɔr ama ɔnam emi, otsitsir yi mu, Kraest Jesus eeyi ne penkyɛr nyina edzi, ma maayɛ mfatoho ama hɔn a ekyir no wɔbɛgye no edzi akɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu no.
Na afei, mbersantsen Hen a ɔtse ase daa, enyiwa nnhu no, na no nkotsee nye Nyankopɔn no, ɔno na enyidzi nye enyimnyam nka no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
Me ba Timoti, dɛm kasakyerɛ yi na medze hyɛ wo nsa, dɛ mbrɛ nkɔnhyɛnsɛm a wɔkaa faa wo ho kan no tse no, ama aafa do ako ɔko pa,
eesuo gyedzi nye tsibowa pa a binom egyaa mu akyen egu esu wɔ gyedzi no ho no mu dzen;
hɔn mu bi nye Himeneus nye Alɛksanda a meyi hɔn ama Satan, ama woeesua dɛ onnyi dɛ wɔka ebususɛm wɔ Nyankopɔn ho.
Dɛm ntsi m’afotu nye dɛ, odzi kan, wɔnyɛ nkotoserɛ asɔr, wɔmbɔ mpaa, wɔnsɔr mbisa na wɔnda ase mma nyimpa nyina;
ahemfo nye hɔn a wodzi tum nyina: ama yaatsena ase dwudwoodwo, komm wɔ nyamesompa nye fɔntɔmmyɛ nyina mu.
Iyi na oye na ɔyɛ enyisɔ wɔ hɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn enyim;
ɔno a ɔpɛ dɛ wɔgye nyimpa nyina nkwa, na wɔba nokwar no no ho nyimdzee mu.
Na Nyankopɔn kortsee na ɔwɔ hɔ, na Nyankopɔn nye nyimpa ntamugyinafo so kortsee, Kraest Jesus a ɔnoara so yɛ nyimpa no a.
Ɔno a ɔdze noho maa dɛ apondze maa nyimpa nyina; dɛ ɔnyɛ dase wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu;
no ho na wɔahyɛ me ɔsɛnkafo nye ɔsomafo, (meka no nokwar, minndzi ator), amanaman kyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ gyedzi nye nokwar mu.
Dɛm ntsi mepɛ dɛ mbarimba yɛ asɔr wɔ mbea nyina, wɔma nsa krɔnkrɔn a ebufuw anaa anyanyan nnyi mu do.
Dɛmara so na mbaa nhyɛ ntar a ɔkyerɛ dɛ wɔfɛr adze na hɔn enyi ka famu, mma wɔmmfa afadze hyerɛpɛɛ, tsir ne nyɛɛ ahorow, anaa sika, anaa ahondze pa anaa aboɔdzen ntar nnsiesie hɔn ho;
na mbom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ mbaa a woyi nyamesom kyerɛ no, wɔmfa ndwuma pa nyɛ hɔn ahosiesie.
Wɔmma ɔbaa nyɛ komm nsua wɔ ahobrɛadze nyina mu.
Na ɔbaa dze, memma no kwan dɛ ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ, anaa ondzi ɔbanyin do tum, na mbom ɔnyɛ komm.
Na wodzii kan bɔɔ Adam ansaana wɔrobɔ Eve;
na nnyɛ Adam na wɔdaadaa no, na ɔbaa no na wɔdaadaa no a ɔkɔtɔɔ mbrato mu;
naaso sɛ ɔdze enyidahɔ tsena gyedzi nye dɔ nye ahotsew mu a, wɔbɛgye no nkwa n’abawoo mu.
Ɔyɛ nokwasɛm dɛ, Sɛ obi pɛ ɔhwɛfo edwuma a, ɔapɛ edwuma pa.
Dɛm ntsi, ɔsɛ ɔhwɛfo dɛ no ho nnyi asɛm, ɔyɛ ɔyer baako kun, n’enyi da hɔ, n’adwen mu tsew, ɔyɛ wense wense, ɔpɛ ahɔhoyɛ, otum kyerɛkyerɛ;
ɔnnyɛ nsahweam, ɔnnyɛ pupopupo; na mbom ɔdwe, ɔmmpɛ ham, ɔnnyɛ sikanyibernyi;
ɔhwɛ nankasa ne fie do yie, ma ne mba hyɛ n’ase wɔ fɔntɔmmyɛ nyina mu;
na sɛ obi nnhu nankasa ne fi do hwɛ a, ɔyɛ dɛn tum hwɛ Nyankopɔn n’asɔr do?
Mma ɔnnyɛ obi a ɔbaa asɔr no mu nkyɛree, amma ɔaannhoran annkɔtɔ abɔnsam n’afɔbu mu.
Afei so ɔsɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir so bɔ no dzin pa; amma ɔaannhwe enyimguase nye abɔnsam efir mu.
Dɛmara na asɔr mu asomfo no so ɔsɛ dɛ hɔn enyim yɛ fɔntɔmm, wɔnnyɛ tɛkyerɛmanta, wɔnnyɛ nsahweam, wɔnnyɛ edzifodzepɛfo;
wɔkora gyedzi esumasɛm no wɔ tsibowa a no ho tsew mu.
Na yinom so wondzi kan nsɔ hɔn nhwɛ ana, sɛ hɔn ho nnyi asɛm bi a, wɔasom dɛ asɔr mu asomfo.
Mbaa so hɔn enyim nyɛ fɔntɔmm dɛmara, mma wɔnnyɛ anokumdzifo, mbom nkorɔfo a hɔn enyi da hɔ, na wodzi nokwar wɔ adze nyina mu.
Asɔr mu asomfo no mu biara nyɛ nyimpa a ne yer kor a wɔhwɛ hɔn mba nye hɔnankasa hɔn fie do yie.
Na hɔn a wɔasom yie dɛ asɔr mu asomfo no, wonya gyinabew pa, nye ndamyɛ kɛse wɔ gyedzi a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no mu.
M’enyi da kwan dɛ ɔnnkɛkyɛr na maba wo nkyɛn, naaso merekyerɛw iyi abrɛ wo;
ama sɛ bi a mebɛkyɛr a, eehu mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ ebɔ wo bra wɔ Nyankopɔn fie a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn tseasefo n’asɔr mu a ɔyɛ nokwar no ne fadum nye ne ngyinado no.

Na ekyingye nnyi ho dɛ nyamesom esumasɛm no so ampaara; Nyankopɔn daa no ho edzi wɔ honam mu, wobuu no bem wɔ sunsum mu, abɔfo hun no, wɔbɔɔ no dawur wɔ amanaman mu, wɔgyee no dzii wɔ wiadze, wɔfaa no kɔr sor wɔ enyimnyam mu.
Na Sunsum no ka pefee dɛ, mber a odzi ekyir no mu, binom betsin ndaadaa sunsum nye mbɔnsam nkyerɛkyerɛ do atwe hɔnho efi gyedzi no ho;
osian nyimpa atorfo hɔn ndabraba ntsi; hɔn a hɔn tsibowa ewu tse dɛ gyama wɔdze dadze hyew asaa.
Wɔkyerɛ dɛ ɔyɛ bɔn dɛ nyimpa bɔwar, na obedzi edziban a Nyankopɔn bɔɔ dɛ hɔn a wɔgye dzi na wonyim nokwar no mfa ndaase ngye ndzi no.
Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn abɔdze nyina ye, na sɛ yɛdze ndaase gye a, nna onnyi dɛ yekyir biribiara;
osiandɛ wɔdze Nyankopɔn n’asɛm nye mpaabɔ atsew ho.
Sɛ ekaakaa enuanom no yinom a, ebɛyɛ Jesus Kraest no somfo pa a wɔanyɛn no gyedzi no nye nkyerɛkyerɛ pa a odzi ekyir no mu.
Na mberwa anansesɛm gyangyan a ɔmmfa nyamesom pa ho no dze, pow. Na bɔ nyamesom ho mbɔdzen;
osiandɛ honam mu mbɔdzen ho mfaso suar; na nyamesom ho wɔ mfaso ma adze nyina, na ɔwɔ nkwa a ɔwɔ hɔ sesei nye dza ɔreba no ho anohoba.
Iyi nye nokwasɛm no, na ɔsɛ dɛ wɔgye to mu koraa.
Na iyi ho na yɛbɔ mbɔdzen na yɛper, osiandɛ yɛdze hɛn enyidado ato Nyankopɔn tseasefo a ɔyɛ nyimpa nyina hɔn Agyenkwa, nkanka hɔn a wɔyɛ agyedzifo no do.
Iyinom na tu ho fo enyiber do na kyerɛkyerɛ.
Mma obi mmbu w’aberantsɛyɛ tootooba; na mbom yɛ esusudo ma agyedzifo, wɔ kasa mu, abrabɔ mu, ɔdɔ mu, gyedzi mu nye ahotsew mu.
Ma w’enyi nku akenkan, afotu na nkyerɛkyerɛ mu ara nkodu dɛ mebɛba.
Mma w’enyi mmpa akyɛdze a wɔnam nkɔnhyɛ nye mpanyimfo nsa a wɔdze guu wo do maa wo no do.
Bɔ yinom ho mbɔdzen; fa woho ma hɔn koraa; ama wo mpontu aada edzi wɔ adze nyina mu.
Hwɛ wankasa wo ho yie nye nkyerɛkyerɛ no so; suo mu dzen; na eyɛ dɛm a, ebɛgye woho nye hɔn a wotsie wo no nkwa.
Mma nntwuw ɔpanyin enyim, na mbom tu no fo dɛ egya; na mberantsɛ no dɛ enuanom;
mbaampanyin no dɛ nanom; nkataasia no dɛ nkyerɛbaa, wɔ ahotsew nyina mu.
Ekunafo a wɔyɛ ekunafo ara ampa no, dzi hɔn nyi.
Na sɛ okunafo bi wɔ mba anaa mbanana a, wɔmma wonsua dɛ wodzi kan kyerɛ nyamesompa wɔ hɔn efiefi do, na wontua hɔn awofo kaw; na iyi na ɔsɔ enyi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
Na nyia ɔyɛ okunafo ampa, na aka no nko no, ɔdze n’enyidado to Nyankopɔn do, na osuo nkotoserɛ asɔr nye mpaabɔ mu adzekyee nye adzesaa.
Na nyia ɔdze noho ma wiadze enyigye no, ɔyɛ tseaseewu.
Na nsɛm yi na kyerɛkyerɛ hɔn, amma woeennya hɔn ho asɛm bi annka.
Na sɛ obi annhwɛ nankasa nedze, nkanka ne fiefo a, ɔapa gyedzi no, ɔyɛ nyimpa bɔn kyɛn nyia ɔnngye nndzi mpo.
Mma wɔmmfa obi a onnyae nndzii mfe eduosia mmfora ekunafo nnkan. Ɔwɔ dɛ ɔyɛ obi a ɔawar kun kor,
na wɔbɔ no dzin pa wɔ ndwuma ho dɛ: ɔatsetse mbofra, ɔayɛ ahɔhoyɛ, ɔahohor ahotseweefo no anan ho, ɔaboa hɔn a wɔakɔ ahohia mu, na ɔdze no ho ama ndwuma pa nyina.
Na ekunafo a wonnyinii dze, mma nngye hɔn; osiandɛ sɛ Kraest ho fon hɔn a, wɔbɛpɛ dɛ wɔbɔwar;
na wonya afɔbu dɛ wɔapow gyedzi a odzi kan no.
Na no mu ara so na wosua enyihaw, kyimakyima efiefi; na nnyɛ enyihaw nko, na wɔyɛ anobɛrbɛr nye agyegyensɛm mu so, keka nsɛm a ɔnnsɛ hɔn dɛ wɔka.
Dɛm ntsi mepɛ dɛ hɔn a wonnyinii no, wɔwar, wo mba, hwɛ fie, na wɔaamma ɔtamfo biara kwan mma ɔaannyaw hɔn;
osiandɛ binom adan ekedzi abɔnsam ekyir dada.
Na sɛ ɔbaa gyedzinyi bi wɔ ekunafo a, wɔmma ɔmboa hɔn; na mma wɔnnyɛ adzesoa mma asɔr; ama asɔr no aaboa hɔn a wɔyɛ ekunafo ara ampa no.
Mpanyimfo a wodzi panyin yie no, wombu hɔn dɛ wɔsɛ enyidzi mbɔho, nkanka hɔn a wɔyɛ edwuma wɔ asɛm no nye nkyerɛkyerɛ mu no.
Na kyerɛw no ka dɛ, Mma nnkyekyer nantwi a ɔporow eburow no n’ano, na eso dɛ, Ɔfata dɛ odwumayɛnyi nya n’akatua.
Mma nntsie ɔpanyin ho ntoatoa, gyedɛ adasefo beenu anaa baasa anomu.
Hɔn a wɔyɛ bɔn no ka hɔn enyim, ama nkaa no so eesuro.
Mehyɛ wo wɔ Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Kraest Jesus nye abɔfo a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no enyim dɛ, hwɛ yinom yie, na mma nnyɛ tsirmsum, eso mma nnyɛ biribiara nyiyimu do.
Mma mmfa wo nsa nngu obiara do awerɛfir mu, na eso mmfa woho mmfora binom hɔn bɔn; sie woho krɔnn.
Mma nnda ho nnom nsu nko, na wo yafun nye wo mberɛw a etɔ yɛ ntsi, nom wenyin kakra.
Nyimpa binom hɔn bɔn da edzi dzi hɔn enyim dze hɔn rokɔ atsɛmbu mu, na binom dze dzi hɔn ekyir.
Dɛmara na ndwuma pa so da edzi; na dza ɔsor mbrɛ ɔtse no mpo nntum nnhuntsa.
Wɔmma dodow a wɔwɔ kɔndua ase dɛ nkowaa mbu hɔn wuranom dɛ wɔsɛ enyidzi nyina, na Nyankopɔn dzin nye nkyerɛkyerɛ no wɔaannkasa ho bɔn.
Na hɔn a wɔwɔ wuranom gyedzifo, mma wommbu hɔn enyimtsia dɛ wɔyɛ enuanom ntsi; na mbom wɔnsom hɔn yie, osiandɛ hɔn a woenya adɔyɛ no bi no, wɔyɛ agyedzifo nye adɔfo. Iyinom na kyerɛkyerɛ na tu ho fo.
Sɛ obi ma nkyerɛkyerɛ fofor bi, na ɔammpen hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nsɛm a oye no nye nkyerɛkyerɛ no a ɔdze kɔ nyamesompa mu no a,
ɔahoran, onnyim hwee, na mbom ɔyar ekyingye nye nokotwa a dza ofi mu ba nye nyitan, mpaapaamu, ndzebɔ, adwembɔn,
ɔham a ɔsɛ nyimpa a wɔaprɔw adwen mu, na nokwar no abɔ hɔn, wosusu dɛ nyamesompa yɛ adzepɛ kwan.
Na nyamesompa a abodwee ka ho yɛ adzenya kɛse;
na yɛammfa hwee ammba wiadze, eso yerunntum mmfa hwee mmfi mu nnkɔ;
na sɛ yɛwɔ edziban nye akataho a, hom mma ɔnoara ndɔɔ hɛn so.
Na mbom hɔn a wɔrepɛ ayɛ ahonyafo no, wɔhwe nsɔhwɛ nye efir nye nkwasea akɔndɔ pii a ɔyɛ mbusu a ɔtwe hɔn kogu ɔsɛɛ nye ɔhera mu.
Na sikapɛ mbordo nye bɔn horow nyina no ndwow a binom edzi ekyir atɔ gon efi gyedzi no ho, na wɔdze yaw pii awowɔ hɔnho.
Na ɔwo, Nyankopɔn ne nyimpa dze, guan fi yinom ho; na dzi tsenenee, nyamesompa, gyedzi, ɔdɔ, abotar, nye ɔdwe ekyir.
Ko gyedzi no ko pa, suo onnyiewiei nkwa a wɔbɔɔ dzin frɛɛ wo a idzii ho dase pa no wɔ adasefo pii enyim no mu.
Mutu wo fo wɔ Nyankopɔn a ɔma ndzɛmba nyina nkwa, nye Kraest Jesus a odzii dase pa no wɔ Pontius Pilate enyim no enyim,
dɛ dzi ahyɛdze no do, mma dzɛm anaa fɛr bi mmba wo ho ma onkesi dɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest beyi noho akyerɛ:
dza ɔbɛkyerɛ wo nankasa n’aber mu, ɔno a ɔyɛ Otumfo siarfo kortsee, ahemfo Hen, nye ewuranom Ewuradze;
onyia a no nko wɔ bɛkyebo nkwa, na ɔtse kan a wɔbɛn ho a ɔnnyɛ yie mu; nyia nyimpa biara nnhun no da, na wonnkotum so ehu no da; ɔno na enyidzi nye daa tum a ɔmmbɔ adze da nyɛ nedze afebɔɔ. Amen.

Kasa kyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ ahonyafo wɔ sesei wiadze yi mu dɛ, mma wommbu hɔn ho sorsor, eso mma wɔmmfa hɔn enyi nnto ahonyadze a onnsi pi no do, na mbom wɔmfa nto Nyankopɔn a ɔma hɛn adze nyina pii dɛ yendzi no do;
dɛ wɔnyɛ yie, dɛ wɔnyɛ ahonyafo wɔ ndwuma pa mu, dɛ wɔnkyɛ adze ɔhardo, na wonyi mma ɔpɛdo:
na wɔmfa nhyehyɛ fapem pa nto hɔ mma hɔnho nsie ndaamba, ama woeesuo nkwa a ɔyɛ nokwar nkwa no mu.
O Timoti, kora dza wɔdze ahyɛ wo nsa no, dan woho fi ebususɛm gyangyan, nye nokotwa a wɔfom frɛ no nyimdzee no ho.
Ɔno na binom dween dɛ hɔn nsa aka ma wɔayew efi gyedzi kwan no ho no. Adom nka hom.
Emi Paul, Kraest Jesus somafo a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ do, dɛ mbrɛ nkwa a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu anohoba tse,
dze kɛma no dɔba Timoti: adom, mbɔbɔrhu, asomdwee, mfi Egya Nyankopɔn nye hɛn Ewuradze Kraest Jesus hɔ nka wo.
Meda Nyankopɔn a medze tsibowa krɔnn som no dɛ mbrɛ me nananom yɛe no ase, dɛ minngyaa wo nkaa wɔ mo nkotoserɛ mu adzekyee nye adzesaa.
Sɛ mekaa wo nyinsuwa a, mo kɔn dɔ dɛ mubohu wo na dɛw aahyɛ me ma:
dɛ ama makaa nokwar gyedzi a ɔwɔ wo mu a odzii kan tsenaa wo nana Lɔis nye wo na Eunise mu no; na megye dzi dɛ ɔwɔ wo so wo mu.
Ɔno ntsi mekaa wo dɛ kenyan Nyankopɔn akyɛdze a inyae wɔ wo mu no ber a medze me nsa guu wo do no.
Na Nyankopɔn amma hɛn suro sunsum bi, na mbom ahoɔdzen nye dɔ nye adwenmutsewee dze a.
Dɛm ntsi mma w’enyi nnto hɛn Ewuradze adasedzi no, anaa emi a meyɛ ne daduanyi no ho; na mbom sɔw asɛmpa no ho akotorka no bi, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ahoɔdzen tse.
Ɔno na ɔgyee hɛn, na ɔdze ɔfrɛ krɔnkrɔn no frɛɛ hɛn, nnyɛ hɛn ndwuma do a, na mbom nankasa ne tsirmpɔw nye n’adom a ɔdze doom hɛn wɔ Kraest Jesus mu fi tsetseetse,
na afei wɔnam Kraest Jesus ne nyikyerɛ do eyi no edzi no do a; ɔno a oeyi owu efi hɔ, na ɔnam asɛmpa no do dze nkwa nye bɛkyebo aba kan mu,
no ho nna wɔahyɛ me ɔsɛnkafo, nye somafo, nye kyerɛkyerɛfo.
Ɔno ntsi so na muruhu amandze yi: naaso m’enyi nnto; osiandɛ minyim nyia magye no edzi, na megye dzi yie dɛ obotum akora dza medze ahyɛ ne nsa no esie da no.
Suo nsɛm pa esusudo a etsee no me nkyɛn no mu yie,
wɔ gyedzi nye ɔdɔ a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no mu. Akoradze pa a wɔdze hyɛɛ wo nsa no dua Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a ɔtse hɛn mu no do kora do.
Inyim iyi, dɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ Asia nyina danee fii me nkyɛn;
hɔn mu bi nye Figelus nye Hermogenes. Ewuradze nhu Onesiforɔs fie mbɔbɔr, nna ɔtɔ dɛ ɔma mo ho dwe me, na n’enyi annto mo nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ho.
Na ɔbaa Rome no, ɔdze mbɔdzen hwehwɛɛ me, na ohun me.
Ewuradze mma onnya ɔnoara Ewuradze hɔ ehumbɔbɔr wɔ da no mu; na dodow a ɔsomee wɔ Efeso, woara nyim no papaapa.
Dɛm ntsi ɔwo, me ba, hyɛ dzen wɔ adom a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no mu.
Na dza etsee no m’anomu wɔ adasefo pii enyim no, ɔnoara na fa hyɛ nyimpa anokwafo a wobotum akyerɛkyerɛ binom so nsa.
Na ɔwo so sɔw akotorka no bi dɛ Kraest Jesus sordaanyi pa.
Ɔsordaanyi a ɔwɔ som mu biara mmfa daa daa asetsena mu nsɛm mbrabra noho, ama ɔaasɔ nyia ɔfaa no yɛɛ sordaanyi no enyi.
Na sɛ obi si akan wɔ agodzi bi mu a, wɔmmbɔ no konyim abɔtsir, gyedɛ odzi esi dɛ mbrɛ no ho mbra tse.
Okuafo a ɔyɛ edwuma no, nna otwar dɛ odzi abakan no bi.
Dwen dza mereka yi ho; na Ewuradze bɛma wo adze nyina mu ntseasee.
Kaa Jesus Kraest a ɔasoɛr efi ewufo mu no, ofi David asefo mu, dɛ mbrɛ me nsɛmpa tse no,
no mu na mosɔw akotorka dze besi mpokyerɛ mu, dɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi; na Nyankopɔn asɛm dze, wɔnnkyer no.
Dɛm ntsi na mosɔw yinom nyina wɔ hɔn a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no ntsi, ma hɔn so woeenya nkwagye no a ɔwɔ Kraest mu no, nye enyimnyam a onnyi ewiei.
Nokwasɛm nye yi: Sɛ yɛnye no wui a, yɛnye no bɛtsena ase so:
sɛ yetsintsim a, yɛnye no bedzi hen; sɛ yɛpa no a, ɔno so bɛpa hɛn:
sɛ hɛn, yɛnnyɛ anokwafo a, ɔno dze, ɔyɛ nokwafo; osiandɛ onntum mmpa noho ekyir.
Iyinom ho na kaa hɔn, na kasa kyerɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn enyim, dɛ mma wɔnngye nsɛm mu ekyingyehun a mfaso biara nnyi ho a ɔsɛɛ etsiefo adwen.
Bɔ mbɔdzen yi woho kyerɛ dɛ nyia Nyankopɔn apen no, odwumayɛnyi a onnyi dɛ ɔfɛr, na ɔpeepee nokwasɛm no mu yie.
Na nsɛnhun dze, yi woho fi ho: na wɔbɔkɔ enyim ara wɔ mbusubɔ mu,
na hɔn kasaa bɛtserɛw dɛ kuprɔwee: hɔn mu bi nye Himeneus nye Filetus;
nkorɔfo a wɔayew efi nokwar no ho ka dɛ wusoɛr no etwa mu dada, na woebutuw binom hɔn gyedzi.
Naaso Nyankopɔn fapem tsim hɔ pintsinn kitsa nsɔwano yi, Ewuradze nyim hɔn a wɔyɛ nedze: na ma obiara a ɔbɔ Ewuradze dzin ntwe noho mfi dza ɔnntsen ho.
Na ofi kɛse mu nnyi sika nye dwetɛ ndzɛmba nko, na ndua nye dɛtse so; na wobu bi bi, bi so wommbu no.
Na sɛ obi tsew noho fi iyinom ho a, ɔbɛyɛ adze a wobu no bi, wɔatsew ho, owura dze yɛ biribi a ɔyɛ yie, na woesiesie dze ama edwuma pa biara.
Guan fi mbabunber mu akɔndɔ ho, na nye hɔn a wofi akoma a no mu tsew mu frɛ Ewuradze ndzi tsenenee, gyedzi, ɔdɔ, nye asomdwee ekyir.
Na mbatam hɔn nkwasea ekyingye dze, pow, osiandɛ inyim dɛ ɔdze ntokwaa ba.
Na ɔnnsɛ Ewuradze akowaa dɛ ɔyɛ ntokwapɛfo, na mbom ɔsɛ no dɛ ɔdwe ma nyimpa nyina, ohu nkyerɛkyerɛ, ɔto no bo ase,
ɔkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn a wɔnye hɔnho dzi esi wɔ ɔdwe mu; dɛ bi a Nyankopɔn bɛma hɔn nnuho akɔ nokwar no ho nyimdzee mu,
na hɔn enyi do aatsew hɔn efi abɔnsam a ɔafa hɔn ndɔmmum no efir mu ama Nyankopɔn apɛdze.
Mbom tse ase dɛ nda a odzi ekyir no mu awerɛhow ber bɛba.
Na nyimpa bɛyɛ ahopɛfo, sikapɛfo, ahohyehyɛfo, ahoramfo, ndzebɔfo, awofo do asoɔdzenfo, bɔnyiayɛfo, hɔn a hɔn ho nntsew,
hɔn a wonnyi tsema, asɛnkadofo, anokumfo, hɔn a wonnyi ahohyɛdo, abɔyafo, hɔn a wɔmmpɛ papa,
yimafo, akakabemfo, ahomemadofo, hɔn a wɔdɔ enyigye sen Nyankopɔn;
hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛ wɔwɔ nyamesompa, naaso wɔpow n’ahoɔdzen no: woyinom na dan woho fi hɔn nkyɛn.
Woyinom mu bi na wɔhɛnhɛn efiefi mu, kɛfa mbaa nkwasea a bɔn ahyɛ hɔn do na hɔn akɔndɔ horow dze hɔn rokɔ no ndɔmmum,
hɔn a wosua daa, naaso wonntum nndu nokwar nyimdzee no ho da no.
Na dɛ mbrɛ Jannes na Jambres nye Moses dzii esi no, dɛmara so na woyinom nye nokwar no dzi esi; nyimpa a hɔn adwen mu aprɔw a wɔmmfora wɔ gyedzi afamu.
Na wɔronnkɔ hɔn enyim dodow biara: na hɔn nkwaseasɛm bɛda edzi wɔ nyimpa nyina enyim dɛ mbrɛ hɔndze so yɛe.
Na ɔwo dze, idzii me nkyerɛkyerɛ, m’abrabɔ, me tsirmsɛm, me gyedzi, me penkyɛr, mo dɔ, m’abotar,
m’ahohia, m’amandzehu ekyir; dza ɔbaa mo do wɔ Antiok, Ikonium, nye Listra; ahohia a mosɔwee; na Ewuradze gyee me fii ne nyinara mu no.
Nyew, hɔn a wɔpɛ dɛ wɔdze nyamesompa tsena ase wɔ Kraest Jesus mu nyina bɔsɔw ahohia.
Na nyimpa bɔn nye esisifo dze, wɔbɔkɔ hɔn enyim wɔ bɔn mu, wɔdaadaa, na wɔdaadaa hɔn.
Na ɔwo dze, tsena dza esua na ehu no no nokwar no mu, na inyim hɔn a esua no hɔn ho.
